The already low intelligence of the undead types, stripped of their souls, was majorly affected!
Even if their bodies were completely healed, the essence of their being was completely gone...
....
Finally.
The style of the battle, because of Su Lun's "Reaper of Death" talent, gradually went awry.
The seemingly unbreakable bug of infinite resurrection within the "Four-Entity Fallen Spirit Sacrificial Formation" started to be slowly decoded by an unconventional method.
Su Lun guessed that the sudden deaths of these "four ghouls" must be directly related to the battle upstairs.
The weaker the monsters became, the better it was for Edward and the others.
With that, he was even less anxious to join the battle upstairs.
He just remained in the banquet hall, shearing the soul shards of the four second-tier ghouls again and again.
Endless resurrection, repetitive stripping...
And since the stripping targeted the same entities, each shard obtained was guaranteed to hold unique memories.
Unknowingly, Su Lun managed to strip and compile a complete set of "Illusion Techniques: Drowning Technique" and "Illusion Technique: Suffocation Technique" from the two ghost types, even achieving a "mastery" level of proficiency!
Moreover, he stripped some abilities related to the four elements of Earth, Wind, Water, and Fire...
But no matter how resilient, frequent stripping was tough even on a tough body.
Su Lun was quite pleased to have mastered some new skills,
Although the four twisted monsters continued to resurrect, the style had totally changed.
When they initially appeared, their ferocity was overwhelming, feeling like one alone could annihilate everyone on the floor.
Four together, utterly unstoppable.
If Su Lun hadn't acquired the "Four-Piece Ghost Defensive Set" beforehand, dealing with just one would have been exasperating.
But now,
The two ghost types had turned into complete dimwits, with blank stares and not the slightest hint of ferocity...
The two undead types had become childlike fools, just mindlessly relying on their remaining instincts to attack...
The term "severely weakened," spotted in the diagnosis, was strikingly conspicuous.
Having stripped even the memory related to creating illusions, how could the two ghost types perform spirit illusions?
With their predatory instincts also stripped, their already low intelligence, couldn't even coordinate their limbs to move properly...
The current "four ghouls" probably couldn't even kill a common Scavenger anymore.
....
And the main culprit, Mr. Su, had not yet ceased his wool-shearing activities.
Where else could one find monsters that could be killed over and over again?
Strip a little each time, and after ten times, you could compile all the skill shards.
Su Lun had nearly killed all the other deformed monsters in the banquet hall. He was guarding a few sand scorpion groups' survivors, using them as bait to lure four monsters over.
Then, he simply waited for these four nearly incapacitated monsters to burst open again before reaping them once more.
He even took the initiative to start killing.
In this way, the style of battle turned from fierce combat to leisurely fishing.
The evil ritual formations in those four rooms were still running normally, but the four "main ingredients" had been irreversibly damaged...
Su Lun, hearing that there was still noise from the fighting upstairs, thought about reaping a few more waves and gathering a few complete elemental skills, then it should be about time to go up.
However, at that moment.
Suddenly a figure shot down from the second floor, appearing in the hall in a few quick movements.
It turned out to be Barbara.
....
Barbara was covered in wounds, looking as though she had been through a fierce battle.
She had intended to come down to check on the situation, prepared for another fierce battle against countless monsters.
But, seeing what was before her, the ancient Magician was stunned on the spot.
At this moment, the banquet hall was a field of corpses, a river of blood, piles of monstrous bodies like mountains, limbs and organs scattered everywhere...
There were hardly any living humans left, but the monsters were gone too.
In the hall, those "four resentful corpses" were wandering aimlessly like fools.
Seeing her come down, they showed no signs of attack.
Glancing at Su Lun, who was guarding the four monsters, Barbara showed a confused expression.
In her limited understanding, such a scene was hard to comprehend.
Seeing Barbara suddenly come downstairs, Su Lun thought something had gone wrong with the battle above and curiously asked, "Huh, Miss Barbara, why have you come down?"
"..."
Unable to make sense of what had happened, Barbara could only ask, "This... Officer Johnny, what exactly happened? Did you kill all these deformed monsters?"
Su Lun glanced at her and saw that she hadn't been completely "contaminated," and he breathed a sigh of relief.
He shrugged and said, "I saw them suddenly die for no reason, then I used a little technique, and this happened. By the way, what exactly happened upstairs, why did these 'four eerie corpses' suddenly explode?"
Barbara then explained, "Elizabeth the nun has been enchanted. She used an evil rite to transfer her injuries onto these 'four resentful corpses'..."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun suddenly understood.
So, every time one of these four monsters died, it meant Howard and his team had killed that old nun again upstairs?
But since the damage was transferred to these four corpses, the old nun essentially gained "immortality," plunging Howard and the others into a fierce battle.
This was supposed to be a no-win situation.
The four specially crafted corpses, due to the [Four Eerie Spirits Fallen Sacrifice Formation] being active, would resurrect through the formation if they died.
Plus, the "Seal Artifact" provided an unending energy supply.
They would have resurrected indefinitely.
Without killing the caster, the four corpses couldn't die.
However, the caster, Elizabeth the nun, cunningly transferred her own injuries back to the four corpses.
This created a vicious cycle.
At least within this hotel, no one could kill her!
But...
This cycle had been disrupted by Su Lun, who used an unexpected method to break the deadlock.
The cycle of the formation continued, but some key materials in the cycle had already been depleted.
The four eerie corpses became weaker and weaker, naturally affecting the battle situation upstairs.
The monsters could endure less and less transferred damage, and the old nun's injuries became more and more severe.
This was ideally good news for Edward and his team,
but they could never expect, and also wondered if it was a deceptive tactic by the old nun...
That's why Barbara came down to check on the situation.
....
Now, seeing the situation,
Barbara also breathed a sigh of relief.
Looking at Su Lun, she spoke with a bizarre tone, "I never thought Officer Johnny would be such a powerful Spirit Magician..."
Su Lun didn't elaborate much and asked about the situation upstairs.
Hearing it was a pyrrhic victory, he immediately stated, "If you can kill that old nun a few more times, I might be able to completely resolve this sacrificial formation."
Barbara, relieved by what she saw, replied, but the battle wasn't over yet, she didn't linger, "Okay! Officer Johnny, I'll leave the downstairs to you!"
Su Lun nodded, noticing that her aura of dark energy was very dense, and reminded, "Miss Barbara, your condition doesn't seem too good."
Barbara's face showed determination, "Yeah, I know."
Without looking back, she rushed back upstairs.
....
Knowing about the situation upstairs, Su Lun was in no hurry to go up.
According to earlier intelligence, if the "Ghost Fog" occurred at midnight, the Scavengers wouldn't have heard any battle noises from upstairs.
It also meant that Edward and his team would unconsciously become "contaminated" and enchanted.
Now that they knew about their condition, it seemed they would not let themselves be enchanted, even if it meant destruction for both sides.
Perhaps, by the time Su Lun went up, he might not need to make a move himself and could just collect materials.
The best outcome would be... if they could kill the old nun first.
From start to finish, that old nun was the ultimate boss.

chapters.title: Chapter 163 - 163 [The Magician's Top Hat] (For 'Yi Feng Ye Yu' in the Second Dimension, a reward for extra chapter)
chapters.content:
After Barbara went up, indeed, the frequency of the grotesque sudden deaths increased.
Su Lun reaped time and again, the Formation teetering on the brink of collapse.
But now, the closer he saw victory, the more he couldn't be careless.
He knew that it was standard for the BOSS to unleash a powerful move before death.
With the four sinister puppets posing no threat, Su Lun felt no relief; instead, his unease grew denser.
He looked at the increasingly thick ghost fog enveloping the hotel, always feeling that something unpredictable was about to occur.
Since there were no other enemies left in the cursed space, there was no need to hide. Thinking this, Su Lun removed the "Ozzy's Mummy Wrappings" from the abomination zombie and wrapped it around himself.
Though it would consume a bit of his lifespan, he always felt this would be safer.
...
However.
It turned out that Su Lun's cautiousness indeed helped him avoid a huge crisis.
After the last reaping of Soul Shards, the ghost entity "Hanging Corpse" could no longer gather enough souls to succeed, and the sacrificial Formation completely collapsed.
Almost simultaneously, a piercing scream echoed from the end of the corridor.
Like nails on a chalkboard, the sound made one's skin crawl.
On closer inspection, a two-meter-tall Sinister Nun charged down from the second floor staircase with murderous intent!
Its speed was extremely fast, almost like teleportation.
It seemed to Su Lun that the blue-faced Sinister Nun was still a hundred meters away at the staircase, but in the blink of an eye, she had already appeared before him.
Now in the large banquet hall, the only thing standing was the abomination zombie.
The old nun's target was very clear, it was to kill the "chief culprit" who had destroyed its Formation.
With a swipe of her hand, the three-meter-tall zombie was sent flying by her slap, the sounds of bones cracking and muscles tearing echoed as the massive body flew backwards.
With a "boom," it broke a load-bearing pillar and cracked a wall, heavily falling into the rubble.
"What kind of power is this!"
Su Lun quickly lowered his gaze, daring not to look further at the terrifying creature just a few meters away.
He didn't even dare to check what its rank was.
Given that terrifying strength, even the abomination zombie suffered bone-cracking impacts, Su Lun felt his body would not withstand a couple of hits.
Moreover, with that near-instantaneous speed, he couldn't even dodge.
...
Luckily, the mummy wrappings were a "Sealing Item," isolating all energy fluctuations.
Standing close to the load-bearing pillar, Su Lun thus escaped a calamity.
But the Sinister Nun seemed to know there was still someone nearby, and although she couldn't see him, she waved her hands frantically, endlessly probing through the air...
Watching the Sinister Nun getting closer, Su Lun, even in his calmness, felt a soul-chilling oppression from her, drenching his back with cold sweat. This nun had completely become demonic, not emitting a normal aura, but that of a "super-tier creature."
Su Lun's eyes were full of seriousness, quickly thinking about how to deal with the imminent danger.
His own strongest means was the dark scythe.
But with the old nun's quick speed, it was impossible for him to grab the scythe and make a swing.
He didn't even dare to move the zombie to test whether it was still alive.
Obviously, the situation was dangerous, but it hadn't reached a hopeless state yet...
Just then, more noise came from the staircase.
Su Lun looked over, two ragged figures staggered down.
One with a huge hole in the abdomen, another with an arm severed.
Only two?
The one with a big hole in the abdomen was, shockingly, the "Magician" Edward. The wound looked as if it had been gouged out, yet it was temporarily stopped from bleeding by a dark spatial power.
Barbara had a broken arm, her face completely drained of color, and she looked in very bad shape...
Su Lun surveyed their injuries...
Could these two, severely injured as they were, possibly take down the Sinister Nun?
"The BOSS has indeed gone berserk..."
Su Lun didn't dare to confirm it, but he roughly guessed as much.
If it weren't for some special factor causing the rage, the fight, which had been at a stalemate for so long, wouldn't have suddenly concluded.
At that moment, the noise below from Edward and the others caught the Sinister Nun's attention immediately.
No longer seeking Su Lun, it furiously charged over, flickering like a glitching image, teleporting every step and covering a hundred meters in a blink.
A look of determination crossed Barbara's pretty face as she surged forward with an overwhelming pink aura!
"Swoosh!"
The old Nun reached out and pierced through Barbara's chest, spewing black blood.
However, at the same time, Edward right behind her was rapidly changing his sorcerer's seals, with an intricate Octagram Array already shining beneath his feet.
His face turned pale as it looked like he was overexerting himself with some Forbidden Technique.
It was the brief moment that Barbara fought for, his spell formation was ready, and with a clap of his hands, he uttered a solemn, deep chant, "Spatial Mastery · Pitch Night Seal!"
As the spell was cast, the surroundings turned pitch-black as if someone had turned off the lights, engulfing the corridor in darkness.
The space around where the Sinister Nun stood turned into a tar-like viscous substance.
Space transformed into a black fluid, slowly climbing and compressing against the tall Sinister Nun's body, utterly restricting its near-instantaneous speed to the spot.
Edward, managing to control the nun, couldn't help but spew out a mouthful of blood.
It seemed that the strain from the overpowering spell caused him to lose control over his injuries, and his abdominal wound suddenly burst open.
Edward attempted to form sorcerer's seals to execute a killing spell, but he clearly struggled greatly.
....
"Great opportunity!"
From a distance, Su Lun, witnessing this scene, wouldn't just stand there waiting for death.
A fierce light flashed in his eyes. Without hesitation or care for exposure, he reached out into the void and yanked fiercely.
The abominable living corpse was still breathing faintly, meaning it was not yet dead!
Su Lun didn't bother to check the state of the living corpse, tugging at his black sickle, and swung it towards the neck of the Sinister Nun.
Now that the Sinister Nun was controlled, this was his only chance to strike!
The black sickle descended, and as the blade cut through, a rift in space emerged at the end of the corridor — right at the Sinister Nun's neck.
"Clang," a head fell to the ground.
No matter how resilient the Sinister Nun's body was, it was cleanly bisected by the space rift.
Su Lun, seeing this, let out a sigh of relief.
Edward also felt a great burden lifted.
Barbara's expression relaxed too, and she slowly closed her eyes, her life force gone.
....
Since he had acted, there was no going back.
Since no mist was seen, Su Lun did not let his guard down and charged forward, pulling the "Oil-Swallowing Baby" and "Fire-Starting Baby" to start torching the Sinister Nun's corpse.
Being close enough, he also harvested the mist from Barbara's body.
"Gained 'Contaminated Barbara's' memory shard *3"
"You have stripped a soul brand, acquiring 'Advanced Succubus Ownership Compact'..."
"You have gained some memories, spiritual spell proficiency +11..."
"Spiritual Power +4.1"
Su Lun didn't have time to process which memory had just been stripped away when, as expected, the "accident" still happened.
Just then, the temperature around them suddenly dropped significantly.
Edward, sitting slumped on the ground with a pale face, seemed to sense something and murmured in despair and reluctance, "Did it still fail..."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun almost reflexively pulled out a gold card from his pocket and flicked it out.
At that moment, the surrounding "ghost fog" grew thicker and thicker.
The dark mist gradually gathered on the body of the Sinister Nun lying on the ground, extinguishing the flames.
That headless body suddenly stood up again.
Almost at the same time, it seemed as if an indescribable will had descended upon the corpse.
The force continued to rise more and more.
Merely glancing at it made Su Lun feel as if there was a mountain pressing on his brow. It was an overwhelming, indescribable... great terror that seemed to crush him into the dust!
But this pressure appeared only for a moment; the overwhelming force suddenly dissipated.
Su Lun, weighed down, appeared dazed, as if he heard someone whisper in his ear, "Is it finally out..."
He didn't know how much time had passed,
Su Lun's gaze focused again and, in an endless black abyss, he saw a dim yellow light flicker on.
The light wasn't dazzling, flickering as if it might extinguish at any moment.
But it dispelled the darkness, advancing step by step, growing brighter and brighter.
More and more real.
In Su Lun's vision, there was nothing else.
He watched a person in a Gold-Patterned Cloak, carrying an antique Hexagonal Copper Lamp, slowly walking from the depths of darkness.
The light from the Copper Lamp dispelled the darkness and also sucked in those wisps of black smoke.
The surroundings finally returned to their original appearance, that of the hotel corridor.
The person in the Gold-Patterned Cloak took out a box, conjured a ball of light flame into a glove with one hand, reached out, and seemed to tear a pitch-black mass from the Sinister Nun's body, quickly stuffing it into the box.
The box snapped shut, sealing it, and the soul-shivering sensation instantly vanished completely.
....
Su Lun recognized the person and let out a breath of relief, "I knew you would come..."
The Gold-Patterned Cloak was naturally the symbol of Mr. Hei's organization.
The style of the Copper Lamp looked familiar — it was precisely the "Volgan's Furnace Lamp" they had previously slain a monster to acquire for just this moment.
What surprised Su Lun was not just that he recognized this cloaked person, but the Magician Edward, at the brink of death, seemed to recognize either the person or the cloak,
A fanatical look representing honor and loyalty appeared on his face, and then, with difficulty, he got up and knelt on one knee before the cloaked person, performing a single-handed knightly salute over his chest!
The cloaked person afforded him a glance, nodded perhaps in acknowledgment of his gesture.
A look of relief passed through Edward's eyes as his life faded away.
This made Su Lun confused.
An NPC from a thousand years ago showed such a grand gesture to someone from the modern era?
What... special significance does that cloak hold?
However, sensing no malice, he felt they were friends rather than foes.
Su Lun didn't overthink it.
Indeed, from the moment Mr. Hei gave him that card yesterday, he had guessed that today's space exploration would probably end this way.
That powerful organization was definitely after the "curse source" of this cursed space.
This great BOSS was bound to be taken down.
Without this factor, Su Lun wouldn't have dared to make his move previously.
Although it seemed perilous, all the "accidents" were expected.
With no real danger, Su Lun took a long, relieved breath.
The cloaked figure glanced at Su Lun, hesitating for a moment, apparently surprised that he could achieve so much.
His tone, unemotional, simply cautioned, "The space will collapse in a quarter of an hour, be careful. There might be trouble outside."
"Hmm, thank you."
Su Lun nodded.
The cloaked figure spoke no more, turned, and walked up the stairs.
...
Su Lun watched him leave, then casually harvested the grey mist from Edward's body nearby.
'Obtained "Contaminated Edward" memory shards*2'
'You have gained some "Spatial Spell skills"…'
'You have gained some magic skills…'
'Spiritual Power +1.6'
He did not go upstairs, nor did he go anywhere else.
He simply looked eagerly at the slowly condensing light on his corpse.
Materials had appeared, but they might not be the advanced materials he wanted; they could also be implantation tools...
Those few minutes felt incredibly long.
However, the wait finally paid off.
A glowing hat appeared above Edward's body.
[Magician's Top Hat]
Quality: Gold
Description: Who knows what might be hidden inside a magician's hat, perhaps a whole world?
Cursed Feature: You can pull an item from within a certain range near the hat, but a counterpart item of equivalent energy will also be drawn into you randomly;
Details: Can be used as a material for professional advancement, greatly enhancing skills, agility, moderate toughness, and ultra-high perception attributes, and grasping Spatial Ability; Fusion requires a high containment value, dark spiritual value of 18000+ is suggested for a high success rate;
Rating: 96% compatibility; This is a very rare high-quality spatial material;
"Oh… it finally appeared."
Su Lun gazed at the discerned attributes, his eyes quivering.
Looking at the attribute details, skills, agility, perception... and Spatial Ability.
This advancement material was a perfect fit for him, just as he expected!
And the surprises didn't stop there.
Not only had materials appeared on Edward's body,
but a sinister doll had also formed on the body of the headless Sinister Nun.
[Thanatos's Death Puppet]
Quality: Legendary
Description: A life borrowed from the Grim Reaper, dare you use it?
Cursed Feature: After a blood sacrifice, the puppet will take one fatal attack in place of the host; but after revival, you will hear whispers from the beyond for the next month, which are the enticing voices of demons; you may comprehend some high-tier demonic secret techniques, but there's a high chance of mental instability.
Details: A replica Divine Artifact, trading souls with the Grim Reaper, for a chance at rebirth;
Legendary quality, another treasure level item.
Seeing these two items, a smile slowly spread across Su Lun's face.
This trip to the space was worth it.
ps. Guys, please subscribe. Subscriptions keep dropping, making me doubt my existence…

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - 164: Advance to the Second Order
chapters.content:
```
"Thanatos's Substitute Puppet," yet another forbidden artifact..."
Su Lun held the pitch-black eerie puppet, scanning the identified information about the puppet, a trace of contemplation showing in his eyes.
This looked somewhat like a downgraded version of that old nun's death damage transfer technique...
Could it exempt one from transferring a fatal injury?
Thinking this, he dripped a drop of blood on it.
The object, which appeared to be made of wood, absorbed the blood and then a dark light flashed and disappeared.
The identification showed that the contract was successful.
Su Lun felt as though he had signed a contract with some mysterious existence.
Although the high chance of mental instability after resurrection seemed like a serious backlash, it was preferable to losing one's life.
Moreover, Su Lun always felt that "mental instability" might not be such a big deal for him.
"Mr. Hei's friends sure seem easy to get along with..."
Su Lun murmured to himself as he looked at the puppet.
Of course, he knew this was a windfall for him.
If truth be told, the materials produced by the headless nun were actually the spoils of that cloaked figure.
Without that figure's intervention, Su Lun wouldn't dare provoke the ultimate BOSS in this curse space that was currently considered "T-level" difficulty. At most, he would just wander on the first or second floor.
This was a gift left behind by them.
However, Su Lun didn't feel like he had gained much of an advantage.
Without surprises, this incident in the curse space would likely be blamed on him, "S-class wanted criminal Su Lun," again.
But that was just as well.
Su Lun felt that this kind of fair trade relationship was the most reasonable.
....
Forbidden items couldn't be placed into the Storage Ring, so Su Lun had to hang the puppet on his person.
He checked the injuries on the abomination once more.
Its chest had been punched, leaving a bloody hole, and several bones had also been broken...
But it wasn't dead; it was rapidly regenerating.
He was growing increasingly excited about advancing to the second tier and mastering true Spatial Ability.
By then, there would be no need to keep the scythe, the undead, the puppet... always hanging around him.
He was also looking forward to the magical Spatial Techniques that "Magician" Edward had used...
This trip to the "1911 Hotel" had proven to be very productive, for he not only found the materials needed for advancement but also his dark spiritual power was brimming.
He wasn't sure where the "source of the curse" came from, but seeing no signs of mutation in himself, Su Lun kept absorbing the ghostly fog.
And in just a few hours, his dark spiritual power had risen by several hundred points, reaching a point where it could hardly increase anymore.
Upon leaving, he could advance at any time.
....
With the "source of the curse" sealed, this space also began to collapse gradually.
Without a portal appearing, the scene of the thousand-year-old luxury hotel started to disintegrate before his eyes...
There were probably some valuable loots left, but there was no time to search – they would turn into energy and return to nature.
Meanwhile,
outside the curse space, in the temporary camp, the Scavengers were still busy.
```
The leaders of the scavenging teams from the five major families had already made a decision to increase the "casualty rate" soon in order to break the seal in advance.
The next group of people entering the space were lining up to register, oblivious solo scavengers listening to the temporary team leader explain the precautions for the ruins.
There was a time discrepancy between the Cursed Space and the outside world. It hadn't been long since the last group entered. Normally, it would still be some time before the light gate exit appeared.
But at that moment, an abrupt anomaly occurred.
On the site of the 1911 restaurant ruins not far from the camp, a mirage-like shimmering phantom abruptly emerged. It looked like the interior of a busy restaurant, but it was a scene of carnage, with bodies strewn everywhere.
This anomaly naturally drew the attention of everyone in the camp.
"Look, what's that over there!"
"Eh... isn't that a scene from inside the Cursed Space?"
"Why are there so many corpses, what happened? Those are people from the Sand Scorpion team, I recognize them."
"No, this is a sign that the Cursed Space is about to collapse!"
"..."
The scavengers paled, watching the restaurant phantom begin to disintegrate, they grasped what was happening.
Hearing the commotion in the camp, the leaders of several scavenging teams also quickly exited their tents.
Looking at the anomaly before them, they were all dumbfounded.
"How can the Cursed Space collapse all of a sudden?!"
"Could it be that someone got their hands on the 'Source of the Curse'? Impossible... The source of the curse in this space should be on the third floor; just the difficulty of the second floor which has already been explored is already at A+ level. How could that team that just went in have the strength for that? Besides, didn't we already arrange for the bizarre creature in room 1021 to be released? They should have been wiped out..."
"..."
At that moment, someone remembered the abnormal number of people entering the space earlier.
One hundred people were supposed to go in, but only a little over sixty did.
"Damn, high-rank professionals must have infiltrated the scavenging teams before! Someone's going after that thing!"
"We must stop him; if the 'Source of the Curse' is lost, and the Black Tower holds us responsible, we're dead meat!"
"..."
With this reminder, the leaders of the large teams immediately realized the gravity of the situation and their faces turned pale.
.....
The collapse of the Cursed Space happened swiftly.
Less than a minute after the anomaly, the "mirage" suddenly shattered into specks of light and disappeared from everyone's view.
At this time, leaders of the second-order scavenging teams were standing by with their weapons at the ready, waiting for anyone who survived to come out, preparing to ambush them.
Even without the hooded figure's warning, Su Lun would have guessed that he'd be ambushed by a group of people upon exiting.
The collapse of the space had only one or two possible causes, and explanations were futile; it was either fight or flee...
He was also secretly glad that he had observed the retreat route when he first entered the ruins.
The collapse of the Cursed Space, to Su Lun inside, was like the end of a movie; the lights and shadows dispersed, and then he found himself facing a group of menacing big shots opening fire...
However, their target wasn't Su Lun, but a group of hooded figures scattered in different directions.
Crackling and booming, a barrage of gunfire rang out, and various control spells were unleashed upon these hooded figures in unison.
But soon, they realized something wasn't right.
The hooded figures burst open under concentrated fire, not into flesh and blood, but into a flurry of wooden splinters.
Upon closer inspection, under the tattered cloaks were nothing but wooden puppets.
"Damn, these are all puppets!"
"Be careful, take cover, that giant is holding [Xiupunos's Scythe of Night]!"
"That's 'S-Class Wanted Fugitive Su Lun'! Damn it, we must catch him!"
"He still has the 'Wrappings of the Oz Glacierman' on him, watch out for invisible targets!"
"..."
The camp erupted into chaos.
Meanwhile, Su Lun's real body had already quietly climbed over the camp's perimeter wall during the first round of cannon fire.
With the corpse wrappings around him and puppets attracting the gunfire, he managed to escape naturally and smoothly.
As for the abominable zombie, it took some cannon fire, but as long as it wasn't blown to paste, it was all good.
It held a black scythe, with one swing, even second-order professionals had to dodge its edge, and no one dared to face it head-on.
More than ten puppet decoys dispersed the enemy's gunfire, and by the time they realized what was happening, Su Lun with his octopus spear arms had initiated sprint mode. The threads were long enough, with one strong pull, the zombie and the scythe also zipped out of the camp.
Even with puppets in tow, Su Lun's speed was far superior to that of the majority of first-order professionals.
Those second-order team leaders chased after him furiously, but with the black scythe killing one, the others quickly simmered down.
Orders are important, but lives are even more so.
None of these old birds dared to stick their necks out, instead they just shouted and chased among the throng of people.
And just like that, Su Lun dashed into the ruins, easily losing the group of professionals.
....
Su Lun didn't return to the Storm Manor camp,
The materials for his advancement had just arrived and were still warm; he was in perfect condition.
He planned to find a secluded spot outside of the ruins to advance to the second order directly.
To avoid being besieged and interrupted, he ran for half a circle around the outer city of the ruins, took some anti-tracking measures, and finally found a bunker identical to the one he had stayed in before and dived in.
After resting for a moment, Su Lun sealed off the entrance of the bunker, then cleared a space.
He began drawing a Hexagram Array.
The auxiliary materials needed for the second-order advancement formation had been prepared for a while, and he was already proficient in the process of drawing the double-ringed hexagram.
Copper powder mixed with Mithril formed the base, outlining a perfect outer circle; the hexagram pattern inside the circle was drawn using a blend of refined borax and sunflower oil essence, to which he added a couple of drops of Wind Wolf's tears, assembling the four basic elements of Earth, Wind, Water, and Fire; red crystals inscribed with runes were placed at the formation's base, which were quite high-level materials; naturally, there was the alchemical core—mercury, as well as the cursed crystals for energy...
With everything in place, Su Lun took out the 'Magician's Top Hat.'
He stood at the center of the Hexagram Array and began chanting the universal alchemical incantation, "By the law of equivalent exchange, I praise the glory of the original creator, let alchemy bear witness to the miracle of creation..."
During his second professional advancement, Su Lun felt a hint of anticipation, but his heart remained calm.
As the lights of the alchemical formation slowly brightened, the top hat also gradually fused into the formation. Within the golden Hexagram Array, strands of black light representing the "spatial attribute" appeared.
After the top hat melted, a mysterious force started to merge into Su Lun's body.
The fusion of Spatial Power was a magical experience, making Su Lun feel as if he were traveling through the cosmos, beholding the vast expanse of the void world...
It made him feel as if he had been nothing more than a graffito character on the "canvas" of space previously.
At that moment, he sensed the feeling of breaking free from the "canvas" and touching the world beyond the painting.
That world was still blurry, and he couldn't see it clearly yet.
But he truly felt it.
....
Half an hour later, the dazzling light of the Hexagram slowly faded away.
The initial fusion of the materials was complete.
Su Lun sat down cross-legged and began meditation to absorb and stabilize the special force that had merged into his body.
Advancing to the second order was different from the first; the greater the energy fused, the more time it took to digest the materials.
The 'Magician's Top Hat' was an unconventional material with a vast amount of energy.
Even if Su Lun succeeded in the fusion, completing the digestion process would take a long time.
Just like the food that you eat, you must digest it to transform it into nutrition that nourishes the body, otherwise it will all go to waste.
Time flashed by, and it was half a month.
Su Lun had been meditating and absorbing the nutrients from the advancement materials, hardly ever leaving the fortress.
Fortunately, there were no deformed monsters or Scavenger group disturbances, and the digestion went smoothly.
That day, when he finally felt that the energy forcibly infused into his body and the dreamy murmurings by his ear had completely vanished, Su Lun realized that he had successfully stepped into the realm of a second-tier professional.
The data on the panel was the most intuitive; the previously explosive daily increases had settled down, and the increments started to become moderate and gradually imperceptible.
"Phew... No wonder there's such a big gap between first-tier professionals and second-tier ones. Not to mention the awakened abilities, just the data increase alone is a multiple fold growth. The physical strength isn't even on the same level..."
Su Lun opened his eyes from the meditation and exhaled a long breath of turbid air. His eyes sparkled with excitement, "But having said that, the boost from the rare Gold advancement materials is truly exaggerated."
Looking at his data panel again, the changes were earth-shattering.
It was an increase in almost all attributes.
Strength and resilience, these melee-type attributes, had a slight increase,
but attributes like "Agility," "Skill," and "Perception"... such Magician-type attributes had an enormous increase.
"Perception" went from 13 to 24;
"Agility" went from 36 to 95;
"Skill" had the most exaggerated increase, jumping from an initial 51 points directly to a three-figure sum of 145.
Even though the changes in data were visible, they seemed pale in comparison.
It was the actual feeling that was truly tangible.
Agility didn't just mean running fast; it also involved changes in nerve reactions and muscle responses.
At this moment, Su Lun could finally comprehend what kind of physical quality was needed to "chop a bullet" with a knife. He felt that his current nerve reaction speed and muscle reflex speed had reached that level.
Techniques that once astonished a novice in his eyes, he now truly possessed.
The moment a bullet came, his nerves and muscles could completely react and predict the bullet's location, avoiding it with ease.
Within a certain distance, the bullet's muzzle velocity couldn't outpace his perception and reaction!
And the nearly threefold increase in skill was even more exaggerated.
Su Lun's fingers clawed the air, controlling a rune puppet single-handedly.
In the past, his manipulation consisted of simple, crude movements like running, slashing, straight punches, and kicks...
So, in regular combat, he relied more on the rune puppet's abilities, rather than its physical capabilities.
The reason being that his skill wasn't adequate.
Despite the will, the control didn't reach the "nuanced" level.
But now, the puppet under Su Lun's finger manipulation performed complex movements, leaping, rolling, scratching its head, pulling its cheeks, lifting a gun to pull the trigger, throwing darts...
It even exhibited a complete set of vigorous grappling and fighting techniques under precise control...
It appeared nearly indistinguishable from a real person.
Moreover, with such high skill level, Su Lun finally understood why previously, both Mr. Hei and that "Magician" Edward could produce spells instantly with just a snap of their fingers.
Before advancing, it took him about a second to release the eight sorcerer's seals of the Spider Lance Armor.
Now, forming such first-tier seals was almost instant, with a single clap of the hands.
It wasn't that there was no forming of seals, but rather an instantaneous eight seals.
The super high skill level gave him a terrifying degree of bodily control.
Of course...
What was most anticipated was that magical "Spatial Ability."

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - 165: Black Hole Baby
chapters.content:
Su Lun set down the puppet and gently grasped at the void in front of him with one hand.
It was no longer the sensation of touching the air,
as if the space under his claw had become a thin membrane that could be easily torn.
He gathered the dark spiritual power in his palm, and a pitch-black hole in the void appeared before his eyes.
Then he reached his hand into it.
Miraculously, a section of a hand slowly extended out a meter away.
He was very aware that his palm was still connected to his arm, but there was a meter between them.
"Tsk tsk, so this is what it feels like to have mastery over space..."
Upon seeing this, Su Lun could not hide his delight. His hands instantly transformed through sixteen sorcerer's seals, and as the dark spiritual power circulated within him, a "black hole" his own height appeared in front of him.
He stood up and walked straight into it.
Then, as he stepped out, his front foot was already emerging several meters away, and his whole person appeared there as well.
This was true "Spatial Teleportation,"
not the kind of movement that was so fast it couldn't be caught by the eye.
Su Lun savored the feeling for a moment, a hint of a smile spilling over his lips.
Although the operation was clumsy, it was his first time experiencing the sensation of "teleportation."
It wasn't entering some sort of temporal tunnel; it was simply the "canvas" of space being folded, and by taking just one step, he moved from one spatial coordinate to another.
But at the same time, this attempt revealed some shortcomings to him.
Su Lun pondered for an instant, analyzing to himself: "The distance of the Spatial Teleportation is directly related to the amount of dark spiritual power infused. To achieve precise control over the destination and instant seal teleportation, I still need to improve a lot of proficiency..."
"But where do I learn those spatial techniques..."
Su Lun frowned, feeling a bit of a headache.
If it hadn't been for the skills he had stripped from a fragment of Edward's, just fumbling with this most basic spatial displacement ability would have taken him a great deal of time.
Besides, what he craved even more was that "hand-spun black hole" technique!
"Eh..."
At that thought, Su Lun's occupational habit as a Puppeteer flared up again, and a spark of inspiration flashed, "I can't do the complex sorcerer 'hand-spun black hole' with my current body. Why not make a spatial puppet with an absorption device? Wouldn't that achieve a similar effect?"
Having mastered Spatial Ability now, creating a real spatial artifact was within his reach.
For instance, a spatial puppet?
That wouldn't be an inferior space like those of ordinary rings, but a real "foldable space" capable of containing living corpses and scythes!
Just like the hat of a Magician, it could be accessed any time, accommodating everything a regular space could hold.
The thought arose, and the first reaction in his head was a little dwarf holding a purple gourd.
"How about, making a puppet version of the gourd brothers with runes?"
Su Lun's mind was suddenly hit with inspiration.
....
Now that Su Lun had mastered Spatial Ability, crafting a storage ring was as easy as blowing bubbles.
But what he needed now was not a Storage Ring, but a "foldable space" that could hold living corpses and sealed objects.
The inferior space of ordinary storage rings was like a bubble in water, ready to pop with a single press.
A "foldable space," on the other hand, was like a bubble floating on the water's surface, unrestricted by water pressure; it could expand almost infinitely with sufficient power.
Several days later,
Su Lun finally succeeded in creating a space carrier, collecting the scythe and the living corpses into it.
But since the detestable living corpses needed air to breathe, he had to create an opening in the space carrier.
For easy carrying, Su Lun also thought of a hat and eventually fashioned a Magician's "top hat."
Because he felt it was appropriate to use magic under the guise of Edward's tricks. It would allow him to practice spellcasting anytime without being readily noticed.
But he wasn't in a hurry to go out; instead, he continued fiddling with his new idea.
He wanted to create the envisaged "Black Hole Doll."
That day.
The bunker was filled with various puppet parts, alchemical objects, and rune materials.
This temporary hideout had become a veritable puppet workshop.
Su Lun was engrossed in tinkering with a puppet arm.
Mechanical and puppet designs often had a lot in common.
His expertise with mechanics had reached a level of proficiency, and applying it to puppets came naturally to him. He fitted the puppet arm with a trigger-style mechanical design, so that once the mechanism was triggered, the arm would unfold like a fan blade. Upon closer inspection, the six spread out fan blades formed a complete Hexagram Array...
While screwing on bolts, he muttered something under his breath.
"The arms of this puppet are hollow tubes, the insides etched with 'Whirlwind Runes', activating to create suction. When it encounters elemental spells, it can directly absorb them..."
"Etching 'Reverse Whirlwind Runes' inside the mouth could allow it to not only suck in but also spit out. Or perhaps, include a pressure storage device?"
"As for the energy source of the runes, we could directly use cursed crystals as 'batteries'..."
"..."
"Done!"
In no time, Su Lun assembled the puppet, producing the first version of the "Black Hole Doll."
He manipulated the puppet with threads, trying to move it around, and it felt pretty good.
....
"Now, it's time to witness a miracle..."
Su Lun looked at his new creation, quite satisfied.
Then, he brought out a "Phosphorus Fire Doll" and planned to test the "Black Hole Doll" against it to see if its effectiveness met expectations.
Multitasking allowed Su Lun to control both puppets simultaneously with the threads in each hand, like gladiators in an arena, they fought each other.
One glowing bright with red runes all over, spewing phosphorus fire;
The other spreading its arms into a fan shape, with blue wind runes swirling, quickly forming a vortex of suction...
The initial test proceeded normally.
A small jet of fire was directly absorbed into the void within the puppet's belly.
However, as the intensity of the flames increased, problems arose.
The "Black Hole Doll," having absorbed the fire, suddenly cracked from the high temperature; moreover, the suction power of the arms was not enough to fully absorb the increasingly large flames.
With a "clang,"
The puppet, unable to bear the load, exploded with a bang.
Su Lun frowned at the broken puppet pieces on the floor, rubbing his chin as he pondered.
"The suction is nowhere near strong enough... If it encounters higher-level spells, this degree of suction wouldn't be sufficient. A mere 'Second Order Whirlwind Rune' can't satisfy the need for full coverage absorption head-on. Furthermore, the fire would scorch the space, which requires the puppet material to be highly resistant."
He took careful notes in his notebook: 'December 13th, first experimental test of Black Hole Doll failed. Body fragmented after exposure to second-level phosphorus fire... Analysis of causes, material strength insufficient, defects as follows...'
However, a single experimental failure didn't shake Su Lun's confidence.
The fact that it could absorb small flames at least proved that his idea was viable.
He quickly thought of a way to improve it.
"As for the strength of puppets, it's hard to find high-grade materials, but the alchemical automaton left by the 'Trickster' Lloyd is of sufficient quality and already a finished product; a little modification should meet the requirements. But runes are a bit more troublesome..."
"For greater suction... one could try retrofitting the puppet arms into a more complex spiral structure like a mechanical jet propulsion device. But the key lies in the runes; a compound rune could produce greater attraction, a combination of wind plus lightning elemental runes might work well. Ideally, an 'energy recycling system' would be created that could convert absorbed energy directly into puppet power..."
Su Lun furrowed his brows at that thought.
He suddenly realized that his own knowledge was insufficient to support his creativity.
He was not yet proficient in the field of runes, especially not in the higher-order runes of the second and third tiers, from which he had not gleaned much experience.
He knew something about runes but was far from being able to create rune combinations.
But if he couldn't do it himself, he could ask for help.
"It seems I need to consult Mr. Hei next time, he is well-versed in all kinds of runes and should be able to help me solve this problem. The 'Thousand Threads' implants must also have been ready by now..."
With that thought, Su Lun's tightly furrowed brow suddenly relaxed.
He began to pack up his tools and materials inside the bunker.
Finally, he was planning to go out.
Having absorbed the materials, his rank was now stable.
The key point was that he had almost figured out his Spatial Ability, and that qualified him to go out and "roam."
It had been over half a month since he had received any news from the outside, but without a doubt, an "S" might have already been added to his wanted poster.
Those who wanted to claim the bounty on his head could probably line up from Dawn City to Old Lington.
He didn't have the privilege to roam freely before.
But now...
Su Lun felt that he should be about ready.
Although he was still a Tier 2 prospect and hadn't learned any implants or advanced skills.
Ordinary Tier 2 professionals hardly posed a threat to him anymore.
High skill, high agility, high perception...
In a direct confrontation, Su Lun's stats could crush over ninety percent of his peers, even those seasoned Tier 2 professionals.
Even when facing Tier 3 professionals, although he couldn't win, with his Black Scythe and Spatial Teleportation ability, he also had a fair chance of escaping...
....
After Su Lun finished packing, he clasped his hands together, and his sorcerer's seals were instantly formed.
It was as if he were opening a door; he simply lifted one hand, and a portal appeared in front of him.
He stepped through and upon a second glance, his figure was already outside the bunker.
"Spatial Teleportation" required a large amount of dark Spiritual Power, and the farther the distance, the consumption increased almost exponentially.
The more frequently the spell was cast, the higher the consumption as well.
But Su Lun, who needed to practice the proficiency of spatial control in teleportation, was not stingy with his dark Spiritual Power.
Moreover, he had one huge advantage.
His dark Spiritual Power reserves were much more plentiful than those of an average Tier 2 professional.
The "X Serum" had enhanced his body's tolerance for dark Spiritual Power.
This meant that not just at Tier 1, but at every rank, he would have a higher tolerance for dark Spiritual Power than ordinary people and could store and absorb more dark energy.
Su Lun believed that a "high mana consumption" ability like Spatial Teleportation would become stronger in his hands in the future.
He took a few steps, then teleported a few meters.
After walking a bit further, he teleported another few meters.
As long as the dark Spiritual Power in his body stayed above a safe level, he would continue to practice.
He wanted to test the precise consumption in various teleportation scenarios...
So that in the battles of the future, he could calculate down to the last detail.
If anyone saw him, they would surely be startled, flitting in and out of the faint mist, like a ghost...
....
A few hours later, Su Lun avoided some Scavenger groups and returned to the Dawn City camp.
However, he didn't rush to enter, but instead hung upside down on a cliff, looking down at everything in the city from a high vantage point.
The city had transformed anew since a little over half a month ago.
Buildings and steam chimneys soared high above the city walls. Scavengers were everywhere, the streets were crowded with people, and the noise was so loud that it could be heard from a far distance...
A scene of prosperity and bustle.
Although far away, Su Lun could still see everything very clearly.
The number of guards at the city gate was thirty-five per squad. The defenses on the city wall were thinner on the eastern side, and one could even clearly see the white paint number "BS-2213" sprayed on the mechanical armor of the guard whose gaze was focused at the moment...
Before, at this distance, it would have been absolutely impossible to see clearly with the naked eye.
Reflected in Su Lun's eyes, the bustling traffic of the city flowed, and he murmured, "My vision has been greatly enhanced, as well as my night vision and the ability to distinguish high-frequency targets. As expected, after advancing, the innate capabilities of the 'All-knowing Eye' have also improved."
The innate abilities of a Transcendent can become stronger with development and occupational advancement.
On his way to the camp before, he had noticed something abnormal with his eyes.
On the way back, he had encountered a mutated lightning sculpture.
This kind of flying creature's diving speed is faster than a bullet. To a normal person, watching it catch its prey, especially in poor light, seems like a glitch, a flash spanning a hundred meters...
This is what is commonly referred to as "Physical Blink."
It's because the eye's capture of light changes faster than the nerve response time; missing out a segment of the visual light capture makes it appear as if it's teleporting.
But Su Lun discovered that his current vision could clearly capture the silhouette of the lightning sculpture.
This has a huge impact on combat.
For example, say.
Previously, he dodged bullets by predicting the direction of the gun barrel.
But now, he could clearly capture the entire trajectory of the bullet, not just the two moments of firing and hitting.
In combat, especially against those who can "Physically Blink" in close combat professions, this is incredibly useful.
Now, Su Lun's vision could even capture every detail of a fast-moving target's actions like slow-motion replay. By seeing the movements clearly, he could anticipate and react in advance.
He could fight, he could flee.
However...
The capabilities of the 'All-knowing Eye' have indeed been enhanced, but it seems 'Death Reaper' hasn't changed much.
Thinking of this, he suddenly remembered the secondary awakening of innate abilities that Qian Tiao had mentioned to him before.
According to the words of the gambling-addicted lady, that is the true qualitative change.
Thinking of this, he also felt some anticipation about what these two "S-grade" innate abilities would be like after their secondary awakening.
But he didn't dwell on it, because the secondary awakening is something you come across by chance and can't seek out.
If one is often on the edge of life and death, the probability might be higher.
Su Lun felt that ordinary people probably wouldn't want to awaken any abilities through such means.
Before long, after observing the routes to escape in case of trouble, he walked towards the camp.
....
Although Su Lun wouldn't mutate in a high spiritual power environment, he still needed to return to the city to buy supplies. He also needed to contact Mr. Hei to get his 'Thousand Threads' alchemical planting gear and to ask some questions.
Moreover, Su Lun had now advanced to the second rank, but there were still two needs that hadn't been met: one was the secret technique for spiritual power, and the other was the spells for various spatial magics.
The Dawn City Ruins were vast, and it was impossible for him alone to find what he needed.
The Scavenger Guild was a good place for that.
Su Lun planned to go to the city to browse the Scavenger market, to see if there were any bargains to be had.
If he didn't find any, he would post a reward offering for information on "Spatial Magic."
The Scavenger Guild might just provide the information he needed.
Perhaps, the omnipotent Scavengers had encountered that 'Magician' Howard in some other cursed space, or through other channels, had obtained some spatial magic.
But before that, Su Lun had one more thing to do.
He planned to have a "heart-to-heart" talk with the Gang Lady, Sabina.
When it came to information, who knew more than the Chief Intelligence Officer of the Umbrella Organization?
Before, he wasn't sure he could win a fight, and even if he did win, he wasn't sure he could escape, but now...
It was time to avenge that night's ambush.
Moreover, Su Lun also planned to try the 'High-class Succubus Ownership Contract' he had obtained in the cursed space to see if it would work on that woman...

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - 166: Night Raid on the Bathroom
chapters.content:
Su Lun walked towards the campsite at Dawn City.
Being alone was too conspicuous, so he blended into a caravan.
With the frontier development booming, more and more caravans and Scavengers from Old Lington City arrived at the ruins.
A few months ago, the small path through the cave had turned into a cement road, bustling with unending traffic.
It might have been an illusion, but Su Lun felt that the quality of these groups had significantly improved compared to a month ago. Many, evident from their clothes and equipment, were professionals who clearly weren't short of money and were also mingling in the crowd.
Mixing in with the group and eavesdropping, Su Lun found out that these people were indeed bodyguards and security teams from major families and financial conglomerates, apparently sent to scout ahead.
Reiss family, Leonard family, Rockefeller, Dupont, Morgan...
People in the group mentioned that apparently all these top financial tycoons from the inner city had sent representatives here.
"So the inner city is also getting involved in Scavenging on a large scale…"
Scavenging had always been an opportunity for the poor in the outer city to earn their living, risking their lives; people from the inner city, at least their direct heirs, would almost never participate in such high-casualty endeavors.
But now, things had changed.
Su Lun remembered Mr. Hei mentioning that there would be a Scavenging craze soon. It was said that the upper echelons of the Black Tower planned to fully develop the central and core districts of Dawn City, mandating that all major families from the inner city send their best people over.
After listening for a while, he picked up some disjointed pieces of information.
Su Lun also had some thoughts.
....
From a distance, Su Lun saw several wanted posters stuck at the city gate.
The top two, naturally, were for Number Nineteen and his own true identity.
As he had expected, due to his frequent "major actions," he had finally become one of the only two "SS class wanted criminals" in Old Lington at present.
The official bounty had reached five million and a bunch of other stuff, with an additional massive reward added by the wealthy Oliver family below...
However, he looked over and figured the situation wasn't too bad.
The wanted poster still displayed his former Bald Punk look.
But since it was an "SS wanted notice," the details were very thorough.
Major features were all described in detail, such as being skilled with dual guns, a Puppet Master, accompanied by a blue-skinned giant, possessing two prohibited items: "Xiupunos's Night Scythe" and "Oz's Mummy Wrappings"...
Those bounty experts had even analyzed the models of his dual guns, right down to the renowned "Blue Demon" and "Lightning Snake."
Not only his height, shoulder width, weight, shoe size... but also his abhorrence for the undead.
It could be said, everything about Su Lun that had been exposed before, had been meticulously recorded in the wanted poster.
If he still had his Bald appearance, no matter how he disguised himself, entering the city would make him a target for the Bounty Hunters, not to mention the burden of carrying along such conspicuous items like the undead and the Black Scythe.
For normal criminals, such a level of the wanted poster truly left no place to hide.
But one thing slightly puzzled Su Lun.
He noticed that his current long-haired appearance hadn't appeared on the wanted poster.
But Su Lun wasn't harboring any illusions.
Although he wore a mask that night, Sabina, that woman, had only seen half his face.
But he always felt that, with her methods, she wouldn't let go of such valuable intelligence.
...
Various large and small caravans lined up at the camp gate for inspection to enter the city.
Due to the large crowd, there was a longstanding queue at the city gate.
Su Lun felt that it was probably because of the last time he and Number 19 had infiltrated the city and caused a commotion that the city defense and guards had significantly strengthened.
The number of checkpoint personnel had doubled, and there were armed inspection teams wearing white helmets, seemingly designed to prevent the guards from being bribed or showing favoritism...
Everyone had to remove their hats and masks for inspection, and the large goods of each merchant troop had to be opened.
There were also some "undercover" agents mingling in the queue, their gazes flitting suspiciously over the crowd.
Su Lun had already scoped out these checkpoints and knew that following the merchants was his best chance to get close to the city walls.
Entering the city required a long wait, which couldn't stop people from needing to relieve themselves urgently.
A few simple sheds had been constructed outside the city walls to serve as temporary toilets.
Feigning an urgent need, Su Lun went to a corner behind the toilets, avoiding the eyes of the crowd.
He had previously observed that this was the shelter closest to the city wall.
The city wall was about ten meters thick, and he would have to teleport roughly ten meters to avoid being detected by the guards.
Su Lun was still unable to master long-distance teleportation, but the distance here was just right.
He was already adept at the technique of spatial teleportation and chose a direction before pinching the sorcerer's seal, and a black portal appeared instantly.
Stepping through, he looked around and found himself already inside the city.
....
"A slight miscalculation, not bad..."
Checking his landing spot, Su Lun revealed a slight smile.
He straightened his suit and lowered the brim of his bowler hat before heading towards the city streets.
The Black Baron Pub was the territory of the Steam Party, and Sabina, as the Gang Lady, was naturally a frequent visitor there.
This time, Su Lun didn't dare go directly to the Black Baron for fear of encountering an accident and being recognized prematurely.
So, he chose a small pub a few shops away, where he could find a window seat with a view of the Black Baron.
He ordered a drink and listened to the Scavengers in the pub boast and blather, which also gave him a good idea of what had recently happened.
Apart from the scavenger information, he frequently heard the name "S wanted criminal Su Lun," but mostly in a tone of admiration.
Hearing it made him, the person in question, occasionally smile.
At the table next to him, there was a Big Beard boasting about his encounter with "Su Lun."
"Hey, let me tell you, I was also at [1911 Restaurant] last time, and I indeed met that 'S wanted Su Lun' himself. That battle was spectacular, hundreds of people tried to kill him, along with several major Scavenger group leaders, but they failed to capture him and even got one of their own killed ..."
"I also heard that Su Lun is actually a third-tier professional. Those guys at the Bounty Hunters' Guild just deliberately play it down because they're scared no one will dare to provide information..."
"Exactly! Even with that banned item, which first-tier professional could travel from Old Lington to Dawn City? Do they really think everyone in the inner city is useless?"
"That guy is truly incredible. I heard he came from the slums and then made it through fighting in the gang, which led to his present status..."
"Eh, I heard he used to be a bodyguard in the inner city..."
"..."
All kinds of messy information came out of the mouths of the patrons, making Su Lun, the person in question, doubt if the "protagonist" in the story was actually him.
For the ordinary Scavengers struggling to survive at the bottom, the bounty on a criminal was too distant, merely a tale to pass the time over tea and meals.
The tough life always needed some amusement. Suddenly, there was someone who could make the big tycoons grimace, and they enjoyed hearing about it.
To them, Su Lun was a "legendary figure."
....
Su Lun waited in the pub for almost three hours.
Finally, as midnight approached, he saw the person he had been waiting for.
At the entrance of the Black Baron tavern, a woman in fox fur finally appeared.
Even from afar, you could see a stunning woman basking in the spotlight on stage, surrounded by men, all smiles and spirited conversation—it was none other than the enchanting Gang Lady.
She seemed to have settled matters with a group of inner city big shots and left the tavern.
The slightly tipsy old gentlemen, escorted by the scantily clad tavern girls, laughed and bid her farewell as they headed to a fancy hotel next door.
Sabina led a group that included Steam Party executives and underlings towards another inn.
It looked like they were preparing to rest.
Tommy was also in the group. Over the past month, it seemed he had also been tamed by the methods of the Gang Lady, his mouth unconstrained yet unspoken, his face stern.
As a spiritual profession practitioner, Su Lun had extremely sharp perceptions. He dared not stare directly and observed everything with a diffused gaze.
He watched the group enter the three-story building and didn't rush out himself.
After waiting a moment, seeing the light suddenly come on in a room on the third floor, he then exited the tavern.
Su Lun just stepped onto the street, passing by the entrance of an inn called "Starlight Inn," without any pause. He listened briefly and had roughly discerned the distribution of people inside. All of the Steam Party underlings were in the ground floor hall, playing cards and boasting.
Su Lun avoided the eyes of others and turned into a narrow alley behind the inn.
The defenses looked lax enough that he could simply climb the wall to get upstairs.
But as Su Lun examined the unassuming alarm devices on the wall, a knowing smirk crossed his face, "Hah, as expected of someone into espionage, cautious enough..."
Ever since he had mastered spatial ability, his perception system had incorporated the concept of space, allowing him to distinguish the architectural layout within a certain range, even with his eyes closed.
For instance, he could clearly identify the partition wall, bed, and cupboard in the room with the light on, three floors up.
This way, he wouldn't teleport and end up inside a wall.
....
Since he had decided to make a move, Su Lun didn't hesitate.
With a pinch of the sorcerer's seals, the Octo-Arms Spider Lance was revealed, and a void black hole appeared out of nowhere; he stepped into it.
The next step he took, he was already inside that room on the third floor.
The room was spacious, with ambient warm lighting casting luxurious shadows, and the air was tinged with a hint of moisture.
No one was seen on the bed, a white fox fur and a silk dress hung on the coat rack, white lace intimates were scattered on the bed, and high heels by the door...
Seeing these items, Su Lun immediately confirmed his judgment was correct.
This was indeed Sabina's room!
Hearing the sound of water from the bathroom, he didn't hesitate and charged straight towards it.
The person in the bathroom also reacted quickly, seemingly hearing the faint noise of someone entering, and suddenly there was a "splash" sound like that of water.
Unfortunately for her, Su Lun, who was prepared, was quicker!
With his agility-enhanced Octo-Arms Spider Lance, the distance was nothing; it shot up the wall, and he was instantly within the bathroom.
Su Lun gave the enemy no chance to react; as soon as he entered the bathroom, he delivered a punch to her stomach, interrupting her attempt to reach for a golden bracelet on the washstand.
At this moment, Sabina had already transformed into a seductive demon form, her eyes emitting a sinister red glow.
With that cold-flame punch, the dark spiritual power within her stalled.
Being a high-level professional, although caught off guard, she wasn't totally defenseless.
Yet Sabina chose not to linger in combat and decisively opted to escape—having an opponent who could enter the room silently was a severe threat!
Following that punch, her body suddenly burst into a cloud of pink mist, clearly attempting to utilize the demonic charm's innate ability to escape just like the other day.
Unfortunately for her, Su Lun was already prepared.
Right as his fist dispersed her tender body with a punch, his eyes hardened, his hands clapped rapidly, and the sorcerer's seals were instantly formed. The space around seemed to freeze.
As soon as the pink gauze dissipated, she had not escaped far when her figure was revealed just a meter away.
It was like flashing into a wall, her head buzzing in confusion.
Sabina looked at herself still in the bathroom, her pretty face also showing a trace of shock.
But this time, she was not given a chance to escape as a hand, strong as iron tongs, was already lurking around her neck.
In that instant, Sabina's face drastically changed, and she cried out in her heart, "Spatial lockdown!"
She found herself choked by that hand, her whole body like sinking into a quagmire, not only making casting difficult but even her struggles were restricted.
The opponent clearly knew of her abilities and had come prepared, countering her means of escape.
Spatial control is a very rare ability.
In her mind, she was immediately searching for what kind of enemy would possess such a power.
But she did not need to think further; looking at the eight-armed spider spear before her, Sabina already knew who the visitor was.
....
Su Lun gave Sabina no chance to resist. The moment he controlled her, the "Deadly Poison Spikes" of two spider spears, glowing with dark luminescence, were already a mere centimeter in front of the woman's eyes. Any sudden movement, and the spears would pierce through her eye sockets and into her skull.
And that was not all!
To restrain her from any movement, several other spider spears drew out countless silver threads, enclosing her entirely like in a giant net. The threads cut into her flesh, preventing her not only from forming seals but even from moving her fingers.
Spatial restriction + silk threads + spider spears...
Naked, Sabina was held in a highly embarrassing pose against the bathroom wall by Su Lun.
The entire process was completed in one go; Su Lun did not utter a single word, he pulled out a sharp dagger and immediately slashed a bloodstained gash on her arm.
This dagger, dismantled from a "PZ911 Mechanical Limb," had a strong anti-magic effect.
With this single slash, it penetrated the jelly-like protective barrier on Sabina's skin, drawing blood.
Su Lun, watching the bleeding, then took out a prepared sheepskin scroll, intricately inscribed with a complex contract seal, and dropped the blood onto it.
The sheepskin scroll absorbed the blood, and spiritual light spilled out.
Seeing this strange action, Sabina's expression finally changed significantly.
She realized that things were seriously amiss.
However, being a Major General of Intelligence within the Umbrella Organization, whether in mentality or strength she was top-notch, and the shock soon disappeared.
Suddenly, she stopped struggling. She did not feel embarrassed about her naked state; instead, she stretched her body openly, as if wanting the man before her to see everything clearly.
A pair of red pupils spilled out a strange, bewitching light, a wave of spiritual power subtly emanating.
The air filled with a scent that sent hormones spiraling...
Unfortunately, with the two spider spears pointed at her eyeballs, most of her vision was blocked, preventing her from daring to move.
Those bits of peripheral vision she could catch sight of also revealed a pair of almost numb eyes, faintly reddening, seemingly unaffected by lust.
That look, Sabina was all too familiar with it.
It was a sign that the man before her was about to unleash the monster within his heart.
Back then, she had almost suffered a great loss at the hands of this red-eyed monster.
Watching Su Lun holding a potion syringe to her neck, ready to inject it at any moment, Sabina inwardly cursed.
A high-grade calming potion?
In that moment, she realized that her opponent thoroughly understood the succubus's capabilities, with every step calculated.
PS. I dare not correct the typos in the next two chapters as it would trigger a review, please bear with it.

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - 167: 167
chapters.content:
Su Lun had not expected Sabina to be bathing, but that made things easier and saved a lot of trouble.
She had no clothes or equipment on her, which also lessened many unforeseen complications.
After all, a mere glance at the vanity nearby revealed an identified artifact known as "Nitokris's Gold Bracelet," a tricky mental curse item.
If he hadn't been quick enough, had this woman gotten hold of it, today's events might have taken a different turn.
....
At that moment, Sabina was captured yet she swiftly regained her composure, and she took the initiative to speak, "Sir, I think there might be some misunderstanding between us?"
Her voice seemed to carry magic, soft and gentle, making her sound like a harmless, delicate woman.
Feigning ignorance, she waited for Su Lun to respond.
Unfortunately, the current Su Lun, who had harvested Barbara's memories, was all too familiar with the tactics of a succubus.
There are four practical techniques of a succubus's Bewitching Technique: voice, gaze, scent, and body.
How could he not know what this woman was planning?
If he let her talk too much, he might become hypnotized without even realizing it.
"Shut up!"
Su Lun commanded, his voice devoid of any emotion.
Sabina saw his demeanor and knew that he was aware of her "Bewitching Sound" ability.
Suddenly, her body went limp, as if she had given up all resistance, "Alright. But... may I dress first?"
She cleverly added another line, making it difficult for anyone to move against her.
Did she really want to put on clothes?
No.
Her words were actually a reminder to Su Lun that she was completely naked.
How proud was a succubus's figure?
Sabina was already irresistibly enchanting fully clothed, so one can only imagine her allure when undressed.
Steam was still rising from the bathtub, and the faint scent of rose petals permeated the entire bathroom.
Just having emerged from the bath, she was without a stitch on, and her fair skin was still dotted with petals. Her skin was so smooth that it seemed even clear droplets of water could not stay upon it, as they slowly trickled down her fragrant shoulders and beautiful legs...
Seemingly out of nervousness and fear, her breathing was hurried, yet on closer listening, it resembled a seductive, mellow tone.
Her chest heaved with rapid breaths, and her fair, full bosom trembled gently...
The sight before him was undeniably a breathtakingly beautiful body that could arouse any man.
Not only was the visual impact striking, but her body also exuded a special seductive scent that quickened one's blood flow.
Together with her shy demeanor that seemed ready for anyone's touch, it constantly stimulated sensual desires.
Given a chance, she would retaliate!
Unfortunately for her, the parrot-shaped plague doctor mask that Su Lun wore was not an ordinary one; it was a "Plague Doctor's Beak Mask" that filtered 99% of toxins.
Even libido-inducing toxins were still toxins.
And they were filtered right out.
....
Su Lun had anticipated everything and was not about to give this woman any opportunity to turn the tables.
Without glancing elsewhere and unaffected, he coldly said, "Now, recite with me."
The "High-Tier Succubus Mastering Contract" required, besides a Formation, that the succubus willingly recite an ancient demonic oath.
This was the most troublesome part.
After a pause, he recited a difficult oath in a foreign tongue, "&*%фκ%λ￥ёъ..."
On hearing this, a serious expression flickered across Sabina's eyes.
She had just watched Su Lun absorb her blood with a parchment and was now trying to make her recite something, naturally guessing it was some ancient ritual.
Although she did not know what he planned to do, Sabina was not foolish enough to comply blindly.
She realized this was a dangerous ritual.
Sabina still wanted to struggle for a chance, starting to speak, "We can make a deal! I can give you everything you want..."
But before she could finish, Su Lun suddenly thrust the dagger in his hand into her collarbone.
Blood spurted out, and the dagger pierced through her shoulder, pinning her directly to the wall.
Su Lun said coldly, "Recite with me. I don't have the patience to talk further."
He was just trying; if the contract could not be successfully formed, he planned to kill this woman outright.
To make a deal with such a cunning and astute woman, and a high official of the "Umbrella Organization" at that?
Su Lun was not so vain to believe he could control her.
Sabina, catching the numbness in Su Lun's tone, her eyes turned cold.
She understood human nature too well; the man before her was as cold as stone, offering her no opportunity whatsoever.
She knew if she refused, this guy would definitely kill her without a second thought.
Yet, she would never agree; with a tilt of her head, she let out a cold snort.
....
Su Lun had known it would come to this.
He had no mercy for his enemies.
He was here to try his luck, if it succeeded, all the better, if not, he considered it a harvest of experience.
At that moment, he took out a potion and injected it straight into Sabina's vein, his tone utterly emotionless as he said, "This is the 'Interrogation Potion.' As an intelligence officer for the Umbrella Organization, you should be aware of what this is. I know you've undergone professional training, and your will wouldn't allow you to submit easily. But I will keep increasing the dosage until you are hypnotized or overdose and die."
Looking at the potion, Sabina showed no emotion; she had already prepared herself for death.
Instead, she was more concerned about another matter, "You know my identity?"
"What do you think?"
Su Lun responded with a cold laugh, constantly monitoring his own panel. If there was even a slight anomaly, he was ready to commit murder instantly.
After one injection, he took out another potion, preparing for another injection.
At that moment, Sabina seemed to guess something and asked, "Is this the 'Demon Contract of Servitude'?"
Su Lun made no attempt to hide it, "Of course. Either become my servant or... die."
"..."
Sabina knew she couldn't defy him, yet upon hearing it was that contract, she fell into deep thought.
She suddenly shouted urgently, blocking Su Lun from injecting the second potion, "Wait!"
Su Lun looked at her, "Oh? Changed your mind?"
Sabina, fully aware of what signing the contract entailed, suddenly appeared relieved, as if she was ready to be captured, "Promise me one thing. I will cooperate with you."
Su Lun listened and stopped pushing the potion, "Let's hear it."
Sabina, being a mental professional, surely had an exceptionally strong will.
An overdose of the potion could leave her an idiot, even if it didn't kill her.
Even if the contract succeeded, there would be no point.
If she were willing to cooperate, that would be best.
Sabina said, "When you're capable, help me kill someone."
Her tone sounded as if she were stating her last wish.
Su Lun showed a bit of interest, "Who?"
Sabina: "Servis Gerard."
Su Lun found the name unfamiliar, "Who is that?"
Sabina: "The leader of the Umbrella Organization."
Su Lun did not hesitate, "Possible. If one day I have the capacity, I will surely kill him for you."
It wasn't too outrageous a request since the leader of the Umbrella Organization was already an enemy.
If one day the capability was there, he definitely intended to kill him.
The two then reached a verbal agreement.
Su Lun felt the process went smoothly, surprisingly so. He had thought this woman would rather die than submit, then he asked, "Can you tell me why, upon hearing it was a 'Demon Contract of Servitude,' you suddenly changed your mind?"
Upon hearing this, Sabina appeared very calm, "It's just a change of allegiance, nothing more. From the mythological era, demons have always been vassals of some powerful beings. If this contract is as legendary as they say, it could greatly benefit me in some ways. The stronger the master I serve, the stronger I will become."
After a pause, she added meaningfully, "Besides, I am not as loyal to the Umbrella Organization as you think."
Su Lun found her words somewhat surprising, but didn't comment further.
...
With Sabina's active cooperation, the contract was established smoothly.
