He paused, a mocking curve to his lips as he scrutinized Lena's delicate, doll-like pretty face, "Actually, we can discuss this further, perhaps we could come up with a solution. If you don't mind, after this soiree, I'd like to invite Miss Lena for a drink, I wonder..."
The tone sounded like a query, but in reality, it was aggressive.
Lena's face already showed anger, and she didn't give this hypocrital Young Master any face, coldly stating, "Sorry, I don't have the time!"
Su Lun, listening from the side, raised an eyebrow.
The so-called high society is precisely this bothersome.
Knowing it was you who did it, even without tearing off any masks, without evidence, there was also no way to fight.
Because there's too much to consider.
Unlike in the Brotherhood, where everyone was barefoot, I damn well won't bother with you, and if you dare provoke me, I dare kill.
"That's really too bad..."
Lena gave no face at all, and Eli just shrugged.
Young Master Eli, his expression momentarily darkened, then suddenly stopped pretending and scoffed, "But I gave you the chance, and you didn't take it. I won't force it. If Miss Lena changes her mind, you can always come to me..."
If he could win over the eldest daughter of the Reiss Clan Leader, he stood to gain more than if he simply destroyed them.
Unfortunately... this woman was not astute enough.
Meanwhile, Young Master Danze and the heirs of several other families who watched this unfold also pointed and laughed.
Seemingly placing bets.
Young Master Eli lost, utterly humiliated.
....
Listening to these blatantly humiliating words, Lena's pretty face flushed with anger.
But manners and upbringing kept her from retaliating with harsh words. She could only turn her head away, disregarding him entirely.
This was a negotiation doomed to fail from the start, seeming headed towards an unhappy conclusion.
But Su Lun didn't expect that he, a mere bystander partaking in gossip, could also be affected.
Possibly because he was snubbed by Lena, Eli was somewhat angered too.
He looked at Su Lun and asked coldly, "This friend looks unfamiliar? Which clan's Young Master are you?"
The tone was unmistakably threatening.
I damn well don't allow anyone to help the eldest line of the Reiss Clan, and yet you dare defy me?
"..."
Hearing this, Su Lun didn't even lift his eyes, completely ignoring him.
"You upper-class folks worry about social etiquette; I'm just a thug from the underworld."
"Who cares, who gives a damn."
Being ignored by Miss Lena was tolerable since she was on the same level. But being ignored by Su Lun now, Young Master Eli felt a tremendous insult.
He stared at the two interacting alone, made some assumptions, and said sarcastically, "Oh... Miss Lena, is this the help you found?"
Lena seemed unwilling to involve Su Lun and quickly turned around to say something, "He has nothing to do with it..."
But at that moment, Su Lun interrupted her, disclosing his alias: "I am Zoro."
We are going to be enemies anyway.
Let the hatred be full.
Upon hearing this, Eli thought for a moment and couldn't recall anyone by that name: "Hah, it seems you don't recognize me?"
He felt the man was unfamiliar, thus surely not from one of the inner city's top families, and so he had nothing to worry about.
He didn't know yet that he had messed with someone a hundred times more troublesome than any top tycoon.
"I don't recognize you."
Su Lun glanced at him with disdain and said, "So, you want something?"
That comment effectively ended the conversation.
If he doesn't know you, there's no point showing off anymore.
Young Master Eli's face turned sour, his skin twitching, at a loss for words.
After struggling for a while, he managed to squeeze out a few words with a malignant look, "Zoro, is it? Hah, you're capable. Just don't fall into my hands..."
Su Lun felt the tangible murderous intent and glanced at him, "Oh."
But he didn't pay it much attention.
In this party, no one dared to make a move.
....
Young Master Eli left in a huff, and Lena turned back to Su Lun with a face full of apologies: "I'm sorry for the trouble, Mr. Zoro."
Su Lun shook his head lightly and said indifferently, "It's okay."
Lena thought Su Lun really didn't recognize Young Master Eli and anxiously explained: "It's not that—the guy just now is the young master of the Clark family… messing with him is troublesome..."
Su Lun shook his head nonchalantly, "I know."
"Ah?"
Lena was a bit perplexed, knowing yet still offending?
Not to mention the outer city bounty hunters, even in the inner city, there aren't many who dare to provoke that young master.
She wanted to say something more, but just at that moment, the entire venue of the party suddenly quieted down.
All eyes turned, and a young girl in a magnificent princess dress, surrounded by a group of attendants, entered the venue.
The arrival was naturally tonight's protagonist, Princess Theresa of the Duke's estate.
They had met briefly in the afternoon when Princess Theresa was fully veiled.
Now, although lightly veiled again, only covering her eyes, it allowed people a good look at her exquisitely beautiful face.
For a moment, the gaze of every young master and lady in the inner city was captivated.
Su Lun, however, was not as impressed; he had separate the visage of Princess Theresa from a fifth-tier memory fragment before.
But seeing the memory fragment and seeing the person were two different things.
"This lady's charm is quite high..."
Somewhere, Su Lun always felt that Princess Theresa seemed familiar to him.
Not just the face, but a certain special familiarity, as if... he recognized a unique aura or a distinct vibe.
And when Su Lun looked at the butterfly brooch pinned on the chest of the princess' dress, his pupils instantly constricted.
It was identical to the brooch he had once buried in a cave somewhere!

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - 191 A Thousand is Not a Thousand
chapters.content:
Seeing the black butterfly brooch on Princess Theresa's chest, Su Lun's gaze faltered.
He immediately realized that things might be more complicated than he had anticipated.
The more he thought about it, the more his hair seemed to stand on end.
On his first day after crossing over, he had encountered a ghostly little girl called "Pestoya" in this very manor, in this very banquet hall.
That little girl had given him a brooch just like this one.
After using the All-knowing Eye to see that there was "???" information inside the brooch, he, to be safe, had hidden it in a corner of the caves.
Looking back, he still felt that hiding the brooch had been a very necessary action.
This was a world of mysterious powers.
Every time the All-knowing Eye identified "???" information, it involved extraordinarily sophisticated matters.
Although Su Lun didn't know what exactly it was, it most likely involved some indescribable entities.
Moreover, Su Lun was no longer the ignorant newcomer that he was on the first day of his arrival.
He now understood that the people in the cursed spaces, no matter how real, were either remnants or illusions.
Generally speaking, even ghostly entities were non-player characters with lower intelligence.
But after experiencing so many cursed spaces and encountering many creatures, Su Lun realized that Pestoya's intelligence was not on the same level as those he met before.
Emotions, conversations, logical thinking abilities...
Pestoya was just like a real person!
This made Su Lun even more convinced that the cursing space level of this "Storm Manor" must have been unimaginably high.
Or perhaps, very special.
After all, Pestoya also had another identity, she was Sir Isaac's beloved daughter!
With this background, now that Su Lun understood part of Dawn City's history, he was more convinced that there were ancient secrets involved.
So, the appearance of that brooch here...
Became all the more eerie!
....
The moment he saw Princess Theresa, Su Lun diverted his gaze and then subtly shifted his position, trying to avoid being seen by her.
Upon seeing the brooch, two thoughts reflexively popped into his head.
1. The brooch he had buried had been dug up by someone, and it was just an ordinary cursed object;
2. There was a big problem with this brooch;
Su Lun's way of thinking always leaned towards the worst.
He chose option 2.
There was a very high chance that there was something wrong with the brooch.
Previously, he had been wondering what in the Dawn Relic could attract the direct involvement of a princess from a great Duke's family.
Now, it seemed either she had discovered some secret from the brooch, like a treasure map.
But even if it were a treasure map, she wouldn't need to come in person.
After all, the entire underground world was her family's mining pits, it would suffice to send someone else.
Or, there was some reason she had to come herself.
And urgently.
Whichever it was, Su Lun felt it best to not get involved.
Watching the lone and proud aura of Theresa, he also faintly understood what that familiar sense previously was all about.
...
The moment Theresa made her appearance, all eyes were focused on her.
Even within the inner city, those from the wealthy conglomerates who had seen this princess were extremely rare.
After all, whose tycoon daughter would frequent her own mines for no reason?
Most of those present would think her aloof face represented the dignified air of high nobility.
But who could imagine, perhaps the Ducal Palace in the inner city was just for show.
The occasional descent into the mines by her to inspect the situation was taken by these people as a gracious act.
After entering the banquet hall, Theresa didn't say a word.
But it was this indifferent attitude that excited these inner city people even more.
Ah... this indeed is true nobility.
Each of them was generous with their compliments, which sounded like whispers, but their voices seemed eager for their praise to be heard by the princess.
"Oh, Princess Theresa is absolutely beautiful, just like an angel..."
"To see the princess with my own eyes at this event, not to mention coming to this relic, even if it were to embrace death, I would not hesitate..."
"Yes, if she would allow me to kiss the tip of her foot, it would be the honor of my lifetime..."
"Ah! My Valen family will forever be the most loyal servants of the Duke and Princess Theresa..."
"..."
Su Lun listened, always feeling something odd in his heart.
This was his first time attending such an upper-class society gathering, and the culture of flattering the lords was something he found a bit hard to adapt to.
Fortunately, it seemed that Theresa had no intention of merely drinking and dining here; as soon as she arrived, she directly went into the main topic of the banquet.
Her lady-in-waiting announced, "Her Royal Highness, Princess, gathered everyone here for the Dawn Relic. The purpose of this mission is for everyone to explore the relic and find something..."
She rambled on about a bunch of things.
Listening to the lady-in-waiting's words, Su Lun quickly analyzed some key information.
Pioneering the wilderness and finding things.
It seemed that Theresa was also uncertain about where the "thing" was and needed to pioneer the entire relic.
Then there was a mission and also rewards.
Listening to the lady-in-waiting's words, it was about whichever family could find what the princess wanted would certainly gain favor from the Duke's estate and become the foremost family in the inner city.
...
"All major families must arrive on time and follow the routes to the core area of the relic..."
Before long, the lady-in-waiting finished speaking.
She waved her hand and commanded softly, "Draw lots!"
As her words fell, a group of servants came forward carrying trays.
The heads of the major families stepped forward to draw lots; it was like cutting a cake—the relic was divided into over thirty routes, and the one you drew was yours.
By some coincidence, young Rena drew and received number sixteen.
Number fifteen was the Olli family, and number seventeen was the Clark Family...
This meant that on the road to hunt in the wilderness, enemies flanked them on both sides.
Compared to young Rena's troubled face, Su Lun looked at this scene and couldn't help but chuckle to himself, "These guys do have some tricks, even managing to rig the drawing of lots..."
But that was also just fine.
He was still thinking about that treasure in Young Master Danze's possession.
This expedition to hunt in the wilderness was fraught with danger, and it was highly likely that the young master would bring it along.
After the drawing of lots ended, Princess Theresa left the scene.
Su Lun also inexplicably sighed in relief.
Only then did that sensation of pain quietly pressing at his forehead disappear.
Though he had only seen a familiar butterfly brooch, he felt a vague apprehension.
....
Everyone thought that the official banquet would follow after the princess's departure.
But unexpectedly, at that moment, several maids walked in with trays covered by silver lids, and began serving the "main course."
When the main course was served, a thick scent of blood immediately swept through the banquet hall.
People exchanged glances, initially thinking it was some sort of exotic "sashimi."
With Princess Theresa already gone, the attendees at the banquet were no longer so restrained.
Curious, someone opened their plate to take a look.
All eyes turned to watch.
But to their horror, they discovered it was a simply marinated bloodied head!
Not all the young lords and ladies of the inner city had experienced the sight of blood, and, at this sight, everyone turned pale and instantly exclaimed in shock. But since it was at Miss Theresa's temporary residence, each of them covered their mouths, none daring to scream out loud.
Someone recognized the origins of the head, whispering in trembling terror, "This... isn't this the youngest son of Mr. Marino of the 'Tessali family'?"
As other plates were opened, it became clear—the Tessali family members were all accounted for.
From the eldest to the youngest, the heads of more than twenty direct descendants of the family were all present.
A banquet of heads...
The horrific scene stunned everyone present.
Looking at this table full of heads, these young lords and ladies of the inner city immediately understood something;
This was a warning to scare the monkeys.
But they also did not understand why the "Tessali family" had suddenly been annihilated.
"This... why is this happening..."
"Yes, wasn't Mr. Tessali actively responding to the call to hunt in the wilderness? They also sent quite a few people this time..."
"Could it be a mistake, or is there another reason?"
"..."
There are no secrets in the upper echelons of society.
At that moment, a woman stood up and revealed the real situation.
"Well... I kind of know what this is about. Mrs. Tessali had been unwilling to let her son come to hunt in the wilderness and, banking on chance, had a bodyguard's son come as a stand-in at the last minute. She even advised me to do the same..."
While speaking, this lady did not forget to express her stance, "I had warned them earlier not to use such tricks, and now look what has happened. It would've been fine if they had just followed the Duke's orders properly, rather than making a mess like this."
When this was mentioned, everyone understood.
They thought they had covered all their bases, but everything was under the control of the Black Tower.
This also made those young masters and misses who had planned to manipulate the hunting expedition unexpectedly feel a chill around their necks.
The firm attitude of Princess Teresa shattered any illusions they had.
For a moment, the grand banquet fell silent.
But...
These people, though without merit, had certainly endured hardships.
As subjects of Duke Rafael, those who could stand here were, after all, prominent figures from the inner city.
Was it necessary to warn them in such a brutal and ruthless manner?
It seemed not a crime deserving of death, yet Duke's mansion showed no mercy, erasing a whole major family just like that?
The crowd wore complex expressions, filled with worry, anger, confusion, and indignation...
Yet no one dared to speak out.
But the more prominent the families of the inner city were, the more they knew the terror of the Black Tower.
Especially those who had heard fragments about the rebellion fifty years ago from their elders, dared not say a word.
....
Su Lun watched from a distance, and his shock was no less than that of others.
However, it was not the shock of this bloody spectacle that affected him, but the method, which felt eerily familiar!
The same banquet hall, the same bloody methods...
Scenes from the past seemed to flash before Su Lun's eyes as he thought, "These tactics of Teresa... why do they feel like Pestoya's? Could it be a coincidence?"
For a moment, related clues connected in his mind.
He had a vague feeling that he had guessed part of the truth of the matter.
But some things contradicted each other, and something didn't feel quite right.
For instance, the critical question, why had Sir Isaac burned his own daughter?
Suddenly, an incredible guess crossed his mind, "Or perhaps... the Pestoya I met was not really Sir Isaac's daughter at all? If not, then who was she?"
The only certain thing now was that the butterfly brooch was definitely problematic.
....
Su Lun's thoughts continued to drift, and just then, Qiantiao came over from somewhere.
The only necessary part of the banquet had ended, and there was no need for them to stay.
She called out to the two of them, "Let's go, we're heading back too."
As she spoke, Qiantiao naturally took Su Lun's arm.
The three of them left the estate, and Lena asked, "Auntie, where are you and Mr. Zorro staying?"
Qiantiao replied, "The Rose Hotel."
Lena thought for a moment, seemingly realizing the conditions at the Rose Hotel weren't very good and warmly invited, "Oh, that's just right. I have a spare suite at my place; come stay with me!"
As she spoke, she added in a somewhat coquettish tone, "I haven't had a good chat with Auntie in such a long time..."
While rooms were hard to come by for others, this naïve girl of a landlord still had vacancies.
"Okay,"
Qiantiao naturally agreed happily.
The trio made their way downstairs.
"We drew the number fifteen line, and we'll depart the day after tomorrow at the latest. But we haven't yet recruited a hunting team or mercenaries..."
"That's not a big problem. You can also command the Cross Society's men and horses when the time comes. Mr. Zorro will be going too; he's very capable, so just turn to him if there are any problems..."
"..."
Su Lun listened to the two women's conversation on the side, unable to interject.
As they walked, he curiously noted that the gambling-addicted lady seemed to have gotten used to her ladylike dress, as he hadn't heard her complain about it anymore.
Before long, they reached the "Unicorn Hotel."
Su Lun had intended to return to the Rose Hotel for a good rest, but Lena invited him along as well.
He found it hard to refuse and followed them upstairs.
The hotel was luxuriously decorated.
The top floor had two suites, and since Lena, the young lady, was staying there, no one else was allocated rooms there.
The suite was several times larger than the room Su Lun had stayed in at the previous hotel, complete with a bathtub.
Qiantiao seemed very pleased, and the two women took one room.
Su Lun went to the other.
....
The bed in the room was very comfortable, very soft to sit on.
Thinking about going on the hunting expedition and likely not being able to bathe for a long time, Su Lun also took a quick shower in the bathroom.
It turned out that when one is bathing, their inspiration and thoughts are most active.
With his head covered in bubbles, as the hot water washed over him, it felt like weak currents of electricity stimulating his thoughts, making his senses clearer.
On the way back, he had continually thought about the "butterfly brooch."
Now, still unable to figure it out, he decided not to dwell on it anymore.
His thoughts shifted to the neighbor, Rena.
"Rena is really in a terrible situation now. From what she said, several branches of the family and the Olivers in the inner city seem to intend to thoroughly target the main branch this time. But her dad has such a large foundation in the inner city, he should have more tricks up his sleeve..."
Su Lun pondered to himself.
Could it be that the Black Tower was targeting the Reis main house?
He knew Qiantiao was a member of the "Mirror Organization," and he suspected that the Reis family was definitely associated with "Mirror."
But if that relationship had indeed been discovered, it should be the Umbrella Organization that would take action.
Or, could it simply be that the Duke's mansion didn't want to see too big a conglomerate emerge, and that's why they acted?
So, was the turmoil of the great Oliver family tolerated?
Su Lun's thoughts raced in his mind.
....
The room's soundproofing was excellent, and he could not hear any noise from next door.
But listening to the faint sound of flowing water within the walls, Su Lun guessed that someone next door was taking a bath.
It was probably Qiantiao.
Su Lun thought.
With a bathtub, that gambling-addicted lady would probably enjoy a good soak.
But suddenly, a flash raced through his mind.
"Huh! That's not right. Qiantiao has been acting strangely ever since we left the manor..."
Su Lun suddenly thought of something and frowned.
If this had been back in Old Lington, he might not have noticed anything.
But having spent so much time together with Qiantiao lately, he was now extremely familiar with her personality.
Although they left the manor together, hand in hand, as if very affectionate,
Su Lun still distinctly felt some differences in the minor details.
In that moment, an epiphany struck him, and he finally realized what had been bothering him all along.
The lack of that soft touch!
Qiantiao was very open with Su Lun since they were quite close. If it were any ordinary day, her carefree nature would have ensured she stayed close to him.
But just now, she had maintained a very rational distance.
"That 'Qiantiao' just now, wasn't really Qiantiao?"
Su Lun considered a possibility that deeply alarmed him.
And yet, he was also very confused.
"No, that can't be right! The aura and physique were exactly the same. Disguise couldn't possibly achieve that level."
He was confident that his current perception couldn't possibly have mistaken a fake Qiantiao for the real one without noticing.
And he felt that the gambling-addicted lady's capabilities had already reached the fourth tier; she definitely couldn't have been silently replaced by someone else.
But a sudden thought occurred to him.
Suddenly thinking about the mysterious appearance of that "butterfly brooch,"
Or perhaps some items that seal special abilities...
It might not be impossible!
"A special talent holder?"
Thinking this, Su Lun could no longer remain calm.
The more he thought about it, the more suspicious the previous "Qiantiao" appeared.
It was a difference in details that others would not notice!
.....
The more he thought about it, the more uncontrollable it became.
If his suspicions were correct, the problem was significantly serious!
Who would impersonate Qiantiao?
Had the Black Tower discovered some clue, confirmed her identity, and was now fishing?
That seemed unlikely...
But as this thought occurred, Su Lun recalled too many peculiar details.
What if he was overthinking it?
To clarify his suspicions, Su Lun decided to go and personally check the situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - 192: Alibi
chapters.content:
Su Lun put on his clothes and stepped out of the room.
As soon as he appeared in the corridor, he sensed a gaze observing him.
There was no hostility, only caution.
"Quite powerful, must be Lena's shadow guard..."
Su Lun sensed for a moment and, besides that gaze, there weren't any other people around.
He didn't show any odd behavior and walked directly to the door next to his, knocking on it.
Knock! Knock! Knock!
"Who is it?"
"Miss Lena, it's me, Zorro."
Soon after, the door opened.
Lena, now in a house dress, opened the door and, seeing it was Su Lun, smiled and said, "Oh, it's Mr. Zorro. Are you looking for my aunt? She's taking a bath."
"Yes. I just remembered something urgent and I need to speak with her..."
Su Lun nodded gently while looking at Lena, but his peripheral vision darted inside the room. He paused then added, "May I come in and wait for her?"
Although Lena felt it was a bit improper to let a strange man into her room in the middle of the night, his mention of "urgent business" made her agree, "Please come in."
Once the door was closed, the watchful gaze from outside disappeared.
...
Su Lun stepped inside, but he did not wait on the sofa.
Listening to the sound of water from the bathroom, he looked towards it and called out, "Qiantiao, when will you be done with your bath? I need to talk to you."
It was uncertain if it was by pure chance or not, but the water stopped abruptly as soon as Su Lun entered the room.
At that moment, "Qiantiao," wearing a bathrobe, also came out of the bathroom.
She looked at Su Lun, lazily asking, "What's up?"
Her demeanor showed no signs of irregularity.
Su Lun watched her seemingly languid expression and even started to doubt himself for a moment.
However, at further inspection of her chest, well-concealed by the bathrobe, he felt something was off.
A gambling addict wife wouldn't guard herself against him.
Especially the way the belt was tied... It simply wasn't Qiantiao's style!
"Um... Indeed, there's a bit of business..."
While Su Lun was still speaking, his hand did not hesitate at all; he suddenly drew his gun.
The barrel was instantly aimed at the head of the "Qiantiao" in front of him—if she made the slightest wrong move, her head would undoubtedly be blown off.
The smile on Su Lun's face turned cold instantly as he asked in a stern voice, "Who are you?"
As he spoke, his left hand gestured in the air and an invisible zombie wielding a scythe appeared by his side.
He didn't open fire right away,
because he felt that the intent of this "Fake Qiantiao" was ambiguous,
and it seemed very likely she wasn't an enemy.
Moreover, if she was below Tier 3, it didn't make a difference whether he shot immediately or not; his reaction speed was sufficient.
If she was above Tier 3, shooting immediately would also make no difference.
If by a small chance this "Fake Qiantiao" was an enemy,
escaping would be futile.
The moment he left the manor, it meant he was being targeted.
....
Su Lun thought this "Qiantiao" would offer some excuse, but unexpectedly, she just glanced indifferently and muttered to herself with raised eyebrows, "Oh... I've been discovered, huh."
Lena, who was inside the room, watched as Su Lun suddenly raised his gun. She was about to say something when she suddenly lost consciousness and collapsed onto the soft carpet.
Catching a glimpse of this scene out of the corner of his eye, Su Lun was immediately shocked.
He was horrified to realize that he hadn't even seen how the woman opposite him made her move!
In an instant, a lethal crisis surged in his heart, and the thought of pulling the trigger vanished.
It was as if she suddenly had no weaknesses.
Even with a scythe and a firearm on hand, Su Lun felt as though he had no angle to exploit...
It seemed as if any move he'd make would be in vain.
```
This sense of powerlessness, he had felt it once before.
It was when Mr. Hei and his group encircled and attempted to kill that fifth-rank professional.
Only in the presence of those top professionals did one feel the crushing pressure of rank.
This woman...
She's very strong!
Extremely strong!
"Qiantiao" remained composed throughout, completely ignoring the threat posed by the sickle and the gun as she walked directly toward the sofa, casually calling out to Su Lun, "Sit."
From start to finish, there was no hostility felt.
She had no intention of acting either.
In that instant, his mind raced.
Su Lun's brain suddenly cast aside certain dangerous thoughts entirely, and the tension in his nerves abruptly loosened.
He no longer displayed a murderous aura and calmly put away his firearm and the living corpse.
Su Lun glanced at the woman sitting on the sofa, let out a slight sigh, and showed an expression of wry amusement, "Mr. Jing?"
Even if it wasn't, the person before him was surely another member of the Jing organization.
"Qiantiao" looked at Su Lun and smiled ambiguously without confirmation or denial, "How did you guess?"
Hearing that tone, Su Lun's gaze became complex.
He had never imagined that the one impersonating Qiantiao would turn out to be the leader of the Jing organization.
Mr. Jing...
A mirror?
So, her ability is mirror mimicry?
Although unaware if "Mr. Jing" is actually male or female, judging by her demeanor, unless she normally cross-dresses, the odds are high that she is indeed female.
Su Lun responded, "I noticed some habits differing between you and Sister Qiantiao."
"Is that so..."
Upon hearing this explanation, Mr. Jing, thinking of something, revealed a meaningful smile.
Su Lun then asked, "Why have you come here?"
He used polite language, as he was almost certain that Mr. Jing was not young.
After all, she was the teacher whom Mr. Hei referred to with respect!
He was also curious about why Mr. Jing was there and where the real Qiantiao had gone.
Mr. Jing stated directly, "The leader of the Umbrella Organization, the forensic doctor Servis Gerard himself is here. That man's cognitive abilities have awakened, making him extremely skilled at solving cases. Due to some slight clues, Qiantiao and the Reiss family are now under suspicion. So, tonight, we have to deal with this problem. Also... to retrieve something."
"Sister Qiantiao is under suspicion?"
Su Lun grasped the gravity of the situation immediately, with succinct clarity.
He thought back to the bespectacled middle-aged man who committed murder at the casino, and his expression became somber.
While it was just suspicion, for the Reiss family, it was nothing short of a catastrophe.
This was a major incident; a fifth-rank professional had died.
Gauging by the Black Tower's attitude toward the great families of the inner city, a slight "suspicion" was enough to annihilate a clan.
Moreover, if Qiantiao were truly exposed, it would also mean his own exposure was imminent.
If not for the composed figure of the big shot sitting before him, upon hearing this news, Su Lun knew he would likely be planning his escape by now.
Mr. Jing picked up the teacup on the table and took a sip, "You'll find out soon enough. It's not too troublesome."
....
Reassured by Mr. Jing's relaxed tone, Su Lun had just breathed a sigh of relief.
But at that moment, a sudden emergency occurred!
He felt a ring on his finger starting to heat up, and his face turned pale.
This was a special signal he had with Sabina; ordinary information would be transmitted through other means, but if the Alchemy Ring grew hot, it indicated utmost urgency.
Su Lun glanced at Mr. Jing, who was calmly sipping tea, and spoke very quickly, "I have inside information. It seems the people from the Umbrella Organization are also coming for me."
Hearing this, Mr. Jing continued to sip her tea unhurriedly, as if she had expected this, and casually remarked, "Mm. We've been followed since leaving the estate."
"..."
Su Lun thought to himself that it was indeed so, but said nothing more.
At that moment, Lena, who had collapsed on the ground, slowly opened her eyes.
She appeared to have completely forgotten the events prior to losing consciousness and asked with sheer bewilderment, "What... What happened to me?"
```
Su Lun, swift and agile, dashed over and courteously helped her up, "You must be overworked recently; you just fainted."
Then this Miss Lena really believed she had just passed out, "Oh, I indeed haven't had much sleep lately."
She muttered with a furrowed brow, stood up without thinking much of it, and politely responded, "Thank you. How embarrassing."
Su Lun nodded, acknowledging her words.
After a pause, Lena looked at Su Lun and asked, "By the way, Mr. Zoro, I remember you came looking for my aunt because you had some urgent matter, didn't you?"
Upon hearing this, Su Lun's expression became slightly odd, "This..."
...
The three people in the room glanced at each other, the atmosphere suddenly turning odd.
He had initially suspected "Fake Qiantiao" of looking for trouble.
Now, the tables had turned, although he was sure this was a fake, it was almost identical to the real one.
And it would've been fine not knowing who this "Fake Qiantiao" was,
but now that he knew it was the leader of the Jing organization, he dared not act rashly.
Unexpectedly, "Qiantiao" patted the spot next to her and boldly said, "Zoro, come sit here. Help me dry my hair..."
Hearing this, Su Lun went over and quickly got into character.
His mentality was excellent.
If the boss dared to call, he dared to sit.
He plunked down next to "Qiantiao," their closeness just like before.
After all, it seemed like something was going to happen tonight.
It was safer to stay close to the big boss.
He also guessed that Mr. Jing was probably there to provide an alibi for Sister Qiantiao.
....
Su Lun casually found an excuse to muddle through the previous incident.
The three of them chatted desultorily when suddenly, a series of urgent knocks came from the door.
"Miss, something terrible has happened!"
Upon hearing this, Lena immediately went to open the door.
At that moment, an elderly butler holding a box said anxiously, "Someone just delivered Miss Julia's head."
"What?!"
Lena's complexion turned pale instantly upon hearing this.
She looked at the bloodstained box in the butler's hands, trembling all over, and for a moment was at a loss, "This... she..."
"This old butler is indeed a third-tier professional. The Reiss family still has some resources."
Su Lun narrowed his eyes slightly, observing the imposing butler, and guessed he must be the expert who had been secretly protecting Lena outside the room.
And Julia...
Seemed to be the blonde girl at the party earlier who wanted to help Lena?
It was unexpected that she had been killed.
The butler continued, "Earlier, I heard noises of a fight from the 'Blue Moon Hotel.' Julia Miss's guards didn't last long; the attackers must have had a third-tier professional among them! It might be the people from the Oliver family. They were likely targeting you, Miss. I think we need to leave the camp immediately..."
Before he could finish, the butler suddenly seemed to notice something, "Someone is coming!"
With a shout, he vanished from the spot.
Immediately afterward, a thunderous voice sounded from outside the hotel, "Humph! This is Reiss family property, who are you people!"
....
Su Lun also heard the commotion outside; it seemed there were quite a few people approaching.
They first visited Julia's place, probably looking for accomplices?
Now with a head delivered, they clearly wanted "Qiantiao" to take action and reveal herself in retaliation.
Once a third-tier expert arrived, she would have nowhere to hide.
Su Lun now understood why Mr. Jing had come here tonight.
Besides protecting Lena, it was more important to use this third-tier elderly professional to block the organization's third-tier experts.
Su Lun and the others quickly descended the stairs and saw the old butler and several guards confronting a group of people in trench coats.
At the front was a middle-aged man wearing glasses.
This man was naturally the leader of the Umbrella organization, the "forensic doctor" Servis Gerard!
This guy was now clad in a linen suit stained with fresh blood, his face adorned with a hint of manic pleasure, as if he had just savored a bloody banquet.
Su Lun saw a smoldering violence in this guy's eyes that was hard to suppress.
He wondered if the man had come to deliver his own head or... Did he simply have a murderous intent and just wanted to kill for the sake of it?
Su Lun felt this was likely and glanced again at the shadows of the buildings in the distance only to discover several figures with concealed auras. Judging from the flickering elemental barriers, it was clear they were fourth-order professionals. They had encircled the entire hotel in a pincer movement.
As soon as "Qiantiao" showed up, he didn't hesitate to unleash his disguised equipment and drew his blade with a backhand slash.
The sharp "clank" of the unsheathed sword, like a Pavlovian response, instantly tensed up the group opposite him.
The bespectacled middle-aged man clearly did not dare to underestimate his opponent, and his face changed dramatically, "swoosh" donning a black and white[Clown Mask]that smiled menacingly.
As soon as the mask was on, the aura of the "forensic doctor" Servis Gerard shifted drastically, instantly suppressing the violence within him.
Indifferent, as if he were not human.
"Huh... This clown mask can suppress abnormal psychic states?"
Su Lun speculated in his mind, not daring to make any appraisal.
Watching "Qiantiao" make a move, he too drew his gun, playing the role of the Bounty Hunter Zorro.
Although his gaze did not stray, he was curious in his heart - how could this "Mr. Jing" even perfectly mimic Qiantiao's alchemical enhancements?
And yet, her aura was not exceptionally strong, roughly at the level of a second-order.
Once blades and guns were drawn, both sides launched into battle without further ado.
....
The people from the Umbrella organization did not reveal their identities, probably thinking that in case a mistake was made, they could pass off the incident as a bandit attack.
After all, some clues were only speculation.
Moreover, the Umbrella organization was not the Black Tower; for such an enforcement agency to attack a top family in the inner city, they still needed a plausible excuse.
The bodyguards brought by Miss Lena were not weak. Besides the third-order elder, there were also two second-order professionals, making a total of twenty to thirty elite men in the hotel.
They held their ground against the group in trench coats for the time being.
Because... none of the fourth-order professionals had made a move.
"So, they're just suspecting and testing, huh..."
Seeing this, Su Lun muttered to himself.
His persona was a gunman, so he didn't need to engage in close combat. He just huddled by Lena's side, occasionally firing from a distance.
In the midst of battle, the third-order butler was tied up by the "forensic doctor" Servis Gerard with the clown mask.
In the battlefield, Qiantiao was the target of focused attention.
Luckily, her slicing with four arms was impermeable, and she managed to hold her ground for the time being...
Su Lun's gaze flickered over, and he couldn't help but marvel again - this "Qiantiao" couldn't be more real.
The style of the blade, the aura, the fighting manner – all were exactly like the real Qiantiao!
The fight was fierce.
The surrounding buildings collapsed in droves.
Casualties appeared.
After all, the few could not withstand the many; "Qiantiao," facing the concentrated attention of several second-order professionals, began to show signs of defeat.
The people from the Umbrella organization were just suspicious, and now, seeing Qiantiao's all-out fight revealing only second-order level ability, they couldn't help but feel perplexed.
In the current situation, there was absolutely no need to feign strength.
They had planned to intensify their probing,
But unexpectedly, at this moment, a huge commotion erupted from the direction of Storm Manor.
"Boom boom boom~"
"Boom boom boom~"
"..."
The intensity of the spell's fluctuation was alarmingly exaggerated, decidedly not something a third-order professional could produce.
Everyone immediately understood – someone had launched an attack on Princess Theresa's residence!
Even from a great distance, several cloaked figures were seen charging towards Storm Manor with fierce attacks, and behind one of them, the phantom projection of the Rakshasa Woman was strikingly conspicuous.
"Not good!"
Hearing the commotion, members of the Umbrella organization, along with the lurking fourth-order experts, all turned pale.
How could they not realize that the enemy, taking advantage of the weakened defense, had actually gone to assassinate the princess?
They could no longer concern themselves with the "minor scuffle" here; in an instant, the group vanished from the scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - 193: Seeing Pestoya Again (7700+)
chapters.content:
The battle in front of the Unicorn Inn suddenly came to an end.
The fight from Storm Manor ignited the underground world, turning the entire camp into chaos in an instant.
The clash of super-tier spells exploded around the manor, creating terrifying noises reminiscent of landslides and earthquakes.
From afar, one could immediately see the residence of Princess Teresa manifested four towering phantom knights, each two or three dozen meters in height.
It seemed as if someone was fiercely battling those knightly phantoms, the clanging sounds of weapons echoing throughout the camp.
The shockwaves surged higher with each wave, battering the camp like an unrelenting tide.
With the protection of phantom knights at the manor, the methods of the assailants were no less formidable.
Fourth-tier Fire System Technique "Meteor Burn City", with meteors coalescing within the Seven-Pointed Star Formation in the sky and raining down like droplets...
Wide-range fourth-tier Thunder Technique "City-Destroying Thundercloud", with lightning crackling and thunder dragons rampaging from above...
Third-tier Secret Technique "Earth Splitting Technique", causing the earth to quake and the camp to fracture into countless chasms around the manor...
Upon seeing these multi-element super-tier spells, Su Lun instantly knew Mr. Hei was the one behind them.
That Scholar really had a profound understanding of various elemental alchemies, and even though he wasn't fifth-tier, his spells could be more troublesome than those of a fifth-tier when he took action.
How many in the camp had ever witnessed super-tier spells?
Facing this apocalypse-like turmoil, everyone was horrified.
For a moment, near Storm Manor, ice, frost, thunder, fire... all sorts of elemental spells collided like festival fireworks, exploding across the sky.
Though dangerous, it was a time to show valor.
"Assassins are attacking Princess Teresa, we must go support her!"
"We cannot let the culprits escape!"
"..."
Shouts of excitement never ceased, as one after another was eager to lead troops to the rescue.
The major families in the camp, together with their personal armies, rushed towards Storm Manor in droves, thousands converging upon the scene.
And as fate would have it, as the crowd surged forward, a Seven-Pointed Star Formation suddenly lit up under the feet of someone mingled within them. Before the crowd could react, another super-tier spell blasted over, forcing several fourth-tier guards who were trying to seal the manor to hurriedly dodge. Although it wasn't necessarily fatal, it made clear that there were still assassins among the group.
Immediately following, a thunderous shout erupted!
"All are forbidden to approach the manor, or you will be killed without mercy!"
But this command not only failed to stabilize the situation, but it also made it even more chaotic.
Before those at the top could retreat, more people from the lower city districts incessantly tried to push forward, hoping to perform a heroic deed before the Princess.
The camp was filled with various hunting groups, mercenaries, family guards, city guards, peacekeepers... Dozens and hundreds of factions, unfamiliar with each other, didn't know who fired the shot, and it quickly descended into a melee.
"Dammit! Who's firing the rockets..."
"Fuck, stop shooting randomly. We're mercenaries from the David family!"
"We're targeting you because I just saw one of you shooting the rockets. You're with the assassins!"
"Go to hell, you're the ones with the assassins."
Some fanned the flames, some took pot shots, and those who came out to mediate were bound to get hit.
Bang! Bang! Bang...
Pop! Pop! Pop...
The sound of gunfire was chaotic.
Suddenly, someone shouted loudly.
"Not good! The assassin has broken through!"
"..."
The chaotic situation provided the "assassins" with convenience for their attack and retreat.
The battle started quickly and ended just as swiftly.
Several cloaked figures caused some sort of disturbance in the manor; it seemed they had achieved their goal and had no wish to linger in battle, making a beeline for the city outskirts to escape.
Perhaps it was the lesson learned from the last time they lured and killed a fifth-tier professional; a precedent had been set.
The high-level guards in the manor did not dare to give chase for fear of falling into the same trap or being led away from a decoy.
The lower-tier professionals were no match to stop them, and the cloaked assassins encountered little resistance, breaking out of the encirclement, vaulting over the city wall, and disappearing beyond the city gates.
....
Outside the Unicorn Inn.
A few guards had died, and "Qian Tiao" had also sustained some injuries.
Su Lun watched as the "Rakshasa Woman" and others successfully fled into the distance and let out a slight sigh of relief.
Now, there was absolutely no connection between Qian Tiao and Rakshasa Woman.
Though it appeared coincidental, it didn't matter anymore.
As long as Qian Tiao wasn't the "Rakshasa Woman," merely a gang member, no matter what, the danger level had dropped by innumerable degrees.
Even such ordinary gang records would never again enter the perspective of top-level officials like the leaders of the Umbrella Organization.
The Umbrella Organization would probably stay quiet for a while too.
On the other hand, Reina stood there, dumbfounded.
This young lady, who had never experienced major setbacks, witnessed her best friend's head being presented to her this night. She witnessed an attack without reason. The intense emotions of helplessness and being at the mercy of others surged like tides, repeatedly eroding some of her perceptions. Her eyes, once clear and bright, trembled with indescribable ripples...
The old butler was injured in the fray with the "forensic doctor" Servis, a patch of bright red blood on his chest.
He tidied himself up, concealed the stain with his jacket, and approached. Seeing his young mistress in a daze, he sighed and said, "Miss, you should go upstairs and rest. Leave everything here to me. We will leave the city tomorrow morning."
They recognized that it was the people from the Umbrella Organization who led the attack.
So they had no choice but to swallow this bitter pill.
Even if the Reis family was once a top-tier inner-city financial tycoon, that organization was not to be trifled with.
Reina vaguely returned to her room and sat blankly on the bed.
"Qian Tiao" glanced at her and then turned to Su Lun, "Let her be by herself for a while, it might be good for her."
Su Lun nodded, "Hmm."
The cruelty of this world far surpassed what Reina had seen.
The act must go on; Mr. Jing and Su Lun entered another room.
....
The door closed, and a soundproof formation was set up.
Although Su Lun knew that Mr. Jing daring to take action meant he had a comprehensive plan, he was still curious and said, "Mr. Jing, won't revealing the movements of so many people alert the Black Tower?"
"It won't have much of an impact," Mr. Jing said, his expression calm as if everything was proceeding according to plan. "After this relic expedition, preparations are almost complete."
As he spoke, a miraculous scene unfolded before Su Lun's eyes.
"Qian Tiao," who had only the strength of a second-tier, had also been gravely injured in the previous fight, her body marked with numerous wounds.
Yet in the moment she entered the room, Su Lun suddenly saw those wounds on her body visibly healing—without any potions, without any spells—relying solely on her exaggerated self-healing ability, she was instantly as good as new.
Su Lun felt a trace of astonishment: Had Mr. Jing also undergone some sort of bloodline modification?
This efficiency of self-healing was almost comparable to that of an "Abomination."
He was much stronger than he looked.
But considering that this expert was most likely a fourth-order, or even higher, it was normal for him to have some methods beyond Su Lun's understanding.
Instead, Su Lun paid more attention to Mr. Jing's words, "Everything is almost ready."
It sounded like the big shots were confident about making a move on the Dark Tower?
But Mr. Jing didn't seem inclined to continue on this topic. She looked at Su Lun and reminded him, "Although tonight's trouble has been muddled through, the 'forensic doctor' Severus's methods are not that simple. The Umbrella organization will definitely probe again. Be careful in the future."
After a pause, she continued, "I will follow the team for the next few days, but once we get to the ruins, I have other matters to attend to. When the time comes, take extra care of this team, don't let them be wiped out. And especially take care of Lena for me."
Su Lun nodded, "Hmm."
Lena had helped him several times, so naturally, within his capabilities, Su Lun would also want to save her life.
His expression didn't change, but upon hearing this, a slightly odd thought emerged in his mind.
Mr. Jing actually cared so much about Lena—could it be... they had some special relationship?
Like, a secret daughter?
Although Su Lun didn't ask, Mr. Jing seemed to guess what he was thinking.
She glanced at Su Lun, and her expression seemed a bit helpless as she added another explanation, "The Reyes family was established with my help. Lena's mother died for me. That girl has good talent and learning, she just lacks experience. I plan to groom her to be the successor of the Reyes family."
"Oh..."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun suddenly understood.
But with that explanation, his thoughts became even more active.
Established with her help?
That was quite a bit of information.
The Reyes family had been a well-known household name for decades. If she established them, just how old was Mr. Jing?
Su Lun thought of her unusually rapid wound healing earlier—very high cellular activity could indeed make a person appear young, but... could she actually be an elderly woman?
However, as this thought crossed Su Lun's mind, he clearly saw "Qian Tiao" hold her forehead and shake her head, giving him a strange look as though a bit exasperated.
"I... never mind..."
She seemed as if she had more to say but decided against further explanation.
Not sure whether it was because she was in the guise of "Qian Tiao," Su Lun found this "Mr. Jing" quite approachable and lacking in any aloof coldness that kept others at a distance.
Considering that Mr. Hei's teacher was right in front of him, Su Lun naturally asked directly, "Mr. Jing, I saw a mask appear on the face of that Umbrella organization leader earlier. It seemed like an artifact related to spiritual power, a curse?"
"Qian Tiao" placed her sword on the table and started to tidy up her battle-torn clothes, nodding as she said, "Yes. Over the years, the Dark Tower has uncovered quite a few good things. That is the 'Life Usurper's Three-Colored Mask,' a very decent ancient cursed artifact. Severus encountered a snag in his professional cultivation, leading to an aberration in his spiritual power. The mask is used to suppress his uncontrollable split personas..."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun thought it made sense.
Also, considering the functionality, it seemed to suit his own "symptoms," didn't it?
He asked directly, "Mr. Jing, that mask... could it be suitable for me?"
"Qian Tiao" glanced at him and said, "I've heard about your situation from Emmerich, and indeed, the mask would be beneficial for you. But it's a temporary solution, not a cure. The essence of the mask's effect is suppression, the same as you suppressing it with willpower, and it will eventually backlash."
(Emmerich, Mr. Hei's real name)
Su Lun initially thought the artifact might be redundant, but then he heard "Qian Tiao" seem to recall something, the conversation taking a turn, "But if you can master a top-tier spiritual secret technique, it would be an excellent advancement material for your 'Puppeteer' lineage and help you break through the limitations of 'Distracted Operation.' Normally, the 'Life Usurper's Three-Colored Mask' is an advancement material that only a fourth-order spiritual profession practitioner can withstand. But you... you're a bit special. You should be able to handle it at the third-order."
"Advancement material?"
At these words, Su Lun perked up immediately.
He understood what she probably meant by his "special" trait—likely referring to the extraordinary spiritual power caused by his "Reaper" talent.
If someone like her said it was suitable, it must be a material with an extremely high compatibility rating.
Moreover, she went straight to the point that after advancing, it could break the limits of 'Distracted Operation'?
"Qian Tiao" looked at Su Lun, her eyebrows curving, and asked, "Do you want to kill him?"
Su Lun nodded: "Mhm."
Not to mention the curse materials, when he had previously signed a master-servant contract with Sabrina, they had agreed that once he had the strength, he would help her kill that guy.
"Killing that guy won't be easy."
"Qian Tiao" joked with a remark but didn't say much else, then added, "Just a reminder. Remember, if you ever encounter him, be extremely careful if his mask is 'Red Face', but if you see the mask turn to 'Black Face', he has strength not inferior to a fourth-order..."
"Mhm."
Su Lun didn't expect to be able to kill the 'forensic doctor' Servis in a short time on his own.
However, didn't he have strong reinforcements at hand?
And now that he had a target, his thoughts were focused on achieving that goal.
In an instant, he came up with some ideas.
A plan quietly took shape.
"Qian Tiao" smiled and didn't respond much.
Since he had the opportunity, Su Lun simply asked another question he was curious about, "Mr. Jing, do you know about the underground altar in Storm Manor? Mr. Hei said before that you could help me solve puzzles, including the symbol that represents 'Destiny'..."
"Qian Tiao", true to what Mr. Hei had initially said, seemed quite willing to clarify his doubts, explaining, "The underground altar in Storm Manor is a relic from a prehistoric civilization of the 'Dawn Era', the time of Akkavia. Those five statues represent the most mysterious alchemy organization of that age, the 'Rose Cross,' its five elders, real divine-order alchemists. That was the most authentic and recent period of alchemy's brilliance that mankind can access today. Sir Isaac named this city with the intention of restoring alchemy to its glory during the Dawn Era..."
Having said this, she seemed to feel that since she had already spoken, she might as well share a bit more, "This represents a prehistoric interrupted civilization that is nearly unrecorded in the current historical materials of Old Lington. Legend has it that the alchemists of the Dawn Era fought across various fragmented planes, with top magicians even capable of hunting gods. They created a very powerful alchemy civilization..."
"I see..."
After hearing her words, Su Lun's eyes trembled, deeply shocked for a long time.
Well, it seemed that this bigshot knew everything.
Moreover, from her words, one could see that her understanding of Dawn City reached an unthinkable level.
She not only knew about the altar but also was clear about its origin.
This world was not only fascinating now; the history buried in dust was equally amazing.
....
Mr. Jing, although not Qian Tiao, seemed to share the same habit of enjoying baths as the gambling-addicted lady.
The battle had left her with blood stains all over, which made her frown deeply.
While talking, she also began to remove her robe and said without looking at Su Lun, "Alright, I'm going to take a bath. We'll talk later."
Su Lun naturally understood and averted his gaze.
The gambling-addicted lady wouldn't avoid him, but this bigshot still minded.
Soon, the sound of running water could be heard from the bathroom.
The noise from outside the window never ceased, as the operation to hunt down the assassin continued into the late night.
After bathing, "Qian Tiao" laid down on the bed to rest.
Su Lun sat cross-legged on the sofa nearby, meditating.
It must have been around two or three in the morning when,
suddenly, "Qian Tiao", who appeared to be fast asleep, noticed something and let out a quiet shout: "Someone's coming!"
Upon hearing this, Su Lun immediately understood her meaning.
Zorro was Qian Tiao's male companion; they had to play out the whole act.
They had to make it look like nothing was amiss to anyone peering into the room at their current state.
Su Lun quickly changed into pajamas and hopped onto the bed, while "Qian Tiao" also cozily lay in his arms, as indicated.
The bigshot had given the signal, so he did not show any reluctance—he held her as he should. "Qian Tiao" was now dressed in a light nightgown, her touch distinct. Their significant skin contact allowed both of them to clearly feel each other's warmth.
Despite this, there were no romantic emotions.
Although the touch of her firm skin was just like the gambling-addicted lady's, thinking Mr. Jing was probably not young, something about it felt odd to Su Lun.
Su Lun didn't detect any movement suggesting someone's arrival, so the visitor must be a master of at least the third order.
He wondered if it was the Umbrella Organization coming back to check?
The persona of "Qian Tiao" was that of a second-order professional, naturally, she shouldn't have detected the other person.
The two of them were snuggled up in bed, lying there for a long time, as though already deep asleep.
However, things didn't seem to be entirely as Su Lun thought.
Because before long, the supposedly sleeping Su Lun heard someone calling his name by his ear.
"Mr. Su Lun, long time no see..."
There hadn't been any noise, had there? No doors were open, no one had climbed through the windows, and there weren't even sounds of footsteps.
Yet oddly enough, the calls seemed to be right next to his ear.
"Heehee... I know you're not asleep..."
Su Lun thought he might be hearing things, but he lifted his eyelids a crack nonetheless.
In an instant, a face glowing with a pale blue light appeared right before his eyes.
Just ten centimeters from his own face, a semi-transparent little girl was staring at him, face to face, with a pair of watery big eyes filled with a mischievous smile.
If it weren't for Su Lun's strong mentality, a normal person seeing this scene in the dead of night would probably have leaped up like a startled cat with its fur on end.
....
"Pestoya?"
Su Lun tentatively asked.
The little girl in front of him, dressed in a prim and cute princess dress, was deeply impressed in his memory; naturally, she was the "ghost kind" little girl he had met on his first day after crossing over.
Looking at "Qian Tiao" beside him, her breathing was even, seeming to be fast asleep.
Whether she was truly asleep or feigning it, Su Lun knew today's situation seemed to be going south...
Pestoya, seeing Su Lun had recognized her, revealed a joyous expression on her little face.
She floated in midair, twirling around, "Oops, I thought you had forgotten me~"
Listening to this lively female voice, Su Lun recalled their first meeting.
Although this ghost kind little girl was occasionally a bit unruly, the two had a kind of instant "resonance."
He smiled and said, "How could I forget?"
As he spoke, Su Lun got out of bed, tucked "Qian Tiao" in properly, and then asked, "Pestoya, what brings you here?"
If he hadn't seen that "butterfly brooch," he might have been quite happy to catch up with the ghost kind whom he had once felt quite an affinity for.
But now, her presence here complicated matters.
"I don't know. I felt you close by, so I came over to see you~"
Pestoya tilted her head, pondering, as though she was missing a part of her memory.
But she didn't mind; in this thousand years, she had forgotten many things.
But upon seeing an old friend, she was genuinely happy: "I can't believe it's really you, Mr. Su Lun."
Su Lun kept his composure and walked over to the coffee table in the suite, pouring himself a glass of water.
Though he wasn't sure if the ghost kind could drink tea, he still poured a cup for Pestoya, who was seated beside him.
While pouring the tea, Su Lun joked, "I've become so handsome, how did you recognize me?"
Pestoya sniffed the tea cup, took a sip, and said, "Of course I could recognize you. I recognize your soul~"
Blinking, she added, "But your soul has grown much stronger than before, I almost didn't recognize it~"
It was like the reunion of old friends, the atmosphere very harmonious.
```
The two struck up a somewhat intermittent conversation.
...
After beating around the bush with a few questions, Su Lun discovered that Pestoya didn't remember what had happened after he left.
It was as if upon waking up, she felt his presence nearby, which is why she came again.
But... the cursed space of the storm manor had clearly disappeared before.
Moreover, were the ghosts from the cursed space actually running around outside?
All of this was bizarre.
After chatting about a few light topics, Su Lun was certain that this girl before him was the same one he had seen before.
He ventured another question, "Pestoya, where are you living now?"
"I live in the manor~"
As Pestoya spoke, she floated up in a little bear hug, giving Su Lun an enthusiastic embrace, "I thought I'd never see Mr. Su Lun again. I'm really so happy~"
Her physical state was strange, clearly a spiritual body, but when she wanted to touch something, it became solid.
"Yeah, I'm happy to see you too."
Su Lun smiled.
Listening to that cheerful tone, he could feel that her happiness was coming from the heart.
After all, he was the first "friend" this girl had made in a thousand years.
The two chatted for a while.
Su Lun's extensive knowledge of flirting techniques also came in handy.
He was able to make various jokes and share little stories effortlessly.
Even the young girl enjoyed them.
Pestoya was so amused that she laughed heartily, her laughter ringing through the room like silver bells.
Su Lun just treated her as an old friend catching up, discussing only light topics.
But there were two questions he deliberately avoided and dared not bring up.
One was the question she had entrusted him to ask.
The other was about the brooch.
However, just as Su Lun tried to avoid it, Pestoya, floating in front of him, suddenly remembered something and asked, "Eh... Mr. Su Lun, why don't I see you wearing the butterfly brooch I gave you?"
"..."
Su Lun felt a sudden clench in his heart.
He had purposely avoided it, yet it was brought up.
That girl seemed extremely sensitive to emotions. Before Su Lun could find the right words, her expression suddenly darkened, "You... don't like the gift I gave you?"
Her crystalline eyes began to shimmer with waves of light, taking on a look of hurt, "But... it was my favorite, my most precious thing."
As she spoke, the glimmer in her eyes slowly turned red.
It wasn't the red of feeling hurt but rather a shift towards a sinister, fierce crimson.
Pestoya gazed at Su Lun, tears uncontrollably falling from her face, drop by drop of pale blue tear light that vanished before touching the ground.
With a sobbing voice, a surge of extreme sadness burst forth, "Mr. Su Lun, I don't know why, but I feel so sad right now..."
Even though I gave you my most precious gift, you lost it.
It was like a thousand years ago, recalling the heart-wrenching pain in that great fire...
Those were my beloved parents, the most cherished beings in my life...
```
That was the pain of losing the most precious thing in one's heart...
It was like having one's heart gouged out.
Su Lun watched the scene and knew she was showing signs of a violent and dark transformation.
The first time they had met, she was in the same state when she slaughtered "Ironhead" Ivan's group.
He wanted to explain something, but indeed he couldn't produce the brooch.
After all, he had no ill will toward the little girl.
He could feel Pestoya's indescribable emotions, loneliness, sadness...
He sighed, reached out his hand and touched her head, and said truthfully, "I liked the gift you gave me. But I'm sorry, it seems I've lost it..."
His words seemed to console the aggrieved Pestoya, the red glow in her eyes dimmed slightly, but it still didn't fade away.
Su Lun then rubbed her face with both hands and said seriously, "However, I will definitely find it."
Though she was a millennium-old ghost, she still had the heart of a ten-year-old girl.
She was easily consoled.
Hearing this, the red glow in the girl's eyes finally stopped.
Emotions can't deceive people, and Pestoya clearly felt Su Lun's sincerity.
But still with a face full of grievance, she looked at Su Lun and said with a resentment, "Mr. Su Lun, if you don't find the brooch I gave you, I will eat you up!"
That tone sounded so aggrieved, very aggrieved indeed.
While speaking, Pestoya even bared her little fangs and bit down fiercely on the hand Su Lun had used to touch her head.
A bite, firm and solid.
"..."
Su Lun didn't mind, smiled, and didn't pull back his hand.
However, he was also curious, how come his current body actually felt pain from a bite?
....
With the bite over, she probably let out her anger.
Pestoya lifted her head, and at that moment, her gaze was attracted to a necklace on Su Lun's hand, "Huh... Mr. Su Lun, how did you get this necklace?"
With that, she waved her hand, and the crystal pendant fell into her grasp.
She seemed to recognize something, and her mood suddenly changed again.
Su Lun caught the abnormality in Pestoya's emotional eyes and his mind stirred.
The clues in his brain connected like lightning.
This was the [Sereya's Crystal Pendant] he had obtained by slaying the fortuneteller of the Umbrella Organization on the way to the ruins.
He had been wearing it because this alchemical item had a property that evaded divination.
When he first saw the name on this necklace, Su Lun thought it sounded very familiar.
Now, hearing Pestoya's tone, he immediately confirmed something.
The name "Sereya" was quite common among women,
But unfortunately,
this necklace just happened to have a significant background.
The very Puppeteer who entrusted Su Lun to meet a certain Curse Space Master, the founder of the Puppeteers, was also called "Sereya."
Even more coincidentally, Su Lun's Puppeteer inauguration materials were obtained from Pestoya herself.
Some special professions are carried down in succession.
The source of the coincidence was because Su Lun, when he had crossed over, had seen this name in the family portrait in the library of the Manor of the Storms.
She was the mother of the little girl before him, Sereya Isaac (married and changed surname).
....
Pestoya's just-settled emotions suddenly became violently agitated, "You... saw her... my mother?"
Su Lun, afraid that she would remember something and get upset again, said directly, "Didn't you entrust me to ask them a question? I've learned some clues, and I plan to help you ask."
Pestoya remained silent.
After a while, she gave a tiny sound, "Oh."
Su Lun could feel the conflict in her heart.
There was love, yet it was mingled with hysterical resentment.
The atmosphere suddenly went cold.
Seeing the necklace, Pestoya seemed to be reminded of someone, and, upon reflection, was unable to part with it.
"Can you give me the necklace?"
"Sure."
But she had lost the interest to stay any longer and said to Su Lun, "Mr. Su Lun, I'm sleepy, I'm going back to sleep, I'll come find you another time."
"Yeah. See you next time."
Su Lun nodded and waved to her.
He watched her sadly drift out the window and then slowly disappear from view.
In the end, Su Lun did not tell her about the brooch being with Teresa.
He felt that matters were a bit too complicated.
Pestoya seemed to have some memory loss.
Intuition told Su Lun that before things were clear, it would be best not to trigger any other obviously strange plots.
....
And just after Pestoya's departure, "Qiantiao" on the bed suddenly opened her eyes.
Su Lun didn't see it, but a teardrop flashed through her deep eyes.
Now that Pestoya was gone, Su Lun sat on the sofa, frowning deeply.
Many doubts in his mind were connected together, but without the key information, he couldn't untangle any of them.
He felt it necessary to discuss the situation with the boss, so he glanced at "Qiantiao" on the bed and cleared his throat gently.
"Ahem! Ahem!"
He immediately got a response.
Without turning around, Qiantiao said indifferently, "Go to sleep. It's alright now."
Obviously, she had been awake all the while.
"Then..."
Su Lun thought she was unaware of the situation and wanted to say more.
At that moment, "Qiantiao" cut him off directly, "Can't talk about it."
Upon hearing these three words, Su Lun's gaze faintly hardened.
Can't talk about it?
Which means...
Did Pestoya also somehow involve that indescribable entity?

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - 194: Reclamation
chapters.content:
After all, there was quite a commotion tonight, and many people would want to understand the situation.
Pestoia's night visit was a minor episode, and it didn't stop there; several groups of uninvited guests came one after another to the Unicorn Inn.
There were second-order and third-order, all experts in stealth—assassins.
It seemed like it was probably the Umbrella Organization, or maybe spies from the factions who wished to harm Miss Lena.
In order not to reveal any flaws, and because he found the constant harassment troublesome, Su Lun simply shared a bed with Mr. Jing for the night.
It wasn't presumptuous, and both were very calm about it.
Having such a high-level combatant by his side, Su Lun didn't need to worry about his own safety and surprisingly had a good night's sleep.
...
The next morning, the stern rebuke of the old butler Anthony could be heard in the inn as early as dawn.
"Everyone, get ready with your gear, we depart at seven o'clock sharp!"
Su Lun got out of bed and also put together an adventurer's outfit for himself, complete with a trench coat and cowboy hat.
"Thousand Stripes" was still washing up; he went downstairs, found the latest briefing and messages among a pile of letters at the front desk.
These were the hastily printed newspapers produced by the intelligence brokers, containing the latest information about the camp.
They were pricey, but sold well.
Su Lun skimmed the content of the newspapers, which mentioned last night's attack extensively.
However, it was crude; aside from a few descriptions of "the mysterious cloaked person", there was no intelligence on the identity of the assassins.
He also saw the hidden message left for him by Sabina, which roughly informed him of the Umbrella Organization's next moves.
People from the Umbrella Organization were indeed still monitoring him.
However, they had lowered his profile level, so the threat was much smaller.
Just as Su Lun was reading the newspaper at the front desk.
A few people came down the stairs; turning his head, he saw it was Miss Lena leading her personal maidservant down.
Overnight, the sorrow had vanished from the young lady's face, replaced by a cold composure. She was wearing a liquid leather suit, not the standard Black Tower Academy design, but a more advanced alchemic product with special modifications. On her waist were a pistol, dagger, mechanical vest, and tactical belt, including a gas mask...
Even more notably, on her back she carried a mechanical case with a red cross painted on it—military-grade individual medical equipment.
It seemed the young lady was prepared for combat herself.
Su Lun glanced at her and raised his eyebrows slightly, naturally noticing certain changes in her as well.
Overnight, she had shed her youthful naivete, and now held an air of maturity.
When Lena saw Su Lun, she nodded, by way of greeting.
....
Unlike the hunting expeditions from other families that could reach thousands in number, the Reiss family only had four to five hundred people.
Apart from the hundred or so family guards brought by Lena, there were only a few medium-sized Scavenger groups from the Cross Society.
The group assembled in the tent area outside the camp, immediately drawing murmurs and comments from all kinds of people.
"Hiss~ That's Anthony, the Reiss family's butler, if I remember correctly. Didn't expect the old guy to have advanced to third order."
"I saw last night's battle; he is indeed very strong. But what a pity, with so few people, they probably won't make it to the center of the city area before facing annihilation..."
"Heard the Unicorn Inn was also attacked by assassins last night?"
"Assassins? Those were no ordinary assassins. I've heard..."
"So it's acknowledged by the Black Tower, no wonder the other branches of the Reiss family are so active. A storm is brewing..."
"..."
The news that Lena's close friend Julia was wiped out along with her entire family spread across the camp, and no one dared to interact with the members of the Reiss main family.
Lena faced the idle gossip without any expression throughout.
The team didn't linger for long and immediately set out on "Route Sixteen" towards the northeast of Dawn relic.
....
Because a third-order professional was leading, Su Lun's group moved quickly.
The monsters from the outer ring city area around the relic couldn't stop their progression. Moreover, since most of the outer ring had already been explored, there wasn't much reason to pause.
After a few minor skirmishes, by noon, they had already reached a section of broken city walls.
This was the landmark for entering the middle ring of the relic.
The team crossed the wall and continued further inward.
As they progressed deeper, there were more frequent monster attacks.
In no time at all, they arrived at a large area of unexplored ruined buildings and the group stopped.
Although the middle ring was separated from the outer ring by only a low decayed wall, the strength of the monsters varied greatly.
The outer ring generally housed first-order and below mutant beasts and abyssal creatures, but the middle ring saw second-order, third-order, and even beyond-order special monsters.
Beyond the middle ring was the "forbidden zone" for medium and small Scavenger groups.
Encountering any single group of social monsters could annihilate a medium Scavenger group led by a second-order professional.
The fog in the air thickened, and the atmosphere grew increasingly tense.
This was a real "high casualty area", where no one dared to take things lightly.
Through the communicators, orders from the team's commander came one after another.
"Stay sharp everyone! Pay attention to any anomalies. After entering the middle ring, keep your voices down, don't shoot at will..."
"Team Three, cover nine o'clock. Team Two, cover three o'clock... Assassins, spread out a bit for scouting, and keep an eye out for monsters and suspicious followers."
"Everyone, start searching this area according to plan!"
"..."
The team spread out in a lotus formation around Miss Lena.
The Cross Society's Scavenger groups were indeed funded by the Reiss family, and the members were akin to 'bondsmen' on a lifelong contract, tasked with the most dangerous pioneering duties in the front.
Su Lun and "Thousand Stripes" didn't do anything special, just followed the pioneering teams, beginning their venture into the unknown.
```
Moreover, in this place, there is hardly any difference between the head and the tail of the team—monsters might attack anyone at any time.
The ring of building ruins in the central area grew denser, with small buildings of more than ten stories already surrounding them.
In addition to residential houses, there were also large structures such as opera houses, city halls, and bathhouses.
Like a lush primeval forest, these large buildings were also the favorite haunts of monsters.
And not just on the ground.
Such a vast city also had a very complex sewer system, far more complicated than that of Old Lington.
Su Lun's current auditory perception enabled him to clearly sense the scurrying sounds coming from those sewer openings because of their arrival. It was as if a pair of eyes were hiding in each of those dark caverns, spying on them as uninvited guests.
This was the territory of aberrant monsters.
....
The relic was shrouded in fog, without any light, and visibility was very low.
Since they couldn't recklessly use large-scale illumination, the team members had to rely on the limited sight provided by alchemical night vision devices and carefully grope their way around.
The task given by Princess Theresa was to ask each family to carefully explore their respective routes and find some "things" of which they still did not know the purpose.
Therefore, the team needed to carefully examine each building, check every suspicious target, and break through every cursed space.
The exploration progressed slowly.
After the tasks were divided,
Su Lun followed "Thousand Stripes," leading a Cross Society Scavenger group to explore a residential building.
The team members were all unfamiliar faces; it seemed they were mostly "newcomers" the organization had recruited later.
Once they were away from the main team, the members spoke without so much restraint.
"Boss Thousand Stripes, why are there so few people in our group this time? I see that other families' Scavenger groups have at least a few thousand people... I heard it seems that our sponsor is facing a crisis?"
"Miss Thousand Stripes, there was such a big commotion in the city last night, what happened? I heard that the Princess's residence was attacked?"
"They say that the princess from the Duke's family is the 'First Beauty' of Old Lington, is it true..."
"Heh heh, this time those nobles from the inner city have to come scavenging just like us, right? Our lives don't matter if we die, but they would lose big..."
"..."
Scavengers from the lower echelons hold their lives cheap, ready to face death having chosen this bowl of rice.
Their mentality was quite optimistic.
Especially seeing the inner city folks join them in scavenging, they felt a heartless schadenfreude.
They didn't know about the relationship between Thousand Stripes and Lena, so they spoke without any concerns.
The group chatted and joked all the way.
Their spirits were much more joyful than those gloomy-faced elite city guards not far away.
Still alive,
chat about women,
earning money,
and gossip...
That's good enough.
The happiness of the lower-tier Scavengers was that simple.
The monsters within the relic were dense; in the dilapidated building they explored, there lived a group of monsters identified as [Abyssal Bloodthirsty Sentinels].
The constant "squeak, squeak, squeak" could be heard, and Su Lun had already spotted those crawling creatures that resembled bald, hairless white monkeys with large, off-putting human faces.
They could use rocks as projectiles, with a force comparable to bullets.
Fortunately, they were weak in defense and could be killed with normal bullets.
With Su Lun and "Thousand Stripes" in the team, they encountered no real danger.
Making their way and clearing enemies, they found good loot.
```
