```
"Ha ha... these monkeys even dropped cursed materials. The drop rate for materials from the monsters around the central city wall is so high. The sponsor said that the scavenging materials belong to us; we're going to strike it rich this time."
"Let's talk about it if we can make it out alive..."
"But speaking of which, these standard firearms from the inner city are so reliable, they never jam. Our sponsor is actually pretty nice, the equipment each of us got might be worth hundreds of thousands..."
"Yeah, I heard the conditions for the Scavenger groups from the Steam Faction and Raven Gang are much worse than ours. They have to buy their bullets, not to mention getting equipped with gear..."
"With this gear, even if a second-tier monster comes at us, I dare to stand my ground against them!"
"..."
Not sensing any troublesome monsters in the building, the team dispersed to speed up the exploration process.
The captains formed teams of ten and took their groups to different floors.
Su Lun and "Thousand Stripes" chose a corner to sit leisurely, ready to provide immediate support in case of any unexpected events.
The communicator crackled with reports now and then.
"Reporting to the Commander, a small-scale monster attack was found in the opera house, and it's been cleared."
"Red Brick Building has found a high-tier aberrant monster group, requesting support from high-tier combat power!"
"Commander, a 'cursed space' was discovered in the dilapidated building in the direction of ten o'clock. Preliminary judgment is a 'Class C space,' please advise."
"..."
Gunshots burst throughout the relic, with the clearing operation proceeding methodically.
.....
In terms of individual strength, Lena's team was no less than any other Scavenger team.
Indeed, it was among the top.
With tier three professionals and more than a dozen tier twos.
The over one hundred direct descendants from the family that Lena brought were mostly well-trained official professionals. They had the best firearms, mechanical armors, and other equipment that money could buy... very strong in combat.
But the team also had one fatal flaw.
That is, too few people, low error tolerance.
```
Encounters with wild beasts mean that numbers are the guarantee of survival.
But it's high-risk cursed spaces that are truly deadly.
Because Princess Theresa had issued a death order.
No matter what, once a cursed space was discovered, it had to be investigated and dispelled.
This meant that if a squad led by a rank-one professional didn't return from an unknown-level cursed space, then they would have to send in a rank-two; and if they were wiped out, send in a rank-three...
Until they kept sending people in to investigate.
But in reality, most cursed spaces could be probed multiple times to find a method of resolution.
If there were enough people, using a slave group to pile in could also probe for a lot of information.
Just like the "1911 Hotel" Su Lun came across last time, theoretically it's "T-level", but after a few hundred deaths, some methods of resolution can always be determined.
Therefore, numbers are critically important.
And Lena's team did not have this opportunity to trial and error.
They only had a few hundred people in total.
Every loss of a squad meant that their overall chances of survival dropped a notch.
In the end, even high-ranking professionals would have to personally explore the spaces.
The density of cursed spaces in the middle ring area was much higher than the outer ring, and in this current ruin, they had discovered several cursed spaces.
The most deadly thing was...
Even knowing the danger, there was no opportunity to cheat or shirk!
Because there were three "supervisory teams" with white helmets following the team, and they were from the inner city's military. Their task was to supervise the Scavenger teams and report the battle situation and progress at any time.
If they died, or if the Scavenger team refused to carry out orders, masters from the Black Tower would come.
....
It looked like it was only a dozen or so kilometers from the middle ring to the core of the inner city, but the progress of pioneering was very slow.
In just one day, Su Lun's team had only managed to clear a few streets nearby.
The first day's battle was quite brutal, with more than thirty people dead and many injured.
The team didn't move forward but chose to make fire and camp in a sturdy building.
It's worth mentioning that Miss Lena had been busy since the beginning of the battle, actively present on the battlefield.
She cast aside the precious arrogance of being a rich young lady and personally worked with other members of the medical team, appearing in various parts of the battlefield that needed medical support, and treated the wounded with her own hands.
Lena's medical skills were quite good, more professional than that of most Scavenger teams' professional doctors.
Even now, during rest at the camp, she was still busy in the wounded's tent.
And because she, a distinguished young lady, had personally involved herself and was busy on the front line, the injured were not only without complaints but were instead excited, as though they had been injected with adrenaline.
"Oh, Miss Lena, my life... isn't worth such precious Potion..."
"My goodness, Miss Lena personally stitched up my wound..."
"To be able to serve Miss Lena is the honor of my life..."
"..."
The views on gratitude and resentment of ordinary Scavengers were very simple.
If you're good to them, they are willing to give their lives for you.
Normally, after fierce battles, the wounded would greatly affect the morale within the team.
But because of Lena's devoted and diligent treatment, not only did it not disperse the team's morale, it actually brought them closer together.
In the current situation, only by sticking together as a team would they have a greater chance of survival.
In the tent area not far away, everyone watched it all happen.
....
In the individual tents, Su Lun and Mr. Jing were having a simple meal.
Mr. Jing, looking at the busy Lena, lamented, "This girl has finally wised up..."
"She has indeed changed quite a lot."
Su Lun nodded as well, biting into the bread in his hand.
Then, he asked, "Mr. Jing, are you planning to leave?"
He remembered that he had said before that he would leave once he entered the relic.
"Yes. In a day or two, I'll find an opportunity to leave. There are very important matters to tend to."
Mr. Jing thought of something and said, "When that happens, be careful on your own. Those supervisors have been watching you, and there are a few fellows with bad intentions around Lena, who seem to have been bought off."
Su Lun wasn't surprised and replied, "Mhm, I've noticed too. I received information earlier that people from the Umbrella Organization still haven't given up their suspicions."
He had been aware that during the day's battles, there were always a few glances on him.
It seemed as if they wanted to pick up on a clue from his fighting style, to confirm whether he was "Su Lun" or had other connections.
Mr. Jing asked, "Can you handle it?"
Su Lun said indifferently, "No problem."
"That's good, then."
Mr. Jing didn't say more, as she had great confidence in Su Lun's abilities.
Something came to her mind, and she added, "Oh, one more thing. The monsters get stronger the deeper you go into the relic, so be careful to avoid these areas..."
Su Lun listened attentively and kept it in mind.
After Mr. Jing finished speaking, he asked the question he had been curious about for a long time, "Mr. Jing, where are all these monsters in the relic coming from?"
The monsters in the Dawn Relic were killed in droves yet still seemed unending, which was a bit against common sense.
Theoretically, the monsters in an area should satisfy an ecological chain.
If some are killed, the numbers should become scarce after a long period of time.
But in the relic, new and unseen monsters always seem to emerge, and their numbers never seem to dwindle.
Mr. Jing pondered for a moment and then spoke with a slightly stern tone, "It came from an interdimensional rift."
On hearing a new term, Su Lun slightly surprised, asked, "Interdimensional rift?"
"Mhm."
At this point, Mr. Jing seemed to think of something, with a solemn look appearing in her eyes.
She glanced at Su Lun and added, "Beneath this city of Dawn, in fact, there's a spatial passageway that connects to the otherworldly planes. In ancient texts, that plane is known as 'The Abyss.' This is something that dates back to the previous era, it is said that Alchemists of the Akavia civilization would use this passage to wage wars in other planes. Unfortunately, such a formidable civilization also vanished, and no one knows exactly what happened back then... When Sir Isaac founded Dawn City here, on one hand, it was to investigate the true reason behind the discontinuation of that civilization and to pursue the ultimate pinnacle of Alchemy; on the other hand, it was to guard this interdimensional rift, to kill those extraplanar creatures that mistakenly enter our plane from the Abyss's rift..."
After a long while,
Su Lun also understood.
The Akavia civilization of the "Dawn Era," once so powerful that it could wage wars across various planes, suddenly vanished from history.
And the people of that civilization left behind a sealed spatial passageway underneath the ground.
But due to the lapse of time, some cracks appeared in the seal, leading to some Abyss monsters leaking out.
And the "Dark Spiritual Power," it turns out, had spilled over from another plane.
Su Lun was also curious whether those powerful Alchemists who could hunt gods were destroyed, or if they had migrated to other planes...
....
In the ruins, especially in the central urban area, don't even think about getting a peaceful night's sleep.
The previous battle attracted monsters from far and near, and the gunfire lasted intermittently all night long.
It was not only their group who experienced this; nearly the entire Dawn Relic was the same.
Su Lun and Mr. Jing talked through most of the night.
This person of mysterious origin seemed to have no qualms about discussing some ancient secrets with Su Lun.
She seemed to be an eyewitness to that period of history, knowing many details that others could not possibly learn from historical records, or any other channels.
....
The next morning, the team broke camp and continued towards the core urban area of the relic.
Another day of fierce fighting ensued, yielding a not insignificant number of ancient relics; however, the casualties were becoming more and more serious.
Even exploring an A-class cursed space resulted in the death of a second-tier professional.
The central urban area of Dawn City was a dangerous place that would make even Mr. Jing furrow his brows when mentioned.
Not to mention this kind of blanket Scavenger operation.
It was almost no different from courting death.
However, the good news was that there were dozens of teams in the city "courting death" simultaneously.
As if a huge net was contracting inward, it also dispersed the monsters in the relic, easing the attack pressure on individual teams. Some big monsters were driven toward the center of the relic by the commotion coming from all directions.
Mr. Jing initially planned to find a valid reason to disappear from the team discreetly, but it wasn't easy for someone with the combat power of a second-tier professional like "Zoro" to find themselves in an accident.
And coincidentally, on the second night of camping, the team encountered a "Nightmare Mist."
This spreading black mist was quite strange; once inside, a person would vanish, just like a head-eating monster.
In reality, its essence was a kind of "moving cursed space."
Whether one could come out alive after entering it was one thing; even if someone truly did make it out, they would find themselves in a different location due to the movement of the space.
As the ghostly mist drew near, Mr. Jing detected the abnormality beforehand, and Su Lun also felt the unusual spatial energy fluctuations within the mist.
Conveniently, this also provided a reasonable excuse.
Then the watch team led by "Zoro" just so happened to wander into the ghostly mist that looked hardly different from ordinary mist, and the entire team vanished without a trace.
The disappearance of that patrol team threw the entire camp into chaos at once.
To avoid the mist, the entire Scavenger group relocated overnight in a panic, retreating hurriedly to the previous night's campsite.
....
"Zoro" had disappeared, his fate unknown, leaving Miss Lena heartbroken but even more resolute.
The Scavenger mission had to go on.
From the start, this Scavenger mission was destined to end in tragedy. No one could guarantee their own survival until the end.
Lena was mentally prepared for this.
After entering the middle zone of the relic, the Dark Spiritual Power in the air had become so dense, it was almost outrageous; everyone hardly ever took off their filtering and gas masks.
Mr. "Zoro" had essentially become a loner.
He only had "Zoro" as a familiar face in the team, and now even that was gone, appearing very solitary all day long.
However, this was just as well.
Su Lun knew that besides the three supervising teams, there were other hidden experts in the team keeping an eye on him.
Therefore, he needed to completely dissociate the identities of Zoro and Su Lun.
To prevent any trouble that might involve the Lei family.
Two days later, a special report was sent to the upper echelons of the Umbrella Organization: "Zoro Cerna, confirmed as a close-combat second-tier professional, proficient in combat skills, with weak spiritual power fluctuations, combat preferences lean towards the ranger profession... High probability of excluding SS wanted criminal Su Lun, recommend downgrading the file level to C-Class!"
Meanwhile, almost at the same time "Zoro" was still active within the Lei family's main house Scavenger group, the Oliver family's Scavenger team was ambushed.
A high-ranking member of the Crow Gang was killed, three second-tier bodyguards met a gruesome end, and over a hundred others were injured or killed.
Luckily, with many on their side and the presence of the third-tier Scavenger Guild Vice-President, the Thunder Sword King Nero Redgrave, Young Master Danze managed to avoid assassination.
The assassin retreated with injuries.
The news quickly spread. The assassin wore a crow mask and was skilled in manipulating invisible zombies and black scythes.
Intelligence matches, it was SS wanted criminal Su Lun.
Presumed to be seeking revenge!
Thereafter, within the files of the Umbrella Organization, the suspected link between the identities of Su Lun and Zoro was completely severed.
....
Finally, ten days later, the Lei family's main house team reached Su Lun's destination for this journey, the super-large cursed space — [Dawn City's Central Prison].
PS. Still struggling with the text, only one chapter. It's rather weakly written, apologies.

chapters.title: Chapter 196 - 195 Desperate Situation
chapters.content:
The Reiss family's leading scavenger team was not large, and their progress was slow.
It took ten days for them to finally reach the Central Prison of Dawn City.
Even though part of it had collapsed from a distance, the structure could still be recognized as a peculiar building shaped like a pentagram. By its shape, it resembled a giant pentagram formation.
"Commander, a cursed space has been detected in the ruins over there, with a very large coverage area, energy fluctuations S+, and the space is stable..."
"Judging by the building, it should be a prison. It's preliminarily identified as a large composite-type cursed space. Requesting high-ranking professionals to assist in the reconnaissance..."
"It has been confirmed that the entrance to the space is currently inaccessible, requiring special conditions to open..."
"..."
Due to consecutive days of fierce fighting, the original team of four or five hundred had suffered heavy losses, and only about fifty to sixty wounded survivors remained.
The vanguard forces of the Cross Society were almost completely annihilated, and Miss Lena's elite troops also suffered severe losses. Of the team's dozen or so second-tier professionals, only six were left.
Even the three members of the supervisory team, who never participated in combat, had lost several, with the military from the inner city sending new ones to fill their places.
No one could retreat without completing the mission.
Looking at the prison ruins in the distance with black miasma swirling around the space vortex, despair hung on everyone's faces.
They had never seen such a large space entrance before.
The only piece of good news was that within a certain range of the cursed space, there usually weren't any deformed monsters or abyssal creatures lurking.
Before long,
an old man clad in runic light armor led a recon team back.
The elderly man was naturally the only third-tier professional among them, Butler Anthony.
With a shortage of hands, even second and third-tier professionals had to personally lead teams to explore dangerous routes, to reduce casualties.
Anthony discussed the findings with the supervisory team members,
then, as usual, those fellows reported the intelligence back to their superiors using the military communicator.
The team set up camp on the spot.
....
As the number of survivors was not large, the team members chose a sturdy building that was easy to defend, erecting an encampment using mechanical arms and armor.
Now, upon hearing the order to camp, everyone began taking out their marching tents from their backpacks and started setting them up.
Old Butler Anthony found Miss Lena, who was setting up her tent.
Her personal maid had also died in combat three days prior, and the young miss was not asking to be served; she was doing everything herself now.
Anthony reported with a heavy tone, "Miss, that cursed space entrance is currently inaccessible; it appears to require special triggering conditions to enter. Marjorie's team is currently trying to decipher the method of entry..."
"I know."
Lena, her expression calm, did not stop working on the tent upon hearing this news.
Seeing the change in his young mistress, a flicker of relief passed through Anthony's eyes, but he soon voiced his concern, "Miss...it's preliminarily judged to be a 'T-level' space. This time, I fear we may not make it through."
"Mm."
Upon hearing this, Lena paused for a moment.
But apparently having already prepared herself mentally, she spoke with resolved and indifferent tone, "If it really is T-level, it's pointless to explore it in batches. Once we find a way to enter, I will join the exploration myself this time."
"This..."
Anthony looked at her with a complex expression and said no more, "Yes, Miss."
They were all well aware,
that no one could defy or escape the duke's orders.
Since the start of the scavenging, they had only two possible outcomes.
Either complete the mission,
or be annihilated.
If they did not continue the search, even attempting to escape, they would surely not survive.
Eventually, failing to complete the mission would inevitably bring disaster upon the entire Old Lington family.
Lena had been prepared for the entire force to be wiped out from the moment they set out.
This moment was bound to come sooner or later.
Lena heard the news and didn't forget to comfort the loyal old butler, "Grandpa Anthony, the situation may not be as bad as it seems..."
"Ah..."
Butler Anthony let out a small sigh, said nothing more, and turned to leave.
At this moment, Miss Lena thought of something and turned her head to look at the man in the corner setting up a tent, the ever so solitary Mr. Zoro.
Upon reflection, she walked over and greeted him, "Mr. Zoro."
"Mr. Zoro" responded, "What is it, Miss Lena?"
His face covered with a full-face gas mask that was crude and had complex mechanical modifications, it was impossible to see his features clearly. His voice sounded very hoarse through the filter canister.
"Thank you for looking after me all this way."
Miss Lena bowed to Enzo, fully aware of how much Mr. Zoro had looked out for her during their journey.
Otherwise, a few days ago, during the battle with that third-tier [Three-headed Giant Serpent with a Human Body], she would have been either dead or severely injured. Back then, Butler Anthony was tied up by the monster, all of her personal guards were killed in battle, and if not for Mr. Zoro, she would have also been hit by the monster's corrosive poison gas.
Indeed, as Auntie said, he was very powerful.
After bowing, Miss Lena continued, "Mr. Zoro, what I want to tell you is that after figuring out how to enter the cursed space, I will lead all the members of my family in. You are not a contracted member of our family, and there is no need for you to join us... "
"No, Miss Lena, you don't need to be so polite,"
Mr. Zoro shook his head, his tone sounding not as heavy as Lena's, "After all, Aunt Qian asked me to take good care of you."
"You have already done more than enough, thank you so much."
Miss Lena sincerely expressed her gratitude once again, then revealed the harsh truth, "That might be a 'T-level' space, there's no need for you to die alongside me."
Listening to this, Mr. Zoro shook his head, seemingly smiling, "No, what I mean is... even if I wanted to leave, I couldn't."
He paused and then said with deep meaning, "Moreover, I did not plan on leaving anyway."
"???"
Upon hearing this, Miss Lena showed a puzzled expression.
She was just about to say something more when suddenly, an urgent report came through the communicator.
"Miss, we have a large force on our left quickly approaching us... looking at the flags, it's the people from the Clark family!"
"Miss, a force is also coming from our right, it's people from the Olli family!"
At this report, the entire camp immediately tensed up.
....
The Dawn Relic was already vast, but dozens of teams were simultaneously clearing it, so in reality, the distance between each team wasn't far.
Miss Lena's team drew the sixteen slot, with the Olli family at fifteen and the Clark family at seventeen.
Although mist and ruins obscured their view, preventing sightings, the sounds of gunfire and combat indicated that these teams were actually quite close to one another.
It was like pieces of a cake being divided, the closer to the core city area, the closer the distance between each team.
In fact, a few days earlier, Lena and her team had already noticed the movements of the two teams on either side.
Those families had enough manpower to divide into several groups to clear the land, progressing rapidly.
The hunting group in front, with the young masters and misses' main team following behind.
Much more relaxed than their team.
....
A few minutes ago, within the Olli family's team, a few kilometers away from Miss Lena's team.
Young Master Danze was leisurely enjoying his afternoon coffee inside the tent.
Compared to the fierce front-line battles, although they too encountered some minor monster attacks here, it was negligible.
After all, they had the Deputy Chairman of the Hunter's Guild, the famous third-tier professional, the Thunder Sword King, Nero Redgrave.
Ever since the last ambush by Su Lun, Danze had not dared to stray far from this third-tier professional.
He and the bearded swordsman were sipping coffee while playing chess on a black-and-white checkerboard, chatting.
As they talked, they came back to the topic of the attack a few days ago.
"Mr. Nero, what do you make of the strength of that SS wanted criminal, Su Lun?"
"It's hard to say..."
"Hard to say?"
"I paid close attention during that ambush. The true strength Su Lun exhibited then was just that of an average second-tier professional. But his eight-armed spider spear's teleportation ability in the relic is exceptional. Even for me, it's not easy to catch him..."
"Just good at running, that's all."
"It's not that simple. Now that we've confirmed that guy has relations with the reactionary organization, he shouldn't be underestimated. Besides, have you noticed that he hasn't shown his second-tier advanced abilities yet? I suspect the intelligence we have is far from his real strength."
"The advancement choices for a Puppet Master are quite limited. The guy is young, yet his puppet-control skills are so proficient, his professional ability is almost certainly the 'puppet-control technique' direction of advancement. After all, you know as well, puppet control requires a lot of time and energy to practice... It's impossible to awaken other unrelated abilities."
"Hmm, this analysis makes sense."
"In my opinion, that SS most-wanted criminal, Su Lun, seems to be relying on the scythe in his hands that's bound with a seal to wreak havoc. The guy really is lucky, having mastered a secret technique for zombie refinement that can evade the curse's backlash from sealed items. However, now that I've completely stabilized my second-tier realm and have mastered this 'Stanitz's Chessboard,' should Su Lun come again, I guarantee he won't return."
"Although I think you should be a bit more cautious, Young Master Danze, with that cursed object and combined with the 'Puppet Theater,' indeed, there's no reason for you to lose against any second-tier professions..."
Upon hearing this, a smug smile appeared on Danze's face.
While the two were chatting, at this moment, a subordinate came to report.
"Young Master, the Black Tower has sent an order for us to dispatch people to help the Reyes family's main branch team open a large cursed space..."
Hearing this, both faces showed surprise.
Turning his head, Danze asked, "Mr. Nero, are you interested in having a look?"
"Of course."
Nero, narrowing his eyes slightly, added, "Since the Reyes family's main branch has been offended, it's essential to eradicate them completely. Now that the Black Tower has tacitly approved of your actions, Miss Lena and Old Anthony must not be allowed to leave the relic alive. Otherwise, there might not be such a good opportunity next time. Carnegie Reyes is very capable, having survived such division before. If we can't completely break them this time, a weakened tiger is still troublesome..."
Danze smiled, "That's exactly what I was thinking."
....
Lena had long been aware that the vanguard team of the Clark family on the left had far surpassed their team in terms of progress, and she had been keeping a close eye on them.
Now these guys had suddenly changed their route, obviously with ill intent.
Sure enough, not long after, a hunting party of several hundred emerged from the distant mist.
Looking at the family crest engraved on their equipment, it was precisely the elite team from the Clark family.
The young man leading the Clarks, dressed in brand-new hunting gear, was naturally Young Master Eli Clark.
After half a month's absence,
this Young Master, seeing Lena's few dozen remaining soldiers, spoke in a tone full of mockery, "Yo, Miss Lena, it seems like you're not in a good situation, are you?"
The visitors were clearly hostile, and Butler Anthony had promptly guarded Lena. He looked at the three bodyguards beside Young Master Eli, his pupils contracting slightly, and whispered in introduction, "Be careful, Miss. Those are the Ice, Lei, and Earth elders from the Old Lington Mystical Studies Association, very strong elemental Magicians. They also have troublesome cursed items in their hands. Combined, even I am not sure if we can gain the upper hand in a short time."
There were three people beside Young Master Eli.
An archer with a blue longbow, a woman in a robe with a Lei-patterned Magic Wand, and a green-haired punk strongman.
Lena glanced at them, then turned her gaze coldly to the approaching group and responded, "What have you come for?"
Eli, leading his squad, strolled over and said lazily, "I just received notification from the higher-ups at the Black Tower, saying that you might not be able to handle this high-level cursed space, so I've brought people over to help you out."
It wasn't necessary for him to come personally, but now hearing that it was Lena's team, Young Master Eli couldn't resist kicking them when they were down.
Lena frowned slightly upon hearing this. She glanced at the three white-helmeted inspectors nearby, seemingly inquiring about something.
The black-faced commander of the inspectors responded plainly, "The order from above is only to oversee your pioneering efforts. We won't interfere in family affairs or get involved."
After saying this, the three inspectors deliberately distanced themselves, as if making a statement: if you fight, don't get us involved.
Not expecting these people to mediate anyway, Lena shouted, "Everybody, listen to my command! Kill without mercy anyone who approaches the camp!"
At her command, both sides almost simultaneously raised their guns.
Click-click sounds of dense firearms being loaded filled the air.
Tempers flared, and it seemed they were on the verge of fighting at the slightest provocation.
.....
With a nearly tenfold difference in numbers, the Clark family held an absolute advantage.
Young Master Eli appeared completely undaunted by the guns pointed at him, with three bodyguards around him, making firearms virtually useless against him.
He even gestured for his men to lower their weapons.
After all, even if they allowed the opponent to shoot first, the Reyes family had no chance of winning.
He continued to provoke Lena, "Yo, Miss Lena, there's no need for that. I think... we can have a good chat."
As if it were coordinated, just as the Clark family arrived, Young Master Danze from the Olli family also emerged with his team.
Young Master Danze, seeing the two poised groups, gloated, "Tsk tsk... did I come at a bad time?"
By his side was a heavily made-up young woman who resembled Lena to some extent.
It was none other than Miss Betty Reiss, the second daughter from the Reyes family's secondary branch, and Young Master Danze's fiancée.
She had played a significant role in the efforts to undermine the main branch this time.
She looked at Lena and couldn't help taking pleasure in her misfortune, "Sister Lena, long time no see."
.....
The two opposing forces amounted to nearly a thousand men, all of them enemies.
In the current situation, it seemed that Lena's party might not be able to enter the cursed space and would be annihilated outside instead.
Young Master Eli advanced step by step, pressing, "Miss Lena, now... shall we talk?"
Lena, facing enemies who had closed in to within fifty meters, showed no fear and pulled the trigger.
"Bang!"
The gunshot echoed.
The bullet hit right in front of Eli's feet, producing white smoke.
Lena, holding the gun, said calmly, "Come any closer, and the next shot will be in your head."
Apparently anticipating the bullet's trajectory, Eli's bodyguards didn't even bother to look up.
Though Eli shuddered with fright, the smirk on his face grew even wider.
Turning his gaze to the guards beside Lena, he uttered an intriguing statement, "You don't want to live for yourself, but don't you think of your subordinates?"
Those words acted like a signal.
Just then, a second-order commander named Pruitt Keith suddenly led a dozen subordinates to distance themselves.
Upon noticing this, Old Butler Anthony roared, "Pruitt, what are you doing!"
Pruitt, looking at Lena, said, "Miss Lena, I apologize. I've made many contributions to the Reiss family, but I don't want to die here..."
Clearly, these men had been bought off.
Undercover up to this point, there was no need to keep hiding.
Whether it was the cursed space ahead or the predicament here, staying with the ranks of the Reiss main family seemed like certain death.
Saying this, they held their guns at the ready and walked out of the hastily constructed camp.
Lena's team was already short on people, and with more than ten defectors, a gaping hole appeared in the camp's defenses immediately.
Most crucially, the blow to morale was severe. With these men gone, the eyes of those remaining were filled with anger and despair.
Old Butler Anthony wanted to strike down the traitors, but with covetous enemies all around, he dared not act recklessly.
Lena did not speak, nor did the worsening situation cause her much change.
The hand holding her gun remained as steady as ever.
At this moment, Young Master Eli's scornful gaze intensified as he asked again, "Now, has Miss Lena changed her mind?"
The plight of the Reiss main family had become a dire predicament at that moment.
Without turning her head to look, Lena pondered for a moment, then said indifferently to the remaining guard squad beside her, "If anyone still wants to leave now, I won't blame you."
She was well aware that they had come to obliterate the Reiss main family.
To surrender?
It would achieve nothing except humiliation.
After a pause, she continued with resolute tone, "But if you stay, prepare to fight to the death with me!"
Upon hearing these words, the guards, who had just been demoralized by their leaders' betrayal, suddenly became impassioned.
The guards rallied around Lena, ready to fight a decisive battle.
"Miss, we won't leave!"
"Sworn to live and die with our family!"
"Right! Sworn to live and die with our family! To battle till the end!"
"..."
The crowd was excited, the spirit of the dozen men burning fiercely, boldly confronting the nearly a thousand encircling enemies.
And Old Butler Anthony seemed to have released some secret technique; his head began to sprout horns, his bones cracked loudly, and his figure expanded into that of a muscular, nearly two-meter-tall humanoid mountain goat.
Looking at this group of people, the experts from the Oliver and Clark families frowned, even the third-order professional "Thunder Sword King" Nero Redgrave looked solemn.
He watched the old goat whose presence had suddenly surged and muttered to himself, "'Magic Goat' Anthony, the champion of the Old Lington fighting contest twenty years ago... Tsk, it's been a long time since I've seen this form."
A third-order professional fighting desperately was not to be taken lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 197 - 196: Who is Zoro
chapters.content:
Young Master Eli watched as Leyna remained so resolute and didn't dare to advance any further.
They had originally thought that facing such desperation, a young lady who had been brought up in luxury would surely back down.
But to their surprise, she showed no inclination to negotiate and chose to fight to the death instead.
"Hmph! A woman who doesn't know what's good for her, don't blame me for not being polite!"
Young Master Eli gave a cold snort, just about to retreat.
Just then, an out-of-place voice suddenly emerged.
"Um... Young Master Eli, I hear, we have some unfinished business?"
All eyes shifted to see the masked man leaning against a stone pillar inside Leyna's camp.
Although he stood with Leyna's group, he seemed not to fit in.
Leyna, feeling a slight sense of guilt and puzzled, said to the suddenly vocal Zorro, "Mr. Zorro, you..."
Before she could finish, "Zorro" interrupted her with an indifferent tone, muttering to himself as if he were talking to himself, "After all, I promised Sister Qian and that person to protect your life as much as possible. Naturally, I must be diligent and responsible."
That person?
Leyna was momentarily puzzled upon hearing this.
But reality did not allow her to ask in detail.
...
Because he was wearing a gas mask, Eli did not recognize him and questioned, "Who are you?"
The masked man calmly replied, "I am Zorro. Seems like Young Master Eli forgets easily?"
"Heh, it's you."
Something clicked for Young Master Eli, and with narrowed eyes he took a moment to appraise the masked man, chuckling dismissively, "So, what, you have come to beg for mercy now?"
"No."
Zorro shook his head with a smile, "I am here to borrow something from Young Master Eli."
Eli scoffed coldly, "Oh? And what would that be?"
Zorro, with a tone that sounded like a joke, said, "I'd like to borrow your head for a moment."
"Heh..."
Eli laughed as though he'd heard a laughable joke, full of scorn, "Just you?"
I have a few hundred men with me, not even that third-rank old man dares to speak up, and you think you can take me down?
"Mm-hmm."
To this obviously mocking question, "Zorro" surprisingly nodded seriously.
As he spoke, he played with the dagger in his hand, his wrist flicking to produce a beautiful flourish of the blade, his tone still casual, but the murderous intent in his eyes gathering, he added, "I also wanted to say, you shouldn't stand so close. At this distance, these few people won't be able to protect your life..."
Before he even finished speaking, the killing intent burst forth suddenly.
The three elders beside Eli were the first to sense something, their expressions changing dramatically as they bellowed a warning, "Young Master, be careful!"
While Zorro's words still echoed in the ears of the crowd, they suddenly heard a "bang" as the sound of stones shattering resonated.
Looking closer, the stone pillar that "Zorro" was leaning against seemed to have been struck by some invisible colossal force, instantly cracking into countless web-like fractures.
"Crack," "crack," "crack"...
Following the dense series of splintering sounds, the force spread, and the whole pillar, already unable to withstand it, immediately shattered into chunks of rock, exploding violently.
The onlookers could only watch in disbelief as the pillar, nearly one meter in diameter, inexplicably shattered.
The moment the explosion sounded, a shockwave ripple finally burst forth from the spot where "Zorro's" back foot had been tensed.
After a brief delay, a "snap" of air exploded, piercing eardrums.
Upon looking again, the figure of "Zorro" in front of them had already dissipated.
It was a visual illusion,
The person had vanished from the spot.
....
The previously calm and collected "Zorro" suddenly burst into action.
The lower-tier professionals hadn't realized what was happening yet, but the two third-tier professionals present had preemptively caught "Zorro's" movement.
The two third-tiers simultaneously changed color.
Butler Anthony, already transformed into his demonic goat form, was shocked, "Mr. Zorro is this strong?!"
Only he, a close combat class professional like him, could understand just how terrifying this instantaneous movement technique was from merely observing the cracking pillars.
He had never imagined that a bounty hunter, who had appeared so ordinary up until now, possessed such impressive physical capabilities.
Thunder Sword King Nero spotted the technique of stepping on air at a glance, and his heart shockingly exclaimed, "Stepping on Air!"
This was a secret technique even he hadn't mastered; to think he was witnessing "Zorro" pull off such a move.
The subtle skill of stepping on air might seem simple, but it required extraordinary talent to master!
It was then that Nero understood why "Zorro" had made that remark earlier; with the ability to charge forward, no matter how strong the second-tier bodyguards were, they couldn't protect Young Master Eli's life within fifty meters!
"Not good!"
Nero's heart seized with urgency; he naturally couldn't stand by and watch Eli get killed right before his eyes.
Almost the moment he noticed "Zorro's" explosive move, he suddenly swung his sword, blasting out a sharp Sword Qi that shot forward dozens of meters in an instant.
But...
As another third-tier professional on the scene, how could he let things go as planned?
Butler Anthony snorted coldly, his figure transforming into a streak of light, perfectly intercepting the Sword Qi in the middle.
Transformed into a demonic goat, his formerly aged features disappeared, his body now brimming with explosive power.
Upon this contact, Anthony's hands, covered in white hair, enveloped a vortex of air, incredibly blocking the Sword Qi with his bare hands!
The reactions and exchange between the two third-tiers were extremely swift, almost taking place in the blink of an eye as the pillar collapsed.
Nero's Sword Qi was fruitless, and at this moment, the vanished figure of "Zorro" reappeared, already dozens of meters away.
Young Master Eli also realized that something was terribly wrong. The immense fear of facing death changed his complexion, his mind screaming for help!
But his throat was utterly incapable of voicing the cry.
Instinctively, he wanted to dodge, but his body just couldn't keep up with his mental reflexes. He could only watch helplessly as the figure flashed before him.
A pitch-black poisoned dagger crept silently towards his neck.
As crisis descended, the Three Disasters Elder of ice, thunder, and earth also responded.
But how could their spells ever be faster than a close combat class professional using "Stepping on Air"?
Among them, the earth-element Baldy with his strong defensive capabilities, the only close combat professional, moved first, positioning his body in front of Young Master Eli. At the same time, his skin shimmered with an earthy luminescence, indicating his intention to withstand the attack head-on.
If "Zorro" had charged straight forward, he would have collided with a full embrace.
....
But would Zorro proceed as they wished?
The "Stepping on Air" technique was not only fast but also known for its abrupt stopping and change of direction!
Before anyone could react, another ripple explosively burst in the air.
"Zorro" stepped on air once more, abruptly changing direction, his figure tracing a "ϟ" shape in mid-air, effortlessly evading Baldy's interception.
Young Master Eli caught a glimpse of a figure from the corner of his eye, but before the image could transfer from his retinas to his brain, he suddenly felt a chilling sensation at his waist.
The sharp poisoned dagger precisely sliced through the weak spots in his protective gear, craftily creating a gash.
In an instant, the wound was exposed to the air, turning black rapidly as foul-smelling pus spurted out.
Before Young Master Eli could utter a word, his vision darkened, and he collapsed, his breath as thin as a thread!
....
"Zorro" had severely injured Young Master Eli, protected by many experts, stunning everyone present.
Watching the man fall, the sounds of "Stepping on Air," the "pat pat pat" of the exploding air, only then echoed in everyone's ears.
Time seemed to pause for an instant as those people finally recovered from their shock.
"Quick, administer the antidote to Young Master!"
"Damn it, stop him!"
"Protect Young Master!"
"..."
The scene descended into chaos.
Not far away, the Thunder Sword King, Nero, witnessed this scene and his eyes widened in astonishment, "Wasn't the intelligence report about a mere ranger? This seems like a professional assassin? And a third-stage Stepping on Air, such exaggerated burst speed, how strong must this guy's body be?! When did such a powerful expert appear among the second-rank professionals?"
With this "Stepping on Air," even he felt a considerable threat.
Obviously, Nero's first reaction was that this "Zorro" was problematic!
How could someone so strong be just a somewhat famous bounty hunter?
"Could it be a hidden card laid down by Carnegie Reyes?"
Nero's eyes darted around, his mind raced with too many unanswered questions.
But reality didn't give him the chance to think more.
Because by then, the battle had already ignited.
Enzo's assassination attempt on Young Master Eli lit the fuse of the powder keg.
Guns fired in a cacophony.
After severely wounding Young Master Eli, "Zorro" continued moving nonstop, charging directly into the Clark family's main force.
His speed was such that even second-rank professionals couldn't react, let alone the ordinary guards.
Because they had arrived in haste and relied on sheer numbers for strength, the group had not even formed a defensive formation.
Now, taken by surprise, "Zorro" was like a bullet easily piercing through the enemy's defense. Moving like a ghost with nimble maneuvers, his sharp dagger left cunning trails of blood where it traced gaps in armor and bulletproof vests.
"Don't fire wildly, careful of friendly fire!"
"Use area control spells!"
"Deploy the heavy mechas, stop him!"
"Use net guns! Use net guns!"
"..."
The enemy was in disarray.
Because of "Zorro's" presence, most of the Clark family's firepower was drawn to him, significantly reducing the pressure on Lena's side.
Though the Reyes family's numbers were few, their equipment was exceptionally sophisticated, plus they leveraged the defensive advantages of the terrain and their position. Several heavily armed mecha warriors blocked the front, unleashing a barrage of firepower, holding ground for the moment.
However, if the standoff continued, it would inevitably lead to a dead end.
Moreover, no matter how formidable "Zorro" was, he was but one man.
Among the enemies were second-rank experts,
Previously he had the advantage of a surprise attack and they didn't react in time,
Now that he had killed someone, although mixing within the crowd, his speed had slowed down.
Two second-rank assassins tangled up with him.
Daggers clashed, sparking flashes of light with each contact.
Even though "Zorro" still held the upper hand for the moment, with the enemy's overwhelming numbers, once caught, he too would face certain death.
And the area spells from the magic wielders were taking shape...
"Zorro" was obviously aware of this and didn't give his enemies a chance to surround him.
He charged in, wreaked havoc for a round, injuring dozens, and then immediately sprinted towards the perimeter of the encirclement, looking like he intended to break through and escape.
If they let him disappear into the mist, with his speed, no matter the number of pursuers, catching him would be impossible!
....
The people near Lena, seeing that Mr. Zorro was now at the edge of the battlefield, let out a sigh of relief.
In this situation, escaping was all that mattered.
But just at that moment, the unexpected happened.
Normally, it's quite difficult to catch up to a professional assassin who can "Step on Air," yet there are certain special alchemical items.
"Don't let him get away!"
Seeing Mr. Zorro intent on escaping, a figure among the enemy suddenly increased their speed several fold, reaching an unbelievable speed.
While "Mr. Zorro" was still mired in the crowd, the person abruptly surged forward to intercept him. Their speed was even a fraction faster than Stepping on Air!
That very moment, the difference in speed brought the two into contact.
The person threw a punch at "Mr. Zorro's" head, and even though he twisted his body in an effort to divert the force, he was still struck in the mask, halted, and sent flying backwards.
Mr. Zorro flew backwards, but without much surprise. He murmured to himself, "Tsk tsk... capable of accelerating time, must be that 'Watkins's Pocket Watch' the guy mentioned. Indeed, just as I thought. If he were here, he could probably wipe out all these guys..."
A punch to the face sent the gas mask flying.
After landing on the ground, "Mr. Zorro's" demeanor suddenly changed from before. There was no intention of a desperate fight,
and rather unheroically, he raised his hands,
He... made a gesture of surrender?
At that moment, realizing that their target was no longer resisting, someone suddenly shouted, "Take him alive!"
With that order, the lethal tactics also came to a sudden stop.
Only then did everyone see clearly that beneath the mask was a face with blue skin.
From a distance, Lena and Butler Anthony, who had seen "Mr. Zorro" before, were greatly surprised.
They discovered that this blue-skinned person was not the dashing Mr. Zorro they had met before!
....
This blue-skinned "Mr. Zorro" was naturally not Su Lun.
It was Kai, who had merged with X serum and advanced to a second-order assassin.
Kai, looking at the crowd closing in on him, raised his hands in surrender.
He had not a hint of the resignation of a captive on his face; instead, he wore a radiant smile and muttered, "Just as he said, upon seeing the 'X Serum,' you definitely wouldn't dare to kill me."
Hearing this, a middle-aged man with a grim expression stepped forward.
He took a careful look at Kai's blue skin and, seeing that Kai's mind was completely clear, recognized the effect of the "X Serum."
This revelation also shocked him greatly.
Where did their "X Serum" come from?
And how could someone inject it without becoming deformed?
This was the very reason he had ordered that they take a living capture.
They were people from the Umbrella Organization and naturally cared little about family feuds.
The middle-aged man, ignoring the ongoing fierce battle among the three major families, shot Kai in the leg,
with caution, likely to prevent Kai from using that kind of speed to escape again.
After firing the shot, he asked in a deep voice, "Who gave you the potion?"
Kai was shot in the thigh, the alchemical bullet tearing through his muscle. He stumbled, nearly falling over.
Though his forehead was covered in cold sweat, his face showed no sign of pain. Instead, he grinned, saying, "You'll know soon enough."
The middle-aged man's eyes narrowed as his expression grew more solemn, guessing what was happening, "Are you stalling for time?"
"Yeah... just noticed?"
Kai, looking at the cursed space's glowing gate that had suddenly intensified nearby, gave a sly smile, "Tsk tsk... Perfect timing."
Before the people in front of him could react, they suddenly noticed that everything around them had changed dramatically.
Everyone then realized that due to some special condition, they had been swept into the cursed space!

chapters.title: Chapter 198 - 197 Central Prison
chapters.content:
The prisons a thousand years ago were not much different from those in Old Lington.
The dark, closed underground space, cramped cells, cold runic iron bars, the walls were built with large chunks of blue stones like bread, and every few meters there was a dim gas lamp on the wall.
The air was slightly damp, carrying a stench of decay like that of a sewer.
It was probably to dispel the moisture and foul smell that there were burning fire pits in the corridor outside the bars, with firewood crackling as it burned.
Intense gunfire could be heard.
The prison seemed very large, with the sound of gunfire echoing on and on.
.....
The spiritual power of darkness in the prison had become very dense, so thick that it seemed it could cause deformities at any moment.
Kai paid no attention to the gunfire outside, greedily breathing in a few mouthfuls.
The rich dark spiritual power made him feel very comfortable.
Although his thigh had been shot through, it did not hinder him from suddenly drawing a dagger and effortlessly cutting the throats of two elite members wearing Clark family uniforms in the same cell.
Coincidentally, in the cell opposite him were Miss Lena and Butler Anthony.
Seeing the change of scene, the old butler firmly held Lena's hand, and only then did he relax.
Suddenly dragged into the cursed space from the midst of fierce fighting, both of them had looks of shock and bewilderment.
However, they naturally also saw Kai killing people in the opposite cell.
Although they did not know who this blue-skinned stranger was, they knew he was a friend rather than a foe.
Through the iron bars, Anthony asked, "Young man, what exactly is going on here? Where is Mr. Zorro?"
Kai was attending to the gunshot wound on his leg. The super regenerative power from the "X Serum" was visibly healing his torn flesh.
Upon hearing the question, he looked up at the two of them, his tone slightly strange, "Zorro? Hmm... he should be arriving soon."
As he spoke, Kai looked at the old butler who seemed to be testing the strength of the iron bars and stopped him, "Oh, right. He told us to stay inside the cell and not to go out, or we might run into trouble. The prison guards outside... they cannot be killed."
Hearing this, Anthony seemed to realize something, startled, he quickly asked, "Was it Mr. Zorro who activated the cursed space just now?"
Kai didn't intend to hide anything and casually said, "Yes."
Upon hearing this,
both Lena and Anthony were shocked.
They had thought it an accident, considering it too coincidental that they were swept into the cursed space during a battle.
Was it really man-made?
And this was a "T-level" space, right? Listening to this strange man's tone, that Mr. Zorro seemed to know some "secrets" that others did not.
At this moment, Lena looked at Kai, who was treating his wound, and said, "Sir, the through-and-through wound on your leg has elemental damage, which will prevent the wound from healing. I have a specific healing medicine here. If you need it..."
Before she could finish, Kai didn't hesitate, grinning openly with a bright smile, "Thank you."
Lena tossed the potion over and nodded, "I should be thanking you... By the way, sir, what should I call you?"
She was very aware that this man was strong; they wouldn't have been dragged into this if he hadn't stayed behind.
It was also because of her that he was injured.
As Kai poured the medicine on his wound, he reintroduced himself, "Miss Lena, you can call me Kai."
He paused, then shook his head dismissively, "You don't need to thank me. 'Zorro' asked me to come and take his place, and to protect Miss Lena, you, in the meantime."
Having said that, a light smile crossed his face as he glanced at Lena, "You can thank him later when it's time."
"We should be grateful."
Lena felt somewhat puzzled.
Even if it were Mr. Zorro, there wasn't much of a connection.
It seemed somewhat of a stretch to say it was because of Aunt Qiantiao's relationship.
Without thinking too much, Lena apologized again, "I'm sorry for getting you involved in such a troublesome affair."
Kai merely smiled noncommittally.
....
As the young lady spoke, Butler Anthony, naturally, did not interject, but listened silently by the side.
He also guessed at Kai's identity in silence.
Suddenly, thinking of something, Anthony looked at Kai and, testing the waters, asked, "Mr. Kai, if I may be so bold, are you the one who injured Geiger previously?"
As Butler Anthony, naturally he would deal with all the intelligence held by the family.
He knew far more than Miss Lena did.
In fact, when he saw Kai burst into action earlier, he had thought of something.
Such an impressive professional surely couldn't be some unknown nobody.
Moreover, a professional capable of "Stepping on Air" were few and far between in Old Lington.
Then, his mind went to that nickname in the recent intelligence reports, the Mysterious Lone Wanderer known as "Hyena".
That man who had once slaughtered the "Steel Cannon Wild Hunt Group" and nearly killed the "Gun King" Gage all by himself, seemed to possess a ghostly agility.
Although the reports mentioned that he was just a rank one professional, there was a bit of a gap compared to the one in front of him.
But those daring to oppose the major families of the inner city, seemed to have no one else to their name.
Kai glanced at the old butler, seemed to ponder for an instant, and then lightly exhaled one word, "Yes."
At that, Anthony's pupils slightly constricted, and his heart was already tossing and turning with shock.
The "Hyena" himself wasn't much of a problem, as the intelligence reports also described him as a lone wanderer without much background.
But he was involved in a massive trouble,
That was the "SS wanted criminal Su Lun"!
......
Miss Lena, still not understanding anything, looked at the old butler with confused eyes, noticing that his tone wasn't quite right.
Anthony didn't know how to explain and thought with a complicated expression for a moment before muttering to himself, "So it is Your Excellency..."
He looked at Kai and then something else occurred to him.
If he could guess his identity, so could others.
He directly expressed his concern, saying, "Thank you for your righteous action, Your Excellency. However, this might bring trouble. The Oliver and Clark families have a close relationship with the military of the inner city, and there might be people from the umbrella organization among their teams. If you let them get out alive, there could be big trouble..."
"Get out alive?"
Kai shook his head, interrupting his concerns, and said plainly, "No. If that guy intends to do it this way, they won't possibly get out alive."
"???"
Anthony thought Kai was unaware of how formidable top-ranking professionals were, especially since there were but a few rank three professionals in all Old Lington.
His concern did not lessen, but instead intensified as he explained, "But... The elites from the two big families are strong. That 'Thunder Sword King' Nero is very powerful, and even I am not certain of defeating him. And the Three Disasters Elder, if they join forces, no one among the rank two professionals could stand against them..."
Kai shrugged his shoulders, with an expression of agreement on his face as he said casually, "Mr. Anthony, I quite agree with you."
Anthony grew more puzzled upon hearing this.
However, after a pause, Kai's tone suddenly shifted, and his eyes deepened as he continued slowly, "Although I also think it's unlikely. Whatever that guy says he can do, he always manages to do it."
Anthony frowned deeply upon hearing this.
The day's events were filled with too many surprises, making him feel somewhat unreal.
He suddenly thought, could it be... they are planning to make use of this cursed space?
But this was a "T-class" space, a dead end for enemies, but wasn't it the same for them?
....
Meanwhile, the sound of gunfire in the hallway outside was growing more intense.
The prison wasn't just filled with this group of outsiders, but also NPC prison guards and prisoners.
It sounded like a large team was fighting and exchanging fire with the prison guards, seemingly trying to violently break open the prison's cell doors to make a break for it.
Almost all cursed spaces had one thing in common when it came to breaking the curse, and that was to fight one's way through.
As the noise outside grew louder, Kai seemed able to keep his composure, but Miss Lena and Butler Anthony appeared very puzzled.
Miss Lena asked, "Mr. Kai, should we go out now?"
Kai shook his head, "No. Although those prison guards out there aren't very strong, that guy said not to kill them under any circumstances, as killing them would lead to big trouble."
Hearing this, Lena thought for a moment and asked, "Does that Mr. Zorro... know about this cursed space?"
Kai spread his hands, "Don't look at me. I don't know much more than you do."
Before they could discuss further, Anthony suddenly looked alert and said softly, "Someone's coming."
After a breath or two, Lena and Kai could hear amidst the gunfire someone's footsteps approaching their corner of the two cells.
The footsteps were steady, betraying no haste.
As they got closer, they could also hear voices from outside carrying on a conversation.
It was like a conversation between NPCs in this space.
"Prison Guard Chief! A large-scale prison riot has broken out in Block One and Block Two, please instruct!"
"Hmm, stand your ground. The rapid response team will deal with it. I need to interrogate a few prisoners."
"Yes!"
"..."
No sooner had the voice faded than there came a man dressed in a dark blue prison uniform, wearing a grim iron mask.
Looking at the shoulder insignia, it turned out to be the very Prison Guard Chief who had been speaking.
The masked man walked to Kai's cell, "clattering" out a bunch of keys, and as he unlocked the door, he said, "Sorry for the delay, I had to deal with some issues."
Kai recognized immediately that the figure was Su Lun. Not too surprised, he was still curious and asked, "How did you become the Prison Guard Chief?"
"Having this identity saves a lot of trouble."
Su Lun explained nonchalantly.
He opened Kai's cell and then turned to unlock another iron door opposite.
Because she couldn't see past the mask, Miss Lena tentatively asked, "Mr. Zorro?"
Su Lun seemed to ponder for a moment, purposely not revealing his identity, and chuckled, "Yes, Miss Lena."
But Butler Anthony sized up the enigmatic masked man with a serious look in his eyes.
Why is it that while everyone else who comes in here is a prisoner, he is an NPC?
....
Su Lun led the three out of the prison.
Only then did Kai and his companions see in the corner of the prison corridor a few armed prison guards who did not seem very intelligent.
With their "Prison Guard Chief" Su Lun leading, they strolled past without any hindrance.
This method also surprised the three following behind Su Lun.
The gloomy corridors felt narrow and oppressive, as if shackled at every turn.
After some distance, and with no one else in sight, Su Lun finally elaborated, "The guards on this first level might not be strong, but killing them would cause much trouble. The guards below are much stronger. Once they take action, none of the escapees, especially those who killed a guard, will survive."
Upon hearing this, Kai and the others began to understand.
Butler Anthony instinctively asked, "Mr. Zorro, how strong are the guards below? And how many levels are there in this prison?"
Considering himself the strongest combatant there, he felt it was necessary to gauge the strength of the enemy and gather intelligence about the space.
He needed it to plan their escape.
Su Lun pondered for a moment before replying with two words: "Very strong."
After a thought, he explained in terms they could understand, "This prison has five levels. According to ancient classifications, prisoners below tier three are held on the first level where we were. The prisoners on the second level, though their records show them as 'beyond tier' beings, have dissipated much of their energy over time. But there, you will find beings beyond tier three. I am not aware of the situation on the third or fourth levels. But I do know there is an undefeatable presence on the fifth level. This prison is also peculiar as its exit is on the fifth level. So, anyone who wants out must go downward."
Listening to this series of explanations, Kai and his companions were filled with astonishment.
Talk of "beyond tier" and descriptions of undefeatable beings...
Lena asked, "So... is this truly a T-level space?"
Su Lun simply nodded, "Mhm."
"..."
Anthony's face twitched with skepticism after hearing this.
I understand what you're saying, but your tone...
If someone could read minds, they would definitely hear him thinking: Sir, you surely have some misunderstanding about "T-level spaces"?
T-level implies no survivors.
The content of your description certainly fits that classification.
But your tone... it's as if you're discussing a "D-level" space!
Moreover, what surprised them even more, given that it was "T-level," was where did this guy get his information?
Kai, however, seemed to know something and arched an eyebrow but did not inquire further.
Lena couldn't understand why, but watching the scene unfold before her, she felt an odd sense of familiarity.
There had been someone like this in the past, always calm and indifferent no matter the situation, providing an indescribable sense of trust, even in desperate times.
Shaking the impractical thoughts from her mind, she went straight to the point and asked, "Mr. Zorro, you seem to be quite familiar with this space?"
Su Lun walked ahead, his voice indifferent, "Mhm, I've been here a few times before."
Been here...
A few times?
If anyone said they had come out alive from a "T-level" space, anyone would think that person was boasting.
You say not only have you been here, but you've been here "a few times"?
Upon hearing this quantifier,
Kai and the others,
all had a very peculiar look in their eyes.
....
Su Lun also knew that his experiences were somewhat unbelievable when spoken aloud.
He had previously thought of using Fake Qiantiao's method, planning for Kai to take on the identity of "Zorro" to create an alibi.
And during the time he freed up his hands, he wasn't idle either.
He went over to the Olli family and killed a few people, showing his face;
then he came to the cursed space early to scout out the situation.
Su Lun had the things given to him by Mr. Jing, originally intending to come straight in and find "Madam Sereya" of the prison.
With those tokens, getting out safely wouldn't be a big issue.
But he always felt that since this was a T-level space, if he came just for business, it would be a waste.
Having the All-knowing Eye, he could naturally see all the intelligence regarding the cursed space.
[Dawn City's Central Prison]
Detailed Description: A super-large compound cursed space, T-level; once the central prison of Dawn City, this place confined countless extremely vicious criminals; if you want to stay alive, then stay in your cell and don't wander around; otherwise, the prison guards will kill all the escaping fugitives; without the pardon of that warden, you can never leave the space; requires a specific spell to open; once the space is activated, it will absorb all living beings within a three-kilometer radius.
When Su Lun saw the space's feature of "absorbing all living beings within a three-kilometer radius" for the first time, an idea immediately popped up in his mind: Assassin's trap!
This was a curse space that could be described as unsolvable.
Those who enter can only stay in their cells; breaking out would mean being treated as an "escaped convict" and killed by the prison guards.
But staying in your cell, you can't do anything.
Either die trapped or get killed.
So, in reality, there was only one way out, and that was to break out of jail and push through.
But in actuality... it was simply impossible!
The difficulty of this cursed space was truly "T-level"!
After his chat with Mr. Jing, Su Lun also knew that as time passed, the difficulty of a cursed space might downgrade due to the dissipation of energy and the lack of certain rules, weakening the NPCs inside.
Over this past millennium, the originally fifth and sixth order Magicians' remnants probably only had the strength of the second or third order, or maybe even lower.
This was also why the cursed space NPCs that Su Lun previously encountered were not of high orders.
But this place was very close to that "spatial passage," with dense dark spiritual power, keeping the cursed space well-preserved. And after all, it was a city where "Demigods" once resided, so the Dawn Central Prison had many super powerful beings confined within.
During Su Lun's previous investigation, he had already seen NPCs over the third order on the second level of the prison.
On the third and fourth levels, he estimated that there would be at least fourth and fifth order entities, or maybe even higher.
The fifth level held that "Madam Sereya," whose strength was unknown...
So, it was absolutely impossible for Old Lington's hunting team to push through!
Moreover, if Su Lun felt that he didn't do something, once Miss Lena and her team arrived, that team would be doomed.
After meeting and conversing with "Madam Sereya," he was even more convinced of his plan.
He wanted to use the space to dispose of those troubles.
And the young masters of the Olli and Clark families didn't disappoint; hearing that Lena was about to be annihilated, they indeed came to "kick her while she was down."
Then the previous scene unfolded.
....
As they walked, suddenly, Butler Anthony was the first to notice something and said with a serious tone, "Someone's coming. They seem to be after the young lady."
Su Lun seemed to have anticipated this, his tone still composed, "Mhm... just in time."
PS. Chapter two is not yet finished, will post later.

chapters.title: Chapter 199 - 198 Madman
chapters.content:
Oliver and Clark's families both brought their elite members; plus, with their equipment advantage, they quickly slaughtered all the NPC prison guards on the first floor, leaving them toppled chaotically.
Once the main force had gathered, they began to search for a method to break the curse's spatial lock.
The first level of the prison had a circular layout, and the two families combined had nearly a thousand people.
Even when attempting to avoid them, it was easy to bump into them.
Su Lun originally wanted to settle his people on the next level before dealing with these fellows.
Now it seemed they were going to be intercepted ahead of schedule.
Before they saw anyone, the old butler Anthony detected some commotion; with a flash, he positioned himself in front of the others and spoke with a grave tone, "Mr. Zorro, let me hold them off, please take the young lady and leave!"
Upon hearing this, Su Lun shook his head and said, "Among them is a very formidable figure. Even you, Mr. Anthony, would not be able to defeat him."
Anthony expressed his puzzlement, "Are you speaking of 'Thunder Sword King' Nero Redgrave? If it's him, even if I can't defeat him, I'm fairly certain I could stall him for a while."
"No, he's... far more formidable than Nero."
Su Lun didn't elaborate further, instead, he revealed his plan, "The exit is where I mentioned before. When the time comes, find an opportunity to break through. There are monsters below, so don't wander off. With the 'bail letter' I gave you, you should get captured by the second floor's prison guards. Don't resist, just wait for me in the jail cell."
Upon hearing this, did Miss Lena realize that Su Lun intended to stay behind alone to cover their retreat?
She shook her head decisively and said, "Mr. Zorro, we can help you!"
This young lady had completely shed her naivety; she no longer felt entitled to let others sacrifice themselves for her.
She knew very well that at this moment, only with everyone working together was there a chance of survival.
Su Lun glanced at her and said, "You'll die if you stay here."
Lena's tone remained unwavering, "Mr. Zorro, I've long made peace with facing death..."
Before she could finish, Su Lun interrupted her, his voice suddenly becoming very low, uttering a seemingly nonsensical remark, "No, what I mean is... staying here, you might be killed by me."
With that statement, the serious atmosphere suddenly became very strange.
All three of their expressions grew stern at once.
What did that mean?
Without explaining, Su Lun simply turned to Kai and said, "Kai, remember if you see my eyes turn red later, no matter what, take everyone and leave."
He knew that only his old friend would believe him unconditionally.
As he spoke, Su Lun took off the mask on his face, revealing his handsome features.
But even then, a trace of an eerie emotional fluctuation in his eyes added an ominous charm to his appearance.
"Are you confident?"
Kai frowned upon hearing that.
After a pause, he added, "I feel there's something off about your state."
Kai hadn't noticed while Su Lun was wearing the mask, but as they walked, he realized the aura around Su Lun was very strange.
It was as though a murderous intent he couldn't suppress was indiscriminately radiating out, giving anyone close to him a subtly unsettling sensation.
"Sure."
Saying this, Su Lun's voice, unable to contain his excitement, emitted a low growl, akin to a wild beast, "Hehehe... My body has never felt so exhilarated. Just thinking about killing them all gets my blood boiling..."
It felt like a beast beneath the human skin was about to burst free.
"You..."
In that instant, Anthony clearly perceived the change in Su Lun's emotions.
Even as a third-tier magician, he felt a chill run down his spine.
With furrowed brows, he asked, "Mr. Zorro, are you sure you're alright? Your spiritual power seems very odd..."
On closer examination, he realized the peculiar energy around Su Lun was not just spiritual power; his dark Spiritual Power was overflowing so violently it seemed like a wave of energy.
This persona was entirely different from the composed and graceful "Mr. Zorro" they had previously known—it was like they were two different people!
Hearing this, Su Lun reined in his emotions, and his expression suddenly returned to normal, as genteel as before.
He said, "No, I'm quite lucid now, it's just my body that is agitated. I'm brewing a very dangerous secret technique, so it's a bit hard to control my aura right now... Sorry to have frightened you."
Upon hearing this, Kai said no more.
He trusted Su Lun.
If that guy said he was confident, then he must be confident.
Although Anthony and Lena still had their doubts, they refrained from voicing them.
That was because the members of the two major families had already begun to close in.
....
Caught in a curse space unexpectedly, Young Master Danze and Young Master Ely were utterly terrified.
They had come just to revel in the misfortune of the Reiss family's main house, hoping to profit from their troubles if possible.
Even when hunting in the wilderness, it was their subordinates who went, not them in person.
But they never could have imagined...
That things would turn out this way.
Before coming here, they had heard that this was a suspected "T-level" curse space, extremely dangerous.
Now being trapped within, how could they not be afraid?
Besides, a mere probe revealed that the NPCs on the first floor of the prison were easy enough to handle, but the second floor was far more anomalous.
None of the scouts they sent had returned!
The elite teams led by second-tier professionals hadn't even surfaced before being completely wiped out below.
It made them think that this space, if not "T-level," was at least "S+."
Even with a third-tier professional, the chances of survival were not high.
Now, observing Su Lun and his companions, they no longer acted hastily.
Witnessing the peculiar behavior of that blue-skinned monster, they could deduce even with their toes that the activation of this space was related to these people.
Moreover, unless they wanted mutual destruction, the other party likely knew the way out.
Young Master Ely, having just saved his life by spending a fortune, had not even cleared the toxins when he was swept into the space, was too frustrated to express his rage. Surrounded by a group of guards, he questioned with a cold face, "Miss Lena, was it you who brought us in here? Damn it, do you realize what you're doing!"
Miss Lena frowned upon hearing that because she herself hadn't figured out what was happening.
She glanced at "Zorro" not far from her and saw that the expressionless gentleman hadn't made a statement.
There was no need to be polite to enemies, so she kept a stern face and remained silent.
In the distance, Young Master Danze, seeing that Miss Lena remained quiet, didn't dare to provoke her further, for fear that she might be contemplating mutual destruction.
Killing these few people now would be easy, but after that, how would they get out?
All he could do was speak persuasively, "Miss Lena, I think there might be some misunderstanding here. We can talk this over; everything is negotiable."
The heavily made-up young lady by his side was already pale with fear, "Oh my God... Lena, I am your sister! I just came to look. Why did you drag me into this? Tell me how to get out of this damn curse space..."
They were playing good cop, bad cop, and pulling the sympathy card, making it a headache to listen.
Su Lun narrowed his eyes, suddenly realizing what these guys were babbling on about for so long.
Although he hadn't sensed anyone approaching, his threads had detected someone "stealthed" heading towards Miss Lena.
Probably fearing exposure, the perpetrator was not moving fast.
It looked like the plan was to first capture this young lady.
Meanwhile, those guys on the other side were still blabbering to buy time.
....
Upon spotting the enemy, Su Lun let out a cold chuckle and suddenly spoke, "Mr. Anthony, could you hold that Nero guy off for a moment later? I'm going to make a move."
"I can."
Anthony agreed, but looking at the few hundred people on the other side, he frowned, "But there are too many enemies, I can't guarantee how long I can hold them off."
"No, just hold him back. That's enough."
Su Lun's killing intent grew ever stronger, and his tone turned chilly, "The rest... I'll take care of them!"
Anthony frowned upon hearing this.
He glanced at the throng of enemies, outnumbering them by a hundredfold, and immediately felt it was ludicrous.
In this surrounded situation, he could understand if it was a fight to the death.
But for this man to claim he was about to kill? Where was he getting his confidence from?
Recalling the madness in that face, he suddenly understood why something had felt off.
No matter how one looked at it, the Zorro before him appeared to be... a madman.
A complete madman!
A flicker of worry crossed Anthony's mind, pondering whether it was really wise to trust this man.
But before he could think further, Zorro, standing nearby, suddenly clawed at the void and murmured softly, "Caged Sparrow!"
With a sinister smile on his face, he reached out and pulled,
Suddenly,
threads of air solidified, and an invisible figure was pulled out.
It was a second-tier Assassin clad in a special alchemical cloak.
To deceive the perception of a third-tier professional, how skillful must this Assassin's stealth techniques be?
Anthony immediately guessed the identity of the newcomer, fear gripping his heart for a moment, "The 'Blade of Night', Ibn Jaliad!"
Ranked fifth among Old Lington's professional Assassins, a top-tier Assassin who had once single-handedly assassinated and seriously wounded a third-tier professional. The cloak he wore was none other than the famously sought-after assassin's gear, the "Assassin's Invisibility Cloak."
But how had "Zorro" discovered an Assassin that even he had not noticed?
At that moment, Anthony finally understood the strange energy fluctuation he had sensed before; it was this invisible hair.
But this...
Isn't this a Puppet Master's technique?
How come Zorro possesses this skill?
And... it's the highly recognizable "Witch's Hair"?!
Could it be...
A flurry of thoughts raced through Anthony's mind.
Reality gave him no time to ponder.
In the blink of an eye, surges of cold flame suddenly erupted from Zorro's body, and the dark golden octo-spear on his back was revealed.
"Clang!"
"Clang!"
"Clang!"
"..."
A series of sharp sounds rang out.
The black stingers at the tips of the spider spear shot out, and the tightly ensnared Assassin had no time to react; the octo-spear pierced straight towards all the Assassin's vital points—eyes, throat, abdomen, groin...
Assassins, valuing agility, normally did not wear full-body heavy armor.
But this Ibn Jaliad, aside from armor over his vitals, had also an extra layer of a strong imitation skin. Ordinarily, even if an ambush failed against a second-tier professional, this rune-infused skin would be enough to save his life.
Besides, his skills were also top-notch!
"Such quick reflexes on this man!"
Trapped, Ibn saw the incoming spider spear and had a bad feeling.
Only a top-tier Assassin could appreciate the swift speed of the spear and knew the required skill level was frighteningly high.
But his response was also lightning-fast. Twisting his body and using the momentum, he did not wrestle with the threads. Instead, he used a bizarre, counter-joint technique to quickly dislocate several of his own joints with a "crack" and "crack."
While this would reduce Ibn's mobility, the contorted body allowed him to create some space to maneuver among the threads, avoiding most of the vital points.
Just holding on for a moment would give his allies a chance to intervene, and he would have the opportunity to free himself from the threads!
