However, what Ibn Jaliad never expected was that the spider spear, even not hitting the vitals but striking on the rune skin, pierced through effortlessly with the cold flame.
It was an easy piercing that was clearly a result of overpowering magical rules.
Su Lun's comprehension of laws below the third tier had reached a level beyond the wildest dreams of ordinary second-tier professionals. The cold flame buff of the[Wu Shi]increased the power of its armor penetration to a degree that was simply undefendable for ordinary second-tier professionals!
After a few piercings, Ibn could no longer move, followed by several more to ensure the wound.
The throat was perforated, and blood spurted out violently.
The Assassin hadn't even had the chance to wait for companions to come to his aid before he was pierced by the spider spear and killed on the spot.
....
"This...!!"
Anthony, watching from the side, turned pale. He had just thought of intervening when the Assassin was already killed.
Not detecting the Assassin was one thing,
but what shocked him more were the characteristic techniques of controlling the silk threads and the octo-spear.
In all of Old Lington, only one person had these abilities.
That was... the SS-class wanted criminal, Su Lun.
This Mr. Zorro was actually Su Lun!
How is that possible?
Miss Lena's crystal eyes were filled with shock and confusion.
But at this moment, she finally realized where that familiar feeling came from.
Kai knew Su Lun was now very strong, but watching him in action, he was also greatly alarmed, "He... He has become this strong?!"
This "Blade of Night" Ibn was an infamous top-tier personality within the assassin profession.
This veteran assassin was in many ways stronger than himself, and now he was killed in a single encounter?
....
Just as Su Lun showed signs of making a move, the people opposite him didn't remain idle and launched their attacks at the same time.
The moment the spider spear pierced through the assassin, an ice arrow cunningly appeared a meter away from Su Lun.
The blue ice arrow moved at a strange speed, seemingly only leaving the bowstring, yet it reached him in the blink of an eye.
Recalling the trajectory in his mind, he realized the arrow wasn't shot at a constant speed but instead accelerated explosively in three phases, each faster than the last.
After the three explosive bursts of speed, it was already faster than a sniper bullet!
At that distance, there was absolutely no way to avoid it.
Even if Anthony had seen it, he wouldn't have had time to help!
If Su Lun hadn't killed Ibn with one strike just now, this arrow would have been enough to pose a lethal threat to him.
Even having spotted it, he would have had to turn back to dodge.
Unfortunately, the killing was too fast, and the arrow didn't pose much of a threat to Su Lun.
His eyes had already clearly tracked the trajectory of that arrow the moment it was fired.
Fast as the arrow was, it was not faster than his perception.
The explosive speed was tricky and unpredictable, but the trajectory was still a straight line!
Su Lun was also well aware that this was a technique of the mysterious society's "Ice Disaster Elder" Iori Randis.
After using the spider spear to kill the assassin, he nonchalantly tilted his head slightly and watched as the ice arrow grazed his face with a gust of cold air, muttering to himself, "Tsk tsk... the 'Frost Bow of Kaione', huh!"
The ice arrow didn't hit its target, and instead struck a wall several meters away.
In an instant, an intense chill erupted, and the surrounding temperature dropped significantly.
With a loud "bang", the terrifying cold air burst open, instantly turning the entire wall into an ice barrier, extinguishing the fire in the braziers in the hallway.
Had that arrow hit someone, they would likely have been frozen solid immediately.
...
"What kind of reaction speed is this!"
Anthony was taken aback.
While he was shocked, the old butler transformed into a magic ram and charged forward.
Now that he knew the true identity of "Zoro", he also knew that Su Lun had a Black Scythe!
With his interference, along with the Black Scythe, they might be able to kill the 'Thunder Sword King' Nero.
If they could eliminate the most troublesome third-tier professional among the enemies, the situation would instantly improve!
"That's Su Lun!"
"Damn it, watch out for his Black Scythe!"
"Beware of invisible targets! Reveal, powder!"
"...."
Recognizing the person who made the move as Su Lun, everyone from the two great families was terrified.
Especially the high-ranking professionals, all of them kept a close watch on every move Su Lun made, fearing the sudden appearance of the Black Scythe.
"Hmph! I've been waiting for you!"
Young Master Danze looked at Su Lun's revealing of himself not with alarm but with delight.
He naturally knew that he absolutely could not allow Su Lun to use the Black Scythe.
Although he was half a beat slow and missed the first round of attacks, he confidently took out a brilliantly glowing chessboard and with the pinch of a sorcerer's seal, the Hexagram Array manifested.
In an instant, a huge black and white checkered chessboard appeared out of nowhere.
A beam of light shot out, enveloping the distant Su Lun without waiting for any reaction and forcibly pulled him into the chessboard.
After killing one, Su Lun looked at the changing surroundings without any surprise.
"Tsk tsk... finally here, huh?"

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - 199 [Stanitz's Chessboard]
chapters.content:
The scenery around Su Lun changed, and when he focused his eyes again, he had already appeared in an independent space with black and white squares.
There wasn't the slightest bit of surprise on his face.
He lifted his hand to try, and he could still create ripples in space.
That meant, from the beginning, this chessboard space had no restrictive effect on someone who had mastered "Spatial Ability."
Hmm...
That is to say, for him, Su Lun, it was utterly useless.
However, certain law restrictions meant he couldn't retrieve anything from his Space Ring, that kind of inferior spatial storage device.
For anyone else faced with this situation, they'd probably have to fight this guy based on brute strength alone.
But this did not limit Su Lun's folding space.
Even though, he didn't need to take out anything to kill this guy.
Just as well.
He had cast the bait for so long, and this guy had finally brought this treasure with him.
[Stanitz's Chessboard]
Description: Chess should be a fair one-on-one duel.
Characteristic: By using this chessboard, you can forcibly select a lifeform target and engage in a one-on-one duel within a restricted space until one side dies or voluntarily releases the duel; it's not a cursed item, but once you contract to use the chessboard, the residual regrets of that old lich will haunt you in your dreams, compelling you to play chess. If you can't beat him, then keep him company for more games.
Detailed Explanation: This is a soul container for ancient alchemy known as 'Mishael Toxter', who, through dark magic and necromancy, transformed himself into a lich; it's an artifact from the Dawn Era, the time is too far gone, the lich's soul is shattered, and the curse characteristics have lost much of their power; perhaps its value isn't just the chessboard itself, that old lich who constantly mutters to himself that he is the 'King of the Talcro Empire,' chat more with him, and you might learn some secrets of the Dawn Era.
"Forced spatial restrictions... what a great item," Su Lun scanned the information identified, which was almost what he had known beforehand.
No wonder that 'Trickster' Lloyd was obsessed with it even at death, this chessboard was indeed well-suited for Puppet Masters.
Equipment's worth isn't in its strength, but in how well it aligns with one's professional abilities.
Though it appeared the chessboard held no offensive power, it could forcibly keep the target in this confined space for a 1V1 duel, with no escape.
With an ability like [Puppet Theater], which covers an area with puppets, it's indeed hard to find an equal within the same rank.
No wonder Young Master Danze was so confident.
Theoretically, this thing could really restrain Su Lun.
But in reality... it was of no use.
....
Young Master Danze had waited for this day for a long time.
Since that encounter with "Su Lun" at the Dawn Camp's marketplace where he had a few hairs stolen, his smooth-sailing life began to encounter frequent frustrations.
In the battle at the White Monastery, this guy snatched his opportunity, killed his guards, leading to his family's loss of face; afterward, during an ambush, again he killed his teacher and ten secondary-order masters along with a hundred elite fighters, causing huge losses for the Olli family; just a few days ago, the audacity to challenge him to his face...
Time and again, Danze had bottled up anger—unless he personally killed this guy, he felt he couldn't swallow that anger.
Looking at Su Lun in front of him, his sorcerer's seals in his hand shifted rapidly, his eyes filled with hatred as he said, "You think you're worthy of opposing me?"
Just an outer city lowlife bullying others with banned items.
Hmph, now without your scythe, let's see how you die!
Listening to these rather juvenile words, Su Lun slightly lifted his eyelids.
He was very familiar with those sorcerer's seals—it was the preparation for [Puppet Theater].
The proficiency was quite good; it was clear that it was taught by a master.
It's probably because these spoiled young masters feel they need to say a few words to showcase their sense of superiority.
If it were somewhere else, Su Lun might have been interested in bantering with the young master for a while.
But now, with all the excitement outside, he had no interest in wasting time here.
The moment the thought occurred, he too began forming sorcerer's seals with his hand.
It was with this action that Danze's gaze rigidly fixed on him.
How could he not be familiar with this action?
"He... how does he know [Puppet Theater]?"
Although he knew that Su Lun had the detailed scrolls of this Puppet Mastery technique, how could one possibly master it without years of arduous training?
Shock crossed Danze's face not only because Su Lun was using the same move as him, but also because Su Lun's seal formation speed was even faster than his own!
What's going on...
Danze was greatly alarmed in his heart.
[Puppet Theater]'s Mystic Art required a total of thirty-six sorcerer's seals.
He had the first move, so logically, he should have an absolute speed advantage in executing the technique.
But just when he was halfway through the seals, Su Lun's movements suddenly caught up with his?
Sorcerer's seals were not just about changing hand gestures; the more complex the seals, the more intricate the energy manipulation.
One must be not only fast but also precise, or else the effort would fall short.
Yet, the guy before him was even more adept?
Seeing that proficiency, Danze felt like he was seeing the shadow of his own teacher.
At that moment, he even doubted his own eyes.
But reality didn't give Young Master Danze the chance to think further.
One after another, almost simultaneously, the last seals were formed.
In the sky, two blue Hexagram Arrays lit up at the same time, both astoundingly invoking "Puppet Mastery · Puppet Theater"!
As the Formations appeared, two massive crosses slowly emerged in the air.
When the same Spell appears in a limited space at the same time, a situation of "energy domination" occurs.
The stronger side would easily demolish the other's Spell.
When the two crosses appeared at the same time, one of them, indeed, rapidly disintegrated.
"I... I'm actually losing to him?!"
Young Master Danze's complexion changed drastically; even if he forcefully added a handful of cursed crystals to supplement the energy of the Hexagram Array under his feet, he couldn't prevent the collapse of his Spell.
This overwhelming momentum was a sign of a crushing difference in rank.
This also meant that, whether in terms of the laws or the understanding of Spells, there was a crushing gap between the two of them!
Is he a third-level?
How could that be possible...
Danze's face turned ashen.
The ultimate killing method that he had eagerly prepared for so long had unexpectedly resulted in this outcome?
....
Su Lun paid no attention to Young Master Danze's shock.
As the cross formed in the sky, countless threads cascaded down like a dense curtain.
Young Master Danze also wanted to rely on his own threads and puppets for defense, but whether it was the quality of grafting, strength, dark spiritual power, or proficiency in Spellcasting...
Or anything else,
The gap between the two was too great.
When thread met thread, there was no contest; they disintegrated upon contact.
Danze could only defend passively, using the threads of his graft to protect his body.
Su Lun gave him no chance at all, with a grasp into the void, he manipulated the threads to tightly wrap the fellow into a silken cocoon.
Seeing that he was about to be subdued, Young Master Danze hurriedly opened the space of the chessboard and let out a desperate cry, "Save me!"
Kill him?
No, Su Lun did not intend to do so.
As long as Young Master Danze was alive, the Oliver family's guards would keep coming to rescue him.
This was much more convenient than chasing down each one to kill.
Su Lun looked around at the collapsing chessboard scenery, licked his lips, and the ferocity in his eyes grew even more intense, "Now... it's just the beginning."
....
Mr. Zorro suddenly transformed into the SS-ranked fugitive Su Lun, and amidst the shock of Lena and Butler Anthony, there was also a hint of anticipation.
Just a moment ago, Su Lun, who had single-handedly slain Ibn Jaliad, the Blade of Night, had demonstrated a level of power that could truly be described as astounding.
Moreover, with the sealed scythe, it had to be said, they even had a chance to turn the tide.
But unexpectedly, in their first encounter, that Mr. Danze suddenly produced a chessboard treasure and teleported people away?
Without question, Young Master Danze must have been confident he could counter Su Lun, which is why he would do such a thing.
This sent a chill through the hearts of Kai and the others.
"Mr. Kai, take the lady and go! I will hold them off!"
"Alright!"
"..."
With the situation being urgent, there was no room for hesitation.
The old butler had already made up his mind for a do-or-die resistance; with a roar, his entire being transformed into a robust Black Wool Demon Sheep, standing directly in the line of gunfire. Even alchemical bullets that hit him were deflected away with a "clang."
However, the high-ranking professionals from the two great families were not weak either, and a group of them swiftly gathered around.
In the front was the third-level Thunder Sword King Nero, behind was the Three Disasters Elder from the Mysterious Association, with more than twenty second-level professionals and nearly a thousand elites...
In an instant, countless Spells poured down like a torrential downpour.
Even though the Demon Sheep's body and rune armor could withstand artillery, with one encounter, it was bombarded with intensive attacks, causing it to vomit blood.
The old butler, with the thought of delaying them for even a moment, aimed to attract the majority of the fire to create a slim chance of escape for Kai and Lena.
But unexpectedly, before he had a chance to fight with all his might, he suddenly heard a scream that echoed through the prison,
"Save me!"
The despairing cry for help, which seemed to belong to Young Master Danze, was ear-piercing.
Looking again, Danze, once protected by black threads, was completely wrapped into a cocoon by silver threads.
With enormous pressure squeezing like a python, the young master let out a cry, spewing blood from his mouth.
This scream also seemed to hit the pause button on the fierce battle.
The troops engaged in battle were momentarily stunned.
What was going on?
The fight had ended in just a few breaths?
The "Puppet Theater" spell in the sky hadn't even dissipated, and looking at the silver threads on the cross, the "Thunder Sword King" Nero's face turned dark as he instantly understood something.
He was well aware of the function of "Stanitz's Chessboard," so Danze had been defeated within that restricted space?
At the same time, he was filled with disbelief and alarm, "This... how does Su Lun also know this spell!"
Before the crowd could ponder further, at that moment, Su Lun, who had reappeared, suddenly pulled out several scrolls and spread them out in the air, crying out, "Release!"
The scrolls exploded, and their fragments filled the sky.
Looking again, the gloomy prison corridor suddenly filled with hundreds of red-faced rune dolls.
They wore sinister, eerie smiles on their faces, and their lower jaws trembled incessantly, emitting a low-frequency, hair-raising strange noise.
There were ones with single heads, double heads...
Ones with two arms, four arms, six arms...
Like kites, over a hundred bizarre puppets floated in the air, staring directly at the enemies surrounding them.
By this moment, the red glow in Su Lun's eyes had gradually become apparent.
Even those of weaker perception could feel as though he was a burning flame, his special spiritual power radiating from his body, like spreading ripples, causing onlookers to feel somewhat dazed.
Su Lun revealed his teeth in a wide grin, his lips curling up in a mad and excited smile.
He let out a beast-like, deep and soft cry from his throat: "Secret Technique·A Hundred Tricks at Night!"
....
Is this still a Puppet Master?
Seeing Su Lun controlling a hundred puppets at the same time left everyone stunned.
It was only now that the people from the Olli and Clark families realized how ignorant their previous thoughts had been.
The SS-wanted felon Su Lun they knew from reports, and the one before them with such combat power, were simply not on the same level!
Not just Young Master Danze who had underestimated the enemy; before this event, almost everyone thought Su Lun was just a wanted felon who was lucky to have mastered a method to evade the repercussions of the Black Scythe Curse and had escaped repeatedly by chance.
But reality struck them a heavy slap, waking them up instantly.
Putting aside the combat prowess of the hundred puppets, the mountainous, oppressive sensation of death emanating from Su Lun at this moment was definitely not fake.
It was the kind of feeling that made even second-tier professionals' scalps tingle.
Who else among their peers could make them feel as if they might be killed with just a glance?
Just from the sensation alone, they knew this guy's true strength was absolutely terrifying!
Even the lone third-tier professional, the "Thunder Sword King" Nero, turned very solemn upon seeing Su Lun.
"Such strong spiritual power, no wonder he can control so many puppets..."
Seeing this, the eyes of this veteran third-tier harbored nothing but solemnity.
He didn't believe for a second that these hundred-plus puppets were mere bluffs.
The intuition of Nero told him that he should kill that "Su Lun."
But with Butler Anthony desperately holding him back, he simply couldn't free his hands.
....
With Su Lun's entrance as a Puppet Master, one man turned into an army, forcefully bridging the huge gap in numbers that was previously in the opponent's favor.
Although there was still a disparity in numbers, the puppet army's momentum was in no way inferior to the two great families.'
As soon as the puppets entered the fray, Su Lun didn't give the enemy any time to react as he controlled the eight-armed spider spear.
Originally, even if Su Lun's skills were high, it would be impossible for him to precisely control a hundred puppets at the same time,
but now, things were different.
Su Lun gradually released those suppressed emotions, his thoughts expanded, and a whole new world appeared before him.
Joy, anger, sorrow, thought, grief, fear, shock...
Those suppressed emotions were like different "Su Lun's", helping him multitask in controlling the puppets.
When it came to killing, "they" were all very interested.
His senses became clearer and clearer, feeling as though he was drawing out threads in a dazed state, yet also feeling ecstatic...
Indulgence in his emotions brought his body to the pinnacle of pleasure.
Su Lun licked his lips, growing more and more enamored with the sensation of extreme excitement and pleasure.
With a flick of his finger, hundreds of puppets surged wildly toward the crowd.
"Click" "Click" "Click"...
The friction of the wooden puppet joints formed a harrowing symphony of sounds.
Watching those terrifying red-faced puppets flying towards them, people from both the Olli and Clark families raised their guns in unison, and gunfire erupted.
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
"Snap!"
"..."
The two great families were not without sharpshooters, and many puppets were hit.
But in an instant, they found that ordinary bullets were almost useless against these puppets.
Bullets rattled against the puppets' bodies, but these seemingly wooden creatures had become indestructible thanks to the enhancement of high-grade runes.
These cunning dolls were no longer the crude creations Su Lun once made.
Ever since he stripped a fifth-level professional of their Soul Shard, Su Lun's understanding of second and third tier runes and enchantments had surpassed most of Old Lington's "rune masters."
All the dolls were enchanted and written with second-tier runes, some even with third-tier knowledge.
In the realm of alchemy, the division of rune tiers signifies the might they possess.
Second and third-tier runes meant the strength of their offense and defense was of second and third tier as well.
Even if alchemy bullets occasionally penetrated the puppets, what of it?
The troublesome part about Puppet Masters was that as long as the controller didn't die, all fighting was meaningless.
Even if they were reduced to mutilated limbs, the puppets could still kill!
....
"Kill that guy!"
"Be careful, don't use area attacks. Save the young master first!"
"..."
Yet it was with Su Lun's pull on the thread that the first round of gunfire failed to stop the puppet army, the fearless puppets pouncing into the midst of the crowd like hungry tigers upon sheep.
The puppets' daggers were inscribed with third-tier runes like "Armor Piercing," "Sharpness," and "Magic Breaking"... able to effortlessly slice through metal and stone.
For first-tier professionals, apart from those in heavy armor, it was almost one stab, one bloody hole.
At first encounter, the puppets charged into the crowd, killing with screams everywhere.
And moreover, the true horror began when those cunning dolls got up close!
The most troublesome aspect of the rune puppets was the spiritual power runes within them.
"Nightmare Dolls" could cause visual and auditory spiritual confusion, and once someone got within ten meters, the effects would intensify.
If the dolls managed to get close, even second-tier professionals would suffer greatly.
Caught off guard, they would be stabbed to death by the puppet in a moment of dazed expression.
Cluster attacks were even more formidable.
Su Lun's puppet legion caught these people entirely off guard.
Soon, members of the two great families realized the problem.
The commander screamed hoarsely into the communicator.
"Don't look at the puppets' faces, there's a visual illusion technique!"
"Don't listen to..."
"Spread out..."
But,
Knowing is one thing,
But what of it?
Most professionals relied on vision and hearing to catch their targets. If they didn't look at the puppets and closed off their hearing, how could they fight?
This was precisely the troublesome part of the rune puppets.
For a moment, this group deeply experienced the terror of being dominated by rune puppets.
....
The strength of the "Puppet Theater" lay in its almost unstoppable power within a certain range!
Within a radius of a hundred or so meters where Su Lun stood, he had absolute control.
The puppet manipulation was extremely flexible, and with their group attacks, there were no equals in their wake.
However, Puppet Masters also had their weaknesses.
Control distance was a significant issue.
The members of the two great families were almost powerless against the puppet legion, and the experienced commanders issued retreat orders, with everyone hastily backing off.
Su Lun watched those guys run far, the puppets unable to catch up.
He didn't waste the effort.
He directly brought the tightly bound Young Master Danze to his front, the binding threads were partially loosened to reveal his head.
Then, Su Lun stabbed the guy in the buttocks.
The Young Master Danze cooperated with a painful cry, "Ah... save me!"
The screams echoed through the prison corridors, lasting a long time.
PS. There's one more chapter; I'll post it later.

chapters.title: Chapter 201 - 200: No Solution
chapters.content:
With Young Master Danze as a shield in hand, the two major families naturally hesitated to kill Su Lun.
They dared not unleash large-scale, covering spells, and even refrained from firing their guns recklessly.
Su Lun's keen perception and quick reflexes left no possibility for them to take him down with a sniper.
And with the example of Ibn Jaliad from the "Blade of Night" being instantly killed previously, they didn't dare send assassins to approach him stealthily anymore.
In the "Puppet Theater," it was simply impossible to silently approach Su Lun, who was surrounded by countless invisible threads.
Especially since Su Lun was surrounded by a bunch of ready-to-act tricky dolls, like the "Black Hole Doll," the "Nightmare Doll," and the famous puppet "Twelve Armored Knights" from the Trickster Lloyd.
The puppets formed an iron barrel formation around him, making it nearly impossible to kill him without some special means.
Moreover, there were those invisible zombies and black scythes hidden somewhere, which even third-tier professionals feared.
....
People could only vent their frustration on the puppets, but ordinary people couldn't even defeat the puppets.
These pain-resistant and fearless puppets, once broken, were just broken.
Often, destroying one puppet would result in several people dying.
More than a hundred puppets, that would mean hundreds of people dead...
The situation suddenly changed.
The side with more people was instead beaten back and didn't dare to approach too close to the domain of the Puppet Theater, confronting it from a distance.
The sounds of gunfire also gradually died down.
Su Lun didn't even pay attention to those people. This prison was not small, and with so many people needing to run separately, it was really not possible to chase each one down.
However, the Young Master Danze he was holding fared terribly.
With no one coming to die for him, the hostage suffered two more stabs.
Young Master Danze screamed in agony, and the fear of death made him lose all the demeanor of a privileged young master, crying out with a sobbing voice, "Come and save me!"
He was genuinely scared,
and had truly felt the despair of death approaching.
He had never felt such a terrifying intent to kill from someone.
Approaching Su Lun closely, that tangible intent to kill was like needles, frightening him so much that his soul shivered.
Those crazily surging negative emotions were like an expanding balloon, invisible but clearly felt...
Danze had no doubt that the moment those emotions exploded completely, this demon would stab him to death immediately.
This feeling of not knowing when the explosion would occur was the most terrifying.
Young Master Danze wailed nonstop,
The gunfire suddenly stopped,
And the battle between the two third-tiers also came to a halt temporarily.
Although Nero, the Thunder Sword King, seemed to be a notch stronger than Anthony, he was not sure he could take down this devoted old butler quickly.
Instead, once entangled, he was more worried about that black scythe that could appear at any moment.
That's why he deliberately kept his distance.
Anthony didn't dare pursue, as he did not want to stray too far from Leina.
Seeing the increasingly intense red glow in Su Lun's eyes, Kai and the other two knew what they had to do. During this lull in the fighting, the three had already slowly moved closer to the passage leading to the second level.
Although worried, seeing Su Lun's current state, they also knew they could not help him.
The military commander of the Oliver family stepped forward and said in a deep voice, "Put down Young Master Danze, and we can talk about your terms."
"Talk?"
Su Lun smiled with a playful look, shaking his head, "Tsk tsk...no, I just want to kill all of you."
As he spoke, he stabbed Danze again.
This stab pierced an artery, causing blood to gush out massively.
Without immediate treatment, Danze would not survive.
This was also to force the people of the Oliver family to come forward and save him.
....
While the battle was fiercely ongoing, a middle-aged man with glasses leaned against the wall in a corner of the prison, quietly observing the situation.
Although he wore the Oliver family's battle suit, seeing the bodies strewn all around, his face showed no intention of intervening.
Instead, smelling the strong stench of blood, the middle-aged man's face showed an expression of enjoyment and pleasure.
His eyes only sparkled a bit when they landed on Su Lun.
.....
Su Lun had no intention to negotiate, and actually, neither did the people of the Oliver family.
They were just looking for an opportunity to launch a surprise attack.
In their eyes, Su Lun was a must-kill target.
And just then, suddenly, a burst of lightning flickered among the enemy crowd.
Secret techniques all needed a certain amount of time to gather the energy of the formation, the higher the level, the more time needed. But this burst of lightning erupted very suddenly, as if time had locally sped up several times, instantly completing the "Thundercloud Flash Chain."
This was a second-tier Thunder Spell, not very lethal, but it had one effect: Paralyzing enemies in the area.
The use of it now to save someone couldn't be better.
Su Lun's sharp eyes caught the surge of purple thunder and guessed that the initiator was Declan Menard, the elder of the mysterious association known as the Thunder Speaker. To cast a spell so swiftly, it was evident that the special time curse item "Watkins's Pocket Watch" was also employed.
He was not a bit surprised, but instead lightly exclaimed, "So that's where it is..."
How fast could the thunder light be?
The moment the light flashed, the explosive thunderbolt was already in front of him.
Together with the puppets around Su Lun and even Young Master Danze, they were shocked, not giving him the chance to use the "Black Hole Doll" to absorb the thunder.
"Zi Zi~"
"Zi Zi~"
A vast flash of thunder swept by, gone in a flash.
The injured Young Master Danze was shocked into foaming at the mouth, and Su Lun stood dumbfounded on the spot, seemingly finding the paralysis effect satisfactory.
Almost simultaneously with the flare of thunder, several second-tier professionals from the Oliver family rushed forward without hesitation.
They feared Su Lun would recover, and they were also afraid of the Tier 3 Antony coming to the rescue.
"Bang!"
A loud noise from an alchemy bullet.
The sniper's bullets were faster, faster than the professionals, striking Su Lun in the head.
Unexpectedly, there was no bloody scene of his head exploding.
With a "clang,"
the bullet hit his head, emitting a crisp metallic sound.
On closer inspection, Su Lun's scalp was broken, revealing a layer of dark golden glowing skin.
Seeing this, the leading professionals' faces drastically changed, screaming in their minds, "No, it's synthetic skin!"
They hadn't expected Su Lun to have covered his face with another layer of synthetic skin, concealing the abnormalities of his real body surface. Only when they got close did they detect the thick gold element.
Sensing trouble at this point, they instinctively felt it was bad news, but it was already too late.
Because of their rapid, fierce charge, they had already entered the range of the "Puppet Theater."
Just as their sense of danger flared, they suddenly saw Su Lun turning his head toward them, revealing a wicked smile.
As if he had anticipated this.
When they came to their senses, the air around them suddenly became viscous.
The invisible witch's hair strands suddenly solidified, making them feel as if they were in the middle of a waterfall, surrounded by silvery strands.
Su Lun suddenly yanked with one hand, murmuring softly, "Silk Control Secret Method - Flower Waterfall!"
The witch's hair entwined in a special way, leveraging and conveying forces, resulting in multiple, even tenfold the twisting force. Countless strands wove into a web, the more the trapped prey struggled, the tighter it bound them.
Those few who led the charge, mostly in light armor, had fallen into the same predicament as the previously slain "Blade of Night," Ibn Jaliad.
After Su Lun secured them, he didn't give them any chance to escape; the eight-legged spider spear "swooshed" a few times, piercing vital parts and leaving gaping wounds.
The second-tier professionals had no chance to react and died on the spot.
After casually reaping a wave of Soul Shards,
to the astonishment of those at a distance, Su Lun did not stay within the coverage area of the "Puppet Theater," but made a baffling move.
Like a barbaric warrior, he charged toward the direction from which the thunder had surged!
....
Although they couldn't understand why Su Lun wasn't paralyzed, and why he had killed those few second-tier executives who came to rescue in one encounter,
as he charged towards them, people from both major families opened fire in unison.
The next instant, a scene of despair appeared before them.
Su Lun faced the barrage of bullets without flinching or dodging.
Bullets hit him, emitting a "pit-pat" crisp sound.
Even faced with a handheld cannon, he could easily dodge by merely tilting his head.
After the synthetic skin layer was completely broken, a copper cast body shining with golden lacquer appeared before everyone!
Upon closer inspection, the dense shower of bullets had not caused him any damage.
Seeing this, a thought of disbelief surfaced in everyone's minds.
A Puppet Master, actually withstanding gunfire and ammunition, charging forward like a bloodied bull warrior?
Who the hell would believe it?!
Even more surprising to them was the speed exhibited by Su Lun.
Just as he surged forward, with a "snap," a loud bang resounded through the air.
Then, in the eyes of most people, Su Lun's figure suddenly dispersed.
How familiar was this scene?
In the crowd, Young Master Eli's soul was terrified to the point of dissociating, that hauntingly familiar sensation had returned...
Outside the cursed space previously, wasn't it this same ghostly technique that had almost killed him used by that blue-skinned man?
...
"Stepping on Air! No, wait... it's not just ordinary Stepping on Air!"
From afar, "Thunder Sword King" Nero finally changed color.
Previously, he was only wary of the dark scythe in Su Lun's hands; other elements, whether it were puppets or silk threads, posed very limited threats to him as a third-tier professional.
But now, seeing Su Lun clad in gold paint and using the Stepping on Air technique,
he realized something was wrong.
"Is this the Flesh Alchemy Technique condensed from third-tier gold elements?"
Nero finally understood,
that merely this Body Technique, which could withstand alchemy bullets, had already made Su Lun unbeatable.
Even if he took action himself, it would be very difficult to kill him.
Therefore, this also meant that if there were no third-tier professionals present, Su Lun, with his ability to control hundreds of puppets and the dark scythe, could indeed kill everyone here!
"What kind of monster is this!"
Nero's heart was no longer just shocked; it was a tumultuous upheaval.
Only third-tier professionals could appreciate how rare and difficult it was to master such impervious Flesh Alchemy—a top-tier Body Technique that required a deep understanding of the laws!
Stepping on Air, Flesh Alchemy, and even a Puppet Master...
He suddenly realized that even without Anthony, he himself had no confidence in killing this SS-ranked fugitive, Su Lun.
....
Meanwhile, the shock in the hearts of Kai and the two others, who were preparing to head to the second floor at any moment, was no less intense.
Kai's eyes trembled violently: "He is actually this strong..."
This was a scalp-numbing display of strength, charging invincibly into the enemy ranks.
Anthony's face twitched fiercely, feeling like his prestige as the 'ceiling of professionals,' a third-tier, faded in the presence of that golden-painted young man.
And Lena was already speechless, as if thrown back to their initial cave encounter: he said he could, then he certainly could.
Seeing this scene, they finally understood what Su Lun had said earlier.
When he said he would kill all these people, he was serious!
...
Although Su Lun's profession and growth were not directed towards physical enhancement, the speed of Stepping on Air was still so fast it left no time for reaction.
Such speed naturally allowed him to evade more than 90% of the attacks.
The few that did hit, landing on his body condensed with third-tier laws [Vajra], were neither painful nor bothersome.
His target was precise, heading straight for Declan, the Thunder Speaker who had just used the thunder spell.
The Female Sorceress holding the magic wand and silver pocket watch hadn't reacted before Su Lun had already charged in front of her. Leveraging his momentum, he thrust straight with his spider limbs. Such an attack was simply unavoidable for a magician relying on physical speed.
Just at this life-or-death moment, Declan had no choice but to press the stopwatch in her hands, and suddenly the surroundings slowed down significantly.
The deadly spider spear was also easily avoided.
She had just thought of escaping further when suddenly, wrinkles bizarrely appeared on her face, and her hair rapidly turned gray. In the blink of an eye, she had aged fifty years, turning into a white-haired old woman.
This sign was clearly a backlash curse from Watkins's pocket watch!
Declan, suffering from the backlash, no longer had the strength to fight.
Su Lun easily pierced her chest with a spear, extracted the Soul Shard, and then took the pocket watch in his hand.
"Got the item."
Su Lun muttered to himself, then raised his hand and seemed to grasp something invisible in the air.
He curved his finger, and the stopwatch floated in mid-air, then with a "click", it was pressed.
These barely perceivable movements caused Nero, who had been watching Su Lun from a distance, to change his complexion dramatically; he stomped the ground and retreated explosively, trying to leave the spot he was standing on.
"Hehe... the corpse really is usable,"
Su Lun felt something and the corners of his mouth curved higher and higher.
This was also why he had been concealing his strength and had not fully erupted.
He wanted to see if the corpse could use the watch too.
Now, it seemed, as he had anticipated.
Now, he truly had the power to slay a third-tier professional!
[Xiupunos's Blade of Night]+[Oz's Ice Man's Shroud]+[Watkins's Pocket Watch]= an unbeatable mega weapon!
The pocket watch could provide a 2 to 5 times acceleration in individual time, making the corpse's movements extremely fast.
Though luck played a factor, if he gambled on a speed more than four times faster, Su Lun was confident that even third-tier professionals would not easily react!
Moreover... the corpse wasn't afraid of any life-shortening backlash.
That one slash gambled on reaching a speed of 3.7 times.
The swinging speed of the scythe was astoundingly fast.
....
Although Nero reacted extremely quickly, that one slash still appeared on his right shin bone.
Su Lun had predicted that the man would dart aside, the body would move, but the feet would be the last to move.
This slice, not aimed at a vital point, targeted the leg.
As expected, it directly severed the third-tier swordsman's calf.
The spatial rifts lightly sliced through, and a moment later, blood "sputtered" out.
A severed foot remained in place, Nero, unable to stabilize, stumbled and fell to the ground.
After all, he was a third-tier fighter, and even with a broken leg, his reaction was still incredibly fast; the moment he fell, he fiercely thrust his remaining leg and burst forward, escaping Su Lun's line of sight.
Although he didn't die, this third-tier fighter was essentially disabled after losing his leg.
The effect of the black sickle was just so OP,
either it missed,
or if it hit,
if it didn't kill, it crippled.
Su Lun sneered coldly and disregarded the enemies fleeing around him; he charged toward the direction of the severed leg.
This third-tier had to be killed first!
...
The members from the two great families should have breathed a sigh of relief when they finally saw Su Lun, the invisible zombie.
After all, they had prepared many battle plans specifically against the black sickle.
For instance, the tactic of overwhelming numbers, area control tactics, reveal powder...
The sickle could only strike once at a time, and many second-tier professionals could avoid it if careful.
With so many of them charging together, they were bound to find an opportunity.
After all, previous information indicated that Su Lun was just an ordinary second-tier who could run a bit faster.
But now...
Seeing that golden lacquered figure using "Stepping on Air" to charge forward, was that still an ordinary second-tier?
Moreover, the zombie who had gotten hold of the pocket watch, even a third-tier was maimed and lost a leg, who could stop him?
And this pocket watch, who the hell brought it?!
This has produced an unsolvable monster; who could deal with it?
Of course, the item was brought by members of some umbrella organization.
They too realized that things had gotten out of hand, beyond control.
But they felt wronged in their hearts,
because they had no idea that they would encounter SS wanted criminal Su Lun here!
...
Su Lun advanced swiftly, passing by as if avoiding the god of plague; nobody dared to provoke him.
With such a deadly weapon as the black sickle in hand, whoever blocked, died.
And those below second-tier didn't even qualify to block.
After being pummeled by inconsequential bullets, Su Lun swiftly arrived beside the severed leg, picked up the furiously bleeding leg, then pulled out a black voodoo doll and smeared the blood on it.
With a fierce slap, the doll shattered.
This series of movements didn't give anyone a chance to escape far.
Meanwhile,
Inside a nearby prison cell, the legless Nero, who initially planned to ambush Su Lun, let out a muffled groan.
Su Lun's ears twitched, and he immediately pinpointed the exact location, raising his hand and slashing with his blade.
A spatial rift swept across, accompanied by the faint sound of fabric tearing.
Target hit.
Suddenly, with a "pop" sound in the air, Su Lun had already appeared in front of the prison cell.
But as he materialized, a fierce sword qi burst forth, slicing the arriving figure into two.
Yet no blood was seen.
Nero looked at the puppet on the ground and gave a bitter smile.
It wasn't an undeserved loss.
So strong and yet so cautious, even in a direct combat, defeating him would be very difficult...
With his waist and guts sliced open, he no longer had the strength to fight again.
This last strike didn't succeed in ambushing, and there was no chance left.
Su Lun conveniently ended the life of this famous third-tier strongman.
Stepping into the prison cell, he devoured the cloud of mist, the red glow in his eyes becoming overwhelming, no longer suppressible.
....
Su Lun walked out of the prison cell and headed back to the corridor he came from.
The people from the two big families had already gathered together, seemingly determined to fight a decisive battle.
Su Lun didn't hurry to attack but let out a freakish laugh and greeting the empty prison, "Mr. Gerald, if you don't take action soon, I might just kill them all, you know?"
He knew that those who were enjoying the spectacle, had seen enough.
As puzzling as this comment was to others, after being quiet for three seconds, a lazy response came.
"Just kill them then. It doesn't really matter. These weaklings won't survive once I take action…"
At that moment, a middle-aged man wearing glasses stepped out from the darkness.
PS. Writing hasn't been smooth, sorry for the late update.

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - 201: Hormone Rampage
chapters.content:
The middle-aged man wearing glasses stepped out from the dark prison at a steady pace, neither hurried nor slow.
He removed his half-face gas mask, revealing the plain face of a middle-aged man, slightly sallow and sickly in complexion.
Yet, this unremarkable-looking middle-aged man, upon emerging, gave off an undeniable presence.
His expression was eerily calm, out of sync with the battlefield around him, as if none of it mattered to him.
The man was none other than the leader of the Umbrella Organization, the "forensic doctor" Servis Gerard.
His name was not widely known.
Even among the higher echelons of the Umbrella Organization, few had truly seen his face.
As he emerged, the members of the two great families of Oliver immediately became vigilant.
This man and that SS most-wanted criminal Su Lun had a strikingly similar presence. In their eyes, both regarded people with an indifferent coldness, as if viewing corpses.
Moreover, listening to the conversation between the two, they seemed to know each other?
Trash?
This tone, hearing this arrogant tone, clearly wasn't that of a "friendly force."
Moreover, this man's sudden appearance behind their ranks forced the members of the two families to be on their guard.
....
Gerald completely ignored the guns pointed at him.
Unhurried, he walked toward the front, stripping off his coat as he walked, revealing a standard linen shirt underneath. He seemed to think fighting in full attire hindered his movements and began to roll up his sleeves.
Throughout this process, he treated the others as if they were invisible, with his eyes only on Su Lun.
As Gerald rolled up his sleeves, he asked, "I'm curious, how did you know I was here?"
His tone was without a trace of emotion, as if exchanging pleasantries with an old friend who had been reunited.
"Guessed."
Su Lun squinted at the middle-aged man in the distance, the only one who could feel the murderous intent surging beneath his calm expression.
However, there was no fear in his own eyes, but rather an eagerness to try, "If I were you, I would have also followed the Reiss family here... after all, it's the most logical clue. Didn't you guess I would appear as well?"
"Yes."
Gerald smiled, his face indifferent, "Knowing I would come, it looks like you also have a very reliable source of information."
He had long seen that the two were of the same kind, a glance was enough to understand many things.
Su Lun gave him a half-smile without denying it.
It's impossible to hide anything from such people, a little bit of a clue, and much of the truth is revealed.
Gerald seemed to have guessed something, lightly pushing the glasses that had slipped down his nose.
He didn't say much more, just smiled again and said lightly, "Now that you've shown yourself, you must be confident you can kill me. But that alone won't suffice. I'm curious as to what other means you have."
"Not sure. But I want to try."
Like the calm before the storm, Su Lun wore a devilish smirk as if his sanity was no longer present, yet spoke unnervingly serene words, "Whether it's to kill Mr. Gerard or even if Mr. Gerard ends up killing me, just thinking about it excites me…"
Their tones were both very calm, as if discussing the life and death of others.
Gerald's face rarely showed a knowing smile, "Your abilities do amaze, Spatial Ability, Puppeteer, and a superlative understanding of rules... any one of these would qualify you as a genius. There are many talents in Old Lington, but of those I have met, none compare to you."
He paused, then added, "It's a pity, if we weren't enemies, we could have had a good chat."
Su Lun grinned, showing his white teeth, "Indeed, what a pity."
No sooner had these words fallen than the atmosphere between them grew increasingly tense.
.....
The two of them conversed as if no one else was around, which baffled the onlookers.
Their eerie atmosphere was such that no one dared to interrupt,
and it seemed that the others were also trying to discern something from their conversation.
The situation for the two major families was odd at the moment, blocked in front by Su Lun alone, with another figure appearing from behind.
Both men seemed to emanate an invisible force, pressuring the hundreds of people around them to retreat step by step.
Gerald could easily ignore the members of the two major families, but after all, he emerged from behind the crowd and to leave, he naturally had to pass close to them.
Young Master Eli, who was continuously frightened, was forced into a corner.
The Commander watched Gerald approaching and immediately sensed something was off.
But hearing that this person wasn't part of Su Lun's group, he had no choice but to bite the bullet and step forward, asking, "Who exactly are you?"
As soon as he spoke,
The delicate balance of the atmosphere was shattered.
Gerald glanced at him, like a ferocious tiger interrupted during its meal, his gaze suddenly sharp.
The killing intent that had previously been fixed solely on Su Lun now turned towards the Commander.
In an instant, it was as if needles were piercing the eyes, and in the brief moment the Commander met his gaze, it seemed he saw endless mountains of corpses and seas of blood in his eyes.
Gerald's aura erupted suddenly, emitting the same pale blue cold flame as Su Lun, revealing he too was a practitioner of the Secret Technique "Shadowless"!
With a flick of his fingers, his fingernails turned into sharp, scalpel-like blades.
Nobody saw clearly what happened next, only that in a flash the blades passed by, and the Commander, who was clad in heavy knight armor, had pieces of his armor falling off, showing no reaction, before kneeling on the ground. At a closer look, he was as drenched in sweat as if he were just pulled out of water. He was still breathing, but his eyes were empty and spiritless, as if his soul had been sucked out.
Without any agreement, violence erupted suddenly, utterly unreasonable.
The members of the two families also took action together.
In an instant, gunshots rang out.
But a bizarre scene occurred.
Gerald moved like a drunken man, swaying unsteadily. To the onlookers, it seemed as if there were multiple images of him, making it hard to pinpoint his exact location.
But in the blink of an eye, his illusions were everywhere.
His ghostly movements weaved through the crowds, splattering blood everywhere.
Along the way, bodies fell like mown grass.
Upon closer inspection, the wounds on the bodies were very precise, like slashes from a scalpel, opening up the arteries at vital spots, causing blood to spurt out. But even the mechanical warriors covered in heavy armor could not survive an encounter with him.
Whether they were first or second tier.
Anyone who blocked his path perished without exception.
Gerald walked through, leaving bodies behind as if cutting down grass.
Young Master Eli, pushed into a corner, was so terrified that he wet himself, waiting fearfully for death.
Yet surprisingly, Gerald did not intend to kill everyone there.
Not that he couldn't, perhaps he just found it too bothersome.
Without anyone blocking his way, he simply stopped.
He walked straight up to Su Lun and stopped a short distance in front of him.
Standing with his back to everyone, no one dared to fire a shot.
Gerald clapped his hands, and suddenly a red alchemy formation lit up under his feet, and he appeared to be muttering something.
The next moment, the vital energies from the corpses behind him, as if drawn by a force, were sucked into the formation.
Once the technique activated, Gerald greedily absorbed this blood energy, his expression revealing a blend of pleasure and enjoyment. His body involuntarily began to get excited, his arm muscles bulging dramatically.
This state, not far from Su Lun, was strikingly similar.
Both had intense, morbid madness in their eyes, with a vibrant red glow intensifying.
And at that moment, as if the rioting energy reached a threshold, Gerald's face suddenly displayed a black-and-white clown mask.
Upon closer examination, the clown mask transformed into one of red and black colors.
....
"Scary, scary, scary..."
Low sounds came from Su Lun's throat.
It seemed like laughter, yet also like roaring, as he tilted his head looking at the red-faced Gerald, licking his lips, "Red-faced clown, underestimated aren't you... I heard Mr. Gerald has an even stronger state of the black face?"
Gerald responded, "I hope you get the chance to see it."
He didn't rush to act, seemingly waiting for something.
Red eyes met red eyes, two patients sharing an unspoken bond, as if finding a kindred spirit was a rare treasure.
It was their final exchange, and then, Su Lun slowly closed his eyes.
The light before him narrowed into a slit, and that last bit of reason faded into the darkness.
In a sudden moment, blood streamed from all his orifices, his hands spread out as if embracing and accepting the whole world.
For the first time, he fully opened the constraints in his heart, letting the emotions he had suppressed for many years to overpower him...
The ferocious beast within him leaped out of its cage.
When he opened his eyes again, they were blood red.
In an instant, an invisible spiritual power exploded out from Su Lun as the epicenter.
He looked around, as if sizing up this new world, and sneered, "So this is what it feels like..."
No sooner had he spoken than there was a loud "bang" of an airburst.
A circle of visible air ripples burst out from under his feet, and after a one-second delay, the bluestone ground showed an intricate web of cracks.
This time, the noise made by stepping on air was far more exaggerated than before; Su Lun's step seemed to affect the entire space, making everyone feel a ripple in the air around them.
This Stepping on Air was several times faster than before!
The release of emotions was not just a change in spiritual power, but also caused him to enter a hysterical state where his hormones surged wildly.
This temporarily opened the safety valves of his muscle fibers, letting his muscles unleash many times, even tens of times, their normal strength!
Among third-tier professionals, who dared say their physical condition was ten times stronger than Su Lun who had been enhanced with the X serum?
His body could now withstand bursts of power much stronger than that of an average person.
This was a terrorizing speed that not even third-tier professionals could achieve.
When he looked again, at the exact moment of the commotion, Su Lun, with a body cold as flames, had already charged in front of Gerald, whose golden-painted fist hammered like a cannonball straight into the middle-aged man's abdomen.
Caught off-guard, Gerald was knocked back, crashing into the crowd of the Oliver family member.
This strike smashed several people back spitting blood and created a huge crater in the wall.
The dreadful speed left everyone present aghast.
Everyone thought the fight had decided the victor,
but unexpectedly, a crumbling sound came from the broken wall.
Upon another look, Gerald stood up from the broken bricks as if nothing had happened.
He made a habitual motion to adjust his glasses, but realizing he was wearing a mask, he muttered to himself, "Tsk, tsk, interesting... I thought I was the only one who knew this technique, but it seems you know it too."
Gerald dusted off his clothes, clasped his hands in the sorcerer's seals, and shouted, "Flesh Alchemy: Hormone Rampage!"
It was as if some change occurred, and his aura surged dramatically.
The next instant, his entire figure suddenly dispersed on the spot.
Almost simultaneously, a piercing metallic tearing sound reverberated throughout the entire prison.
Upon focusing again,
Gerald, who had undergone a transformation, moved even faster than Su Lun,
so quickly that the second-tier professionals present couldn't catch him!
Blade-like nails glided lightning-fast over golden-painted skin, sparking fires and creating a flurry of "zzzt" noises.
Gerald moved like a whisper of wind, flashing continuously around Su Lun, front, back, left, right...
As if there were countless versions of him,
disappearing,
then reappearing.
The lethal bladed claws sparked off Su Lun's body with each slash.
This "Vajra" Flesh Alchemy technique, condensed from the gold element, was nearly impossible for a third-tier professional to break through provided there was enough dark spiritual power.
Gerald's claws, which could easily severely injure second-tier professionals and were wrapped in the cold flames of "Void Servant," could only cause superficial damage to Su Lun.
But suddenly, Su Lun felt something was amiss with his condition.
Limb disarray?
Hormonal disarray?
Gerald's attacks were not merely physical damage.
This "forensic doctor" had a profound understanding of human anatomy, nerve control, and certain hormone secretions.
The moment the blade pierced the skin, a certain bioelectricity was created immediately, which interfered with Su Lun's brain control over his limbs. The brain intended to move the left hand, the signal was sent, but it was the right hand that moved; it meant to move a finger, but instead a toe moved...
Moreover, fighting with this guy, the body's hormones could also be unconsciously affected, such as the secretion of negative hormones associated with the emotion of fear, which could be artificially controlled...
If a normal person were to confront him, these disorders were like adding a "weakened state," already weakening them by a third without even fighting.
Though Red-eyed Su Lun had lost his sanity, his combat instinct was still present, even intensified.
At the moment, his emotions were as if multiple people were calculating this battle in his mind; he could overcome the "limb disarray" in an instant. As for emotions...
Everyone utilized emotions; masked Gerald wasn't necessarily crazier than Su Lun.
There was no advantage in speed, and physical combat wouldn't hurt anyone for a while.
Su Lun pinched his sorcerer's seals with both hands, condensing "Puppet Theater" once again.
Silver threads intertwined in space, dozens of puppets attacking simultaneously.
This time, the so-called unsurpassable "Puppet Theater" at the same rank also showed its deficiencies in a cross-rank battle.
A single thread could easily be cut by sharpened nails, and when they formed a bundle, he could dodge flexibly with his ghostly movements...
Gerald moved like a fish swimming agilely through seaweed, these witch-like hairs didn't much trouble him.
And as the main force of attack, it was still those puppets.
Su Lun multitasked, controlling dozens of puppets to attack simultaneously, as if one person had dozens of hands and feet.
But the "Nightmare Doll" that could affect the minds of second-rank professionals was useless against this leader of the umbrella organization. And with his method of stripping armor, he didn't even need to smash the dolls to easily dismantle them into parts.
Before long, the battlefield had become a horrific slaughterhouse, with various doll limbs scattered in the air...
If it had been humans, Gerald would have probably already turned it into a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood.
But these were puppets,
Even the dismembered limbs continued to attack Gerald fiercely.
Both sides were injured to different extents,
But both faces bore an expression as if they didn't feel the pain,
And in this Central Prison, where dark spiritual power was very dense, inhaling and exhaling could greatly replenish their exhaustion. This was enough for Su Lun to hold on for a long time.
Moreover, with the 'X serum' that provided super recovery capability, he was not likely to lose anytime soon.
The two engaged in a fierce battle.
....
As the two battled, the bystanders were stunned.
A baffling one-on-one duel had simply turned into a clash of the gods.
Members of the two major families then realized that this nondescript middle-aged man in glasses was actually a third-rank professional, and an exceptionally strong one at that!
Turning to look at Su Lun, they also understood that this second-rank SS wanted criminal, even without using the black scythe, was formidable enough to be daunting.
"This..."
"What speed! Even President Nero might not match the two of them..."
"Both are using methods that stimulate hormone secretion to enhance their combat power; Su Lun probably won't live much longer..."
"Let's go! Whichever of them wins, it will be very disadvantageous for us!"
"Right, let's think of a way to break this cursed space and get out."
"..."
The remnants of the two major families didn't watch the battle, choosing to flee instead.
Meanwhile, Kai and the other two at the second level entrance saw red-eyed Su Lun. Although concerned about the battle, they dared not hesitate and entered the second floor of the prison.
PS. There should be another update later, don't wait, I don't know when it will be, writing hasn't been going smoothly recently.

chapters.title: Chapter 203 - 202 Black Clown
chapters.content:
What is a battle between madmen like?
It's reckless!
They recklessly attack each other for hundreds of rounds.
Both use their bodies in a state of overload brought about by explosive hormone levels, achieving a speed and strength that most ordinary third-order individuals could only dream of.
It must be said, Gerald was the kind of person who perfected an art to its utmost extreme.
He was a "forensic doctor", with an intimate understanding of human anatomy.
He was not only familiar with the functional aspects of human limbs, muscles, meridians, nerves, and so on...
He even utilized these functions in combat.
Beyond the tactics of "limb confusion" and "hormonal disruption", he could also use his fingernails transformed into blades to precisely sever certain key points of meridians, blocking the flow of energy in the body.
This was somewhat similar to the concept of "acupuncture points" from Su Lun's previous life.
When a magician casts almost any spell, they need to coordinate with the dark spiritual power inside their body. This strike could immediately disrupt their spellcasting under normal circumstances, and in severe cases, even cause backlash.
This technical manner of fighting often produces tenfold the effectiveness with just one part of the effort.
It was fortunate that Su Lun's [Vajra] was at the third order, also containing the incomplete rules of the fourth and fifth orders within condensed gold elements, rendering him nearly invulnerable.
Otherwise, if it were any other third-order professional, even if they knew this Vajra technique, facing Gerald's surgical blades would likely result in being pierced, and the technique easily broken in an instant.
This leader of the Umbrella Organization was one of the strongest professionals Su Lun had encountered, aside from those from the Mirror Organization—at least, several times trickier than the previously deceased "Thunder Sword King" Nero Redgrave.
But the stronger the enemy, the better Su Lun himself was.
With the [Vajra] technique, he was already indomitable.
Within the [Puppet Theater], the dense web of threads acted like the hairs on his body, allowing him to precisely sense Gerard's position within the theater. Any slight mistake from the enemy could trap them.
At this moment, hundreds of puppet arms bearing sharp blades hovered around Su Lun.
These high-level runes and enchanted daggers stabbed chaotically around Su Lun like a torrential downpour.
Although Gerard's means of killing were strong and unique, his professional focus was still that of an assassin. Strong in attack, explosive, but weak in defense, and he had to engage in close combat.
Even with agile movements, the coverage of the daggers meant that at least some would penetrate him.
....
Shadows flitted around the dark golden figure, with the intensity of the battle escalating wave by wave.
Just then, the sound of a bell "thudded" heavily.
Gerald hit Su Lun with a flying cleave, smashing him on the shoulder with a ferocious kick.
Su Lun anchored his energy, channeling a massive force from his shoulder down through his legs, shattering the hard stone on ground into powder. The force continued unabated until his feet broke a foot deep into the ground before stopping.
Su Lun's combat skills had reached "master level", and this technique of energy discharging had become instinctive.
It was difficult to beat him on the level of technique.
Yet, even as he took the blow, Su Lun manipulated the threads in the air and pulled, resulting in dozens of knives stabbing downward. Gerard dodged many, but still got hit by some.
He retreated rapidly, pulling back dozens of meters.
Both men stopped fighting simultaneously.
Gerald glanced at the cut on his right forearm and exhaled a turbid breath.
Although a high secretion of hormones could hasten wound healing, this level of recovery efficiency couldn't outweigh the formation of new injuries.
Blood-eyed Su Lun found this grand battle exhilarating, showing a blood-streaked grin, and slowed his attacks. An unusual state triggered a crow-like eerie laugh from his throat, "Mr. Gerald, with your red-faced clown status, you can't kill me..."
"Indeed,"
Gerald nonchalantly shrugged his shoulders, and rolled up the sleeves scattered during the fight.
His fingernails were sharp as blades, rolled up meticulously.
Having fought to this point, he also discerned what Su Lun was planning.
Turning his head, he asked, "You intend to use spiritual power to breakthrough the brain domain?"
Blood-eyed Su Lun twisted his stiff neck from the kick, which cracked audibly, and responded, "Yes."
He too had learned of this ancient method from "Lady Seraya" in the fifth level of the prison.
Some "uniquely gifted" ancient magicians, before learning the secret techniques of spiritual power, could try to use the release of violent spiritual power to shock their brain's development.
This could give them an additional chance at a "spiritual advancement" compared to others.
Otherwise, once spiritual power was bound by constraints, the precious gift would be wasted.
Su Lun belonged to that rare case of "uniquely gifted" individuals, with strong initial spiritual power, yet he hadn't gone mad.
Hearing this, Gerald revealed a calm expression as expected, and calmly asked, "Can you use this spatial rule to kill me?"
He had already sized up the opponent's strength; to him, that black scythe was not a fatal threat.
If the opponent was confident, then this was the only possibility.
Su Lun didn't hide it, "Yes."
"Oh."
Upon hearing this, Gerald's emotions showed no fluctuations.
From the moment he had been pulled into the cursed space, he had guessed that he would die today.
At the life's final juncture, the leader of the Umbrella organization, neither afraid nor sad, suddenly asked calmly, "How much longer can you last?"
If others heard this, they would probably find it puzzling.
But for the two of them at this moment, each could guess the purpose of the other's question.
Su Lun said, "At most four minutes."
Stimulating hormone secretion to overload wasn't without a cost.
Amid the intensity, muscle fibers also frayed bit by bit, and the burden on various organs and bones was tremendous. A normal person using this method to fight would have died from rupture long ago.
Su Lun, relying on the super cell vitality from the "X serum" transformation, hadn't fallen dead on the spot.
He didn't think a normal human body could withstand such an exaggerated overload.
Su Lun himself was like this, and so should Gerald.
Even if he couldn't be defeated, from the moment they entered, the outcome had already been sealed.
This meant that within four minutes, the two must determine life or death.
No, Gerald must die.
"Hmm... then as you wish."
Gerald was well aware of this fact.
Speaking, he seemed to have made a decision and added, "You are the second person to see my 'Black Clown,' but I hope I won't have to kill you. Otherwise, it would be a pity."
True peers are rare,
Since death cannot be avoided,
then face it openly,
unleashing the most dazzling flare at the last moment of life,
Such an ending is also quite good.
The two patients with reddened eyes began to talk as if they were not mortal enemies but old friends sharing good words.
They also understood simultaneously that it was not that they couldn't communicate in this mad frenzy.
It was, rather, that other people couldn't communicate.
Both found an unprecedented sense of recognition.
Upon hearing this, a twisted and insane smile appeared on Su Lun's face, his red eyes brimming with intense combat spirits.
He licked his lips, "Tsk tsk, I am honored..."
...
Gerald did not say much more, didn't bother to straighten his shirt, but just ripped it apart.
A "swish" of fabric tearing.
The middle-aged man revealed his muscular upper body, wrapped in bandages.
His body shook, and the bandages burst instantly.
But what was shocking was that Gerald's back had a centipede-like suture mark. The shape of the suture was a hexagram array!
This stitched piece of flesh was distinctly different in color from the rest of the body.
It was pitch black, emitting a faint black mist, as if a piece of dead flesh was stitched onto the normal flesh!
Seeing this, the All-knowing Eye already discerned the origin of that flesh, and Su Lun muttered, "So it's stitched with the flesh of a different creature to withstand the overload of battle, I see..."
This was not synthetic gear; it was simply another piece of flesh, probably taken from some corpse, stitched onto his own flesh.
But seeing the inflammation and swollen redness of the wound, it seemed the human body strongly rejected that black flesh.
This guy actually forcibly used alchemy to stitch it into his own body.
True to being a 'forensic doctor'."
"Just a small experiment. Be careful,"
Gerald responded indifferently, clapped his hands, and uttered a low shout, "Flesh Alchemy - Release!"
The moment the sorcerer's seals were undone, a bizarre scene unfolded.
The stitched hexagram array mark gleamed for a moment, and the piece of "dead flesh" on his back came to life, wriggling as the black pigment spread rapidly over his body. His muscles seemed to come alive, pulsating in bundles, as if countless snakes were squirming under his skin.
Even the deep blue ［Non-Attendance］ cold flames engulfing Gerald shifted to bright purple. The temperature remained unchanged, but it struck a chilling coldness into the soul.
And his clown face mask also turned pitch black in a "swish." The smile, shaped like a crescent moon, had a menacing edge that made one's hair stand on end.
The most powerful "Black Clown" state... appeared!
With this transformation,
Gerald seemed to bear no light burden,
"Puh-ch!" a sound emerged,
as he bent over and spewed a mouthful of dirty blood.
His chest heaved violently.
His muscles, overloaded, generated a great amount of heat; the high temperature evaporated the moisture in his body, expelling a visible white mist from his mouth and nose, accompanied by the breathing sounds of a wild beast.
"Huff-huff~"
"Huff-huff~"
"..."
Gerald stooped, looking up at Su Lun.
In that moment, the Black Clown's eyes showed no trace of rationality, having completely transformed into a monstrous beast driven solely by the need to kill!
In the instant of their gaze meeting, the Black Clown raised a clawed hand, and in the dim light of the prison, a cold blade sliced through the void, casting five icy trails of afterimages. It was as if one could hear the sharp tear through the air, a "clang" in an instant.
What was even more astonishing was that this clawing gesture had flung away the purple flames he was concentrating in his hand!
Su Lun's pupils sharply constricted, and instinctively, he twisted his body to dodge.
The purple flames did not touch his body, but exploded into a cluster of purple flames a foot away with a "pop".
Even though he was also clad in cold flames, this burning sent a shiver through his soul, leaving him slightly dazed.
Upon looking again, the silhouette of the Black Clown had already dissipated on the spot.
Even though Su Lun's eyes caught the incoming figure, his body couldn't react in time.
It was simply too fast,
the figure's speed had doubled compared to before!
As the figure swept past, Su Lun could only see a claw of sharp, icy light suddenly brightening in the air.
All that filled his ears were the grating metallic sounds of "screech, screech" tearing through the air.
A claw raked across his chest, and before he could react, another claw struck his lower back...
One claw followed by another,
before his eyes, a blur of sharp luminescent claw lights filled his vision,
Gerald's form had completely become like a ghost.
Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!
In that moment of reaction, Su Lun was hit four times!
And unlike the previous skin-grazing attacks, this time, each swipe tore a finger-deep gash into his pure gold-like skin, locally even exposing the crimson blood beneath.
Just as Su Lun was about to gather threads to completely bind himself, that pair of claws flashed out of thin air, slamming heavily into his chest.
With a "thud" like an iron block hitting the ground, a seemingly light slap exploded with the force of thunder.
The chest burst up a visible ripple of shockwave, which directly flung Su Lun out of the Puppet Theater's bounds.
The entire person flew backwards a hundred meters, crashing through a thick wall and falling into a prison cell.
Su Lun couldn't hold back a large gush of blood.
....
In his "Black Clown" state, Gerald's combat power had multiplied several times.
Just from this one encounter, Su Lun had already been wounded.
But the red-eyed Su Lun was undaunted, instead sneering with great delight, his heart overjoyed, "Hahaha... so strong! So strong! So strong!"
The stronger the opponent, the more excited his spirit became, and the greater the development in his brain.
His current feeling was extremely peculiar; previously his consciousness was like a lone island in a vast sea, surrounded by fog.
He isolated himself on the island, unable to escape.
Now unfettered, drifting with the waves, he saw a brand new world.
In this moment, as the opponent fought desperately, Su Lun did not hesitate to fight desperately as well!
Emotions fueled a rapid and crazy secretion, to a potentially fatal degree.
Without pushing to the limit, how could he know where his potential boundary lay!
Fully unleashing his bodily potential allowed him, for a brief period, to possess strength close to a fourth level.
Gerald used the same method, using this "alien species meat fast" to bear the pressure that now needed to be endured.
But this was just an increase at the level of strength; technically, he was still at the third level.
But Su Lun was different; he truly understood part of the fourth level, even fifth level power rules!
Moreover,
While Gerald endured the pressure in combat,
Su Lun was releasing it,
Unleashed like a dam breach,
Shattering everything effortlessly!
"Twice as strong, then let's double the increase again!"
Su Lun shot up from the ruins, his face contorted fiercely.
Rationality couldn't suppress the intense desire to fight,
The fear of death couldn't suppress the ultimate enjoyment of reckless emotions,
He hesitated not a second to choose "battle"!
He clenched his fist violently, and his muscles visibly swelled. His body, too, became steaming hot due to the overload of energy conversion.
Hormones secreted, potential reached its limit, and the body also reached its limit, muscles began to tear apart extensively...
This state, his body on the verge of collapse at any moment.
However...
Death?
No, that was never a reason for him to back down.
At this moment, controlling the power felt extremely joyous to Su Lun, he greedily sucked in the air, feeling as though the whole world had slowed down, and his body finally caught up with his reactions.
And just then, the Black Clown rushed towards him at almost teleportation speed, Su Lun faced it head-on without any fear!
In both their red eyes, there was no sign of any human emotion, completely transformed into two humanoid beasts.
One reached for the chest,
Another punched the shoulder,
Limbs fricting the air, the visible wave of air from the punch.
The speed of both was so fast it baffled onlookers,
Striking each other almost simultaneously.
A bloody hole appeared in Su Lun's chest, hearing the "sizzle" of tissue penetration.
But at the same time, a clear sound of bone cracking also rose.
His own punch completely shattered Gerald's right arm and shoulder into a mess of splattered flesh, the entire arm flew off!
Both were seriously injured.
Both figures flew backwards simultaneously, crashing onto the ground breaking the bluestones, rolling dozens of times before stopping.
However, the next instant, Gerald, despite his broken arm, stood up first and instantly appeared right in front of him.
"Hehehe..."
Su Lun snarled fearlessly, still eager to fight.
But as soon as he thought of moving, he realized his body had reached its limit and suddenly "crashed."
No, to put it precisely, he was stopped by an external force, involuntarily.
Consciousness cleared for a moment,
He knew,
It was the Madame "Sereyah" who had been watching the fight all along.
"Didn't win, huh? What a pity..."
Su Lun took deep breaths, slowly closed his eyes, the tide of crazed emotions receding.
But in a haze, it seemed like he instinctively tapped into something.
'Acquired "Servis Gerard's" memory fragments*7'
'You have gained a piece of information: "The Duke suspects that Miss Teresa has been invaded by an evil entity, keep a close eye... A secret team has come from outside the tower, probably people from the Riga land family, although they avoided the umbrella, I still discovered their tracks, probably here for the lady's situation..."'
'You have gained an obsession: "Why can't there be a perfect life form if Alchemy could create one... the physical body of an Alchemist is too weak, and the mechanical body is too clumsy..."'
'You have acquired a great amount of "biological dissection knowledge"'
'You have discerned the Flesh Alchemy Secrets[Hormonal Rampage]'
'You have mastered some Necromancy Techniques'
'You have acquired some [No Servant] skill fragments'
'You have acquired ample "knowledge on stitching different species' limbs, biological corpse recognition +99"'
'Combat experience +155'
'Spiritual Power +4.8'
"So, she made her move..."
As consciousness was fading, this was the last thought that flashed through Su Lun's mind.
His entire world of consciousness suddenly plunged into darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - 203 Teacher
chapters.content:
"Are you awake?"
Su Lun opened his eyes, and a gentle female voice asked.
This was an alchemy workshop, quite tall, probably about seven or eight meters in height.
