As long as his spiritual power grew strong in the future, these "willow branch" tendrils of spiritual power would multiply endlessly, extending infinitely...
Moreover, Su Lun could not only grow his spiritual power through visualization.
He could also augment it by harvesting residual souls from corpses through "Reaper of Death," a secret technique that highly suited his innate talents!
....
Su Lun had learned the secret technique of spiritual power, completely resolving the potentially lethal threat of backlash from spiritual power overwhelming his mind.
Now he could still manage negative emotions, not by "blocking" them, but by "channeling" them.
The additional spiritual power fluctuations created by negative emotions directly became nourishment for his spiritual secret technique.
Now he could really get a good night's sleep.
As the negative emotions vanished, it seemed that Su Lun had lost a desperate measure, which was the "Red Eye State."
But that was not the case.
Negative emotions can stimulate the body's hormones to be secreted excessively.
Like before in the cursed space, where Su Lun fully released his emotions, breaking through the safe limits his body could bear, he even briefly possessed the strength of a third, or even fourth tier fighter.
Now that the raging negative emotions were gone, there were no external stimuli.
However, Su Lun had mastered another method, forensic doctor Gerald's unique alchemy, "Hormonal Frenzy!"
After digesting his memories, Su Lun discovered that this guy was not only the leader of the umbrella organization but also a true biological genius.
His research in human anatomy and biology had reached a very high level. Particularly in the study of corpses, no one in Old Lington could match him; he was unparalleled.
In the past, Su Lun's method of using hormones was barbaric—just opening the valve and roughly gauging the intensity, then leaving the rest to fate.
But Gerald was different; he controlled precisely!
He could control almost every tissue in his body, control the precise secretion of his hormones to enhance battle power.
The "Black White Red" clowns were the three stages of hormonal frenzy that he had researched, requiring sealed objects to control the three types of uncontrollable state manifestations.
The first stage excited the body, with almost no risks; the second stage doubled the strength but came with the risk of muscle tissue tearing; the third stage was a lethal dose, but it could also far exceed the original strength.
This method was much more scientific than Su Lun's barbaric approach.
....
Thinking of this, a strong interest and curiosity suddenly surged in Su Lun's heart.
He wanted to know how Gerald managed to unravel such a complex system as human hormonal secretion and mastered it?
After listening to his teacher Seraya's teachings, he now understood that an alchemist must not only know how to use but also understand why.
With that thought,
he rummaged through a pile of notes from his storage space.
People who are invested in research usually have the habit of keeping research diaries.
Gerald was no exception.
Su Lun found his many years of research outcomes in his storage ring.
Tens of densely packed research journals, all numbered.
Su Lun opened the first one, numbered 001.
Rows of neatly written research notes appeared before his eyes.
"I like studying corpses; to me, they are communicative..."
"I found that people secrete different hormones under different emotions. Fear, joy, excitement, sorrow...some hormones clearly invigorate, while others make one timid. I want to clarify the connections..."
"People who are dying secrete hormones very chaotically. I try to choose live targets, provide them with different stimuli, and record the data..."
"Experiment number #771, confirmed that fear and excitement both secrete a hormone that excites the body..."
"Since hormones are controlled by sensory emotions, controlling the emotions could potentially control continued secretion..."
"Experiment number #1222, I finally mastered a method to absorb hormones from other corpses. The external Qi-blood can supplement the body's own insufficient hormone production..."
"Experiment number #1555, after injecting three times the quantity of hormones, the test subject collapsed. Human bodies are indeed too frail, even though they can exert stronger battle power..."
"..."
Not merely skimming ten lines at a glance,
but listening to the continuous, clear and pleasant "rustle" of pages turning.
So fast that each page only stayed for a second or two.
Yet the sound of flipping through the pages was not hurried, even maintaining a rhythm.
He was practically scanning each page at a glance, flipping over quickly.
Even with content that required understanding, his mind could process it swiftly. Even encountering calculations that necessitated time, it did not affect his reading speed.
His brain would allocate a portion of focus to concentrate on calculations, while the rest of his thoughts continued to flip through and absorb new content.
This was the marvelous outcome brought about by a 5% increase in brain capacity development and the release of spiritual power...
With the double learning halo of "Isaac's Alchemy Manuscript" and "Seraya's Blessing," Su Lun's learning efficiency had reached a level that would seem inconceivable to ordinary people.
Su Lun was completely immersed in this wonderful and novel sensation,
reading, learning, mastering, pondering...
He voraciously absorbed the knowledge.
Hearing this page-turning sound, even Mr. Jing, who was meditating, couldn't help but glance over.
She looked at Su Lun, paused momentarily, seemed to think of something, and then slowly closed her eyes again.

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - 208 "Shadow Fiend" Tim
chapters.content:
The territory of Duke Rafael lay on the western edge of the Luying Empire, about half a month's journey by steam ferry.
It was one of the most flourishing territories of the Empire.
Further west, several days' journey across a vast sea, there lay a place not marked on maps known as "Black Castle Reef."
Atop the reef was a castle with a towering lighthouse.
But inside the castle lived no ordinary residents, only a secret guard unit loyal to Duke Rafael.
This was purely a military fortress.
Little known to outsiders.
Recently, the conflict between the Luying Empire and the Mafa Mechanical Empire on the East Coast had intensified, prompting many lords to call up military forces to join the fight.
The major nobles' withdrawal of troops from their territories also provided opportunities for pirates.
A fleet belonging to a pirate leader known as the "Northern Sea Overlord," Oleg J. Popov, was active near the territories of Duke Rafael, raiding passing merchant ships.
"Black Castle Reef" was also discovered by a small pirate scout team passing by.
Typically, such purely military fortresses were the last thing pirates wanted to touch.
High casualty rates, and not much treasure to plunder.
However, unusual movements on the reef caught the attention of a notorious pirate.
He was the division captain under the "Northern Sea Overlord", a pirate with a bounty of 160 million Riso, a fifth-tier professional known as "Shadow Demon," Tim Ashley.
After several days of patient observation, this notorious pirate realized that the military strength on the reef was too "high-end", far exceeding the needs of a normal military fortress.
Finally, he decided to take a risk and explore the island.
....
That day, a steam warship entered the military dock inside Black Castle Reef.
Only after multiple stringent checks were the several people on board allowed to enter the interior of the castle.
They went directly to the lighthouse inside the castle, descended underground, and entered a black tower, heading deep underground...
Unbeknownst to them, within a man's shadow, hid a great pirate.
"The 'Super Mechanical Warriors' secretly researched by the Duke showed remarkable performance on the battlefield. Even those fellows from the Mechanic Sect suffered a great loss..."
"Yes, compared to those bulky mechanical armors and warriors, ours are far superior. When it comes to mechanical limb replacement technology, our territory is the top..."
"This great victory in the 'Normandy Sea Battle' will surely change the Empire's view of the Duke. Even the Empress should value and reward him..."
"Of course, our Duke this time might be conferred the title of 'First-Class Duke.'
"Hey~ I've heard that the women from Old Lington are quite something. They spend all year underground, their skin is pale and smooth, not at all like those sun and wind-battered women on the surface. Shall we take a stroll in the city later? Hehe, the leader said that these so-called nobles, madams, and young ladies in the city are not inferior in demeanor to the high-ranking nobles outside. Whoever we like, we can pick freely, play however we want..."
"Don't just talk, I really want to try it."
"Let's settle the important task first. The Duke sent us with so much material; he expects us to send the latest batch of mechanical warriors to the battlefield. Let's go to the research institute first..."
"..."
Soon, the group had arrived in Lingdun City.
After exiting the Duke's residence, they went straight to the mechanical research institute.
And because it was underground, lighting was needed, casting shadows everywhere.
The group had no idea that after exiting the tower, the shadow of one of them connected with the shadow in the corner of the wall, then eerily "detached" from the man's shadow, merged into the darkness at the corner, and swiftly moved towards the outside of the Duke's residence.
After moving away from the guards of the black tower, in an alleyway within Lingdun City, the roaming shadow suddenly twisted into shape, becoming solid, and in a blink, transformed into a man clad in assassin's attire with triangular eyes.
It was naturally the great pirate "Shadow Demon" Tim Ashley.
His talent was [B-021 - Shadow Mimic], enabling him to hide his body in any shadow.
This underground world, full of shadows, provided immense convenience for his abilities.
"Tsk tsk...almost got caught there. Lucky for me, the boss gave me that artifact; otherwise, it wouldn't have been easy to infiltrate through so many checkpoints."
Tim murmured to himself and heaved a great sigh of relief.
After all, if a pirate were caught, he would be directly sent to the gallows.
But in a moment, as he looked at the bustling Old Lingdun Inner City before him, the pirate's eyes suddenly lit up.
Whether there was any "easy pickings" could be discerned just by looking at the buildings on the streets and the attire of the pedestrians.
Goodness, where is this a mine?
It was a bustling large city!
The people here dressed so luxuriously, not only were they a hundred times richer than these poor pirates, but they also matched those wealthy territories.
Moreover,
I heard from those guys that this is also Duke Raphael's secret research base!
Super mechanical warriors?
The "Full Mechanical Limb" technology that even the obsessive mechanics of the Mafa Mechanical Empire could not breach, has it really succeeded here?
And the ancient relic of a thousand years, the legendary Dawn City?
My God, does that 'Demigod' Great Alchemist really exist?
And so many people, just by capturing and selling them, wouldn't that be real gold and silver?
Isn't this the most ideal place for plundering?
"Tsk tsk, so the secret behind Duke Raphael's immense wealth lies here... It has always been rumored that the Raphael family owns a mine with endless treasures, so it was true!"
Tim was extremely excited, not expecting that his venture here would actually meet with such a super surprise.
The key was, being wealthy yet weak was a sin!
"The highest rank among the mine slaves here is only third tier, hahaha... It's time to get rich. I need to quickly clarify the intelligence and send it out, let the boss send a fleet over!"
Thinking of something, the pirate could hardly conceal his joy and once again blended into the darkness.
....
Meanwhile, underground.
In a tower near the city's core area of Dawn Relic.
Su Lun and Mr. Jing were still patiently meditating and waiting.
Because he stripped away some of the forensic doctor Gerard's memory fragments, Su Lun was not too difficult to understand the content in the research diary.
He quickly flipped through the contents of the notebook.
But this was just research notes, and the human body was one of the most complex life forms, so it was still far from a thorough study.
After looking through it once, Su Lun knew he would need a lot of time to digest it in the future.
Even Gerard himself often laments in his notes that he had only touched the "tips" of biological alchemy, leaving one research topic after another in his notes.
Su Lun closed the last notebook and exhaled heavily, feeling complex emotions in his heart, "The field of biological alchemy really is complex."
He finally understood that saying, the more you know, the more doubts you have.
After reading the notes, Su Lun finally understood why Gerard wore the "Life Usurper's Tri-colored Mask."
This guy had once found a humanoid ancient creature carcass, at least tens of thousands of years old, and then discovered living tissue within the corpse.
After experimental research, Gerard found that the tissue could merge with human flesh, giving the test subject super vitality and also withstand the third-tier state of "Hormonal Rampage."
He then used ancient alchemy to solve the not too strong alien biological rejection reaction and sewed that piece of flesh onto his own body.
But he did not realize that this thing would affect not only the flesh but, over time, also affect the mind.
And then, his mind became distorted.
Being the leader of the umbrella organization, he naturally had access to the right cursed objects.
He then found this mask that could suppress the distortions in his spiritual power.
"Life Usurper's Tri-colored Mask"
Description: Once the mask is worn, no one loves.
Cursed characteristics: Wearing the mask maintains absolute rationality, suppresses other abnormal spiritual power fluctuations, and resists spiritual arts attacks not exceeding the fifth rank; if the spiritual power doesn't exceed 500, you will be affected by the cursed characteristics, once the mask is worn, it can't be taken off; it also causes mental splitting, ultimately turning you into a crazed monster; it absorbs other people's negative emotions, enhancing the cursed characteristics.
Detailed explanation: An ancient Life Usurper made this mask during divination after suffering a backlash, often hearing whispers from demons, to keep himself from going insane; but the mask absorbed too much negative emotion, becoming a cursed item with strong properties; can be used as material for professional advancement, spiritual power reaches 300, dark spiritual power value no less than 12W, amalgamation mutation probability not exceeding 5%; amalgamation leads to the understanding of 'Divided Spirit Technique.' This is not mental splitting, you can consider it as 'multi-hearts, multi-uses';
Su Lun also discovered that as his knowledge increased, the detailed explanations of the items he appraised became more detailed.
The very nature of cursed material empowerment is to allow the Magician to comprehend abilities via these "external" means which they are currently unable to grasp through normal approaches.
This "multifaceted focus" skill indeed has a very high compatibility with Puppeteers.
In the realm of spiritual power, this ability is as rare as Spatial Ability.
Su Lun could precisely control over a dozen puppets with one focus;
and with multifaceted focus, the number he could control would multiply several times.
This ability would also increase with the augmentation of his spiritual power.
It truly is an ideal material for advancement.
However, the conditions for advancement are exceedingly stringent.
No wonder it's a material that others couldn't integrate before reaching at least the fourth tier.
That 120,000 dark spiritual power requirement, Su Lun estimated that he could barely meet it when he was at the peak of the third tier. But this was under the precondition that his body was modified with "X serum," making his tolerance significantly higher at each tier compared to others. Normally, only a fourth-tier professional would potentially have several hundred thousand dark spiritual power.
Then there's the matter of spiritual power.
Even after absorbing so many spiritual fragments, his panel showed a spiritual power value of only 192, far from the 300 threshold needed for integration.
Luckily, he now had the "Starry Sky Visualization Technique," which allowed for the acquisition of spiritual power through meditation.
But even with this top-tier technique for bolstering spiritual power, it would probably take a year and a half to reach that level.
Hmm... there's also the "Reaper" talent.
If he encountered enough enemies, it should significantly reduce that time.
....
Su Lun was still sorting through the loot of the two elite family groups from before, identifying and categorizing, keeping some materials and equipment useful to himself, and then packing up those he couldn't use, preparing to sell them later.
Just then, Mr. Jing, who was beside him, abruptly opened his eyes and suddenly said, "He's here!"
Su Lun also tensed up, "So... should I go now?"
Mr. Jing nodded, "Yes."
As he spoke, he performed a sorcerer's seal with both hands, and a glow emerged from Su Lun.
Upon looking again, Su Lun found himself teleported outside the tower.
"What a marvelous technique..."
Su Lun looked at the fading glow on his body, then glanced back at the tower and shrugged.
Normally, as a second-tier "lousy chicken," meeting that Fallen Angel was akin to a suicide mission.
Regardless of His combat power, the guards at the duke's estate around Him were definitely not something Su Lun could handle.
But with Mr. Jing's technique, Su Lun was not panicked at all.
To avoid the stealth guards around Madam Theresa being mistaken for an assassin with unclear intentions, he didn't wear a mask and simply walked into the depths of the mist.
Now Su Lun had a rough understanding of the whole affair.
The brooch he found at the Storm Manor was made of a special material that could carry souls.
Now, Su Lun affirmed that the hidden information impossible to identify was indeed a fragment of the Fallen Angel's spirit hidden within the brooch.
In retrospect, burying it cautiously was the right decision.
Otherwise, he might have unknowingly become a "puppet" controlled by that deity.
But he didn't know how, that butterfly brooch ended up in the hands of Madam Theresa at the duke's estate.
Then, probably possessed by the soul of the Fallen Angel, Theresa became very enthusiastic about the relic-hunting expedition in Dawn City.
She even came personally.
Calling it relic-hunting was actually mobilizing the entire force of Old Lington in search of the sealed limbs of that deity.
Unfortunately, they were mostly intercepted by Mr. Jing and his group.
...
As Su Lun walked along, his thoughts were rapidly spinning.
Before long, he "expectedly" saw a little girl floating through the mist.
Seeing that well-behaved appearance, it was naturally Pestoia, the little ghost he had just seen not long ago.
Upon seeing Su Lun, she greeted him enthusiastically, "Hi, Mr. Su Lun, nice to see you again..."
Su Lun smiled as well, knowing already why she appeared here, yet he deliberately asked, "Pestoia, what brings you here?"
Pestoia tilted her head and thought for a moment, as if waking from sleepwalking, "Ah? I don't know... I sensed you nearby, so I came looking for you."
The Fallen Angel knew the whole truth, but Pestoia was completely unaware that there was a "god" soul hidden within her own.
Su Lun didn't pursue the question further.
He extended his hand, signaling Pestoia to hold it.
Pestoia didn't mind and happily reached out to grab the offered hand.
At that moment, as if she had discovered something, she floated in front of Su Lun, very close, and sniffed with her cute nose, "Hey, there seems to be a nice smell on you too~"
"What smell?"
Su Lun, of course, knew it was the scent of "Isaac's Alchemical Heart", which the Fallen Angel had come for, but he pretended not to know.
After all, in the normal script, he was supposed to know nothing.
Unaware of the Fallen Angel's existence, unaware of any divine body, and unaware of any millennia-old schemes... He should only see Pestoia as a ghost "good friend."
The Fallen Angel was cunning, previously defeated by Sir Isaac and had its body severed and sealed.
Though just a mere human, it would certainly not underestimate such an enemy.
It also suspected that the earlier "execution by fire" hid other conspiracies.
Even after a thousand years, this once thriving city of Dawn had turned to ruins, and the enemy had disappeared without a trace.
But without clarity, it would absolutely not casually let go of Pestoia, this "amulet".
....
Su Lun directly got to the point, holding Pestoia's hand, and said, "Last time you entrusted me with something, didn't you? I met Madam Sereya."
"Ah..."
Upon hearing this, Pestoia's eyes filled with a mix of nervousness, resentment, and anticipation...
Su Lun took out the ring given to him by Sereya and gestured, "Give me your hand."
Not giving the young ghost lady much time to think, Su Lun took her tender hand and slid the ring onto her index finger.
The ring looked unremarkable.
The Fallen Angel still thought Su Lun was unaware of its existence and continued to pretend...
And our little ghost lady truly had no defenses up.
As Su Lun was placing the ring, he calmly said, "I asked her your question, and Madam Sereya asked me to tell you a message, she said..."
Hearing this, Pestoia's face filled with anticipation, completely forgetting to withdraw her hand.
Su Lun paused, looked at her, and then slowly uttered three words, "She loves you."
"..."
Listening, Pestoia froze completely, her big, bright eyes full of bewilderment.
She never expected to hear such words.
A thousand years of resentment,
with no outlet,
suddenly turned into endless grievances.
But before Pestoia could dwell further,
at that moment, the ring in her hand suddenly emitted a scorching light.
Pestoia felt nothing unusual, but the entity hidden deep within her soul screamed in panic.
Meanwhile, about one or two kilometers away in Theresa's team, a sudden blast of activity erupted.
An indescribable and terrifying will abruptly descended upon the entire relic!

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - 209: The Divine Cannot Be Gazed Upon Directly
chapters.content:
Since Su Lun knew that another team was secretly coming to exorcise the demon from Princess Teresa, Mr. Jing naturally wouldn't overlook such crucial intelligence.
God's methods are ultimately unfathomable to ordinary humans, even if the divine fire has been sealed, one cannot know what incomprehensible abilities He may possess.
Therefore, rather than triggering a trap himself, it made more sense to let the enemy test the waters and consequently weaken their strength.
The folks at the Duke's mansion still thought that Princess Teresa was a victim of a common "evil spirit invasion."
....
While Su Lun was conversing with Pestoya, as soon as he put on the ring sent by Sereya, he heard a scream from afar.
It seemed some entity was trying to compel Pestoya to remove the ring, but Pestoya's face was full of struggle, obviously resisting with her strong will.
This was a gift from her mother.
She didn't want to take it off.
Moreover, it seemed the ring couldn't be removed.
Before she could struggle further, Pestoya's figure suddenly vanished.
It appeared she had returned to the host body of Princess Teresa.
Su Lun listened to the commotion from afar and glanced in that direction.
After a moment of thought, he quickly followed.
With Mr. Jing's image magic, he didn't have to worry about his life safety for the time being.
He wanted to observe the battle,
and also wanted to try his luck.
After all, there were many fourth-tier guards, and even a fifth-tier one, around Princess Teresa.
What if he found a few corpses and managed to extract some Soul Shards?
...
Su Lun's spiritual power was now considerable, and he was very sensitive to its fluctuations.
Feeling that terrifying pressure descend, he knew that the god had shown His face.
The exorcism team from the Duke's mansion seemed to be quite skilled, actually managing to force the Fallen Angel's spiritual body to appear.
Su Lun didn't know what Mr. Jing had done previously, but it seemed that he had successfully instigated a fight on the other side.
He cautiously approached, staying about a kilometer away to observe the battle, and found a sturdy cover to hide behind.
Su Lun hadn't forgotten Mr. Jing's advice; he closed his right eye and watched the battle solely with his left eye that held the All-knowing Eye.
He now also knew that this gift had a filtering and protective function, allowing him to avoid seeing some "unwatchable" beings.
Mortals cannot gaze upon God.
This was the warning left to later generations after Sir Isaac's great battle with the Fallen Angel.
...
It was clear that the exorcism team from the Duke's mansion came prepared.
When Su Lun arrived, he saw hundreds of people surrounding Teresa, looking like they were facing a formidable enemy.
But the ones who could actually get within a hundred meters of Princess Teresa were only about twenty individuals, all masters of the third tier and above.
At that moment, the leader, a red-bearded old man wearing a white robe resembling an exorcist, was holding a cross that emitted a blinding silver brilliance, confronting Princess Teresa.
Glancing at the Seven-Pointed Star beneath his feet, Su Lun could tell that this fellow was a fifth-tier professional as well.
On closer inspection, the old man's Holy Knight's Exorcism Cross in his hands turned out to be a sealed artifact-level treasure.
The silver light from the cross shone upon Princess Teresa, emitting threads of black gas.
Like light dispersing darkness, normal people didn't notice how the silver light was any different, but the princess's face contorted vilely, as if she were enduring immense pain, letting out piercing screams from her throat.
Under the Holy Light, it was as if her body was being scorched.
Teresa writhed under the searing Holy Light, her throat issuing agonized roars, "Foolish humans! You are angering a great deity!"
With the cross pressed against her face, the Fallen Angel knew she could no longer hide, and she made no attempt to.
But to the people of the Duke's mansion, her words meant nothing.
The red-bearded exorcist even spat a mouthful of old blood at the cross, causing the intensity of the Holy Light to surge dramatically.
No one took "Teresa's" words seriously; evil spirits were not uncommon in this world.
Those spiritual bodies formed for particular reasons often boasted themselves as gods to delude people, and exorcists had long since grown accustomed to it.
In fact, they were just higher-level spirits.
They thought that the situation with their princess was more or less the same.
But Su Lun knew that these guys were about to face great misfortune.
After all, this being was once genuinely of the divine tier!
...
The people from the Duke's mansion had taken so long because they were waiting for this sealed artifact, the cross, to arrive, to ensure infallibility.
Indeed, the object was quite effective, capable of driving away anomalous spiritual bodies within humans.
After all, a Fallen Angel that had lost both divine fire and physical body was no longer of the divine tier.
This cross, with its holy properties, was particularly harmful to dark entities.
It didn't take long under the Holy Light for Teresa's black qi to slowly converge into a shadowy figure of an evil spirit.
But what nobody expected was that this "evil spirit" shadow was not just human-shaped; it had a pair of black wings, spanning meters, protruding from His back.
With the emergence of these wings, a majestically evil presence suddenly descended.
On a closer look at the silhouette, it strikingly resembled the Fallen Angels from mythological tales.
The bystanders didn't understand and were visibly shocked.
From a distance, Su Lun murmured to himself, "So this is the Fallen Angel..."
The red-bearded exorcist, with ample experience in exorcism, barked loudly, "This is a demon's Illusion Technique. Guard your minds and do not be bewitched!"
His six disciples coordinated seamlessly, forming a hexagram pattern, and the rope binding "Teresa" remained taut, giving Him no chance to break free.
Just then, the old man holding the cross stomped his foot, and the Seven-Pointed Star Formation beneath him shone brightly with white light, a clear sign that he was ready to unleash a powerful move.
At this moment, he took out a crystal glass bottle and splashed the water towards "Teresa."
The Holy Water fell upon the phantom of the Fallen Angel, hissing and steaming like sulfuric acid.
By the looks of it, the plan was to exorcise the "demon" that had manifested on the spot.
"Ah... pitiful humans, you have succeeded in angering me!"
The voice of "Teresa" became exceptionally terrifying, filled with anger and overwhelming intent to kill.
If it were an ordinary evil spirit, by now it would have either been destroyed or expelled.
Unfortunately, this one was a True God.
His understanding of the various laws was something far beyond the grasp of these mortals.
He had been taken by surprise and attacked earlier, unable to get free from the light of the holy cross, but now, He had recovered!
Just as the soul was about to be expelled from Teresa's body, He made a move that baffled everyone.
A black fire suddenly burst from His right wrist, and the silver rope binding the wrist instantly turned pitch black. The darkness spread swiftly from the wrist, quickly reaching the exorcist holding the rope.
"Damn it, it's elemental theft!"
Seeing this, the red-bearded man's face changed dramatically, "Damn it, how could it forcibly reverse the divine power of the 'Binding Spirit Rope'?!"
Su Lun, watching from afar, was not particularly surprised.
This "elemental theft" was something Su Lun had seen before. It was used by Mr. Hei and his group when they killed a fifth-tier professional.
Mr. Hei had used the same technique to dissolve a fifth-tier incantation using fourth-tier power.
To use this technique required an extremely deep understanding of the laws.
The alchemical item "Binding Spirit Rope" contained sixth-tier solidifying runes. To transform the stable runes' divine power into dark power was more complicated than a simple technique, requiring at least a seventh or eighth-tier grasp of Holy Incantation.
Currently, there were few in the world who could achieve this.
But regrettably, this one could.
The red-bearded exorcist tried to take some remedial action,
But by then,
It was too late!
"Teresa" suddenly broke free with her right hand and plunged it into her own chest without hesitation, causing blood to spray out.
Did she commit suicide?
Su Lun, watching from a distance, was also somewhat confused.
It was a move that seemed puzzling.
Not just to him—everyone was visibly stunned at that moment.
The palace guards had come to save someone, and now the demon possessing their princess had made her commit suicide. What was going on?
And more horrifying was yet to come!
"Teresa" directly pulled out her own heart and, without any hesitation, crushed it.
With a "pop," it burst like a bag of plasma, with blood splattering everywhere.
Now, the once noble and elegant princess had become a terrifying blood-soaked figure.
Exorcism?
Continue the exorcism if you dare!
His soul was still there; Teresa wouldn't die yet.
Once expelled, Teresa without a heart would surely die.
At this point, everyone understood why the evil spirit behaved in such a manner.
....
From a distance, Su Lun marveled at the tactic: "Can a god actually live without a heart?"
He immediately thought of some research reports he had seen in the notes of forensic doctor Gerald.
That man also studied the topic: how to survive if crucial organs like the heart were destroyed.
The proposed solution in the notes was to create blood circulation with an external force if the pumping function of the heart wasn't needed.
But that remained a theoretical experiment, and now, there was a living example before his eyes.
Su Lun closely observed the changes in the body of "Teresa" with a bloody hole in her chest.
Having harvested Gerald's memories, he now had a profound expertise in human anatomy.
Noticing the faint signs of a pulse in the body, he speculated, "She must be using muscular contractions combined with dark spiritual power to create an alternative circulatory system. Hiss—Gerald's hypothetical solution seems to actually work."
Su Lun, as an observer, was taking it in stride, but the people from the palace were completely stunned, their faces pale with fear.
They never imagined the situation would turn out like this. An exorcism that seemed almost fail-proof turned into serious harm for the princess?
If she died, Duke would never forgive those responsible for her protection.
But the situation having reached this point, they had no choice but to fight to the death!
Not to say that they could certainly save the princess, but at the very least, they had to kill the "demon."
The man dressed in a military uniform and with a pale face decisively ordered, "Take action, seize the person first!"
Unfortunately, "Teresa" didn't just rupture her own heart to make the exorcist hesitate.
A massive amount of blood gushed out and rapidly coalesced in Her hands into a red blade.
The blade, forged entirely from red glints, with sanguine lightning flashing, was as if She clutched a bolt of lightning.
With a dagger in hand, He suddenly underwent a dramatic change in demeanor.
This Fallen Angel wasn't employing Alchemy, nor was there any alchemical Formation in sight. But Su Lun keenly noticed that some grey hairs had suddenly appeared among His black locks, surmising in his mind, "It seems He has used some kind of Forbidden Technique that sacrifices lifespan to condense a spiritual formation."
The body of that Princess Teresa was said to be of only the second rank, too weak despite being supported by the soul of a god.
...
In the blink of an eye, both parties were locked in fierce battle.
Su Lun had also come to understand a bit about the situation of the abyssal plane through conversations with his teacher, Seraya.
It was a realm with a brutally harsh environment for survival.
The hostile living conditions within this cavern were but a microcosm of that place.
However, correspondingly, it was full of formidable beings.
Those who could survive in the abyss were the elite of their kind.
This Fallen Angel from the abyss was naturally no exception.
Just by watching the fluid dagger techniques of "Teresa," Su Lun, the "Combat Master," couldn't spot a single flaw.
Not only was His combat experience impeccable, but the red thunderbolt dagger in His hand was also enigmatic. Upon contact, thunder exploded, slicing through ordinary weapons and mechanical gear as if they were soft mud. Even when blocked, that crimson electricity would completely transform into elemental thunder, catching people off guard and killing them instantly.
First and second-rank professionals were killed with a single slash, third-rank ones could only take a few moves, and only those fourth-rank professionals shielded with "Elemental Barriers" could barely cling to life under the Thunder Dagger when working together.
The people from Duke Rafael's mansion had initially hoped to capture the "Evil Spirit," but only now, amidst the battle, did they realize how naïve they had been.
Faintly, everyone began to sense that there might have been some truth to the Evil Spirit's earlier claim about being a divine being...
However,
nobody had ever seen what a god looked like,
the fight had already begun,
and they had no way to retreat.
As private soldiers of Duke Rafael's mansion, the lives of all of them combined weren't worth as much as Miss Teresa's.
The only option left was a fight to the death!
...
How terrifying is the battle among high-rank professionals?
For a time, all sorts of high-level incantations exploded throughout the ruins like a bomber dropping bombs incessantly, with shockwaves of the battle surging higher and higher.
Those millennia-old sturdy structures easily turned to dust, limbs flew through the air, and rivers of blood truly formed...
"This fighting power is truly outrageous..."
From a distance, Su Lun watched with grave eyes.
Even if He had used a life-shortening Forbidden Technique, this "Teresa" barely matched Mr. Jing's prediction of possessing the level of a fourth-rank professional.
But watching Him hold His own against two fifth-rank, plus over a dozen fourth-rank, and numerous second and third-rank professionals...
Who would dare believe this was only fourth-rank?
The equipment of those people from the Duke's mansion was by no means inferior; they were the top of the elite, several levels stronger than those from families like Oliver and Clark's.
All manner of ancient relics, alchemical objects, cursed items, and scrolls... were thrown out as if money were no object.
It was as if one could hear the sound of money cascading down...
Su Lun couldn't help but widen his eyes in amazement.
Indeed, in this world ruled by nobles, with the scariest reserves belonging to the wealthiest few, Duke Rafael's foundation was terrifying to behold!
However, even as money paved the way, the casualties among the Duke's entourage only continued to rise.
Corpses littered the ground, and clumps of "grey mist" waved at Su Lun enticingly as if calling out to him, eliciting great envy.
These were Duke Rafael's trusted aides, selected from among the best of the best.
One could only imagine the quality of their souls, right?
If all of these were harvested, it was estimated that at least ten to eighteen years of knowledge accumulation could be saved...
However, as much as he drooled over them, he didn't dare make the slightest move.
The core of the battlefield had now turned into a meat grinder, with third-rank professionals standing no chance of survival—and second-rank professionals facing mortal peril within moments.
Although Su Lun was a bit stronger than the average second-ranker, he was not so arrogant as to think he could take on the battle head-on.
"There are still two fifth-rankers, so many fourth-rankers..."
He chanted silently in his mind, consoling himself that the Soul Shards of those third-rank and higher professionals were the real treasures.
He also prayed that when Mr. Jing and the others arrived, those grey mist fragments wouldn't have completely dissipated.
...
Although the battle seemed one-sided, with several fourth-rankers already slain,
Su Lun gradually noticed something was amiss.
The lifespan of a human body is finite, which meant that "Teresa's" Forbidden Technique must have a time limit and couldn't be used repeatedly.
This fact became evident during the midst of the battle.
As the fight dragged on, "Teresa's" hair turned into a full head of silver.
Those from Duke Rafael's mansion evidently noticed this change as well.
The harder they pressed, the quicker Teresa would perish.
If Princess Teresa were to exhaust Her lifespan and die, the battle would lose its meaning.
Yet capturing Her alive was not feasible.
To fight or not to fight...
It was this hesitation that gave "Teresa" the chance to kill several more people. Even two fifth-rankers were wounded to various degrees under the unpredictable Thunder Knife.
It seemed to be a situation where both sides would suffer heavy losses.
It remained to be seen whether "Teresa" would run out of life first, or whether the Duke's people would all be killed.
...
But no one noticed that when "Teresa" killed, it almost always occurred on certain special nodes, the position of the corpses, as if aligned with some kind of formation.
As time passed, the blood of those who died in battle was quietly absorbed by the ground.
Su Lun watched from afar, his All-knowing Eye capturing everything in front of him.
Soon, he also detected the peculiar flow of blood in the air and identified it as a Forbidden Technique that was forming, thinking to himself, "Is He invoking some kind of forbidden spell?"
It wasn't described as super-order, but as "forbidden," that is... Divine Arts?
Discovering this, Su Lun wasn't at all surprised.
As a god-level powerhouse, it's impossible not to have some tricks up one's sleeve.
Moreover, he also felt that this "Teresa" must have guessed something.
Really being entangled and struggling to cope with these people was going to be even worse later on.
Was it these fellows that the Fallen Angel dreaded?
No!
From beginning to end, what He truly dreaded was Sir Isaac, who had defeated Him a thousand years ago!
Although Mr. Jing and the others hadn't shown their faces yet, some clues had already indicated that a conspiracy targeting Him was closing its net.
Just like Pestoya's ring earlier, and the oddly coincidental timing of being "exorcised"...
If it were Su Lun himself, he would have become alert long ago.
...
Su Lun speculated that "Teresa" was gathering Divine Arts.
Sure enough, just then, the sky hundreds of meters high suddenly became stormy.
The thick fog in the ruins converged into a swirling black cloud in the sky.
The vortex grew larger and larger, with the center condensing into a black hole dozens of meters in diameter.
This commotion was so extraordinary that the Duke's guards, who were in a fierce battle on the ground, stopped fighting and glanced at the sky with the corner of their eyes.
This upheaval was simply too exaggerated, and it couldn't be caused by any fifth or sixth-order Alchemy.
It was as if the end of the world had come.
At this moment, they were still completely unaware of what kind of being they were facing.
But they also had a vague guess.
At that time, the black hole slowly cracked open a gap, revealing a pupil emitting a strange, ghostly light.
It was a massive eye!
The very instant this huge eye opened, a sense of awe that made people want to worship surged from the bottom of everyone's hearts...
It was as if a deity was gazing down upon the world,
And everything,
Was mere ants.
Those who saw that giant eye, one after another, kneeled down.
Even two fifth-order professionals only held out for a moment before kneeling, powerless to resist.
On their faces, only piety and fanaticism remained.
Su Lun thought that "Teresa" would control these people to guard herself.
But unexpectedly...
Upon looking again, the Duke's entourage was seen uniformly drawing their swords and committing suicide on the spot!
Simply with one glance, they all perished!
Their blood and energy completely merged into the formation on the ground.
At this time, with the power of the formation absorbed, behind Teresa, a pair of solid black wings slowly formed, with an aura so overwhelming that one could no longer look directly at her.
"The power of lower beings is really weak..."
The whispers from the Abyss echoed in the ears, as if possessing a kind of magic power that made people convinced.
Su Lun felt that strange sensation, his left eye immediately identifying the text [???], and automatically blocked the forbidden power that would have made him lose his composure.
He instantly understood, "The divine cannot be looked upon directly... So that's how it is!"
Su Lun knew he had been discovered.
Just then, "Teresa" suddenly looked in his direction.
With just a gaze, Su Lun died violently on the spot.
However, there was no explosion of blood.
Like a shattered mirror, his body disintegrated into specks of light.
Yet, seeing this turn of events, that "Teresa" who had just been so self-satisfied, suddenly changed color.
Clearly, She recognized the origin of this "mirroring ability"!
....
It was at the moment the giant eye formed in the sky, in the far distance, inside that tower.
Mr. Jing, though not present on the battlefield, also felt that power that made people want to worship and was clear about what it was.
After all, she was the only person in this plane who had truly seen a "God"!
She murmured, "The Power of Faith... finally using this move, huh? With the divine flame gone and only a little Power of Faith left, it seems like He's preparing to fight to the death to escape back to the Abyss."
As the thought flickered through her mind, her figure vanished from the tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - 210: The Rank of Mr. Jing
chapters.content:
"Such terrifying power, is this a god..."
It was just a glance, but Su Lun felt his body endure an indescribable shock, and his mirror image body shattered into pieces.
Yet before he could reflect on it, before his body completely disintegrated, he saw "Theresa" react even faster. Without paying Su Lun any heed, her originally god-tier "Angel" black wings flapped fiercely, and her figure rushed towards the central area of the relic.
Incredibly... she fled!
This was in stark contrast to the lofty demeanor she had just moments ago; now, she was decidedly resolute in her escape!
Right after the mirror image shattered, Su Lun, who was in meditation in a distant tower, suddenly opened his eyes.
When he looked again, Mr. Jing was nowhere to be found.
"It seems this Fallen Angel is also acquainted with Mr. Jing..."
Su Lun muttered to himself.
From the recent events, it was clear that "Theresa" recognized the mirror ability and was scared away.
After all, an S-level talent is extremely rare, and ordinary people might not encounter a second one in their lifetime.
More coincidentally, this was happening in Dawn Relic, the place that nearly led to her downfall as a deity.
Without even thinking, one would definitely assume it to be an "old acquaintance."
Su Lun's curiosity about Mr. Jing's true status deepened; what level was he, to scare a god into running away?
Though she was but a remnant soul, her combat strength displayed earlier was such that even a sixth-tier professional wouldn't likely scare her into such desperate flight.
Or perhaps... she was reminded of the terrifying experience of being outwitted to death by Sir Isaac a thousand years ago?
...
Su Lun didn't dwell on it, as he was more concerned about something else.
He looked up at the sky not far away, where the giant eyeball that the Fallen Angel had conjured was also starting to dissipate because of her flight.
The feeling that made his eyelids twitch also vanished abruptly.
Su Lun hadn't forgotten about the corpses scattered all around.
Mr. Jing was likely chasing after "Theresa." Such a level of combat was beyond Su Lun's involvement.
There was no need for him to get involved either.
In the Mirror Organization, there wasn't just Mr. Jing; if she didn't give any orders, it meant she was confident.
But as for looting corpses, Su Lun was more than willing.
The Duke's men were annihilated, and the nearby creatures had likely been killed during the battle, or frightened away.
There shouldn't be much danger left.
Su Lun didn't hesitate; he unfolded his Eight-Armed Spider Spear and quickly ran towards the recent battlefield.
After all, the Soul Shards on the corpses would disperse over time.
Su Lun was fast, and by the time he arrived, that "grey mist" still seemed very clear.
Being cautious, he used the All-knowing Eye to scan the surroundings again, didn't spot any other dangers, and then started to approach the corpses strewn about.
The first to be reaped, naturally, were the memory shards of the two fifth-tier professionals.
The closest was the corpse of the red-bearded Exorcist.
'Received "Matic Doyle's" Memory Shard*6'
'You have acquired a wealth of "Exorcism Knowledge," comprehending the skill [Thirteen Methods of Evil Spirit Dispel].'
'You have obtained the alchemy formula [Sun Holy Water Mixing Method].'
'You have gained some knowledge in mysticism.'
'You have mastered a wealth of "1~5th tier Alchemy Knowledge"'
'You have comprehended the incomplete fifth-tier rules of the Divine Arts.'
'Spellcasting experience +175'
'Spiritual power +8.4'
Typically, the knowledge base of spellcasting professions is many times greater than that of melee professions.
The Exorcist profession belongs to the "mystical" category within spellcasting.
These guys dive deep into obscure and uncommon fields of knowledge.
Su Lun eagerly reaped that cluster of grey mist.
Even though he felt that the "quantity of shards" seemed a bit low,
the acquired knowledge filled in the gaps in his understanding of mysticism, broadening his horizon...
Which was just fine.
He clearly remembered the dazed state that lasted a long time after absorbing a fifth-tier professional last time.
But now, with a flood of knowledge entering his mind, it was quickly assimilated, and it was exceedingly clear!
It was like the difference between digesting food that is gulped down whole and food that is thoroughly chewed; the nutrition received by the body was entirely different.
Su Lun immediately noticed this difference.
The same amount of memory fragments, now digested with at least ten to twenty percent more knowledge.
Even some completely disordered fragments remained in the memory, not forgotten.
"Spiritual power secret techniques and brain domain development can increase the efficiency of reaping, this is good news…"
Su Lun's thought flashed by, and his heart leaped with joy.
It was akin to playing a game where slaying monsters came with a ten to twenty percent experience bonus.
The short-term benefits may not be noticeable, but this is a substantial improvement that can impact the late game.
Moreover, with negative emotions completely cleared, Su Lun now had enough energy to suppress those external memories in the short term without worrying about them impacting his own consciousness.
After the brain domain development, both memory and comprehension improved significantly, visibly enhancing the talent of the "Reaper of Death" by a large margin!
...
Su Lun did not dwell on the content of the memories he harvested.
He simultaneously operated the eight-armed spider spear, swiftly stripping the corpses of their storage rings and equipment almost in tandem with reaping the Soul Shards, cramming them into his storage space.
He also took the opportunity to collect the sealed item "Exorcist's Cross of the Holy Knight."
He glanced at it briefly. It was a very powerful but specialized piece of equipment for Spiritual Bodies, of little daily use.
Then, he quickly approached the body of another fifth-tier professional, the pale-faced man in military attire who had been at Teresa's side, a court guard wielding a thin sword.
But this reaping took Su Lun by surprise.
'You have gained 2 memory fragments from "Lasati Kale"'
'You have acquired fragments of Alchemy knowledge'
'You have gained a small amount of combat experience'
'Spiritual Power +0.3'
"Is this really a fifth-tier?"
Su Lun looked at the harvested fragments, his gaze froze, thinking he had mistaken the corpse.
Those fragments were not even comparable to a first-tier.
And they were "finely broken" to an extreme degree.
But the odd thing was... there were indeed some incomplete pieces of knowledge from the fourth and fifth tiers.
That proved this was indeed the body of a fifth-tier professional!
Not understanding what had happened, Su Lun harvested a few more corpses nearby that he remembered were fourth-tier professionals.
The result was the same.
But soon, he noticed a pattern.
The souls of close-combat professionals had almost entirely dissipated, or what remained were tiny fragments so broken they could not be any less intact.
While the souls of magic professionals, already stronger in spiritual power, retained somewhat more, but still not much.
"Did that Fallen Angel's Divine Arts take away even their soul power?"
Su Lun furrowed his brows, roughly understanding the reason.
And fortunately for him, he arrived quickly, otherwise he wouldn't have even a soupçon to partake in.
As for the relatively intact soul of the bearded Exorcist, it was probably because Magicians of the Mysterious force often practiced some spiritual power defense techniques. Even in death, their souls were better preserved than others.
However, Su Lun's mentality was good; he was quite satisfied with what he earned.
The sum of Soul Shards he gathered equated to almost seventy to eighty percent of what he obtained last time from a fifth-tier, and it was the valuable knowledge of the Mysterious force, inestimable in worth.
Of course, spoils of war weren't limited to Soul Shards.
Equipment and storage rings on the corpses were also a great harvest.
This was Duke Raphael's personal guard!
And thankfully the Divine Arts of that Fallen Angel greatly helped, otherwise those few hundred elites could probably have breached the defenses of Old Lington directly.
Su Lun would not have had the chance to loot the bodies.
...
A century of "mining" had the treasures assembled from the bottom up, like a pyramid, ultimately almost all converging in the Duke's mansion.
The equipment on those guards' corpses was all meticulously selected quality material.
Weapons, armors, robes, leather armors, boots, alchemy accessories...
The vast majority were "silver quality" and above.
Even the team leaders had "gold equipment" and a small amount of "dark gold equipment."
Each item was rarely seen and top-notch in Old Lingdun Inner City auctions.
Su Lun took them all. These were not only his spoils of war.
If anything, the lion's share belonged to Mr. Jing.
Without her plan, the Duke's force would not have met their demise here.
Aside from these pieces of equipment, Su Lun also found in the storage rings of the two fifth-tier and those fourth-tier individuals a considerable number of gemstones, resembling burning coal, that radiated heat.
Upon appraisal, this was revealed.
[Sun God Stone]
Description: A special gemstone containing rich light energy;
Su Lun now knew it was one of the essential materials for alchemists to advance to the fourth rank.
Most of the guards from the duke's private army were "Light Sorcerers" from outside, who could not withstand the dense dark energy underground and needed to carry these gemstones to prevent the dark energy from causing mutations.
On normal days, people from the duke's household hardly left Old Lingdun Inner City, making a hunt almost impossible.
This was an opportunity that could be encountered but not sought.
Being able to obtain so many [Sun God Stones] at once was indeed a rare "harvest."
There were many of them, certainly a lot more than the last time they ambushed that fifth-rank individual.
Su Lun was only at the second rank at the moment, and still far from advancing to the third rank, so he had no immediate use for these gemstones.
But other members of the Mirror organization might need them, like Qiantiao.
Moreover, from the hints Mr. Jing had previously let slip, it seemed they already had plans to break out of the Black Tower.
With these gemstones, the chances of success were likely even greater.
If they really made it out, these gemstones, which could only be considered high-level materials in the outside world, would not be scarce anymore.
...
Seeing these gemstones, Su Lun was also very much looking forward to it. If Qiantiao and the others were to advance to the fourth rank, how strong would they be?
But he also found it strange, where were the other members of the Mirror organization?
Could it be that they went to ambush that "Teresa"?
Just as this thought emerged, suddenly, anomalies occurred around them!
The thick dark energy in the relic formed a mist, but at that moment, as if stirred by an invisible force, it began converging in one direction, like "dragons sucking water," forming two vortexes that gathered above the center of the relic.
The mist was absorbed and dissipated, and the view was instantly clear.
Seeing this phenomenon, Su Lun immediately realized what it was, his pupils violently contracted, "An 'elemental domain' that could perhaps be controlled by a professional above sixth rank?"
From the memories he had harvested before, he knew that such natural phenomena were some kind of techniques.
There were two major hurdles in a professional's advancement: one was moving from third rank to fourth rank, which required mastering the "elemental barrier"; the other was the "elemental domain" from the sixth rank advancing to the seventh rank.
Legend has it that those who master the elemental domain can absorb elements from miles around for their own use.
This was a means at the level of principles that only truly top-level alchemists could master.
But...
Such beings, even on the surface, were among the tiny elite at the pinnacle of the pyramid.
How could they appear here?
Su Lun thought he was mistaken, and as this idea flickered through his mind, his eyes swiftly shifted.
He then saw at the core of the converging mist, two figures confronting each other in the sky!
The two figures both had wings?!
Su Lun looked over.
One of them was the "Teresa" he had seen before, with a pair of pitch-black wings.
And the other, shrouded in a golden silk cloak, had a pair of huge bat wings behind her!
"Vampire?"
Su Lun thought of a kind of legendary abyssal undead creature when he saw those bat wings.
It was the long-lived "vampire," capable of sleeping away countless ages.
And upon closer inspection of the patterns on the cloak, who else could it be if not Mr. Jing?
At that moment,
everything seemed to make sense.
No wonder Mr. Jing could live for a thousand years; it turns out he was of vampire lineage!
However, Su Lun had already suspected that Mr. Jing wasn't a "regular human," and he wasn't too surprised seeing those bat wings.
After all, Su Lun himself had a special body with a portion of the Fallen Angel's bloodline after being altered by the "X Serum."
What shocked him even more was Mr. Jing's strength!
That "Teresa" was capable of deploying an elemental domain, which didn't seem so astonishing to Su Lun. After all, it was a genuine divine soul, although her physical body was somewhat lacking. Diminishing the techniques a bit, it wasn't strange to use them. It was like the fifth-rank [Vajra], which Su Lun at second rank could also downgrade and use.
But how could Mr. Jing do it?
Amid his shock, Su Lun immediately felt confused and conflicted, "Mr. Jing shouldn't be at the seventh rank, but why could he use the 'elemental domain' of the seventh rank? Could it be due to his mirror image imitation ability? But that's not right, that talent shouldn't be able to mimic abilities beyond his understanding..."
Su Lun had now stripped away the memories of those people from the surface and wasn't entirely ignorant about the outside world anymore.
He vaguely knew that the Black Tower was on an island called "Black Reef."
There was a castle on the island, garrisoned by a secret guard of about one or two thousand men under Duke Raphael, the strongest of whom was a sixth-rank Great Commander. Although their overall military power was strong, if Mr. Jing truly had a strength above the sixth rank, he shouldn't be trapped here, growing stealthily.
....
Mr. Mirror was a mystery to everyone.
She had never shown her face.
Even within the Umbrella Organization, information about Mr. Mirror was limited to just this "code name."
No one had ever seen her take action; no one knew what her true strength was or what means she possessed.
To be exact, even when she did take action, because of her mimicry ability, she used the powers of others. Others also did not know she was "Mr. Mirror."
She might have countless disguised identities.
What her true appearance was, there was no point in pursuing.
Su Lun had also been curious, what rank did Mr. Mirror really belong to?
Although this underground world currently lacked the conditions for ascending to the fourth rank, Mr. Mirror was different.
Now, seeing his vampiric state, Su Lun was even more convinced that his conjecture was correct: Mr. Mirror really was an ancient relic from a thousand years ago!
He had previously speculated that since the Mirror Organization dared to attack fifth-rank professionals, the strength of Mr. Mirror, as the leader, could only be higher, not lower, than the fifth rank.
But without breaching the Black Tower, her rank wouldn't be outrageously high.
Suddenly turning into the seventh rank,
Su Lun felt there was a contradiction.
Huh?
Suddenly!
In that moment, a flash of insight crossed Su Lun's mind.
Since it was certain that Mr. Mirror was an "ancient," then was she someone close to Sir Isaac?
Upon this thought, Su Lun's mind surfaced with several clues that fit the criteria.
He vaguely guessed Mr. Mirror's identity from a thousand years ago!
If she really was that person, it would make sense for her to possess strength above the sixth rank.
But, reality and strength seemed to conflict again.
If she truly had the seventh rank, wouldn't "Teresa" already be dead under the absolute pressure of that power?
Or could there be other reasons limiting her strength?
Without waiting for Su Lun to think further, the two in the sky began their fierce battle.
The two silhouettes with wings wielded identical crimson lightnings in their hands, and when they clashed, the wind and clouds surged, thunder and lightning flashed across the sky, "crackle and pop" sounds were incessant to the ears, and streaks of red lightning tore through the sky, the crimson light illuminating most of the relic like a cataclysmic end-of-world scene.
Whatever technique "Teresa" used, Mr. Mirror was able to completely replicate it with her mimicry ability, leaving Her no chance to counter with elemental theft.
The magic you know, I know it too...
You throw a lightning bolt at me, I'll throw one right back at you...
You can fly, I can fly too...
The two tangled, giving Her no chance to break free, with an attitude of utter extermination.
Su Lun watched for a while, and then confirmed his speculation.
His realm was far from sufficient, but his perspective wasn't lacking, and he could tell that neither side was holding back: "Indeed...Mr. Mirror only shows the combat power of around fifth rank, but why does she have a seventh-rank elemental domain?"
Although the commotion was exaggerated, it still hadn't reached the destructive level of the legendary seventh rank.
The body of "Teresa" was only second rank, managing to exert the strength of around fourth rank, which was already the limit her body could withstand.
And since Mr. Mirror could fight Her evenly, naturally she wouldn't exceed that by much.
Yet paradoxically, both displayed an understanding of the laws far beyond their ranks.
Fifth rank, sixth rank, seventh rank...
And even higher!
Then, slowly, the battle moved in a direction beyond Su Lun's comprehension.
Lawful confrontations, collision of domains...
Rallying substantial dark spiritual forces from all around, their auras soared like primordial ferocious beasts; this was simply not a fight that professionals below fifth rank could participate in—it was an outrageous battle.
Even with the protection of the All-knowing Eye, Su Lun's eyelids jumped wildly at that overwhelming pressure.
The crimson light in the sky made his scalp tingle.
While enjoying the spectacle, a stray lightning bolt that erupted from their clash suddenly burst from the sky, "boom," and carved out a several-hundred-meter-long fissure in the ground dozens of meters away from Su Lun...
It startled Su Lun into alertness.
Looking at the two women manipulating lightning with their bare hands...
Hissss~
He gasped in a breath of cold air, gathered his spoils of war, and hurriedly ran a few kilometers towards the outer perimeter of the relic, selecting an even safer spot to watch the battle.
This level of combat was not commonly seen, and understanding even a part of it was a gain.
He also wanted to see just how substantial the "gift" Mr. and Mrs. Isaac left for their daughter was.

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - 211: The Innate Ability of the Succubus
chapters.content:
Others may not understand why this sudden great battle occurred.
But Su Lun knew.
A thousand years ago, Sir Isaac and Lady Isaac had always possessed the ability to annihilate the soul of that Fallen Angel.
However, they let him live to this day, not for anything else, but to revive Pesutoya.
That Fallen Angel clearly guessed this point as well.
Thus, the Pesutoya card, a lifeline, he would definitely not give up.
The two winged silhouettes were still fiercely battling in the sky, fighting from the edge of the ruins to the very center of the city.
Su Lun's All-knowing Eye had extraordinary vision, and even from afar, he could observe the battle.
Previously, the fog obscured his view, and he thought there might be some special structures in the city center. But due to the battle, the fog that blocked the view had also been dispersed.
Upon seeing the center, he was also greatly shocked.
The core area of the city was actually a huge pit that was one to two kilometers in diameter and bottomless!
It was like a spring eye, from which the fog in the ruins and those distorted beings and abyssal monsters continuously emerged from this cavernous hole.
"Is that the passage to the abyssal plane?"
Su Lun looked on with speculation in his heart.
Looking at the edge of the pit and its irregular, pockmarked traces, it was obviously caused by external forces.
It was probably the catastrophe that destroyed Dawn City a thousand years ago that caused the center of Dawn City to collapse into this large hole.
Su Lun, seeing that "Teresa" had no intention of fighting any longer, also guessed the god's purpose: "Does she want to escape into the abyss?"
....
Mr. Jing was entangling "Teresa," gradually forcing her to the skies above the city center.
After all, her original body was only at the second rank, and the high-intensity battle left her with no chance to catch her breath. The secret technique that consumed her lifespan was also gradually becoming strenuous, and not only did the hair of this young lady from the Duke's mansion turn white, but her body also began to rapidly deteriorate, unable to control such terrifying law power anymore.
Finally, her arm holding the lightning suddenly crumbled, and the skin on the other parts of her body cracked open, scattering like flying dandelion seeds.
"Teresa" knew her body had reached its limit, her face suddenly set, and she ballooned like an overstretched balloon. Visibly, streams of red lightning surged within her, and the red glow became clearer through the cracks of her skin...
"Is she going to detonate herself?"
From a distance, Su Lun watched with trepidation and quickly pulled a few puppets to protect himself.
Although this distance was already quite far, he prepared himself to flee at any moment.
Seeing this, even Mr. Jing had to spread his wings and fly, quickly putting a safe distance between them.
"Boom!"
The next instant, Teresa's body exploded with a deafening sound, and red lightning serpents surged through the sky.
It was this explosion that, like breaking a critical point, caused the ground to shake violently and a volcanic eruption-like roar echoed through the skies above the ruins.
At the same time, the ground trembled fiercely, and an ink-like black fog burst out from the abyssal entrance, shooting straight up to a thousand meters at the top of the cavern.
In the midst of the dense fog, one could faintly see a large number of abyssal monster silhouettes emerging from the hole.
"The fog tide has erupted again..."
Su Lun narrowed his eyes slightly.
Having experienced a "fog tide" before, he was naturally familiar with it.
This kind of anomaly happened from time to time within the ruins. He used to be unclear about the cause, but now he knew it was the occasional rupture of the seals that released a large amount of dark spiritual power from the abyss, also randomly "ejecting" some abyssal monsters.
This time, the volume that surged out was exceptionally shocking.
Su Lun, looking at the shadows of the abyssal monsters tens of meters tall within the fog, knew that he could no longer just watch and quickly retreated.
He also guessed that the Fallen Angel probably wanted to use these monsters to free himself.
But was it possible?
This was a battle that might have accidents, but the outcome was already ordained.
How could the Demigod, who had mastered "Fate" and schemed for a thousand years, let him escape?
...
Su Lun retreated toward the outskirts of the ruins, his view gradually obscured by the dense fog.
Indeed, at the same time as the explosion, a Fallen Angel's soul illuminated with black luminescence flashed by in an instant, taking advantage of Mr. Jing's evasive opportunity to plunge headlong into that deep pit.
Unfortunately, he was completely unaware that, during the two's battle, six mysterious individuals in Gold-Patterned Cloaks had quietly appeared in six directions around the pit, each with a rune-etched casket before them.
It was all to wait for his soul to leave the body!
Watching the moment the explosion occurred, the six individuals simultaneously performed hand seals and uttered in unison, "Release!"
Almost simultaneously, six streaks of rune-etched chains appeared, stretching rapidly to an infinite length.
They moved as quick as lightning, and as if equipped with trackers, no matter how the Fallen Angel's soul tried to flee, the chains flexibly weaved and changed direction to accurately secure it tightly.
As the rune-etched chains bound the target, all six individuals collected their spells, and the chains went taut in an instant.
Like fishing, they pulled him out from the deep dark hole.
High in the sky, without any sound waves, but Su Lun, who was evacuating, heard a clear roar: "Kill me, and she will die too!"
This god, once again experiencing the oppressive sensation of death's approach that she felt a thousand years ago.
"She" naturally referred to Pesutoya.
A thousand years ago, this Fallen Angel had used this amulet to survive to the present.
He now wanted to use the same method to continue living.
What a pity.
Mr. Jing simply didn't give Him any chance and pulled out a silver mirror.
Thrown into the air, the mirror split into eight thousand, filling the sky with reflections.
With the final sorcerer's seal completed in Mr. Jing's hand, he softly chanted, "Sealing Technique·Eight Thousand Mirror Images!"
Blazing white light, like eight thousand moons in the sky, beams focused on the Fallen Angel bound by rune chains.
For a moment, it scarcely dimmed the divine pressure of a god.
In this instant, the Fallen Angel finally understood and roared, "You want my soul origin to pave the way for her? Hahaha... Even in death, you will not succeed!"
Unfortunately, Sir Isaac had anticipated this a thousand years ago.
It was as the Fallen Angel was ready to detonate its soul that a shadowy figure suddenly appeared beside the Fallen Angel's soul, becoming more and more solid.
She stretched out her arms, embracing the whole world. In an instant, the ferocious expression of the Fallen Angel turned into that of an obedient little girl. Those confused eyes gradually became clear.
For the first time, Pestoya's soul overwhelmed the will of the Fallen Angel, taking control.
Looking at the familiar figure before her, with tears streaking her face, she reached out to touch it.
Celestia gave a slight smile, but had already dissipated.
....
"Teacher..."
Su Lun looked up at the compassionate white-clad phantom deep in the mist, his heart sighing softly.
Back in the cursed space, Celestia had given two rings, one of which was "Celestia's Blessing" for him.
The other was "Celestia's Protection" for Pestoya, and this ring had a purpose, to protect Pestoya's soul from dissipating.
Now, Su Lun had fully understood this millennium-long arrangement.
Had he waited a thousand years just to kill the soul of the Fallen Angel?
No, not just that.
Mr. and Mrs. Isaac had left their daughter another gift,
The soul origin of an abyssal deity!
With this, Pestoya's path to the highest echelons was smoothed, nine out of ten obstacles removed.
She wouldn't even need to toil in meditation; her future extraordinary status would be frighteningly high.
And at that moment, a voice suddenly came from the communication ring that Su Lun wore, specially provided by the mirror organization, "The Mist Tide has erupted, everyone, evacuate the ruins quickly!"
Hearing this serious warning, the eight-armed spider lance on Su Lun's back revolved at breakneck speed, and he ran far away in a puff of smoke.
Having experienced a "Mist Tide" firsthand, he understood the terror of the abyssal creatures that emerged from within. Moreover, this eruption seemed far more exaggerated than the last.
A glance was enough to spot several gigantic creatures.
An "Abyssal Volcano Turtle" with a volcano on its back that erupted as it moved...
A "Nine-Headed Heart Thief·Odule" resembling nine eels stitched together...
A creature entwined with several thick vines, "Kasantan's Treant"...
Named creatures usually meant they weren't low in intelligence and were all "lord monsters."
And there were countless lesser creatures, like blood-thirsty giant bats, illusionary poison beasts, copper ghost black pythons, and green-tailed two-headed lizards, swarming together.
It was not only monsters below the third rank; there were also fourth, fifth, sixth ranks...
These abyssal creatures, spewed out by the Mist Tide, were like a tsunami's fish, dense and overwhelming.
One alone might not be a big problem, but with such a staggering number, no Scavenger team could withstand them.
Even Mr. Jing and his associates had to avoid their sharp edges.
The black mist erupted from the pit, rapidly spreading to the surroundings of the ruins, like locusts passing by, leaving behind screams and gunfire.
With eight legs and the ability for Spatial Displacement, Su Lun ran quickly and felt no immediate danger.
But soon, the crisis arrived.
He thought the ruins had been mostly cleared and nothing would obstruct his way.
However, unexpected to him, with the "Mist Tide" release, the entire cavern boiled over, as the abyssal creatures and mutants hidden in the deep recesses also scurried out.
The Scavenger teams had only cleared the surface dwelling monsters; the ruins' complex sewer system hid various swarms of creatures.
As Su Lun sprinted with his eight-armed spider lance, the ground suddenly began to roll.
Wormlike tendrils, as large as giants, and coated with wet, corrosive mucus, sprang up from the ground like bamboo shoots after a rain. It was as if he had stumbled into a pink seaweed zone, an ocean of tentacles everywhere, wrapping around any living creature that passed and pulling them underground.
Su Lun, witnessing the tentacle monster that spanned several blocks, felt a chill down his spine.
And it was unknown how massive the creature's body buried deep in the ground was.
Luckily, he had teleportation; sensing the scent of live flesh, the tentacles began to surround him, but he teleported away just in time.
Identifying those tentacles revealed them to belong to a fifth-ranked "Overlord" abyssal creature, "Abbas the Flesh Mountain"!
It was the source of contamination that led to Brooke's mutation in the "Bell Tower Monster" cursed space.
This creature was so vast; its body was all soft flesh, virtually all weak spots, but at the same time had no weaknesses. Even with a black sickle, there was no way to attack.
Su Lun dared not provoke it further. After several consecutive teleports, he hurriedly fled.
....
This time's "Mist Tide" was not like the localized diffusion in the ruins before; the black mist, mixed with countless creatures, was like a hundred-meter-tall tsunami, spreading from the center of the ruins outward.
Su Lun left the creature-infested Ruins City and only then did the hair-raising sense of danger dissipate.
The monster was indeed fast, but it was nearly not as swift as his eight-legged sprint.
Before long, the outline of the Scavenger camp had already appeared in his sight.
There were many non-combatants in the camp, like professional merchants, noblewomen, and their servants and maids.
They too had already noticed the anomaly within the ruins.
Those with quick wits had already taken to their heels, while those still observing were now only filled with despair. To these people, the camp that once seemed as fortified as an "iron hedgehog" now had its defenses look as feeble as a thin sheet of paper in the face of the black tsunami.
Su Lun didn't enter the city but instead darted directly towards the cave leading back to Old Lington.
Before long, the mist engulfed the entire camp, and although invisible to the eye, one could still hear the incessant gunfire.
Su Lun's hearing was very sensitive, and he noticed that the sound of gunfire within the camp had dissipated in a very short span of time.
By the looks of it, the Scavenger camp was thoroughly destroyed.
Moreover, the Dawn Relic would be a "forbidden zone" for a very long time to come.
However, the good news was that the monsters that had just emerged from the abyss seemed to require a high concentration of "mist," and they would not actively rush out of the mist-covered area. It was like fish would not leave water.
And as the mist seeped into the extensive network of caves, its spread slowed down, and the marauding monsters didn't catch up.
Su Lun let out a long sigh of relief.
He happened upon a group of several hundred refugees and, putting away his eight-armed spider spear, he followed the large party as they slowly made their escape.
Along the way, they encountered even more fleeing people.
After an entire day of escape, those noble lords and ladies could not run anymore, and they encountered a merchant caravan camp that had departed for the city half a day before. They decided to stop moving forward.
Thousands of people came together, finally feeling a sense of safety.
Everyone began to make fire and set up camp.
Su Lun also mingled in the camp, setting up a tent for himself.
Before long, clusters of campfires illuminated the entire camp, the light shimmering and the smell of food wafting through the air.
But within the camp, there was only wailing.
The Scavengers were accustomed to this, life and death were routine, but
those from the upper classes had never experienced such hardship, each one of them grumbled endlessly.
After a whole day of fleeing, even with guards assisting and carrying them, everyone was utterly exhausted.
"Ah, I just hope the Duke won't blame us Scavengers for the poor hunt this time. This isn't desertion on the battlefield."
"How could he lay blame? The camp has been destroyed. I've always heard of the 'fog tide' in the ruins, but I never expected it to be this terrifying..."
"I reckon that for a short while, the 'fog tide' won't dissipate, and the excavation of Dawn City's relic..."
"I heard that Princess Teresa also went to the relic, I wonder if she encountered any danger..."
"The Duke's manor has so many experts, there's no need for us to worry. We should think about what to say when we get back to the city. The major families have suffered heavy losses this time; Old Lington might be severely weakened..."
"..."
The fog tide came suddenly, and no one knew what exactly happened at the center of the ruin.
