However, the abrupt emergence of the "third-party force" represented by Anbei Taiwa made the situation more complicated.
Suddenly, Su Lun thought of something and asked, "Is there any movement from King Oleg of the North Sea?"
Su Lun had not asked before, so naturally, the Princess wouldn't have brought it up on her own initiative. Now hearing this, she said, "The news I've just received is that King Oleg of the North Sea's Ninth Fleet has set sail from Pirate City towards the Mountain Hermit. The fleet, led by 'Gluttonous Grand General' Yixier Peion himself, will arrive at Edo shortly."
"Oh..."
Su Lun frowned as he listened.
He wasn't too surprised that Oleg would send more people.
The previous fifteenth tax collection vanguard team was essentially sent as "cannon fodder" to probe the situation.
Now that the entire army has been wiped out, naturally, an even stronger fleet would come.
A fleet led by a Class 7 professional indeed had the military strength to suppress Mountain Hermit.
He was just puzzled whether King Oleg truly was the "third-party force" meddling in Mountain Hermit affairs.
If not, then who could it be?
As they discussed this, the Princess looked at them again, "I am very grateful that Mr. Su Lun and Miss Chekhov plan to accompany me. If things become impossible, please ensure your own safety..."
Chekhov raised an eyebrow and glanced at her as if she hadn't really taken in what the Princess said.
Impossible?
First strike, then talk.
Su Lun also wore an indifferent expression.
No matter how intense the battle, his ability to protect himself was not weak.
If things really became unmanageable, he at least had some chance of keeping Princess Mitsuko, this newly befriended ally, safe.
....
As they chatted, the hot pot meal came to an end.
Lorota tidied up the room and sat down with her long sword to begin meditation.
Although staying inside the room pressed by Chitose's aura was quite uncomfortable, it was also the best opportunity to gain insight.
The Demon Blade, now possessing a significant spiritual nature, was fiercely contending with Chitose's fierce Sword Intent, wrapped in the demonic aura of its previous users.
It was like two peerless swordsmen sparring, a rare chance to observe.
Even Su Lun, a layman in this regard, passively perceived insights into the way of the sword.
He didn't sleep, always vigilant of Chitose succumbing to demonic possession, sitting beside her while flipping through the scroll of Magician lineage.
Princess Mitsuko was also nearby, surrounded by divine instruments like the Kagura bells, Bat Fan, taiko drums, and bamboo flute, ready to help immediately if something went wrong.
Unconsciously, the night deepened.
Looking out the window, the moonlight was like silver, casting mottled black shadows in the courtyard.
In the room, the phantom of Raksasa and the Hundred Eyes Centipede were still in a stalemate, and Chitose's condition remained stable.
Part of Su Lun's attention was always on her, while his eyes quickly scanned the text on the scroll.
Before, the content of the scroll had been abstruse and difficult to understand, but now it seemed clear and straightforward.
The predecessors of the Magician lineage had summed up these highly practical rune Secret Techniques over countless years, which were priceless treasures.
In the outside world, such a systematic body of lineage knowledge would be impossible to purchase.
As Su Lun looked at the Secret Techniques, his eyes sparkled with enthusiasm.
From first order to second order, third order... all the way to sixth order, countless epic rune knowledge unfolded before him completely.
Having assimilated the "Imitation of Primeval Runes," even the most arcane secret techniques were instantly understandable to Su Lun.
Linguistic runes were swiftly digested, integrating into his mind and adding lush leaves to his already dense skill tree.
This systematic rune knowledge completed an vital part of Su Lun's work on puppetry, alchemy, mechanical research, and combat.
Beyond the technical aspects of rune knowledge, what Su Lun coveted most was the Rune Old Man's signature move—[Runic Flesh].
Treating one's flesh like a crafted object, inscribing runes into skin, flesh, veins, and bones, until reaching the state of a "human-shaped curse artifact."
"This [Runic Flesh], combined with the [Vajra] secret technique, to create a [Rune Vajra], would skyrocket defensive power by many times over..."
"And it is not just the metal series, there are also wind, fire, water series... matched with various elemental techniques, all of which would enhance power."
"Blood runes directly amplify the toughness of muscles, meaning I could even consider initiating hormonal outbursts on the fourth or fifth levels, as my body would be able to handle it. Why do I feel like I am straying further and further onto the path of melee combatants..."
"..."
Su Lun's thoughts raced through his mind.
Not to mention anything else, his life-preserving ability had taken a substantial leap forward.
Then another thought occurred to him.
"Oh, right, the living dead!"
Su Lun remembered those top-level rune-inscribed living dead in the cursed space of [Havier's Morgue of Grudges] in Old Lington.
Now that he thought about it, weren't they of the same origin?
With this scroll as a "textbook" in his possession, along with the research notes of the resurrection madman Tillmido M. Chekhov on the living dead, everything he needed was at hand.
Those high-level rune secrets that were once beyond reach were now finally within his grasp for in-depth study.
If he managed to create those top-tier living dead, sheesh...
Su Lun's thoughts soared wildly.
....
Chitose's process of subduing the Demon Blade was somewhat like enduring a trial, a test of who would give in first.
She didn't leave the house, and neither did Su Lun and the others.
But the situation seemed quite good, and after enduring for a day and a night, Chitose hadn't fallen behind.
The situation was much better than the previous time.
Su Lun was happy to stay indoors, as he was indeed very busy.
After completing his rune knowledge, he had so many things to do.
Inscripting [Runic Flesh] upon himself, creating advanced decoys, the living dead, and finally having a lead on the [Hand of Silver]...
As for the required materials, with Princess Mitsuko, the Mountain Hermit, they scarcely lacked anything.
In the room,
Chitose engaged in meditation with the Demon Blade, while Su Lun busied himself with other tasks.
Because of the advancement in rune knowledge, his mind suddenly opened up.
Inspirations bubbled up like a spring.
He needed to turn too many thoughts into action, and the sinister eight-armed spider lance behind him was incessantly busy.
Some were carving puppets, others tinkering with machinery, some dealing with silver arms in petri dishes, and still others drawing runes onto his skin.
The room, too, was made to resemble a spider's den, with various reference materials and alchemy ingredients hanging from threads, densely arranged...
Since Su Lun had grown accustomed, he didn't avoid others and displayed his multitasking abilities to the fullest.
This scene had long left the Shinfuku Mitsuko and Lollota speechless.
Having previously witnessed Su Lun's accomplishment in Alchemy and his extraordinary combat capabilities, they were already quite amazed. Now, seeing his endless variety of "fancy moves," they were lost for words.
This near-madness of multitasking was dizzying. It was already quite something for a normal person to do well in one activity, yet Su Lun was managing several simultaneously without a single mistake.
What's key is, he still had time to chat with the Princess, exchanging knowledge.
In the midst of the busyness, time flew by.
....
Finally, a breakthrough occurred in the deadlock between Senjo and the Demon Blade.
At noon the following day, Lollota was meditating, the Princess was reading, and Su Lun was still engrossed in his various research endeavors.
Each was busy with their own activities.
Suddenly!
The Princess noticed something and exclaimed in surprise, "Eh... The 'Zongzheng's' demonic energy is weakening, it seems like Miss Senjo is showing signs of taming it."
Su Lun, who had been monitoring Senjo's situation, naturally noticed the anomaly as well.
His hands paused for a brief moment as he glanced over.
Senjo was still meditating with closed eyes, and though her aura was much weaker than the previous day, the six-armed Asura phantom behind her clearly had gained the upper hand. The Hundred Eyes Centipede's ferocity was contained, showing faint signs of submission.
Seeing this, Su Lun also felt it was strange.
Could it really go so smoothly?
At least the first time Senjo got her hands on this Demon Blade, she almost became demon-possessed.
The Princess was naturally puzzled, murmuring to herself, "Eh... That's strange. The hardest part of mastering this Demon Blade is to tame the sealed Hundred Eyes Demon King inside. Such a mature great demon can sense a person's fate. Under normal circumstances, except for gods and spirits, humans can hardly gain its recognition."
Being a Shinto Shrine Maiden, she clearly knew much more.
This was also why the 'Onimaru Zongzheng' had never been tamed before.
With a puzzled face, the Princess thought of something, "Miss Senjo's state of mind seems much more resolute than before. Could it be because the seal on her arm was lifted? But that can't be right... The Demon Blade did not recognize her fatal potential before, so why would it submit now?"
Su Lun, too, understood why it was going so smoothly this time.
It seemed Senjo's fate had grown stronger?
The Princess's eyes shifted, suddenly thinking of something. She looked at Su Lun and asked, "Mr. Su Lun, could something have happened at the cliffside hot spring earlier? Looking back, I also feel that Miss Senjo's fate seems to have changed since then..."
All these days, they had been together constantly, the only time out of sight being the day they went to the hot springs on the cliff.
"Nothing happened..."
Su Lun did not understand these matters of fate.
But listening to the Princess, he also reminisced for a moment.
That day, soaking in the hot springs, there seemed nothing special.
Just lifting the seal, and then...
Oh,
Right,
He also took a little advantage of the gambler's wife.
Su Lun figured that probably wasn't the reason, right?
Seeing Su Lun's expression, the Princess blinked, as if guessing something, but did not pursue further, merely smiling.
It was then that a sudden, extraordinary event occurred.
As soon as the Demon Blade's defeated momentum was revealed, it suddenly collapsed like a landslide.
Senjo, meditating with her eyes closed, suddenly opened her eyes, and an invisible aura instantly swept across the entire room.
In that instant, her eyes blazed with a red light, yet they were also crystal clear.
The surging demonic energy mingled with the Asura phantom behind her, enveloping her entire being in an eerie atmosphere!
"Did it work?"
Su Lun's eyes sharpened with a hint of anticipation.
He distinctly sensed Senjo's exaggerated and somewhat alien demonic aura, but did not detect any chaos in her body.
This meant that she might have tamed the Demon Blade?
The Princess and Lollota also looked on expectantly.
Just then, the bizarre aura on Senjo retracted abruptly, and despite her tired appearance, she could not conceal her excitement.
Her gaze focused as she looked at them and said solemnly, "I have mastered the blade!"
Upon hearing this, all three of them heaved a sigh of relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - 320 "Shadow Buddha" Kato Danzo
chapters.content:
Su Lun did not know how much the "Demon Blade Hyakumenzou Masamune" would enhance Mitsuko's capabilities, but it was definitely much stronger than when he, a novice in Sword Dao, had it in his possession.
After taming the Demon Blade, Mitsuko's entire demeanor had dramatically transformed, making her seem more ethereal and elusive. With her aura radiating outward, she resembled a divine being, like a Rakshasa Woman from hell, exuding a terrifying murderous aura that chilled onlookers to the bone.
The Famed Sword, once recognizing its master, would perfectly synchronize, and with this Demon Blade in hand, Mitsuko even outdid Su Lun with his Black Sickle, as if there was nothing in the world she couldn't cut through.
However, this wasn't without side effects.
According to Mitsuko, even though she could now wield this masterwork of the twelve craftsmen, she would continually suffer from the demonic influences of the Demon Blade in the future. The sword had developed a spirit, had been worshipped for years with incense, and had become a demonic weapon of the hellish path. As she continued to battle, it would absorb the spirits and the aura of slaughter from beneath its blade to grow stronger, becoming increasingly ferocious over time, and would eventually backlash against its wielder.
This meant that she would need to constantly become stronger and make breakthroughs in her Sword Dao to keep it suppressed.
In this regard, Su Lun wasn't worried at all—Mitsuko's faith in her Sword Dao was unshakeably strong, beyond ordinary people.
....
Princess Shinfuku Mitsuko had previously chosen to come to Tea Crying Mountain as a refuge.
Now that the situation was largely clear, there was no point in continuing to stay.
After some discussion, they decided to set off immediately and head back to Edo.
The next morning, they left the grandma's tea house and arrived at a mountain road junction from Surveyor's Mountain towards Akita. Mitsuko had already informed the royal family with a paper crane, and they were to be escorted by guards arranged to meet them.
This was a secluded hill, not a single passerby in sight.
The group had already been waiting here for a while.
Su Lun was not the least bit impatient.
He was preoccupied with inscribing eight layers of runes on his own skin, which he could do anywhere. He could draw while walking; waiting was even better.
The practice of Rune Magicians involved the Secret Technique "Rune Flesh," which required inscribing runes on body skin, muscles, and bones depending on one's needs, to produce runes of a certain element or effect.
Su Lun was just starting out.
To complement the "Vajra" Secret Technique, he was creating a gold-adaptive sixth-order rune called "Gold Dragon Pattern." This variant rune was complex, somewhat similar to weaving a fishing net—interlocking loops that formed a "rune protection net" over the body. It could resist, disperse, and cushion attacks. Once inscribed, it also significantly enhanced the toughness of the skin, dramatically increasing close combat and survival abilities.
Su Lun had no issues comprehending rune theory, but it was meticulous work that required a lot of time; thus, he spent almost the entire day and night tinkering with it.
Mitsuko, having just tamed the Demon Blade, spent her days holding the blade, "communicating feelings" with it.
Seeing Su Lun working meticulously, she didn't forget the opportunity to train her disciple, "Aren't you always admiring how great your 'Mr. Su Lun' is? Now you understand why he's so formidable, right? Today's practice task is to perform the Iai Slash three thousand times..."
"Yes, Teacher."
Lorota was very serious and obedient; she immediately began practicing the Iai Slash, the sharp clang of metal resounding incessantly.
Princess Mitsuko, overhearing Mitsuko's words, chimed in, "Mr. Su Lun really is very diligent. He's always hard at work, which is no wonder he's so formidable."
Su Lun simply smiled noncommittally.
He was accustomed to it, as studying and researching were integral parts of his life; it had always been like this for him.
This was also a day in the life of an Alchemist.
At that moment, he glanced at the time and casually asked, "Miss Mitsuko, did you arrange to meet the guard at exactly ten o'clock?"
"Yes. They seem to be late."
Mitsuko frowned as she listened.
The appointed time was almost upon them, yet there was no sign of the guards.
A look of unease appeared on her face.
As a princess, under normal circumstances, the royal warriors could only be early, never late.
If they were late, it likely meant something had happened.
"..."
Su Lun also frowned slightly upon hearing this.
Many factions were currently seeking Mitsuko's death, and he harbored no illusions of luck.
The hill's elevation was high, and black crows stood on the treetops, looking out at a distance. Even with their shared vision, nothing unusual was detected.
But it was exactly this calm that gave Su Lun a vague bad feeling.
As he watched Mitsuko release another paper crane, probably trying to confirm the situation, he felt they might only need to wait.
However, before long, a death crow perched on a branch, seemingly sensing something, suddenly started cawing loudly.
Su Lun's expression changed abruptly, and he exclaimed, "Not good, let's move!"
At his words, Mitsuko, who had been resting on a rock nearby, sprung to her feet and asked in a grave tone, "What happened?"
Princess Mitsuko, not understanding what was going on, looked at Su Lun with confusion.
"Not sure. But danger is approaching!"
Su Lun's expression was grave; he himself was also unclear about the situation.
But he knew well that the death crow's ability was to foresee death.
Its urgent warning just now meant that a "deadly" danger was quietly approaching!
Seeing Su Lun's serious demeanor, both Mitsuko and the Princess tensed, asked no further questions, and followed the already retreating Su Lun.
...
As Su Lun ran, several thoughts rapidly crossed his mind.
If danger was approaching, then it was most likely those aiming to assassinate the Princess. The warning from the death crow as a "deadly danger" meant the opponent's strength must be very formidable. Had it been him setting up an ambush, the main roads would definitely be heavily guarded.
"Take the mountain path, don't take the main road!"
Su Lun glanced at the completely deserted flat road and suddenly changed direction.
He had been carefully observing the terrain near the hill, and if there were an ambush, only the winding mountain path would offer the greatest possibility of escape.
He plunged into the woods, followed closely by Qian Tao, Princess, and Rorota.
Almost at the same moment they left the hill, a sudden "swoosh" sound came from not far behind them.
Listening again, there was a "boom" as a signal arrow exploded in the air.
Seeing this, Qian Tao and Princess also immediately understood what had happened: there was an ambush!
They sped even faster through the mountain forest.
....
"There seem to be a lot of them, it might be people from the Takeda government!"
"Not necessarily. It could be that Abe Yasukazu..."
"Be careful. Let's retreat from this mountain area first."
"..."
Although their combat ability was not bad, they were not foolish enough to fight within the enemy's encirclement.
Su Lun was holding a black umbrella, running while expressionlessly pondering something.
Just then, he suddenly noticed something, his fingers grasped at the void, and with a tug on several transparent threads, he watched a thick tree cleanly cut into two halves.
Qian Tao and Princess also noticed Su Lun's action, and with a glance, they saw fresh, crimson blood flowing from the cut on the fallen tree.
There had been a ninja using Wood Escape hiding inside the tree trunk!
Looking up, dozens of bamboo gliders suddenly appeared in the sky.
Princess's pupils contracted, recognizing the ninja star emblem on their clothes, and exclaimed, "Those are Koga ninjas!"
Su Lun's gaze sharpened.
There are many sects of ninjas in Mountain Hermit, mainly the Koga and Iga sects.
Iga sect ninjas are skilled in protection and pharmacology, loyal to the royal Shinfuku family.
However, Koga sect ninjas are belligerent, skilled in ninjutsu and researching various ninja tools, usually serving warlords in warfare, and are very active on battlefields. Currently, the largest faction is within the Black Dragon Syndicate.
Seeing Koga ninjas meant there was an eighty percent chance the people were from the Takeda government!
It was now clear that the enemy had long been lying in ambush, even predicting that they would take the mountain forest route. This meant the situation on other routes was even more perilous.
It was fortunate the heralding bird had warned them earlier; otherwise, if the encirclement had closed, the consequences would have been unimaginable.
But now that their whereabouts had been exposed, a major battle was unavoidable.
Su Lun, seeing the ninjas beginning to jump down from the sky, thought of something and quickly said, "Miss Princess, there might be strong opponents among the enemies, prepare the second plan."
"Okay!"
Princess, without any hesitation, took out a human-shaped white paper from her bosom, bit her finger to draw blood, drew a spell charm on it, and handed the newly created "Shikigami paper doll" to Su Lun.
In that moment, an old man appeared in front of Su Lun and the others, blocking their path.
This guy wore a dusty, tattered felt hat and had a sake gourd hanging at his waist, his nose reddened by alcohol flush; he looked like an inebriated country farmer.
But despite his disheveled appearance, once Princess saw him, she yelled, "Be careful, it's one of the 'Demon Hand' Koga Three Ninjas, Ueno Sasaki!"
Su Lun had heard of this man, a special jonin, an assassin-type ninja whose reputation definitely ranked in the top ten of Mountain Hermit ninjas.
There are no false reputations under great names, and he didn't underestimate him at all.
The little old man was unceremonious, looking at the three approaching, he raised his hand forming a seal, and suddenly a visible wind blade sprayed out of his mouth, "Ninpo: Wind God Kama Itachi Technique!"
The wind blades grew elongated with the wind, initially just the size of a finger when expelled, they quickly turned into crescent moon wind blades.
Those thousands of wind cycles rampaged through the forest, and in the blink of an eye, these thick trees were "blown" down like cut wheat.
Qian Tao was at the forefront, his sword swinging impermeably.
Astonishingly, when the sword blade touched those wind blades, sparks flew with a clang, indicating that the wind blades contained the edges of thousands of sickle blades.
The wind-attribute Ninjutsu permeated everywhere, its area attack unstoppable.
Su Lun, lacking Qian Tao's exceptional swordsmanship, pinched a sorcerer's seal, and his skin instantly shimmered with a dark golden luster. Looking closer, it effused a pattern like dragon scales. A fifth-tier "Vajra" Secret Technique combined with a sixth-tier Rune "Rune Golden Body"—not so easily breached, the dense wind blades cutting on his skin left not a single mark.
Su Lun's attention was never on these wind blades.
He knew this was the enemy's smoke screen.
Looking again, that little old man in the distance had indeed disappeared into thin air.
"Such a superb Invisibility Technique! Worthy of being one of the Koga Three Ninjas..."
Su Lun's gaze slightly narrowed.
Sight, hearing, and touch completely failed to detect that man's presence, only in the Soul Perception did he sense a soul fire mingling with the wind blades moving towards Princess.
Pretending not to notice, it was in that instant that Su Lun suddenly burst out, "String Control Secret Technique: Caged Sparrow!"
With one hand, he pulled, and countless threads turned substantive, enveloping the person's shadow.
Before the threads could sever, a smoke bomb inside suddenly exploded with a bang, and that soul fire, like teleporting, ran a hundred meters away.
The old man, slippery like an eel, quickly fled after his attack failed!
Su Lun inwardly exclaimed, noting the extraordinary escape speed of the Ninjutsu.
Qian Tao, not to be outdone with her volatile temper, hadn't even settled from the wind blades when she fiercely stomped the ground, launching herself like a human cannonball, charging towards the defense line the old man had escaped to.
In midair, he drew his sword and slashed ahead, a Sword Qi tearing through the air.
Ueno Sasaki, compelled to reveal himself from his Wind Escape, crossed his steel claw blades on his hands to block the slash.
Seeing this, Su Lun was already able to roughly gauge Ueno Sasaki's strength.
Although Qian had just tested him with a slash, the ease with which it was blocked suggested that this guy also had the strength of a fifth-order professional.
"Ueno Sasaki is proficient in the Art of Wind Escape, don't tangle with that guy!"
"Okay!"
Su Lun and his three companions didn't pay attention to that guy and continued running towards the deeper part of the dense forest.
But just then, they vaguely heard someone chanting next to their ears: "Ninpo: Myriad Flower Wheel Technique!"
Looking again, the forest suddenly filled with falling cherry blossoms, like snowflakes, breathtakingly beautiful, casting a momentary spell of fascination.
The Princess quickly warned, "Be careful, that is 'Sakurahime' Kobe Kaoru, one of the three Koga Ninjas. Skilled in controlling demons and proficient in illusion techniques. She has the 'Mind Replacement' bloodline limit!"
In the Mountain Hermit nation, because believers cultivate divine power, the probability of innate awakening is very low. But once there is an awakening, the probability of bloodline inheritance is extremely high, often referred to as "bloodline limit."
Having heard the Princess's words, Su Lun immediately translated the term in his mind to an alchemy talent, [B-025-Instigator].
This talent naturally possesses persuasive charisma and high growth in spiritual power.
Indeed, it is a talent very suitable for an illusionist.
Qian, possessing the Demon Blade, naturally wasn't affected.
Only Lolota was momentarily dazzled with infatuation, then promptly snapped out of it when hit by the Princess with a Shinkou Bell.
Su Lun had already seen through the illusion technique from the start; such a magician was no big issue for him now.
But what made him more curious was that he had seen this spirit flame before in his Soul Perception.
It was actually the female ninja who had disguised herself as a guide back in Sword Forging Village!
....
This brief encounter revealed some insights to both parties.
"Damn it, weren't Lady Takeda's arms sealed, how could she still possess such strength?!"
"And why is the Demon Blade Sohi here!"
"That one using the strings, that's the guy I told you about, be careful, he is very skilled!"
"..."
Su Lun recognized Kobe Kaoru, and that female ninja recognized him too.
...
"The three Koga Ninjas" had already shown two; from the looks of it, they were determined to kill the Princess.
If Qian and Su Lun hadn't been by her side, perhaps those guys might have had the chance to kill the Princess.
But now, they were far from enough.
However, Su Lun had no intention of fighting.
A warning from the Black Dragon kept him vigilant.
None of these people could pose a fatal threat to them.
After all, ninjas are primarily assassins; without a certain kill, the two particularly sharp ones had not dared to clash but just followed along.
With the Black Dragon still cawing, Su Lun and his companions had not paused for a moment, killing several blocking Koga ninjas along the way, thinking they had probably broken out of the encirclement.
But just then, Su Lun suddenly sensed an incredibly fast-moving figure.
He shouted urgently, "Someone underground!"
"This person is strong! Be careful, I'll stop him!"
Qian yelled explosively, also feeling the chilling murderous intent akin to the one she felt when they assassinated the sixth-order Rune Old Man before.
Facing such a high-level adversary, there was no choice but to commit fully.
She reached out, and with a magical trick, her kimono was instantly replaced with a set of bright red armor, the famed war armor 'Iron Red Scales Painted Five Panels Fully Equipped.'
With a Tengu mask covering her face, she suddenly looked extremely formidable.
This time, she drew the Demon Blade Sohi outright.
Her fighting spirit was surging.
Watching Qian's actions, Su Lun's gaze also sharpened.
For someone who could make the now fifth-order Qian say "very strong," there probably weren't many in Mountain Hermit.
This guy was probably the reason why the Black Dragon had been so restless.
Su Lun dared not be the slightest bit careless; the eight-armed spider spears were already displayed behind him.
The man who emerged from the earth just a hundred meters away stood out, clad in black iron armor, face covered, legs bound, in standard ninja attire, with a clan crest of a crescent moon on his armor.
Seeing this, the Princess was also surprised, "That is... that is the leader of the Koga Ninja Clan, 'Shadow Buddha' Kato Danzo!"
Listening to this almost legendary name, Su Lun's eyes filled with solemnity.
The number one person in the Mountain Hermit ninja clan, a master of both Ninjutsu and physical techniques, the sole "Shadow level" ninja.
Although his Soul Perception only showed the strength of a fifth-order professional, this man's true power was profoundly inscrutable.
Legend had it that this man had actually assassinated a Daimyo amidst a myriad of troops!
....
Su Lun and the rest, due to their decisive actions, had now escaped the encirclement, with only a few high-ranking ninjas catching up to them.
But seeing the "Shadow Buddha" Kato Danzo in front of them, they stopped in their tracks.
Su Lun also felt somewhat intrigued, actually encountering such a "legendary character".
But since he had seen the person, he wasn't panicking anymore.
Kato Danzo was strong, but many of his techniques were "already known".
The outcome of the battle could also be somewhat predicted.
Currently, with the Demon Blade in hand and famed armor on his body, Su Lun was confident in self-protection, not to mention beating Kato.
Moreover, with the Princess by his side, if it really came to a fight, there was a good chance both sides would suffer.
Su Lun sensed the rising battle intent from Chisen standing beside him, guessing what she wanted to do, he asked, "Chisen, what do you think?"
The safest plan was naturally not to force a confrontation; as long as Chisen could hold off the strongest one, Su Lun and the others could find a way to kill some of the others.
Then, it was time to...run again.
As expected, Chisen responded with the answer he had anticipated, "You guys go first, I want to test my blade on this guy."
Though both actions involved fighting, "holding back" and "testing the blade" represented two different mindsets, one defensive and the other aggressive.
Swordsmen are forged through countless battles like this.
Encountering a worthy adversary and not fighting when the urge struck, felt wrong.
The "Shadow Buddha" Kato Danzo was not only a ninja, but in terms of swordsman skill, he absolutely ranked among the top five within the Mountain Hermits—a top-level giant of the sword.
His strength could pose a real threat to Chisen, making him the best possible opponent.
Chisen now had the Demon Blade in hand, just missing a fierce battle to feel utterly fulfilled.
"Oh."
A fierce light flashed in Su Lun's eyes as he casually responded.
During the brief moment of their exchange, Kato Danzo wasn't idle.
Just then, the ninja formed a technique seal and exclaimed, "Ninpo: Fertile Cloud Wild Marsh Technique!"
Thunderous sounds were unremitting; upon another glance, the man had actually spit out a waterfall. The dam-like volume of water, like a mountain torrent, voraciously washed over everything, instantly leaving rocks and trees in a state of disarray...
In a blink, the vast forest had turned into a marshland.
"So this is the 'Shadow's' strength..."
Su Lun's Octopus Spear floated easily on the surface as he remarked sentimentally.
He also looked at the extravagant volume of water being spit out, not understanding the principle, and internally criticized, "How can this guy spit out so much water?"
Ninjutsu and Alchemy are entirely different; this technique wasn't just concentrated water elements, but more like using a spatial spell to pull a river from somewhere else. Otherwise, if it were completely like a magician gathering water elements to cast a spell, it would require a seventh-tier professional to produce such an amount of water.
For a group, this ninjutsu was definitely a disaster-level attack.
But for Su Lun and his group, the problem wasn't too big.
Just as Su Lun was pondering the motive behind Kato Danzo creating so much water, with another look, the man was also using a special skill, directly stepping on the water and charging over.
It turned out this was to create a favorable battle terrain for himself.
Seeing this, Chisen didn't show any weakness either, shouting out loud, "Here I go!"
"Snap," "snap," "snap"...a series of Stepping on Air resounded.
One skimmed the water; the other stomped the air, charging towards each other.
In the blink of an eye, the two were about to collide.
Unfortunately, Chisen had just advanced to the fifth rank, and her strength might be much weaker than Kato Danzo's. But the sword in her hand was the "Demon Blade Masamune."
It could blind, possess demonic aura, and confuse the mind...many negative statuses.
With one slice, Sword Qi extended for hundreds of meters, and waves several meters high surged on the water's surface.
The moment Kato Danzo made contact, darkness filled his vision, and he immediately knew something was wrong. His reaction was extremely fast as he violently withdrew his body, leaving the affected area.
With that one slice, he immediately knew the strength of his opponent.
With only his eyes visible beneath his cover, his gaze turned icy as his hands formed the ninja technique seal.
But this time, a faint luminescence condensed around his body, as if blessed by some mystical volition.
"Divine Arts: Thousand-Armed Stone Buddha"
Kato Danzo finally used the ultimate technique of the Iga ninja, handed down in secrecy.
Upon looking again, a Stone Buddha of several hundred meters in height appeared out of nowhere, imposing and terrifying in its divine might.
This move, it was said to have the power of a deity!
...
Just as the two exchanged blows, Su Lun had already run a great distance in another direction.
Feeling the earth-shaking noise behind him, he turned back to look, raising his eyebrows, "Indeed, these believers in divinity really have unimaginable strength..."
He was no match for this level.
"But then again, to force out the opponent's full strength with one move, Chisen has really grown strong..."
Thinking this, Su Lun didn't look back, leading the few pursuers behind him and disappearing into the mountain forests.

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - 321 The Mysterious President of the Black Dragon Society
chapters.content:
Make adjustments before changes. Two of the Koga's top three ninjas arrived, and even Kato Danzo, an "elite-class" ninja who had long faded from the public eye, was present. This lineup was sufficient to assassinate any Daimyo from the Mountain Hermit nation.
Furthermore, considering the troops that might be barricading the main roads, the Takeda Shogunate was decidedly set on winning this round.
Unfortunately, they had underestimated the strength of Su Lun and his companions.
Or rather, they had not anticipated the variable at the Princess's side, one capable of taming the Demon Blade Zongzheng — a Chihiro, and one Su Lun.
As Su Lun ran, he also weighed the pros and cons.
A royal princess of the current era, who had almost no connection to the right of imperial succession. Therefore, if Takeda Nobuyasu went to such lengths to kill her, it was very likely because of the "Black Sun Grand Festival."
Su Lun was also curious about what role the Princess would play in the ritual that made the Shogunate's people so determined to kill her.
On the other side, Chihiro's battle with "Shadow Buddha" Kato Danzo was of such a level that even elite ninjas had no right to interfere. Therefore, when Su Lun fled, he also attracted the pursuit of nearly all Koga ninjas following him.
In fact, they weren't coming for him.
But because of the "Shinfuku Mitsuko" he had at his side.
As long as the target was there, those pursuers were relentless.
However, upon closer inspection, the expression in the eyes of the "Princess" next to Su Lun seemed slightly stiff.
...
Behind them, the sounds of "bang" and "bang" were ceaseless.
All kinds of pellets, ninja darts, shuriken, flying needles... whipped past him.
Although these Mountain Hermit ninjas were without advanced firearms, they wielded all sorts of peculiar fire tubes.
Don't be fooled by these firearms that seem crude, taking half a minute to reload after each shot; their destructive power is far from small. The secret-formula gunpowder creates poisonous smoke and some special shrapnel upon ignition, and their damage is no less than that of a grenade.
Luckily for Su Lun who was tough-skinned, this shrapnel couldn't penetrate the protective "Rune Vajra" he wore.
With a tell-tale bird sharing its vision from the sky, Su Lun wasn't worried about being surrounded.
He continuously switched directions in the forest, always managing to avoid the encirclement of his enemies.
But the dangers were real, and several times he was almost caught by his pursuers.
Actually.
Su Lun had had the opportunity to shake off those chasing him.
After his advancement, the curse properties of his eight-limbed spider lance had also increased, and now his mountain Spatial Displacement ability had also greatly improved, his speed not the slightest bit inferior to those ninjas skilled in various Escape Techniques.
Besides, he had Spatial Displacement.
He wasn't escaping with all his might simply because he was deliberately creating the illusion to those behind him that they could catch up.
After all, in Plan B, adept at strategic retreat, he was merely "bait."
Because the "Shinfuku Mitsuko" at his side, was also a fake!
It was a life-sized puppet and an illusion created with "Robert's Monocle."
...
Having spent day and night together these days, Su Lun naturally knew thoroughly the appearance and figure of Shinfuku Mitsuko, so the illusion he conjured up could easily deceive the eye.
Moreover, the puppet was also plastered with the Princess's "stand-in paper figure," making it difficult for the sensory ninjas to distinguish true from false by aura.
As for the real Princess, she had taken the chaos earlier as a chance to hide away.
The longer Su Lun drew the pursuers away, the more time the Princess had to escape.
But ultimately, it was a fake, and after some time, it began to show flaws.
With the overwhelming number of pursuers, no matter how careful Su Lun was, he could protect himself, but not the "Princess."
```
Two special Jonin's moves were not simple either, as they seemed to have also sensed something fishy, making multiple probes. Finally, "Demon Hand" Ueno Sasaki blew a series of wind spells haphazardly, the "Princess" couldn't avoid them in time and had a leg sliced off.
Looking at the blood gushing from the severed leg of the "Princess," the illusion expert "Sakurahime" Kobe Kaoru finally realized the problem and shouted, "Damn it, we've been tricked! It's an illusion!"
Upon hearing this, dozens of ninjas stood frozen in place.
An awkward silence filled the air, as if a flock of crows were "caw-caw-cawing" as they flew by.
Hmm... there actually was a black crow.
Su Lun listened as his ruse was exposed, the corners of his mouth curling slightly. He thought his bloody illusion had been rather convincing and didn't know how it was discovered.
However, having delayed for so long was enough.
By now, the Princess should already be safe.
Given the current situation, it was time for these Koga ninjas to be caught in a dilemma.
With their chase target gone, pursuing Su Lun no longer made much sense.
But then again, it seemed, going back didn't hold much meaning either.
The old man Sasaki made a swift decision, ordering in a light voice, "Kaoru, take the men back to search for them! I'll go kill him!"
Kobe Kaoru thought of her brief encounter with Su Lun in the Sword Forging Village and a touch of worry flashed through her eyes.
She knew that the guy in front of her didn't seem too strong, but his methods were very unorthodox.
It appeared he was even more formidable than before.
But now was not the time for talk, she responded sharply, "Yes! Senior, be careful."
Saying so, she turned with her team and retraced their steps.
....
In the blink of an eye, dozens of Koga ninjas were reduced to just that old man with the rosacea nose.
With the numerical advantage gone, the pressure on Su Lun was suddenly lifted.
The man before him was skilled in wind ninjutsu, could run fast, and was one of the three great ninja, a bona fide fifth-tier professional.
Normally, Su Lun's most prudent course of action would be to flee with all his might.
With his ability for Spatial Displacement, escaping wouldn't be difficult.
But, after hesitating for a moment, he stopped in his tracks.
Su Lun thought of the scene where Senjo confronted Kato Danzo before.
Even when facing an enemy stronger than herself, she was fearless.
Only by facing adversity in life can one feel the kind of pressure that transforms a person.
It was like a renowned saying in alchemy: True gold is tested by fire.
Su Lun knew this was what he lacked.
His character was too cautious and prudent, but it lacked a bit of "spirit".
With this thought, Su Lun looked towards the elderly ninja standing before him.
He had never faced such a high-level opponent alone and had no assurance.
To fight might not mean a loss.
But to avoid battle, he would definitely not "win".
As this thought arose, a fighting spirit surged within him.
The moment Su Lun decided to stay, it was from this old man before him that he truly felt a tangible sense of oppression.
```
This was the sense of crisis that he had been chasing for so long, without feeling the slightest hint of it.
The murderous intent below him made his hairs stand on end.
It seemed like a long time...
Since he had felt the dance of swords.
Su Lun had an inexplicable familiarity with it.
His body took pleasure in this sensation, and a hint of excitement began to rise within him.
"Hehe..."
Su Lun's mouth stretched into a grin, revealing a sinister smile at the corners.
Seeing Su Lun stand still, Ueno Sasaki felt a bit surprised and snorted coldly.
Once again, his feet generated wind, and his entire figure turned into a blur, charging fiercely forward.
Su Lun lured his opponent into the dense forest, then suddenly raised his hand as if presenting a chessboard, and a beam of light enveloped Ueno Sasaki.
A second look showed that the surroundings had already become a space of black and white chessboard squares.
If he had decided to fight properly, then he shouldn't allow outside interference.
....
Realizing he was trapped within a chessboard space, Ueno Sasaki's gaze turned cold, but he did not panic.
"Ninjutsu: Wind Barrier Barrier!"
"Secret Technique: Puppet Theater!"
Both sides were unyielding, forming seals at the same time.
Just as the alchemy formation lit up, and a giant cross slowly condensed in the sky, Su Lun felt the air around his body suddenly become as viscous as asphalt.
And it was solidifying rapidly!
This made every movement he made feel as though he was bound by a weight of a thousand pounds.
"Area control? What a masterful counter!"
A sharp flash passed through Su Lun's eyes.
This Ueno Sasaki, facing a limited space, also used an area control ninjutsu,, making it so neither side seemed to have a definite advantage.
Su Lun was not panicked either, he raised his hand with the "Rune Human Skin Umbrella" and with a "bang," opened it up, the sorcerer's seals in his hands changing once more.
But at that moment, Ueno Sasaki didn't give him the chance to form seals, his figure flickered several times in an approaching rush. His steel claws glittered coldly, grabbing towards Su Lun.
The edge was menacing, and Su Lun hurriedly performed a Flash retreat several meters, only to see the afterimage in front of him being ripped into pieces by the sharp claws.
"Wrong!"
Although Su Lun had dodged that strike, at that moment, his back hairs stood on end.
One's vision could be deceived, but within his soul perception, he clearly sensed that this old man in front of him was just an illusion!
Even without turning around, he knew perfectly well that his enemy was behind him.
"Such a high speed!"
A chill ran through Su Lun's heart.
Flash allowed him to quickly avoid danger, but it was not without an interval time. The enemy had accounted for this, predicting that after one strike failed, another lethal move would follow.
The technique was clearly the very advanced Ninjutsu "Double Illusory Flash"!
The pressure on his back was like a mountain collapsing, and Su Lun immediately felt a sense of death closing in.
When facing such a true expert, no matter how many tricks you have, the threat is limited.
Because the adversary simply won't let you use them!
Su Lun had intended to use the Rune Black Umbrella to strip his opponent of his senses, not expecting that before the sorcerer's seals in his hands could be formed, he would receive such a heavy blow.
He caught sight of the enemy, but his body couldn't keep up with his reaction, forcing him to change hand signals, "Puppet Substitute!"
The next instant, with a "clink" of a subtle cutting sound, "Su Lun's" body was suddenly cut into three sections by the sharp steel claws.
With two strikes, his opponent had broken both his lifesaving techniques.
But at almost the same time, Su Lun's expression shifted anew a few meters away, because at that moment he saw a second "Ueno Sasaki" suddenly appear beside him!
There was no soul fluctuation, only "qi."
"Wind Shadow Clone!"
Su Lun immediately grasped what was happening, deserving of his status as a top-level killer, his opponent's techniques flowed one after another in succession.
But as he realized this, the clone had already launched its attack.
These three desperate moves took only a second or two in total, leaving no time for reaction!
At this extremely critical moment, Su Lun's fingers pulled, and several strands of thread suddenly converged, pulling his body off to one side.
But even so, the claw still struck his back.
"Creak..."
A grating sound, like a metal blade cutting, erupted, and Su Lun was sent flying backward.
Although the claw failed to breach the defense of the "Rune Vajra," the immense force penetrated his organs, causing his blood to surge violently.
Unable to hold back, he spat out a mouthful of blood as he flew backward.
...
"The body is too weak..."
Only when up against a true master did Su Lun fully realize his shortcoming.
His neural response was sufficient, but his physical response simply couldn't keep up.
He had thought his body was strong compared to other Puppet Masters, but now he saw that, in front of a true master, it was still far from enough.
A prestigious Puppeteer, unable to use even a single puppet, was nearly killed.
Luckily for him, he had many lifesaving techniques. Had it been an ordinary Puppet Master, even of the fifth rank, they would have already been captured as a dead soul by now.
Su Lun's thoughts flashed through his mind as his body was thrown backward.
Just then, leveraging the force from being thrown, he finally managed to pull out three puppets in mid-air, guarding himself with them.
These were rune puppets he had refined after advancing to the fourth rank, barely possessing forth rank combat power.
Against such agile opponents, a strategy of quantity over quality with lower-ranking puppets would not hold any advantage. Even if he brought out mechanical armors, besides passively getting hit, they wouldn't be of much use!
For a moment, tactical thoughts whirled in Su Lun's mind.
....
Seeing Su Lun continuously dodge three lethal techniques, "Demon Hand" Ueno Sasaki was also greatly surprised. He had killed many enemies stronger than the one before him with this one move over his years as an assassin, yet this man had escaped?
High explosive physical techniques took their toll on the body, and having used "Double Illusory Flash," Ueno Sasaki wasn't able to perform the triple strike tactic he had previously executed in such a short period.
But his motion paused only for an instant before he vanished from the spot like a wisp of breeze.
Su Lun watched the dissipating light and shadow in front of him, and behind him, he suddenly pulled back the eight-armed spider lance, "Silk Control Secret Method - Flower Waterfall!"
In an instant, numerous threads converged like a white waterfall, closely enveloping him.
This move was for defense, but it also trapped the enemy!
Yet, since the reaction was so swift, the figure still charged in.
"Squeak..."
There was another piercing sound of metal being torn apart.
Su Lun's limbs didn't have enough time to dodge when he felt a burning pain in his chest.
The blade-encased cyclone steel claws didn't slice him into pieces, but they left three bloody gashes on his gold-painted skin.
"These steel claws are also of famous ninja tool quality!"
A thought flashed through Su Lun's mind, and he endured the severe pain, yanking hard on the silk threads, but upon looking again, that Ueno Sasaki had already dropped two smoke bombs and disappeared without a trace.
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
Two explosions rang out.
Purple toxic smoke instantly spread everywhere.
Su Lun covered himself with a plague doctor mask, and to make the other party suffer as well, he also threw out two poison gas bombs.
The hissing sound of gas leaking was incessant, and within moments, the vast chessboard space was covered in purple and black smoke.
The other party was silent, obviously also holding back a major move.
Su Lun didn't dare to delay, and the sorcerer's seals in his hands rapidly formed and changed.
He didn't think that the opponent would be unable to track his position without sight! Such a top-tier ninja's hearing and sense of smell were too keen.
He must strip this guy's senses to stand a chance at victory!
The Rune Vajra umbrella was the only tactic Su Lun could think of as feasible.
Otherwise, even if he played his trump card, the "Xiupunos's Scythe of Night," it would not change the situation!
As Su Lun was concentrating on the spellcasting gestures, the opponent was naturally not idle either.
Suddenly, cries that resembled ghosts howling and wolves wailing surrounded him.
"It's a wide-ranged wind magic spell after all..."
Su Lun's expression grew very solemn, yet he wasn't the least bit surprised inwardly.
In a closed space, there was no avoiding wind-style ninjutsu!
If he were that Ueno Sasaki, he would naturally choose such a method as well.
"Ninjutsu: Mountain Gale Wild Boar Technique!"
Su Lun's hands didn't cease weaving the magician's seals, but just then, he suddenly felt countless wind blades slicing towards him.
Even if there was a waterfall of hair woven into a wall by his side, it was as fragile as paper mache in front of the wind blades, instantly shredded to pieces.
"Such formidable cutting power..."
Su Lun felt the wall of threads being instantly slashed and lamented in his mind.
It was much stronger than his own "Wind Elemental Cutting" ability.
The wind blades also snuck through the gaps in the threads, "scraping" across Su Lun's body, producing a sharp noise that made one's scalp tingle.
Peering through the gaps, he saw a strange wild boar demon head in the sky, faintly showing signs of dispersing his Puppet Theater's crucifix!
This was a suppression of spell rank...
Agonizing pain assaulted Su Lun as if countless steel blades were scraping his bones. He clenched his teeth, choosing to tough it out against the spell.
Without the "Golden Dragon Runes" engraved over the past two days, even the [Rune Vajra] Secret Technique, condensed from fifth-tier principles, would not have held.
But the wind seemed endless, showing no sign of subsiding.
Just when Su Lun felt he was about to collapse and be "dissected," his last sorcerer's seal finally materialized in his hands.
If this attempt were interrupted as well, he'd immediately choose to flee!
Fortunately, as soon as the complex set of sorcerer's seals was completed, Su Lun's momentum abruptly soared, and the phantom of the Grim Reaper surged behind him, sweeping through the whole space with the breath of death. In a low voice, he intoned, "Dark Domain: Nightfall!"
With the spell achieved, a dark tide as pitch as asphalt swept across the entire chessboard space from the black umbrella at its center.
Countless malicious spirits with fierce faces rushed towards the one hidden in the wind nearby.
....
In the confined space, it was also an unavoidable, area-wide attack.
The darkness of the night obscured everything, and Ueno Sasaki instantly felt like he had lost his vision. Not only was his sight stripped away, but his hearing and touch vanished too.
He couldn't even feel his own body, nor the presence of the wind.
It was as if he had stepped into hell, where countless demons beneath were reaching out to pull him into an endless abyss...
Shock flashed through Ueno Sasaki's mind.
Being a potential "special higher ninja," he too had undergone various grueling training. During the psychological control, he bit his tongue hard, momentarily regaining clarity of perception.
Seizing the moment, he spat out a mouthful of crimson blood and burst a Ninjutsu Scroll, forming sword fingers with both hands and shouting before his five senses were stripped away again: "Spiritualism Technique: Wind God Eye Connect!"
No sooner had the Ninjutsu been deployed than a violent wind swept through the sealed chessboard space.
Su Lun was immediately annoyed.
Because, once again, he sensed the will of a god.
Though weak, it was real.
Without a doubt, that guy opposite must have summoned some creature of faith, a "monster" or so to say, "god."
(PS. There are tens of thousands of gods revered by the Mountain Hermit, none of which are of the divine rank)
As expected, another glance revealed a gathering whirlwind amidst flying dust and rocks, the poison was also sucked in, and the visibility cleared up, rapidly forming a vortex in the air.
The whirlwind in the sky visibly enlarged and then transformed into a terrifying eye nearly ten meters in diameter.
He just opened his left eye, a stream of light circling as he looked over.
[Wind God Eye Connect]
Explanatory note: One of the myriad gods manifested by the Mountain Hermit's faith, responsible for the domain of wind, able to use wind as eyes to perceive the shape of objects; fears the energy of Acorus calamus.
Only when Su Lun saw this did he finally take a deep breath in relief.
If it weren't for the will being not too strong, he would have already released the spell and fled.
Many of the Mountain Hermit's "Mountain Gods" and "Water Gods" are not true gods, rather "special monsters" with various bizarre abilities, also possessing weaknesses.
Those weaknesses, besides the knowledgeable Onmyoji and shrine maidens, are rarely known, especially to those outside the Mountain Hermit.
But Su Lun possessed the All-knowing Eye.
He looked at the identified information, his heart leaping with joy. The Princess had given him more material, and there was plenty of Acorus calamus left.
Moreover, he sharply caught onto something, "wind" could only sense solid objects!
....
Ueno Sasaki's eyes were lifeless, his pupils unable to focus, seeing that his body was indeed affected by the "Nightfall Domain."
But somehow, this guy regained control of his body by some means, and the moment he summoned the eye of the storm in the sky, his aura surged several times over without hesitation, and he charged fiercely towards Su Lun.
Su Lun had a moment to breathe and used Flash to avoid him.
In the instant of the Spatial Displacement, several space scrolls simultaneously exploded in the chessboard space, and hundreds of puppets appeared out of thin air.
There were humanoid objects everywhere.
At that moment, Ueno Sasaki suddenly froze, clearly unable to discern where the target was.
Seeing this, Su Lun felt a surge of joy in his heart, "That's right!"
It was in that instant that he finally saw the possibility of defeating his enemy.
Ueno Sasaki didn't understand why so many "people" had suddenly appeared, but he didn't stop his hand movements, forming ninja seals and exclaiming, "Ninjutsu: Peacock Dance!"
As soon as he formed the seal, dense Wind Blades, like peacock feathers, condensed behind him, and he pointed ahead, "Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh," as if darts were flying towards the humanoid objects filling the space.
The area attack instantly sliced through the group of puppets, but unfortunately, without hearing and sight, even if the Wind Blade hit Su Lun, it was hard for Ueno Sasaki to tell which one was the real body.
Su Lun wouldn't give him a chance to tell either; every time he used Flash, a bunch of puppets would appear at the same time.
Besides, even with area ninjutsu, there was still a primary and secondary target.
Unable to catch Su Lun's real body and attacking hundreds of targets at once, the damage caused was nothing more than a scratch.
Su Lun hid among the puppets and began to counterattack.
.....
After a fierce battle for over half an hour, the outcome was finally decided.
One of the three great Ninja of Koga, "Demon Hand" Ueno Sasaki, perished on the spot.
But there was no denying that this guy was truly strong.
Especially after summoning that "Wind God Eye Connect," his Wind Escape Ninjutsu was absurdly powerful.
Even stripped of his five senses by Su Lun, his combat ability remained fearsomely strong.
Meticulous in thought, rich in combat experience, he also knew various tactics to lure the enemy. If he caught even a slight opportunity, he would deliver a fatal blow.
Under normal circumstances, even a fifth-order professional who encountered him would likely have little chance of survival.
Unfortunately for him, Su Lun, with stripped emotions, was as calm as a machine.
He was the kind of person who simply didn't make mistakes or slip-ups in battle!
From the moment Ueno Sasaki failed to distinguish his real body, the outcome of the fight had actually been destined.
No matter how strong he was, human physical strength had its limits.
Su Lun was in no hurry to take action and didn't engage directly. He just used various puppets and undead to wear his opponent down, never giving him a chance to breathe.
The two tested each other, using their wits and bravery. Ueno Sasaki, facing an opponent who never made mistakes, ultimately exhausted all his strength.
Su Lun used a black scythe to kill him.
....
Su Lun, amidst the wreckage of the chessboard space, glanced again at the bisected corpse on the ground, deeply moved, "So strong..."
Having lost hundreds of puppets and sustained numerous wounds himself, it was a narrow victory.
This was also the first time he had killed a fifth-order combatant using only his own strength.
This battle was extreme; relying on numerous cursed items, he had luckily won.
In a head-to-head fight, Su Lun would still have a long way to go.
However, for an Alchemist, there was nothing shameful about this.
Making good use of cursed items was also a part of an Alchemist's fighting strength.
This battle provided tremendous gains.
However, it had also exposed his shortcomings.
His Dark Spiritual Power wasn't strong enough...
His defenses weren't strong enough...
His bodily reactions weren't quick enough...
His "normal attack" methods lacked lethality...
As a Puppeteer, when facing professionals who could directly confront him, his survival tactics were still insufficient...
In an instant, Su Lun's mind flashed through the scenes of the recent battle, and he fully recognized his deficiencies.
Fortunately, knowing his shortcomings, he now had directions for improvement.
But now was not the time to review the battle. He composed himself and stripped the soul from the corpse.
"You have stripped the soul of 'Ueno Sasaki' and gained a wealth of 'Ninjutsu' inheritance knowledge."
"You have comprehended the spell insights related to 'Wind Escape.'"
"You have gained knowledge and insights related to 'Mountain Hermit Divine Path.'"
"You have learned some top-secret information: 'The Black Dragon Association has a very mysterious chairman'..."
"..."
Su Lun had thought he might strip away some profound insights into the "Wind Elemental Laws."
But clearly, he had thought too much.
The Ninjas from Mountain Hermit were also devout believers; their Ninjutsu consisted just of a few spells and seals, far simpler than the casting processes of an Alchemist. But despite this "rudimentary" nature, they achieved incredible effects.
Upon investigation, it was the power of the divine system they believed in that empowered them.
With this stripping, Su Lun understood the whole Ninjutsu system, which didn't delve into the principles but focused on application.
Without knowing the principles, there were few Ninjutsu he, as an Alchemist, could use.
Even the few he could use wouldn't be as powerful as those wielded by Ninjas.
However, certain experiences could be correlated, and he still gained quite a lot.
Moreover, Su Lun had obtained a sensational piece of information from Ueno Sasaki's memories: The chairman of the Black Dragon Association was actually the one known as "the most beautiful princess in the world," Shinfuku Mitsuko?!
This connected perfectly with the previous speculations of his allies.
After their assassination attempt failed, a "mysterious person" appeared behind Shogunate General Takeda Nobuyasu and turned the tide.
Now that the Black Dragon Association was actually under the control of this "Princess Yoru Hime," everything made sense.
But how could a geisha be the boss of the Black Dragon Association?
Moreover, she seemed to have a significant relationship with Takeda's shogunate!
Why specifically her?
Having remained hidden for so many years without discovery, what was she plotting?
Too many questions arose, but Su Lun didn't think about them in depth.
The answers could only be found in Edo.
With the dissolution of the chessboard space, he quickly disappeared into the mountains.

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - 322: Met an Old Lady
chapters.content:
Su Lun had taken out "Demon Hand" Ueno Sasaki and then fled into the mountains; naturally, it was very difficult for anyone to catch up with him.
Before long, word also came from Qiantiao that after a tough battle, she had been wounded, but had successfully escaped as well.
Su Lun breathed a sigh of relief.
He did not go to meet with the Princess or Qiantiao but disguised himself as a down-and-out samurai and headed to the docks of Izumo Castle, planning to take the water route to Edo.
Now that they had evaded the Takeda shogunate's round of encirclement and assassination, the most dangerous moment had passed. However, the whole of Izumo, and even the neighboring fiefs, were likely under blockade. Now that they had been exposed, splitting up actually made each target less noticeable.
....
The Hii River is the largest river in Mountain Hermit Country, with tributaries covering the whole of Honshu Island like veins on a leaf. The river is hundreds of meters wide and can accommodate large ships, allowing seagoing vessels to sail upstream from the estuary directly to Edo Castle.
The docks of Izumo Castle were bustling with people early in the morning, a busy scene.
The dockworkers unloaded bundles of cargo from merchant ships—goods brought by foreign traders; they also loaded some heavy items onto the ships, with fine ironware and ores transported from here to various parts of Mountain Hermit Country and overseas.
Su Lun, in his shabby samurai clothes and wearing a bamboo hat, with a cheap iron sword at his side, was hardly noticeable among the crowd.
No one knew how the shogunate officials spread the news, but the bounty board at the docks had already listed the latest Bounty Orders. Su Lun, Qiantiao, and Lolo were all on the list. The Shinfuku Mitsuko was not, probably due to her special status.
As Su Lun passed by, he glanced at it and then shook his head and walked by.
Not to say his disguise was very clever and completely different from his original appearance. Even if he hadn't disguised himself, the hastily drawn portraits with ink brush were unlikely to be recognized by anyone.
Although the guards conducting inspections would check household registration plaques, those household registration sheets without any anti-counterfeiting marks were all too easy to fake.
Moreover, his fluent local accent, which he had peeled off, also made it hard to doubt him.
Su Lun passed the inspection with ease.
He made his way to the docks where a bamboo and thatched hut stood, under which some people squatted with cloth bags on their backs, travelers preparing to take boats to other places, as well as peddlers who roamed around.
Cargo ships generally did not carry passengers, so Su Lun had to wait here for a passenger ship to pass by.
About once a week, several ships would pass by Izumo docks, but in this era, there were no schedules. One simply waited at the docks, and when a ship came to shore, one would ask if there was room, pay some ship fare, and board the ship.
Su Lun was not in a hurry, after all, there were nearly ten days until the "Black Sun Grand Festival," and there was still plenty of time. He sat on the ground, holding the broken sword in his lap, closed his eyes to rest, his mind going over various alchemical knowledge.
The battle the day before had yielded a lot, and he needed a lot of time to improve on his weaknesses.
After a long wait, people came and went under the hut, with twenty to thirty people gathered.
The wandering peddlers, who traveled from south to north, were well-informed and struck up conversations.
Most of the conversations were mundane, which Su Lun listened to, deliberately and indifferently.
Then, he heard news of the King of the North Sea's fleet.
"Just yesterday, a lot of big ships passed by here, all loaded with cannons and armed men. I don't know what they're up to."
"That's the ninth fleet of the King of the North Sea. I heard they are going to Edo. Are they coming to impose taxes on us in Mountain Hermit Country?"
"I've heard that those pirates are intending to invade and rule over us..."
"Our great and benevolent Emperor is a monarch granted by Amaterasu Omikami itself, how could we let outsiders rule over us? Those foreigners will surely be punished by the gods..."
"War is about to break out. Haven't you seen? These past few days, the docks have been shipping lots of swords and bows to Edo? I heard various Daimyo have jointly petitioned, preparing for a decisive battle against those foreigners..."
"..."
While Su Lun absorbed alchemical knowledge in his mind, he also thought about these pieces of news.
He was also curious about whether a war would break out.
Oleg wanted to become the true "king" over the vast waters of the North Sea, and the four countries of the north were definitely his targets for conquest.
Mountain Hermit, though small, would not be easy to subjugate.
At least in his previous communications with the Princess, Su Lun knew that the Shinfuku Imperial family's stance was to never submit, preferring to be shattered jade rather than intact tile.
....
Due to the need to transport a large number of supplies to Edo, the usual passenger ships had been conscripted to carry cargo.
Su Lun waited at the docks until the afternoon but was unable to catch a ship.
Just as he was considering whether to inconvenience himself by taking the land route, a fleet of boats slowly made their way up the river.
The ships bore flags with white cherry blossom patterns on a black background, official merchant ships of Mountain Hermit Country. They came from Pirate City Hastelin. The great Daimyo of Mountain Hermit had many businesses abroad, and these ships were laden with various imported goods that would fetch huge profits after being sold.
Seven ships docked for resupply and unloaded a lot of cargo, keeping the dockworkers busy.
The itinerant peddlers seemed to be familiar with the ship's stewards, went to ask, and soon came back with news.
"Hey! The folks on the ship say they can let us board!"
"Of course, given the special circumstances. There's limited space on the ship. The tickets are going to be a bit more expensive than before..."
"..."
Su Lun heard this and understood that the peddler was also selling "channels".
He stood up and paid the fellow an extra fifty percent of the passage fee. His identity as a destitute samurai could still support such an expense.
He thought it was better to travel by a large sea vessel to avoid encountering any sea monsters or storms that could easily sink a smaller boat. Moreover, a big ship with many people and backgrounds was not easy to inspect. It saved a lot of trouble.
Su Lun and a dozen other travelers boarded the middle ship.
After perceiving his surroundings, there were no particularly troublesome presences on board.
He also didn't mind squeezing into the cargo hold that had just been cleared out for them.
Before long, the merchant ship was resupplied and set sail again.
Su Lun stayed in the cabin for two days.
The large ship had a dining room, but it wasn't provided for them, the temporary passengers who had jumped on at the last minute.
When he was hungry or thirsty, he ate some dry food and drank water he had brought with him, and he didn't feel restless.
He spent his days in meditation and digesting knowledge.
Traveling with stops here and there, it would take about four to five days to reach Edo Castle from Izumo if all went well.
But on the third day, Su Lun suddenly opened his eyes from meditation.
He saw sunlight pouring in through the ventilation window, casting a golden beam. The fine dust in the rays of light was clearly visible.
Today was a rare day of good weather.
"The sun has come out..."
Su Lun suddenly had a feeling that he should go out for some fresh air.
But at the same time, he furrowed his brows.
It felt "strange" for him to have such a thought.
Being able to control his emotions meant that, under normal circumstances, he wouldn't need some inexplicable relaxation just because he'd been enclosed in the cabin for two days like a normal person would.
After awakening the second stage of his Reaper talent, Su Lun had become more sensitive to many mysterious abilities and was less likely affected by them. After his professional ranking increased, this ability had strengthened considerably.
"Could it be that I've been influenced by some supernatural power?"
Su Lun thought about the time he and Mr. Jing had encountered the manipulation of fate in Gadronte Harbor.
Since then, he was extra cautious of similar situations.
Or was it just an illusion?
Su Lun pondered with a furrowed brow for a moment, but he still decided to go out and have a look.
....
Although this fleet was an official merchant ship of the Mountain Hermit, it was a motley crew.
In addition to the kimono-clad Mountain Hermit folks, there were also many blonde and blue-eyed people of various skin colors on the ship, career merchants who had been traveling to and from pirate ships to the Mountain Hermit domain.
Especially since war seemed imminent, the ship was also mixed with many who wanted to follow along and profit from the warfare.
Su Lun left the cargo hold and observed along the way. The upper deck was noisy with gambling and the enticing dances of the Singers, some of the few entertainment activities aboard, and the crew enjoyed themselves immensely.
Su Lun didn't notice anyone special and went straight up to the deck.
After not coming out for two days, breathing a breath of fresh air rejuvenated him.
The inland river had no big waves, and the large ship traveled smoothly on the river surface.
On the deck, apart from the indolent sailors idle with card games, there were also a few travelers who had come up to bask in the sun. At the rear upper structure were the Captain's quarters, the first mate's room, and several luxury cabins for big merchants and their families.
After a glance, there was nothing worth noting.
Su Lun walked to the ship's rail, leaned against it, and murmured, "Was it really just an illusion?"
The sun's rays felt warm and pleasant on his skin. He wasn't in a hurry to return to his cabin, thinking it was nice to come out and get some air.
Su Lun gazed at the riverside scenery, his eyes slightly narrowed.
The green mountains and white snow were intermittently visible.
Just then, a "gurgle" sound arose, a silver coin rolled from behind on the deck and stopped by Su Lun's foot.
He turned his head to look; it was a clumsy maid chasing after it.
Su Lun bent over to pick up the silver coin that had stopped by his feet and handed it over; the young girl thanked him with a "Thank you".
Su Lun smiled faintly, not lingering on the girl before him, but his gaze fell upon the old woman behind her.
The old woman was dressed in a well-fitting purple gown, with neatly combed silver hair, exuding an air of distinct elegance even while simply standing. Although she wore no dazzling jewelry, her bearing immediately revealed her exceptional upbringing. Even though age had etched deep lines upon her face, that one look suggested to Su Lun that: she must have been very beautiful in her youth.
However, what surprised Su Lun more was the fire of her soul that his Soul Perception detected.
```
Very faint.
Like the flickering candlelight in the wind, it could be extinguished at any moment.
Su Lun immediately realized that this was an old woman whose life had reached its end.
...
Suddenly encountering such a special old crone on the ship, Su Lun didn't think it was a coincidence.
His expression showed no sign of surprise, nor did he make any move.
But it was that mere glance that seemed to alert the old woman, and she slowly walked over.
The deck was not long, and within a few steps, she was beside him.
The old woman took the initiative to speak, "I originally wanted to find an excuse to casually meet you. But it seems you've noticed I was waiting for you."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun immediately realized that his prior feeling was correct!
But he didn't sense any hostility, and he cautiously asked, "Old madam, do we know each other?"
Addressing an elderly woman as "madam" is always correct.
"We've met once before."
The old woman gave Su Lun a look, and a glint of light flashed in the depths of her eyes before she retracted her gaze. Leaning against the railing just as Su Lun had, she added another phrase: "At 'San Torii'."
"..."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun immediately remembered.
In Pirate City there was a shop called "San Torii," which he had visited only once. He was there to buy materials and had encountered several cloaked figures. He remembered an old woman who had boldly bought up all the grand manuscripts of the great writer Fujiwara Hayato.
Clearly, it was the woman before him.
Moreover, Su Lun also knew that his disguise had been seen through. No, he had been recognized back in Pirate City already.
Su Lun's brows furrowed slightly, "May I ask, madam, who you are?"
She was probably not an enemy.
If she was an enemy, this introduction would be a bit too gentle.
The old woman straightforwardly said, "I am Naqiusha's great-grandmother."
"..."
Hearing this, Su Lun's eyelids twitched fiercely.
This was truly a great surprise!
Naqiusha's great-grandmother, what's going on?
For some reason, Su Lun felt as if he had trifled with someone's young lady and her elder had come knocking on his door.
Indeed, where would there be so many elegant old ladies.
Only the grandmother from a grand noble household could possess such an air.
So when he felt observed at San Torii, it wasn't an illusion—was it that girl Naqiusha?
But how did she recognize him?
Was his disguise that bad?
Su Lun felt somewhat speechless inside but guessed it must be some special secret technique.
However, speaking of which.
The life before him had reached its end, and she had specifically come to find him?
As if guessing his thoughts, the old woman smiled, "I didn't come especially for you. I just had some business with the Mountain Hermit. It was fate that let us meet."
Her smile deepened the wrinkles at the corners of her eyes, but it allowed one to see the kindness in her gaze.
Since she had already mentioned Naqiusha's name, Su Lun naturally couldn't feign ignorance. But he didn't believe this was some twist of fate, so he directly asked, "You... How do you know I am here?"
The old woman spoke gently, "Meeting a capable person is a kind of fate. Magicians struggle against fate all their lives, but often do not realize that many times, fate is already decided."
It sounded like nonsense, but Su Lun understood something from it.
A talent similar to [S-003-Fate Controller]?
And in that instant, thoughts began to race through his mind, connecting like lightning.
He suddenly had a bold thought: the "third party" behind Abe Yasukazu, could it be Naqiusha's family?!
What the fuck...
This was the territory of the Four Countries of the North, under Oleg's domain. Did the hand of the Ruying nobility reach so far?
```
Moreover, from the looks of it, this scheme wasn't concocted on a whim; it might have been years, even decades in the making, with seeds sown long ago.
Sure enough, only those great families with centuries of heritage had the foundation and the finesse for such endeavors.
Indeed, what could a bunch of pirates know about spinning conspiracies? It was up to those seasoned professional politicians of the Luying faction!
Su Lun even felt that the Ninth Fleet's arrival this time, to a greater or lesser extent, had the shadow of some conspiratorial puppet-master behind it.
....
But this elderly person's life was nearing its end.
Su Lun really couldn't guess, why did she come to Mountain Hermit?
Before he could sort out his thoughts, the old person took the initiative and said, "I am here to see an old friend."
"..."
Su Lun felt as if someone had peeked into his mind.
Just like when he first encountered Mr. Hei, there was something about the gaze of the wise that seemed to see through everything with a clear light.
The old person asked, "Young man, may I have a few words with you?"
Su Lun nodded, "Of course."
The old person's benevolent smile was like the warm sun in winter, making it impossible to entertain thoughts of refusal.
"I mean you no harm. It just so happened that I ran into you, and I wanted to see for myself what kind of man could earn such high praise from that girl Naqiusha."
At this point, she paused and glanced sideways at Su Lun, "Now that I see you, you indeed seem quite special."
Listening to her, Su Lun found some of her words to be a bit cryptic and somewhat unusual, yet he responded with a polite smile, "You flatter me."
The old person chuckled and shook her head, "Among so many young talents in the empire, that girl Katyu Sha holds herself with pride, and she has never truly favored anyone. But you are the only one."
"..."
Su Lun felt even more puzzled.
Although he got along very well with Katyu Sha—somewhat like... there wasn't that kind of implication, right?
The old person seemed to lack energy; after just a few sentences, she needed to rest.
Looking at the distant mountains and waters, she continued, "Katyu Sha was like an ugly duckling as a child, somewhat reclusive by nature.
