But actually, executing Sword Qi Slash consumed a lot of her Inner Dark Spiritual Power.
Killing a hundred, or even a thousand, was manageable, but these hundreds of thousands of ghosts and demons were endless!
And, ordinary ghosts and demons were one thing, but there were also some bizarre fiends.
"Don't go near the river. The sludge in the water hides the 'Rotten God.' If the river isn't dry, it can't be killed! Don't waste your energy..."
"'Wind Raccoon' isn't harmed by cuts, target its head with area hammering strikes!"
"Be careful of your shadow; a 'Shadow Woman' has entangled it. It fears light!"
"..."
Beneath their feet, in the air, within shadows, rivers, walls, trees, stone carvings... Those demons could emerge and attack from anywhere.
If it weren't for Su Lun's Soul Perception that allowed him to detect demons all around, and the All-knowing Eye that could pinpoint weaknesses instantly, if they had blindly charged ahead, these bizarrely tactical monsters would have killed them over and over again.
Su Lun was a Puppeteer, accustomed to winning through sheer numbers. Now, he too felt the terror of being overrun by the quantity of his enemies.
Because they were fleeing, the puppet theater was useless; he only carried around twenty to thirty puppets, which shattered again and again.
Moreover, Qian Tiao was in no better condition.
She was at the forefront of the charge, already accumulating wounds.
Moreover, to harm spectral monsters, or reviving special ghosts like 'Ghost Warriors,' she had to use the demonic power of 'Onimaru Hyakume Zakusōji.' Although she had tamed this demon blade, utilizing demonic power also required a significant consumption of her Inner Dark Spiritual Power, a tremendous burden.
But even so, their situation did not improve at all; instead, it was getting worse, as more and more monsters were attracted to them.
Su Lun shared a look with the death birds in the sky, saw that the road to the southern city had been blocked by various monsters, and immediately decided, "If this continues, we can't escape, we need to find a place to hide!"
Qian Tiao responded, "Okay!"
Just then, Su Lun's monocle lens flashed, and he suddenly took out several high-explosion smoke grenades and threw them forward. A thick smoke instantly filled the streets, and Qian Tiao immediately understood and dashed in.
In an instant, the shadows of the two figures charged in from one end and rushed out from the other.
A group of evil spirits also followed in pursuit.
Seeing this, two people in Gold-Patterned Cloaks inside a wooden house breathed a sigh of relief.
Black crow, adhering only to the paper puppets made by the Princess, "Robert's Monocle," created almost real illusions, temporarily deceiving the group of evil spirits and giving Su Lun and Qian Tiao a chance to breathe.
The alchemical cloaks made by the Mirror Organization greatly prevented their scents from leaking, seeming also to have deceived the demons' perception.
Su Lun looked at Qian Tiao's pale face and asked, "Are you alright?"
Qian Tiao's chest heaved violently and her forehead was covered in sweat, clearly showing she had not lightly consumed her energy. She replied, "I'm okay."
Su Lun said, "Those illusions won't last long, we need to leave here."
"Mhm."
Qian Tiao nodded and took the recovery drink Su Lun handed to her, gulping it down.
The two only stayed for a few breaths before silently sneaking out the door.
But after all, this was a "T-grade Cursed Space."
They had not walked far when Su Lun's expression suddenly changed drastically.
Because by then, they saw a handsome young man in a floral robe standing at the entrance to the alley. With his chest bared and a heavy demonic aura on his face, he stood there exuding an overwhelming demonic pressure without leaking any demonic power.
Qian Tiao also sensed the terrifying pressure that felt like a thorn in her back, slightly shifted to position herself in front of Su Lun, her gaze serious, "If you find a chance, just go. Don't worry about me!"
Being a person of resolute decision, she naturally understood that it was time to separate life and death; to let even one escape would be worthwhile.
Hearing this, Su Lun narrowed his eyes slightly and remained silent.
The name identified by the All-knowing Eye was "Ghost King Shuten Douji."
One of the most terrifying Ghost Kings from the legends of the Mountain Hermit's Hundred Ghosts, impervious to blades and spears, its strength unfathomably deep.
This was also the strongest entity detected by Su Lun's Soul Perception.
Shuten Douji, with a mocking smile playing on his enchanting face, looked at them and said, "Humans, you do have some clever tactics. It's been a long time since the Netherworld was this lively... I really don't want to kill you just like that."
Su Lun immediately realized that the Gold-Patterned Cloak could not hide their presence from this entity, and he quietly retreated back into the house.
Shuten Douji naturally noticed his action, scoffed and said, "It seems your companion wants to escape."
Qian Tiao's face remained expressionless as she slowly drew the long sword that had already been sheathed at her waist.
"It's a good sword. Too bad, your proficiency in the Sword Dao is still lacking a bit."
Shuten Douji looked at the Demon Blade, his eyes flashing coldly, yet he didn't show much dread.
As he spoke, his forked crimson tongue, similar to a snake's, suddenly licked his lips, showing even more interest in Qiantiao's body, "Tsk tsk, the sweet scent of a virgin... And such a rare pure Yang energy, it must be a delicious body indeed."
At these words, the atmosphere should have instantly become tense.
But Su Lun didn't know why, something about what he heard felt odd.
He knew that Shuten Douji liked to eat humans, but Qiantiao was actually... what?
Qiantiao ignored the comment, gathered her Sword Qi to its peak, seized the moment, and charged forward with her blade drawn: "Single Sword Style·Demon Funeral!"
The Demon Blade was wrapped in a layer of green flame, as the blade traced a green line through the air.
In a flash, Qiantiao's blade struck Shuten Douji.
With a clang, it sounded as though it had struck metal.
On closer inspection, Shuten Douji had a face full of contemptuous smile and in his hand, a bundle of red lotus fire, easily catching the blade strike.
Qiantiao pulled back her blade and retreated explosively. Her hands formed a sorcerer's seal and for the first time, the fiery, vertical silhouette of a Rakshasa appeared behind her. Six arms, six blades, she was finally about to unleash a powerful attack.
Seeing this, Shuten Douji finally took a proper look, "Huh... A Rakshasa Woman? Turns out it's a human who practices the Hell Path. Hehe, this is getting interesting."
With a loud pop of stepping on air, Qiantiao stomped on the ground and surged forward.
Suddenly, her Sword Qi filled the air, sending stones and sand flying.
Shuten Douji was not to be outdone. His fists, wrapped in red lotus fire, met her attack head-on, filling the sky.
That Sword Qi, which could slice stones and cleave gold, didn't even scratch his true form.
In the air, waves of ripples spread, and buildings around were sliced down...
....
Watching from not far away, Su Lun wasn't surprised by this, as the legend says, Shuten Douji, the Ghost King is immune to blades and spears.
He also knew Qiantiao was fighting desperately.
However, despite the Rakshasa Woman's strength, her energy consumption was also exponentially greater. Given the situation, it was clear that she couldn't hurt the enemy, and the outcome was predictable.
Su Lun still hadn't made a move. Joining the fight blindly now wouldn't change anything.
The light swirled in his left eye, and he observed something else, thinking, "This demonic power is so condensed... It's not that the 'Demon Blade' isn't sharp, but the red lotus fire formed by that demonic power is a big problem. It's somewhat similar to a sixth-tier professional's 'dominance'—unable to break through that demonic field, even the sharpest blade can't hurt its true form. Moreover, that guy's combat skill is really superb…"
After observing for a moment, Su Lun still couldn't see any opportunity to exploit.
He was facing a Ghost King. The Ghost Path techniques were not very effective, and since the Demon Blade hadn't blinded him, the black umbrella probably would be limited in use too.
So...
Su Lun knew he had only one method that might hurt that child, and that was "Xiupunos's Scythe of the Night!"
But the guy's combat skill was indeed superb, very crafty.
In a battle of skill, Qiantiao had no upper hand. Even if she launched a powerful strike, he could either withstand it or block and avoid it.
Su Lun had no confidence he could hit him with a surprise attack using the scythe.
In an instant, his mind was like a computer, rapidly calculating all the possibilities,
With such a powerful Ghost King appearing, the situation had dramatically worsened. But the upside was, with this guy taking the lead, the other monsters seemed very wary of this Ghost King and hadn't dared to approach.
Looking again toward the movements of the North Sea fleet in the distance, they were getting smaller and smaller. Dragging it out further would become increasingly unfavorable for them.
Qiantiao also realized their predicament, initially thinking there might be a chance to fight for it, but now it seemed, there was no chance of victory at all.
An indestructible corporal body, already in an invincible position.
Seeing that Su Lun had not left, she used the communicator to send a mental message, "You go first!"
She knew Su Lun's escape techniques were strong, and with her holding this guy back, he could possibly get out alone.
A stern look flashed in Su Lun's eyes, not saying much, he replied, "Qiantiao, I have a method…"
.....
As soon as the words were out, Su Lun's hands rapidly formed a sorcerer's seal, "Rune Vajra·Concentrate!"
Another look, and his skin suddenly shimmered with a dark gold luster, revealing densely packed dark gold runes.
And that wasn't all!
Veins bulged at Su Lun's temples, his expression fierce and twisted as he clenched his teeth, his hands shifted the sorcerer's seal, and he roared, "Flesh Alchemy: Hormone Rampage!"
For the first time, he activated the fourth tier state in combat.
As the sorcerer released the seal, hormones crazily rushed into his limbs and organs. His muscles visibly swelled up, his body brimming with eruptive, volcanic strength!
"Rune Vajra" plus "Fourth Tier Hormone Rampage," he only had three minutes.
Su Lun's muscles began to heat up, steam pouring out, and with a ferocious laugh, he explosively sprang forward like a cannonball.
With a pop of Stepping on Air, the figure he left behind flew apart.
Another look, and his figure had already charged a hundred meters away.
His speed had reached an extreme!
The commotion was not small and naturally didn't escape Shuten Douji involved in battle.
Seeing Su Lun charging towards him, knowing he couldn't dodge, his demonic power surged as he punched out in anticipation.
"Boom!"
The severe shockwave swept through streets like a tidal wave.
A dark and a red torrential wave collided, Su Lun was knocked back dozens of meters, while that child was pushed back three steps.
Feeling the exaggerated power of that punch, Shuten Douji looked at Su Lun, looking like a bronze man, and became more excited, "Hey, I underestimated you. Even though your cultivation isn't high, you possess such power. A secret technique that stimulates the body's potential? Tsk tsk, it reminds me of someone I once encountered who practiced the 'Art of Escaping Armor.'"
"..."
Su Lun didn't bother arguing with it.
From this collision, he immediately concluded that he could fight it!
Though impervious to bladed and blunt weapons, it was only adept at physical attacks and was not skilled in Teleportation or Spell attacks—this was also where Ghost King Shuten Douji fell short!
Despite fighting, it occasionally murmured a few words.
But in fact, thousands of swords, and his own fists, posed a significant threat to it!
Su Lun's punch was ineffective, and he charged forward again.
Simultaneously, Qiān Tiáo also silently drew his sword, and the two attacked together.
"Clang," "Clang," "Clang"...
"Thud," "Thud," "Thud"...
The attack frequency was extremely high, and their fists and sword gleams sparked numerous sparks on Shuten Douji's body.
The Ghost King realized it couldn't completely dodge their high-frequency attacks and simply stood its ground, generating a layer of fierce red lotus flames on its body surface. It remained unmoved by any attack method used against it.
As legends had it, Shuten Douji was arrogant, conceited, and haughty, and Su Lun had verified this after such a long test.
Even then, it kept murmuring.
"Tsk... such methods won't hurt me..."
"Tsk tsk, you both seem incapable, don't you?"
"..."
Just as the legends suggested, this creature enjoyed verbally humiliating its opponents.
After fighting for so long, Su Lun also knew that it must have recognized its weakness!
And that was that its corporeal Secret Technique wasn't lasting.
In fact, Su Lun's body was nearly at the point of collapse.
After intense combat, numerous muscle fibers in Su Lun's body felt like they were about to snap, his bones showed cracks, and his body temperature made his skin seem like molten metal.
This was not his own strength, but rather obtained by squeezing his body to its limits.
The longer it dragged on, the more severe the injuries became.
Just then, Su Lun's condition visibly weakened in the midst of the battle. Seeing his chance, Shuten Douji punched him in the lower ribs. Su Lun's breath hitched, he instinctively twisted his body, curling his arms around his ribs like a large shrimp, trying to protect his vitals, but he exposed a huge opening in his abdomen.
"Hmm!"
Seeing this, Shuten Douji inwardly sneered.
This kind of opportunity required no thought; its hand, sharp as a blade, instinctively stabbed forward.
"Pfft" Despite it being a hand strike, it sharply pierced through Su Lun's Rune Vajra, and blood spurted out.
Shuten Douji thought that even if this strike didn't kill him, there would be no suspense afterward. Just as it was about to stab fiercely again, at that moment, Su Lun suddenly let go and clamped down on its arm.
"Eh... courting death?"
Shuten Douji couldn't understand why Su Lun would make such a move, but at the same time, six long swords were placed on its body.
Not to injure it, but to restrain its other arm.
"You think you can capture me?"
Shuten Douji was baffled by this move. What could these two do by restraining it?
If it was restrained, weren't these two as well?
Moreover, it could break free from such a level of restraint instantly!
But a death instinct told it that something was off.
....
"Puh~"
A hole was stabbed in Su Lun's abdomen, and he couldn't help but spit out a mouthful of blood tinged with a metallic taste. Yet, a sinister smile crossed his lips, "String Control Secret Art: Titan's Hand!"
In an instant, silver threads that had never appeared in the battle suddenly coalesced like a corpse.
These were his hairs, recently inscribed with "Sixth-order Resilience Runes," demonstrating the strongest single-entity control technique from the Puppeteer.
In just a moment, the threads tightly wrapped around both Su Lun's body and Shuten Douji's arm.
The grotesque Shuten Douji finally changed color, faintly realizing something. It forcefully tensed its arm, snapping numerous threads, attempting to break free.
But just then, it suddenly saw a figure with a black scythe looming behind Su Lun!
The moment their eyes met, it seemed to see the gaze of a higher being, causing its gaze to falter.
Seeing this, Su Lun was overjoyed, "It worked!"
As he anticipated, a second-phase Death manifestation could still intimidate such a high-level ghost creature!
At such a close distance, even a momentary shock from the Death manifestation was enough.
Almost precisely calculated to the millisecond, a spatial rift suddenly appeared at Shuten Douji's neck, drawing a fine line.
The usually infallible spatial rift cut through the indestructible demon-protected body like a knife through cowhide, not too smoothly.
"Eh..."
It was the first time Su Lun encountered such resistance when cutting with the black scythe.
But the outcome was still favorable, as the shock from the Death had not allowed Shuten Douji to react, and this slice ultimately severed its head.
Su Lun, watching the dissipating "gray mist" from the corpse, didn't know if the ghost mist had other ways to revive, but he gave no opportunity, directly allowing the Death manifestation to devour it.

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - 331: Begging the Gods, Sensoji Temple, Izanami
chapters.content:
Su Lun had previously read in the annals some legends saying that the Netherworld is the final abode for the dead.
Therefore, ghosts under normal circumstances wouldn't "die." Even if they were killed, they would only lose some of their cultivation, and then they would be reincarnated and their bodies recondensed under some special laws.
However, Su Lun also felt that this was the general situation.
In dealing with various types of ghosts proficient in revival, his abilities were exactly the antidote.
If a Soul Shard was stripped away, there was a high likelihood of no resurrection.
Su Lun skillfully stripped the soul mist from the Shuten-doji.
"You have stripped the soul of the Ghost King of Hundred Demons 'Shuten-doji' "
"You have comprehended a special Gang Qi body protection secret technique 'Imperial Flow Overbearing Body'."
"You have gained a piece of information: 'The Yomi Country Lord Izanami is the supreme being...'"
"You are now aware of: 'Some history of the Netherworld'..."
"Spiritual power +..."
"..."
Since Alchemy and demons aren't from the same system, he didn't choose to strip away some cultivation insights, but he did want to understand the Netherworld through this channel to find a way out.
The intelligence gained was indeed substantial.
Keywords: Yomi Country Lord, Izanami?
Su Lun vaguely felt that he might have found the key to breaking the situation.
Many "deities" manifested in this cursed space, but in the heart of Shuten-doji, a great demon at this level, there was only one supreme being above all others, and that was Izanami.
Su Lun didn't know if it was the one from the legends.
After all, that's a "Mother Goddess" even more ancient than Amaterasu Omikami.
A true True God.
No mortal could depict deities; hence they were called "indescribable."
Therefore, Su Lun also felt that She wouldn't appear in this cursed space.
Stripping memories would scatter a small part of the soul. Su Lun was ultimately curious about why his black scythe hadn't smoothly cut the target for the first time, and casually stripped another horizontal training secret technique 'Imperial Flow Overbearing Body' from the ghost child.
Upon inspection, he learned that apart from the creature's inherently strong body, the most important factor was a sophisticated technique of using "Qi" to protect the body.
Upon stripping, it was an unexpected delight.
This was a very advanced and insightful skill that was still outside of Su Lun's accessible knowledge.
Under normal circumstances, this would be an area only a sixth-order professional would explore.
Su Lun couldn't use it.
Because his "Qi" hadn't yet reached the level needed to utilize this secret technique.
Condensed Demonic Qi ≈ A type of Gang Qi ≈ Overbearing Qi?
Because Mr. Jing had always said that "Qi" is a key to advancing to higher levels for professional careers, Su Lun could vaguely understand some of it.
Although the carriers were different, it seemed that the essence was the same.
But now, his "Qi" was like a thin mist that would disperse upon the slightest touch.
In that secret technique, the "Qi" must be as solid as steel and not scattered at all. It was like being fully proficient in controlling the transitions between the three states of metal; solid, liquid, and gas.
Exceptionally difficult.
In the future, once he has mastered "Overbearing Qi," the secret technique seemed usable.
By then, it would be 'Rune Vajra Tyrant Body,' which seemed like a rather good survival ability?
A flurry of thoughts passed through Su Lun's mind, but he didn't dwell on it.
Because at that moment, something even more strange happened before his eyes.
The body of the Shuten-doji unexpectedly turned into wisp after wisp of black Qi, which was absorbed by his body!
No,
More precisely,
It was absorbed by the Death's shadow behind Su Lun!
....
Qianniao, who was nearby, also witnessed this bizarre event and before she could deal with her own roiling qi, she cried out sharply, "Su Lun, are you alright?"
Su Lun knew she was concerned about him but shook his head.
Because he too clearly felt the Death's shadow absorbing a type of energy that made him feel extremely, extremely euphoric.
The All-Seeing Eye identified at a glance that the black Qi from the corpse displayed was "Demonic Qi mixed with the Power of Faith."
"This black Qi can actually solidify Death's shadow?"
Su Lun was both shocked and overjoyed in his heart.
He had previously guessed that the creatures of Mountain Hermit were bodies of collective faith, and it turned out that this was indeed the case.
But what he didn't expect was that the faith-infused demonic Qi was essentially the same kind of thing as Death's shadow.
In the instant of their conversation, they watched as the beheaded corpse of Shuten-doji was completely absorbed, vanishing from sight.
In just that moment or two, Su Lun also distinctly sensed a tremendous change.
Death's shadow visibly became more solid!
Previously, the face beneath Death's cloak was completely foggy, but now the facial contours were faintly visible. On a closer look, although the features were unclear, the outline vaguely resembled Su Lun himself.
Furthermore, the external changes were secondary.
Su Lun strongly felt that his understanding of the laws of death and some indescribable abilities had grown enormously!
He estimated that if he were to naturally comprehend the laws of death himself, he might not see this degree of progress in five years, or even ten years.
"Powerful!"
A glimmer flashed in Su Lun's eyes, unable to conceal his amazement: "Such faith-infused demons... can directly enhance the understanding of Death's shadow!"
Innate abilities generally could only be strengthened through one's own comprehension, yet because he had been sucked into this cursed space, he had discovered a shortcut.
An S-ranked talent was already rare to awaken; progressing further and developing abilities required not just time but also great fortune. Just like how Su Lun had to die once before to awaken the second stage of his talent. Now, the development of his ability was crawling like a snail, with increments like 0.001%, 0.002%, 0.003%...
Yet now, there was a leap of a whole 1%!
This showed Su Lun that a window had been opened and before him was a whole new world.
"If this growth continues, after the second stage of talent awakening, might there be a third stage?"
However, Su Lun also clearly felt that the absorbed demonic energy was impure, containing a strand of negative energy.
That was demonic power.
The negative impact was not on the body, nor on spiritual power, but it made his entire demeanor slightly eerie.
But compared to the gains, this minor negative side effect was negligible.
....
Having killed Shuten-doji, Su Lun discovered a great opportunity hidden within this dire situation, which was a blessing in disguise.
However, now was not the time to ponder over those gains.
Because their crisis was not over, and their situation had become even more dangerous.
The surrounding evil spirits, having seen Shuten-doji killed, all froze on the spot. Especially upon seeing the Death's shadow behind Su Lun, it was as if time had stopped, and the ghosts looked at each other in bewilderment. But then, a shrill, ear-piercing screech, like a tidal wave of wailing, erupted from the nearby streets.
Without the Ghost King's deterrent, those minor spirits fell into madness and swarmed in.
"Run!"
Qian Tiao shouted sharply, drawing his blade and charging ahead.
"Right!"
Su Lun didn't dare to delay and turned to make a run for it.
But he hadn't expected that just as he moved, a burning sting spread through his muscles, and he staggered, nearly falling.
He immediately understood what was happening.
The activation of stage four hormonal overload had caused his body to fight in an overburdened state, resulting in massive damage.
Muscle ruptures, bone fractures, although he didn't die on the spot, he still needed time to heal.
However, these ghosts certainly wouldn't give him time to recover.
"Body's at its limit, huh..."
Su Lun's face turned ugly.
This was his first time facing an unknown enemy of this caliber. Even being extremely cautious, it was impossible to completely calculate the opponent's damage.
Being able to kill it was merely a result of the two gambling with their lives and not having bad luck.
Especially with that hand blade strike to the abdomen, though he had tried to avoid vital points, the surge of Red Lotus demonic energy also made his blood and Qi chaotically violent.
Su Lun was very aware that his body was already on the verge of collapse and utterly incapable of sustaining intense combat any longer.
Escape was no longer an option.
Having rapidly analyzed the pros and cons, Su Lun was a decisive person.
Seeing various ghosts surging from all around, his gaze turned cold, and he took out the scroll to unseal the Mecha battlesuit, preparing to tear it open, "Huff... It's the final stand."
The Mecha battlesuit had strong defenses, and its operation in combat wasn't heavily dependent on the user's physical condition; it might be able to hold out for a while.
But Su Lun also knew that once he entered the Mecha, there would be almost no chance of escape.
The Mecha lacked the capacity for Spatial Displacement, and its speed was somewhat clumsy; it was impossible to escape from the city amidst the encirclement of hundreds of thousands of ghosts.
He took it out only because he thought that in a fight to the death, maybe he could distract some monsters and give Qian Tiao a slim chance for survival.
However, the moment the scroll was taken out,
Qian Tiao's peripheral vision caught sight of it and she seemed to immediately guess something, unhesitatingly turning back to kill her way back.
The speed of the swordfighter was even faster than Su Lun pulling at the scroll. With a flash of her figure, she scooped Su Lun up and burst out with him in tow.
Though being carried away, Su Lun still spat out a mouthful of blood, enduring the pain all over his body, he said gravely, "Sister Qian Tiao, I can't make it. You go first!" "..."
Seeing his condition, Qian Tiao's pupils narrowed, clearly understanding what Su Lun was trying to express.
She was already at her limit, and carrying another person meant almost certain death for them both.
So the most rational decision would be for those who could escape to do so.
But she didn't even think about it and with a fierce shout exclaimed, "Hmph! Nonsense!"
Su Lun frowned upon hearing this.
The two of them had reached a level of familiarity where they could read each other's thoughts. He knew well that this gambler of a woman was always led by her emotions; she would never flee alone even if it meant dying.
Just like he had chosen to stay behind just a moment ago.
Su Lun did not say more, merely lying silently on her shoulder and occasionally tossing out a few bombs to alleviate some of the pressure.
"Boom," "Boom," "Boom"...
The fireworks from the bombs exploded with dazzling brilliance throughout the city.
Su Lun even took out his hidden high-explosive bombs.
Unfortunately, powerful as they were, many of the ghostly creatures weren't affected by firearms.
Gasping for breath, Qian Tiao swung her sword slower and slower, and her Sword Qi grew ever weaker...
Their situation became more and more perilous.
....
In fact, since they had been discovered by Shuten-doji, they had been in a hopeless situation.
Whether they won the fight or not, with time spent and the surrounding ghosts having closed off all the exits, the likelihood of escaping had plummeted.
Even at their peak, getting out was a matter of luck; now that both of them were injured, the thought of breaking out was a mere fantasy.
Qian Tiao's long sword hacked away until blood filled her vision.
On her shoulder, Su Lun controlled the only fingers that could still move to create a bit of chaos with a few puppet bombs.
Both of them couldn't even maintain their second-tier talent states anymore.
Eventually, Su Lun and she encountered another formidable Demon King-level monster.
It was a Great Tengu with the combat power of a fifth-stage pinnacle.
The monster with wings on its back and a stature as imposing as a Minotaur's had a ruddy face; it was a formidable swordfighter, too, equipped with famous swords and armor.
Even at her best, Qian Tiao wasn't sure if she could win easily. In their encounter, after barely holding on for a few rounds, she was sliced down and sent flying dozens of meters, crashing into a heap of ruins. If not for the protection of the famous armor "Iron Red Scales Painted Five Panel Harness," both she and Su Lun would have likely been split in half by that blow.
....
In the midst of the ruins, Qian Tiao's helmet had been knocked off by that strike; her blue hair scattered, with blood trickling down from her forehead, making her look ferocious and disheveled.
She propped her sword against the ground, kneeling on one knee, and only then did she manage not to fall.
Su Lun was just as disheveled beside her. Throughout the brutal battle, those ghostly creatures had left various wounds all over his body. If not for the runes drawn previously on his bones and skin, which greatly strengthened his physique, he would have likely been minced by now.
Escaping from the southern city gate had become hopeless.
At this moment, what entered their eyes were ghosts and monsters, with the black, towering spirit of the ghosts surging towards the sky like a tsunami. When it crashed over them, they would instantly be crushed to pieces.
Qian Tiao struggled for a moment, wanting to charge forward, but instead, a mouthful of blood spewed forth.
Su Lun glanced at her sideways.
Just moments before, he had thought there might be a chance, his spirits were highly tense.
Now, with all their options exhausted and no chance left, he seemed to have reached a state of resignation.
Qian Tiao felt that gaze as well.
Their eyes met, and there was no despair or sorrow in them, only a smile.
"Qian Tiao, there's a slim chance we can kill it."
"Oh? Let's give it a try then."
"Right."
After that brief conversation, both of them slumped down where they were.
Qian Tiao's profile was beautiful, if a little sharp, but that was just nitpicking.
She sighed and asked, "Su Lun, you clearly had a slight chance to get away earlier. Why did you stay?"
In fact, Su Lun's best chance to survive was when Qian Tiao was holding off Shuten-doji.
Su Lun panted heavily, and seriously replied, "Qian Tiao, I've always wanted to say that fighting side by side with you is something I've been looking forward to."
For the first time, he felt death wasn't so... resistant.
Hearing this, Qian Tiao's eyebrows arched, "Oh..."
It seemed many thoughts had become clear.
The lights in the city were like the afterglow of a setting sun, making their faces glow red. A very beautiful smile also appeared on her face.
Unfortunately, they didn't have much time left in life.
The Great Tengu sensed the danger. It didn't rush forward immediately, but it was slowly closing in.
Su Lun was gathering his strength for a desperate final strike, but the cautious delay made him choke on his breath, causing another mouthful of fresh blood to spurt out.
He wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, his lips revealing a bitter smile.
That was the best he could do.
It's over.
All of a sudden, a thought occurred to him, and he suddenly turned his head, "Qian Tiao, can I ask you something?"
"What?"
Qian Tiao instinctively replied.
But then she looked at Su Lun's eyes shifting and suddenly realized something, a glint of understanding crossing her eyes.
She guessed what Su Lun was going to ask, and an unnatural blush flashed across her imposing face for the first time.
Su Lun's eyes were full of teasing as he directly asked, "Qian Tiao, are you really a virgin?"
At the end of life, they needed to find something to be happy about.
To him, there was no question more amusing than this.
"..."
As expected, it was that question. Qian Tiao shot him a look but did not respond.
"Hahaha..."
Seeing her reaction, Su Lun burst out laughing.
Even though Shuten-doji was a legendary demon, it still had a keen nose.
Su Lun thought....
So it was true!
Listening to that annoying laughter, Qian Tiao finally lost her composure and glared at him, complaining, "Hey hey hey... You're really asking for a beating. Is it that strange to you?"
"Ahahaha..."
Su Lun laughed uncontrollably, blood still bubbling from his mouth.
Qian Tiao glanced at him, her eyes shimmering with emotion, but ultimately she let him be.
Just then, the overwhelming presence of the Great Tengu came bearing down; its five-meter-tall figure stood in front of them.
It swung its blade, slashing forward.
...
Sword Qi approached, kicking up dust and pebbles along its path.
Qian Tiao's eyes were fierce with anger as she slowly drew the Demon Blade. She was ready to perform her final cut in the stance of a swordsman.
Su Lun's body wasn't nearly recovered enough to dodge abruptly. He felt certain this cut would seal his fate.
But suddenly, a thought flashed through his mind: "That prophecy from the Qin Master with the Heavenly Eye..."
The blind woman saw in her vision that Qian Tiao would laugh amidst burning flames...
This outcome was wrong.
Moreover, the death-predicting bird on his shoulder had stopped its cries.
Could there be a chance for a turning point?
Although Su Lun hoped for a turnaround, he couldn't think of any means to change the situation.
The various seals and curses on his body were impressive, but they could only delay death, not save his life.
Could it be an external force?
For instance, a Princess descending from the heavens?
Su Lun thought of all possibilities.
He looked up at the sky, and indeed, just at that moment, a mysterious event unfolded.
However, what Su Lun saw was not a Shinfuku Mitsuko descending from the heavens, but a battered porcelain bowl that suddenly appeared there.
"???"
Su Lun found the broken bowl vaguely familiar.
But before he could further contemplate, the porcelain bowl was already blocking the Sword Qi.
"Clang," "clang," "clang"... A series of sparks and sounds erupted.
Watching a beggar's bowl, seemingly fragile enough to shatter on impact, successfully block the Sword Qi was astonishing.
Witnessing the scene, both Su Lun and Chitose were stunned.
Though the "Netherworld" was filled with monsters, not many could block a strike from the Great Tengu.
Could it be that another powerful demon had come to snatch their "food"?
This was Su Lun's first thought.
Before they had much time to think, a fierce wind suddenly whipped up around them, and dilapidated buildings formed a massive vortex. The howling wind and flying debris isolated all the monsters around them.
Then, two mud pills fell from the sky, landing before Su Lun and Chitose.
[Beggar God's Mud Pills]
Explanation: A spiritual medicine imbued with the essence of the Netherworld, extremely rare; after consumption, the medicine's effects can continuously conceal the living person's Yang energy preventing them from standing out like a beacon in the night and attracting ghosts, but it won't let you be assimilated by the Netherworld's essence. The effects last for 30 days.
Su Lun felt somewhat baffled but, recognizing the mud pills' effects, his spirits immediately lifted.
He finally remembered why the broken bowl with the blue-and-white pattern seemed so familiar.
Wasn't it the bowl belonging to the two freezing beggar children he had encountered on the streets when he had first arrived at Mountain Hermit?
At that time, he remembered tossing a few Copper Coins into it.
It was an act without thought, yet it seemed he had received something in return?
Su Lun had a feeling of disbelief.
In a flash, he finally understood the bizarre words that the "demon" Abe Yasukazu had told him, "In our Mountain Hermit, there's an old saying, 'Good intentions may not be immediately rewarded, but they are observed by the gods.'"
....
It was when the mud pills hit the ground that a voice came through the whirlwind, "I can't hold on much longer... leave quickly."
A figure in tattered rags materialized.
"Thank you, Beggar God, for your assistance!"
Su Lun bowed respectfully in the Mountain Hermit's customary gesture of thanks toward the apparition, and without hesitation, picked up the mud pills from the ground and said to Chitose, "Quick, eat it!"
The [Beggar God] is one of the many deities in Mountain Hermit, but to call him a deity might just mean a slightly more powerful demon. Now intervening amidst thousands of ghosts to save them, their chance of holding out was uncertain.
Chitose too, without hesitation, looked at the dirty mud pill that Su Lun handed her and swallowed it in one gulp.
It felt like swallowing mud, the pill scraping down her throat. Although it was hard to swallow, once the medicinal power spread, a minty coolness with a hint of floral fragrance swept through her lungs and infused her limbs and veins.
Su Lun didn't notice any changes in his body, but he immediately no longer felt repelled by the chilly environment around him.
At that moment, he finally saw a glimmer of hope for breaking the stalemate.
The primary reason they had been relentlessly pursued by phantoms was their "Yang energy," which they simply could not hide. No matter where they fled, they shone like bright lamps, easily detectable.
But now, the mud pill had addressed the root problem!
Chitose also felt the changes in her body, but she was completely clueless about what had happened.
Why would a demon help them?
After glancing at Su Lun, she guessed that he must have brought about this miracle.
They both showed a flash of sharp brilliance on their faces, as they had narrowly escaped from a desperate situation.
In that moment, Su Lun had regained a bit of mobility. He formed sorcerer's seals with his hands, and beneath his feet, a purple-black six-pointed star appeared, opening a spatial rift in front of him.
"Let's go!"
He grabbed Chitose's hand and stepped through.
.....
Su Lun, gravely injured, did not teleport far with Chitose.
But it was enough.
When they emerged from the spatial rift, they were inside an empty dwelling.
Able to sense the fires of souls, Su Lun perfectly avoided all ghosts.
Yet, he could clearly sense that just beyond the door, dozens of ghosts lingered.
The very instant they appeared, it seemed some ghosts sensed something, but without detecting "Yang energy," none entered to investigate.
They had truly evaded detection!
Looking at each other, Su Lun and Chitose shared the same realization: They were saved!
Soon after, the wild wind outside died down.
The monsters, unable to find their prey, cursed and grumbled.
"Damn it! Greedy God, where did you take those two humans!"
"That damned beggar, don't think you can keep them to yourself..."
"Run, run, kekeke... No living person can escape the Netherworld, let's see how long you can hide..."
"..."
Outside the house, the air was heavy with spectral energy. Ghostly creatures passed through the walls, glancing briefly at the two hiding inside before drifting away.
Fortunately, the "Gluttonous Grand General" Peion seemed to be holding strong, and the battle on the western side at the Ghost Lantern Night Market had not yet ended. The spectating ghosts as well were drawn there.
Su Lun and Chitose remained hidden, waiting until the sounds of the surrounding monsters faded into the distance before they dared to take a deep breath.
Since the ghosts were oblivious to their presence, there was no urgent need for them to attempt an escape from the city.
Chitose asked, "Where do we go now?"
After some thought, Su Lun replied, "Let's recover a bit first then head over to the Senso-ji Temple to check the situation."
He had stripped some souls from the ghosts, and now he had a target.
If all went as expected, the Yomi Country Lord, "Izanami," could very well be the key to escaping the cursed space.
But given the current situation, where Su Lun and Chitose had nearly perished facing a Shuten-doji, seeking out the "King" was most likely a mission with no return.
They needed to find some other opportunity.
And Su Lun had also learned that the evil spirits were reluctant to approach the outskirts of the city near the "Senso-ji Temple," as it was imbued with divine power and would be safer.
Moreover, his intuition told him that Senso-ji Temple would be a critical place.
After all, the great literary figure Fujiwara Hayato had completed the [Death Novel] right there at the Senso-ji Temple!

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - 332: Getting Thicker-skinned
chapters.content:
Su Lun and Qian Tiao were both seriously injured. They had planned to treat their wounds in the house before leaving the city.
However, the "Messenger of Death" birds they released found that ghosts were still wandering nearby, seemingly not giving up on searching for them. This made both of them very cautious.
Although they took the "Supplication Pills" to mask their living breath, Su Lun wasn't sure whether some monsters with unique sensing abilities could still locate them.
If discovered, it was unlikely they would be so fortunate to have someone come to their aid again.
It was not safe to stay in the city, so they quickly bandaged their wounds and left the house.
Ironically, soon after they stepped out, the commotion from the Ghost Lantern Night Market ceased.
The Ninth Fleet of the Northern Sea had been completely annihilated.
Su Lun guessed that the fleet's commander, the seventh-tier "Gluttonous Grand General" Peion, was probably not killed but assimilated by the energy of the Netherworld.
Despite the dangerous battle, Su Lun could roughly assess the strength of the ghosts in this cursed space.
He estimated that the strongest boss in the city should probably be of the seventh-tier professional level, right?
Otherwise, if there was an eighth-tier power, the battle at Peion's side would not have been in such a stalemate.
Of course, the Yomi Country Lord Izanami is another matter.
Previously, when Su Lun extracted the Soul Shards from those ghosts, they regarded this being as a very special existence.
...
After the battle, the chaos in the city subsided into quietness.
At the corners of streets, ghosts were still fighting over the bodies of the living, and everywhere there were gruesome scenes of blood and flesh being devoured.
Su Lun and Qian Tiao changed their clothes and blended in with the crowd of ghosts. Without their living breath, they smoothly made their way to the southern city wall and climbed out.
Much of the population of the Mountain Hermit Country was concentrated in cities and villages, with almost everything outside being "lonely wilderness." The Netherworld was even more desolate, where hardly a ghost's shadow could be seen outside the city.
Moreover, the paths here were different from reality.
Even though Qian Tiao said she knew the location of Sensoji Temple, they still wandered on the mountain roads for a long time without finding it.
Finally, they reached a point in the pitch-black mountain where there was no longer any path, and they stopped.
Su Lun asked, "Sister Qian Tiao, could we have taken the wrong direction?"
The wilderness, with tall grasses all around, seemed like a perfect place for shooting a horror film but did not look like the path to Sensoji Temple at all.
Qian Tiao also massaged her temple with a puzzled face, "I shouldn't have remembered it wrong. The incense at Sensoji Temple is very prosperous, and I've been there once. The temple covers a large area, almost half a mountain is dominated by the temple and Buddhist sculptures. It's strange, why can't we find it? I remember it should be on this mountain..."
"..."
Su Lun frowned upon hearing this.
No temple was in sight, not even a glimmer of light, just slopes upon slopes.
He even felt as if they had been fooled by some ghost, but the All-knowing Eye didn't detect any anomalies.
After pondering for a moment, Qian Tiao suggested, "How about we go further in and look? This place seems different from the real world. The way to Sensoji Temple I remember was always a stone pavement leading straight to the temple gates. But here, without incense, maybe no ghosts come?"
"Yeah."
Su Lun nodded, agreeing that this was the only possibility.
Without any delay, they chose a direction and plunged into the grass, groping their way deeper into the mountains.
Finally, the Messenger of Death Bird flying in the sky saw traces of a structure in the mountains.
"Found it!"
Su Lun also sighed in relief, finally certain they had not gone in the wrong direction.
Qian Tiao muttered, "I said so, I shouldn't have remembered the direction wrong."
Soon, they emerged from the tall grass to find a narrow trail.
Following the trail for half a mile, they finally saw a stone with the faded characters for "Sensoji Temple."
Looking up, a few dilapidated houses built against the mountain were seen, with the red walls long faded. The paper-covered doors and windows were torn, covered in cobwebs, and the tiled roof was covered in snow. There were no lights, making it look like no one had visited for a long time.
Qian Tiao pointed to Buddhist statues carved into the cliff, saying, "I've seen this statue in the main hall of Sensoji Temple before; it's said to be the oldest statue in the temple..."
While talking, she also expressed her confusion, "Strange, why does this Sensoji Temple look different from what I saw?"
Su Lun wasn't surprised, smiling slightly, "We should have realized earlier. This is the Netherworld, the world of ghosts and monsters; there shouldn't be any temples here. Keeping these few dilapidated buildings is already fortunate."
Looking at the large Buddha sculpture, he paused and added, "Moreover, if I'm not mistaken, this is the 'Ancient Sensoji Temple.' Sensoji Temple has been rebuilt many times, each time larger than the last. It even burned down before. It was rebuilt during the Heian period, which is when it grew to the size outside of Edo Castle."
"Oh, that's how it is. I see..."
Upon hearing this, Qian Tiao seemed to finally understand, "How do you know so much?"
Su Lun spread his hands and said, "I've glanced through the books in the Godly Garment Royal Library; I just happened to pay more attention to this temple, and I have some impression."
"Not bad at all."
Qian Tiao showed a hint of appreciation in her eyes and then asked, "But why did Granny Aju suggest we come here? What's special about this temple?"
Su Lun too was puzzled, and after a moment of contemplation, he said, "The history of Sensoji Temple predates Edo Castle. There are many mysterious legends about this temple. Apparently, it housed many high monks, some special monsters, converted bandits... It also sealed the legendary 'Yamata no Orochi.'"
Upon hearing this, Qian Tiao seemed to sense there was more to it and asked, "So, what have you found?"
Su Lun's left eye flickered with luminosity, shaking his head, "Nothing."
No matter where he looked, there was nothing special about this decrepit temple.
He also guessed, "Perhaps it's because ghosts and goblins instinctively avoid temples, so it feels safer?"
Qian with a frivolous frown, said, "Shall we go in and have a look?"
Su Lun nodded, "Mhm."
....
The two stopped in front of the temple gate for a moment.
Black Crow went in for a look and found nothing unusual.
Su Lun was holding an umbrella in his hand, sending out his perception, but didn't detect any soul fluctuations either.
Only then did they walk inside.
And what they saw was chilling to the bone, dilapidated and desolate.
Hmm... No matter how you looked at it, it was just an unremarkable, broken temple.
The courtyard was filled with snowdrifts and fallen leaves, a few jujube trees were bare, and the stone steps were covered in moss.
Su Lun also felt somewhat disappointed, having thought that this place, where Fujiwara Hayato once stayed, might be key to breaking the cursed space.
But looking at the situation, it seemed like he might have thought too much?
Arriving at a "Senso-ji Temple" on an unknown timeline, many things were different.
The two pushed open the temple's main hall door riddled with holes, only a few rays of moonlight pouring through the roof breaches provided visibility, which was very low.
Su Lun's night vision was strong, and he immediately saw various menacing wooden statues inside.
He instantly concluded, "These Buddha carvings are new, made in the past few years, there must have been someone staying here before."
"Mhm."
Qian by his side seemed to have discovered something special about these statues.
She took out an alchemy magic lamp, and as soon as it was lit, an orange glow dispelled the darkness.
Statue after statue of exquisite Buddha figures immediately appeared, some with fierce frowns, others with malevolent expressions, and still others majestic and solemn...
The craftsmanship was fine and the expressions were lifelike.
Were it not evident at first glance that these were wood carvings, Su Lun might even have thought they were alive.
Qian leaned in close, examined the craftsmanship carefully, and immediately said, "These carvings are by a Sword Dao expert."
After a moment of contemplation, her voice took on a note of shock, and she quickly corrected herself, "No... His swordsmanship is very high, he might be a Sword Saint!"
"Sword Saint?"
Su Lun looked again more closely.
He himself often carved Rune Vajra, and felt that even now he couldn't produce such lifelike statues.
Hearing Qian's words, he too thought it likely so.
Traces of Sword Intent lingered on the marks of the carvings.
But at the same time, a sense of alertness arose in him.
This was a cursed space, and ghosts did not welcome the living.
The higher the master's skill, the more dangerous it was.
Su Lun glanced around, noting only a cushion and a campfire in front of the Buddha statues and nothing else, and spoke solemnly, "There are no footprints on the snow in the yard, and the campfire ash inside the hall has turned cold, that person must have left three or four days ago."
Qian became even more convinced, saying, "With such a serene craftsmanship, his disposition is beyond that of ordinary people. That 'Sword Saint' definitely isn't someone who kills indiscriminately. It's a pity, it would've been great to ask him for guidance on the Sword Dao."
High-ranking swordsmen indeed can discern the temperament of others through Sword Intent.
Listening to her, Su Lun's furrowed brow finally relaxed, and he added, "Perhaps... this is the reason Granny Aju asked us to come here."
"Mhm."
Qian nodded and asked, "Shall we rest here for the night then?"
"Okay."
Su Lun also felt they had no other choice; both their injuries were at a point where not treating them would be troublesome, and the decrepit temple, though shabby, at least had no ghosts to disturb them.
Going elsewhere, they might encounter other monsters.
....
Having decided to stay for the night, Qian hung the magic lamp on a beam, casting a light that was neither bright nor dim around the room.
Su Lun took out a camping tent and laid out a mat.
Both of them started to tend to their own wounds independently.
Now in a relatively safe environment, Su Lun could properly address his injuries. Having sustained a cut to his abdomen, he opened the blood-soaked bandage, revealing a gory wound. If it was a regular injury, his natural healing abilities would have already closed it up, but the wound contained the crimson demonic energy of Shuten-doji, its eerie power impeding the healing and coursing through his veins.
However, Su Lun had ample experience handling such injuries and had prepared high-grade potions just for this kind of situation.
He released two "Healing Dolls" from the Eight-Arm Spear, which continually emitted a healing aura. Meanwhile, he poured an alchemical potion designed to cleanse the wound of foreign energy over the cut and began to stitch it up.
Aside from the abdomen, he had several other minor injuries on his body.
Because he possessed multiple hands and was "Expert-Level Medical Proficient," he handled his wound care with ease. Even surgeries that normally required multiple people were no challenge for his eight spider-like limbs.
Qian, on the other hand, was not having such an easy time.
It wasn't that the higher one's professional level, the better their healing techniques.
At least a thousand such gambling-addicted wives would be just like her.
Her healing methods were limited to topical potions, ingestible concoctions, rough bandaging... she didn't even know the basics of suturing.
Oh... that's not right.
After knowing a certain fact, describing her as a young wife seemed somewhat inappropriate.
Qian Tiao's injuries were no less severe than Su Lun's; she removed the shoulder armor of the "Iron Red Scale Coated Armor Set", then she could wipe off five scale-like red breastplates. Only then did she see the next layer of chainmail with unfastened buckles, revealing the fabric underneath. When the last layer of fabric was gone, only a bandaged chest wrap remained.
In the process of dismantling her armor, she couldn't help but spit out another mouthful of dirty blood.
It was only then that Su Lun saw her back full of marks that looked like flame burns, signs of demonic energy contamination that were quite dangerous. There were also some fine, scale-like wounds from Sword Qi. This made her originally smooth skin look like it was covered in wounds.
Su Lun observed and his gaze slightly narrowed as he said, "You can't deal with the wounds on your back by yourself, let me do it."
"Oh?"
Qian Tiao, with her back turned to him, glanced over her shoulder and said, "Okay."
With that, she gathered her long blue hair high up and tied it with a red string, revealing her entire beautiful back.
Because the wounds covered her entire back, she proceeded to unravel the bandages around her chest, as if it were just a normal thing to do.
But as soon as she started, pausing as if she remembered something, her hands stopped in front of her chest for a moment.
A trace of unusual color flashed across Qian Tiao's face, but she soon continued.
She unwound the blood-stained bandages round and round until her upper half was completely exposed to the air.
The angle of the magic lamp cast her silhouette on the ground, graceful in the light and shadow, her chest rising high with proud curves.
Without any distraction, Su Lun conjured several spider lances, first using potions to clean the wounds on her back, and then began to suture them methodically.
The higher the tier of extraneous energy needing to be cleared, the more painful the process, akin to sulfuric acid being poured on skin, a deeply stinging pain.
Close combatants like Qian Tiao were even more severely contaminated.
Yet from beginning to end, she remained expressionless, even managing to tend to some of her wounds by herself.
The dense sweat on her forehead and her pale complexion confirmed that she was not at ease.
....
Professional medical care naturally yielded much better results than haphazard bandaging. Once the negative energy is cleared, with potions and healing alchemy arrays to help, except for some large wounds, minor injuries usually heal quickly.
Su Lun's excellent medical skills and multitasking ability allowed him to handle it adeptly.
In a short while, he had almost finished dealing with the wounds on his own abdomen.
It was about time to suture Qian Tiao's back wounds...
As if he had finished his homework and wanted to turn the page, Su Lun casually added, "All right, Sister Qian Tiao, your back is treated, turn around."
If it had been before, Qian Tiao would have turned around without hesitation, unashamed to be so exposed. After all, it wasn't as if they hadn't seen each other before.
But then after someone asked her a silly question earlier, she felt as though something had changed.
Feeling somewhat less confident, Qian Tiao squeaked, "I have mostly taken care of the front already..."
"With your level of wound treatment? It could take ten days or even half a month to heal."
Su Lun, with an expression of disdain, interrupted her unceremoniously and barked, "Hurry up and turn around."
"..."
For the first time, Qian Tiao felt that she had lost the upper hand in presence to Su Lun.
Nevertheless, she turned around, completely unguarded before him.
Su Lun, without glancing aside, looked at the sloppy bandaging on her abdomen and frowned, "You call this self-treatment? Is this it?"
"..."
Qian Tiao, put down by his scolding and without a retort, rolled her eyes at his pure gaze and let him take over.
Su Lun began to work on the wounds, cleaning them, dispelling the foreign energy, suturing...
....
Because Su Lun had trained in life-saving skills, the Rune Vajra left him with few superficial injuries. Aside from his abdomen, the rest were quickly dealt with.
But Qian Tiao's injuries were much more serious; after the upper limbs were taken care of, there were also many wounds on her lower limbs.
Under Su Lun's firm stance, Qian Tiao also undressed her lower body armor.
Knee guards, tassets, thigh armor, shin guards... the pieces of armor were taken off one by one.
In the end, not even her close-fitting underwear could remain.
Qian Tiao's extraordinarily beautiful body was completely exposed to the air, as she stood there with a slightly helpless expression.
Emotions could be sensed.
If Su Lun's gaze had been completely unswerving before, by the time he was nearly finished treating her, that gaze had become almost provoking.
Qian Tiao was helpless against this shamelessly thick-skinned fellow.
She thought of pretending she didn't notice by closing her eyes, but that annoying man insisted on speaking.
"Yo, Sister Qian Tiao, upon closer inspection, you have a really nice figure," he said.
All the serious injuries had been dealt with, and this was Su Lun's first time appreciating Qiān Tiáo's figure from such a close distance, and on top of that, occasionally his hands could get legitimately involved.
Completely unobscured, tsk tsk... quite a feast for the eyes.
"Focus on what you're doing and please don't stare randomly, okay?"
"Oh."
"What does 'oh' mean? Just 'oh-ing' doesn't mean you should hold back a bit? Also, for that spot on my butt, you could have just used the spider lance. Your hands make it really ticklish..."
"..."
Oh, well, if he had to look, he had to look.
This rascally behavior was something Qiān Tiáo couldn't do anything about.
Even though his gaze and hands were a bit unruly, after all, he was truly treating her injuries.
She couldn't really punch him for that, could she?
And in fact, Qiān Tiáo didn't really mind; they were quite familiar with each other after all, but it did feel genuinely strange.
She had never imagined she would be in such a situation.
If it were someone else, those daring to look like that would've been chopped down long ago.
Fortunately, Su Lun did not make the atmosphere awkward; after treating all the wounds, he truly composed himself and started cleaning the surgical tools on the side.
Qiān Tiáo donned a loose plain white cotton robe; with clothing as a cover, that odd feeling disappeared.
....
After the earlier fierce battle, both were extremely exhausted.
Even Su Lun, mockingly called the "study demon" by Lolota, didn't want to meditate, just wishing for a good night's sleep.
The decrepit temple was draughty from all sides, and snowflakes fell from the tattered roof, creating a desolate and lonely atmosphere.
Su Lun spread out a soft mat inside the tent, and they lay down there.
Originally, this was nothing more than a normal way of interaction.
Countless times they had shared the same room, the same mat.
But as it turned out, relationships are peculiar that way; the more time spent together, the more intimate they became over time.
When they first met, they acted very properly. After they became familiar, they stopped minding the little things. Then, after spending more time together in the same room, they even stopped caring about changing clothes around each other, and then, even some intimate contact became routine...
It didn't feel inappropriate, and somehow, it seemed that after becoming familiar, this was exactly how it should be.
The two of them lay back on the mat, each under their own blankets, thoughts racing.
Having walked the thin line between life and death tonight, looking back, both couldn't help feeling emotional.
While neither had fallen asleep yet, they started to chat.
"Kid Su Lun, do you think we can make it out of here?"
"I don't know. The potion's effect should last a month, so we still have enough time to figure something out."
"What if we can't get out?"
"If we can't get out, then we can't. But, I've got some ideas; there might be a chance."
"Actually, it doesn't really matter whether this place is the Netherworld or not. Being able to meet the deceased masters of the Sword Dao is really a great fortune in life. Ah... if I can enter the 'Sword Saint Realm' in this lifetime, I would have no regrets."
"Yeah, I feel the same. If only I could know what kind of novel Fujiwara Hayato had written. It's getting more and more intriguing."
"..."
Both were in good spirits and didn't let their current predicament lead to despair; they took it in stride.
But as they chatted, Qiān Tiáo suddenly felt her blanket being pulled away, and then it felt rather crowded.
Ordinarily, this would have been due to her own sprawling sleeping position. But since she was still awake, she knew she hadn't moved.
Qiān Tiáo grumbled, "Hey, why are you squeezing over here? It's really crowded..."
In the darkness, Su Lun's reply came, "The cold wind blowing in is a bit chilly."
"Heh, is that so?"
Qiān Tiáo chuckled coldly, as if sensing something, "Then what's the deal with your hand coming over?"
Su Lun: "Ah, I have a wound, and it's more comfortable to put my hand like this..."
Upon hearing this, Qiān Tiáo pursed her lips in retort, "Oh, you're quite presumptuous, aren't you?"
This guy's cheekiness was really increasing by the day.
Last time at the Tea Crying Mountain hot spring, at least he would have asked. Now, he just went ahead and laid his hand there?
But despite her words, she didn't knock his hand away.
During this brief exchange of words, the Su Lun beside her seemed to have fallen asleep, no longer stirring. The awkward feeling that had beset her also quickly faded away.
"..."
In the dark, Qiān Tiáo wore an expression of helpless resignation, and her normally unfussy self didn't seem to think anything was amiss. She shifted slightly to find a comfortable position for herself and closed her eyes in languid repose.
Just let it be.
Sweet dreams throughout the night.

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - 333: When I draw my sword, it is hell
chapters.content:
The Netherworld knows no division between day and night; when Su Lun awoke, the sky still bore that ghostly gray moon.
A good sleep had restored his energy.
Even the hormonal rampage that had torn through his body tissues had mostly healed.
Su Lun glanced at Qian Tiao still sleeping soundly beside him, raised an eyebrow slightly; this gambling addict of a woman seemed to have no defenses against him, her spread-eagled sleeping posture brought a smile to the corner of his mouth.
Melee combat professionals require more rest, so he didn't wake Qian Tiao. After dressing, he set up a stove in the dilapidated great hall and prepared to make something to eat.
The food in this cursed space should not be eaten, but luckily, Su Lun was always prepared with plenty of food.
Having Spatial Ability is convenient; there's no worry about the Storage Ring running out of space.
He took out a bunch of canned beef and started fussing over a beef soup pot. Mafa's military food, in terms of both taste and quality, was superior to that of a typical restaurant.
Snow still drifted outside, the cold wind shrilling.
Soon, the aromatic scent of stewed meat permeated the entire great hall.
In her sleep, Qian Tiao instinctively sniffed and, without opening her eyes, her body sat up. The loose cotton white dress couldn't hide her fine figure, half of the collar hanging loosely on her shoulder, and the deep V-neck further revealing part of her proud peaks enticingly smooth to the eye.
"Something smells so good..."
Qian Tiao muttered as if sleep talking, seemingly aware of some gaze, and suddenly opened her eyes.
Then she saw Su Lun's mischieviously smiling face.
She gave him an annoyed glare, somewhat speechlessly adjusting the clothes on her shoulder, covering the revealed scenery. Her eyes seemed to disdain, what's there to look at?
Su Lun didn't shy away at all, smiling cheerfully, "Come and eat."
Qian Tiao, seeing the meat in the pot, immediately cheered up and approached, "Tsk tsk, I knew that sticking with you, kid, I'd never go hungry."
Su Lun felt a bit surprised upon hearing that.
Isn't preparing food a basic action when traveling?
He casually asked, "Sister Qian Tiao, have you ever gone hungry?"
Qian Tiao didn't blush at all as she admitted, "I have. Before, when I was at sea and supplies were not sufficient, I ran into a storm and couldn't even catch fish. Starving every other day, I almost couldn't make it to shore..."
Su Lun's eyes twitched, and then he laughed softly.
Qian Tiao seemed not to notice anything amiss and kept scooping up the meat, eating with great enjoyment.
Outside, the wind and snow blew, and the two huddled near the stove, eating the boiling hot pot and chatting leisurely.
Quite pleasant, indeed.
Before long, they were full and satisfied.
Both had wounds on their bodies and did not plan to run around. They decided to stay at the Senso-ji Temple for a day or two.
Qian Tiao seemed bored to death, staring at the wooden Buddha statues for a long time. Then she wrapped her chest with gauze, changed her clothing, and began practicing her sword in the snowy yard.
Su Lun meticulously toured the "Senso-ji Temple," examining almost everything that could be identified by the Eye of Omniscience.
However, to his slight disappointment, he found nothing special and no clues to help them escape.
The surroundings were all barren mountains, devoid even of larger trees.
The good thing was that no ghosts approached the place, making it quite safe.
....
"Swish," "swish," "swish"...
The sound of Sword Qi tearing through the air was incessant.
In the courtyard, Qian Tiao, with a serious expression, swung her sword again and again, the ground's snow marked with a succession of traces.
Su Lun sat in meditation under the eaves where the snow did not reach, his previous battle having given him much to ponder, requiring time to digest the large amount of information obtained.
This "Death Story: The Netherworld" differed so much from the regular cursed spaces, with NPCs undistinguishable from real persons and the known map seemingly boundless, with no flaws to be seen in its rules...
So many parts Su Lun couldn't figure out.
He needed a great deal of information from the world to piece together those scattered clues and see if he could find any hints to leave this place.
The two of them were each busy with their own tasks, the time passed leisurely, not at all like being in a T-level cursed space.
It seemed as though there was no division of time in the Netherworld, the moon in the sky hadn't shifted at all, it always hung in that same spot.
When Qian Tiao got tired, the two of them would have a full meal again.
It was still her practicing with the sword, and Su Lun in meditation, each busily engaged.
The time on the pocket watch was probably in the evening when a crow on a dry tree branch suddenly cawed.
Su Lun abruptly opened his eyes and looked solemnly towards the outside of the temple, exclaiming, "Someone's coming!"
Qian Tiao also showed a guarded expression and asked, "A monster?"
"No. It should be a human ghost."
Su Lun's eyes reflected the image the crow had seen, it was a hunchbacked old man in a hemp garment, balancing a yoke on his shoulders and stepping on two massive logs, walking unhurriedly from the narrow path outside the temple.
From his attire, Su Lun guessed something and added, "It seems like the 'Buddha Carving Master' who stayed here before."
Upon hearing this, Qian Tiao immediately showed interest, looking forward expectantly, "That Sword Saint?"
"Yeah."
Su Lun thought it likely was, his face grew slightly somber.
As the man approached, within Su Lun's perception, the soul fire was much stronger compared to ordinary ghosts.
Moreover, the man's perception was very sharp. The moment Su Lun noticed him, he immediately spotted the crow on the tree branch.
Qian Tiao, even more intrigued, said, "Let's go have a look!"
....
Sensō-ji Temple was a rare place of safety in the Netherworld, and naturally, Su Lun and Qian Tiao wouldn't leave lightly.
Plus, Qian Tiao indeed had a great interest in that mysterious "Buddha Carving Master."
The two went into the courtyard to wait for the visitor.
Before long, the old man entered through the temple's main gate. He wasn't at all surprised by the presence of two more people in the ruined temple. He walked in as if it were his own home, very familiar with the place, and then placed the two logs he had carried under the eaves.
Su Lun sensed for a moment; it was naturally a "ghost."
But judging from the strength of the soul, it was only around the fourth or fifth order, not very strong. However, that ancient calmness exuded from him gave an inexplicable sense of oppression.
Su Lun didn't underestimate him. Even though a person becomes a ghost after death and their cultivation starts anew, this was, after all, a "Sword Saint."
Qian Tiao went up to him directly and performed a swordsman's salute, holding her sword, "Senior, I apologize for the intrusion."
The dilapidated temple had been claimed by someone else earlier, so their presence was indeed a disturbance.
The old man glanced at them and said indifferently, "Are you the two humans who escaped from the city yesterday?"
When their past was so accurately divined, Qian Tiao didn't deny it, "Yes. Granny Aju guided us here. We apologize for disturbing you, Senior."
The old man was easy to talk to, seeming to know they came looking for refuge, showing no malice, "If you truly can't find a place to stay, then it's fine here. This is a Buddhist temple, not my dwelling, so it's not an intrusion. It's just unfortunate that the Yomi Country isn't a place for the living, you've come to the wrong place."
Seeing his attitude, Su Lun breathed a sigh of relief in his heart.
It looked like their previous judgment was correct; this "Buddha Carving Master" wasn't like those evil ghosts always looking to devour the living. It seemed they could get along.
The old man didn't mind at all that there were two more people here. As if nobody else was around, he sat down on a small stool under the eaves, picked up his carving knife, and started working on the two logs he brought back, apparently planning to carve a new Buddha statue.
Witnessing this scene gave Su Lun a very strange feeling.
Once the old man sat there, it was as if he instantly merged with the surrounding environment. He became a part of it, just like the stone pagodas, logs, dead trees… and so on. He wasn't an abrupt human presence.
It was a feeling of "a person within a painting."
"Is this the Saint Realm..."
Su Lun murmured to himself.
Realms cannot be measured solely by professional levels, but generally speaking, the understanding of "entering the Saint Realm" on the level of principles is about the standard for a seventh-tier professional.
There are also poetry, magic, art, music… any path that can concentrate divinity has such a significant threshold.
Qiān Tiáo, standing nearby, also noticed this point, her eyes filled with reverence.
She bowed once more and said frankly, "Mr. Akutagawa, I wish to learn Sword Dao from you."
Indeed, this was the renowned Akutagawa Ryuichi, the only one in the Mountain Hermit country in the past two decades who had entered the "Sword Saint" realm, a great grandmaster of the Sword Dao.
Qiān Tiáo had noticed the Sword Intent left on the wooden Buddha carvings in the hall previously and felt it was familiar. Upon comparison, she realized it was almost identical to the Sword Intent on the carving knife given to her by the blind qin master she met at Edo Castle.
Qiān Tiáo came to the Mountain Hermit country specifically for him.
Unfortunately, this Akutagawa Ryuichi had already passed away.
But fortunately, she encountered his spirit in the Netherworld.
The old man, hearing Qiān Tiáo's words, showed not the slightest surprise.
He merely glanced at the sword marks in the courtyard and recognized the slash practice of "Akutagawa Ittoryu," saying indifferently, "Since Xiao Xun has given you the carving knife... her choice of person would naturally not be poor."
At these words, Su Lun finally breathed a sigh of relief.
But speaking to this point, he suddenly shook his head, and the conversation took a turn, "However... Ittoryu is not used like that."
Su Lun, who was standing nearby, listened and glanced sideways. Qiān Tiáo's cultivation in the Sword Dao was not weak—wherever "great swordsmen" are found, they are considered experts. But in the old man's tone, she was spoken of as if she were merely an apprentice barely starting the Sword Dao?
He was also curious about just how powerful a "Sword Saint" really is.
Hearing this, Qiān Tiáo did not feel embarrassed by the denial but was instead delighted, "Please enlighten me, senior."
Since the old man spoke these words, he was evidently willing to teach the Sword Dao.
....
Akutagawa Ryuichi's reaction seemed to have the delay common to the very elderly.
Upon hearing this, he appeared to respond with a beat's delay, setting down his carving knife leisurely, and then looked at the blade in Qiān Tiáo's hands, asking, "Are you perhaps puzzled about your current realm, feeling that, despite having excellent weapons and your sword techniques being refined to the point of hardly improving, you still feel powerless against higher-tier enemies?"
"Yes! I beg senior to resolve my doubt."
Qiān Tiáo was taken aback by his comment, which pinpointed her greatest confusion.
She had suffered a significant loss in the battle the day before.
Facing off against the Red Lotus Demon Fire of Shuten-doji, she did not lose in skill or in blade, but she did not gain the upper hand and almost died there. She was clearly aware that her understanding of Sword Dao did not match the sharpness of the blade, rendering her unable to unleash the true power of a renowned sword.
Moreover, it was even more challenging to slash at Spiritual Bodies; aside from using the Demon Blade's own demonic qi to scorch the Spiritual Bodies, Sword Qi could hardly cause effective damage.
She knew where the problem lay—she needed to use the Sword Dao to condense a dominating aura.
But she did not know how to break through.
That one step to move beyond, in the end, was just extraordinary.
The old man did not seem in a hurry to talk about Sword Dao, but instead, he looked at the white-sheathed blade in Qiān Tiáo's hand, "The blade in your hand is 'Onimaru Hyakume no Munemasa,' isn't it?"
Without waiting for an answer, he answered for himself, "This hellish demon weapon, I've wielded it too. Alas, it didn't choose me as its master. How unexpected that it ended up in your hands, that too is destiny."
Qiān Tiáo felt a hint of surprise—what a coincidence?
"Destiny, huh..."
The old man's tone was somewhat wistful, and seeing that blade seemed like seeing an old friend he hadn't met in a long time.
Truly, it was like a separation between life and death.
Never thought he would see it again in the Netherworld.
After musing for a moment, his turbid eyes casually flickered with a sparkle as he asked, "Have you... ever seen the hellish landscapes beneath this blade's edge?"
Qiān Tiáo replied earnestly, "I have seen them. They are awe-inspiring."
The old man smiled ambiguously as if in agreement, as if he had finally reached the heart of the matter, asking, "So, what do you think your Sword Dao is?"
Upon hearing these words, a fierce Sword Qi seemed to burst from Qian's eyes as she firmly said, "Once I unsheath my sword, I can split mountains, sever rivers, cleave seas, and slay gods and demons."
The old man shook his head upon hearing this, "The resolve in your sword heart is good, but that's not your Sword Dao. Sword Dao is the courage in your heart. Before you unsheath your sword, if you believe that what you're holding in your hand is 'something', then your Sword Dao is that 'something'."
"This..."
At these words, confusion flooded Qian's eyes.
She gripped the handle of the Demon Blade Soujirou, seemingly unable to comprehend, and then asked, "Senior... may I ask what your Sword Dao is?"
"Mine...?"
Upon hearing this, a smile appeared on the old man's weathered face, and his presence suddenly became unfathomable.
With that, he mimicked unsheathing a sword with the carving knife in his hand and said, "Like you, I cultivate the path of hell."
....
A great sword expert and a Sword Saint were discussing Sword Dao; Su Lun was far from reaching their realm and felt completely confused by their conversation.
Moreover, this was no longer a matter of mere "technique"; listening in prematurely might not necessarily be beneficial.
While eavesdropping, Su Lun also fiddled with his Alchemy.
But it was the old man's words that suddenly changed the harmonious atmosphere.
Out of the blue, Su Lun felt goosebumps explode all over his body.
It was like... before in the city, when countless malicious spirits surrounded him, like the oppressive feeling of facing a desperate situation.
Su Lun turned his head to look, his expression complex: What a terrifying aura!
In front of him,
Not far away.
The old man was holding the handle of the carving knife backwards, as if slowly drawing a long sword.
It was just an unremarkable carving knife, but it seemed even more terrifying than Qian unsheathing the Demon Blade Soujirou, exuding an indescribable dreadful pressure. With each inch he pulled, his presence rose to new heights.
And behind him, one could almost see a towering sea of blood.
Akutagawa Ryuichi's eyes were as sharp as lightning, his voice as if coming from the deepest abyss, "When I unsheathe my blade, it is hell."
With that casual remark, it felt as if thunder exploded beside the ear, "This is my Sword Dao."
One face is that of a Buddha, the other bears the overwhelming killing intent capable of turning hell into a river of blood.
In the heart is the Buddha, behind is hell.
Even Su Lun, a novice in the way of the sword, faintly felt as though he had grasped something. As he looked at the Buddha carvings behind Akutagawa Ryuichi, he came to understand.
It seemed to be about the sword, but it was more about the "Dao."
