Su Lun held the black scythe in his hand and currently could still use it without worrying about curse rebounds, which was an opportunity to try.
But there were other methods of Ote Himeya's to be concerned about.
For instance, that method of polluting the sun.
It was still early, not time for entertainment.
The geishas had not opened for business yet, and since there were hardly any customers, they gathered in small groups outside.
Su Lun did not directly enter the "One Foot Interval" geisha house; he wandered around nearby, intending to see if there were other breakthroughs besides a direct confrontation.
Ironically, just as he was passing by, he suddenly sensed a familiar "soul fire" in a tavern.
....
"How could this guy be here?"
To Su Lun's surprise, he found 'the demon' Abe Yasukazu, disguised as a drinking customer in the tavern.
Last time, this fellow had tested Ote Himeya, fought a big battle, and then disappeared.
This guy is really audacious...
Su Lun thought.
Having witnessed the technique of "Tainting the Sun" and the method that summoned the "Moon Reading God," he became even more convinced of Ote Himeya's inscrutable tactics and schemes.
This Abe Yasukazu now dared to appear in Edo Castle, his courage and methods naturally impressive.
"This guy must know Ote Himeya is here, could he also be here for her?"
Su Lun knew he was from the Kachusha family, naturally not an enemy.
What purpose?
Thinking this, he walked straight in.
The moment he entered, the cautious guy noticed him.
Abe Yasukazu sat by a second-floor window, a position perfect for observing everyone in the bar.
Su Lun's approach almost made this demon jump out the window to escape.
Fortunately, it seemed he recognized him too.
Su Lun sat across from him. Abe Yasukazu stared at him incredulously as if he had seen a ghost, "You actually came out on your own?"
However, at the same time, it seemed as if he had accomplished some task, he sighed with relief as if a heavy burden had been lifted.
Su Lun didn't plan to explain much, "Mr. Abe, what are you doing here?"
Listening, Abe Yasukazu's tone was a bit odd, "What am I doing? I'm here for you, of course."
Despite the disguise, the bewitching look in his eyes made Su Lun very uncomfortable. He asked, "For me?"
Abe Yasukazu nodded and said, "That lady heard about the situation in Mountain Hermit and asked me to confirm your whereabouts. You were sucked into the Black Sun Grand Festival previously, and I was trying to find a breakthrough to save you..."
"..."
Su Lun also felt a strange sensation in his heart.
Kachusha is so afraid I'm dead?
Although grateful, Su Lun always felt that the girl's motives weren't so pure. Wanting him alive seemed not just for friendship, but mixed with some other factors.
Abe Yasukazu didn't continue, he sighed deeply, "Well, since you're safe, I can report back now."
The tone of relief was evident, one could imagine the pressure he had been under.
The Divine Royal Family had been overthrown by the Takeda Shogunate, and he, all by himself, however powerful, would find it difficult.
However, Abe Yasukazu seemed to discover something and asked, "Why do I feel like you've turned into a 'ghost'?"
He was adept at the Yin Yang Secret Technique, naturally sensing something aberrant in Su Lun's body.
Su Lun, without explaining his experience in the underworld too much, simply asked, "Can you fix it?"
Abe Yasukazu frowned, seemingly seeing a tough challenge, and instead of answering, asked, "May I check?"
Su Lun extended his hand.
Abe Yasukazu, like feeling the pulse, carefully sensed it.
But the more he saw, the stranger the expression on his face became. Looking back at Su Lun, he seemed not to see a person but a monster, his eye corner twitched violently, "How are you still alive in this state?"
"..."
Listenting to this, Su Lun gave him a glance, but said nothing more.
He now had several negative states such as mental and physical mutations, underworld Qi contamination... It was truly a miracle for a normal person to survive.
He was probably still alive because of the "X Serum."
But the reasons weren't important anymore, the result was whether he could be saved.
Abe Yasukazu shook his head, "Becoming a 'ghost' is irreversible. Your condition is very special, not only your body but your soul has been demonized."
At this point, he seemed somewhat pained, then added, "I can only suppress a bit with the Yin Yang Secret Technique. Moreover, I can only transfer a portion of the ghost Qi. For the rest, I am powerless."
Abe Yasukazu took out something that looked like a weather doll and placed it on the table.
Su Lun inspected it and found it to be a rare treasure.
[Onmyoji's Weather Doll]
Detailed Explanation: An Abe Familial Yin-Yang Dao inherited instrument, containing a hint of Yin and Yang power; when carried, it can transfer some of the continuous negative states the body suffers; it wards off evil and balances Yin and Yang, greatly restraining ghostly bodies;
This item, counted as an alchemical object, was also a rare "dark gold quality" treasure.
He exclaimed in surprise, "For me?"
"Yes."
Abe Yasukazu's expression changed slightly.
He didn't say it aloud, but he thought to himself that the lady had instructed him to protect your life at any cost.
"Oh. Thank you."
Although Su Lun didn't say it, he could guess as much.
The two weren't particularly familiar with each other, but this fellow had given such a valuable item for the sake of Katya.
Last time in Cursed Valley, he was still haunted by that "corpse soldier," and here it was again.
It seemed like the debts of gratitude were accumulating...
Since it was a lifesaving item, he didn't hesitate to take it.
He had actually long thought of someone who could heal his bodily deformity, and that was Danny's father, Dr. Banks, a top expert in the field of biotechnology with a high level of skill in researching biological deformities. If he couldn't solve it, it was doubtful anyone else in the world could.
But now, in his condition, he probably couldn't leave Mountain Hermit alive, so having this "Fair Weather Doll" was just the solution to his urgent problem.
....
Although he had lost a treasure, the mission was finally completed. Anbei Taiwa suppressed his depression of several days, and finally felt relieved, saying, "Well, now I've done all I can. I'll arrange for you to leave Mountain Hermit."
Since Su Lun had come out alive, he no longer needed to find a way to approach Ote Himeya.
After several probes, he had completely lost the spirit to confront that woman. The more he understood about her, the more mysterious she became.
Upon hearing this suggestion, Su Lun remained silent.
He didn't respond to the matter of leaving, but instead said, "Mr. Abe, I would like to consult you about a secret technique."
Upon hearing this, Anbei Taiwa looked slightly perplexed, "Armor Escape Secret Technique?"
Although it was a closely guarded secret, it wasn't a big problem for this individual.
But why?
A strange light suddenly flashed in his eyes.
Su Lun nodded, "Yes, if it's convenient."
Previously in the underworld facing Shuten-doji, he had almost perished alongside him during a four-stage hormone rampage fight.
Upon reflection, he realized there was a slight flaw in his technique.
Now in his "Rune Vajra" state, his physical strength was sufficient to support that level of combat, indicating that generally, there was no problem.
However, some organs still suffered from fatigue damage, indicating detailed issues.
The secret technique "Hormone Rampage" wasn't about how much more hormones were better but the precise control of them. Specific hormones needed to stimulate specific bodily organs, and the precision of hormone secretion directly affected physical combat abilities.
This secret technique originated from Gerald, the leader of the Old Lington umbrella organization and a forensic doctor. But due to the limitations in professional rank in Old Lington, the great talent interested in studying corpses only researched up to the "third stage."
This fourth stage was something Su Lun was exploring on his own, still a "half-finished" technique.
Originally, with ample time for attempts, he could slowly improve this technique, but now, he couldn't wait.
Now isolated and without support, facing Ote Himeya, the only desperate measure he could think of was this "Hormone Rampage" secret technique.
And now, he was only half-aware of the "fourth stage," and the "fifth stage" was completely unknown.
Blindly unlocking the "fifth stage" without considering combat, he would most likely die on the spot.
Therefore, he needed a shortcut to perfect the "fourth stage" or even to try reaching the higher level of the fifth stage!
And now, there was an opportunity right in front of him.
Su Lun had studied the Armor Escape Secret Technique of Mountain Hermit, which essentially also stimulated the body's potential to bring forth stronger combat power.
Although fundamentally different, some theories were similar, such as how to handle the body's excessive stress, energy flow, how to protect the meridians, and high-pressure combat techniques...
The royal family only had some incomplete texts. Princess mentioned that Ninja and Yin-Yang Dao each had their top-level Armor Escape Secret Techniques.
The person in front of him, Anbei Taiwa, just happened to be the most orthodox inheritor of Mountain Hermit's Yin-Yang Onmyoji.
....
"What... what are you planning to do?"
Upon hearing this, Anbei Taiwa was asking, but he had already guessed that the person in front of him was probably up to some mischief.
Having seen you come out alive, still going?
His face became very gloomy as he hurriedly urged, "Don't be rash. I must tell you, that Ote Himeya is very special and has some mysterious methods. Even seventh-tier professionals from your alchemy system have no chance of winning against her! And I suspect that one of the three divine artifacts of Mountain Hermit, the Yata Mirror, is in her possession, very powerful..."
"Mhm."
Su Lun listened with an undoubtedly indifferent expression and nodded his head, neither happy nor sad. He didn't insist further and immediately stood up, saying, "Then, I shall take my leave, Mr. Abe."
His mind was made up. Regardless是否有人帮,他都是要去的.
"You..."
Anbei Taiwa watched Su Lun preparing to leave, his expression turning very troubled.
Although he didn't understand why Su Lun wanted to do this, his attitude was already very clear.
If it were someone uninvolved, Anbei wouldn't care about his life and death under such circumstances.
But this was the person that the young lady had explicitly requested him to protect!
Finally, seeing Su Lun really about to leave, Anbei resignedly waved his hand, "Wait a moment!"

chapters.title: Chapter 348 - 348: 347
chapters.content:
"Do you really want to go after Ote Himeya?"
Mr. Abe's expression became oddly complex.
He could not help but detect the resoluteness hidden beneath Su Lun's seemingly casual demeanor.
Persuasion was futile, so faced with choosing the lesser of two evils, he could only ask, "When are you planning to make your move?"
With a faint air, Su Lun replied, "Within three days."
"So soon?"
Mr. Abe's brows furrowed upon hearing this.
The last Black Sun Grand Festival had practically wiped out all of Edo Castle's undercover agents; he had no more pawns to play.
Given more time, he might have thought of some other way.
Or perhaps seek support from beyond the Mountain Hermit's reach.
"Hmm."
Su Lun did not provide any further explanation.
The suggestion given to him by "Fujiwara Hayato" in the novel was best executed within three days for a surefire chance of perfect resurrection. Otherwise, staying in "Yomi-no-kuni" for too long would render resurrection impossible, even if the soul was still intact.
Mr. Abe asked, "How confident are you?"
"Hard to say,"
after some thought, Su Lun uttered these three words.
He felt his only advantage lay in the fact that Ote Himeya was his mentor's alchemy creation.
Mr. Jing said that her mother would not design an alchemical homunculus that she could not control. Although Cereya did not detail the method to make this "Pandora" in her research notes, as a successor to the Puppeteer lineage, Su Lun had guessed at some possible ways to restrain her.
But it was just a possibility.
He had no other choice but to take a gamble.
After a pause, he added, "But no matter the odds, I'll make my move within these three days. The sooner, the better."
"..."
Upon hearing his words, Mr. Abe's eyes narrowed slightly.
This "hard to say" left much to the imagination.
At the very least, if Mr. Abe were to face Ote Himeya himself, he would only have one answer: no confidence at all.
He had thought to simply knock her out, take her away and be done with it, but now, it seemed as if that plan was not feasible.
Moreover, this willingness to risk his life was the most touching reason for Mr. Abe's concern.
Indeed, the lady who summoned him at all costs to protect someone was not to be underestimated.
His gaze hardened as he agreed, saying, "Alright! The Art of Escaping Armor isn't quite the same between the Ninja Sect and us Onmyoji. Ninjas study the 'Eight Gates Escaping Armor', while our Onmyoji tradition is the 'Art of Qi Men Escaping Armor'. Coincidentally, I'm familiar with both. You want to use it to research the secret technique you used before, right? I've also done some research in this area..."
Since it was an utmost command, Mr. Abe naturally wouldn't just let Su Lun go by himself, and he indicated his stance, "When the time comes, I'll help you as much as possible."
....
Initially, Su Lun had only wanted to borrow the "Art of Escaping Armor" from the Onmyoji lineage for his research. He didn't expect Mr. Abe to not only provide him with the original text to read but also share his personal insights and the inherited training experience of the Abe family.
This greatly facilitated Su Lun's endeavor.
It was as if he had a teacher by his side whom he could immediately question if he were in doubt.
Onmyoji in the feudal society of Mountain Hermit held a position akin to "traditional scientists." They understood astronomy and geography and sought the true essence of life. They were responsible for devising the calendar, interpreting omens, and exorcising spirits and demons.
Su Lun was initially the one to ask for the secret technique.
But after half a day of combined research, their interaction evolved into mutual learning from which both greatly benefited.
They both made extremely important breakthroughs in this secret technique.
The [Hormonal Burst]focuses on the "principle" of Flesh Alchemy Technique, which requires full understanding of hormones' effects on the body. Dosage, type, stimulation form, and release presentation all need to be precise with no errors.
The [Art of Escaping Armor], on the other hand, emphasizes the "practicality" of the technique. Mr. Abe may not know the dosages, but his lineage, after countless generations and attempts, has discovered the most optimal usage. Knowing how to use it allows one to transform this secret technique into a warfare advantage, maximizing its potential.
It wasn't just the Hormone Rampage - Fifth Unleashing. Su Lun realized that in Mountain Hermit before the Era of Great Devastation, there were legends of ninjas who could simply use their bodies to cast the Art of Escaping Armor and possess combat power comparable to deities.
After hearing this, Su Lun had many thoughts, and his mind was fully opened.
At least it gave him a clear direction for his future study of [Hormonal Burst], rather than having to fumble in the dark.
As a gesture of reciprocity,
Su Lun also gave Mr. Abe a set of copies of the dissection research notes from the forensic doctor, Gerald, along with a generous gift of modern medical texts.
This immediately made the otherworldly being experience a sensation akin to opening the "gates to a new world."
He was a "mad scientist" restricted by his environment, possessing an extraordinary understanding and talent for human anatomy.
Just looking at those notes sparked all sorts of bizarre ideas in Mr. Abe, and he immediately conceived concepts like: eternal life through body swapping, interspecies biological grafting, reviving the dead...
Though these topics are commonplace in the realm of alchemy,
in Mr. Abe's eyes, such fervor was chilling. He thought not of modern science but of applying Yin Yang Secret Techniques.
Su Lun even felt, with a twinge, that this inadvertent action of his might give rise to a future grand villain.
...
Two days later.
In the Ginza district of Edo Castle.
The small bar not far from "Ichi Sun Ma" geisha house.
Su Lun and Mr. Abe were still sitting by the window on the second floor of the bar, drinking.
"Mr. Abe, is everything set up?"
"Hmm. As per your instructions, I've placed the Energy Barytes around the geisha house."
"Was it not discovered?"
"After all, I was once the court's chief Onmyoji, I still have some confidence in that."
"Right, I'm sorry, it's a matter of great importance..."
"..."
Su Lun and Abe Yasukazu were confirming the final preparations.
Once night fell, Su Lun planned to meet with Ote Himeya.
After speaking, Abe Yasukazu confirmed again, "Are you really going alone? What I mean is, I might be able to help a bit if I go."
Su Lun shook his head, saying, "Dealing with Ote Himeya, having more people doesn't necessarily help."
Based on the information they had obtained, during the failed assassination attempt, the Princess had used Divine Power of Amaterasu just to barely escape, and Ote Himeya's methods were not something an ordinary person could handle.
Besides, he was staking his life on this.
If he lost the bet, there was no need to involve others.
Abe Yasukazu listened with a grave expression, but he didn't insist any further.
Having interacted over the past few days, he had also realized that Su Lun was the type of person who acted with careful planning and steadiness; further persuasion was futile.
Thinking it over, he then said, "At that time, I will use Yin Yang Secret Technique to isolate the surge of faith around the geisha house, which can prevent anyone from summoning the 'Great God Tsukuyomi.' My people will also create chaos in the city. We should be able to hold them off for the time it takes to burn an incense stick, preventing Takeda Nobuyasu from getting timely reinforcements. And one more thing, if she really has the Yata Mirror, one of the Three Sacred Treasures, you must be cautious. That is a treasure of Visual Illusion Technique. Once it hits you, there is no escape. The last Black Sun anomaly was likely related to that Divine Artifact..."
"Understood."
Su Lun nodded, raised his cup of sake, and sincerely said, "Thank you, Mr. Abe."
Whether it was for the sake of the Katushya family or not, Abe Yasukazu had helped him far too much. His compiled intelligence had at least increased the chances of success for this operation by twenty percent.
"Take care."
Abe Yasukazu raised his cup and downed it in one gulp.
....
Su Lun left the tavern and headed straight for the entrance of "Ichi Sun Kan," a geisha house.
Normally, to flip the sign for an appointment with Ote Himeya, "the number one beauty in the land," without a reservation six months in advance was impossible.
Even now, with the geisha house business so quiet, the local Daimyo, generals, and rich merchants from Mountain Hermit still flocked there.
It was through Abe Yasukazu's remaining connections in Mountain Hermit that Su Lun was able to secure an appointment for that evening.
Su Lun's current disguise was as the illegitimate son of a fringe lord of Mountain Hermit.
His identity could withstand scrutiny, and even his identity tags were genuine.
As soon as he entered, asserting his identity, the Madam immediately greeted him warmly. Although they didn't know each other, she had the air of being well acquainted, "Oh my, if it isn't Master Shota from the Miyamoto family?"
A client who could find Ote Himeya was naturally generous. Su Lun casually threw two pieces of gold nuggets as a tip, and the Madam beamed even more brightly and led him through the cloister to an annex.
As "Mountain Hermit's number one geisha," Ote Himeya certainly had some status and had her own independent courtyard.
Su Lun walked in without revealing any emotion, not daring to look around too much, squinting and using only his left eye to see. He sensed around a bit—Ote Himeya's soul fluctuations were right here!
"Master Shota, please wait a moment, Miss Himeya will be here soon."
"Sure."
He entered the guest room, the Madam excused herself, and Su Lun was left alone in the house.
It didn't take long for the sound of light footsteps to come from the courtyard.
"She's here!"
Su Lun completely closed his eyes, relying solely on Soul Perception.
Having confirmed the target, he didn't hesitate at all. It was best to strike first!
With rapid movement of his ten fingers, Su Lun formed sorcerer's seals. Behind him, the eight-armed spider spear appeared in an instant, and the Thousand Threading Armor materialized just as quickly. With a soft chant, he invoked, "Puppet Mastery · Puppet Theater!"
As the Hexagram Array was still forming beneath his feet, the sorcerer's seals shifted again. The spider spear and hands grasped at the void, pulling out countless shimmering threads.
"Silk Control Secret Art - Cocoon World!"
This was a sequence of actions he had rehearsed countless times in his mind, leaving no possibility for error.
In just a brief moment, Su Lun had completed the casting of four alchemic seals.
The person at the door was clearly stunned by this sudden surge of energy and hastily retreated.
Too late, though!
Abe Yasukazu had arranged for his men to deploy a large number of Energy Baryte and alchemy formation auxiliary devices around the courtyard—it was all for this moment.
As Su Lun activated them, a myriad of threads suddenly sprouted around the small courtyard, swiftly enveloping the place into a gigantic cocoon.
As the lethal threat surged like a tide, Ote Himeya reacted swiftly, using an almost ghostly technique to try and flee the courtyard before the threads fully enveloped it.
But it was wishful thinking, for just then a talisman appeared in the sky, suppressing her phantasmagoric technique on the spot!
"Yin and Yang talismans, Abe Yasukazu?!"
Ote Himeya's gaze sharpened slightly as she guessed the assailant's identity.
If it was him, she was still not concerned.
But at the moment this thought arose, she suddenly realized something, her expression drastically changed, "I can't sense the Power of Faith anymore!"
She soon realized that her opponents had guessed her trump card and came prepared!
On the street outside the gate, Abe Yasukazu squinted slightly and muttered, "Actually made a move, huh..."
He also pulled out a scroll, red eyeshadow appearing on his face, his aura surging dramatically as he pointed with a sword gesture and shouted, "Onmyoji Secret Technique: Night Parade of One Hundred Demons!"
In an instant, the whole Ginza district suddenly became eerily haunted, with a horde of ghosts surging wildly from the scroll.
...
Once Su Lun chose to act, he would not give his opponent any chance to react.
Just as he confirmed that Ote Himeya was trapped, he raised his hand, and "Xiupunos's Scythe of the Night" was in his grasp.
```
"Swoosh," "swoosh," two consecutive slashes headed straight for the door.
At the same time, a light grunt came from the courtyard, clearly having been hit by the spatial rifts.
Not dead?
That didn't surprise Su Lun.
Given Pandora's design strength, her body material should be the best available in this plane. Under normal circumstances, she could probably resist the skills of seventh or eighth tier professionals with ease, not to mention some other tactics. Even with the black scythe in hand, a regular ranged slash wouldn't do the job for Su Lun. But channeling too much of the death rule would backfire, causing his own body to suffer from recoil. A reanimated corpse would fare even worse.
Moreover, Su Lun's purpose in coming here wasn't to kill her.
After those two slashes, he clapped his sorcerer's seals together again, and suddenly his skin shimmered with a dark golden metallic luster, runes slightly visible, "Hormonal Outburst·Quadruple Dissolution!"
With a "pop," he charged out.
"The scent of blood?"
Su Lun didn't dare to open his eyes, but he clearly smelled it and knew that Ote Himeya had been injured.
The black scythe could hurt her—this was a good sign.
And now, tackling her head on, he knew the moment to decide the battle had arrived!
...
Ote Himeya was caught off guard by Su Lun's decisiveness.
She hadn't expected to be trapped here, let alone injured, without even seeing her assailant.
This was the first time she'd been wounded since she had memory!
This caused her to feel fear.
Ote Himeya looked at her opponent's tactics—how could she not know that he might possess a lot of information about her?
But... how was it revealed?
Even the previous assassin, Shinfuku Mitsuko, only knew about her indestructible body, so why did this attacker manage to seal off her connection with the Power of Faith...
Could he have guessed something?
She had no time to think further as danger struck again!
The wounds on her abdomen and arms were healing at an astonishing rate, almost completely healed in the blink of an eye.
But the "attacker" inside the room was even faster.
Almost the next second after those two slashes hit her, a "pop" resonated through the air, and that face had already appeared a few meters in front of her.
And he still had his eyes closed!
Seeing this, Ote Himeya felt panic for the first time, as if she had been thoroughly seen through.
That means he knows I have the Yata Mirror?
Damn it, how was it exposed!
Ote Himeya felt a surge of killing intent. No matter who he was, since he knew her secret, he must be killed.
Her greatest skill wasn't just her physical strength and the Yata Mirror, but her Art of Enchantment!
She was Pandora, possessed of a legendary beauty that could even captivate deities, the ultimate allure of this world.
No one could resist such charm.
Even if he had his eyes closed!
...
Because Su Lun had the upper hand with his surprise attack, he seemed to have gained a huge advantage at every step.
But he didn't let his guard down for a second, because he knew very clearly that Pandora's trump card had yet to be played, and only if he could withstand this challenge would his "life gamble" truly see a chance of victory.
Just as he was dashing out, suddenly, a ridiculously terrifying wave of spiritual power came crashing towards him!
Even with his eyes closed, he saw a "pink world"...
The [Plague Doctor's Beak Mask] filtered out any possibility of breath-related poisons, but he still smelled a captivating "fragrance" akin to that of a young girl...
The seductive sounds that reached his ears threatened to lure him into oblivion...
Su Lun immediately realized this was Pandora's unique psychic charm.
This strange spiritual technique was so incomprehensible that he couldn't make heads or tails of it even with his current mastery.
"Here it comes!"
Su Lun had anticipated this.
But to his surprise, the next instant he found the mental shock completely bypassing his spiritual power!
It was as if...
A finely meshed net had almost captured all the fish in the lake, yet missed the water itself!
"As expected! The Puppet Master's lineage [Starry Sky Contemplation Secret Technique], with its linear spiritual power, is the key to counter Pandora!"
Su Lun was overjoyed, his guess was correct!
He had speculated on many possibilities, thinking that the most important legacy of the Puppeteer lineage besides rune puppets was that unique form of spiritual power technique.
If his teacher left a countermeasure within Pandora, it would likely have something to do with spiritual power.
But until now, it was merely a guess, and Su Lun wasn't sure how to use it.
Now, forced into a head-on confrontation, he discovered that Pandora's mental tactics couldn't control him!
If one could perceive it, spiritual power has a shape. The spiritual power of ordinary people is a misty human shape, while those who practice psychic techniques have spiritual power in all sorts of forms to fulfill the needs of their techniques. Spiritual needles, spiritual knives, spiritual hammers...
Su Lun's, however, was so fine it was almost imperceptible, the signature secret technique of the Puppeteers, perhaps unique throughout the entire plane!
It was precisely this linear shape that perfectly evaded Pandora's psychic net.
Rendering him immune to the enchanting technique that topples mortals!
```
....
Ote Himeya used her unique charm techniques.
Normally, no one would be immune to her control.
Just like countless times before, daimyos and generals lured by her beauty, and even the current "Moon Emperor" Takeda Nobuyasu, would be lost in their spiritual world with just a glance. No one had truly touched her, nor could anyone defy her commands.
This was also the most important means by which she had managed to keep her disguise a secret all these years.
But... the anticipated scene did not occur.
A fist as big as a casserole dish, with no regard for beauty, smashed into her eye.
There was a "boom".
Even though Ote Himeya felt that the punch hadn't harmed her in the slightest, the sheer force sent her flying backward.
"How is this possible?! How could he be uncontrollable?"
Ote Himeya had never expected such a turn of events.
How could there be someone in this world who could resist her beauty?
But before she could ponder any further, Su Lun charged at her again.
Ote Himeya's combat skills might not match up to Senjo, but they were certainly not weak.
The two were locked in close combat.
Blow for blow, fist to flesh, the sounds of their skirmish echoed with "bangs" and "booms".
But because of her indestructible body, Ote Himeya was not at a disadvantage, no matter how hard she was hit.
Su Lun knew very well he couldn't get the better of her like this!
The black scythe was sharp, but the opponent wouldn't just stand there and let themselves be cut down.
Moreover, this was Edo Castle; the longer the battle dragged out, the less favorable it was for Su Lun.
Though Abe Yasukazu was out there holding the fort, if Su Lun were to be surrounded by a large force, even if he completed his objective, he would be trapped!
He could not delay any longer.
Su Lun's gaze turned fierce, and a sinister expression suddenly crossed his face.
Now that he couldn't get the better of Ote Himeya, and she couldn't get the better of him either.
In the midst of the fight, Su Lun formed the sorcerer's seals with both hands and let out a bestial growl from his throat: "Hormone Rampage - Fifth Unleashing!"
This technique was still theoretical, never before tested in actual combat.
With this action, he was effectively "betting his life".
Yet Su Lun did not hesitate in the slightest.
If you want to tie up a ferocious beast, first you have to subdue it!
The moment the technique succeeded, a surge of hormones flooded his limbs and organs, inflating Su Lun's body like a balloon. The accumulation of strength produced an immense amount of heat, which made his entire skin appear as though it had been scorched red, presenting a steamy, unhealthy pink color.
An unprecedented sense of explosive power surged through him.
Su Lun felt fantastic!
He was also fortunate to have inherited Abe Yasukazu's "Dunjia Secret Technique," otherwise this trial by fire would be enough to end his life due to the high temperature.
But Su Lun was also acutely aware that this state wouldn't last long, and without any hesitation, he stomped on the ground. With a "snap," he surged forward.
His speed had increased tremendously, and with this advance, Ote Himeya had no time to react before he was already in her face!
Su Lun landed a heavy punch, striking her hard in the stomach.
Immediately afterward, the "most beautiful beauty under the heavens" was sent tumbling away in a sorry state, smashing through a wall of the small courtyard like a cannonball.
But as she rolled on the ground, she suddenly saw a figure who had already teleported to her landing spot, moving at an unbelievably fast speed.
Those iron-tongs-like hands instantly grasped her neck, and another punch hammered down on Ote Himeya's head.
There was a "dong" sound, like the muffled toll of a bell.
While Ote Himeya did not feel any fatal damage, she felt an overwhelming humiliation.
Hitting my face?
No man had ever dared to do this to her before!
She wanted to struggle, but found that the iron-tongs-like hands possessed a terrifying strength, almost as if they were indifferent to the prospect of crushing her slender, jade-like neck.
This guy was simply a madman!
Su Lun's eyes were closed, yet blood had already spilled from the corners of his eyes.
He bellowed, "Speak! Where is that cursed novel?"
Before his words fell, the blade of a black scythe had already touched Ote Himeya's neck.
The cold metallic sensation made her heart skip a beat in fear.
....
The man standing before her, bleeding from every orifice, was like a demon, utterly ferocious.
Ote Himeya was truly scared.
Having spent so many years in the geisha house, her skills in reading people were highly refined. How could she not hear the resolve of joint destruction in his voice?
She was very clear that if she dared utter half a "no," this man who had gone berserk would not hesitate to sacrifice his own life to kill her on the spot!
Yes!
He had completely lost his mind!
From him rose a will to destroy the world, intense and mad.
It was this suicidal momentum that frightened Ote Himeya into loose her tongue, "It's in... in the hidden compartment in the room."

chapters.title: Chapter 349 - 348 【Death Novel】
chapters.content:
Was that novel in a hidden compartment of the room?
Cursed items of a binding class definitely couldn't be stored in ordinary storage spaces, and this statement wasn't wrong.
But Su Lun didn't think Ote Himeya would hand over the item that easily. He had initially wanted to ask a few more questions, but before he could speak, he suddenly felt a fiery burn surge up his throat.
With a "puff" sound, a scalding stream of blood sprayed out.
The temperature of the blood was extremely high, and when it landed on the tiles of the courtyard, it hissed out a stream of blue smoke.
"My body has reached its limit..."
Su Lun was very aware that his body couldn't withstand the "Hormonal Rampage" of the fifth stage, and struggling to hold on for even a dozen breaths was already pushing it to the limit.
Taking advantage of the fact that he still had control over Ote Himeya, he forcefully suppressed the rolling surges of blood and the debilitating pain flooding through his muscles. With the spider arms on his back extending as flexibly as real arms, he stripped Ote Himeya of all her clothing and accessories in an instant.
This woman's methods were too bizarre; Su Lun didn't dare take her lightly.
As he removed her clothes, he also used a few of the rare "Fifth Order Toughness Rune Threads" to tie the woman up like a mummy, tightly and securely.
Su Lun didn't harbor any sentiments of pity or leniency. At some joints, he even used special binding techniques to ensure she absolutely couldn't struggle free. He then took out the "Magic-Sealing Amulets" that Abe Yasukazu had specifically prepared for her and struck her with several yin-yang white talismans, completely severing any connection she might have had with the divine power.
...
Ote Himeya hadn't even registered what was happening before she was stripped and tied up, completely unable to move. She let out an indignant and embarrassed cry, "What are you doing!"
Su Lun paid no attention to her reproach and had no intent to press her with any question.
After completing all this, he finally took a deep breath as if relieved of a heavy burden, releasing the state of Hormonal Rampage.
"Huff," "Huff," "Huff,"...
Su Lun breathed rapidly, the cold air filling his lungs and slightly easing the burning sensation.
It was as if a pressure cooker had suddenly released its pressure, saving his body from the brink of exploding. Any longer and it would likely have ended with his body exploding.
Su Lun didn't dare delay. After catching his breath and being able to move normally again, he poised the black scythe at Ote Himeya's neck and said in a grave voice, "If I can't find the item, or if I trigger any seals, your head will immediately hit the ground."
"..."
A shock went through Ote Himeya's heart.
She could tell that this man was indeed here to stake his life against hers.
Whether it was daring to make a move inside Edo Castle or using that secret technique just now, it all screamed a desperado's tactics.
If he said he could do it, he definitely could!
Ote Himeya watched as Su Lun controlled the threads towards a hidden compartment inside the room, knowing full well that even if there were traps, they wouldn't necessarily be 100% effective against this cautious intruder.
If any seals were triggered, it would certainly be her head rolling first.
She hurriedly said, "Don't open it, first turn the candleholder on the left stone pillar clockwise!"
Having awakened from a slumber of nearly a thousand years, she had finally regained consciousness, and she had no intention of being killed now.
Moreover... not having fallen for her allure, she vaguely had a guess about the identity of her attacker.
"Heh."
A cold laugh echoed inside Su Lun's heart.
He had long concluded that this woman, having laid out her plans in the hidden depths for so long, must have a grand scheme and definitely wouldn't gamble her life against a "barefoot" desperado like him.
Hearing this, he then manipulated the threads to twist the candleholder, finally opening that hidden compartment.
"Click..."
A sound of a mechanism echoed softly.
The floor of the room slowly opened, revealing a hidden compartment underground.
Su Lun still dared not open his eyes, but instead used the threads to feel around.
Inside, there seemed to be a box with magical fluctuations.
"How do I open the box?"
"There's an alchemy key on the side. Turn the first ring to the left three times, the second ring to the right twice, the third ring..."
"..."
Su Lun carefully opened the box with the threads.
There weren't many items inside, and he immediately "felt" a mirror-shaped object.
"Could it really be one of the three Divine Artifacts of the Mountain Hermit, the 'Yata Mirror'?"
Su Lun thought to himself, taking out the mirror without looking at it directly, and immediately plastered it with talismans, then securely sealed it into a storage scroll.
Being alone, he wouldn't let his curiosity grant his enemies any chance to overturn the situation.
The suspended Ote Himeya, hearing these minute noises, finally let go of her last trace of luck. The assailant's caution was impeccable.
Su Lun ignored the mirror; the threads continued to search, skipping over several miscellaneous items, and sure enough, found a "book-shaped object" at the bottom of the box.
"Found it!"
Su Lun was overjoyed inside; he was all too familiar with the chilling aura emanating from that book.
"Isn't this the aura of the Netherworld?"
However, out of caution, he still hadn't opened his eyes.
Moreover, time didn't allow him to scrutinize.
Because at that moment, the noise from the battle outside the "Cocoon World" was growing more exaggerated, sounding like thousands of troops were in combat.
The shared vision through the black crow showed exactly that.
The commotion here was significant, and the Black Dragon Society and the city's guards hadn't broken through yet, all thanks to Abe Yasukazu fiercely blocking them outside.
That guy said he could hold them off for a quarter of an hour, and he was likely to risk his life to make sure of it.
Don't be fooled by his usual flamboyant demeanor; he was actually quite decent to hang around with.
When it really came down to it, though he complained a lot, he truly dared to step up.
A thought flashed through his mind, and Su Lun shoved everything from the novels and the box into the sealing scroll.
After thinking it through, he didn't just leave,
He found the items, but he naturally had to take the "Puppeteer-created alchemical being" Ote Himeya with him.
Not to mention she was considered a treasure among Puppeteers, there were also the secrets she knew...
Furthermore, Su Lun was worried that the "Novel of Death" might have some restrictions attached.
But simply taking them away was definitely not going to work.
Thinking of this, he pinched his sorcerer's seals with both hands, lifting his left hand forward, a black vortex appeared in the center of his palm, gradually increasing suction power – he was employing the ability "Void Whale Swallow".
This technique was rather underwhelming in combat, but it was perfect for storing things.
Without needing too much suction power, as soon as the large space rift opened, Su Lun threw both Ote Himeya and the items he had just obtained into it.
This action was also to guard against any tracking or location devices on the woman or those items.
And, it could prevent Divination!
Though Divination was rare in Old Lington, it was quite prevalent in the outside world. And even more so within the Shinto belief system. There were many witches and miko proficient in this Shinto divination in the Mountain Hermit country, and Abe Yasukazu was adept as well...
Those bizarre practices were even more peculiar than the divinations in Alchemy.
Especially since Ote Himeya was involved with the "God Tsukuyomi".
Previously, Su Lun didn't have a solid method to deal with this situation, and he didn't possess any artifacts that could surely avoid divination. But after merging with the fourth-tier growth gear "Endless Stomach of the Traveling Whale", the "Minor Void Realm" he acquired now served a great purpose.
Divination location wasn't without cost; the further the distance, the greater the cost.
This Minor Void Realm wasn't just a storage space, but a "Minor Plane".
Not even being in the same plane, how could one perform divination?
If someone really forced a divination, the backlash from the divination might cause the majority of diviners to die on the spot.
...
Once the technique was und
one, the black hole in Su Lun's palm immediately disappeared.
Finally, everything was proceeding perfectly according to plan, a look of joy on his face, but he couldn't help spitting out another mouthful of blood.
He quickly administered two high-level healing agents to himself, then tossed a couple of incendiary grenades around the small courtyard to erase traces of the battle.
The black crow continued sharing its vision, he sensed the soul fluctuations in the Ginza district and easily avoided the center of the crowded combat.
With a slap of the Space Wizard seal, Su Lun teleported, appearing inside a house.
Another spatial displacement, and he had already left the Ginza district.
Explosions were erupting throughout the city, with a large number of warriors congregating on the streets, and there seemed to be combat activities at the foot of Sunlit Divine Mountain as well.
Su Lun didn't dare stop, stealthily sprinting all the way and directly found a part of the city wall unguarded by sentinels, jumping over it.
Then, he tore up the shiki-gami paper doll that Abe Yasukazu had given him and sprinted madly towards the wild countryside.
...
On the other hand.
In the core battlefield of Ginza, the battle was still evolving into increasingly intense noises.
At this very moment, the pressure Abe Yasukazu was facing was so immense it made his scalp numb. The masters of the Black Dragon Society, the ninja clans, the Shinto experts... He had to use all his trump methods just to protect himself.
But because he was tasked with keeping people from breaking into "Isshi-Space Geisha House", he had to engage in defensive warfare, which was really costing him.
However, since the lady he was supposed to protect deemed it necessary, Abe Yasukazu was naturally willing to lay down his life to see it through.
It probably wouldn't be long before Takeda's main forces closed in.
He thought it likely that this time he would end up giving his life for that reckless guy.
However, just then,
He felt the shiki-gami paper doll being torn apart!
Abe Yasukazu's heart suddenly jumped, "Has he already taken care of it?"
Did that guy really settle things with Ote Himeya?
In such a short amount of time, how did he manage it?
Abe Yasukazu screamed in disbelief and, at the same time, was greatly surprised.
Looking again, the guy didn't even withstand firmly, he turned into a ghostly shadow and hightailed it out of there.
.....
Su Lun sprinted southward all the way, planning to get as far away from Edo Castle as possible.
Since it was night, there was absolutely no one traveling on the official road. He didn't need to worry about being discovered, so he directly pulled out his prepared steam-powered motorcycle and rode at full speed.
After approximately several hundred kilometers at night, Su Lun didn't find any signs of being pursued, so he finally stopped at a deserted mountain.
He then used a spider spear to travel about ten more miles through the mountain's forests, carefully erasing tracks, smells, and all other possible traces that could be followed.
Before long, when the night was deep.
Su Lun finally hid in a cave where a grizzly bear resided.
After setting up a barrier and dealing with some inevitable injuries, he collapsed onto a stone stool and lay there, unable to get up for a full quarter of an hour.
From the initial battle up to just now, his nerves had been highly strained.
Now, he could finally breathe a sigh of relief.
Without checking, Su Lun knew his current condition was terribly bad.
Forcefully using the "Tier Five" state of hormonal frenzy left his body like a dam bursting, cracks everywhere.
If it wasn't for the "X-serum" enhanced self-healing ability and relentless treatment by the [Healing Doll] regardless of cost, he would have died on the run long ago.
However... he'd just realized that the physical body, once mutated and strengthened by demonic energy, actually improved its endurance.
Lying and resting for a moment, Su Lun let out a long breath of foul air, barely managing to sit up.
He once again condensed sorcerer's seals, opening the "Minor Void Realm."
Ote Himeya, wrapped up like a cocoon, couldn't move at all, just hanging there.
Su Lun wasn't worried about her dying; a life force of an alchemical artificial person is beyond normal human imagination. Apart from chopping her into pieces with the Black Scythe, not even Su Lun himself could think of any way to kill her.
For now, Su Lun hadn't figured out what to do with this "most beautiful princess in the world", so he could only leave her hanging there.
The priority was to revive Chiyo and the Princess. He took out that novel.
As soon as the object appeared, a chilling cold air instantly swept through the entire cave.
Su Lun cautiously opened his left eye and took a look.
[Deadly Novel: Netherworld]
Quality: Epic
Description: Can you believe that someone used a mortal's quill to depict gods?
Curse Trait: Using this object can seal targets within the range whose understanding of laws is not higher than this object itself into the novel's world, never able to escape; this object must be activated by the Power of Faith, and its range of effect is determined by the Power of Faith; users below the prerequisite condition will suffer soul damage, and if the gap between the sealer and the target is too wide, it will cause soul disintegration;
Details: Great literary master 'Carl Gustav Jung' turned his journey to the Netherworld into a novel which, in reality, also utilized the 'Divine Country Technique' to create an independent world; the first page of the novel states, "If the world is a prison, then love is the key to unlock the prison"; he used the unique romance of a novelist to recount that passionate love in his life, waiting for the girl he was meant to meet. Can be used as a professional advancement material, upon fusion obtains the 'World' ability, requires spiritual power to reach saint level, Death Law, Space Law, and the ability of Imaginal Reality to achieve SS-grade evaluation.
...
Su Lun, looking at this novel, did not see any traps left behind, which finally allowed him to heave a sigh of relief.
"Epic?"
His gaze slightly hardened as he looked at the rank, higher than his Black Scythe and as rare as [Isaac's Alchemy Heart].
This thing was pretty useful, able to directly seal targets into the novel.
It's just that ordinary people can't use it.
It requires Divine Power to operate, otherwise it will directly harm the soul.
"So, does this mean Ote Himeya used this novel with Divine Power? An alchemical artificial person, actually possessing the power of a deity?"
Su Lun speculated in his heart. The curse backlash from sucking nearly all foreigners from Edo Castle into it definitely wasn't something humans could endure; it was probably connected to that sudden appearance of the "Moon Reading God."
It could also serve as material for professional advancement...
Su Lun looked and there were still some things he couldn't understand yet.
And he was still far from meeting those fusion conditions; it would probably be possible to consider them after reaching the seventh tier.
He didn't linger on those pages, instead he randomly flipped one open.
The moment he flipped it, a passage he wanted to see automatically appeared: 'Princess Shinfuku Mitsuko decisively gave up her own life and turned into a shower of cherry blossoms scattering through the sky...'
Another passage read: 'Chiyo, without any fear, slashed at Izanami with one sword strike. The Rakshasa Golden Body condensed a kilometer-long Sword Qi that slashed down from the sky, as if splitting the entire Netherworld. This sword strike, which even gods and spirits feared... but unfortunately, Izanami's True Flames of the Fire God Kagutsuchi could burn all matter in the world, and even the Sword Qi was totally consumed. After a hard struggle, Chiyo finally exhausted her strength. As the sea of fire thundered down around her, she was buried in that sea of fire...'
Su Lun, looking at the two passages, felt his eyes moisten slightly.
These were the scenes just before Chiyo and the Princess died.
A sense of guilt, stemming from surviving only by bearing the lives of others, crept into his heart. Because the two women sacrificed their lives, he was able to live up to this moment.
Gathering his spirits, Su Lun took a deep breath and exhaled a murky one, "So it was, truly diminished..."
Life turned into a string of text,
This journey to the Netherworld was an experience that overturned what he knew of life.
Su Lun's expression was very complicated.
Knowing his condition wasn't good, he gathered his spirits while he still had the energy and began setting up a demonic contract formation.
....
A magician making deals with demons was originally deemed heretical.
But Su Lun, the transmigrator, held none of these rigid views.
He used mercury and high-tier magical beast blood to draw a complex eight-pointed star alchemy formation on the ground, arranging some sacrificial beast blood and energy crystal cores for the demon.
Then, he carefully tore out two pages from The Deathly Novel that described the moments before their deaths.
These pages were made from the legendary material "Golden Sheep Parchment," collected with difficulty by Fujiwara Hayato, sourced from divine sheep bred by the gods capable of growing golden wool. This small book, found in an ancient ruin by the great adventurer, had turned into a novel; otherwise, even the Royal Library of Rule, famed to be the world's greatest, couldn't have gathered enough for such a thick volume.
Tearing out the two pages also degraded the quality of this forbidden item somewhat.
Yet Su Lun showed no regret for damaging this treasure.
He placed the two pages at the center of the formation, beginning the special incantation: "From the unknown abyss, the highest of gods, the monarch who controls death, the great dark lord of the lands, I call upon your revered name... please hear my prayer, I am willing to offer my soul to fulfill my wish..."
As the spell was spoken, the energy crystals in the formation began to glow.
Just as Fujiwara Hayato had said, he received a response from that indescribable being.
This was the first time Su Lun used an alchemy formation to communicate with a high deity from another plane, and he found it marvelous, yet instinctively felt a fear from the unknown. It felt as if he was being glanced at casually by an indescribable giant, feeling as though his future and past were thoroughly exposed.
In that moment of communication, he felt as if a "debt" marker had been placed on his soul, which he would ultimately have to repay one day.
It was probably like granting an ant a grain of rice; nothing out of the ordinary happened.
Even then, Su Lun wasn't actually qualified to exchange any words with that entity.
This made him realize for the first time how insignificant and trivial his life was.
However.
Having chosen to use this sacrificial secret technique, Su Lun was already prepared to pay the price.
....
Before long, the black light in the formation grew stronger, and those two parchment pages disintegrated into powder within the dark glow.
Su Lun saw two semi-transparent spiritual bodies appear in the glow of the formation.
Looking at those features, weren't they Princess and Chitose?
Regaining the most important friends in his life, he felt indescribable joy.
The hopeful gleam in his eyes grew more intense.
At that moment, with a significant consumption of energy, the two figures slowly condensed into solid forms.
Finally, Su Lun felt that they "lived"!
Princess and Chitose retained the memories from their time of death, then they were engulfed in darkness, as if trapped in a long nightmare.
But upon awakening, they found Su Lun standing in front of them?
Tears shimmered in Su Lun's eyes as he called out to them, "Sister Chitose, Princess."
Chitose seemed to understand what had happened, her eyebrows furrowing, "Su Lun, did you die too?"
Hearing this, the originally somber atmosphere suddenly lightened considerably.
Su Lun couldn't help but chuckle.
He walked up and gave Chitose a warm and firm hug.
Feeling the warmth of a living person, Chitose finally realized, "I'm not dead?"
Princess, well-versed in divine rites, seemed to guess something, her face showing disbelief.
Su Lun, seeing her standing alone and looking a bit lost,
thought about it and extended a hand, opening his arms to Princess.
Seeing Su Lun's gesture, Princess hesitated but also stretched out her arms, returning his embrace.
The three of them hugged tightly.
"Hey, hey, hey... what's going on here? Is this the Netherworld? Weren't we dead?"
As she was embraced, Chitose murmured a complaint.
It was then she noticed the alchemy formation on the ground, her expression mixing disbelief and awe, asking, "You resurrected us?"
"..."
With a pale smile on his face, Su Lun was about to say something when everything went black, and he fainted.

chapters.title: Chapter 350 - 349: Ask the Princess to Help You
chapters.content:
"Sister Qian Tiao, ah... this... Mr. Su Lun's body, it won't have any problems, right?"
"This kid probably hasn't touched a woman in a long time, a normal reaction. Hehe, even unconscious he can't behave. Now it's up to you, Princess."
"Ah? Up to me? I... I don't know how to…"
"If you don't know, then forget it, just leave him dirty. Anyway, this guy is tough-skinned, being a bit dirty won't hurt him."
"But Mr. Su Lun's injuries are very serious, they must be dealt with immediately..."
"Well, then there's no helping it, I'm not good at treating injuries, at most I can administer a potion."
"Then... then... I will try."
"..."
In a daze, Su Lun seemed to hear Qian Tiao and the Princess talking, and then a pair of soft hands were cleaning his body and tending to his wounds.
The movements were meticulous but slightly awkward and clumsy, it seemed she had never done this sort of serving before.
Su Lun wanted to open his eyes to see, but he was in terrible shape.
After successfully reviving Qian Tiao and the Princess, the strong belief that had been sustaining him relaxed, and he didn't have a single thought left, only wanting to sleep comfortably.
And he fell asleep.
This sleep was very long, and his dreams were filled with all kinds of monsters.
Having been infected with too much netherworldly energy, the dreams he had were all nightmares.
Su Lun could distinguish between dreams and reality, but even so, he didn't want to wake up.
His body was too weary, and it needed rest too badly.
...
He did not know how much time had passed.
Su Lun felt his brain was finally willing to reconnect with the body that would flood him with intense signals of pain, numbness, ache, itchiness... all sorts of negative sensations as soon as the connection was made.
Though he still felt like after a heavy workout with delayed onset muscle soreness, it was much better now.
He moved his fingers and immediately heard an excited chirp by his ear.
"Sister Qian Tiao, Mr. Su Lun seems to have woken up!"
"Hmm."
Then, he heard the sound of two women letting out a sigh of relief in unison.
Su Lun slowly opened his eyes.
He saw two faces very close, blinking... in Qian Tiao's eyes was a look of relief, while the Princess's eyes seemed to twinkle with stars of anticipation.
Seeing the somewhat exotic temperament between his brows, Qian Tiao inquired with concern, "Su Lun?"
Being awake didn't mean there were no other issues.
Su Lun's gaze focused as he looked around, it was no longer the cave of the bear he remembered, but it seemed he was still outdoors.
After pondering for a moment, it was as if he re-claimed the ability to speak and asked, "Where is this?"
Qian Tiao replied, "It's Tea Crying Mountain in Izumo, the cliff hot spring we found last time."
Qian Tiao and the Princess weren't foolish, seeing that Su Lun was reviving them in a wild mountain cave, they realized the situation was complicated. The "Death Novel" space of curse was controlled by the Takeda Shogunate; seeing Su Lun's condition they guessed that acquiring the novel must have involved a dangerous and arduous battle.
Now, with the Mountain Hermit's situation unclear and without understanding what had happened, any possible exposure of their whereabouts could be a fatal threat.
So, they decided not to rashly contact anyone before Su Lun woke up.
They could only get as far away from Edo Castle as possible, changing locations several times, and just so happened to arrive at Tea Crying Mountain they had passed before.
In order not to attract attention, they even avoided visiting Granny's Soup House and instead pitched a tent directly on the cliff.
It was only then that Su Lun came to realize.
The view here was very open, as if it was halfway up the mountain.
He then asked, "How long have I been unconscious?"
Qian Tiao answered, "Two days."
"Oh."
Hearing this, Su Lun's mind gradually recalled the events of the past few days.
Seeing his slightly bewildered state, the Princess beside him also asked with concern, "Mr. Su Lun, how do you feel now? Your body showed signs of 'turning into a ghost,' and the injuries were very serious..."
"I'm fine now. No immediate danger to my life."
Su Lun responded.
He sensed his body, the injuries were mostly healed. However, the degree of "anomaly" had deepened on his status panel.
Hearing this, Qian Tiao interjected, "In the past two days, you've had a high fever and sweated profusely, and it was the Princess who took care of you, changing your clothes and wiping your body."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun looked at the Princess whose expression was a bit reserved and said gratefully, "Thank you, Princess."
Having such a pampered royal serving him, just the attitude and intention alone was quite astonishing.
The Princess seemed to think of something, unable to meet his gaze, "Compared to what Mr. Su Lun has done, what I did was just a trivial matter."
She was well aware that acquiring the novel as well as the revival of the deceased must not have been easy, and that Su Lun must have paid a high price.
...
Su Lun struggled to squeeze a smile out of his stiff facial muscles, just as he tried to sit up, he realized his body was too stiff to manage it.
The state of "Hormonal Rampage" had put a great strain on his body, and even now, his muscles had not recovered.
Seeing this, the Princess quickly stepped forward to help him up.
Chitajo knew that Su Lun's body had been polluted by absorbing an excessive amount of ghost energy in the Netherworld.
A deep concern surfaced on her face as she furrowed her brows and said, "I found that your body seems to be 'mutated,' and the situation looks rather bleak. The Princess can do nothing but use a secret technique to temporarily suppress the spread of the ghost energy..."
As she spoke, she gave Su Lun a glance and said seriously, "We must think of a solution as soon as possible."
Physical mutation was no small matter. Based on the Princess's examination, Su Lun could become a "ghost" at any moment, which posed a life-threatening risk.
Su Lun, knowing she cared about his condition, nodded and said directly, "I know someone who should be able to handle the mutation issue. As long as I can hold out until we reach Hastelin in Pirate City, the problem with my body should be resolved."
Everyone who came out of Old Lington was aware of the horror of mutation, and fearing that he was just toughing it out, Chitajo pressed further, "Is there anyone else who can resolve the mutation?"
"Yes."
Looking at her, Su Lun gave a slight smile and truthfully said, "I encountered Dr. Banks, the lead scientist of 'Project X' before. Oh, he's little Danny's father."
"Didn't the Banks couple die in a laboratory accident?"
Chitajo's face lit up with joy.
If it was that person, there was indeed a possibility!
"No. He was lucky enough to survive that laboratory accident. He's now hiding in the Northern Fleet."
Su Lun knew he couldn't explain everything in a few words, so he didn't elaborate further, and added, "That's why I need to leave Mountain Hermit as soon as possible and find Dr. Banks."
"Right!"
Chitajo also felt this was an urgent matter and said solemnly, "This is Izumo, the last major city from Mountain Hermit to the sea. If there's a ship setting sail, we'll find out right away here. However, due to Mountain Hermit's situation, the number of ships leaving has decreased greatly. We may have to wait a day or two."
They had chosen to head south previously considering the possibility of an escape by sea in case they were pursued.
After thinking it over, Su Lun said, "A delay of a few days should still be okay."
The current situation in Mountain Hermit was complicated; having a ship available for the sea was already fortunate.
The Princess, of course, could not show herself, even if her Shinfuku family still had some hidden methods at their disposal.
If all else failed, they could still contact Abe Yasukazu and use the Kasios family's channels to set sail.
The problem didn't seem too large.
After expressing concern for Su Lun's physical condition and finding hope for a solution, the heavy concern in Chitajo's brows finally eased completely.
She then asked, "By the way, what exactly happened before? Didn't we die in the Netherworld? How did we come back to life?"
The curious Princess, with large eyes, also looked over.
Hearing their inquiries, Su Lun took a deep breath and said, "This starts with the novel written by Fujiwara Hayato..."
...
"Princess, you were at Cangshan Shrine... and Chitajo, you delivered that final blow..."
Before long, Su Lun recounted the whole experience of seeing through the curse space, and the subsequent fight with Ote Himeya after emerging.
Chitajo and the Princess were stunned by Su Lun's near-death experience.
Only then did they learn that so much had happened afterward.
However, when it came to the price Su Lun paid for their revival, he glossed over it, "Later, in that cave, I just brought you back to life..."
Although he didn't spell it out, it didn't mean the two women couldn't guess.
Battles and the like were secondary. Since they had come back to life, the outcome was already more than satisfactory.
Chitajo directly asked, "What method did you use to revive us?"
Su Lun looked at her and responded indifferently, "I offered my soul to a demon."
Chitajo's expression darkened upon hearing this.
The Princess became very serious as well.
Su Lun fully understood the guilt of living by burdening someone else's life, and he didn't want the two women to feel the same way, so he said with a relaxed demeanor, "It's no big deal. Based on some information provided by Fujiwara Hayato, I speculate that the 'demon' of the contract holder is likely existing in a special higher plane. He won't demand I fulfill the contract until I'm powerless. Once I have the power, I will inevitably want to explore the divine planes anyway. Considering that I can see you both again, it's not too terrible a price to pay."
Chitajo stayed silent.
The Princess did as well.
The three had entrusted their lives to one another, so naturally, they could understand this kind of sacrifice.
But the deed was done, and there was no use in discussing it further.
Seeing the atmosphere turning somewhat somber, Su Lun shifted away from the topic and said, "By the way, when I captured Ote Himeya, I also found a mirror. It might be one of the three Holy Artifacts of Mountain Hermit, the 'Yata Mirror.' Princess, would you like to have a look?"
Upon hearing this, the Princess's expression changed with surprise, "The Yata Mirror?"
The three Holy Artifacts had long disappeared into the annals of history, with the legendary Illusion Technique treasure last appearing eight hundred years ago.
She had not expected it to reappear in the world.
Her bright eyes moved, and she then said, "If it really is the 'Yata Mirror,' it would explain why Ote Himeya could affect the entirety of Edo during the Black Sun. The legend says that if the mirror is powered by strong enough Divine Power, it could even plunge all the humans in the world into an illusion."
That powerful?
It was naturally something she wanted to see for herself.
Hearing this, Su Lun also felt fortunate that he had not hesitated during the battle and had not given Ote Himeya a chance to use the mirror.
He cautioned, "I heard that even a single glance at the mirror can trap you in an illusion. Can I take it out now?"
The Princess nodded and said, "It's just perfect that our Iga Shrine has secretly passed down the techniques to use the Three Divine Artifacts. And my divine power of Amaterasu can restrain some of the infinite Illusion Techniques of the Yata Mirror."
"Oh."
Previously, Su Lun alone, he did not dare to take this thing out, lest if he fell into an illusion, there would be no one else to help him out of it.
Now that he had the Princess, an expert, by his side, Su Lun no longer had any reservations. He and Chitose both closed their eyes before he took out the tightly sealed mirror.
The Princess took it over and immediately recognized it, barely concealing her shock: "It really is the Yata Mirror!"
Really?
Su Lun didn't know what was happening; he just felt a surge of divine power emanating from the Princess, as hot as the sun's flames.
He did not open his eyes out of curiosity but asked, "How is it?"
The Princess sounded clearly excited, "I can control it temporarily. Mr. Su Lun, Sister Chitose, you can open your eyes now."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun breathed a sigh of relief and opened his eyes to see that the Princess had completely sealed the mirror with her own talisman papers.
This was the first time Su Lun had actually seen what it looked like since acquiring the object.
It was a bronze mirror about the size of a face, with very simple engravings, and one could immediately sense the endless years it had witnessed. Because it was sealed with talisman papers, it looked quite ordinary.
Su Lun took a look and agreed it was as the legends described, capable of making someone lose themselves in an illusory world forever.
But this was also similar to the Holy Artifact of the Dalu tribe; only a specific divine power could use it. To anyone else, it was just a peculiar mirror that could trap people indefinitely.
He became even more curious: how could Ote Himeya, this artificially created being, use it?
Su Lun noticed the hardly concealed joy in the Princess's eyes.
It had always been the divine mandate of the Shinfuku family to recover the lost Three Divine Artifacts.
He directly said, "You might as well keep the mirror, Princess. It is an Artifact of Mountain Hermit, and others can't use it anyway."
Since the Princess was capable of using it, that was for the best, and it could also give her more ability to protect herself.
The Princess was slightly surprised and flattered, and after thinking about what polite words to say, she softly uttered two words: "Thank you."
The experiences in the Netherworld had eliminated any awkwardness between them.
They were both people who could trust each other with their lives.
With Shinfuku Mitsuko present, they could have brought "Ote Himeya" out from the space to interrogate her and learn the truth about everything.
But after discussing it, they decided not to dare to do so.
Now knowing that Ote Himeya could also use the Yata Mirror, the sudden appearance of the "Lunar Reading Deity" was definitely related to her!
If they were to release her, it could lead to some unpredictable consequences.
Su Lun planned to wait until they had left Mountain Hermit before figuring out what to do.
With the behind-the-scenes manipulator taken away, the situation in Mountain Hermit should improve a lot.
...
Although their recent experience in the Netherworld could be described as a close brush with death, in the end, they all survived.
That was the most ideal outcome.
The three of them chatted and laughed, talking about many things.
Suddenly, Su Lun's stomach growled, and he looked at the other two, a bit embarrassed: "I'm a little hungry."
Although he had injected nutrient fluids, his stomach's emptiness intensely signaled that he needed some steaming food to fill it.
But now he was half a cripple, with no ability to take care of himself.
The Princess at his side, hearing this, took the initiative to say, "I'll get us something to eat."
With that, she skillfully took out some instant canned food, set up a stove, and soon the aroma of meat and alcohol began to fill the air.
Before long, they had eaten their fill, and as the sky became dark, the three lay in the tent, gazing leisurely at the stars outside.
There was no pursuit here, and this was not the Netherworld...
Time seemed to slow down.
Chitose purposely chose to lie on the far left. In doing so, whether Su Lun or the Princess slept in the middle, they would end up next to each other.
Su Lun knew this was probably Chitose's little mischief. But since he was currently "half-disabled" and couldn't take care of himself, he didn't want to make a fuss and felt quite content to sleep in the middle. The Princess was on the left.
Thankfully, they had previously been in a similar situation in a dilapidated temple in the Netherworld, so the atmosphere felt fine.
As none of them felt sleepy, they started chatting.
The situation in Mountain Hermit had almost reached a conclusion, with the former "Sun Emperor" a thing of the past, and the Shinfuku family nearly wiped out.
With the command of the "Lunar Reading Deity," Takeda Nobuyasu had swiftly settled the chaos, and the current situation in Mountain Hermit was even more stable than before.
This left Shinfuku Mitsuko, a royal princess and Saio, in a very awkward position.
Since Su Lun's physical aberration required them to leave Mountain Hermit, the Princess's future became an issue.
As the night deepened, clouds drifted across the sky, concealing the moonlight, and the light suddenly dimmed.
In the tent, Chitose asked, "Princess, are you really not going to leave with us? The situation in Mountain Hermit is tough. If you stay, your position might be very bad."
In the darkness, the Princess's tone was firm as she replied, "Even though the royal family is no more, the Shinfuku family still needs me. Besides, as a miko of the Iga Shrine, I can't leave..."
"..."
Su Lun was listening quietly and also discerned the heavy responsibility carried by the Princess.
She represented not only herself, but also her status as a royal princess and the Shinto lineage of the sun goddess Amaterasu.
Some burdens can't simply be thrown away with a word.
With royal power being seen as divinely granted, even their Shinfuku family had no choice but to acknowledge the "Moon Emperor." Although it seemed like there might be something fishy about it, it was for this exact reason that the Princess, as the ninety-ninth Zaio, had to take on the great task of investigating the truth behind it all.
Fortunately, now that one of the three Divine Artifacts, the "Yata Mirror," has been found again, her ability to protect herself is nothing short of strong, so there's not much need to worry.
Chitose understood this too and didn't keep persuading her.
All she did was whisper softly, "Some people, once you miss out on them, you really have missed out."
As soon as these words were spoken, the tent fell into a brief silence.
The Princess was no longer the young maiden who would blush red at the slightest tease.
After pondering for a moment, she actually responded, albeit in a soft voice, "When my tenure is over... I might come to find you, and then... we can go on an adventure together. Chitose, and Mr. Su Lun, take care too."
"Sure!"
Hearing this, Chitose's smile brightened. Suddenly, she turned to the side, reaching over Su Lun to pat the Princess and added, "I told you a long time ago, after meeting this guy, the idea of serving the way of the gods for life... that wasn't going to happen anymore."
Upon hearing this, the Princess also remembered that she had once said something like that, and couldn't help but smile a little.
Now it seemed that she really was entertaining the thought of wavering.
She had intended to cover her own minor embarrassment with silence.
But perhaps she felt that after this parting, it would likely be a long time before they would see each other again.
Or perhaps,
Just like the story of Fujiwara Hayato and Miss Natasha in the books.
A parting in life could really mean never seeing each other again.
A wave of sadness suddenly rose in the Princess's heart, and she boldly responded, "It's certainly related to Mr. Su Lun. But most importantly, I want to go on an adventure with you and Chitose as well."
With that said, the darkness concealed the faint blush that appeared on the Princess's lovely face.
Su Lun didn't think there was anything amiss with the Princess's words.
But because Chitose was leaning over to the side, her whole body was almost pressing down on him. This pressure made Su Lun feel his arm sinking into extreme softness. Since the pajamas were thin, the feeling was very real, a bone-melting delicacy that was endlessly memorable.
Moreover, Chitose's movements were quite significant, the large patches of skin in contact, and even the subtle details of their soft bodies, were distinctly felt.
Normally such physical contact wouldn't disrupt Su Lun's control over his thoughts. It wouldn't be a problem.
But now his body had become deformed, and that "demonic energy" made some of his emotions completely uncontrollable.
Chitose listened to the Princess's reply and "giggled" with a laugh, not seeing through everything.
She was about to pull her hand back, but suddenly, as her hand brushed over Su Lun's body, she also sensed something unusual.
"Eh..."
With a light exclamation, she discerned the anomaly.
In the darkness, her eyes suddenly glowed.
Being straightforward and never mincing her words, she blurted out immediately: "Hey hey hey, Su Lun, can't you hold yourself together a bit? Isn't this embarrassing...?"
His awkward situation exposed, Su Lun felt a bit sheepish and could only admit truthfully, "I can't control it. My body has become distorted."
"..."
Hearing this, Chitose seemed to fall silent all at once, seemingly contemplating it.
The Princess didn't yet grasp what the other two were talking about; she was still immersed in the previous conversation.
Suddenly, Chitose spoke up again.
With a very understanding look, she grumbled, "You kid haven't touched a woman in a long time, have you? I can understand that, but..."
Chitose, who came from the gangsters, had seen all kinds of pleasure houses.
After a pause, she continued, "But don't let your mind wander. I'm not interested in men. If you really want to, go ask the Princess to help you."
Listening to this, Su Lun was quite helpless, answering stiffly, "Ah... Chitose, you really don't hold back with your words."
Could someone really say something so blunt?
Yet his body was honest, completely uncontrollable.
Chitose didn't mind in the slightest, her tone casual as she said, "Tssk—what's there to be embarrassed about? The Princess has been taking care of you these past few days, she's already seen all of your embarrassing moments."
"..."
At this, Su Lun's face was streaked with lines of embarrassment.
The Princess, on the other hand, had already blushed red with shame, and didn't dare to join in.
Help...?
The darkness concealed the pink blush that spread to her neck.
As if not caring at all, Chitose kept on chattering, "But speaking of which, Princess, your figure is really top-notch. Don't you think so, Su Lun? You saw during the Kagura dance. I've been telling you to give it a try..."
Su Lun: "..."
The Princess: "..."
The three had shared the same space many times before, but this was the first time the atmosphere in the tent felt a bit unusual.

chapters.title: Chapter 351 - 350: The Mysterious Incident at Sea
chapters.content:
Luck was on our side.
Early the next morning, as Su Lun looked down from the waist of Tea Crying Mountain, he saw a large ship departing from the port of Izumo.
The trio quickly packed up their sundries and leaped down from the cliff.
After a whole night of meditation, Su Lun could just about walk on his own. Senjo supported him down the mountain path, and with a rune umbrella used as a walking stick, he moved at a decent pace.
The port of Izumo was vast. Hidden in an inconspicuous corner of the street, the Princess watched the two about to depart, her eyes shimmering, "Goodbye, sister Senjo, Mr. Su Lun."
Senjo glanced at her, "Are you really not coming with us?"
The Princess gave a small smile.
She didn't speak.
She was afraid she might let out an involuntary "yes".
Seeing her like this, Su Lun smiled and opened his arms; the Princess didn't hesitate, and they embraced to say goodbye.
As Su Lun smelled her fresh and tranquil fragrance, he tenderly stroked her smooth hair and said, "Take care."
The Princess buried her head in his chest, not daring to look up, "Take care, Mr. Su Lun."
After saying their farewells, Su Lun and Senjo headed towards the ship.
The Princess watched their departing figures, her gaze lingering for a long time.
...
After the "Black Sun Grand Festival" event, Edo Castle had almost purged all the outsiders, and foreign trade had nearly come to a halt.
