He had already held the "Squadron Captain Thousand" in high regard, overestimating the "Dawn Squadron," but now he realized he had still underestimated them by far too much.
No wonder they dared to clash head-on, even though they clearly knew this was a vice captain of the Northern Seas Fleet.
It turns out they truly possessed the strength to clash!
...
With a single slash, Qian Tiao unleashed a thunderous Sword Qi, cutting through the air from dozens of meters away, and suddenly a figure hidden in the void was forced out in a sorry state.
Dorosel, the "Demon Hand," evaded the deadly Sword Qi, but no one dared to block it. It tore through the air, covering a hundred meters in the blink of an eye, and turned those squadron captains' half-destroyed warship into splinters.
Now, everyone was soaked in the sea.
Not everyone knew how to "Stepping on Air" or had gear to move in the sea...
With the warship destroyed, the combat power of these over a thousand people was instantly reduced by eighty percent.
Dorosel, the "Demon Hand," looked on with a gloom so dense it seemed about to drip water. Only then did he realize that the "Fifth Order" he had not taken seriously was actually a "Sword Saint" with such domineering mastery over the Sword Dao. But the deed was done, and there was no room for regret as he charged again.
Qian Tiao was not to be outdone and leaped from the assault boat.
"Pop," "pop," "pop,"... After a series of explosions, she fearlessly faced the pirate boss who was a whole major rank above her.
Since she knew about the guy's abilities in advance, Qian Tiao didn't foolishly clash head-on but slashed from a distance with several cuts of Sword Qi. Although a Sixth Order professional was strong, they had not yet formed their own domain and were quite wary of the Sword Qi.
But Dorosel had mastered Spatial Ability, with flexible Teleportation, so the Sword Qi could not achieve success in such a short time.
Seeing this, Captain Barrett would not just stand by and watch.
He exchanged a glance with Su Lun, asking if they should offer help.
Su Lun shook his head.
Seeing that, Barrett didn't hesitate any longer and charged fiercely into the fray.
Although he admitted that the several dozen mechanical octopuses were astonishingly impressive, he didn't believe that Su Lun could withstand those over a thousand pirates by himself. After all, many of those pirates were Fourth and Fifth Order professionals, and what was more critical, nearly everyone in the fleet had Spatial Ability. Mechanical gadgets could dominate momentarily but definitely could not completely suppress these people.
If it had been before, Barrett might have had doubts, thinking it impossible.
But now, he had absolute trust in Su Lun!
He had a hunch that this person would bring even greater surprises.
...
As planned, as long as they could hold off the Sixth Order "Demon Hand" Dorosel, Su Lun's own survival ability was not to be underestimated.
The lives of the "Judgment Group" were at stake, so Barrett naturally went all out. Qian Tiao wouldn't let Su Lun fall into danger, and even if she were in a perilous situation herself, she wouldn't let that guy get close to Su Lun.
Dorosel was embroiled with two experts and couldn't take care of himself.
Su Lun also breathed a sigh of relief watching this.
Looking at those over a thousand people in the water, his hands forming sorcerer's seals were moving rapidly.
Those pirate squadron captains and team leaders naturally saw him too, and a group with wings were already flying towards him.
A cold light shone in Su Lun's eyes as he murmured, "It's my turn to perform now..."
A Fleet from the Void?
In Su Lun's eyes, as long as they were the enemy, they were just experience points!
As Qian Tiao and the others were engaging the enemy commander, Su Lun felt that it was finally time to go all out. His sorcerer's seals condensed, and the ferocious form of the eight-armed spider lance appeared behind him.
When the sorcerer's seals changed once more, the Hexagram Alchemy Array lit up beneath his feet, and a huge cross, a hundred meters in diameter, slowly formed above his head.
"Mystic Art: Puppet Theater!"
He casually tossed out five scrolls, and "Bang" "Bang" "Bang"... a burst of white smoke exploded, suspending five hundred rune puppets out of thin air. The spider lance behind him pulled, and one by one, the puppets with painted blush and eerie smiles on their faces seemed to come to life, emitting "click" "click" sounds from their gnashing mouths as they charged toward the multitude.
A glance revealed that in his left hand, he held the "Human Skin Umbrella," and in his right hand was "Xiupunos's Scythe of the Night."
It had to be said, Spatial Ability was a natural counter to mechanical equipment.
Even mechanical octopuses with high-order runic patterns couldn't withstand several slashes from fourth and fifth-order professionals, leaving tentacles scattered everywhere.
The "Void Fleet" wasn't just filled with spatial professionals; they also possessed cursed items imbued with Spatial Ability. The weapons capable of slicing through space were the real trouble. Even a small cut could be fatally damaging to mechanical products.
Su Lun was not willing to see his hard-earned fifty mechanical beasts destroyed by these people.
The battle losses had already pained him greatly,
Fortunately, the mission of the mechanical octopuses was complete, and Su Lun had sunk them into the water, waiting for the right moment to act.
Now was the time for the rune puppets to take the main stage.
Puppets weren't afraid of being destroyed.
Let them be destroyed, painless and itchless, after all, there were plenty of reserves.
Su Lun, single-handedly controlling five hundred puppets, engaged in various combat on the sea.
Not all members of the pirate group were fourth or fifth-order leaders, and even within the North Sea Fleet, more than 80% were first and second-order professionals.
Although these fellows had awakened some Spatial Ability, which could be incredibly sharp against other professionals, when facing puppets...
Go ahead and destroy them if you wish.
Your blade might be sharp, but do I, a puppet of wood, fear being cut?
The suicidal charges of the puppets sent pirates scattering in all directions.
Of course, the most lethal was Su Lun himself.
At the moment, he held the black scythe, and the shadow of the reaper rose behind him.
The sea was littered with people like dumplings in water, on broken pieces of shipwrecks, barrels...
With a few swishes of Su Lun's black scythe, he didn't even need to aim to hit several enemies.
Although the black scythe had a lower chance of hitting higher-order professionals, it gave almost no time for lower-order professionals to react.
More often than not, a single slash would send limbs flying haphazardly, and blood spurting everywhere.
Once the corpses multiplied, the blood soon stained the entire sea red...
Meanwhile, Su Lun himself wasn't just standing by; looking at the "gray fog" over the sea, he rushed over and began a harvesting spree.
"You have stripped 'Akhmum Red' of his soul."
"You have gained some casting skills of 'Space Spell,' experience +13."
"You have gained a slight understanding of Space Law."
"..."
"You have stripped 'Ogar Kingsley' of his soul."
"You have stripped 'Siyam Bali' of his soul."
"You have stripped 'Mick Tyson' of his soul."
"..."
Experience +18, experience +9, experience +131, experience +12, experience +41...
These lower-order pirates, relying on the integration of spatial implants, had some understanding of Space Law, albeit slight, but in large numbers!
Even if there were overlaps later in the harvest, in a short time, Su Lun visibly saw his "Space Law" comprehension skyrocket.
As for those fourth and fifth-order pirates who wanted to gang up on him?
Within the "Puppet Theater," Su Lun's combat capabilities were extraordinary.
Even if he couldn't beat them, he could run.
Su Lun's Spatial Ability was no less than that of any Pirate Squadron Captain here.
His ability to save himself was incredibly strong.
Moreover, not far away, people from the "Dawn Group" and the "Judgment Group" were fiercely approaching on speedboats.
....
The battle reached its climax the moment the mechanical octopuses destroyed three warships.
With the ships destroyed, there was no chance of escape; the battle for survival had both sides fighting with desperation and fierceness.
Not far away, Qian Tiao and Captain Barrett were fiercely locked in combat with "Demon Hand" Dulosel.
As both sides fought desperately, the battle was intense and indecisive.
Dulosel, a professional from the "Fighter" class, excelled in close combat. Whether it was his cursed glove or the "Void Ghost Hand" implant that he had fused with, both matched his profession perfectly. His punches could shatter the void, ignoring armor and elemental shields, and they absolutely made his opponents question their life choices.
Dulosel was confident, believing he had a chance to triumph even against two opponents. But frustratingly, they didn't engage him directly, making his punches feel like they hit cotton, unable to exert his true strength.
Dulosel vaguely sensed that they were dragging out time, but he didn't understand why they would do such a thing.
Was there reinforcement coming?
Despite the ship being destroyed, Dulosel wasn't particularly panicky.
After all, he possessed Spatial Displacement ability; if he really wanted to escape, no one could prevent him!
If he found a chance to kill the two who were ensnaring him, he could turn the tables!
However, little did he realize that Su Lun was precisely waiting for the enemy to have this "I can turn the tables" mentality...
If "Demon Hand" Dulosel chose to flee at the first chance, Su Lun would indeed be helpless against him.
But he decided to stay, awaiting an opportunity for Su Lun to free up his hands.
Then, the outcome, most likely, would not be as "free to come and go" as he had anticipated.

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - 365 The Fear Dominated by Su Lun
chapters.content:
Having obtained detailed intelligence about the North Sea's eighteen fleets in advance, Su Lun's plan had considered almost everything that could happen at the moment.
A strategic "combination punch" caught the enemy off guard. Before the pirates could even react, three warships had been sunk with crew members thrown overboard.
After he had wielded his black scythe to swiftly kill two fourth-tier squad captains and a bunch of underlings, it was only then that the remaining squad captains realized what was happening.
'Drunkard' Roberson was the fleet's lead squad captain, wielding a Void Claw with strong armor-piercing capability and few equals in his tier. It was his weapon, the Void Steel Claw prosthetic, that had sliced off several of the kraken's tentacles, preserving half of the ship—although it was later breached by a sword qi strike from Qiantiao, his strength was beyond doubt.
As everyone knows, the most direct way to deal with a Puppet Master is to kill the controller.
Roberson's eyes were cold as he stared at Su Lun on the sea surface and bellowed, "Kill that Puppet Master first!"
With those words, he exchanged glances with the nearby fourth squad captain 'Whaler' Aireno and ninth squad captain 'Python Fist' Teck.
The three Tier-Five experts instantly understood each other and charged forward.
....
Su Lun's Puppet Theater was positioned cunningly, covering the area of the three sunken ships, where the crowd was densest.
Qiantiao and Barrett had already joined forces to push the sixth-tier Dorosel far outside the range of the sunken ships, allowing Su Lun to freely manipulate his puppet legion in combat.
The black umbrella enhanced his Soul Perception range; he could see all the souls on the sea surface and below, their fluctuations were crystal clear. The Dead Herald birds circling in the sky shared their vision with him, allowing Su Lun to see everything happening on the sea. His ability to multitask also enabled him to maintain perfect control of the entire battlefield.
This also meant that he was simply impossible to ambush!
Even without using his eyes to see, a casual swing of his black scythe was bound to strike its target.
This near-complete sensory coverage left the enemy with no defense. No line of sight to capture, no perception of malice, no breath targeting... one could never know where the next spatial fissure would appear.
With a swing of the black scythe, a random "lucky one" was taken away.
As if Death itself was following at their side, nobody knew when the black scythe would reap their life.
The cursed object of sealed-item grade truly demonstrated its equivalent rank of lethal prowess at that moment.
Unstoppable!
No one dared to stand where the scythe's blade pointed!
Panic spread rapidly.
And just then, Su Lun sensed that the fifth squad captain had vanished from his perception, and his gaze suddenly sharpened.
He identified that the leading figure was 'Drunkard' Roberson, an Assassin by profession.
"Void powers" and Assassin professions were a perfect match, allowing their stealth to be more than just optical disappearance; it was slipping into the void itself.
Su Lun tended with no less caution.
Suddenly, he perceived a spatial fluctuation behind him and without any hesitation, he used a "Flash" to dodge away from his original position.
Almost at the same time, the afterimage he left was caught by five void fissures and dispersed.
"Such a sharp assassination technique!"
Su Lun's pupils contracted sharply because an arrow barrage was heading his way.
The one attacking was the fourth squad captain 'Whaler' Aireno, a master archer, whose weapon was a rare cursed object capable of firing void arrows.
Su Lun had glanced at it earlier and recognized it on the spot. Harvested from ancient ruins, with an effective range of three hundred meters, it could ignore armor defenses.
Another very troublesome cursed object.
And what's worse, in the blink of an eye, Su Lun noticed a figure stepping on air, charging towards him vigorously. It was none other than the Ninth Squad Captain, 'Python Fist' Teck, whose Stepping on Air was combined with Void Displacement, moving so fast that several afterimages remained in the field of vision.
Three tier 5 professionals were working together seamlessly, nearly cutting off all of Su Lun's avenues of escape.
Su Lun looked at the dozens of Spatial Arrows mere inches away, a flash of cold light in his eyes.
Instead of avoiding them, he suddenly took out a black-and-white chessboard.
Faster than the arrows, a beam of light shot forward, hitting the 'Whaler', Aireno Mei, who had been shooting from cover.
When it came to cursed items, Su Lun had more than these pirates could handle!
In an instant, the surroundings flickered with light and shadow, and suddenly he was in the enclosed space of the black-and-white chessboard.
...
The firepower of archer professionals was formidable, and they possessed a terrifying ability for long-range sniping.
But usually, if a profession has strengths, it inevitably has weaknesses.
And most archers' physical combat capabilities were weak!
Therefore, professions like archers and snipers were generally the key protection targets within a team.
Just like now, this guy was guarded by an entire small squad.
But Su Lun's [Stanitz's Chessboard] was meant for one-on-one duels, pulling people in unreasonably directly.
The scenery shifted all around.
Aireno Mei's face turned pale as well.
His reaction was quick; raising his hand, he drew his longbow, and several more Void Arrows materialized.
Su Lun gave him no chance, pinching a sorcerer's seal, and a layer of dark golden runes appeared on his body as he softly commanded, "Hormonal Outburst·Quadruple Dissolution!"
The spell rapidly took shape, and his muscles swelled instantly. With a fierce stomp on the ground and a "crack" sound, he shot forward like a cannonball.
Aireno Mei was horrified and puzzled: How could a Puppet Master possibly be this fast?
But his hands didn't stop moving, firing three arrows in quick succession.
Su Lun didn't dodge at all, charging towards the incoming arrows.
Just as the arrows were about an inch from his forehead, [Flash] was ready for use once more.
In this constrained space, Su Lun's exaggerated speed allowed him to close the distance abruptly, appearing right in front of Aireno Mei's face.
At this very moment, the pirate squad captain's face was a mix of disbelief and terror.
The spatial chessboard couldn't restrain those who were capable of Spatial Displacement, but unfortunately for Aireno Mei, he couldn't use it!
His path of advancement wasn't Spatial Displacement. In order to use that cursed longbow in his hands, he put all his advancement options into "output."
Under normal circumstances, a professional in a team doesn't need every member to be all-around capable.
As long as the healer has enough healing power, the tank can take damage, and the damage dealers can strike... that's enough.
Everyone complements each other, allowing collective combat power to multiply exponentially.
But now, turned into a "1V1" by Su Lun, Aireno Mei was completely flustered.
He had just stripped enough "grey mist" from the corpses of those pirate lackeys, allowing Su Lun to understand the capabilities of the various squad captains like the back of his hand.
Multi-tasking and extremely high brain capacity development were utilized to their fullest in such complex combat, making Su Lun's brain operate like a high-speed computer that could quickly process newly acquired information.
It was precisely because he had mastered these pieces of intelligence that he didn't hesitate to opt for close-quarters combat.
Once he got close, his black scythe slashed horizontally, and Aireno Mei's frail body meant he couldn't perform extreme dodges right after shooting arrows and could only watch helplessly as a spatial rift appeared at his waist.
The leather armor he was wearing wasn't ordinary either. Under normal circumstances, it could protect him from fatal injuries, even if he faced an opponent of the same level.
Unfortunately, what Su Lun wielded in his hand was a "sealed item."
It was a smoothness without the slightest pain, and Aireno watched as his upper body separated from his lower, his life force rapidly fading away.
It wasn't that the squadron captain wasn't strong enough; from beginning to end, he was calculated to death due to the asymmetry of information.
...
"You have stripped 'Aireno Mei's soul."
"You have gained a large amount of casting skills for 'spatial spells', experience +751"
"Your comprehension of the Space Law has been enhanced..."
"You have stripped some information: 'The death rate of fusing with the void is extremely high, but at least I finally pulled through. All the companions that were once with me are dead, only I am left...'"
"..."
After slaying his target, Su Lun stripped away that mass of gray fog.
The comprehension of the laws by a fifth-order professional was incomparable to that of lower-order professionals; this mass of gray fog brought him improvements many times greater than the dozens of other mass he had stripped before—enough to save him ten years of arduous cultivation.
Squadron captain-level pirates would possess more secrets, and Su Lun also learned about the situation of the "void fleet" from this guy's soul.
This fleet was formed over a mountain of bones.
Not everyone is suitable for fusing with the void profession, but human life isn't worth much in this world. King Oleg of the North Sea tried with a large number of people, numerous deformations, and deaths later, and only one in a hundred survived. Only then did this "void fleet" come into being.
Without the time to think deeply, Su Lun didn't even look at the spoils of war, but stuffed the corpses and arrows into his storage space.
The scenery around him changed once more, returning him to the surface of the sea.
...
The pirates had no clue what had happened, watching Su Lun vanish into thin air and then reappearing similarly out of nowhere.
The whole process took less than ten breaths of time.
What was key was that the Fourth Squadron Captain 'Whaler' Aireno who vanished with him never reappeared!
The pirates understood all too well that the squadron captain was probably more unlucky than not.
Meanwhile, Qian Tiao and Captain Barrett, who were fiercely battling in the distance, also saw what happened here.
Although it seemed that these two high-ranked fighters were the biggest factors influencing the outcome of this sea battle, they both understood that the actual, most important variable was "Su Lun."
The battle changed in the blink of an eye, and in just this short period, so many unexpected things happened. Barrett was so utterly shocked he couldn't speak.
Previously, when he saw those dozens of mechanical octopuses appear, he thought Su Lun was a [Beast Tamer].
But now, looking at the sky filled with silken threads and runic puppets, he realized, was he actually a Puppet Master?
But even so, he never could have imagined that Su Lun alone could oppress over a thousand people in battle?
Which Puppet Master could control hundreds of puppets at once?
He could still afford to be distracted while fighting several professionals a whole major rank above him, and even managed to counter-kill one?
Barrett's gaze was complex as he looked at Su Lun in the distance, with the specter of a scythe-wearing death reaper looming behind him.
Emperor Luying's domain was a place where talents converged, with all sorts of rare A-tier and B-tier talents; what hadn't he seen before?
But this death reaper phantom wielding a black scythe, he truly had never seen before.
He had not even heard of it!
Yet, that did not stop him from discerning that this was an extremely rare "S-rank" talent.
Moreover, the fact that the specter was externally manifested also meant that it was a talent at its second awakening.
Barrett felt that today, he had exhausted a lifetime's worth of shocks.
He had just witnessed a second awakening of Rakshasa Woman, which he thought was one in a hundred million, only to encounter another talent that was even more unique.
Barrett himself was a second awakener of the "Talent C-071-Ape"; how could he not know, the higher the rank of a talent, the more difficult it was to develop?
Without exaggeration, could a normal person who hadn't been through several near-death experiences awaken such a high-level talent's second form?
But these two guys in front of him both were...
Forget it, incomparable.
For the first time, Barrett felt that his former reputation as the "prodigy graduate of the Imperial Capital Military Academy" was so dim and dull in the presence of these two.
It was said that they also had a very powerful and mysterious leader.
Barrett couldn't help but wonder, just who exactly are these people in the "Dawn Group"?
....
As Su Lun left, the Puppet Theater lost its support, and runic puppets floated all over the sea.
After he appeared on the sea's surface, the sorcerer's seals were joined once more, and the cross in the sky again began to slowly condense.
Watching Su Lun act so brazenly, how could those squad captains stand it?
Just at the moment Su Lun materialized, the "Drunkard" Roberson emerged once again from the void and reached out for another grab.
Su Lun too caught the glimpse of a soul fire that had appeared behind him.
This fellow was truly a professional assassin; he had chosen a very tricky moment to appear, exactly when Su Lun was concentrating on his spell. Under normal circumstances, this grasp, even if it did not injure someone, could interrupt the casting of the spell.
And the killing intent did not come from just one direction.
On another front, "Python Fist" Teck also teleported and burst through the air, swinging a heavy punch.
This combined attack maneuver was all too familiar by now.
Su Lun knew clearly that his chessboard couldn't keep these two guys under control.
This time, however, he did not make any superfluous movements. The sorcerer's seals in his hands continued to condense, but a certain thread pulled by the spider spear behind him moved ever so slightly.
The crows in the sky that herald death could clearly see that the assassin behind was aiming a grasp at the back of his head.
Su Lun tilted his head slightly, splitting open the grasp.
The cooperation between these two squad captains was extremely synchronized. Under normal circumstances, as long as he chose to dodge, he would definitely face the oncoming heavy punch.
But at that moment, a bizarre scene occurred!
The "Python Fist" Teck was originally aiming to bash Su Lun with a punch, but for some reason, his fist unexpectedly veered off, as if he had suddenly changed his mind, and he charged straight towards the "Drunkard" Roberson instead.
The moment that was captured was Su Lun just managing to crane his neck away from the claw when Teck's heavy fist eerily landed on Roberson's head.
With a "thud," the sound was like a hammer smashing a watermelon.
This punch, entwined with distorted space, hit right in the face.
Luckily for him, the assassin's extraordinary reaction speed allowed Roberson to lean back to the extreme, unloading seven or eight parts of the force.
Otherwise, his head might have been blown apart by that punch.
Even so, the punch still sent the Ninth Squad Captain flying out like a cannonball.
Seizing the opportunity, Su Lun rapidly retreated dozens of meters, and the sorcerer's seals in his hand were also successfully condensed.
A hundred meters away, Roberson, with a face blurred with blood and flesh, climbed up from the seawater, outraged, "Teck, what the hell is he doing?"
This punch had nearly taken his life!
Teck looked at his own fist as if he had seen a ghost, confusedly saying, "I... I don't know!"
He was clearly aiming for that guy, so how did he end up hitting his own partner?
All the pirates' gazes collectively turned toward the expressionless man.
....
The cross in the sky had once again condensed.
Su Lun breathed a sigh of relief.
With "Puppet Mastery: Slaughter Theater," he felt once again as if everything was under his control.
Looking at the pirates who had yet to react on the opposite side, he murmured to himself with an indifferent expression, "Didn't kill him... that's a bit of a pity."
However, the next second, a murderous intent suddenly surged!
A cold glint flashed in his eyes, his left hand suddenly made a grabbing motion in the air, resembling the act of pulling on threads, while the scythe in his right simultaneously swung down.
Teck, who was still in a daze, saw the dark scythe far away swinging toward him and showed an expression of horror.
An instinctive sense of danger made him stomp on the wooden board beneath his feet, trying to use the force to dodge.
In a normal situation, such an obvious attack trajectory could never harm him.
But in that split second of dodging, he suddenly felt his body stiffen, and the spiritual power inside his body uncontrollably paused for a moment.
"Not good!"
Teck realized the abnormality in his body and understood what had just happened: someone had taken control of his body!
How could this be?
He hadn't fallen for any illusion technique, so how could his body be controlled?
But reality left no time for further thought; he clearly sensed a spatial rift appear above his neck.
In that instant when death approached, Teck twisted his body to the limit, narrowly avoiding the spatial rift.
Did he avoid it?
No, he hadn't!
Su Lun hadn't unleashed a single strike, but two!
At that moment, Teck also sensed another spatial rift appearing in his perception.
The opponent had even calculated that he would move to the right!
With a face full of despair, Teck realized he had already lost his balance and couldn't dodge any longer.
He could only watch in horror as the spatial rift sliced off half of his head, plunging his vision into darkness.
From afar, Su Lun watched impassively as that head was split in two, whispering to himself, "Skilled in heavy side kicks with the right leg, which means the left leg is often used as the supporting leg to generate force... He most likely would dodge to the right."
He had determined this from the intelligence he had obtained and from observations he made earlier.
The guy was wearing shorts, revealing the muscular patterns on his legs, which were uncovered. Fighters, in their professional tier, could deduce force habits from certain details of the body's muscles.
Once figured out, some impulsive reactions could be predicted.
Moreover, Su Lun had taken one more precaution: he manipulated the tilt of the wooden boards on the water's surface with threads, which was difficult to notice.
In order to maintain the force and balance, the guy would most likely move to the right as well.
So, it was a one-strike kill.
As for why the Ninth Squad Captain had hit the wrong person before, and why his body had tensed up for a moment, it was because of the "Soul Perception."
Did the Puppeteer only control puppets?
No, wherever his gaze fell, all became puppets!
Su Lun was well aware that it was almost impossible for him to control high-ranking professionals with "Soul Perception" at the moment, but changing a little bit at a critical moment was still achievable.
Soul Perception was a form of physical control, like inserting silver needles to instantaneously block the blood flow, sending false signals to the nerves, which was indeed achievable.
Just before, he had stripped a fifth-tier professional in the chessboard space, so now Su Lun's understanding of the "Space Law" had reached that of a fifth-tier professional. This meant he could break through Teck's protective void barrier with threads without drawing much attention.
This, too, led to the moment earlier, when the guy was misled by the wrong neural signals, thus losing control of his body for an instant.
On the battlefield, such a mistake was enough to cost him his life.
...
Each phase of the plan was linked to the next.
He had been holding back his "Soul Perception" control ability for so long, just to set a trap for a high-tier professional.
Now it seemed, it worked just perfectly.
Although Su Lun was just standing there, his body was surrounded by countless translucent energy threads, and if one could sense the energy fluctuations, they would realize he resembled a jellyfish.
By this time, the lower-ranking lackeys' bodies were already pierced with various "thread ends."
Those hair-like threads were difficult to detect.
"The Wailing Witch's Infinite Hair" had an outstanding discontinuous property, which is to say, it could be connected at any time.
Now that the "Soul Perception" was exposed, Su Lun wasn't planning on hiding it anymore.
At that moment, a sinister and ferocious look appeared in his eyes. With ten fingers making a grabbing motion in the air, he pulled countless threads and exclaimed, "Puppet Mastery: Slaughter Theater!"
...
Three fifth-tier squad captains attempted to kill a fourth-tier individual, but instead of succeeding, two were killed in two rounds.
Witnessing this scene, the pirates could not help but feel a chill.
More than a thousand people looked at the solitary figure standing on the sea, the Harpoon Reaper, with eyes full of terror, as if time itself had stopped, and everyone had forgotten to attack.
They truly didn't know how to kill the man before them.
He was clearly just a fourth-tier, so why was he so terrifying...
He had too many inconceivable methods at his disposal.
And then, an even more horrifying scene unfolded.
The moment Su Lun's spell was one percent complete, countless threads fell, and the pirates thought they were about to face a puppet army again, but without warning, their comrades suddenly drew their blades and stabbed at them.
"Mark, what are you doing!"
"I... I don't know! My body isn't under my control!"
"Damn it, don't come near me!"
"Be careful, that guy has the ability to control the target's body... Everyone, stay out of the range of that cross."
"..."
Firearms discharged wildly, cannons thundered and exploded.
The low-ranking lackeys were like puppets on the front line, each turning to shoot and slash at their own comrades.
Their minds were clear, but their bodies were uncontrollable.
For a time, it was extremely chaotic.
This group of pirates was experiencing the horror of being dominated by a "Puppeteer" for the first time.
It was like when Su Lun had first crossed over, witnessing in "Storm Villa" Pestoya manipulating the puppet for the first time.
That type of fear from the unknown was truly terrifying.
Was it truly one against a thousand?
No, from the start of the fight, it was destined to be legion against legion.
Su Lun's "Mental Tentacles" could turn enemies into his puppets.
As soon as they were controlled, they would immediately "mutiny."
This move directly resolved Su Lun's situation of fighting a lone battle.
The pirates had only needed to defend against Su Lun alone; now, they had to beware of the people beside them,
Even those squad leaders of the fourth and fifth tier instantly lost their will to fight.
They then realized that from the start, that man's face was always incredibly calm.
It was a kind of despair... that no one could resist!
Like the mastermind behind a puppet theater, he was composed,
He was in control of everything.
....
As Su Lun manipulated the pirates to slaughter each other, members from the "Dawn Group" and the "Judgment Group" also gathered around from a distance.
They hadn't imagined that in the short time it took to charge, "Mister Su Lun" had already secured the victory by himself.
But on everyone's face was a look of horror.
Even the members of the Dawn Group.
A thousand people slaughtering each other, the blood dyed a large area red, what an appalling sight?
Beyond the shock, the crowd roared excitedly, chasing after the fleeing pirates to kill them.
...
On the other hand, seeing this from afar, Barrett also heaved a sigh of relief.
Su Lun fought against three squad leaders, killing two of the fifth-tier.
He also caused chaos among the thousand pirates with his strange controlling techniques.
Barrett was numb with shock...
Drawing in a cold breath, he exclaimed, "This fellow's combat power... is equal to that of an entire legion!"
Barrett didn't fail to see that the extremely meticulous battlefield calculation was the most terrifying part...
Like a dance of swords, any mistake could mean irreversible doom.
And yet, he had done it.
He was eerily calm.
Despite his astonishment, Barrett felt a surge of elation.
He knew that under the current situation, as long as he and the Thousand Stripes Miss could continue to hold on, the pirates of the "Demon Hand" Doloress would inevitably be defeated, and their Dawn Group would finally turn the tide.
But Doloress had extremely strong spatial displacement abilities; Barrett knew that he couldn't keep him here and would ultimately have to let him escape.
Just then, Thousand Stripes' communicator seemed to receive a message.
She slashed out a Sword Qi, retreated a great distance in a burst, then cried out to Barrett, "Captain Barrett, get ready to make your move!"
"???"
Upon hearing this, Barrett was bewildered for a moment.
What did she mean?
Weren't they in the middle of a fight?
He thought he had misheard.
But then, under his astonished gaze, he saw that Thousand Stripes, who had already been quite impressive, suddenly had her aura shoot up dramatically.
Looking again, the shadowy six-armed Rakshasa behind her slowly condensed into a golden statue-like form.
"This... this... this!"
Barrett cried out in his heart,
He might not have seen this before, but he already had a guess in his mind.
This was definitely not the Rakshasa Woman in her second state!
So, could it possibly be the third state?
He then realized, from the beginning to the end, she had not really shown her true power?!

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - 366: A Wave of Fat
chapters.content:
Su Lun used "Psychic Tentacles," plunging these thousand-plus pirates into internal chaos in a short time.
This situation was not one they could fight through.
Those pirates who were not controlled frantically escaped towards the areas outside the range of the puppet theater.
Limited by his rank, Su Lun's dark powers were not too abundant. The area covered by his puppet theater was not very large. If those pirates were determined to escape, there was little he could do.
Su Lun could only kill as many of the controlled pirates as possible.
With this killing, hundreds of "fog clusters" rose above the sea surface again.
But just then, the crew members from the "Dawn Group" and "Judgment Group" arrived in the waters near the Sunken Ship.
Su Lun had no intention of continuing to tangle with these pirates, as there was a "big fish" waiting in the distance.
Only by killing that deputy fleet captain "Demon Hand" Duo Luo Sai Er, would the battle truly be over.
And thus, avoid major future troubles.
Su Lun displayed his Eight-Armed Spider Lance and quickly circled the sea surface, gobbling up the "fog clusters" like a roaming gluttonous snake.
With rapid assimilation and digestion, his comprehension of Space Law surged, increasing significantly.
Although the gains in law from harvesting those first and second-tier pirates became less and less, Su Lun nevertheless acquired various "experiences."
Close-combat spatial application experience, magic system experience, spatial weaponry experience, spellcasting tricks, Space Arcana, rare techniques, habits of void creatures... all sorts of knowledge.
It was as if he had browsed through a library, Su Lun's "Reaper of Death" talent allowing him to peel off the content he needed and then insert it directly into his brain.
After informing Qian Tiao of his battle plan, he undid the puppet theater spell and, controlling the Eight-Armed Spider Lance, sprinted across the sea surface towards the distant battlefield.
...
At this moment, several leagues away, a fierce battle was in full swing.
"Demon Hand" Duo Luo Sai Er was completely baffled, not having anticipated that the thousand-plus men he brought would tend towards a major defeat in such a short amount of time.
"How is this possible... A single person overpowering a thousand of my men?"
Duo Luo Sai Er's face was the picture of disbelief.
At this moment, he realized what he hadn't seen clearly before; he had thought that the "Signal Officer," a mere minion, was the most troublesome enemy.
One mechanical octopus sink ships, then another inexplicable puppet secret technique, a single person managed to dominate over a thousand with no remedy.
Seeing this, Duo Luo Sai Er even began to doubt his own perceptions: Could it be that after spending too long in the Void Fleet, having not seen the outside world for a long time, dual-evolved talents were everywhere?
All three enemies in front of him were of this caliber.
He realized that he must fight with all his might.
Only by killing the two who were holding him back could their eighteenth fleet have a chance to turn the tables.
Otherwise, today might spell a significant setback.
But after trying, Duo Luo Sai Er became more and more puzzled; no matter how desperately he fought, exhausting all his methods, he still couldn't kill the two opponents.
Finally, when he saw the martial vigor of the six-armed Rakshasa female swordsman surge again, he understood why he always felt stuck and unable to shake free.
It turned out that the female swordsman had never used her full strength!
Although said to be only rank five, be it the chilling dominance or the Sword Intent that stirred a sea of lightning, how could these be just an ordinary rank five?
When he felt the majestic and sacred pressure appear, Duo Luo Sai Er realized that this was not a dual-evolved "Rakshasa Woman" after all!
"Could it be... the legendary triple-evolved talent?"
At that moment, he finally understood the source of the unease in his heart.
Just then, Duo Luo Sai Er saw the figure wielding the Eight-Armed Spider Lance rushing quickly toward him from a distance on the sea surface.
Seeing the momentum, was he coming to corner and kill him?
Hah!
Duo Luo Sai Er looked on in anger.
As a mighty tier-six professional, he was part of the tiny elite at the pinnacle of this world's extraordinary pyramid; how could he not have his own pride?
He, who traversed the void with impunity, could not simply be sheared by any Tom, Dick, or Harry, could he?
But the next instant, his confidence dissipated like smoke.
Because at that moment, Su Lun, in the distance, suddenly stretched out a hand wearing "Kronos's Spatial Gloves" embedded with an Energy Baryte and violently grabbed towards the front.
With a "clang," the Crystal Stone shattered, and an invisible force pulsed out.
Yet, it seemed like nothing had changed.
Neither Qian Tiao nor Barrett were affected in the slightest.
But in an instant, Duo Luo Sai Er's complexion drastically changed, terror rising in his heart: "Space has been restricted!"
Being highly proficient in Space Law himself, how could he not feel the space around him being sealed by a mysterious force?
It was as if a swimming pool suddenly turned into a concrete floor; how the hell was he supposed to "swim" now?
At this moment, Duo Luo Sai Er finally panicked.
He finally understood that the other party really meant to kill him.
They had even prepared the means to take his life in advance!
....
Battles between Rank Six professionals were not something that lower ranks could casually join in on; Su Lun had come over solely because the gloves had a limited release distance.
This Spatial Technique of restriction immediately solidified a large area of nearby sea space, sealing it tightly.
Duo Luo Sai Er's first reaction was to try and escape the area enclosed by the spatial barrier, but to no avail; Qi'an and Barrett were not about to let him have his way.
Without the ability to Teleport, Duo Luo Sai Er's ghostly speed advantage disappeared.
After all, if you had the ability to fly, who would be desperate to train their leg muscles to run?
His physical speed was not even as fast as Su Lun, a Rank Four professional!
Because of Su Lun's move, the balance of the battle suddenly tipped from a stalemate towards one side.
Even though the range of the spatial restriction was indeed limited, Su Lun had come prepared.
He had also collected several top-tier Energy Barytes during this time; just enough... to be sufficient!
Even if each one was worth a hundred million lire, today, Su Lun would absolutely not let Duo Luo Sai Er escape using Spatial Displacement!
...
The appearance of Rakshasa Golden Body in its third phase formally announced that the battle had reached its final stage.
The thunderclouds in the sky had grown very thick, with purplish-red lightning snakes constantly flickering within them.
And at that moment, a more extravagant scene appeared in the sky: slowly emerging from within the thunderclouds was a Rakshasa Golden Body phantom standing a hundred meters tall. As soon as the phantom appeared, it was as though chantings from the beyond were heard by the ear. With an angry Rakshasa face on one side and a dignified visage of a holy figure on the other, the image was eerily bizarre.
The Rakshasa Woman in her third phase had once cut down ghosts and deities. Although Qi'an's current state wasn't as exaggerated as it had been during her time in the underworld nation, the oppressive aura that emanated from her still caused the scalp of a Rank Six professional to tingle!
Su Lun didn't forget to communicate through the communicator: "Captain Barrett, keep that guy under control!"
Barrett had already heard the reminder from Qi'an and knew full well the desperation of this final fight.
He, too, was prepared; gritting his teeth, he bellowed: "Flesh Alchemy: Open!"
Upon reaching his first attainment as a Magician, he suddenly grew beast-like fur all over his body, transforming in an instant into a one-armed gorilla with bloodshot eyes.
The fact that Barrett had only one arm greatly affected his ability to form seals, but he still exerted himself to use his killer technique.
After a thunderous roar, the fur on his body stood up against the fiery waves of Qi, and a hysterical howl came from his throat: "Power Mystique: Ten Direction Fierce Beast Ban!"
In a flash, four ferocious white Qi gorilla phantoms appeared in the sky above the sea area, and the surrounding air visibly thickened.
Even Su Lun, who was far away, felt as if his breathing had become stagnant.
The air had turned to glue, making it difficult even to breathe.
He had seen this move before; it was an ultimate martial technique that relied purely on physical strength to suppress a space. It could compress the air in an area to its limit, rendering the target immobile.
Barrett, after all, had once been one of the best among Rank Six professionals, and his comprehension of the laws was no less than that of the vast Pirate.
Even though this "Ten Direction Fierce Beast Ban" only had a fraction of its peak power, with the additional restraint of the gloves' spatial limitation, it pinned down the "Void Ghost Hand" Duo Luo Sai Er, rendering him unable to move in an instant.
Unable to Teleport, the formerly overbearing Pirate leader finally showed panic on his face.
But, being a Rank Six professional himself, he managed to condense a layer of obscure Void black light on his arms in the instant he was controlled, forcibly breaking free of the restraint and regaining some movement.
Duo Luo Sai Er grimly charged his fist, then lashed out with a preemptive punch and roared, "Die!"
This shout was naturally a warning to Barrett that he was about to unleash his killer move; Barrett should get out of the way!
But Barrett, with a defiant look in his eyes, showed no intention of dodging, and the four Qi gorillas continued to solidify around him.
He was well aware that it was because of Su Lun's surprise attack with the cursed item that they had managed to control Duo Luo Sai Er.
There was absolutely no way they could let this man escape now.
If they allowed him to be wary and escape, he would not be so easy to handle next time!
However, it was this perseverance that caused Barrett to miss the first opportunity to dodge. Standing in place, Duo Luo Sai Er's pair of Void punch shadows landed squarely on Barrett's chest.
"Thump," "thump" went the muffled sounds.
The Qi concentrated Protecting Body Qi did almost nothing to weaken the force of the punches, which created deep indentations on Barrett's chest.
Unable to help himself, "Puh" went Barrett, as blood sprayed from his mouth.
Duo Luo Sai Er's alchemically enhanced prosthetics were the "Void Ghost Hand," designed specifically to overcome all types of defensive gear, Mecha, and Protecting Body Qi, causing real damage across the void.
Barrett, taking those two punches head-on, was severely wounded!
But it was because of his moment of steadfastness that Qi'an's accumulated Sword Qi could be slashed down as well.
As the sword swung, the hundred-meter-tall Rakshasa phantom in the sky swung in unison, calling down a turbulent deluge of lightning from the heavens.
Duo Luo Sai Er felt an unprecedented threat of Death bearing down on him, as the chilling Sword Qi caused all his hairs to bristle.
Under normal circumstances, the slash of a Rank Five swordsman would pose very limited threat to a Rank Six professional who had mastered the Qi into Gang.
But Qi'an was an exception!
Not only had she comprehended Qi into Gang at Rank Five, but with the enhancement of the "Rakshasa Woman" third phase, her Sword Qi could now pierce through the Protecting Body Qi of a Rank Six professional. Moreover, she wielded the Demon Blade, "Ghost Pellet Hyakume Masamune," ranked third among the "Twelve Master Craftsmen Blades," which had an edge comparable to a forbidden item. The Sword Qi, augmented by such a sharp blade, had an almost void-breaking prowess!
Seeing that he couldn't evade the oncoming slash, Duo Luo Sai Er's eyes flashed with a cold light, and a barrier of black energy coalesced around him, distorting the light.
...
Others might not understand what this was, but Su Lun who was watching from a distance, his pupils shrank abruptly, recognizing the technique: "Distorted Barrier?!"
As expected of a rank six spatial ability user, his use of the technique was so proficient that it was nearly instantaneous.
The thin black barrier seemed only palm-thick, but the actual distance might be several meters, or even dozens of meters.
This defensive method could lead enemies to misjudge the distance, greatly reducing the damage sustained.
The slash from Qian Tiao was fierce, but it might not necessarily hit the target!
But now that he had recognized the technique, how could Su Lun let this guy get away so easily?
He too charged forward recklessly, sprinting over the sea surface with his spider spear while the Reaper's shadow behind him became more solid, and his black scythe became filled with a massive amount of dark spiritual power.
Ordinary spatial slash attacks were of limited effectiveness against someone who had grasped higher levels of space law, so Su Lun could only infuse as much death law as possible.
Almost in the instant when Qian Tiao's blade light fell, Su Lun's black scythe also slashed down simultaneously.
Far away, Duo Luo Sai Er had already known about the fierceness of Su Lun's black scythe, and upon seeing it slash towards him, a look of despair appeared on his face: It's over!
Because he understood space law, he knew just how tricky the rifts created by that black scythe were.
Dodging on one side meant he would definitely not be able to avoid the other.
In his moment of despair, a final thought rose in Duo Luo Sai Er's mind: "How was that guy able to see through my technique..."
He couldn't fathom how Su Lun could possess such profound comprehension of space law!
...
The battle ended very abruptly.
With a "whoosh" of Sword Qi cutting through the air.
Qian Tiao's slash carved through hundreds of meters, slashing a trench over a dozen meters deep into the sea surface.
The Sword Qi churned in the water, forcing the sea to part to either side. The trench remained for a long time before closing up again.
Su Lun, watching as the bisected corpse surfaced with a "grey mist", finally relaxed and rushed towards the battlefield.
He chose to extract immediately.
'You have extracted the soul of "Duo Luo Sai Er·Castillo."'
'You have drawn a massive amount of rank six space law comprehension, experience +32114.'
'You have stripped away the Spatial Technique [Mystery·Spatial Barrier (Mastery)].'
'You have stripped the execution skills of Void Displacement, significantly improving your proficiency in related abilities.'
'You know some detailed information about the "Void Fleet."'
'You have obtained some information: "In the dangerous seas to the southwest of the Roman Kingdom, we have discovered a Void Relic. It is an ancient site from the Dawn Era known as 'Tokster Royal Alchemy Academy.' But we have also found that deep within, there seems to be a sealed spatial passage connecting to another plane, inhabited by a large number of unknown void creatures, extremely dangerous. Due to many ancient technological devices we cannot decipher, Mafa will send experts over to work together on this..."'
'You have obtained a top-secret piece of information: We found a legendary item, [Kronos's Void God Hand], in the relics, a sealed-item level spatial artifact, it seems. Alas, Lord Oleg plans to offer it to the Mafa Empire as the first batch of return gifts for the trade. Now, that treasure is likely already in the hands of "Princess Frostmoon," Scatty Harris. Oh, such an intriguing lady...'
'...'
As expected of a rank six professional, Su Lun saw too much in his soul that he desired.
Every professional who advances to rank six is a prodigy.
This fellow had an incredibly rich combat experience, high-level law comprehension, secret knowledge, spatial techniques...
Su Lun selectively stripped away the most important parts, directly boosting his comprehension of space law significantly.
While still not reaching rank six, he was at least ten times higher than before.
Su Lun casually reached into the void, feeling an intense stagnation... a sign of a great increase in spatial affinity.
Trying out a casual [Flash], it was as smooth as breathing.
He felt this was truly a "fat loot."
It was "forcing the growth," and his combat power had leaped to a new level in an instant.
Moreover, the most important thing was that he now had the coordinates to that Void Relic controlled by the Northern Sea Fleet!
Su Lun immediately digested the information, his eyes shining brightly.
...
In the state of "Triple Unlock" talent, Qian Tiao was brimming with fighting spirit; having killed Duo Luo Sai Er, she had no intention of staying put and said to Su Lun, "Su Lun, I'm going to help clean up the battlefield!"
Su Lun nodded, "Okay!"
Qian Tiao didn't pause and treaded across the sea surface, heading out.
Barrett, beside them, looking heavily wounded but still not showing signs of retreating, also said, "Young friend Su Lun, I'll go ahead and help too."
Su Lun didn't say much, just tossing a top-tier Healing Medicine, "Captain Barrett, take care."
"Okay."
Barrett wasn't shy; he was in dire need of medicine.
He chugged the potion in one gulp, then rushed toward the still raging battlefield where the sunken ship lay.
Su Lun had waited for a moment, specifically to retrieve the corpses from the sea.
At that time, two glowing objects were slowly coalescing atop the bisected corpse.
They were the gold-level advancement material, "Sky God Strike boxing gloves," and the dark gold prosthesis, "Void Ghost Hand."
After a quick assessment, both items were identified as very decent cursed objects.
Su Lun looked at the "Void Ghost Hand," originally intending to merge it with Chien Tiao.
This kind of ultra-high physical and magical penetration, prosthesis that inflicts "true damage," would have a very high compatibility with the swordsman profession.
But after stripping the memories from the corpse, he learned that Princess Frostmoon seemed to possess an even better legendary prosthesis—the "Void God Hand" of Chronos.
That was an upgraded version of the "Void Ghost Hand."
He wasn't sure if Chien Tiao could assimilate it, but since there was a better option, Su Lun decided to wait and see.
After all, there seemed to be many great secrets inside that space relic.
....
Since Su Lun had previously shattered the pirates' morale, the Dawn and Judgement groups encountered very limited resistance.
With Chien Tiao and Barrett joining the battlefield, the battle at the shipwreck site ended quickly.
Several fifth-rank squad captains were killed, the remaining men scattered in disarray, fleeing in all directions, easy as chopping vegetables.
Of the thirty-six men from the three squads put together, Su Lun kept count of each one.
He stripped away a thousand and eighty swirls of grey mist; the rest might be corpses at the bottom of the sea or a few who managed to escape. But in these waters, it's likely they wouldn't survive anyway.
Leaving no survivors was for the best.
That way, the events here could be kept secret a while longer.
Soon, members of the Dawn Group began the much-anticipated task of salvaging spoils from the sunken ship.
This "Eighteen Fleet" was Lord Oleg's ace secret fleet, with the best equipment configuration.
The ships held a large amount of top-tier magic mechanical equipment, instruments, cannons... almost all brand new.
These items were very valuable and could be used on their own ship upon retrieval.
It was a pity, though, that three pirate warships better in quality than the Dawn had been sunk.
But Su Lun had no choice.
If they didn't sink the pirate ships immediately, they wouldn't have had the capacity to take on the three squads.
Su Lun had mechanical octopuses; retrieving the materials at the bottom of the sea was quite doable, and not long after, the Dawn was packed to the brim.
Aside from the ship's materials, storage rings, equipment, countless void prosthesis, and advancement materials were also stripped from the corpses.
The crew salvaged with great fervor.
"Hahaha... this time, our 'Dawn Group' has reaped a huge harvest. With so many advancement materials and prosthesis, we have plenty to choose from now."
"Indeed. Mr. Su Lun is wise, our leader is mighty!"
"But speaking of which, Mr. Su Lun is truly incredible, nearly wiping out these three squads by himself. Oh, if I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, anyone who'd dare brag like this, I'd kick his ass with my shoe~"
"My God, I've only just realized how far Captain has come. Sword Qi severing seas, that's something I could never dare to imagine in my lifetime..."
"Oh, look what treasure I've salvaged, a gold prosthesis!"
"..."
Looking at the loot they had gathered, everyone's faces were filled with excitement.
Su Lun smiled in response to his crew's lively greetings and let out a long sigh of relief.
This batch of spoils would immediately alleviate the financial situation of the Dawn Group.
Despite the Dawn Group's growing strength and the merger with Dr. Banks's people,
the group's finances had always been tight.
The consumption of a team wasn't just as simple as filling the bellies of two or three hundred people. Advancement materials were needed for the team members, resources for cultivation... high-ranking professionals were built with vast amounts of resources.
Of course, that was just a part of it.
The real big money burners were Su Lun's puppet legion and mechanical octopus legion,
with damages this time amounting to at least several billion...
Second was the research undertaken by Dr. Banks.
Scientific research was an endless money pit; no matter how much you threw in, results weren't guaranteed.
With the spoils gathered this time, Su Lun could buy more materials to strengthen his puppet legion and ensure Dr. Banks had enough materials and equipment to continue his research.
It could be said they dodged an emergency.
No wonder piracy was addicting—bag a big haul, and it really fattens you up.

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - 367: Alchemy Gargoyle
chapters.content:
"Hey, brothers, look what I fished out! An 'Androfor gold-carved flintlock pistol'! Oh my, this is a craft from a hundred years ago, only the noble gentry could possess such a firearm. I think it suits our Captain perfectly."
"Wow—a whole case of twelve-year-old Popodi Manor golden rum! Hahaha, we're in for a treat tonight."
"Quick, look! There's actually a top-tier gemstone in this guy's storage ring."
"..."
The people of Liberty Dawn were fervently salvaging the spoils of war.
With each surprising discovery, the crew's spirits soared higher.
After Su Lun used the mechanical octopus to salvage the large objects from the ocean's floor, he didn't personally bother with the rest.
Fragments of three pirate warships were scattered across several nautical miles; salvaging them was a meticulous task that would take many days. This was a rare, delightful time for the crew during the otherwise tedious sea voyage.
Since Liberty Dawn had taken the lead in battle, the soldiers of Sacred Judgment didn't take part in collecting the spoils. These professional soldiers didn't covet the loot and stayed on their ships to avoid any appearance of conflict.
...
The battle hadn't cost much, but Captain Barrett's condition was rather bad.
He had earlier taken two punches from 'Demon Hand' Dorsel, dragged his severely injured body to join the final pursuit, and finally collapsed into the sea, where he was carried back to the ship for treatment.
Upon hearing the news, Su Lun returned to the Dawn.
In the ship's cabin, Dr. Banks was performing surgery on Barrett.
Standing by, two deputies from the Judgment group watched tensely. After all, Dr. Banks' appearance after biocellular alteration was somewhat frightening.
Su Lun walked in and asked, "Doctor, how is it going?"
Dr. Banks didn't stop his work and said, "The spleen, lungs, and liver all have severe trauma; the situation is quite bad. Those two punches would have killed a regular Rank 6 professional. Fortunately, his physique is of a growth-oriented career. I am using the active components of eternal cells to restore his damaged organs. The problem isn't too big..."
As he spoke, his arm transformed into something like black fluid, merging into Barrett's damaged chest cavity.
This method made the watching deputies' skin crawl. It was precisely because the onboard doctor of the Judgment group couldn't handle it that they had brought the injured here. They had not expected to witness a treatment even more bizarre than black magic.
Listening to these obviously severe symptoms being described in such an understated tone, their expressions were extremely complex.
"Oh, that's good."
Su Lun wasn't surprised.
Dr. Banks was not only a top-tier biologist but also a very skilled surgeon.
One could say that as long as a person wasn't dead, there was nearly no chance of dying in his hands.
Just then, the previously unconscious Barrett suddenly woke up.
He looked palely at the "monster" fiddling with his chest, his gaze turning as sharp as a tiger's in an instinctive combat response. But then, catching sight of the deputies and Su Lun out of the corner of his eye, he quickly regained his composure.
Su Lun asked, "How do you feel, Captain Barrett?"
If it hadn't been for Barrett managing to control 'Demon Hand' Dorsel earlier, ending the battle wouldn't have been so easy.
Though he came to save him, Su Lun had reaped a great harvest and now owed Barrett a favor.
Barrett, perceiving his own steadily improving condition, and understanding what was happening, said, "I feel my body recovering."
After a pause, he looked at Su Lun, then at the strange individual treating him, and sincerely said, "Thank you."
Su Lun smiled slightly, unconcerned, and introduced, "This is Dr. Banks, our chief medical officer and biologist of Liberty Dawn."
He didn't go into further details.
The two exchanged polite greetings.
Seeing Barrett on the operating table, Su Lun remembered something and said, "Oh, there's one more thing."
With that, he directly pulled out a glass container from the storage space.
A tank full of greenish fluid held a sturdy silver arm inside it.
Upon closer inspection, one could see clear muscle texture on the silver arm, and even the faint pulsing of veins and nerves.
The texture was metallic, yet the detail was indistinguishable from a human limb.
Su Lun explained, "Captain Barrett, this is the 'Hand of Silver' prosthetic I told you about. I have already tested this, and after integration, it can almost perfectly replace a normal limb. Moreover, it has strong 'memory healing' and 'toughness' characteristics, melding perfectly with flesh without hindering the flow of spiritual power. I even think its performance might be better suited for combat than an original human limb."
He had tested it many times on zombies, and these effects were conclusions drawn from those tests.
'Revitalizing Silver' is a divine material, with features well-documented in ancient texts.
Ancient Great Alchemists highly valued this top-tier material. If it weren't for Su Lun not being an extreme "Explosive Modification Sorcerer," he might have even considered turning his limbs into such metal bodies, greatly enhancing his survivability.
"That amazing?"
Barrett looked at the silver arm in the culture dish, his eyes showing anticipation.
"Yes."
Su Lun nodded, put the glass jar on a table next to the operation table, and said earnestly, "This was part of our deal earlier. Now, the finished product is yours."
Barrett glanced at the arm, hesitated only a moment, then earnestly said, "If possible, could you help me attach it now? I'd like to try it out."
The installation of the unfamiliar prosthetic limb onto the body was a matter that required great caution.
However, after two interactions, he had absolute trust in Su Lun.
Moreover, the loss of his arm had really impacted him greatly. He had been targeted by pirates during this period, and strength was too important for their current situation in the adjudication group.
Since it was his own product, Su Lun also felt that he should include installation and after-sales service.
"Of course,"
he cheerfully accepted and then said to Dr. Banks, "Doctor, could you help me with this?"
"Sure."
Dr. Banks was also eager to try out these interesting surgical procedures.
Su Lun had an eight-limb spider spear, and limb stitching surgeries were all too familiar to him.
Under the cooperation of him and Dr. Banks, they started the busy procedure of reconnecting the severed arm.
...
When Su Lun walked out of Dr. Banks's lab two hours later,
the integration of the Hand of Silver had gone smoothly, and Barrett had not shown any signs of rejection. The task ahead was to observe and see if there were any areas for improvement.
On the sea, the crew was still energetically salvaging spoils from sunken ships.
Su Lun didn't stay on deck long; he returned to the captain's cabin.
There was too much to digest today, both the spoils and the harvested Soul Shards needed a lot of time to process.
Plus, he had acquired the much-coveted "Living Silver."
Su Lun was somewhat impatient.
In his storage ring, there were about ten cubic meters of silver metal, likely all the inventory of the adjudication group.
It must be said, Barrett's generous nature made him a pleasant companion.
Looking at this top-tier puppet metal, Su Lun couldn't hide his anticipation.
He took out the alchemy notebook he had acquired in the Central Prison of Dawn City from Sereya, flipping to the volume that contained details on the "Gargoyle."
The notebook had detailed design schematics and thickly packed data.
During these days, Su Lun had been consciously collecting related materials, and now that the main material was in his hands, he was eager to craft the "ultimate alchemy golem" envisioned in his teacher's notes.
Su Lun placed the mold, blueprints, and materials one by one on the workbench, and after making sure everything was ready, he began the creation.
This task took several days.
....
With Dr. Banks's superb medical skills, Barrett's injury healed quickly.
The installed Hand of Silver achieved the expected results perfectly, not only showing no adverse reactions but, as Su Lun had predicted, this bionic metal arm was even more suited for combat than the original natural limb.
Following the limb repair, Barrett's strength did not just recover to a sixth-order peak but, due to the special properties of the metal arm, he gained a powerful "Iron Arm" that was proficient both in offense and defense. Due also to his life-and-death experiences during this period, he sensed some breakthroughs in his realm.
Su Lun was very satisfied with his own work.
However, after Barrett was healed, he did not stay with the Dawn Squad for the journey but led the "Sacred Judgment Legion" away on their own.
It wasn't that he was rejecting the Dawn Squad's goodwill, but rather because they had urgent business to attend to.
Barrett said that if the matter was resolved, he would look forward to meeting again.
Su Lun didn't ask where they were going.
He knew that, although the adjudication group's members were in dire straits, they still retained their dignity. Even at their lowest, they were reluctant to be indebted to anyone.
Recruiting them now would seem more like charity. For that group of unwilling warriors, it would likely shatter their last bit of dignity.
Su Lun provided them with a substantial amount of supplies and bid them farewell personally.
Later, from some news gathered by the crew, he learned that Barrett and his team had gone on a rescue mission.
The affairs of the "Sacred Judgment Legion" were somewhat complicated; since they last stumbled upon a potential collusion between the royal family and "heretics" in the Cursed Valley, they had been continuously pursued and hunted.
But as they had been drifting at sea, it wasn't easy for the royal household of Luying to kill them.
That's when they resorted to a stratagem.
It seemed that the intelligence department of Luying's military deliberately left some members of the adjudication group alive in the capital, only for them to be captured by slavers and sent to Romandon as gladiators.
They were just waiting for them to attempt a rescue.
The previous pirate attacks were part of Luying's intelligence department's scheme to use others to accomplish their ends.
The news of Barrett's death hadn't been confirmed yet, and it was highly likely that the "bait" was still alive.
So, a rescue was definitely underway.
But such a rescue, clearly a trap, was bound to be fraught with danger.
Now, the adjudication group had bounties posted by Luying, the Bounty Hunters Guild, and the pirate black market. Their appearance anywhere would immediately attract the attention of various forces.
Su Lun thought that Captain Barrett probably didn't want to involve his team, Dawn Squad.
Indeed, it was difficult for Su Lun to get directly involved in the rescue. He could only wait for Barrett to speak up.
Moreover, Dawn Squad had their own matters to address.
...
On this day, the weather was clear.
Standing on the mast, one could already see the coastline at the horizon.
In about half a day's time, they would arrive at the Roman Nation.
Dr. Banks's biological marker led them here, meaning that the "Frost Moon Princess" Skadi was likely nearby.
Su Lun and his team needed to rescue Kai and find those submarines, so naturally, they had to dock and check the situation.
It had been somewhat quiet on the Dawn these days.
The crew wasn't fooling around either, because everyone was busy advancing themselves.
The last battle had yielded several thousand Spatial Implants and fusion materials, which left the members of Dawn Squad spoiled for choice.
Previously, there was no choice, but now, almost every professional could choose to incorporate Void abilities at a certain stage.
Whether it was for combat or survival, "Spatial Ability" was one of the best options.
The spoils of war contained Spatial materials suitable for various professions, and everyone in Dawn Squad found materials that suited them.
Being mostly from the lower echelons, the squad treasured this great opportunity; everyone practiced diligently, aiming to integrate the Spatial materials as soon as possible.
Moreover, with models like Qian Tiao and Su Lun, the crew had aspirational targets, and the atmosphere for cultivation was increasingly improving.
Inside the captain's cabin, Su Lun continued to study the Alchemy Golem.
At this moment, in front of him appeared a three-meter-tall, burly "Gargoyle."
It had a demon-like humanoid body, horns on its forehead, a triangular tail, and sharp fangs, with a pair of massive bat wings on its back. Sturdy and robust, its entire body displayed a thick, dark silver color. If one got closer, they could feel the cold energy seeping from its body surface, and the oppressive feeling of death originating from the material.
After all, the so-called Living Silver was said to be a product of divine flesh corruption.
And this Golem's overall appearance was very "smooth", its head, various joints, buttocks... all had a roundness unlike human structure. This wasn't for aesthetics but was the most stable structure for the material "Living Silver", as researched by Celaire.
Many materials have their most stable forms. Just like ordinary glass, the flat shape differs greatly in the stress it can handle compared to a spherical state.
This detail might seem mundane, but Su Lun had tested it before; the special curvature on the Golem's body could deflect attacks like bullets, a phenomenon one could understand as "curvilinear deflection." Most damage could be reflected, and the attacks did not even reach the Golem's basic defenses.
Previously, Su Lun was merely amazed at the clever design of the blueprint, but only after actually constructing the physical Alchemy Golem did he realize how profound his teacher Celaire's expertise in puppetry was.
So profound that he felt he could only look up to her, although he had reached a master level in "Puppetry," "Engineering," and "Mechanical Studies."
If not for this complete blueprint, Su Lun, even with Living Silver, would absolutely not have been able to create such an exquisite Alchemy Puppet.
At this moment, Su Lun was using an Octo-spear to apply the final layer of coating to the Gargoyle.
His skilled craft allowed him to complete the highest standard of coating he could draw at his current stage.
The materials were top-notch; the craftsmanship could be improved later.
Finally, it was done, and Su Lun let out a long sigh of relief.
Gazing at it, he raised his gun and fired.
With a "clang" sound, the bullet failed to leave any mark on the Golem.
After multiple attempts, Su Lun found that none of the methods in his hands, except the Dark Scythe, could directly damage the Gargoyle.
Thinking it over, he called Qian Tiao.
....
Qian Tiao entered from the deck.
Although both of them slept in the captain's cabin, one half was a resting area, and the other half was a mechanical workshop.
She pulled open the curtain in the middle of the room and, seeing the Alchemy Puppet that Su Lun was examining, asked, "What's up?"
Excitement sparkled in Su Lun's eyes as he pointed at the Alchemy Golem and said, "I want you to help me try out this Gargoyle."
"Oh, you finished it?"
Qian Tiao raised her eyebrows and gave it a look.
She knew that Su Lun had been tinkering with this thing these past few days.
Seeing the finished product, she felt ... it didn't seem very impressive.
At least, this slightly chubby Alchemy Golem didn't look as good as other puppets, nor did it have the intimidating appearance of mechanical combat armor.
When Su Lun asked her to try it out, Qian Tiao naturally knew what he meant.
Her hand on the hilt, a cold light flashed, and a crescent of Sword Qi precisely hit the Gargoyle.
However, Qian Tiao's eyes widened in surprise.
She discovered her sharp Sword Qi was actually repelled?
That slash just now, while not exceedingly powerful, could easily sever a few centimeters of steel.
"Huh..."
With a light gasp, she also noticed something intriguing, "That's quite interesting."
She saw that her Sword Qi had clearly touched the alchemy golem, but it was rebounded right off its surface.
Su Lun seemed quite pleased with this and suggested, "Why don't you try hitting it harder with another slash?"
She asked, "Aren't you afraid it will be damaged?"
Su Lun's eyes revealed a teasing smile, "It's not that easy to damage."
Listenting, she didn't say much. At that moment, flames and air currents suddenly surged around her, she accumulated Sword Qi for three seconds, and then suddenly drew her blade again.
This time, the Sword Qi, filled with dominance, streaked out of the blade and almost at the moment of unsheathing, there was the sound of the blade sheathing back.
On closer inspection, there was clearly a one-foot-long gash on the shoulder of the alchemy golem.
"This..."
She couldn't believe that a slash powerful enough to kill a fifth-tier professional had only left such a small wound, and she found it inconceivable.
Moreover, before the thoughts in her mind could even turn into an expression of surprise on her face, she watched in disbelief as the wound on the alchemy golem miraculously healed!
The Sword Qi had left no trace on it at all.
Seeing this, she exclaimed in awe, "Your puppet is that powerful?"
Su Lun explained with a smile, "The 'Living Silver' not only has extremely high physical and magical defense and a stable structure, it also has a strong memory feature. Once its form is fixed, even if it is cut into two, it can fuse back together and return to its original state in a short time."
Listening to this, she suddenly realized and thought, "This puppet is indeed impressive. With this memory feature, even a sixth-tier professional wouldn't be able to damage it. It's good for safeguarding. Too bad, if controlled by threads, it might not be flexible enough..."
Normally, choosing strong defense means sacrificing some agility. Such a large metal lump, anyone would think it's quite clumsy at first glance.
Thus, she thought, the defense is enough, but in the realm of high-tier professional combat, it could probably only serve as a "shield."
However, as soon as she finished speaking, a strand of blue hair by her cheek stirred in the wind.
Her gaze sharpened, and she caught onto something.
Looking again, the space in front of her was empty, the puppet alchemy golem had disappeared without a trace.
She knew the gargoyle was now behind her, reflecting for a moment, she asked in surprise, "Spatial Teleportation?"
"Yes!"
Su Lun nodded, explaining, "I solidified a 'Teleportation' spell inside it."
This is truly what makes the gargoyle an alchemy "golem."
Because it can use magic!
This is the brilliance in Ceresia's puppet research.
Not only is its form similar to humans, but the gargoyle also has an almost identical meridian system to humans. That is to say, from its design, it was meant to utilize various energies like humans and then convert them into alchemy through the principle of equivalent exchange.
Theoretically, this is like a computer with top-tier hardware; as long as Su Lun could install various "software", it could perform various functions.
Such as spewing dragon flame, releasing lightning, storms, floods, and other spells; it could also inflict stun, pierce, and other types of physical damage.
Recently, his "Space Law" had advanced to a sixth-tier level, and that's why he solidified 'Teleportation.'
With this speed, it temporarily compensates for the golem's clumsy disadvantage.
Unfortunately, Su Lun's current "software" wasn't sophisticated enough. In the future, once it's perfected, this will become an almost flawless alchemy creation without any weaknesses!
Seeing this, she couldn't help but remark, "You really did create a powerful weapon. If there were enough of them, these creatures could probably encircle and kill top-tier professionals..."
Even she found it extremely troublesome.
Alchemy bodies feel no pain, fear no death, and slashing attacks can't inflict fatal damage, which almost renders them invincible.
"Hmm."
Su Lun felt grateful; this was a crystallization of his teacher Ceresia's wisdom, a great alchemy creation, the pinnacle of the Puppeteer lineage of puppet making.
He also thought that a gargoyle legion was a decent idea but then shrugged his shoulders, saying, "But I don't have enough materials, I could only make two or three more at most. Forget about a legion, having a few gargoyle bodyguards will greatly enhance my survival capabilities."
He didn't need quantity now but needed to improve the quality of these gargoyles.
This gargoyle had significant potential for future upgrades.
Apart from not having a soul...a gargoyle is essentially a form of alchemic life.
Thinking this, Su Lun thought of a certain "Pandora" enshrined in the cabin, a bona fide alchemic life form.
If he could study her body, Su Lun felt he might solve many mysteries.
Unfortunately, Pandora would definitely not be willing.
Su Lun thought he could only wait until their relationship improved in the future before considering asking her.

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - 369: 368
chapters.content:
"Captain, we've arrived at Roman!"
"Hahaha... finally, we can unwiind ashore."
"..."
