Not to mention anything else, just dismantling a few columns from this palace and selling them off could support an ordinary person for several lifetimes.
He drifted into the crystal palace with the current, his shock increasingly intensifying.
Inside the palace, countless treasures were placed.
Mountains of Gold Coins, pearls, agate, coral, mithril, crowns, scepters, pure gold statues, swords, ancient armors, utensils studded with various gemstones...
These treasures were piled up in every corner of the palace.
Though time had given these treasures a layer of decay, it couldn't hide the dazzling "glow" of the treasures.
At this point, Su Lun understood why treasures could be seen all over Devil's Island.
It was because the palace could no longer contain them, resulting in treasures scattered everywhere.
Moreover, it wasn't just treasures, there were many magic items too.
The [All-Encompassing Magic Sphere], [Azerim Invisibility Cloak], [Dwarf's Ring of Suffering], [Soul Siphon Crown], [Giant's Shield]...
Although most of the magic items had lost their magical magic power over the endless years, even as materials, these were priceless.
Su Lun felt like a rat who had entered a rice warehouse, where grabbing just a bit would fill him to bursting!
These treasures were once burial offerings presented by countless worshipers of the Sea God!
Su Lun, looking at this massive collection of treasures, immediately had a thought: his mechanical puppet army finally had a destination.
Advanced mechanical puppets needed billions for each production, including those super-large battle mechas and mechanical magical beasts...
With money, everything became possible.
Moreover, in one of the treasure chests Su Lun opened, he saw a gem emanating red, blue, yellow, and green — a product of alchemy.
[Heart of the Four Elements (Slightly Damaged)]
Description: A treasure left behind by the ancient goblin civilization, forged from the 'Rainbow Stone' found in the Elven Sanctuary. It automatically absorbs spiritual power to charge, providing 0.013% automatic energy recovery per second; possesses the ability to convert all elemental energies, with a storage capacity of 8556 alchemy units, and an energy conversion rating of S+; This is a crystallization of ancient goblin wisdom, one of the most perfect energy cores;
"It's indeed here!"
Upon assessing it, Su Lun found himself unable to look away.
The attributes of this item were simply exaggerated!
The best energy core Su Lun could currently create was the[Mono-Elemental Heart]installed inside the gargoyle, boasting a storage capacity of 421 alchemy units and an energy conversion rating of C+. Besides using the "Teleportation" spell smoothly, it was nearly impossible to use any other spells without a horrendously high energy loss.
This had already been master level.
Compared to the core in front of him, it was inferior by more than just ten levels!
Moreover, this[Heart of the Four Elements]could also automatically store energy, fully recharging itself after a few days.
This would save countless energy crystals and demon crystals, which was quite literally saving money!
The most crucial point was, if it were installed in the gargoyle, Su Lun could engrave more spells into it: earth, wind, water, fire... all sorts of spells.
By then, the gargoyle could unleash a[Dragon Flame Breath Technique]with every breath, and a[Windstorm Rending Technique]with every grab...
The gargoyle's silver body could already withstand extensive modifications without collapsing, making it a perfect match with this[Heart of the Four Elements]!
...
"Hiss... this is a true fortune."
Su Lun gazed at the ground full of treasures, his eyes shining brightly.
However, he didn't rush to pack up the treasures, for as long as that[Sea King]was not defeated, no one could take these items away.
What he needed to do now was to find the object imbued with the Power of Faith, as mentioned by Pandora.
That was the source of the[Sea King]'s power.
Su Lun ventured deeper into the Crystal Palace, unaffected by the remnants of the battle outside. He was like a transparent fish, undulating his body, roaming through the seawater.
He swam into several side-halls of the Crystal Palace, circling over mountains of treasures.
Soon, he made another discovery.
Su Lun looked over and also noticed that the more precious the treasures, the more prominently they were placed.
While he didn't find the divinity he was searching for, at the very top of a pile of gold coins, he saw another golden chest holding a piece like a bronze snake fragment.
[Urobolos Fragment]
Description: An incredibly intricate alchemy fragment, approximately one half; carved with the name of the dwarven divine smith 'Iswitt Hammer'; besides possessing an aura of primal materials, you see other incomprehensible *** information;
"Is this what 'Princess of Frost Moon' wanted to exchange with the Sea King?"
Su Lun's gaze slightly hardened upon seeing this.
Merely examining the small snake scales on the fragment conveyed a supremely mysterious feeling, as if they were not crafted by human hands but instead naturally formed.
With his current knowledge and experience, which was extraordinary, the fact that he still encountered information he couldn't comprehend indicated that the fragment's grade was terrifyingly high.
"Could it be that the legendary 'Pirate Emperor' Drake was hunted by a ninth-tier powerhouse because he stole this treasure from Mafa?"
Su Lun guessed some of the pre-death rumors about this[Sea King], and also surmised that this fragment could potentially have originated from the royal family of the Mafa Empire.
But... what was this thing used for?
Su Lun didn't understand.
But it certainly was a treasure.
Thinking that if he could leave the sea ruins, he would definitely take this item, and later there would be plenty of opportunity to gradually figure it out.
Su Lun didn't linger and continued to swim deeper into the palace.
As he progressed deeper, he discovered that this palace group, filled with treasures, was only the entrance to the divine tomb.
After a turn, the view suddenly opened up.
It was a vast pit.
Then, Su Lun saw a scene he would never forget.
In the pit, a massive golden gate violently burst into view.
...
"This... this is too exaggerated!"
Su Lun thought he had seen a land of gold, but upon closer inspection, he realized it was a colossal golden gate that opened downward in the sea.
This giant gate was a kilometer in both length and width, adorned with exquisite bas-reliefs of a female Sea God battling various monsters... At this first glance, the giant golden gate seemed to radiate the brightest gold light in the world. The scorching gold light burst forth, creating a domain of golden light and allowing the resonance of heaven and earth to be heard. An overwhelming, majestic, sacred, and indescribable aura emanated from it...
The deity probably did not welcome creatures disturbing her, and thus, a divine seal barrier was placed on the golden gate.
Luckily, Su Lun had only used the "All-knowing Eye" to look, but even then, his expression was slightly dazed. One could imagine that direct sight would cause immediate addiction to this golden light.
"The divine pressure! This is a high-ranking deity!"
Su Lun looked on with an extremely solemn gaze.
It gave him the feeling of witnessing the will of the "Nature God" descending among the Dalu tribe.
Even though it had perished, it was a terrifying presence.
Seeing this, Su Lun had absolutely no desire to explore what lay behind the golden gate.
He avoided direct eye contact, and at that moment, he saw a pile of gold coins illuminated by the golden light, surprisingly topped with a Baroque-style crown.
The golden base was decorated with flowers and spirals of waves, inlaid with flawless crystals and pearls. The crown's arches crossed at the top, supporting a golden sphere engraved with mysterious runes and a silver-gleaming cross.
Seeing the crown, one would think of a king with great authority.
"Pope Flaydron's Crown"
Explanation: This was originally a magic instrument from the post-Acquirian civilization era, symbolizing power and status. Forged from metal capable of harboring the Power of Faith, it has developed some special effects. Having served as grave goods for tens of thousands of years, it has absorbed a trace of divine Power leaking from the exterior of the divine tomb; now, it serves as Francis Drake's vessel for "pseudo-divinity."
"Found it!"
Su Lun was delighted upon seeing this item.
Another person might indeed overlook this among the myriad treasures in the crystal palace, for there were not one hundred of such crowns, there were at least eighty.
Besides, the area in front of the golden gate was the perfect spot for hiding treasures, requiring no guard. A common person would immediately face the overwhelming presence leaking from the tomb of the fallen deity, likely losing themselves instantly.
Su Lun saw the item and slowly drifted toward it.
But soon, he discovered a triggered rune barrier hidden near the crown.
Invisible to the naked eye, imperceptible, with no touch, it would not reveal itself.
But Su Lun was different; he fused with "Replicated Primeval Runes" at the fourth order, making him exceptionally sensitive to runes.
He only realized upon approaching that those wave patterns were not normal sea currents but a very complex layer of runes!
Su Lun stood pondering for a while without much inner turmoil, then he muttered, "Thirteen-layered rune lock of Luin, secretive enough for alerting, but sadly not complex enough... with Master Joseph Dietrich's technique of loop unfastening, it should unlock."
A pseudo-god is a pseudo-god, perhaps raised to a level by the Power of Faith that Su Lun currently cannot comprehend.
But knowledge, if not accumulated personally, is nonexistent.
The rune level of that Sea King was not very high.
Seeing this, Su Lun's mind began to work rapidly, as any physical trial would trigger detection. He could only calculate in his mind, mysterious symbols spinning, intertwining: ᛇᛗᛘᚱᛟᛯᚭᛊᛔᚠᚯ...
It was like playing blind chess, extremely challenging.
He had to analyze and decode layer by layer, and also remember what he had decoded, requiring vast computational power.
However, this would not defeat Su Lun, as his brain development and multitasking abilities were perfectly suited for such a situation.
He needed high rune comprehension and decoding abilities, a task unsuitable for any other member of the Dawn Group, except for Su Lun.
About half an hour later, Su Lun's eyes suddenly brightened, "Unlocked!"
He looked at the rune prohibition before him, verified it once more without error, and decided to act immediately.
Su Lun removed the shroud wrapped around him, revealing his body in an instant, as a powerful will suddenly swept over him.
Knowing he had been discovered by the "Sea King," he did not hesitate to generate a glowing aura also covered with runes in his hand, then reached out.
As he had already completely decoded the prohibition in his mind, Su Lun grabbed the crown in one swift motion.

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - 387: Sea King's Golden Soul Shard
chapters.content:
Draft
Because he was well-prepared, Su Lun successfully stole the artifact carrying the divine power of the "Sea King."
But he also knew that this was the most dangerous time.
The moment he grasped the icy crown, the surrounding seawater suddenly solidified into a transparent humanoid monster. The "Sea King" could teleport at will within the seawater, a very troublesome ability.
Su Lun had identified this earlier, so without any hesitation, he used "Teleportation" for the first time in the seawater. With a flash of light and shadow, he instantly left his previous position, a tingling sense of a deadly crisis flashing by, as if he had just brushed shoulders with the grim reaper.
He didn't need to look to know that he had just dodged a possibly fatal attack.
Su Lun's combat instincts were fully extended, not daring to hesitate for a moment, he had prepared his hand to form a sorcerer's seals, "Hormone Rampage - Fifth Unleashing!"
A surge of hormones flooded his limbs, veins on his forehead bulging, his muscles instantly knotted and swelled, as if a volcanic force was erupting within his body. The sorcerer's seals transformed again, and his dark golden skin was already faintly shimmering with dense runes, activating both "Rune Vajra" and "Elemental Barrier" simultaneously.
Almost at the same moment as his spell formation coalesced, a powerful water pressure instantly squeezed toward him.
"Snap!"
Su Lun's body was crushed into fragments, bursting into pieces of puppet debris.
He had used "Substitute Puppet."
Su Lun had already appeared several meters away.
Having exhausted two rapid life-saving methods, his gaze intensified. The fifth level of Hormone Rampage caused dark spiritual power to overflow from his body like flames, creating a large controlled area in the sea.
Su Lun also felt that terrifying pressure; dark spiritual power surged out protectively, and fortunately, the Elemental Barrier formed by his law of Death absorbed most of the damage, otherwise, he would have likely burst on the spot. Even so, he felt as if a great mountain was pressing on his chest, and he realized that if he dared to take a breath, he would instantly burst into a cloud of blood mist.
He was well aware that in this environment surrounded by seawater, no external force could block the attack; only his own physically strong body could hold on for a moment, giving him a chance to survive.
Just then, the surrounding seawater suddenly boiled, forming countless sharp water blades.
The water blades swept through like a storm, slicing open the Elemental Barrier formed by the law of Death, cutting into Su Lun's dark golden skin as if they were flaying him.
"Clang," "Clang," "Clang"...
It sounded like a water knife cutting through a steel plate, and Su Lun felt as though his whole body was in excruciating pain as if on fire. If he hadn't recently enhanced the runes inscribed in his body, he might have been tossed into a meat grinder.
Even so, he couldn't hold on much longer. The surface of his skin was lacerated by the water blades, blood exploded instantly, and his vision was filled with red. Fortunately, his muscles and bones were also inscribed with runes, which still supported him.
However, at this moment, a look of joy sprang up in Su Lun's eyes; he knew he had succeeded!
Because at that moment, Pandora finally arrived!
Pandora burst into his view in an immensely terrifying form; her body seemed to be condensed from blood-colored moonlight, standing seven to eight meters tall, surrounded by hundreds of ghosts with blood-colored pupils that were utterly emotionless and horrifying.
As she entered, blood-colored silk ribbons danced wildly, the surrounding seawater steamed away, uttering a soft reprimand, "Tsukuyomi - Lunar Divine Path!"
Su Lun felt the pressure around his body suddenly lighten, and he didn't dare hesitate for a moment, quickly handing over the crown to Pandora.
Holding this hot artifact in his hand meant that the "Sea King" would keep troubling him.
As expected, as soon as the object was handed over, all the pressure around them abruptly dissipated.
Su Lun's mouth overflowed with fresh blood, and he gasped for air. A great relief surged through his heart, and he thought, "Puppet Master, indeed it's the flesh that performs miracles! Teacher Seria had great foresight!"
No matter how strong a puppet is, if the flesh can't endure, it is but an external object.
He also felt fortunate to have such a good teacher who had shown him a clear path.
Only by cultivating both the body and profession, one could have a chance to see the world beyond the peak of an alchemist!
...
Once Pandora obtained the "Crown of Pope Fryley," the Sea King had no intention of troubling Su Lun anymore.
Because Su Lun didn't know the use of that object, but Pandora did!
She possessed a unique way of stealing the Power of Faith, which was the skill Sir Isaac and Teacher Seria initially bestowed upon her when they created the alchemic homunculi.
Their goal was to create a real deity.
The moment Pandora got the crown, a dazzling brilliance suddenly burst from her hands.
Su Lun watched as strands of golden thread were released from the crown and absorbed into Pandora's body.
"She can directly extract the Power of Faith..."
Su Lun understood, his eyes sparkling with clarity.
It was clear that the situation had reached the turning point of the battle.
This was originally the stronghold of the "Sea King," surrounded by the ocean, constantly supplied by an unending force of the elements, practically impregnable.
But once the Power of Faith was extracted, the situation was reversed.
By striking at the root of the "Sea King's" source of power, the foundations were undercut.
Su Lun didn't dare linger in this Crystal Palace for too long, understanding that the closer it was to the end, the more dangerous it would be as gods fought.
Enduring the stabbing pain of wounds corroded by high-level water elements, he teleported to the edge of the aquarium-shaped barrier.
With another Spatial Displacement, he just ran out.
Breathing in the air again, Su Lun felt a huge relief.
He could not interfere with the battle inside the barrier anymore, so he glanced at the multiple blurry wounds on his body, thinking of treating them first. Although these wounds were not fatal, the corrosion from the high-level water elements was like poison and troublesome to clean. It was impossible to rely on just the body's self-healing.
He deactivated the formula of the "Rune Vajra." In that instant, the wounds in his body exploded, spurting out a great cloud of blood mist.
The "water poison" frantically destroyed his body tissues, relentlessly burrowing into the flesh.
Su Lun, expressionless, took out some potions that neutralized the water poison and poured them over his wounds, causing white smoke to hiss forth.
The pain was excruciating, and his muscles involuntarily twitched from time to time.
As Su Lun tended to his wounds, he watched the battle inside the barrier.
The red glow representing Pandora now overwhelmingly dominated, forcing the blue "Sea King" faction into a continual retreat.
The struggle at the brink of death was the most terrifying.
Although the water barrier had absorbed the majority of the energy collision shockwaves, from the outside, the entire barrier looked like a balloon bulging everywhere, ready to burst at any moment.
...
After the battle had continued for over half an hour, suddenly, the water barrier burst like a water balloon with a loud "bang."
The heavy rain poured down from the sky, drenching the forest.
"Is he dead?!"
Su Lun quickly urged the herald bird towards the crystal palace, and sure enough, he saw Pandora standing there alone. After the fierce battle, not only had her aura not weakened, but it had become more ethereal than before. The terrifying pressure in her blood-red eyes was unbearable to look at, fierce aura swirling in her Tsukuyomi Law Phase.
The large-bodied "Sea King" was already lying on the ground, his trident fallen to the side.
Seeing this scene, Su Lun, not caring about the tearing pain of his wounds, hurriedly approached.
He feared some misfortune may have befallen Pandora, so he directly had the herald bird stop in front of her.
Pandora glanced at the black crow, and as if she could see Su Lun a thousand meters away with a single look, she finally showed a hint of mortal emotion and indifferently said, "It's done."
Su Lun, feeling joy upon hearing this, teleported over in nearly the blink of an eye.
He saw Pandora and asked, "Are you all right?"
"I'm fine."
Pandora slightly nodded, withdrawing her Law Phase.
Then, looking at Su Lun again, her pearly teeth slightly parted as she added, "Thank you."
Her tone was not the cold aloofness of the past but an unprecedented gentleness, a heartfelt gratitude.
Su Lun naturally knew what this thanks was for. Watching Pandora with the now dim crown in her hands, he grinned and responded, "No need for thanks. We're just helping each other out."
If he hadn't risked his life to infiltrate, Pandora wouldn't have gained this crown.
The Power of Faith was very important for divine paths. Su Lun felt that she definitely gained a lot from this experience.
Of course, without Pandora, the situation Su Lun and the others faced in the sea ruins would likely have been very dire.
It was a mutually beneficial arrangement.
Su Lun felt that after this experience, their relationship had clearly deepened.
However, there was no time for pleasantries now.
Su Lun saw the golden mist rising from the Sea King's corpse.
It was his first time seeing a golden soul, presumably because this was a demi-god.
This "golden mist" was a true treasure for him.
Su Lun attempted to touch it, and it was like unlocking the gate to a massive library.
Normally, stripping a soul from someone was like peeling apart a book.
But now, though the book was roughly the same, it was extremely "large."
But most of the soul of "Sea King Drake" contained content related to divine faith, not the path of an alchemist like Su Lun, so those parts were of no use to him.
However, many aspects related to universal laws were useful.
Su Lun thought it over and stripped some away.
'You have stripped the soul of 'Francis Drake (deceased)''
'You have gained 'Water Element Law Comprehension 61%', element experience +171412'
'You have obtained a special Divine Rune script [Ximing Laiwa's Sea God Rune], understanding at 15%'
'Spiritual power +12251'
'...'
If he could bear it, Su Lun planned to absorb this "golden mist" completely, a rare opportunity he would not waste.
But just stripping two parts felt like throwing the sea into the ocean, and he immediately felt "overwhelmed."
Su Lun felt dizzy for a moment, nearly losing his balance.
Pandora, nearby, asked unusually, "Are you all right?"
Shaking his head, his eyes still foggy like a hangover, Su Lun replied, "I'm fine."
It wasn't a major issue, but the sheer volume of knowledge he had just stripped made it a bit hard to digest.
He didn't dare to talk more, focusing on absorbing the foreign knowledge desperately before the "golden mist" disappeared, trying to take in as much as possible.
Though Su Lun hadn't completely stripped the Water Law mastered by Sea King Drake, he had acquired most of it.
His current rank was still too low to make full use of such advanced comprehension of the laws, but the path ahead was paved. Going forward, his study and use of Water Element Spells and runes would be smooth.
And that [Ximing Laiwa's Sea God Rune] was what Su Lun most desired, a Divine rune!
This was the tattoo of fish-scale patterns previously on Drake's body.
These were runes passed down by the Sea God Ximing Laiwa. Even Drake had only understood about 15%.
But just this 15% had directly blocked the spatial fissure of the black sickle, enough to demonstrate its power.
The principle of the rune was like a punch thrown into the water, where the force would be partly dissolved by the water's vibrations.
The [Sea God Rune] allowed the layers of Water Element to compact tightly around the body, forming a special elemental barrier that could dissolve even more external forces.
Su Lun had previously felt that his Rune Vajra's defensive power lacked some higher-tier runes. Now, this [Sea God Rune] was a perfect fit!
The rune language in the high-ranking domain, like "Dominance," was no longer merely the peeling off of knowledge but a "world perception ability" on the level of enlightenment. If it weren't for the fourth-order career choice's understanding of runes, he would not even have been able to peel off 1%.
This was the surprising gain that made Su Lun feel excited.
For his future growth, its value even far exceeded that of a sealed artifact!
....
Sea King Drake was killed, and Su Lun was also temporarily free from the pressure of death.
Although there were still other troublesome undead creatures in this sea ruin, without the command of the Sea King, the threat was reduced by seventy to eighty percent.
Su Lun contacted Qiantiao through the communicator, and indeed, the pressure from the monster siege that Dawn Group encountered was also immensely alleviated.
Without the deterrence of the Sea King, those high-ranking creatures, seeing that they couldn't gnaw through this tough bone, gradually scattered and fled.
The people of Dawn Group were making a breakout, heading towards the Crystal Palace.
Su Lun, who was seriously injured and still digesting the knowledge he had just stripped, didn't rush to gather the treasures inside the Crystal Palace but sat cross-legged in meditation at the original spot and waited.
Pandora, although victorious, was not relaxed after a big battle and likewise sat cross-legged in meditation.
After waiting for a while, suddenly there was a disturbance in the jungle.
The sentinel raven was blasted by a shot, and in his perception, hundreds or thousands of soul fires also appeared.
Su Lun opened his eyes, only to realize that instead of waiting for the Dawn Group, he had waited for some adventurers attracted by the battle commotion here.
This group of people, each carrying something on them at a glance, even included some acquaintances.
The man leading a black panther and a fifth-order Big Beard, was naturally the leader of the treasure-hunting group they had previously encountered on the southern side of Devil's Island, followed by a bunch of people with the same team emblem.
However, the leader of this band wasn't Big Beard but a sixth-order, curly-haired middle-aged man dressed in red and black marquis noble attire.
The people from the imperial capital all had an air of arrogance about them; their attire, demeanor, and equipment were noticeably a few levels higher than the average adventure group. Su Lun glanced at the badges on their chests and recognized these as people from the Luying "Adventurers' General Union," probably an officially funded adventure group.
However, he had no interest in dealing with these people.
Pandora didn't move either; even as people arrived, she even hid her face.
...
The forest here was in disarray because of the battle, but precisely because the trees and vines were cleared away, the architectural ruins on the ground were even more visibly apparent.
Even the Crystal Palace in a distant water pit could be seen.
On the ground, the energy of Sea King's corpse had already dissipated, barely discernible. But next to it, the brightly shining trident was eye-catching.
Anyone with eyes could tell that this was definitely a great treasure trove.
Su Lun felt those numerous greedy, burning gazes, and his eyebrows slightly furrowed.
He also heard the excited murmur of those people.
"Look, there's a Crystal Palace over there! My God, I've never seen a palace entirely built of crystal before, this is even more luxurious than the Frederic Royal Palace..."
"My God, I can already see the golden glow shining in the palace, there must be countless treasures there!"
"This Devil's Island is filled with treasures, this place must be a treasure vault. Haha, we're going to be rich..."
"The 'Four Elements Heart' might be here, if we really find it, we could become nobles..."
"Did you notice, that trident on the ground looks like a sealed cursed item..."
"Shush..."
"..."
That group was completely dazzled by the treasures everywhere; looking at those treasures, they even completely overlooked the two strangers in front of them.
It's understandable, even Su Lun's state of mind was not calm upon seeing those treasures before, let alone some common adventurers.
Leading the black panther, 'Red Nose' Myles naturally recognized Su Lun, and he had a favorable impression of this young man who had previously offered them kind advice, not perceiving him as an enemy.
Moreover, the restless scratching of the black panther at his side seemed to remind its master not to make certain dangerous moves.
Seeing the adventurers already mesmerized by the treasures, he quickly spoke up, addressing the curly-haired marquis, "Chairman Siegel, the 'news of the sea ruins' I mentioned to you before was informed by this gentleman. We..."
He got this far in his speech but suddenly choked on his words, clearly unsure how to proceed.
Normally, treasure hunting followed a first-come, first-served rule—whosoever found the treasures first owned them.
But in reality, on the lawless islands of the wild seas, few adhered to this rule, and there was little difference between adventurers and pirates.
Besides, with such a multitude of precious treasures before them, Myles knew everyone would definitely not give up.
They had over eight hundred people, would they easily relinquish the treasures to two individuals?
He was willing, but his companions definitely would not be.
"Oh?"
Hearing this, the curly-haired man named Siegel narrowed his eyes and began sizing up Su Lun and his companion.
His gaze was sharp, and he was also assessing the strength and risks of the people in front of him.
Su Lun's external injuries appeared severe; "sea poison" made his wounds heal very slowly. He seemed utterly drained, and despite so many people arriving, he remained in meditation. It gave the impression that he couldn't lift a hand due to heavy injuries.
Little did they know, this was simply because Su Lun didn't want to deal with them.
Siegel's hand rested on the handgun at his waist as he asked, "Which group are you with?"
Su Lun responded expressionlessly, "Dawn Group."
Their Dawn Group's information would inevitably become known to others after this incident, so there was no harm in revealing it.
"Oh?"
Siegel seemed uncertain about where exactly the confidence in the attitude of the two before him stemmed from.
If he were a top-tier professional, this seasoned adventurer who had spent years at sea should have heard of them to some extent.
Yet this "Dawn Group" sounded completely unfamiliar, as if it were a minor third-rate team.
However, although he had not witnessed the previous battle, he had experienced its aftermath, which was certainly not a minor skirmish.
Siegel's eyes shifted but he did not underestimate Su Lun's strength, and he cautiously proposed, "This Devil's Island is rich in treasures, and since we've all met by fate, let's uncover them together."
His words were clever, not asserting who arrived first. Proposing to develop the treasures together was also a way to test the other party's reaction.
"No. I think you're misunderstanding something."
Su Lun sighed slightly, seemingly troubled, but elaborated further, "Previously, a very powerful undead creature occupied this place, and we expended great effort to kill it. By the rules, the treasures here belong to us. If you wish to hunt for treasure, look elsewhere."
Upon hearing this, the expression of the 800 opponents across gradually turned dangerous.
Were these two unable to read the situation?
If they had agreed to the proposal to excavate together, they might have shared some treasures.
Were they intending to monopolize everything?
Their "Prince Carnap's Treasure Hunt Group" was not to be trifled with.
In Luying, no one dared to offend them.
Moreover, in the eyes of the royal official adventure groups, any group that wasn't royal was not a problem.
Upon hearing this, Siegel's expression also soured as he scoffed, "Your Excellency intends to monopolize the treasures here? Heh..."
Ultimately, as a noble, he still cared for some semblance of dignity. He mocked and then retorted, "My subordinate had discovered a crystal palace here earlier. Your Excellency just happened to appear here for unknown reasons. Now you claim the treasures are yours, do you think that's appropriate?"
Give up?
That was naturally impossible.
Since negotiation had failed, the only option left was to take it by force.
He, a distinguished noble, had already shown immense kindness by allowing a lowly adventurer to share a slice of the cake, and this fellow still wasn't satisfied?
The talks had now collapsed, and at this moment, the man with the black panther, "Red Nose" Myles, interjected to make peace, saying, "You see, sir... we are from 'Prince Carnap's Treasure Hunt Group.' The gentleman here is the Prince's trusted aide, the Honorary Vice-President of the Adventurers' Guild, and an Imperial noble. We came here…"
He felt that when they had encountered each other previously, Su Lun had kindly cautioned them about the situation here.
The current stance didn't seem too favorable.
Reminding the other party of one's own status here could also prevent getting into trouble best avoided.
Otherwise, even if the treasures here were taken by some "Dawn Group" and brought back to Luying, they would still have to be relinquished.
But before he could finish, Su Lun interrupted him, saying sternly, "I have said all that needs to be said. This is a treasure discovered by our Dawn Group. If you want treasure, look elsewhere."
He paused, then looked at a few members of the so-called Judging Group he had recognized earlier, and added, "Also. I said I know your Captain Barrett, and he is here on the island. So, if they want to make a move, it's best you guys don't get involved."
Upon hearing this, "Red Nose" Myles and a few members of the Judging Group looked extremely troubled.
Given the sensitive nature of the "Judging Group" at this time, was it appropriate to bring up this topic?
At this, Siegel glanced sideways at his subordinate Myles, guessing something yet ominously making no scene.
He stared at the unyielding Su Lun and no longer masked his threat in his tone, "What do you mean, Your Excellency? Are you also acquainted with Barrett, that traitor?"
Su Lun knew these guys were bent on murder for treasure. Uninterested in explaining a third time, he said, "If you want a fight, bring it on. If not, get lost!"
At these words, Siegel's spirit immediately lifted.
Real or not, he now had a perfectly legitimate reason to fight.
He shouted aloud, "By Her Majesty's order, anyone associated with the traitor is to be killed without mercy!"
With that, he instantly drew the firearm at his waist and pulled the trigger at Su Lun.
"biu~"
A blue light burst from the muzzle.
When that shot was fired, apart from the black panther group who remained still, nearly everyone raised their firearms and opened fire.
....
Su Lun had noticed earlier that the man's waist holster carried a Magic Energy Handgun.
This Magic Energy Gun was a type of powerful Alchemy firearm that the Luying Royal Academy of Sciences had been developing in recent years. It not only fired alchemy bullets, but the entire firearm structure was also a specially designed Magic Conductor. It was essentially a supplement for the shortcomings of gunmen in the field of high-level professions.
But the Magic Energy Gun was powerful indeed, though slow to reload and incredibly costly.
Apart from nobles, nobody else could afford to use such a device.
Su Lun watched the barrage of gunfire and explosions without flinching.
For at that moment, a burly figure suddenly appeared before him, and his imposing, thick silver arm struck and shattered the blue light with one punch.
The figure's puppet body moved in front of Su Lun, taking the full brunt of the gunfire and cannon fire behind him.
After positioning himself,
the air only then filled with a series of "pop" "pop" "pop" explosive sounds!
The group finally recognized the disheveled yet resolute man.
The few from the black panther group immediately knew him, and with a mix of joy and shock, exclaimed, "Captain Barrett!"
Barrett nodded slightly without saying much, just side-stepping to reveal Su Lun, clearly indicating that his identity was special.
Simultaneously, Tsukuyomi also suddenly appeared on top of a stone pillar. Her hand on the hilt of her sword, she lazily looked down at the group eyeing them eagerly, and muttered, "Oh... seems like someone wants to mess with our Dawn Group..."
At that, it sounded as though a large number of people were converging from the jungle.

chapters.title: Chapter 389 - 388 Moving the Palace Away
chapters.content:
Su Lun never showed mercy to his enemies.
From the moment those guys harbored the intent to kill and seize the treasure, every single one of them who fired their guns had to die.
Perhaps feeling that their numbers were roughly equal, the "Prince Carnap Treasure Hunt Team" still held blind confidence they could win.
Without waiting for the members of the Dawn Group, who were still rapidly gathering in the jungle, to come closer, the would-be baronet Siegel issued an order, and the members of the Prince's team actually made the first move.
Suddenly, the roar of guns and cannons exploded in the air.
Bullets poured down on Su Lun's side like raindrops.
But once the fight began, those guys realized that they had hit a hard spot.
They had overestimated themselves and underestimated the Dawn Group.
Normally, the equipment of the official Luying adventurer groups was many grades higher than that of the civilian groups, and the average combat power of professionals was also much higher. Under normal circumstances, encountering other groups, the advantage would always be on their side.
But just as the fight broke out, the firepower of the "Prince Carnap Treasure Hunt Team" did not have any advantage at all.
In the jungle, fierce return fire responded.
They did not know that the equipment of the Dawn Group was previously seized from the elite units of the North Sea Fleet. Although it was pirate equipment, it was military supplies smuggled over from Mafa. In terms of firepower, it was not inferior to Luying's military equipment, let alone some adventurer groups?
Even though the members of the Dawn Group were still a great distance away, the precise single-soldier cannon shells had already covered the area.
This response speed, tactical arrangement, combat capability, and individual soldier quality...
Anyone with insider knowledge could tell at a glance, these were professional soldiers!
After this attack, the members of the "Prince Carnap Treasure Hunt Team" realized that the enemy in front of them was not some third-rate wild group, but the Luying Royal Knights equipped with Mafa weaponry!
They regretted taking action.
What was thought to be a confident equipment advantage instantly turned into being suppressed.
But they could only continue to fight.
Moreover, during this exchange of fire, a massive disadvantage that made the "Prince's Team" even more desperate immediately became apparent.
Only then did they realize that the gap in high-end combat power was also very large!
....
Barrett watched the enemy make a move, stamped his foot fiercely, and his figure instantly vanished from the spot.
There were several "pop" sounds in the air.
A shadow flashed, and the next moment Barrett had already appeared in front of Siegel. His fist, which twisted the light, was hurled out with full force.
Facing this overwhelming momentum, Siegel's face showed utter horror. He tried to dodge, but he found his body restricted by an eerie force field, unable to move as if he was trapped in a quagmire.
As a sixth-order professional himself, how could he not understand what this meant?
This was suppression by rank, a field of energy created by the laws of power.
This was the sign of a near-seventh-order level!
After just this encounter, Siegel was frightened to his core, crying out in his heart, "He... Barrett has actually condensed a power field?!"
The "Domain" condensed by the seventh order is the watershed for top-tier professionals. The Luying Empire had many geniuses, but this barrier had stopped ninety-nine percent of the people their entire lives.
He hadn't expected Barrett to have half-stepped into the seventh order already?
Moreover, what shocked him even more was yet to come.
With a punch thrown out by Barrett, Siegel barely managed to avoid the critical spot by relying on his lifesaving abilities. But even being hit by that punch, he was sent flying like a cannonball. The punch directly shattered his protective aura and severely damaged his internal organs.
The power was far beyond imagination!
"How is this possible... Wasn't Barrett said to have suffered a great decline in strength due to a severed arm, only retaining the power of a fifth-order?"
Siegel violently spat out a mouthful of dirty blood, his eyes filled with disbelief.
Although he was a sixth-order professional, he was far inferior to a professional soldier like Barrett, who had grown up in the Royal Knight Corps since childhood.
Thinking that the opponent only had the power of a fifth-order, Siegel had been so assertively decisive in taking action.
But now, upon clashing,
It was damn well near the seventh order!
Everyone knew of the great battle in the city-state of Morlos that night. But not many truly knew what had transpired. Almost all attention from various forces was on the "Temple of Aghaparnon Theft" and the "Princess of Frost Moon Assassination" concerns.
Few knew that the people of the Sacred Judgment had been rescued, nor did they know that Barrett, merged with the Hand of Silver, now possessed a strength even stronger than his peak!
"How is it possible, ah, how can a strength-based professional lose an arm yet not decrease in strength but instead become even stronger?"
Siegel couldn't make sense of it at all.
He had previously seen Barrett's silver arm and thought it was a mechanical arm, paying no mind to it.
It was only after taking a beating did he realize that the fist was much stronger than anticipated.
But reality left no room for his regrets, Barrett punched someone and sent them flying, then forcefully stepped forward and gave chase once again, with the intention of thoroughly decimating his foes.
Siegel's face was filled with despair, fully aware that he was no match at all.
"Thud," "Thud," "Thud"...
The force of the punches was like exploding cannon fire.
He could only hastily block them, and after taking a series of heavy blows, his body was sent flying around like a punching bag.
In Siegel's heart, there remained a sliver of hope that his several fifth-tier squadron leaders would come to his aid and together they could encircle Barrett.
But upon seeing the sudden appearance of "thunderous lightning" in the sky, Siegel truly despaired.
That heaven-reaching Sword Qi was sharply imposing from afar, and he could clearly see that his subordinates were each struggling to save themselves, so how could they come to help him?
Out of the corner of his eye, he looked at the six-armed female swordsman, his face ashen, already foreseeing his end.
Inside, his heart was filled with unwillingness and confusion.
The second form of the [Rakshasa Woman], Sword Intent, domineering aura, famous blades...
Such a mighty warrior, wherever placed, would be a person whose name resounded throughout the region. How could there be absolutely no mention of this person at sea?
...
Qian Tiao, with her six arms and six blades, murderously charged into the crowd.
To deal with these people, she didn't even need the third form of [Rakshasa Woman]; just the Thunderous Sword Qi stimulated by the Demon Blade was enough to overpower most of them.
Lower-tier combatants were harvested in swathes, while only those of the third and fourth tiers could barely withstand a few strikes.
It seemed Qian Tiao didn't plan to exert her full power. After killing a wave of people, she targeted the two fifth-tier combatants in Prince Carnap's group.
She fought against the two alone, pressing them into retreat at every turn while still having plenty of energy to spare.
At this moment, the lower-tier combatants from Prince Carnap's treasure-seeking team were utterly astonished.
If all their team leaders were forced back so miserably, what were they to do?
To the side, the only ones who hadn't joined in the battle were 'Red Nose' Myles, the leader of the 'Black Panther Squad', and several dozen core members.
Faced with the choice between a financier and friends, they chose their friends.
Previously, just hearing from Su Lun that he knew Barrett may have made the decision difficult.
But now, with Barrett miraculously appearing before them, where would they take action?
If it weren't for a life-and-death friendship, Myles wouldn't have pulled strings to buy the loyalty of several members from a holy team.
Besides, the Black Panther Squad had no ties with the other teams; they were merely strangers on the same path, each paid to be there.
Moreover, he was now extremely relieved that he had not taken action.
This "Dawn Squad," though not famous, had strength that was certainly not to be underestimated!
Whether it was their equipment or that female swordsman, their power was surprisingly strong.
Myles thought if his old friend, known as 'Ferocious Beast' Alek Barrett, was helping out, the Dawn Squad would definitely not suffer a loss in this battle.
But thinking this, thinking this...
Myles was also seized by a trace of doubt.
He turned his gaze towards the young man who was wounded.
The very person who had caused his magical pet 'Beibei' to feel extremely uneasy from the first time they met was right before his eyes.
So what about him... would make the spirit leopard feel "extremely dangerous"?
He didn't seem to exhibit any special traits.
Before the members of the Black Panther Squad could dwell on their doubts,
At that moment,
An assassin from the Prince's team, a fourth-tier combatant, set his sights on Su Lun.
After all, being a battle-hardened high-tier assassin, he made his own judgment.
He saw that Su Lun's identity was absolutely not simple, and he thought to either kill or capture this key figure to perhaps turn the tide of the battle.
Amidst the intense battle, the assassin used a large tree to conceal himself and then stealthily entered a state of stealth.
On the battlefield, it seemed no one noticed his existence.
The injured young man appeared to have no awareness at all.
'Red Nose' Myles saw it, his gaze sharply narrowing. Just as he was about to say something was amiss, hesitating on whether to speak up and warn them,
It was at that moment, out of nowhere, a winged creature teleported in front of the young man. With no forewarning, it reached out with a grab, pulling the fourth-tier assassin, who was hidden in the air, out of stealth. Before the man could react, the winged creature struck with a heavy blow, smashing the assassin hard into the ground with a "boom," creating a spiderweb of cracks on the surface.
It was then that everyone clearly saw that the winged creature was actually a metallic automaton.
"A Puppet Master? What kind of automaton is this?"
Myles frowned deeply at the sight of the automaton with its dark golden sheen, which even made him, a fifth-tier professional, feel a sense of crisis.
It turned out that this puppet was the source of the young man's calm composure.
The members of the Black Panther Group all revealed a sudden realization, and it was fortunate that they hadn't had a conflict the first time they met, otherwise this puppet would have indeed been a big problem.
But the black panther became restless at the sight of Su Lun suddenly getting up.
Myles felt the anxious emotion of his companion that "wanted to flee immediately" and suddenly woke up, looking at Su Lun and exclaiming in his mind, "No, it's not the puppet that Beibei fears! He... he has another ace up his sleeve!"
...
The battle erupted in an instant; the troops of the Dawn Group had not yet assembled, and Su Lun did not want these treasure-hunting killers to escape.
He had almost finished assimilating the stripped knowledge and could now spare the energy to deal with these scoundrels.
Although his physical injuries were indeed serious, for a Puppeteer, combat power was not solely in the physical body.
The gargoyle continued to hammer down heavy punches on the fourth-tier assassin, but Su Lun did not take another look.
With both hands forming sorcerer's seals, quickly behind him condensed eight-armed spider spears, and a giant cross in the sky instantly solidified.
With one hand, he pulled out two sealed scrolls, and exclaimed, "Unseal!"
A series of spatial fluctuations burst forth, and hundreds of differently shaped runic puppets appeared before his eyes.
The "Prince Group" used the complex terrain of the rainforest to engage in guerrilla warfare, and even with the Dawn Group in pursuit, the killing efficiency was not high, and it came with great risk.
However, to charge through the jungle, puppets could not be more suitable.
With the eight-armed spider spears behind Su Lun unfurling, the puppets charged into the forest emitting "click-click" noises that made one's skin crawl.
Even without looking, he could easily sense the location of those people's souls.
When encountering a difficult opponent, a few slashes of the black scythe in his hand could swiftly decapitate them.
Su Lun harvested the lives of his enemies with an expressionless face, while the gargoyle protected his surroundings, capable of both fighting and defending, not feeling the slightest threat from the enemies that outnumbered them by hundreds.
Once the puppet army made its move, the enemy completely lost any advantage they had.
Seeing this, the bystanders from the "Black Panther Group" were utterly dumbfounded.
The operation of this one person controlling hundreds of puppets stunned these adventurers who had seen the world in Emperor Luying's domain.
And it was only now that "Red Nose" Myles understood why "Beibei" was so uneasy.
The strength of this young man in front of him was truly frightening.
A single person facing a large adventure group of several hundred, not falling behind in the slightest,
also meant that he could just as easily kill them, the Black Panther Group!
Luckily they had not made an enemy of him...
Cold sweat streamed down Myles' forehead.
Just then, the main force of the Dawn Group finally arrived.
They charged into the forest, forcing the "Prince Group" enemies into a retreat.
...
The fate of the Prince Group's annihilation was sealed from the moment they decided to trouble the Dawn Group.
The battle in the jungle was extremely bloody, with corpses everywhere; the Dawn Group swept through with an overwhelming force.
After the main force arrived, Su Lun joined forces with Qiantiao to kill those two fifth-tier leaders, then they surrounded and attacked the sixth-tier together.
Barrett's combat strength was now very strong, originally killing Siegel wouldn't have taken too much effort, but for some reason, it had taken longer than expected. To end the battle quickly, they all joined in to help.
Before long, the battle was over.
Siegel was slain on the spot.
Under normal circumstances, it would be Su Lun's turn to harvest knowledge.
But while stripping the soul of this man, Su Lun also peeled away some strange things.
"You have stripped the soul of 'Siegel Kuhn'"
"You have comprehended some 'Fragments of Calamity Law'"
"You have acquired knowledge on 'Magic Energy Firearms'"
"You have learned some intelligence about Emperor Luying's capital"
"You have a piece of obsession: 'I am a member of the 'Giant Hermit Society', the great master has bestowed upon me extraordinary powers, enabling my advancement to the sixth tier...'"
"Spiritual Power +11.2"
"..."
Su Lun had stripped the souls of sixth-tier professionals before, but the amount of knowledge he gained from Siegel was far greater.
This was like... a half-baked sixth-tier.
Moreover, he stripped a very strange piece of information from him; this guy was clearly an alchemist, yet he was a member of something called the "Giant Hermit Society."
That appeared to be a "religious organization."
The corpse's memories revealed an unmistakable reverence for a certain existence.
Su Lun wanted to know more about that mysterious organization, but he discovered that some key memories had been erased, such as the object of worship and the ritual processes...
He stood beside the corpse with a furrowed brow, pondering for a moment.
Now that the Luying royal family had issued a new decree proclaiming freedom of religion, indeed many strange cults had emerged within the territory of Luying.
It would not be easy to use external forces to achieve a breakthrough from the fifth to the sixth rank.
Thinking of something, he turned to Barrett, who also looked puzzled, and asked, "Mr. Barrett, what do you think?"
Barrett pondered for a moment, "It's a bit like that 'heretic' we encountered before."
"I think so too."
Su Lun nodded as well.
It was in Cursed Valley that Barrett had lost an arm, a gift from that "heretic".
As he said this, he suddenly beckoned with his finger.
The strands of thread in between immediately tensed and sharpened like a scalpel, then made a cut across the corpse's chest and extracted a blood-drenched heart.
At first glance, there appeared to be a blood-red worm entwined around the heart.
The worm, seemingly sensing the presence of the living, stretched out its body like a bloodthirsty leech, reaching out in all directions.
Seeing this, Su Lun's pupils suddenly narrowed as he thought, "It's really this thing!"
He immediately called out through the communicator, "Dr. Banks, could you come over here?"
Dr. Banks had a great interest in odd and peculiar creatures and had conducted extensive research on them.
He carefully examined the heart that Su Lun had placed into a glass jar, mumbling to himself, "This worm seems to be a creature from an extraplanar space. The Plane of Calamity? Oh, that sounds like a very bad place. I've read about it in some ancient text before."
Su Lun was at a loss with the worm but felt it might be significant, saying, "This worm can't live for more than a few days outside the body, not even in a reanimated corpse."
Dr. Banks replied, "Hmm. I'll give it a try. I should be able to keep it alive longer."
...
Once the battle was over, it was time for the joyful task of harvesting the spoils.
There were vast treasures in the Crystal Palace, and the members of the Dawn Group excitedly transported them to the surface.
Before long, the treasures on the shore had piled up into a mountain.
All kinds of riches glinted in the sun, dazzling the eyes.
"Be careful, everyone; Mr. Su Lun said not to go deep into the Crystal Palace..."
"Hey, Jack, just pile those gold coins to one side; this is the box for magic treasures—don't waste space with gold coins!"
"Oh, the [Elemental Ivory] has a strong curse property; Hannah, bring a sealing box to Captain Black Feather!"
"Let's pack up the treasures first, then dismantle those crystal structures and put them on the shore!"
"Right, Team Three, if you can dig out those stone carvings and statues, especially the ones with inscriptions and bas-reliefs... Hey, brothers of the Steam Team, your mechanical arms have some serious work to do."
"..."
Some were counting, others recording, while yet others carefully distributed and packed up the treasures.
For an average adventure group, the treasure inside this Crystal Palace would've been impossible to handle; even seeing it would mean not being able to take it away.
Because there was just too much.
The members of the Dawn Group went from the initial shock, excitement, and ecstasy to later feeling numb, as if picking up gold coins was as mundane as picking up stones.
In this ruin, the least valuable treasures were the various gold and silver artifacts.
With a thousand members in the Dawn Group, each person carried at least one half-cubic storage ring, but even then, after strapping all their gear on their backs, they were filled to the brim.
Eventually, they could only pack up the excess and leave it on the ground.
Moving so many treasures to the ship would have been a time-consuming and laborious task.
Fortunately, they had Su Lun.
Su Lun's principle for treasure hunting was clear: as long as there was no danger, scavenge every part of the Crystal Palace.
Including the palace itself.
The crystal pillars, each longer than a typical sea vessel, were impossible to move unless broken down, which would have been a shame as their value would drastically decrease.
Such large natural crystals were exceedingly rare, used in certain super-large alchemical arrays, valuable commodities not found in the outside world.
The crossers of the Dawn Group disassembled them one by one and hoisted them out of the water with cranes, then piled them up on the shore.
Su Lun's "Little Void World" also came into great use; although it drained a lot of his shadow spiritual power, he managed to fit those large objects in, one little piece at a time, like ants moving a house.
This time, the Dawn Group reaped a great harvest.

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - 389: New Comrade, Sea Emperor Class Battleship
chapters.content:
```
The Crystal Palace was full of treasures, too many to salvage in a short time, and the members of the Dawn Group were somewhat weary after a series of tough battles, so they pitched tents by the lake to rest and recuperate.
There was no distinction between day and night in the Sea Ruins, and the glow from the alchemy lamps illuminated the tents scattered throughout the jungle, everyone bustling about busily.
With Kama, the attentive little apprentice, taking care of setting up the tents, Su Lun found it rather comforting.
The injury he sustained was "water poisoning" strengthened by Divine Power, indeed tricky, but, fortunately, with Dr. Banks's help, he was recovering not too slowly.
By the time the treasures of the Crystal Palace had been completely salvaged, two days had passed.
It was then that the members of the Dawn Group broke camp and set out.
...
Through the dense jungle of Devil's Island, the thousand-person troop stretched out very long.
Since the Sea King had been killed, those undead creatures in the Sea Ruins lost their leader and couldn't gather in large numbers.
This posed not too great a threat to the Dawn Group.
Higher-order creatures usually have not insignificant intelligence, sensing that Dawn Group was not to be trifled with, few sought to cause trouble. However, occasionally, passing by swamps or riversides, they would disturb one or two hibernating high-level undead creatures, which were quite troublesome. But with the focused fire of the Dawn Group's members, they could be handled without much risk, and the group proceeded with utmost caution.
Devil's Island was vast, and it took the large force a full day to reach the sea.
This excursion yielded a huge amount of treasures, exciting everyone.
In the middle of the troop, Su Lun walked shoulder to shoulder with a thousand others, surrounded by Kama and a few other youths from the group.
Tanni, the kid, had been excited since last night because he had acquired a great treasure.
At this moment, he was showing off the new spell he had successfully mastered. He conjured a large water ball with his trident and excitedly boasted, "Lolota, Kama, look quick, I can now conjure the second-order mystic spell 'Water Elemental Imprisonment'!"
This spell was exceedingly complex, and even many of the established second-order professionals in the group found it difficult to grasp. It was truly astonishing.
Kama listened and just smiled without saying a word.
Lolota gave him a white glance and said in an ethereal voice, "It's only because Mr. Su Lun gave you that treasure. Otherwise, you'd be a long way from conjuring this spell."
Tanni didn't mind acknowledging this fact and showed off the trident in his hand, his pride nearly sending his behind skyward, and said, "Exactly! Mr. Su Lun's 'Aegir's Trident of the Sea God' is a sealed artifact level treasure!"
While saying this, he also didn't forget to shout a thank you to Su Lun, "Thanks, Mr. Su Lun."
Su Lun, hearing this, just smiled and nodded.
'Aegir's Trident of the Sea God,' a seal-level artifact capable of controlling waves and considered a treasure of the water series, was of no use to anyone in the group. Su Lun had given it to Tanni to practice controlling water elements and, at the same time, to see if he could awaken his innate ability to control the wind and waves.
Other members of the Dawn Group overheard and also revealed friendly smiles.
Giving away a sealed artifact so readily was unheard of in any other team, even the wealthy Ruying royal family. Although the Dawn Group had only been established for a short while, the atmosphere grew increasingly harmonious with each passing day.
Hearing Tanni boast like this, Lolota flicked her ponytail and harrumphed.
Due to her relationship with Qian Tiao, she was already very familiar with Su Lun and could be considered half a disciple of his.
Like her teacher, the lass had developed a rather carefree attitude. She immediately ran up to Su Lun's side with a tone of grievance, "Mr. Su Lun, you're playing favorites..."
```
Su Lun couldn't help but laugh and cry at the situation, where the insinuation was clear, and he could only respond, "Haha...next time if I get one, I will make sure to get a famous sword for Lolota too."
On hearing this, Lolota immediately perked up, "Wow~"
But before she could even get excited, she was hit on the head with the sheath of a sword.
She turned her face to Qiantiao next to Su Lun, looking aggrieved, and said with a pained expression, "Teacher, why did you hit me again~"
Qiantiao replied irritably, "All day long, not practicing swordsmanship seriously, just thinking about external objects. When your Sword Dao reaches a certain level, naturally you will encounter good swords. Otherwise, even if I gave you 'Zongzheng', one of the 'Twelve Fine Craftsmen's Famous Swords', you wouldn't be able to wield it."
"Oh."
Lolota, being chastised, lost her spirit and pouted, "I understand, Teacher."
At these words, the others laughed even more brilliantly.
...
Meanwhile, at the end of the group.
Barrett and the leader of the "Black Panther Corps," 'Red Nose' Myles, were casually chatting.
Old friends meeting, they were full of nostalgia.
The major incident with the Judgement Corps caused an uproar throughout Ruying, and with an imperial command from the Empress herself, no one thought Barrett would survive.
It was as if they had already said their final farewells.
Moreover, if it hadn't been for encountering the Dawn Corps this time, it's likely that the Black Panther Corps would have faced total annihilation in this "Sea Ruin".
This meeting was not easy to come by.
The two friends, not having seen each other for a long time, still had endless topics to talk about since they met yesterday.
They also took everything in front of them into their view, watching and sharing a laugh.
Looking at the harmonious atmosphere of the Dawn Corps, Myles sighed with a mix of envy and emotion, "Your Dawn Corps really is a very special team. That young man is indeed extraordinary. However, I'm also curious why you, Barrett, with a temper that dares to throw your hat at an imperial marshal, would serve as a squad leader. If you had been willing to pick a side back then, you wouldn't need to be leading troops in battles all the time. By now, you'd probably have been a 'Major General' and wouldn't have come across such an incident..."
This old friend was also puzzled, as aside from the Mafa Empire, it was hard to imagine any other force that could willingly enlist a general like Barrett.
"The Judgement Corps has become a thing of the past..."
Barrett shook his head with a bitter expression, as those old stories were no longer important.
Honor, military rank, social status—all had dissipated like smoke.
Having gone through this ordeal, he had come to understand far too many things.
His gaze fixed on the path ahead, he spoke with profound meaning, "Su Lun is a very courageous and insightful young man. The Dawn Corps is also quite exceptional, everyone is outstanding. In the future, they will certainly shine brightly."
Myles, listening, did not ask further but recalled the scene of yesterday's battle in his mind, "I, too, am looking forward to it."
Talents in the Ruying Imperial Capital were numerous as carp crossing the river, but he had never seen such an extraordinary young man.
Moreover, it wasn't just the combat ability of one individual; the entire Dawn Corps seemed to exude a vibrant and flourishing vigor.
With these thoughts, he let out another long sigh, "A decaying empire is like the setting sun, truly making it hard for one to see a sliver of hope. Now that you've told me, I only just found out how dire the situation in Luying has become. If not for the many things that still concern me, I would really wish to join you in welcoming the light of dawn..."
Barrett's expression was also very complex, as he shook his head with a light chuckle.
At that moment, Myles seemed to think of something, sighed softly, and then said, "Ah. I wasn't much help this time either. After hearing about the troubles with your Judgement Group, I ran a lot of connections in Lindon. Your old teachers and classmates from the War Academy also tried all kinds of methods, but to no avail. The Empress herself issued the orders, and no one dared to defy them."
Barrett shook his head, having grown indifferent to many things, "My old friend, you've already helped me a great deal."
Myles kept sighing, saying, "If you have a chance to return to Lindon, please visit your old teacher, General Rostov. He tried to vouch for your Judgement Group, to save your families, but was suppressed by opportunistic politicians in the Congress, and also suffered a lot of repercussions, relegated to staying at home."
Speaking of this, his tone suddenly became indignant, "Even such a loyal old general received such unfair treatment; the empire will sooner or later be gnawed to the core by those damned arms dealers and filthy maggots!"
Listening, Barrett's expression darkened, "Mm."
...
The "Devil's Island Treasure" attracted over one hundred thousand treasure hunters, and these past two days have seen a continuous stream of unsuspecting adventurers entering the Sea Ruins.
The sounds of battle were heard everywhere on Devil's Island, and through the mist, one could occasionally see the flash of cannon fire on the distant islands.
The Dawn Group had personally tested it; the Sea Ruins were filled with countless undead monsters, but not all adventure groups possessed the strength of the Dawn Group.
The adventurers lured here by the treasure, were destined to suffer heavy casualties and death.
Su Lun and the others now planned to leave the Sea Ruins, but they had left some carved markings with inscriptions along the way on Devil's Island. These inscriptions explained the truth about the treasure and also how to leave the Sea Ruins, it was their way of giving any surviving fortunate souls a chance at life.
Now, to leave, they needed a battleship.
Previously, two of the Dawn Group's three warships had been destroyed. Upon reaching the shore, they found that the last one left was also badly damaged by monsters.
Clearly, that dilapidated ship was incapable of carrying them all away.
But now, they had a better option at their disposal.
Su Lun had also been keeping an eye on that imperial-class warship, the "Eternal Night Emperor".
During the initial cannon battle, Dr. Banks had left a mark on that black-sailed warship.
Now, Su Lun and the others made their way there and successfully found the legendary battleship quietly anchored in a cove.
Next to it were over a dozen ancient, tattered ghost ships.
Without the Sea King, the wars
hip was like a throne with no king, evidently proud yet somewhat desolate.
But this was good news for the Dawn Group.
The fewer ships there were meant the fewer endless undead monsters there would be.
Su Lun and the Dawn Group crew observed from the clifftop for a long time. The harbingers of death flew in cycles, while the Perception-based professionals exhausted all their methods, ensuring there weren't too many high-tier undead monsters.
Only then did they decide to mount a full assault!
Soon, the battle commenced.
"Team One, intercept at the bay. Team Two, clear the other ghost ships. Team Three, come with me and clear out the monsters in the 'Eternal Night's' hold!"
"Everyone check your ammunition and prepare for battle!"
"..."
Under Barrett's command, the members of the Dawn Group charged into the bay.
Perhaps because those undead monsters had dispersed to chase various adventure groups, there weren't many monsters here—about ten to twenty thousand.
It was a bit troublesome, but not too much to handle.
With Su Lun's dozens of mechanical octopuses appearing, the rickety ghost ships were utterly destroyed.
As the Dawn Group assembled and pushed forward in a military formation, Su Lun harvested "gray mist" all the way, preventing the monsters from reviving. Their momentum was unstoppable, like a sharp dagger plunging deeply into the monster horde.
The battle was orderly and proceeded without any unexpected incidents.
After Barrett and Qian Tiao took down a few high-ranking undead monsters, the battle completely entered its final stage.
The people of the Dawn Group successfully boarded the "Eternal Night Dawn."
....
What is the experience of boarding a "Sea King class" warship?
The ship, over three hundred meters in length, really resembled an aircraft carrier!
The expansive upper deck was so spacious that one could even drive quad bikes on it.
A cursory inspection revealed that the masts were permanently solidified with seventh-tier rune variants, the [Moises Sturdy Runes], designed specifically for the materials, truly bringing integration to the extreme. Additionally, the runes on the masts were not isolated but connected with the entire warship. This allowed its defense to be integrated; an attack on a mast meant the whole ship would absorb part of the energy impact.
The wood of the ship was [Gold Oak cursed by Demon Gods], a mythic material hard to come by.
Even the ropes onboard, determined to be woven from the whiskers of the magical creatures [Mountain Fish Cats], were so durable that they hadn't decayed for hundreds of years. But the arm-thick ropes coiled on the deck were perhaps a few thousand meters long, the amount of whiskers used almost unimaginable.
And most astonishing was that the ship's keel was not wooden but the actual skeleton of an ancient [Blue Dragon]!
Even the sails were not made from woven materials but from the skin of [Deep Sea Lantern Fish], possessing extreme toughness, pressure resistance, and corrosion resistance...
After boarding the ship, Su Lun, worried about hidden dangers, carefully inspected it from end to end.
It was this careful examination that left him increasingly astounded.
Every detail of the ship was used to perfection.
Though large, the ship was like an intricately carved piece of art, with details that showcased the wisdom of the legendary shipbuilding Grandmaster Moises.
This was a masterpiece of the highest artistry in sail warship building.
This was a ship that, even with blueprints, could not be replicated.
...
Scattered sounds of combat emerged from the cabins, where the members of the Dawn Group were clearing out the monsters lurking in the shadows.
This enormous warship had six decks, dividing into countless cabins with a structure as complex as tunnels.
Ammunition hold, cannon hold, storage room, watertight compartments, kitchen, ship's energy hold...
An extra-large dining hall?
Oh, that's something unimaginable on any other sail battleship. I heard that only those super-large Qi warships of the Mafa Empire are luxuriously equipped like this.
Previously on Su Lun's three "second-tier battleships," the crew had to fend for themselves during meals, finding a spot on the deck or squatting in some corner to eat.
"Hahaha...this time our Dawn Group has a fine ship indeed!"
"Oh, the number of barracks, enough for each of us to have one to ourselves! The sound insulation of the cabins is so good that I no longer have to listen to Sandru snoring loudly after a night."
"Haha, yes. This ship was probably built to accommodate 5000-10000 people. Even if we had several times more people, it could fit them all. My God, the legendary 'Sea King-class' battleship, it's really too extravagant!"
"..."
The crew was also excited.
A ship is akin to their second home, and having such a good ship improved everyone's living environment dramatically.
Following the group members, Su Lun continued to clean downwards, determined to clean the "Eternal Night Emperor" spotless.
Because there were still many special chambers concealed by spells that limited perception.
As they cleaned, they encountered several centuries-old evil spirits formed from the resentment trapped on the ship. These things had to be cleared out, or they would surely create some "supernatural incidents" for the people aboard at night.
With Su Lun's black umbrella out, he directly harvested them as fertilizer for the umbrella.
As they installed magic lamps along the way, these dark chambers that had been neglected for centuries were lit up for the first time.
Before long, they arrived at the cannon chamber, where the undead creatures had already been wiped out.
The crew was busy unloading spoils from the bodies and throwing the skeletal frames into the sea.
Owing to his ability to sense the layout of space, by the time Su Lun got here, he already had a clear understanding of the ship's structural diagram in his mind.
The three-layer cannon chamber was interconnected, designed ingeniously.
It was amazing that, after so many years in the sea ruins, the powder in the ammunition sealed chamber was still very well-preserved!
This one chamber housed nearly sixty cast iron cannons, each weighing several tons, some even tens of tons.
Because those spirits had fired them two days ago, the chamber was filled with a strong smell of gunpowder.
Barrett knocked on the thick barrel with his hand, producing a series of dull thuds and muttered, "Yo, these hulks haven't rusted at all, the foundry work is really good."
Barrett also looked at these ancient cannons and remarked with some emotion, "This M1817 cannon was the most advanced cannon there was two hundred years ago. There are still a few samples in the Ruying War Academy museum. These have the mark of the Luying military shipyard. In those days, except for the royal navy, it was impossible to get them through any other channel. I wonder how these pirates managed to get their hands on them..."
Thinking it was probably the doing of some greedy arms dealers, after all, the scenario of arms dealers dominating the council had persisted for centuries.
Barrett just shook his head.
Pausing for a moment, he added, "These cannons were made big and long to achieve range, taking up a lot of space. Back then in naval battles, having several hundred cannons was invincible. But now, even a random cannon bought on the market can match the power of these cannons. They are smaller and more convenient."
Listening, Su Lun also smiled, thinking of many possibilities for retrofitting and said, "Yes. With the current number of two hundred cannons on one side, we could crush any sail battleship in a cannon battle. If we switched to modern cannons, we could have several times the number, given the same weight. Hmm... We could also add some shipborne rapid-fire cannons, anti-ship missile launchers. We could even add steam mechanical boilers to provide some extra power when necessary."
The exaggerated displacement of the "Eternal Night Emperor" could support much heavier equipment.
With the technology that had come about in the past two hundred years, Su Lun, being a mechanic himself, thought of countless possibilities for retrofitting.
But the problem was, where were they going to find so many advanced cannons and retrofit equipment?
The best shipborne cannons were with the Luying military.
One or two might be found on the black market, but to equip them in bulk...
They'd have to plunder the North Sea Fleet, these pirates!
Oh no!
There was also Duke Raphael!
Su Lun had once witnessed Duke Raphael's colossal steel battleship, and the Duke had secretly developed many fine things under his command.
As the topic reached this point, Su Lun and the adjacent Barrett exchanged glances, and in each other's eyes, they saw the significant smiles emerge.
They were pirates now.
Building your own takes too long, when robbery is quicker.
....
Before long, Su Lun and the others continued their cleanup all the way on
this "Eternal Night Emperor," which was the pirate ship of the Pirate Emperor Francis Drake back in the day, and they also found some valuable antiques on board.
But after all, the Dawn Group had just come out of the Crystal Palace, and everyone had been numbed by treasure and such. After a quick inventory, there was nothing particularly exciting.
"Everyone, clean up the cabins. From now on, this will be our Dawn Group's battleship!"
"Okay! Brothers, let's get moving..."
"..."
Apart from the structure of the ship itself, almost all of the accompanying items had decayed.
This would be the new home for the Dawn Group, and the crew got started on the cleaning enthusiastically.
All ship functions were intact, and the shipwrights and mechanics began their patching and maintenance to ready the ship for long voyages.
After cleaning up the creatures, Su Lun and the others were about to head up.
But just then, a voice echoed from the hold. It was Tanni's voice, "Mr. Su Lun, could you come to the cockpit? There's been a slight... issue."
Su Lun looked up to see that the voice was coming through the intricate brass tubes in the walls.
Two hundred years ago, there were no mechanical communicators, but such a large ship still needed prompt communication. So the captain's chamber and cockpit were connected to all the important cabins by "communication tubes."
Shouting into these tubes could send the voice to specific places.
Tanni had probably figured out how these antiques worked. Having communicators was useless, and he was testing them out for fun.
...
Su Lun made his way up and soon arrived at the spacious cockpit.
As the chief navigator of the Dawn Group, Tanni naturally made this place his domain, staying here upon boarding the ship.
But now, looking at his worried and frowning expression, it seemed like he had encountered some trouble.
As soon as Su Lun entered, he asked, "What's wrong?"
Tanni pointed to the ancient steering wheel marked with the sign of the years and said somewhat speechlessly, "Although I feel I shouldn't say this, it seems like it's 'haunted'... Just now, I clearly didn't touch it, but the wheel moved on its own. I checked, and there's nothing wrong with the structure, just that the gears and bearings need oiling."
Haunted?
Su Lun raised his eyebrows and retorted, "The steering wheel moved by itself?"
Lorota, standing beside him, also expressed her confusion, "Yes. Mr. Su Lun, I saw it too."
Kama added, "Teacher, I saw it too. But I didn't detect any trace of a ghost."
Tanni shrugged his shoulders to show he wasn't making things up and then twisted his head to describe the odd feeling in his heart, "Moreover, I feel... like this ship is different from others. It seems like it doesn't quite enjoy being controlled by someone."
For materialist alchemists, supernatural incidents were almost always regarded as special phenomena caused by the overflow of abnormal energies.
But hearing the three of them say this, Su Lun began to take the matter seriously.
Using the All-knowing Eye to evaluate the situation revealed nothing special; the cockpit was full of antiques, a few alchemical devices, but nothing out of the ordinary.
