The Major-General charged forward, and before he arrived, the "Magical Energy Magma Python Knife" he wielded in his mechanical arm stabbed forward like a whip. The high-temperature red whip boiled in the seawater, and swathes of white steam rose before the eyes.
Seeing this unit appear, Su Lun knew the mechanical octopuses would be ineffective against it and didn't waste them trying to block its path.
Without dodging or evading, he continued to swing the black scythe, slashing at the lower-tier controlled mechanical warriors. Occasionally, he even had time to lash out at the submarines twice, creating gashes and forcing the crew to accelerate their ascent.
In the blink of an eye, the scalding red whip came slicing through the boiled water vapor; Su Lun spared it only a peripheral glance, and a massive figure appeared at his side, absorbing the blow with its robust body.
With a "snap," it seemed as though one could hear the sizzling sound of something being scorched.
One had to admit, the "Magical Energy Magma Python Knife," capable of penetrating the protective aura and elemental barrier of a tier-6 professional, was indeed formidable. Even though the gargoyle's defenses were so strong that even the black scythe struggled to cut through, this whip left a charred wound an inch deep, revealing a metallic shine with a silvery hue.
But in an instant, the wound on the gargoyle healed as if it had never been there.
Seeing this, Su Lun's slightly furrowed brow also relaxed.
Since the whip didn't bother the gargoyle, the battle could almost entirely proceed according to plan.
With many new functions, the current alchemy golems couldn't be defeated, if not kill the enemy outright.
Equipped with the "Four-Color Elemental Heart" as the energy core, if it came down to endurance, it would surely outlast that Major-General's mechanical battle suit.
As long as he persisted a little longer, Su Lun's goal would also be achieved.
The Major-General, seeing his whip was ineffective against the gargoyle, clearly knew this to be a Puppet Master's trick.
He didn't tangle with the puppet and once again the power boiler charged up, his form quickly changing position against the strong water resistance. The rushing and teleportation made explosive-like commotion in the sea, which was extremely exaggerated.
Unfortunately, no matter how many times it teleported, the gargoyle's instant movement was always there to block its path beforehand.
The Teleportation technique, though with intervals, was still much faster than the mechanical battle suit, and was completely within Sur Lun's control.
The gargoyle Su Lun controlled held back the enemy's strongest Major-General, greatly reducing the threat from the rest.
...
Even with the appearance of the Major-General, the attackers were not killed, and indeed, the people on board the three Mafa submarines panicked.
The submarine surfaced in a very short amount of time.
Su Lun also stepped onto the back of the submersible and emerged from the water, where he could clearly see that it was an enormous vessel over one hundred and fifty meters in length and more than twenty meters wide.
The other two combat subs were much smaller, only about eighty to ninety meters long.
Once they reached the surface, the mechanical octopuses were also exposed to the air.
As the hatch on the command tower opened, hundreds of mechanical warriors clad in various types of battle armor filed out.
These mechanical warriors fearlessly entangled themselves with the mechanical octopuses, with a few taking on one, using ship-cutter swords, siege hammers, powerful demolition tools... all sorts of methods were utilized in an effort to rapidly clear away the octopuses.
Su Lun, however, had no intention of letting things go their way, and seized the moment to slice down with his black scythe.
At the same time, with a "whoosh" sound, a signal flare shot into the sky and exploded into a splendid firework display.
This was clearly a call for reinforcements.
Although Su Lun had used a signal jammer to block the signals in this sea area, he couldn't prevent this kind of physical method of calling for reinforcement.
"Time to end the battle quickly..."
He muttered to himself, clasping his hands in a magician's seal, and instantly crosses condensed in the sky.
Then, tossing out several scrolls, hundreds of curse dolls appeared on the surface of the sea.
While the Rune Vajra dolls were strong against professinals, they were nearly ineffective against these fully-armed mechanical warriors.
But the warriors hadn't noticed that among those Rune Vajra dolls, there were a few [Siren Banshee Dolls] hidden within.
As Su Lun was setting up the puppet army, he popped open his black umbrella with a bang. The spell he had been preparing for quite some time was just about to coalesce when he gave a soft cry, "Nightfall Domain, activate!"
In an instant, nearly a hundred thousand wraiths burst forth from the umbrella, turning the sea surface into a ghastly spectacle.
With its strong necromancy spell penetration, although the wraiths couldn't invade the armored suits with spiritual defense right away, the attack was sustained. As long as one stayed within the domain's range for long enough, they would eventually be influenced by the wraiths.
There was an original shortcoming to this move—if the opponent didn't succumb immediately, they could escape the range of the wraiths.
But now, Su Lun was practically "guarding the corpse."
He stood on the submarine, and the mechanical warriors, in order to protect the submersible, had to come close for a melee attack.
But once they got near the coverage range of [Nightfall], they would be affected.
As for ranged attacks, they were also severely limited.
Patterns like fish scales emerged on Su Lun's skin, clearly the [Ximing Laiwa's Sea God Runes]. Alchemical bullets struck him, creating ripples like those on the surface of water, yet they were completely harmless.
Although the mechanical battle armors were equipped with heavy artillery capable of destroying ships, they also dared not fire at will.
The range of the artillery was too wide. It wasn't clear whether they could damage Su Lun, but it would definitely damage the submarine.
No one dared to fire recklessly.
...
Mystic attacks are the last thing mechanical warriors want to encounter.
Only magic could defeat magic.
The black umbrella's function had been experienced by that "Commodore" before, and it was clear they were prepared for it.
It was after the "Nightfall Domain" unfolded that the equipment compartments on the arms of the mechanical warriors clicked open, revealing neatly arranged magic scrolls much like potions. Among them, a white scroll shot out, detonating in midair and emitting a "Holy Light Technique" that burst forth like the dazzling white light of a flash grenade.
Dozens were released at once, illuminating this vast expanse of sea.
The red spirits released from Black Umbrella were caught off guard and a portion of them were instantly burnt by the Holy Light, while some retracted back to the bottom of Black Umbrella.
Su Lun looked on impassively. "Holy Light Scroll?"
The Nightfall Domain he was now deploying, driven by his Death rules, wasn't something a low-level Holy Light Technique could dispel.
Even with the Light rules as a counter, to dispel his technique, at least a Level Six kind of law from the realm would be needed. But scrolls of that caliber weren't readily available. Normally, a Sixth Order Magic Scroll required a Level Six professional to spend several days crafting, with a high cost and a limited shelf life.
It was absolutely impossible to mass-equip them as regular war preparedness resources.
This batch of third- and fourth-order scrolls only managed to slightly slow down the erosion of the evil spirits and were of little effect.
The presence of Su Lun remained unsolved.
The Major, still entangled with the gargoyles, made the mechanical warriors commanded by the Colonels and Lieutenant Colonels seem too feeble and ineffective against Su Lun's methods.
Instead, constrained by the mechanical octopus, Su Lun was reaping mechanical warriors one after another with his black scythe.
Mechanical warriors kept pouring out of the submarines, and swarms of puppets were blown to pieces. However, Su Lun found the opportunity to let the "coincidentally" demolished corpses of the [Siren Dolls] fall into two of the attacking submarines.
The pressure-resistant shells of submarines have a very high technological content, able to defend against most spiritual and sonic attacks. Only by throwing them inside was there a chance of injuring people.
...
Su Lun looked like he was about to destroy the submarines,
while the Mafa mechanical warriors, heedless of their own lives, were intent on protecting them,
so the battle was very fierce.
It looked like Su Lun was gaining the upper hand, but actually, his mechanical octopus was also heavily damaged in the battle.
Killing a thousand enemies, he might not have lost eight hundred, but certainly five hundred.
But his face displayed an exceptional composure throughout.
It wasn't that he didn't care about his hard-earned possessions; he was actually waging psychological warfare.
He was waiting for the giant submarine to open its hatch before persistently controlling the mechanical octopus to continue slicing the hull.
It seemed like he was there to damage the submarines, but he couldn't really afford to sink the ships.
If he delayed any longer and exceeded the planned time, he would have to retreat.
By then, though he would have killed some mechanical warriors, he would also have lost most of his mechanical octopuses, which could only be considered a pyrrhic victory.
That was not the outcome he wanted to see.
Although it pained Su Lun to see his hard-earned mechanical octopuses being spent, he continued the consumption.
He knew the other side was definitely more panicked than he was!
In everyone's mind, this was a premeditated ambush.
If the enemy dared to make a move, they must have secure confidence.
Moreover, it was an enemy encountered time and again.
And sure enough, Su Lun gambled right!
Just then, the hatch of the large submarine suddenly opened, and a distinctly shaped mechanical warrior was ejected out.
The mages knew that if they didn't kill Su Lun, the consequences would be disastrous.
Even if they managed to hold out until reinforcements arrived, they would suffer heavy losses.
They couldn't afford to gamble.
It was the moment the hatch opened that Su Lun felt a spirit rush in, and he let out a sigh of relief in his heart, "Finally, there's a chance!"
That spiritual projection was naturally the art of Astral Projection from Pandora.
This was the most crucial part of the plan.
As long as Pandora's spiritual power could invade, those inside who were not wearing battle armor could be controlled. The value of this vessel could then be preserved to the greatest extent possible.
But before Su Lun could rejoice, at that moment, the mechanical warrior in mid-air suddenly turned its head.
Within the All-knowing Eye, an unfeeling red light eyeball was seen.
[Alpha Laser Alchemical Eyeball]
Quality: Dark Gold
Description: Red eye effect, piercing gaze.
Curse Characteristics: Can quickly determine the target material's defense state and energy barrier type, emitting laser beams of different wavelengths accordingly, causing 100% penetration to targets not above the item's level of law, along with additional effects such as burning and light corrosion damage; users who have not comprehended high-order light-related laws will consume a significant amount of life energy and suffer permanent blindness;
Explanation: A product of alchemy from the Dawn Era, a magic eye forged from a Void Evil Eye, releasing a fatal beam of light at the cost of blindness; extremely fast attack speed, by the time you see it, it's already too late;
It was upon this eye-to-eye meeting that Su Lun internally cursed.
People usually think that mechanical warriors, being far less advanced in alchemy research than ordinary professionals, are less likely to possess such odd cursed items.
Mafa may have started with mechanics, but that doesn't mean they lack traditional professionals.
The one before him is an alchemist disguised in battle armor, using a very dangerous cursed item!
As the red glow lit up in the enemy's eyes, his body visibly withered away.
Yet, it was this glance that made Su Lun feel as if his scalp was exploding.
He had never underestimated the enemy.
But the weird and bizarre cursed items in this world are truly endless and unpredictable.
How fast is the speed of light?
Almost simultaneously as Su Lun saw it, the red light had already struck his forehead.
The red light penetrated his Death Barrier as easily as poking through paper, then like a sharp knife, it drilled fiercely into his skull.
Fortunately, he was bolstered by [Rune Vajra]
Skin, muscle, and then bones, were all engraved with runes.
Su Lun felt as though his head was about to explode from the intense burning.
But it was this momentary resistance that gave him the chance to teleport.
"Swoosh~"
Next thing you know, Su Lun had appeared several meters away.
He was panting heavily, his back already drenched with cold sweat.
Luckily, the runes inscribed on his skin were [Ximing Laiwa's Sea God Runes], divine-grade runes that, even at 15%, had a principle level far above most top-tier techniques.
Had he been protected only by [Rune Vajra] before, he would have been instantly killed by that red light.
"Damn!"
Having walked the line of death, a curse burst from Su Lun's heart.
As he teleported, he swung the black scythe in his hand, decapitating the individual who had unleashed the red eye.
Su Lun tugged on the threads and pulled the metal-embedded head into his hands.
Without lingering, at that moment, Pandora's psychic message came through his mind: "We've got control!"
His heart lifted with joy, the fear from his brush with death instantly dissipating.
Having control over the people inside the submarine meant that half of the plan was already a success.
He immediately sent a message: "Close the hatch door. Miss Pandora, please protect me for a moment!"
Pandora responded promptly: "Okay!"
No sooner had she spoken than the hatch of the submarine was sealed shut. A figure clad in a cloak approached over the waves and landed beside Su Lun.
Seeing Pandora by his side, Su Lun's sense of security soared, and he spoke quickly, "Thanks for your help."
Pandora nodded slightly in acknowledgment, "Mhm."
With such an unfathomable ally at his side, Su Lun had no more concerns and didn't bother to go after the mechanical warriors. He clasped his hands together, and a black hole slowly began to form in his palms: "Alchemy·Void Whale Swallow!"
Then he looked at the submarine and slammed his palm down.
As dark spiritual power was infused, the black hole grew larger and larger.
That's right!
Su Lun's plan was to seize this submarine right in front of the Mafa mechanical warriors!
....
Almost exactly as Su Lun had anticipated, right when Pandora took control of the large submarine's crew, Chien sent over an urgent message.
"Su Lun, we've been attacked by the main force of the North Sea fleet. We've managed to stop the first wave, but a powerful enemy is on their way. We can hold out for a maximum of half an hour. Be careful over there."
"Good! That should be enough time!"
After responding, Su Lun didn't say more, continuing to channel dark Spiritual Power to make the mouth of the [Void Whale Swallow] technique grow larger.
To "swallow" such a submarine over one hundred meters long was indeed a risky move!
It required a significant amount of time.
As the black vortex in Su Lun's hands grew, the Mafa crew realized what he was attempting.
The enemy didn't intend to sink the submarine fleet; they wanted to hijack it!
Good heavens, are these people mad?
The admiral was fraught with anxiety and disbelief.
But he couldn't escape the harassment of the gargoyle, only able to watch helplessly as the black hole in Su Lun's hand got bigger and bigger.
"Damn it, the enemy's real goal is to take 'Royal Number 7'! All combat personnel of Ship One and Ship Two, come out of the bay and kill the enemy with all your might!"
"Yes!"
At that command, mechanical warriors from the other two submarines also began to emerge from their hatches.
But an unexpected scene occurred.
No sooner had those mechanical warriors been ejected than they began to tumble into the water in a drunken state, falling with a splash.
"Heh."
Su Lun watched, his eyes slightly narrowed, not the least bit surprised.
He had thrown a few "Siren Dolls" into the submarines just a moment ago, and those subsonic waves, imperceptible to the human senses, had been covering the area for quite a while now. They might not be lethal, but they were certainly sufficient to cause a group of physically weak mechanical warriors to become dizzy and disoriented.
Taking advantage of the opportunity, Su Lun controlled a zombie to swing its black scythe and reap a few more soldiers.
....
"Damn it!"
Watching his subordinates fall into the water one after another, the commodore's face turned ashen. He swiftly retreated hundreds of meters, leaving the coverage of Su Lun's puppet theater.
Since he knew that the enemy's intention wasn't to sink the submarines, there was no need to protect the vessels at the cost of their lives.
He had also realized that Su Lun needed to stand still to cast his Spatial Techniques, presenting a rare opportunity.
But he was also reluctant to take the risk.
Sink the "Royal No. 7 Secret Mechanical Research Institute"?
No,
If the vessel were sunk, all the precious research instruments inside would be destroyed—an immeasurable loss!
It wasn't just a matter of financial and technological loss; numerous researchers would be lost as well.
The catastrophic consequences could even affect the alliance between Mafa and the King of the North Sea!
That was more responsibility than a commodore could bear.
Without an explicit order from Her Royal Highness Princess Stika, no one would dare make that decision!
But if they didn't sink it, there was still a glimmer of hope.
This was the Void Domain. If reinforcements from the North Sea Fleet, the true experts, came to their aid, they could still retake it!
With this in mind, the commodore immediately issued an order: "Everyone, attack from a distance! Do not harm 'Royal No. 7' but kill those two first!"
"Yes!"
Upon receiving the order, the hundred or so mechanical warriors also stopped their tussle with the mechanical octopuses and withdrew hundreds of meters away.
Then they raised their guns and bombarded Su Lun and his companion.
Su Lun watched as the mechanical warriors left and did not control the mechanical octopuses to chase them. Instead, he continued cutting through the other two submarines.
With the current situation, it was certain that the other two warships were beyond reach, but he also couldn't leave them for the enemy to chase after them later.
Just then, the sounds of "crackle and pop" rang in his ears as various bullets and artillery shells fell like rain.
Su Lun controlled the gargoyles to shield him, and the Alchemical Golem stretched its huge wings wide, blocking almost all the attacks.
The occasional bullet that slipped through was hardly painful.
For the artillery shells, there was Pandora.
This Alchemical Automaton displayed an amazing feat of catching artillery shells with bare hands, shocking Su Lun considerably.
Looking at the intensity of the attack, Su Lun knew the enemy had reservations and lacked the resolve to sink the submarine.
However, this was as he expected.
Had it been a regular submarine, it would probably have been sunk by now, vessel and crew together.
But now, having confirmed it was the "Secret Mechanical Research Base," the people of Mafa certainly weren't willing to destroy it.
Technology, equipment, personnel—these were all priceless treasures.
Especially the technicians brought from Mafa, if lost, were gone for good.
Moreover, Su Lun had received word from Qian that high-rank professionals had bypassed their blockade and were heading straight over. In no more than ten minutes, they would arrive.
Therefore, the people of Mafa probably thought they "could still counterattack" and therefore refrained from using their most devastating weapons.
The "commodore" had led several charges in an attempt to cause trouble for Su Lun and disrupt his casting.
But not once did they manage to get past Pandora and the gargoyle's interception.
Helplessly, they could only watch as time slowly ticked away.
Both sides were playing for time.
....
Thus, they were at a deadlock for several more minutes.
"Void Whale Swallow," this technique was terrifyingly draining on dark spiritual power, Su Lun's face was ashen from the continuous output, showing signs of nearing collapse.
And the progress of the technique in his hands looked to have reached only halfway.
This successfully deceived the enemy.
But in reality, Su Lun had already completed ninety-nine percent of it.
This was a little spatial trick he had stripped off earlier, using some special layers of space to confuse visual perception!
Suddenly, a look of joy burst from Su Lun's eyes: "Got it!"
Guessing the enemy's reluctance to destroy the submarine was one thing, but there was a risk involved.
After all this suspense, he was waiting exactly for this last moment.
The cost he had previously paid was about to be rewarded a thousandfold, even ten thousandfold!
Struggling against the sensation of impending collapse, Su Lun changed the sorcerer's seals once more, and the black hole suddenly expanded by a hundred meters, visibly engulfing the entire submarine.
As the technique was retracted, the massive submarine disappeared without a trace from the sea's surface.
"Got it inside!"
Su Lun's heart surged with ecstasy as he instantly lost his strength.
No longer caring about tidying up the aftermath, Pandora grabbed hold of him, and with the Moon Reading Illusion Technique employed, dozens of shadows remained on the sea's surface.
The people of Mafa wanted to pursue, but after chasing a short distance, the lights and shadows dissipated, and where could any trace of a person be seen on the sea's surface?

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - 394: Mechanical Warfare Workshop
chapters.content:
The calm sea surface slowed down Su Lun and Pandora, having shaken off the Magic Emperor's pursuers.
Having hastened their journey, several high-grade demon cores in Su's hand had been drained into powder, and only then did the pallor on his face begin to ease.
Just now, having stored that submarine in the mini Void World had drained his dark spiritual power, which had now recovered a layer or two, finally reducing his feeling of total exhaustion.
Su Lun took a deep breath and turned to Pandora, who had been with him all the way, and said, "Thank you."
Pandora was habitually reticent, merely nodding and responding, "Hmm."
However, now was not the time for pleasantries.
Initially, it was just about trying his luck to verify the actual existence of that "secret Mechanical Research Academy."
Unexpectedly, his luck was phenomenal, striking the jackpot on the first attempt.
It was only after Su Lun harvested some memories from the mechanical warriors on the submarine that he realized the vessel was "Royal Number Seven." It indeed belonged to the princess of Mafa as part of her dowry and was also a technical support extended to King Oleg of the North Sea. The submarine carried Mafa's most advanced mechanical equipment and mechanical engineers, its value immeasurable.
Now that he had the goods, both the princess of Mafa and the North Sea fleet would definitely go insane trying to search for them.
This Void Sanctuary was not a place one could leave at just any time; departure depended on specific ocean currents and wind directions, too.
Taking advantage of his recently recovered dark spiritual power, Su Lun took out a spatial scroll and shouted softly, "Unravel!"
A small assault boat dropped into the water.
The two boarded, and as the steam boiler started, the small boat sliced through the sea, creating a streak of white waves, speeding off.
After making a round, they picked up Dr. Banks, who had evacuated earlier, and Su Lun steered the small boat toward the northwest.
...
The Void Sanctuary was vast, easily the size of a duchy.
The North Sea fleet, vast as it was, couldn't possibly defend every location.
Moreover, Su Lun knew almost everything about their defensive positions.
Driving the assault boat, Su Lun navigated toward the blind spots in the watchtower's surveillance. A quarter of an hour later, he saw the "Eternal Night Emperor" slowly approaching in the darkness.
This was the meeting coordinate planned in advance.
The battle happened in the southeast; the meeting point, in the northwest, perfectly evaded the pursuers.
Su Lun and his two companions leapt onto the ship, where the members of the Dawn Group greeted them warmly.
The fight they just had in intercepting the pursuers had also been fierce, with evident signs of cannon fire damage on the Eternal Night.
Su Lun looked around, his concern evident as he asked, "Sister Qiantiao, did you encounter any mishaps here?"
There were many bloodstains on Qiantiao's clothes, but she seemed unconcerned as she replied, "No, we sank two ships that were pursuing us, killed some people, no big issue. The Eternal Night is faster than their ships, and we quickly lost them."
After saying this, she asked, "How about you?"
Su Lun replied, "Very smoothly."
Hearing this, Qiantiao raised an eyebrow and said, "Yo. Seems like we really hit the jackpot this time."
"Yes, the haul was substantial."
Su Lun nodded and briefly explained, "Just as Dr. Banks predicted, that submarine housed a 'secret research facility.' It took some effort, but I managed to capture it just now."
At these words, joy appeared on the faces of everyone in the Dawn Group.
They all knew the value of a Mafa mechanical research facility and began to whisper excitedly among themselves.
"Did it really succeed? My gosh, that's incredible."
"Mr. Su Lun is unbelievably strong, to forcibly capture a Mafa submarine? You know, that's guarded by a brigade of colonel-level mechanical warriors, something not even an entire fleet could easily overcome..."
"Well, it's Mr. Su Lun, after all!"
"Hahaha, with such a precious thing stolen, King Oleg and the princess must be nursing some serious headaches now, perhaps even breaking their alliance..."
"Mafa's mechanical technology is decades ahead of Ruyin's. Once Mr. Su Lun decrypts it, the Dawn Group will also have cutting-edge technology... Oh, those cannon fires we endured were really intense; now, we're even."
"..."
The people chatted and laughed joyously.
Clearly, however, this was not the time to celebrate, as the lookout in the watchtower had already spotted the enemy approaching.
Su Lun also spoke up, "The situation now is that the research facility is of great significance to the North Sea fleet, who will definitely send heavy forces to hunt us down. And we can't leave just yet..."
They hadn't planned on leaving now anyway; the Void Academy was just ahead, and they were intent on visiting it no matter what.
Upon hearing this, Qiantiao shrugged and said, "Then we stick to the plan. Looks like we need to 'disappear' for a while."
"Yes."
Su Lun nodded.
Having taken action, they were naturally well-prepared.
He addressed everyone, "All those with spatial abilities, prepare to execute the 'Stealth Plan'."
"Alright!"
Upon receiving the order, everyone began to make their moves.
...
Last time, after ambushing three detachments of the North Sea Void Fleet, they got a large amount of spatial materials and gear. Now, the Dawn Group had over a hundred professionals who had successfully integrated these materials and acquired preliminary spatial abilities.
These people began setting up alchemy formations in the various chambers of the Eternal Night, each person responsible for a small part, but when linked together, they formed a gigantic cohesive alchemy formation.
That was because Su Lun had previously studied the structure of the Eternal Night, planning it ahead of time.
The others didn't need a deep comprehension of the Space Law, just basic knowledge of introductory magic spells, which allowed for dummy-proof operation.
The casting speed of any alchemy spell could be enhanced with external items, such as pre-engraved alchemy formations and using a large amount of energy crystal cores.
Su Lun's "Void Whale Swallow" spell could do the same.
The plan was to engulf the entire Dawn Group and the "Eternal Night" into the small Void World.
This way, his target would be much smaller.
The enemy, even if intent on surrounding them, would almost certainly not be able to find them.
Previously, it took him nearly twenty minutes to engulf the hundred-meter "Royal Number Seven."
Now, to swallow the much larger "Eternal Night Emperor" would take several times longer.
But now, with these hundred-plus people helping, it could be resolved within minutes.
"Deck alchemy formation is set up!"
"Cabin layout completed!"
"Outer hull deployment finished!"
"Everyone, prepare to activate the alchemy formation."
"..."
In just under two minutes, on the vast sea ship, over a hundred people simultaneously formed the sorcerer's seals to activate the alchemy formation.
The arranged energy crystal cores also lit up one by one, channeling energy into the formation.
In an instant, a unique black glow of the Space Law covered the whole battleship.
The entire casting process would probably consume energy crystal cores worth several hundred million resos, but it was not a pity.
No matter what, this time they were going to make a huge profit.
Su Lun stood alone atop the main mast, the black hole in his hands growing larger. Soon, it was as large as a giant black whale with its mouth wide open, gulping down the vast ship in one swallow.
The entire sea surface instantly became calm.
Su Lun looked at the pursuers rushing towards him in the distance, his lips slightly curling up, and he conjured a "replacement doll" as if by magic.
He sliced his finger and drew a line of blood on the puppet, and as soon as a faint light flashed, a phosphorous fire ignited, turning the doll into ashes in the blink of an eye.
With that, the causal connection was severed,
this time,
even mysterious methods wouldn't be able to find him.
Su Lun didn't bother with the pursuers, he headed in a barren direction, disappearing over the deep blue sea shrouded in night.
....
Before long, dozens of ships bearing the flag of the North Sea Fleet sails arrived consecutively near the last known area of the Dawn Group.
Among them, the "Princess Stika" of the Sea King class was particularly conspicuous among the pirate ships.
It was as though hounds had suddenly lost the scent of their prey, losing direction, these pirate ships aimlessly circled the sea, searching for clues.
But no matter what methods they used, they found that not any trace could be found.
"Her Royal Highness Princess, the scent and biological markers end here, completely cut off; the scouting squad lost the target information."
"Your Highness, the mechanical tracking instruments are also showing beyond the sensing range, signal lost..."
"Your Highness, Master Cruz's pendulum divination also didn't yield any results. Those people must have used counter-divination measures."
"..."
One piece of bad news after another, on board the "Princess," Princess Stika, dressed in a water-blue long dress, had a face so grim it could kill.
She exclaimed in disbelief, "How can they just vanish? Such a large ship full of people, how can there be no trace at all?!"
Repeated frustrations, this Princess of Mafa was truly consumed by rage.
Previously left markers, blood traces... bizarrely disappeared without a trace.
Whether tracking signals or mysterious measures, all completely lost their response.
These people seemed to have vanished into thin air from this world.
Aboard dozens of pirate ships, nobody dared to speak at that moment; the atmosphere was extremely tense.
Princess Stika's murder intent erupted like a volcano, unable to maintain her royal composure, she shouted angrily, "What are you standing around for, go chase them down?! Those people can't leave the secret realm, they must be hiding somewhere. Even if you have to turn this sea upside down, you must find them for me!"
"Yes!"
With that, the royal guards and pirates hurriedly dispersed in fear.
Unable to contain her anger, Princess Stika couldn't help but curse, "Hmph, a bunch of trash!"
Until now, she couldn't comprehend why they could be attacked by an external force in this secret realm, reportedly top-secret of the North Sea Kingdom.
How did the opposing side precisely locate the submarine hidden in the sea?
Moreover, the attack had just occurred not long ago; not only was the enemy unidentified, now not even a trace of them could be found?
These bizarre coincidences strung together forced one to suspect a shocking conspiracy was at play.
Could there be a traitor among their own high ranks?
Princess Stika's expression became uglier than ever.
If they truly lost the "Royal No. 7," then her greatest bargaining chip was lost. This would be a disastrous consequence for the Mafa Empire, for the North Sea Kingdom!
No one could bear the responsibility!
The North Sea Fleet had now mobilized all available manpower within the secret realm to commence a carpet-style search.
She only hoped that they could find them before those people could get away.
....
And just then, a detailed battle report also came from the previously ambushed submarine.
Mechanical octopus, Black Scythe, Spatial Ability...
Hearing these clues, Princess Stika's mind instantly went back to those who had attempted to assassinate her at sea half a month ago.
"Those people survived the Sea Ruins?"
"Your Highness, I'm afraid so. The Sea Emperor-class battleship that interfered with our reinforcements before seems to be the 'Eternal Night Emperor,' which is over two hundred years old, belonging to 'Pirate Emperor' Francis Drake, reportedly in the Sea Ruins..."
"Damn it, didn't the priests of the Temple of Aghaparnon say that no one could survive the Sea Ruins? What the hell is going on now?!"
"..."
Princess Stika was in turmoil.
She could not have imagined, those who ambushed the submarine this time, were the same group that had attempted to assassinate her previously.
Royal family of Lu Ying?
Duke Raphael?
Rega'an family?
Or even, the opposing factions within the empire...
Which faction's people were they?!
After analyzing the battle report, the staff team also arrived at a conclusion that was hard to believe.
Although they felt it was impossible for anyone to steal a "Hurricane Submarine" using Spatial Ability,
the fact had already occurred right in front of them.
Moreover, it was now entirely possible to deduce that the sudden disappearance of that Imperial-class battleship was also for the same reason. That person had hidden the entire ship in another dimension.
That's why all sensing signals had been lost.
But how did that person manage that?
Under normal circumstances, even spatial professionals of the seventh or eighth rank absolutely couldn't achieve such a feat.
"The Royal q," even when sealed in a storage space, could be traced through instruments or divination methods.
What about this situation where not a single trace was left?
Unless... it was another dimension.
How is that possible!!!
Princess Stika, after connecting the dots of several incidents, was completely certain that this was a long-planned grand conspiracy.
"Damn it, notify the Imperial Intelligence Service, activate all the dormant spies in Ruying, and find out who is behind this move. Intercept all suspicious persons leaving the North Sea at all costs, especially the movements at Duke Rafael's end! Otherwise, the leakage of those critical technologies would be a disaster for the Empire..."
"Yes!"
....
While the North Sea Fleet was launching a carpet-style search involving hundreds of thousands of people in the secret realm,
dozens of miles away, Su Lun had taken a [Submarine Breathing Potion] and was casually floating in a deserted part of the ocean.
The sea here was like the backyard pool of the Secret Realm Academy; there were no particularly dangerous marine creatures, and even fish were rare. A body bag was always ready, and he didn't believe anyone could drain the sea to find him.
Although it was possible to encounter someone with a special talent like Tanni who could "listen to the beasts of the sea," the chances were extremely low.
At least, the intelligence Su Lun stripped previously indicated that there was no such person in the Magic Emperor's royal guard, and the North Sea Fleet never said they had one either.
"Her Royal Highness Princess Stika must be thinking about troubling Duke Rafael now,"
Su Lun thought to himself.
Only Duke Rafael had the Mechanical Octopuses.
As long as they didn't catch their Dawn Group, it was destined to remain an unsolved case.
Duke Rafael's side claimed they weren't involved, but Magic was definitely not going to believe that, could it eventually lead to various espionage battles?
Su Lun raised an eyebrow and did not think much about it.
He lay back leisurely in the sea waters, his mind also venturing into the "Little Void Realm."
This was his cultivation space, but Su Lun's original body couldn't venture there because he was the "linking point" between two dimensions.
If he went in, that point would cease to exist, trapping him inside forever.
At this moment, a massive black-sailed ship and a mechanical submarine were floating in the void.
Even with these two colossal objects inserted, they only occupied one percent of the space in this dimension.
In the Void Realm, there's no such thing as a "gravity field"; originally, there was nothing here, not even air, which was later added by Su Lun.
So everything here was floating in midair.
Supplies, equipment, puppets, materials... and the treasures previously obtained from the sea ruins, all here.
Other than Pandora and Barrett, none of the Dawn Group had ever visited Su Lun's "Little Void Realm."
As Su Lun's will descended, he watched them floating around curiously, imagining what it felt like to be free from gravity.
"Hahaha... it's magical, I never thought I could fly!"
"Oh, Mr. Su Lun, this space is truly mystical. Had I known it was this fun, I would have come here sooner."
"Wow... Kama, your teacher is so wealthy, there are so many treasures, my eyes are dazzled."
"Ah, sister, no wonder the teacher said that high-ranked puppeteers need financial support. Oh, I feel, to become a successful puppeteer, one must first become a rich man."
"..."
Kama, Lolota, Tanni, and Abuk floated around the space, marveling at the treasures in Su Lun's realm.
Even Qian Tiao was seeing Su Lun's wealth for the first time, and couldn't help but be amazed.
The gambling-addicted lady always had empty pockets and no concept of saving money, chatting and laughing slyly with some of the Dawn Group's upper echelons.
Qian Tiao was not about to be polite with Su Lun, boldly grabbing treasures others dared not touch. Not only did she take them, but she also commented, "Heh, Su Lun the kid really is rich. Not to mention the treasures obtained from the sea ruins, but his previous collections make him wealthier than some major nobles."
Barrett also looked very happy, laughing as he said, "That's natural, at least I was never as rich as him before. No, at least many of the centuries-old nobles I've seen are about the same. Tsk tsk... when we get out, we definitely need to slice a big piece off him."
Hearing this, everyone in the Dawn Group agreed in unison, "Hahaha, right, right! Next time we dock, we absolutely must make Mr. Su Lun treat our whole team!"
Even the always serious Dr. Banks laughed and responded, "As it should be."
As soon as Su Lun's will entered, he heard everyone talking about his treasures, and he grumbled in a feigned aggrieved tone, "Hey hey hey... come on everyone, this isn't very nice, is it?"
.....
Suddenly, Su Lun's voice echoed in the void, but no figure was seen, leaving everyone puzzled and looking up at the space.
Everyone was joking, not serious at all.
With that said by Su Lun, everyone burst into laughter again.
Curiously blinking her big eyes, Kama asked, "Eh... teacher, have you come in?"
Su Lun said, "Yes. I can see everything in the space, but my body can't enter."
This feeling, it was as if he were... a deity of this world.
He continued, "The North Sea Fleet has already started a large-scale hunt, so you might have to stay in this space for a few days. There are supplies over there."
"Okay."
Naturally, everyone had no objections to this.
All members of the Dawn Group had absolute trust in Su Lun.
Su Lun did not say much else, his main concern being the "Royal Number Seven" mechanical submarine.
Here, his perception could easily cover everything.
Peering into that submarine, there were still more than eighty living people inside. Except for a few wearing Royal Naval uniforms, the vast majority were researchers in white lab coats.
All of them were top-notch mechanical engineers, the real crème de la crème of the mechanical field.
Having captured some captives, Su Lun couldn't hide his joy.
The value of these people was even comparable to that of the submarine filled with top-notch equipment.
Simply placing them in the Royal Academy of Luying could support a top-level "Mechanical Research Academy"!
They were not just labor and R&D resources, but also teaching resources.
Normally, capturing these captives would cause trouble for anyone.
They were scientists from Mafa, brought by Princess Frost Moon, so naturally they had absolute loyalty.
Su Lun wanted them to work for him, which was absolutely impossible. Or rather, it would take a long time and a great cost to convert them. Forcibly enslaving them would only destroy these valuable scientists. In the end, probably few would survive.
But now, with Pandora as a special ally, everything became simple.
As the "God of Moon Reading," she was best at using spiritual means to influence her followers.
It was a basic ability of the gods.
In just a few days, these people's loyalty would change, and then they would wholeheartedly obey Pandora.
Su Lun didn't care about their faith, as long as they could help him work.
He didn't look at those people anymore.
Instead, he turned his gaze to the precision instruments stuffed inside this hundred-meter-long submarine.
....
"My goodness, I've really struck it rich now!"
Su Lun looked at the rows of precision instruments in front of him, feeling an excitement that he hadn't felt for a long time.
Inside the cabin, there was an entire mechanical armor production line.
The MT667 Stamping Machine, the Hail VI Ultra-Precision Laser Cutter, the Ancient Goblin Rune Carving Machine, the Void Particle Stabilizer, the Miniature Energy Core Manufacturing Boiler, the Dwarf's Gold Armor Machine Tool, the KII Special Steel Alchemy Furnace…
Su Lun had once dreamed of having such a batch of instruments to help him forge mechanical equipment.
But he hadn't expected his dream to come true just like that.
It made him feel like he did when he first received the forbidden item "Xiupunos's Night Scythe," as if he had gained a new world.
These were high-end instruments that couldn't be seen on the market.
Even in Mafa, they could only appear in the military's most advanced labs.
Inside the cabin, there were over ten complete combat Mechas that didn't leave their chambers, one at "Colonel level," four at "Major level," eight third-tier "Soldier level."
In the mechanical safe, there were also basic type mechanical armor forging diagrams, mechanical cannon drawings, special ammunition blueprints, and mechanical equipment blueprints...
It seemed they likely planned to build a production line in the North Sea and then mass-produce those mechanical armors.
Although these blueprints are mostly basic first, second, and third-tier soldier armors, once mass-produced, the increase to the North Sea fleet's combat power would be terrifying.
The impact on the northern parts of Luying would also be very significant.
Now, however, Su Lun had intercepted them.
Seeing these instruments, the first thing Su Lun thought of wasn't mechanical armors, but a mature "assembly line" capable of producing mechanical octopuses!
That Ancient Goblin Rune Carving Machine could actually automatically carve any rune below the seventh level!
(Note: Seventh-level runes and above generally require integration with Space Law understanding, and currently no machinery can replace this)
Although it still couldn't carve some overly complex runes, it was completely sufficient for manufacturing ordinary mechanical octopuses.
This was much more efficient than Su Lun manually drawing the runes.
Then there was the MT667 Stamping Machine - as long as suitable molds were made, it could mass-produce extremely precise mechanical parts.
This was perfect for tasks like forging the thousands of mechanical armor pieces required for mechanical octopuses.
Previously, Su Lun had to forge each piece by hand, but now, just by entering data, the machine could forge tens of thousands of metal pieces overnight!
There were also boilers, cutting machines, laser quality testers...
If they could accommodate the forging of mechanical armor, they could also meet nearly all the mechanical component requirements of mechanical octopuses.
Su Lun just needed to address some minor issues with "biological nerves" to start production.
Su Lun was even breathing heavily.
Although he estimated that the mass-produced mechanical octopuses would be lower in quality than his handmade ones, that didn't matter anymore!
Absolute quantity suppression could compensate for all quality deficiencies.
No,
The current quality might be somewhat lacking, but in the future, it definitely wouldn't be!
The quality would only be higher!
Besides the equipment, Su Lun realized he had also captured this group of Mafa's senior mechanics!
The mechanical skills they mastered were far superior to those of the mechanics under Duke Raphael, definitely capable of rectifying deficiencies in the mechanical parts of mechanical octopuses and creating brand-new mechanical octopuses!
With both talent and equipment,
Theoretically, as long as he could find enough materials, this production line could continuously produce mechanical octopuses.
And, Mafa didn't have neural mechanical technology, nor did Duke Raphael have top mechanical technology.
This also meant that Su Lun's future mechanical octopus army would be unique!
The most advanced!
And, previously, the people of Mafa placed the mechanical production line in a submarine for safety.
But Su Lun had no such concerns.
His small void realm had enough space and was safe enough.
He could even deploy some super-large mechanical tools in the space later, and directly set up a "Mechanic Warfare Workshop" here, which would greatly increase the output!
If a thousand mechanical octopuses weren't enough,
What about ten thousand?
Or even a hundred thousand! (Wishful thinking, I can't control that many yet.)
At that thought, Su Lun could already envision the unstoppable dominion of his mechanical puppet master.
He murmured, "Work is aligned, now the concern is where to get so much material..."

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - 395: [Unstable Planar Gateway]
chapters.content:
In the following days, Su Lun simply lay in the seawater, drifting with the waves, and he did encounter several groups of people conducting patrols.
Some sailed in ships, some flew in the sky, and some swam in the water...
Su Lun could spot them, but those people couldn't detect him.
Although the North Sea fleet had numerous personnel within the secret realm, the number of high-order professionals was limited. If fourth or fifth-order high-order professionals had come, there might have been a chance to sense his presence, but unfortunately, most were first or second-order pirates.
Finding him in this secret realm of over ten thousand square kilometers was like picking a specific grain of sand from a desert, nearly impossible.
Since they couldn't find him, Su Lun had no interest in how the Frost Moon Princess was fuming with rage. Every day, he would project his will into the little void realm, tinkering with the advanced mechanical equipment in "Royal No. 7".
...
The members of the Dawn group were quite happy staying in the little void realm, with plenty to eat and drink, some cultivating and some conducting research.
As Su Lun had plans to build a "mechanical workshop," he decided to remodel the little void realm.
Everyone got excited when they heard about his idea, offering various suggestions and strategies.
Since most of them had nothing else to do, they all helped out in making the little void realm look better.
Coincidentally, there was a crew member holding a "Royal Lington Architect Designer Certificate" in the group. After that person drafted a blueprint, everyone began to bustle about.
Elemental professionals used Earth System Arts to form a large piece of land and then set up a local "Gravity Barrier" on it. As long as a not too great amount of energy was consumed, it could be maintained indefinitely.
Su Lun's original plan was to casually create a piece of land and construct a simple workshop on it.
However, Barrett and those team members who had taken elective courses in architecture at Royal Lington Academy were perfectionists. With the cooperative efforts of several hundred alchemists, they quickly built a beautiful gothic castle.
The group then figured out a way to stabilize the castle, preventing it from drifting around.
Now, it could not only serve as a workshop but also as a vacation castle.
Then, Su Lun moved all the machinery from the submarine into the castle. The space suddenly opened up considerably, and the various instruments no longer needed to be cramped together. The idea of a mechanical assembly line finally took its first step.
Seeing Su Lun's intention to set up a war workshop here, Dr. Banks couldn't hold back his excitement either.
He had taken a liking to this enclosed space when he first arrived, deeming it the perfect laboratory, quiet, enclosed, undisturbed by the outside world, and free from constant relocation.
Setting up a lab on a ship was really inconvenient, not to mention frequent relocations and limited space. The rocking of the waves and naval battles also greatly affected many experiments.
Dr. Banks eventually moved his biological laboratory into the castle as well.
He even declared that he would stay there from now on, not going out unless necessary.
Su Lun couldn't help but have mixed feelings about this.
However, as he often experimented with Dr. Banks before, he was quite familiar with him, and having a neighbor was pretty good. He could also manage those "captives" well.
Meanwhile, in just a few days, Pandora managed to convert the more than eighty mechanics from the land of Mafa into her followers.
The group easily accepted the reality of their capture, subconsciously harboring no hostility towards the Dawn group.
They began assisting Su Lun in setting up the "Mechanical Octopus Production Line" and started producing the first batch according to the design plans.
These Mafa mechanical engineers brought with them the empire's most advanced mechanical technology. They not only adjusted the equipment but also improved upon the initial design flaws of the mechanical octopus. Every day brought new blueprints and inspiration.
Su Lun was actively involved as well.
The more he understood, the more he was astounded by the technological level of the Mafa empire; it indeed surpassed Lington's by decades and was an area of knowledge Su Lun was blind to. There were even many special techniques of ancient goblins and dwarves, each a potential "treasure trove of knowledge" waiting to be unearthed.
He learned as he participated in the creation process, gaining a great deal of benefit.
```
Eighty people plus a host of the most advanced mechanical instruments. Work efficiency was something Su Lun could never match on his own.
The several dozen mechanical octopuses lost in the previous battle were quickly replenished.
Now with large machine tools at his disposal, he could even manufacture and design new mechanical warriors according to his own needs, compensating for the "Mechanical Puppet Legion's" shortcomings in ground combat.
Su Lun watched as his mechanical workshop gradually took shape.
But a new problem emerged: material shortages.
The mechanical engineers had the knowledge and the instruments, but not enough materials.
Both research and production required a large amount of raw materials.
Su Lun already had a large pile of "material purchase lists" that made his head hurt just looking at them.
He thought he could only replenish his supplies at the black market when they made landfall.
However, many of the materials needed for manufacturing mechanical battle suits were strictly regulated by Luying officials and were not circulated by trading companies, meaning there was naturally not much stock in the black market of Pirate City. The possibility of making large purchases was not high.
Luckily, Su Lun asked Mr. Jing for advice and received some good news.
He said that the bloodline Count Antonio, who had been operating in Luying for several hundred years, had established a fairly large noble trading company with channels to obtain regulated materials.
A trip to Luying in the future meant that there would be a solution for the bulk materials as well.
Now, from material supply to mechanical workshop, a complete "war workshop assembly line" was truly in full swing.
....
Su Lun spent his days tinkering in his small virtual realm, and time flew by quickly.
After several days of intensive search without finding anyone, the patrols from the Northern Sea Fleet quieted down.
Those guys probably realized that the likelihood of catching the attackers was slim to none. Even the people who did come, they just came to casually stroll around to fulfill the search task.
Knowing that the danger had passed, Su Lun gradually made his way to the core of the secret realm without rush.
This virtual secret realm was a site of an Alchemy Academy from the Dawn Era, containing thousands of islands, large and small.
Almost all of these islands have ruins of ancient buildings, but since the Northern Sea Fleet had been developing here for several years, most of the treasures had been unearthed.
The main structure of the academy was located on the largest island in the center of the secret realm. It housed a spatial passageway to the virtual plane, which was the constant source of virtual materials for the Northern Sea Fleet.
Su Lun's primary goal in visiting this virtual secret realm was to try his luck in finding suitable fifth-order spatial inauguration materials and to gather some resources for the members of Dawn Group.
If he didn't luck out, he would have to go and fleece the Northern Sea Void Fleet once more.
From the memories stripped from the deputy fleet captain, he found that the materials fused by the fleet captain and several squadron leaders in the void fleet were quite good...
Ever since the grand harvest from robbing Mafa's submarine, Su Lun really felt that being a pirate was quite good.
Venturing out for treasure hunting couldn't match this efficiency.
Because he was very familiar with the map of the secret realm and had the black raven circling in the sky, Su Lun could sense the movements of the nearby patrol guards in advance, so he didn't encounter any accidents.
He sailed through the water all the way.
Finally, from a great distance, he saw the main complex of the "Tokster Void Alchemy Academy."
It was a vast expanse of ruins built upon a hill. From the scale, one could see that this had been a bustling city thousands of years ago.
Although most of the buildings within the city were destroyed, one could still discern the very distinctive architectural style: white as the base color with various exquisite towers, domed roofs adorned with golden rings, extensive arch bridges, and elaborate reliefs...
It somewhat resembled the sight of Dawn City beneath Old Lington, a scene of decay after a period of prosperity.
```
However, at this moment, the city is filled with encampments and bustling with voices.
This is the secret base of the Northern Sea Fleet, hosting hundreds of thousands of people.
Even after several years of development, there are still many twisted vortexes near the building complex.
Upon assessment, nearly all of them are high-risk curse spaces of A or S rank.
Su Lun was not unfamiliar; in the stripped fragments of memory, he knew that these curse spaces had brought massive casualties to the Northern Sea Fleet, while also yielding many ancient relics.
But the most eye-catching curse space was the terrifying virtual void fracture at the mountaintop, hundreds of meters in diameter.
It was like a huge and eerie vertical pupil, staring down at the entire academy.
[Unstable Dimensional Passage]
Description: The endless void is, to human understanding, an indescribable monster.
Detailed Explanation: This is an extremely large curse space where strength and luck coexist, with difficulty ranging from B to T rank; during the most splendid era of Dawn Era Alchemy, the alchemists of the Tarkolu Empire intended to merge with the void, but a laboratory accident led to a backlash from the void; this curse space preserves the final seventy-two hours of brutal combat at the Void Academy, where students and teachers fought with their flesh and blood against the invasion of the void, preventing a planar disaster; you need to survive the omnipresent attacks of void monsters, and hiding is the best option, as it will allow you to survive with ease; deeper into the passage are complex spatial fractures, but also hidden are the most energetically fluctuating void treasures, though these places are also connected to the void dimension, inhabited by extremely powerful monsters;
...
Su Lun, looking at the information identified, showed a touch of solemnness in his gaze.
It was almost the same as the intelligence he had obtained in advance.
This largest curse space lay above a spatial passage to the "Void Dimension," and was the only curse space the Northern Sea Fleet had not managed to explore more than 20% of thus far.
Even so, having explored only a small part, it had already yielded the highest-quality void materials.
For example, the legendary Void Ghost Hand that Su Lun and his group had intercepted, along with some very high-level ancient alchemy apparatuses.
It was because the Northern Sea Fleet's pirates couldn't figure out those ancient devices that they invited experts from Mafa to dig together.
And the difficulty with this space lay in its many unstable spatial fractures.
The deeper one ventured, the weaker the space became, rendering it increasingly unfriendly to high-level professionals.
It was like thinner and thinner ice sheets; the high-level professionals' fights could easily tear through space and draw them inside.
For example, there were sixth-order void monsters at the depths of this curse space, which could exist there without any harm. But if sixth-order professionals went, they would find it almost impossible to avoid the omnipresent spatial fractures during combat, let alone battling the creatures.
As a result, the Northern Sea Fleet had lost far too many high-level professionals. This even included a sixth-order senior and several sixth-order war slaves bought from Luying.
That's why this curse space remained unexplored to this day.
...
It was almost a checkmate situation, as sixth-order professionals couldn't go, yet there were sixth-order void monsters present.
Even the numerous top-level experts of the Northern Sea Fleet were unable to do anything about it.
But as Su Lun looked at the identified information for the curse space, his eyes revealed contemplation, and a spark of inspiration flashed through his mind.
The current situation was that their Dawn Group had robbed the Frost Moon Princess's submarine and exposed their whereabouts. Trying to rob the "curse material warehouse" from the original plan now would likely result in being closely watched. Those people were probably already prepared for them to fall right into their hands.
The plan, naturally, had to be changed.
At the very least, if they were to make a move, it would have to be postponed.
"Or else, shall we take a look inside that curse space?"
Su Lun pondered the feasibility in his mind.
Based on the intelligence they had gathered, as long as one didn't venture too deep and court death, the difficulty of the cursed space wasn't high.
Moreover, just because others couldn't reach the deeper areas didn't mean he couldn't.
After all, he was only a fourth-order, theoretically, the probability of triggering spatial rifts was even less than that of a normal fifth-order professional.
And with his nearly sixth-order comprehension of space law and the All-knowing Eye, he had a great chance of avoiding areas where space was weak.
Facing such a cursed space, for the first time, Su Lun felt that having a lower rank was actually advantageous.
As for those high-order void monsters that had already been identified, they could pose a great threat to fifth or sixth-order pirates, but that didn't necessarily mean they could kill him.
He was still a Puppet Master, with countless puppets to detect for mines...
Being cautious, he might be able to explore further and find treasures yet undiscovered.
The current intelligence suggested that there were definitely high-stakes treasures in this cursed space, and it was absolutely worth taking a gamble on.
What's more, he wasn't alone; he had the entire Dawn Group behind him.
Thinking this, Su Lun asked Qian and the others inside the little void realm.
Everyone naturally had no objections, and they were even looking forward to it.
They knew very well that when it came to survival capabilities, no one in the Dawn Group was stronger than Su Lun. With him leading the way into the depths, it was obviously safer.
This secret realm had already proven to be highly productive in various void materials, so they had to grab a share when they had the chance.
...
With the support of the Dawn Group members, Su Lun began to wait patiently.
The Academy ruins were currently full of people from the North Sea Fleet, most of whom were spatial ability users.
Even if he teleported there, there was almost a hundred percent chance he would be discovered.
So, he needed to wait for an opportunity.
Su Lun was very clear that almost every time a secret realm opened, the North Sea Fleet would bring in large supplies and slaves from outside.
That was when a large number of outsiders would come in, and it was the best opportunity to blend in.
Su Lun knew that the North Sea Fleet's supply runs almost always followed a fixed route, and even if they had been attacked before, they probably wouldn't change it.
Sure enough, after waiting another three days, eight pirate ships laden with supplies entered the secret realm.
It was also at midnight, as Su Lun watched the Milky Way fall from the sky, eight sailing ships descended from the sky into the sea.
Carrying a black umbrella, Su Lun quietly approached, and sensing inside, he found three of the ships' cabins were packed tightly with people. They were crammed into less than one-meter-high interlayers of the cabins, stuffed like barrels of wine.
This was a slave ship.
Taking advantage of the violent shaking as the ships hit the water, Su Lun teleported into a cabin in an instant and, without alarming anyone, absorbed a slave into his little void realm and took the person's place.
All the slaves wore slave collars and foul-smelling hessian hoods, meant to prevent them from memorizing the route of the secret realm.
This provided an excellent cover for Su Lun's actions. With a quick change of disguise, he donned the same outfit. The skin tone and whip marks he had prepared in advance made him indistinguishable from the slaves around him.
Perhaps sensing the subtle spatial fluctuations, a pirate came down to check the cabin but, finding nothing amiss, returned above deck.
After all, in this secret realm, some weak void creatures would occasionally run amok, so some spatial fluctuations weren't strange.
Su Lun curled up in a corner and kept silent.
This pirate fleet sailed directly into the main base on Ruins Island.

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - 396: Void Gene Potion
chapters.content:
Soon, eight pirate ships docked at the port.
Su Lun squatted in the pile of slaves in the cabin, listening to the noisy movements on the wharf outside, without any emotional fluctuation.
Since the ship was docking and it was time to disembark, pirates finally came to remove the slaves' hoods.
Having squatted for many days, the slaves were dizzy and disoriented, and a few sick individuals in the corner who were barely breathing were slightly sluggish, earning whiplashes across their backs that snapped crisply.
"Line up and follow quickly! Don't fucking dawdle!"
Su Lun also endured a couple of lashes.
After stepping out of the cabin onto the deck, he was finally able to breathe fresh air instead of the stuffy atmosphere inside, and his expression brightened for a moment.
Su Lun observed the bustling dock with an expression indistinguishable from the other slaves, a dull look coupled with a hint of curiosity. It seemed he wanted to know where they were being sold to, but the curiosity in his eyes flashed only briefly before disappearing.
Mining, hard labor, land clearing, fighting... It made no difference.
The slaves lined up and walked down from the ship, heading towards the city gate along the dock's pathways.
"Tokster Void Royal Alchemy Academy" was surrounded by a white stone wall that spanned most of the island, reaching a hundred meters high and majestic in appearance. Unfortunately, now only remnants and ruins remained.
Two groups stood at the city gate: a group of mechanical warriors and another group of pirates.
Their gazes were sharp, carefully scrutinizing every individual entering the city.
Su Lun knew they were searching for spies attempting to infiltrate the city and was not the least bit worried.
He had a thorough understanding of everything within the encampment, so he had no reason to feel nervous. Amongst the gatekeepers were those with sensing capabilities, and normally, Su Lun's fourth-tier status could not be concealed. However, he possessed a very special mechanical alchemy device called an "Energy Fluctuation Disruptor."
This was Mafa Empire's latest spy device, several of which were seized when a submarine was intercepted.
Mafa's mechanical warriors could discern the tier of practitioners because their helmets were equipped with energy observation devices. Working similarly to the methods of sensing professionals, these devices could accurately capture the outflow of energy from living beings to determine their tier. Moreover, the machinery was even more precise, with less margin of error.
But if energy fluctuations could be observed mechanically, they could also be disrupted.
Hence, the disruptor existed.
This was cutting-edge technology currently unmatched by any power on the market.
Su Lun had tested it before and even fourth or fifth-tier practitioners could be deceived. Now, wearing it on his person, he entered the city with no trouble.
...
The North Sea Fleet had been operating in this secret domain for several years, and although it had almost cleared the cursed space within the academy's main building only in the last six months, this ruin still housed many void monsters.
The situation here was quite similar to Old Lington.
Both were ancient ruins, both had a space channel still leaking energy from a foreign dimension, and over countless years, the creatures had developed their own ecological system.
As Su Lun walked, he could clearly feel the spiritual power fluctuations of monsters in the sewer below. The complex network of caves was an ideal environment for them. Near the space rift that resembled a vertical pupil, dense spatial energy continued to seep out, marking the location of the space channel.
Even though it was midnight, the city was brightly lit, and pirates carrying weapons could be seen everywhere.
Some entertainment venues like taverns and brothels were open and bustling with activity.
Not only were there military tents in the city, but there was also extensive construction as the pirates built new structures, making it a bustling city.
The buildings flew the flags of the North Sea Fleet and the banners of "Void Fleet" divisions.
Su Lun could tell that King Oleg of the North Sea was likely planning to turn this place into a stronghold of his own.
For the purpose of long-term development.
Normally, humans had a high chance of mutation when integrating with virtual materials, but living for an extended period in an environment rich with virtual energy could improve a practitioner's spatial affinity, increasing the chances of successful integration.
It was like Old Lington, where the locals had a high affinity for dark spiritual power.
In a few years, the North Sea Fleet would produce a large number of practitioners with spatial abilities, and it was not impossible that some strong high-tier practitioners would also emerge.
This was undoubtedly the foundation of Lord Oleg.
"Yo~ the quality of the female slaves that arrived today is quite high."
"Tsk tsk, there's entertainment tonight. Just went to a cursed space yesterday and earned enough points, time to have some fun."
"Hahaha, your Squad Ten is indeed lucky. The mission you completed last time cleared an A-level cursed space, and you've earned enough points not to work for the next half year..."
"Haha, indeed."
"..."
Su Lun and the other slaves were herded into the city, among them several female slaves, barely covered by tattered rags. Along the way, the pirates couldn't help but point and comment. To call this a secret realm, it wasn't much different from a prison, except for the rare arrival of fresh women.
Having been marched the entire way, the female slaves were sent to the Pleasure Pavilion. Su Lun and the male slaves were locked in a dark dungeon within the city to continue their confinement.
However, unlike before, the slaves had just been locked up when they were rewarded with a hearty meal.
The slaves all knew all too well that a good meal likely meant that work was coming.
In the dim, lightless cage, the slaves eagerly devoured the distributed food.
Compared to the daily meager helpings of water and black bread, the current meal of mashed potatoes with meat and rum was a feast.
No matter the task, even if it was walking to the gallows, having a full stomach before death wasn't so bad.
To call it 'last meal' wasn't an exaggeration at all.
Su Lun was well aware that female slaves could be sent to brothels, while male slaves were cannon fodder filling the cursed spaces.
The survival rate for slaves sent to explore these secret spaces was less than one percent.
Surviving once didn't guarantee survival the next time.
And Su Lun didn't behave any differently, eating the food distributed by the prison guard.
Before long, with their bellies filled with food and drink, a fourth-tier pirate lieutenant walked atop the cage.
Swinging a whip, he snapped it against the cage with a "crack."
This was the way they disciplined slaves, signaling everyone to listen to him.
The slaves, as if by conditioned reflex, anxiously looked his way.
"You are slaves, and in other places, you would be slaves for life! But here in the North Sea Kingdom, you have another choice..."
"Now, I offer you an opportunity, and that's to join in exploring the cursed spaces. I won't lie to you—the mortality rate is high. But if you can complete the mission, you can survive. And if you earn enough points, you can even join our North Sea fleet, escape slavery, and become official crewmen..."
"..."
Su Lun quietly listened to the lieutenant "painting a big pie."
The words were very straightforward: by participating in the exploration of cursed spaces, not only was there a chance to survive, but also an opportunity to escape slavery.
For slaves, the draw was indeed huge.
In Ruying, as long as you are a slave, you are a slave for life. Their status was the same as mules and horses, the personal property of slave masters. Those with good luck might be slaves in a plantation for life. Those with bad luck could end up mining until they died or being used as human shields on the battlefield...
So having the chance to escape slavery was definitely a formidable temptation.
The quality of this batch of slaves was high, most of them war slaves from various territories in Ruying, with quite a few second and third-tier professionals.
Su Lun knew when boarding the ship that this was a deliberate selection for the development of the cursed spaces.
The pirates naturally hoped that the slaves would be more proactive in their response, rather than sending hordes of the living dead with no will to live to their deaths.
At the end of his speech, the lieutenant shouted again, "So, those who wish to explore the cursed spaces, raise your hands! Once you decide to participate, you can eat the same food every day as you did tonight!"
It seemed like he was asking whether they were willing.
But actually, there was only one choice.
Either you volunteer, or you're forced to go.
No sooner had he finished speaking than someone excitedly raised their hand.
"I'm willing to go!"
"And me!"
"Count me in. I'd rather die than live as a slave!"
"..."
Su Lun knew there were pirates' plants among the group, but as soon as these people spoke up, the atmosphere indeed heated up.
This encouraged the slaves who were still hesitating to raise their hands one after another, fearing they would miss the chance.
Seeing it was about right, Su Lun also raised his hand.
...
While Su Lun was still in the cell.
In a luxuriously decorated building in Ruins City, the lights were bright as a group of people discussed an exploration plan for the cursed space.
Even in the ruins, the princess from the Mafa royal family enjoyed the best living conditions.
However, because the "Royal No. 7" had been hijacked and the main culprit had not yet been found, Princess Stika had been in a bad mood for the past few days.
The "unstable planar passage" was difficult to pioneer, and the people from the North Sea Fleet were not in a hurry either. Even if they couldn't fully explore, the space could provide them with a continuous supply of low-level cursed materials. Given enough time, there would always be a day when a solution would be found. If they could, like Duke Rafael, secretly develop for a few decades, they would certainly build a formidable Void Fleet for Lord Oleg.
But the situation had now changed.
The submarine attack meant the secret of the space sanctuary had been exposed.
All forces in Luingdom coveted the space sanctuary. If its treasures weren't excavated quickly, there was a risk of unforeseen complications.
The magic lamps lit up the room brightly.
A group of people sat around a luxurious mahogany round table.
At the head of the table, Princess Stika, with a grim look on her face, asked, "Dr. Bachar, how are things on your end?"
"Yesterday, we just attempted a formula for a 'Void Endurance Potion' that we acquired recently. The test result is that it can increase the endurance of low-level professionals by 15-23% and significantly raise the probability of integrating with Void materials. However, its effectiveness is not ideal for high-level professionals..."
The speaker was a big-bearded old man in a white lab coat.
He was the principal scientist brought by Princess Stika, Bachar Pearson.
Even in the academic circles of the Mafa Empire, he was a renowned figure, specializing in biotechnology and mechanics.
He was also the key person sent by Mafa for the joint development of the Void Relics!
A few days earlier, because of the hijacking of "Royal No. 7," Bachar and several senior scientists had come ashore, so they were not captured along with the others, making Princess Stika not feel the situation was completely dire.
As long as this man was around, they could find a way to bring another batch of equipment from Mafa.
Continuing, the bearded old man said, "Based on the current intelligence, this Void Academy had conducted a lot of research to enhance human Void endurance. Moreover, several had achieved considerable results. In those records, I stumbled upon the possibility that this academy had once developed a special potion capable of altering human bloodlines—the 'Void Gene Potion.' This potion directly alters the genetic chain, granting a permanent increase in spatial affinity, akin to obtaining an additional talent of a 'B-040-Void Patron.' So, my suggestion is, if we can acquire those research findings, we could quickly put together a group of professionals with high spatial tolerance..."
Hearing this, everyone in the room was shocked.
Man-made B-level bloodlines with rare Void abilities?
Even if such a potion truly existed, it would undoubtedly be challenging to produce, but its value would be beyond imagination!
Upon hearing this, Princess Stika looked up at the man in the white suit sitting on her left and asked, "What do you think, Mr. Samikina?"
The man in the suit, with a genteel smile devoid of a pirate's roughness, responded, "Your Royal Highness Princess, I've also heard of that potion. It's associated with a man named 'Herbert Hillbilly.' But despite our multiple ventures into the cursed space, we have never found such a person in the academy, nor any information about him. So I even doubt whether that project exists at all. Or perhaps, the existence of this person was deliberately 'erased' by the Void Academy for some special reason. To find clues, we would need to venture into even more dangerous regions, such as... T-Zone experimentation areas."
This man was none other than the fleet admiral of the "Void Fleet," a seventh-tier professional, Samikina J. Luo.
Although there was no bounty on him in the outside world, his strength was definitely among the top in the North Sea Fleet.
Princess Stika listened to their words, her expression inscrutable.
If this "Void Gene Potion" truly existed, she had to have it!
After pondering for a moment, she said, "You have all heard. Now, what are your thoughts?"
At this, the various staff members began to speak up.
"The dean of the Void Academy holds the key, perhaps even the pivotal point for lifting the entire cursed space. We could figure out a way..."
"There is an archive in the library where you can find some hidden information…"
"The 'T-Level Test Zone' must have some research materials; perhaps we could find some physical information…"
"…"
These were the members of the Mafa Royal Think Tank, who were also very experienced in breaking curse spaces.
They quickly came up with several feasible plans.
Around the round table, Samikina listened without speaking, but as he listened, a sneer crept onto his lips.
To him, these fools from Mafa were steeped in arrogance, not taking anyone from the North Sea Fleet seriously, not even him, the fleet commander.
When they had finished speaking, Samikina, with a tone of ridicule, said, "Blunt force is definitely not going to work.
