By the time you get there, you're probably going to miss the excitement. If he's taken action, he will surely kill the man before anyone can intercede."
```
Hearing this, Bartolo became somewhat unhappy, grumbled, "Hey, hey, hey, I've never seen you have so much confidence in your old dad before. Is that kid as good as you say, everywhere you say?"
Yekaterina glanced at her father dismissively, too lazy to explain.
Thinking of something, the Duke muttered without the dignity of a master, "Oh, it seems I was too soft on him last time. No, I need to see him again!"
The endless prattling continued at her ear, buzzing like a bee.
She couldn't even focus on her book anymore.
Yekaterina looked at her father with a somewhat helpless expression, knowing full well that he just wanted her to join him in watching the spectacle.
She finally stood up and said, "Well then, let's go have a look. There should be more developments to come. Just a Marquis of Purple Mountain isn't significant enough. His choice to act within the city is probably also to make a big scene, to expose all those rats in the sewers to the light..."
Bartolo immediately became happy.
"Hey, let's hurry then! Maybe we can still catch the climax. Hahaha... let's go quickly, I've already had the butler arrange the carriage, it's perfect timing now."
"..."
"When do you plan on stepping out from behind the scenes to the forefront? Your old dad is ready to give up his position for you. And then I plan to embark on my own dream journey. Oh, being the Family Head is truly boring."
"Soon."
"Oh, you'd better hurry up. Otherwise, your old dad won't even be able to catch the tail end of his youth. There are so many beautiful sights waiting on the road ahead for your old dad to encounter..."
"..."

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - 452: 451
chapters.content:
In Franklin District's Winery Street, what once was a bustling arts district had now largely turned to ruins.
Through the hazy fog, dozens of figures were still engaged in fierce battle.
After just a few probing skirmishes, the fight had reached its climax.
[Earth Rock Dwarf], [Wind Howling Puppet], [Black Flame Demon], [Toxic Water Puppet], [Mechanical Assassin Shadow], [Divine Power Vajra], [Candy Witch]...
By now, all seven of the nearly seventh-tier dark gold puppets known as the [Seven Dwarfs], Master Aubrey's signature collection, had been revealed.
Suddenly, the clattering noise of combat ceased for a moment.
Atop the rubble, Su Lun gasped for breath, his right hand holding a black scythe, surrounded by a dominating aura, yet unable to move.
Upon closer inspection, several black threads were wrapped around his arm and body. As sharp as blades, the threads had cut into his flesh, not severing his arm, but leaving trails of blood. The strength of the threads continued to intensify.
Su Lun glanced at his arm, a momentary gravity flickered in his eyes, and he thought to himself with a sense of irony, "The String Control Technique is several levels behind... that old man's schemes are indeed cunning."
Master Aubrey was truly deserving of his title as a Great Grandmaster of puppetry; his String Control Technique was almost divine.
This [Checkerboard House] secret technique was not only for controlling puppets but also for dominating the battlefield, with deadly traps hidden at every turn.
Just on the level of technique, it was far more complex and refined than Su Lun's own [Slaughterhouse].
Even though Su Lun was thoroughly informed about his opponent's capabilities, the battle nonetheless had its moments of extreme peril.
Just like now.
Previously, the old man's threads had not achieved much, limited at every turn when facing the Witch's hair. This led Su Lun to fall into a pattern of inertial thinking, assuming that apart from their sharpness, the threads posed no other danger. However, the old man, using his superb String Control Technique, had stealthily hidden several threads inscribed with "Spatial Confinement" within the battle, finding an opening and successfully trapping Su Lun.
Had it not been for his robust physique, such a cut would have killed him or at least taken an arm.
In this exchange, Su Lun had indeed experienced the strength and tactics of one of the very best in the puppeteering world.
And he had to admit, the gap was significant!
Under normal circumstances, not to mention fifth- or sixth-tier professionals, even seventh-tier ones would have a hard time gaining the upper hand.
That was the advantage of being a Puppet Master.
Puppet Masters had almost no chance of being countered, and they could find a way to counter any professional they faced.
The old man's Elemental Puppet lineage with their [Seven Dwarfs] puppet combination was polished to perfection, lacking nothing in defense, control, healing, or offensive capabilities.
Whether tactics, technique, cooperation, or the quality of the puppets, everything was nearly flawless.
Had Su Lun's understanding of Puppetry Technique not been extensive, he would have had no right to face this seventh-tier Great Grandmaster in battle.
...
After all, Su Lun had gone with the intention of sparring with a senior peer.
Defeat was expected.
To suffer it without complete humiliation was already more than he had hoped for.
But the shock in Master Aubrey's heart was indescribable.
He looked at Su Lun, who had been seemingly cut to pieces by his threads, his murky eyes filled with disbelief as he exclaimed, "Rune inscriptions in the lineage of Spell Technique for reinforcing the body? No wonder you have such a strong physique, on par with even a fifth-tier hand-to-hand combat professional."
He hesitated, then spoke with a complex tone, "Had I not witnessed it with my own eyes, I would have never believed one could integrate so many high-level implants and master so many diverse techniques. I must admit, you're the foremost among all the prodigies I've seen!"
Master Aubrey indeed had lethal intentions.
Such an enemy, if allowed to grow, would undoubtedly become a thorn in his side.
In Lyndon, he would not tolerate any other puppeteering lineage surpassing his Elemental Puppets.
But after a bout of fighting, Master Aubrey helplessly discovered that he simply could not kill this colleague who was two major ranks below him!
It was a feeling of helplessness that not even his peers could impose upon him.
Master Aubrey looked back on the better part of his lifetime, acknowledging he had seen countless puppeteering prodigies.
Yet he had never met another Puppet Master that struck him as so remarkable.
In terms of technique, mentality, combat style, or understanding of puppeteering, this young man was the best of all his juniors.
No!
Even among the older generation in the Puppet Master's Guild, few could compare.
...
Listening to the old man who obviously held murderous intent, praising him, Su Lun too cracked a smile and responded, "I've also experienced the prowess of the Master. If there's an opportunity, I will certainly seek your guidance again."
Such a tense battle wasn't the time to waste words.
But both knew that they couldn't kill each other.
Although Su Lun's smile was tinged with blood seeping through his teeth, he didn't appear disheveled at all.
Because he had achieved his goal: to gain some combat insights in front of the Great Grandmaster while looking for a chance to turn the tables.
At this moment, his arm was wrapped in threads, and had it been only for the body of the [Rune Vajra], he couldn't have stopped the old man's lethal weapon, the lifebound threads.
It was only because of his Divine Power that he had held on thus far.
Mr. Jing had once told him that the best way to temper Divine Power was to fight enemies above one's own rank.
Only the threat of death from a surpassing enemy could impose the pressure of rank and baptize you with the Divine Power and realization of a stronger foe.
And Master Aubrey was such a rare adversary.
If Su Lun were to wait until he was on par with this Great Grandmaster, or even advanced to the sixth-tier, the old man would no longer be able to exert such pressure.
And only among Puppet Masters could one so readily spot the opponent's weaknesses.
This battle.
Su Lun, using Master Aubrey as a mirror, had seen too many of his own deficiencies in detail.
But he didn't waste any more time, because by then, he had already found a method to break the situation.
....
His arm was wrapped in threads, with the cuts growing deeper, looking as if it couldn't last even a few seconds without being sliced into segments.
But just then, the black crow that had been perched on Su Lun's shoulder, merely watching the scene unfold, suddenly flapped its wings and swooped down, then pecked with its beak.
The special threads that were not easy to cut, instantly turned into lines that looked as if they were drawn on Su Lun's skin with a pencil.
In an instant, that sharp sensation of being cut disappeared without a trace.
Master Aubrey was shocked, and before he had a chance to retract his threads, he watched his own threads being downgraded.
He hurriedly cut off that section of thread to prevent the downgrade from spreading, while a flicker of gloom passed through his eyes, thinking to himself, "An omen crow with mutations? What a freak. Where did he obtain such great fortune..."
Even if he didn't want to admit it, the Great Grandmaster who controlled all the resources of the Puppet Masters Guild in Lindon couldn't help but feel an indescribable jealousy swelling inside him.
Su Lun escaped in an instant, without wasting any more time.
At that moment, he suddenly created some distance before having a gargoyle stand guard beside him and formed complex sorcerer's seals with his hands.
The seven-pointed star of the alchemy formation beneath his feet gradually lit up as a strong wave of spatial disturbance grew stronger.
Master Aubrey, watching his actions from the other side, also suddenly had a fierce look in his eyes!
Having clashed for so long, he knew all too well how difficult it would be to kill his opponent even with all his tactics deployed.
And the reason the other party was still here was because he wanted to kill Miss Elsa!
Su Lun gave no chance for the old man to intervene, and as the gargoyle blocked a wave of interference spells, the complex sorcerer's seals he had been forming for seconds solidified and a violent spatial fluctuation suddenly surged around him!
Master Aubrey had thought that hiding the person within the "Shadow Puppet" was foolproof, but now, seeing the space around him tremble, his complexion drastically changed: "Not good!"
He realized at a glance, his heart shouting in shock: This man had such profound mastery of the laws of void!
It was only an instant after the magician made his move, but the old man had already guessed what Su Lun was about to do.
But it was already too late to stop him, and there was no way to do so.
Master Aubrey had his own puppet, "The Killing Shadow," which could merge into the void, but that was an inheritance from his ancestors; he did not have a deep understanding of the secret void techniques.
Now, watching the spatial fluctuations emerge around him, all he could do was watch helplessly as his "Shadow Puppet" was forced out from the spatial rifts.
The old man tried to keep the puppet hidden, but to his surprise, found that an external force was expelling it!
This was the disparity in the understanding of the laws.
Although the "Shadow Puppet" was of a high grade, for someone who only knew how to activate fixed formations and manipulate them, there were inherent flaws.
Against practitioners of other professions, it might still work, but against an opponent who truly had a deep understanding of the spatial laws, a close observation would inevitably reveal opportunities to exploit.
Having fought for so long, Su Lun was actually calculating how to break the spatial seal secret technique on the puppet and pull Elsa, who was hidden inside, out!
Because the puppet was hidden in a subspace, there was no concept of real-world spatial distance.
To Su Lun, hundreds of meters was no different from being directly in front of him, within arm's reach.
When Su Lun chose to make his move, it was bound to be swift and resolute.
As soon as the puppet was forced out of the subspace, the black crow cawed and soared over, and then the whole bird became two-dimensional, turning into a black cloth full of black lines that wrapped around the entire puppet, severing all contact between the puppet and the outside world.
"Void Alchemy · Remote Grasping!"
Su Lun's hands formed sorcerer's seals again, and a black hole appeared out of thin air.
He reached into the void with one hand and pulled out a woman with a terrified expression.
Looking at the man who appeared as a god of death before her, the noble lady's pupils dilated immensely, her eyes filled with terror as if her gall had been ruptured by death.
Miss Elsa could never have imagined that even though her teacher had already made a move, how could this person still manage to capture her?
But reality didn't give her a chance to ponder; with a "crack," Su Lun directly snapped her neck.
To prevent that old man from having any life-saving measures, Su Lun even activated a Spatial Technique, brutally grinding the woman's head into dozens of pieces of bloody flesh.
Only when he saw the "grey mist" rising from the corpse did he finally relax.
...
Watching his disciple being killed in front of him, Master Aubrey's old face turned dark with anger and flushed with a strange crimson, "You... you..."
Only then did he understand that from the beginning, this person wasn't just bluffing but actually had the capability to kill!
The incident started because his disciple was kidnapped and killed by that old man's disciple – it was a death feud. Su Lun didn't have any intentions of holding back and said indifferently, "I said, the person I want to kill, you cannot protect."
He immediately collected the grey mist.
In a moment, Su Lun also confirmed that this matter had indeed nothing to do with Caroline, with whom he had a brief encounter before. Because although that woman guessed that he was the "Death," she did not know that he was "Fike Regadi."
This spared him the trouble of killing one more person.
Initially thinking it was almost over, but after pondering the details of the kidnapping, instead of feeling relief, his brows furrowed deeply.
"Things really aren't that simple, huh."
Thoughts flashed through Su Lun's mind in an instant. Not intending to entangle with the old man before him any longer, he added before leaving, "Though Your Excellence has a high rank, your understanding of the Space Law is far inferior to mine. I'll gladly take this puppet..."
For an enemy who already harbored intentions to kill, he wouldn't be polite.
At this moment, the crow had already wrapped up the [Mechanical Stealth Puppet], and all dozens of threads from Master Aubrey's implicated puppet were degraded.
The lifeline threads that were tough to cut with a black sickle before, Su Lun now severed with a single stroke.
Then, without breaking stride, he collected his spoils of war into a small void realm.
Yes, it was an outright robbery.
Now the old man's [Seven Dwarfs] became [Six Dwarfs].
Saying so, with a flash of spatial fluctuation, Su Lun disappeared from above the ruins.
...
Almost at the same time, hundreds of meters away.
Su Lun hadn't left Red Wine Street but teleported into a group of people.
This was the Bach family's personal bodyguard team; they couldn't participate in a battle of that level, but they hadn't left either.
Su Lun instantly spotted a woman in a black suit who was observing the battle.
This fourth-level professional was Miss Elsa's personal bodyguard leader.
Su Lun looked at Elsa's memories as an outsider, and thus he also noticed something amiss.
Clearly, the woman did indeed harbor resentment toward Kama due to the previous Puppet Master contest. But her murderous intent was incited by someone using a mysterious supernatural power of "spiritual manipulation."
The instigator was none other than this bodyguard leader.
Su Lun had seen her in the exhibition hall, so he remembered her soul's vibrations and quickly found her in the crowd.
The pair of severed hands that belonged to Kama had been given to Elsa by her.
Upon Su Lun's sudden appearance, the group of bodyguards showed a flash of shock on their faces.
But before they could react, a towering figure teleported behind this leader.
A gargoyle's claws, wrapped in a space storm, tore through the high-grade bulletproof vest and gouged a big bloody hole in her chest, killing her instantly.
Su Lun didn't bother with the other bodyguards who were making their moves; instead, he harvested the "gray mist" from the body of this suited woman.
The moment he digested that information, hope sparked in his eyes, and he was shocked to realize, "Kama isn't dead yet!"
While the suited woman didn't know much, the information she had was crucial.
The kidnappers had taken Kama, and given the chopped-off hands to the "middleman."
And when the middleman handed the hands to the suited woman, he also conveyed an important piece of information.
That was that Kama was still alive!
A part of the memory went as follows:
"Where is the body?"
"It's been sent to 17 Parrot Street in the Queen's district. Lawrence 'Raging Bear' of the Razor Gang owes me some favors, hoping I can bail him out by getting him a few virgin professionals. Anyway, Miss Elsa will rest assured once she sees these hands. Lawrence doesn't mess up. I'll take care of it."
"..."
Razor Gang, human trafficker, virgin professionals, urgent need...
To others, these keywords might still be shrouded in mystery.
But for Su Lun, they were enough to allow him to figure everything out.
He sensed a grand conspiracy approaching as he saw these messages.
Initially, he thought somebody was using bait to fish again,
but unexpectedly,
it turned out someone had cast a net!
Upon a moment's thought, Su Lun guessed why Kama was sent to "17 Parrot Street."
Because there resided an old monster that needed to feed on virgin blood.
Only then did he realize that Kama's kidnapping was directly related to last night's assassination attempt on the old creature Augustus.
The person planning from behind the scenes aimed not only to kill Elsa, but ultimately to lure him there!
...
Su Lun knew that the "Vampire Ring of Lilith" could sustain eternal youth, but the precondition was it needed enough young girls' fresh blood for nourishment.
Although he did not know which generation of the Rodriguez family that creep Augustus belonged to,
that guy had kept his youth due to the ring, which also granted him an immortal-like ability similar to that of a vampire.
He had narrowly survived the assassination last night but would need to absorb a considerable amount of virgins' essence to recover and stay alive.
Now, he suspected it wasn't because of Augustus's strength that he had a narrow escape, but rather the assassin deliberately left him alive.
All for this moment!
To await Su Lun's arrival, then transfer the crime of assassinating a top noble onto him.
He quickly pieced together the entire sequence of events, remarking with a sigh, "Such meticulous planning... Those guys probably also knew that Augustus is an important figure in the Rodriguez family. Should I kill him, even if I'm caught, not even revealing 'Fike's' identity, both the Lance and Regadi families wouldn't be able to protect me. Thus, the planned marriage would fall apart, and several Senior Councilors would be embroiled in civil strife, plunging the ruling faction of Ruying into complete chaos. Tsk tsk, killing many birds with one stone, no wonder they've been so eager to stage this play."
Su Lun knew his identity was unique.
He was "Fike," yet also a member of the Dawn organization.
A single person tied to several massive forces.
And he was pivotal during the critical moment of the marriage alliance between the Lance and Regadi families.
Therefore, targeting him would immediately achieve the effect of throwing the Ruying political scene into turmoil.
And the cost was small.
Even if exposed, outsiders wouldn't see much involvement in this affair.
Even with an investigation, it would look like nothing more than a kidnap-murder case motivated by jealousy, which accidentally dragged in a "vampire scandal."
At this very moment, that old creature Augustus probably didn't even realize he was being used.
And since he had guessed the motive, it wasn't hard for Su Lun to conjecture about the person behind the curtain, thinking, "In this light, with Ruying's political landscape thrown into disorder, the one to gain the most would be Duke Raphael, currently the first military industrialist of Ruying. It seems the young master William may also be involved in sabotaging the marriage..."
...
Knowing that Kama was still alive brought initial joy to Su Lun's heart.
But after understanding the whole backstory,
he no longer felt happy.
Kama might still be alive now, just to give him a glimmer of hope.
But from the moment he learned the news, Kama was most likely already dead at Augustus's hands.
Because only such a mortal grudge was sufficient to give Su Lun a reason to kill Augustus.
The moment Su Lun dared to kill Elsa, his humanity had been coldly calculated.
Being manipulated at every turn was a deeply uncomfortable feeling.
Su Lun realized the ins and outs of the whole affair, his eyes flickering with a cold light: "Now that this matter is concluded, it's really time to drag these sewer rats out into the sunlight one by one..."
However, it wasn't entirely without opportunity.
As long as he went early, there might still be a chance to save people.
Moreover, another positive aspect was that the person behind the scenes most likely didn't know that Su Lun had guessed that August was hiding and recovering at "17 Parrot Street in the Queen's District."
He feared that if he knew in advance, he might not dare to make a move because of the other party's identity.
However, the person behind the scenes probably didn't expect that Su Lun would not be merciful towards the followers of the "Giant's Hermit Society," the cultists of the Evil God.
They didn't realize that even if there were no kidnapping involved, if he truly found out where August was hiding, he would go anyway.
Especially since he had been coveting that "Lilith's Vampire Ring."
He had previously been vexed by the lack of a way to get his hands on it, so he wasn't in a rush to take action.
It was also known that August was an important leader within the "Giant's Hermit Society," and killing him could yield even more information about this evil cult.
He was not confident before about killing him one-on-one.
Now that person behind the scenes was afraid he wouldn't be able to kill him—after all, last night's assassination had severely injured him.
Furthermore, the life-prolonging method of that vampire ring can't withstand the light of day and must be concealed and used surreptitiously.
Being hidden means fewer people know, and there are fewer guards.
Now Su Lun felt that this was the best opportunity.
But now that these guys had dragged his disciple into this, even if the chances of survival were slim, Su Lun still wanted to do his utmost to help.
The risk was indeed not small, but he would definitely not submit to the will of those schemers!
"17 Parrot Street in the Queen's District, this address was probably deliberately made known to me. It seems that the person behind the scenes might have guessed that I have the ability to extract information from the souls of the deceased. They gave this clue with the intention that I would seek out the 'middleman' in the kidnapping to confirm the situation..."
With a brief thought, Su Lun immediately had a response in mind.
Now that he knew Kama's location, he did not hesitate at all and used Spatial Teleportation in succession to traverse the streets.
A thousand meters in the blink of an eye.
Heading straight over now, there might still be a slim chance to save Kama.
Moreover, when contacting Sabina, he received more good news—that the underground king of Lington, "Shadow Duke," had responded and would get involved in this matter.
...
Su Lun killed Miss Elsa and did not linger at the scene.
And Master Aubrey, the Puppetry Technique Grandmaster, having watched his disciple be killed, didn't stick around to wait for the Mounted Police to inquire.
Moreover, as his disciple was not in the right regarding the kidnapping and murder, he lacked the face to tell others.
Above the ruins of Winery Street, the smoke gradually dispersed, and the crowd of onlookers grew.
The always tardy Lington General Police Department arrived just in time to miss the action, perfectly coinciding with the end of the conflict.
In another district, a luxurious carriage from the Lance family rolled by.
Inside the carriage, Duke Batholomew looked at the ruins devoid of excitement and pursed his lips with disinterest, muttering, "Ah, the fight was indeed intense. It's a pity I didn't get to see it happen."
Being a top-tier fighter himself, he scrutinized the traces of battle and reconstructed some of the skirmish in his mind, "Judging by these marks, it looks like 'The Seven Dwarfs' quiet elemental golems must have made an appearance. Tsk, to make old Aubrey actually want to kill, yet not managing to... That kid's methods are becoming more and more formidable."
Ekaterina, standing beside him, listened to her father's prattling while expressionlessly surveying the surroundings.
Suddenly, she shifted her gaze a few hundred meters away, to a high ground that conveniently overlooked the nearby movements of Winery Street.
Something occurred to her, and she lightly parted her lips, whispering, "That William, the one behind the scheme, must have been watching the battle from there earlier."
Batholomew, curious, inquired, "Oh? Did you figure that out with astrological divination, Katusha?"
"No."
Ekaterina shook her head, saying, "William is too arrogant. He would surely come."
Batholomew seemingly understood yet didn't, "Criminal psychology? The perpetrator returns to the scene of the crime to take a look?"
Ekaterina replied, "It's just that William's character flaw. With a fair bit of talent, he always thinks the world revolves around him. Growing up smoothly in the Regadi family has certainly made him grow, but he can't handle setbacks. Once things stop going smoothly, his mentality is prone to extremism. He won't accomplish great things."
Batholomew, somewhat bored, shrugged and said, "I also find that William fellow quite distasteful. As for the other kid, he's more to my liking. But..."
Here, he seemed to recall something unpleasant, "Forget it. Otherwise, I'll feel like thrashing that guy again."
Ekaterina listened with an impassive face.
Batholomew glanced at his daughter and asked, "Nothing exciting to see here anymore? So, where to now?"
Ekaterina answered, "Keep an eye on the other Senior Councilors, especially the two families that bear a grudge against Duke Raphael. Also, their noble military units—if there is any large-scale troop movement, it means they have begun to fight."
Batholomew suddenly understood and continued, "But by the time we get there, the people might have all been killed. What excitement is there to see then?"
"The excitement begins after people are killed. Astrology predicts bloodshed today, an omen of great misfortune. A 'big shot' of considerable standing is likely to die."
Ekaterina toyed with a pair of purple meteorites in her hand.
As she spoke, she pondered for a moment, then murmured to herself, "Could it be some old fellow from one of those families? Tsk, this is getting more interesting."
...
After multiple instances of teleportation, Su Lun had appeared in a bustling, noisy district.
Parrot Street in the Queen's Quarter, a well-known arms trade market in the southern city.
The entire street was lined with gun retail and modification shops.
The arms business brought huge profits and inevitably involved gangs.
This area was a mix of several gangs—Razor Party, Motor Club, Fire Stealer Society, Ghost Gang... all remnants of smaller factions left after the whitewashing of the three big gangs of Lington.
The illegal human trafficking business in Lington was practically in their hands.
While the gangs might not have many high-level professionals, when it comes to kidnapping and knowing which family's young lady is a professional, no one was more proficient than them.
PS. Still not feeling well today, will make up for the updates tomorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - 452 [The Anywhere Door of Different Space Dimensions]
chapters.content:
Queens, Parrot Street.
Su Lun walked out of a deserted alley expressionlessly.
As he approached, a drizzle began to fall from the sky, and there were few pedestrians on the streets.
He held a black umbrella to shield himself from the rain, and the raindrops pattered lightly on its surface.
Extending his senses outward, he did not detect any formidable enemies.
It was as he expected.
The mastermind behind the scenes wouldn't make his entry too difficult.
Dressed in a black suit, Su Lun walked past several gun shops.
It didn't seem any different from an ordinary day here.
...
When Su Lun arrived, at Martin Arms Company's headquarters, No. 19 Parrot Street, the office was filled with smoke.
Razor Gang, Motorcycle Club, Fire Thieves, Ghosthead Gang...
The leaders of several major gangs from the southern city district were all gathered together.
Each one had a dark expression, engaged in a heated argument.
"Lawrence, what the hell is going on? Why this sudden rush for 'goods'? We've already managed two to three hundred since last night. Isn't that enough?"
"Exactly. If it were just ordinary young girls, fine, there are plenty to find. But damn, you also want professionals! My underground brothers are running ragged; we've kidnapped everyone we could in Queens. You say it's still not enough and need at least another hundred or two? If we keep this up, it's going to cause big problems."
"Hmph, well I can't manage anymore! Only the young ladies from wealthy families become professionals early, but after we kidnapped a few more, it seems the rich folk are onto us. They're prepared now. Just now, my boys tried to kidnap a manufacturer's daughter on Pelican Street, and a gunfight broke out, killing eight people! Eight of my brothers!"
"..."
Hearing the complaints of his fellow mob bosses, Lawrence, the "Raging Bear" from the Razor Gang, stood with a face just as dark and eyes filled with unspeakable bitterness and fatigue.
After listening, he shook his head and sighed, "Gentlemen, I know it's hard. But this is a strict order from the higher-ups. Just do your jobs."
Hearing this, Albert, the "Welding Gun" from the Motorcycle Club, said discontentedly, "Lawrence, give us a clear answer. Who needs these goods so desperately and in such large numbers? Aren't you afraid the Military Intelligence will start watching us?"
Lawrence shook his head, "Forgot the rules of the road? Even if I could say, would you dare to hear it? The steward from 'Blackstone Corporation' is here, who it is doesn't matter anymore."
Upon hearing this, everyone fell silent.
Indeed, as Lawrence pointed out, these mobsters mainly dealt in arms smuggling which all depended on "Blackstone Corporation" for a share of the spoils. An order from their big shots indeed was something they couldn't defy.
Yet, after a moment's thought, someone still unwillingly asked, "How big of a 'Big Shot'?"
Lawrence wanted to say, but he dared not, so he simply pointed upwards and said, "Top of the sky big."
Continuing, he added, "Go get it done, gentlemen. I can guarantee there won't be interference from the officials in Lindun. Can't get a merchant's daughter? Then target nobility, or scouting in the major preparatory academies... no matter what, you must gather enough! I'm laying it all out here; if you pull this off, we all strike it rich. If not, if the Big Shot gets angry, I'm definitely doomed, and you surely won't survive either."
The faces of the gang leaders showed fluctuating expressions, fully aware of the seriousness.
Eager to find a solution, they all bit their teeth and started notifying their gang members to continue the kidnappings.
...
Su Lun continued on his way.
He wanted to sense if there were any top professionals lurking around and to see if he could pick up any trace of Karma.
Walking on, he eventually reached a building whose iron gate bore the number 19.
Sabrina had already gathered that this place used to be a military warehouse abandoned by the Luying military. Now, it was the office of "Martin Arms Company."
A few gang members on lookout under the eaves were idly chatting away, clearly bored.
Su Lun knew he had found the right place.
Because in his perception, in a room on the third floor of this building, there was a group of third or fourth-tier professionals.
Although he didn't sense the presence of Kama or Augustus, among those people, there was one Su Lun had seen before.
It was the Raging Bear Lawrence from the Razor Gang.
Given what had happened previously at the music clubhouse, this mob boss was probably the one who handled the dirty work for the Rodriguez family. He was also the one who provided virgin blood for Augustus.
Finding him would immediately reveal where Augustus was.
Su Lun lingered at the door for half a minute, observing his surroundings and just about to enter, but at that moment, a black steam sedan swiftly approached from the side of the street.
As soon as the car arrived, the driver opened the window and shouted, "Hey, brother, delivery."
The guard looked at him and then the entrance barrier was opened, allowing the car to drive straight in.
In his perception, aside from the driver, there were three more people in the car.
Listening to their conversation, one of them was likely the "goods" that had been kidnapped.
Normally, this wouldn't have made Su Lun take a second glance, but he unexpectedly discovered that there was someone clinging to the underside of the car!
Moreover, the soul fluctuation of that person was familiar—it was the Old Cowboy "Spiritual Detective" Jerome whom he had seen before.
"How did this guy get here?"
A moment of confusion flashed through Su Lun's mind.
But seeing this guy infiltrating by clinging to the bottom of a vehicle, he immediately guessed that he was probably here to investigate.
After all, this guy was a very capable private detective.
"But this matter obviously involves a lot, given this guy's cautious nature, he shouldn't dare to take on such a case…" Su Lun suddenly thought of something and added mentally, "Could it be that his assistant Amelia was kidnapped?"
Thinking it over, he was most likely right.
Based on the information gathered so far, Rodriguez family's Augustus might be a very old monster.
That meant, he was heavily reliant on the Vampire Ring for sustenance.
But the assessment previously indicated that the curse properties of the ring required increasingly greater sacrifices as it got later.
After being seriously injured by an assassination attempt yesterday, the number of young girls he needed to consume was probably staggering.
As Su Lun learned from Sabina, from last night till now, the cases of missing young professional girls in southern Lington had indeed occurred frequently, with queued police reports.
However, in Lington, finding missing persons or similar cases was quicker through private detectives than through the police.
Especially for the civilian class.
As a result, private detectives received more assignments to find missing persons.
Su Lun thought of the excessively justice-driven Amelia.
At this crucial moment, being a detective and a second-tier professional, it wouldn't be strange for her to be kidnapped.
...
Su Lun sensed that the Old Cowboy had already entered the building, and there was no doubt about his investigative abilities.
His plan seemed to be to follow the girl who was kidnapped earlier and then find out where the human traffickers were sending her to.
He would then trace from there to locate the person.
However, Su Lun felt it wasn't necessary to go through such trouble.
Although he hadn't sensed Augustus's presence nearby, since the human traffickers had brought the victim here, Augustus was likely hiding somewhere close.
Now Kama was in imminent danger, and there was no time to delay.
Su Lun wasn't prepared to wait for Old Cowboy to find more clues.
Since they were here to rescue, startling the snake in the grass didn't matter.
Making some noise might even force the hidden Poison Snake to reveal itself.
With that thought, Su Lun didn't hesitate, looked at the third floor office, pinched a sorcerer's seal, and stepped towards the spatial rift that appeared before him.
Another look, and he had already moved from the small building's entrance to inside the room.
...
In the office of "Martin Firearms Company," noise filled the area.
But suddenly, the room was joined by a strange man wielding a black umbrella and a black scythe.
"Who are you..."
Seeing a stranger intrude, the expressions of these third and fourth grade gang leaders changed.
But before they could ask further, Su Lun's black scythe slashed twice swiftly.
Wherever the scythe blade passed, it cut everything in two.
These gang leaders knew they had encountered a tough opponent, and while firing back with their guns, they desperately ran towards the office exit—some smashed through the glass, some bolted through the doors, and some hid under desks...
Su Lun paid no attention to those fleeing, his black scythe decisively aimed at the slick-suited 'Raging Bear', Lawrence.
Under the stern and commanding presence, Lawrence's face showed great terror, and he immediately guessed that the kidnapping incident had been exposed, causing serious trouble.
However, this guy must have had some skills to be valued by August.
Watching the black scythe come down, he agilely dodged in an instant, astonishingly avoiding the swing.
At once, he let out a wild roar, his muscles twisted, his hair grew rapidly, and he transformed into a beastly Raging Bear state in a blink.
Seeing someone daring to attack directly, Lawrence knew he had encountered tough resistance.
He didn't plan on clashing head-on at all and decisively dashed forward. With a 'bang', he shattered the office wall and ran without looking back.
Would Su Lun give him that chance?
He appeared to have anticipated this, single-handedly clutched, and transparent threads on the wall suddenly materialized. The beast-transformed Lawrence was suddenly like prey stuck in a spider's web, frantically struggling to escape.
This guy's strength was obviously much higher than the ordinary fourth-grade professionals. In his violent struggling, he even began to show signs of breaking free of the threads.
Seeing this, Su Lun's eyes narrowed, and he swung his black scythe again with a raised hand.
But an unexpected scene happened again— a ring on his hand suddenly shattered, while simultaneously emitting a yellow light.
It was this light screen that surprisingly dissolved the spatial rift of the black scythe.
"Eh...?"
Su Lun uttered a light eh in his heart.
Clearly, this was another fine defensive cursed item, though it was disposable.
Having avoided two lethal attacks from Su Lun, Lawrence proved to be exceptional among the fourth-grade professionals.
The guy violently broke free of the threads, escaping dozens of meters in the blink of an eye.
But the next second, Su Lun ghostly appeared beside him, his spell fully condensed. He raised one hand forward, softly uttering, "Void Alchemy - Spatial Confinement!"
Space became sticky like glue, and Lawrence tried to struggle.
But would Su Lun give him another chance? The black scythe slashed down, and immediately a human fountain ensued.
A "gray mist" quickly appeared on the corpse.
After Su Lun harvested, he immediately digested the relevant information and was surprised to discover that August was actually hiding in this building!
...
At that moment, a sneaky fellow also rushed over upon hearing the news and appeared at the end of the corridor.
Seeing Su Lun, who was projecting the shadow of a second-stage Death reaper, he was greatly surprised, "Second-stage 'Death'? Did this guy also offer his soul to the gods?"
Su Lun also noticed the Old Cowboy hurrying over and glanced sideways at him.
Though he had no intention to kill,
his talent in the second-stage state carried with it a terrifying pressure, as if Death itself had descended.
Commanding respect without anger.
Worried that Su Lun might not recognize him, the Old Cowboy quickly removed his gang disguise and said timidly, "Oh, Mr. Client! It's me, one of your own, don't attack!"
He hadn't expected to encounter Su Lun here.
Initially, he wanted to search for clues, but now, well, someone bolder and more skilled had directly stormed in.
Obviously, there was a more direct approach.
Seeing the abnormal manifestation of the Death reaper shadow, the Old Cowboy knew this was a powerful death-related ability.
Su Lun walked straight over, without wasting words, threw a communicator and said, "I need to find a door with an enchantment in this building. It might randomly appear in the position of any door."
This Old Cowboy was a very skilled professional detective, and having one more person to search would add more strength.
"A special door?"
The Old Cowboy was momentarily taken aback, then quickly understood, "Alright!"
No need to ask further, anyone here was certainly here for the same reason.
The two then split up, each heading down a staircase.
Having just stripped the memories from that Lawrence, Su Lun also knew that August was indeed healing in this building.
But the location was not certain.
Because August had a very special spatial curse object—"Doors of Arbitrary Spatial Dimensions" in his possession.
The guy was hiding inside it.
...
Su Lun forcibly entered the office of Martin Company, stabbing into the stronghold of a major gang.
In an instant, Parrot Street exploded into chaos, as various gang leaders started mobilizing their forces.
The first wave, several motorbikes and motorcycles swarmed from nearby streets, and the previously sparsely populated street suddenly swelled with hundreds of people. As the communicators spread the call, countless gang members continued to flood into Parrot Street.
And since this district was already an armory street, the reinforcing gang members were not short on firearms, picking up weapons and swarming into the building.
Su Lun had just walked up the staircase when he collided head-on with a group of gang members wielding various firearms.
The two sides didn't bother with pleasantries, just a chaotic burst of gunfire.
Then a heap of bodies fell.
Having collected the guns, Su Lun continued to check the doors on every floor, trying to find an unusual "door."
Apart from his side, another staircase also erupted with the sounds of intense gunfire.
Su Lun was not worried.
The Old Cowboy might seem timid, but his actual combat strength was definitely strong.
This was far beyond what those gangs could handle.
There were many rooms within the headquarters of Martin Company including the basement warehouse, totaling a few hundred rooms.
Su Lun quickly scanned several floors but still didn't find any door with abnormalities.
Just then, a voice suddenly came through the communicator, "I've found it!"
Su Lun's expression hardened, and in an instant, he had teleported to the side of the Old Cowboy on another floor.
Seeing a living person appear out of thin air next to him, the Old Cowboy, who still had the communicator by his mouth, was slightly startled.
But thinking of the previous scene of the specter of Death, he guessed that this was the person from the newspapers.
It no longer surprised him.
As soon as Su Lun arrived, he looked at door 304 in front of him which had no anomalies, and asked, "Where?"
The Old Cowboy pointed at the door, "Just here, but it escaped!"
As he spoke, he hastened to add, "I've marked the door already."
Su Lun frowned and asked, "Where is the door now?"
Hearing this, the Old Cowboy took out an ancient, copper-smelling compass from his pocket, checked it, and pointed underground, "Basement first floor, twenty meters down the left corridor!"
As he spoke, he didn't forget to add another word of caution, "It's a sentient door that runs at the hint of danger. When you spot it, make sure you secure it immediately."
"Hmm."
While Su Lun's voice still echoed in the corridor, his figure had already vanished.
...
In the blink of an eye, Su Lun appeared on the first basement floor.
At a glance, there was a plain-looking door before him, but his All-knowing Eye identified it not as a "normal door" but an "Interdimensional Any-door."
Su Lun observed the energy fluctuations emerging from the door, which clearly contemplated escape.
He was well-prepared, and with a lightning-fast move, grabbed the doorknob.
The spatial fluctuations solidified, and the door, like a fox tethered by iron chains, settled down immediately.
Upon careful inspection, this door and Su Lun's own "Stanitz's Chessboard" had similar effects, capable of creating an independent alternate dimension.
However, this was not real space, but rather a dream-like virtual space, classified as a mysterious cursed object.
This was precisely why Su Lun hadn't sensed it with his spatial senses earlier because this door was of the mysterious type and not the spatial type, and it was of no low tier.
Moreover, the door itself possessed a degree of sentience, sensing the intentions of those who touched it and then preparing to flee or not.
It was indeed very safe for Augustus to heal inside of it.
If Su Lun hadn't understood the Space Law, and seized it,
ordinary people wouldn't have noticed anything amiss, and even if they had, upon opening it, they would find it just a ordinary door.
Seeing this cursed object, Su Lun couldn't help but feel moved.
The Rodriguez family, with its centuries of accumulation, indeed possessed quite a few special treasures.
Su Lun grew even more cautious in his heart.
That old monster had probably more in hand than just the "Lilith's Vampire Ring."
...
This door was very special, not only hard to locate, but once entered, one would find themselves in a world constructed by mysterious forces, which could also trap those who ventured inside.
However, for Su Lun, this was a minor issue.
Instead, he was concerned about what condition Augustus was in inside.
Such a creature, even if gravely wounded, would definitely not place itself in danger.
His daring to heal here meant that he must have had some assurance of survival should he be discovered.
Su Lun didn't hesitate; after leaving his spatial coordinates on the doorknob, he turned the handle.
Upon opening the door, he was greeted by an expanse of void.
Su Lun stepped right in.
The scenery shifted around him from the hallway into something resembling... the interior of a biological organism.
A heavy stench of blood assaulted his nostrils.
It was a foul smell of blood.
Although Su Lun was not gifted with olfactory talent, his ability to discriminate scents was quite strong. He recognized the repulsive odor immediately; it was a mixture of several hundred types of human blood.
Moreover, the resentment was profound.
The space was dimly lit, the walls around were dark red, and even pulsed as if with a heartbeat. On closer inspection, the walls were covered with thick blood vessels, and the space was hung with some crimson flesh tissues.
It was a flesh space.
Su Lun was not surprised.
He had witnessed a similar scene before in the "Legend of the Bell Tower Monster," knowing this was a manifestation of human body mutations merging with the space.
Upon entering, he knew, Augustus's condition was worse than he had imagined.
His pupils dilated, taking in the entire space at a glance.
As expected, the identity revealed was not human but "The Mutating Gluttonous Tyrant - Augustus."
...
"It really has mutated..."
Su Lun observed, his brows slightly furrowed, tightening his grip on the rune-inscribed black umbrella.
He didn't concern himself with what Augustus had turned into; upon entering, he felt over a hundred soul fluctuations.
Some spirits were very faint, on the verge of dispersing, others showing signs of turning into resentful spirits.
This meant there were both living people and those who had just died.
Su Lun carefully distinguished among these soul fluctuations and his pupils narrowed immediately, "Kama realmente is here after all!"
His heart surged with elation.
Once locked onto the perception,
Su Lun also found that Kama's soul fluctuation was still very clear,
Not appearing to have already died,
but still displaying faint signs of life!
Moreover, not just Kama, he also discovered that within that group, the soul fluctuation of Amelia was also precisely here!
"Good, they're not dead!"
Su Lun felt a wave of relief.
Since he was here to rescue people, he didn't hesitate, teleporting hundreds of meters and appearing in a corner of this world of flesh.
Looking around, he saw a mass of scarlet tissue resembling embryonic tumors, hung in mid-air by robust blood vessels.
Upon closer inspection, each of the hundreds of flesh tumors contained a young, naked girl. Like a blood transfusion bag, the flesh surrounding them was extracting blood from their bodies to supply the entire space.
The naked girls curled up in the transparent fluid looked peaceful, as if they were asleep.
But when Su Lun sensed their presence, he found that the souls of the vast majority were gone, leaving only pale husks behind.
They had clearly been dead for some time.
"Augustus, this old monster, sucked dry hundreds of people in one night..."
Su Lun's eyes narrowed slightly.
At the same time, his camera, which he carried with him, went crazy snapping photos, capturing every scene.
The silver lining, however, was that Karma, perhaps because she was brought in too late, hadn't yet been drained of her blood and still showed slight signs of life.
Su Lun quickly swung his black scythe, "swish, swish, swish," severing the blood bags of Karma and twenty or thirty other girls who were still barely alive.
The "splash" of transparent viscous fluid flowed everywhere, and dozens of unconscious girls fell to the ground.
Some of them were still somewhat conscious, and others were awakened by the fall. But because of the excessive blood loss, they could only look up with pale, helpless eyes at Su Lun, who had come to their rescue.
The very moment Su Lun severed the flesh tumors, the bloody space seemed to come alive. Blood vessels on the floor and ceiling, like leeches extending their necks, grouped together and reached out as if they wanted to reconnect and continue sucking the girls' blood.
Su Lun's scalp tingled slightly.
It was then that he sensed a soul fluctuation not far behind him.
Turning around sharply, he saw a lump of wriggling red flesh bulge from the bloody floor, which rapidly morphed into a human form.
Looking at the handsome features, who could it be if not Augustus?!
...
The intruder in his strange space clearly surprised him too, and as he looked at Su Lun, he asked in a deep voice, "Who are you?"
He knew well that healing his wounds required a large number of girls; capturing so many, he couldn't keep it hidden.
But to be found so quickly, that still surprised him.
A gloomy look filled Augustus's eyes as he watched Su Lun sever his numerous sources of blood, but he did not interfere.
Because as long as they were in this space, they were meat already swallowed into his stomach.
He didn't feel even slightly threatened by this intruder.
Because in this space, no one could leave alive.
Even a seventh-tier professional would die!
And the person in front of him was clearly not of the seventh tier.
...
Though Su Lun had seen Augustus a few times, this guy clearly didn't recognize him.
Hearing the question, he didn't bother with courtesy; as soon as they met, he swung his black scythe in an attack.
Augustus noticed the black scythe and his eyes narrowed slightly, but he did not attempt to dodge; instead, a mocking smile crept over his lips.
A "swish" of the blade, and a spatial fissure bisected his body.
Immediately, a cold laugh of "ske ske ske" filled the air.
Upon looking again, the bisected Augustus was visibly regrowing a new body.
Su Lun's eyes grew sharp, and he discerned some trick at play: "Can't kill him in this space?"
At that moment, his peripheral vision caught sight of Karma and the group of girls on the ground, already beginning to be drained of blood again.
Su Lun did not hesitate; he raised his hand and swung two more cuts, chopping Augustus into several pieces again.
It was just like the scene that had just occurred a moment ago.
Augustus once again coalesced from the blood-meat walls, his mouth spilling contemptuous cold laughter, and he incessantly asked: "Who are you, exactly? How did you get here? Speak up, and maybe I'll let you leave with your life."
He recognized that the black scythe was no ordinary enchanted item, it looked somewhat familiar, but he couldn't quite place it.
Like a cat eyeing the fish in a bowl, this old monster from the Rodriguez family didn't rush to act but instead aimed to extract some useful information from Su Lun's mouth.
His intuition told him the situation was a major issue.
Attacked last night, and today someone shows up? Just when his injuries would've healed in a couple more days, somebody comes now?
And with his mob outside, the fact that this person got in meant that his situation had been exposed.
How did this guy find his way here?
What did he know?
Augustus felt he needed to clear these questions up, or else he might face serious problems.
But the response he received were just more spatial fissures from the black scythe.
...
"Swish," "swish," "swish"!
The flesh-and-blood body was again chopped into pieces.
Augustus's body was chopped up for the third time and finally couldn't regenerate. He had to grow a new body from the flesh walls again.
Seeing the futility of the stranger's efforts, he still tried to persuade, "Useless. Here, you can't escape, you can't kill me. If you came to rescue someone, tell me who it is. If you answer my questions, I might let you all leave…"
"..."
Su Lun didn't believe his lies.
Having stumbled upon this old monster's secret, he must have murderous intentions.
Let him go?
Heh.
Did he really think no one knew he was an old monster?
Being calculated by enemies to this extent, he was still naively hopeful.
Besides, Su Lun could leave this place on his own and save everyone without anyone letting them.
The few probing slashes he had made were to buy time and figure out how to kill this old monster.
Now was his chance!
Su Lun suddenly made a grasping motion in the air, and with a fierce tug at the threads on his fingers,
the dozens of trapped girls in the flesh orbs were jerked forward, pulling the blood-drinking vessels taut. At that moment, sharp threads swept across, once more severing the connection between the tumors and the space.
This time, Su Lun didn't place the severed tumors on the ground but instead swiftly formed a sorcerer's seal with one hand, quickly creating a vortex black hole in his palm.
With a pull of the threads, dozens of girls were stuffed into the small void world.
There, Dr. Banks' medical team was ready, and the girls, suffering from significant blood loss, could receive immediate medical attention.
Having done this, Su Lun finally took a deep breath of relief.
Karma was finally saved!

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - 453 【Siegfried's Dragon Slayer Dagger】(Supplement)
chapters.content:
This the first draft; there are quite a few errors, and I am in the process of correcting them. You can read it a bit later.
"This... you...!!"
Seeing this scene, Augustus's face suddenly changed, his eyes twinkling with disbelief.
He hadn't had time to stop it when he saw his remaining "blood nourishment" being stowed away in a space.
How is that possible?!
In an instant, Augustus completely lost contact with those blood nourishments, plunging him into endless panic.
These blood nourishments were fundamental to his survival; without them, his mutation would be uncontrollable.
Even if he did not die, he would soon turn into a monster.
After such difficulty obtaining these blood nourishments, how could someone have taken them away?
...
"You... what on earth did you do!"
Augustus roared, his face no longer held the mocking amusement of a cat catching a mouse, only the worry and fear of facing death.
He found he could not sense them at all!
How could that be? Even if hidden in a storage space or similar sub-space, he could absorb it in this alien space.
This was the most important reason why he had been so fearless before.
But now, it had completely vanished!
Su Lun was not about to explain to an enemy that the "Little Void Realm" was an independent plane.
He had just rescued the person and could have teleported away immediately.
The laws of this alien space were indeed very high, and with Su Lun's current understanding of the Space Law, he really couldn't escape.
But he had a large piece of "Shattered Plane Crystal Source," a top-class space treasure at the plane level.
As long as he was willing to use it, almost any special space in this plane could not trap him.
This was also why Su Lun dared to make his move in the master-filled City of Spirits.
With this crystal, unless the enemy's strength was so great that his teleportation spells couldn't react in time and he was killed instantly.
Otherwise, if he wanted to leave, no one could stop him!
....
But now, seeing the distraught Augustus, Su Lun was not in a hurry to leave.
A severely injured old monster was a rare opportunity.
Kama was successfully rescued, and he himself had life-preserving means. Now was the time to ponder the "Lilith's Vampire Ring."
Since he was already involved, it would be more exciting to stir up bigger trouble.
After a few probing attacks just now, this guy really could regenerate infinitely.
But now that I've cut off your nourishment, let's see if you die?
Just as expected, the moment several dozen young girls were taken into the Little Void Realm, the entire flesh and blood space suddenly became agitated.
The blood vessels, like starved leeches, searched everywhere for targets. Unable to find them, each one became frantic.
Light shimmered from Su Lun's left eye, clearly showing that this guy's previously reversing mutation had now intensified!
Even without interfering, this guy would gradually turn into a monster.
"Damn it! What exactly did you do!"
Augustus was dumbfounded by Su Lun's move.
He could never have expected that someone in this alien space could take away his blood nourishment?
He now needed to continually consume the essence of young girls' blood to ensure he did not continue to degrade.
He had just stabilized his injuries by consuming them all night, and now that someone had taken dozens of his blood nourishments, he was immediately plunged into a life-or-death situation.
Moreover, it was unclear what was happening outside, and chances were that something had gone wrong, making it difficult to expect more fresh nourishment to be brought in.
This act posed a lethal threat to him!
At this moment, Augustus held no more illusions; he knew that killing the man before him was the only way to possibly reclaim his blood nourishment.
In an instant, he charged towards Su Lun.
"Such incredible speed!"
Su Lun's gaze hardened.
After all, this Augustus was a genuine sixth rank!
And the kind who had lived for who knows how many years!
Moreover, at the very moment this old monster developed a killing intent, Su Lun suddenly felt as though there was a suction force around him. It was as if a water pump was rapidly drawing out the dark spiritual power from his body. Especially from the ground beneath his feet, the speed at which the spiritual power was draining was like gathering the consumption of a sixth-level Alchemist!
Just as he noticed something was wrong, Augustus had already charged in front of him, and the two of them exchanged blows, suddenly plunging into a fierce hand-to-hand combat.
And during the combat, Su Lun realized the problem was even bigger!
With each punch and kick that connected, Augustus's body exhibited a strong suction force, sticking to Su Lun and making it hard for him to break free, while his internal spiritual power leaked out like a dam burst!
"So strong!"
Su Lun instantaneously thought of the level-two ability, "B-010-Glutton," which could devour all energy for its own use.
Moreover, this was different from the level-two Glutton ability he had previously understood.
Augustus, this old fellow who had lived for who knows how long, had developed a special use of this ability. Now, the entire different space was at his disposal.
That meant, as long as Su Lun was trapped here, he would eventually be drained dry and die.
"No wonder he was so confident hiding and healing on Parrot Street, so this is why. In this space, he can't die, but one's body energy will continuously be absorbed... In this situation, even a seventh-tier professional without countermeasures would die on the spot."
Only then did Su Lun come to a realization.
Normally, Augustus would just hide in this different space. Not to mention whether anyone could find him, even if someone did, entering here would most likely mean death as nourishment.
...
It was just a fleeting thought, and Augustus had already fought him for over a dozen rounds.
Each contact resulted in a large portion of the dark spiritual power inside Su Lun being sucked away.
With this rate of energy consumption, a normal sixth-tier professional's spiritual power would be drained dry in just a few rounds.
Unfortunately, Su Lun had the epic implant, "Isaac's Alchemical Heart," that provided him with an endless supply of dark spiritual power.
Su Lun didn't think of how to kill Augustus for a while, so he just kept fighting.
No matter the black scythe, overwhelming aura, or any other method, even if they could cause severe damage to this old monster, he would recover instantly.
Su Lun felt somewhat helpless.
The only way he could think of to kill this guy was to drop enough bombs to blow up the entire space.
However, this method was obviously not considered, as blowing it up could destroy the different space and possibly the Vampire Ring as well.
As they continued to fight, Augustus obviously also noticed something unusual.
Under normal circumstances, even a seventh-tier professional should show signs of spiritual exhaustion by now, but why did this guy show no anomalies and seemed even more vigorous as the fight continued?
Originally unbeatable in this different space, he could slowly test out the depths of his opponent.
But now, he was in a hurry to retrieve those blood meals and had no intention of entangling with Su Lun for long.
At that moment, during their fight, he deliberately took a hit from a scythe, but suddenly a dagger emitting an eerie red light "grew" out of his palm!
Su Lun saw this and felt a bad premonition, but this old monster's moves were extremely tricky, and it was already too late to dodge.
The blade passed, and the rune-luster on his skin subtly emerged.
But what was intended happened.
In a moment of crossing, time seemed to slow down by tenfold.
Though Su Lun tried hard to avoid, he could only watch as the dagger's blade grazed his arm's skin and then... cut a deep blood mark!
Even the rune-infused bones clearly had another cut mark.
"How is that possible!"
Seeing this, Su Lun was greatly shocked.
The "Rune Vajra," enveloped in overwhelming aura, had previously faced a seventh-tier Puppet Grandmaster, O'Bri and hadn't been cut through, yet now it was sliced as easily as paper—how was this possible?
Su Lun never expected such a result; his skin, flesh, and bones were all inscribed with "Himinlewa's Sea God Runes," making his body strong enough to withstand cannonballs, yet they weere breached by a dagger?
The key was that the opponent was only a sixth-tier professional!
In that instant, Su Lun knew that there was something strange about that dagger., Upon closer inspection, it indeed was extraordinary!
"Siegfried's Dragon Slayer Dagger"
Quality: Corrupted Magic Weapon
Description: Indestructible, nothing unbreakable;
Curse Feature: Devours the essence of high-grade living beings to feed the dagger, enhancing its sharpness; Continuous killing and absorption of the essence blood of living beings activates the God Slaying Runes, temporarily granting a 'Sharpness' effect, the higher the quality of essence blood consumed, the greater the increase in sharpness, with no upper limit; Effects include breaking aura, breaking magic, breaking energy barriers, and forced bleeding effect; Needs to be fed daily, otherwise the sharpness increase will gradually fade until it returns to ordinary;
Detailed Description: This is a cursed dagger that had once slain more than one divine-class giant dragon. Forged by ancient dwarfs using God Meteor Iron, which even gods fear, and inscribed with the forbidden "God Slaying Runes." A magical item left from the ancient dwarf civilization, its sharpness makes even mythic dragons tremble; after millions of years sealed, this magic weapon lost its sharpness for slaying gods and demons, but because it returned to being ordinary, it went unnoticed by gods and thus survived in this broken plane."
Su Lun's eyes momentarily gleamed as he discerned the results of his inspection.
A magic weapon?
This... what kind of quality is this?
Su Lun knew the Rodriguez family had some good treasures, but he never thought Augustus would have an ancient magic weapon in his hands.
The dagger's effect is very simple and brutal, just sharp, capable of penetrating anything with its sharpness!
Indeed, none of these top-tier old nobles are simple.
The moment it was identified, Su Lun forcefully endured the pain from his wounds and suddenly pulled away.
He teleported to dodge and create distance, but Augustus's figure had already appeared behind him again.
In this dimensional space, the old monster could sense any fluctuation of energy.
So he anticipated Su Lun's landing spot in advance, and the crimson dagger stabbed at him once more.
Unable to dodge in time, Su Lun could only raise his hand to pull a gargoyle in front of him.
As the red light swept by, the indestructible gargoyle had its arm cleanly severed!
"What a sharp dagger!"
Su Lun watched, his eyelids twitching.
Glancing at the wound on his arm from the corner of his eye, his expression grew serious.
The dagger's "forced bleeding" effect caused relentless bleeding from the wound, and if not treated, he could bleed to death.
Luckily, being both a doctor and a Puppet Master, threads quietly emerged from the wound, stitching together the broken nerves, blood vessels, and tissue.
Although there was no sign of healing, at least the bleeding wasn't so severe anymore.
At that moment, Su Lun realized that killing Augustus was indeed not going to be easy.
...
However, the Dragon Slayer's Dagger from Siegfried was ultimately just a melee weapon and couldn't unleash any sort of long-range attacks like Sword Qi.
After a few tentative moves, Su Lun gradually adjusted to the rhythm of the battle and finally could breathe a sigh of relief.
If the dagger could attack through the air like his Black Scythe, it would truly be invincible.
He could only choose to leave.
Despite fighting for so long, Su Lun had not found a way to kill Augustus, and the battle had forced him into an increasingly pitiful state.
That guy could appear anywhere in the dimensional space, impossible to kill, impossible to hide from, evidently determined to wear him out.
Wear down?
With Isaac's Alchemical Heart, Su Lun naturally couldn't be worn out.
He harbored the same intention, waiting for Augustus to be worn out.
Yet, he felt, even if he dragged it out until Augustus mutated into a monster, it wouldn't improve his situation.
It would probably get even worse.
After all, the combat prowess usually became even stronger in a mutated state compared to the human state.
In this dimensional space, Su Lun likewise couldn't kill the mutated Augustus.
Moreover, dragging it out any further, he still had no idea what the situation outside was like.
Once he went out, he would be bombarded by a crowd of seventh- and eighth-tier professionals, and even if Su Lun was incredibly strong, he'd be killed instantly.
Just when Su Lun felt he truly couldn't overcome this and was considering retreating to find another opportunity.
Suddenly, as he glanced around, he noticed something unusual.
That was part of the flesh, which had turned from red to black.
Su Lun immediately realized something, thinking, "Is this because too much dark spiritual power was absorbed and couldn't be digested in time?"
Suddenly, he thought of a way to break the situation!
The second solution's B-010-Glutton was indeed very powerful, capable of consuming all types of energy for its use.
But this talent also had a prerequisite, that it was limited by the professional himself.
Although Augustus was strong, he was only a sixth-tier professional. The amount of energy his body could hold was limited!
It was absolutely impossible to contain the massive amount of dark spiritual power from Isaac's Alchemical Heart!
In the previous battle, Su Lun had already lost several sixth-tier professionals' dark spiritual power, showing signs of "indigestion" in Augustus.
Su Lun had previously been carefully controlling it, fearing that supplying too much dark spiritual power to the opponent would be detrimental to himself.
But now, he no longer controlled it, as dark spiritual power crazily surged from his body!
He released energy actively, much faster than before, by tens of times!
You absorb, and I'll let you absorb!
In an instant, Su Lun himself became a huge vortex of dark spiritual power, with energy crazily overflowing.
Augustus also noticed the issue and immediately stopped the active absorption.
But this space was as good as his own body, where even if he didn't actively absorb, some would still be passively absorbed. Moreover, in a sealed space, without absorption, there was simply no other way for the energy to dissipate.
It was like the food in his stomach, with someone relentlessly stuffing more food inside, and even if he didn't want to digest it, the food swelling in his throat would suffocate him!
Gradually, the walls of flesh changed color from bright red to dark red, and some even turned black, producing uncontrollable tumor-like growths!
The only outcome of the excessive surge of foreign Spiritual Power into his body was mutation.
Su Lun saw his plan was succeeding, and he stopped fighting Augustus head-on. Instead, he dodged while frenziedly releasing dark Spiritual Power.
Fear finally appeared on Augustus' face.
When he realized that he couldn't kill the man in front of him and that this man's energy seemed inexhaustible, he went from fear to despair.
"Damn it, what the hell are you doing!"
"Oh! No, don't! Spare me, I can pay a ransom of ten billion..."
"I am the family ancestor of the Rodriguez family. I can give you everything..."
"..."
No matter how much he pleaded, Su Lun had no intention of stopping.
The dark Spiritual Power continued to pour in relentlessly.
Like that, after nearly half an hour, Augustus, already heavily injured, couldn't hold on any longer.
The curse of the Vampire Ring and the "indigestion" from the massive amount of dark Spiritual Power finally caused this ancient monster to completely mutate into a creature.
The mutated Augustus no longer had any rational control over absorbing energy.
In its monster state, it crazily absorbed everything.
Then, under Su Lun's continuous energy infusion, the energy balance within the creature was ultimately disrupted, and several mixed forces collided in another dimension.
"BOOM!"
A loud explosion occurred.
The flesh of the entire space exploded, casting bits of flesh everywhere, a terrifying display of power.
Only after the explosion subsided did Su Lun emerge from a clear puppet.
It must be said that this newly acquired war trophy, the "Machine Killing Stealth Puppet," was really useful.
It withstood the sixth-order Dark Gold tier bizarre self-explosion unscathed.
Su Lun saw the "gray mist" rising from the flesh and finally breathed a sigh of relief.
...
"Killed him, huh..."
Su Lun raised his eyebrows, looking exhausted.
Blowing up that monster had also nearly depleted all his dark Spiritual Power.
Fortunately, Isaac's Alchemical Heart possessed a continuous powerful automatic recovery ability, so he wouldn't take long to recuperate.
After harvesting the gray mist, a stream of information flooded into his mind.
"You have stripped 'Augustus Rodriguez's' soul."
"You have comprehended some of the sixth-order 'Calamity Law' and 'Darkness Law'"
"You have gained 'Hundred Years of Devouring Techniques Experience', comprehending [Devouring], [Foreign Energy Absorption], [Enhancement] abilities."
"You now know a vast amount of the Rodriguez family's secret intelligence."
"You have obtained intelligence: 'The spread of the Red Death was preparation for that great one's descent onto the world...'"
"You have obtained information: 'I have a safe under the alias 'Williams' at the Royal Bank's headquarters in London, where a large amount of high-tier treasures is stored...'"
"..."
"Lived more than one hundred and fifty years old? The true power holder behind the scenes of the Rodriguez family?"
Su Lun, looking at the memories he had stripped, also realized that he had poked a huge hole this time.
The Rodriguez family, one of the senior councilor seats of the Ruying, had their leader killed by him?
However, these were not things he needed to ponder in detail right now.
Su Lun turned his attention back to the flesh in front of him.
Disgusting as it was, he had no choice but to search through it.
He looked for the [Lilith's Vampire Ring], the magical weapon [Siegfried's Dragon Slayer Dagger], and some storage rings...
Fortunately, he had a puppet, so he didn't have to search through the mudslide-like rotten flesh himself.
Su Lun began the pleasant phase of collecting the spoils of war.
PS: Supplementary update

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - 454: A blood rain fell in Lyndon, wetting my umbrella.
chapters.content:
```
First draft. The alternate space was filled with shattered flesh and tissue, and for some unknown reason, after Augustus's monstrous self-destruction, the flesh fermented rapidly, emitting a hideous stench.
Luckily, Su Lun had plenty of puppets and threads. Before the space was completely filled with flesh, he managed to find what he wanted.
A ring as rustic as a ruby and a long dagger emitting red light, the treasures naturally being the "Lilith's Vampire Ring" and the magic weapon "Siegfried's Dragon Slayer Dagger".
As for whether there were other items in the space, such as Storage Rings and materials separated from the corpses, Su Lun planned to sort them out when he had more time.
Now, time was of the essence; he needed to flee at once.
After all, it was only after harvesting Augustus's memory that Su Lun knew this was a creature that had lived for over a hundred years.
It was also the true power behind the Rodriguez family.
The Senior Councilor in Congress, Bog Rodriguez, was this monster's own grandson!
Now that Augustus was dead, the Rodriguez family was bound to retaliate.
Su Lun was also relieved that this guy, probably to hide his identity, hadn't brought any high-level bodyguards with him.
Moreover, if it hadn't been for someone stirring up trouble in Lingdun's political scene and launching a sneak attack last night, Su Lun really didn't have the confidence that he could kill Augustus in his prime.
However, although the risk was great, the reward for killing this man was indeed substantial.
It wasn't just about treasures but also alchemy knowledge and various secrets.
This old monster had been stuck at the threshold of rank seven for over a hundred years; in terms of the sheer amount of knowledge, depth of principles, and understanding of Alchemy, he was absolutely the best among all those Su Lun had harvested from!
Harvesting the knowledge of a hundred-year-old professional was not something that could be equated with harvesting that of five twenty-year-old professionals put together.
When knowledge accumulates to a certain depth, one's ability to understand the world undergoes a qualitative change.
Moreover, Augustus was from a prominent noble family, one of the few at the pinnacle who had access to top-tier knowledge. His insight was certainly beyond the comprehension of ordinary people.
But unexpectedly, he met his demise in a most unexpected way.
Su Lun didn't know how the person behind the scenes had found out that this guy was an old monster.
But it sure did benefit him.
If he could assimilate this loot, Su Lun's understanding of Alchemy would definitely take a huge leap forward.
But those were not the current considerations.
After securing the spoils of war, Su Lun asked the crow on his shoulder, "Mr. Crow, should we scram?"
The crow "cawed" in response: No biggie.
Reassured by this, Su Lun walked out of the "Alternate Space Gate" that had appeared once again.
...
"Guys, search! We must find those two!"
"Word from above, kill on sight! All squads, report your status!"
"The first floor corridor's clear!"
"The second floor balcony is empty too!"
"…"
As soon as he emerged, Su Lun saw a sleazy-looking guy by the door, imitating the voices of the people upstairs, yelling, "The basement storeroom's clear too!"
At that, the corner of Su Lun's eye twitched.
With that sleazy manner, who else could it be but Old Cowboy?
The guy had changed into a mobster's black leather jacket and pants, slung a shotgun over his shoulder, and wore a big gold chain around his neck. It was probably because of this getup that he had managed to infiltrate the enemy lines, evading the mobsters' blockade.
What's key was that nobody in the mob's lair had yet noticed anything amiss.
Now that's some real skill.
Seeing Su Lun emerge, the fellow quickly came over and said, "Oh dear, my dear client, you finally came out! That, um…"
Before he could continue, Su Lun saw the genuine anxiety in his eyes, and interrupted, "Amelia is still alive. My doctor is treating her right now; she should be fine."
Hearing this, Old Cowboy visibly sighed in relief.
He theatrically patted his chest and muttered to the air, "That reckless girl, I told her not to touch this case. She just had to go bam, now she's prompted a big mess. She ought to learn her lesson..."
Though grumbling, his tone conveyed deep affection.
Su Lun didn't hold a bad impression of Old Cowboy, despite his seeming cowardice.
Plus, Su Lun always felt that he saw a bit of himself in the man.
After murmuring to himself, Old Cowboy then remembered something and exaggeratedly said to Su Lun, "Whoa, a lot of folks have shown up outside. You need to be careful! And outside, they've activated some kind of barrier, flashing with blue light; it looks like a kind of spatial restriction barrier. You definitely shouldn't use any Spatial Techniques."
Old Cowboy's observational skills
Hearing this, Su Lun peeked through a vent in the wall and sure enough, he saw a blue barrier in the sky.
"Prism Barrier?"
Su Lun was slightly surprised.
Even without the All-knowing Eye, he recognized the sparkling blue barrier at a glance.
