But as long as Rafael chose to avoid battle, neither Su Lun nor Yekaterina could do anything about him.
But this guy also hadn't found any hope of breaking the combined forces of the two.
The situation suddenly seemed to have reached a deadlock.
Su Lun, looking at Rafael with an ugly expression, continued to provoke him verbally, "Now you've also tried but couldn't kill us. We can't kill you either. How about we stop here? The triple commission I mentioned before is still valid."
Upon hearing this, Rafael's eyes filled with a cold glint, and he remained silent.
He was here to kill, not for the money.
But having just tried, he no longer had any assurance of being able to kill these two.
If things continued like this, waiting for the Lance family or the masters from the Regadia area to come to aid, there would no longer be such an opportunity.
With this in mind, the demon monk seemed to make a decision and suddenly let out a cold laugh, "Hehehe... I must admit, both of you have indeed exceeded my expectations. Even, if everyone in Luying knew that Miss Lance possessed the strength of a top-tier fighter, they would be shocked beyond belief. But... don't you think that you can leave alive tonight?"
This cold laugh seemed to imply: Alright, I'm done pretending.
Su Lun listened without any expression, but continued taunting, "I'm not afraid to tell you, I've already contacted Lyndon, and soon reinforcement will arrive. You don't really think that just because you're a legendary hunter, you can definitely kill us, do you?"
Yet in his heart, he was anticipating some imminent events: I've waited so long, is it finally coming?
Rafael ignored the threat and chanted to the sky, invoking the name of a divine deity, "O great Lord of Calamity above, your devout follower begs for your power..."
As the spell was chanted, the muscles under the demon monk's skin also began to move. On closer inspection, they resembled worms wriggling.
At the same time, his momentum grew increasingly stronger, and a terrifying and indescribable will descended upon this world.
Su Lun's complexion drastically changed when he saw this!
He swiftly put away Yekaterina and without hesitation turned and fled, appearing several hundred meters away in a blink.
Seeing this, Rafael showed no surprise nor did he pursuit, only a mocking sneer on his face, "Heh... Running away?"
"You think you can escape?"
It wasn't long before that will fully descended, and the demon monk's momentum suddenly changed, becoming ethereal.
Once again, he took out the previously collected blood and began chanting the mysterious incantations of Curse Magic.
With the chant of the spell, a black nine-pointed star magic circle instantly appeared.
Rafael shouted, "Curse Magic: Nashmara's Gaze!"
Simultaneously, a gigantic hollow eye appeared in the sky, as if a True God was watching over the mortal realm.
With the divine power augmenting the same technique!
Whoever it targets would undoubtedly die!
Can your fate be tougher than a god?
As the technique solidified, a wild smile broke across Rafael's face, as if he could already see Su Lun's death.
...
Meanwhile, sensing that indescribable will that he had once encountered, Su Lun looked panicked, but actually, he was not surprised.
As if he had been waiting for a long time, he merely murmured, "Has it finally come out?"
Even with the overwhelming murderous aura pressing down, causing a tingling sensation on his scalp, Su Lun wasn't much perturbed.
At that moment, the concrete crisis of death from the god rapidly approached, and a beam of black light reached across thousands of meters in an instant.
Su Lun's expression was calm yet slightly tense, with only a hint of madness betting it all.
The medium for the Curse Magic was his own blood, a vulnerability left from the beginning.
For this very moment!
In an instant, he seemed to transform, his fingers forming an orchid sign, a very strange yet "cute" smile lifting the corners of his mouth. He opened his eyes and stared directly at the mysterious will descending from the sky, letting out a girlish, sinister giggle, "Hehehe, interesting... "
In that moment, the light of the curse fell.
Su Lun stood bathed in the black light, his smile still radiant.
In the distance, Rafael, whose aura was as mighty as a god's, suddenly spit out a mouthful of old blood.
The demon monk, yet again, died on the spot!

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - 478: Turmoil in Lington
chapters.content:
The indescribable will that had descended suddenly disintegrated when the "Undead Demon Monk" Las Vegas cast a curse spell.
The strange charm and smile in Su Lun's expression also faded away, and the cold sharpness returned to his eyes. Looking at the demon monk who had fallen to the ground in the distance, then at the rune umbrella in his hand, he whispered softly, "Thank you for your help this time, Pestoya."
No one responded to his words, but at that moment, the air seemed filled with a joyful atmosphere, and even the wind became lighter.
Su Lun fixed his gaze on the fallen demon monk in the distance, his eyes suddenly hardened, and without hesitation, he teleported and charged in that direction.
There was no better opportunity to kill this guy than right now!
...
When Su Lun first heard that William Jr. had hired a bounty hunter who was the legendary "Undead Demon Monk" Las Vegas, he had analyzed the relevant information with Yeka Katrina.
This guy was known as "undead," which certainly wasn't without reason.
The military intelligence department had some accurate information, all pointing to several instances where this guy had mysteriously survived what should have been certain death.
Alchemy magicians are a group seeking the truth, and this "undead" phenomenon, which defied common sense, clearly had issues.
But Su Lun was not unfamiliar with it.
Because he himself had been resurrected once before, Sen Jiao had been resurrected, and the "Spiritual Detective," the Old Cowboy Jerome, also had the undying body of a ghostly duke.
Resurrection was possible at a certain price.
And behind this ability pointed to various deities who had comprehended the true essence of death.
So, it wasn't hard to guess that Las Vegas possessed the ability of immortality because he was a divine believer.
Previously, in the wax museum, he himself had been cursed, but didn't die, and the demon monk didn't die either, which further confirmed his speculation.
However, the various deities worshiped by the believers in Luying were myriad, and at first, Su Lun didn't take it seriously.
But through Yeka Katrina, he had seen the top-secret information of the military intelligence department and learned that the demon monk was the queen's lover, which led him to surmise that this guy might be a crucial figure in the collusion between the "Giant Hermit Order" and the Bonaparte royal family.
This was very subtle.
Divine believer + Giant Hermit Order = the only conclusion.
Therefore, Su Lun boldly concluded that the deity worshipped by this demon monk was the one worshipped by the "Giant Hermit Order"!
Having guessed this, Su Lun's thoughts became more active.
This was no longer just about solving the problem of William Jr.
Su Lun even guessed that the demon monk was probably also using the opportunity of William hiring an assassin to avoid some troubles like divination, specifically to assassinate the "Death" seen as an enemy by their sect.
If it were just to deal with the assassination by one of the "top ten legends," it wouldn't be a big problem for either the Lance family or Su Lun himself.
But since Su Lun had deduced this far, he felt that he could make a big move!
Now, with the red death disease spreading widely and the political situation in Lingdun City being so treacherous, the alchemical civilization was in jeopardy...
No matter what stance Su Lun took, he could not allow the schemes of that outer god to succeed.
And that outer god was still hiding, not showing up, accumulating power, and preparing to descend.
Even the conflicted Master Pierre was helpless and could only plan for after its descent.
But if they could lure it out early, or even seriously injure it, it would be an unmissable opportunity for the great battle that lay ahead.
...
The deities aren't idle, waiting all day to respond to the prayers of their believers and then descend to kill.
There are definitely some limitations to a deity's will descending.
So once it descends, it must be related to its interests.
Su Lun had forced Las Vegas to summon the deity by planning the entire operation with Yeka Katrina.
When the two of them set out from Lingdun City and had the gangs distribute all the secretly developed antidotes, they were already laying the groundwork.
And Yeka Katrina's display of amazing combat power was actually only for one purpose.
That was to show the enemy their "threat," compelling the demon monk to kill them at all costs.
After fighting together for so long, Las Vegas couldn't kill them, so his only option was to summon the deity.
Now that the potion to treat the red death disease had been distributed, that outer god must have become aware. Although it wasn't enough to force it to descend early, to find the root cause, Su Lun, the primary culprit, was naturally the first choice.
So, upon request, it came.
And because the summoner was Las Vegas, a curse magician.
Su Lun had analyzed his abilities before formulating the subsequent "trap for a god plan."
Even if he faced one of the top ten legends, Su Lun could escape if he truly wanted to, and this guy couldn't keep him.
But curiously enough, curse magic also countered various teleportation methods; once targeted, there was no escape.
So, Su Lun deliberately left a "flaw," his blood essence.
He was certain that after summoning the deity, the guy would use curse magic.
Hence earlier, he had turned and fled as soon as he saw the divine will descend.
He had perfectly created all the conditions for the enemy, and with Yeka Katrina's script interference, Las Vegas would definitely get carried away!
Human life energy is almost insignificant to higher beings like gods, similar to an ant. The backlash from cursing a mortal is probably equivalent to a deity losing a single hair.
Su Lun was well aware that his own destiny couldn't be tougher than a god's.
So he was "definitely doomed."
But, he still had a trump card that no one else had.
That was Pestoya.
Mr. Jing's sister, once the ghostly young lady of the Storm Manor.
Curse magic, this mysterious technique, is ultimately a touch of destinies, and the backlash is equivalent.
Su Lun knew his destiny couldn't stand against a semi-competent outer god,
but what if it was an entity that had merged with a fallen angel's "divine fire"?
...
Prior to calling upon the deity in Las Vegas, everything was based on Su Lun's conjecture.
But even if the plan was wrong, it didn't matter, the worst-case scenario was only killing a demon monk and William.
However, if he guessed right, this would absolutely be extremely profitable!
The Giant Hermit Society's outsider god had the covert support of the Bonaparte royal family and had now gained momentum.
This battle was almost about the rise and fall of the alchemical civilization's future.
Although Su Lun was not clear about the specifics of what Mr. Jing and the ninth-order master, Pierre, had planned, he was also very aware that a direct confrontation, even with those two working together, held no certainty.
Su Lun even guessed that the production of the cure for the Red Death would, at best, reduce some deaths but would not be able to stop the arrival of that outsider god.
But now, the opportunity had arrived!
And it was successful!
Pestoya had just awakened not long ago, and Su Lun had only then come up with this ambushing scheme.
The condition of this ghostly lady was very special at the moment; during the past two or three years of her dormant state, she had been merging with the "divine fire" of the fallen angel that had once merged with her soul.
This was a great chance left by Sir Isaac and Lady Isaac for their beloved youngest daughter.
To allow her to reach the pinnacle in one step.
Although she didn't have a divine body capable of concentrating godhood and her strength wasn't at the divine tier,
She now possessed a true "soul divine fire"; her fate was now considered that of a True God, making her the highest-level being of this plane!
It was impossible for True Gods to exist in this plane, which meant that the sea giant from the Giant Hermit Society could not possibly have a stronger fate than Pestoya!
Just as Su Lun had anticipated, when Las Vegas began the summoning and cast Curse Magic, the will of the outsider god collapsed instantly.
And Pestoya was unharmed.
The ambush was successful!
With the god's will shattered, the sea giant was unlikely to die, but was certain to be severely injured!
...
Su Lun didn't dwell on what happened to the outsider god after its collapse; he teleported to the fallen Las Vegas.
He had left directed displacement spatial coordinates during the fight, allowing him to arrive in an instant.
As he appeared via teleportation, he also released Yeka Katrina.
The Las Vegas on the ground had its flesh writhing, looking like countless bugs were rolling under the skin, appearing to be mutating.
The two charged forward, Su Lun swinging his black scythe, not missing a beat, and chopped down toward the monk's neck.
Yeka Katrina's fists also gathered a layer of nebula, and she punched toward the monk's heart.
The oblivious monk, lacking consciousness, was defenseless; a "swish" of the scythe decapitated him, and a "boom" of the punch blew a huge hole through his chest.
However, what was strange was that not a single drop of blood spurted out.
Su Lun saw the writhing red worms in the wound and shouted, "Back off!"
Far from being dead, the monk's body seemed to be growing more vigorous in its life force.
Yeka Katrina reacted quickly too, pushing her palms forward, creating an odd repulsive field and retreating a hundred meters in a flash.
Just then, countless red worms surged like a tide from the "corpse", quickly mutating into a skinned giant monster.
Having witnessed this scene before, Su Lun knew right away it was these body worms going out of control and turning on him.
And as he watched the corpse, a message suddenly came through the communicator of the Mirror organization, bringing a smile to his face.
Yeka Katrina glanced at him.
Su Lun explained, "There's trouble in Lingdun City! All the followers of the Evil God have mutated!"
Hearing this, Yeka Katrina obviously understood as well.
Their purpose had been achieved!
The price of the Crimson Potion had been driven too high, and it had not yet been widely distributed. Under normal circumstances, it would take some time to ferment before the outsider god could descend.
But now, the movement had suddenly begun, meaning that it had just received a heavy blow and was forced to descend sooner!
Compared with the situation in Lingdun City, the mutating monster in front of them was insignificant.
Su Lun looked at the standing mutated monster and asked, "Can we kill it?"
The mutated seventh-order professional was irrational, and its strength was even stronger than when it was alive.
And as they had just experienced, beheading and destroying the heart could both be recovered from, making it really troublesome.
For the moment, Su Lun hadn't thought of a way to kill this monster.
The best approach would be to ignore it.
But unexpectedly, Yeka Katrina decisively nodded and said, "We can. This monster hasn't fully revived yet; control it and I can kill it!"
As she spoke, a cold light flashed in her crystal eyes, and decisively, she smacked her spell, "Astrological Alchemy - Second Resolution!"
Looking again, the night sky changed as the stars moved, their light drawn by a mysterious force, all converging onto Yeka Katrina.
Although Su Lun had never seen this phenomenon before, he knew it was the ability of her "A-012-Astrogator" second resolution.
With her innate ability released in second resolution, the starry domain draping Yeka Katrina rapidly shrank; the layer of starlight that had hovered around her body collapsed at a high speed, as if the entire universe had gathered in the palm of her hand, creating a black hole that twisted light.
A look of unprecedented seriousness appeared on her face, and as her sorcerer's seals changed, she chanted the name of the spell, "Astrological Alchemy · Abyssal Black Hole!"
This was serious!
Seeing this, Su Lun's eyes abruptly narrowed.
Although one couldn't see the phenomenon where all light was being absorbed, his spatial ability clearly felt a deformed space nearby, slowly twisting into a terrifyingly powerful black hole due to a gravitational pull.
This was a real black hole!
Su Lun himself could "handcraft black holes," but in reality, they were just absorption powers of spatial spells.
However, in the palm of Yeka Katrina's hand, it appeared she was indeed holding a celestial body with terrifying gravity formed by the collapse of a star.
Although Su Lun didn't know how she managed to do it, he could see she was struggling with using this move.
At this moment, Yeka Katrina was trembling slightly, with fine sweat covering her forehead, clearly indicating that at her rank, it was somewhat forced for her to use this technique.
Despite his shock, Su Lun's actions did not slow down.
With a slap of his sorcerer's seal, it rapidly transformed, instantly creating a spell.
"Void Alchemy - Grand Imprisonment Spell!"
"Control Silk Secret Technique - Titan's Grip!"
"Terrifying Wax Figure - Four Symbols Elemental Sealing!"
"Gargoyle - Diamond Lock!"
He alone simultaneously employed four-fold tactics, with threads, wax figures, space, and gargoyles all converging on the monster.
The gargoyle was the most direct, teleporting to hug the monster's thigh tightly as its body hardened and sank, weighing tons.
Then countless shimmering threads wrapped around the monster's body, spatial seals rigidified, followed by four wax figures joining hands to control... It was like layers upon layers of shackles trapping the grotesque giant on the spot.
All these methods were still within the scope of the sixth rank but were enough to control the not-so-bright monster for a moment.
Right then, in Yeka Katrina's palm controlling the black hole, she charged at the other controlled monster.
The grotesque beast instinctively tried to run, but before it could avoid it, that delicate jade hand had already pressed against its chest.
The terrifying energy sealed within the palm's black hole exploded in an instant, and visibly, the monster's body disintegrated into fragments. Such was the degree of disintegration that even the replicative worms immediately lost their vitality.
"Impressive!"
As Su Lun marveled at the power of the move, he also saw a layer of "grey mist" emerging from the pieces of the monster's corpse.
Seeing this, he teleported over and harvested the Spiritual Body.
'You have extracted the soul of "Rasputin (Grotesque)"'
'You have obtained a vast amount of seventh-rank "Dark Law Fragments," "Death Law Fragments," "Disaster Law Fragments"...'
'You have harvested a wealth of combat skills and have comprehended "Seventy-Two Forms of Ancient Guma Techniques (Master level)"'
'You have extracted the "Yaksas Dark Civilization Human Body Research Archives"'
'You have gained a vast amount of curse knowledge and dark magic profession knowledge'
'...'
The body had only recently transformed, so the soul was still relatively intact.
Su Lun extracted what he wanted and was pleased.
Dominance and realms couldn't be extracted, but understanding the laws of the seventh rank and profession-related knowledge was exactly what he currently needed.
Having looked at the scenery from the peak of the seventh rank, he turned back to look at many of the problems he'd confronted at lower ranks and suddenly gained clarity.
This had a crucial impact on Su Lun's own comprehension of realms.
However, before he had the chance to digest those memories, his gaze fell upon the fragments of the monster's corpse.
After advancing to the sixth rank and acquiring the ability of "Blood Devour," he became extremely sensitive to life energy.
Although the life energy of the shattered grotesque monster was rapidly dissipating, the quantity was quite astonishing.
He raised his hand, and a sorcerer's seal appeared; a void vortex appeared in front of him, and the fragments were instantly devoured into it.
Su Lun looked at the changes in the vitality values on his panel and mused, "Such high life energy from these monsters? Is it because of those worms?"
He had previously tried to consume the essence blood of various magical beasts and had an approximate comparison of various parameters in his mind.
Now, devouring this seventh-rank grotesque beast, the data was several times higher than what the theory suggested.
So, he was a bit surprised.
A few thoughts flashed through his mind, and he caught a glimpse of Yeka Katrina by his side, looking a little pale. Clearly, the burden of that last technique was not light.
Su Lun asked, "Are you alright?"
Yeka Katrina shook her head, "I'm fine. It's just that I haven't reached the seventh rank yet, and using that technique is a bit of a stretch for me now."
Just then, she also seemed to have received a message from Lingdun City and, with no intention to stay longer, said solemnly, "That Outer God has been seriously injured and seems to need to absorb the Power of Faith to recover. There's been a big change in Lingdun; we need to hurry back."
Su Lun nodded in agreement upon hearing this.
Mr. Hei had already sent various reports collected by the Mirror Organization. The zombie outbreak had erupted in Lingdun City, affecting several districts in the southern city. Although no specific figures were available, it affected at least millions of people.
Additionally, various nobles were also in chaos. Both the Rodriguez and Ernest households, which were Senior Councilor seats in the National Assembly, had made significant moves.
The situation in Lingdun City had already turned chaotic.
...
Su Lun did not delay any further, bringing Yeka Katrina into the miniature void realm, and also found his bodyguard Ralph, who had been rendered unconscious from the severe injuries inflicted by the demon monk.
Seeing that the "Windmill Castle Towards the Sun" vehicle was still intact, he collected it as well.
Then, Su Lun kept employing Spatial Teleportation to hurry on his way.
The over one hundred kilometers they had traveled in one whole day before, he now covered in less than fifteen minutes.
Without entering the city, in the suburban area to the south, a Gusmao airship from the Ruying military force had already been waiting for some time.
Yeka Katrina was now the head of the Ruying Military Intelligence Department, and she needed to go to command the regular battles.
Beneath the airship, Su Lun released Yeka and several maids, but he did not plan to follow them aboard.
Their cooperation had ended here.
The alliances, assassinating William, and trapping the Outer God... they had coordinated this cooperation perfectly.
The situation was dire, leaving no room for extended conversation.
The two had already developed an understanding, and with Yeka Katrina looking at Su Lun, she said lightly, "Take care."
Continue your journey at My Virtual Library Empire
"Sure."
Su Lun nodded and also said, "Take care too."
Yeka Katrina nodded her head, and then, turning back, her face showed only the assertive dominance of a high-ranking leader.
She shouted, "Notify all departments, initiate Plan X!"
The surrounding staff members responded in unison, "Yes!"
Su Lun watched as Yeka Katrina boarded the ship, her maidservants who had served her day and night for the past several days also looked back and smiled slightly.
He smiled back at them.
Then he turned and walked away.
He had not walked far when a faint voice suddenly inquired beside him, "Mr. Su Lun, are you going to live with that young lady from now on?"
In the desolate wilderness with no one else around, Su Lun heard these words but knew who it was; he shook his head with a smile and said to the void, "No, it was just a collaboration. I am me, Phoebe is Phoebe."
"Oh."
As soon as the words fell, a ghost girl in a black princess dress suddenly floated out of the black umbrella in his hand, cheerfully circling around Su Lun.
She was naturally Pestoya.
Su Lun watched and smiled slightly.
This ghostly young lady was the first friend Su Lun made in this world.
And Su Lun was also the first friend that Pestoya made after being trapped in Storm Manor for a thousand years.
Their relationship was very special.
It was like a chick seeing the world for the first time at birth; there was always an inexplicable sense of kinship.
Both felt the same about the other.
When he thought of this plan three days ago, he thought of Pestoya.
She came before they set off but stayed inside the Rune Umbrella without coming out.
They chatted occasionally through mental communication.
Seeing her suddenly come out now, Su Lun asked with a smile, "Why did you stay inside all this time and now want to come out?"
He had thought that there might be some restrictions for a Spiritual Body to wander outside, which was why Pestoya had not shown herself these past few days; unexpectedly, she gave an unrelated reason, "I don't really like that noble young lady."
Her tone was not very good, but Su Lun was not surprised, he just raised an eyebrow, "Oh? Why's that?"
A young lady who had been confined for a thousand years was occasionally defiant, which he was well aware of.
Pestoya tilted her head, not really explaining, "Just don't like her."
"Oh."
Listening, Su Lun just smiled slightly and did not ask further.
The city was in turmoil, and he planned to meet up with Mr. Hei and the others, and along the way, see the situation in the city for himself.
A man and a spirit, walking through the darkness.
But probably because she hadn't been out to play for a long time, Pestoya seemed very excited.
After circling around Su Lun a few times, she suddenly flew in front of him, then unabashedly clung to Su Lun's neck like a koala, and it seemed as if she thought of something, blinked, and said, "Mr. Su Lun, actually, I think..."
With one arm, Su Lun embraced this suddenly corporeal ghost girl, the corners of his mouth slightly helpless, "What is it?"
Pestoya gazed at him, her large eyes sparkling with mischief and brilliance.
After pondering for a moment, she said seriously, "Actually, I think... if Mr. Su Lun is going to get married, my sister would be a good choice. She is as beautiful as that lady, with a nice figure, and a gentle temperament. Hmm... and for maids, we can hire a few for the house too..."
"..."
Su Lun listened and couldn't help but laugh and cry.
What was she even talking about?
He teasingly replied, "What are you thinking about, you silly girl."
Pestoya seemed to have considered it very thoroughly, adding, "I mean getting married. You seem to really enjoy that kind of life. You are my only friend, and my sister is my most beloved sister. Of course, I hope you two can be together. Then in the future, we can all live together. Like... um... like today, we can go on a trip together. Have a real adventure. We could travel the world, go on a sailing expedition..."
The more she talked, the more excited she became, and in her cheerful expression, it seemed as if she had already planned the future family trip.
Naive, pure, and romantic.
Su Lun, not taking it seriously, smiled and tapped her forehead, "Marry your own silly head, your sister is my mentor. She is also the person I respect the most."
Upon hearing this, Pestoya blinked, murmuring, "Is that so?"
Su Lun said, "Yes, it is."
Thinking that this little girl had no clue what marriage was all about, he casually added, "You don't have to be married to live together. I frequently visit my mentor to seek advice on alchemy, and we all live together. In the future, you can live with me too, Pestoya. I would welcome that."
Pestoya pondered it, and it seemed to make sense to her, "Oh."
Once this was said, neither of them spoke for a while, and all was quiet.
Unexpectedly, a playful look crossed Pestoya's face, as if she had thought of something, she added, "But... when you were living with your maid Sabina, you changed into my sister's appearance. Sister wasn't angry; she probably wouldn't mind. Marrying the two of you seems really good..."
"???"
Su Lun, upon hearing this, stood frozen on the spot, as if his brain couldn't process what he had just heard.
He looked at the ghostly young lady hugging him, and even with the thickest face, felt a bit uncomfortable.
You know about that?
As if Pestoya could read minds, she continued with a sly look, "I've always been by my sister's side, just sleeping. But that doesn't mean I'm unaware. I know all about you two."
"..."
Su Lun, no matter how thick-skinned, found it difficult to respond to that.
He could only knock on her little head, "Don't be nosy about adult matters, little girl."
Pestoya, seeing Su Lun at a loss for words, was even more cheerful, "Mr. Su Lun, I am also your mentor, okay!"
Su Lun: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - 479: Opportunity in the Great Catastrophe
chapters.content:
```
Ekaterina had now inherited the title of "Shadow Viscount" from her master, Master Pierre, and had become the king of the underworld gangs in Lingdun City.
During the early morning when she set out for her honeymoon trip, she had already instructed the Lingdun gangs to distribute the secret cure for the Red Death disease developed by the Lance family.
It was at the same time Su Lun and Ekaterina were parting in the southern suburbs, at the northern bank of the Lokwarren River, inside a luxurious manor in the wealthy district.
Dozens of distraught potion merchants and great nobles were gathered together.
These people were discussing how to deal with the collapsing potion market.
When they woke up today, they found that the world had changed.
Someone in Lingdun City was distributing the cure for the Red Death disease for free.
At first, it was taken as a joke.
After all, virus experts had already said that it was impossible for a new cure to be developed within the next few years.
Unexpectedly, upon investigation, it turned out to be true!
Someone had spread hundreds of thousands of potions through the black market channels, curing all those infected commoners.
This nearly scared the potion merchants who had massive stockpiles to death.
Because with this new effective cure, their stocks of Crimson Potion became worthless.
One after another, potion merchants and the great nobles behind them became busy.
From dawn till dusk, they used various policy tactics and public opinion smearing to obstruct and suppress this new effective cure everywhere.
But because the distribution of the loose goods was arranged by all the major gangs in Lingdun, who were exactly the lower-class people most affected by the Red Death disease, they were best at smuggling and criminal activities.
As a result, the interception was not very effective.
"Damn it, what the hell is going on? So many potions, who the hell released them!"
"The potions were spread out through black market channels. I asked the people at the police headquarters to investigate, but all the clues they found were fake, or led to dead ends. No one can confirm who is behind this..."
"Dammit, what does that guy want to do? Even if there is a cure, you should at least set a price, so everyone can make money. Giving it away for free to those poor devils, is this not forcing us to be stuck with all the Crimson Potion?"
"Dammit, if we really investigate this and find out who it is, we will definitely make him completely disappear from Lyndon!"
"..."
All day long, only bad news came.
These great old masters of the nobility were in a state of furious panic, fearing that they were about to suffer heavy losses.
No!
It's a complete loss!
Just yesterday, the Crimson Potion was sold for tens of thousands a bottle, but now it couldn't be sold for a single lyso.
How could you compete with someone giving it away for free?
The only chance they could think of to turn things around was to find the source and utterly annihilate it.
Then, they could proceed as originally planned, letting the Red Death disease spread further, causing broader infections throughout Lyndon, or even poison Mafa...
In that case, the potions in their hands would still yield tremendous profits.
But these people had been deliberating all day and still couldn't understand why the person spreading the cure behind the scenes would do such a self-detrimental thing?
By doing this, they had offended the entire upper-class society of Lyndon, but to what end?
No one could withstand the consequences of this action that broke the pot and left everyone unable to eat!
Even the royal family!
While everyone was discussing, suddenly the sound of gunfire outside the mansion grew louder and louder.
They had heard sporadic noises about fifteen minutes earlier, but now not only did it not stop, they finally realized something was wrong.
Marquis Edward, the master of the manor, asked, "What the hell is going on with that gunfire in the south of the city? Has it been figured out?"
Just as he finished speaking, suddenly a servant rushed in, his face full of panic, and reported, "It's not good, my lord! A major incident has happened!"
Everyone simultaneously turned to look at him.
The servant, out of breath, said, "There's an urgent message from the south city, countless mutated monsters have appeared in the city! And there have also been warnings from the police and intelligence agencies telling everyone to be careful. It seems... it seems... those monsters are related to our Crimson Potion!"
"What?!"
"Monsters? How could there be mutated monsters in Lingdun?"
"Yeah, hasn't the police department and military intelligence dealt with it?"
"..."
Upon hearing this, everyone's faces turned pale with shock.
They hadn't realized the severity of the situation and were talking all at once.
Suddenly, a mysterious summoning will descended.
Without realizing what was happening, a crisis suddenly befell them.
In the room, several of the dozens of people present had veins bulging on their faces, as if crimson worms were squirming under their skin, and they began to emit low, bestial growls.
"Baron Balen, your... your eyes, what's wrong with them? They look like they've got worms..."
"Viscount Haus, you look very pale, are you feeling unwell? Oh, God, don't scare me..."
"..."
These noble masters had not yet reacted to what was happening before their eyes.
```
The mutated individuals suddenly pounced toward the crowd, biting and tearing at them.
Blood stained their dress fronts, creating a terrifying scene reminiscent of ferocious beasts lunging at their prey.
"Damn it! Guards! Guards!"
In an instant, the entire estate was thrown into chaos.
It wasn't just the noble lords; among the guards and servants, more and more began to mutate, and commotion arose everywhere.
These people had once drunk the "Crimson Potion."
Those who were bitten quickly became infected and swiftly mutated into monsters.
But after a brief moment of panic, the guards reacted quickly, shooting the mutated individuals dead.
Fresh blood soaked the luxurious carpet in the hall, and within the blood, tiny worms still teemed with life.
But before they could even breathe a sigh of relief, they watched as the monsters with shattered heads began to slowly merge, transforming into a multi-limbed mutated amalgamation.
Witnessing this eerie scene, terror-stricken, these people immediately thought of the "Queen Rodrica Cruise Ship Incident," where thousands had gone missing just over a month ago, as reported in the newspapers!
At the time, both the "Lyndon Daily News" and the "Queen's Metropolitan Daily" had covered the story—one claimed it was a dark cult's sacrifice, the other a storm accident.
Even the attitude of the Ruying royal family was baffling, with no investigation results released to date.
Seeing what was unfolding before them, everyone understood who had been lying!
Now reflecting on the "Crimson Potion," this group of greedy potion merchants realized that disaster was upon them.
Senator Lance's previous warnings had been right!
There was a serious problem with the potion!
Suddenly, gunfire erupted throughout Lingdun City.
These undead, mutating monsters that couldn't be killed spread infection at a terrifying rate.
...
Having experienced it firsthand, Su Lun was not too surprised by the sounds of gunfire coming from Lingdun City.
But as he saw the flashes of gunfire lighting up the city, his brow furrowed slightly.
Such parasites, spawned by foreign gods, were difficult for ordinary people to kill; either the bodies had to be thoroughly dealt with or the parasites killed with authority, otherwise, they would unify into even more horrifying multi-faced monsters, growing stronger like a snowball rolling downhill.
But given the population of thirty million in Lingdun, there were not many who possessed such authority, so it was foreseeable that a large number of people would become infected.
Moreover, considering the dense population of the southern city slums, should a zombie wave break out, countless people were bound to perish.
Normal people turning into zombies after being infected was a relatively minor issue, but if professionals got infected, their capacity to infect others was truly terrifying.
Su Lun was constantly receiving updates from the Jing organization's communicators and knew that the situation in Lingdun was indeed very bad.
The Rodriguez and Ernest families, aligned with the foreign gods, had long plotted in their role as Senior Councilors. Cult followers of the evil gods had already infiltrated all major key departments.
Police stations, city defenses, security teams, emergency management offices... nearly every official department capable of handling sudden incidents had completely collapsed.
Then there were fighting units like the military and military intelligence where intense gunfights had erupted.
This was just the beginning.
The foreign gods had not yet shown themselves, but there likely were further calamities to come.
Given the deep waters of tonight's events, Su Lun was in no hurry to join the battle in the city.
As he walked, an idea suddenly occurred to him, and he took out a three-pointed black-light crown.
This was the "Blasphemous Crown" obtained from killing William.
Having had no chance to examine it closely before, now was the perfect time to take a closer look.
In Su Lun's hand, the crown felt like iron yet not iron, as if holding a highly condensed mix of law principles; in an instant, his entire sensory perception became clearer.
"Eh..."
He uttered softly to himself.
Just holding the crown in his hand, it seemed as if the world before his eyes had changed.
Earth, wind, water, fire, light, darkness... the various elements of law became several times clearer to sense.
At the same time, however, holding the crown brought a feeling as if his vitality was being drained.
Su Lun muttered, "Such a powerful curse effect..."
Having an item like "Oz the Iceman's Shroud" on hand, he was all too familiar with this sensation.
Looking at the attribute panel, indeed, the data representing his life span was accelerating its depletion.
Calculated, it was somewhat better than the shroud; it felt like wearing it for a day consumed ten days' worth of life span.
But this was the basic consumption.
If he continued to actively infuse spiritual power, the perception of the laws would become even clearer, but his life would deplete even faster.
Su Lun surmised that William, the young master with his prematurely white hair, might have used up a lot of his life to speed up his understanding, advancing to the seventh tier.
Of course, besides the decrease in lifespan, the crown also had a distorting effect on spiritual power.
However, for Su Lun who was already mutated, such minor negative mental impacts were merely a drizzle.
With the item in hand, he considered it for a moment, touched it with a bit of fresh blood to successfully sanctify it, then placed it upon his head.
Then his entire head felt as though it was constantly immersed in ice water, and that sensation of "seeing through everything" instantly became much clearer.
It was as if he could perceive the natural laws of the universe at work.
What were once vague sensations now became crystal clear, as if he could grasp them at any moment.
Su Lun's eyes sparkled with excitement, "Such a powerful effect!"
With this thing, he had an inexplicable confidence that he could definitely advance to the seventh level in domain comprehension.
It all depended on how much lifespan he would have to consume in the end.
With a flick of his hand, he formed the sorcerer's seals and released a fifth-level Fire Python Technique.
He immediately noticed that the crown's ability to control the elements made the spell's power half a level higher than what he had previously mastered.
Additionally, he saw that the skill comprehension also had an unusual increase.
Although it was not easy to perceive the difference, the data panel showed detailed changes.
After releasing several skills, Su Lun confirmed that the enhancement was indeed due to the crown.
To put it in terms of data, previously casting a skill would earn a "+1" in proficiency; now it earns "+3" or "+4".
The comprehension benefit was several times greater.
Seeing this, Su Lun was greatly moved, "This blasphemous crown really is a divine aid for comprehending various principles and skills!"
However, wearing it for a year consumes ten years of lifespan as a base cost.
Many people get stuck at the threshold of the seventh level for a lifetime.
With this crown, it only increases the chances of domain comprehension, but it's not a certainty.
Su Lun could only pray that he would comprehend his domain sooner rather than later.
...
Su Lun was somewhat reluctant to part with it, and once he put on the crown, he had no intention of taking it off.
This clear-minded feeling made his brain feel extremely pleasant.
Suddenly, a flash of inspiration struck him; he also thought of the crown as a material for advancement, which seemed to also require a strong will.
He tried casually, and his domineering presence surged around his body.
In an instant, a soft "eh" escaped his lips.
He actually discovered that the sensation of lifespan decay had lessened, to probably less than half of what it had been before!
With this new discovery, Su Lun's eyes sparkled with excitement, thinking, "Could my domineering spirit actually suppress part of the crown's curse characteristics and reduce lifespan consumption?"
This was a significant positive development.
It meant that he could use less of his lifespan to comprehend domains.
But after thinking about it, he wasn't surprised anymore.
There were very few who could comprehend the "dominating spirit".
Usually, these were high-ranking individuals like the Grand General or emperors — those in commanding professions, who needed to possess a dominating aura. Explore more stories at My Virtual Library Empire
After all, Lei had once been of the royal family, and this crown was originally meant for the emperor and his heirs, so it all made sense.
....
With the crown on, it seemed like his thoughts had become clearer.
Su Lun had walked all the way from the southern suburbs and was now gradually seeing buildings.
At this moment, the battle inside Lingdun City was incredibly intense, with explosions reddening the night sky all over the city.
His night vision was excellent; he jumped onto the rooftop of a building and could see the entire Queen's District of the southern city beneath him.
In the sky, several military small flying ships were floating above the city, using loudspeakers to shout to the inhabitants.
"Everyone, please stay at home, and keep your doors shut!"
"The creatures reanimate after being killed, so avoid killing them if you can, and try to hide!"
"Do not gather in densely populated areas!"
"..."
The broadcast repeated these precautions in a loop.
Considering the catastrophe had struck less than half an hour ago, and they had already figured out the monster's traits and informed the whole city, it must be the Alliance formed by Senator Lance and Rafael.
Monsters in the streets posed no threat to the flying ships for now, but there were still rockets shooting from the streets, bringing down the ships, followed by fierce battles.
The combat involved not only humans and monsters but also humans and followers of the outer gods.
Looking up at the sky, the moonlight also exhibited a spooky blood-red color, casting a crimson hue over the fog that enveloped Lingdun City as if draping the entire city in a blood-red veil.
Su Lun assessed it and it showed as "moonlight with minor spiritual contamination".
The reddish hue of Lingdun's moon had been present since Red Death began spreading, but tonight's red was the most demonic, and he deduced it was the doing of that Evil God.
"Contaminated the moon?"
Su Lun murmured to himself, inexplicably thinking of a method used by someone he knew.
He inquired about Mr. Hei's situation; Dawn Organization members had all arrived, and they were trying their best to deal with the monsters.
Only those with high-level professions capable of using domineering spirit could deal fatal damage to those creatures.
Screams echoed from street to street as hordes of zombies roamed, and in the shadowy mists, large "Hundred Faces Creatures" and "Thousand Faces Creatures" could be seen.
Su Lun planned to meet up with Mr. Hei and the others.
The situation today couldn't be reversed by any individual heroism; only by uniting their strengths could they possibly resolve the issue.
Just as he was communicating, suddenly, a few hundred panicked civilians burst out of the foggy street corner not far away.
This was Pietmont Street in Queen's District, Newman Avenue, one of the oldest parts of the city, and also one of the most densely populated areas.
"Run for your lives! The monsters are catching up!"
The crowd ran out in a panic.
And behind them, a group of zombie-like creatures were relentlessly pursuing them.
Being in the suburbs, when they heard of a monster attack, a large number of residents ran frantically on the streets, looking to escape the city.
But people in the crowd kept mutating.
Although a few low-level professionals shot at the monsters in retaliation, not only were the monsters not killed, their numbers were increasing, and they were getting closer and closer.
The unknown fear of people mutating at any moment left everyone's eyes filled with terror and despair.
The crowd surged past, and seeing someone "foolishly" standing there, a kind-hearted uncle even anxiously pulled at him while urgently shouting, "Young man, snap out of it, run! If those monsters bite you, you'll turn into one of them!"
Su Lun didn't move, and the uncle didn't have time to say a second sentence and could only flee in anxiety and helplessness.
As the crowd fled past him, he still stood quietly.
Until a moment later, when a zombie bared its teeth and pounced, Su Lun's gaze suddenly turned stern, his body covered with an imposing aura, and he charged towards the swarm of monsters.
Although the events of the evening were beyond the control of any individual, he still intended to resolve the immediate problem.
Moreover, seeing those monsters, he was also planning to confirm an idea.
These were all first-order mutated creatures, which could be blown up with a single punch by a high-ranking professional.
Su Lun charged into the midst of the monsters like a god of death, his punches capable of killing several creatures at once.
The monsters, seeing "human bait," swarmed towards him.
Su Lun didn't need to chase them down; within a few short encounters, he had killed a swath of monsters, leaving behind mangled limbs and flesh.
Hundreds of zombies were dead and gone.
In the distance, the people who had fled breathlessly were stupefied.
Within the foggy streets, strange noises multiplied, indicating that even more monsters were emerging. These people dared not stay longer, and after repeatedly thanking Su Lun, they escaped towards the outskirts in a panic.
Su Lun looked at the few monsters that chased after the fleeing individuals and, with a flash of insight, swung his black scythe, cutting them into two pieces.
This simple physical attack couldn't completely kill those monsters, and without giving them another glance, he concentrated his magic and raised one hand forward: "Void Blood Devour!"
In an instant, a spatial vortex formed, and a tremendous void suction force absorbed all the crimson remains and fragments of the monsters in the vicinity.
Before long, their life essence was drained, and a pile of impure powder fell to the ground.
Just in the time it took to devour them, those three monsters cut by the black scythe had also merged and congealed into a six-armed, three-faced zombie that stood up.
Su Lun teleported and blasted it with a punch, devouring the limbs that contained the red parasites with his "Blood Devour" ability.
In an instant, his vitality was abundant, and his complexion became slightly rosy.
After carefully discerning the changes in the vitality and power data, he confirmed something to himself, "Indeed, these Evil God parasites really have a high level of life. The life essence of the multi-faced monster is greater than the combined life essence of several zombies!"
When he harvested the mutated monk Las Vegas, he had this suspicion.
It was now confirmed.
The merging with "Isaac's Giant Strength" still required a lot of power attributes to meet the threshold, and he had seen a significant boost after accidentally acquiring a few "Blood Refinement Crystal Cores."
Since then, he hadn't found any Crystal Cores, and the increase had slowed down.
Su Lun figured that absorbing them slowly, it might take at least a year and a half...
But now, he saw a new pathway, which was to absorb the parasites of the Outer Gods inside these mutated creatures.
Although the situation was unclear, it was certain that by absorbing more monsters, the Outer Gods would recover less power!
Moreover, Su Lun had just realized that during battle, the comprehension effect of the "Blasphemous Crown" was greatly multiplied.
Whether it was the understanding of elemental laws or the comprehension of domains, it was much higher than what meditation could achieve.
No matter which stage of professional development required contemplation and understanding, battle was the best shortcut.
1+1>2,
Battle + Crown = Multiple shortcuts!
Thinking of this, Su Lun immediately contacted Mr. Hei on the communicator and asked, "Mr. Hei, do you know where the highest concentration of monsters in the city is right now? I have an idea..."
It was a very risky plan, as once the Outer Gods noticed someone was undercutting their power, they would definitely take special care of them.
But at the same time, there was also an opportunity not to be missed.
Su Lun was no weakling; to kill him, it would take at least a level-seven professional.
And he was not without allies.
If the Outer God showed itself, or if the top masters of the Giant Hermetic Order came, naturally there would be top professionals like Master Pierre and Mr. Jing to engage them!
The situation was such that the longer it dragged on, the more people would be contaminated in Lingdun, and the stronger the Outer God would become.
An early decisive battle could be a good thing!
Opportunity and risk coexisted.
If Su Lun could plunder enough vitality from that Outer God in the fierce battles, not only could he weaken the enemy's strength, but he could also greatly shorten the time needed to merge with the Giant's prosthetic.
Even with the Crown's enhancement, he might be able to gain a "great opportunity" amidst such perilous combat!

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - 480: She Comprehends the Domain?
chapters.content:
First draft, please wait.
"Everyone, prepare for battle!"
"Yes!"
In the eastern suburbs, thousands of heavily armored knights of the Lance family's private militia estate were ready for action.
A grim atmosphere permeated the air.
Duke "Tulip" Bartolo Lance, clad in battle armor, personally commanded the fight.
Suddenly, a distinct scent of perfume spread through the air, and several of the armored knights couldn't help but sneeze.
Before they could react, they were seized by those around them.
These were the adherents of the Giant Hermit Society who had infiltrated through various means. The Lance family had been biding their time, waiting for this moment.
At the same time, in the private militia estate of Duke Rafael in the southeast, a similar assembly was underway.
In the vast estate, tens of thousands of fully armed soldiers were lined up, but on closer inspection, they wore no armor and had no skin.
Under the moonlight, their bodies reflected a metallic luster, and on their chests were the characters "PX-911."
Indeed, this was Duke Rafael's "Super Mechanical Warrior Legion," which had performed brilliantly in the wars between the two great empires!
And it wasn't just humanoid mechanical warriors, outside the estate were densely packed various magical beasts. Spiders, bears, tigers, leopards... They too shimmered with the metallic glow of machinery.
This was the first public appearance of the Mechanical Magical Beast Legion!
After assembling, they transformed into a torrent of steel, violently charging into Lingdun City, which was swarming with zombies.
The same scene of heavy troop assembly played out in the home of Roberts, one of the six senior councilors.
The opposition alliance of the three senior councilors commenced their long-prepared massive extermination operation!
Tonight was the decisive battle.
After this battle, the political landscape of Lingdun would change completely.
...
In the Franklin District's Lighthouse Block, the most famous industrial area of Lingru.
Since it hosted over eighty percent of Lingdun's labor-intensive factories, this area was also the most densely populated in the southern city.
The dormitories of those large factories were overcrowded, with thousands of people crammed into a single building. The workers' families also lived nearby, and over decades, the area gradually became Lingdun's largest slum area. A few small streets were home to hundreds of thousands of people.
Visibility at night was getting lower, with a blood-red fog enveloping the entire block.
The sound of heavy gunfire had ceased for a while now.
Lighthouse Block had only a few small police stations. Since this area was a hotspot for the Red Death plague, the several dozen patrol officers had all taken the "Crimson Potion" and were infected into monsters at the start of the zombie apocalypse. Being professionals, their ability to spread the infection after mutation was extremely strong, spawning chaos; a wildfire of infection spread to the nearby factory residences...
When the disaster erupted, the nobles in the wealthy northern districts were too busy to fend for themselves, and most of the military was concentrated at various bridges by the Lokwarren River, trying to prevent the zombie wave from entering the north city.
The Alchemy Guild, Potion Guild, Puppet Guild... various professional groups were either self-preserving or infighting.
No one could manage the terrifying wave of zombies in the civilian areas.
Even if there were a few high-level professionals in the Lighthouse area, upon discovering that the monsters were unkillable, they either got infected and killed or found a way to flee.
At that moment, fear-filled howls and screams resounded everywhere in the Lighthouse area.
The air was thick with a scent of despair, sensing the domination by monsters, yet feeling powerless to resist.
"Help, help!"
"Ah... so many monsters..."
"Someone save us..."
"..."
At a major crossroads in the Lighthouse area, listening to the cries for help nearby, Su Lun felt helpless.
The sounds of fighting "crackle and pop" never ceased. His powerful punches crushed one zombie after another that charged at him.
At his feet, piles of zombie corpses had accumulated up to several meters high.
All around were severed limbs and blood-red vistas.
This crossroads was the core area of the industrial zone, nearby were directions leading to "Salcon Cigarette Factory," "Birmingham Textile Factory," "Lingdun Royal Steam Machine Factory" among other huge factories housing thousands. Because these factories also operated at night, their tall chimneys were still puffing white vapors; inside those factory areas, it was a veritable hell on earth.
In just the fifteen minutes since Su Lun had arrived, he had killed over a thousand zombies.
But it was impossible to kill them all.
He didn't have the capability to save those who were trapped in the dormitory buildings.
There were zombies everywhere; he just couldn't save them all.
Taking advantage of a brief respite as one wave of zombies paused to catch their breath, he pinched the Suren Sorcerer's Seal and used "Void Blood Devour," swallowing the pile of corpses several meters high at his feet.
The energy of blood and qi drew into his body, he gasped for breath, his pale face quickly returning to a healthy rosiness.
The sensation of replenished strength gave him a complete sense of security; he muttered to himself, "The Blood Clan's vampiric recovery ability is so overpowered. The more I fight, the stronger I get. With just one absorption, the consumed physical strength and injuries are immediately restored to full condition. It truly is the ultimate ability for endurance battles..."
The parasitic worms of the Evil God inside those zombie bodies were really something else; the life essence was ridiculously exaggerated, probably even more efficient than the Blood Clan feasting on human blood.
This enabled Su Lun to not only recharge fully after absorbing the zombie bodies but also visibly raised his physical strength on his attribute panel.
It was truly getting stronger as he fought.
And he also had "Isaac's Alchemical Heart" to continuously supplement the drain of dark spiritual power.
His physical strength was replenished by the "Blood Devour" ability, and his spiritual power was supplemented by his gear.
In such an environment, he felt he could fight for days and nights without any issues.
This was also when Su Lun was advancing his profession, the planned combination for capability choice.
Endurance battles, large-scale troop battles, getting stronger as he fought.
Having killed the monsters in this area, Su Lun moved on.
His Soul Perception covered a large nearby area, and he could clearly sense where more monsters were.
The ordinary zombies' sense of smell and hearing were not very strong, only about a hundred meters, so after clearing one area, he had to actively move to another.
...
"Help!"
"Help!"
"..."
The visibility on the streets was only a few dozen meters, with zombies everywhere inside the buildings on both sides of the road, and occasionally, people were still calling for help.
Su Lun couldn't possibly save each one, nor was he able to.
All he could do was carry a megaphone and inform those who were not infected to hide at home.
As for himself, wandering the streets and making noise to attract zombies was the best way to rescue.
He wasn't afraid of being exposed since he was using his body to lure the monsters anyway.
This way, as he walked down the road, many zombies lurking in the buildings also noticed the living on the streets and rushed out ferociously.
Then, with a few "bangs", Su Lun punched and exploded them into a mess of flesh on the ground.
Although the monster count in the Lighthouse District was astonishing, the good news was that there were no extremely powerful aberrant monsters so far.
Even the "Hundred-Faced Monsters", which were previously unknown who let them out, only had the fighting strength of third or fourth-tier professionals, posing no threat to him.
Su Lun had also noticed that the zombies this time were not quite the same as the ones he encountered on the cruise ship before.
As time passed, the combat ability of the zombies clearly became stronger, as if they were evolving.
Looking at the faint blood-colored mist, he pondered, "The spiritual pollution from the moonlight has a significant impact on ordinary people. Resentment, fear, despair, madness, irritability... these negative emotions are the main source of power for the catastrophe laws. That Outer God is not only drawing on the Power of Faith but also needs this force... "
Wearing the "Blasphemous Crown", his perception of these catastrophe laws was crystal clear.
Having harvested many related insights of catastrophe laws before, and looking at the blood moon, he gradually understood that the Outer God needed this force.
Those panicked residents, screaming and running wildly around, were actually under the influence of the polluted moonlight.
Terror would spread and worsen.
Su Lun asked Mr. Jing, who said she was aware of the situation.
So he didn't say much more.
Some plans do not bear speaking.
But from the beginning, the growth of the Giant Hermit Society and under the covert support of Queen Charlotte, it was destined that Lingdun City would suffer heavy casualties tonight.
No one could stop it.
Previously, Su Lun had made a sneak attack on the Outer God with the Undead Demon Monk, which could be considered as triggering the decisive battle early, already reducing a lot of casualties.
A thought flashed through Su Lun's mind.
He always felt that the Bonaparte royal family, which had been somewhat inconspicuous, might drop a major bombshell.
Just then, he had reached another large intersection a few hundred meters away.
Both sides of the road were lined with ancient large buildings, which were the dormitories of factory workers.
In his perception, inside each building were densely packed thousands of soul fluctuations.
Su Lun stopped there, then took out a can of blood bait and smashed it on the ground.
Like cold water dropped into a hot oil pan, several buildings instantly boiled over.
"Awooo..." "Awooo..." "Awooo..."
Various types of zombies swarmed out, with Su Lun's body surrounded by Dominator's Bodyguard, he began to clean up again.
Although there were crosses floating in the sky, he did not use any puppets.
One reason was because the Dominator's Bodyguard puppets, needing to completely destroy the zombie bodies, consumed a lot, and
the second reason was that Su Lun wanted to grasp those intermittent "insights" during the fight.
With the enhancement from the "Blasphemous Crown", even this not too intense battle yielded a lot.
At least the combat techniques from the Undead Demon Monk Las Vegas and the compatibility with his body surged dramatically.
Moreover, in the high-intensity slaughter, Su Lun seemed to have gained a deeper understanding of Death.
It seemed as if... Death, was annihilation.
Gone with smoke and clouds.
The essence of the Domain is the ability for absolute control over deeper layers of laws through the application of Dominator's Bodyguard, and it's also a form of closed-loop understanding of certain world rules.
Su Lun also vaguely sensed that enhanced perception brought about by the crown.
This seemed to be the "Domain" he needed to master.
But currently, the feeling was too elusive, like catching a glimpse of a twinkling star in the night sky, then it was gone.
He still needed more.
....
Before long, the battle ended again.
At Su Lun's feet, bodies again piled up like mountains.
Once again, he squeezed the Suren Sorcerer's Seal, absorbing the essence of blood from this large wave of zombie monsters.
Looking at the panel, having absorbed those several batches of zombies, his power had now reached 2200. Although the increase slowed down as the numbers got higher, this was already the quickest shortcut. If the number of parasites were enough, he felt it wouldn't take long to complete the target of 4300 fusion.
But Su Lun was not completely optimistic.
Shearing wool without others knowing, that Outer God certainly knew.
It was inevitable that an expert would come to intercept him.
Su Lun didn't mind; if someone came to intercept him, he would fight.
If no one came, he would just move on to the next place.
After all, this night was bound to be restless.
With a well-established intelligence system now in place, Su Lun was constantly updated on the situation in every part of Lingdun City through his communicator.
Fights were breaking out everywhere, not just in the southern city. The northern city's wealthy district was even more fiercely contested.
It had turned into a slaughtering field for high-level professionals, where the noise and turmoil far exceeded that of the south. Various legions clashed, and bodies were strewn everywhere... News of the deaths of sixth and seventh-level professionals came frequently.
The top aristocrats of Luying now starkly divided into two distinct camps.
The zombie wave had really frightened those noble lords; anyone with eyes could see that siding with monsters was not a good choice.
The opposition alliance of Duke Rafael, Lance, and Roberts quickly rallied the city's neutral and swinging forces.
They stood on a platform of righteousness and carried out devastating purges against their political enemies.
Due to the "Crimson Potion" being overpriced earlier, it was not spread widely among the believers in time; also, this night, Su Lun accidentally severely injured that outer god, forcing it to descend prematurely; moreover, the alliance of three councilors was already prepared... Many factors played a role.
Although the battle was fierce, overall, the opposition was largely prevailing.
...
Listening to these reports, Su Lun didn't feel very optimistic.
The monsters on the streets were getting stranger; even if left unharmed, they somehow fused into more advanced "multi-faced monsters."
Later, it was not just multi-faced; the shapes became even weirder.
Su Lun had witnessed various forms of zombies tonight.
The fleshy orbs filled with sharp teeth and eyes, the tentaculous entities resembling a cluster of earthworms fused together, the deer-shaped monsters with arms as antlers, the building-sized tumors...
Dense teeth, tumorous growths, tentacles... these were the hallmarks of the Calamity Dimension creatures.
In any case, they came in the most disgusting forms possible.
All were capable of eliciting humanity's primal fears.
There were those that attacked mentally, physically, magically, with various methods of assault.
Fortunately, Su Lun felt he had no weaknesses and had cleaned them all up one by one.
The fight had begun around ten at night, and after several hours, it was approaching one in the morning.
Methodically, Su Lun was clearing out these mutated creatures on the streets.
It must be said, although the fused advanced creatures were a bit more tricky, the "Blood Devour" stripped the essence of life more intensely from them.
After battling for two hours, Su Lun's energy was not the least bit diminished; in fact, his condition only improved the more he fought.
However, he felt a bit "stuffed."
Having absorbed too much blood energy in a short time, he was experiencing some indigestion.
Su Lun decided to speed up clearing out the monsters when suddenly, the black crow on his shoulder called out with a "caw."
"They're here!"
Su Lun's eyes narrowed as he watched a figure emerge from the fog at the corner.
The moment that figure appeared, the fog over the entire block cleared, and large snowflakes began to fall.
On the ground, a layer of white frost visibly spread rapidly, and the sounds of ice cracking echoed incessantly while the temperature in the air plummeted by tens of degrees.
No sooner had Su Lun seen this person arrive than the ground beneath his feet was covered in white frost.
The extreme cold froze, sticking his feet to the ground.
Then, the frost spread rapidly from the ground up, instantly covering his body with a layer of ice armor. His joints, muscles, and blood seemed to freeze in an instant.
Not only him, but all the surrounding mutated creatures and buildings were also encapsulated in ice.
"Frost Domain?"
Su Lun instantly recognized this domain.
There were not many seventh-level professionals throughout Lingdun City, and he roughly guessed the identity of the newcomer.
Read exclusive content at My Virtual Library Empire
Upon closer inspection, it indeed was the seventh-level guard captain of the Rodriguez family, the "Frost Knight" Oscar Zimmerman.
However, at this moment, his eyes were bloodshot, his armor clearly showed signs of battle damage and bloodstains, indicating he had been through a fierce fight before coming here.
Moreover, red worm-like creatures floated in the air above his exposed skin... a very bizarre sight.
...
"Just seventh level..."
Su Lun muttered to himself.
Seeing someone had come, he wasn't surprised at all.
He wondered if it was because the outer god had been tricked before and didn't dare to descend in its true form, or perhaps the battles elsewhere were also demanding.
In any case, only one had come.
Yet, Su Lun did not take it lightly. His perception told him this person had a very strange aura.
The moment his body was covered by the frost domain, a layer of blue flames suddenly appeared on his skin, and the feeling of being frozen stiff vanished.
Almost simultaneously, Sabina rushed her report through the communicator, "Master, Tommy has sensed several powerful presences converging towards your location, they'll be here in no more than five minutes!"
Upon hearing this, Su Lun slightly narrowed his eyes.
So experts were coming.
But for now, it was just one, and he spoke into the void, "Let's not strike yet. I'll give it a try. It's a good opportunity to test my new spell."
Because it was in that moment when the "Frost Knight" Oscar targeted him that Su Lun distinctly felt a very clear insight into the realm of ice magic!
With the "Profane Crown" in hand, he desperately needed that valuable combat insight.
Sixth tier no longer pressured him, seventh tier was better.
At the moment of their exchange, the "Frost Knight" Oscar rushed at him through the snow and wind.
Su Lun's eyes narrowed as his sorcerer's seals concentrated: "Hormone Rampage·Seven Releases!"
The runes on his body shone for an instant, his muscles suddenly bulged, and the scorching heat instantly dispersed the frosty sensation.
The overwhelming feeling of strength made him charge forward without fear, his physical speed was not even slightly slower than that of a seventh tier.
With a "snap," almost in the blink of an eye, two figures collided.
Fists and elbows met, creating a visible shockwave in the air.
Because the surrounding buildings were already frosted, this violent impact was like an invisible tidal wave, causing a large area to collapse instantly.
Su Lun blocked that punch with his elbow, intending to pull back and counterattack; even though he had the Dominator's Bodyguard, contact for an instant brought a terrifying chill that made his entire arm feel glued, unable to break free.
He mentally cried out in alarm, "What a formidable Frost Domain!"
When the temperature drops to a certain level, it not only causes rigidity but almost halts the activity at a microscopic cellular level.
It made one's senses feel as if "time had stopped."
Truly stuck, he barely even had time to teleport.
Su Lun was prepared though, like a reflex, his fist muscles weirdly throbbed a "shiver," and the layer of frost instantly shook off.
Following that, he leaned back, spun around in one fluid motion, and his leg whipped into Oscar's lower back.
However, a miraculous scene occurred.
This time, Su Lun wasn't glued in place, and both men, propelled by the collision, sprang apart rapidly.
...
Watching the enemy some meters away, Su Lun's eyes sparkled, and he inwardly praised, "The 'Guma Card Fighting Technique' is indeed amazing!"
If it had been before, his physical self would definitely not have had the strength to clash with a seventh-tier professional.
Although he was slightly disadvantaged in that skirmish, he managed to endure it.
In the presence of tier suppression, it was purely a matter of technique.
This was all thanks to the soul of the 'Undead Demon Monk' Raszburg he had stripped before.
Whether it was the Hormone Rampage unleashed or the Combat Technique that controlled the muscles minutely, both were newly acquired abilities.
The Domain: Bliss World of that demon monk wasn't stripped, but his research on human hormone secretion had reached the zenith. That "Yaksas Dark Civilization Human Research Archive" had given Su Lun new insights into his previously perceived as flawed "Hormone Rampage" technique.
On the other hand, it was the "Guma Card Fighting Technique."
This lost martial art had an extremely high difficulty for beginners!
The seventy-two moves, the profound martial arts needed immense strength, muscle resilience, and also intellect and skill.
Normally, a seventh-tier professional could not fully master it.
That demon monk had exceptional talent and, with the parasitic worm of an outer god, obtained an undead body, which allowed him to cunningly master the Guma Card Fighting Technique to this proficient level.
Su Lun had picked up a bargain.
He directly stripped the guy's technical experience.
But Su Lun's current sixth-tier physical abilities could not unleash the master level of the combat efficacy.
It was precisely because he had devoured too many zombies and now was full of vigor. Combined with the secret Hormone Rampage technique, he wanted to test it out.
The attempt felt incredible!
Previously, whenever Su Lun fought at close quarters, it was always with brute force.
But the Guma Card Fighting Technique opened up another path for him.
This martial art contained many profound technique-level applications, perfectly accomplishing the feat of using the strength of few to move many.
After becoming familiar with various moves while killing zombies, now using them felt much smoother.
With the crown amplifying his insights, his body's understanding of the moves surged dramatically.
Not falling behind much in a trial spar gave Su Lun even more confidence.
The Oscar in front of him, although also a seventh-tier, was far from the top ten legends— he was the perfect opponent.
As the two separated momentarily, he coated himself in flames and charged again, clashing loudly multiple times.
During the fight, figures intertwined on the street.
The cold wind was as sharp as blades, and the force of their punches was like cannon fire.
In just a few minutes, the two had exchanged dozens of rounds of blows.
Under the suppression of their tiers, Su Lun was repeatedly heavily injured, repeatedly facing perilous situations.
But even while taking blows, his eyes were incredibly excited.
In this high-pressure combat state, his insights became ever clearer.
Unfortunately, before long, several powerful presences suddenly surrounded the street from all sides.
On closer inspection, several monstrously deformed figures charged forward. Though monstrous, each one's aura was terrifying, not inferior to top-tier professionals.
Almost at the same moment the monsters appeared, "swoosh," "swoosh," "swoosh"... several people in Gold-Patterned Cloaks leaped out from various ruins around the street.
One of them was particularly conspicuous.
Her body was enveloped in purple lightning as she brandished her sword, a six-armed demon shadow filled with murderous intent following her. Before she arrived, several strikes of lightning sword qi had already reached, as if one could faintly hear a soft cry: "Thunderclap One-Cut School: Sakura Demon Seven Kills!"
Su Lun was not surprised by her arrival, but upon seeing the hellish phantom swirling around her body, he twitched vehemently, feeling extremely astonished, "This is... Sister Qian Tiao actually comprehended her own domain?"

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - 481: If I Don't Hold Power, What Use Is Lu Ying?
chapters.content:
The masters of dawn had come to support, and in an instant, over a dozen more people appeared on the block.
Su Lun no longer had the opportunity to continue his one-on-one battle with the "Frost Knight" Oscar and gain insights, as the duel quickly turned into a chaotic brawl.
He raised his hand, and with the formation of the sorcerer's seals, more than a dozen terrifying wax figures appeared by his side and charged into the battlefield.
Not only did Qiantiao come, but also Mr. Hei, Barrett, Red Demon Kai, Kite... almost all of the old members of the Mirror Organization from Old Lington had arrived.
The golden patterns on their cloaks shone exceptionally brightly in the night.
Then there were Mr. Jing's bloodline descendants, "Blood Duke" Moore Wazhuaz leading a swarm of vampires, transforming into a crazy flurry of giant bats sweeping through the sky.
In a flash, the vast Lighthouse District erupted into a brawl.
The commotion of the battle between sixth and seventh-tier professionals was extremely exaggerated, with various high-level magicians bombarding indiscriminately, making the sky above look like a display of elemental fireworks, with the earth shattering and buildings collapsing in heaps as the ground cracked inch by inch.
As it was a prepared ambush, even though the outer god fanatics who had mutated did not fear death, Su Lun and his companions still had an absolute advantage in combat strength.
The fight lasted for half an hour before it subsided, and all six mutated monsters were killed.
However, to Su Lun's regret, aside from the "Frost Knight" Oscar's soul being relatively intact, the others were severely mutated and their souls were seriously fragmented, leaving only some broken law fragments. The six monsters combined were not even equivalent to a single demon monk.
The only piece of good news was that these top-tier mutated beasts had more life essence from the parasitic worms of the Evil God within them.
But the corpses decayed quickly, and Su Lun had previously "overfed" himself, thinking it was somewhat wasteful.
Unexpectedly, after communicating with Moore Wazhuaz, the vampire who had lived for seven hundred years, he discovered that over the long years, the vampires had also developed some very special blood sucking insights.
Su Lun also mastered a Secret Technique that allowed him to absorb life essences beyond his body's tolerance level.
Due to their constitution, vampires can almost directly absorb the blood of any creature ("eat fish without spitting out the bones"). But precisely this blood, tainted with divine law, could lead to mutations if consumed.
Su Lun then shared with Moore Wazhuaz some insights into purifying and absorbing the blood's impurities that he had acquired from Augustus, and both parties benefited from the exchange.
...
The battle on the north side of the city involved Luying's top elites fighting fiercely, not just clearing out monsters, but also vying for power and profit.
Dawn is a neutral organization and had no interest in joining the battle.
Su Lun and his companions didn't run around either; they just wandered around the factories near the Lighthouse District, clearing out various mutated monsters.
They waited, perhaps for more powerful servants of the Evil God to come and try to assassinate them.
Being able to hold some back was also considered helpful.
