A figure heroically leapt into action.
She showed no hint of fear as she charged toward the towering Evil God.
It was as if a second moon had abruptly appeared in the sky before, and suddenly, a phantom image identical to the Flame God Revered by Master Pierre emerged around her!
It looked as though two Master Pierres were attacking the outer god.
Pestoya recognized the person and immediately exclaimed, "Sister?"
Su Lun looked at the Gold-Patterned Cloak, his pupils abruptly constricting, "Senior sister?"
He was not surprised that Mr. Jing would intervene, but he was surprised that his own master sister's mirror ability could mimic ninth-tier combat power.
The two joined forces and immediately gained the upper hand.
Su Lun watched in awe, but after a while, he also began to understand something.
It seemed that only after Master Pierre had used a technique could Mr. Jing replicate it. She couldn't initiate them on her own; she could only copy them.
Yet, even so, having a portion of ninth-tier combat power at the eighth-tier was already an unbelievable capability.
Lights dancing in his eyes, Su Lun inwardly exclaimed at the spectacular scene.
With double the insight, he felt a mysterious sensation growing clearer and clearer.
Although he couldn't figure out why Mr. Jing, an eighth-tier, could perfectly replicate ninth-tier techniques, even including those of the "War" rules, Su Lun sincerely admired it, "My master sister's ability is truly amazing."
Seeing the grand battle unfolding before him, Su Lun also silently felt lucky that they had repeatedly plotted against that outer god, prompting Its premature arrival.
Otherwise, who could stop It if It had arrived with full force?
Had It become the guardian deity of the Bonaparte Royal Family, the entire realm of Luying would have become fertile ground for It to cultivate followers, even in Mafa.
The lifespan of humans is limited, whereas deities can live endlessly.
Should Empress Charlotte pass away, the power of the contract would slowly dissipate.
In just a few hundred years, the alchemical civilization would truly vanish.
...
The aftermath of a battle involving ninth-tier professionals is extremely terrifying.
Su Lun could see that Mr. Jing and Pierre intentionally moved the battlefield to the less populated suburbs of the northern city.
As they fought, they forced the Sea Giant toward the north.
It wasn't just the three of them; the followers, the opposition, the entire battlefield was gradually shifting northward.
Even the meteors had stopped.
Previously, everyone kept attacking the palace mainly to force the outer god to descend.
Now that the outer god had shown itself, the palace was ignored.
Everyone knew that the key to the battle lay with that outer god.
As long as it was killed, everything would be over.
Seeing this, Su Lun no longer proceeded to evacuate to the southern city.
Though the battlefield was dangerous, it truly was an excellent opportunity for insight, something he might not encounter again in his lifetime.
And with the entire battlefield shifting north, most top-tier professionals had gone there, leaving the area near the palace not as perilous.
"There are still many Soul Shards on the battlefield..."
Thinking this, Su Lun no longer hesitated and teleported back.
The battlefield lacked nothing in terms of death, and where there was death, there were souls!
Before, he dared not approach because the center of the battlefield was a veritable meat grinder. Massive troop clashes meant certain death for a sixth-tier like him.
But now, that concern was completely gone.
With several teleports, Su Lun had already returned near Holy Light Avenue.
From here, the streets were already densely littered with bodies.
Though some time had been lost and the souls on the bodies were no longer intact, the sheer number made up for it!
A shadow of Death arose behind Su Lun, and he summoned several puppets to pick through the spoils, carefully making his way through.
With the great battle raging, neither side had time to clean up the battlefield, making him the perfect scavenger for the job.
"You have stripped 'Winnie Mung's' Soul Shard, obtaining 'Fourth-Tier Power Law Fragment'..."
"You have stripped 'Dave Garcia's' Soul Shard, obtaining 'Alchemy Potion Knowledge'..."
"You have stripped 'Nelson Cleire's' Soul Shard, obtaining 'Fifth-Tier Wind Element Law'"
"You have stripped..."
Those who could participate in the battle in the northern city were among the upper echelons of Luying's alchemical sorcerer pyramid.
These bodies were either elite military forces, noble knights, elite private soldiers...
Most had come from the royal academy, their knowledge reserves astonishing.
Even a small amount of Soul Shard could yield substantial gains.
This area filled with bodies was like a treasure trove, occasionally allowing him to pick up a "surprise," gaining some bizarre new knowledge.
Bodies were everywhere, as Su Lun reaped his way past them, his knowledge of various laws also rose dramatically.
Whenever he encountered surviving zombies or followers of external gods, he could slay them with a single blow.
Moreover, as he traveled, he gained other insights.
Previously, under Mr. Jing's deliberate guidance, Su Lun had touched upon some of Master Pierre's rules of "war," which had already left him deeply shaken.
From that moment, it was as if a door to enlightenment had opened, and the feeling of time slipping through his fingers became increasingly clear.
"Annihilation, dispersion, life returning to nothingness, energy dissipating completely... Is this what death is?"
Walking among the corpses, Su Lun felt as if he had grasped something, the black crown on his head shining brightly.
He didn't know what he was supposed to realize.
This feeling had also appeared before when he had killed nearly ten thousand pirates in the city-state of Moros.
But at that time, without the crown, his understanding of the laws was insufficient, and the feeling quickly dissipated.
Now, with the augmentation of the blasphemous crown, Su Lun saw something else.
After a person dies, there are more than just the visible manifestations of the body and soul.
There is something deeper, a natural law concerning death itself.
It's as if... from the moment a creature is born, it is destined to gradually fade away and then return to nothingness.
This law exists inherently.
It's just that normally people only see the "death" phenomenon and fail to see the law of energy exhaustion and demise.
Walking step by step among the corpses, Su Lun seemed immersed in a profound state of enlightenment.
The feeling of flowers seen through a mist was very mysterious, with dominant fierceness and dark spiritual power pouring into the blasphemous crown on his head, making the sensation ever clearer.
It was a wonderful feeling, as if, in the obscure interaction with some universal rules, he understood some things that he hadn't understood before.
Even Su Lun himself didn't know that at some point, as he walked down the street, his body's force of law radiated outward, wrapping around a bizarre black light field.
In the range covered by this black light field, the remaining fresh flowers and grasses in the roadside flowerbeds rapidly decayed; the corpses quickly rotted and visibly turned into lifeless mummies; frightened rats ran through, only to lose their lives instantly and decay...
By the time Su Lun snapped out of that state, he had already reached the end of the street.
The hostile gazes coming from the direction of the palace instantly sobered him, heightening his sense of crisis.
Su Lun frowned, feeling very displeased by the interruption of his enlightenment.
He glanced at the few palace guards who had noticed him.
Those fellows didn't dare to come out.
All they could do now was rely on the palace's defensive enchantments, guarding Queen Charlotte, daring not take any proactive action.
Besides, facing the "Reaper," not to mention whether they could kill him or not, what if it was a ruse to lure them out?
Su Lun guessed their thoughts and simply ignored them.
He wanted to re-enter the state he had just experienced, but found that he could no longer access it.
Looking back along the way, the path of decay, the street full of corpses seemed as if it had experienced a hundred years, a scene of ancient decay.
Su Lun speculated in surprise and asked, "Eh... Did I do this?"
At that moment, the usually stoic face of Pestoya following him also showed a strange expression as she replied, "You just realized a very special domain of death, and then walked over here, and it ended up like this."
Su Lun's eyes shimmered with delight, realizing that this was the embryonic form of a domain.
Sheesh... This domain, it's kind of powerful!
But recalling the attempt to reassemble it, it seemed he couldn't manage it again.
However, this was surely a good beginning!
Once a domain field is formed, it's like hacking a path through the wilderness in the thicket, even if overgrown with wild grasses, trying more and grasping it next time becomes much easier.
Moreover, the blasphemous crown also had an astonishing effect in aiding understanding,
Thinking of this, Su Lun was no longer worried.
He glanced at the corpses strewn across the palace square and swaggered over.
Reaping as he went, using puppets to gather materials along the way.
Knight armors, equipage, inauguration materials, also Mafa's mechanical battle armors, Rafael's super mechanical warriors, mechanical beast corpses...
A variety of things, he picked them up in piles.
Su Lun never had any halo of idolatry, having climbed up from the bottom step by step, and faced with such an excellent opportunity to enrich himself, he wouldn't let it pass.
He continued reaping the souls of the corpses on the square, collecting spoils of war, while also keeping an eye on the faraway battles, and the movements of those hiding in the palace.
Especially after a few sixth-tier mutant monsters were easily killed by Su Lun, Queen Charlotte and her royal guards dared even less to come out.
They could only watch in shock as Su Lun cleaned up tens of thousands of bodies and their war spoils around the square.
Even though he was only reaping fragments, Su Lun felt the harvest was abundant.
War?
Death?
Having traveled through mountains of corpses and seas of blood, Su Lun felt that he had come to understand some of the true essence of "war."

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - 485: Curtain Call of the Old Era
chapters.content:
The twin crimson moons in the sky were like a pair of divine eyes watching over the human world. While causing widespread mental pollution, they were also draining the life essence and faith of millions in Lington.
The battle became more and more ferocious.
Lington's northern suburbs.
The sky hung low, scattered with thick fragments of azure flame clouds, making it seem as if the entire sky had cracked.
Master Pierre had the strength to lift mountains, and his Divine Arts were enhanced by his servants. Both his moves and spells had the power to destroy the heavens and obliterate the earth.
In a desperate battle, everyone around was shocked.
Mr. Jing copied each move precisely with his hand mirror.
The two flaming giants teamed up and beat the ugly tentacled outer god into steady retreat.
While Su Lun marveled at the unrivaled combat prowess of Master Pierre and his mentor's sister, he also sensed something ominous.
Although the two top experts currently had the upper hand, there was no sign that they could annihilate the outer god anytime soon.
Su Lun's All-knowing Eye could see each thread of faith. During the battle, he noticed that the red threads broke massively, but the newly infected zombies would reconnect them. The outer god was clearly transferring some of the damage to its followers. Despite significant battle damage, it was far from death. Born from disaster and fed by fear, as long as the believers in Lington survived, it would not be destroyed.
Su Lun knew clearly that everyone on the side of the royal family was enduring, waiting for Master Pierre to be unable to hold on.
Once this ninth tier could no longer hold on and suddenly perished on the spot, the situation would resolve itself.
Then, no one would be able to kill this "Sea Giant Clarence."
And Master Pierre's aura had already reached its peak, without rising further.
This was actually a sign of impending decline.
Su Lun looked slightly worried and pondered, "Does my mentor's sister have any other fallback? Things will get worse this way..."
At this moment, if the fight couldn't be resolved quickly, the situation would increasingly turn against them.
Whether it was Pandora's Faith Stealing or everything else she had done before, it seemed everything that could be done had been done.
Even Mr. Jing had personally joined the battle.
If there was any strategy left, now was the best time to use it.
If things dragged on, even a backup plan would be useless.
Su Lun walked along the street, having almost finished collecting the Soul Shards near the palace.
He always felt that he should do something.
Suddenly, a bizarre thought flashed through his mind: "Could it be... that my mentor's sister's fallback is me?"
The thought wasn't alarming initially,
but once it arose,
it was deeply frightening.
In the battle against the outer god to the north, only eighth-tier professionals barely qualified to participate.
Su Lun initially thought that, as a sixth-tier, he couldn't be involved.
Not to say whether he could survive getting close, even if Su Lun went into battle wielding the Black Sickle and Dragon-Slaying Dagger, the thought of hacking while shouting, "I'll slash your cuticle, chop a few of your hairs..." was absurd—the disparity in levels of battle was too great for him to be directly involved, let alone be of any help; rather, he might add to the trouble.
But... not being able to participate directly didn't mean there was nothing he could do!
Since Mr. Jing had personally entered the battle, there had been no more communications from her.
She didn't say, but that didn't mean he couldn't do anything.
Su Lun was one of the very few people who had seen gods with his own eyes and knew some taboos about battling gods.
He and Pandora had discussed in detail before, even pseudo-gods who hadn't yet coalesced divinity couldn't be killed by ordinary means as long as their faith remained intact.
The most direct method was to deal with the object carrying the god's faith.
Recalling their last conversation at the underground altar, Su Lun suddenly realized: "That stele!"
...
The battle between mortals and gods had to be conducted with the utmost caution at all times.
Such high-level beings possessed some special perceptual abilities.
Any targeted plotting could potentially be perceived by the outer god, leading to calamity.
That's why from the beginning until now, nearly all plans to combat the outer god had not been discussed by Mr. Jing.
Su Lun had only guessed some based on the tacit understanding between them.
Just like the previous plan to ambush and severely injure the Evil God; from start to finish, only Su Lun knew.
But Mr. Jing guessed it, so did Yekaterina: that's why they cooperated wholeheartedly.
Because he had never spoken it aloud, he had successfully ambushed that outer god.
At this moment, the outer god had descended in its true form, and the red moon in the sky was absorbing faith while simultaneously "monitoring" every inch of land under its moonlight.
Its perception was stronger than before.
No wonder there had been no communication since Mr. Jing personally joined the battle.
Because even if she thought of this plan, she absolutely could not speak of it!
Su Lun instantly understood everything.
Currently, only two people knew about the existence of the stele. Mr. Jing was now locked in, and Su Lun himself, because he had Pestia by his side, was undetected by the outer god.
He was also the only one who could approach the stele silently!
Thinking of this, Su Lun's mind immediately started racing, and a plan was instantly formed.
...
Meanwhile, at the royal harbor in the north city.
The royal dock on the sea was in the midst of a fierce battle, with the opposition's navy trapping the royal navy in the port, both sides engaged in a relentless bombardment.
Meanwhile, silently laying below the sea was a heavy submarine, its cabin hiding a corps of Mapha's mechanized warriors. They were dressed in highly advanced mechanized armor, ready for battle at any moment.
This was a secret legion that even Queen Charlotte herself did not know about.
In the cabin, these people watched the battle above through a crystal ball, each of them feeling their hearts pound with trepidation.
Clearly, this was a scene they had not anticipated.
Seeing the outer god coalesce into a body, Baldy in the group of mechanized warriors sighed with a presence that commanded respect, "Ah... no wonder the 'cession treaty' was signed so promptly; they harbored such a sinister plan all along. That old woman has indeed plotted against all of Mapha this time!"
His eyes reflected the repulsive visage of the tentacled outer god as he solemnly added, "I never thought she would betray the alchemical civilization and conjure up a 'guardian deity'. Luckily, Master Pierre still has the strength to fight, or the consequences would be unimaginable..."
Baldy, his body augmented with mechanized exoskeletons, bore on his shoulders the military rank of the Imperial Golden Eagle General Star.
Even in Mapha, there were no more than a handful who held this military rank.
If a stranger were here, they might recognize him but would hardly believe that this was Meredith Ben Moses, the Grand Admiral of the Mapha Empire!
And those around him were the pinnacle of Mapha's combat forces.
Originally, they planned to quietly infiltrate Lingdun under the pretext of reinforcements, looking for an opportunity to achieve greater victories. But they had not expected to witness the descent of the outer god.
Marshal Meredith watched the battle stall and stopped watching, signaling his men, "Let's go. Prepare for battle. Should Master Pierre show signs of waning, we'll have to assist, see if we can kill that outer god."
"We are entering the battle?"
At his words, a staff officer nearby, slightly puzzled, spoke up, "But Lord Marshal, letting Lu Ying's people weaken themselves could maximize benefits for us. If Pierre dies, Lu Ying's fortune will diminish greatly, reducing a significant threat to our Empire."
Another staff officer chimed in, "Yes, Lord Marshal. If we intervene now, not only will it be difficult to explain to the Bonnar royal family. If we really enter the battle at Lingdun, those domestic anti-war factions will definitely accuse our military of intentionally provoking a large-scale war, creating tremendous pressure from public opinion..."
The young Mapha generals were somewhat confused. It made sense to assist Queen Charlotte since there was an alliance.
But fighting the outer god? What was that about?
Wouldn't that be helping Lu Ying's "opposition"?
If the Bonnar royal family were overthrown, wouldn't all their previous efforts be in vain?
Hearing his men, Meredith shook his head and sighed, "We have no choice but to go."
"That old lady has given us a tough problem..."
He paused for a moment, then explained to the group of young generals, "If we do not stop it this time, once Master Pierre dies, the outer god will eventually become powerful and we will never have another chance to kill him. Even if we could secure a decisive advantage in the clashes between the two great empires over the next few years, a hundred years later, the alchemical civilization will inevitably be destroyed. A Lu Ying ruled by an outer god presents an endless threat to us. No matter what, alchemical civilization must never fall into the hands of theocrats!"
Whether traditional alchemists or mechanized magicians, despite being political adversaries, this was about allegiance.
But all of them were devotees of the original creator in the lineage of alchemy, unwilling to let an outer god intervene in the path of civilization's development. This was a principle.
Hearing this, the young generals finally understood and responded in unison, "Yes, Lord Marshal!"
...
Because he had earlier determined a location for an altar, Su Lun already had a rough idea of the ceremonial magic circle covering the entirety of Lingdun in his mind.
He was proficient in various ancient magic circles and, using those ancient magic circle concepts, could easily calculate a few suspected coordinates.
Once he confirmed the position of the second altar, he would be able to accurately locate all altar positions.
After multiple teleportations confirmed the first two coordinates were incorrect, he appeared near the royal dock on the East Coast.
This was the location of his third calculated coordinate.
When he arrived, the dock too was immersed in intense combat, with gunfire filling the sky.
Su Lun paid no attention to the fighting factions; instead, he constantly kept an eye on the wildly flying shells, searching for that calculated coordinate.
But coincidentally, just as he was walking, he suddenly noticed a group of sneaky individuals emerging from the direction of the royal dock.
These individuals, each cloaked in a black cape, moved with a discipline characteristic of well-trained soldiers.
Even though he couldn't see their faces, Su Lun immediately realized, "Mapha's mechanized warriors?"
Although this group was cloaked, the robustness of their bodies was unmistakable—where were they normal people? Each one was distinctly muscular, clearly outfitted with external mechanical devices.
Moreover, the rustling of mechanical joints was evident as they ran, and the fluctuation of soul fire was not too high…
Every sign pointed to their identity as Mafa warriors.
"Such advanced armor…" Su Lun murmured, squinting, immediately guessing something.
He himself was skilled in the creation of mechanical armor, and knew well that any without the sound of steam boilers was top-tier magic-powered mecha.
Why had the Mafa hidden such a group at the docks?
To guard the altar?
That couldn't be right… wasn't that something fewer people should know about, the better?
Ideally, no one would know.
Su Lun didn't avoid them, thinking instead to see what the other party was up to.
A group emerged, and in the dimly lit district, they collided with Su Lun.
Instantly, swords were drawn and crossbows cocked.
A caw came from Black Fang on his shoulder, and Su Lun realized then how dangerous these people were!
"There are at least Grand General-level fighters among these people?!"
This immediately made him cautious, his grip tightening on his black scythe.
The cloaked group, seeing the crow and the black scythe, also guessed who he might be.
To Su Lun's surprise, after a few seconds of confrontation, they didn't act but silently retreated?
"Eh… were they not reinforcements for the Bonaparte royal family?"
Su Lun was puzzled.
Weren't all the Mafa mechanical warriors here reinforcements for Empress Charlotte, yet seeing himself, they didn't attack?
He looked at the black crow on his shoulder, who clearly was capable of attacking as well.
Su Lun chose not to pursue them.
With a Grand General present, chances were he couldn't win, and his immediate priority was to find that stele; he had no intention of wasting time.
Watching them truly leave, Su Lun wandered nearby for a bit more, then once again dove underground using an earth elemental wax figure.
However, after descending another thousand meters, Su Lun finally discovered another familiar hidden space!
"Found it!"
With a thrill of excitement in his heart, he pinpointed two locations and quickly calculated all the array points of the entire magic formation by the foreign god.
He didn't rush in, but appeared on the surface instead.
Now that the positions of the nine corners of the Nonagram Alchemy Formation were confirmed, with Mr. Jing destroying one, eight remained! Your journey continues at My Virtual Library Empire
But he had seen before that the stele could move!
Su Lun knew it was futile to just go in.
Just then, he thought of something, pinched the sorcerer's seals, and performed targeted spatial displacement. Looking again, he found himself inside a steam airship thousands of meters above Lingdun City!
...
The previous second, Ekaterina felt a slight chill from the pendant on her chest, her eyebrows lifting.
The next second, a person appeared beside her, and she was hardly surprised.
But the command room suddenly having a mysterious cloaked person caused the guards to tense up.
Ekaterina gestured with her hand, signaling the crowd, "You all go out first."
"Yes, Miss."
A number of staff and guards immediately exited, leaving only two people in the vast command center.
Su Lun walked over, took out a map of Lington, and spread it on the table, marking eight places with red crosses.
Ekaterina saw this and her pupils slightly contracted.
Su Lun got straight to the point, "Is it possible?"
Ekaterina apparently understood, nodding her head, "Five minutes."
Su Lun said, "Good!"
The two conversed without specifying what needed to be done, but both understood each other perfectly.
At that moment, Ekaterina took out two elegant wooden boxes from her storage space.
Su Lun recognized one of them; it contained a collection of beautiful and exquisite meteorites.
Upon opening another box, it was filled with premium energy crystals.
Su Lun watched as a mysterious aura emerged from Yekaterina, her domain expanded, and celestial phenomena appeared on her body's surface.
A box of energy baryte instantly shattered, the energy gathering in the octagram alchemy formation under her feet. From another box, eight meteorites also floated out slowly.
Above the command room of the airship where they were was a brilliant, unobstructed starry sky. In a moment, she seemed to merge with the stars, and the entire night sky became her shadow.
Su Lun noted the pallor on Yekaterina's face and knew this ritual was a great burden on her.
But this plan could not be communicated to anyone else; only Yekaterina could accomplish it.
All eight altars must be attacked, destroyed simultaneously!
Otherwise, once they began, the outer gods would know the plan, and it would be impossible to defeat them one by one.
Su Lun watched her cast spells, his expression solemn.
The location of the command room provided a clear view of the battle situation in Lingdun City, with fires blazing everywhere within the city.
He could clearly see the north of the city, where two flame giants were besieging the outer god.
However, much to Su Lun's surprise, a gigantic mechanical war armor over a hundred meters tall suddenly emerged in the chaos of battle!
As soon as this armor appeared, thunder boomed across the sky.
Yet, confusingly, the giant armor charged toward the Evil God.
"A near-ninth level 'Thunder God' Mecha? Isn't that the war armor of the Navy Grand General from Mafa, how did it end up here?"
Seeing this, Su Lun suddenly realized what the group of people he had encountered at the royal port was all about.
A thought flashed through his mind, leaving him shocked and surprised, "Those guys from Mafa, they actually 'turned the tide' to help fight the outer god?"
After thinking it over, he understood and also gained a bit of respect: "That Grand General really has a vision for the bigger picture, huh."
Any discerning person would know that continuing this way, Master Pierre would indeed be defeated, which currently would be beneficial to Mafa in every way without any harm.
But in the long run, it would be a catastrophic disaster for the alchemy civilization.
Although Mafa clearly had a secret alliance with Queen Charlotte, this Grand General chose to join the battle despite the risk of infamy, which alone was admirable.
However, just as Su Lun saw the fierce fighting in the city, Yekaterina had already completed condensing her ritual.
Stars sparkled in the starry sky, her eyes already a brilliant, profound expanse, her slender fingers shaped into star seals, she chanted softly, "Astrological Alchemy: Curtain Call of an Era!"
Upon hearing this, Su Lun faintly sensed a special significance in this ritual.
Looking again, he saw the stars in the sky, like raindrops, falling toward the ground.
...
"This..."
Su Lun looked up, and outside the airship window was a fireworks display of colorful splendor.
As he watched hundreds of meteors fall toward the ground simultaneously, he was briefly stunned.
The meteorites wrapped in fireballs even whistled past just tens of meters away from the airship...
This was a spectacular meteor shower.
It felt like a festival celebration, romantic wishes, joyous blessings... and like it was announcing the end of an era.
It was supposed to be just eight altars, so why were there hundreds of meteors?
Su Lun glanced at Yekaterina's eyes, radiant with an unusual gleam, and then he understood that she was bidding farewell to her teacher.
No matter what, today was undoubtedly Master Pierre's end.
In an instant, Su Lun also understood that all the stars in the sky were there to provide cover for those eight meteors.
The people on the ground were stunned by the rain of meteors, their eyes wide with horror as they watched.
If these meteors really fell in Lingdun City, the vast area would likely be destroyed at once.
But to everyone's surprise, when they were still thousands of meters above the ground, almost all the meteors exploded like fireworks, bursting into beautiful sparks in the night sky.
The night lit up like day, everyone's eyes filled with a gleam.
Master Pierre, watching the fireworks across the sky, seemed to sense something, looked up, caught a glimpse of the airship hidden among the stars, and with a content smile on his face amidst his life's twilight, he murmured, "A new era is coming, huh?"
And suddenly!
The fireworks blazed intensely, and eight fireballs burst through the dazzling white brilliance.
How fast are meteors?
Those thousands of meters, passing in an instant, smashed into the ground, causing the soil to churn!
"Boom," "Boom," "Boom"...
The vast Lingdun City then started to tremble with each blast.

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - 486 "Hymn Witch" Maria
chapters.content:
Like on a deep blue canvas, silver stars were slipping down.
Then, those stars exploded into brilliant bursts of light on the canvas.
Su Lun watched the fireworks before him, his eyes reflecting the colorful world, his gaze slightly blurred.
The view from up high is truly different.
"Boom!"
The intense sound of explosions merged into one, pulling Su Lun back to reality.
Eight meteors fell to the ground, like bundles of flaming spears thrusting into the earth, the violent shockwaves made the solid ground roll like waves.
The cracked lines on the ground spread out, connecting dot to line. From a high altitude, it looked like the outer circle of a gigantic nine-pointed star magic circle arranged in Lingdun City.
At this moment, all nine altars had been destroyed.
Almost simultaneously with the explosion, Pestoya discovered something and urgently shouted, "I've found It!"
Su Lun's spirits lifted upon hearing this.
The time was now!
With no altars to shield the smell, Pestoya could accurately locate the foreign god's stone sculpture.
Now that the stone sculpture had escaped the altar, rushing over immediately might give them an opportunity!
Without delay, Su Lun turned and looked at Yekaterina, who was not far from him and pale.
Without speaking, they looked at each other and nodded.
Su Lun formed the sorcerer's seal, and in an instant, he had teleported outside the airship.
His body plummeted rapidly, the wind whistling past his ears.
Pestoya also materialized, enjoying the sensation of freefall. She sensed briefly, then excitedly pointed towards a building in the North City, "Over there, near the farm with the orange glow."
Su Lun identified the location and saw that it was far from where Master Pierre and others were fiercely battling the foreign god, and his heart leaped with joy.
The foreign god wants to escape?!
Seeing the foreign god appearing at that remote location, Su Lun immediately guessed Its intention.
Now that the Stele of Faith had been discovered, it was like exposing its lifeline. Once discovered, no one could protect It!
Naturally, the farther away from the main battlefield, the better.
With this in mind, Su Lun did not hesitate any further. He grabbed the ghost lady, still new to the sensation of crashing, into his arms, "Hold on to me, we're leaving!"
"Oh."
Pestoya's face was filled with excitement and she clung to Su Lun's neck like a koala.
Within a few teleports, the two of them had already landed on the ground from thousands of meters in midair.
....
When Su Lun's feet touched the ground, the ground was still experiencing the aftershocks of the meteor impact.
He staggered for a moment.
Before him stood a Gothic-styled building resembling a church, an alchemy temple located on the outskirts.
"That foreign god is even targeting the alchemy temple now..."
Su Lun murmured to himself, his gaze sweeping across like an eagle's in an instant.
Gripping the black umbrella tightly in his hands, he extended his soul perception outward without any carelessness.
Meanwhile, the crow on his shoulder cawed out loud, and Su Lun's brows relaxed slightly: Dangerous, but not fatally so.
That meant, the enemy inside was not of the eighth order—the kind that spelled certain death.
Perhaps because Su Lun had arrived decisively, the stele had not been appearing here for more than ten seconds.
Just as he landed, a wave of spatial fluctuation emanated from the temple.
To others, it might not mean much, but Su Lun, with his keen senses, recognized the attempt to establish a connection with a distant space, and inwardly shouted, "The foreign god wants to use a spatial transportation circle to escape?"
It was really fortunate that he arrived in time, otherwise the foreign god would have indeed escaped!
It was also fortunate that it was him, for others might have simply watched the foreign god teleport away.
Su Lun had a way.
Without hesitation, he immediately took out the "Chronos Spatial Gloves" and put them on, pinching towards the direction where the spatial fluctuation was coming from within the building.
Besides solidifying space, the glove was not much useful, but at this moment, it was perfect.
With a "crack," the crystal core on the glove shattered, and the increasingly intense spatial fluctuation abruptly ceased.
The transmission circle was disrupted!
Seeing this, Su Lun also exhaled in relief, "See where you can run to now!"
It was also lucky that it was him who came, as others might not necessarily have been able to stop the foreign god from escaping.
But at the same time, a sense of crisis instantly surged in his heart.
Just as Su Lun disrupted the space transportation, a woman in a nun's robe and with blond hair burst through the stained glass of the church, appearing like a flash of lightning in his field of view.
An enemy appearing did not surprise Su Lun; he had disrupted the transportation so it would be odd if no one came out to check.
But recognizing the identity of the blond woman before him, his expression grew solemn.
As he had guessed earlier, she indeed wasn't of the eighth order, but she was one of the most problematic existences among the seventh order.
She was one of the seventh orders Su Lun least wanted to encounter.
This blond woman was none other than one of the ten Legendary Bounty Hunters, the "Hymn Witch" Maria G. O'Casey.
A professional skilled in the art of Melodic Mass Attack Techniques.
...
This woman appeared without mincing words and the magician hardened.
"Domain: Magical Choir!"
A circle of invisible force field spread out from her body, engulfing the entire alchemy temple.
Though it seemed harmless, the sound of beautiful music that began to drift around the ears, heavenly in nature, was intoxicating.
Su Lun furrowed his brows.
This was not a good sign. Beneath the beautiful melody, a murderous intent was already hidden.
He had thoroughly researched the details of each of the top ten legends.
Seeing this person, Su Lun felt an immense headache coming on.
But he didn't rush to make a move, instead, he calmly used the communicator to inform everyone in the Dawn Group, "Gentlemen, the pseudo-divinity of the Outer God is at the North City Anderson Farm, requesting support."
Now that everything about the Outer God was exposed, there was no need to hide anything anymore.
They were far from the main battle zone, where previously those professionals of the seventh and eighth ranks, as well as various legions, were engaged in fierce battle at a distance. It would take no small amount of time for them to disengage and come over.
Knowing that his stele was discovered, the Outer God would certainly notify reinforcements to come.
Seeing Maria here, Su Lun knew he couldn't deal with this woman.
Therefore, he didn't plan to fight alone; he immediately notified Mr. Jing and Yekaterina.
Almost immediately after communicating, the fierce battle in Lingdun City climaxed.
The sounds of battle, like a thunderstorm, became even more exaggerated than before.
The followers, receiving instructions from the Evil God, spared no effort to reinforce; the opposing coalition also received the communication, sparing no expense to intercept.
The more desperately the enemy tried to break free, the more they tried to stop them.
Since the abnormal behavior of the Outer God that began with the falling meteor, almost everyone realized that a crucial turning point in tonight's disaster might be approaching!
Both sides plunged into a desperate, vicious battle, restraining each other.
On the other hand, Su Lun originally wanted his sister, who was a top-level combatant, to help, as with her help, all problems could be solved instantly.
But the bad news was that she was tied up in a chaotic battle with Master Pierre and Marshal Mafa, fighting against the rampant Outer God, unable to extricate herself.
If any of them pulled away even slightly, the delicate balance would be broken, and the god-body of the Outer God might descend near Su Lun, worsening the situation.
The good news was, if Mr. Jing didn't come, the Outer God wouldn't arrive either.
Master Pierre was also staking his life in the struggle, and the Outer God as well.
This meant that for a short time, Su Lun could only rely on himself, ensuring the Faith Stele of the Outer God couldn't escape.
The precondition was ensuring he wouldn't be killed by the "Hymn Witch" Maria.
...
"Surviving under the hands of a legendary hunter is not easy…"
Su Lun looked at the legendary hunter before him, his expression very serious.
On a normal day, encountering her, the best option would be to run upon sighting her.
Because if you choose to confront her head-on, you are already within her domain.
There are only two outcomes: kill or be killed.
Though he knew it wouldn't be much use, Su Lun didn't hesitate to cast a spell: "Auditory Stripping!"
But in this woman's domain, even if the hearing was stripped away, the beautiful melody of the song could still be clearly heard, which was already a deadly crisis in the making.
This was no ordinary seventh rank.
Amongst the top ten legends, Su Lun had encountered several, none of whom were undeserving of their reputation.
Su Lun did not feel that he currently had the strength to confront this woman head-on, nor did he plan to entangle with her.
From the beginning to the end, his goal was that stele.
Not this woman!
Seeing this woman gathering the sorcerer's seals, Su Lun didn't hesitate to use Teleportation, appearing inside the sanctuary.
Upon looking again, there was a teleportation circle set up here, with the roughly carved stele in the center of the circle.
Su Lun looked at the once again activated teleportation circle patterns, his brows tightly knitted.
Just by seeing the complex magical patterns on the formation, he could tell it was a long-distance teleportation circle.
If it truly teleported away, the Outer God might indeed escape.
A thought flashed through his mind, and he raised his hand to pinch, shattering the gemstone on his glove, simultaneously disrupting the teleportation circle.
At that moment, Maria, dressed in a nun's habit, appeared in the sanctuary like a specter.
Seeing Su Lun again disrupt the teleportation, her face darkened as she raised a hand.
The previously tranquil four to five hundred individuals sitting inside the sanctuary all stood up at once.
These people looked like ordinary locals from nearby farms—elderly, children, pregnant women...
They were not followers, but merely under an Illusion Technique, gazing numbly with straight eyes at Su Lun, the intruder.
Continue your adventure at My Virtual Library Empire
In an instant, they opened their mouths and began to sing in unison, "My Lord bestows peace, dispels my worries, grants me freedom..."
As they sang, their bodies swayed rhythmically and neatly like water plants.
Although Su Lun had stripped his hearing, the song, as if penetrating deep into the soul, echoed in his mind and could not be dispelled.
Moreover, even knowing the song was very dangerous, its beautiful melody made one addicted to listening forever.
Stranger still, he found his body moving uncontrollably, swaying rhythmically like the water plants.
Struggling against the discomfort, Su Lun teleported out of the sanctuary.
Seeing this, Maria O'Casey revealed a mocking smile and suddenly condensed her spell: "Explode!"
Outside the sanctuary, in the cowshed, Su Lun had just teleported out.
This was an area-covering spell.
The dozen cows that had been peacefully grazing while listening to the beautiful song suddenly trembled. With a 'bang,' they burst like water bags and exploded into bursts of blood mist.
And Su Lun in the air felt that terrifying shock wave as if his body was hammered by a wild wind, "puh," spitting out a mouthful of old blood, he heavily fell onto a haystack of feed.
...
Even though the woman had done nothing, Su Lun nearly died on the spot.
That was the terrifying aspect of "Hymn Witch" Maria O'Casey.
Her spells could kill invisibly.
[C-025-Singer], this was originally considered a trivial talent by ordinary people. Usually, those who awakened it became major singing stars or vocal artists.
But this woman had developed her talent to the second dissolution state and had gained unusually bizarre combat abilities.
Music, too, was one of the higher rules that could coalesce divinity!
Maria became divine through her singing, her talent giving her an extremely wide vocal range. Her voice was a triple attack of vibrations, rhythm, and mental illusion!
Su Lun flipped up, wiping the blood spilling from the corner of his mouth, his hands rapidly changing Suren Sorcerer's Seals.
At that moment, Maria also followed out of the sanctuary. Seeing that she hadn't killed her target, she exclaimed with surprise, "Eh... You're not dead?"
She was only surprised for a moment.
Maria did not try to stop Su Lun from gathering his spells; instead, like a conductor, she made a gesture as though she was directing the high notes of a melody.
"Ah... my Lord..."
In an instant, the beautiful melody lingering around the sanctuary suddenly soared, kindling a faint fervor in those who heard it.
Feeling the air around him tremble, Su Lun's expression drastically changed!
This was an area-of-effect attack—there was simply no way to dodge if you were within the range of the sound waves.
The only option was to endure it!
Moreover, the most inexorable part was the ongoing song by his ear, this area damage was continuous!
Having been hit just now, his blood and qi had not even settled yet.
If it hit again, he feared he might collapse on the spot.
Because he chose to retreat decisively, Su Lun completed his Spatial Displacement spell first.
As the sonic deathtrap swept past, he had already vanished from sight.
...
Several kilometers away.
Finally escaping the melody at his ear, Su Lun fiercely exhaled in relief.
He gazed toward the distant sanctuary, his back and forehead covered in cold sweat.
Just facing those ten Legendary individuals for that instant nearly cost him half his life.
Puppets, wax figures, cursed objects—he hadn't managed to use any of those methods.
This was a classic case of professional counters.
No!
To be precise, that "Hymn Witch" Maria's abilities almost countered everyone.
No wonder that external God had her guard the teleportation circle. With this woman and her range attack domain present, within her level, few could be her match; those below level seven were simply meting out their death!
The power of the Ten Legends was indeed extraordinary.
"Without mastering a domain, there's simply no resisting her sound wave domain..."
Su Lun inwardly grumbled.
He breathed heavily a few times, slowly calming the restless blood and qi from the recent attack.
If he had not absorbed a vast amount of life essence tonight, keeping his blood and qi in a vigorous state, he might have been unable to stand up just now.
He could escape, but alas, he could not contend with her!
Su Lun immediately fell into deep thought.
Not to mention resistance, aside from directly teleporting out of the domain's coverage area, he had no leeway to counterattack.
He wouldn't even be able to save himself.
However, now was not the time to retreat from difficulty; he had to think of a way to stop her.
Recalling the teleportation circle he had seen earlier, Su Lun rapidly analyzed in his mind: "Activating that teleportation circle takes about twenty seconds... which means I have to enter it within twenty seconds at most."
Realizing this, he knew he had no time to rest.
Fortunately, he had already set multiple spatial coordinates.
Without hesitation, he performed Directed Displacement again, teleporting over.
...
The light and shadow flashed silently, and Su Lun appeared outside the sanctuary.
The beautiful melody echoed again by his ear.
Looking at the increasingly strong teleportation circle, he swiftly pinched ahead and "crack" shattered a gemstone, disrupting the teleportation circle once more.
But clearly, Maria had already anticipated his disruptive return; the moment Su Lun acted, the singing abruptly intensified.
Su Lun felt as though he was at the center of an explosion, the air in all directions violently trembling.
"Bang," he spat out fresh blood again, his face pale as he crashed to the ground.
Before he even hit the ground, Maria, dressed in a nun's attire, ran out again.
Seeing the teleportation disrupted for the third time, the rage in her eyes had turned into raging killing intent.
But seeing the culprit still not dead, she was quite surprised.
After a brief observation, Maria had an epiphany and said, "Eh... so you used the Space Law to isolate the medium transmitting the sound waves; no wonder you're not dead. You are somewhat clever."
Pausing for a moment, she added, "It's a pity, though, that you met me."
She spoke arrogantly, seemingly showing many flaws.
But Su Lun was well aware that this woman was deliberately luring him.
Anyone who reached a profession of the seventh level would certainly not underestimate an opponent, even one ranked lower than themselves. If there was a chance to eliminate a target, she would definitely not hold back!
This woman was not just blabbering.
Instead, because her spell chanting took a long time, she was casting spells while talking.
Su Lun was not fooled; he once again gathered his spells and teleported away.
Seeing this, Maria's expression stiffened, but she scoffed, "Hmph!"
Avoiding once was possible, but how many more times could he dodge?
With the domain activated, the end had essentially been announced.
"Next time, it will be your demise!"
....
Several kilometers away, Su Lun collapsed onto the grass, his chest heaving violently as he gasped for air.
Recalling the recent events, his expression turned bitter.
Sound wave transmission requires a medium; Su Lun's spatial ability to create vacuum zones and distort space, had effectively countered his opponent's techniques.
Yet, even though he had formed a vacuum layer over his surface, due to the difference in their levels, that woman's sonic blast and law penetration caused him severe damage.
Now, he had been seen through as well.
Next time, measures targeted at him were inevitable.
Going there again might indeed be fatal.
Just as these thoughts flitted through his mind, another twenty seconds were about to pass.
"That woman's 'Domain: Magical Choir'—her control over the range of sound waves—is truly indefensible..."
Su Lun looked bitter, still unable to think of a good countermeasure.
Reinforcements hadn't arrived yet, he had to stall her himself.
Reality left no room for hesitation; in just twenty seconds, the Evil God would escape.
Figuring his physical condition was still decent, he could withstand another hit without dying.
Thinking this, he teleported over once again.
...
The same method had already been used twice.
Maria, realizing Su Lun would definitely teleport back within twenty seconds to disrupt the teleportation circle, had begun to form the sorcerer's seal: "Song of the Mysteries: Solo Choir!"
As the technique coalesced, her aura surged dramatically, and she began singing a melodiously beautiful song.
Her solo singing sounded like a vast choir of hundreds, her voice robust with multiple echoes, covering all ranges of high and low tones.
The beautiful singing resonated in the vast space of the sanctuary.
It wasn't long before, two hundred meters northwest of the sanctuary, she suddenly perceived someone's presence!
Here he comes!
A fleeting glint of cold light flashed in Maria's eyes, a sneer crossing her face as her singing abruptly turned high and piercing: "Maria Ave Maria..."
At the high notes, the stone walls surrounding the farm instantly crumbled, the stones turning into a cloud of dust.
Sheds, tools, buildings—all turned to powder under those strident sound waves.
How terrifying was the power of this technique?
Su Lun teleported over, interrupting the spatial teleportation for the fourth time.
It wasn't that he didn't want to destroy the teleportation circle or kill the Legendary Hunter.
But the reality was that he simply couldn't!
Currently, he could not think of any way to endure for more than thirty seconds within this constant sonic attack.
This time, as soon as he appeared, a sharp sound wave assaulted him.
The enemy was well-prepared; Su Lun couldn't avoid it, and instantly blood streamed from all his orifices, a strong sense of death encroaching upon him.
That familiar sensation of nearing death returned again.
The more perilous the situation, the clearer his mind became, feeling as though he was walking under water, and his thoughts became distinct.
He had to resist the sound domain to survive!
Immersed in this extreme crisis, Su Lun was unaware that the black crown atop his head glowed intensely, a mysterious power enhancing his insight. He felt as if he was about to grasp something.
Unfortunately, the tempo had already thrown his breathing into disarray, delaying his techniques.
If he didn't leave now, and waited for that woman's next technique to coalesce, he would almost certainly die!
Though reluctant, Su Lun still prioritized his life.
However, just as he thought to teleport away, suddenly, a slightly playful voice resounded beside his ear: "Her singing is really nice."
The moment these words were uttered, bizarrely, Maria's piercing song abruptly ceased. Had it been interrupted?
Su Lun was momentarily stunned, gaining a moment to catch his breath.
Looking again, Pestoya floated out.
The ghost lady cocked her head, looking at the blonde woman in the distance with a mischievous smile on her face, giggling, "I really want to make her my doll~"
Maria O'Casey didn't see the figure, but she heard that bell-like mocking laugh in her mind; her expression suddenly changed: "There's an expert here!"
And just in that moment to breathe, the insights that were half a step away suddenly became clear.
It was like a dam bursting forth, and then... inspiration surged out like a flood!
Su Lun felt a notion suddenly clear in his mind.
Indescribable, but he distinctly sensed it!
In an instant, a strange yet familiar sensation arose.
He exerted his authority, and suddenly a circle of black halos appeared under his feet. As soon as the halos appeared, a bizarre scene unfolded again. Within the few meters that the black light covered, the green grass visibly withered and turned black, and the earthworms and beetles in the soil instantly died and decayed. His standing spot turned into a circle of stark deadly silence.
This time, Su Lun clearly saw the domain of death swirling around him.
"Eh... did it work?"
As soon as this domain appeared, he was surprised to find that the song that had been lingering around his ears had disappeared by ninety-nine percent.
The little that remained no longer posed any lethal threat.
This bizarre domain of death, even before fully consolidating into a domain, had actually completely blocked the domain of the "Hymn Witch," one of the ten legendary figures, Maria?
"What a strong domain!"
Su Lun was shocked, suddenly seeing a hope for breaking the deadlock!

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - 487: Alchemy Witnesses the Miracle of Creation
chapters.content:
Before facing the "Hymn Witch," Maria O'Casey, Su Lun felt he had no chance of winning, mainly because he couldn't resist her vocal range, leaving him no room to counterattack. Stay connected through My Virtual Library Empire
And, by a stroke of luck, he had managed to condense a field of laws?
In this predicament, he suddenly saw a glimmer of hope to break the situation.
What surprised him even more was that a half-finished field could actually withstand the domain of a veteran among the top ten legendary Hunters?
The feeling was bizarre, as if he had control over the life and death of all beings within a region.
But now was not the time to ponder the intricacies of domains,
Su Lun turned his attention to the ghost Miss who had suddenly floated out.
He had been so focused on the fight that he almost forgot about Pestoya.
Since he hadn't seen her in a long time, and had never seen her use any combat abilities, Su Lun had treated her as a talkative ghost Miss.
Moreover, top-tier professionals usually don't leave glaring weaknesses in their domains, and such a sonic domain could be deadly to spiritual bodies as well.
She had been hiding inside the rune umbrella the whole time.
Su Lun assumed she was not good at fighting and thus didn't expect any help from her.
But obviously, Pestoya was unaffected now.
Su Lun thought he had mastered the field, and it was time to show his prowess.
However, at this point, an absurd scene unfolded.
He just watched as Pestoya floated out, then, the ghost Miss floated towards the Alchemical Holy Temple as if no one else was around.
Strangely, Maria's stern gaze searched everywhere but seemed unable to see her.
At this point, Su Lun wasn't too amazed yet.
He figured that since Pestoya had merged with the divine fire, it might be normal for others not to see her.
Then, the ghost Miss just casually floated into the Alchemical Holy Temple, completely unobstructed.
What followed was a mind-boggling scene!
Su Lun's puzzled expression froze on his face.
He was astonished to find that after Pestoya entered, the spatial fluctuations in that area had completely disappeared!
Without needing to think what had happened, he watched as the ghost Miss floated out of the window holding a huge dimensional gemstone in her hand.
"She... she destroyed the spatial array?"
Seeing this, Su Lun's eyes twitched severely as if his thoughts were stuttering.
If it was so easy to destroy, he would have teleported inside and done it himself much earlier.
That teleportation matrix was protected by top-level magical restrictions, even top-tier professionals couldn't break it quickly!
And you just snatched the core dimensional stone like that?
It made Su Lun feel that his earlier desperate attempts to block the teleportation several times seemed... rather foolish?
But if it was so easy to break the teleportation array, why didn't she act earlier?
...
Maria might not see Pestoya, but she could see the huge dimensional gemstone floating in midair!
This legendary Hunter knew there was a master nearby, but no matter how hard she sensed, she couldn't find anyone.
Now, watching the teleportation array being destroyed, the dimensional gemstone "floated out."
While astonished, her eyes flickered with murderous intent like flashing lightning, as she darted towards it, trying to snatch the gemstone back.
A long-distance spatial teleportation array, especially one capable of transporting an outer god-level entity, requires a gemstone of invaluable rarity. Even the Royal Treasury of Luye couldn't find a second such gemstone!
Seeing this, where would Su Lun allow her to have her way? With a pinch of the magician's seals, he also teleported over immediately.
Who could outpace teleportation with mere legs?
He was the first to pocket the dimensional gemstone into his storage space.
Maria's face changed drastically, but she knew that at this point, she had to kill the fellow in front of her first.
This legendary Hunter changed tactics, opening her mouth to sing a piercing ballad.
Su Lun knew that woman would definitely seize such an opportunity to attack, and he had initially prepared to withstand the strike head-on.
But at that moment, he discovered that the world seen through his eyes was glaringly different.
He clearly saw the "fluctuations" of the spell.
It was no longer the traceless lethal move from before; the spell created visible ripples in the air.
"Eh?"
Su Lun felt both shock and delight.
It was an extraordinary experience he had never had before.
It was as if he suddenly stood above the clouds, realizing that what he had thought of as the "sky" was merely another layer of clouds.
Reaching a certain height truly changed one's perspective of the world.
The previously imperceptible sound waves now materialized in the form of ripples, significantly reducing their threat instantly.
But the trajectory of the gemstone theft had been anticipated, making it unavoidable.
Su Lun's body instinctively entered a defensive state.
With a surge of his domineering energy, the black "field" around his body automatically enveloped him.
He was mentally prepared to be severely injured and knocked to the ground, but then, something unexpected happened.
"Puff," "puff," "puff"...
Several crisp sounds of his robe tearing, muscle tissues being sliced.
Su Lun stood there, looking at himself still standing, equally puzzled.
Not amazed that he was hit,
But surprised that he was still standing after being hit?
A seventh-tier spell had struck him, and he had only felt a slight sting?
Simultaneously incredulous, his eyes gleamed with vibrant spirit, and he joyfully thought, "Did I... did I just block it?!"
Being attacked by sound waves before felt like being thrown into a meat grinder, where both soul and body were crushed comprehensively, with a slight mishap leading to total disintegration.
But just then, only a few sharp notes had pierced through his domain like sharp little knives, breaking through the Rune Golden Body.
Roughly estimating, the damage reduction was over 90%!
With his current physical condition, what's a few stabs?
Experiencing the defensive enhancements of the Death Domain for the first time felt incredible!
...
For the first time in a clash, Su Lun didn't fall much behind, so he didn't rush to teleport and escape.
As long as he could stand his ground, what was there to fear?
"What kind of domain have I actually grasped, that it's so powerful?"
A thought flashed in Su Lun's mind, but his hands didn't slow down at all.
He no longer paid attention to that woman and had already appeared inside the Alchemical Sanctuary through a teleportation.
At that moment, in the dimly lit teleportation circle, the situation of that stele seemed somewhat awkward.
It couldn't escape, and being just a hunk of stone without hands or feet, it couldn't do anything against Su Lun.
The stele originally posed a deadly danger; it bore upon itself the horrific Divine Disaster Power of Faith from an Outer God.
This was a divine force that humans simply couldn't withstand.
The closer one was, the more dangerous it became.
Even if a top professional were to come here, they would mentally collapse almost instantly under the assault of this Power of Faith upon hearing the indescribable whispers.
In this respect, it was originally imperishable by standard means.
But because of Pestoya's reasons, this faith-based attack had no effect on Su Lun.
Now, as he looked again at this stone, his gaze gradually turned menacing.
...
Just as Su Lun approached the stele, a frantic warning from the Dawn members came through the communicator.
"Be careful, those followers of the Outer God are going crazy and are trying to break out recklessly!"
"The Outer God is showing abnormalities, it seems like it's going to go all out!"
"Su Lun, it's probably targeting you, be careful!"
"..."
It wasn't just the followers, the true body of the tentacled Sea Giant was also going all out.
It had already been surrounded and since it had no advantage, it had mostly been defensive, trying to wear down Master Pierre.
But now, with its divine object threatened, it had no choice but to go all out.
At that moment, the battle truly reached its most intense phase.
Su Lun knew he couldn't delay, drew his Dragon-slaying Dagger, and aimed to strike the stele.
Unexpectedly, a sudden burst of red light emerged from the stele, forming a Magic Shield that prevented Su Lun from getting close.
The Outer God was using its last resort to prevent humans from approaching.
This was not just a Magic Shield, but a protective layer of highly dense Power of Faith, impenetrable even to teleportation!
And with the sharpness of the Dragon-slaying Dagger being purely physical, it demanded close proximity; Su Lun frowned deeply upon seeing this.
Before he could think of a way to break through, at that moment, the several hundred residents inside the sanctuary again turned their blank stares his way and opened their mouths to sing.
Su Lun had learned before that this song was a powerful spell, and it was dangerous to listen to.
He also guessed that Maria O'Casey brought these civilians here, probably with the intention of moral kidnapping.
Followers could be killed without hesitation
But these innocent civilians were mostly elderly people, children, pregnant women...
Anyone with a bit of rationality would hesitate to strike.
In high-level professional confrontations, even a moment's hesitation is a fatal flaw.
Or perhaps, killing them would also trigger some kind of evil magic trap?
Su Lun had already thought through several possibilities before.
The best response was to ignore them.
But if he ignored them, these people would start "singing."
Su Lun thought of a compromise between killing and not killing.
As these people were about to start singing, he stretched out a hand and with an empty grasp, strands of invisible threads appeared at his fingertips, instantly spreading throughout the sanctuary.
These were ordinary people, the threads easily pierced their skin, like strands of silver needles piercing their nervous systems, depriving their nerves of control over their bodies.
This move instantly paralyzed several hundred people present.
Now, even if they wanted to sing, they couldn't open their mouths.
If you can control their minds with magic, then I can physically control their bodies.
And as Su Lun controlled the crowd, an idea suddenly flashed through his mind; he stealthily tugged on the threads, subtly adjusting several pieces of glass in the sanctuary.
The mirrors on the glass showed a distant main battlefield. There, flares made the night as bright as day, and several large figures continued to clash fiercely.
Suddenly, a piercing song burst through.
The crow on his shoulder cawed, and Su Lun's pupils suddenly dilated; a tingling sensation of lethal danger washed over him, causing him to teleport out of the sanctuary like lightning.
Just in that instant, the room exploded, sending hundreds of bodies bursting apart, flesh flying everywhere.
The explosive power of the Corpse Explosion Technique wasn't strong, but the flesh curiously seeped into the ground, lighting up a mysterious nine-pointed star magic circle.
...
"A blood curse from the Black Witchcraft lineage?"
Su Lun looked at the distant blood-filled sanctuary, recognizing the origin of the technique, his brow slightly furrowed.
Even from this distance, an oppressive and nauseating wicked aura hit him.
This was a curse around the eighth order.
An assessment showed that if Su Lun were to go now, he would likely turn into a puddle of pus and blood.
The sanctuary was now inaccessible.
The Outer God was trying to buy itself some final time.
As Su Lun teleported out, the crisis struck once again.
He raised his hand and four terrifying wax figures and a heap of puppets formed a protective circle around his body.
Previously, he had been unable to establish a foothold in the sound domain, which is why he had no intention of engaging in direct combat.
Now that the threat was not too deadly, he immediately entertained the idea of testing his might against this "Hymn Witch" Maria.
Since the woman's sound domain had little effect on him, the effectiveness of other techniques was now up for debate.
The moment the puppet was summoned, a beautiful melody reached his ears, followed by another wave of expansive sound vibrations.
"Boom," "Boom," "Boom"... A series of explosions erupted.
The ordinary puppets blasted into dust.
Su Lun was not surprised.
He had only intended to test the weaknesses of puppets in combat against such professionals, planning to refine related runes later.
Even the stone gargoyles, as hard as they were, morphed like modeling clay, their silver bodies undulating.
The elemental puppets too did not maintain their corporeal form for long and dispersed into their elemental forms.
Not just the puppets, the common threads easily collapsed under the sound waves; only a few threads twisted with the domain of death remained usable.
The only puppet that remained intact was the one imbued with the complete soul of young William, crafted from wind element!
"Indeed, it can use the Domain of Wind..."
Su Lun muttered to himself.
With a seventh-tier elemental puppet at his disposal, he felt even more confident.
Though the four elemental puppets were four independent entities, their spirits were connected, supporting and regenerating each other.
Unless one was destroyed, the rest could not collapse!
Behind "young William," the shadow of the "Phantasmal Servant: Wind Witch" rose, and once the Domain of Wind opened, the entire vicinity of the sanctuary was overwhelmed with a howling wind that screamed and screeched.
The Wind Blades were omnipresent, sharp as knives.
Even Maria, formidable as a seventh-tier legend, had to be cautious against the four elemental puppets, pulling back her own domain defenses.
Su Lun then manipulated his elemental puppets, orchestrating a surround-and-attack strategy.
Being too famous had its downsides as well; all kinds of information about him were known.
Apart from her sound-based techniques, this top ten legend had another killer move: controlling sound-sensitive metal needles for assassination.
One hand controlling sound waves, the other launching needles through the brain—almost a guaranteed kill.
Unfortunately for her, Su Lun had Biang.
Old man Biang had previously followed Su Lun and had collapsed a few times too.
But now that Su Lun could stand firm, the silly bird had also smartened up, transforming into a cloak and hiding within Su Lun's domain of death, no longer venturing out.
With it around, almost all physical attacks posed little threat.
...
Although Su Lun was temporarily safe, he couldn't kill Maria quickly either.
As a legendary Hunter, she had endless techniques up her sleeve.
Su Lun's puppet rankings still needed improvement. It was only after advancing to the seventh rank and understanding advanced runes that he could create higher-tier rune puppets effective against seventh ranks.
The battle between the two was intense, with constant exchanges.
Communications devices also relayed various messages; the Outer God was desperate, and the battlefield was amply moving this direction.
Su Lun also felt a headache coming on.
The situation seemed to have reached another deadlock.
Although his life was no longer in danger, likewise, that stele seemed equally unassailable.
Suddenly, he remembered Pestoya.
This spectral lady who had destroyed the teleportation array earlier had been floating beside him without taking further action.
She seemed to be enjoying a concert, her expression pleased. Perhaps she was coveting Maria's body, contemplating in her mind how to turn her into a doll.
It must be said, Maria's singing voice was indeed beautiful.
It was the kind that upon genuinely listening, could resonate with the soul and bring joy to body and mind.
But given the pressing circumstances, it wasn't the time for music.
During a lull in controlling his puppets, Su Lun suddenly asked, "Pestoya, have you always been confident about dealing with this woman?"
Pestoya replied, "Yes, her sound waves don't affect me at all."
"Then why didn't you take action earlier?"
Su Lun's eye twitched slightly.
After all the risks he had taken to retain the Outer God, it seemed it had initially been an easy task.
Pestoya said, "Because sister told me to wait."
"Sister said so?"
Upon hearing this, Su Lun knew there must be some hidden context.
But his expression also turned strange. This spectral lady had no physical objects, not even clothes except those illusionary ones, let alone a communicator. When did she speak?
Guessing his thoughts, Pestoya straightforwardly said, "I sensed that sister wanted it this way."
Su Lun: "Telepathy?"
Pestoya blinked, "Yes... After merging with the Divine Fire, I can sense the thoughts of those around me. Although I'm not very skilled at it, communicating with sister is quite smooth."
As she spoke, she playfully added, "I can also sense Mr. Su Lun's thoughts. So, you better not have some weird ideas normally."
Su Lun rolled his eyes: "..."
This ability was even more sinister than Mind Reading Technique, almost like a deity listening to the prayers of the faithful.
But hearing this, his mind whirled with activity, leading him to another thought.
From the beginning, he had felt something was off.
Facing the civilization-disaster-level Outer God, Sea Giant Clarence, if his sister's contingency was only someone of his modest sixth rank, it seemed too frivolous.
At least, Mr. Jing's contingency was definitely not just him.
Looking at Pestoya now, he understood everything.
Mr. Jing was probably the most experienced alchemist in this dimension when it came to battling gods.
Moreover, with not insignificant knowledge of the "Laws of Destiny," he could not have failed to anticipate that the Faith Stele might escape or the like.
A sixth order, at least Su Lun who had just failed to comprehend the domain field, was absolutely unable to stop it.
Just as this thought flashed, Peistoya seemed to read his mind and said, "I could have taken action earlier, but sister told me to delay a bit of time, and I also noticed that your state just now was very rare, Mr. Su Lun, so I didn't disturb you..."
Su Lun chuckled inwardly as he listened.
No wonder, at the moment he felt he was about to die, Peistoya "coincidentally" took action; so that was the case.
Moreover, because he had walked on the edge of death time and again before, he had seized that rare near-death insight, and he had successfully mastered the domain field of death—a truly serendipitous gain.
...
However, at the very next moment, Su Lun finally understood why Mr. Jing had asked Peistoya to buy time.
Because in his perception, a figure appeared out of nowhere!
"Pandora?"
Su Lun sensed the familiar soul fluctuation and immediately knew who the comer was.
A figure sprang out from a mirror.
Su Lun had seen Mr. Jing use this move at Gadronte Harbor.
No matter how far, as long as there is a reflection in the mirror, one can directly teleport people out from the mirror image.
This was also why he had instinctively thought of aligning the glass mirror of the cathedral towards the battlefield earlier; it was to facilitate Mr. Jing's arrival.
Upon looking again at the two red moons still dazzling in the distant sky, it was clear that the one on the battlefield was indeed a duplicate of Pandora.
Upon teleporting over, Pandora went straight for the stele inside the cathedral.
She was an alchemical creation, apparently unaffected by the curse.
Su Lun exhaled deeply in relief,
Regrettably not being able to get that stele, but this one, she can!
This one is precisely the Tsukiyomi Great God who specializes in stealing faith.
The stele gathered an overwhelmingly terrifying power of faith. Toxic to humans, it was the best supplement for her.
Although not at the level of that "Sea Giant Clarence," some techniques were
Mr. Jing + Peistoya + Pandora = God-Slaying Method?
The moment Pandora appeared here, everything fell into place.
By now, Su Lun had a very clear idea in his mind, and an odd thought even emerged: Sir Isaac's relative once captured a real deity; could it be that among the skills left to his daughter by the Alchemical Demigod, there was the "God-Slaying Method"?
The likelihood was significant.
Mr. Jing carried the great ambition of the rise and fall of realms and civilizations; he definitely needed to master some methods to counter outside gods.
And both Peistoya and Pandora, one controlling souls and the other siphoning faith, were techniques targeting deities.
Thinking of this, Su Lun finally felt the overwhelming pressure that he couldn't breathe under begin to dissipate.
Just as Pandora rushed into the cathedral at that moment, a tremendous force of faith burst forth.
It was as if screams rang by his ears, along with that indescribable whispering of the deity.
This was the stele making its final resistance; its power of faith was being stolen, rapidly collapsing.
Seeing this, the "Hymn Witch" Maria O'Casey rushed over, trying to stop her.
But where would Su Lun give her a chance?
All means were deployed to keep the woman outside.
As Pandora began to siphon the faith power from the stele, the outer god on the distant battlefield also went mad.
Su Lun watched as a red parasitic wave, like a torrential flood, surged towards him from afar.
The indescribable great terror gradually drew near, making Su Lun's scalp tingle.
It felt more terrifying than facing a hundred legendary Hunters.
It madly tried to approach the cathedral, to reclaim its "Divinity."
However, Mr. Jing and the others were also hot on its trail.
Just then, Su Lun suddenly heard someone chanting a spell.
...
The ancient and distant chanting echoed throughout Lingdun City, as this Great Alchemist bid farewell to this world.
"Adhering to the principle of equivalent exchange, praise the glory of the original Creator, witness the miracle of creation with alchemy..."
This phrase was no spell. Alchemists never needed any magic spells for casting.
It was merely the shared creed of all alchemists.
From the first day as an apprentice, everyone learned to recite this creed-like spell from their teachers. From then on, they embarked on the path of seeking the truths of the world.
This phrase seemed magical, providing alchemists facing confusion with the faith to proceed.
In his final moments, Master Pierre, standing at the pinnacle of planes and alchemy, recalled his childhood memory of first reciting this creed as he learned alchemy.
Back then, he felt that alchemy was infinitely fascinating.
The process of seeking truth, like peeling back layers of the world's veils, was indeed very beautiful.
Now, looking back, as he could scrutinize the truth, he praised the Creator's miracles even more.
Alchemy is great.
Master Pierre gathered his last spell and thrust forward: "Divine Art: God-Binding Chains!"
The giant of flames turned into cold fiery chains, locking the grotesque creature in place.
The "flood" was halted in its advance; the aura of the flame giant also decreased.
Su Lun watched from afar, his eyes filled with respect.
When another figure appeared outside the alchemy cathedral in a flash of mirror light, no one could stop Pandora from stealing the faith any longer.
The blood red hue of the moons in the sky faded, and the Evil God finally walked towards its demise step by step.
Without the will of the Evil God to control them, the city's followers and mutated creatures instantly lost their lives, falling down in droves.
The bloody world dissipated like smoke, and the survivors watched as dawn-colored clouds brightened the edge of the sky, a rosy light entering the city.
Only then did people realize that dawn had arrived.
On those unsettled faces, a light slowly emerged.
PS. Request for a wave of guaranteed monthly tickets for August; the beginning of the month is very, very important, please help!

chapters.title: Chapter 489 - 488: Big Turnaround!
chapters.content:
Initial draft, I'll make some adjustments, check back in twenty minutes.
The battle at the Andrew farm gradually reached its conclusion.
Master Pierre burned his life to seal off the outer god that had transformed into a sea of red threadworms, preventing it from advancing an inch.
No one else dared to approach the battlefield where two top-tier existences of different dimensions desperately fought to the death.
On the other hand, Su Lun had previously been unable to deal with the "Hymn Witch" Maria, but now Mr. Jing had arrived.
She was unbeatable if the musical domain couldn't resist her.
Once it could withstand her, her other abilities were merely that of a common seventh-tier combatant.
With Golden Leg subtly manipulating from the shadows, Su Lun used a little tactic and shortly after, he slew her on the spot.
Finally, her body fell in the cattle shed of the farm.
The souls of the ten legendary Hunters were rare treasures; although they would definitely make fine wax figures, Su Lun chose to directly absorb and digest them instead.
With this harvest, he completed many shortcomings in his mastery of the [Music] laws.
And after harvesting, Su Lun realized how superficial his previous understanding of musical laws had been.
Was the melody just about singing?
No, it was one of the cosmic origin's rules.
Su Lun finally understood why the [Siren Witch Doll] he had created before was less powerful than expected.
After digesting Maria's soul, he realized that he had only known how to make the puppet produce sound, while neglecting the power of the laws inherent in the melody itself.
When the original creator made everything, sound was a crucial part as well.
The crying of a baby, the decline of living beings, the sound of wind, rain, thunder, and the collapse of stars... these sounds might seem like specific noises when heard separately.
But resonating together, they are like a grand chorus performed by the entire universe.
Only by listening can you hear the universe telling you a mysterious story, a story about sound.
...
Pestoya crouched next to Su Lun, watching him clean up the spoils of war.
