```
Mr. Jing nodded, "Yes. 'All-solving True Revelation' is an extremely rare talent. Even within that 'heavenly god race,' there are definitely not many who can awaken the third eye. That guy's status in the heavenly god race is probably not low."
Hearing this, Su Lun pursed his lips in disappointment, "A pity... "
Even their joint forces had failed to kill him; confronting him in the future would be even harder.
That heavenly god race was indeed a big trouble.
Mr. Jing said, "Let's go. What I've been waiting for has come to pass, and this place is no longer suitable to linger in."
Qian Tiao sheathed his sword.
Su Lun nodded too, and, glancing at the severed hand on the ground, picked it up reflexively, wondering if it might come in handy later.
But upon a closer look, he found a special storage ring on the guy's finger.
"Huh... Isn't this an Alchemy civilization's storage ring?"
As someone proficient in Space Law, Su Lun immediately detected something odd with it.
This storage ring was not only large but also had a robust space, entirely different from the ordinary storage rings he was accustomed to seeing.
What was more crucial was that inside, there were several items that clearly looked like treasures!
Su Lun didn't look too closely, fearing covetousness from some divinity, and promptly stashed it into his little void realm.
He also brought Qian Tiao along.
Following Mr. Jing, Su Lun teleported several times and quickly arrived above the ocean.
An endless sea, where a large black sailing ship had long been waiting.
It was the Eternal Night Emperor.
Stepping onto his own ship, an unexplainable sense of security washed over him, and Su Lun let out a huge sigh of relief.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - 491 Giant Breeding Gear Fusion, Soaring Strength
chapters.content:
"Leader!"
"Teacher, you're back."
"Mr. Su Lun! Wow, seeing the news of your marriage in the paper, we thought you were going to become a prince and not come back, hahaha..."
"Oh, Mr. Su Lun did marry a very beautiful noble lady."
"..."
After Su Lun and his two companions boarded the ship, the members of the Evernight Group gathered around.
Tanni, Lolota, the Giant Three Brothers... Familiar and warm greetings made Su Lun's heart swell with comfort.
Setting sail, the huge black warship ventured into the deep sea under the cover of night.
On deck, the three of them stood at the bow, faces thoughtful as the crisp sea breeze blew around them.
An inexplicable "Celestial" had just arrived, providing some critical intelligence.
But the intel was rather fragmented and needed further thought and analysis.
That person had actually been quite strong, even tremendously so.
With the blessing of a deity, normally few in this plane could pose a lethal threat to him.
Unfortunately, that guy mistook Mr. Jing for a common level eight and was unaware that this daughter of Aisak held many methods to counteract deities right in her hands.
It was indeed a pity they didn't kill him.
"We now have some understanding of what the 'Celestial Plane' is all about. Judging from what that 'Saint Heir' said, they indeed seem to be preparing for a plane invasion..."
"Since that guy is still recruiting people, it means, as elder sister had speculated, they don't have the ability to invade on a large scale."
"Listening to the Saint Heir, it's not hard to deduce that the deity ruling the Celestial Plane must belong to a divine race that has solidified the 'All-encompassing True Resolution' bloodline talent... truly very powerful."
"..."
The trio chatted intermittently, reviewing the brief battle that had just taken place.
At this moment, Su Lun thought of that ability that simply with a glance could dissipate a thousand strands of Sword Qi, and asked with a frown, "Elder sister, what exactly is the ability of that 'All-encompassing True Resolution' talent? Why could he dissolve a thousand strands of your Sword Qi, but my domain seems to block it?"
The strike earlier had Su Lun thinking that if his Death domain were dissolved, it wouldn't be him chopping off an arm, but his own arm facing disintegration.
Mr. Jing pondered for a moment upon hearing this, then responded, "I've told you before that the 'All-encompassing True Resolution' talent possesses the ability to revert matter to its original state. This includes spells, energy, life forms... everything in the cosmos. In the realm of Alchemy, this is what's often referred to as 'reverse Alchemy'. Of course, what that person used was a technique from a divine system..."
"..."
Upon hearing this, traces of surprise flitted across the faces of Su Lun and Qian Tiao.
An S-rank talent, indeed none was simple.
They had personally witnessed its formidable power just moments ago.
With this, the Pupil Skill seemed invincible.
But obviously, such a heaven-defying ability must have its limitations.
The two listened quietly for what would come next.
As expected, Mr. Jing continued, "This talent is extremely powerful, but it comes with a condition. That is, to use the Pupil Skill to dismantle the target, the prerequisite is that the target must be within the cognitive understanding of the talent holder."
Su Lun suddenly understood and also breathed a sigh of relief.
If such a heaven-defying talent required one's own understanding, it didn't seem too troublesome.
Learning knowledge is difficult, especially the knowledge in high-level domains, which will become increasingly challenging.
Su Lun had deeply experienced this.
He thought to himself, had that three-eyed Frank probably taken the path of scholars like Mr. Hei?
But is it even harder for scholars to break through, relying on self-study? Could one truly reach such a level?
However, Mr. Jing's face seemed to show a hint of helplessness as he revealed the hidden ability of this enviable talent, saying, "Those who awaken this talent also have a hidden ability, which is their innate high comprehension. They can easily grasp knowledge that others find incomprehensible. They also demonstrate an incredible learning ability, almost effortlessly mastering all knowledge understandable at their level. That's why that guy earlier said the deity race was 'omniscient and omnipotent,' which isn't wrong to some extent. At his level, there indeed isn't much he can't understand."
Su Lun: "..."
Qiantiao: "..."
With added high comprehension, even their weakness was no longer an issue.
Upon hearing this, they once again realized why the "All-phenomena True Solution" was truly an "S-rank Talent."
All knowledge easily understood?
Moreover, it seemed to be the kind of talent without any weaknesses.
Theoretically, it could be said that this guy's ability countered all professions, but no profession countered him.
Mr. Jing seemed to have guessed the slightly somber mood of the two, and said, "But this talent actually has a real shortcoming, which is limited by one's own 'insight.' Because the knowledge people come into contact with is limited, the knowledge they learn and master is inevitably what they have encountered. Like the basic elemental techniques of Earth, Wind, Water, Fire, that guy must have mastered them. Sword Qi is also easily understood by people. Death, as one of the supreme Laws, is rare. And in this plane, it's unlikely that anyone understands it more thoroughly than you, Su Lun. Even I am no match. That person couldn't break through your domain, which is within reason."
With that said, Su Lun fully understood.
In the end, it was still a matter of knowledge reserve.
A seventh-rank believer in the divine able to understand the Sword Qi of the seventh rank was also within reason.
When Qiantiao heard this, he showed no sign of losing confidence; on the contrary, there was a determined will to overcome a formidable opponent in his eyes, as he muttered to himself, "My Sword Dao isn't strong enough yet..."
Mr. Jing also said, "Although that Frank is only seventh-rank, he has the blessing of deities. Not necessarily even eighth or ninth-rank professionals can deal with him. Earlier, I cut off his connection with the divine using a barrier, only then was there a chance. Next time we meet him prepared, it will be difficult to kill him."
However, when Su Lun heard about the "All-phenomena True Solution" talent, he suddenly thought of his own "All-knowing Eye."
Mr. Jing once said that the compatibility of the two abilities was extremely high.
One to understand all things, and the other to decompose all things after understanding.
But Su Lun's "All-knowing Eye" could only identify a name and basic effects at the moment, far from "understanding."
Su Lun guessed that after the second awakening of this talent, there would surely be a qualitative improvement.
Although it was impossible to awaken such a talent again.
But for an alchemist, it wasn't a big problem, whether it was turning that "third eye" into a cursed object, alchemic prosthetics, or even advanced materials, it's possible to gain a part of the All-phenomena True Solution's abilities.
When the time comes, one hand with the All-knowing Eye to understand all things, and the other with the All-phenomena True Solution to decompose, wouldn't it be like staring someone to death?
Su Lun, having thought of something, muttered to himself, "It seems that I must take a look at the treasure location recorded on that 'Hanged Man Tarot Card' when I get a chance..."
...
As the conversation reached this point, Qiantiao thought of something and asked curiously, "Why was that three-eyed guy looking for Kitte?"
Su Lun had some doubts before, but now he was sure, saying, "It should be for the coffin in the Mirror Library."
In his hand was a [Sealed Iron Coffin], a divine forbidden artifact from the Bonaparte royal collection.
And on the coffin was a large relief of a human face, which happened to have three eyes.
Before, Su Lun wasn't certain about the situation of the coffin, but looking at that Saint Frank's three eyes, wasn't it exactly the same?
And that guy went directly to him, wanting to inquire about Kitte's whereabouts, which made it almost certain that he was after the coffin.
There was also ancillary evidence.
Su Lun said with an odd tone, "Inside the storage ring of that guy's severed arm, I found a [Key to the Divine Plane Passage]."
That eyeball-shaped key was the same one that Empress Charlotte had used to open the spatial passage before, and somehow it ended up in that guy's possession.
Moreover, it's not just the key, there's also a "Divine Contract Scroll", which is likely the very scroll of the contract Queen Charlotte had with that Outer God.
And a pile of royal treasures...
In short, it seems that Frank had made a trip to the royal treasury and stolen the treasures of the Bonaparte royal family.
This worked out quite conveniently for Su Lun.
That Planar Key looked particularly special.
Unfortunately for him, the sealed coffin he had also possessed a keyhole the size of an eyeball, seemingly made for this key.
He surmised that the Planar Key could likely open that coffin.
But even with the key in hand, he had no intention of opening it.
Being sealed by an ancient Great Alchemist, the coffin must contain some formidable remains.
Possibly material for alchemy, or something so dangerous it had to be contained.
It certainly posed a challenge.
Moreover, as soon as the planar passage was opened, that "Saint Heir" came looking for this coffin, further proving its critical importance even to the divine hierarchy of the Sky God race!
It was also fortunate that he had the Small Void Realm; otherwise, Su Lun wouldn't dare hold these hot potatoes in his own hands.
Mr. Jing listened and concurred with Su Lun's speculation, saying, "We'll have to be more careful with Kit."
Su Lun nodded, "Hmm."
...
The Eternal Night sailed through the sea.
Once everyone on the ship learned about the planar invasion, the joyous atmosphere changed instantly into one of solemn crisis.
However, after a brief moment of tension, everyone went about their duties diligently, but it was evident that the atmosphere of cultivation on the ship intensified.
Everyone understood that the urgent priority was to improve their own strength, in preparation for the great upheaval that had arrived.
They were a pirate group, but not just any pirate group.
They were "Dawn".
Su Lun returned to his cabin.
Qian Tiao and Mr. Jing went off to the captain's quarters for a bath and sleep, planning to get a good rest.
Su Lun's mental state was still quite good, so he went to the adjoining meditation room specially designed next to the captain's quarters, planning to take advantage of the time to digest his gains.
After the numerous battles from last night until now, he had much to gain and reflect upon and urgently needed time to process all that he had acquired.
Now afforded a rare safe environment, Su Lun had no intention of wasting it.
After meditating cross-legged for a moment, he took out the "Hundred Thousand Blood Refinement Crystal Core".
The greatest gains from the battle were the insights into his own domain and the Soul Shards of Master Pierre and that Outer God.
But Su Lun didn't plan to directly absorb those Soul Shards.
He felt that his capacity to endure spiritual power was nearing the saturation limit that his body could presently handle, and absorbing them rashly might be wasteful.
Unable to increase the limit of his spiritual capacity in the short term, the only option was to enhance his physical strength.
He planned to merge with this Crystal Core first, to see if he could meet the conditions for integrating the alchemic enhancement "Isaac's Giant Strength".
If possible, his physical strength would surely surge after the integration, making it efficient to digest those Soul Shards without waste.
Thinking this, Su Lun let out a long breath and, looking at the blood-red Crystal Core in his hand, sighed, "This Life Essence is indeed quite rich."
It's like a grain of rice dropped by a deity, enough to fill an ant to bursting.
The thought flashed through his mind and dissipated, his spell formation coalesced, and the seven-pointed star Alchemy Formation glowed beneath him. The capability of "Blood Devour" was released from his hand, and strands of crimson from within the Crystal Core were gradually drawn into his body.
In this meditation, time flew by without notice.
...
Thanks to the continuous supplement of dark spiritual power from Isaac's Alchemy Heart, and the incessant absorption of the essence of life, Su Lun didn't need to rest at all and could maintain his energy at all times.
Several days later, the once crimson Blood-Refined Crystal Core in his hand had become transparent, its life essence completely absorbed.
Within the Alchemy Formation, Su Lun's complexion was rosy, and an overflowing vigor of qi and blood was visible even to the naked eye.
Even through his clothing, it was evident that his muscles had swelled significantly, bulging with taut sinew.
"Hoo..."
Suddenly, Su Lun opened his eyes, exhaling a long breath as if a burden had been lifted from him.
But at the same time, his eyes sparkled with a brilliant light, and he exclaimed with joy, "Success!"
Su Lun looked down at his hands and never before had he felt his body to be as strong as at this moment.
With a casual squeeze, he felt an explosive surge of power.
With just a slight buildup of force, the sensation of his muscles contracting felt like a volcano about to erupt, a powerful energy accumulating and releasing with his punch.
With a "pop", he casually produced a burst of air explosion!
"So strong!"
Joy was undeniable in Su Lun's heart.
He glanced at his attribute panel, where the most critical strength value had risen from "2411" a few days ago to "4432" now; his health rating had also reached SS+.
He had finally met the conditions for fusion with the bio-augmentation.
But the process was not easy; in fact, it was fraught with life-threatening risks.
He had reached the strength value of "4000" three days before, and the last few hundred points nearly made him give up.
Even with the consumption of the Blood-Refined Crystal Core, the body's various attributes wouldn't increase indefinitely.
There is a limit to what the human body can endure.
This is what is commonly referred to as the "threshold of fleshly body stages".
And "4000" was almost the current limit Su Lun's body could withstand.
It was like sprinting a hundred meters in a previous life, where improving by 0.1 second beyond ten seconds is extremely difficult.
Normally, only after breaking through the seventh rank would this upper limit be raised again.
If he continued to forcibly absorb qi and blood, the probability of mutation would increase.
Yet, Su Lun felt he was close and, with Mr. Jing's assessment and protection, it would be a pity to give up.
Luckily, Dr. Banks had deep research in the field of bio-technology, not just mutation suppression potions but various body enhancement potions as well.
Su Lun had procured several body amplifying potions with various side effects from him, which had increased his body's endurance limit.
After a series of procedures, he eventually increased his strength value to meet the fusion requirements before the onset of any mutation.
At this moment, Su Lun once again took out the arm bio-augmentation swirling with dark energy, "Isaac's Giant Strength". Now the probability of fusion mutation fluctuated around just 5%.
He had no reason to hesitate; after resting for a moment, he took out all the previously prepared fusion materials.
Then, he drew the Alchemy Formation for fusing the bio-augmentation on the ground.
In no time, Su Lun, standing at the center of the Formation, began to recite a universal incantation used by alchemists: "Observe the law of equivalent exchange, praise the glory of the primal creator, and witness the miracle of creation through Alchemy..."
The magic crystal at the corner of the seven-pointed star formation lit up, and the arm within the formation gradually merged into the figure.
....
This merger took almost two more days.
[Isaac's Giant Strength]wasn't a functional implant but an attribute-enhancing one. It required the release and fusion of the curse traits in the implant into the flesh, a process that took a long time. The curse traits of an epic-level implant were even stronger, making the fusion process more cumbersome.
Even with an isolation barrier, Tanni and Mr. Jing, in the neighboring captain's quarters, could still sense the power of laws that spilled out from it.
After dinner in the evening, Tanni didn't stroll on the deck but returned to the captain's quarters to maintain her beloved sword.
Suddenly, she sensed the energy fluctuations from next door subsiding, and she knew it was a sign that the implant fusion was nearing its end.
There has been no movement yet, so it's highly likely that it was a success.
Tanni felt a sense of relief in her heart for no particular reason.
As she wiped her sword, she glanced at Mr. Jing sitting on the sofa reading the newspaper and asked curiously, "Philo, what kind of implant did Su Lun merge with anyway? Why is the spilling power of laws so exaggerated?"
Mr. Jing flipped through the newspaper and raised his eyebrows slightly, responding indifferently, "He had previously come across an ancient 'Hundred-Armed Giant King's arm,' which is why the [Giant's Strength]implant he crafted is of such high quality. That curse trait is the strongest I've seen among strength-based implants. I thought he wouldn't be able to merge it at his sixth rank, but it looks like he's encountered a great opportunity during this external divine catastrophe. By the looks of it, he must have succeeded in the fusion..."
Upon hearing this, Tanni said with great interest, "Tsk tsk... It feels like that guy is going to become very powerful."
Mr. Jing also looked up and with a sparkle in his crystalline eyes, his tone dragging out a bit longer, "Yes. Once merged, it will absolutely give him an exceedingly exaggerated increase in strength."
While the two were conversing, the door to the training room next door suddenly opened, and a "little giant" walked out.
This was Su Lun in his state with the implant released; his build was extremely exaggerated. He had grown a head taller, and his muscles swelled up. Even through his clothes, the exaggerated sinuous lines were visible.
Being newly fused with the implant, he couldn't skillfully control the massive surge it provided, causing his aura to spill out uncontrollably.
The entire persona exuded a "murderous aura," an oppressive feeling.
Tanni, seeing the sharp gleam in his eyes, instinctively sensed the surging power within.
As she looked at Su Lun's gaze directed at her, she said in a teasing tone, "Yo~ Su Lun, you look pretty impressive."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun's eyes lit up with pride, "Yeah, it feels amazing."
Having merged with the implant, he felt like the ancient giants of legend, possessing the strength to move mountains and valleys.
He had already appraised earlier that upon fusion, [Isaac's Giant Strength]would grant a colossal increase of (350—980%) in strength, resilience, and physical constitution attributes!
Su Lun's body had a good compatibility with the implant, and his attributes had an average increase of six to seven times.
The most direct was the change in his strength attribute, which had surged more than eightfold!
What did that mean?
Su Lun estimated that even the seasoned seventh-tier practitioners of strength-based professions couldn't compare to him!
From the bottom of his heart, Su Lun marveled at Sir Isaac, truly a great and ingeniously creative alchemist!
Only after the fusion did he fully appreciate the intricate design Sir Isaac had put into the implant.
The implant allowed the magicians who merged with it to almost perfectly graft the material's strength attribute and also granted the practitioners the Giant race's talent for growth in strength.
Because the material was the unique "Hundred-Armed Giant King's arm," it was crafted into an epic-level quality, giving Su Lun such a terrifying boost in strength!
More importantly, merging the implant directly unlocked the upper limit of his body.
In the future, Su Lun could continue to enhance his physical attributes with the [Blood Devour]ability, growing ever stronger.
This upper limit was almost that of the Giant King from which the material originated!
This is the greatness of alchemy!
This is the significance of an alchemical implant!
They could graft abilities from other races onto themselves through external objects, thereby gaining the ability to glimpse the truth!
Mr. Jing admired the ripple-like power Laws emanating from Su Lun's body and did not hide his admiration as he said, "Very impressive..."
"Thank you, senior sister."
Su Lun grinned, fully aware that Mr. Jing had not left these past few days precisely because he was acting as his guard, to prevent any disturbances.
Mr. Jing, undisturbed, responded with a gentle smile.
Standing by, Qian Tiao's interest intensified, and she stood up to ask, "Shall we go out and try it?"
Su Lun nodded and said, "Yes! That's exactly what I was thinking. After merging with the graft, I feel like I need to release this built-up strength; otherwise, I'm just not comfortable."
Mr. Jing obviously knew why and explained with a smile, "Trying it out is good. Power grafts need to be repeatedly tempered to grow. It will also make the body more attuned to them."
Su Lun listened, suddenly enlightened.
...
The three of them went up to the deck.
Everyone in the Dawn group knew that Su Lun had not shown up these days because he was merging with the graft, and now that he was going to test it, they all surged onto the deck to watch the excitement.
The night at sea was unlike the dense fog of Lingdun, which was always gloomy.
As long as it wasn't stormy, a bright moon was always visible.
The moon tonight was favorable, casting clarity over the sea.
The sea breeze was slightly cool.
"What kind of graft do you think Mr. Su Lun has merged with, why does it seem like such a huge change..."
"It must be a power graft. Haven't you seen Mr. Su Lun's muscles? They're about to explode. Oh, could the title of 'First Great Strongman' of our Dawn group be facing a challenge..."
"..."
The crowd pointed and discussed eagerly as they watched.
If one's rank wasn't high, they wouldn't be able to see the spectacle of the power Laws overflowing.
Under the gaze of all, Su Lun approached the mast and moved to an open area where he immediately felt the volcanic surge of power within him almost uncontrollable.
He didn't hold back and exerted strength with a burst.
"Tear~"
The sound of his robe tearing resonated.
Under the gaze of hundreds of eyes, Su Lun's upper body robe exploded, revealing an iron-like Rune Golden Body.
Fully swollen with power, his muscles bulged with perfect lines as if carved by a sculptor's knife and axe, which, under the moonlight, reflected a dark golden sheen like a bronze statue.
Upon seeing this, the ship fell silent for a moment.
Then burst into loud laughter.
Qian Tiao raised her eyebrows and smacked her lips, "Yo, not bad at all."
Lolota beside her had stars in her eyes, "Wow..."
The other female members of the ship cheered excitedly, "Mr. Su Lun is so strong!"
Even the rugged men showed envious glances, "Never realized Mr. Su Lun had such a formidable frame."
However, Mr. Jing spotted something else, his eyes gleaming.
At that moment, Su Lun had already completed his power buildup and unleashed a punch towards the distant sea surface with the speed of lightning!
In that instant, as if time slowed down, one could clearly see the air being compressed, with a layer of visibly distorted whirlwind wrapped around the fist.
With a loud "bang," a huge hole several dozen meters deep suddenly exploded open on the distant sea surface.
Under the moonlight, the impression on the sea's surface was that of a fist.
Moments later, the indentation suddenly burst apart, kicking up waves several dozen meters high.
It was as if someone had hit pause on the scene; the deck of the vast Eternal Night was silent as a graveyard.
Shock and disbelief were painted on everyone's faces.
It was as though everybody's expressions hadn't yet caught up with the astonishing sight they had just witnessed.
If that punch had struck the ship, it could have destroyed a mid-sized warship outright!
One punch to blast a warship away?
Holy shit!
The excitement exploded instantly.
"My god, is this the strength of a human?"
"Wow, what kind of punching technique did Mr. Su Lun use just now? That was amazing!"
"..."
The members of the Dawn Group, seeing such an exaggerated punch from Su Lun, were excited to the point of flushed faces, shocked but also greatly exhilarated!
Su Lun, looking at the bursting white waves, also found it somewhat unbelievable.
The effect was so astonishing that it exceeded even his own expectations.
That punch was the "Void·Cannon Fist" from the Guma Technique. Previously, because his strength wasn't enough, he couldn't achieve such a spatial-blasting effect.
On a whim while gathering power, he decided to give it a try, and as soon as he threw his punch, the move flowed out smoothly as if it was riding on clouds and flowing water.
"So strong!"
Even Su Lun couldn't conceal the joy in his heart.
He continued to launch punches, and the sea surface erupted with "bang," "bang," "bang"… consecutive explosions.
As he released the accumulated strength, he felt refreshed and clear-headed.
After a while, the sea settled down.
"Let's go, time to dive and catch some fish!"
"Hahaha, Mr. Su Lun has blasted many fish to the surface, tonight's supper is going to be lavish..."
"..."
Everyone shouted excitedly.
Surrounded by a crowd, Su Lun was bombarded with questions about that cannon-like martial skill and the inconceivable source of that power.
The girls from Lilotana, who were familiar with him, even boldly prodded his muscles with their fingers...
Almost all the alchemical knowledge within the Dawn Group was shared, and Su Lun didn't keep it to himself; he informed them that the martial skills and such were available in the library of the small void realm and that they could borrow them as needed. He would also explain things from time to time.
Seeing that a few of the leaders wanted to talk, everyone dispersed tactfully.
Once the crowd had dispersed, Qian Tiao finally spoke up, slinging an arm around him and teasingly said, "Tsk tsk... Su Lun, with your close-combat capabilities now, there aren't many among Lucien's seventh-order professionals who can beat you. No one's going to believe you're still a puppet master with that punch you threw just now."
"Hahahaha..."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun couldn't help but laugh and cry at the same time.
It seemed like he was straying further and further from the path of a brute, wasn't he?
No, this is the necessary path to firmly advance towards the realm of a top-level alchemist.
Ordinary practitioners might not have this sense of advance preparation; they usually advance wherever they can.
But behind Su Lun is an elder sister who has witnessed the pinnacle of the world.
This made him very clear about what he would need for his path in the future.
Alchemy is different from other cultivation systems; there is no divine power to assist, just reliance on external objects for improvement.
As understanding of the laws increases in the future, a frail body will become a fatal weakness.
And Mr. Jing has made it clear that the body is the necessary hardware to carry the power of high-level laws.
It can be said that without a strong enough body, it is impossible to touch the ninth order, let alone peer into higher realms!
That is why Master Pierre, a ninth-order fire magician, also possesses an unbelievably strong physical body.
Therefore, in Sir Isaac's five alchemy notebooks, there are two kinds of alchemical augmentation suits, "Isaac's Giant Strength" and "Isaac's Dragon Rune Golden Body," that directly enhance physical strength.
For Su Lun, merging "strength" was also one of the best choices.
And for a puppeteer, this increase is not merely for his own body.
His understanding of the laws can almost be replicated 100 percent onto his puppets, using rune language and materials!
His comprehension of the law of strength had soared by a great margin, allowing him to also bestow exaggerated strength upon his puppet ghosts.
And the gargoyle's material can withstand various high-ranking laws.
If Su Lun became a strongman, his puppets would inevitably also be able to follow the strongman path.
...
The three of them chatted and headed back to the cabin.
Mr. Jing had been silently watching and not speaking; once alone, she finally offered her suggestion, "Su Lun, your control of strength is still not quite proficient, refine it in the future, and the augmentation suits will bring many benefits to your physical body. And, the ultimate end of 'strength' is also 'death'. You've already understood your own domain field, and advancing to the seventh order should be without any accidents. If you can lay a solid physical foundation, it will be of great help in comprehending the 'overpowering body' to enter the eighth order..."
"Mhm."
Su Lun nodded humbly.
His elder sister indeed had given him much guidance; this was the "top-tier cultivation resource" that others envied but couldn't obtain.
Su Lun had just integrated the augmentation suit and indeed was a bit raw in controlling the law of strength.
He had felt it quite clearly when he threw his punches.
It was like a toddler learning to walk for the first time, the consciousness yet unable to master the coordination of the limbs smoothly.
The higher the quality of an augmentation suit, the longer it takes to assimilate.
For others, this might normally take years or even decades to adapt.
But... Su Lun now had a "surprise blind box."
That was Master Pierre's Soul Shard!
That top-tier powerhouse at the pinnacle of the alchemist pyramid had also merged "Isaac's Giant Strength" and attained a very high understanding of the law of strength.
If any bit remained in those shards, it would be a great help!
A grain of a god's rice can feed an ant.
A bit of insight from a top-tier practitioner might save a lower-tier practitioner decades of detours and even enlighten them.
Thinking of this, Su Lun became somewhat impatient to continue his retreat, to assimilate those Soul Shards nurtured in the rune black umbrella!
PS. Asking for monthly tickets and subscriptions.

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - 493: 492
chapters.content:
After successfully integrating the armor, Su Lun began a new closed-door cultivation to digest the soul shards he had acquired earlier.
This time, it took a full ten days.
Since he awakened the talent "Reaper," he had never taken such a long time to digest soul shards.
It wasn't that stripping them was difficult, but that digesting the vast amount of knowledge and understanding beyond his current level was.
It was an extremely energy-consuming process.
"You have stripped the soul shard of 'Pierre Ray Polunareff'."
"You have gained a small amount of 'Ninth-Tier Power Law Fragment,' 'Ninth-Tier Fire System Law Fragment'..."
"You have realized some 'Combat Technique Insights,' 'Advanced Rune Language Techniques,' 'Earth, Fire, Thunder Elemental Law Fragments,' 'High-Level Alchemy Knowledge'..."
"You have mastered some usage experiences of 'Isaac's Giant Strength Armor.'"
"..."
"You have stripped the soul shard of 'Sea Giant Clarence.'"
"You have glimpsed the essence of 'Famine,' 'Plague,' 'Death'..."
"You have acquired a small amount of Ancient Divine Techniques, a moment of incomprehensible 'Super-Tier Calamity Law' insights."
"..."
Master Pierre was proficient in the law of strength and the fire system, but that didn't mean he only understood these two systems.
Top alchemists are generally well-learned.
At a certain height, the understanding of lower-tier laws will translate across others.
Even if not majoring in them, they are still not far behind.
Master Pierre's understanding of other peripheral laws, like those of the earth, wind, water... elemental laws, were at least at the eighth-tier level, and the rarer light and dark also around the seventh-tier understanding.
Almost all were much higher than Su Lun's current level.
Although rare and fragmented.
They were crucial!
Because of the "Reaper," Su Lun's own foundation was exceptionally solid; below the seventh tier, he could be said to be proficient in all systems.
Even a slight nudge might trigger a qualitative transformation.
And Master Pierre's soul shards let Su Lun stand from the perspective of the ninth-tier, instantly broadening his horizon.
Things that he previously couldn't understand, suddenly became clear.
The most direct was the change in the "Strength" and "Fire" system laws. Previously on the panel, Su Lun's current level understanding was rated S and B+; now, it was double S+.
The laws of other systems almost all saw a qualitative leap.
As for the soul shard of the outer god, it was much more straightforward.
It's said to be a deity, but It is actually a collective of the believers' faith.
It is the manifestation of "Calamity," its existence being a concentration of natural laws.
After harvesting, Su Lun realized a lot and understood some scattered fragments of the ancient divine system.
Overall, the gains were enormous.
This spared him years, even decades, of arduous cultivation.
Su Lun was also glad that he had first integrated the armor to enhance the strength of his body, otherwise, he would have wasted a lot.
After digesting those soul shards, Su Lun's spiritual power surged again, almost reaching the limit his body could withstand.
Too much water poured in, and the jar couldn't hold it, just spilling and wasting.
...
In the cultivation room.
The process of meditation was like thoughts voyaging through the sea of consciousness.
The countless thoughts in Su Lun's mind were like a spiderweb.
Gathering his consciousness, his mind gradually became clear.
He opened his eyes from meditation, his gaze slowly becoming lucid as he murmured to himself, "For seventh-tier advancement materials, perhaps I should fuse it with the 'Blasphemous Crown'?"
He now needed to advance to the seventh tier, which would further increase the upper limit of the spiritual power his body could endure.
The 'Blasphemous Crown' was indeed an ideal advancement material.
It was a cursed item of the mystical series, perfectly suited for significantly enhancing the endurance of spiritual power in the body.
More importantly, it would grant him permanent understanding of part of the crown's universal law capabilities.
It could also touch upon the thresholds of the cosmic rules of "Sovereignty" and "Dominion," which would qualitatively enhance his control over the puppet legion.
Overall, the various attributes of the crown closely matched the capabilities Su Lun currently needed for advancement.
Previously, the conditions had been too harsh, and he simply couldn't fuse with it.
But after absorbing the soul shard of Master Pierre, his understanding of various laws had nearly reached the fusion requirements, which inspired him to consider this possibility.
However, there was no rush.
Su Lun thought of something and stood up, "The field of dominion is not yet perfect, and my elemental understanding is lacking too; advancing should be delayed..."
His self-realized "Domain of Death" was strong, but precisely because it was strong, forming an impeccable logical loop was more difficult than ordinary domains.
For advancing to the seventh tier, the domain was most important. If it wasn't perfected, exposing flaws against true masters in the future would be fatal.
Moreover, if the foundation wasn't solid, subsequent advancement would inherently be deficient.
Su Lun felt he was still lacking a bit in terms of epiphany.
And he also needed time to adapt to the surge in his power.
There was no hurry to advance to the seventh tier.
After secluding himself for nearly half a month, Su Lun hardly ever left the training room.
Opening the door, he walked into the adjacent captain's room.
The room was empty.
At this time, Chentiao was probably still training on the deck.
Lately, the training enthusiasm of the Dawn Group was very high, and sounds of sparring were often heard.
Mr. Jing had left the day after he fused with the grafting gear.
In the battle with the external god in Lingyun, everyone recognized the leader of this Dawn organization.
The Dawn organization's headquarters in the province of Senodia still needed her to oversee the overall situation.
Moreover, having severed the Saint Heir's arm before, Mr. Jing was now a person of significant concern to the divine race. Her staying on the ship might indeed put Su Lun and others in danger.
Su Lun found the captain's room empty; it was just as well.
Looking at the large bath in the captain's room, and smelling his clothes that now carried a scent, he decided to walk over and turn on the boiler's hot water valve to take a bath first.
Chentiao never skimped on bathing accommodations, having replaced the previous small tub with this current 4x4 meter large tub, making it nearly like a bathing pool.
However, after trying it once, Su Lun also found it quite satisfactory.
After he had fused with "Isaac's Giant Strength," his physique had become much more robust, and the spacious bath was just right.
The sound of water splashing as he washed, the bath nearly filled.
With no one around, Su Lun stripped down and got into the water.
The warm water soaked his entire body, and his pores relaxed and opened.
Unexpectedly, just as he got in, he heard the sound of the door handle turning near his ear.
The few who might come to the captain's room were known without need for perception.
Chentiao walked in, looking at the steaming bathroom, "Yo... have you prepared the water? Tsk tsk, I was just thinking about taking a bath."
She said as she walked into the room, followed by a "clank, clank," which sounded like she was placing a knife on the table.
Then came the rustling sound of undressing.
It seemed she was planning to join him.
Su Lun had long been accustomed to this and didn't pay it much attention.
He lay comfortably by the side of the bath, eyes slightly closed, and casually asked, "Philo, have you completed your cultivation today?"
A few meters away, the sound of the shower started up again; just listening to the sound of the water, one could imagine that upon opening one's eyes, a beautiful scene would be seen.
As Philo washed, she replied, "Yes. Recently, the dimensional rules have become denser, making it easier to perceive some of the higher laws that were previously hard to sense. My cultivation efficiency is very high. Also, I've found that my 'Rakshasa Woman' form seems to have some special insights into the lofty laws of that other dimension. My domain has broken through almost without my noticing... I am now almost ready to advance to the seventh tier."
"..."
Listening to this, Su Lun felt a mix of amusement and frustration.
He himself was still struggling with how to perfect the domain of death, yet Philo was already confident about advancing?
He carefully sensed her aura, and indeed, it was clearly different from before.
However, Su Lun caught another crucial piece of information from her words and countered, "You said the dimensional rules have become denser?"
"Yes, haven't you felt it?"
Philo responded, "It's denser by the day. Many people on the ship have advanced recently."
"Oh."
Only then did Su Lun remember what Mr. Jing had mentioned, that once the dimensional portal was connected, the lofty laws of the divine dimension would spill over into the alchemy plane.
But these past days, he had been occupied with digesting the Soul Shards of Master Pierre and had been in a state of focused enlightenment, so he hadn't noticed the changes.
However, this situation was a double-edged sword.
The denseness of the laws made it easier for practitioners from the alchemy plane to advance, which seemed like a good thing.
But that also meant that the dimensional channel had been successfully established.
Perhaps people from the divine dimension had already arrived.
....
By the time the bath was full, a sound of "whoosh" indicated the arrival of water.
As the water rippled, Su Lun knew Philo had entered.
The bath was large, but the two were used to soaking side by side.
Without any reservation, Philo placed a towel on the side of the bath and lay down not far from Su Lun.
The water rippled, and occasionally their skin touched.
Su Lun closed his eyes and pondered for a while, and neither of them spoke for a long time.
Then Su Lun thought of something and asked, "Philo, any new updates recently?"
With her eyes closed, enjoying the water, Philo responded, "Yes. After the Polunareff royalty stepped down, there has been constant warfare in Luing. It's in the newspapers every day. Duke Raphael is now the head of the Luing Parliament and his influence is growing. That guy has ambition, too. Probably realizing the long-term problems with the feudal system, he wants to centralize power from the lords. His mechanical legions are waging wars everywhere, nearly sweeping through the major lords of former political factions..."
Su Lun wasn't surprised to hear this.
Although not particularly interested in the Luing political situation, he suddenly thought of Catherine. Compared to the thriving Duke Raphael, she seemed too low-profile.
Philo continued, "What's more, there's some unfortunate news. Duke Raphael has announced a nationwide ban on the spread of foreign god worship, and our 'Dawn' has now also been banned from entry."
Su Lun was slightly surprised, but then guessed something, "Because of Pandora?"
"Yes,"
Philo hummed, continuing, "The Luing Parliament has sent a letter to Philo demanding that Pandora be handed over for investigation, saying it's to control the risk of faith. Philo would surely not agree. So, our 'Dawn' has been characterized as a foreign god sect. Although it was not issued a warrant due to opposition from the Lance family, its members are now not allowed to enter Luing anymore."
"..."
Su Lun frowned as he listened.
During the last Lindon disaster, Pandora played a crucial role with her faith-stealing.
But to outsiders, wasn't this just another "foreign god"?
Any power not in one's own hands is a potential threat, so the ambitious Duke Raphael's response was not surprising.
Philo casually mentioned a few more important things, adding, "Also, Mafa has declared a temporary ceasefire. Not sure if it's due to the dimension channel or something else, but they have stopped fighting."
"Oh."
Su Lun wasn't interested in politics, so he just listened casually.
She wasn't particularly interested in that either.
At this moment, she thought of some news she was interested in, her tone noticeably lighter, "And then there's the information about the Regar family. The newspapers have already published the story about Fick killing William, calling it a crime of passion. Now, the Regar side has announced that 'Fick' is the first in line to inherit."
At this point, she suddenly elbowed Su Lun slightly, implying deeply, "Su Lun, don't you really want to go back and be a prince? The newspapers say that Regar XI is not in good health, you might be able to become king very soon. Tsk tsk, king huh!"
Su Lun rolled his eyes as he listened, "Not interested."
Listening to her teasing, the two of them were very close, so he casually placed his hand over.
It was just a friendly gesture, and she did not mind it.
But a moment later, this gambling-addicted lady suddenly noticed something, pursed her lips, and grumbled, "Hey hey hey, kid... your hand."
Su Lun pretended to laugh foolishly but did not intend to withdraw his hand.
He didn't overstep any boundaries either.
It just lay there, enjoying that heavy and warm touch.
She looked at this thick-skinned guy with a somewhat helpless expression.
She glanced at him with an annoyed look, as if remembering something, and then complained in a deep tone, "Don't think I'll help you again."
Hearing this, a smirk appeared on Su Lun's face in an instant, knowing exactly what she meant.
He had no such overreaching thoughts, but hearing her say this, his mind involuntarily conjured up some enchanting images... his brow slightly furrowed, showing some interest.
He quite liked this kind of interaction between the two of them.
Not too deep, not too shallow.
Occasionally a bit deeper, which was indeed quite nice.
She rolled her eyes, not disliking it, and couldn't do anything about it, so she simply let him be.
After soaking in the bath, they were refreshed.
Su Lun rarely rested.
The two shared a blanket and slept through the night without a word.
...
In the following days, Su Lun continued to practice controlling his "Death Domain" in the cabin.
As she had said, Su Lun gradually felt the rich laws of that day.
It was like someone had sprinkled a spoonful of salt into clear water soup, slowly making the taste richer.
Especially in the state of the second release of the Reaper, Su Lun distinctly felt those previously elusive high-level laws become easier to grasp.
With the addition of the "Desecrated Crown," he had new insights into his Death Domain every day.
This greatly shortened his advancement time.
Tanni rarely went out; she was just at the threshold of advancing to the seventh tier and needed to stabilize her state.
And Su Lun's Death Domain, which condensed the laws of death, was also greatly beneficial to her Sword Dao.
The two of them stayed in the cabin, each cultivating and aiding each other.
During this process, Su Lun also discovered that the talents of tier three may involve some super-tier realms that only gods could reach.
Tanni's "Rakshasa Woman" clearly demonstrated exceptional efficiency in capturing those high-level laws.
During these days of constant companionship, under the crown's enhancement, Su Lun often felt some very dangerous auras emanating from her from time to time. It was not just any ordinary law, but seemed like the super-tier law he still could not understand, similar to when they stripped an outer god before.
In short, very strong.
...
The crew of the Perpetual Night sailed westward, headed for "Prospector Sea Island," Duke Raphael's secret base.
The sea island was located in a dangerous and desolate sea where no merchant ships would pass through, almost never encountering any other vessel.
Tanni had specifically planned a hard-to-detect route.
However, one day, while Su Lun and Tanni were meditating in their room, the communicator suddenly rang: "Captain Tanni, Mr. Su Lun, a pirate ship is tailing us. It seems to be the crew of 'King of the Western Sea,' Morlock Poppen!"
PS. These two days, I have been organizing the outline for this volume and haven't finished it yet. Sorry for the shorter length.

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - 493: Great Slaughter
chapters.content:
Today the weather is fine and visibility at sea is high.
Su Lun and Thousand Sashes went up to the deck, leapt onto the mast, and then they saw a medium-sized warship following them far away on the distant horizon.
Taking out a spyglass, they saw the ship flying a flag with a crocodile mouth and skull, the insignia of the dominant Western Sea fleet.
"King of the Western Sea," Morlock Poppen, was also a veteran at the eighth-tier, with a bounty of 7.655 billion lyso. His fleet's total manpower was even proclaimed to surpass that of Oleg from the North Sea.
But in terms of strength, they were a notch below.
After Morlock advanced to the eighth-tier, he had two recorded battles among his peers. He fought against Oleg over a hunting ground division but didn't win; he was also defeated by a commander from the Luying Navy.
The assessment from the Bounty Hunters Guild was that he barely crossed the threshold of the eighth tier.
Su Lun, observing the angle of the sails on that ship, knew that those fellows were indeed tracking them.
"Are they really coming for us?"
Su Lun pondered to himself, somewhat puzzled by their motives.
Since their last battle in the Morlos city-state, which severely weakened the King of the North Sea's fleet, the "Dawn Group" had become well-known among pirate circles.
Within these circles, strength and fame served as a pass.
Normally, to avoid discord, there are certain groups one simply does not follow.
Moreover, they had no significant conflicts with this group of Western Sea pirates.
Thousand Sashes was much more straightforward, shouting an order, "Truda, signal them with flags to leave, or we'll sink them if they keep following."
"Yes!"
A voice responded, and the sailor at the top of the mast sent out the flag signal.
Through the spyglass, it was clear that someone on the opposing ship had seen them, yet there was no reaction.
Seeing this, Su Lun mused, "Tsk, tsk, this is getting interesting."
However, the Dawn Group was not afraid of a bunch of pirates with their current strength. Unless Morlock himself came, these people were hardly worth noticing.
His eyes shifted as he said to Thousand Sashes beside him, "I'll head over there."
Since they'd already greeted them and they still weren't leaving, there was no need for pleasantries.
Thousand Sashes also placed her hand on the hilt of her sword, intuition telling her that there was something fishy about today's turn of events. "Be careful," she said.
"Mhm."
Su Lun nodded, glancing at Mr. Crow lazily perched on his shoulder, who hadn't made any comment.
Then, in a blink, he had vanished from the deck.
....
Meanwhile, aboard the "White-headed Eagle."
This was the main battleship of the 11th squadron of the Western Sea's second fleet. The squadron's captain, "Poisonous Jellyfish" Mori Vilard, was observing the distant black-sailed ship through his spyglass on the deck.
That moment, the sailor at the top of the mast shouted, "Captain, they're signaling us with flags, telling us to leave or they'll sink us!"
On hearing this, Mori scoffed, "Hehehe, since when can anyone address the Western Sea fleet in such a tone on this sea?"
Upon hearing his remark, numerous underlings chimed in.
"The captain is right! What the hell is this Dawn Group, even daring to warn us? We're not like those North Sea losers who let a small pirate group escape from hundreds of thousands of us."
"Exactly. They think because they've made a bit of a name for themselves, they can mess around in the Western Sea?"
"..."
Pirates all have a rebellious streak, especially those from dominant pirate groups. Their members are all unruly and insubordinate.
Whether or not they could win in a fight was another matter, but their rowdy insults would never fall short first.
The clamor among the crowd was nonstop.
Yet, someone in the squadron expressed concern, "But... Captain, the Dawn Group managed to cause serious trouble for Oleg from the North Sea, so their strength must be considerable. By following them like this, could we not trigger an unnecessary conflict? I've heard the Dawn Group's leader is an eighth-tier..."
Mori shook his head, unconcerned, "We're not going to fight them; just keep following. And the boss said, that eighth-tier from Dawn is currently in the Senodia province, not on the ship. Besides, the message has been sent out, we'll just wait for those big shots to handle it."
As he said that, he looked toward the distant black-sailed ship and added, "Tsk, tsk... you never know, our fleet might just gain a Sea Emperor battleship from this."
At those words, the throng of underlings burst into laughter.
With the eighth-tier absent, it seemed like there was suddenly no pressure.
"Captain, who exactly are these big shots at headquarters, so arrogant and overconfident? They don't seem like those noble royals from Luying..."
"Who knows? The boss told us to follow their orders, so that's what we'll do. As long as they're paying well, who cares who they are."
"..."
While the crew was still joking in ignorance, a hint of unease crossed Mori's eyes.
As the squadron captain, naturally, he knew more than the others.
Intuition told him there was something off about this tailing mission.
But then again, he thought, even if a fight broke out, with his capabilities, he could escape even if he couldn't win—as long as the eighth-tier from the Dawn Group wasn't there, there weren't many in the sea who could kill him.
It seemed there wasn't much to worry about.
However,
just as this thought formed,
an unexpected turn of events occurred!
...
Ripples flickered in the void, and a figure holding a black umbrella with a black crow perched on his shoulder appeared out of thin air above the battleship.
That look was almost instantly recognized by all the pirates on the ship—it was the notorious killer from the Dawn Group, the "Death" Su Lun!
The pirates on the ship, facing the young man who looked down on them from above, had initially been hoping he wouldn't dare to act.
After all, this was the Western Sea, and any passing pirate group owed them some respect.
If they really attacked, Lord Morlock would personally come after them.
Merely tailing them wasn't sufficient reason for such a deadly enmity.
Yet Su Lun swept a cold glance, devoid of any hint of "consideration" in his eyes.
It was that single glance that made Mori's eyes abruptly contract, understanding the meaning within that indifference.
But what shocked him the most was that he felt absolutely no courage to rebel against this man?
This isn't good!
Mori inwardly cursed his luck, trying to stall for time with words, "Wait, perhaps Your Excellency has some misunderstanding..."
But before he could speak any further, with a flash of light and shadow, the figure was already standing on the deck.
Suddenly, a sense of impending death swept over everyone's hearts like a tsunami.
Despite being alone, he pressured the several hundred people on the ship to hold their breath and break out in cold sweats.
The opportunity had been given earlier, and Su Lun had no intention of bickering with these people. A dark domain that absorbed light spread out from under his feet, and before the pirates could react to what was happening, they fell like wheat at harvest, as if their souls had been sucked out.
In almost the blink of an eye, the corpses lost all vitality, decaying and blackening rapidly.
As the strongest on the ship, Mori didn't die instantly, but his complexion drastically changed: "A domain? Impossible!"
He distinctly felt a strange force rapidly draining his life, making his entire body weaken.
How could it be so terrifying!
Weren't the reports saying that he was only fifth-tier?
Su Lun wouldn't give his enemies any chances. Seeing that this guy was still alive, he teleported a few meters, grabbing his neck in one move.
With a "crack," the terrifying force turned his neck into a crushed tomato.
The sound of bones breaking seemed a bit too brittle. Su Lun frowned slightly at the blood plasma oozing between his fingers.
Just thinking about killing, he squeezed with all his might, not expecting to dirty his hands.
"Still not precise enough with controlling strength..." Su Lun muttered to himself.
The [Isaac's Giant Strength] had increased his power by so much that he couldn't yet control it perfectly.
At the same time, he felt somewhat nostalgic because the fifth-tier pirate captains who once seemed invincible to him now couldn't withstand even a single move in his hand.
...
With the domain of death, taking down this complete pirate crew wasn't much effort for Su Lun.
He didn't delay, harvesting the souls that rose from the bodies on the ship.
In the instant he digested these memories, he understood the entire truth behind the pursuit, murmuring, "So they really were after us..."
The underlings knew very little, but from the captain Mori Vilard's memories, Su Lun found many useful pieces of information.
Not too surprising.
The first piece of news was that beings from the divine plane had already descended.
The second was that they had cooperated with "King of the Western Sea," Morlock Poppen.
Right now, the only ones who would dare trouble them openly, aside from the ambitious Duke Raphael, were likely the Saint Heir with a motive.
Both empires are still identified as the Alchemical Empire; it was unlikely they had become devotees of the gods just yet.
If "Saint" Frank wanted to recruit troops, he inevitably had to rely on some fringe forces.
Pirates were one of the best options.
However, it surprised Su Lun that the people from the divine plane sought out Morlock not for combat but to search for something in the Western Sea?
"Those guys from the divine plane are also looking for the [Mimir's Spring]?"
When Su Lun got to this piece of information, his surprise was not slight.
The name [Mimir's Spring] was something he had decoded from the [Hanged Man] tarot card as the location indicated by the treasure map.
He had guessed it might be related to the origins of the All-knowing Eye talent.
Unexpectedly, beings from the divine plane were also in search of it.
Moreover, these pirates' memories precisely contained this directional name.
In the memories of the captain, those mysterious big shots were also looking for something called "Horseshoe-shaped Island."
This was in high agreement with the intelligence Su Lun had.
With a bit of reflection, it made sense within the grand scheme of things.
The alchemical plane was destroyed during the Dawn Era. It wouldn't be strange for the civilization of the divine plane, if not interrupted, to know some ancient secrets.
Receiving this information simultaneously brought an unexplainable sense of urgency to Su Lun's heart.
He contemplated, "It seems I must make haste to visit Dragon Country soon..."
Knowing those beings were after the [Mimir's Spring], it also directly confirmed something for him.
That was, for a god-level civilization to regard it so highly, the spring must indeed represent a tremendous opportunity!
If possible, he wanted to find it before top-tier powerhouses from the other side arrived.
A chance of this level, if missed, would truly be a pity.
....
Beyond that, there wasn't much useful information in the souls of this gang of pirates.
After digesting their memories, Su Lun felt somewhat lamentable that their information was extremely outdated.
In their minds, he was still only fifth-tier?
But it wasn't really surprising.
Constantly drifting at sea, these pirates sometimes got newspapers that were several months old.
In the memories he stripped away, they didn't even know about the catastrophe in Lynden that happened nearly half a month ago, let alone about the inter-plane channel.
Otherwise, if they had known the detailed current affairs of Dawn, they probably wouldn't have dared to follow so blindly and confidently.
They even didn't know the identity of those "mysterious big shots."
It was Su Lun who inferred that.
```
But now that they knew they were being instructed by someone from the divine plane, the purpose of their visit wasn't hard to guess—they were most likely after Kite, seeking the whereabouts of that coffin as well.
Moreover, given the current situation, some thoughts became clearer.
The main goal of the first batch of divine plane beings who descended to the alchemy plane was treasure hunting.
The "Saint Heir" Frank was no exception.
Because there was no point in rushing into a fight; they could conquer the entire plane, which didn't even have gods, sooner or later once the large-scale invasion commenced.
Instead, now was the time to find some treasures before their kin invaded en masse.
It was like adventurers discovering a large cursed space, and these guys treated this place as a treasure-hunting paradise.
...
"The message has been sent out, which means someone is on our trail..."
Su Lun pondered, but a bold idea flashed through his mind.
If they wanted to be cautious, they should escape right away.
But Su Lun had another plan in mind, carefully assessing to himself, "To subdue an Eighth-Tier Gatekeeper like 'King of the Western Sea' Morlock Poppen, they needed several people to gang up on him and even called upon a god to descend... This means that there are probably no Eighth-Tier beings among those who have arrived so far."
From the memories of those guys just now, he found that none of the people from the divine plane had the characteristic "third eye."
Which meant Saint Frank wasn't there.
And according to Mr. Jing's analysis, the talent "All-knowing True Revelation" was very difficult to awaken to begin with, but to also manifest with the phenomenon of a third eye, made it even rarer.
So, among the group that went to deal with the pirates, there wasn't likely to be anyone with such an extraordinary talent.
The gods don't have the leisure to protect every believer all the time.
Piecing together various clues, Su Lun almost concluded that the combat power of this group wasn't necessarily very high.
They knew very little about the divine plane at the moment and were in desperate need of intelligence to determine how to respond in the future.
And the best method was to capture a few people from the divine plane, kill them, and search their souls.
Now was the best opportunity!
The planar portal hadn't stabilized yet, and the ascending enemies were of a low order. Otherwise, there would be fewer and fewer chances like this once the stronger beings descended.
Moreover!
There was an even more important point.
After the pirate's information became blocked.
Correspondingly, the outsiders from the divine plane likely got their information from the pirates as well, meaning they had little to no information about the Dawn Group!
Those people might not be aware of his and Qian Tiao's combat strength!
This kind of information asymmetry was the most precious opportunity!
With these thoughts, Su Lun decisively made a decision and operated the communicator, "Sister Qian Tiao, I have an idea..."
Qian Tiao, upon hearing about a fight, didn't hedge at all.
With an advance notice, everyone in the Dawn Group sprang into action.
...
Having informed Qian Tiao of the battle arrangements, Su Lun didn't rush to leave and strolled on the pirate ship, scavenging some spoils of war.
Although from his current perspective, the pirates were really poor.
But the equipment and materials of an entire pirate crew were worth quite a bit of money.
Su Lun collected everything he could take and also set up some alchemy formations in preparation for emergencies.
Before long, he suddenly sensed a spatial fluctuation surging a few hundred meters away.
"They arrived quite fast... So, there's a spatial mage," Su Lun raised an eyebrow and glanced over.
Glancing at the crow perched calmly on his shoulder, he felt no urgency at all.
In that instant, he appeared on the deck.
An old man with a white beard who had teleported over was also holding a magic wand, chanting an unintelligible spell.
Watching the intense white light bloom on the magic wand, Su Lun thought, "A seventh-tier space mage, is this the best you've got?"
He could have interrupted the old man's spellcasting if he wanted to, but after some thought, he didn't make a move.
Although the old man seemed like a seventh-tier mage, Su Lun didn't really feel... threatened at all.
However, it was precisely in this moment, when Su Lun deliberately gave the opportunity, that six more figures emerged from the old man's magical portal.
The people who appeared were enveloped by domains around their bodies, obviously seventh-tier professionals.
But Su Lun was puzzled as he observed, "Such weak dominance, how did these guys advance to the seventh-tier?"
This wouldn't have been possible in the alchemy plane, not by a long shot.
Ah, believers advance through the power of the gods.
As Su Lun realized this, he understood.
Seeing people from another plane for the first time, he had already gleaned too much useful information in an instant.
Considering the degree of pressure, Su Lun felt that these divine plane seventh-tiers were far inferior to the alchemy plane's seventh-tiers.
Compared to the several "Top Ten Legendary Hunters" he had encountered before, they had probably only a tenth of the strength.
And with a full seven people having arrived, not a peep from the crow on his shoulder?
Which meant, these people actually posed no fatal threat to him?
In a flash, Su Lun regretted that some of the arrangements he had made in preparation to flee were now wasted.
These guys were far weaker than expected.
Today, without the gods descending, these people were bound to die here.
...
The divine plane folks who saw Su Lun on the ship hadn't yet realized what kind of opponent they were facing.
```
```
Did he seem about the same as an ordinary sixth-tier among the pirates?
Seven people looked at Su Lun with disdain in their eyes.
That condescending look was all too familiar to Su Lun.
Wasn't that the same attitude adopted by the Saint Heir before?
It was probably like the way Americans in the past with hunting rifles looked at Native Americans, right?
It seemed that all their sensory abilities instantly confirmed Su Lun was only sixth-tier.
The seven seventh-tier professionals felt they had him in their grasp. The bearded old man leading them waved his hand grandly, and three of them headed straight for the "Eternal Night Emperor" in the distance.
Leaving just four here.
Su Lun watched but didn't stop them.
Speaking of killing prowess, Qian Tiao could hardly be considered weaker than him. Those three guys heading over there? Hehe...
Just as these folks were about to speak, out of nowhere, Su Lun suddenly made his move!
Even though he didn't perceive these people as threats, he didn't treat them with the slightest contempt when he struck. He stomped his foot fiercely, and with a "snap" sounding crack of Stepping on Air, he shot out like a cannonball.
Fused with "Isaac's Giant Strength," Su Lun's Stepping on Air short distance power made him so fast he couldn't even be seen!
Watching the residual light and shadow of "Su Lun" left in place, the four mages' faces changed dramatically, and they each raised their magic staffs, chanting their spells.
But how fast was Su Lun?
His first target was the white-bearded old man who could use spatial magic.
Only by killing him first, the others would have no chance to escape!
The white-bearded old man, driven by that terrifying intent to kill, felt his scalp go numb. He could have never imagined that a sixth-tier professional could unleash such frightening combat power.
But shock was shock, and the old man's reaction was not slow. As a space mage, he had long been accustomed to being the prime target. His right hand holding the magic wand flashed, and the pages of the magic book in his left hand flipped open, casting the solidified instant spell fluidly.
An invisible ripple of space flowed out, a seventh-tier magic, the "Spatial Compression Barrier," capable of blocking most fatal attacks.
The Spatial Barrier was perfect against all sorts of brute force melee fighters. It appeared to be only a few meters away but was in fact tens of meters distant.
The white-bearded old man breathed a sigh of relief. At the same time, he finished chanting his spell, and the teleportation magic formula had already taken shape.
One glance and he had already teleported a hundred meters away.
But as soon as he appeared, the killing intent that had locked onto him not only hadn't dissipated but had already arrived right in his face!
"How is this possible?!"
The white-bearded old man couldn't understand how that fellow had caught up so quickly.
But a moment later, after sensing the spatial fluctuation, it dawned on him: This guy was also a practitioner of spatial techniques!
In an instant, the old man's face turned ashen.
Only amongst peers could one judge the depth of their abilities, and it was this spatial fluctuation that made him realize he was actually inferior to his opponent?
Wasn't this man supposed to be a brutal melee fighter? How could he possess such a profound understanding of space law?
As thoughts flashed through his mind, Su Lun didn't give him another chance to act.
To others, the Spatial Barrier might seem tricky, but to him, it was as good as non-existent.
He charged forward, his hand holding a Death Scythe wreathed in black light, and slashed at the old man's waist.
With powerful coiling strength in his arm, the slash was so swift that it was utterly unavoidable!
The black scythe encountered some resistance, but his arm suddenly coiled, a freakish strength enhancing the black scythe handle. After breaking the defense in an instant, he easily cut through the opponent's protective field, and a spurt of blood jetted out.
Too weak!
That dominion and field were the weakest Su Lun had ever seen for a seventh-tier!
They were even inferior to the Death Domain he had condensed.
....
With one slash from Su Lun, the old man wasn't bisected, but his lower abdomen was ripped open, spilling his intestines and inner organs.
Just as Su Lun was about to make another cut, at that moment, a bolt of lightning hacked down from the magic wand of another fellow with a "crack."
Su Lun instinctively dodged the strike of lightning.
The people from the celestial plane hadn't expected this sixth-tier native to be so fierce, injuring one of their own in a single encounter?
Luckily, they worked well together and saved their companion in time.
Having been severely wounded by a slash, the white-bearded old man hurriedly opened his magic book in his off hand, wanting to use his already-prepared teleportation spell again to flee the battlefield for healing.
But far away, Su Lun saw this and his eyes flashed coldly. He raised his hand wearing the "Chronos's Space Gloves," and with a virtual grasp, he seized the air with his fingers.
The white-bearded old man was just about ready to teleport when, to his surprise, after the magic light flickered, he found himself still in the same spot!
Realizing suddenly what had happened, the old man looked at the man in the distance in horror.
The focus tightened, and the man was already up close.
Alchemy wasn't just about spells; they also developed various cursed objects to counteract divine magic!
If Su Lun's first strike could wound, then the second strike against an already severely injured old man would be even more devastating?
He swung the black scythe again, and this time, it severed the old man at the waist!
Su Lun didn't give anyone a chance to save him, swiftly chopping the head and body into several pieces with two more "swish" sounds.
In a moment, a "gray fog" rose from the corpse.
Behind Su Lun, a terrifying shadow of the Grim Reaper emerged, reaping this cloud of gray mist.
Not rushing to assimilate what he had obtained, his gaze then turned to the other three.
....
Having killed one of their seventh-tier companions in just two encounters, the remaining three celestial beings were utterly horrified, shocked on the spot!
This... this native, who was he?!
How could he possess such terrifying combat power?

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - 494: The Divine Plane
chapters.content:
In the distance, the sky above the sea where the Eternal Night Emperor's flagship was located was filled with lightning and thunder, a terrifying spectacle resembling an apocalyptic disaster.
The battle had also started over there.
But Su Lun didn't spare it another glance.
The thunderous Sword Qi from afar, even though at such a distance, still exuded an oppressive sharpness. Those three poor souls who had gone looking for trouble were definitely not gaining any advantage.
Su Lun's cold gaze turned toward the three before him, and now, it was their turn.
Having swiftly killed the space Mage among these people just moments ago, these fellows were now unable to escape, no matter how fast they could run.
How could the three of them not understand this?
Facing Su Lun, their faces turned ashen.
And as they looked at the dominantly powerful Thunderous Sword Qi in the distance, amid their horror, they were also perplexed.
Why did every person they encountered have such frightening combat power?
According to the intelligence they had received, hadn't the top-tier professionals from "Dawn" been confirmed to be ten thousand miles away in the Sinodia province? Now, on a pirate ship that lacked even a Seventh-tier Mage, their team of seven Seventh-tier Magic Conductors had come to execute a siege but had ended up in such a dire situation?
Su Lun certainly wasn't going to give these men a chance to recover. After killing one of them, he stomped fiercely on the ground.
With a "pop," his entire body shot out like a cannonball once again.
Watching the residual image flash by, the three Mages hastily lifted their Magic Wands, chanting esoteric magical incantations.
Su Lun didn't understand the "Divine Plane Common Tongue" these people spoke, and he found their incantations to be a gibberish mess.
But he had just unraveled the language from the old man's memory, and he could understand everything all at once.
The dark-skinned female Mage touched the black crystal ball in her hand, and a field aura spread out from her. "Oh great omniscient and omnipotent god, grant me the power of darkness, summon mighty magical power to oppose evil will, and call upon the magic spell that imprisons everything..."
She shook her Magic Wand towards the ground, and a strange magical halo, like a bubble, covered a one-kilometer radius: "Black Magic Mystery · Magic Forbidden Zone!"
Though magic and Alchemy were not from the same system of techniques, some fundamental principles were the same.
Su Lun, listening to the incantations, had already vaguely guessed the nature of this spell. Glancing at the elemental vacuum around him, how could he not know this was some kind of Magic-Banishing Field?
But just as the magic was released, he was already face to face with the three.
His hand brandished a dark scythe, slashing down. The burly middle-aged Mage's body shone with a golden, runic luster. With a metallic clang, he actually managed to block the sharp blade.
"Rune Mage, huh…" Su Lun murmured to himself.
With the information he had stripped before, he was not unfamiliar with these people's techniques.
This was a magic plane, where Mages reigned supreme.
Pure melee professionals did exist, but they were few and not held in high regard.
Rune Mages usually served as the shields in a magic squad.
And it was this very man who had blocked Su Lun's dark scythe that now braced himself as another killing intent arrived. The man with the silver rune on his forehead finished his chant; the skull at the top of his Magic Wand flashed with dark light as another Seventh-tier spell was released: "Grimoire · Nightmare Erosion!"
Control, tank, and psychic attack…
The trio's coordination was impeccable, executing their combined techniques flawlessly.
Su Lun wasn't surprised, for these seven were from the same magic group from the Divine Plane.
A nightmare Mage specializing in psychic abilities, a rune Mage adept in melee combat, together with an all-rounded Mage capable of creating a Magic-Banishing Field—their abilities compensated for each other's weaknesses, making this small team equipped to handle the vast majority of enemies.
As the psychic assault came rushing in, normally all it would take was to control the target for a moment, and then the killing strikes would follow.
But since he already knew the enemy's strengths, the course of the battle could be predicted.
Su Lun had anticipated this scenario before even making his move.
An instant of confusion flitted through his eyes, though in his mind he mused: This spiritual power is quite mediocre.
Su Lun's spiritual power had already reached the overflowing limit of his physical body; even a Seventh-tier psychic Mage of this plane wouldn't necessarily be able to control him, let alone an Eighth-tier.
Indeed, they fell for it!
The opposing Rune Mage, seeing Su Lun affected, shifted from defense to offense in an instant. His right hand condensed a lightning magic blade, lunging straight for the vital points.
As the enemy took the bait, Su Lun's eyes briefly cleared, and he muttered softly in his heart, "Alchemy · Repel!"
A swift glance revealed that beneath the black scythe, as if by sleight of hand, a crimson dagger had appeared.
Being a melee Mage, the Rune Mage's reactions and combat experience were not lacking. Directly revealing the Dragon-slaying Dagger might not have guaranteed an injury.
Su Lun had been using the black scythe up until now, in part to imprint a fixed image on his foes, to let them assume that was the extent of his attack.
Now, catching them off guard was the opportune moment!
Countering the psychic control with reverse Alchemy, in an instant, he drew his dagger, and the Crimson Dagger made a cut across the Rune Mage's wrist.
"Swish!" A spray of blood erupted, and the Dragon-slaying Dagger, bolstered by a terrifying force, managed to sever the arm despite some resistance!
At the same time, a powerful repelling force struck, as the Magic-Banishing Mage instantly cast a "Resistance Aura."
Su Lun didn't get the chance to make another strike, as he was sent flying backward. Then, a follow-up burst of lightning magic hit, unavoidable, and "crack" it struck his body.
High-level confrontations are precisely like this, responding to each move. If you're even half a step slower in making a move, you must also prepare to counter half a move in advance from your opponent.
Especially since there were three opponents.
Su Lun took the lightning strike head-on, and suddenly his body swelled up, with the hint of runic light shimmering, his muscles bulging as if made of steel.
