Narrowing her eyes, she murmured again, "That guy...probably plans to bury this ten-thousand troop group in this cursed space."
Hearing this conclusion, the middle-aged general beside her turned his head and looked at her in surprise, revealing a face full of disbelief.
A level eight mechanical warrior like himself had no assurance at all, could a level six professional be sure?

chapters.title: Chapter 512 - 511 Battle Angel
chapters.content:
Su Lun charged alone into this camp of five hundred, and after killing four eighth-tier Magic Conductors at first encounter, the remaining mages could not withstand the attack of the thousand-puppet army for long and were soon scattered in all directions.
Su Lun overpowered his peers among the Magic Conductors, and the puppet army crushed the mage army. With both strength and numbers overwhelmingly in their favor, not to mention the advantage of a surprise attack, defeat was out of the question.
Within just a few minutes, the vast camp was littered with corpses and rivers of blood.
The battle had barely begun when it was already nearing its end.
Su Lun was harvesting the bodies and souls of these magic groups along the way.
One must admit, the profession of a mage is indeed quite rich.
In the divine realm, where resources are abundant, all sorts of fine materials were concentrated in the hands of the mages, the higher their level, the wealthier they were. The storage spaces of these corpses were filled with countless magical beast crystal cores, energy barytes, magic equipment, and materials.
There were even many rare items not found in the Alchemy planes.
Even though the cultivation systems were different, for an alchemist, these spoils of war could be decomposed into usable materials and represented a tremendous fortune.
In the world of Mafa, the worth of a ten-thousand-person mage group could completely fund an entire fleet.
...
Su Lun did not bother to closely inspect the spoils of war, storing whatever he could grab into his storage space.
He also collected some special talented corpses, which could be used later to create living wax figures or such.
Those that couldn't be collected were left for later.
The commotion of the camp's battle was not small, startling a flurry of birds in the forest.
Actually, when Su Lun first triggered the magic alarm, nearly all camps in this forest received the signal at the same time.
The nearby camps also dispatched people to support immediately.
The ten-thousand-person mage group had set up a "Forbidden Spell: No Air Forbidden Domain," a super-large trap formation covering an area of ​​about seven to eight kilometers, with a compound double nine-pointed star of eighteen formation angles, comprising eighteen five-hundred-person camps.
Normally, if one camp was attacked, nearby camps could immediately come to their aid.
Unfortunately, that was under normal circumstances.
Su Lun's tactics were so fierce that by the time the puppet army devastated this five hundred-person camp, the enemy reinforcements had not yet arrived.
He looked expressionlessly over the devastated camp.
Aside from a hundred or so who had escaped, almost all had been slain.
However, Su Lun didn't wait for the enemy to encircle him, but regrouped his mechanical puppet army and charged fiercely toward another camp.
Not long after, he encountered several "hundred-people troops" from another camp.
They were all about defense magic and various attack spells, with a fierce momentum.
Su Lun remained calm.
The thousand-puppet army by his side was his confidence.
Before the eighth-tier Great Magic Conductors arrived, these hundred-people troops posed no threat to him.
After pinpointing the enemy's location, he repeated his tactics. He teleported into the midst of the enemies and went on a slashing spree, followed by the puppet army descending to charge and kill.
With today's battle, the mechanical puppet army finally made its mark on the high-level battlefield.
...
While the intense battle unfolded in the woods, another group from the land of Mafa followed the commotion, drawing near to the battlefield.
Dora and General Sam chose a tall tree, staying far back to watch the situation unfold.
The collapsing of whole swathes of trees actually broadened their view.
But by the time they arrived, the camp was already a complete wreck.
Burned, frozen, corroded, entwined... The campsite was left with traces of various magic battles.
But there were no living people to be seen.
The ground was only covered with large patches of blood, still very bright red.
What happened?
At the same time, a thought occurred to Mafa and his group, guessing the reason, but they were hesitant to believe it for a moment.
"This... has everyone been killed?"
General Sam murmured incredulously.
They had previously observed the composition of these magic groups in the Divine Plane, "The 500-person Magic Brigade" which had several seventh-tier magic conductors, formulating battle formations, which could withstand the fierce attacks of level-eight mechanical warriors for a considerable amount of time.
They had just arrived a few minutes ago, and everyone had been killed?
Looking at the fierce battle taking place in the distance, the dark puppet army, Mafa and his group were collectively speechless.
The figure surrounded by black light, with the phantom of the Cloaked Reaper emerging behind him, was charging destructively against several hundred-person groups.
Seeing this scene, Dora's eyes also revealed disbelief, "That guy has advanced to the seventh tier... What domain is that, how can it be so terrifying?"
Even from such a distance, Mafa and his group felt a chilling sensation down their spines as they looked at that black light domain.
It was as if... they were seeing the end of life.
That black light symbolized decay, decline, end, plague, disaster, war... and all other elements representing death.
Upon hearing this, even General Sam's expression was filled with solemnity, he seriously doubted that his level-eight early mechanical armor could defend against that terrifying death domain.
He glanced at Dora, sighing slightly, "I really underestimated... Turns out there was such a terrifying force in Dawn."
Stepping into the seventh tier truly means becoming a top professional.
Previously, because the Thirteenth Princess 'Princess Scatty' Scatty Harris died in the North Sea, officials in Mafa had a fair understanding of "Dawn Brigade."
But the battle in the Moros City-State, what really caught their attention was the mysterious eighth-tier expert "Mr. Jing" who stopped Oleg.
However, a "Reaper" who killed ten thousand pirates was, to the people at this level of Mafa's military, rather insignificant.
After all, it was only a fifth-tier, and those killed were merely a mob, no threat to the military hierarchy.
But now, looking at Su Lun, who had entered the seventh tier, Mafa and his group didn't know how to describe their feelings.
The mechanical army, which is Mafa's military forte, relied on the advantage of numerical superiority and the ability to repair mechanical armor losses, making it formidable on the battlefield.
Looking at the puppet army in front of them, they seemed to see the shadow of their mechanical army.
No!
To be precise, it was as if they were seeing a combination of the traditional knight regiments of Ruying and their Mafa mechanical army.
Mechanical warriors had an absolute advantage over traditional professionals in terms of battle losses, and the puppet army's advantage was even greater.
As long as the controller did not die, there was practically no concept of battle loss anymore.
Dora knew that Su Lun had a mechanical workshop, which was actually the production line that Mafa gave to Princess Scatty as a dowry, but she hadn't expected it to be so ingeniously utilized in a puppet master.
If the empire also used such mechanical puppet masters...
The thought barely surfaced in Dora's mind before it was extinguished.
Others couldn't walk this path, only this guy could.
It's not everyone who can control a thousand puppets simultaneously; nor does everyone have the capacity to ensure they aren't beheaded; there's also that exaggerated spiritual power, multitasking ability...
Dora couldn't help but sigh slightly.
But her eyes also lit up as she muttered to herself, "This guy's mechanical puppet army indeed counteracts the mage corps. With his power alone, he could probably annihilate several thousand-person groups. His own strength is also very difficult to defeat..."
A thousand-person mage group wasn't even sure they could defeat the eighth-grade modified mechanical warriors; the puppet army was indeed outrageous.
However, thinking this, her brow furrowed slightly, "But after attracting the Black Dragon, how could he be certain to kill two eighth-order Grand Magic Conductors?"
However, just as Mafa and the group had recently arrived to watch, suddenly those mechanical puppets "biu" "biu" "biu"... shot out hundreds of smoke bombs.
In an instant, the bodies of the bombs exploded, emitting a vile red smoke. This bizarre wind did not disperse and rapidly covered a large area of the forest.
Seeing this, the people of Mafa immediately recognized it: "Alphas VI-type Necrosmoke Bomb?"
Wasn't this their latest alchemical product researched by the Mafa military, made using a formula of necromancer's smoke by the alchemists?
...
The thick smoke enveloped the entire forest, and in the blink of an eye, visibility was reduced to less than five feet.
This alchemical smoke bomb produced a dual-effect confusion smoke that was not just unaffected by wind but also poorly dispelled by Holy Light.
The quantity of smoke produced was large, and its effect on disrupting perception was excellent.
After Su Lun had obtained this secret military formula from Mafa, he immediately thought of how perfectly it complemented his puppet army's tactics!
Su Lun now had numerous means of perception, and even if his vision were restricted, it wouldn't affect his battle capabilities at all.
Soul Perception and thread could precisely capture the position of his enemies.
Moreover, now with mechanical beasts, nearly every beast acted as his "eyes."
As long as Su Lun's perception was unaffected, his puppet army could slaughter indiscriminately in the fog.
Conversely, the limitations were significant for the enemy.
The mage army wasn't composed entirely of versatile magic users, the vast majority of mages knew only a handful of combat spells.
Once the fog covered the area, over eighty percent of the mages were instantly blinded.
With the fog, it was nearly impossible to discern the puppeteers amidst the chaos.
Even with defensive countermeasures, the puppet army, like a reckless brute, rampaged forward, killing indiscriminately.
Using this well-prepared "smoke bomb + puppet" tactic, Su Lun quickly exterminated several hundred-person groups again.
This movement finally drew out those two eighth-grade professionals sitting central in the mage tower within the formation.
True to form, it wasn't long before a tyrannically unmatched killing intent rushed forth!
Su Lun's gaze slightly narrowed, "They've come?"
Without any hesitation, not even taking time to reorganize his puppet army, he teleported away the moment he felt the wind stir behind him.
Looking again, an eighth-grade professional clad in a blue robe appeared where he had just been standing.
Su Lun, having gathered much intelligence, also recognized this person from his trademark elemental wind teleportation—a surprise—it was Polis Wheeler, the Grand Magic Conductor injured in the previous battle with the Black Dragon.
"Eighth-grade, huh..."
Su Lun clearly felt the terrifying pressure of that rank.
He had no intention of confronting this eighth-grade head-on, and at the moment this person appeared, he uttered softly, "Explode!"
Instantaneously, at the foot of the Giant God Mountain, a massive detonation occurred, causing part of the rocky base to collapse.
Suddenly, an enraged and high-pitched dragon chant pierced the sky.
Hearing that nightmare-like dragon chant, the faces of the mages in the forest simultaneously paled.
In the distance, atop the canopies, the people of Mafa observed with a very strange expression on their faces.
They had been watching the entire time, guessing that Su Lun might attract the Black Dragon, but they did not expect it to happen in such a manner.
Dora also commented in a mocking tone, "That guy actually blew up the dragon's lair... No wonder he was so confident the Black Dragon would definitely come for revenge."
...
Previously, someone had left behind the recipe for the "Multi-layered Thermonuclear Explosive", which Su Lun found useful, so he stored several hundred tons of it in the war workshop.
This type of explosive was specifically designed to mine through hard ore layers. The palace of the Dwarf race was extremely sturdy, and ordinary explosives couldn't even make a dent. Now, it was the perfect time to use them.
Su Lun, whose engineering and architecture skills were also not low, selected several of the palace's load-bearing columns and installed the explosives for precision demolition.
This explosion nearly destroyed the entire underground palace.
Having blown up their lair, even if the Black Dragon was usually even-tempered, it would likely come out desperate.
However, the moment the dragon roar sounded, the expression of the eighth-tier Magic Conductor, Polis Wheeler, also darkened.
But it wasn't entirely unexpected.
In his view, if a monkey dared to provoke a tiger, it must have something to rely on.
This native really thought to repeat the same old trick?
Ridiculous!
Having set up the Forbidden Curse Array for so long, it was just waiting for the Black Dragon to appear.
It was the perfect opportunity to take care of everything at once.
He didn't bother with the Black Dragon, his robe swirling with wind elements, and with a wave of his magic wand, he cast the spell instantly, "Arcane Magic: Wind Imprisonment!"
Even though Su Lun had teleported several hundred meters, just as the magic surged around him, it felt as though the air had solidified.
After fully understanding the laws, almost all of them have some spatial suppression.
Previously, when Su Lun wanted to teleport, it was like tearing through a thin "paper" to enter into the void, but now the void was fortified into "iron sheet" by wind elements. He could run, he could teleport, but the process of casting the spell would take more time.
And in the battles between top-tier fighters, often all it takes is one moment of restraint to determine the winner.
The very moment he was restrained, a soul fluctuation had already appeared behind him.
The Magic Conductor's teleportation ability within short distances was no slower than instantaneous teleportation.
Polis flipped through the pages of his magic book with a breeze, automatically turning to a page. He then cast a teleportation spell with a raise of his hand, "Wind Oath: Wind Wheel Cutting Technique!"
A double combo, giving no chance at all.
This eighth-tier wind cutting magic was enough to severely injure most seventh-tier creatures!
Under normal circumstances, Su Lun could only have used the "Crystalline Plane" to escape.
But at this moment, he didn't.
Even though he was trapped just for an instant, Su Lun's face turned stern, the runes on his skin lit up, muscles bulged, and Giant's Strength erupted with terrifying power.
He endured the sharp cutting sensation on his skin and punched out forcefully towards his back!
With a muffled "thud," the punch wrapped in Spatial Technique heavily smashed onto Polis's magic shield.
Su Lun felt as though his fist had sunk into a quagmire. A strong buffering and adhering sensation wrapped around his fist, instantly negating the possibility of his fist forcibly penetrating.
But, it wasn't over yet!
Su Lun narrowed his eyes, power emerging from his waist, an invisible force traveling along his muscles into his arm, exploding forward!
In the "Ancient Techniques," it talks about Inner Strength. When a fist is thrown, it's like setting up a cannon, but the real killer is the subsequent Inner Strength.
It would blast out like a cannonball directly from the barrel!
Fused with Giant's Strength, the punch he threw now could shatter mountains!
"Cannon Fist: Dual Pole Kill!"
A cold gleam flashed through Su Lun's eyes, and a terrifying force erupted from his fist.
Polis, relying on his eighth-tier magic shield, wanted to resist the force outright, but his face suddenly changed when the immense power was poured into him.
With a loud "pop", the air burst, and the leaves within several meters all turned to fine dust.
The void was like a shattered mirror, cracking with web-like traces.
This punch was not just a physical attack, but it had shattered the entire space.
Polis instinctively retreated a hundred meters.
Yet Su Lun stood his ground, a glint of eagerness for the battle sparked in his eyes.
Although the cutting magic had gashed a bloodstain across his skin as it sliced through his field, the injury wasn't too severe.
Instead, the pressure from the eighth-tier Grand Magic Conductor had given him a feeling of oppression once again!
Being wounded in their first clash did not worry him, but rather, it bolstered his confidence.
After this probing attack, he had gained a clear understanding of the eighth-tier Grand Magic Conductor's combat level.
At sixth-tier, facing this eighth-tier Magic Conductor, he nearly had no ability to fight head-on, but now... he did!
Moreover, Su Lun had also discovered that his field was indeed very special.
Even when facing a rank suppression, it remained incredibly powerful!
The pressure exerted by the opponent during that brief confrontation was much less than he had anticipated.
Moreover, Su Lun's understanding of the wind element, one of the four basic elements, was also not inferior.
Even though the difference was still significant, the opponent wouldn't be able to kill him in a short time!
...
Polis was clearly surprised that he had not managed to kill Su Lun even after personally intervening.
Looking at that dark light field, his face turned very somber.
Having such natives in the Alchemy Realm was something he truly had not anticipated.
The outcome was thankfully swayed by the rank difference, otherwise, the result of the battle would have been hard to predict!
Just as he was about to continue the assault, a dark silhouette flashed across the sky like lightning.
The Black Dragon had arrived!
Su Lun had intentionally stormed the camp, causing such a huge commotion, just so the Black Dragon could locate the camp.
With its lair destroyed, old grudges combined with fresh, it immediately launched an attack.
It did not care who had blown up its den; all humans looked like ants to it, and it was fine to destroy them all together.
The Black Dragon, without any disregard, spewed a Dragon Breath at the ground, and the dark acid instantly turned a hundred people to decay.
Seeing this, Su Lun swiftly teleported to escape the area.
He was well aware that once the Black Dragon appeared, the magic trap would be activated.
From beginning to end, killing Su Lun, this native, was not the goal in the eyes of this group of godly realm mages.
It was to kill the wicked dragon, only then would they have a chance to leave.
In a way, Su Lun also helped them draw out the Black Dragon.
Sure enough, just as the Black Dragon was about to revel in its fierceness, a magic glow suddenly lit up from various parts of the forest.
From the built magic towers emerged different colors of light, which converged in the sky, and a massive nine-pointed star magic circle lit up.
This magic circle was like a massive cage, restricting a section of space within it.
The beams of light from the magic towers acted like iron bars, limiting the Black Dragon's flying range.
As the Forbidden Curse Array activated, a light ignited, and thousands of mages in the forest began chanting a profound spell simultaneously. In an instant, countless magic chains appeared in the air and entwined around the Black Dragon.
Although the Black Dragon was fierce, breaking one magic chain after another, as more chains wrapped around, its flight became increasingly laborious.
It didn't struggle for long before it crashed loudly to the ground.
The most intense battle then began...
...
Meanwhile,
Polis watched Su Lun flee, a flash of gloom in his eyes, and immediately chose to pursue him.
In his view, once the "Forbidden Spell: No Air Forbidden Domain" was activated, the Black Dragon was doomed. Even if he did not join the battle, it would not affect the overall situation.
Instead, it was the native with the Time Bow who posed a great danger.
If his assumptions were correct, that fellow was planning to employ the same tactic as ten days ago, shooting cold arrows while they concentrated on killing the Black Dragon!
Thinking this, Polis absolutely would not allow the scenario from ten days ago to repeat itself.
Ignoring his injuries, he pursued relentlessly.
Su Lun frequently used Teleportation to escape, but behind him, the incoming Magic Conductor was like a haunting ghost, relentless in his pursuit.
While chasing, he unleashed various Wind Spells, leaving trails of blood on Su Lun.
To onlookers, he appeared to be fleeing desperately without any ability to resist.
This was exactly what a group of people hiding in the forest thought.
A staff officer, watching the disheveled Su Lun fleeing, analyzed, "That eighth-rank mage did not join the battle against the Black Dragon, probably an unexpected event for them. Now, with the Black Dragon lured out, there is nothing in this cursed space that could make the grand Magic Conductor hesitate, no matter where he flees, he will be pursued..."
Another person also said with regret, "Yes. Although his Teleportation ability is strong, this is cursed space. He can't escape..."
Hearing his subordinate's analysis, General Sam glanced at Dora next to him and suggested, "Should we go help now? That kid indeed has remarkable combat strength, but he's definitely not a match for an eighth-rank mage. If this continues, he has no doubt of surviving."
Although he was the highest combat power in the squad, the actual command was in Dora's hands.
Dora frowned, not rushing to make a decision.
She seemed to be considering something, muttering to herself, "Strange. That guy has more detailed information than we do; he shouldn't fail to anticipate this situation. But why would he take action, unless he has some other backup plan?"
But in this cursed space, there was no second Black Dragon to leverage anymore.
Dora couldn't figure out where Su Lun's confidence came from.
Before she could hesitate further, Sam said, "I think if we are going to make a move, now is the best time, while the grand Magic Conductor is isolated. Otherwise, after those people kill the Black Dragon and can focus on us, it'll be too late."
Upon hearing this, though she felt something might have been overlooked, Dora could only say, "Hmm! Get ready, find an opportunity to ambush him, and try to deal a crippling blow!"
"Yes!"
Everyone responded in unison, their combat Mechas also entering battle readiness mode.
However, just then, an unexpected change occurred!
A golden angelic figure rushed into the sky, causing the expressions of all of Polis's people to freeze right there!
....
A chase and a flight.
Su Lun ran for a while, surrounded by dangers.
After confirming that the magical traps behind him were thoroughly sealed off and that the army of mages couldn't disengage from their fierce battle with the evil dragon, he clenched his face and commanded, "Take action!"
In that instant, Number Nineteen, who had been lurking underground for a long time, suddenly burst forth.
Her wings of gold flapped behind her, swift as a bolt of golden lightning.
Su Lun had anticipated that the people from the Angel Realm had just arrived and were completely unaware of the existence of "Super Mechanical Warriors."
Even if they knew, it would be very difficult for them to detect her using conventional sensory methods.
No. 19 was a Super Mechanical Warrior, whose body temperature could be adjusted to match the environment, and who emitted no biological scent, while her light-sensitive layers could even physically render her invisible... In essence, without methods like Su Lun's Soul Perception, she would be nearly impossible to discover.
Polis's face changed drastically as he saw the golden flowing light charging toward him, already feeling a hair-raising crisis of death encroaching.
He had not overlooked the possibility of Su Lun having allies, constantly extending his perception along the way, but he had detected nothing unusual.
However, watching the approaching figure, the reaction of the Grand Magic Conductor was extremely quick.
Pointing his magic wand, the magic he had been gathering to release at Su Lun was cast toward the person chasing from below.
"Wind Oath: Hundred Thousand Wind Tornado!"
This wind-related magic was both offensive and defensive, not only capable of killing enemies but also using the fierce wind to repel them.
Polis had used it many times against peers of the same rank, and it had never failed.
Yet, as this magic was released, he encountered a scene he hadn't anticipated at all.
The figure, gleaming with metallic luster, showed no intention to dodge and plunged head-first into the storm, which was like a meat grinder.
"Clang," "Clang," "Clang"...
As sparks flew, the crisp sound of metal contact echoed by his ears.
"A mechanical body?"
Seeing this, Polis finally understood where his sense of unease came from.
What was worse, he watched as his eighth-tier magic left not a single mark on that mechanical body!
How could this be...
The blades that could grind steel, left not a trace?
What terrifying defensive power was this?
However, before he could ponder any longer, another disaster struck!
At first glance, not only had the attack been ineffective, but even the storm's repelling effect had lost its function!
On closer examination, a visible layer of airflow appeared on the golden wings, but the special structure of the feathers suddenly shifted the direction of the airflow. Instead of repelling her, this reverse storm became an aid, speeding Su Lun up by a fraction!
"Not good!"
Polis internally cried out in urgency, as magic power surged from his magic book, transforming his magic shield into an amber-like viscous state.
He had already entered a full defense mode!
However, this gave him no sense of security; instead, the sense of impending doom grew stronger.
...
No. 19 transformed into a stream of light and arrived in an instant.
She transformed into a Golden Battle Angel, standing mid-air.
Behind her, the golden dual wings burst out from the rapid flying state, reflecting dazzling golden light under the sun.
The moment the wings unfolded, numerous golden feathers "whooshed" out like flying shuttles, turning into golden streams of light, heading straight for Polis!
Amidst noises of knives plunging into a swamp, those knife-like feathers met stiff resistance from the magic shield, struggling to penetrate.
However, this was just the beginning!
No. 19's dual wings folded tens of thousands of golden feathers, which, within a few moments, all flew out.
In an instant, the sky filled with golden feathers, glittering like scales of light on a rippling lake!
The encounter kicked off with a major move: "Sky Feather Blades" is the continuous output skill of the battle angel's wings.
As long as there's enough energy accumulated, they could repeatedly charge and attack.
Tens of thousands of feathers formed a metal tornado, trapping Polis Wheeler in the storm and grinding him repeatedly.
Though the magic shield was strong, it was still a concentration of magic power.
Once the damage exceeded its blocking limit, it would immediately burst.
In those few moments, number 19's Gold Wing Storm inflicted tons of damage on the enemy!
"So powerful!"
Su Lun looked on, shocked yet delighted.
He had thought that number 19 would just hold Polis Wheeler off, but he hadn't expected him to be so powerful.
After being modified by the Dwarf King, his mechanical limbs could withstand a level 8 attack, and the golden wings were outrageously strong.
But there was no time to think further, as he turned his head and charged fiercely ahead.
Such a good opportunity must be seized to slay this foe on the spot!
However, Polis Wheeler was ultimately an experienced tier 8 Grand Magic Conductor with life-saving measures at his disposal.
The moment he knew he couldn't hold out any longer, he burst explosively with a "bang."
His robe was shredded into pieces in the metal storm, and a few hundred meters away, a battered old man reappeared, covered in wounds.
Seeing this, a cold flash flickered in Su Lun's eyes.
He was not surprised that his foe had a life-saving escape method, but how many times could he use it!
Seeing this, number 19 spread the framework of her wings, and the tens of thousands of gold feathers instantly reformed into that pair of large wings.
Together with Su Lun, they charged at Polis Wheeler again!
...
Meanwhile, Mafa's group was completely stunned.
They had never imagined that just this encounter would bring them so many shocks.
A tier 8 Grand Magic Conductor severely injured?
The moment they realized what they had seen, Dora understood the situation.
"A super mechanical warrior? But... what are those golden wings made of as a mechanical limb!"
"It must be the divine forbidden item 'Battle Angel Wings' from the Royal Collection of Luying. Three hundred years ago, it was heard that a royal adventure group of Luying discovered a piece of ancient shipwreck and found that mechanical artifact piece. Unfortunately, it was lost later. At that time, King Quinton had used various means to find it, but none succeeded..."
"Not only the golden wings, but the other mechanical limbs of the mechanical warrior are extremely well forged. Clearly not a product of the military factory. It looks like they were hand-forged by some Great Grandmaster of forging. Although the technology content isn't top-notch, the defense brought by the materials and forging standards is on par with any tier 8 enhancements. Strange, who forged this set of mechanical armor, when the best forging masters are all in Mafa?"
"..."
Known as the Mechanical Holy Land, Mafa made its crowd of mechanical experts shocked at the ostentatiousness of number 19's mechanical armor.
"He still has such a strong companion!"
As Dora was shocked, she also glanced at the retreating Polis Wheeler, her gaze hardened, and she decisively said, "Let's help too! Aim to kill that tier 8 mage in a short time!"
Everyone responded in unison, "Alright!"
A group of people charged forth fiercely.
They had clearly seen that if they could kill one tier 8, the remaining magic groups might not be beyond their capability to annihilate completely!
Seeing this, General Sam felt extremely complex inside as he finally understood that that guy had indeed intended to annihilate the ten thousand mages completely.
Even without their help, this idea could very well be possible!

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - 513: 512
chapters.content:
Su Lun and Number Nineteen charged towards Polis the Eighth-order Mage, and in an instant, they both detected something.
Suddenly, the distinctive sound of energy furnaces charging up burst from the distant forest.
"Pfft!"
"Pfft!"
"..."
The mecha surged with energy for propulsion, their feet creating ripples of air waves as if stepping on the air.
The figures were incredibly fast, arriving in the blink of an eye.
Even in full-coverage mechanical armor, Su Lun recognized at a glance the soul of that hostage, Miss Dora, and murmured to himself, "Heh, what a coincidence."
He was not at all surprised to find people from Mafa in this cursed space.
When someone had previously sabotaged another magic circle's base outside, he knew that experts from Mafa's military had arrived.
However, he didn't expect to run into Miss Dora again.
Seeing among them a Grand General-level modified eighth-order mechanical warrior, Su Lun felt quite pleased.
With these people helping, he was even more confident he could kill Polis in a short time.
Su Lun informed Number Nineteen, and without any communication, both sides tacitly joined forces to surround and attack.
...
"Damn it! How does this guy have backup!" Polis's eyes were filled with gloom.
Seeing a Mechanical Angel suddenly joining the fight was completely unexpected.
And now, this group of mechanical warriors as well?
However, it wasn't the time to think about this; dealing with the present crisis was the urgent matter.
The members of the Thousand Mage Group were being held back by the Black Dragon and couldn't lend a hand right now.
The Wind Mage knew he could only rely on himself.
He originally wanted to use his rapid teleportation ability to avoid the fight, but the speed of the Golden Angel Wings warrior was extremely fast, and he couldn't escape.
Once he was entangled, it immediately became a group beating.
Facing numerous enemies, he was put into a dire situation right from the start.
Polis reacted very quickly; he took out a crystal ball and instantaneously drew a massive amount of magic power, his body surging with magical energy, his robe fluttering fiercely. At the same time, he lifted his magic wand and began chanting an arcane incantation, and shouted, "Sanctuary·Open!"
At another glance, a huge blue wind vortex had formed within a kilometer radius centered on him.
Magicians and Alchemists have vastly different training systems.
The symbol of an eighth-order Magician is the "Law Sanctuary," which can be roughly understood as an enhanced version of a domain.
A Sanctuary is like a temporary magic tower that draws from the massive elements nearby, providing the Great Mage with ample magic power to cast various high-energy-consuming "Taboo Arts" level spells, multiplying their combat power several times on the spot.
However, unluckily for him, mechanical warriors don't need to absorb elemental energy from the outside world!
Their power all comes from their own magic energy furnaces and various internal combustion mechanical furnaces.
So the Sanctuary had very limited restrictions on the mechanical warriors.
And the only traditional Alchemist on the scene being Su Lun, who had the continuous spiritual power recovery from the [Heart of Isaac's Alchemy], wasn't greatly affected either.
In the Divine Realm, there was no machinery at all, and even though this Eighth-order Mage had profound knowledge, he knew very little about machinery.
As Polis watched his Sanctuary unfold without affecting the enemies, his complexion turned very grim.
But his magic book in his right hand was already flipping in the wind, and his left hand's magic wand was also gathering a thick force of wind elemental power, releasing one after another high-energy-consuming magic.
"Forbidden Spell·Wind Dragon Descent," "Arcane Art·Great Wind Song," "Taboo Art·Wind Demon Curse..."
In an instant, a fierce wind arose.
All sorts of powerful magic that would usually consume one's lifespan and cause severe magic power backlash were cast.
In the sky, a melee of magic unfurled, and in the vast cursed space, all the winds were stirred.
"Clang" "Clang" "Clang"... Sparks lit up the sky.
The mechanical warriors braced themselves against the wind that could slice gold and split stones, and unleashed their full offensive capability.
Luckily, all of them were mechanical bodies; otherwise, even seventh-order professionals would likely have their domains shredded to pieces by this demonic wind.
Number Nineteen and that Mafa General took the lead in the front, brawling wildly.
The rest followed up with all sorts of attacks.
Compared to them, Su Lun was relatively relaxed.
He might not have a mechanical body to block the damage from the wind magic, but he had the terrifying wax figure [Young Master William].
The wax figure transformed into an elemental body, and the shadow of the Wind Witch enveloped Su Lun. The wind elemental domain absorbed most of the damage from the wind magic. The wind blades that hit his Rune Golden Body still made a clang sound.
Even so, the crisis was not small.
No one dared to underestimate an Eighth-order Mage's desperate combat power. Any carelessness could lead to fatal injuries.
Mafa's mechanical warriors might have been covered in heavy armor, but the wind is omnipresent and penetrative. Once the wind magic scraped off the coatings and runes on the surface of the mecha, the metal alloys alone could not withstand the force of the eighth order's wind.
Polis was accumulating more and more injuries, his attacks becoming sharper and sharper, fighting as if he was trading life for life.
In the midst of such a ferocious battle, several sixth-order modified armors were torn apart, turned into countless fragments, and fell from the sky.
And unfortunately, that hostage, Miss Dora, wore sixth-order modified armor.
Seeing her injured, Su Lun immediately teleported over, intending to protect her.
After all, they came to help, and killing them under one's nose would be somewhat indecent.
However, what surprised Su Lun was that at the moment of contact, when he saw Dora's body within the wind element cutting Mecha, it actually revealed a metallic sheen?
It was like a gargoyle, with the wound instantly recovering.
"A metallic body?"
With a sideways glance, Su Lun was also slightly astonished.
He remembered that Miss had clearly been of normal flesh and blood, so why was this happening?
For a moment, he thought of something and guessed this was the odd sensation he had previously felt.
The secrets Dora harbored were not small ones.
Clearly, even if he didn't come to her rescue, she would not die.
The two exchanged a glance, and Dora still showed a touch of gratitude, although her mechanical limbs were damaged, it was nothing serious.
With the battle being critical, Su Lun didn't say much more and rejoined the fray.
...
Su Lun and his cohort had intended to kill quickly, so they didn't hold back, greeting the enemy with various trump cards.
After getting through Polis Wheeler's final burst of strength, it was time for the strangulation.
Before long, General #19 and the Mafa General joined forces to seriously injure Polis. Once the magic shield broke, Su Lun teleported behind him and beheaded the Eighth-order Mage with a single strike.
As soon as his soul appeared from the corpse, Su Lun instantly harvested it.
"You have stripped 'Polis Wheeler's' soul."
"You have gained a great deal of 'Eighth-order Wind Element Law Insights,' 'Wind Magic Spells,' 'Wind Runes.'"
"You now know 'the structure of a super large magic formation, tactics, legion magic...'"
"You have acquired intelligence: 'The planar gateway is located in an uninhabited mountainous area that has been tightly controlled by the magic circle…'"
"Spiritual Power +1001"
"..."
This was the first Eighth-order power's soul Su Lun had harvested, and it was very much intact.
All sorts of knowledge and insights about wind law flooded into his mind, and with the Seventh-order integration of the "Profane Crown," the super high perception immediately provided him with a very peculiar deep experience. He gained some insights that were beyond the comprehension of his own level.
In the myriad planes, the Alchemy system is quite niche. However, the Magic system is one of the most mainstream. Magical knowledge has many things in common with Alchemy that can be cross-referenced.
Thanks to the insights from the Ninth-order Master Pierre he had obtained before, it was as if a broken ladder to the sky had been connected with several more steps, and many insights suddenly became clear.
Su Lun's own understanding of the wind laws skyrocketed several major steps in an instant.
He did not have time to digest those insights thoroughly.
The group exchanged glances, and Su Lun said, "Scatter!"
The Mafa people also immediately understood and quickly dispersed.
Now, they had handed over the problem to the ten-thousand Mage legion hiding in the distant forest.
These celestial plane beings watched as their Grand Mage Polis was killed, helpless to do anything else.
They were embroiled in a fierce battle with the Black Dragon and had to give it their all. By the time they thought they could spare some forces to assist, the battle was already over.
The complexion of the Eighth-order Mage still fighting the evil dragon darkened.
They were not supposed to be so passive.
A ten-thousand Mage legion with extensive battle experience simply would not make such a basic mistake as underestimating their enemy.
According to their plan, Polis was deliberately sent out to handle any unforeseen incidents.
Even with Su Lun's surprise attack on the camp and the subsequent emergence of the Black Dragon, all this was within their risk estimates.
The original plan was, with the ten-thousand group and the magic formation holding off the Black Dragon, Polis, as an Eighth-order Mage, was fully capable of handling any emergencies.
They thought that even if there were unexpected situations, the combat strength of an Eighth-order Wind Mage certainly wouldn't be easy to overcome.
But they never expected the situation to end like this.
Though that native had very bizarre methods, he was clearly just a Sixth-order Magician!
In the ten days they hadn't seen him, he had advanced to the Seventh-order, not to mention.
Where did this group of mechanical warriors come from?
Among them, there were even two capable of withstanding Eighth-Order Mages?
It wasn't that the magic legion wasn't cautious, it was that no one expected such a scenario.
Even Su Lun himself.
Originally, he just wanted to pick up some "Animated Silver" and other valuables, and that would have been enough.
As for killing an Eighth-order Grand Mage, he simply didn't entertain the idea.
Because it was impossible!
Even with the Black Dragon.
Because he had long anticipated that the enemy would surely set a trap for him.
But he didn't expect to encounter the grudges of the Dwarf King in the Dwarf Underground City. Then, by a stroke of luck, the grudges repaired the "Mechanical Angel Wings," allowing #19 to possess such powerful combat abilities.
After that, encountering Dora and her Mafa companions was also a coincidence.
...
Meanwhile, the Mafa group quickly withdrew from the battlefield and hid in the forest.
Although there were some losses, this group of troops was greatly invigorated.
After all, they had just killed an Eighth-order enemy!
Moreover, looking at the current situation, it was very likely that the entire ten thousand mage group would be buried in this cursed space.
To their empire, this was definitely great news!
General Sam looked into the distance, squinting his eyes and reflecting sentimentally, "That Mechanical Angel with the Golden Angel Wings is really strong. I noticed earlier that the style of the rune forging clearly inherits from the mountain dwarf race. It must be crafted by at least a Great Grandmaster. And what's more remarkable is... she is a fully mechanically modified super Mecha. I didn't expect that in addition to 'Mr. Jing,' there would be such forces in Dawn."
As he said this, he seemed to think of something else, and did not skimp on his shock, saying, "Then there's Su Lun... his strength is outrageously strong. Among all the geniuses I've come across, whether it's combat power, temperament, or talent... he is the strongest I have seen, and no one can compare with him. It's no wonder he could comprehend the Master's overbearing presence, indeed he has the potential of a top powerhouse."
Miss Dora listened as General Sam directly spoke Su Lun's name, along with a series of complimentary words, her gaze crossed with a touch of complexity.
She pondered for a moment before murmuring, "This 'Dawn' organization is indeed extraordinary."
She had her doubts when that detestable fellow spoke of cultural heritage and justice.
After all, she had been blackmailed.
She always felt that his motives were impure.
But now, seeing his mechanical puppet legion kill those plane invaders, she suddenly felt that the ransom was also worth it for a moment.
No matter how one looked at it, what Dawn did was consistent with what they proclaimed.
At this moment, someone asked, "Colonel Dora, what should we do now?"
Miss Dora let out a deep sigh and said, "Let's hide. The rest will be left to time. That guy had thought of this step from the very beginning. That ten thousand mage group is bound to not make it out alive."
"..."
Upon hearing this, the Mecha warriors who had just participated in the battle looked complex.
...
Su Lun and Number Nineteen also found an inconspicuous place in the forest to hide.
Now, all they had to do was wait.
Wait for the ten thousand mage group and the Black Dragon to fight to the death.
In the distance, the battle within the magic formation was intense.
The evil dragon was still fighting desperately.
If it hadn't been for the appearance of Su Lun and his group, the ten thousand mage group's large-scale magic trap would have been able to kill this Black Dragon and leave the cursed space at a very small cost.
But now the situation was different.
If they continued to fight the Black Dragon, they were clear that "those natives" would definitely not let them kill the Black Dragon smoothly.
However, not fighting was not an option either.
The Black Dragon's lair was destroyed, and now it was trapped in the magic formation, being battered and riddled with wounds, having formed a die-hard hatred. Even if they let the Black Dragon leave the magic trap, they would only face devastating revenge, and the situation would only be worse.
Although the ten thousand mage group seemed to have not suffered major losses, they were actually in a desperate situation.
Besides, this was a cursed space; there was no possibility of escape.
Even if they sacrificed the car to protect the commander, thinking of saving some people was also impossible.
The Eighth-order leader, Adelaide, commanding the battle, was very aware of this.
"Those natives," having killed Deputy Leader Polis, could naturally also kill him.
Since they had more people, they would certainly attract the Black Dragon's attention.
Those bastards hiding intentionally was exactly for this purpose.
No matter what, it seemed they were all on a path to death.
...
The battle inside the magic formation suddenly became fierce.
The mages were using all their tricks; it seemed that they wanted to quickly take care of the Black Dragon.
Out of all the terrible choices available, this was the most reasonable.
Only by quickly killing the Black Dragon would they have a chance to preserve their fighting power to deal with "the natives."
Su Lun was not at all surprised; he had anticipated that these guys would do this.
So he wasn't in a hurry to take any action to interfere.
If they wanted to break free from this cursed space, they would definitely have to kill this evil dragon.
With others helping to serve as cannon fodder, it couldn't be better.
At least before the evil dragon was severely wounded, he only intended to watch the drama unfold.
Moreover, he also wanted to see if this group of mages had any other ace up their sleeves, such as the ability to summon a divine will, or a magic conductor with special effects.
....
The Black Dragon's vitality was incredibly tenacious; even though it was bound by various magic chains, its ground combat power was not to be underestimated.
The battle between the two sides lasted for half a day.
The fight was extremely brutal.
But overall, the mage group had the upper hand, suffering several hundred casualties, and severely wounding the Black Dragon.
With the restriction of the magic trap "Void Forbidden Domain," most of the Black Dragon's battle power was limited. Although its dragon scales were immune to most magic, the various army magic conductors were specifically designed to deal with these difficult beings. At this moment, the dragon's roars were becoming weak, and its body was covered with turned-out flesh, its wings tattered everywhere.
The rhythm seemed to be moving in the anticipated direction.
It seemed that in another hour or two, the dragon would be killed.
But seeing this scene, Dora, hiding in the forest, seemed to perceive something and suddenly spoke up, "The mage group have a hidden card up their sleeve, those guys are going to make a move. We should also prepare for battle."
"Yes."
At that, the Mages around her instantly entered battle readiness.
General Sam had also sharply caught the opportunity but he asked with curiosity, "Dora, do you see that the Mage circle has a backup plan?"
Dora, however, shook her head as if she had a tacit agreement with Su Lun thousands of kilometers away, saying, "I didn't see it. But this is the only chance for that Mage group. That guy will definitely think of it. So he absolutely won't give the opponent a chance to turn things around. He will definitely make a move."
Upon hearing this, Sam naturally also understood the subtleties involved.
He smiled ever so slightly, his expression meaningful as he said, "This era is really going to be exciting with you guys in it."
...
Meanwhile, in another part of the forest.
Su Lun stood up from his hiding spot, raised the Bow of Time in his hand, the corners of his mouth curving into a slight smile as he thought, "Looks like they have some sort of trump card waiting to take out the Black Dragon in one fell swoop, catching us off guard. Tsk tsk...doesn't matter if they do or not, I'm not going to give them that chance."
Having observed for so long and seen all sorts of final tricks from the Mage circle, it was time for him to act.
He couldn't just watch as these people killed the Black Dragon.
Without hesitation, Su Lun shot the arrows, which flew swiftly, precisely taking out several key points in the Magic Circle.
It was this action that instantly destabilized the Magic Circle.
With one struggle, the Black Dragon caused several Magic Towers to collapse on the spot, and dozens of Mages died instantly.
Like toppling a set of dominoes, it quickly triggered a chain reaction.
More and more Magic Towers collapsed, and the light of the Magic Circle dimmed significantly in an instant.
The Mages were thrown into panic.
Su Lun didn't intend to shoot any more arrows and put away the Bow of Time. He turned to Number 19 beside him and said, "Get ready to slip away, those guys are going for their last ditch effort."
Number 19 glanced at him, nodded solemnly, and said, "Mhm."
As soon as those words fell, suddenly, the two of them saw the Magic Circle in the distance disappear completely.
The Mafa General Adelaide knew that his last plan had been thwarted, and the "natives" wouldn't give them the opportunity to execute the Black Dragon.
At that moment, all hope was gone.
Adelaide's face darkened as he shouted, "Scatter!"
Almost simultaneously, the several thousand Mages scattered in all directions.
Freed from the restraint of the Magic Circle, the Black Dragon took flight, and its furious Dragon Breath spewed forth, instantly killing hundreds.
Still unsatisfied, it soared into the air, chasing after clusters of people with its Dragon Breath in a frenzy.
Without the protection of the Army's Magic Shield, how could these people withstand the Dragon Breath?
Even in a severely wounded state, the Black Dragon was not something these fifth or sixth-order Mages could withstand.
The Black Dragon, in its fury, pursued the Mages who were running chaotically throughout the forest, and in an instant, cries of despair filled the air.
This ten-thousand-strong Mage Army, which had arrived from the Divine Plane less than a day ago, was utterly doomed from the moment their formation broke.
The Eighth-order Mage General, his face full of grief and anger, led a few elites charging straight at Su Lun and Number 19.
They no longer harbored a sliver of hope for survival, determined to drag these natives to the grave with them even in death!
But would Su Lun allow this?
He could perform Spatial Teleportation, and Number 19's Golden Angel Wings were also extremely fast. If they could outrun that Wind Grandmaster Mage before, could they not now outrun a close-combat Rune Mage?
Seeing the General coming, they didn't hesitate to run.
They had no intention of clashing head-on with the Mafa General and just kept on running.
Even if they occasionally were hit by a long-range Magic attack, Number 19 could easily withstand it, posing no threat.
Su Lun even took the chance to harvest souls from areas with a higher concentration of bodies.
Their chase was not a big issue.
But the ten-thousand-strong Army was on the verge of annihilation in the blink of an eye.
How fast could the Black Dragon fly?
The furious Brother Dragon, like a black lightning, crazily spewed Dragon Breath in the forest.
In less than fifteen minutes, seven to eight thousand Mages from the ten-thousand-strong group were dead, with the few survivors scattered throughout the jungle.
With no more targets, the Black Dragon turned its attention to the two groups being chased, changing its direction to fly towards them.
The Black Dragon's intelligence was not low; how could it forget Adelaide, the chief culprit who had dealt it a serious blow?
Instantly, it turned into a three-way chase.
Adelaide too, in a grim turn of face, decided to draw Su Lun and his companion into the hatred of the Black Dragon.
Seeing this, Su Lun's lips curled slightly.
He had never planned to share the Black Dragon's pressure with this man from the beginning.
In the very instant it became a three-way chase, he decisively brought Number 19 into the small void world.
Then, with one precisely coordinated long-distance teleportation, he reappeared in another inconspicuous corner of the forest several kilometers away.
Wrapped in a shroud, his presence vanished completely.
The original spot was left empty.
The Eighth-order Great Mage Adelaide looked at the spot where Su Lun had disappeared, his face full of astonishment.
He turned and looked behind him at the Black Dragon coming with ferocious momentum, his eyes filled with nothing but despair.
PS. Sorry, had something to deal with outside today. I'm fixing some mistakes in the text which I wrote in an internet cafe, please bear with me.

chapters.title: Chapter 514 - 513: Great Opportunity, Divine King's Divine Artifact!
chapters.content:
The commander of the ten-thousand-member mage group, Adelaide, was an eighth-tier Rune Mage, skilled in both magic and combat, with formidable close-combat capabilities.
Even alone, he had fought against the seriously injured Black Dragon for a long time.
The site of their fierce battle resembled a scene from a meteor strike in the forest, utterly devastated.
In the end, he was no match and died under the claws of the Black Dragon.
Moreover, since Su Lun had blown up the dragon's lair, the Black Dragon, still enraged, had no place to return and began massacring isolated mages in the jungle after killing Adelaide.
However, just as the Black Dragon left, Su Lun teleported back to the battlefield.
Adelaide's body had already been corroded by the dragon's breath to almost half.
But his soul was still intact.
Su Lun decisively summoned a shadow of death behind him and successfully harvested the soul of an eighth-tier Grand Mage.
This guy followed the path of a physically strong mage, his knowledge providing Su Lun with much inspiration.
As the leader of the ten-thousand-member mage group, his storage space also contained many treasures, including the legion's Holy Artifact.
Particularly, the "Rune Anti-Magic Chain" he used was a remarkably valuable treasure.
...
Before long, more than ten mechanical warriors arrived together.
Miss Dora, watching Su Lun carefully clearing the battlefield, both amazed and speechless, spoke, "Mr. Su Lun, if you intend to confront that Black Dragon, we can offer some help."
The group from Mafa knew that to leave this cursed space, they would still need to rely on Su Lun.
Moreover, Dora knew that this man before her wanted to maximize benefits and would surely aim to kill the Black Dragon. Given his characteristic of leaving no opportunity unexploited, it was certain he would have this intention.
Su Lun glanced at this clever hostage of a lady and cracked a smile, "Sure."
Dora, looking at that smile, always remembered how he had blackmailed her family with the same detestable expression and internally cursed, "Despicable fellow."
But aloud, she said, "What do we need to do? If you have a good battle plan, we can fully cooperate with you."
At this statement, everyone around her, including General Sam, became very serious.
They knew very well that even now, with two eighth-tier modified warriors, their chances against the Black Dragon were not great.
If they clashed head-on, the outcome would likely be extremely dire.
There might be few survivors in this group of people.
But even so, no one raised any objections.
Unexpectedly, Su Lun's expression remained calm as he said, "In a moment, I ask the General and my partners to hold off that wicked dragon, not allowing it any time to rest or catch its breath. Also, attach my rune mark to the back of the Black Dragon."
He had a plan already, hence his unhurried speech.
With people helping, their chances of success were much greater.
Dora frowned upon hearing this, "Just to hold it off?"
She had quickly guessed that Su Lun might have another strategy but didn't ask further, adding instead, "If that's all, it shouldn't be a problem. I have a special industrial adhesive in my possession that can stick to nearly anything. It should be able to stick to dragon scales."
Su Lun smiled slightly at that, "That's even better."
As he spoke, he pulled out several small gemstones engraved with coordinates and handed them to Dora.
Dora then handed them to General Sam beside her, saying, "Uncle Sam, please."
Sam nodded solemnly.
Turning back, Dora looked at Su Lun again.
Seeing the spatial markers, she had already guessed what was coming.
As they were hardly strangers, she directly spoke up, "Do you plan to take action personally?"
"Yes."
Su Lun nodded without elaborating.
He just looked at the distant Black Dragon, which seemed slightly weary, and said, "The self-healing capability of the dragon kind is very strong. We absolutely cannot give it a chance to recover. Now that its malice has dispersed and its combat strength has significantly weakened, we should also start."
"..."
Dora listened without asking further.
At that moment, Number Nineteen, who had been silent at the side, spread her golden wings, transforming into a streak of golden light that rapidly ascended into the sky.
This was part of the hunting plan that she and Su Lun had previously devised.
Now with the help of outsiders, it was better.
The Mafa group, watching this mechanical angel radiating Holy Light up close, had their eyes flash with unusual colors.
Seeing Number Nineteen take off, General Sam, not to be outdone, the magic energy furnace fully charged, "pfft" erupted, sending him rushing towards the direction of the Black Dragon as well.
...
Su Lun and Dora's group remained on the ground.
Those high-ranking military officials from Mafa also understood Su Lun's identity, and seeing their Colonel Dora with this familiar figure, remained silent and stood a bit farther away.
This left space for a private conversation between the two.
Su Lun, known both as the "Reaper" from Dawn Group and as Prince Andreas of the old royal family, was a significant wanted criminal in the Mafa Empire.
But now, with the invasion of another plane, all internal disputes seemed irrelevant.
The two groups could temporarily ally.
But nobody spoke.
The atmosphere wasn't serious, just slightly awkward.
Meanwhile, the battle had begun in the distance.
The wings of the Number Nineteen battle angel, being fragments of a god-tier mechanical limb with strong magic-warding capabilities, suffered almost no damage even when directly hit by the Black Dragon's breath.
General Sam's mechanical battle armor was also equipped with a massive shield which, despite looking cumbersome, could withstand the dragon's fiery breath.
The two of them facing the Black Dragon managed to hold their ground for the time being.
Su Lun, closely watching the battle from afar, felt it might be appropriate to say something and casually remarked, "Your abilities are quite special."
He hadn't expected a straightforward answer.
Unexpectedly, Dora had no intention of hiding anything and directly said, "I have dual talents."
"Oh?"
Su Lun glanced at her, slightly surprised.
In fact, when he saw Dora's limbs turn to metal in an instant, he had guessed this possibility. He had encountered someone with dual talents like himself.
[B-059-Thinker]+[A-043-Metal Devourer]dual talents.
He just hadn't expected she would actually admit it.
And upon hearing about these dual talents, Su Lun suddenly thought of something else.
Legend has it that Lucien Pepys, the founding Grandmaster of the Mechanical Alchemy Guild of the Mafa Empire, had these dual talents.
There were also some quite mystical legends about him.
A thought flashed through his mind; Dora did not dwell on her talents, simply saying, "Your Dawn is very special. We could collaborate in the future."
Listening to the tone of this senior officer, who sounded older than her years, Su Lun felt slightly uncomfortable, but replied, "Sure. I need a group of Mechanics to build a massive mechanical castle. Have any good recommendations?"
"That shouldn't be a problem. Mechanics are the least of what Mafa lacks."
Dora readily agreed and added, "What are you building? Do you have the blueprints?"
She knew that what Su Lun was planning to build was anything but a conventional mechanical castle.
Hearing her agreement, Su Lun also thought this Miss Dora was agreeable, not bearing grudges, and quite noble.
He glanced at the distant battlefield; now was not the time for details, "Let's talk about this later. I'll contact you then."
Dora also adopted a strictly businesslike attitude, "Okay."
Just then, Su Lun suddenly remembered something and reminded, "Oh right, Miss Dora, remember you still owe me an alchemy manuscript."
Mentioning the ransom, Dora's mood soured again.
A barely noticeable frown appeared at the corner of her mouth as she coldly replied, "I also asked for you, that Isaac's Alchemy Manuscript is in the hands of the royal family. But you killed Princess Thirteen, and the royal family doesn't welcome you. Besides, you're from the Lei Jia estate. Even my grandfather's inquiry has brought no results yet. And..."
She paused there, her face showing a hesitant expression, and said, "Never mind, anyway, my family and I will try our best to get it for you."
"..."
Su Lun listened, his expression slightly altered.
The situation seemed a bit complicated.
But knowing where the item was made things half successful.
Just then, a sudden message came through the communicator from Number Nineteen, "It's done!"
Su Lun's gaze sharpened.
He turned to glance at Dora and grinned, "Great! I'll wait for your good news!"
"..."
While Dora found his smile quite annoying, she knew he was about to make his move.
The people of Mafa were very curious about what Su Lun would do.
Although he was a powerful seventh-tier, the Black Dragon was a dominant creature that even eighth-tier professionals were not confident they could defeat.
Under the gaze of the group, Su Lun spread his hands and performed a magic wardrobe change.
Upon looking again, his body was covered in a set of armor that emitted a dark mist, majestic and imposing, like a dragon transformed into human form.
Dragons inherently carry a bloodline-based suppression against lower beings, and the Dragon Scale Armor, forged from the scales of a fearsome dragon, also carried an aura of intimidation, causing the nearby Mafa mechanical warriors to change color uniformly.
To battle with this sinister dragon, the basic requirement was to withstand the Black Dragon's breath.
With this armor, Su Lun now had the assurance he could kill the dragon.
Moreover, because the flame of the [Eternal Furnace] had reignited, Dwarf King Ironhelm Oru had reforged this armor. Now, the defense of this Dragon Scale Armor was incredibly strong.
Dora was shocked for a moment, but the figure before her had already dispersed, and looking again, he had appeared in the midst of the distant battle group.
She then understood where Su Lun's confidence came from.
...
Just like the whale being one of the rulers of the oceanic food chain, it still can do nothing about parasitic barnacles.
Although the Black Dragon was powerful, its back was an attack blind spot.
Number Nineteen and General Sam, during their battle with the sinister dragon, had placed markers with spatial coordinates on the dragon's back.
Su Lun teleported and appeared on the dragon's back.
The Black Dragon immediately noticed the little "bug" on its back and, with a fierce surge, flung the "bug" hundreds of meters away.
Su Lun fell amidst turbulent currents whipped up by the dragon's wings, the sound of wind whistling past his ears.
But he had anticipated this.
This task could only be done by him.
The moment he was flung away, he teleported again, sticking to the dragon's back once more.
The dragon scales were indestructible; the ten thousand men group tried to kill this dragon starting from its rotting parts.
In other areas, even the attacks of Number Nineteen and General Sam hardly left any marks.
But by then, Su Lun had already produced a Crimson Dagger in his hand.
This [Siegfried's Dragon Slayer Dagger]was specifically designed to counter the corruption of giant dragons.
When Su Lun teleported back onto the dragon's back, he stabbed down with a single motion.
The crimson blade of the dagger emitted a visibly sharp aura, and with a quiet "puff" of breaking through the armor, the blade entered, leaving only the hilt visible.
"It's in!"
Su Lun felt elated inside, silently praising the sharpness of the Dragon Slayer Dagger.
As long as it could breach the defenses, he saw the possibility of slaying the Black Dragon.
The Black Dragon, in pain, once again flapped its wings vigorously, diving downward.
Su Lun, having no leverage, was thrown off again.However, because he tightly clenched the handle of the dagger, when he slipped, "Shh!" a sound rang out as a one-meter-long huge gash was carved on the back of the Black Dragon, clearly exposing a large patch of dark flesh writhing under the dragon scales.
Su Lun, seeing that the wound was not healing quickly, was thrilled once again.
Previously, after killing Augustus, he had found a "Dragon Slayer Potion Formula" in that guy's bank vault. These days, after searching everywhere for materials and using some substitutes, he had finally managed to concoct some miraculous powder. This powder was highly effective against dragon-type creatures, capable of suppressing their powerful self-healing abilities. Coupled with the bleeding effect of the Dragon Slayer Dagger itself, it was simply miraculous against dragons.
Now, having tried it in actual combat, the effect was indeed excellent!
The Black Dragon, feeling the pain, realized that this "little insect" was a fatally threatening presence.
After shaking off Su Lun, it turned around and charged ferociously, spewing a breath of dragon fire right at him.
Seeing this, Su Lun teleported again to its back and plunged the dagger in, creating another huge gash.
"Ong~"
An intensely angry dragon's roar erupted, instantly pulverizing the surrounding rocks and trees into dust.
If it weren't for the Dragon Scale Armor, Su Lun felt all his internal organs would have been shattered by the vibration. Even so, he felt a moment of dizziness.
The panel also displayed an effect of "Shock," causing his body to stiffen momentarily.
Following that, a thick acid-like dark dragon's breath was spit out, and Su Lun felt as if the entire world had plunged into darkness.
Indeed, even with such thorough preparations, the situation was fraught with peril.
And this was still a Grudge Black Dragon; if it were a true Black Dragon, things might not have been so straightforward.
But fortunately, the armor was strong enough to completely block the corrosive dragon's breath that could have reduced Su Lun to ashes.
General Sam and Number Nineteen, seeing this, also hurriedly charged back into the fray to tangle with the Black Dragon, giving Su Lun a breather.
Su Lun teleported again and plunged the dagger once more.
As long as the Black Dragon couldn't shake off the other spatial coordinates on its back, Su Lun could always teleport there, no matter where it fled to.
Although there were occasional mishaps, every two or three tries were successful in making a cut.
The three of them cooperated, repeating this process.
The wounds on the Black Dragon multiplied.
But no matter whether it smashed into mountains or dived to the ground, it couldn't shake off the tenacious Su Lun.
From that moment on, the fate of this Black Dragon was sealed.
Though the cuts inflicted on its massive body might not seem significant, the inability to heal quickly added up over time, eventually proving fatal.
...
In the distance, Dora and Mafa's group could only gape in astonishment.
They had never imagined that Su Lun actually possessed genuine "Dragon Slaying Skills."
Watching such extreme maneuvers, they were not only shocked but also realized that only he could execute such tactics.
Even if others possessed the Dragon Slayer Dagger and armor, they couldn't perform such a high-difficulty kill.
After steadily bleeding for nearly an hour, the Black Dragon grew increasingly weaker.
Its roars became deeper, its flying speed slowed, and its breaths grew feeble...
Finally, a sorrowful dragon's cry echoed across the sky, its wings fluttered weakly a few times before suddenly stopping, and the huge dark shadow plummeted from the sky.
With a "thud" of a loud noise.
The forest trembled, the Black Dragon hit the ground, and instantly turned into a pool of black, foul-smelling liquid.
But Su Lun, with sharp eyes, spotted a glowing object within that pool of liquid. It appeared to be a fragment, carved with snake scales.
"It's really here."
A gleam of joy flashed in Su Lun's eyes.
Upon inspection, this fragment indeed was a quarter of the [Urobolos Fragment]!
He picked it up without any hesitation.
At that moment, General Sam and Number Nineteen also descended.
To their surprise, the cursed space of the Black Dragon didn't collapse.
Only Su Lun had an idea, but he wasn't inclined to explain.
However, a black spatial vortex slowly formed above the Black Dragon's corpse, signaling the exit.
At that moment, Dora and the group of mechanical warriors came running over.
Staring at the exit, their expressions remained serious but a hint of relief from surviving a catastrophe flickered through their eyes.
Dora contemplated for a moment, then said to Su Lun, "Lord Su Lun, since the situation outside is unclear, we'll go ahead."
This was a cursed space officially recorded by the Mafa authorities, and she understood that it surely contained top-tier treasures.
But after all, their survival depended on Su Lun and another.
Even though they had provided a little help earlier, it was actually for their own sake.
They had no reason to share any of the spoils here.
Hearing this, Su Lun grew even more impressed with the Miss, smiling, "Good! See you next time."
Indeed, the daughters of major families were different, high in thought and consciousness. If it were adventurers or the like, faced with the temptation of precious treasures, it would probably lead to a messy internal squabble.
Dora, feeling that their next meeting might not bode well, responded faintly with an "Mhm," and stepped into the twisted portal without any reluctance.
As she left, General Sam and the others followed in quick succession.
The scene was then left with only Su Lun and Number Nineteen.
The battle was over, the army of ten thousand mages was almost completely annihilated, and the Black Dragon was vanquished, as if all the pressure had evaporated.
Number Nineteen, looking at the black water on the ground, asked, "What now?"
There was no need for pleasantries between them; Su Lun directly said, "Stay here and make sure none of those mages get out. I'm heading to the Dwarf Underground City."
Number Nineteen, guessing what he intended to do, nodded.
With a teleport, the surroundings shifted instantly, and Su Lun appeared in a dark environment.
...
Although the underground city was blasted apart, it was a precise demolition, with only the grand hall where the Black Dragon was located collapsing, while the corridors and such were still intact.
Su Lun had come here not only coveting the treasures but also seeking to uncover the secrets hidden within this cursed space.
The curse had not dissipated, which meant the resentment of the Dwarf King still lingered.
This cursed space was quite unique.
It was the most unique one he had ever encountered.
When Su Lun had just obtained the fragment of Urobolos from the corpse of the Black Dragon, he distinctly felt that the cursed space was established through this fragment.
It gave him the same sensation as when he had acquired the plane crystal that formed the Mirror Library before.
Moreover, he just checked and found that he held three fragments in his hand, which exactly assembled into the complete Divine Artifact of the Divine King—the "Urobolos Space-Time Ring".
However, since they were shattered, they held no special effects and were still just three "fragments".
With his current knowledge, Su Lun could only identify them as having "information beyond understanding", barely making out some fluctuations of space-time laws.
He thought to ask if the resentment of the Dwarf King could possibly repair it.
Following the path he had taken before, the soul fluctuations of the Dwarf King were still deep underground.
Going downstairs, he saw that Dwarf King, Iron Helmet Orl, sitting by the furnace lost in thought.
Upon hearing footsteps, he lamented, "Young man, you've come. I didn't expect you really slew that dreadful dragon..."
Noticing that Big Beard Dwarf seemed to be waiting for him, Su Lun directly asked, "Your Highness, the Dwarf King, were you waiting for me?"
Iron Helmet Orl replied, "Yes. I wanted to thank you for slaying the dragon that enslaved my dwarven people. I'd also like to entrust you to deliver some items to my kin."
He was merely a wisp of resentment. With the Black Dragon's death, his obsession should have faded as well.
He seemed to recall even more about his identity as the Dwarf King.
Su Lun quietly waited for more to be said, yet he clenched the rune black umbrella in his hand.
Iron Helmet Orl took out a rune iron hammer, a golden tome, a scroll, and pointing at the burning forge in front of him, he said, "I want you to deliver our mountain dwarf tribe's heritage items to my people."
The hammer was the "Forge Hammer of the Dwarf King"; the golden tome was naturally the "Runic Book of the Dwarven Tribe" that Su Lun had seen before; the path was the "Eternal Forge"... all were treasure inheritances of the mountain dwarves.
Su Lun was not surprised.
However, he felt a slight familiarity with that scroll because he had one just like it.
A dismissal revealed it as a "Divine Contract Scroll"!
The scroll was spread open, and he read the text on it at once.
The content was a treaty of alliance between the Dawn Era Empire and the mountain dwarf tribe, respecting each other, equal...
The one who signed it, clearly a dwarven name, "Barrel High Hill".
And the other, "Andreas Libavius," one of the five elders of the Dusk Cross Society. After this name, there was even a casually written symbol "⍥"!
What was special was that the background of the scroll, like a watermark, was of an ouroboros, its details exactly matching the "Urobolos Space-Time Ring"!
Seeing the text on the scroll, Su Lun's pupils dilated sharply: Was this the treaty that the five elders of the Dawn Era and a God-tier Dwarf King of the mountain dwarves had signed?!
Iron Helmet Orl, noticing Su Lun's gaze on the treaty, said while stroking it, "Our mountain dwarf tribe has never forgotten our ancestors' teachings and has followed the treaty through generations. Our faith in the treaty is as unbreakable as an anvil. We also hope to coexist peacefully with you humans. After all, alchemy and the dwarven tribe share a profound connection. But..."
He did not continue, instead saying, "I want to say, you take it to my people. Tell them, if one day humans are willing to follow the content of the treaty again, our mountain dwarf tribe will still honor our promise and become the staunchest ally of the alchemy civilization."
Su Lun listened and slightly furrowed his brow.
The age of Alchemy had been severed countless times, and it was feared that no human would remember this covenant.
Moreover, in the eyes of today's adventurers, the mountain dwarves were just a group of wealthy "miners".
Only upon understanding the covenant did Su Lun realize that such an agreement had existed between the two races in the Dawn Era.
But reality didn't allow him much time to think; a thought flashed through his mind, and he replied instantly, "Yes!"
Iron Helm Orr watched Su Lun and smiled slightly, then suddenly exclaimed admiringly, "Young man, you are impressive. Entrust these artifacts of inheritance to my people, and you will gain our Dwarf Clan's friendship."
Watching the Dwarf King convey his final wishes, the lucidity in his eyes seemed to fade more and more.
Su Lun hurriedly took out a few fragments and asked, "Your Highness, the Dwarf King, may I ask one more thing? Could you help me repair this artifact?"
Iron Helm Orr's consciousness seemed as though it was about to dissipate, but upon seeing the Divine Artifact fragments, he immediately became excited, as if revived, "The Urobolos Space-Time Ring? My goodness, you've actually gathered its fragments!"
At that moment, the Dwarf King seemed to remember something but ultimately, it was only fleeting, and upon deeper contemplation, a hint of confusion emerged, "This is a Divine King Artifact forged for Lord Andreas by our dwarven ancestors...Sadly, it's a treasure that contains the 'Space-time Law.' To repair it, one needs cosmic origin materials related to space-time."
Su Lun had anticipated this and immediately took out the "Sand of Time" and the "Planar Fragments."
These were the most precious space-time related treasures he possessed.
Iron Helm Orr looked at the materials and exclaimed in surprise, "Oh, I didn't expect you to have such divine-tier materials."
However, he immediately changed his tone, "Although these materials are rare, I'm afraid they are still far inferior to this Divine King Artifact. Moreover, I'm sorry to say, my forging skills aren't sufficient to repair such a high-tier artifact."
Listening, Su Lun couldn't hide his disappointment. Were the fragments coveted by the gods going to collect dust again?
But just as this thought arose, Iron Helm Orr added, "However, with these materials, I could attempt to bond it. Perhaps it could restore a trace of this artifact's divine power...But I can't guarantee it."
With that, he asked, "Are you willing to use such precious materials for this attempt?"
Hearing this, Su Lun immediately knew it was a great opportunity, and without any hesitation, he said, "Yes, please go ahead!"
