A plump woman who looked like an ordinary farmer could effortlessly load several hundred pounds of goods onto a cart; a muscular blacksmith barehandedly subdued a Dragon Scale Horse that weighed tons to force horseshoes onto it; even the slender slaves working on the city walls could carry several hundred pounds of rock and still move swiftly...
The people were generally tall and muscular.
"The land nurtures its people," Su Lun figured this might have a direct relation to the gigantism of the creatures in these seas. Dr. Banks would probably find this phenomenon more interesting.
After wandering around, Tatu asked, "Mr. Su Lun, where are we heading now?"
Su Lun thought for a moment and replied, "Let's head to the Adventurers' Tavern first."
There were many adventurers in the city, so there must be places for entertainment and leisure.
Such spots were also good for gathering information.
He planned to inquire about the "Petrification Curse Potion" and the news about the blue dragon.
However, as they walked, a simple-looking middle-aged couple passed by with a cart full of apples.
That was perfectly ordinary.
Su Lun took a sidelong glance because there was actually someone hiding in the cart.
Because he paid attention, he took a closer look.
The cart headed toward the city gate. Suddenly, a group of guards riding Dragon Scale Horses swiftly pursued it. They dismounted quickly, overturned the cart and out tumbled a golden-haired girl with eyes filled with terror.
Seeing their scheme exposed, the middle-aged couple knelt on the ground, desperately begging.
"No, please, have mercy, don't take Sofia away!"
"Oh, selfish and foolish ones, still trying to flee? Do you know how many deaths your actions will bring to our great Town Lord?"
"No, please, Sofia is only sixteen years old..."
"Without a satisfying sacrifice, disasters will come to Atalan City! Get out of the way!"
"..."
The guards disregarded the couple's pleas, threw a bag of coins aside, and forcefully abducted the young girl.
Su Lun and his companions frowned deeply at the sight.
Lolota was especially indignant, with her hand already on the hilt of her sword, as if ready to strike at a moment's notice.
Tatu further complained, "Humans are so cruel to their own kind."
No matter how you look at it, this was a noble abusing a young girl.
But the previous conversation had led Su Lun and Qian Tiao to deep thoughts.
Only after those guards had left did the onlooking residents dare to discuss it among themselves.
"Alas, pity the girl from the Clayton family. That evil dragon has awakened, and only by sacrificing a young girl and treasures will it not set its wrath upon our city."
"The evil dragon from Thunder Sea Island? Hasn't it been dormant for over a decade? Why has it suddenly awakened?"
"Don't you know? Something happened to the south yesterday. It sounded like thunder. Haven't you seen the influx of adventurers into the town today? Some guess that some relic or treasure has surfaced, and those fellows are swarming in. The crowd will only get bigger over the next few days..."
"..."
As long as it wasn't their own family being taken, these residents seemed to be doing nothing more than discussing it without feeling it was inappropriate.
This was a more ancient lordship system than Burying, with the town lord owning everything about the citizenry.
Tatu translated these conversations for them.
Upon hearing this, the trio Su Lun gathered that it was about the sacrificial offering to that blue dragon.
Su Lun whispered, "It seems that this affair has arisen because of us."
The cannon fire from yesterday had disturbed that blue dragon, leading to the need for a sacrifice.
It appeared that the people of Atalan City had done this more than once before.
If they couldn't defeat it, they'd offer a tribute. This rule applied to both humans and magical beasts.
Off to the side, Qian Tiao's eyes glittered fiercely, her hand casually resting on the handle of her sword, obviously unafraid to fight.
But since it was a sacrifice, for the moment, there was no immediate threat of death. Su Lun thought it over and, without rushing to a decision, said, "Let's go take a look at the situation first."
The group then headed towards the tavern filled with adventurers.
...
Before long, they arrived at the adventurer's tavern.
This place was the liveliest in the town.
Even though it was broad daylight, the tavern was packed with people, and the noisy chatter filled the air.
Atalan City wasn't large, and the adventurer's tavern also served as the adventurers' guild. Mercenary groups would also post adventure bounties here, calling for comrades.
Su Lun and his group found a bustling tavern and walked straight in.
Although Tatu knew the common language of the Dragon Country, this was his first time in a human tavern and he was a bit out of his element.
Su Lun, on the other hand, acted as if he was well-acquainted with the place, and even though he couldn't understand the language, he was a qualified patron.
He pointed at the drinks on a nearby table and threw out two silver coins.
The tip was generous, and the bartender cheerfully brought over the drink.
The four of them took a seat in a corner.
Once the drinks were on the table, Su Lun took a swig and found the flavor to be surprisingly good.
The drink was translated as "Dragon Barley Wine," a local specialty.
Both he and Qian Tiao had good tolerance and guzzled down a large glass.
Lolo Tata and Tatu, on the other hand, sipped lightly and delicately.
They chatted while they drank.
Tatu listened intently to the conversations around and translated any important information he overheard from the patrons.
The most talked-about topic among the patrons was naturally yesterday's "strange noise," as that area was a dangerous sea zone where few dared to venture.
Mostly, they speculated.
Su Lun also kept an eye on his surroundings. But what surprised him was that the top spot on the tavern's bounty board was taken by a material collection quest.
It was a royal bounty offering a hefty sum for "Tears of Death" and "Dragon Breath Fruit."
Before he could get curious and ask around, the adventurers seemed more interested in the material task that the royal family had promised could be compensated with "any request."
"Hey! Old Tut, why is the royal family posting a bounty for two materials?"
"Oh, it's said that Her Majesty the Queen has been cursed with petrification by a vicious witch and urgently needs those materials for a potion to save her life."
"Ah... a witch? Which witch could hurt the Queen?"
"Indeed. It's the infamous Helen."
"Helen? The 'Most Beautiful Woman of Pania' that His Majesty the King snatched from Pania Kingdom? Isn't she highly favored by His Majesty the King? How did she become a witch?"
"Isn't it strange? The temple's seer had long prophesied that she was a witch who would bring a catastrophe to the kingdom. Her beauty provoked a war between two countries and made Her Majesty the Queen endure the pain of the curse. The royal family decided to burn her at the stake, but who would have thought that the witch seemed to be unafraid of the flames? She didn't die from the execution by fire; instead, she escaped. Now her whereabouts are unknown."
"Oh! No wonder there was a warrant for her arrest at the city gate. I was curious why they were hunting a beautiful woman, but it turns out to be her..."
"..."
When it comes to a beautiful woman, us adventurers immediately become interested.
Tatu translated the words of those people.
Su Lun listened, not interested in any witch, but hadn't expected that this ingredient seemed to be the recipe for "petrification antidote"?
But it wasn't surprising either.
The original plan was to try Atalan City and if that failed, head straight to the capital.
In a Lord society, the royal family has everything.
If there really was a recipe for a petrification antidote, it would undoubtedly be in the hands of those with power.
Tatu was also excited, having just arrived and already obtaining the information she was looking for.
But she immediately frowned, troubled, "If it's these two ingredients, then it's going to be troublesome."
If even the royal family was searching for them, they must naturally be rare materials.
Listening, Su Lun questioned, and casually asked, "What are these two ingredients?"
Alchemy Magicians know various materials.
But due to civilization differences, sometimes the names can be different.
In his little void world, the material warehouse was piled high like a mountain, and he felt he might already have them.
After thinking for a moment, Tatu said, "Death's Tears are the tears of a Lord-level undead. But such high-tier undead creatures usually don't shed tears. Once they do, theirs are the most pure essences of energy in the world... This is an extremely extremely rare material."
"Undead Tears?"
Upon hearing this description, Su Lun immediately recalled for a moment.
And as it happened, he realized that he indeed had them!
He once obtained a material called "Alice's Tears" in the cursed space of the White Monastery at Dawn Relic, weren't those the tears of a Lord-level undead?
However, without seeing the detailed recipe, he couldn't confirm whether the properties were the same.
Without further ado, Su Lun asked again, "And what about Dragon Breath Fruit?"
Tatu continued, "It's a fruit that only exists in dragon's nests. It grows where dragons sleep and takes at least a hundred years to mature. It is said, the purer the dragon's bloodline, the better the efficacy of the Dragon Breath Fruit."
"Oh."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun's mind instantly flashed with some thoughts.
To solve a petrification curse of the same caliber as the Gorgon's, the materials would certainly not be ordinary; it was only logical for these two items to be sought after.
Indeed, they were hard to find.
No wonder the royal family issued a bounty.
As they spoke, those revelers at the tavern began to discuss the Dragon Breath Fruit.
"Hey, you guys think, with the unlimited bounty posted by the royal family, will the 'Dragon Hunter' come to Atalan?"
"Who knows. Anyway, I heard the royal Dragon Knight brigade is coming over. After all, the cursed blue dragon on Thunder Sea Island is a pureblood, and its nest most likely contains a high-quality Dragon Breath Fruit."
"Hehe, even if it really does, getting ahold of it is impossible! Even dragon riders can't escape the blue dragon's pursuit. It's as fast as lightning, and can return to its nest in an instant, even if it's out at sea. No one can get it..."
"If 'Dragon Hunter' Bartolo Figaro came, perhaps he'd have the ability to kill that evil dragon. Too bad the guy's whereabouts are unpredictable, and he does whatever he pleases. No kind of payment can bring him out..."
"..."
Tatu translated these conversations as well.
Destroying villages, having been injured by the Knight brigade... The adventurers spoke of some history involving the dragon.
Su Lun also made an estimation of the blue dragon's rank in his heart. He guessed it was most likely a seventh-tier dragon, whose combat power was at the peak of eighth-tier professionals, on the verge of ninth-tier?
Because it was an electric attribute, it made it all the more tricky.
That being said, there seemed to be an opportunity.
What others couldn't do, he could!
Su Lun thought, if that evil dragon left its cave, couldn't he just swing by for a visit?
Then wouldn't the Dragon Breath Fruit be within easy reach?
Moreover, he could even lure the blue dragon to Rainbow Island and let those Mage groups heavily injure it?
With his previous experience hunting dragons in the "Dwarf King's Resentment" cursed space, Su Lun felt that this plan was entirely feasible.
But considering the clever cunning of real-life dragons, he had to think things through carefully.
As Su Lun thought about it, numerous strategies flashed through his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 529 - 528 [Medusa's Serpentine Staff]
chapters.content:
Su Lun and his three companions quietly drank in a corner of the tavern.
They also felt that this trip to Atalan City had been very worthwhile, as they had acquired a great deal of critical information.
The sacrifice would take place in a few days. When that evil dragon roared again to remind the people, they would send out treasures and the sacrificial maiden over the sea for the evil dragon's enjoyment.
Su Lun and his companions still had plenty of time to prepare.
However, the information gained from the tavern, although plentiful, was limited.
Commoners and adventurers could hardly access some of the more high-end information.
For example, as soon as Su Lun heard about "Helen" being struck by the petrification curse, he felt there was something fishy about it—likely some sort of royal scandal.
But compared to the excited tavern chatter about "Pania Kingdom's number one beauty," Su Lun was more curious about how the Queen of the Silver Dragon Country fell under the curse. Wasn't petrification a natural ability of the Gorgons with serpentine hair?
But, this was all secondary.
What was important was that Su Lun had confirmed that the Silver Dragon Country's royal family indeed possessed a formula to undo petrification.
Although he guessed that the ingredients needed for the formula would be difficult to find, there was still great hope for solving his mother Tanni's curse.
...
Before long, the four of them drank up and left the tavern.
They planned to find a place to stay first and stick around the city for the night.
However, not long after they exited the tavern, Tatu suddenly noticed something. She glanced at Qian Tiao and said, "Teacher, it seems we're being watched."
Upon hearing that, Tatu became a bit tense.
For the Naga people, being discovered in human territory was not a good outcome—they were likely to be captured, enslaved, and sold.
"Oh."
Qian Tiao responded lazily, completely unconcerned.
Su Lun also showed no change in expression.
In fact, he knew during the drinking earlier that they were being watched.
Despite all the adventurers in the tavern dressed weirdly, the four of them, even though they were in a corner and cloaked, looked quite odd upon closer inspection.
No matter where they were, there was no shortage of those local bullies looking to scheme and exploit.
The streets of the city were very narrow. As they walked out of the tavern and into an alley, they could already hear the footsteps of those ready to ambush them.
Su Lun thought about it and decided not to cause unnecessary trouble.
With a pinch of his sorcerer's seals, a spatial gateway appeared in front of him, and the four stepped through.
At almost the same moment, in that alley, seven or eight nefarious-looking individuals ran into each other at both ends,
The skinny, sleazy man with a goatee who took the lead looked at the deserted alley, puzzled, and said, "Strange, where have they gone?"
...
Su Lun and his companions stepped out and found themselves in another deserted alley a few streets away.
Atalan City had many adventurers and plenty of inns.
They had not walked far when they noticed an inn with the sign "Beast Knights Inn."
They rented a room, intending to stay just for the night.
But they had not expected the living conditions in the Dragon Country to be so deplorable.
The inn looked to be one of the better ones in the city, but besides a few wooden beds, there were virtually no other furnishings in the room.
Compared to Senior Councilor Lu Ying's inn, this place was as rudimentary as a stable.
Furthermore, it seemed that the people of the city didn't have the habit of bathing, as the inn had no private bathrooms. Not to mention bathrooms, even latrines were just wooden buckets.
The windows embedded in the stone walls were very small, leading to poor air circulation, which caused a fusion of odd smells to always linger in the inn.
In the room, all four of them frowned slightly.
Luckily for Su Lun, the inn was merely a place for meditation in a different location, so the poor conditions weren't much of an issue.
After Tatu made the beds, the four prepared to rest.
Qian Tiao, feeling very bored as she had wanted to take a bath at the inn and was utterly disappointed, sat idle for less than half an hour before she picked up her knife and strapped it to her waist.
With a sudden excited demeanor, as if she had thought of something fun, this gambling-addicted woman turned to Su Lun and said, "Su Lun, you guys rest. I'm going to go out for a bit."
Su Lun couldn't help but laugh and cry at her predictable behavior.
Tatu, knowing her teacher's intentions, asked, "Ah... Teacher, are you sure you'll understand what they're saying in the gambling house?"
Qian Tiao, with a look of someone who knows the ropes, raised an eyebrow and responded, "Watching the size of the dice doesn't require understanding others' words."
She had been pent up during the time on the ship.
Gambling ultimately required betting with strangers to be thrilling; the sensation of risking one's entire fortune was no less exciting than risking one's life, something that couldn't be experienced gambling with acquaintances.
Su Lun didn't say much and simply reminded her with a smile, "Alright. Just remember not to draw your knife first if something happens."
Qian Tiao now had top-tier strength. Language barriers would at most cause some inconvenience, but it wouldn't be dangerous.
After all, she only had this little pastime.
Qian Tiao casually responded, "Got it."
Tatu asked, "Miss Qian Tiao, do you need me to accompany you?"
Tatu also said, "Teacher, do you want me to come with you?"
"No need."
As she spoke, Qian Tiao had already slammed the door of the room shut.
Finally, at a gambling house where she knew no one, she didn't want anyone disturbing her gambling mood.
...
After Qian Tiao left, the room quieted down.
Su Lun and the two others each meditated in their own way, rather leisurely.
But this peaceful scene didn't last long. Around midnight, a group of seven or eight guys made their way to the front of the inn, sneaking around surreptitiously.
Su Lun, whose perception was always extended outward, immediately recognized these fellows as the ones who had been eyeing them earlier at the tavern.
He wasn't surprised that the locals had found their accommodations.
Seeing that these thugs had already let them off once but were still looking for trouble, Su Lun's expression grew darker.
When they reached the door, Lolo Tanni noticed them as well.
She glanced at Su Lun, seemingly asking if they should take action.
Su Lun shook his head and continued his cross-legged meditation.
Hearing no response from within the room, the outsiders assumed they were asleep and, believing they hadn't been noticed, silently took out their tools and began to pick the lock. They were evidently not amateurs at such misdeeds.
The gang burst in, and the dim light of the essential oil lamp cast flickering shadows over several faces.
The Goatee-sporting skinny lecher at the forefront was a bit taken aback. Were these people not asleep?
However, he quickly changed his tune and said, "Town patrol inspection, hey~ where are you folks from?"
The intruders, upon seeing Tatu and Lolo Tanni's alluring figures and not wearing cloaks, also revealed a lecherous glint in their eyes.
In Atalan City, outsiders without any backing were merely sheep awaiting slaughter.
Tatu even attempted to translate the question.
But Su Lun shook his head, not intending to waste time with idle talk. He simply said indifferently, "Tell them to leave the room now. Otherwise, they die."
With his current level of spiritual power, he didn't need to converse to understand the intentions of ordinary people; a single glance was enough.
That malevolent gaze did not escape Su Lun's notice; how could he not know that these thugs harbored thoughts of murder and robbery?
Having let them off once before and now seeing them return, he found the repeated targeting quite troublesome and decided to eliminate this nuisance once and for all.
Even though Tatu translated his words diplomatically, "My master does not appreciate disturbances. Please leave, or we will have to be inhospitable..."
These gentle words of persuasion seemed only to convince the local toughs that they were an easy mark.
They feigned outrage, as though provoked, and suddenly drew the weapons at their waists.
The skinny man with the Goatee saw that Su Lun was unfazed and deduced he might have some skills, but he sneered fearlessly, bringing up his own connections, "Heh, you dare to make a move in this town? Let me tell you, the Deputy Commander of the City Guard is my brother-in-law, and the Town Lord is also..."
But before he could finish his sentence, they saw the figure meditating on the bed suddenly disperse into the air.
Then, before the seven or eight people could react, Su Lun had already appeared behind them.
In the dim room, a sinister black light spread, and a chilling, terrifying presence quickly suffused the area.
In an instant, a cold sharpness stabbed at their backs, as life swiftly slipped away.
In the face of Death, life was as fragile as a stalk of rice.
In their final moments, the local thugs looked back in horror, their terrified eyes reflecting the shadow of a cloaked figure wielding a scythe.
The eerie black light vanished as quickly as it had appeared.
Dealing with a group of almost third or fourth-tier robbers took but a moment.
Su Lun harvested their souls without a sound and left no trace in the room.
After absorbing their memories, Su Lun murmured to himself in an epiphany, "So they were indeed emboldened..."
Only then did he realize that these men weren't foolish; they were simply too accustomed to rampant arrogance.
In the eyes of these local thugs, those staying in an inn surely weren't nobles.
If they were adventurers or merchants, the local thugs were used to bullying them anyway.
After all, this skinny leader did have some genuine connections to the Town Lord, and someone would have his back if things escalated.
But they had never imagined they would encounter a formidable outsider from the open sea.
Compared to those nepotistic connections, Su Lun found something even more interesting in those memories: the Town Lord of Atalan was surnamed "Rodriguez"?
....
It seemed that nobles everywhere weren't much different.
They liked to constantly talk about their family's ancient history, to distinguish themselves from the common folks.
Therefore, from the memories he had just stripped away, Su Lun also learned that this Lord Bald was from a once-prosperous royal family among the nine great kingdoms of Dragon Country—a lineage ancient as years passed.
What Su Lun found coincidental was that one of the Senior Councilors Lu Ying, was from the "Rodriguez family."
And more coincidentally, after harvesting the memories of that old monster August, Su Lun found this Map of Dragon Country's Sea Area and learned that Lu Ying's Rodriguez family originated from this region.
"Could they really be from the same lineage?"
A rush of thoughts passed through Su Lun's mind, and he felt the chances were high.
Big Shots rarely coincidentally shared a surname.
Moreover, in the soul of that skinny man, Su Lun discovered an intriguing memory: there was a secret treasure vault in the lord's mansion.
A powerful noble ruling the area would have even more useful data and intelligence.
Thinking of this, his eyes shifted, and he said to Tatu and Lolo Tanni beside him, "I'm going to the Town Lord's mansion. Wait here for me."
The thugs had come secretly, and they died quietly, so the inn wouldn't pose any problems for the moment.
```
Even if there were any issues, they were minor.
Lolota obediently responded, "All right, Mr. Su Lun."
"Ah... oh."
As they were about to leave, Tatu, who stood to one side, reacted for a moment, coming back to his senses as Su Lun spoke.
She had truly been stunned just now.
Several suspicious-looking men had burst in, and she had thought a fierce battle was about to ensue, but who could have imagined it would end so quietly?
It was the first time she had seen Su Lun take action.
She had never imagined that the refined and composed Mr. Su Lun could be as terrifying as the god of death.
Su Lun smiled, a ripple in the space passed, and he had already disappeared from the room.
As he walked away, Tatu finally felt the heart palpitations, akin to being accompanied by the god of death, fade and weakly asked, "Miss Lolota, just how formidable is Mr. Su Lun?"
Lolota blinked and laughed, "I can't quite explain it. But super impressive, for sure."
...
There were no streetlights in the city, and the night was pitch black save for the occasional dots of candlelight.
The souls of the eight ruffians contained no valuable intelligence, but they did know every alley and street of Atalan clearly.
Su Lun teleported along his way, quickly arriving outside the highest castle in the city center.
The castle was completely isolated from the common residential areas by its tall walls.
Green vines crawled over the white stone walls while guards constantly watched over the ramparts from the arrow towers.
After sensing the spatial structure, although there were magical warning measures, they seemed virtually nonexistent in Su Lun's eyes, and he teleported directly inside.
As soon as he left, several magic beasts with keen senses of smell ran over, sniffed around the area, and finding nothing, they left again.
Su Lun didn't wander aimlessly in the castle but teleported directly into the study.
Unlike the simplicity of the common residences, the study was decorated in ultimate luxury, with various gold and silver objects everywhere to be seen.
There were also shelves full of various tomes.
Even if nobles were illiterate, they would still collect all kinds of books in their studies.
Su Lun gave them a cursory glance.
Because he had incidentally acquired the common language of the Dragon Country, he immediately spotted various titles.
"Beast Taming Skills," "History of Niguna Civilization," "The Nine Kingdoms," "Rodriguez's Dragon Slayer Warrior Tales"...
Seeing the same dragon emblem that signified nobility, Su Lun was certain that the lord of Atalan City and Senior Councilor Lu Ying's Rodriguez were from the same lineage.
The skinny ruffian and the wife of Lord Bald's butler were related, and although he relied on the lord's mansion for food, he was also coveting the treasures within the castle.
That led him to find out from the butler that there might be an entrance to the lord's secret chamber within this study.
The study was full of magic traps, and it wouldn't have been easy to find the entrance.
But for Su Lun's spatial ability, it was more than easy.
His gaze settled on the oil painting of the lord behind the mahogany desk.
The picture depicted a noble dressed figure with a goatee and a fat face, who was none other than Lord Bald.
Su Lun ignored the intricate alarm mechanisms, sensing the location of the passage behind it.
He asked the black crow on his shoulder, and the old crow indicated there was no danger.
Su Lun teleported through.
On inspection, he found a dark staircase descending below, with a not-so-small space sensed underground.
"There's actually someone here?"
In Su Lun's perception, dozens of meters below, there was a rather large space with more than ten souls fluctuating within.
He initially thought it might be a secret prison, but upon teleporting over, he was greeted by a ghastly red scene.
The space featured an altar made of human bones, with magic formations of red flesh, and the air was thick with the stench of blood.
Carvings that resembled hellish demons adorned the surrounding walls, and the chamber blatantly radiated nauseating waves of chaotic spiritual power.
"An altar to an Evil God?"
The sight was increasingly familiar to Su Lun, and his brow furrowed.
It was clear to him that the lord of the city was secretly worshipping some Evil God.
The dozen individuals were sacrifices to the Evil God, hanging from the stone walls, slowly being drained of blood. The piled skeletons made it unknown just how many commoners the Rodriguez family had sacrificed.
Su Lun had thought this was just an ordinary noble, but hidden within was this terrible spectacle.
No matter what that man worshipped the Evil God for, the mere act of sacrificing humans was certainly the work of an Evil God.
Su Lun didn't rush to destroy the Formation but teleported again, deeper down.
He then arrived in front of a magic stone door and, inspecting the magical inscriptions, let out a light sound of surprise, "Huh... there's a spatial prohibition too?"
The door's prohibitions were highly sophisticated, truly reflective of the once royal heritage.
Su Lun used the power of the "Space-Time Ring of Urobolos" to teleport right past it.
Once inside, he was met with a dazzling array of gold and silver.
"This rich?"
Su Lun looked at the small mountain of amassed treasure and was slightly surprised, gaining a new perspective on the lord of Atalan City, a town of just over a hundred thousand inhabitants.
This treasure was likely worth more than if the entire town were sold ten times over.
```
However, Su Lun wasn't very interested in the ordinary gold and silver treasures; he turned his gaze toward the special items instead.
Common gold and silver treasures along with agate steamed and piled up on the ground, probably a few dozen cases.
In the secret chamber, there were also some wooden shelves, on which were placed some high-level Demon Cores, gemstones, Dou Qi secret techniques, knight's breathing methods, martial techniques, and so on—things that were obviously more valuable.
But Su Lun's eyes were drawn to a long, conspicuous sealed box placed in the most eye-catching position.
The box was about one meter twenty, with densely packed symbols that looked like gold inlay craftsmanship. Evil
Su Lun was greatly surprised at the sight and thought to himself, "This is... a divine level seal?"
The seal on the box was very advanced, and it was clearly an alchemical Sealing Skill, not magic.
Did Dragon Country still have an alchemical system?
Upon appraisal, the name was displayed.
[Sealed Sovereignty Treasure Box]
Details: The treasure box that once symbolized the royal power of Dragon Country's nine great kingdoms; a ninth-order Blood Demon Rune seal, only the fresh blood of the Rodriguez family can open it.
"Blood Demon Rune?"
Su Lun murmured to himself.
From what he knew of such sealing runes in this system, they were usually used to seal very dangerous things.
A treasure box that symbolizes royal power, did it need such a high-grade seal?
Looking at this box, he immediately guessed that it must contain something extraordinary.
And looking at the "corrosion runes" that hadn't been opened for countless years, Su Lun was puzzled again. It was like the dragon language magic box he had obtained in Lington before, which hadn't been opened by anyone for at least a few hundred years.
But since the Town Lord was a member of the Rodriguez family, why hadn't he opened it?
Was it that he couldn't open it? Or that he shouldn't open it?
Su Lun's mind was full of doubts.
But the blood of the Rodriguez family was the key to unleashing the seal... didn't he just happen to have Augustus's body in his hand?
Thinking about trying it out, if anything unusual happened, this secret vault was the best place to be.
As the thought struck him, he directly took out Augustus's body and smeared the fresh blood on the box.
Upon another look, the entire box's magical runes lit up.
The box opened a crack, as if something extremely dangerous was about to emerge into the world, and a mysterious aura rushed forth.
Su Lun was on high alert, ready to teleport away at a moment's notice, but the crow on his shoulder was entirely calm.
He just watched patiently.
However, the bad situation he expected didn't happen, and the box opened smoothly.
Inside was a scepter with a golden carving of a snake.
The serpent appeared lifelike, its scales clearly visible.
This was not long for a scepter, and it exuded a sense of "sanctity," "dignity," "supremacy,"... and even a hint of danger.
Su Lun felt this was the most exquisite gold carving he had ever seen.
Upon appraisal, it turned out to be a legendary cursed object!
[Medusa's Serpentine Staff]
Grade: Legendary
Description: Curse of the earth, this is the power of gods;
Cursed Features: Accumulate the power of the earth (9999/9999), using this staff can activate 'Petrification Curse,' turning all creatures not exceeding the artifact's own law into stone; Those not mastering the corresponding level of Earthly Law will suffer the curse's backlash and petrify themselves;
Details: A Great Alchemist, Martin de Rio, once slew a divine-ranked gorgon and refined its serpentine hair into nine Scepters of Sovereignty for the human kings of the nine great kingdoms; the scepters symbolized power, as well as the strength to confront dragons; releasing all accumulated energy could likely petrify an eighth-order dragon;
"Can petrify an eighth-order dragon? That strong?"
Su Lun's eyes lit up, and his blood surged with excitement, "What a treasure!"
The staff, having not been used for hundreds of years, was fully charged.
As for the curse's backlash, others might fear it, but an undead like himself didn't worry about it in the slightest.
Seeing the staff, Su Lun immediately realized that he had acquired another formidable weapon.
He hadn't expected that a casual visit would result in the discovery of such a priceless treasure.
Since he was a follower of an Evil God, there was no need for courtesy.
Originally, he just wanted to see if he could find any information about a petrification potion, but now it seemed he should take on the role of a thief.
....
But just at the moment he opened the box, the crow on his shoulder let out a "caw," warning him of danger.
Su Lun immediately realized the danger did not come from the scepter or any guards, but rather, something in the vast beyond had taken notice of him.
"Strange... Could it be that some false god related to this scepter has noticed me?"
Su Lun guessed in his mind.
He quickly threw the scepter into the small void world, and that feeling immediately vanished.
Taking advantage of the situation before being discovered, Su Lun swiftly emptied all the treasures of the treasury.
Then, after exiting, he rescued the dozen or so sacrifices, destroyed the Evil God's altar, and casually fed the power-gathering stele to Pandora as nourishment.
On his way out, he ransacked all the books in the study, then set a fire to completely erase any traces.
By the time the commotion of the fire started in the Lord's mansion, Su Lun had already teleported back to the inn, as if he had never left.

chapters.title: Chapter 530 - 529 "Dragon Hunter" Bartolo Figaro
chapters.content:
"So the 'Town Lord of Atalan City' isn't actually from the 'Rodriguez Royal Family', but is a descendant of the royal servants?"
After reading the diary, Su Lun suddenly understood.
Having returned to his room in the inn and with no one coming to look for him, he spent his time perusing the texts he had taken from the Town Lord's mansion.
Then, he discovered an ancient family diary.
After reading it, he found out that the current Town Lord was, in fact, a pretender, a destitute member of the royal lineage.
Originally, the true Rodriguez Royal Family was defeated and fled overseas, the branch Su Lun knew about in Emperor Luying's empire. Meanwhile, a servant of the royal family had stolen some royal treasures along the way, leading to today's Atalan Town Lord.
That servant had also recorded this experience in a diary, which was left behind.
Only then did Su Lun understand why the box containing "Medusa's Serpent Hair Scepter" had not been opened for a thousand years.
It turned out that those who were not descendants of the Rodriguez Royal Family bloodline couldn't open it at all.
Su Lun looked through these texts with great interest, reading a hundred lines with a single glance.
His multi-focused ability had reached its peak, allowing him to open dozens of books at the same time and quickly absorb their content.
At this moment, the room in the inn was filled with dense cobwebs, with dozens of books suspended in mid-air, and the rustling sound of pages being turned occasionally reached his ears.
Lolota had seen this scene before and was no longer surprised.
But Tatu, who was beside him, was completely astounded by Su Lun's ability, her pretty face full of disbelief.
This was her first time seeing someone read books in such a manner.
But her surprise aside, she didn't interrupt.
Su Lun concentrated on perusing these texts while Mr. Hei in the little void realm also helped turn the pages, looking for some needed intelligence.
Gradually, they acquired a considerable understanding of the history of Dragon Country.
Unfortunately, they did not uncover any information about the formula for the petrification curse.
A night passed without incident.
Unknowingly, daylight had already brightened outside the window.
...
The castle atop the mountain had been robbed and set ablaze, and Atalan City was noisy throughout the night.
However, since Su Lun had perfectly erased all traces, he didn't stir up any trouble.
It was only at dawn that the city guards came to search the inns for outsiders. Exhausted from searching all night, the city guard probably assumed the thief had already left the town, so their search was largely a formality. With just a little use of psychic technique, Su Lun easily concealed the truth.
After all, by this time, daylight was in full swing, the city gates had opened, and a large number of adventurers and merchants were pouring into the city again, making it impossible to conduct a search.
Playing a thief last night saved Su Lun a lot of trouble.
There was nothing left worth exploring in this city, waiting only for the dragon sacrifice in three days.
Since Su Lun needed to assimilate those texts, he did not leave the inn.
The sun was shining brightly today, and the streets had already become lively.
Meanwhile, at the "Gold Dragon Gambling Den" on the city's tavern street, the largest gambling house in Atalan City and a favorite gathering spot for adventurers,
the noise continued unabated, just as rowdy as before.
Qiantiao had been gambling there all night.
At this moment, in front of the spacious gambling table, this gambling-addicted woman swaggered into the dealer's seat, urging the hundreds of gamblers in the room to place their bets.
"Come on now! Bet and leave your hands off!"
"A small gamble for pleasure, a big gamble to get rich!"
"..."
Qiantiao didn't know the common language of Dragon Country, but after gambling all night, she had learned these few gambling phrases quite fluently.
And her luck at gambling last night was extremely good, winning big and reducing the house to just another player.
Right now, in front of her, there was a pile of various gold, silver, and copper coins, as well as monster pelts, gemstones, armor, swords, daggers, materials... even two monster cubs.
In short, anything adventurers could produce as betting currency could be wagered with her.
Qiantiao won all night, almost draining the gambling house's dealers and various gamblers.
This kind of all-or-nothing with strangers was the real thrill of gambling.
Although the gambling house was itching with frustration, they were helpless!
The backstage boss even thought about playing dirty, sending some thugs with the excuse of summoning Qiantiao to a back alley.
Not intending to murder and rob, but at least to threaten her to stop gambling.
Yet not only did the scheme not succeed, but several thugs capable of barehandedly hunting third or fourth-tier brown bear beasts were instead severely beaten.
Qiantiao didn't kill anyone, but she turned back to continue gambling instead.
Not because her temper had improved, but because she didn't want to spoil the fun of gambling that she had finally found.
If she had killed, she wouldn't have been able to continue gambling in the end anyway.
After daybreak, more adventurers entered the city from other places. Hearing about the high-rolling gambler presiding over the bets, they all flocked to the Golden Dragon gambling house, which became even more lively.
Qiantiao's luck in gambling remained unstoppable, with betting capital piling up like a mountain beside her.
However, while gambling, a strong-looking old man with greying hair quietly emerged from the crowd of gamblers.
He was dressed in blue linen clothes, with a straw hat hanging on his back, and a hand gripping a bamboo pole that had a patina from age.
Most of the people from Dragon Country had blond hair and blue eyes, and there were also some with flaxen or brown hair, but black hair was very rare.
Upon closer inspection, you could see a bit of his flesh at the cuff of his sleeves, and on his skin appeared to be tattooed with a pattern resembling cherry blossoms.
The old man seemed very interested in gambling because he brought out Gold Coins, he was eligible to sit at the table.
Qiantiao glanced at the old man as if sensing something, and a fierce light flashed in her eyes.
But for the two of them, gambling seemed all the more fun.
Like evenly matched players in a game of skill, they exchanged moves, each having their wins and losses.
But the bystander gamblers, seeing the old man could "win," started to place their bets following him.
If no one was cheating, the luck of the casino wouldn't always favor one person.
Gradually, the wealth that Qiantiao had won began to dwindle behind her.
While she was losing money, she didn't feel unhappy about it.
Instead, the opportunities for her to find pleasure in gambling were becoming increasingly rare.
The old man before her was an exceptionally rare opponent.
It was not just the clash of their gambling skills,
but also the sharpness only top swordsmen could understand.
...
The game continued until evening.
Qiantiao lost more than she won, and gradually all the winnings by her side were taken by the old man.
The old man became the Qiantiao of the night before, slaughtering his way through everyone. The casual gamblers, scared to lose their bets, could only watch as the casino's own people came up, leading to a thorough cleanout.
Qiantiao's enthusiasm did not diminish, watching her money nearly gone, she prepared to call over Su Lun for some extra gambling funds.
However, just then someone came and spoiled their fun.
The behind-the-scenes boss certainly couldn't watch these two hustle the casino out of business.
A group of knights riding dragon-scale horses rushed in, jabbering away in their language.
The gamblers, though clearly unhappy about being disturbed, didn't dare to speak out in anger.
The atmosphere turned cold in an instant.
However, Qiantiao couldn't understand the language of Dragon Country and disregarded these fellows, continuing to place her bets.
The old man opposite her also paid them no heed.
Each of them kept to their own, continuing the game.
Seeing the two ignore them, the knights drew their swords with a "whoosh," each brandishing their weapons.
Seeing the seriousness of the situation, all the gamblers were scared off in an instant, clearing out the space.
In a flash, only Qiantiao and the old man were left at the big gambling table.
The knight leader shouted again, jabbering what seemed like a warning.
But to everyone's surprise, though the sharp blades pointed at them, they didn't even lift an eyebrow.
Watching the two still ignore them, the knight leader angrily placed his knife on the old man's neck.
Finally, the old man's brow slightly lifted, and he translated a sentence to Qiantiao across the table, "They suspect you and I have something to do with the theft at the Town Lord's residence last night and want to take us in for questioning."
Qiantiao responded nonchalantly, "What does the Town Lord's residence being robbed have to do with me? I've been gambling here all night."
Although she knew it was Su Lun's doing, it really had nothing to do with her.
The old man shrugged his shoulders, with a touch of malicious amusement mocking himself, "I only entered the city this morning myself."
Hearing this, Qiantiao paid no attention to the knights, instead saying meaningfully, "It's rare indeed to hear the common language of Luying here."
The old man laughed, "Indeed, I also think it's quite rare."
Clearly, the old man's background was very mysterious.
However, the two of them did not dwell on this subject.
Qiantiao, the thick-skinned one, was more concerned with something else. She narrowed her eyes slightly and said, "Old man, you're quite strong."
The old man's eyebrows, white with age, lifted slightly, as if he saw a young talent that impressed him, and he sincerely praised her, "Your Sword Dao is also not bad at all."
Originally, they could have had a good chat about the Sword Dao, but it clearly wasn't the time.
"Ah... it seems we really can't gamble any longer, what a pity to find a good opponent like you, old man."
Qiantiao pursed her lips, grumbling.
Her playful mood about gambling was ruined, souring her mood completely.
And just then, as the group of knights saw the two resisting arrest, a heavy sword suddenly slashed towards Qiantiao.
Knights were not to be offended, and arrests could lead to on-the-spot execution.
The heavy sword, wrapped in fighting spirit, moved at lightning speed.
With a "swoosh," the sound of a blade cutting through the air, it seemed a tragic incident was about to occur.
But what happened next shocked all the onlookers.
Hearing the sound of the blade, Qiantiao moved her ears slightly, still not dodging.
But in her eyes, the formerly idle gaze suddenly sharpened like lightning.
She didn't even bother to look at the heavy sword being swung at her, as her imposing aura erupted forth.
In an instant, an invisible force field rippled outward from her as the center, the aura easily deflecting the blade a foot away from her body, and the several hundred gamblers in the house were simultaneously overcome by a terrifying killing intent, falling haphazardly to the ground.
Even the knight squadron of over twenty people outside on the street was thrown into chaos.
With her aura alone, Suri dominated the several hundred people present.
It was at the moment that aura burst forth that everyone seemed to see a death god from hell, with the tangible sense of impending doom enveloping their hearts.
Everyone simultaneously took in a sharp breath, unwittingly drenched in cold sweat.
At this moment, the backstage boss of the second-floor gambling den had already turned deathly pale with fear.
He knew that this female gambler was an expert, having thought that summoning the town guard would solve the problem.
But what he didn't expect was that he had not provoked a mere expert, but a terrifying killing god!
In the vast gambling house, only the old man in the blue shirt opposite her remained calm and unmoved.
In an instant, the vast gambling house fell silent as a graveyard.
All eyes were now fixed on the woman with the three knives at her waist, and each was fraught with shock.
...
"Oh..."
At almost the same time, Su Lun from the inn let out a light exclamation.
The moment Suri's aura exploded, he had felt the releasing aura.
Although there wasn't much in Atalan City that he considered a threat, he also didn't want to attract too much trouble.
Without hesitation, Su Lun also teleported directly over.
The scenery changed around him, and he had gone from the inn room to the gambling house.
He caught the scene of the knights in disarray.
The first thing Su Lun noticed was the old man in blue sitting opposite Suri, and he immediately thought, "How strong!"
Professional individuals above the seventh tier are hard to gauge in terms of soul strength, but one glance at the real person can almost immediately reveal their true strength.
This old man was definitely a top-tier powerhouse!
Su Lun first thought the enemy was this old man, yet sensed no malice, which seemed very strange.
He also caught a glimpse of the patina-covered bamboo stick in the old man's hand.
As far as he knew, there were no bamboo plants in the waters of Dragon Country.
As Su Lun took another look at the old man, the old man also naturally noticed him immediately.
Upon seeing Su Lun, he too let out a light exclamation and murmured, "Interesting. I thought I'd only encounter one, but here's another. With such strength, no wonder you've crossed the Eternal Night Black Sea."
Surprised, Su Lun listened and wondered: the old man actually spoke the common language of Luying?
Such a formidable person could not be a nobody.
His mind rapidly speculated about the old man's identity.
All along, Su Lun's gaze had never landed on any of the other people in the gambling den.
The atmosphere in the room grew even more eerie.
What was clearly an arrest operation seemed to have been completely disregarded by the alleged "suspects."
However, at this moment, one of the knights seemed to have recognized the identity of the old man, and, as if clutching at a lifeline, spoke with a panicked expression: "Elder Bartolo, I'm sorry for the disturbance!"
With that, the group of knights found their way out, exiting the gambling house in a disordered rush.
Su Lun keenly picked up on the name, and immediately made the connection: "The 'Dragon Hunter' Bartolo Figaro? The legendary figure who's said to be able to slay a giant dragon alone?"
The fact that such a powerful old man could be him was the only explanation.
Su Lun had not anticipated that he would encounter this legendary top powerhouse from Dragon Country.
And it seemed like the guy could speak the common language of Luying?
...
It was like a farce that had come on fiercely and departed just as quickly.
As the knights retreated, the people in the large gambling house looked at each other, baffled.
Gambling was clearly out of the question now. The old man also turned and left, not saying another word.
Su Lun had been curious about the old man's origins, but, seeing that he did not wish to speak with strangers, he dismissed the thought.
Suri also lost interest, got up, and called to Su Lun, "There's nothing left to bet on — let's go."
The two left the gambling house with no one daring to follow.
Walking into a deserted alley, Su Lun asked, "Suri, did you know that old man just now?"
Suri shook her head: "I don't know him. But he is a very formidable swordsman."
After a moment of reflection, she added, "Hmm... He may even surpass the realm of a Sword Saint."
"Swordsman?"
Su Lun mused upon hearing this.
A top swordsman, speaking the Luying language, around seventy or eighty years old...
Naturally, he first thought of the members of Black Sam's pirate crew who had come to these waters thirty years ago.
Su Lun thought of something, "Could it be 'Sword Demon' Saito? Is he still alive?"
It was a pity there had been no chance to ask a few more questions just now.
If it really was that renowned Sword Saint from the Black Sam's crew, that would definitely be a great help to seek out.
Meeting an old acquaintance in a foreign land, and with the relationship of Tanni, the son of the Pirate King, there should be something to talk about.
However, Su Lun didn't dwell on it too much.
That person came here, most likely for that blue dragon, and there should be chances to meet again later.
Su Lun asked again, "Did you just discover something?"
He knew that Qian Tiao wouldn't draw his sword for just a few knights, so there must be some other reason.
Qian Tiao: "It seems we were being watched by some unclean entity. But the moment I thought about making a move, it disappeared."
Suri thought of the altar in the castle's secret chamber and speculated, "It could be that unformed Evil God worshipped by the Town Lord..."
After hearing this, Qian Tiao also felt it was possible.
After the Lingdun disaster, they had seen an Outer God that had taken form.
So now, encountering it was just that.
...
Meanwhile, a prison carriage was camping in a forest two or three hundred kilometers away from Atalan City.
The prison carriage was tightly wrapped in thick black cloth as if it contained some monstrous beast that dreaded the light.
The bonfire burned brightly, and the thick soup on it bubbled over, filling the forest with a rich meaty aroma.
A group of fully-armed knights gathered around the fire.
Even during meal and rest times, there would always be a team of knights taking turns guarding the prison carriage.
Around the bonfire, the resting knights, also curious, whispered amongst themselves.
"What do you think, who is this Big Shot we are escorting this time, that we were told never to open and look inside?"
"I don't know. It might be some female demon or humanoid monster from within, but since we're told not to open it, let's not open it."
"Hey, have you ever thought it could be that person on the recent wanted poster?"
"Ah, that 'Number One Beauty of the Pania Kingdom'? The witch rumored to have started a war between two countries?"
"Shh..."
"..."
Unknowingly, the night deepened.
A knight on guard duty finally couldn't resist his curiosity and secretly lifted a corner of the black cloth on the prison carriage.
He swore in his heart to only take one peek.
He just wanted to see what kind of beauty could have ensnared Your Majesty the King.
When the black cloth was lifted, his gaze penetrated inside.
It was this secret glimpse that allowed him to see a pair of beautiful azure pupils.
In an instant, the knight's eyes were filled with bewilderment; he saw a dreamlike world.
...
Perhaps because the altar of the Evil God did not want to be exposed, the incident of the burglary and fire at the Town Lord's mansion ultimately did not cause much of a stir.
Instead, Atalan City, due to the awakening of that blue dragon from dormancy, saw an influx of more and more outsiders.
Many of the locals had escaped beyond the city to seek refuge. That evil dragon had been in these seas for a hundred to two hundred years already, and the earlier generations had bloody lessons to show for it; if the sacrifices didn't satisfy the evil dragon, it would come to ravage the city.
On the third day at noon, adventurers crowded at the cliffs outside the city.
Eighteen frightened young girls with tear-streaked faces and a full ship of treasures were pushed into the sea. The sailboat, propelled by the wind, slowly headed toward the open waters.
The people ashore watched in solemn silence.
Suddenly, a high-pitched dragon's cry sounded from a great distance.
Among the crowd, Su Lun watched the black dot soaring in the far distance and narrowed his eyes slightly.
He swept a glance over the surrounding crowd but did not see the mysterious old man he had met the day before.
And it wasn't long before a communication from the Dawn's crew arrived: "Seven signal observation points have simultaneously confirmed the blue dragon's energy fluctuations within the 221~245 seventh-order unit range, and it is highly probable on the law level that it hasn't broken through to the eighth order!"
Dora brought the best energy observation instruments from Mafa; these could precisely observe the range of biological energy fluctuations, and also determine the creature's tier, with minimal error.
This data meant that the current energy overflow of this seventh-order blue dragon was equivalent to more than two hundred normal seventh-order professionals!
A typical seventh-order magical beast was only three to five times stronger than a human of the seventh order.
This two hundredfold energy, even if not an eighth-order giant dragon, was already absurdly exaggerated.
But as long as it was not eighth order, the problem wasn't too big.
Having heard this and reconfirmed the rumors, Su Lun was certain this blue dragon was of the seventh order.
He immediately made a decision and instructed, "Proceed as planned. Prepare for dragon hunting!"

chapters.title: Chapter 531 - 530: The Dragon That Was Severely Beaten by Society
chapters.content:
Tens of thousands of people from Atalan City gathered at the Suspended Coast, watching as the small boat laden with offerings sailed into the deep sea.
Under normal circumstances, the evil dragon would devour the eighteen maidens and then carry the treasures back to its dwelling island to continue its slumber.
However, unbeknownst to everyone, two groups were plotting against the evil dragon at that moment.
Apart from the Dawn Group, several miles away from the city within the forest, hundreds of Dragon Knights from the Silver Dragon Kingdom had long been waiting.
Among the squad, there was also an old man holding a bamboo pole.
Listenging to the news that the huge dragon had set out to sea, the Knight Commander turned to the old man and said, "Mr. Bartolo, His Majesty the King insists on obtaining the Dragon Breath Fruit on the island. When the battle begins, we'll rely on you to slay that lightning blue dragon."
The old man casually responded, "Since I promised to come, I will naturally give my best. But once this is over, tell him that my debt of gratitude is repaid."
Knight Commander: "Alright. I will pass your words along to Lord Garcia."
"..."
The old man said no more, instead turning his indifferent gaze towards the distant city.
Although his mind had long been as still as an ancient well, for some reason, he always remembered the swordsman junior and her companion that he encountered at the gambling house the day before. After pondering for a moment, a trace of reminiscence seemed to emerge in the old man's eyes as he emotionally muttered to himself, "Companion, ah..."
...
The Dawn Group had been navigating the sea these past few days, having already thoroughly explored all the conditions in the nearby sea regions.
They had established observation outposts on various deserted islands, and they would report to Su Lun anytime the blue dragon ventured far enough from Thunder Sea Island.
The lightning blue dragon, named "Kazzak," produced a lot of noise when flying. It was constantly accompanied by a thundercloud, a sign of a highly condensed form of Thunder Magic. The crackling non-stop, like an approaching storm, was immensely terrifying.
In Atalan City, Su Lun, among the crowd, heard the dragon's roar from miles away, which made everyone's hearts quake. He murmured to himself, "Truly a pureblood dragon, such dragon presence is indeed terrifying."
It was merely a seventh-tier giant dragon, yet its dragon presence felt like a rank pressure, striking a deep, vibration-like fear into one's soul.
Although Su Lun remained unharmed, the ordinary women and children and the lower-tier magical beasts in the city were already trembling in fear.
Perhaps because it had been hibernating for more than a decade, the evil dragon hovered in the sky for a while to stretch its limbs, then headed towards the city.
The blue dragon's speed was incredibly fast, like lightning.
Over the communicator, Su Lun had already received detailed data reports.
"Mr. Su Lun, the flying dragon's current speed is 930 meters per second, and it is still increasing..."
"The blue dragon has passed through observation point two, flying speed 1080 meters per second, and it is still increasing..."
"The blue dragon has passed through observation point three..."
"..."
Su Lun listened to the urgent reports coming from the communicator, his gaze sharply focused, always watching that dark spot on the horizon.
The speed of this lightning blue dragon was indeed too fast.
This was a speed almost incomparable by any means except Spatial Teleportation.
In just over a minute, it could travel from its lair a hundred kilometers away to Atalan City.
Correspondingly, it could fly back as well.
With such speed, it was no wonder that no one dared to provoke it.
If this evil dragon targeted them, even those skilled in Teleportation among the Wind practitioners would literally be chased to death.
Seeing the blue dragon charging furiously, its dragon presence growing more terrifying by the moment, the oppressive feeling was like a mountain's collapse, making it feel like even breathing had halted. Ordinary people simply couldn't withstand the pressure facing such a high-level creature.
At that moment, the previously enthusiastic spectators mostly got scared and ran back into the city.
The people around Su Lun also instantly fled.
Yet, he watched expressionlessly, closely feeling the true dragon presence, contemplating, "This dragon presence is quite similar to Dominator's Bodyguard, both being a control over all things..."
The difference was that dragon presence was an innate ability of the dragon race, while Dominator's Bodyguard needed to be understood by humans themselves.
As the dragon presence assaulted him, his own Dominator's Bodyguard gradually surged forth, resisting that invisible pressure.
In just a moment, Su Lun heard that the blue dragon had passed the last observation point.
He did not linger any longer and instantly appeared at a previously prepared remote Spatial Formation.
With a clamp of the Sorcerer's Seals, the Alchemy Formation lit up.
The next step Su Lun took, he was already on a deserted island several kilometers away.
...
The deserted island already had spatial coordinates set up by members of the Dawn Group, being one of the islands closest to Thunder Sea Island.
Su Lun looked back one last time, seeing the blue dragon already at the edge of his vision.
At this distance, it would need at least thirty seconds to return.
He didn't hesitate any longer, switched outfits to a Mage's robe, and looked towards the distant island flickering with thunder, then teleported again.
In just a blink of an eye, Su Lun was already at the lair of the evil dragon.
Where the giant dragon dwelled, no other creature could exist, as no other creature could withstand the dragon presence for an extended period and live next to the giant dragon.
This also spared him a lot of trouble.
However, Su Lun did not dare to be careless, holding a black umbrella and fully extending his senses.
He looked up at the sky, his eyes further confirming some of his speculations: "This blue dragon has left, yet the thunderclouds are still here. This island itself must have issues."
Su Lun had considered this issue before.
"Thunder Sea Island," where the blue dragon resided, was constantly filled with thunder, which was definitely abnormal.
Some speculated it was due to the blue dragon's innate ability to attract thunder, while others guessed it was a region of chaotic laws left over from an ancient gods' battlefield.
But once Su Lun himself landed on the island, he immediately judged that there might be some kind of treasure here!
He noticed right away that the thunder and lightning in the sky seemed to be attracted by a lightning rod, regularly concentrating and striking at the core of the island.
It was clearly attracted by something.
Su Lun knew it was the lair of an evil dragon, so he teleported there.
But he hadn't gone far when the dense air of lightning elements made him stop.
Even with Dominator's Bodyguard, the violent lightning elements were like pins and needles and made his whole body ache.
Su Lun frowned tightly, "Super-tier laws?"
His own flesh was now completely resistant to the force of common lightning.
So this was definitely not something the force of natural lightning could achieve.
He became even more certain of his judgment, there had to be a treasure on this island!
The violent lightning elements formed a huge isolation zone, making it virtually impossible for ordinary people to approach the dragon's nest.
But this was not a problem for Su Lun.
He slapped his mage's seal, and four elemental wax figures guarded around him.
Earth, wind, water, fire—the four basic elements of the universe. In the hands of an alchemist, four wax figures forming an Elemental Domain Field could perform an equivalent exchange with any other elements and also assimilate any other elements.
The moment the wax figures elementalized, the violent lightning elements around Su Lun were immediately assimilated by the wax figures, turning into the four basic elements to sustain the wax figures.
Guarded by the four wax figures, Su Lun smoothly made his way inside.
But as he reached the center of the island, it was as if he had walked into a sea of lightning, surrounded by a flashing silver light.
However, miraculously, there was an area of several hundred square meters at the center that seemed to be insulated, shielding a huge gap from the lightning.
The ground was covered with heaps of gold and silver treasures.
And within the pile of treasures, there was a deep depression that clearly showed the mark of a giant dragon curled up in sleep.
Giant dragons liked to collect shiny treasures, and Su Lun was no longer surprised by this.
Although the pile of treasures contained many fine items and high-tier demon cores, his gaze was instantly drawn to a golden lightning spear that was broken.
[A Fragment of a Broken Lightning Spear]
Details: A mid-tier divine artifact fragment, containing powerful high-tier lightning laws; it can gather lightning elements, and its bearer can command the power of thunder;
"A Divine Artifact fragment?"
A simple introduction, but Su Lun's eyes lit up.
Indeed, he hadn't guessed wrong.
Even as just a magical fragment, it was still a rare treasure.
And what Su Lun saw was not its offensive capability.
As a Puppeteer, he was not short of weapons for battle.
Instead, he valued the function of this fragment even more.
This lightning spear could continuously gather thunder, wasn't this just a "perpetual motion generator"?
Although the power of thunder was uncontrollable, methods for harnessing natural lightning as an energy source had already been developed years ago in the Mafa Empire. Su Lun had personally seen lightning hunters who lived off this energy on the airship to the Mafa imperial capital, Kabithrone.
If this lightning spear were installed on the "Sky Fortress," wouldn't that provide a continuous energy source?
No energy consumption needed, just continuous attraction of lightning, where else could you find such an ideal generator?
For an alchemist, energy was literally "money"!
With this thunder energy source supporting them, whether for creating super demonic energy cannons or for powering uses, it was an excellent choice.
The Mini Void Realm had Dora and a group of senior mechanics from the Mafa Empire; they would always find a way to utilize this item.
Looking at this, Su Lun felt a surge of excitement.
He had not expected to come here and discover such a treasure.
He glanced over to the side, where there was a small tree with seven or eight purple misty fruits hanging from it.
[Thunder Dragon Breath Fruit]
Details: Dragon Breath nurtured for a hundred years yielding a fruit of laws, rich in the essence of life; consumption increases affinity for lightning by +199, immunity to lightning spell damage by +288;
Looking at these fruits, Su Lun also breathed a sigh of relief.
This was likely one of the materials for an antidote to petrification, bringing him one step closer to curing Tanni's mother's petrification.
Opportunity comes and goes quickly.
Su Lun dared not delay, but he also didn't try to pick the fruits himself.
"Dragon Secret Technique" has a line that warns: "The intelligence of dragonkind is not less than the vast majority of humans; don't treat them like monsters, or you will pay a heavy price."
The Black Dragon encountered in the Dwarves' curse space was just a resentful spirit, not a true member of dragonkind.
Su Lun was now facing a true pure-blood blue dragon.
He raised his hand to beckon, and two corpse dressed in mage robes appeared by his side, one holding a sealing box and the other a bag, and they walked towards the lightning spear and the fruits.
Very smoothly, one corpse was charred by electricity, but also managed to place the lightning spear in the sealing box.
The other corpse managed to pull the whole tree and the fruits into a bag specifically for holding materials.
With the treasures in hand, Su Lun tugged at a thread and quickly stashed the two items into the Mini Void Realm.
However, because he had taken the lightning spear, at the same time, the violent clouds in the sky above the island suddenly quieted down.
The lightning elements no longer gathered, and the clouds showed signs of dissipating instantly.
The sign was clear even from tens of kilometers away.
Through the communicator, various observation points of the Dawn Squad immediately reported, "Mr. Su Lun, be careful, the evil dragon is flying back to the island! Its speed is faster than before, having reached 5.5 times the speed of sound!"
Su Lun wasn't surprised at all; the Thunder Dragon's speed, no matter how fast, wasn't faster than his spatial teleportation.
However, after obtaining the treasure, he didn't intend to flee.
Hearing that the evil dragon was flying back as planned, Su Lun responded through the communicator, "Everyone, move into the designated hunting area, prepare to hunt!"
As he spoke, he didn't even have time to attend to the treasures, leaving only the body that had been scorched earlier, then teleported away from Thunder Sea Island.
...
Elsewhere, in Atalan City.
The Blue Dragon moved as fast as lightning, streaking a blue line across the sky.
It wasn't in a hurry to partake of the human sacrifices offered to it but was patrolling its hunting grounds instead.
The city's crowd, full of trepidation, eagerly watched the evil dragon consume the sacrificed girl, hoping it would be satisfied thereafter and then return to Dragon Island.
The girls floating on the small boats in the sea had mostly fainted from fright; even the ones still awake shuddered under the dragon's might, helplessly waiting for death.
Suddenly, without any warning and for reasons unknown, the evil dragon let out an extremely angry dragon roar that filled the skies, then turned around and flew back?
This scene baffled everyone.
Everyone clearly heard the dragon's fury and faintly sensed that something terrible was about to happen.
People hiding everywhere looked at each other, all guessing what could have enraged the dragon so much.
"That... why did the evil dragon fly back?"
"Could someone have really gone to Thunder Sea Island to steal the Dragon Breath Fruit?"
"It seems that only this possibility would make the dragon react so. "
"We're doomed now; that guy has doomed us all, and Atalán City too. Even if there are sacrifices, after the dragon kills that thief, it's bound to vent its fury on the city..."
"Run for it!"
"..."
At that moment, everyone in the large city fled.
They could already imagine that once the evil dragon returned, Atalan City was bound to turn into ruins.
Meanwhile, the sudden turn of events had also caught the dragon knights deployed outside the city off guard.
They had planned to ambush it near the coast when the dragon approached, then strike.
With "Dragon Hunter" Bartolo Figaro and a full squadron of flying dragons under their command, they were confident of slaying the giant dragon despite some losses and then moving onto the island to search for the Dragon Breath Fruit.
But what was happening now?
"Commander Bennett, the lightning around Thunder Sea Island has dissipated!"
"How is that possible? Did someone really go to the island?"
"The current situation is unclear, our scouts have already been dispatched to investigate."
"..."
People in the Knight Order were also very perplexed.
If their brains were in order, they would never entertain the idea of targeting that evil dragon.
And that Thunder Lightning Blue Dragon flew so fast; even if someone really stole something, they couldn't possibly escape.
It wasn't long before the message came again, "Commander, the latest intelligence from the front line reports that the Blue Dragon returned to the island and then flew southeast, apparently chasing someone."
Hearing this, the man named Bennett pondered for a moment.
He found it hard to understand, besides their royal knights, who else would dare to provoke that evil dragon.
But he quickly made a decision, "Prepare for battle as originally planned. Although we're unsure who went to the island, after the dragon kills that thief, it will surely return to Atalan City to unleash its fury, and we still have a chance."
The crowd responded, "Yes!"
Throughout, the "Dragon Hunter" Bartolo, who was accumulating Sword Qi, remained silent.
He also believed someone had gone to Thunder Sea Island, but he didn't think the dragon would come back.
"Could it be them?"
Bartolo suddenly thought of two young men he had met at the casino the previous day.
But he was unsure, even though he felt they were strong, they shouldn't have the capability to handle a seventh-tier Thunder Lightning Blue Dragon.
Then suddenly, he remembered something, a bright glint flashed through his eyes, and he muttered to himself, "Oh, I almost forgot, they managed to cross the Eternal Night Sea, they must have an excellent team. I underestimated those two young men..."
...
The Blue Dragon "Kaz Kaz" returned to its lair at lightning speed.
The evil dragon found that while most of the gold and silver treasures were still there, its two most prized possessions were missing!
Dragons are not only mighty but also have an extremely keen sense of smell.
It immediately discerned that seven thieves had come to the island!
Four of them carried the scent of death, like undead creatures.
The other three humans were the ones who had stolen the treasures!
Oh, look, the dragon also found a freshly dead body.
It was one of the vile thieves who had attempted to steal the Thunder Spear and had been struck dead by lightning!
"That detestable little thief, after this dragon eats that thief, I must go to that city and eat a thousand humans to quell my rage!"
The arrogant "Kazka" roared furiously into the sky, rising like a bolt of lightning, furiously pursuing the scent.
...
Su Lun had stolen two treasures on Thunder Sea Island and then teleported southeastward.
The "Dragon Taming Secret Techniques" detailed the habits of dragons extensively, so how could he not know their sense of smell was incredibly strong?
Within a few hundred kilometers, the desk blue dragon could smell the scent of its prey.
Su Lun could have used ultra-long-distance teleportation to escape this range and leave the blue dragon with no trail to follow.
But he did not do so.
The direction of his escape led to a temporary camp of a celestial plane mage on Rainbow Island.
A pure-blooded giant dragon in excellent condition and in a state of fury was not something to be trifled with...
Luring disaster to the east was part of the plan.
It turned out that those who fly with wings cannot outrun those who can perform spatial teleportation.
Especially one who possesses the "Isaac Alchemist's Heart" with nearly infinite spiritual power to support a tier-seven alchemist.
Su Lun, to allow this wicked dragon to catch up, also secretly disrupted the teleportation.
Once discovered, he fled "in panic," with the lightning blue dragon closing in behind him.
A few hundred kilometers was but a few minutes' journey for this man and dragon.
Upon checking, the defense barrier of Rainbow Island was already in sight.
With one teleportation, Su Lun had already vanished without a trace.
...
Where was the blue dragon "Kazka" not aware of the human thief's destination?
From afar, it smelled the dense presence of humans on that island.
Moreover, the scent of those humans was identical to that of the corpses previously on the island!
So there were accomplices.
You think hiding here, you can survive?
Hmph, the mighty dragon race is not so easily provoked!
Contempt was all that was in the eyes of the blue dragon.
As a creature at the top of the food chain, it never knew what "fear" was.
A bunch of humans was not enough to make it retreat.
"Kazka" charged towards the magic barrier and unleashed a breath of lightning.
Suddenly, the sky was filled with dense thunderclouds, this breath akin to a tier-eight arcane level magic.
But to "Kazka's" surprise, the breath was actually blocked by the defense barrier?
This made it angrier, its wings flapping as it dived down, whipping up a terrifying storm of thunder and lightning.
At the same time, over a dozen magic towers within the defense barrier also lit up.
The professional mage legion had ample combat experience, and the celestial plane mages had been battling attracted deep-sea leviathans for days. Thinking this giant dragon was another troublemaker, they naturally unleashed a flurry of spells in retaliation.
Those who controlled did so, those who dealt damage did so, various legion magic conduits were also rolled out, and stronger magic forbidden spells were being chanted.
The battle turned fierce from the very first moment.
...
Seeing both sides clash upon encounter, Su Lun, hiding in the sea somewhere, also enjoyed watching while muttering, "It's only been a few days and so many have teleported here. Tsk tsk... That blue dragon's temper will get it beaten."
It turned out, despite being intelligent, the dragon could not possibly understand beings it had never encountered before.
In the dragon's eyes, the humans in this maritime area were merely its hunting grounds, ready to be hunted whenever it was hungry.
But these humans were not the humans it understood.
Not to mention the alchemists, how could it have ever encountered these mages from the celestial plane?
Although the blue dragon was strong, several ten-thousand-person mage legions were stronger.
To know, a ten-thousand-person mage legion could match the power of tier nine!
The result was...
Su Lun witnessed this maritime ruler, the blue dragon, getting thoroughly beaten up by society.
But the blue dragon was, after all, from the pure-blooded dragon race; its dragon scales were almost entirely immune to magic, and the likelihood of it being killed in a short time was not great. Moreover, its speed was extremely fast, and if it wanted to escape, those ten-thousand-person mage legions could not possibly catch up.
However, this was also the scenario Su Lun wanted to see.
From the beginning, he had guessed that the blue dragon and these celestial plane mages would be at an impasse, and a two-sided loss was the best scenario.
Eventually, the blue dragon would certainly flee.
Su Lun watched the intense fight with satisfaction.
The more these mages exhausted the wicked dragon, the easier it would be for the Dawn Brigade to handle it.
Finally, after half an hour of fierce battle, the wicked dragon finally recognized the reality amid its fury; it couldn't do anything to those humans hidden within the magic barrier.
It had already developed the intention to retreat.
Su Lun, seeing the first part of the plan succeed, again notified his people, "Everyone, prepare to intercept the target!"

chapters.title: Chapter 532 - 531: Void Mechanical Octopus
chapters.content:
The blue dragon "Kazka" was severely beaten on Rainbow Island, and though it had caused a number of mage casualties, it ultimately couldn't overcome the magical barrier of the tens of thousands of people. The pride of its dragon lineage unwillingly kept it lingering for a long time but only added more wounds to its body, and in the end, it fled.
While Su Lun was secretly enjoying the spectacle, he gained an accurate understanding of this malevolent dragon's combat power.
The dragon's lightning breath was an area-of-effect attack, with an average energy fluctuation on the level of an eighth-tier professional's spell, which was almost impossible to avoid.
