"Could it be that 'Helen'? No, that doesn't make sense either; she came to rob, so there's no need for such elaborate schemes to kill me..."
Su Lun felt as though he was missing a critical clue in his mind.
However, just then, a high-pitched dragon's roar suddenly echoed from outside the window.
Even without looking, Su Lun knew it was Princess Becky and the Tier 6 Silver Dragon flying over.
The haughty princess saw Su Lun from high above, then leapt down from the dragon's back and burst into the room, furious.
Garcia, seeing the princess who barged in suddenly, spoke with a troubled expression, "Your Royal Highness Princess, this humble servant is discussing important matters with a noble guest from overseas. You..."
It seemed like an accident.
Princess Becky cut off the old man's words, a dragon spear pointed at Su Lun as she demanded, "Bastard! Speak up, where is that swordsman who was with you?"
She certainly didn't believe those "I don't know him" kinds of lies.
That despicable woman had dared to lay hands on her, so both she and her accomplice must die!
"..."
Su Lun watched as the dragon spear, only a foot away from his head, narrowed his eyes slightly.
This was truly a woman who had never been harshly beaten by society...
Su Lun also specially caught the expression on Garcia's face.
Although the old fox's words were to stop the princess, his expression revealed a helpless resignation, a resignation to simply acknowledge her actions.
This meant, if Princess Becky really wanted to kill him, this old man would definitely not stop her.
The tip of the dragon spear was wrapped in a fighting spirit, looking ready to strike if one word went wrong.
Su Lun was certain, if this haughty princess raised her spear, she would certainly dare to thrust it forward.
"Is this designed to provoke me into acting?"
Su Lun immediately realized that this haughty princess might have been used as a pawn.
Yet, why would the other side allow a princess to come and disrupt if they were ready to act?
He immediately guessed, "So, these guys also want to use me to kill this woman?"
No!
Even if I do not kill her, now that she has come, she is doomed.
Previously in Rueing, having witnessed various noble conspiracies for power, seeing a princess die wouldn't be strange.
Su Lun immediately figured some things out.
So what would be the consequences of killing this Princess Becky?
A struggle for the throne?
Princess Becky, who could tame a Silver Dragon, indeed had a great chance to ascend to the throne, but it wasn't necessary to use an outsider like me.
Or perhaps Garcia is a spy from either the Pania Kingdom or Arcatites Kingdom, wanting to destabilize the foundation of the Dragon Country?
In an instant, many possibilities flashed through Su Lun's mind.
But none had sufficient motive.
Su Lun felt he was a stranger to the Dragon Country; there was no need for them to set such a trap.
Unless, they were enemies from the beginning.
The enemy? Su Lun racked his brain, and presently, there was only one enemy he must drive to death—the beings from the Divine Realm!
Had Garcia colluded with the people from the Divine Realm?
Suddenly, a lightbulb went off in his head.
He had finally realized an important detail that he had overlooked!
Through the princess, Su Lun pondered for a moment, then asked Garcia across from him, "I am curious, which deity does the Haydon family lineage of sorcerers worship?"
Princess Becky listened, her expression bewildered. Wasn't he supposed to answer her question?
"Hey, hey, hey..."
Feeling ignored, she was just about to lose her temper.
Unexpectedly, Garcia calmly responded, "Oh... Your Excellency is quite perceptive to have noticed so quickly."
The two of them carried on their conversation, completely ignoring the royal princess before them.
Speaking of his beliefs, a trace of devoutness to the divine appeared on Garcia's face as he added, "The Haydon family are descendants of the divine race, naturally, we worship the great All-knowing Almighty God."
Just as expected!
Su Lun, having heard this, finally understood.
This guy was a follower of the divine!
No wonder.
It wasn't merely a power struggle between kingdoms nor was it targeted solely at him.
It was those guys from the Divine Realm using Garcia to infiltrate the Silver Dragon country.
And that Silver Dragon country still had a national guardian Silver Dragon whose combat power matched that of a ninth-rank, who must be eliminated before they could fully seize control.
They were after the eighth-tier Silver Dragon on Mount Loki!
...
Today's plan served multiple purposes.
If successful, without the Silver Dragon Kingdom's protection, it would easily fall under the control of the beings from the Divine Realm.
Controlling such a large kingdom not only increases the followers of the deity but also greatly aids those Mages in their search for the "Mimir's Well."
However, even having guessed the entire truth of the matter, Su Lun didn't feel much of a crisis.
If he wanted to leave, these people couldn't stop him.
He no longer paid attention to the person before him but asked through his communicator, "Sister Qiantiao, what's your situation?"
Qiantiao immediately responded, "Someone has stopped me. Looks like someone has come to bother you too."
The two of them already had an understanding and knew the situation well.
Su Lun then asked, "Can you handle it?"
From the other end of the communicator came Qiantiao's dissatisfied grumble, "Ah, to be underestimated like this. They sent a few squads of seventh-rank Dragon Knights and thought they could trap me..."
Su Lun listened but said no more.
With Qiantiao's strength, those below the eighth-rank were not easily defeated.
...
Meanwhile, in the forests a hundred kilometers away from the royal city of Aike,
Qiantiao, seeing thousands of fully armored flying Dragon Knights closing in, showed no intention of breaking through; instead, her face was filled with a fighting spirit.
The very moment she ended the communication, those before her had already begun their charge.
Qiantiao's domain instantly expanded, her six-armed exoskeleton released, each hand wielding a blade, showing her ferocious true nature.
Thunder roared instantly in the sky, with purple-red lightning explosively resounding through the heavens.
Different from a few days ago, her Hell Domain now truly resembled a hellish world; upon drawing her sword, it turned into a bizarre blood-red scene.
Gazing at the group of Dragon Knights trying to kill her, she scoffed with a sneer, murmuring, "Did these guys really think they could trap me just like that? Tsk, tsk, if only you knew how formidable Su Lun is... The more people there are, the more freedom he has to act."
No sooner had her words fallen than the six-armed Asura leapt into the air, with Thunderous Sword Qi shooting skywards.
...
Su Lun inquired about the situation at the Evernight again.
Similarly, they had sighted the Dragon Knight Corps.
But the Dawn Group was not weak, and without the intervention of ninth-rank forces, they were not easily trapped.
Su Lun informed them and wasn't in a hurry to teleport over, instead turning his attention back to the room.
Feigning ignorance, he asked, "Your Excellency, what do you mean by this?"
Garcia watched him, a fox-like cold smile appearing in his eyes, "Your Excellency indeed has courage, remaining so composed even in such a situation."
"This guy had a look that said he had him all figured out and spoke, 'Are you waiting for your swordsman companion or the 'Dragon Hunter' Bartolo? Unfortunately, I must tell you that they can't come anymore.'
As Su Lun listened, his brow furrowed.
Was this guy planning on taking Bartolo down today as well?
In the room, only Princess Becky had not yet realized what was happening. Nonetheless, she sensed the strange atmosphere and furrowed her brow as she demanded, 'What on earth are you all talking about?!'
No one responded to her.
In the eyes of the two in the room, she was already a dead woman.
Su Lun neither intended to save her nor could he have saved her.
Since Garcia, the old fox, had come alone, he obviously had made thorough preparations.
Furthermore, he was not weak., Su Lun had not found a good opportunity to make a move until then.
So, he waited, waiting for the instant this man would kill Princess Becky to seize the opportunity for a fatal strike.
Seeing that no one paid her any heed, the haughty Princess Becky flew into a rage, and with her anger directed at Su Lun, she lunged at his head with a spear!
Su Lun slightly tilted his head, easily dodging the attack.
Towards this truly murderous haughty princess, he held no anger, only calmly reminding her, 'Your Royal Highness, this uncle-in-law is trying to kill you. If you can escape, then escape.'
Regardless of whether he warned her or not, the princess was doomed.
Upon hearing this, Princess Becky's expression froze, and her innocent large eyes looked doubtfully at Garcia standing beside her.
Though she was unreasonable and overbearing, it didn't mean she was truly foolish., She instantly realized something was off.
Garcia also seemed surprised and seemed to have abandoned the idea of continuing his pretense, saying, 'Tsk tsk, Your Excellency is truly impressive to have guessed as much. I'm very curious where I slipped up.'
It sounded like a question, but he wasn't expecting an answer, and continued, 'Now everyone has seen the princess have a confrontation with you. How will you explain it?'
The charge of attacking the princess would bring the kingdom's army storming in, and death would then be certain."
Su Lun asked nonchalantly in return, 'Why should I explain?'
Hearing the conversation between the two, fear finally appeared in the eyes of Princess Becky, and she abruptly felt the urge to flee, wanting to call for the silver dragon waiting in the courtyard.
But how could Garcia let her leave the room alive?
The instant she showed a hint of retreating, the white-robed wizard suddenly exclaimed softly, 'Corpse Gu Explosion!'
Upon a closer look, with a 'boom', Princess Becky's head exploded into a cloud of blood mist, and a dense fog instantly filled the room, so thick you could not see your hand in front of your face.
At the same moment, Su Lun made his move!
Seizing the instant Garcia acted, the Hell Domain burst forth instantly, his arm muscles bulging, and he magically produced a large black scythe, swinging it fiercely.
In the fog, Garcia, who had appeared calm a moment before, suddenly found himself overwhelmed by a terrifying sense of impending death, thinking in shock, 'How can it be this horrifying!'
As a seventh-tier white-robed wizard, he was confident in his ability to hold his own against any peer, but now, suppressed by this strange domain, he felt shaken.
'Why is it so unbelievably strong!'
'Damn it!'
In the reports, everyone had said that only the swordsman called 'Thousand Cuts' was worth noting. Why was this man also so powerful!'
And more importantly, why hadn't he been poisoned?
If he hadn't been poisoned, it meant that from the moment he walked in and was first offered a cup of tea, he had already seen through his plan?
'How is this possible?'
Garcia's mind was filled with questions, facing such a baffling opponent for the first time.
Su Lun didn't give him a chance to figure things out. With a swift stroke of his black scythe, he cleaved the man in two.
A 'pu-chi' sound of a robe being torn rang out.
Garcia's body was cut in half at the waist, a large amount of black blood spurting from the cut, and a foul stench of poison filled the room.
A nearby black crow cawed sharply, causing Su Lun to suddenly become alert.
Without time to strike again, he teleported and rushed out of the room.
Just as he hovered in midair, the vast medical hall suddenly collapsed under a tremendous force, creating a kilometer-wide crater in the ground.
Su Lun was unaffected, but the silver dragon hatchling in the courtyard was instantly killed, buried in the dust.
From a distance, Isabel, hiding atop a high tower, was completely stunned.
She hadn't understood at all what had happened.
She had just watched Princess Becky storm in angrily, worried that the foolish girl would be at a disadvantage and was thinking about causing a distraction.
But before she could even ponder further, the entire inn had collapsed in front of her, and even the silver dragon had died?
Isabel's face turned pale instantly, completely clueless about what had transpired.
But she knew that today's incident was likely to cause an uproar.
...
Princess Becky and her mount died at the inn, and suddenly someone yelled, "Princess Becky has been assassinated, capture the murderer!"
It was clearly premeditated.
At the sound of this voice, the entire royal city shook, countless royal guards began to assemble, and groups of dragons took to the skies above the city.
Most dramatic of all was the mournful dragon's cry that came from the towering, unseeable peak of the mountain behind the palace.
"An eighth-tier dragon..."
Su Lun felt the terrifying oppression, and his gaze suddenly hardened.
In the current situation, everyone would think he was the killer, whether he carried the blame or not.
But it didn't matter anymore.
Su Lun had no intention of teleporting away from the scene, the situation was urgent, and there was no time to think further.
Grasping the black umbrella in his hand, he sensed a rapidly moving soul wave hundreds of meters away.
Thinking of escaping?
It wouldn't be that easy.
The wizard heritage indeed had some life-saving capabilities, just now a blade did not kill Garcia, allowing his half body to escape.
But being targeted by Su Lun, where did the enemy have a chance to escape?
Though the enemy's evasion technique was clever, their soul wave was continually locked on, and Su Lun followed with a teleport.
The surroundings changed in an instant, and upon looking again, only the upper half of Garcia's body eerily floated in the air, moving southeastward through teleportation.
Even without his lower half, he moved rapidly, escaping swiftly.
With a wave of his wizard's staff, another wave of foul-smelling black wind arose, but it unfortunately did nothing to stop the pursuers.
Su Lun, watching the spatial fluctuations around this man's body, could only sneer, "So you're proficient in spatial displacement as well..."
To him at his current level, such teleportation was no different from racing a child.
With another teleportation, he was already beside Garcia. Even though this man still had the energy to resist, in the face of overwhelming power, Su Lun easily severed his head.
The "Gray Mist" emerged instantly, and Su Lun decisively stripped the man's memories.
"You have stripped 'Garcia Haydon's' soul"
"You obtained [Antidote Formula for Petrification] and the method for concocting wizard potions"
"You stripped a vast amount of wizard heritage knowledge"
"You understand some secrets of the Dragon Country"
"You obtained an intelligence: The annihilation plan of the Ten Thousand Mage Group..."
"Spiritual power +488"
"..."
Searching further, Su Lun not only obtained the complete petrification recipe as hoped but also understood the whole story.
The process was almost as he had speculated.
The divine plane mage, by some means unknown, arrived at the royal capital of Aike before the Dawn Group, and then connected with the Haydon family, devout followers of the divine plane.
With the support of this influential, high-ranking royal family, a Ten Thousand Mage Group was already teleported into the city, and a magic tower was set up.
A deity from the divine plane had issued a divine decree, stating that He needed the followers from here.
Thus, the hunt was orchestrated.
According to the current intelligence, it was not just the Ten Thousand Mage Group, but also several families headed by the Haydon family, that already possessed the capability to overthrow the royal power.
Killing Su Lun and Bartholo was just part of the plan. The most crucial objective was to hunt down that eighth-tier silver dragon, seize control over the royal power, and establish a faith kingdom of the divine plane.
However, Garcia knew non-detailed plans and was merely acting on orders.
After knowing this, the orchestrator behind this plot was Augustus of the Eighth Order Holy Military.
After a moment, Su Lun had digested the information and frowned, "They intend to lure that silver dragon to kill Bartholo?"
The Ten Thousand Mage Group was strong, but that did not necessarily mean they could contend with Bartholo, the supreme swordsman.
As long as he didn't confront them directly, he could escape at any time.
But if it involved a pureblood silver dragon with its swift flight speed, truly there was no escape.
Only then did Su Lun understand why the method used to collapse the inn and kill that young silver dragon seemed familiar.
It turned out they had deliberately left Bartholo's scent behind, waiting for the silver dragon to follow the scent.
If Su Lun were to help, would that mean he had to face off against an eighth-tier silver dragon?

chapters.title: Chapter 540 - 539: [Tartarus' Soul Lamp]
chapters.content:
"Roar~"
A sorrowful yet angry dragon's cry echoed over the capital of Aiklance.
Most of the city's inhabitants were confused.
The residents, even the royal family members within the palace, looked up at the sky with faces full of terror.
They didn't know why the guardian silver dragon was so furious.
Su Lun had just found out that the sixth-tier young dragon, ridden by Princess Becky, was the offspring of the silver dragon from the snowy mountains.
The Mages from the divine plane had killed the young dragon, naturally provoking this adult dragon.
It was after the dragon's cry reverberated through the city and the dragon's presence made people's souls tremble, that a huge silver-white silhouette dove from the sky, heading towards the west of the city.
The silver dragon, like a stream of silver light, blinked down.
"So fast!"
Su Lun's pupils sharply constricted.
The flying speed of this eighth-tier silver dragon was even faster than that of the lightning dragon he had encountered in Atalan City!
This was not a physical level of wing flapping and riding the air currents, but a high-level light system rule, similar to the rule displacement ability of Mr. Jing.
"This is bad..."
Su Lun watched, his eyes full of concern.
With such speed, even if he wanted to save someone, the slightest carelessness would be fatal.
The Holy Light Dragon Breath, comparable to ninth-tier arcane, left almost no room for error, one would either die or be crippled upon contact.
But upon seeing this scene, Su Lun did not hesitate and followed in the direction of the diving dragon.
...
The surroundings changed in an instant, and the silver dragon landed in the city before Su Lun could arrive.
This massive creature, with a wingspan of a hundred meters, dove down like a falling meteor, the situation was incredibly dramatic. Merely the trend of its enveloping body descending was enough to crush a vast area of the southern city into dust.
His offspring being killed, this silver dragon was driven to peak rage, at this moment only his Dragon Breath could vent his anger.
It unleashed a breath of Holy Light, and those terrified residents hadn't even realized what was happening before the hundreds of meters long scorching beam turned the civilians and buildings within the block into ash.
At the same time, snowflakes began to flutter in the sky, and a domineering Sword Intent surged to the heavens.
The temperature plummeted by tens of degrees, and a hundred-meter long Sword Qi burst forth from inside a house, slicing through that terrifying Holy Light Dragon Breath.
From the burning ruins, a figure retreated explosively for a hundred meters, landing far away on the street, it was the "Dragon Hunter" Bartolo Figaro.
Su Lun looked at the Sword Qi, slightly surprised, "Can Dragon Breath even be split?"
This level of Dragon Breath was terrifyingly high on the rule level, and breaking it with Sword Qi was not as simple as it appeared; it was definitely a competition at the level of rule understanding. He was also surprised that this Dragon Hunter faced an eighth-tier giant dragon without being at a disadvantage?
Bartolo was also clearly confused at the moment, his eyebrows deeply furrowed.
But the silver dragon did not give him a chance to understand, as it had sniffed out the murderer!
After a blast of Dragon Breath, the dragon swooped down rapidly, its wings whipping up a storm of sand and stone on the street, and in another moment, it charged again.
The silver dragon was incredibly fast, and the instant it flapped its wings, its figure dissipated on the spot.
Bartolo, who was far away, evidently anticipated this; after years of dragon hunting, he was familiar with every habit of the giant dragons.
But the silver dragon was so fast that he didn't even have time to dodge sideways, he could only cross his sword in front of him, a visible ripple of Sword Qi enveloping his body.
"Bang!"
The silver dragon collided head-on with Bartolo.
Aside from its Dragon Breath, its robust body was also one of the most savage weapons in the world!
When the Holy Light collided with the chilling snow, the two energies exploded at the point of impact, creating a visibly huge shockwave.
At the moment of collision, a figure was sent flying backward, like a cannonball, crashing heavily onto the street.
"Bang," "Bang," "Bang"...
After crashing through more than a dozen buildings and shattering a thick city wall raising dust all over, it finally stopped moving.
How terrifying is the combat power of an eighth-tier pure-blooded giant dragon? Just two encounters had buried an eighth-tier swordsman more than ten meters underground.
Yet it was only after the collision that the shockwave slowly hit, making Su Lun's robe flutter noisily.
Watching with tightly furrowed brows, he knew however that Bartolo was still alive, his soul fluctuations were steady.
At the moment of the collision, Bartolo had obviously not been passively hit, but had actively rebounded. This was clearly a highly skilled technique of unloading force.
"Bartolo is really strong..."
Su Lun murmured to himself.
Previously, when their Dawn Team together had killed an eighth-tier Gatekeeper "King of the Western Sea" Morlock Poppen, they hadn't felt very impressive.
Now watching Bartolo, this "Sword God", he understood that the gap in combat power among eighth-tier professionals was also massive.
But that silver dragon was even stronger!
This terrifying speed made Su Lun fear that even if he teleported to put Bartolo into the mini void realm, that action alone would be enough to cost him his life.
Such was the level of battle that there was simply no room for low-tier professionals to participate directly.
...
Clearly, if Su Lun could sense that Bartolo was not dead, so could the dragons with their keen sense of smell!
Even after slamming him into the ground, the Silver Dragon didn't hold back its anger and flashed its wings again, creating a hurricane that rivaled an Eighth-Tier "Hurricane Technique," howling fiercely through the air.
In an instant, buildings on the ground were uprooted by the fierce wind, countless people were swept up into the sky like ants, and some were even torn into a mist of blood by the powerful wind.
Su Lun hadn't expected the dragon to summon such a formidable hurricane. Even from a distance, he could feel the wind blades painfully cutting as if they were scraping bone, illuminating the horrifying power at the storm's center!
Near the city walls where Bartolo landed, sand and stones flew chaotically. Amid the chaos, it seemed like someone faintly shouted, "Disengage armor!"
Looking again, a figure emerged unscathed from the dusty storm.
He stepped through the wind as if he were climbing an invisible staircase, walking step by step in mid-air, unaffected by the violent winds.
From a distance, seeing this scene, Su Lun wore an expression of newfound understanding and thought to himself, "Legendary secret technique—'Imperial Air Walk'!"
This was the ultimate technique of "Stepping on Air," which allowed one to manipulate air flows and float freely in the sky.
"Ancient Guma Techniques" recorded this secret technique, but it required extremely high skills, which Su Lun had not yet mastered. He hadn't expected to see it used by Bartolo.
However, what shocked him even more was yet to come.
At that moment, the robe Bartolo was wearing had shattered from the impact and was now completely torn apart by the fierce wind, leaving his upper body fully exposed.
Holding a Snow Blade, his muscles tightly wound, it was astonishing to see his body covered with runes that glimmered with golden light, resembling dragon scales!
Su Lun's left eye flashed, identifying the runes - it was armor, which surprised him: "Isaac's Dragon-marked Golden Body armor! Did the Black Sam Band also know the contents of that notebook?"
He had never imagined that the runes on Bartolo's body were actually the Dragon-marked Golden Body.
At that moment, Bartolo showed no fear, even when facing an enemy of a higher realm. This sword god was fearless.
"Domain·Frost Flower Night Snow."
Suddenly, he swung his blade, and with his domain expanded, countless frost flowers in the sky turned into blades of sword Qi.
These thin snowflakes fell on buildings, cutting into them sharply like blades, easily making deep incisions.
When they landed on dragon scales, they made a series of "clang," "clang," "clang" sounds, slicing out small white marks.
The Silver Dragon roared long and charged fiercely again.
A fierce battle between man and dragon erupted once more.
...
Su Lun watched the snowflakes land on the body surface, his thoughts myriad.
Eighth-tier "Overbody," physically resisting a giant dragon, is truly formidable!
In the field of alchemy, the difference between Seventh and Eighth tier is like two entirely different levels of combat power.
He hadn't expected Bartolo to be so monstrously strong.
It seems that after the obliteration of the Black Sam Pirate Crew, he had his own great fortune, achieving an unimaginably high realm in swordsmanship.
The sudden turn of events made Su Lun feel less urgent about rescuing him.
However, from the moment Bartolo's slash failed to penetrate the dragon scales, it was determined that he wouldn't be easily defeated, but he definitely couldn't win.
Moreover, those celestial mages lying in wait behind the scenes, waiting to kill with a borrowed knife, would definitely not let him live.
Su Lun dared not rush into the battlefield recklessly.
But he knew he had to do something.
Thinking it over, he pinched a sorcerer's seal and sent a spiritual message towards the distant Silver Dragon: "Your Excellence the Silver Dragon, I know you can understand my words. There's a conspiracy here, someone has plotted to ambush and kill you. Those people are in the east palace of the city..."
Su Lun used the "Language Proficiency" magic and some Beast Tamer's communication skills, believing that high-level beings like dragons would mostly understand.
Moreover, dragons are naturally cunning. Hearing it was a conspiracy, they should be wary regardless.
Su Lun imagined the best scenario where the Silver Dragon understood his words and then led them to that ten-thousand mage group.
But... things went contrary to his wishes.
The instant the spiritual message was sent, the Silver Dragon's gaze fiercely turned towards him.
Clearly, it had understood.
But Su Lun had underestimated its rage and pride.
In the eyes of a giant dragon, humans are no different than ants.
Good insects and harmful insects are essentially the same!
Even though it had once harbored kind intentions towards humans, serving as a mount for a dragon knight and protecting these human kingdoms for a thousand years.
Did it now think that its offspring had been killed by humans?
It turned dark in an instant.
Whether it was being designed to be killed or actually being killed, these were unalterable facts!
Humans were the culprits.
Let everything be destroyed!
Su Lun saw a flash of chilling luster in those dragon eyes and thought to himself that this was not good.
He didn't hesitate to use teleportation.
Just as the spatial fluctuation appeared, a blast of Holy Light Dragon Breath engulfed his afterimage, burning the entire street block to a charred black.
...
"Dragons really can't be reasoned with!"
Su Lun cursed silently in his heart, once again experiencing the arrogance of the dragon.
Even if it really was a conspiracy, the silver dragon did not regard him as an equal being, so there was absolutely no chance of becoming "the enemy of my enemy is my friend."
As soon as Su Lun landed, Black Fang on his shoulder cawed loudly.
"???"
He was suspicious, not sensing where the danger came from, but instinctively chose to teleport away from the spot.
However, a beam of black light was faster than his teleportation, covering most of the city.
When Su Lun looked again, his attribute panel had shockingly gained a new status: "Soul Locked."
He frowned and followed the direction of the black light, catching sight of the palace's outer arrow tower, where several black-robed mages were lighting an ancient bronze lamp.
The black light emitted by the bronze lamp was not intense, but it imprisoned all the people in the city like a cage.
On inspection, it turned out to be an alchemic curse item of a sealed level.
[Tartaros's Soul-Binding Lamp (Fragment)]
Quality: Legendary
Description: A lamp ignited by souls, guiding the way to the underworld
Curse Traits: When using this lamp to release 'soul marker' within range, it can lock the target's soul, preventing souls weaker than its own from escaping the light's range; after ritual transformation, it can collect free-floating souls to strengthen the wielder's own soul; without understanding higher-order death magic, the soul suffers a curse of evil spirit backlash, resulting in soul dispersion; killing the holder dissolves the soul mark;
Detailed Explanation: This is not an ordinary lantern; it was once a lantern used by a deity of death to imprison souls;
"Is it actually this thing?"
Su Lun looked somewhat familiar with the effect.
Looking again at his own inventory, didn't he just have a piece of [Tartaros's Soul Lamp Chain]?
That chain was from when he had escaped from Old Lington, something the pirates of the Northern Sea had used in an ambush against Mr. Jing.
Kept in the inventory without much use, he never thought he would encounter another component now.
The opponents knew he had spatial displacement abilities, so having measures against spatial displacement was not surprising.
However, he had thought that with the [Urobolos Space-Time Ring], no matter how the space was restricted, he could still escape. He never expected the enemy to have side abilities like soul marking.
At that moment, Su Lun immediately thought of a phrase to describe his situation—caught in a turtle trap.
Those guys didn't even need to come looking for him; the Soul Lamp had restricted everyone in the royal capital.
After hunting down the dragon, they could just take their time to search.
If Su Lun wanted to escape the marking, he had to kill the necromancer holding the lamp.
Either caught in a turtle trap or wait by the tree for the rabbit.
Neither was a good outcome.
...
Su Lun himself always relied on overpowering his enemies with equipment, so now being caught by a special curse item didn't bother him much.
Instantly, his mind started working at high speed, calculating the possibility of breaking the situation: "The black light covers approximately a dozen kilometers, meaning I can only teleport within this range. Moreover, the range of the black light can be controlled and reduced by the manipulators, which is the real trouble..."
The light range can also be controlled and reduced. Making it this large now is to cover the entire royal capital. Another reason is not daring to get too close to the battlefield of Bartolo and the silver dragon, fearing to catch the attention of the evil dragon and Bartolo.
So, as long as Bartolo is not dead, the light range will not be reduced for the time being.
Su Lun quickly thought of a strategy to deal with it.
If that evil dragon does not trust humans, then stir up more commotion and pull the mages from the realm of gods into the fray.
If they can't cooperate, then let it be a three-way chaotic battle.
There would always be an opportunity.
From the current perspective, the situation was not too bad.
At least, those from the realm of gods had not yet pinpointed his location nor paid too much attention to this mere seventh-tier.
For them, he was just a minor "side target" apart from slaying dragons and killing Bartolo.
But he had already locked onto the soul position of the necromancer controlling [the Soul-Binding Lamp].
As long as he killed this fellow, the deadlock could be broken.
Having thought this through, Su Lun notified Bartolo then his figure quietly vanished from that place.
...
The streets were filled with people panicking everywhere.
The battle between Bartolo and the Silver Dragon was exaggerated to the extreme, like a constant magnitude eight earthquake, shaking the entire city continuously.
The streets were covered in web-like cracks, and buildings collapsed in large patches.
The royal dragon knights and the royal guards, too, were like headless flies, still clueless about what was happening.
They had just received orders to arrest the assassin who had killed Princess Becky at the embassy.
But before they could find the person, they witnessed the fierce battle between the "Dragon Hunter," Bartolo, and the guardian dragon of the nation.
This was not a battle that low-tier professionals could partake in.
The furious, eighth-tier, pureblood Holy Light Silver Dragon unleashed its oppressive aura indiscriminately, suppressing the entire city and causing those dragons with only a trace of dragon blood to tremble on the ground.
Not a single dragon could fly in mid-air.
Su Lun also approached the royal palace with ease.
According to the memories he had stripped away previously, Garcia, taking advantage of his position as the brother-in-law of the nation, had hidden a thousand-member magic squadron behind the palace walls.
It was originally the garrison of the imperial guards, fortified to defend the palace against attacks.
When Su Lun teleported there, the palace was already illuminated by the glow of magical restraints.
On the bricks of the city walls outside, a series of mysterious high-level magical runes flickered.
Su Lun assessed them and quickly dismissed the idea of forcing his way through.
This was a legion barrier with a magic tower hidden underground, capable of withstanding spells of the ninth level.
The enemies had also calculated well, as even an eighth-tier professional of Bartolo's caliber would find this barrier could hold up for a considerable time before breaking.
Su Lun could teleport inside, but without needing to think about it, teleporting in would likely trigger countless pre-arranged magical restraints, leading to his control until death. Moreover, the eighth-tier Augustus of the Holy Army had yet to show up, possibly hiding inside.
However, if he didn't enter, it seemed he couldn't kill the necromancer.
But if people couldn't, alchemy could.
Su Lun's goal was to kill.
Since he couldn't breach the barrier by force, he decided to destroy it altogether.
His own powers, even if a thousand times stronger, might not break the barrier, but he had explosives.
In the words of his bomb-genius disciple, Jike, there was no barrier in the world that couldn't be blown open.
If there was, then there was simply not enough ammunition.
The ammunition expert's favorite was always a stationary target.
People could run, but magical restraints could not.
The deities of the Divine Plane had calculated everything, but those who had never seen a cannon couldn't realize the power of explosives.
Alchemy could create miracles, allowing humans to harness energy far beyond their own capabilities.
Realizing this, Su Lun took out the "Multi-layered Cascade Thermite Bomb."
This was the explosive formula that Jike had come up with to break the prohibitions at the Royal Library of RuYing.
Having tested its effectiveness at breaking through restrictions, Su Lun had the war workshop produce a pile of them for backup.
The temporary legion barrier before him was clearly not as robust as the Royal Library of RuYing.
Originally, one hundred kilograms had been sufficient to blast a large hole in the library, but Su Lun casually took out a barrel weighing a thousand kilograms.
Dora and the senior mechanics from Mafa designed an ultra-precision detonation device that even a fool could operate, ensuring the explosives were directed precisely for blasting.
The data on explosive energy was exact, detailing how many kilograms were needed to blast a barrier of any given tier.
With the enemy's situation unclear, Su Lun didn't skimp and thought about killing everyone inside, so he piled about a hundred barrels of explosives in a building outside the city wall.
....
The people from the Divine Plane inside might have sensed someone approaching, but no one came out.
Their orders were to defend the barrier at all costs, never falling for any "lure the enemy" tactics.
No one came to stop Su Lun, allowing him to proceed smoothly with his operations.
A few moments later, the explosives were in place.
Su Lun teleported out and, without hesitation, pressed the detonation button.
The enemies inside the walls might have noticed something was amiss, but Su Lun's actions took only a few moments, leaving them with no time to think.
As their sense of crisis became increasingly clear, the mages still thought not of escaping but of pouring magic power into strengthening the barrier.
Seeing this, Su Lun felt relieved of any hassle.
If the people escaped, he would kill them.
If they didn't escape, the explosives would solve the problem.
Reaction efficiency of the explosives was much faster than gathering magic power. Almost the instant he pressed the button, there was a loud "boom," and a giant mushroom cloud rose.
In the city walls, all the mages had not yet grasped what was happening when their world was enveloped by a blazing light.
Watching the blaze in front of him, Su Lun suddenly thought of his disciple Jike's favorite motto: "Explosions are art indeed..."

chapters.title: Chapter 541 - 540: Visit the Royal Treasury?
chapters.content:
The southern city wall of the palace erupted with a deafening blast, flames soaring into the sky.
The intense flames were blindingly white as the shockwave plunged underground, causing the entire city and the mountains behind it to tremble.
"Boom" — a flood-like sound resounded. Looking up, one could see the age-old snow of Mount Loki crumbling away and rushing down the mountain.
However, the explosion, precisely directed, was confined to this section of the city wall and didn't cause any civilian casualties.
Even the cluster of buildings behind the city walls within the palace grounds hardly collapsed.
Su Lun looked at the huge hole, dozens of meters deep, that had been blasted in front of him and raised his eyebrows — the explosion was almost as expected.
In his Soul Perception, the waves of about a thousand living souls that were previously hidden within this magic barrier instantly vanished. A dense "ash mist" floated above the debris.
As expected, the necromancer he was targeting was also killed by the blast.
Seeing the negative status of soul lock disappear from his panel, Su Lun breathed a sigh of relief.
The ruins of the city wall in front of him were charred, with blue smoke rising from everywhere. The mage group of a thousand, along with their storage rings, were annihilated. The high temperature and shockwaves had turned most of the matter into ash. Some metal objects had also melted into scorching hot streams, unrecognizable in their previous forms.
Su Lun didn't delay and dashed into the ruins to harvest souls.
He harvested the soul of the mage controlling the "Lamp of Forbidden Souls," gaining insights into the rare death magic principles, and thought unexpectedly, "Huh… this necromancer was actually a member of the Sacred Army?"
The Sacred Army generally contains warriors around the top ten legendary powers, each having special abilities. This "Heizel Howard" necromancer was quite powerful, possessing an exceptionally high understanding of death magic principles, the highest Su Lun had ever encountered.
Even facing him directly, it wouldn't have been easy for Su Lun to kill him.
It was a pity that he died in the explosion before he could exhibit his many methods.
Looking again at the ground, the previously vibrant "Lamp of Tartaros" was now dim and lifeless, displaying the words "Damaged and unusable."
Well, at least the enemy won't be able to use it if they reclaim it.
With one fatal method restricting his ability to teleport now gone, Su Lun breathed another sigh of relief.
Fortunately, the higher the quality of a cursed object, the better its materials, and it was still largely intact. In his mini Void Realm, there were a group of mountain dwarves skilled in forging, including the animated corpses made by Dwarf King Iron Helm Aike.
Su Lun believed it was probably repairable.
The soul lamp seemed to have a high compatibility with his death magic abilities, and he was looking forward to what qualitative changes it would undergo if he embedded it together with the soul chain.
...
The original plan of the mages from the divine realm was to use this Lamp of Forbidden Souls to control the entire city's population, making escape from the city impossible for anyone.
Within this defined area, their ten-thousand-strong mage group was practically invincible.
The plan initially had no issues.
Regrettably, Su Lun, using methods beyond their comprehension, killed the lamp controller in an incredibly short time, catching them off guard.
However, the explosion at the palace walls was so loud that it instantly drew the attention of everyone in the capital city of Aike.
While those from the divine realm mainly intended to kill that silver dragon and Bartholomew, with Plan A now ruined, they naturally had a backup plan.
Almost simultaneously, magical glows like lighthouse beams lit up from each direction—east, west, south, and north of the city.
There used to be a magic tower here at the city wall too. Although it was destroyed, there was clearly a backup.
As soon as Su Lun saw the setup, having witnessed several large-scale mage group actions before, how could he not know that things were about to get serious?
Previously, those mage groups had planned to hide and wait until the Silver Dragon had killed Bartholomew before taking action.
But now, without the soul mark, they could only act ahead of schedule.
The moment the large mage group revealed itself, the Silver Dragon was also aware of it.
The sudden surge of magical fluctuations within the city was so exaggerated that even a fool would know there was danger.
Not only are dragons arrogant, but they are also cunning.
It remembered that previously a human had warned it, suspecting that someone was planning an ambush against it.
The Silver Dragon immediately became alert.
But its pride prevented it from fleeing the city right away. Instead, it angrily continued to observe who dared to plot against it.
However, it was just this moment of delay.
Within the magical barrier, a beam of light rushed towards the Silver Dragon. It seemed well-prepared, making the Silver Dragon's speed too slow to evade.
Despite its best efforts to dodge, the beam still pierced through the left wing of the Silver Dragon, passing straight through.
Su Lun's eyes narrowed as he watched, and even with his excellent vision, he only saw a shadow.
"Cadmos's Dragon Hunting Spear"
Detailed Description: Once used by dwarves to repel evil dragons, this spear was forged from eternal gold; inscribed with 'Dragon Slaying Rune,' 'Deception Rune,' and 'Flash Rune,' it possesses the speed of a flash, deceives the dragon's senses, and has the ability to penetrate dragon scales.
Looking at the identified information, Su Lun felt slightly envious, "What a nice item!"
The spear was sharp enough to pierce through the wing of an eighth-tier Silver Dragon, which speaks to its sharpness.
But just piercing a hole in the wing was obviously a minor injury.
Clearly, the celestial clan had more tricks up their sleeve.
Right after the spear pierced, a magical light flashed, and what seemed to be the airflow from the previous trajectory of the spear suddenly solidified, turning into a rope.
The rope pierced through the dragon's wing and quickly wrapped around it.
Su Lun's own "Wailing Witch's Hair" was this kind of energy thread; he clearly understood what had happened.
Upon further inspection, it was indeed another treasure.
"Gracie's Entangler"
Detailed Description: Known as the most resilient rope in the world, with +999 resilience; crafted by ancient gnomes using cats' steps, rocks' roots, women's whiskers, fishes' breath, bears' vigilance, and birds' saliva; it is a magical device that can stretch indefinitely as long as there is sufficient magic power.
...
"The celestial plane really has no shortage of mage treasures..."
Looking at these two items, Su Lun immediately felt that the Silver Dragon was in danger today.
With the spear piercing through the dragon's wing, the rope promptly bound its wings.
The Silver Dragon also realized it was being plotted against, struggling to fly high as the rope continued to lengthen.
But at the same time, the legion's magic barrier, formed by nine magic towers, also exerted its power.
The magic towers acted as the anchors for the ropes; if the dragon wanted to flee, it was like dragging an entire city behind it—escape was naturally impossible.
This scene was like a fisherman who had hooked a big fish, not in a hurry to reel it in, the two were stuck in a deadlock.
The ropes, as Su Lun had identified, possessed an almost unbreakable toughness.
How terrifying was the power of the eighth-tier Silver Dragon?
But struggling, diving, and circling in the sky with various fancy flying maneuvers, there was still no sign of the ropes breaking.
Instead, the higher it flew, the tighter the ropes pulled, making it even more difficult for it.
The Silver Dragon roared in anger, turned direction and dove downward, spewing Dragon Breath towards the city below.
Unfortunately, this was a carefully planned dragon hunting battle.
The Holy Light Dragon Breath, capable of crystalling sand and stone, was helpless against the ropes. Furthermore, the Dragon Breath sprayed on the legion's barrier was also absorbed by the magic barrier.
The Silver Dragon dove down and tried to smash into one of the magic towers with its massive dragon body, but alas, despite the great commotion, the thick layers of amber-colored magic shield completely blocked the physical shockwaves.
Although some mages died within the barrier, it remained intact.
Dragon Breath and dragon claws were useless, tied by ropes and unable to fly away...
In an instant, the Silver Dragon found itself in a situation where all its methods were futile; it crazily spewed Dragon Breath, struggling...
Like a hooked fish, waiting for exhaustion to set in—it was the fisherman's time to harvest.
...
Su Lun was not surprised watching this.
The strength of the ten thousand mage legion was no less than that of the ninth-tier, plus so many treasures and prearranged plans, the Silver Dragon falling into the trap was inevitable.
However, it seemed the Silver Dragon's stamina wouldn't run out anytime soon, and those legion mages could only hide inside the barrier, unable to determine victory or defeat.
Now without "Soul Lock," Su Lun was not even a bit panicky.
He wanted to leave now, and no one could stop him.
Looking at the struggling Silver Dragon, he still prayed that this arrogant lizard would hold on a bit longer.
It being tied down meant the main force of the ten thousand mage legion wouldn't come looking for trouble with him.
However, Su Lun also didn't have the opportunity to destroy any more magic towers.
That kind of plan could only be used once; next time, knowing he had such a tactic, it would definitely not succeed.
"Wonder how Bartholo's injuries are..."
As soon as Su Lun thought that, he always felt those beings from the divine realm must still have strategies targeting Bartholo.
Thinking about going to check on him, he teleported in the direction Bartholo had fled.
Meanwhile, the entire city was also in chaos.
This giant dragon was the kingdom's guardian dragon, and now someone dared to ambush the Silver Dragon in the royal capital, the royal guards naturally went to help the Silver Dragon in battle.
Unfortunately, the luxurious and indulgent Gracie royal family didn't have many supporters.
The nobles of the kingdom, led by the Garcia family, had long secretly sided with the people from the divine realm.
Those magic towers were also built with the secret support of the major nobles.
Thus, the nobles' private soldiers and the royal knights ended up mixing in the streets, subtly encircling the royal palace.
Apart from Su Lun destroying one magic tower, everything else was part of the divine realm mages' plan.
...
In a dense forest ten kilometers outside the city, a fierce battle was taking place.
Although Bartholo was unmatched in battle strength, having fought alone against the Silver Dragon, he was severely injured.
At this moment, his bare upper body was covered in wounds, a dent in his chest where a dragon claw had struck him, shattering his ribs. This left him unable to exert strength in his entire left arm and half of his body.
But more dreadful than the injuries was the aberration in his body.
Previously, to obtain the strength to match the ninth-tier Silver Dragon, Bartholo had exhausted all his methods in a bitter battle, barely managing to drag the Silver Dragon into restraint.
Just when he thought of escaping the royal capital, the aberration exploded.
He immediately realized he had been cursed by a sorcerer.
Once, the white-robed sorcerer Garcia Haydon had given him a formula to suppress aberrations, but it also contained a hidden catch.
Those people wanted to kill him with the aberration!
Luckily, he had a few of the "Aberration Suppressants" that Su Lun had given him; after injecting them, the signs of aberration were amazingly suppressed.
But before Bartholo could feel relieved, he was blocked by a five hundred mage legion, and the battle had been fierce ever since.
Having depleted much of his energy in the great battle with the Silver Dragon and still having to devote part of his attention to suppressing the aberration, he found his fighting capability somewhat lacking now.Moreover, this five hundred-person legion was no ordinary group.
The leader was only a seventh-tier, but they seemed to move as one; fighting one was like fighting five hundred—extremely tricky.
Bartholo knew these were the divine realm mages Su Lun had spoken of, but it was his first encounter with such an odd seventh-tier, his first encounter with a magic legion.
His sword hacking at these gilded-skinned fellows was like striking a metallic body, sparks flying everywhere.
He could inflict wounds, but they completely ignored the pain.
The more wounds they had, the more blood they spilled, the stronger they seemed to become.
Bartholo also grew concerned; if the fight dragged on, he would no longer be able to rely on his own strength to suppress the aberration, and then, no potion would work.
However, just then, the space fluctuated suddenly, and a figure appeared nearby.
Bartholo recognized him immediately and felt grateful; the one to come to his aid at this critical moment could only be Su Lun.
But his brow furrowed immediately.
Although he knew Su Lun was strong, the current situation, with just one person arriving, wouldn't solve the problem.
...
Fortunately, the battle was noisy here, allowing Su Lun to successfully find his way over.
As soon as he arrived, he noticed that the facial features on Bartholomew's back were already fully distinct, and the hellish aura visibly steamed out from his body. This was a sign that he was always on the verge of deformation.
Looking at the syringe on the ground, it appeared it had already been used with a deformation potion.
If not suppressed, Bartholomew would undoubtedly die.
Su Lun furrowed his brow.
Looking again, on the other side was a group of five hundred Mages.
However, this group was different from other mages; they all wore white robes resembling those of priests.
Su Lun knew, these were the Ascetic Monks of the temple.
They could be roughly understood as the reserve force of the holy church's army.
The leader was a bald old man.
This skinny old man's body was covered in sword scars, densely packed like fish scales.
Yet eerily, his skin seemed like a layer of copper, and the bones revealed by sword cuts looked like black metal. Even the blood flowing on the ground was a dark red, giving the impression of flowing liquid rust.
Not just the leader, but the skins of those five hundred people were more or less tinged with various degrees of golden lacquer.
Thanks to the memories he had harvested before, Su Lun recognized this person's identity: "The Ascetic Leader of the holy church's army, Ferna Fan, half-step eighth rank..."
No wonder these fellows were riddled with wounds, because they were all "stacking passives."
...
The Ascetic Monks normally practiced refining their bones and muscles, belonging to the lineage of melee Mages.
Through their own suffering, they liberated the believers.
They possessed an incredibly BUG-like passive skill called [Pain-Driven Fury].
After being injured, they'd fall into a berserk state, the more pain their flesh endured, the stronger their combat ability grew, infinitely stacking until death.
At the brink of death, they could even acquire abilities close to those of deities, chanting the names of their gods, confessing their sins, and gaining divine power.
This was a capability that sounded bizarre and looked sickening in battle, but undeniably, it was extremely powerful.
It was only then that Su Lun understood why Bartholomew hadn't been able to defeat them yet.
These guys had extremely tenacious vitality and could also regenerate as a legion, sharing damage among the group, making it very hard to kill them.
The damage shared among five hundred people was significantly reduced.
To kill one, you almost had to wipe out the entire group of five hundred.
But their attack was like the collective punch of five hundred people.
The Ascetic Monks' legion with such BUG-level capabilities, even ordinary eighth ranks would genuinely struggle against them for a while.
...
Just as he observed this instant, Bartholomew spewed another mouthful of old blood.
Su Lun, seeing the disordered aura of the Old Sword God, hurriedly said, "Senior Bartholomew, don't take action anymore, leave these people to me."
"But..."
Bartholomew frowned upon hearing this.
The methods of these enemies were so tricky; definitely not something a seventh rank professional could handle.
He wanted to remind Su Lun and also felt he should help somehow.
But before he could speak, he was already a step too slow.
Su Lun didn't explain much; with a pinch of the sorcerer's seals, waves of empty space fluctuations appeared.
In an instant, the nearby light dimmed suddenly.
Looking again, densely packed gargoyles emerged mid-air, covering the sky.
Bartholomew looked up and was instantly dumbstruck.
Not just dozens, but more than a thousand!
"How is that possible? Even a Great Grandmaster Puppeteer couldn't control so many puppets..."
Bartholomew's eyes were full of disbelief.
He watched these gargoyles, glittering with silver light, and instantly thought that Su Lun was just deploying them in formation, not necessarily able to control them all simultaneously.
But in the next moment, a bizarre scene unfolded.
Bartholomew watched as Su Lun's hands and the arachnid spears behind him trembled slightly, threads connecting them, and those thousand-plus gargoyle puppets moved in unison.
The thousand-plus puppets assembled in a formation clearly meant for legion battle, their aura connected as one.
Then, they began their charge.
On those massive iron fists, space-cracking waves buzzed simultaneously, charging towards the previously rampaging five hundred-person Ascetic Monks!
In that instant, it was as if he saw the once-great charge of the Royal Legions of Ruel.
"This..."
Bartholomew's eyes trembled, and his heart was beyond shocked.
...
Dealing with such an Ascetic Monks' legion was indeed too challenging for one person.
They formed a collective halo protected by divinity, even Su Lun's Domain of Death was severely limited.
Moreover, however strong the attack, when divided among five hundred, the damage was very limited.
There was almost no countermeasure against the Ascetic Monks' legion.
If there was one, it was only legion against legion!
Su Lun's gargoyles each possessed the combat power of professionals of the fourth or fifth rank, not at all weaker than these Ascetic Monks.
Ascetic Monks were bodies of Vajra runes, but could they outlast true metallic bodies?
The structure of the gargoyle was immune to most physical and magical attacks, and even if its fist punched a dent, the memory metal properties of "Living Silver" immediately restored it.
The ascetics feared neither life nor death, and the puppets were equally fearless.
Besides, Su Lun was proficient in various legion formations of the Divine Plane. Could a thousand legions lose to one of five hundred?
In an instant, the gargoyle legion transformed into a steel torrent, charging forward with irresistible force.
"Thud," "Thud," "Thud"...
There were no fancy magics, both sides excelled in hand-to-hand combat.
Fist clashed against fist, ringing out like the sound of a bell throughout the surroundings.
Bartolo, who had just been thinking of helping, was completely stupefied.
How could he have imagined a Puppet Master being this powerful!
Controlling a thousand puppets simultaneously?
Also knowledgeable in legion formations, cooperating flawlessly without any flaws, his calmness nearly numb...
And it seemed this was far from Su Lun's limit; he clearly had many more tricks up his sleeve.
Bartolo muttered to himself, "He really is an exceptional young man..."
He had thought a "Sword Genius" who could handle a thousand was already a rare talent, yet this Su Lun was even more special.
For a moment, he thought of the former Black Sam's Pirate Crew. Only like-minded and similarly outstanding companions could come together.
But then, unable to help himself, he spat out a mouthful of crimson blood and hastily began to meditate right there on the spot.
...
And everyone knew that the only shortcoming of a Puppet Master was his physical body.
Just kill the body, and anything else falls apart.
Unfortunately, Su Lun the Puppeteer had no shortcomings.
Without special abilities to counter him, without the suppression of ranks, being strong below the eighth tier was meaningless.
Now, Su Lun's ability to preserve his life made it nearly impossible for those below the eighth tier to kill him.
Although the fanatical zealots' "Suffering Frenzy" grew in power with sustained damage, intensifying as injuries worsened, the human body had its limits, and upon reaching those limits, they would perish on the spot.
The gargoyle legion feared not the loss of its members, constantly replenished at all times.
Thus, the two sides clashed head-on several times, from the initial thousand versus five hundred gradually changing to a thousand versus four hundred, three hundred, two hundred...
The number of zealots who perished explosively increased, and their combat effectiveness weakened accordingly.
However, always, the number of gargoyles remained the same.
The Ascetic Leader, Ferna, also attempted to kill Su Lun, but, alas, it was not that easy.
Su Lun's prowess wasn't only in his puppets; his own combat ability was not weaker than that of Ferna.
Eventually, in a very short time, Su Lun brazenly resolved the battle using his legion to suppress theirs.
The ground was strewn with corpses, not one spared.
Su Lun stood amid the pile of bodies, a shadow of Death emerging behind him, reaping the five hundred souls.
His eyes sparkled; the ascetic monks' bodhisattva secrets were greatly beneficial to him.
The bodies along with the spoils of war were all taken into the tiny void realm, a pull of a thread, and the puppets also disappeared.
If not for the messy traces of battle, one would never know that five hundred people had just died here.
Su Lun turned his head to see Bartolo meditating in the distance.
His body's aura of hell had become unbearably manic, his expression faintly ferocious.
Su Lun knew what this meant – a transformation was imminent.
It seemed there was also a foreign force similar to "Curse Magic" affecting his transformation.
He wasted no time throwing Bartolo into the tiny void realm.
With the void separating him, any curse magic would be ineffective.
Moreover, with Dr. Banks and others there in the tiny void realm, the transformation should be controllable.
Having done all this, Su Lun looked towards the distant capital of Aike.
At this moment, the sounds of an angry dragon's roar could still be heard, indicating the battle was still intense.
"Where to next?"
Su Lun narrowed his eyes.
With the Silver Dragon occupying the main force of the ten-thousand mage assembly, those guys, even if they knew about the Holy Ascetic Corp's demise, probably couldn't spare any forces.
If Su Lun left now, indeed he would be safe.
But he felt this was a good opportunity.
They had schemed against him once; not to retaliate didn't fit his character.
And that Silver Dragon was an eighth-tier pure-blooded dragon.
The situation had turned.
He had become a spectator, a cuckoo in the free stand, with plenty of room for maneuver.
"Why not take a look inside the Gracie royal treasury?"
The thought suddenly struck Su Lun, and his face immediately brightened.
He was a pirate, after all!
Looting was what he loved best.
Previously, as an invited guest and with restraint, it was predictable that once the Silver Dragon was killed, the Gracie royal family would be overthrown and the entire kingdom would become a divine nation of the Divine Plane with everything in the royal treasury becoming booty of the Divine Plane.
Should he take a look first?
As soon as the thought occurred to Su Lun, his figure had already disappeared from the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 542 - 541: Scouring the Treasury
chapters.content:
The battle over the skies of the capital Aike Lunsa had become incredibly fierce.
The silver dragon, bound by the Magical Rope "Grapnir the Entangler," was unable to break free. But being a pure-blooded giant dragon of the eighth order, it knew it could not escape its fate today, and fought with such ferocity that it was terrifying to behold.
Even those from the divine plane didn't dare to be careless, hiding behind defensive barriers, casting ninth-order magic and forbidden spells of all kinds. The two sides engaged in a bombardment against the city's nine magic towers.
Dragon Breath versus army magic, the raging energy exploded over the city like a boiling pot.
The violent shockwaves flattened buildings throughout the city in swaths, while rubble and avalanches from Mount Loki behind the city poured down like torrents, causing people to run about in panic, everywhere a scene of disaster.
When Su Lun teleported back into the city, he avoided the main battlefield and headed straight for the post station near the palace.
He hadn't forgotten that he was ambushed here earlier, and that there was still the body of a young silver dragon.
When he arrived, the body was still unattended in the pit, so Su Lun casually picked it up and threw it into the biological research institute of his little void realm. As Dr. Banks would say, the genetic research of pure-blooded giant dragons is extremely valuable.
The post station had a clear view of the palace.
At this moment, the avalanche had covered a large part of the palace courtyard, and the fighting inside was also intense.
The guards loyal to the royal family were locked in fierce combat with the private soldiers of the nobles who had already sworn allegiance to the divine plane.
Su Lun had no interest in meddling in their fight, and directly teleported in the direction he planned.
The memories of the white-robed Mage Garcia Haydon, who had been stripped away earlier, happened to be clear about the location of the palace's treasure vault.
After teleporting, Su Lun appeared in front of a wall with a magic gate.
Though the Silver Dragon Kingdom had only existed for a mere thousand years, the dragon-taming civilization of the Dragon Country Waters had been ongoing for tens of thousands of years. Of the nine great kingdoms, only three remained, holding the vast majority of treasures from this sea area.
Su Lun was also very curious about what was inside the treasury.
He pinched a sorcerer's seal, and a spatial crack appeared before his eyes.
He bypassed the intricate prohibitions directly and entered the midst of the treasure vault.
Upon a glimpse, the thousands of square meters of the treasury were dazzling with gold and silver.
"Indeed, nobles everywhere are quite wealthy..."
Su Lun muttered to himself.
Despite the commoners' lives in the Dragon Country still being stuck in a primitive state of agriculture, with very basic food, clothing, housing, and transportation, the Gracie royal family was exceedingly wealthy.
At the moment, various treasures were piled up like mountains in the treasury.
However, Su Lun was not interested in the ordinary gold and silver objects; he was more concerned about those things that looked particularly special.
After all, the Gracie royal family was a lineage of Dragon Knights. Upon entering, he saw a row of Dragon Knight heavy armors, maintained to a shine, along with dragon lances, two-handed greatswords, shields... and so on, a total of twenty to thirty sets of fine armor and weapon suites identified as "silver quality" or higher.
Knight heavy armor, even in Luying, was a top-tier luxury.
A good set of armor could elevate the combat power of a knight by several levels.
Moreover, since these armors were Dragon Knight armor, the enchantments and runes, specifically designed against draconic might and Dragon Breath, were even more precious.
It was when Su Lun saw this batch of armor that his gaze was immediately drawn to one particularly tall set of armor, identified as the "Gracie's Dragon Rider Heavy Armor (Legendary)".
"The armor worn by Gracie the First?"
Looking at this legendary-quality armor, Su Lun was pleasantly surprised.
He hadn't expected to find such a legendary treasure.
This was a full set of heavy armor, which looked to have very thick plating, with a noble pattern of thorny roses emblazoned on the chest—now the royal emblem of the Gracie family. Despite the passage of countless years, it still radiated a fierce aura.
This heavy armor had accompanied its owner through battles, soaked with dragon blood, the blood of powerful enemies, and the souls of innumerable unjustly slain. Even as an empty suit of armor, it evoked an impressive image of a majestic Dragon Knight wearing it, exuding a chilly and oppressive aura. Within the T-shaped slit of the helmet, there seemed to be a pair of ghostly eyes staring at the unfamiliar intruder who had breached the treasury.
"Eh... it has already developed sentience?"
Su Lun clearly felt the slight soul fluctuation within the armor and was surprised.
Just as the famed sword "Onimaru Kunitsuna" had spirit, so did this armor.
Su Lun had heard of such things but was seeing it for the first time, and he exclaimed with delight, "What a fine piece!"
He reached out to try, and though he managed to pick up the small round shield next to the armor, his right arm's muscles bulged and twisted, making it very difficult for him.
It was as if it wasn't designed for humans at all but for beings with the divine power of giants.
And this was just a shield.
One could imagine how terrifyingly heavy the complete suit of armor would be if worn.
Considering King Gracie the First of the Ancient Dragon Country had tamed a level eight silver dragon, he must have possessed level nine strength himself. Armor that could be worn by a level nine professional would surely have astonishing defensive capabilities.
While Su Lun now had the strength to wear it, it would be impractical for battle.
No wonder it was left in storage gathering dust; this Dragon Knight armor was not only frighteningly heavy but also selective of its wearer.
A general strength-based professional without level eight capabilities would almost certainly be unable to wear and fight in it.
Su Lun felt an artificial heaviness and knew the armor's spirit was rejecting him, a Puppet Master.
However, this did not dampen the joy of his find.
The Dawn Brigade had now come to the Dragon Country for adventure, and they would inevitably have to fight against dragons and sub-dragons. This batch of armor was perfect for filling the gaps in the members' high-end equipment needs.
Moreover, Barrett and his "Sacred Judgment Legion" brought along professionals of the strength class, especially suited for this heavy armor.
If the full armor wasn't suitable, parts of it could be used; if level seven was insufficient, one could wait for level eight—the right time would always come...
Su Lun was pleased as he stored the armor away.
His gaze then moved elsewhere. The royal treasure was abundant.
Ordinary gold and silver treasures were piled in brass-studded chests on the floor, dozens of them varying in size. Along the wall stood rows of cabinets containing treasures of precious value.
Among them, Su Lun found some ancient documents and relics from the Ancient Dragon Country that he wanted.
There were also various ancient relics, weapons, magic gemstones, and the like...
But there was no time to look closely, so he quickly gathered them all.
To his surprise and delight, he found a box of Dragon Crystals in a sealed case.
The accumulated quantity over a millennium in the Silver Dragon Country was considerable. Naturally, those collected by the royalty were all level six or above Dragon Crystals. Although mostly from sub-dragons, these few hundred crystals were enough to create a large number of high-level puppet cores.
Just then, the noise of battle outside grew louder.
The violent shaking made the royal treasury feel as if an earthquake had occurred.
"Someone is trying to break the treasury door?"
Su Lun sensed the commotion and immediately guessed it must be the nobles' private soldiers breaking through the palace. Otherwise, the royal family wouldn't have triggered those traps to get into the treasury.
By now, most of the treasures in the treasury had been moved. Su Lun ignored the scattered gold coins on the floor that were not easy to pick up, and with another teleport, his figure had already left the treasury.
With a cunning thought, he imagined the surprise on the faces of the rebels when they broke in only to find an empty treasury.
...
The scenery changed around him, and Su Lun was back near the postal station.
Looking again, the rebels had already breached deep into the palace, and the battle was still fiercely severe.
Glancing upward, Su Lun saw the silver dragon still full of life, its battle against the magic battalion appearing to be nowhere near conclusion.
At that moment, Su Lun thought of something and teleported to the royal prison.
Now that most of the capital, Eklundsa, was reduced to ruins, this specially reinforced prison had suffered little damage.
Su Lun had come here with the intention of rescaring Bennett.
After all, the captain of the Miracle Legion had been captured and had not forgotten to send a message through his sister, making it a matter of both sentiment and principle to attempt a rescue.
At this time, the prison was also in turmoil.
With the battle raging so violently outside, the prisoners naturally sought opportunities to escape. Having killed the guards, they were fleeing in disarray.
The royal prison had a total of seven floors, five of them underground.
Su Lun knew Bennett was on the bottom floor with the most serious offenders and immediately teleported down.
The surroundings became dim, and the air was filled with the dampness and stench of dead rats.
The fifth level underground was a water prison, and it had the most rigorously enforced restrictions. Even if the levels above were in disarray, this place remained sealed.
As soon as Su Lun arrived, he saw Barrett and his few hundred subordinates of the Miracle Army in the sewage, looking disheveled and dirty.
Those people also saw him.
Barrett rubbed his eyes, as if both expecting and surprised, and exclaimed, "Mr. Su Lun!"
If he could see people, then it meant the message he sent for his sister had successfully gotten out.
But immediately afterward, he quickly asked, "What exactly happened outside?"
Su Lun casually swung his black scythe and unlocked the prison cell, succinctly explaining, "Garcia colluded with mages from the divine realm and rebelled, having become a devout follower of foreign gods. They planned and killed Princess Becky and the young dragon, and now they are besieging the protector god dragon..."
"What?!"
Upon hearing this, Barrett and the members of the Miracle Army showed a drastic change in expression.
They had not known the reason for their capture until now; upon hearing it, they instantly understood.
So the royal uncle Garcia was a devotee of the foreign gods!
One by one, they were filled with righteous indignation, ready to rush out and fight.
Su Lun let everyone out and added a reminder, "The palace has already been breached by the rebels. Outside, the magic army and the silver dragon are still in a fierce battle, and this dungeon is actually the safest place..."
In a battle of that scale, even seventh-order fighters would be cannon fodder.
Barrett clearly understood his meaning and said, "Thank you for the reminder, Mr. Su Lun. But as royal knights, it is our duty, and we must go out."
Hearing this, Su Lun nodded and said nothing further.
In any situation, loyalty is a rare quality.
He had not rushed to rescue them because he didn't want them to get involved.
Now that he had rescued them, there was nothing more to say.
...
Watching the members of the Miracle Army rush out of the prison, Su Lun's mind began to work again.
Now that the royal treasury had been emptied, he had left only some loose change for those devotees of the divine realm.
It was a small inconvenience for those fellows.
But, not significant.
Looking at the current situation, if there are no surprises, the death of the silver dragon seems to be a matter of time.
Then the entire Silver Dragon Country... no, even Pania and Acatistes, the two kings, would become divine nations under the divine realm, posing endless dangers.
Su Lun didn't want to witness that scene.
He thought the best outcome would be for the silver dragon and those people from the divine realm to suffer mutual losses.
Thinking so, he teleported and summoned an "Earth Elemental Wax Figure."
Since the prison level was reinforced with elements, he teleported to a crack in the underground.
Then, using the wax figure to elementalize the mud and rocks, he moved through the earth.
Unable to confront the magic army head-on, Su Lun thought of using explosives.
After experiencing the terror of explosives with the city wall destruction, the enemy would surely be cautious.
With no chance above ground, Su Lun considered whether he could bury the explosives deeper underground, using a larger quantity to damage any one of the nine magic towers.
Just like that, he followed the wax figure deeper down.
He planned to go deep enough to avoid the mages' sensory range, then circle back up.
Su Lun was incredibly cautious.
He descended several kilometers before slowly moving upward.
The Mechanics in the miniature void had already taken samples of the soil and rock layers, calculating the precise depth data and quantity of explosives needed for the blast...
According to his plan, installing explosives around seven hundred meters underground could also precisely demolish a magic tower.
Su Lun was thus led upwards by the elemental wax figures.
The dark underground with only the fluctuation of earth elements and without any light source gave a slight feeling of claustrophobia.
Everything seemed to have no issues.
Su Lun's perception was also fully extended outward and he didn't notice any signs of being discovered.
But suddenly, an accident occurred.
The crow on his shoulder suddenly "cawed" loudly, warning of an impending lethal threat.
"Discovered!"
Su Lun's expression changed dramatically, the sense of crisis came so swiftly, it made his hair stand on end.
Without any hesitation, he pinched his sorcerer's seals and teleported to the surface.
It was just an instant when Su Lun sensed the elemental wax figure that he couldn't recall in time had lost connection.
Appearing on the surface, he knew well that he had just skirted the edge of death.
That very instant, he had wanted to bring the wax figure with him but he clearly sensed that the spirits in the statues left behind had been "frozen."
Such a situation, Su Lun had only seen once before, which was petrification.
The petrified persons did not die immediately, their souls would be sealed within the stone statues.
That was the case with Tanni's mother.
Clearly, a high-level gorgon had just made her move.
"Do those guys from the divine realm actually have a gorgon helping them?!"
Su Lun was also somewhat incredulous.
But after a careful thought, only a gorgon could achieve such a feat.
Gorgons are truly of demigod lineage, and one of their sources of Divine Blood is the "God of Earth"!
Their affinity and understanding for the earth element are extraordinary, and petrification curse is one of their methods.
Just now underground, that was their home field.
Although gorgons are seen as demonic creatures in human eyes, they, like dragons, are genuine demigod creatures. How could they possibly ally with humans?
Su Lun had no time to think further, for he had already closed his eyes.
Through the shared vision with the crow, the ground in the distance suddenly bulged, and then gradually took the form of a human.
The gorgon was pursuing!
A murderous intent prickled his back like needles, and the tingling sensation made Su Lun think that the gorgon was even stronger than the seventh-rank gorgon that Bartholomew had slain before!
Without any further hesitation, he teleported again.
Upon looking again, he had already appeared in the forest outside the city, dozens of kilometers away.
However, at this moment, the crow on his shoulder, having looked one extra time at the gorgon, started to visibly petrify from its eyes. In the blink of an eye, its glossy black feathers had turned to the gray of limestone.
It was just in the blink of an eye that the plump bird had completely turned into a stone bird.
No longer stable, it fell from Su Lun's shoulder.
With a "clatter," it shattered into stones.
The black mist on the ground dispersed and then gathered again, and a completely intact crow came back to life.
