The towering Hell Volcano was still visible at the edge of the horizon; this was the core area of the Dragon Country's ruins now.
The surrounding sea no longer presented the vast expanse of azure but showed an increasing number of islands.
According to the sea chart, the Dawn Brigade had entered a highly dangerous area.
Over the communicator, Tanni reported on their current navigation: "Everyone, be careful. We're about to enter the Parrot Archipelago ahead. The chart indicates a possible overlord-level sea monster, the Titan Serpent. Watch out for strange objects in the water..."
"Roger that!"
The members of the Brigade heard it and continued their specific preparations.
For everyone, battles had become a daily routine.
Up on the mast, Su Lun was maintaining the illusion ahead with his eyes fixed on the distance.
The Dawn Brigade now had a well-established command system, and Su Lun didn't need to worry about it.
But the further they sailed, the more he felt an inexplicable sense of crisis in his heart.
Su Lun didn't think this was a false alarm.
Having progressed to his current understanding of the rules of death, he had become extremely sensitive to certain causal links that could lead to death.
His premonition of death even far surpassed most sensory professionals and prophets.
However, the current situation was that this sea area was full of danger, and as long as they continued to sail, danger was inevitable, so he wasn't sure where this sense of crisis originated from.
It felt like walking on thin ice, unable to predict which step would lead to a plunge into a frozen abyss.
The Raven Lord on his shoulder remained quiet, which was the assurance that made Su Lun feel somewhat at ease.
With a well-planned navigation route, they were currently sailing through the Parrot Archipelago, which was marked as a three-star (★★★) danger level on the sea chart.
Even if they encountered a monster attack, according to the danger rating on the chart, it was likely to be below ninth-tier.
It shouldn't be too fatal.
However, without any warning, a beam of light, like a shooting star, descended from the sky and in a thousandth of a second, pierced through the projected Evernight, exploding a few hundred meters high wave on the sea surface.
The light bomb was also enveloped in a heat so intense that it twisted space itself, burning a large hole in the sea and billowing clouds of white steam into the sky.
The attack was so sudden that Su Lun's pupils shrank sharply, and he cried out in his heart, "A demi-god forbidden curse, Divine Punishment Light!"
That beam of light turned out to be a demi-god level spell.
Facing an attack near the speed of light like this forbidden curse, Su Lun himself might be able to teleport away in an instant, but the Evernight would undoubtedly suffer a devastating blow.
Seeing the huge waves caused by the magic explosion before him, he also felt immensely relieved, "That was close!"
The stronger the magic, the longer it took to chant and gather magic power.
Because they didn't want to be discovered, they must have launched from an extremely long distance.
Su Lun was also lucky that he had conjured an illusion; otherwise, if that previous strike had been aimed at the Eternal Night, the consequences would have been unthinkable.
Watching the ship ahead being pierced in one hit, the recently bustling crew of the Eternal Night froze, their movements stopping as they all swallowed hard.
Even the seasoned warriors' faces turned pale.
Because none of them was absolutely sure they could have avoided that strike.
But it wasn't over yet!
Before anyone could react, two more beams of light struck the same spot.
Releasing three forbidden spells regardless of cost, it seemed like those beings from the Divine Plane were intent on completely wiping out the Dawn Brigade in one fell swoop.
The shockwaves from the forbidden spells whipped up huge waves at sea, revealing the blurry outline of the Eternal Night's invisible coating in the wake of the shockwaves.
The Dawn Brigade didn't dare feel any sense of relief.
Because they knew if the enemy realized they hadn't sunk them, there must be more to come!
In an extremely short time, the Dawn Brigade's sensers had calculated the exact location of the magic release, and the various combat channels immediately erupted with noise.
"The enemy is at 11 o'clock direction, eight miles away!"
"Adjust the ship's left cannons for a covering volley! Load and fire the [T1 Blast Bomb] from the number three main cannon! Shoot the [Magic Interference Shells] from the close defense cannons in rapid succession!"
"Change course, widen the distance..."
"..."
The Eternal Night immediately responded by moving away from the direction of the magic release, and the cannons belched flames in unison.
In a flash, cannon fire roared deafeningly, and shells flew across the sky.
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
"..."
The sounds of gunfire merged into one.
Cannons had a longer range and a higher firing efficiency than magic, which also made them a formidable weapon against Mage Legions.
The best tactic in battle was to create distance.
After several rounds of cannon fire, a large expanse of explosive mushroom clouds appeared to the northwest in an instant.
The mages from the Divine Plane were clearly out of reach and there were no more magic fluctuations.
Su Lun watched the distant flames, his eyes narrowed, feeling far from optimistic.
The enemy did not have better ships than the Eternal Night, so it was unlikely the main force could catch up.
If a small number came after them, the Dawn Brigade wasn't worried.
The enemy clearly understood this as well.
Yet, since they had made their move, they must have been very confident.
This sub-god-level forbidden spell was strong, but definitely not their only resource!
As expected.
Right then, Tanni's voice carried a warning through the communicator, "Be careful, everyone. The fish in the sea are saying there are a lot of monsters coming from the northwest!"
No sooner had she finished speaking than Su Lun's perception detected countless soul fluctuations.
He had speculated that the beings from the Divine Plane might use sea monsters to launch a surprise attack, but it wasn't unexpected.
But the density of these monsters caught him off guard, "Why are there so many?"
In the distance lay a vast expanse of mist, making it impossible to see clearly what was on the sea's surface with the naked eye.
But Su Lun could clearly sense a dense, hive-like cluster of soul fluctuations, so tightly packed they seemed innumerable.
What surprised him was that most of these soul fluctuations were very weak, roughly that of second or third-tier beasts.
"What kind of monsters are they?"
Su Lun was puzzled.
But those creatures were even faster than the Eternal Night and, as they drew closer, he spotted some formidable beings of level seven and eight.
Before long, the monsters burst through the mist. Su Lun took a closer look and realized it was a horde of snakes!
Countless poison snakes surged over the sea like a tide, overlapping, rolling, squirming... their dark mass was eerie to behold.
And those powerful presences he perceived turned out to be serpent-haired sirens!
In mythological legends, gorgon women with snake hair could control poisonous snakes, and their hair itself could transform into countless poisonous snakes...
And such a scene of countless snakes swarming is called the "Sea of Snakes disaster"!
It's like the passage of locusts, where all living beings are wiped out.
This is the legendary terrifying strength that could slay gods.
Witnessing this scene before him, Su Lun had now experienced another of the legendary disasters.
The members of the Dawn group were also quite shaken.
"What the hell, why are there so many snakes? It gives me the creeps."
"Eh... there seems to be 'women' among those snakes?"
"..."
Hearing that the others hadn't realized what this was, Su Lun intended to remind them, but unexpectedly Phantom Thief Kit suddenly shouted through the communicator, "Fuck, those are gorgons with snake hair! Careful, don't look into the eyes of those gorgons!"
This guy, having previously suffered from a petrifying light ray, knew all too well how formidable this monster was.
And right after, Tanni's mother Frida also issued a stern warning, calling out urgently, "Be careful, we must keep our distance. Even without looking directly at a top-tier gorgon with snake hair, one could still be affected by the petrifying light ray! To control such a vast swarm of snakes, there must surely be an eighth-tier gorgon among them!"
As the only person in the Dawn group who had been petrified, she was well aware of the danger.
It was the "Sea of Snakes disaster" that had destroyed the entire Naga tribe and dozens of intelligent species near Rainbow Island.
This snake disaster, like a plague, left her with indelible terrifyng memories.
...
Eighth tier?
Even with those words, Su Lun's brows furrowed.
An eighth-tier gorgon with snake hair could almost be considered a top-tier being in this plane.
Yet seeing the gorgon with snake hair, Su Lun was also puzzled.
He knew that the people from the Heavenly God Plane had cooperated with the gorgons with snake hair, but before at the outskirts of King Aike's capital in Silver Dragon Country, wasn't a suspected eighth-tier gorgon killed by Helen, who had completed her trial and transformed into Queen Medusa?
What was the situation here now?
What was going on with Queen Medusa Helen and the swarm of gorgon women?
The map had marked an island populated by gorgons with snake hair close by, within about a day's journey. Because they were uncertain of the risk, Su Lun and the others had specifically avoided that direction. Yet, they still encountered them.
However, at this moment, thinking about it was pointless.
Su Lun closed his eyes too, using Old Crow's shared field of vision to watch the mass of snakes chasing after the Eternal Night.
Over the communicator, the mechanical group leader Dora also issued intensive bombardment commands based on the coordinates provided by Su Lun, "First and second layer cannons, continue fire suppression; third layer cannons, load [Alchemical Scatter Bombs], cover and scatter! Fifteen degrees north by east, Deck Four main cannon, fire!"
"Boom rumble~"
"Boom rumble~"
"…"
The Eternal Night's firepower was fully operational, pouring out alchemical ammunition like it cost nothing.
This snake tide could also be seen as a kind of legion fight—the more there were, the less room they had to dodge.
Even without deliberate aiming, when the shells fell, they inevitably blasted open gory sections among the mass of snakes on the sea's surface.
A few hundred cannons could kill hundreds of thousands of low-tier poisonous snakes every second.
However, not even a hint of relief appeared on Su Lun's face.
Through the crow's field of vision, he saw that even with the Dawn group's intensive firepower coverage, the number of snakes in the chasing tide wasn't decreasing at all but was increasing more and more.
And dealing with low-tier Poison Snakes was one thing; as long as they were numbered, even if they caught up, it wouldn't be a huge problem.
The tricky part was the gorgons with snake hair hiding among the swarm.
Even after Su Lun reported accurate coordinates and the shells accurately hit their mark,
the main cannon shells, capable of heavily damaging an eighth-tier, also turned to stone amidst the gray light swirling around those gorgons with snake hair!
"Petrifying light rays really are unsolvable..."
Seeing this, Su Lun's brow was tightly knit.
That was his concern; the previous antidote for petrification had been used up. Without a solution to petrification, they absolutely could not forcefully confront the gorgons with snake hair.
Moreover, the difficulty was that even now he couldn't understand the principles behind the "petrification curse" at the level of Divine Arts.
Not understanding it naturally meant that he couldn't find a solution.
The Eternal Night could only continue to fire and retreat.
And as they were firing, suddenly Tanni issued another warning, "On our southwest side, a large number of monsters have appeared!"
Su Lun looked, and in another direction of their retreat, the same endless snake tide appeared.
It seemed like a planned interception.
The Dawn Brigade couldn't afford a head-on confrontation, so they were forced to alter their course, avoiding being completely surrounded.
However, it was in this situation that Su Lun keenly sensed something amiss, thinking to himself, "It seems like these snakelike monsters are herding us toward a specific direction?"
This was a common method both in military tactics and in the natural world where magical beasts hunted prey.
A trap is set on several sides, leaving an opening to drive the prey in a certain direction.
Su Lun didn't think it was a coincidence; he immediately used the communicator to notify, "Tanni, Perception Unit, pay special attention to sensing our path ahead, and see if there's any danger."
A prompt response came from the communicator, "Yes!"
After a while, a response came through the communicator, "Mr. Su Lun, we haven't found anything abnormal."
Even Tanni and his mother's perceptive abilities had not detected anything amiss.
Yet, the lack of anomalies made Su Lun all the more cautious.
But the snakelike monsters seemed fearless, confident that if they did not flee along their planned route, they would have to face the overwhelming tide of snakes head-on.
In such a situation, one could say that even a ninth-tier would die here.
Even for Su Lun, the only way out would have been to teleport away.
However, he did not intend to expose his escape ace, the "Space-Time Ring of Urobolos," unless absolutely necessary.
But with the situation as it was, it seemed highly likely that some deadly danger lay ahead of them...
For a moment, Su Lun also found it difficult to choose, "Could there be something even more dangerous ahead than the 'Sea of Snakes disaster'?"
He was also somewhat puzzled.
Just these snakelike monsters and their snake swarms were already dominant forces in this sea area.
What could be more formidable than them?
However, not long after he put down the communicator, suddenly, a strong soul fluctuation appeared in his soul perception.
It seemed as if they had used some kind of Space Arcana, teleporting to a spot less than a hundred meters behind the Eternal Night.
How could the snakelike monsters teleport?
It was probably the work of Mages from the divine planes.
"Seventh-tier snakelike monster!"
Su Lun's expression turned grim.
In the shared vision of the black crow, the moment the snakelike monster teleported, its hair of snakes instantly launched a wide range of petrification light toward the Eternal Night.
Although at this distance, the snakelike monster couldn't petrify those who did not look directly into its eyes, the moment its light shone, the entire Eternal Night was as if affected by "Slowing Light Beam," its speed immediately decreased.
However, the members of the Dawn Brigade also reacted swiftly.
The moment the snakelike monster released the petrifying light, a Frost Flower Sword Qi suddenly slashed out.
With a "swoosh", blood sprayed in all directions.
The hideous, snake-covered head was sent flying into the sky.
A seventh-tier snakelike monster was already breathless.
However, these snakelike monsters probably had no knowledge of the human society and were naturally unaware that someone within the Dawn Brigade could kill it with one strike.
Approaching this close was simply courting death.
But seeing this, Su Lun was now one hundred percent sure that the snakelike monsters' aim was to herd them toward the southeast, toward the unknown sea region marked with a "mist pattern" on the seafaring map.
...
"We can no longer continue to sail..."
At that moment, Su Lun had made his decision.
Intuition told him that even if it meant revealing his trump card, he absolutely could not continue to sail according to the enemy's plan!
Otherwise, if they delayed any longer, they might encounter an attack more lethal than the previous "Divine Punishment Light."
However, just as he was about to order the crew to activate the vessel's space alchemy array and then escape by taking the Eternal Night into a small void world, suddenly, a strange voice came through his mind, "There lies a slumbering sea monster named Setes to your southeast, which will be awakened by the presence of humans."
Spiritual transmission!
Upon hearing this, Su Lun immediately located the person sending the message based on the barriers of spiritual power transmission.
Clutching the black umbrella in his hand and sensing again, he instantly recognized the soul fire as belonging to Helen, Queen Medusa, with whom he had some past encounters!
Why was she here?
Why was she warning me?
Numerous questions surfaced in Su Lun's mind.
But no matter the other party's motives, Helen's words confirmed his own suspicions.
To the southeast lay deadly danger!

chapters.title: Chapter 574 - 573: Artifact Projection
chapters.content:
"The slumbering sea monster Setes?"
Su Lun had guessed that the snake tide pushing them southeast held dangers, yet he couldn't pinpoint the nature of those perils.
Previously, neither Tanni nor his mother, with their special sensory abilities, had detected anything abnormal, leading him to not expect any powerful sea monster either.
But upon hearing Queen Medusa's words, Su Lun felt it indeed might be possible.
If it had slept long enough, the fish in the sea necessarily wouldn't notice a sea monster's presence.
Feigning ignorance, he questioned back through mental transmission, "What sea monster? How powerful?"
Queen Medusa responded, "According to your human terms, Setes is a super-tier sea monster. Now, you can see the largest island in the southeast; it represents the ridge back showing above the water. Over two hundred years ago, a group of powerful human adventurers stirred it from its sleep here, ultimately causing a climate disaster that lasted several months. The sea area is not as simple as you see; there are countless divine-blood sea monsters here..."
"Super tier?"
Su Lun's eyes twitched involuntarily.
Gazing at the island in the horizon, its diameter surpassing ten kilometers, he was greatly surprised: Could this truly be a sea monster?
If that's just its ridge back, how large must its main body be?
A sea monster as large as Lingdun City?
Aside from that, what surprised Su Lun was also the tone of the discourse—as if she personally experienced the event over two hundred years ago. Just how long had Queen Medusa lived?
As a dominant high-tier species in this sea area, the Gorgon race naturally had no need to lie.
Su Lun chose to believe this explanation.
However, the question remained—why would she warn him, a human?
Clearly, it wasn't out of kindness.
...
Mental communication was highly efficient; in just a moment, Medusa transmitted another message: "You must also be heading for 'Mimir's Well,' right? Then I can tell you that even if you escape alive this time, you will never be able to approach Giant Island. The only safe route there passes through Moon Strait, but currently, many human mages have stationed themselves there, building many magic towers. Your warship, although special, couldn't withstand something like the previously released Forbidden Curse Magic. Do you think you can forcibly break through?"
"..."
Upon hearing these words, Su Lun promptly pinpointed the location of "Moon Strait" in his mind.
Currently, the strongest mages descending from the divine realm to the alchemical plane are of the eighth tier, and casting the "Forbidden Curse: Divine Punishment Light" would definitely require the support of a magic tower.
The staff had just calculated the direction from which the magic was released, which exactly matched her statements.
From now on, it seemed everything Queen Medusa said was true.
Conjecturing her motives, Su Lun asked again, "Why tell me all of this?"
Queen Medusa replied with two words: "Cooperation."
"..."
Su Lun wasn't confused at all.
Previously, in the suburbs of the Silver Dragon King Aike's kingdom, he had personally witnessed Queen Medusa kill a very powerful high-level Gorgon.
Thus, the Gorgon race was not monolithic internally—there was dissent.
And currently, those Gorgons were aiding the divine realm forces in surrounding the Dawn Brigade, making them the enemy of his enemy...
But not necessarily a friend.
Su Lun was not clouded by the seemingly generous offer of "powerful reinforcement." Instead, he remained cautious.
Helen had transformed into Queen Medusa, rumored to have returned to her true demi-god lineage.
Her pride might even surpass that of the dragon race. Why would she cooperate with a human?
Su Lun did not hastily agree but candidly asked, "Forgive my boldness, Your Majesty, but having completed your trials, your power is likely unmatched across the entire plane. Why choose to cooperate with us?"
At least for now, he wasn't an enemy and he also held considerable respect for this being at the pinnacle of plane power.
Yet long moments passed without an answer.
As a demigod, Queen Medusa had her pride and she definitely would not respond to questions she disliked.
However, during the brief silence, Su Lun surmised something from her reaction.
This Queen Medusa must have suffered some notable setbacks at the hands of those divine realm mages.
Though a demigod is strong, they might not necessarily be stronger than mages supported by a True God.
While Su Lun was curious about the exact nature of Medusa's setbacks, he knew it was a topic that couldn't be broached.
And the prouder the being, the less likely they are to lie.
Besides, Queen Medusa had previously sworn by the Earth Mother Goddess, making a mutual non-aggression pact.
The chances of her harboring sinister motives were slim.
Without further delay, Su Lun changed the subject and said, "We can cooperate! So, Your Majesty, how do you think we should collaborate?"
Although only a few moments had passed, he had already given it thorough thought; if what Queen Medusa said was true, cooperation was indeed the only option for the Dawn Brigade.
Otherwise, even if they managed to escape this time, they would never have the chance to break through the heavily guarded Moon Strait and get close to "Mimir's Spring" in the future.
Even if they teleported through space, they would likely fall into some magic traps set up by the enemy in advance.
Cooperating with someone like Queen Medusa, who was familiar with the terrain, seemed advantageous for now.
Besides, as far as Su Lun was concerned, even if there were changes, the situation couldn't get worse than it already was.
...
Su Lun chose to cooperate, and Queen Medusa also sent a message, "Sail directly south. I will help you disperse the snake tide, but I can't do so for long. You must hurry. About five miles south there is an Elephant Trunk Island, and there's a cave with a crack that leads to the edge of a dimensional collapse. Once you enter the crack, it will be enough to keep you alive..."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun felt that the Dawn Group didn't need anyone else to show them how to survive. But after thinking for a brief moment, he immediately gave an order through the Dawn Group's communicator, "Tanni, change course, we are heading due south!"
In the cockpit, Tanni responded without any hesitation, "Yes!"
Su Lun continued, "All high-combat units, prepare for battle. Logistics team, be ready to activate the Void Alchemy Array at my command."
Everyone responded in unison, "Yes!"
The Dawn Group had no objections to Su Lun's orders. Even though the southern path led through the snake tide, the Eternal Night turned its sails and charged directly into it.
On deck, Old Sword God Bartolo and a few long-range capable high-combat units stood at the bow, while several heavy-caliber main guns also turned south...
Looking at the snake tide that had completely covered the sea surface, everyone's expression was solemn.
The number of poison snakes was just too great; they assembled before them like a writhing high wall, blocking their path.
Even though the Dawn Group's firepower was powerful, the light from hundreds of cannons firing simultaneously merely made a small dent in that "snake wall."
The Medusas controlling the snake tide were momentarily confused by the Dawn Group's sudden change in direction, but quickly, they gathered more poison snakes to block the path south.
But perhaps because Old Sword God Bartolo had just killed a seventh-tier Medusa, which had a strong deterrent effect, they saw no Medusas rushing to their deaths as they charged through.
Drawing closer, the crew on the deck also got a clearer view of the brightly colored deadly sea snakes, hissing and opening their fanged mouths at them.
Even wearing gas masks, everyone smelled an awful stench after the toxin was filtered.
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"..."
The cannons kept firing non-stop, blasting flames among the snake horde.
Close-defense guns also "rattled" away, pouring tons of alchemy bullets down like a torrential rain.
From a distance, the poison snakes were wiped out in masses, but were quickly replaced by more from behind.
The Eternal Night was sailing at full speed, and both sides headed straight for a collision.
At the mast, Su Lun watched, frowning tightly, ready to activate the Alchemy Array to teleport at any moment when suddenly, something astonishing happened.
The Eternal Night, like a dagger slicing into the snake tide, parted the seething mass without making contact, as if some invisible force pushed it apart.
The poison snakes that were about to collide with the Eternal Night shockingly veered away, creating a wide lane through the middle of the tumultuous snake tide.
Su Lun knew it was Queen Medusa, hidden from view, who had intervened!
If ordinary Medusas could control poison snakes, how could the queen not be capable?
Seeing the channel right before him, Su Lun issued the order without hesitation. The alchemical sails of the Eternal Night lit up instantly, a howling wind arose, and the massive dark-sailed warship, like a speedboat, cut a white wolf across the sea surface, speeding through the snake channel.
"Where did all these poison snakes come from..."
As they delved deeper into the snake mob, Su Lun grew even more astounded.
The sea was boiling with poison snakes, their numbers probably in the billions.
Yet the sheer force of the Eternal Night's rush caught the enemy off guard. Watching them charge, the Medusas thought they were making a desperate stand. Given that there were top experts on board, they were cautious and planned to wear them down with lower-tier snakes rather than confront them directly.
Little did they know, their snake horde not only failed to stop the black-sailed warship but actively made way for it!
At the same time, an eighth-tier Medusa hidden within the horde didn't understand what had happened and furiously exclaimed, "Damned! Why would she help a bunch of humans?"
However, by the time they realized, it was already too late.
Su Lun's decision was decisive enough, and with the unimpeded speed of the Eternal Night so fast, it burst through the miles-wide Sea of Snakes before those distant Medusas could catch up.
The Dawn Group had just passed when the previously parted snake tide quickly closed up.
But in a flash, the snake tide turned direction again, and it became a chase once more.
Although the situation was much better than when they were surrounded, continuing to run like this, the Eternal Night was still unlikely to escape.
The speed of the sea snakes was just too fast, and their coverage far too broad.
Just then, Su Lun saw the Elephant Trunk Island appear in his field of vision.
Extending his senses, he clearly felt the intense spatial fluctuations inside the cave beneath the island.
"A spatial rift? There's actually such a place..."
Su Lun's eyes shifted.
If not a local, one truly wouldn't know about such a place.
Near the space-time rift, there usually existed chaotic space currents, which were extremely dangerous for others, as a slight mishap could sweep them into unknown destinations.
However, for Su Lun, who had the "Urobolos Space-Time Ring," this instead became an "advantage."
He also knew why Queen Medusa had sent him here, it indeed was a good place to hide, at least lacking the space for the deployment of the snake tide.
Looking at the pitch-black cave in the distance, the Eternal Night didn't hesitate and sailed right in.
...
After entering the cave, the light around them suddenly dimmed.
Without the horrifying feeling of being stared at by billions of poison snakes, the crisis seemed to have been lifted instantly.
All members of the Dawn Group inexplicably breathed a sigh of relief.
Only then did everyone dare to open their eyes.
The cave was magical, its interior space was much larger than it appeared from the outside, the ceiling was the wet rock walls of stalactites, and around them was a faint luminescence, which was from some bioluminescent algae.
Looking down, the sea water was very clear, and the fish were swimming among the glowing seaweed.
Like an underground river, the direction of the water flow was heading towards the depths of the cave.
Su Lun sensed the space around him, it indeed seemed like an underground river, the space was not small, and there was clearly chaotic spatial fluctuation.
"What exactly is this place..."
He surveyed his surroundings and could not make much sense of it, but he did notice that the flow of the underground river seemed to be heading towards the direction of Hell Volcano.
Fortunately, once they entered this cave, the pursuing snake tide seemed to dread something and did not follow.
The Eternal Night then followed the river and drifted along the underground river.
Even without reminders, all on board attentively observed their surroundings.
This mysterious cave, since those snake-haired gorgons dared not follow, looked problematic no matter how one saw it.
Meanwhile, Su Lun was searching for something.
After all, it was Queen Medusa who had guided them here.
Instead of fumbling around blindly, it was better to ask directly.
Gripping his black umbrella, he released his full perceptual power, and soon he sensed a familiar soul fluctuation also rushing quickly into the cave.
Queen Medusa had just helped the Dawn Group and had also been attacked.
Su Lun didn't dare to meet the "Helen" who could easily petrify him directly; the black crow flapped its wings and flew towards the direction of the soul fluctuation.
Soon, on a dark reef, he saw through the eyes of the black crow a figure enveloped in a black robe.
The black crow spoke human words, "Your Highness the Queen, thank you for your assistance."
Su Lun thought to perfect the courtesies first.
However, the cloaked figure was unfazed, she snorted coldly and said, "Humans are truly hypocritical. You need not doubt that I would harm you, since I have chosen to cooperate, I naturally will keep my promise."
Su Lun didn't take it to heart.
Such a top-tier existence having its own proud temperament was within reason.
Queen Medusa seemed to see through his concerns and explained directly, "This place is at the edge of a plane collapse, where an ancient war shattered the plane, and a high deity and his disciple repaired the shattered parts, but because the collapse was too thorough, the repair was not perfect. Therefore, you see that volcano outside and these hidden planar fissures under the sea...
With his knowledge of the Space Law, Su Lun understood immediately.
It was nothing but a relic of an ancient battlefield.
Queen Medusa did not elaborate on the origins of this place and continued, "If you want to go to Giant Island to find the 'Mimir's Spring,' you can do so from here. Rest assured, such a thing is a treasure for humans, but it's useless to my Gorgon race. Moreover, Cyclops are descendants of Divine Blood and are not easy to provoke, and I have no interest in antagonizing them..."
Hearing this, Su Lun was more inclined to believe her words.
After all, if the Gorgon race really desired that spring, they would have been fighting you to death by now.
Of course, he also inferred the formidable nature of the Cyclops race from these words.
The black crow continued, "So, Your Majesty, how do we need to cooperate? Or rather, what must we pay in order to get your help?"
In the eyes of alchemists, an equivalent exchange was the most reasonable choice.
So was cooperation.
Su Lun had no illusions about getting a bargain from Her Majesty.
He guessed that Queen Medusa was probably beaten up, so he asked very tactfully.
Unexpectedly, the cloaked figure directly stated her need for cooperation, "Those human mages hold an Artifact Projection which limits my powers. As you just saw, they are now allied with traitors from my own race, who have taken over the temples of my Gorgon race. Thus, I also need an ally."
"Artifact Projection?"
Hearing this, Su Lun felt a sudden chill in his heart.
"Speaking of other things is fine, but matters involving the gods are not so easily touched upon."
"Cooperation is possible."
"But sending to death is not acceptable."
Queen Medusa gave Su Lun a cautious snort again and added, "Rest assured. That item greatly affects me, but it's basically useless to you. So, you don't need to worry too much."
Black Crow directly asked, "May I boldly ask what exactly is the function of the Artifact Projection?"
It wasn't that Su Lun was fearful or retreating, after all the True God Realm as his sworn enemy, was inevitably to be confronted."
But if he could grasp the enemy's techniques in advance, the chances of winning future battles would also be greater."
Medusa, clearly displeased by this probing tone, pondered for a moment before responding to Su Lun's words, "It is a shield that is immune to any magic."
After a pause, she looked at Black Crow and said, "This poses almost no threat to you Alchemists."
"..."
In Black Crow's eyes, that beautiful yet sinister face was reflected, and even from a distance, Su Lun felt as if he was being stared at by her."
But upon hearing its effect, he immediately breathed a sigh of relief."
It was clearly intended specifically against this Queen Medusa."
Immune to all magic, the petrification curse would naturally be immune as well."
No wonder she was at a disadvantage."
The Gorgon tribe's strongest feature was their petrification curse, and once this technique was countered, their own combat strength would not be formidable."
At this point, Queen Medusa added, "I've already said what I needed to say. Our cooperation entails, needing your help to deal with those Mages, at least to restrict their use of that Artifact Projection. As for those of my kin who have betrayed me, you need not worry. In exchange, I will guide you to Giant Island. Of course, if you provide sufficient help, I will also gift you an ample amount of treasures and ancient artifacts that your kind, humans, need..."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun immediately responded, "Agreed, let's sign the contract! Within the realms of our capabilities, we will do our utmost to help you!"
Merely guiding them to Giant Island was not a particularly enticing condition."
But this sea area was an ancient battlefield, what was it not lacking?"
Of course, various ancient treasures left behind!"
The Gorgon tribe had lived in this sea area for countless years and had certainly collected numerous treasures."
Perhaps there were some absolutely priceless artifacts..."
After all, things like equipment, cursed items, Cultivation Techniques, etc., probably meant no more to Queen Medusa than stones."
But for Su Lun and the other Alchemists, treasures passed down from that splendid era of alchemical civilization were definitely valuable."
Moreover, having such an ally to face the Mages of the True God Realm was also a great support for the Dawn Group."
Queen Medusa, hearing Su Lun's words, did not respond further but implicitly granted permission."
...
The covenant was successfully signed."
It was an equal covenant, with no harm or coercive clauses to either party. Within the scope of the contract, both sides exerted their fullest effort to support each other."
However, seeing the covenant signed so smoothly, Su Lun was still somewhat surprised."
He had expected some kind of strategizing."
But there was none whatsoever."
He felt that "Helen" might not know just how powerful the Dawn Group truly was, but even if strong, probably not significant in her eyes. After all, the highest-ranked on the ship, Bartolo, was only of the eighth tier, a whole rank below her, and much weaker in strength."
But she still chose an equal covenant, which clearly felt like she was "lowering her own value"."
And in this sea area, there were plenty of powerful intelligent races; she had many more options for cooperation, so why did she specifically choose to cooperate with these humans from the Dawn Group?"
After the contract was signed and the All-Seeing Eye carefully verified everything was alright, Su Lun finally dared to meet Queen Medusa in person."
He teleported and appeared on the cold, rocky shore."
Out of courtesy and contractual necessity, he naturally came in person to invite this ally to the ship."
Queen Medusa did not refuse the invitation, and the two walked on the water surface together."
As they walked, Su Lun casually asked, "Your Majesty, I have a puzzling question, may I boldly ask it?"
Queen Medusa listened but did not respond, nor did she refuse."
Su Lun realized there was no need for subtlety in front of a high-ranking being and directly asked, "I mean, our strength should not seem very strong in front of you, even perhaps weaker than those Mages. Why would you choose to cooperate with us?"
Hearing this question, Queen Medusa still silently moved ahead, her snakelike tail gliding on the water, creating ripples."
The atmosphere turned slightly cold."
Su Lun thought he wouldn't receive a response and shrugged."
Unexpectedly, Queen Medusa finally responded with something seemingly unrelated to the question, "This sea area was once a battlefield of the gods, and humans without a legendary fate cannot possibly survive leaving this place."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun's eyes gleamed thoughtfully."

chapters.title: Chapter 575 - 574 Shortcut
chapters.content:
Mythical legends describe the snake-haired gorgons as something not to be trifled with, symbolizing boundless fear, darkness, envy, and hatred.
Although Su Lun had already formed an alliance with Queen Medusa, he still maintained sufficient caution in his heart.
The two followed the underground river and soon caught up with the Dawn Team.
On board the Eternal Night, the members of the Dawn Team had already received Su Lun's message and had been waiting for a long time.
Out of courtesy, they also had to welcome this powerful ally.
Before anyone had arrived, the deck was already buzzing with animated discussions.
"So the snake tide retreated because of a Queen Medusa's assistance. Oh, it's just too incredible. How did Mr. Su Lun come to know that Queen Medusa?"
"Who knows? Anyway, Mr. Su Lun always brings surprises, doesn't he?"
"Hey, do you think, what does Queen Medusa really look like? The legends say you'll turn to stone just by looking at her, can we actually look at her?"
"No one can answer that question for you. I dare say that apart from Mr. Su Lun, no one knows what Queen Medusa looks like. Because not even the demigod heroes in the legends dared to gaze directly at her face. My God, just thinking about it is exciting; we are about to witness a presence from mythical legend!"
"If we really return to Luying, our adventures as the Dawn Team might be sung by bards for hundreds of years..."
"Shush, keep your voices down. Mr. Su Lun said it's okay to look, but we must show enough respect and not offend, or it will be very dangerous."
"..."
Everyone was surprised that Su Lun could actually forge an alliance with Queen Medusa from the mythical legends.
At the same time, they were curious about what this kind of being, who only appeared in mythical stories, really looked like.
Bards described Medusa as a terrifying gorgon with an angel's face and a wicked heart, but others said she was an ugly witch, the embodiment of a demon...
In the written records, people had imagined countless versions of illustrated books.
But in reality, nobody had truly seen Queen Medusa.
Because everyone who had seen her had turned to stone.
This was a mysterious ancient mythical race that seemed even more enigmatic than dragons.
Because even in legends, only a very few legendary heroes had actually seen Queen Medusa's face.
And now the Dawn Team seemed about to create a new legendary story.
The ship was noisy when suddenly, someone exclaimed in a low voice, "They're here!"
People stared intently, and far up the river, two figures appeared.
...
As the two figures gradually approached, the atmosphere on the deck of the Eternal Night also quietly tensed.
It was then that the members of the Dawn Team realized that the beings from mythical legends were not so easy to observe.
Even from a distance, the oppressive aura that came from their bloodline made it feel as though an invisible pressure was weighing on their chests, gradually making breathing more difficult.
Before they even got close, their domineering presence, comparable to that of high-ranking dragons, already made people unconsciously avert their gaze.
After all, she was a true-blooded demigod, Queen Medusa's pride wouldn't allow herself to be gawked at like a monster by a group of humans. Moreover, she was a sovereign creature; this was an innate air of authority that brooked no insult.
At this thought, Qian frowned slightly, as if pondering something.
Lower-tier professionals couldn't control their emotions, which could easily lead to unnecessary trouble.
And they couldn't stand under that domineering oppressive presence.
She gestured with her hand and said to the group behind her, "Members below Tier 5, go to the lower deck."
People sighed with relief and responded in unison, "Yes."
They had only been forcing themselves to not look bad, and upon hearing those words, they finally let out a huge sigh of relief.
As they turned around, that spine-chilling sense of impending death finally dissipated. Those who left glanced enviously at the cloaked figure beside Su Lun, feeling regret but also considering their own lives more important.
Before long, Su Lun and Queen Medusa walked unhurriedly from the river's surface.
To accommodate her serpent body, the Eternal Night extended a wide gangplank to welcome this mysterious and powerful ally.
The two walked up the plank onto the ship, and the sound of Medusa's serpentine body rubbing against the wood made a sss-sss-sss sound.
As this person drew closer, the pressure on the deck grew increasingly heavy, and professionals of ranks five and six couldn't help but break into a fine sweat on their foreheads.
Although Queen Medusa's face was veiled by her cloak, making her true appearance unseen, the fearsome snakes for hair writhing atop her cloak sent chills down everyone's spine.
When Queen Medusa stepped onto the deck, aside from the high-ranking fighters from the Thousand Bartholomew group who managed to remain composed, the rest of the members, even the squad leaders, dared not look her directly in the eye.
The air seemed to have solidified, such was the terrifying pressure of the strong presence.
Fortunately, nothing unexpected happened.
The crowd expressed their goodwill with a welcome, and the atmosphere remained fairly harmonious.
Though Queen Medusa was not particularly fond of socializing, she did not express any malice either.
Su Lun arranged for her to have a private cabin, and finally breathed a sigh of relief.
...
Su Lun returned to the deck.
It was then that the people of the Dawn group gathered around.
Without Queen Medusa's oppressive presence, the suffocating pressure finally dissipated.
Having assisted Queen Medusa through her ordeal, Su Lun had thought it unnecessary to mention it before, so no one else in the group was aware.
Ignorant of the situation, they were all shocked.
Even now, they still found it somewhat incredible.
With no outsiders present, Qian Tiao directly voiced everyone's curiosity, "Su Lun, how did you get in touch with her?"
Finding such a strong ally was certainly a good thing for the Dawn group.
And considering the Gorgon race, notorious for not being friendly with humans, how had Su Lun managed to connect with her?
No sooner had Qian Tiao asked the question than she suddenly thought of something, raising an eyebrow and adding, "It couldn't be...?"
She stopped midway through her sentence, and with a sly twist in her eyes, it seemed the rest of her thoughts were indescribable.
At this, members like Mr. Hei and Kit, who were well-acquainted with one another from their time in the Mirror Organization, all turned to look simultaneously, as if instantly understanding something, their expressions turning somewhat amused.
They knew that Su Lun had a white wolf friend from the Dalu tribe, which was still humanoid, after all.
But this Queen Medusa... she was a Gorgon, with snakes for hair, a completely different species.
Those pairs of eyes seemed to be saying: impressive.
Seeing the teasing looks from everyone, Su Lun felt quite helpless; it was not a joke to be taken lightly.
Just as he was about to explain, someone in the crowd muttered, "Why do I feel like I've seen her before...?"
The one who spoke was none other than Commander Bennett Pickhis of the Miracle Legion of the Silver Dragon Kingdom, with his sister Isabel and a few captains of the Miracle Legion by his side.
Previously, they had been sent to be sacrifices to the Lord of the Grey Mist, and Su Lun had saved them by bringing them into the small void world. In gratitude, they were now helping on the ship and had already been through several battles, getting along quite well with the people of the Dawn group.
Hearing this, Su Lun followed up on the topic and explained, "Commander Bennett, you've seen her before."
Upon hearing this, Bennett realized his own intuition had not been wrong.
His sister Isabel also suddenly had a moment of realization and said in astonishment, "Is she that Priest Helen? But... how did she turn into Queen Medusa?"
The crowd, hearing this, also showed surprised expressions.
They had never seen Queen Medusa, but they had heard of the Helen who had been wanted in the Silver Dragon and was a key figure in the wars between the three great kingdoms...
Now she had become Queen Medusa?
The ordeal of the Gorgon was top secret, and Su Lun knew it was not the time to discuss this, so he shook his head, "Alright, let's not talk about this now."
Understanding his cue, the others did not pursue the matter further.
And just then, Tanni's loud voice came through the transceiver, "Mr. Su Lun, we've detected a cliff waterfall in the dark river ahead. Should we continue downward?"
Su Lun also sensed the change in the spatial terrain. About one kilometer ahead of them, a cliff had appeared, going down into a pit so deep they couldn't sense its bottom.
He wasn't familiar with the environment here, but he knew someone who was.
Without waiting for a transmitted message, Su Lun immediately said, "Continue navigating."
Tanni replied with visible excitement, "Alright! Everyone hold on tight, we're going to glide down. Be careful not to get thrown off the ship~"
Such an unknown underground river navigation was also a rare experience for a sailor.
...
Soon, everyone saw that the dark underground river suddenly came to an end, which obviously was a cliff waterfall.
But what was strange was that they didn't hear the sound of the waterfall hitting the bottom.
It seemed as if there was a bottomless pit beneath the cliff, where the endless seawater flowed to an unknown destination.
However, in an instant, the "Eternal Night" surged out of the river channel, hovered in mid-air for a second, and then plunged freely.
The ship gradually tilted, pointing its bow downward, and the sound of howling wind reached everyone's ears.
Excited shouts filled the deck as exploring the unknown was the greatest pleasure of maritime adventures.
But the free fall didn't last long before a "thump" sounded, and the parachute-like sail at the stern swelled up.
After continuous refitting and improvement, the "Eternal Night" was nearly prepared for navigation in any extreme environment. So, even encountering such cliffs wasn't a big problem.
The warship descended steadily, bow first.
Everyone gazed into the infinite darkness ahead, feeling the thrill of plunging into the unknown.
But after several minutes of descent without a glimpse of the bottom, someone exclaimed, "Heavens, how deep can this hole be? Surely it doesn't lead to hell, does it?"
Su Lun listened, his expression showing a slight change.
They had actually hit the nail on the head.
He clearly sensed that the space around them wasn't "uniform". Sensory-wise they were indeed constantly falling, but on a spatial level, it wasn't so; rather, it was a gap spanning from one dimension to another.
This channel was a seam in the overlap between two dimensions, delving deeper, with a real chance to reach the dimension of hell.
And so, the "Eternal Night" kept falling for nearly a quarter of an hour.
Suddenly, the howling sound of the wind through the sails at the stern grew fainter and everyone noticeably felt the descending speed getting slower.
After a few breaths, gravity reached a state of equilibrium.
To the astonishment of the Dawn Group, they and the ship were floating in midair.
The ship seemed to be sailing through the stars, no longer feeling the force of gravity.
"Eh... has gravity disappeared?"
"It seems it's not that gravity has gone, but the gravitational field above and below have balanced out."
"Look, there are so many 'stars' over there."
"..."
It was then that everyone realized that they seemed to be floating in the night sky, as their vision filled with irregular twinkling lights.
Circles, squares, diamonds, irregular polygons...
Like shards of glass scattered across the floor, they stretched out in this endless dark world.
But in an instant, Mr. Hei noticed something, his face changed dramatically, and he bellowed, "Be careful, everyone! Those aren't stars, they're space shards. Don't get close to the left, that's a spatial whirlwind, it can rip the ship to shreds in an instant!"
On hearing this, everyone focused and saw that in the darkness on the left, there was a barely perceptible spiraling black mass, shaped like the form of wind.
And it was only then that everyone realized that the "Eternal Night" wasn't unintentionally drifting, but was being pulled over by a force.
"Release pressure from steam boilers numbers three, five, and seven in the left side of the ship, move laterally!"
"Yes!"
Whether there was wind to propel them or not, the steam pressure that had been building up in the ship's boilers hissed out, and the massive ship then drifted hundreds of meters away from the maelstrom.
Everyone on deck breathed a sigh of relief, only then realizing that this space, which seemed like a starry sky, hid such dangers.
...
Su Lun had actually noticed the spatial whirlwind earlier.
But he didn't speak up because, firstly, he knew the team could handle it, and secondly, because even if they got close, it wasn't dangerous.
With the "Urobolos Space-Time Ring" in hand, such spatial winds were not a significant threat.
What surprised him, though, was that these stars in the sky were actually "plane fragments"!
An ancient battle in the distant past had shattered the plane, resulting in these fragments.
They filled the gaps between two planes like stones.
"They're all treasures..."
Su Lun's eyes lit up as he looked at them.
Plane fragments were treasures to anyone.
If one could take them away, they would be excellent for crafting storage spaces.
Su Lun sensed that, while these plane fragments weren't large, they were about the same size as the one from Black Sam's team treasury.
And there were at least a few hundred of them in view.
If all were fused together, it would be enough to expand the area of Su Lun's own small void space several times!
But while he felt excitement, Su Lun also spotted a problem, "If I really took them away, this spatial crack would collapse..."
Thinking this, his expression immediately became somewhat helpless. These plane fragments, although valuable, had formed a relatively stable state over countless years, filling this planar gap.
Actually absorbing them would be a big issue.
It was like a house built of blocks, where each piece of wood played its stabilizing role; removing one might cause the whole structure to collapse.
Contemplating this, Su Lun smacked his lips, feeling a bit regretful.
He thought he could only wait until he no longer needed this planar crack, then come back and try.
This planar crack was indeed an excellent hiding place.
But for those who didn't understand the higher Space Law, it was fraught with deadly dangers everywhere.
It's no wonder Medusa didn't dare to pursue.
Just as Su Lun's thoughts were drifting, Tanni suddenly spoke up on the communicator, "Mr. Su Lun, which direction should we head now?"
Like entering a minefield, the Eternal Night proceeded cautiously, groping its way slowly forward.
Still, the risk was enormous.
Tanni, a great sailor, could handle any situation at sea, but in this void, he had no certainty.
Su Lun, listening, didn't rush to reply.
The planar crack was almost crystal clear in his perception; spatial cracks, spatial winds, spatial turbulence...all were distinctly visible.
If he truly wanted to leave, it wouldn't be difficult.
But...after all, someone had guided him on this path, so he shouldn't need to figure out the route himself.
As expected, almost at the moment the communicator sounded, a message came in his mind-sea, "Go right, towards that red plane fragment, then head north..."
With the exchange of messages, a precise navigation map immediately appeared in Su Lun's mind.
After sensing that there was no problem, he immediately passed the route to Tanni in the cockpit.
The Eternal Night moved on steadily.
...
The concept of distance within the planar crack was different from the Alchemy Plane.
With this shortcut, what would have been a journey of a day or two by sea took only a few hours in the planar crack for the Eternal Night to emerge successfully.
As Queen Medusa said, they crossed the strategically important location controlled by the Angel Plane at Moon Strait, and appeared directly near Giant Island, where the "Mimir's Well" was located.
This also completely avoided the threats from the groups of magic towers at Moon Strait.
And as Dawn Squad reappeared, those on the Angel Plane who were discussing how to land on Giant Island also spotted them.
Saint Frank, greatly perplexed, also bellowed in rage, "How is it possible?! How did those natives bypass Moon Strait and suddenly appear near here?"
The carefully schemed trap, and the prey had just leaped out?

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - 575: Seriously Injured
chapters.content:
The Eternal Night appeared once again on the surface of the sea.
Time and space within the dimensional rift differed from the normal world; Su Lun immediately checked their spatial location and discovered they had indeed "taken a shortcut" to a spot hundreds of nautical miles away.
The sea around them was calm, with thin white clouds drifting in the sky.
Free from the endless assault of the snake swarm, the members of the Dawn group cheered excitedly.
They celebrated their escape and the novel adventure brought by the recent journey through the dimensional rift.
However, this was not the time to relax.
The advantage of taking a shortcut meant that the Dawn group not only escaped the encirclement of Medusa but also avoided the heavily guarded Moon Strait by the divine forces.
Medusa did not possess the ability to move hundreds of nautical miles in such a short time.
At least they did not have to worry about being surrounded by a large army.
However, based on Su Lun's understanding of the divine dimension's magic legion, those people would certainly pursue them again.
Moreover, now that the Dawn group had allied with Queen Medusa, they had become a significant threat.
Without addressing this threat, those from the divine dimension knew they could not safely reach the Mimir's Spring.
As soon as they emerged, Su Lun immediately turned to the group and said, "Everyone, be careful. We were undetectable in the chaotic space just now, but upon coming out, we've surely been discovered. Everyone, prepare for battle immediately!"
"Yes!"
With this command, everyone responded simultaneously, putting away their casual attitudes and starting their battle preparations.
....
Queen Medusa had previously mentioned that among those mages, there was one with a vertical pupil on their forehead, the one who controlled the Artifact Projection.
Su Lun could guess that this person was none other than the Saint Frank McAdam.
While the members were busy preparing for battle, Su Lun stood on the mast, observing the surroundings.
At that moment, he received a mental transmission from Queen Medusa: "Further west lies the Giant Island, where the Mimir's Spring you seek is located. Some of the mages have already tried to land there. But you needn't rush; the Cyclops tribe guarding the spring won't let anyone obtain the water that easily..."
"Oh?"
This was indeed one of Su Lun's primary concerns.
But he also knew that fretting was useless.
The current situation was that, without dealing with the threat from the divine dimension's mages, their Dawn group couldn't safely approach Giant Island.
The opposition likely felt the same way about them.
Hearing Medusa say this, Su Lun curiously asked, "Your Highness, from what I know, there is one among those mages who can easily summon divine power. Even with divine protection, they can't get the water?"
During this time, Su Lun had gathered a lot of intelligence on the divine dimension and finally understood why the one with the vertical pupil was called "Saint."
The blood manifestation of Talent [S-009-Universe True Solution], was not only a peak cultivation talent. That Frank was also able to easily communicate with the deities and receive more divine power.
A top-tier powerhouse blessed by a deity wasn't commonly stumped by the shattered Alchemy dimension.
Could the Cyclops stop him?
When Queen Medusa heard this, there wasn't the slightest reverence for the extraworldly deities in her tone as she responded, "Don't mention summoning the will of deities; even the arrival of a True God may not necessarily succeed in forcefully taking the spring water."
She herself was of a mythological demigod lineage, and her level of life was not necessarily lower than some lower-tier deities.
She added, "This involves some ancient taboos, and I'm not entirely clear on the specifics myself. But an ancient warning passed down by my ancestors in the Gorgon lineage warns: 'No one can defeat the Cyclops tribe on the island where the Mimir's Spring is located, and do not even think of forcibly taking the water, otherwise even the gods will be cursed...'"
True God's arrival won't even work?
Su Lun pondered this profoundly.
Yet, at the same time, he felt a bit relieved.
Given that the divine dimension had the numerical and initial advantage, their odds of obtaining the Mimir's Spring were far greater than those of the Dawn group.
Now knowing that the threshold for obtaining the spring water was extremely high somewhat leveled the playing field.
Then, Queen Medusa added, "Moreover, my ancestor's homeland is on the northwestern Coco Island. If I can complete the final step of my legacy in the temple, I wouldn't fear anyone on this dimension."
"Hmm."
Su Lun responded, acknowledging her words.
This was also part of the cooperation content previously discussed in their alliance treaty; the Dawn group needed to help Queen Medusa complete her final legacy.
Because they'd taken a shortcut, at the Eternal Night's maximum speed, it would take no more than two hours to reach Coco Island from here.
Now that Medusa's main forces were still hundreds of nautical miles away, this was the perfect opportunity for a stealth attack.
However, Su Lun also knew that things would not go so smoothly.
The enemies from the divine dimension would definitely not let them go unchecked.
...
Just as the Eternal Night was sailing toward Coco Island, Su Lun, who was closely observing the surroundings from the mast, suddenly sensed something and shouted, "Twelve o'clock direction, enemy attack!"
No sooner had he spoken than the space above the sea surface in front of the Eternal Night suddenly distorted, and a blonde man in a grand red magic robe with golden embroidery elegantly stepped out from the dimensional rift.
The arrogant look and the characteristic vertical pupil on his forehead; who else could it be if not the Heavenly God's Son, Frank McAdam?
"Eh..."
As he saw this sudden appearance of the enemy, Su Lun's pupils slightly constricted.
He wasn't surprised that the Saint Heir caught up so quickly, but what was unexpected was how closely this fellow's understanding of the Space Law compared to his own?
Nowadays, Su Lun's grasp on Space Law was such that not even a level eight Space Wizard could necessarily surpass him.
And such a rare command over the law couldn't be elevated to a higher order without a great fortune.
It was only through the fusion of various spatial devices, advanced materials, and Bloodline Potions that Su Lun had reached his current level.
But surprisingly, Frank had reached that height as well.
This made things more troublesome...
Su Lun had always relied on his superior understanding of Space Law to overpower his enemies. Now, facing someone who could fight and escape just as well, he suddenly felt a sense of crisis.
That meant, without the "Urobolos Space-Time Ring," he would undoubtedly be targeted relentlessly by this fellow.
It wasn't just him, but any member of the Dawn Group!
Su Lun narrowed his eyes at the proud golden-haired young man and murmured to himself, "This guy's strength has increased so quickly..."
No wonder he dared to chase over alone, with that strength came confidence.
...
However, the moment the enemy appeared, the Dawn Group reacted extremely quickly.
With Su Lun's warning, almost the moment Saint Frank appeared, "bang, bang" sounds rang out as the main cannon on the deck belched flames.
At the same time, two faster Sword Qi and dozens of slightly slower high-level Alchemy spells also bombarded the area directly in front of the ship.
This strike nearly integrated all of Dawn Group's instantaneous combat power; directly hitting it would likely kill an eighth-level professional on the spot.
Yet, a bizarre scene unfolded.
The Alchemy cannonballs bombarded the position where the young man had just appeared, and he didn't even seem to intend to dodge.
The eerie domain around his body unfolded, and the Alchemy cannonballs visibly disintegrated into particles mid-flight, completely dissolving a few meters away from Frank before dissipating into the air.
No explosion, no shockwave, no alchemical reaction... nothing.
Both energy and matter were decomposed into basic particles by that strange domain.
Even Old Sword God Barrett's swipe of Sword Qi only managed to cut a tiny slit on Frank's Magic Robe.
Seeing this, every member of the Dawn Group visibly paled.
They looked at the man floating in the air as if they were seeing a monster, a shock that they never had even when they hunted an eighth-tier pure-blooded Silver Dragon!
Even Bartolo could only breach the defense; how did this guy manage it?
Could this guy be stronger than an eighth-tier dragon?
It wasn't just that he was strong.
It was his strange disintegrating ability that completely surpassed everyone's understanding and that made him so troublesome.
...
Seeing the shocked expressions on the faces of those on deck, Frank seemed to enjoy this superior feeling. He glanced at the cut on his robe and chuckled, "Eh... Sword God realm? Tsk tsk, that's rare. I didn't expect this plane to still have professionals with such a level of Sword Dao mastery..."
Su Lun focused on this guy, his gaze landing on the glowing small round shield in his left hand.
Even with the All-knowing Eye, the magic patterns on the small shield were still profoundly mysterious; those were divine inscriptions.
Upon identifying it, it was indeed the "Artifact Projection" Medusa had mentioned.
[Mirror of Purity]
Detailed description: This is a magical shield that lets no dust settle and is untainted by any magic; a projection lowered from a higher plane, it possesses some of the properties of a divine artifact, reflecting all magical damage not above the law level of this shield;
"A hundred percent magic immunity..."
Su Lun sighed softly as he read the identified information.
For this alchemical plane to possess a higher-level technique than this shield was almost impossible.
Now that Frank kept this shield with him, he was obviously guarding against Queen Medusa's petrification curse.
Now that Old Sword God Bartolo's Sword Qi posed no threat to him, and Medusa couldn't harm him, his appearance immediately posed an unsolvable problem for the Dawn Group.
Su Lun had witnessed the prowess of Frank's "All-encompassing Resolution" back in Old Lington.
Back then, he, along with Mr. Jing and a thousand others, had combined their attacks but still failed to restrain this guy; now it was even more unlikely.
Dealing with such an enemy wasn't just a matter of numbers.
It was about finding a way to counter his abilities.
After pondering, it seemed only Su Lun's abilities offered some hope of counteraction.
Seeing the first round of attacks completely ineffective, he immediately said, "You guys go ahead, I'll hold him off."
Knowing the severity of the situation, everyone immediately responded, "Yes!"
...
With the [Mirror of Purity] in Frank's hand, it was also the most crucial thing for countering Medusa.
The only option currently was for Su Lun to hold this guy off, allowing the Dawn Group to make an assault on Coco Island.
Only after Queen Medusa accepted the ancestral heritage and her strength surged, would the Dawn Group truly have a reliable ally in this sea region.
Su Lun levitated, holding a black scythe and black umbrella, positioning himself in front of Frank.
The Eternal Night then steered clear of the battlefield between the two and sailed straight away.
Frank watched the black-sailed warship departing but didn't rush to chase it, a mocking cold smile was the only thing in his eyes.
After all, with his current spatial abilities, even if that ship could fly, he could easily catch up to it.
Looking at Su Lun in front of him, he recognized this as the man who had severed his arm back then.
The grievance of a severed limb had cost him, a Saint Heir, his dignity, and Frank decided to kill this man first.
Su Lun was unapologetic, raising his hand to hack down with his black sickle.
Across several hundred meters, a space crack as thin as a hair appeared on Frank's body.
But the fellow didn't panic; he merely glanced at it with his vertical forehead pupil, and before the spatial crack could fully open, it had already closed and disappeared.
While Su Lun was not at all surprised inside, his expression turned grave; he raised his black sickle and slashed down several times, but to no avail.
Seeing that the black sickle was ineffective, he raised his hand to form sorcerer's seals, sending several seventh-level magic spells hurling through the air.
However, the result was the same; any attack nearing Frank would be disintegrated into fundamental particles.
On the other hand, Frank's attacks posed a grave threat to Su Lun, nearly causing disasters several times.
The two exchanged blows, and in the blink of an eye, they had fought over a dozen rounds.
The strengths of both sides were more or less ascertained by each other.
The battle seemed extremely fierce, but Frank didn't feel the slightest threat. He looked down at Su Lun with overwhelming arrogance in his eyes, "Tsk tsk... among the seventh-class professionals I've encountered, your strength is the strongest indeed, far more so than that so-called 'Top Ten Legendary Hunter' I killed earlier. Just managing to withstand so many of my moves, you should indeed feel proud. Unfortunately, such attacks are useless against me..."
Possibly feeling assured of his victory, this fellow showed off an air of superiority.
Su Lun didn't take it to heart as he listened, fighting while retreating as if trying to escape when outmatched.
Frank also realized that Su Lun was either trying to draw him away or truly planning to escape, but he didn't care at all.
He felt that with his current spatial ability, it was impossible for anyone to shake him off, and he pursued relentlessly.
....
The two started a fierce battle above the sea, and the shockwaves of the fight blasted white sprays across the surface.
After a while, Su Lun also formed an accurate concept of Frank's capabilities.
He had to admit, the man seemed utterly intractable.
His own attacks were probably around the eighth-tier professional standard, not too deadly. But the troublesome part was his talent that could dissolve anything, the "All Things True Solution," and the "Mirror of Innocence" in his hand that gave him a complete magic immunity, making him nearly invincible.
Normally, even a ninth-tier might find it hard to trouble him.
Seeing that there was "no escape," Su Lun suddenly conjured a death specter behind him, deploying the Domain of Death and getting ready for a desperate fight.
Frank watched his state, his eyes shining coldly, "You're finally using this move, huh..."
This domain was the same one that had cost him an arm initially, and upon seeing it again, anger surged in his heart.
This move had caused him a great loss before, but it wouldn't work on him now!
Just as he whispered to himself, he started chanting a profound incantation, "It's over... All Things True Solution·Heavenly Divine Light!"
The instant that incantation was uttered, Frank's vertical pupil in his forehead abruptly focused, emitting a bizarre blue light.
The moment this blue light appeared, it seemed as if the surrounding space twisted, and an aura of destruction abruptly arose.
He saw through Su Lun's intention to teleport close for hand-to-hand combat; his forehead's vertical pupil instantly focused a meter in front of him, the gaze targeted there as well.
Su Lun's teleportation was fast, and his combat reactions were almost flawless, but since it was anticipated, that was enough to decide life and death!
Even Su Lun himself felt the mountainous threat of death, his scalp numbing instantly.
As soon as he teleported over, he sensed a destructive force shooting toward his head.
How fast was that blue light?
In that flash of a moment, it had penetrated the dominating aura and domain surrounding Su Lun.
Seeing that there was no escape and that his head was about to be disintegrated by the light beam,
An abrupt anomaly occurred!
A ring on Su Lun's finger flashed red, and his speed weirdly surged by several times.
"BIU~"
The blue light that could penetrate everything shot through Su Lun's head, only to break into a shadow.
On closer inspection, it turned out to be an afterimage!
He had avoided it?
How could that be!
Frank widened his three eyes, completely astonished that his surefire strike had been dodged?
Yet, what shocked him even more lay ahead.
Not only had Su Lun's speed increased several-fold, but his right hand, holding a black umbrella, suddenly gathered a layer of soul fire that resembled phosphorus.
The rune-covered black umbrella transformed into a spear, thrusting straight at his chest.
Frank instantly felt the threat of death and was horrified, "Death God's Fire, how does he have this move?!"
But there was no time to think further, as the green phosphorus fire had already touched his all-encompassing domain.
All that All-knowing Eye could break down was everything he could comprehend.
Now, under divine protection, his cultivation progressed at a rapid pace.
Earth, wind, water, fire, light, darkness... various mainstream or rare elemental laws; space, destruction, time, life... various high-level laws, he had deep insights into almost all of them.
This gave him the confidence to face any enemy with composure.
However, he knew nothing about the soul.
This involved matters of a higher level of life.
"Damn it!"
Frank's domain did little to block the soul fire, leaving him to only watch as the burning black umbrella pierced his chest.
Before the black umbrella even pierced him, green flames had already ignited on his body.
In an instant, Frank felt as if the whole world was engulfed in flames.
His combat instincts made him teleport away from the spot instantly, but, with his soul ignited, Frank felt his life draining away like a breached dam, and he couldn't stop it!
...
"Success!"
Su Lun was overjoyed in his heart.
Even though intense pain from his dissected legs passed through him, his expression eased instantly.
Once tainted by the Death God's Fire, a soul won't stop burning until it is extinguished!
This strike, even if it didn't kill Saint Frank, was enough to severely wound him.
Actually, from the beginning, Su Lun knew that even if he exposed all his methods, he wouldn't be able to kill this guy.
After all, he had witnessed this guy's speed at invoking the will of the gods when in Old Lington, so fast that it gave no one a chance to kill him.
At any sign of a fatal threat, he would inevitably summon divine protection.
Therefore, the only chance was a surprise attack!
Letting the enemy not perceive him as a lethal threat was the only opportunity!
So from the start of the battle, Su Lun hadn't revealed his trump cards.
That was not easy.
After all, Frank possessed the talent of All-knowing Eye, and his insight was unimaginable.
Any thought of fooling the enemy or luring him into a trap, under the gaze of the Three-Eyed Divine Eye, simply couldn't be hidden.
So Su Lun really had been fighting with all his might just now.
Previously, even when he fought with all his might, he couldn't do anything to the opponent; he had only the option to flee.
But after coming out from the cursed space of Hell Dragon Country, he had in his possession an alchemical treasure—the Philosopher's Stone.
This Divine Artifact could enhance the power of alchemy spells, shorten the time of spell consolidation, and allow for a hundred percent equivalent exchange...
It could increase the battle power of an alchemist by several times!
Su Lun had turned this gemstone into an inconspicuous ring and wore it on his hand, never using it until then.
And just in that moment, he found the opportunity to stake everything!
Having fought for so long, the enemy's thinking had become habitual; they thought Su Lun's combat power was only at 100 units, but suddenly it surged to 300 units, and that unexpected moment was his chance.
And indeed, it worked!
...
Su Lun watched the distant Frank, who had teleported and retreated several hundred meters away, suppressed the intense pain from his completely dissected lower leg, and attempted to teleport again to pursue his advantage.
However, at that moment, Su Lun saw a green light emerging from Frank's forehead, suddenly focusing on his own burning chest.
In that split second, the beam of light, sharp as a knife, allowed Frank to dissolve everything below his own chest!
Escaping by cutting off his own tail?
Su Lun also inwardly sighed at the guy's decisiveness.
Nevertheless, he could clearly sense that the opponent's soul fire had weakened significantly in an instant.
However, before Su Lun could advance again, a strand of divine light suddenly descended upon the guy, and he vanished completely.
"He escaped, huh..."
Squinting, Su Lun watched the still-dissolving limbs in the distance and sighed slightly.
But upon further reflection, he was already quite satisfied with the outcome.
Although it was disappointing not to kill him, inflicting serious injury on an enemy that even a level nine couldn't touch was an unexpected delight.
Moreover, there was good news: the Saint's soul had been severely injured, and his strength was likely to plummet greatly.
At least for the short term, this guy no longer had the means to be arrogant.
Su Lun took a couple of deep breaths, looked at his dissolved leg, and didn't linger any longer.
With a flash of spatial waves, his figure instantly disappeared from the scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - 576 Temple of the God of Gears
chapters.content:
PS. Kavan is a bit rough, feel free to skip.
On board the Eternal Night, every member of the Dawn Brigade was intently monitoring their surroundings, ready for battle or to make a swift retreat at any moment.
Having just witnessed Saint Frank of the Heavenly God's domain disassemble everything with his "All-encompassing Decipherment" ability, everyone realized they were facing an "unbeatable enemy."
Old Sword God Bartolo and Queen Medusa, one with combat prowess almost at the peak of physical professions from the Alchemy plane, the other with a mythological curse lineage, were unable to harm that person with their attacks. The rest of the Dawn Brigade couldn't think of any other way to deal with the Saint Heir.
Meanwhile, Su Lun had recently taken a huge risk to stay behind alone and delay the enemy, leading everyone to think that this would likely only buy them some time.
Delay them until they might have a chance to reach Coco Xi Island, where the situation could be reversed.
If they couldn't, then they would need to think long-term.
...
However, it wasn't long after the warship set sail that Qiantiao suddenly sensed a distortion in space nearby.
Her gaze sharpened, and her hand, always resting on her sword hilt, tightened its grip further.
The only one who could precisely locate her was naturally Su Lun.
But at this time, it might not be just Su Lun arriving; the enemy could be following as well.
As Qiantiao's intense killing intent leaked out, nearly everyone on the deck looked toward the twisted space. As soon as they focused their eyes, they saw a man with his robes in tatters stepping out of the spatial rift.
"It's Mr. Su Lun!"
"Mr. Su Lun has returned!"
"..."
Seeing it was Su Lun, and apparently no enemy followed, everyone let out a huge sigh of relief.
But before the look of joy could surface on their faces, their gaze was drawn to Su Lun's empty right leg, and their expressions froze in unison.
At that moment, Su Lun's right leg had completely vanished below the knee, the wound on his knee was a blur of flesh and blood, with some lingering blue specks like flames dissolving the flesh.
Qiantiao quickly supported Su Lun and asked with concern, "How are your injuries?"
"Not too bad,"
Su Lun shook his head to signal it wasn't serious, then added a reminder, "Be careful, this light can disintegrate anything."
Qiantiao frowned as she carefully supported him, eyeing the odd disintegrative force on the wound and muttered, "How did you get injured like this?"
The two landed on the deck, and the Dawn Brigade's medical team approached.
The high-level combatants carefully scanned the surroundings and, finding no enemy pursuing them, gathered around as well.
