Queen Medusa had mentioned before that their Golark tribe had a total of three eighth-tiers.
Aside from herself, who had chosen to face the ordeal, the other two were her dear sisters who had betrayed her.
One had been killed on the outskirts of Aike, the capital of the Silver Dragon Country; the other was right here before her.
This person was the one pulling the strings behind "Sea of Snakes Sanctuary" both previously and now!
Su Lun was aware of the danger, so how could she be unguarded?
Even though she was smeared with the "Blood of Redemption from Queen Medusa," it was impossible to completely ignore the petrification curse of an eighth-tier Medusa.
And the moment they both emerged from the spatial rift and faced each other, this Medusa's hair full of snakes suddenly opened its eyes, and a broad petrifying beam had already covered Su Lun's entire body.
The enemy was well-prepared, why would they make a mistake?
Su Lun was enveloped in a gray light, utterly unavoidable.
And in that moment she locked eyes with the Medusa's amber vertical pupils, a paralysis ten times stronger than before suddenly spread throughout her body, making Su Lun feel as if time had slowed by tenfold; her body immediately entered a bizarre state of rigidity, even her thoughts seemed to stop.
Not far away, Legate Augustus saw this and rejoiced: It worked!
He too was prepared; the phantom vertical pupil on his forehead suddenly burst with light, and a disintegrating beam shot toward the rigid Su Lun.
Two top-notch experts teamed up, giving her no chance to escape. Su Lun, even if she were one or two major ranks higher, would still be unable to flee this predicament.
It looked like this was a certain death situation.
However, at this critical moment, something Augustus and the Medusa could never have anticipated occurred.
...
The petrifying beam of the Medusa race was a high-ranking Earthen Law, almost possessing varying degrees of petrification effects on all energies and matters.
And being from a mythical race, probably only beings above ninth-tier could confidently resist the curse of this eighth-tier Medusa.
The Dawn Brigade had just such a member!
That was the ghostly Miss Pestoya!
It was the moment Su Lun fell into a rigid state; a ghost floated out from the rune-decorated black umbrella in his hand.
Her spiritual body also burned with the same green phosphorus fire as Su Lun, directly ignoring the petrifying beam, and charged straight toward the Medusa.
This eighth-tier Medusa clearly hadn't expected this turn of events!
Fear and confusion filled its eyes.
However, before it could think further, Pestoya had already charged over, using the Death God's Fire to directly ignite its soul.
The trembling of soul burning forced the Medusa to let out a heartrending scream: "Ah..."
However, the crisis was not completely resolved!
On the other side, Augustus's "Omnifactor True Solution" beam had already hit Su Lun.
But at the same time, the necromancy rune Su Lun had drawn on his chest had suddenly shone brightly, and an indescribable, eerie breath suddenly protected his body.
Upon looking again, Pandora had revealed her true form from the Spirit Communion Array, her divine robe formed from blood-colored moonlight, surrounded by a hundred demons.
Prepared for battle, a massive surge of divine power burst forth the moment she appeared, and she lightly chided, "Tsukuyomi - Lunar Divine Path!"
Looking again, her crimson eyes blazing, seemed like two blood moons casting forth an overwhelmingly dominant illusion technique.
This blood-colored light immediately contacted Augustus's disintegrating light.
However, "Omnifactor True Solution" with its illusion-cancelling property was evidently superior, segmenting and then hitting Pandora's body, causing her to disintegrate on the spot.
Yet, although Pandora's aura had weakened significantly in an instant, her disintegrated body, like the moon's reflection on water, shattered but then swiftly restored itself.
It was she who stepped forward to block this certain death attack for Su Lun.
And the Moon Reading Illusion Technique also momentarily left Augustus in a daze.
Pandora's current divine cultivation had reached the "indestructible" property—so long as her object of enshrinement was not destroyed, she would not die!
This was also why Su Lun was confident letting her defend as his most vital maneuver.
One demi-god and one spirit burning with divine fire, he was protected by twin divinities, not too unseemly for a divine being's will to descend.
This assurance was his ultimate ground for engaging Augustus!
But this was almost his last card to play.
Now it was revealed; they must decide the outcome.
The moment Pestoya and Pandora blocked the dual deadly attacks for him, Su Lun broke free from his rigid state.
The spatial teleportation at close range had no forewarning; he had already appeared behind Augustus.
This time, the rune-decorated black umbrella struck the great Magic Conductor's magic shield.
At the touch, sparks flew from the umbrella, tiny sparks that immediately burned into his soul.
However, Augustus was not a half-step Sage of Law Puppet Master for nothing; even under the illusion's effect, he immediately woke up.
As he saw his soul ignite, his combat instincts instantly reacted.
With a "bang," his figure exploded into pieces.
Seeing this, Su Lun muttered to himself: "The epic magic tool, 'Life-Sparing Crystal,' finally used up, huh."
This guy was a legate, naturally equipped with numerous life-preserving items; this was one of them as per the intelligence.
Able to provide instant life-saving.
But how could Su Lun let him escape again?
If not killed in one strike, then strike twice!
Even though there was no one in sight, Su Lun didn't hesitate to use spatial teleportation.
At that moment, the spatial coordinates Mr. Hei had placed on him using both hands finally came into play!
The scenery around changed instantly, and Su Lun found himself inside a cave several kilometers away.
There was also a magic Formation inside the cave, which was lighting up at this moment.
Seeing this, how could he not know that this cunning Old Magic Conductor had prepared this shelter for himself well in advance?
Su Lun didn't hesitate for a second longer, bringing his rune-infused black umbrella up to his face and swinging it down with a thud.
Not good!
Augustus's face turned pale in an instant.
He hadn't expected that just as he had arrived, the other party would follow right behind.
But after slight contemplation, he immediately realized, "Damn it, that black-robed Magician had left a spatial marker!"
Even now that he understood, Su Lun wouldn't give him any more chances.
For the first time, Augustus felt the terrifying approach of true death; he indeed still had many life-saving techniques, just a moment to chant and release would allow him to survive.
However, he also knew there was no chance left.
The decisiveness of his adversary in seizing the moment was enough to determine life or death.
With a "bang," the rune black umbrella struck Augustus solidly in the chest.
This time, the green phosphorous fire ignited like gunpowder, burning up completely in an instant.
Augustus, being a grand Magic Conductor a half-step away from Sage of Law, possessed spiritual power far beyond the ordinary, so much so that in his final moment, he could clearly perceive the passing of his life.
Nevertheless, he still couldn't understand why his foolproof plan had failed.
Although the false god was much stronger than reported, he was still within a manageable range.
But what about the other, the Spiritual Body that ignored the petrifying curse?
He didn't get to understand any of it as his consciousness dissipated.
Su Lun, recognizing that his soul had left his body, knew this person was truly dead.
He hurried to harvest it while it was still burning.
Sadly, it had already burned considerably, and the memories he obtained were just fragments.
But Su Lun's attitude was always good.
Having any harvest at all was good enough.
Plus, those fragments were high-level and very useful to him.
After killing this powerful enemy, Su Lun finally heaved a sigh of relief.
It was a relief to have resolved a major problem.
However, asking about the situation outside, it still wasn't looking good. The monsters drawn by the sound of the horn were still converging towards Cocorosie Island.
The crisis was not yet over.
Su Lun dared not stay longer; he glanced at the body on the ground.
The legendary magic wand was still there, but the Artifact Projection "Shield of Innocence" had disappeared.
Su Lun felt somewhat regretful then.
An artifact with a hundred percent magic immunity, if it had fallen into his own hands, he would be truly unkillable.
However, even if he had obtained it, without Divine Power, he wouldn't have been able to use it.
Su Lun pursed his lips, not dwelling on it further.
He stored the body into his mini-void realm and cleared out all the contents of that giant storage ring.
Augustus, being the Supreme Army Commander from the Divine Realm in the Dragon Country Waters, was naturally extremely wealthy.
The contents of this storage ring—various high-level magic materials, demon crystals, scrolls, etc.—were dazzling to Su Lun.
The gains from just killing this one person were probably worth more than several ten-thousand member mage groups.
Moreover, Su Lun spotted two familiar items immediately.
The "Cadmos's Dragon Hunting Spear" and "Gleipnir's Entangler."
These two treasures were magical instruments used by those Mages in the battle against the Tier 8 national guardian Silver Dragon at the Silver Dragon Country capital, Aikrensar.
The spear could pierce dragon scales, and the rope could prevent the terrifying power of a Tier 8 giant dragon from breaking free—truly rare treasures.
There was no time to consider and count all his gains.
With another instantaneous movement, Su Lun appeared once more in front of the Gorelt God Temple.
....
At that moment, a large Gorgon corpse had already fallen to the ground; this was the Tier 8 Gorgon that had plotted against Su Lun just now.
Its soul had been utterly incinerated by Pestoya, leaving only its shell.
Because of the death of this Tier 8 Gorgon, the snake sea disaster besieging the temple instantly lost its control. The previously endless poisonous snakes had now retreated like a tide, leaving behind only heaps of corpses.
Su Lun glanced at the spirit lady next to the corpse and patted her head, "Thank you."
Pestoya, with a face full of happiness from being able to help, replied, "See? Didn't I tell you I was amazing?"
"Yes, super amazing."
Su Lun nodded affirmatively.
The Death God's Fire that Pesto had just unleashed was indeed the result of genuine hard training, without any deceit.
Su Lun didn't hold back and directly gathered up the body of the Gorgon.
At that moment, Pandora, emanating a celestial aura, also descended, "Hey~ no one even thanked me."
Su Lun looked at her with a smile and sincerely said, "Thank you for your help, Miss Pandora."
Without these two just now, he would have been unable to turn the tables on the enemy.
Pandora listened, smiled seductively, and said nothing.
While the three of them chatted briefly, a sword light flashed in the distance, and a path was cleaved through the mountain of corpses; Tanni, covered in blood and holding a sword, slowly emerged.
Half her arm was exposed outside her Sword Dao robe, and her chest heaved violently; she too looked significantly drained.
Noticing her serious injuries, Su Lun expressed his concern, "Sister Tanni, how are you?"
With a clank, Tanni sheathed her sword and coolly replied, "I've been poisoned. But I've injected an antidote potion, it's not a big problem."
Su Lun listened and his brows relaxed.
Although Mr. Hei was severely injured and Tanni was also not lightly hurt... they had fortunately managed to kill the formidable enemy without mishap.
At that moment, Tanni looked towards the direction of the Hell Volcano where the Titan Spirit Army was approaching and asked, "What do we do now?"
"..."
Hearing this, Su Lun's expression immediately became grave again.
He glanced at the temple, where the inheritance of Queen Medusa seemed nowhere near ending.
Then he looked at the distance.
After pondering for a moment, Su Lun seriously said, "The sound of horns summoning those monsters wasn't controlled by the previous legion commander, it should be a group of 500 arduous trainees. But I don't know where those people are hiding. Without dealing with them, we can't handle these creatures."
He paused for a moment, then said, "Sister Tanni, you should rest in the minor void realm for now."
The implied meaning of his words was that they were preparing to initiate Plan C for evacuation.
"Okay."
Tanni listened with an unfaltering expression on her face.
She didn't think too much; let Su Lun worry about the decisions.
She was only responsible for the fighting.
A vortex of void lighted up in Su Lun's palm, and he placed Tanni into the minor void realm.
Pandora, who had previously taken a mortal blow in her true body and whose divine power was not lightly damaged, also went to the minor void realm to recuperate.
Su Lun then sat alone beside a stone sculpture outside the temple.
Pesto, imitating him, sat down beside him.
Both of them remained silent.
The noise of monsters landing on the island grew louder, and even with the Eternal Night's cannons restraining them, those Titan creatures attracted by the "Gallar's Doomsday Horn" still relentlessly congregated towards Cocolossi Island.
Su Lun planned to hold out until the last moment.
If there truly were no other options left, leaving then would mean he had exhausted all his efforts.
Through the communicator, the crew on the Eternal Night continuously reported the situation: "Mr. Su Lun, be careful, we can't draw those creatures away, they are heading towards you…"
Su Lun heard this and remained silent, his thoughts racing, still seeking the last possible opportunity for a turnaround.
However, no matter how hard he racked his brain, he couldn't find any chance of winning.
In the face of such overwhelming odds, everything seemed so pale and powerless.
Yet, facing the oncoming horde of monsters, he murmured, "This scenario, it's very similar to the situation in the Atlantis Ruins… The war horn sounded, summoning a flood of monsters."
Unfortunately, this time there was no will of the cursed space to help.
Several flying Titan lineage creatures had already reached the temple first, and Su Lun, raising his hand, sliced them down with several swings of his dark scythe.
But as time passed, more and more giant creatures landed on the island.
After repelling wave after wave of creatures alone, Su Lun already felt the situation was beyond salvation.
At the edge of his vision, ninth-tier creatures had started to appear, and he knew he didn't have much time left.
However, just when he thought the situation was irreversible, something completely unexpected happened.
Through the communicator, the outer observation post of the Eternal Night discovered something and sent an urgent message: "Mr. Su Lun, this is bad, a horde of giant dragons has appeared from the northwest! There are a lot of them!"
A horde of giant dragons?
Upon hearing this, Su Lun grimaced.
His first thought was that these dragons were part of the monster tide summoned by the horn.
But with the situation already so dire, he didn't think a few more dragons would make much difference.
Yet on second thought, that wasn't right!
Originally, it was the Dragon race and the Titan gods who battled, so how could these dragons be with the Titan spirits?
Furthermore, the identification of "Gallar's Doomsday Horn" had no effect on summoning dragons.
The moment he understood this key point, Su Lun's expression suddenly brightened.
His intuition told him that the turning point in the situation had arrived!

chapters.title: Chapter 582 - 581: Gods and Demigods
chapters.content:
"Ahh~"
Soon after receiving a message from the Eternal Night, a piercing dragon's cry echoed from the horizon.
The sound, like a bell, came rolling in.
Listening to the reverberating echo in his ears, it was clear it wasn't just one or two giant dragons, but a whole flock!
Wrapped within the dragon's chants was a domineering dragon's might, and even from such a distance, Su Lun could feel the despotic presence that looked down upon all creatures, murmuring to himself, "Could these be Tier 9 dragons?"
Tier 9 dragon clans were already the apex beings of this plane, it was best to stay as far away as possible from such tyrannical creatures on regular days.
But at this moment, not only was Su Lun not afraid as he watched, his heart was, in fact, filled with anticipation: "Now things are getting lively."
Because he distinctly felt that those giant dragons were not releasing their might towards the Golgond Temple, but rather towards the Titan spirits summoned by the sound of the horn above Hell Volcano.
Just as he expected!
Before long, several lightning-fast shadows swept across the sky above the island of Cocoloxi.
Soon after, a long string of shadows followed!
Su Lun looked up and quickly caught sight of the targets; only then did he discern that the fleeting shadows were giant dragons with scales reflecting dazzling colors of all sorts.
Flame Red Dragons, Forest Green Dragons, Frost White Dragons, Lightning Blue Dragons, Corrosive Black Dragons, Divine Silver Dragons, Gemstone Dragons, Coppery Red Dragons, Tyrant Gold Dragons...
Almost all the dragon species that had appeared in myths and legends were now before his eyes.
The sky was densely packed, and he estimated there were at least several hundred purebred giant dragons.
The majority of the dragon clans from the Alchemical Plane must be here!
"This... So many purebred giant dragons?
Even though Su Lun was already counted among the few with the broadest knowledge on this plane, the sight of this overwhelming dragon army left him incredibly shocked.
Ordinary people would be lucky to see a purebred giant dragon in their lifetime.
What then was the concept of having several hundred appear all at once?
The proud dragon race, even when hunting, would act alone; who has ever witnessed such a scene?
The "Dragon Country Waters Chart" that Su Lun had obtained earlier showed that Hell Volcano was a relic of the Ancient Dragon Country. But further west was marked with a skull symbol, the zone of death, with a note: The dragon's den.
It was an area several levels more dangerous than the island of Cocoloxi, home to the Medusa clan.
Looking at the direction from which these dragons were coming, it was obvious that the dragons from Dragon Island had emptied their lairs.
And upon closer inspection, leading them were indeed two Tier 9 giant dragons.
Identified even with names, displayed as [Dragon King Grulnir] and [Red Dragon Clan Leader Odniel].
That dragon might, which made Su Lun's entire body feel a trembling sense of awe, was released by these two giant dragons.
Tier 9 giant dragons, when compared to Alchemists' tier, were absolutely beyond the standard battle power.
Following these pureblood giant dragons were tens of thousands of various lesser dragons, wyverns, and dragonkin creatures.
Their numbers formed a blanket over the sky, seemingly infinite.
This force was in no way inferior to the Titan bloodline exchanged by the sound of the horn.
If it had been just one or two purebred giant dragons, Su Lun might still feel his domineering courage unfazed, but now, even he was shaken to his soul by the passing dragon clan army, almost as if it were going to scare him out of his body.
It was a terrifying pressure, as if the world was about to collapse!
Yet in that situation, Su Lun's face grew more and more spirited as he murmured, "This is really heating up."
Although the vast majority of dragons were considered monsters of the evil alignment to humans, under the current circumstances, the more dragons the better!
...
As dragons with wings were much faster than sea creatures that swam, in just the blink of an eye, several hundred giant dragons and countless wyverns had swept across the skies of Cocoloxi Island, rushing toward Hell Volcano in the distance.
As they flew past, the sea monsters that had previously landed on the island were all intimidated by the dragon's might. A large number of creatures were scared into trembling, and the lower-leveled beasts fainted or even died on the spot.
If not for the [Horn of Apocalypse from Galár] having the effect of boosting morale, most of the Titan sea beasts wouldn't even dare to surface under the dragon's might.
But in the blink of an eye, the first batch of giant dragons to reach Hell Volcano began to fiercely combat the Titan spirits.
The varying Dragon Breaths clashed with the high-level magic of the Titans, creating scenes reminiscent of massive nuclear explosions, with turmoil that seemed to split the earth.
"Boom," "Boom," "Boom..."
The sky above the volcano's crater seemed to have been shattered, with thunder and lightning and terrifying cracks in space flashing repeatedly.
Su Lun, sharing the vision of a black crow in the sky, witnessed the visible shockwaves coming his way.
The islands near Hell Volcano turned into dust; in the blink of an eye, they were completely wiped off the map?
Su Lun was left staring, dumbstruck.
In the Eye of Omniscience, chaotic fluctuations of Laws filled the world.
At the heart of this battlefield, it was a true meat grinder. Only the dragon kin with their naturally full defenses against physical and magical attacks could withstand it; any other high-order magical beast would probably be annihilated.
Without waiting long, an unprecedentedly fierce shockwave swept over Cocolossi Island.
This island was still quite far from the core of the battlefield, but even so, the shockwave was powerful enough to uproot nearly all the trees and send them hurtling into the sky.
Fortunately, the temple of Golgoth was robust enough. The shockwave only scraped away the broken walls on the outskirts, while the main hall continued to stand tall.
Su Lun quickly used his eight-armed spider spear and threads to secure himself onto the main body of the palace. Shrouded in his imposing aura, he managed to hold out against the shockwave.
However, after the first wave of impact, a monstrous tsunami followed closely behind.
Everywhere, the scenes were akin to the end of the world.
Seeing this, Su Lun actually felt a huge sense of relief in his heart.
The titan monsters were preoccupied with the dragons and, thankfully, did not continue to besiege the temple of Golgoth.
Especially those colossal deep-sea leviathans, who were now the primary targets of the dragons.
Without the threat of these overpowering foes, the other monsters seemed far less of a problem for Su Lun.
It was also Su Lun's first time witnessing such an exaggerated battle with his own eyes.
He couldn't help but marvel at how the ancient war had once shattered the very plane of existence; even now, when the highest among the dragon legions were only ninth-order, they were terrifying. One could only imagine the apocalyptic scenes of that plane-shattering war where the Dragon God had participated.
The sudden participation of the dragon kin dramatically reversed the situation.
Su Lun, once a primary participant, now seemed like a mere spectator in this affair.
It was like returning to the battle within the curse space at the Atlantis Ruins when all they needed to do was watch from the sidelines.
The battle between the dragon kin and the titans seemed to be a destined conflict inherited from ancient times.
Even the Evernight received news; the monsters that appeared were being directed by the horns to the central battlefield, showing little interest in the humans and posing no apparent danger.
All of a sudden, the crises seemed to subside.
Su Lun was in no rush to leave anymore.
Looking around, the temple of Golgoth still stood firm, and the soul fluctuations of Queen Medusa within grew stronger, seemingly progressing smoothly.
Turning to look elsewhere, he unexpectedly found that the violent shockwaves that had swept across the island had wiped clean the deadly black water pond that had accumulated for years in front of the temple.
"Huh..."
Su Lun looked over and found that where the toxic pond was, there appeared to be an altar-like structure.
Mr. Hei had mentioned before that this pond was situated above the central axis of the palace, and the structure beneath it might serve some special purpose.
Su Lun, looking at the ancient text on the carvings, had a hunch that it might be hiding some secret.
Besides, for the engravings to survive uncorroded for fifty years amidst such corrosive poison was truly astounding.
But there wasn't time to study this now, as the crisis was not yet entirely over.
...
"Those guys from the divine plane probably didn't expect to create such a huge mess..." Su Lun mused.
He hadn't forgotten that those from the divine plane were the cause behind initiating this great war.
Clearly, the dragons had emerged en masse, likely in response to the sound of the "Gjallarhorn's Day of Judgment."
Or perhaps the dragon kin had always been tasked with guarding Hell Volcano?
Regardless, this turn of events was certainly not something those from the divine plane wanted to see or had anticipated.
Thoughts swirling in his head, Su Lun speculated, "Given the current circumstances, if those guys have any tricks left, they should be going all-in now..."
He looked at the current state of the battle; the dragon kin seemed to be gaining the upper hand due to their home-field advantage.
If the battle were to continue this way, the plans of those divine plane fellows would probably fall through.
Su Lun was well aware that the most important reason for those from the divine plane to come to these waters was not to surround and kill any Dawn Group or to trouble Queen Medusa, but rather they were aimed at the "Mimir's Spring."
So everything they were doing was for the sake of that divine spring.
At that thought, a flicker of insight crossed Su Lun's mind: "Hey... could the reason for the war that erupted here initially have been because of 'Mimir's Spring'?"
Now, considering that the titan spirits in Hell Volcano were certainly connected directly to the divine plane and the deities there were so invested in "Mimir's Spring," it was indeed possible that the battle took place in the Ancient Dragon Country for that very reason.
Now that he knew the enemy's objective, Su Lun pondered, "If I were those guys, I'd definitely head to Giant Island at all costs and secure the spring water before anything else."
This epic battle seemed unlikely to end any time soon.
And the current forces left on the Titan realm had no assurance they could eliminate the Dawn group.
Delay would only lead to unexpected changes.
Once Queen Medusa completed the inheritance, those from the Titan realm would stand no chance.
The best option was a desperate gamble to obtain the spring water on Giant Island.
With that, all previous losses would be worth it.
Otherwise, they would face utter defeat.
Of course, the premise was that they still had the ability to retrieve the spring water from Giant Island.
After all, Su Lun remembered something Queen Medusa had once said, "No one can forcefully take the spring water under the watchful eyes of the Cyclops race."
...
As more dragons and Titan spirits joined the battlefield, the area of conflict centered around Hell Volcano grew increasingly vast.
In the short term, there were no signs of it coming to an end.
If Su Lun could discern this chaos, then naturally those from the Titan realm could as well.
It was at the moment when the battle was at a standstill that the "Wuu... Wuu..." sound of the magical projection "Gjallarhorn of Doom" once again heralded the charge.
A mysterious force drove the Titan spirits and bloodline monsters to act in unison, causing a shift in localized battlefronts.
But this time, those monsters did not head toward Coquelicot Island but collectively moved in the direction of Giant Island.
"They're really going all in," he mused.
Su Lun had anticipated this, but his heart bore no trace of relief, instead his worry intensified.
He saw through the Dawn group's previously placed observation crystals that monsters began to frequently appear near Giant Island.
It was hard to imagine what force could stop so many top-tier monsters converging at once.
As formidable as the Cyclopes were, they might not be able to hold them off.
It seemed that the people from the Titan realm might indeed be able to seize the spring water.
Su Lun did want to observe the situation, but evidently, now was not the right time to do so.
That kind of battlefield was not just muddy waters to fish in, but a meat grinder.
Unable to leave Golgotha Temple for the time being and considering Giant Island too dangerous, Su Lun found himself in a dilemma.
"This spring water is so crucial. I fear it won't just be monsters; gods from the Titan realm will definitely intervene. At that time, those Cyclopes and dragons may not be able to stand against them..."
He closely monitored the distant battle, resolved to make a trip there at the first sign of any person from the Titan realm appearing.
Within his capability, he absolutely could not allow the enemy to successfully take Mimir's Spring.
...
Having amassed so much intelligence, Su Lun's predictions were almost unerringly accurate.
The very scene he least wanted to see still unfolded.
After dozens of monsters stormed Giant Island...
Suddenly, an extraordinary event took place!
Dark clouds churned above Giant Island, slowly taking shape as an indescribable will made its descent.
The clouds in the sky swiftly coalesced into a massive, blurred face.
Although its features were indistinct, the vertical pupil anomaly in its forehead was unmistakably visible.
And beneath this face, a golden-haired youth radiating divine light stood suspended in the air.
"So Frank hasn't perished after all..."
Closing his right eye, Su Lun murmured to himself as he watched the floating Frank in the sky with his left eye.
At this moment, the Saint Heir of the Titan race bore an entirely different demeanor from before, with Divine Power surging like tides, majestic and unapproachable.
This was definitely not Frank's own strength; it was more likely that the will of a god had descended upon his body.
"This is bad," Su Lun sighed softly in his heart.
It wasn't his first encounter with the descent of a god's will, but it was the first time he felt such an overwhelming divine pressure.
Saint Frank, due to his bloodline, could bear an overwhelmingly exaggerated amount of divine power, especially that of the three-eyed deity clan.
At this moment, the colossal face in the sky clearly belonged to a deity of the three-eyed clan.
This also granted him a terrifying force far beyond the ninth tier.
This oppressive force swept across the entire sea area, causing even those eighth and ninth tier dragons to simultaneously let out dragon roars, resisting this indescribable pressure.
And in the instant that this will arrived, a blue light shone from the vertical pupil on "Frank's" forehead, while the same vertical pupil on the colossal face in the sky emitted a beam of light a million times stronger, shooting directly towards Giant Island.
This beam of light seemed to be shining from another plane, penetrating the endless void of planes with an invincible force that diminish dimensional attacks on this lower plane.
Seeing this, Su Lun's heart did not entertain the slightest thought of causing trouble, "This is bad..."
This power of the deities was certainly not something mere mortals could withstand.
Just as the vertical pupil opened for an instant, a Cyclops wielding a Wolf Fang Club and charging towards "Frank" was suddenly pierced by the blue pillar of light.
In a flash, the hundred-meter-tall Cyclops was enveloped in blue light, and his body began to disintegrate into pieces.
But in the blink of an eye, the towering figure of the giant had completely vanished within the column of light.
Seeing this, the corner of Su Lun's eye twitched violently: "..."
A Cyclops of ninth-tier combat power was annihilated in one strike, and in this plane, he felt that even with Pandora's protection, the outcome would be annihilation if hit by such a force.
....
"Frank," descending like a deity, annihilated a Cyclops and then pushed forward relentlessly, flying towards the center of Giant Island.
Behind him, a horde of Titan creatures followed in his wake.
Seeing this, Su Lun felt that no one in this plane could stop this individual any longer.
However, an incredibly sudden change occurred!
Just when Su Lun thought the situation was settled, he felt a violent trembling on the island.
"An earthquake?"
He could distinctly feel that the source of the tremor was not the distant battle, but from deep beneath the sea.
However, while Su Lun was still pondering, suddenly a columnar behemoth surged out of the distant sea with a "splash."
As the giant emerged from the water, Su Lun looked carefully and realized it was an arm!
Visibly, it was an arm nearly five hundred meters long!
Seeing this, Su Lun couldn't help exclaiming in surprise, "What kind of entity is this, with such a long arm?"
A flash of insight crossed his mind, and he immediately realized this might be the forbidden entity Queen Medusa had mentioned!
Yet, what was even more bizarre was what followed.
As that hand reached out from the sea surface, it was as if an ancient aura awoke, and a majestic will as grand as the earth itself swept across the field in an instant, dispersing the oppressive force of the deity's arrival.
This colossal arm clenched into a fist and charged straight towards the three-eyed colossal face formed by the dark clouds.
This punch, while seemingly slow, was inescapable.
Su Lun could see that space itself was locked by a high-tier power of the laws!
On the fist, numerous black and purple space fissures sparkled with a "clang."
Just raising a hand caused the plane to fracture?
How powerful was this punch?
Even Su Lun, who had seen the pinnacle of alchemy, was stunned by this punch.
Mr. Jing had once said that the most powerful being the broken alchemic plane could bear was a "demi-god," capable of bursting out spatial fissures with merely the power of laws in one punch, which undoubtedly confirmed it was a demi-god.
This... There's a demi-god-level Cyclops slumbering beneath Giant Island?
A Cyclops demi-god of mythic bloodline, He truly has the might of a lesser deity!
"No wonder Medusa said such things! A lesser deity's arrival would be futile!"
Seeing this, Su Lun felt an inexplicable surge of excitement in his heart.
It turned out there was still such an existence alive in the alchemic plane.
Without time for further thought, as the punch was thrown, it landed solidly on the colossal face in the sky.
The dark cloud face first distorted and then burst open with a resounding crash.
The previously condescending divine will also vanished in the blink of an eye.
Seeing this, Su Lun's eyes immediately brightened: "A major turnaround..."

chapters.title: Chapter 583 - 582: Attack of the Dragon
chapters.content:
Su Lun looked at the divine will descending from the sky being crushed, his heart overwhelmed with joy.
He had never imagined that such a terrifying Cyclops still existed in the broken Alchemy plane.
The Three-eyed Deity of the divine plane had also not expected it, which is why it had taken such a beating.
Even for a deity, descending from a higher plane was not without cost; this time, the crushed descending will must also have been severely damaged.
According to Su Lun's knowledge, in the divine plane, the followers correspond only to one deity. Thus, even if that Saint "Frank" was not dead, it was highly likely that it would be a long time before he could summon the divine will again.
This was good news for the Dawn Group and even for the entire Alchemy plane.
...
In the instant that Su Lun's thoughts were rapidly turning, that giant hand stretching from the sea had already retracted.
Beyond the turbulent waters, no trace could be seen anymore.
The force of Power of Laws that had been devastating also disappeared without a trace, making it unfathomable that such a mighty presence was hidden beneath the sea.
It was then that Su Lun finally snapped out of his slightly intimidated state.
Having witnessed a battle above the ninth order, Su Lun was also deeply moved: "How powerful... Is this the power that rivals that of a deity."
This must certainly be the pinnacle of combat power on the Alchemy plane now.
He had once heard Mr. Jing describe it; Sir Isaac had such terrifying combat power back in the day.
But no matter how many times he heard it, it was nowhere near as profound as seeing it with his own eyes.
Especially the fluctuations of higher-order laws, even if he only understood some superficial appearances, allowed Su Lun to grasp some precious insights.
In a sense, this was an opportunity not to be missed. Because elsewhere, it would be impossible to witness such a battle again.
Su Lun also guessed why the Cyclops was sleeping at the bottom of the sea.
Because it was simply too strong.
Raising its hand, it easily blasted a rift in the plane; one could imagine if it moved normally, this plane might not be able to withstand its presence.
Even just now, that being had only lifted an arm, not its entire body from the sea.
Su Lun watched this and couldn't help but feel moved.
First, it was the dragons pouring out from all over, and now a sleeping demigod Cyclops King was awoken; truly, he had seen more in one day than many might in countless years.
The folks of the divine plane were rather unlucky.
Whether it was the 100% magic resistant "Shield of Innocence" or the "Horn of Doom of Jalar" that could summon Titan progeny, possessing these two Artifact Projections, they could almost walk sideways in any part of the Alchemy plane today.
If it wasn't for the Dawn Group forcing their hand, they would likely have chosen a more cautious approach, slowly exploring and treasure hunting. They wouldn't summon any Titan spirits or any divine will and had a very high chance of successfully acquiring the "Mimir's Well."
Unfortunately... their luck was not very good.
From setting sail until now, they had been consecutively heavily injured by Dawn's people, not only were several ten-thousand-member Mage groups completely destroyed, but several eighth-order great Mages had also died or were crippled.
Just now, they were driven to desperation, so they had to resort to force.
They didn't expect that, upon using force, they would meet such a tough nut to crack.
However, Su Lun found the current situation quite to his liking.
After that giant hand crushed the divine will in the sky, its residual power lingered, and those Titan creatures also did not dare approach Giant Island again.
On the other hand, although the battle near Hell Volcano was still fierce, the balance of the war had clearly shifted.
With the deities crushed, the morale of those folks from the divine plane naturally plummeted.
Su Lun was guarding the entrance of the Temple of Gorr, and suddenly felt a great reduction in pressure.
At that moment, good news arrived again.
By his side, a somewhat bored Pestoya suddenly spoke up, "I think I've found where those guys who summon deities from the divine plane are hiding."
Su Lun listened, looking at the Ghost lady beside him, "Where?"
Pestoya pointed to the northwest, saying, "Over there, quite far, about... well, very far anyway."
She tried her best to describe the distance, but still couldn't pinpoint it accurately, then added, "When that divine will descended just now, I distinctly felt a wave of divine power from that direction."
Su Lun looked at her little face frowning, knowing that this Ghost lady wasn't very good with distances, and couldn't help but laugh and cry.
However, since she had sensed the enemy's location, that indeed solved a big problem.
As long as those people from the divine plane were dealt with, the problems here might be completely resolved.
However, Su Lun glanced again inside the temple where Queen Medusa's soul fluctuations were still not very stable and seemed to need more time.
Although the Titan monsters had become disorderly and were not specifically encircling Kokolossi Island, without anyone here to guard it, a slip-up could waste all previous efforts.
Just as he was hesitating, a telepathic message suddenly came from his mind: "The temple no longer needs guarding. The wizard from the celestial plane and Astrelide that you killed were my greatest threats."
The tone was very calm, but the ability to speak distractedly was clearly a sign of stability.
Su Lun also felt relieved upon hearing this.
The greatest threat to Medusa was the wizard who possessed the "Mirror of Filth" and her sister, the renegade eighth-level Gorgon.
Now that both were dead, indeed the greatest threat no longer existed.
As for the rest, Queen Medusa herself was not one to be trifled with, even though she was still undergoing some sort of legacy consciousness.
Her implication was naturally that there was no need for him to guard the temple anymore.
Su Lun then confirmed once more, "Then I will leave first to deal with those wizards. If there is a problem, Your Highness can telepathically communicate with me, and I can come back immediately."
"Mhm."
A swift reply came from Queen Medusa.
Although the tone was a bit harsh, Su Lun did not mind as after all, it was an alliance, and it was sufficient that both parties adhere to the oath of the alliance.
Just as Su Lun was about to leave, another message came: "Thank you."
Su Lun's eyes flickered with surprise; he hadn't expected the demigod Queen Medusa to express gratitude.
In terms of strength and the level of life, she had sufficient pride.
This was indeed a friendly gesture as an ally, so he responded politely, "Your Highness is too kind."
As he spoke, there was a flicker of spatial shaking, and Su Lun had already disappeared from the spot.
Upon closer observation, from the dim and lightless temple, it seemed as though a chilling gaze had looked out.
Although Queen Medusa was temporarily unable to leave the temple due to her inheritance, she had sensed everything, even at the most critical moments when Su Lun had still guarded outside the temple.
The courage, insight, and strength of a "Legendary Hero" indeed weren't ordinary.
As allies, this human, Su Lun, had made a good impression on her.
...
Su Lun had teleported in an instant, and the scenery changed; he was already appearing above the sea.
The turbulent waves caused by the great battle were still raging,
Su Lun led Pestroya all the way, teleporting over the sea, entirely depending on the not-so-good sense of direction of the ghostly lady.
"A bit more to that side..."
"Right. I feel we are very close now. It's that deserted island..."
"..."
Fortunately, after a few teleports, the two finally landed on a deserted island a few dozen nautical miles northwest of Kokolossi Island.
If it weren't for Pestroya confirming that the divine power fluctuations were emanating from here, Su Lun wouldn't have been able to detect any problems.
After arriving on the island, he carefully searched and discovered a barely perceptible spatial node.
It was just like in the Atlantis Temple, where Mr. Hei discovered a space with the Philosopher's Stone, concealed by a very ingenious spatial seal.
If it wasn't for Pestroya insisting it was here, even Su Lun himself would have missed it, having been here already.
"Hidden inside a spatial node..."
Su Lun looked on and sneered inwardly, no wonder they hadn't been found.
Those guys probably thought they were undiscovered, still hidden inside. Su Lun did not hesitate, he pinched a sorcerer's seal with his hand and directly destroyed the spatial node.
With a loud "bang," suddenly, five hundred individuals dressed in white robes resembling priest robes appeared on this barren island.
As Su Lun had expected, this was the group of ascetic monks that had disappeared.
Having previously killed a group of ascetic monks outside Eklundhsa, the capital of the Silver Dragon Kingdom, he was well aware of their tricks. He would not give these individuals a chance to activate their "Passive Suffering Fury."
The moment these people appeared, thousands of gargoyle figures floating in the sky immediately launched their punches.
This group of five hundred was originally quite powerful, possibly comparable to half of a ten thousand mage group, but now Su Lun gave them no opportunity to retaliate. With overpowering force, the gargoyles overwhelmed them in numbers, wiping out the entire group in a single encounter.
As these ascetic monks died, the "Horn of Apocalypse" Artifact Projection in the sky also instantly disappeared.
"Heh... It was indeed these guys manipulating it."
When Su Lun saw this, the last bit of worry in his heart also dissipated.
This time, the problem was completely resolved.
Once the sound of the horn that could drive the titan spirits and blood descendant monsters ceased, the monsters that had been fighting the dragon legion also immediately calmed down.
At that moment, they seemed to have regained their senses as one by one, they withdrew from the battlefield, no longer marching to their deaths. The titan monsters that had previously come from further away to assist also submerged into the sea and disappeared.
The noise of the battle instantly diminished, except near Hell Volcano, where the dragons were still fiercely fighting those titan spirits.
However, it looked like the overall situation was decided, with the dragons clearly having a greater chance of victory.
Su Lun wandered around the deserted island, collecting the spoils of war into his miniature void world.
He checked with the Eternal Night crew, and the situation had also instantly improved. With no monster threats, they seemed to be in no danger and could even salvage some of the carcasses of the giant beasts that had died in battle.
The combatants just now included draconic and titanic beings, providing materials that couldn't be found elsewhere.
Su Lun saw that there seemed to be no danger and didn't rush back to the ship but teleported back to Cocolossi Island once again.
At this moment, the monsters that had landed on the island had retreated, and Su Lun hadn't forgotten about the last two mage legions of ten thousand that had landed here.
Now with the legion commander Augustus dead and the Saint Frank's divine descent severely damaged and missing, these guys without leaders also fought each for themselves.
When Su Lun arrived, it was probably because Queen Medusa had already completely gained control over the power of her own Gorugen Tribe, those myriad colorful Poison Snakes obeyed her command and had already spread across the island to surround and kill the Celestial Plane's people.
But those mages, for Su Lun, were also destined to be completely eradicated.
Letting the snakes kill them would just be a waste.
He located the position of the magic fluctuations, teleported several times, and almost effortlessly harvested these mages whose morale had already collapsed.
The ships that these guys had used to land were already completely destroyed, and even if some had survived, it would be impossible for them to leave the island alive.
By the time Su Lun had done all this, half a day had already passed.
He then returned to the entrance of the Gorugen Temple.
At this moment, Queen Medusa hadn't come out yet, but her soul's fluctuations had already become much stronger and stabilized.
Su Lun did not disturb her.
He let Thousand Miles out as well, and both of them, with great interest, observed the high-ranking pureblood dragons still battling the titan spirits at Hell Volcano from afar.
Two six-rank giant dragons leading a group of five-rank and six-rank pureblood dragons in various frenzied attacks, made for a fascinating spectacle.
For Su Lun and Thousand Miles, who were currently at a high realm, watching such peak planar battles greatly benefited their understanding of the Power of Laws.
However, without the sound of the horn calling them, the number of titan spirits dwindled, and eventually, the dragons emerged victorious.
...
When the battle started, it was bright and sunny, and by the time it ended, the dawning sun had already lit up the sea.
Two figures sat on top of a colossal broken pillar of the temple, watching the sunrise behind the towering Hell Volcano and the spectacular scene of the dragons returning to their nests.
Thousand Miles muttered with great vigor, "Ah... so many pureblood dragons."
Su Lun, knowing what she was thinking, also said, "Once these dragon clans have returned to their nests, we can linger around Hell Volcano a bit, and perhaps we can scavenge some carcasses."
From that great battle, they had seen at least dozens of pureblood dragons and countless flying dragons plunge into the sea.
In the eyes of the beasts, these were just food.
But through the eyes of the alchemists, it was as if mountains of gold had fallen into the water.
Waiting for the aftermath of the battle to subside, they planned to go and salvage a bit, which shouldn't be a problem.
Things seemed to suddenly all be developing for the better.
"Whoosh," "Whoosh," "Whoosh"...
Above their heads, several giant dragons swiftly swept past, flying back to their nests.
However, before long, an unexpected situation occurred.
Suddenly urgent news came from the Eternal Night, "Mr. Su Lun, it's bad! We have been attacked by giants dragons!"
The moment he heard this, Su Lun's face drastically changed, knowing there was a serious problem!
If encountering dragons elsewhere, as long as they weren't rank six, they wouldn't pose much threat to the Dawn Brigade.
But right now, it wasn't just one or two but hundreds of pureblood giants dragons, along with countless draconic beings.
If they really provoked them, not even a hundred Dawn Brigades could escape alive from this sea area.
He didn't dare to delay in the slightest, notified the temple using spiritual communication, and took Thousand Miles with him in a long-range teleport, appearing on the deck of the Eternal Night dozens of leagues away.
When he arrived, he saw the deck in the midst of a fierce battle.
Looking closely, three vicious dragons were furiously attacking the Eternal Night.
One eighth-tier white dragon was spouting dragon breath, freezing the ship on the sea surface, while the other two, a seventh-tier red dragon and a sixth-tier small green dragon, were spewing fire and various poisons, respectively.
Normally, these three giant dragons would not have been invincible to the Dawn Group, but it was clear to everyone that at this critical moment, they definitely could not go all out.
Otherwise, if hatred escalated, the consequences would be uncontrollable.
Thus, no. 19 and Old Sword God Bartolo were dragging the white dragon away in the distant sky, deliberately avoiding the Eternal Night.
Su Lun could see that both were holding back in their moves, not using "Dragon Slayer Potion" and hardly dealt fatal blows.
Otherwise, the sixth-tier green dragon would have been slain on the spot.
As soon as Su Lun returned, he saw flames burning everywhere on the deck of the Eternal Night, and the hull was more or less damaged.
The arrogant seventh-tier red dragon was dive-bombing at low altitude, flying while spewing flames, aiming to destroy the ship's mast.
The dragons naturally possessed command no less than humans, they knew that to kill these humans, they had to destroy the ship first.
Just as Su Lun landed, he saw the seventh-tier red dragon muster its strength to break through the encirclement of Barrett and the mechanical warrior legion, heading straight for the mast.
He dared not delay for a moment; with a teleport, he appeared in front of the mast, raised his hand, and summoned dozens of the strongest gargoyles around him, all punching towards the front.
Rings of spatial ripples surged above their fists, with a "thud," the red dragon slammed into an invisible wall, making the nearby space tremble.
This commotion was not small and caught the attention of everyone on the Eternal Night.
Seeing it was Su Lun, everyone seemed to relax simultaneously, excitedly saying, "Mr. Su Lun is back!"
The members of the Dawn Group now had a mysterious firm belief, as if everything would be resolved once Su Lun returned.
Su Lun had no time to greet everyone; his gaze sharpened, and he quickly summoned hundreds more gargoyles.
The move just now was "Spatial Shaking," aiming to stop the red dragon without inflicting severe harm.
But the red dragon clearly didn't appreciate it, being staggered by the impact, soon retaliating with a ferocious dragon roar and spewing flames.
Su Lun raised his hand, and again hundreds of gargoyles simultaneously raised their palms forward, creating black hole vortices that swallowed up the fiery dragon breath.
The sly look in the red dragon's eyes also revealed some confusion as to why this seemingly weak human could withstand it.
And having been thwarted twice consecutively, the great dragon's pride was challenged.
The red dragon, unable to suppress its fury, spread its wings and dived again.
While defending, Su Lun also used his spiritual power to transmit, "Honorable Dragon, we mean no harm to you and do not intend to offend..."
He had been polite enough, but how could dragonkind possibly communicate with mere lowly humans?
The red dragon clearly understood, its wise amber eyes reflecting a mocking emotion.
It had no intention of ceasing hostilities, charging at Su Lun and spouting a breath of dragon fire again.
Su Lun, already familiar with the arrogance of dragonkind, knew well that these negotiations would lead nowhere.
Seeing the red dragon spewing dragon breath again, Su Lun once more released thousands of gargoyles, this time almost completely covering the ship with the gargoyle legion.
The fiery breath from the red dragon proved ineffective, being absorbed as soon as it was spewed.
This further enraged the red dragon, which let out a furious dragon cry. Suddenly, the eighth-tier white dragon broke free from the engagement with no. 19 and Bartolo and rushed towards the ship.
An eighth-tier giant dragon's strength was nearly that of a ninth-tier alchemist. How fast was this white dragon?
Before the Dawn Group members could react, they only saw a flash of white light, and with a "thud," the white dragon slammed into the deck.
The dragon's aura, mixed with unabashed killing intent, intimidated the lower-ranking members on the deck instantly.
Su Lun's gargoyle defensive line was also instantly broken through, and several sailors were frozen by the dragon breath on the spot.
At that moment, any positive feelings he previously had for the dragonkind defending against Titans' spirits vanished.
In this world, only strength spoke.
These arrogant dragons truly held no regard for humans.
Previously, as there were no casualties, a discussion was feasible. Now that there were casualties, these malicious dragons, even if they wanted to leave, could not!
"Kill!"
Su Lun's eyes burst out with killing intent as he decisively ordered, "Activate the spatial alchemy array, prepare to evacuate!"
The Dawn Group was never powerless to fight, they just didn't want to incite trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 584 - 583: The King's Gaze
chapters.content:
"Attack!"
It was Su Lun's command that spurred the members of the Dawn Group into simultaneous action.
Having been previously suppressed by these three malevolent dragons, they had long been simmering with rage; now given the chance to retaliate, they were merciless in their strikes.
The fastest to react were naturally the high-level warriors. Suddenly, there was a "snap" sound of air being trod upon, and swords flashed out like a thousand bolts of lightning.
Looking again, one could see that she was already charging towards the six-tiered evil dragon that was furiously spewing green poisonous Dragon Breath at the stern of the ship.
A slash of purple Thunderous Sword Qi came down without impediment, decapitating a massive dragon head, causing blood to surge forth.
The head of the green dragon was flung into the sky, and in its last moments of death, its vertical pupils were filled with disbelief, as if to say, "How dare these humans?".
These three evil dragons had dared to hunt the Dawn Group, not only because they felt their strength was more than enough to crush these feeble humans but also because there were many of their own kind nearby.
No living being dared defy the dignity of the Dragon Clan.
In the eyes of the Dragon Clan, all inferior creatures were food.
Since they were food, they should simply accept their fate as food and willingly succumb to death.
However, what they hadn't anticipated was that these ant-like humans would really dare to lift a hand against the noble Dragon Clan.
And with that single strike, the green dragon was slain, leaving the other two colossal dragons equally shocked.
However, the same fate awaited them.
At the same moment of the fatal stroke, Old Sword God Bartolo also performed the Imperial Air Walk, moving swiftly towards the seven-tiered flame red dragon. His famed sword, "Frost Flower's Light Whisper," revealed its plain frost patterns, and a flurry of Sword Qi, like falling snowflakes, headed for the red dragon.
"Clang," "Clang," "Clang"...
Each snowflake struck the dragon's scales, emitting a sharp sound like that of metal cutting.
The seven-tiered red dragon instantly felt a wave of death approaching.
It flapped its wings forcefully, attempting to ascend instinctively and flee the vicinity of the ship.
Fear was unmistakable in its amber vertical pupils, and the arrogance it had earlier was nowhere to be found.
But by now it was too late, as the silhouette of Bartolo's sword closely followed.
A stream of flame in the form of Dragon Breath erupted, repelling the chill of the Frost Flower, but in that moment of looking back, a five- or six-meter-long gash opened up in the dragon's belly scales with a "slit" sound.
The famed sword, coated with dragon-slaying Potion, easily pierced through the scales of the red dragon.
Fear and disbelief filled the dying dragon's eyes: This human wasn't so strong just a moment ago!
Normally, a seven-tiered pure-blooded giant dragon's combat power would not be inferior to that of an eight-tiered Magician.
So even though it knew that this old swordsman was the strongest among the humans, the red dragon hadn't the slightest fear, having already sized him up earlier; the fights were just that.
However, unexpectedly, this strike burst forth with sudden intensity, severely wounding it.
And after that strike, another even more lethal Sword Qi came at it.
...
Everyone was well aware that once they started, they had to kill quickly.
Watching Qian Tiao and Old Sword God Bartolo take the lead, the rest of the group also made their moves in unison, unleashing various techniques upon the severely wounded seventh-rank red dragon.
Su Lun, however, did not watch the battle unfold; he changed into his [Dragon Slayer Warrior's Dragon Scale Armor] and, with a flash of spatial teleportation, had already appeared on the back of the eighth-rank frost white dragon that Number 19 was dragging.
The top-tier professionals' ability to assess the battlefield permitted them to know, even without any discussion, that they should eliminate the weaker red and green dragons first and then concentrate their forces on the eighth-rank white dragon.
Besides, the members of the Dawn Group had cooperated in hunting several dragons before and had already developed an understanding of each other's tactics.
Earlier, Number 19 and Old Sword God Bartolo had not been idling; they had already left a spatial marker on the eighth-rank white dragon.
Su Lun teleported directly onto the dragon's back and pulled out his dragon-slaying dagger to stab into the scales.
The white dragon, sensing the lethal threat, flapped its wings to create distance while its dragon might trembled, releasing an icy chill that seemed to freeze thoughts and instantly covered the scales.
As soon as Su Lun's dagger pierced the scales, his body became stiff, and he, the magician, felt a chill; all of a sudden, a faint green flame appeared on his body.
Death God's Fire, following the dagger's path, poured into the dragon's body, causing the white dragon's expression to instantly turn to one of terror, unmistakably feeling the soul-searing pain.
A white dragon of ice, feeling a cold dread to the utmost degree?
The white dragon's neck bulged as it let out a soaring dragon's roar that echoed across the sky.
Su Lun was well aware that it was calling for help, but he was also greatly surprised, "Eh...the dragon soul isn't burning and spreading?"
It was not easy to kill an eighth-rank dragon; even the Dawn Group had previously exhausted all their strength and spent a great deal of time to slay an eighth-rank silver dragon.
Right now, there was not so much time to slowly whittle away its health.
Su Lun had wanted to test if the soul fire would be highly effective, yet the soul fire, able to instantly kill an eighth-rank grand magician, seemingly did not work well against dragon souls.
Although the Death God's Fire was fatal to the dragon, it did not spread after ignition.
That one strike just now had burned off about 3% of the white dragon's soul power fluctuations, then it extinguished.
That meant Su Lun would have to continuously burn with soul fire; otherwise, it would not be as easy as killing other creatures' souls.
"It seems that the soul level of higher beings is, indeed, higher, and the quality of their soul fire is greater as well..."
Su Lun figured out the principle behind this.
But he achieved his goal all the same; that strike forced the white dragon to leave the Evernight.
The dragon charged forward and Su Lun was thrown off.
Glancing back, he saw dozens of pureblood giants already speeding towards this direction, and even further away countless winged dragon beasts were also menacingly closing in.
The dragon's roar carried for dozens of miles—should the battle become overwhelming, there would be an endless stream of giants flying in.
Su Lun narrowed his eyes at the approaching dragon army, his face showing gravity.
They had been reluctant to act before precisely out of fear of this scenario.
The three closest giants were already flying in rapidly, and even Su Lun felt his breathing nearly stop under the pressure of the mixed dragon might.
The white dragon, with the support of its companions, suddenly found its courage and turned to charge at Su Lun once again, its nostrils flaring so wide that it was clear how furious it was at that moment.
Su Lun did not dare to attempt killing the white dragon any longer. No matter how sharp his methods were, facing several evil dragons did not bode well for him.
However, he never intended to face them head-on.
Glancing back at the Night Eternal ship, he saw that the seventh-tier red dragon had already been taken down by Old Sword God Bartolo and a group of elite warriors. Its body had already been collected.
And spatial runes were already lighting up on the ship's body.
Without further delay, Su Lun used Spatial Teleportation and appeared on the deck instantaneously.
The moment he landed, the magic was complete, and the spatial vortex in his palm grew larger and larger.
But in the blink of an eye, the spatial vortex and the ship's rune lights merged into one, and with a whoosh, they were collected into the Void realm.
In the midst of this, Su Lun still managed to glance back at the fiercely pursuing evil dragons.
With a ripple in space, his figure vanished on the spot.
Just moments after Su Lun disappeared, those evil dragons thudded onto the spot where the Night Eternal ship had just been, unable to find their target to attack.
The timing was almost exactly as he had estimated.
...
In fact, when Su Lun had first taken action, he had already accurately calculated the time and distance it would take for the nearby flying dragons to come to the aid of their brethren.
He had observed the entire battle between the Dragon and Titan clans, committing to memory all the various abilities demonstrated by the participating dragons.
Therefore, from the moment he began to engage, how much distance he needed to pull, how long it would take for the nearby dragons to come to aid, and finally, how long it would take to shake them off... all such data was calculated clearly.
Which is why he managed to collect the Night Eternal ship into the small Void realm without issue.
However, he did not feel that Dawn Group was safe yet.
Su Lun disappeared without a trace, reappearing tens of kilometers away.
For humans, once such a distance is opened up, it's almost impossible to be caught up to.
But for the Dragon clan, it was just a matter of flapping their wings a few times.
Especially those dragons adept at speed, they could arrive in an instant.
The news that Dawn Group had killed two giant dragons spread throughout the nearby waters with mournful dragon roars, and all dragons knew that some humans had killed their kin.
Gradually, what started as a few dragons chasing Su Lun turned into hundreds of giant dragons, with countless sub-dragons from land, sea, and air all in pursuit.
The spectacle was so magnificent that Su Lun felt he was probably the first human in countless years to be afforded such "attention".
After all, to survive such a chase from so many giant dragons, he could probably find no second person in the entire plane.
The feeling was as if he was running in front, with dozens of nuclear bombs chasing behind.
Once caught up to, a single blast of Dragon Breath could instantly burn him to ash.
But with the Space-Time Ring of Urobolos in his possession, Su Lun's Spatial Teleportation magic condensed with hardly any interval. Coupled with the "Philosopher's Stone" to elevate his magic and the "Heart of Isaac's Alchemy" providing endless energy, his current escape abilities were far beyond even that of eighth-tier giant dragons.
In the case of ordinary beasts, Su Lun could have shaken them off long ago.
But these were dragons.
These large reptiles had exceedingly high intelligence!
They not only tactically encircled him in battle but, seeing that Su Lun was using Spatial Ability, even thought of countermeasures to deal with it.
Just as Su Lun was using his spatial coordinates to make all sorts of evasive maneuvers.
At that moment, a dragon's roar came from the sky, and suddenly, a strange giant dragon exuding radiant purple light appeared on the horizon.
It was termed strange because, in Su Lun's vision, it was clearly very far away, yet in the blink of an eye, it had already appeared close by.
This was entirely different from the other giant dragons!
The purple dragon did not get there by flying with its wings, nor by teleportation.
Seeing this, Su Lun's eyes suddenly sharpened, "The power of Time Law!"
As identified by the All-knowing Eye, its name was— "Time Dragon Angolos".
If Su Lun himself didn't understand some aspects of Time Law, perhaps he wouldn't be able to see how the Time Dragon had approached.
But because he understood, he was even more astonished.
His own understanding of Time Law was approximately that of the seventh tier, and with the passive affinity provided by the Space-Time Ring of Urobolos, he was barely considered eighth-tier.
But watching that eighth-tier Time Dragon Angolos use its time-distortion Teleportation abilities, it was clear that it had a higher level understanding of the Laws than he did!
Dragons naturally carry high-level Law inheritances in their bloodlines, and for human practitioners, that would be considered as ninth-tier Time Law understanding.
"This is troublesome..."
Su Lun looked on with furrowed brows.
Just seeing that purple dragon for an instant, he knew he couldn't resolve the situation.
If it were just one, perhaps he could have tried, but here, getting entangled would not make it easy to break free.
No one understood the troubles of the power of time better than he did; abilities such as "Time Rewind" and "Time Distortion" were extremely tricky.
Moreover, time and space to some extent could be "equally exchanged," and this Time Dragon clearly countered all sorts of Teleportation.
The moment the thought crossed Su Lun's mind, the purple dragon's body suddenly twisted in space, and on the next look, it had already appeared right in front of him, spewing a mouthful of old Dragon Breath his way.
The image Su Lun left behind, along with the space nearby, shattered into countless small pieces like a mirror under the peculiar Dragon Breath.
Almost at the same instant, several kilometers away, a figure staggered out of a tear in space.
The surrounding sub-dragons also paused momentarily: how did this human appear in their midst?
As Su Lun deployed his Death Law, the seven or eight sub-dragons instantly lost their life force and plummeted.
But he felt no relief, instead casting a glance at the dissipating image of himself behind him, his heart skipping a beat, "That was close!"
The situation just now was extremely perilous, and it was only due to his noticing the signs of the Time Law being activated that he was able to teleport away in advance.
Otherwise, anyone unfamiliar with the power of time would likely have been killed without any awareness.
Even a top-tier fighter like the Old Sword God Bartolo would probably not last more than a few exchanges.
The power of time is just that tricky!
Moreover, this ability is the innate talent of that Time Giant Dragon, and it appears to use it without any cost.
In just a moment of engagement, Su Lun had already discerned something, and he solemnly said in his heart, "This Time-Affinity Dragon really knows how to use the Time Law to twist space..."
The place to which he had teleported was supposed to be much farther away, but it was because of the interference of time here that he appeared at this spot.
This directly proved that the purple dragon's mastery of the Time Law far surpassed Su Lun's!
Although he had the Space-Time Ring of Urobolos in his possession, Su Lun still managed to escape successfully, but just like the brief error just now, he almost crashed into the pile of dragons.
If there were a few more instances like that, it could very well become an irredeemable disaster.
...
Meanwhile, a puzzled look appeared in the eyes of that purple dragon.
Clearly, it was also surprised that a human could escape from the control of the power of time.
But without any pause, it spread its wings and flew, time was distorted once more, and the huge dragon body charged towards Su Lun again.
How could Su Lun dare to delay?
He used Spatial Teleportation even more cautiously than before, seeking to flee the pursuit.
But constantly teleporting throughout the Dragon Country Waters was an extremely dangerous thing to do.
Like that Cyclops King, who shattered a god's will with just one hand, possessed the fighting power of a true Demigod.
According to Queen Medusa, it's very likely that there's more than one such being in these waters.
Su Lun felt that if he were to move blindly, he would undoubtedly face certain death should he encounter one.
So even though he had been teleporting away, he dared not move erratically. The plan was to lead this group of flying dragons around in a few circles, and then find an opportunity to gather energy for another long-distance teleportation.
However, the situation got complicated.
This Time Dragon – Anglos – can use the Time Law to twist space and affect the precision of Spatial Displacement.
This made Su Lun even more wary of using long-distance teleportation recklessly.
"Shall I take a gamble?"
He made a split-second decision.
To drag it out further, once the purple dragon figures out his strength, the risk would increase.
However, just as he decided to risk a long-distance teleportation, suddenly a telepathic message came from his sea of consciousness, "Come to the temple, I can fend off those dragonkin for you."
Queen Medusa?
Has she completed her inheritance?
Upon hearing this, Su Lun's expression immediately brightened.
Since she had spoken, she must surely have been confident.
Su Lun didn't think twice and directly teleported towards the isle of Kokkalo.
Behind him, the Time Dragon and the several hundred dragons and lesser dragons naturally gave chase relentlessly.
As Su Lun looked back at the vast dragon legion, he suddenly felt a bit uneasy.
Could it be that Queen Medusa can't handle it?
After all, the collective fighting strength of the dragon legion, not to mention the ninth order, even a being beyond order would need to show some caution.
...
But before he could think further, Su Lun had already teleported to appear in front of the temple.
Just as he landed, a majestic aura suddenly leaked out of the temple.
"So strong..."
Su Lun's pupils slightly constricted as he immediately sensed that Queen Medusa's soul fluctuation was much stronger than before.
However, in the instant that the aura erupted, something marvelous happened.
The oncoming army of flying dragons in the sky suddenly changed color, and then they stopped in mid-air, not advancing any further.
Even the Time Dragon seemed to have found something, as its dragon face also obviously showed gravity.
It then let out a high-pitched dragon roar, seemingly dissatisfied with the being within the temple sheltering a human.
It looked like the two sides were negotiating something.
Seeing this, Su Lun finally heaved a sigh of relief.
He hadn't expected that Queen Medusa, by her sole imposing power, had actually stopped the dragon legion in their tracks?
The purple dragon let out several dragon roars, looking both furious and helpless.
It seemed the discussion was not going well.
Su Lun sensed that something was amiss and secretly readied the teleportation magic, thinking that if things went south, he would take Queen Medusa with him.
The Gorgon race and the Dragonkin were both mythic bloodlines and dominant creatures, so naturally, neither would easily submit to the other.
It was very likely that these dragons would not give Queen Medusa any respect.
A battle breaking out seemed highly probable.
As he had anticipated.
The talks fell through!
The purple dragon let out a roar and its fury immediately turned into tangible murderous intent, as dozens of lesser dragons obeyed the command and charged towards the temple.
Pressured by the overwhelming dragon might, Su Lun felt his scalp tingle, and his surface aura was as thin as ice, seemingly about to shatter at any moment.
However, it was at this moment that a shadow flashed into existence beside him.
Queen Medusa's golden snake hair viciously spread open towards the sky like a gaping maw, and in an instant, the entire world seemed to turn grey.
The reach of this petrification curse's grey light was tens of times larger than that of the eighth-tier Gorgon Su Lun had encountered before!
"This..."
The curse wasn't directed at him, but Su Lun felt a cold shiver run down his spine just by watching.
The release of this terrifying high-tier curse made him feel as though he was witnessing the moment that monstrous beast burst from the sea once again.
This was the Regal Gaze of a monarch!
Before he could further his amazement, the shining light had already enveloped the space above the temple, and the dozens of invading dragons were covered by the curse's light.
In that instant, Su Lun watched as the sixth, seventh, and eighth-tier flying dragons' eyes instantly lost their luster, their wing-flapping bodies turned rigid mid-air. Then their entire heads turned the color of grey-white limestone, which spread rapidly to their bodies, transforming them in the blink of an eye into stone statues!
Devoid of the power to stay aloft, these stone statues fell rapidly from the sky, then "crash bang" shattered into pieces on the ground.
With just one move, Queen Medusa had vanquished dozens of flying dragons.
Seeing this, Su Lun was deeply shocked, "So strong!"
In the sky, the pure-blooded dragons led by the Time Dragon, seeing the grey light approaching, violently retreated to avoid it.
Queen Medusa clearly didn't intend to annihilate them completely, the demonstration was more of a warning and deterrence, and the petrification light was withdrawn as quickly as it had appeared.
Looking up again.
The Time Purple Dragon and the several nearby eighth-tier dragons looked increasingly angered, the dragon roars were clearly filled with furious bellows.
It seemed that a new negotiation had begun.
But it seemed that the negotiations were still not going smoothly.
Su Lun watched from the sidelines, his eyelids twitching slightly, never before had he felt his situation so awkward.
However, Queen Medusa's aura didn't concede in the slightest, her demeanor showed she was ready to fight if necessary from beginning to end.
Finally.
Whatever the negotiation involved, it appeared that the group of dragons could do nothing against Medusa; they dared not launch another assault on the temple, instead turning away and flying off in a fury.
The negotiations ended in discord.
...
They're really leaving?
Watching the retreating dragon horde in his field of vision, Su Lun found it hard to believe.
Did Queen Medusa really manage to drive off that group of dragons all by herself?
So, she is truly a demigod now?
Su Lun's thoughts raced, but he also felt it was good news, and he politely said, "Thank you for your assistance, Your Majesty."
Queen Medusa didn't seem to care much, "It was merely a pact."
Listening, Su Lun didn't dwell on this topic, and after thinking it over, he asked, "May I presumptuously ask, what were those dragons saying just now?"
He was indeed very curious about the content of the negotiations.
Medusa replied, "They said that you carry the aura of dragons on your bodies and dragons wouldn't allow their kind to be used as materials by humans. They also said you have desecrated the Dragon God's bloodline… And just now, you killed some of their kin, so they insisted on killing you."
"..."
Only then did Su Lun understand why the Eternal Night was attacked before.
With many Dragon Blood warriors and draconic equipment in the Dawn Group, it was no wonder they attracted so much hatred.
But that hatred couldn't be resolved; what was done was done, and there was nothing more to ponder.
After a pause, Queen Medusa continued, "They also asked me if I would protect you at all costs, whether I wanted to incite a war between the Gorgon race and the dragons… I said yes."
Su Lun frowned slightly, "Ah...?"
A war between two high-ranking species was not a trivial matter.
He hadn't expected Medusa to go so far to protect the Dawn Group.
Yet Queen Medusa herself appeared completely calm, saying, "Rest assured, there's nothing we cannot fight. At my level, there's nothing in this plane to fear. Besides, if those old dragons truly understand my current status, a war is even less likely to break out."
Listening, Suri's eyes flickered, and her brow slightly relaxed.
Indeed, strength was the currency of negotiation.
If she said so, then it must be the case.
...
The gods of the Heavenly Plane had been slain, and the battle between the dragons and the Titans had ended, and with the protection of Queen Medusa, Su Lun was no longer in mortal danger.
Everything seemed to be falling into place.
