After absorbing the benefits brought by the "Mimir's Spring," Su Lun not only gained wisdom but also clearly found his thinking had suddenly become incredibly meticulous.
Some pieces of intelligence that previously required deep meditation and painstaking inference almost didn't need to be carefully combed through in his mind now, as if there were strings consciously threading them into a curtain of beads, deducing all kinds of reasonable outcomes.
Therefore, even if the cause-and-effect relationships were complex, as long as there were clues pointing in a direction, they had definitely been taken into account.
Take, for instance, the current ambush by Saint Frank.
Although the Dawn Group had thwarted the plans of those divine beings in recent days, the battles had exposed too many of their methods, and the enemy had surely gathered a lot of intelligence.
Not to mention, the enemy now definitely knew that Su Lun had a divine-grade spatial treasure at hand, that Dawn had a false god capable of stealing faith, and many incredibly threatening alchemy skills...
For those guys from the divine realm, all of these were very enticing.
If it were Su Lun himself as a deity from the divine realm, he would set everything else aside, for an opportunity like this was definitely not to be missed.
...
"This guy was seriously injured and probably hasn't recovered yet; he's likely to rely on external forces," Su Lun thought to himself upon hearing Mr. Hei's warning voice.
Now that he had a thorough understanding of the world, combined with the memories he had harvested before, he also had a clear concept of the higher planes such as the divine realm.
The coming of a god was not without cost, nor could it be done by any means necessary.
At least, the divine will that had descended was greatly restricted by the broken laws of the alchemy plane.
Last time "Frank" had summoned the will of a deity from the divine realm, but as soon as it arrived, it was severely wounded by a super-rank Cyclops. Even if it could still fight now, its strength was inevitably greatly diminished.
Last time it had super-rank strength, and now... it was hard to say whether its original form could exert ninth rank combat power.
Thus, to seek trouble with the Dawn Group, it could only rely on external forces.
Just as this thought came to Su Lun, a familiar horn sound suddenly rang out between heaven and earth again.
"Wuu... Wuu... Wuu..."
Hearing this soul-stirring horn sound, how could he not know that it was the "Artifact Projection of Gjallar's Horn"?
As soon as the horn sounded, an extraordinary phenomenon suddenly erupted on the sea surface.
The waters surged and slowly condensed into an increasingly tall giant humanoid monster.
The identifier displayed the name "Titan Sea Giant," a type of elemental being formed by a Titan Sprit's manipulation of water elements.
Su Lun looked at it with a slightly narrowed gaze, not at all surprised but rather breathing a sigh of relief, "Only one, eh..."
"Frank" had last time used the horn to summon a legion of Titan Spirits from Hell Volcano, seemingly ready to sweep the plane. The commotion was huge, but unexpectedly, it attracted the Dragon Race and was beaten back before it could wreak havoc.
Now the guy had learned his lesson and only summoned one.
Naturally, it was targeting the Dawn Group.
This nearly five hundred meters tall water elemental giant immediately caused towering waves upon its appearance. The overwhelming power of water elements controlled the waves, forming a giant vortex with a diameter of thousands of kilometers on the sea surface.
The powerful pull of the vortex caused the super battleship Evernight, caught in the maelstrom, to spin as if it were about to capsize at any moment, unable to escape.
Although the Dawn Group had Tanni and his mother, both capable of manipulating waves and storms, the rule control of the Sea Giant was clearly much more advanced.
The combined efforts of mother and son could not calm the waves.
Like an untamed wild horse, the Evernight galloped uncontrollably across the sea.
Through the communicator, Tanni roared hoarsely, "Helmsmen, control the sails well, we ride the waves."
Only his superb sailing skills allowed him to steer the ship, keeping it from being swallowed by the sea.
It wasn't just the waves; the Sea Giant's every move also unleashed high-level elemental spells. The seawater pelted down at the ship like arrows and cannonballs, with intense explosions resounding all around.
A command from the command center: "Activate the alchemy formation, protect the ship!"
On the deck, the people of Dawn swiftly retaliated. The runes and coatings on the ship lit up, and hundreds of cannons fired simultaneously, the barrage deafening.
The cannonballs instantly exploded upon hitting the transparent body of the distant Sea Giant.
The explosions from the hundreds of alchemy shells were enormous, enough to flatten mountains.
The upper body of the Sea Giant was blown into a mist of water in an instant, collapsing into the sea.
However, before the people of Dawn could feel any relief, the Sea Giant that had just had its body blasted in half reconstituted itself, turning back into an intact Sea Giant in the blink of an eye!
The Titan spirit that had coalesced was formed of water elemental limbs, which were inexhaustible atop the vast ocean. Any damage it sustained could be immediately replenished. Moreover, the suppression at the level of laws made conventional methods virtually ineffective in causing it any substantive harm.
The might of hundreds of cannons was fierce, sparing no expense in ammunition that could obliterate ninth-tier magical beasts.
But at this moment, they could only slow down the Sea Giant's approach to the ship, unable to defeat it.
The situation, no matter how one looked at it, was extremely unfavorable for the Dawn Team.
Besides, "Saint Frank" had chosen this moment for a reason.
Because at this time, the high-ranking fighters of the team were still tied up in the sky, unable to assist, fighting the Hell Black Dragon.
As the Sea Giant manipulated the whirlpool, drawing the ship of eternal night ever closer, it was then that a remarkably calm voice came through the communicator.
It was a command from Mr. Hei, "Magic teams, prepare. Group one, conjure the 'Elemental Steal' formation; group two, amalgamate 'Absolute Zero' to ice seal the ocean surface."
"Yes!"
Upon hearing this, several sub-team leaders immediately responded.
Their composed tone seemed to reassure everyone.
At the instant the order was issued, the deck immediately lit up with over a thousand alchemical formations, and a tremendous power of Elemental Steal enveloped the ship.
As soon as this mysterious force appeared, elements were frantically stolen. The rain arrows, which had attacked the ship like cannonballs, now turned into mere droplets as they fell.
Soon after, the vast power of the stolen water elements gathered together and was then condensed into an icy white vapor by another group of magic-focused professionals, ultimately converging on Mr. Hei, who stood at the center of a nine-pointed star formation.
This was a combined Legion technique.
On one side, elements were being stolen; on the other, the elements were condensed into chill.
In a flash, the vast deck became bitterly cold, as if winter had fallen.
The alchemical formations glowed brightly, and with a forward point from Mr. Hei, the chilling sound of frost crystallizing made one's scalp tingle.
"Legion Secret Art: Absolute Zero!"
Upon looking again, his finger swirled with cold air, instantly forming an ice spear.
The ice spear possessed a cold so intense that it seemed to freeze even space, and it extended towards the distant Sea Giant at high speed.
A strange scene then unfolded.
Where the small ice spear passed, the seawater froze solid.
The terrifying surge of cold swept across, and as the Sea Giant was in the midst of forming a group of elemental cannonballs, its pale blue translucent body suddenly began to whiten and then turned crystal clear.
However, since the Sea Giant's body was made from nearly high-tier elemental power, the cold didn't completely immobilize it, only slowing down its movements.
"Crack," "crack,"...
The air was filled with the sound of ice cracking.
It appeared that the two forces were at a stalemate.
With the Sea Giant's movements restricted, it no longer posed an immediate threat to the ship of eternal night.
...
Saint Frank probably hadn't expected that this Titan spirit, summoned as a top-tier combat force on the Alchemy plane, would be restrained by an Alchemical Adventure Team lacking even a ninth-tier Magician!
And yet, he watched this countermeasure with a sense of deep familiarity.
Wasn't this the Legion technique of the tens of thousands of Mages from the Divine Plane?
Indeed.
This was the Dawn Team's legion of thousands of Mages!
After numerous encounters with the Divine Plane's legions, Su Lun had stripped many of their memories of magic-based forces, and how could he not compile those precious tactics and experiences into formations suitable for Alchemy Magicians?
Traditional magic-based alchemy could leverage all sorts of alchemical equipment and cursed items, and its combat strength was no less than any other legion of thousands of Mages!
It was just that magic-based Alchemy Magicians were few in number and accustomed to fighting alone, resulting in the lack of a developed legion system.
But now, they had one.
And the combat power of the Dawn Team had changed dramatically from before, with more and more Magicians of tiers 4 to 6, already meeting the basic conditions to form a high-tier legion.
Moreover, during these days of adventure in the Dragon Country, they had acquired countless pieces of ancient equipment, cursed items, and even items of sealed-alchemy class. Now, nearly every crew member had equipment of at least golden quality. This could indeed be considered a top-tier legion arrangement in the Alchemy plane, even more luxurious than any of the thousands-strong Mage legions Su Lun had hunted before!
Then there were the magic towers built by those beings from the Divine Plane in the Moon Strait.
The mages used magic towers to gather magic power and enhance the lethality of their spells, a point that also applied to alchemists.
As for the Eternal Night, the massive displacement of the ship made it suitable for retrofitting and carrying heavy loads. These days, the people of Dawn had transformed the ships into a large magic tower, effectively making it a mobile battle fortress for the magic legion!
Then there was the special existence of Mr. Hei.
As a scholar, Mr. Hei always had the sharpest observations of the battlefield, able to make the most suitable judgments in critical moments.
Now, having drunk from the Spring of Wisdom, his professional abilities had been developed to the extreme.
Just like right now!
Mr. Hei determined at the first moment that they couldn't kill this sea giant, only control it.
And none of their methods, no control spell at their disposal, could directly control such a massive elemental body.
So faced with a sea giant that nearly had an immortal body in the ocean, Mr. Hei did not choose to directly confront the endless water elements. Instead, he opted for elemental theft.
Stealing the sea giant's power of water elements, then consolidating his own spells.
The legion's spell "Legion Secret Art: Absolute Zero" was also very special.
In the eyes of an alchemist, the universe's temperature could reach several billion degrees, but when the temperature dropped to a certain point, the movements of creatures would gradually stop and lead to death, be it elements, cells, energy... everything.
The greater the energy expended outward, the lower the temperature reached by the spell.
This spell did almost no damage to the sea giant, but it could infinitely slow its movements, almost to a halt.
A bizarre scene appeared on the sea surface. The water was frozen over a large area. The Black Dragon, pulling the Eternal Night, raced across the ice, while the sea giant trying to catch up slowed down more and more the closer it got…
Even though this titan spirit had the battle power of the ninth order or even stronger, it just couldn't get the better of the Dawn legion.
The battle immediately fell into a deadlock, and it seemed victory or defeat wouldn't be decided any time soon.
...
In the sky, Su Lun watched this scene unfold with not a hint of surprise.
From the beginning when the titan spirit appeared, he knew that it couldn't possibly trouble the Dawn legion if it was alone.
And after they dealt with the Hell Black Dragon, the titan spirit would naturally be no problem.
It was clear that "Saint Frank" also understood this.
Su Lun murmured to himself, "This guy's options are running out... If he's still hiding and not showing up, is he planning to use the 'Lord of the Grey Mist's' abilities?"
A demigod is an excellent component for a true divine being.
Moreover, a demigod whose consciousness has been greatly damaged—an invading divine will like the one that descended upon Saint Frank—would certainly not let this opportunity pass.
And fighting within the Curse Space was much more convenient than outside it.
As thoughts flickered through Su Lun's mind, he had already deduced various outcomes.
If "Saint Frank" dared to attack personally, he must have a certain degree of confidence, but it was very risky for the Dawn legion to choose head-on battle.
Yet, they must still face this risk head-on.
Now that the divine will was severely damaged, it was the best opportunity to deal with it.
Moreover, "Saint Frank" had grown too quickly due to his talents. It was better to deal with him sooner and eliminate a major threat.
Thinking this, Su Lun continued to burn the soul of the Hell Black Dragon atop the dragon's back.
However, what happened next was almost exactly as he predicted.
Seeing that the titan spirit was completely unable to do anything to the Dawn legion, "Saint Frank" clearly became anxious.
The longer the delay, the greater the likelihood he would be exposed.
His absence thus far was primarily due to the heavy blow he suffered last time, a lesson learned.
Who knows whether there were other transcendental beings hidden in this stretch of sea.
It was then that the communicator conveyed a warning from a distant outpost, "Everyone be careful, the Hell Volcano has erupted with a great amount of black mist!"
Hearing this, nearly everyone in the Dawn legion knew what was happening, as this was not the first time they had experienced such a scene.
The grey mist is a moving Curse Space—the "Hell Dragon Country."
Seeing this, Su Lun once again confirmed a thought, "It seems that the divine will still doesn't know, or is unsure whether it can move freely through curse spaces…"
What he needed to do now was to make the most of the intelligence gap between the two sides and strike an unexpected blow.
The black fog rolled in, sweeping over the vast sea area near the Dawn group.
The Eternal Night couldn't even escape before it was engulfed by the fog tide.
The surrounding light suddenly dimmed, turning hellishly gloomy; they had once again entered the cursed space.
However, no one in the Dawn group panicked; those who needed to wear gas masks did so, and those who were to fight continued fighting.
The purpose of this cursed space was only to restrain them, and then... It was also time for "Saint Frank" to make an appearance.
As expected, right after the Dawn group was drawn into the cursed space, a blonde youth with three eyes mysteriously appeared in the sky.
He was surrounded by a divine aura and wore the majestic face of a high-ranking being, indifferently looking down on the humans below like mere ants.
An alarm immediately sounded through the communicator: "Nine o'clock direction, eight hundred meters on the sea surface, be careful of the enemy!"
Su Lun had always known that the guy was hiding there, but without absolute certainty that he could take him down, he had waited until now.
"Saint Frank" didn't hold back; upon his appearance, a beam of light suddenly shot from the vertical pupil on his forehead toward Mr. Hei aboard the Eternal Night.
The beam was incredibly fast, piercing instantly through the silhouette that was casting a spell, seemingly aiming to destroy the Dawn group's 10,000-member formation.
How could Mr. Hei have failed to notice this enemy's emergence?
From the very beginning, he and Su Lun had guessed that this guy would show up.
At the very moment the beam pierced the silhouette, it dispersed, revealing it to be an illusion.
A few meters away, Mr. Hei emotionlessly teleported to the side, as if he had foreseen the attack, narrowly and safely evading it.
Mr. Hei glanced again at the blond youth in the sky, his eyes devoid of any emotion.
He had already entered the state of the second resolution of the Mind Reading Technique.
...
In the sky, Su Lun saw the beam split apart and felt a great relief: "He's just under ninth-tier standards..."
While the attack looked formidable, it actually did not mobilize ninth-tier laws on a fundamental level.
The ability to produce such an effect was purely due to his "S-009-All Things True Resolution" second resolution ability.
If one could understand this talent, they could decompose it.
If a divine will descended upon a physical body, it would indeed be an unsolvable presence.
Such power could easily kill anyone, including Su Lun; that didn't mean it could hit Mr. Hei, now under the double resolution of "Wisdom" state and Mind Reading Technique!
One hit would be fatal, and all members of the Dawn group were warned.
But that "Saint Frank" wouldn't be interested in the lower-ranked professionals, and the All Things True Resolution beam was not endlessly available to be shot.
After a few beams, Mr. Hei perfectly avoided each one.
Only then did the guy realize something was off with the old man.
However, before Saint Frank could think further, Su Lun had already noticed something, and his figure quietly disappeared from the spot.
In his second resolution of the All-knowing Eye, this plane of existence had no secrets from him.
The moment "Saint Frank" appeared, Su Lun had already seen two distinct fluctuations of faith.
He immediately determined that the divine will had now split in two: one part in Saint Frank and the other towards the Hell Volcano.
Without much thought, it was certain that the "Lord of the Grey Mist" was at the Hell Volcano!
And for a false god to exist, there's a necessary condition: a parasitic object.
If he could find this object, he could erase the false god directly.
Before, Su Lun and Pandora had severely injured the Lord of the Grey Mist, but because they hadn't found the divine host object, they hadn't been able to eradicate it entirely.
Now the opportunity had come.
Su Lun speculated that the divine will of the heavenly plane must have devoured the divine power of the Lord of the Grey Mist to recover from its injuries.
Finding the parasitic object would surely deal a heavy blow to that god!
He took the risk to confront it head-on, just waiting for this moment!

chapters.title: Chapter 594 - 593: Desperate Frank
chapters.content:
Su Lun had waited half a day just for this moment when "Frank" would reveal a flaw!
After drinking from the Spring of Wisdom, his understanding of all laws had greatly improved. As a result, his spatial perception abilities had become much more precise, allowing him to sense spatial coordinates over vast distances more accurately.
During the several instances when "Frank" had released beams of the Truth Unraveler, Su Lun had already accurately determined the source of the power.
In the eyes of the All-knowing Eye's second solution, there were no secrets to be hidden.
Clear as day, Su Lun saw a strand of Faith Divine Power on Frank resembling a golden thread, continuously extending deep into Hell Volcano.
...
Mr. Hei employed various tactics of using finesse to overcome strength, making "Frank" feel like he was hitting cotton.
Despite having the ability to instantly kill, he curiously did not inflict any actual damage.
As he was still contemplating whether to pay a price to perform Divine Arts to first take care of the myriad of alchemists on the ship, suddenly, he noticed that Su Lun had disappeared from sight.
The Saint Heir immediately guessed something and his face drastically changed!
Although he didn't know how his adversary had precisely located the position of the intent from the "Lord of the Grey Mist" that resided in him, he couldn't afford to think about it, and his figure also vanished in a flash.
He knew very well that once the god-forbidden object was found, he would be immediately put at a significant disadvantage.
...
However, in the confrontation between masters, often just a tiny bit of decision-making advantage could create a huge opportunity.
The precise judgment and decisive action of Su Lun had given him that momentary edge.
Even though he did not know where the god-forbidden object of the "Lord of the Grey Mist" was exactly hidden, he was sure that the demigod would never place his avatar in peril.
So even when Su Lun discovered that the coordinates were somewhere deep within Hell Volcano, he did not hesitate to perform Directed Displacement.
As the surroundings changed, he found himself in a cave.
"Just as expected!"
A slight joy crossed Su Lun's mind.
The risk of teleporting here did involve some betting, but his gamble had paid off!
Faith Divine Power was equally tempting to any top-tier monster, so the Lord of the Grey Mist definitely would not arrange for any high-level monsters to guard near his avatar.
The cave was a spatial rift within Hell Volcano, a very special environment. Apart from rocks, terrifying spatial rifts and spatial windstorms were everywhere.
These spatial rifts were the best defensive traps for any intruding creature.
Concealed and powerful.
These dangerous spatial rifts, sufficient to tear apart transcendent beings, posed no threat to Su Lun.
In his eyes, these spatial rifts were like shattered pieces of glass scattered on the ground, glaring and devoid of any cover.
As long as he didn't blindly walk into them, they posed no threat whatsoever.
Ignoring those spatial rifts, Su Lun's gaze immediately fell upon the strange mask on the stone platform of the cave upon his arrival.
Identified as [The Totem Mask of the Hellish Demigod Kambubila].
Probably the worship totem left by an ancient fallen deity.
Su Lun had seen several similar artifacts before, and was not surprised.
Being so close, the residual Divine Power from the mask made his scalp tingle.
This mask, untouchable by mortals, inherently contained a powerful high-ranking mental impact.
However, handling such matters didn't require Su Lun's own hands, someone else was better suited for it.
He raised his hand, and through a vortex of darkness, a divinely robed, extremely beautiful woman with eerie red pupils appeared before him—none other than Pandora.
As soon as she appeared, a bizarre Divine Power immediately suppressed the radiation-like overflowing Divine Power from the mask.
The two exchanged a glance and immediately understood each other.
Pandora started her action at once.
She possessed the special ability to steal Faith Divine Power. Upon appearance, the crimson moonlight on her body turned into strands of red silk, tightly wrapping the mask.
It was these strands of red silk that furiously drew the Divine Power from the mask.
But now that the Lord of the Grey Mist, a divine will of a heavenly god, resided within, how could He just let someone easily steal His Divine Power?
Light flowed in Su Lun's eyes, clearly seeing the two Divine Powers clashing.
Obviously, the Divine Power couldn't be stolen in a short moment.
However, reality did not give them the opportunity. The next second, a golden-haired youth with vertically-slit pupils also teleported into the cave.
"Frank" looked at those daring to steal his Divine Power, his face cold.
Even though He had known through his followers that there was a special false god in this alchemical plane, seeing it in person made him subtly feel a threat.
Faith Stealing was a technique that could directly threaten a True God, so how could such an existence appear on this shattered alchemy plane?
Without further thought, a beam of blue light shot out from between his eyebrows, piercing through Pandora's chest in an instant.
Even though Pandora manifested her Divine Power form, this strike created a huge hole in her body, drastically weakening her Divine Power instantly.
At the same time, Pandora sent a spiritual transmission to Su Lun, "Don't worry about me, as long as you don't die, I cannot die!"
Because at that moment, "Frank's" next target was Su Lun.
However, as she spoke, she caught a glimpse out of the corner of her eye that Su Lun had already swiftly withdrawn, perfectly avoiding the disintegrating beam of light.
From this posture, it seemed that even if she hadn't reminded him, Su Lun had no intention of offering help.
Although she couldn't die, Pandora still looked over with a hint of deep sarcasm in her eyes at the scene.
She did not yet know that Su Lun had now gained "Wisdom."
But actually, even before they started fighting, Su Lun had already deduced that Frank couldn't kill Pandora.
Pandora, who had stolen the powers of several mature demigods, was now a top-tier demigod in this realm.
She might still fear the arrival of a True God, but just a trace of a will incarnate, couldn't necessarily decide the victor.
Moreover, how could the All-knowing Eye not comprehend her current strength?
The blow that seemed severe was actually mostly blocked by the Moon Reading Illusion Technique, and the dispersal of Divine Power was a false appearance intended for the enemy to see.
This Illusion Technique was so sophisticated it almost reached the pinnacle realm of "Turning Illusion into Reality."
Even Frank was deceived at that moment; otherwise, he wouldn't have switched his target.
The two exchanged glances, and Pandora, seeing a pair of cold, wise eyes, immediately understood something but also quietly exclaimed in her mind, "Has he seen through my Divine Techniques? His eyes seem to have changed."
Without much thought, she heard Su Lun's spiritual transmission, "Focus on dealing with this divine artifact. Leave that guy to me!"
Pandora felt somewhat puzzled by his confidence, as if questioning, "Can you handle it?"
Even during the brief combat, she had noticed that this golden-haired young man was definitely not an ordinary foe; the Divine Power in his magic was almost of the fifth order.
She initially thought that Su Lun had called her to deal with this tough opponent together, yet he wanted to handle it himself?
Su Lun didn't explain much that the two foes were actually one and the same; he suddenly appeared behind "Frank" with a teleportation.
"Alright!"
Seeing this action, Pandora also made her move.
Although puzzled about where Su Lun's confidence came from, after having cooperated so many times, how could she not know that he was someone who would never put himself at a disadvantage?
This thought barely flickered through her mind before she put it into action.
Her body surrounded by countless spirits, her eyes shone with a red illusion light like two blood moons, her entire body dissolved into blood-red filaments, madly stealing the Divine Power of faith from the mask.
...
The Divine Power of faith was rapidly draining; Frank's expression drastically changed.
The Lord of the Grey Mist had been heavily injured by Pandora before, and his Divine Power was already limited. Now, summoning the cursed space of the Hell Dragon Country to trap the Dawn Group was already a strain, leaving no strength for other measures.
Frank had intended to continue attacking Pandora, but Su Lun wouldn't give him that chance, having already appeared behind him.
Facing this deity, Su Lun's body erupted with Death God's Fire, and he swung down his black scythe!
The high and mighty divine will, seeing this, was furious. It hadn't expected a human to offend him, but seeing the pale green flames, it couldn't help but dodge.
Seeing this, Su Lun let out a cold, anticipatory laugh in his mind.
How could he not see through this fellow's bluff?
He was a divine will, true, but after all, the vessel of his descent was Frank McAdam, an eighth-tier human.
Moreover, after the previous heavy injury, his current bodily combat strength was less than thirty percent of his peak.
If it weren't for the fear of the True Revelation's ability, Su Lun wouldn't fear this fellow at all.
"Frank" knew that if he didn't kill the person before him, he couldn't stop the demigod who was stealing his Divine Power.
The confrontation was brief and without warning, an indescribable pressure suddenly descended.
Behind Frank appeared a blurry tri-eyed human face phantom.
That indescribable feeling was just like the first time on the sea surface of Giant Island.
"Divine Power!"
The divine will itself descended, unleashing a spiritual oppression from a True God, even more terrifying than a dragon's might.
This was truly a Divine Arts level technique.
This technique, once used, would immediately subdue Su Lun, a mere human.
Just a moment of stiffness would be his end.
....
However, Su Lun, feeling that spiritual power, wasn't surprised at all and thought to himself, "Hehe... no other tricks left, huh?"
Utilizing this strategy meant that the enemy truly had no more tricks up their sleeve.
An existence once indescribable had now become clear to him.
The impossibility of direct sight was merely because the human brain couldn't handle such vast and complex information.
But it's not to say that Su Lun, with the All-knowing Eye, was afraid to face a True God directly— even without it, such techniques could not harm him.
At the very moment the divine will descended, a deeper layer of the Death God's Fire emerged on Su Lun's body.
It was as if there were two souls within one body.
Frank watched, his brows tightly furrowed, as he failed to intimidate this mortal.
Previously, he had received information that Karas, another lesser demigod, responded to a follower's curse of Divine Arts. However, not only did the curse fail to kill a mortal, but it also backfired and severely injured him.
At that time, he guessed that this alchemical realm possessed some treasure or special existence.
Clearly, it was the one before him.
After helping Su Lun resist the oppression, Pestoya also revealed her spectral body.
Understanding something, Frank suddenly realized, "I didn't expect this lower plane to harbor a being who had consolidated Divine Fire..."
Not to mention that he was merely a wisp of consciousness that had descended, even if his true body had come, he might not have been able to intimidate a being who had consolidated Divine Fire.
Yet, this was clearly a broken and lesser plane of rules. How could this be possible?
He was greatly puzzled in his heart.
But suddenly, he understood something else, and his expression dramatically changed.
"Eh, no! This isn't Divine Fire he consolidated himself, but Divine Fire stolen from a god!"
It was already surprising enough for a pseudo-god to steal divine power. He had not expected there to be a spirit here who had already stolen Divine Fire.
Instantly, a conspiracy overwhelmed his heart.
All these tactics seemed aimed directly at him, a True God. Damn these alchemical arts. They truly needed to be destroyed!
...
Su Lun remained unfazed, with no intention of idling.
He teleported and reappeared next to Frank, striking him with a rune-engraved black umbrella.
Simultaneously, the Death God's Fire on his body, augmented by Pestoya, burned several times more intensely than before.
Knowing that it was already too late as he swung his umbrella, suddenly, the fire scales on the umbrella exploded, showering the majority of the cave with countless tiny sparks.
Frank, unable to avoid in time, got some of the soul fire on him and hastily teleported away from the spot.
Seeing this, Su Lun naturally pursued relentlessly!
With the Urobolos Space-Time Ring, how could he fall behind in teleportation?
Now undeterred by divine might, this was the best opportunity to strike.
The two entangled, bursting out of the cave.
Frank was also immensely irritated in his heart.
Originally, his strategy "Complete Truth" and "Divine Majesty," should have been enough to comfortably kill a ninth-string alchemist of this realm.
The plan had seemed perfect and could have resolved the issue instantly.
But he had encountered such an outrageous combination.
A high-ranking pseudo-god, a soul that had consolidated Divine Fire, and a fellow possessing a god-tier spatial treasure capable of fighting and fleeing... Even the Titan spirit had been held up.
Damn it!
This god felt enraged by some lowly humans for the first time.
However, even in fury, there was nothing he could do.
Descension to a lower plane naturally limited him, and his manifested body, already heavily injured, couldn't unleash many tactics.
The situation was increasingly turning against him.
Because if the delay continued, once the Lord of the Grey Mist's divine power was completely stolen, he too would suffer severe injuries.
By then, there would truly be no chance for a turnaround.
Su Lun, however, became calmer as the battle progressed, his thoughts racing swiftly as he envisioned all possibilities.
The longer time dragged on, the more it favored him.
But he was also aware that if "Frank" were pushed to the brink, he would definitely have some desperate tactics.
And sure enough!
Just then, tremendous Divine Power suddenly condensed around Frank.
This time, he didn't attack Su Lun with disintegrating beams anymore. Instead, looking up at the sky, the beams seemed to puncture a large hole in the realm itself, and suddenly, a giant human face condensed in the sky.
Su Lun looked cautiously, "Is it time to use the power of my true body to cast Divine Arts?"
Although the All-knowing Eye had shielded some of the information that would burden him, it was only a bit that he could accept, and he clearly saw that this move had already mobilized the power of cosmic rules.
This was firmly within the realm of Divine Arts.
But creating such a commotion, for Frank McAdam himself, was also a great risk.
This guy probably thought it better to both suffer than to be utterly defeated.
After all, Su Lun also knew that with the capabilities Dawn Group had revealed, if he were that deity, he would pay any price to thoroughly eradicate them.
As long as he could quickly kill them, there was still a chance to turn the situation around.
The face of dark mist in the sky stared down directly, its seemingly empty eye sockets instantly made Su Lun feel targeted.
It was that kind... no matter how far he teleported, he had already been seen, escape was impossible.
Su Lun didn't think his techniques could save his life, but clearly, he had a better way to respond.
With a gesture, a mysterious figure clad in a cloak appeared by his side.
As she lifted her cloak, she stunningly revealed a face full of menacing snake hair yet strikingly beautiful.
If not Queen Medusa, then who?
...
Su Lun didn't know the full power of this Divine Art, but he knew one thing.
Whatever means were available had to be constrained within the scope that the alchemical plane could withstand.
And Queen Medusa's stone curse had already touched the ceiling of the alchemical plane.
This was confidence!
Even if she couldn't petrify Frank, who was protected by the "Shield of Innocence," her Divine Art could petrify those energies that were condensed.
She looked at the face in the sky with a solemn expression, glanced at Su Lun, and murmured, "You really have stirred up quite a trouble."
Listening, Su Lun smiled faintly and actually felt relieved.
Not saying he couldn't be opposed meant they could fight.
But having said that, there wasn't a hint of complaint on Queen Medusa's face.
She hadn't forgotten that these celestial beings were also her enemies!
The moment she appeared, her snake hair fiercely roared at the giant face in the sky, and a stream of petrifying grey mist light burst forth.
Seeing Medusa appear, the cold, giant face in the sky seemed to reveal a hint of mockery.
The True Solution to All, which could decompose everything in the world, would stop the stone curse as long as it could understand it.
He was a True God after all!
How could a demigod serpent-like witch stop him?
The light beam, enhanced by Divine Power with the True Solution to All, shot straight down.
The petrifying grey light clearly couldn't stop it, and was decomposed bit by bit.
However, at that moment, something unexpected happened for Frank.
From the mass of snake hair on Queen Medusa's head, suddenly nine glistening golden shadows condensed.
With a flash of gold, and on closer look, the previously suppressed petrifying light suddenly surged in power by tens of times!
The nine golden snakes also emitted a force not inferior to that of the giant face, instantly restraining the decomposing light beam.
In an instant, the whole world seemed to turn to grey and white.
Wherever the light touched, everything was petrified.
Frank knew that the Golgoun clan had a powerful leader and had guessed that she might have become Queen Medusa, but he hadn't realized they had gathered nine golden snake hairs!
Those golden snake hairs, were a super-tier cursed object made from the sealed Divine Power of a god-tier snake-haired witch by a Great Alchemist of ancient times.
Combined, they could release terrifying Divine Power and even reverse bloodlines.
Queen Medusa had received the inheritance of the Golgoun clan and now fully controlled this power.
This was something Su Lun had confirmed before taking action!
From the beginning of the battle, he had anticipated this move.
....
From a distance, Frank was bathed in the petrifying light, and his face turned ashen.
He could never have imagined that these natives of the alchemical plane would have so many trump cards.
The tide had turned.
Unless a divine entity descended, he couldn't see any chance of victory.

chapters.title: Chapter 595 - 595: 594
chapters.content:
"Frank" looked at the sky filled with petrifying grey light, his face grim and cold.
Even as a True God, he couldn't think of any way to deal with Queen Medusa at this moment.
He had realized that the power of the petrification curse was nearly at its peak; being merely a thread of his consciousness here, he was utterly helpless against her.
He had underestimated her indeed.
From the beginning, he had thought that avoiding that demigod Cyclops in the sea would be sufficient to handle everything.
Yet now, he was being driven to this extent by a group of humans, none of whom were even ninth tier.
A false god capable of stealing divine powers, a ghost of divine fire, Queen Medusa, a spatial divine artifact...and an alchemist Reaper at his second release.
If they were to grow further, they would be a great menace.
"Frank" sighed inwardly, already knowing that his defeat was sealed.
But this body was an extremely rare return to the ancestral bloodline of the "Celestial Tribe," and he had no intention of losing it here.
Protected by the projection of the Divine Artifact "Shield of Purity" in the petrifying beam, he was safe.
A strange halo flashed over his body, and he had already vanished on the spot.
...
Without any spatial fluctuations, nor physical displacement, "Frank" simply disappeared right under the watchful eyes of Su Lun and the others.
Even Queen Medusa looked puzzled as she searched everywhere with her hundreds of snake hair eyes but couldn't find where he was hidden.
However, Su Lun's gaze hardened, his heart ruthlessly set: "Still trying to escape? There's no way I'm letting you get away!"
Since so many methods had been revealed today, he was determined to eradicate them completely.
In the second release of the All-knowing Eye, he clearly saw that the guy was hiding in a ray of sunlight.
This guy's hiding technique was very clever; he had dimensionally concealed himself within the beam of light, physically not in the same dimension.
That's why even the most clever sensing methods couldn't detect him.
With a pinch of the Suren Sorcerer's Seal, Su Lun formed a trianglular shape with his hands aimed at the distant beam of light and uttered softly, "Spatial Banishment!"
At the same time, the old crow on his shoulder cawed and flew over.
Mid-flight, the black crow had already turned into multiple two-dimensional black lines, perfectly entangling the ray of light that was behaving abnormally.
Seeing this technique, "Frank" knew he had been discovered.
In that instant, his figure reappeared in the field of view.
And just as he was about to act recklessly, Queen Medusa's petrifying beam hit him directly. Although it didn't petrify him on the spot, it slowed him considerably.
At the same time, Su Lun had already pulled out an ancient bronze lamp, and with a long hooked iron chain, he hooked it towards "Frank."
The fully repaired "Tartarus's Soul Lantern" served primarily to hook souls!
Once the target was locked, it could bind their soul within the illuminated range of the soul lamp.
As long as Su Lun, the holder, was not dead, this restraint wouldn't be lifted.
He hadn't used this method before for fear of not being strong enough, but now, the timing was perfect!
"Frank" saw the light from the soul lamp approaching and his expression changed.
But with the space already bound, his body slowed by the petrifying beam and no chance to dimensionally hide as even his ability was being restrained by a two-dimensional death bird.
This directly caused the release of his True Removal beam to be delayed by half a beat.
For a moment, he could only watch helplessly as the soul chain struck him.
"Soul Lock?!"
As a widely knowledgeable deity, how could he not know what this was?
But before he could react, a figure appeared behind him.
Su Lun, holding a runic black umbrella, struck fiercely toward Frank's back, not letting him escape this time and landing a solid blow.
The black umbrella, surrounded by Su Lun and the Death God's Fire from Pestoya, made contact with Frank's protective aura in an instant, and burning phosphorous fire poured in ferociously.
Not giving the enemy any chance to react, the green fire completely engulfed the opponent's soul.
"Frank," bound by both soul and space, and slowed in movement, had no power to turn the tide, even as a divine consciousness.
This time, it had to be a kill in one strike!
Just as Su Lun's Death God's Fire was about to burn his soul to ashes, suddenly, that indescribable sense of oppression instantly vanished.
Frank looked as if his soul had been drawn out, his eyes instantly dim and lifeless.
Almost at the same time, Su Lun sensed the anomaly and murmured, "It seems I can't limit a deity after all."
Originally, the plan was to severely damage that strand of divine will, but the soul-bound lamp's imprisonment was only effective on mortal souls and failed to confine it from escaping.
However, the good news was that once the divine will had left its believer's vessel, it could not possibly exist isolated in the alchemical plane.
Su Lun too relaxed a bit in his heart.
Finally, he no longer had to feel constantly watched by an enemy.
In just an instant, Frank's gravely injured soul was completely incinerated by both Su Lun.
The body of the Saint Heir went limp, clearly devoid of life.
Su Lun didn't continue the attack, fearing unexpected complications, and clapped his hands forcefully, "Black Coffin Seal!"
With a series of clattering noises, several rune-engraved wooden boards appeared out of nowhere, assembling into a coffin that instantly enveloped the body.
He then raised his hand, summoning the coffin into a minor void world.
Having done all this, Su Lun finally exhaled deeply, "At last, it is thoroughly resolved."
He inquired with the Eternal Night, and the battle there had ended as well.
The divine will that had descended returned to the realm of the gods, and without control, the Titan spirit vanished into the ocean.
The remaining Undead Black Dragon was like a cornered beast, unable to hold out much longer.
Su Lun hung up the communicator and finally relaxed his slightly furrowed brows.
He looked at the Ghost Lady beside him and praised, "Pestoya, you were fantastic just now."
Their cooperation had grown steadily more in sync, which is why they had overcome powerful enemies multiple times.
Upon hearing this, Pestoya's face broke into a radiant smile. Tugging at her Gothic black veil princess dress, she twirled mid-air, her face clearly expecting continued praise: "Of course, I am quite formidable."
"Mm."
Su Lun smiled and nodded affirmatively.
This Ghost Lady was the first person he had met in this world, and the materials for her Puppeteer profession advancement had been provided by her. Since then, she had helped him out of perilous situations multiple times.
It could be said that without Pestoya, Su Lun might not have survived to this day.
Similarly, Su Lun had become this Ghost Lady's most important friend.
Both exchanged smiles, and the tense atmosphere from moments before instantly lightened.
Su Lun didn't say much more; he teleported right in front of Queen Medusa and said, "Your Highness, thank you for your assistance this time."
Queen Medusa glanced at Su Lun; her stunningly beautiful face remained expressionless as she replied indifferently, "I was merely fulfilling the contract. Since the matters here are settled, I will return to the temple now."
As she spoke, she paused, then added, "If you need my help in the future, you can find me on Cocoloco Island. I will remember my promise."
Hearing this, Su Lun bowed politely, "Thank you."
Queen Medusa paid no attention to these details and turned around indifferently. Just as she was leaving, her eyes briefly flickered with a strange color as she glanced at Su Lun and Pestoya.
...
With that divine will gone, the Faith Stealing at Pandora's side was progressing more smoothly.
Once she stole the Divine Power of the Lord of Grey Mist, her strength would surge significantly.
Too many terrifying beings lurked near Hell Volcano, so Su Lun didn't dare linger.
He returned to the Eternal Night, and after helping to kill the Hell Black Dragon together, the ship gradually sailed eastward, preparing to leave the waters of Dragon Country and return to Emperor Luying's realm.
News came from Mr. Jing that the battle against planar invasion was not looking optimistic, and they needed to return to provide support.
Recalling his voyage to the Dragon Country Waters, although it was fraught with dangers, the gains were tremendous.
Not only did they thwart the plans of those from the divine realm, annihilating several legions of ten thousand mages, but the Dawn Group also amassed many opportunities.
Spring of Wisdom, Dragon Progeny Armor, gene potions, countless ancient treasures, the Naga tribe, Queen Medusa...
It wasn't just Su Lun; the combat abilities of all members of the Dawn Group had ascended a major step.
Moreover, these gains were sustainable.
The ancient ruins they discovered contained a wealth of ancient alchemy knowledge, which, once fully assimilated, could greatly influence today's world of alchemy.
And those gene potions were especially significant; once produced in large quantities, they could enhance the physical talents of all alchemists on the alchemical plane by a huge margin.
The Eternal Night continued its voyage on the sea.
Unlike the bumpy journey there, the return trip was much smoother.
Without enemies from the divine realm lurking in the shadows, they only had to deal with deep-sea monsters and magical beasts.
But by now, the Dawn Group had the power to easily hunt eighth-tier dragons, and even encounters with high-level sea creatures essentially turned into mere material deliveries.
Avoiding those highly dangerous areas, the Dawn Group smoothly sailed eastward.
...
This day.
It was already the ninth day since the Eternal Night had left Cocolo Island.
It was midnight, and a dense fog had drifted above the sea.
The moonlight was obscured, rendering the sky pitch dark.
Since the day he had killed Frank, Su Lun had not left his quarters, as he had been busy using the hell black dragon he had acquired to forge the alchemy prosthetic essential for his seventh-tier needs.
But today, he had come out.
Because there was something very important to do.
Tanni had planned to go to the Netherworld.
By the time Su Lun arrived, the deck was already crowded with many people.
Bartolo, Number Nineteen, Barrett, Tanni, Mr. Hei, Wuzhuasi, Kite ... all the high-ranking members of the Dawn Group were here.
They all knew Tanni's trip would most likely be a one-way journey, and they had come to say goodbye.
In Tanni's own words, this journey to Netherworld was a do-or-die mission.
"Ah, Su Lun is here."
"Mr. Su Lun has arrived!"
"..."
As Su Lun stepped onto the deck, the crowd began to greet him.
He glanced over the crowd, noticing that the Dawn Group was gradually turning into a "Giants Group."
Over the past days, every member of the Dawn Group had accessed potions matching their own genetic lineage.
Whether they were dragon blood or titan gene potions, these genes inherently contained the factor for immense growth.
As a result, the members of the Dawn Group had become exceptionally robust.
Normal people are less than two meters tall, but the members of the Dawn Group ranged from three to five meters tall.
Especially the Giant Three Brothers, who had grown from nearly five meters to over ten meters tall, and their strength had increased tenfold as well.
Moreover, the genetic potions by their nature had the possibility of lifelong impact due to their growth properties.
The strength of the group members was increasing day by day.
The members of Dawn Group now emanated an overwhelming oppressive aura, so much so that even as Su Lun walked on deck, he felt as though he was witnessing human-shaped dragons.
Since it was a farewell, after greeting him, few people spoke.
Su Lun moved to the side of the ship and quietly awaited.
Lolota, as Tanni's sole disciple, knew her master was heading to the Netherworld and might never return, which made her extremely downcast.
Seeing Su Lun approach, her face finally showed some expression as she looked up at the two to three hundred meter tall mast and softly said, "Mr. Su Lun, the teacher is still up in the mast."
"Hmm."
Su Lun nodded.
He naturally knew what Tanni was waiting for, since he himself had drawn the map to the Netherworld.
Checking the time on his pocket watch, the "Ghost Train" would arrive in fifteen minutes.
Su Lun stood quietly on the mast.
At that moment, Dr. Banks, clad in a black robe, approached him.
"You've been indoors these past few days, I couldn't even find you."
He took out a golden potion and handed it to Su Lun, saying, "Take a look at this."
Su Lun examined the potion.
[Titan Demigod Gene Potion]
Details: Divine-grade gene potion; this is the divine blood from the second-generation Divine King, known as Titan, a race born to bring darkness and destruction to the world; true divine blood, inherently possessing immense destructive power; injection leads to significant enhancement of physical attributes, raises level cap, and transforms bloodline; high likelihood of acquiring darkness and destruction rules; mutation probability no less than 98%.
The item was indeed extraordinary, far more potent even than the "X Serum" Su Lun had once fused with.
But looking at the nearly certain mutation rate, Su Lun also showed a hint of bemusement, "This...?"
Dr. Banks guessed what he was thinking and explained, "The drop of [Titan Ancient God's Blood] you gave me earlier, I split the gene chain and cultivated it into various enhanced sub-grade potions. Everyone in the group has used them with good effects. As for this original version, its effects are too violent, even instruments can't analyze it fully, so I wanted you to take a look first. Perhaps you're the only one in the group who could integrate it."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun wryly smiled, "I can't either. My chance of mutation is also close to one hundred percent."
[Titan Ancient God's Blood] was something he had found in Frank's storage ring.
Those from the divine realms had also found quite a few treasures in the waters of Dragon Country, and this divine blood was among them.
He understood what Dr. Banks meant, and added an explanation about the appraisal results.
He had a pair of All-knowing Eyes, which had now also become Dr. Banks's special "detection instrument."
Many of the problems that current precision instruments could not solve were first assessed by him. Because of this ability, the efficiency and accuracy of the biological laboratory had significantly increased.
As Dr. Banks listened, he noted, "Oh, so that's how it is. Now I know the direction for the next phase of research."
Su Lun smiled slightly, not minding being used as a tool.
At that moment, Dr. Banks thought of something else and said, "Oh, there's one more thing."
He paused, then continued, "I've dissected the body of Saint Frank. By comparing him to Augustus, who had also awakened the [True Understanding of All Things] talent, I've found that Frank's manifestation of three additional eyes could potentially be due to ancestral reversion in bloodline genes."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun immediately became intrigued.
He had collected Frank's body, not for the purpose of creating zombie puppets.
The [True Understanding of All Things] talent was his real objective!
Currently, with the amplification from Dragon Blood and Titan's genes, everyone in the Dawn Group had significantly powered up.
If this talent could be replicated through a gene potion...
But before his thoughts could wander further, Dr. Banks threw cold water on them, "Theoretically speaking, if that gene segment could be replicated, this kind of three-eyed anomaly could indeed be replicated in other humans. However, after my research, I found it to be impossible. Even if possessing three eyes were possible, the [True Understanding of All Things] talent couldn't be carried over. The ancestral gene isn't just a biological issue. I had been perplexed all this time until I gained some insight after reading ancient medical texts from the Dawn Era. It involves secrets of higher life forms."
Su Lun listened and frowned, finding it somewhat hard to grasp even for himself.
Clearly, Dr. Banks didn't regard it as an obstacle but rather as a significant challenge. He added, "To put it simply, a professional's talent is not merely an inheritance of bloodline, but also involves a kind of power unreachable by us humans."
As he said this, he gazed intensely at Su Lun with his distorted eyes, "So, I need your help."
Su Lun listening to this "help," felt oddly unsettled, guessing something.
Dr. Banks said, "I have an idea. The body of the Saint now remains highly viable, and his eyes function exactly as when he was alive. Thus, the body still possesses the [True Understanding of All Things] ability...."
"..."
Su Lun was of course aware of this.
This was intentionally done by him to maximize the preservation of the body.
At that point, Dr. Banks finally revealed his purpose, "If possible, I'd like to transplant that eye along with some neural tissue into a living body, directly transferring the [True Understanding of All Things] talent."
"..."
Su Lun, hearing this, twitched the corner of his eye, thinking it was just as he suspected.
This idea...
Dr. Banks continued, "But I've already tested it, almost everyone in the group would reject that gene segment, or the talent would vanish after the transplantation. It's not an issue of genetics or technology. I suspect it's on a higher-dimensional level. Others might not work, but only you and Emmerich are different in the group."
Su Lun listened silently, pondering over this proposal.
Dr. Banks added, "I know you're busy... so I've asked Emmerich, he thought the idea was good and was willing to help me with the experiment. But he wanted to ask you first. After all, the body is precious, and if it's lost, it's gone."
Su Lun, having prepared himself to sacrifice for the experiment, was surprised to learn it wasn't for him to be the subject, but Mr. Hei?
The risks of the transplant weren't high, but the procedure required a considerable amount of time before and after to accommodate various observations.
He was on the critical threshold of progressing to the eighth rank; any change could impact his future advancement, which was his greatest concern.
Moreover, he himself possessed the All-knowing Eye and, although he needed the [True Understanding of All Things], his greater desire was to create living zombies, and it wasn't necessary at the moment.
That's why he had hesitated a bit earlier.
But surprisingly, Dr. Banks needed Mr. Hei's help for the experiment.
Su Lun thought it was good too.
Mr. Hei was more suitable than him.
After all, the old gentleman had previously sacrificed his right eye, preparing to have a new one transplanted.
Wasn't Saint Frank's divine eye perfect for this?
If it were successful, it was hard for Su Lun to imagine what it would be like for a Scholar, already knowledgeable, to also have the [True Understanding of All Things]—what an exaggerated combination that would be?
Su Lun nodded, "Of course you can."
This transplant held significant meaning.
...
While Su Lun and Dr. Banks had been talking, midnight had arrived.
Suddenly, the fog over the sea thickened to the point where one couldn't see their own hand.
At that time, everyone seemed to hear a distant train horn sound "woo... woo..." coming from the sea.
Everyone stared in astonishment at the distance.
It was a desolate sea; where could a train come from?

chapters.title: Chapter 596 - 595: Entering the 8th Tier
chapters.content:
Midnight.
The sea was shrouded in dense fog, and eeriness was present everywhere in the silence.
"Woo... woo... woo..."
The sound of the train's whistle echoed through the fog in all directions.
The sound surrounded the ears, and merely listening was enough to send shivers down the spine. It seemed that this was not a real whistle, but rather the mournful wailing of spirits filled with desolation, resentment, fear, longing, and ferocity.
The train's whistle made everyone on board the Eternal Night feel as though their souls were being pulled out of their bodies by some mysterious force, stirring shock and curiosity in all.
All were witnessing for the first time a train that truly ferried souls from the Netherworld.
"Clang clang," "clang clang," "clang clang"...
As everyone watched, a black, steam-billowing train sped across the sea.
The train was an old-fashioned steam locomotive, very much like those currently in operations in Mountain Hermit Country.
Yet the train itself was like a ghost, appearing in a semi-transparent spiritual state.
This was a famous monster in Mountain Hermit Country known as the "Ghost Train."
Su Lun watched the incoming train with a calm gaze.
He sensed more clearly than anyone the high-order death spells on the train.
Through the All-Knowing Eye, he saw more information and murmured to himself, "This 'Ghost Train' truly is a special existence beyond the plane's rules..."
This was the train that ferried Mountain Hermit Country's followers to the "Netherworld" plane after death.
Ordinarily, crossing between planes required a plane portal.
Even the deities that descended upon Frank were no different.
But this Ghost Train could appear directly on the sea, ignoring the plane portals, which clearly indicated a level of divine cosmic law well beyond the ordinary.
To human eyes, this monster "Ghost Train" appeared as just a train, but in essence, it was a special existence meant to ferry souls.
It was a rule, a regulation, or perhaps some other extraordinary power...
It could take the form of a boat, a horse-drawn carriage, an airship...any form of transportation.
In the belief system of the Netherworld, however, people felt it should take the form of a train.
Su Lun did not know what it was, so high that even his tier-two All-Knowing Eye could not understand it, akin to the rules of time flow and spatial change, close to the cosmic origins.
The scene was exactly as described in Fujiwara Hayato's travel diaries.
...
At that moment, the train stopped beside the Eternal Night.
Because the train was in a semi-transparent ghostly state, everyone could finally see clearly, there were other passengers inside the train carriages.
They were emotionless spiritual bodies, some human and some various bizarre monsters.
Most were dressed in kimonos with wooden clogs, clearly in the style of Mountain Hermit Country.
The sudden appearance of such a ghost train on the midnight sea gave all of the Dawn Group a chilling feeling.
Everyone had the feeling that if the train wanted to take their souls, no one would be able to stop it.
Like the inexorable approach of death when life nears its end, no matter how powerful, it was an unavoidable end.
A terrifying dread enveloped everyone's hearts.
On the vast deck, silence reigned.
As the train came to a complete stop, a train conductor dressed in black opened the door of the carriage, seemingly welcoming passengers waiting at this stop.
At that moment, Qian Tiao also leapt down from the mast.
Originally only a train for the departed, living people could not touch it, yet she confidently walked towards the train, ticket in hand.
The train conductor enveloped in swirling dark airs checked Qian Tiao's ticket, used a ticket puncher to clip a notch on the green ticket, and instantly, the ticket produced a burst of green flame and burned to ashes.
As if an ancient covenant had taken effect, the phosphorescent fire engulfing the ticket surrounded Qian Tiao. Hand on the hilt of her sword, she stepped onto the train without hesitation.
Su Lun knew that after boarding, the next stop was the Netherworld.
He watched Qian Tiao's retreating figure and yelled, "Stay safe, Sister Qian Tiao."
Qian Tiao paused for a moment, as if struck by a thought; everyone missed the slight upward curve of her lips as she responded to Su Lun, "Got it."
Without turning back, she coolly waved her hand, "Off I go, everyone."
The members of the Dawn Group watched Qian Tiao leave with worried looks and waved goodbye in unison.
Board the train, close the door.
Qian Tiao took her seat amongst a group of ghosts.
The whistle of the train sounded again with a "woo" "woo."
The train slowly started moving.
The Ghost Train's engine spurted a great mass of steam and soon, the train disappeared into the fog-shrouded sea.
The surroundings had become silent once again, as if nothing had ever happened.
"I can't sense it anymore..."
Su Lun tried to sense the spatial positioning necklace he had left on Qiantiao, but still could not find that coordinate.
It wasn't that it was far away, but that it was no longer in this world.
Even the "Dagus Goblin Communicator" of the Mirror Organization, which ignored spatial distances, had lost contact.
She could only rely on herself now.
Su Lun stared into the depths of the misty sea, his gaze profound.
The atmosphere on the deck was slightly melancholic, yet he smiled and greeted everyone, "Alright, folks have gone back."
Upon hearing Su Lun speak, everyone slowly sighed and dispersed.
Su Lun remained alone by the ship's rail, continuing to face the chilly midnight sea breeze.
No one disturbed him.
Qiantiao had gone to pursue her own Sword Dao, and even though it was a departure, he should be happy and bless her.
Thinking this, the corners of Su Lun's mouth also lifted slightly in a smile.
With a flash of spatial fluctuation, he was already back in the cabin.
Within the alchemy array sat the half-finished "Isaac Dragon Patterned Golden Body," Su Lun adjusted his thoughts and continued the crafting process.
Unknowingly, time flew by, and more than ten days had passed.
...
The Dawn Group traveled eastward, slaying sea monsters along the way, and safely passed through what was once a demarcation zone between the Dragon Country Waters and the West Sea of Luying, known as the "Eternal Night Sea."
Su Lun remained in the cabin and did not come out, as the current combat strength of the Dawn Group had vastly improved. Most issues could now be handled without his intervention.
He could peacefully focus on merging the necessary Tier 7 equipment.
One day, the Dawn Group finally navigated out of the endless darkness of the Eternal Night Sea.
The rough waves gradually calmed, and the long-absent sunlight suddenly shone into the captain's cabin.
Like threads of gold, the sunlight streamed through the window and fell upon Su Lun, deep in meditation. Miraculously, his body emitted a layer of black dragon scale-like mystical runes.
This special layer of runes gave off a visual sense of unbreakable strength and solidity.
After several days of seclusion, Su Lun had successfully crafted the epic "Isaac Dragon Patterned Golden Body" from a malformed Tier 8 Hell Black Dragon.
Normally, such Tier 8 Dragon-crafted epic gear would require a Tier 9 professional to merge.
But because Su Lun originally followed a pathway of rune-enhanced physical strengthening, along with Dr. Banks' specially formulated Dark Dragon Potion significantly lowering the threshold of merging, he managed the integration without any risk of deformation.
After a few days of adjustment, the equipment's traits completely integrated with his body.
Bathed in warm sunlight on his face, Su Lun opened his eyes, looked at his attribute panel, and exhaled deeply, "Huh... the fusion is perfect."
Once the equipment was released, black dragon scale runes swirled around his body.
He clenched his fist and immediately felt as if his body were cast from copper and iron.
The toughness value on the panel leapt from the pre-release value of 312 to now 4552, increasing by more than a factor of ten.
And other bodily defense-related attributes, including cellular vitality, bone density, physique, muscle strength, immunity to negative curse status, magic resistance, etc., all skyrocketed.
In battle, this would be a nightmare for any enemy!
"So strong..."
Su Lun himself found this somewhat hard to believe.
His body was already strong before, but now, the situation was outrageously robust.
This level of defense might even be attainable to a Tier 9 professional.
Before, cannon fire required the use of firm resistance, but now, he guessed that just standing in place and taking the hits physically would leave him completely unscathed.
It became hard for him to die, which, for Su Lun as a Puppeteer, undoubtedly represented a direct enhancement of his combat capabilities.
Furthermore, after his bodily strength was enhanced, his ability to endure also increased, allowing him to bear greater power, energy, negative states...
This equipment directly boosted "Isaac's Giant Strength" and significantly increased the capacity for Spiritual Power, as well as growing limits for Blood Devour, all-resistance... and various other bodily states were vastly enhanced.
Thinking of this chain of causality, Su Lun couldn't help but reflect, "Sir Isaac's idea to pair this equipment is simply brilliant! With this, almost without any hurdles, one could overcome the 'Calamity Rebound' and successfully harness Firm Body. It might even lay a solid foundation for condensing divine essence above Tier 9."
With a flash of thought in his mind, Su Lun had already envisioned too much.
After meditating for too long without movement, Su Lun stood up to stretch his limbs, pondered for a moment, and then muttered to himself, "This level of body stats should be sufficient to directly advance to Tier 8."
....
Originally, merging with Tier 7 equipment was the career endpoint for most alchemists.
Otherwise, Tier 8 professionals in the alchemy realm wouldn't be so rare.
Even those with supreme talent and opportunity to progress to Tier 8 would be stuck at this threshold for many years.
They would choose to advance only after they were truly confident.
Because while it's not difficult to merge with the career material to advance to Tier 8, what's challenging is facing a calamity—"Calamity Rebound."
This was the only way to comprehend the Dominating Body.
If one couldn't endure, they would die on the spot.
In the eyes of the Alchemist, the energy of the universe was constant.
Thus, as certain individuals in the universe gradually became stronger, they inevitably siphoned energy from other areas.
The career progression of an Alchemist, fundamentally, was a process of gradually plundering energy to become more powerful.
Here's a somewhat inappropriate analogy.
To a plane, professionals are like parasites.
In their juvenile stage, the host remains unaware, but as they grow, their demand for nutrients increases.
And the host instinctively tries to eradicate the parasite.
This is what's called "Calamity Backlash."
It is the plane's rejection of powerful beings.
....
But for Su Lun, this threshold was as if nonexistent.
In terms of physical strength alone, not to mention the seventh order, even those in the eighth order might find it difficult to match him.
The second phase of the All-knowing Eye left him with no doubts about the advancement threshold, such that advancing to the eighth order posed absolutely no difficulty for him.
Everything went smoothly. Su Lun stood up, ready to go on deck to notify everyone.
After all, "Calamity Backlash" was no small disturbance.
However, the moment he stood up, he felt as if something was missing.
His gaze swept the room, and when he saw the square bathtub in the bathroom, he suddenly realized,
Oh, Sister Qian was not here.
In this vast Captain's room, it seemed somewhat empty with him alone.
Su Lun frowned slightly and muttered, "I wonder how Sister Qian is."
Saying this, he stepped through the spatial gate and next, he was already on the deck.
The Dawn Group members on deck were leisurely basking in the sun, fishing, or practicing their Legion Spells through daily sparring...
After leaving the waters of Dragon Country, the level of danger they faced had plummeted from nine stars to just two stars.
Previously, within a few hundred nautical miles, there could be dozens of Gold-class and Lord-class huge deep-sea monsters; however, in the West Sea of Luying, it was rare to even find one over several hundred or even thousands of miles.
For the current Dawn Group, this truly posed no pressure at all.
After growing powerful, the zones once dubbed as "Nightmare Seas" by numerous adventurers, now seemed like backyard gardens they could visit at will.
Without realizing it, the Dawn Group had gone through many battles, big and small, and had become thoroughly tempered.
Both their combat strength and the members' mental states were now more than adequate to deal with anything comfortably.
A spatial fluctuation emerged on the deck, and was immediately spotted by a patrolling sailor.
Seeing Su Lun emerging, someone exclaimed, "Mr. Su Lun is here!"
With that, the crowd gathered warmly to greet him.
"Did Mr. Su Lun successfully integrate the host suit?"
"Oh... I feel Mr. Su Lun has become even stronger."
"Hey, Captain David, stop bragging! With your sixth order level, can you even sense Mr. Su Lun's prowess?"
"Hahaha, exactly! Exactly!"
"Hey hey hey, it's precisely because I can't sense it that it's so amazing, right Mr. Su Lun? Oh, by the way, what order are you at now?"
"..."
The group burst into laughter.
Su Lun also felt this atmosphere was very good.
Only now, having not been on deck for over ten days, did he realize that everyone's strength had visibly surged.
Each one was robust, with a profound aura and a sharp look in their eyes.
Su Lun smiled and responded, "I'm about to advance to the eighth order."
"About to advance to the eighth order?"
Upon hearing this, the crowd was also greatly surprised.
Because they all knew that before Su Lun had sequestered himself, he was merging with a seventh-order host suit.
And the threshold between the seventh and the eighth order was something even none of the former Luying "Top Ten Legendary Bounty Hunters" had been confident about crossing.
Su Lun was advancing after just a few days?
...
The news that Su Lun was advancing to the eighth level quickly spread through everyone's ears within the group.
Before long, the high-level fighters also gathered on the deck.
The group currently had only Old Sword God Bartolo and the "Blood Duke" Wazhuas at the eighth level, along with Qiantiao, who was previously a half step from the eighth level.
It seemed another name was about to be added, which was indeed a cause for celebration.
Moreover, everyone knew that after Su Lun advanced to the eighth level, he probably wouldn't be a mere ordinary eighth level.
It was said the stronger the strength, the stronger the "Magical Backlash" would be during the advancement to the eighth level, and they were all curious to witness how Su Lun would overcome this threshold disaster of the eighth level.
Before long, the deck was crowded with thousands of people.
Everyone wanted to witness this grand event of the Dawn Group.
Lorotar's eyes sparkled as he said, "Wow... Mr. Su Lun, you are going to advance to the eighth level?"
Tanni said, "Mr. Su Lun is so impressive."
No. 19 smiled gently and said, "Congratulations, Su Lun."
Barrett remarked with emotion, "Oh, Su Lun, your rate of advancement is really surprising. I remember when we first met, I was level six and you level four, and now you've surpassed me."
Kit also exclaimed, "Yeah... dude, your rate of advancement is absurdly exaggerated, is there no threshold even for the eighth level for you?"
The Blood Duke Wazhuas said, "I've lived eight hundred years, and Su Lun, you are the most preposterous nearly-eighth level I've ever seen."
The Old Sword God Bartolo said, "I think, Young friend Su Lun, your advancement might invite a very strong magical backlash, be careful..."
The crowd: "..."
With more people, everyone began discussing animatedly.
Others didn't know Su Lun's situation well, so naturally, there were some who were incredulous.
But only those who had also drunk from Mr. Hei could understand why he could advance so quickly.
Seeing Mr. Hei's congratulatory expression, Su Lun also asked, "And you, Mr. Hei?"
Mr. Hei responded, "I'm almost there too. But because of the eye transplant, it will still take a long time."
Pointing to his right eye covered by an eye patch, he continued, "However, I'm not in a hurry, my body's strength is not as exaggerated as yours. At least now, if I were to advance, I wouldn't be confident about overcoming the magical backlash."
Su Lun knew Mr. Hei had noticed the changes in his body and simply smiled noncommittally, then asked, "How is the eye transplant going?"
He had noticed that there were two forces fiercely battling inside Mr. Hei.
Mr. Hei said, "There is still a strong rejection reaction. But that's not a big problem, Dr. Banks can handle it. The troublesome part is understanding the nature of the 'Complete Understanding,' a divine-level talent. After the transplant, I gradually began to understand some of the origins of this talent, which has many similarities to our Alchemy domain's material decomposition, yet the layers of laws are extremely high, almost as high as the universal origin laws... If it still doesn't work, I plan to transform it into an alchemical implant, but then the eye would become a dead object, a real pity..."
Su Lun listened and nodded repeatedly, which matched his own deductions.
The two of them continued chatting like this.
The transplantation of Frank's divine-level eye was indeed a gamble with not a small chance of failure.
But if it succeeded, the implications for the future were extraordinary.
Su Lun was also very interested in the "Complete Understanding."
It was an important part of his future career plan.
Although there was only one corpse of Frank, the same "divine race," there were still other divine planes!
The Plane Wars had fully erupted, and there might be a chance in the future to hunt a few more.
Besides, Su Lun had an even better option.
That was the sealed black coffin he had obtained in the Luying Royal Mirror Library.
Su Lun had already completely deciphered all the secret scripts left on that black coffin.
Once, a Great Alchemist had killed a high-ranking deity from a divine plane, and the coffin contained the corpse of that deity!
However, now was obviously not the best time to focus on the corpse in the coffin.
Not to mention that Su Lun did not yet have the ability to handle the Corpse of the Gods, at least wait until Mr. Hei's transplantation experiment was completed, and then see the situation.
....
As Su Lun and Mr. Hei were chatting, the Eternal Night soon found a deserted island.
He knew his advancement would definitely cause a huge commotion, so he did not dare to stay on the ship.
Su Lun teleported to the deserted island and set up an alchemy array, then took out the advancement material "Descartes' Crystal Skull" he had prepared earlier and placed it within the alchemy array.
Then, with a serious expression, he began reciting the universal incantation of an alchemist: "Follow the law of equivalent exchange, praise the glory of the original creator, witness the miracle of creation with alchemy..."
In an instant, the heavens and the earth changed color.
The disasters of earth, wind, water, and fire came down as if it were the apocalypse.
Dragon scales shimmered on Su Lun's body, standing unyielding in the storm.
The distant onlookers from the Dawn Group were stunned.
That day, Su Lun successfully advanced to the eighth level.
PS. This is the last chapter of this volume.

chapters.title: Chapter 597 - 596: You act as bait, we'll handle the rest.
chapters.content:
Several days later, on the Nameless Deserted Island in the West Sea of Luying.
The Eternal Night sailed far on the surface of the sea, and the members of the Dawn Group gathered on the deck once again, watching the elemental phenomena on the deserted island subside from a distance.
"Hey, look, the cataclysmic weather backlash on the island is completely over. It seems like Mr. Su Lun has successfully advanced, right?"
"Of course he succeeded. How could Mr. Su Lun possibly fail in advancement! However, the cataclysmic backlash these past few days was indeed a bit too exaggerated..."
"Yes, the energy peak detected by the energy meter yesterday reached TⅧ level, which has surpassed the energy released by the majority of volcanic eruptions. It's incredibly unbelievable. If I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I really would not believe someone could bear such a terrifying backlash."
"That's right, Mr. Su Lun has integrated the epic 'Isaac Dragon Pattern Golden Body.' Ah... why could I only integrate a silver-quality one, wuu..."
"..."
The crowd discussed fervently.
Before this, no one would have imagined Su Lun's advancement phenomena to be so exaggerated.
These past few days, they had witnessed one cataclysmic weather event after another as if the apocalypse had come.
The wind was so fierce it could lift the Eternal Night into the sky; the rain sharp as if knives were falling from the heavens; the earth trembled as if the planes themselves were crumbling; the flames burned the skies to a bloody red...
Even the two rank-eight professionals in the group were left deeply moved by the sight.
Now that the cataclysmic phenomena had ceased, everyone let out a sigh of relief.
