However, even if no one had defected, leaking military intelligence was already tantamount to treason.
As he thought of something, Mr. Jing added, "Oh, there's one more thing. 'The Divine Sect's' remnants have been quite active in Lindon recently. This afternoon, I received news that 'Thief Emperor' Karlo from the once ten legendary hunters has joined the Eye of Heaven Sect and was executed on Holy Light Avenue by the military intelligence personnel. That information might have been spread by the followers of the Eye of Heaven Church."
Su Lun's expression changed slightly upon hearing this, considering that this was once an adversary he had confronted.
That guy was someone who recognized money over people, so his defection was not really surprising.
But to defect, whatever legend he had maintained, it suddenly made him seem much less dignified.
And although Saint Child Frank was dead, this Eye of Heaven Sect really was an endless hidden danger.
At that moment, Mr. Jing spoke again, "However, the current problem isn't too severe. I've just entered the ninth tier and haven't yet fused with my prosthesis. Once that's done, it won't be so easy for someone to harm me. Moreover, your situation is very good now, Su Lun, if you can find suitable cosmic essence, advancing to the ninth tier should be no problem. Then, we'll really have a foundation for a prolonged battle."
"Mm."
Su Lun nodded as he listened.
He asked, "Elder sister, what are your plans next? I've been thinking of going back to Old Lington soon. I mean, if you don't have other plans, shall we go together? It's also the right time for your injuries to be fully healed."
Mr. Jing responded indifferently, "I was originally planning to find a place to recuperate for a year or so. But since you can handle it, that's even better. And since I want to return to Old Lington too, I can also collect some things from Dawn City now."
Su Lun felt the same way.
Other than the cursed space at 88 Ginkgo Street in Old Lington, it was also time to check the dangerous cursed spaces in the Dawn Relic, as well as the sealed dimensional passages.
Now, with his strength and Mr. Jing together, almost anywhere on this plane was accessible.
An excited Pestoya chimed from the side, "Yay, we're going home!"
Though Dawn City was now ruins, it was still the former home of the two sisters.
And that relic held many secrets indeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 604 - 603: Return to Old Lington
chapters.content:
Su Lun, Mr. Jing, and Pestoya chatted intermittently like this.
The atmosphere in the hot spring was relaxed and pleasant. They were like family, discussing serious matters, daily trivialities, and even joking around occasionally, teasing and playfully scuffling with each other in harmony.
In fact, after spending a considerable amount of time together, Su Lun had come to understand that although his senior sister appeared cold and aloof, she was actually very approachable. She was kind, elegant, resolute, wise, and considerate—a multitude of positive adjectives suitable for describing good character could be used to describe her.
But Mr. Jing naturally preferred quietness, and her vampiric lineage gave her an inherent air of chilliness. Besides, she was indeed the real daughter of Sir Isaac from a thousand years ago, which placed her in a high generational status, leaving hardly anyone who could talk to her about anything besides serious matters.
Except for her junior brother, Su Lun.
This made their closeness stand out even more.
Although Mr. Jing herself didn't like to talk much, when Su Lun spoke, she would listen with great interest and occasionally, a gentle smile like a spring breeze would flicker in her beautiful eyes.
Without realizing it, the wound under her ribs was treated, and Mr. Jing lay on the side of the pool again, revealing a vast expanse of her jade-like smooth back.
The scar left by the Holy Light burning resembled a scald, extending from the ribs to the lower back, and the redness strikingly stood out against her snowy white skin.
Luckily, it was dealt with in time; otherwise, it would have continued to spread and erode the area.
Such pain was simply unbearable for an ordinary person.
Su Lun concentrated on treating the wound on Mr. Jing's lower back, gradually drawing the coldness out of the muscles and bones. Then he neutralized and digested the divine principles with dark alchemy formulas.
It was a tedious and lengthy process.
After a while,
Su Lun let out a long sigh of relief, and the healing green light in his hand dimmed.
He now possessed almost absolute meticulous thinking ability, and the process of resolving the injury went as smoothly as planned.
However, it was not yet complete.
Su Lun, with his eighth-tier strength, handling the wounds eroded by those sacred principles beyond the ninth tier, found it extremely draining, and he could only remove about one-tenth at a time.
By his estimation, it would take over a week to completely remedy the situation.
"All done!"
At this moment, Su Lun exhaled a sigh of relief, and as he said it, he habitually patted with a smack.
A crisp "smack" resounded in the wilderness, particularly clear.
However, no sooner had his palm landed than he instantly realized what he had done and froze: Had he just slapped right on that round and perky bottom?
Due to his habit of treating Qiantiao's injuries and slyly taking advantages, this motion was purely unintentional.
But this time, it was his senior sister.
Even though it was through a soaked gauze dress, the gesture was somewhat frivolous.
Mr. Jing, having her bottom hit by that slap, was clearly a bit surprised.
But fortunately, since she was facing away, her mixed expression flickered and vanished, and she got up as usual and said indifferently, "Let's go."
The little misunderstanding would usually be harmless, but there happened to be a third person present.
Pestoya blinked her large eyes on the side, extremely curious.
She would not pass up the opportunity to tease Su Lun. With her hands on her hips, she let out a witch-like weird laugh and shouted, "Sister, I saw Su Lun deliberately touching your butt~ He's taking advantage of you, aren't you going to hit him?"
With this statement, what neither Su Lun nor she had cared about suddenly became somewhat uncomfortable.
Mr. Jing was also somewhat helpless with her quirky little sister.
To respond or not to respond, that was the question.
It was an unintentional act, so there's nothing to mind or not mind.
Su Lun felt he was in the wrong, but since Mr. Jing said nothing, he didn't take it to heart. Instead, he glanced at Pestoya with annoyance, pinched her face, and stretched it out long.
With that pinch, Pestoya indeed fell for it, and with a grimace, she clambered onto his neck, "Ah... you despicable Su Lun, you pinched my face again, I'm going to strangle you!"
...
Old Lington was once Duke Raphael's secret mine. After the ambitious Duke's restoration and subsequent sudden death upon ascending the throne, the place was taken over by the Lance family. Later, when Yekaterina became the Imperial Emperor, it became a part of the empire.
Old Lington's residents used to be slaves brought in by the Raphael family. Now, with the United Empire abolishing both slavery and the lordship system, it has become a special administrative district of the United Empire.
Old Lington was originally a mine, rich in various minerals and ancient relics. It also had a wealth of abyssal products and ancient relics due to its existence as a dimensional gateway for countless years.
What attracted adventurers most was "Dawn Relic," the legendary city left behind by the Alchemical Demigod Sir Isaac.
Therefore, after Old Lington opened up to the outside, it drew countless adventurers to seek fortune there.
However, due to the dimensional wars, the United Empire almost controlled all long-distance ships. The regular cruises from Ruying to Old Lington, which used to depart every few days, suddenly stopped, and only a few warships were able to travel back and forth. Old Lington had almost returned to its former state of isolation.
Luckily, Su Lun's Spatial Ability allowed him to travel anywhere, so he didn't plan on wasting time searching for any ships. With a series of teleports, he soon arrived at Black Fort Reef.
In the past, to keep it a secret, Duke Raphael had disguised the black tower on this sea-island with just an inconspicuous fortress. But now, it had changed dramatically.
From a distance, Su Lun and Mr. Jing looked towards the war fortress that bristled with cannons like a hedgehog, their expressions slightly altered.
They had once broken out of the Black Tower and fought a great battle with the pirates of the Northern Sea Fleet's Third Fleet right here. Back then, Su Lun was just a little Level 2 professional, and fighting a group of pirates was fraught with dangers. But now, upon his return, he was already Level 8.
Revisiting the old place, some memories unconsciously resurfaced.
Back then, Su Lun remembered mustering his courage to go back and "rescue" Mr. Jing. Afterwards, the two encountered a storm at sea and drifted for many days before they met Jick and his father, who were on their way to Blizzard City to trade in furs.
Clearly, Mr. Jing remembered it too, as if shadows flickered in her eyes, she said with a slight sense of emotion, "It's been a few years since I've been back, this place has changed a lot."
Su Lun raised an eyebrow and also said, "Yes. I wonder how Old Lington is doing now."
He didn't plan on alerting anyone, and with a pinch of his sorcerer's seal, a spatial rift appeared before them.
The two of them stepped through it.
The next moment, they found themselves surrounded by towering high-rises and a bustling scene.
This was the Inner City of Old Lington.
The tall Black Tower stood in the center of the city, with alchemical light sources illuminating this underground metropolis. High walls separated the Inner City from the Outer City, and the cake-like layout of districts 1~8 featured futuristic style blue glass skyscrapers, as well as those smokestacks hundreds of meters tall billowing with white smoke...
Everything was very familiar.
Although the Northern Sea Fleet had plundered a lot of wealth from Old Lington, the city's foundation remained unharmed, and the underground city had long since returned to its former prosperity.
The streets were bustling with people and lively cries of peddlers filled the air.
Due to its development in isolation, the Inner City of Old Lington possessed a unique prosperity that was no less than any other city.
Most of the old acquaintances had already rushed out, so there wasn't much to miss.
Su Lun and Mr. Jing did not stay long in the Inner City. Another teleport and they were already outside the walls of the Inner City.
Unlike before, the Outer City had undergone tremendous changes.
The once dilapidated scenery no longer existed; numerous high-rise buildings had sprung up.
After the abolition of slavery and the lordship system, everyone in Old Lington became citizens of the empire. Free from exorbitant taxes and exploitation, the wealth adventurers risked their lives for was now enough for them to live prosperously.
Old Lington was the birthplace of neural-mechanical technology, and the various mechanical augmentation industries here were very developed.
On the streets, one could see adventurers with modified mechanical prosthetics everywhere. By their accents, many were even foreigners from Mafa.
Also because of the top-notch technology from the Mafa passed on, mechanical prosthetics in Old Lington now had a breath of fresh air, with various mechanical technologies undergoing qualitative leaps in their research and development. On the streets, various mechanical modification shops could be seen everywhere.
Su Lun was going to pick up number 88 from Ginkgo Street, in the southern part of the city.
Seeing such great changes in Old Lington, they were in no rush, taking the opportunity for a nostalgic trip, walking and sightseeing along the way.
The two walked on the street, witnessing all kinds of magically modified motorcycles roaring and speeding along the road, while the shops on both sides were bustling with activity.
The outer city, once a scene of war and slums, was now completely different, looking like a normal city.
However, as they walked, they also overheard some other news.
"I thought we poor people could finally have a good life, but I didn't expect the newly appointed governor to reinstate the old lordship system just a few months into his tenure."
"Yeah. The taxes are so high, and the treasures obtained from hunting in the wild have to be sold to the Town Lord's office first. This way, fewer and fewer adventurers and merchants from other places will come..."
"What outsiders will come now? Haven't you seen the cruise ships are all being controlled? And the Alchemy Academy, which the empire said our commoner children could also attend, has that not been abolished now? Looking at the situation, that governor wants to monopolize alchemy knowledge as before, confining us for generations of servitude."
"Wasn't it said that the empire has abolished nobility and slavery, and that we have all been granted amnesty from servitude? The law says we are free people, allowed to go wherever we want..."
"Heh, you believe what those noble lords say? They claim it's to prepare materials for the great war, but anyone with clear eyes knows those guys are just amassing wealth for themselves, no different from the former Duke Raphael."
"Shh... keep your voice down. Don't you know the identity of the governor we trust? Be careful what you say privately, or you might bring trouble upon yourself."
"What identity?"
"You don't know that the lord governor is Master Merlin's youngest son? Master Merlin is the strongest profession holder in the empire. It's said that because of his illustrious military achievements, His Majesty the Emperor granted Old Lington as a fief to their family..."
"..."
Su Lun and Mr. Jing walked on the street, without deliberately inquiring, but also roughly learned the current situation of Old Lington from bits and pieces of conversations among the adventurers.
It seems that Master Merlin, relying on his position as the court's premier minister, requested the position of Old Lington's governor from the council.
And then, this new lord named Alvin Gregory, upon his arrival, began to show signs of reverting to the old autocratic lordship system.
But after all, a large portion of the adventurers in Old Lington now were outsiders, who had seen the freedom of other systems, and naturally were full of complaints against such oppression.
On hearing this, Su Lun realized something with a hint of surprise, "The United Empire now has a new ninth-grade?"
Mr. Jing nodded, "Mm. I've been in the Mafa recently and only heard about a new ninth-grade ascender, but I haven't seen him. According to the information from the Jing Organization in Lington, this Merlin minister once served as a royal guard for Prince Carnap, a strong veteran of the eighth-grade, who ascended to ninth-grade half a year ago and is now the court's first minister."
Speaking of this, she added, "Anyone who advances to ninth-grade in their profession won't lack in strength or talent. But it seems he's a supporter of the 'old faction' that's pro-nobility. The intelligence from Lington indicates that this Merlin Gregory doesn't quite get along with the new policies and seems to be wielding his power too independently. But given his strength, no one dares to speak against him. And looking at it now, that's indeed the case."
"..."
Su Lun also revealed a rather wry smile upon hearing this.
Another ninth-grade is a good thing, but a ninth-grade not aligned with the rest poses a big problem.
This guy stationed his own son in Old Lington as the governor, clearly had his own ulterior motives.
Being far from the Ruying mainland, even if a great war broke out, it would be hard for it to reach here. That Master Merlin probably wanted to secure a backup plan for his descendants.
But knowing this, there was nothing they could do.
Su Lun could imagine someone as astute as Yekaterina probably also had a headache over this.
A ninth-grade isn't really something you can't do anything about, but at this juncture, internal conflict was to be avoided.
The empire's first minister represented the highest combat power of the empire, and any situation involving Master Merlin would bring significant negative impact.
At this moment, Mr. Jing spoke again, "Moreover... there is intelligence pointing out that some of the people from the old faction supporting Merlin Gregory have close ties with the Tianmu Sect. However, without concrete evidence, it's premature to draw conclusions."
"Oh?"
Upon hearing this, Su Lun's brows furrowed.
Exploiting one's position for personal gain can at most be considered selfish.
But if there's an involvement with the Tianmu Sect, that is... treason.
Su Lun's eyes darkened as he speculated, "Senior Sister, could it be that the ambush you encountered and the joint fleet's ambush are the schemes of these people behind the scenes?"
Mr. Jing didn't rush to a conclusion and said indifferently, "It's hard to say."
But after walking a few steps, she added, "Now that things here are settled, I'm going to visit Lingdun. By then, whatever the situation is, we'll find out."
"Hmm."
Su Lun heard the profound meaning beneath the calm tone.
If the rear isn't handled properly, and things like his ambush or the joint fleet's ambush happen a few more times, they wouldn't need to fight the plane war; they'd collapse from within first.
However, the two of them didn't talk much more about it.
To others, a ninth-order is indeed a ceiling-level power.
But in their eyes, it isn't an insurmountable trouble.
The current Dawn Group is much stronger than a newly promoted ninth-order.
If Master Merlin truly harbors ill intentions, even if he is ninth-order, they wouldn't leave such a hidden danger unchecked.
...
Su Lun and his companion traveled via a combination of walking and teleportation, and soon they reached the location of Ginkgo Street in their memory.
In an Old Lington with alchemy and various mechanical prosthetics, naturally, there's nothing to say about the speed of urban development.
Even Su Lun, who had once lived on this street, couldn't recognize it; high buildings were densely packed everywhere, and the street was far busier than before.
Luckily, the house numbers hadn't changed, so the two walked along the street and Su Lun immediately spotted the small western-style building at number 88 still standing there.
This is, after all, a "haunted house."
Su Lun wasn't in a hurry to arrive for the reason that he knew the cursed space here couldn't be dealt with by anyone.
Except for someone like him who took a shortcut, knowing the name of the grudge master in the cursed space and chanting it to come out, it is definitely a "T-level" space for others.
After all, the "Living Corpse Research Journal" from the second-floor safe had been taken out by him, and whoever searched later would never know the name of the grudge master. If someone tried to go to the morgue on the third floor below, Su Lun reckoned that even a seventh-order professional might not make it out alive.
This dilapidated small western-style building looked out of place among the new buildings.
Su Lun and his companion paused in front of the small western-style house, and at that moment, a little boy wearing a duckbill cap and with a cigarette box hanging around his neck immediately came up to them, asking enthusiastically, "Sir, would you like to buy some cigarettes?"
As he spoke, he saw Mr. Jing and couldn't help but exclaim, "Oh, you are the most beautiful lady I have ever seen."
Mr. Jing smiled slightly upon hearing this.
Even if her wide-brimmed hat concealed her stunning face, her ethereal aura still caught the boy's eye. However, she carried an innate Mirror Domain with her; if she didn't want to be seen, then she wouldn't be.
Su Lun didn't smoke, but charmed by the compliment and after glancing at the price tag, he took out a 100 Liso bill and bought a box of cigarettes.
The duckbill cap kid happily accepted the money, but seeing the two's interest in the house, he warned, "Are you adventurers from outside? Forgive my forwardness, but this is a haunted house. If you're looking to rent, I'd recommend Norton Street up ahead; it has Old Lingdun's best bathhouses."
Su Lun smiled, "Hmm. We're just looking around."
The boy didn't say much more and left with a polite smile, "I wish both of you the best of luck."
Su Lun didn't miss the familiar cross emblem on the boy's chest, and watching the boy's retreating figure, he beamed, "So the 'Cross Society' is still around."
Norton Street is the heartland of the Cross Society, and Qian Jiao was once the big sister of that street. This kid was drumming up business for his gang's territory.
Mr. Jing also displayed a faint smile upon hearing this, "Indeed."

chapters.title: Chapter 605 - 604: The Dream God's Reflection
chapters.content:
Su Lun and Mr. Jing entered the small building at 88 Green Street.
Only upon entering did he realize that the furniture and decorations were almost exactly the same as when he lived there a few years ago. However, it seemed that no one had cleaned the place in a long time, as a thick layer of dust had accumulated, and a faint musty smell wafted through the air.
"Senior sister, wait here for me a moment; I'm going to take a trip to the cursed space."
"Mhm."
Mr. Jing stayed on the first floor while Su Lun headed straight for the basement.
Perhaps because it was a "haunted house," someone had locked a thick iron chain across the basement door.
Su Lun raised his hand and with a flick of his finger like a sword, a spatial crack appeared, and the arm-thick iron chain instantly had a smooth cut, clattering to the ground.
He walked inside.
This place had once been used as a bank vault, with thick concrete walls on all sides.
Although it was pitch-black, Su Lun could still clearly see some bullet hole marks on the walls—remnants from when he practiced his shooting here.
With the Second Awakening of the All-knowing Eye, the cursed space that had previously been invisible was now clearly visible to him.
Su Lun murmured, "So it's a physical manifestation of consciousness after all..."
Entering this "Havier's Mortuary of Resentment" cursed space was quite unique; one could only be absorbed into it if they became conscious that this basement was a cursed space while inside it.
He just took one glance, and the surroundings suddenly changed, turning into a hospital corridor.
The walls around him were painted white, with iron chairs outside the consultation rooms and no windows; the air carried the faint scent of disinfectant.
There was no one around, and the environment exuded an eerie vibe that could send one's thoughts into reckless disarray.
During his first visit, Su Lun had discovered the pattern: if he controlled his thoughts and refrained from imagining things, no monsters would appear.
His mind calm as still water, he saw no danger on the third floor and went straight for the stairs.
He took a casual stroll on the second floor, finding the previously secured safe containing the "Zombie Research Report" now empty. There was nothing else, aside from the residual thoughts of some unfortunate souls who had wandered into this space by mistake. As for the monsters conjured from the deceased's fantasies, the strongest were merely at the level of thirds and fourths tiers, which Su Lun easily dispatched.
He returned to the stairwell and descended one more level to reach the mortuary.
Here, there was no light, and a thick stench of death wafted up from the darkness below.
It was as if this was the entrance to hell, with some unknown terror monster lurking in the dark.
"Not weak at all."
Su Lun's eyes shone brightly as he glanced once and remained composed.
He descended the stairs with steady steps.
Having taken only a few steps down, suddenly a black shadow charged at him like lightning.
Dragon scales flickered on Su Lun's arm as he raised his hand and threw a punch. The rune-covered living corpse was immediately sent flying and crashed into the wall with a "thud."
"Chekhov truly deserves his reputation as the creator of the Living Corpse Secret Technique; this living corpse's rank is really high..."
Su Lun looked at the runes drawn on the surface of the corpse and commented inwardly.
This was a living corpse whose strength was comparable to a seventh-tier profession. But since it lacked things like aura and domain, its sheer power posed little threat to top-tier professionals.
Such living corpses, despite their strength, would be enough to kill the vast majority of intruders.
Su Lun continued down, encountering a few more rune-engraved living corpses, but they were almost all killed with a single punch.
After all, he had already stepped into the eighth tier, and there weren't many beings that could pose a fatal threat to him anymore. The upper limit of this cursed space was affected by the plane's influence, ensuring that its power could not be too outlandish, no matter how strong.
Reaching the end of the stairs, he found the mortuary.
Upon descending, the scent of the living stirred the thick miasma of death. With a "clang, clang, clang," rows of iron boxes on the walls opened one after another, and one living corpse after another of various forms sprang out.
These horrific undead monsters climbed out, and the atmosphere instantly fell into place.
However, Su Lun hardly gave a second glance at these living corpses that posed little threat to him, instead focusing his attention on the dissection table separated by a transparent curtain in the center.
There lay a half-human, half-spider creature, intently dissecting a mangled corpse.
The name that appeared upon identification was "Deformed Tillmido M. Chekhov," a seven-tier dark gold level oddity.
The eight-armed spider lance was indeed one of the most suitable alchemical grafts for medical professionals, and this Chekhov had also merged with a high-tier spider lance graft, turning into this spider form after the mutation.
With the All-knowing Eye, Su Lun identified all the attributes of the monster, aware that it was a purely irrational deformed creature.
Therefore, he couldn't just talk his way out; he had to overpower and kill it.
The moment he faced the creature, Su Lun charged forward like lightning and appeared right in front of the spider monster, bringing his black sickle down in a swift slash.
A "swoosh" sounded as the muscle tissue was sliced open, and the giant spider was instantly cleaved in two.
By now, Su Lun's understanding of the death principle had reached a very high level, and the ordinary power of "Xiupunos's Night Sickle" was enough to inflict heavy damage on most seven-tier professionals.
A one-hit kill was the logical outcome.
However, he had not expected his cleave to cut the spider monster in half, only for it to instantly recover as if nothing had happened.
Simultaneously, countless sharp spider lances counter-attacked.
It hadn't suffered any damage at all.
Su Lun's eyes narrowed slightly, and he quickly figured out the trick: "Fantasy realization, the source is indeed here... This ability is truly outrageous."
The second scan with the All-knowing Eye revealed the true nature of "Chekhov's" recovery.
It wasn't recovery on a physical level, but a kind of dream ability where fantasy becomes reality.
In other words, the scene that Chekhov "imagined" was what would actually occur.
If it imagined itself to be undying, it would be undying.
At least for most people, even if they were stronger than "Chekhov," in this cursed space, its ability to make fantasies real was utterly inescapable. The monster couldn't be killed, and there was no way out; all that remained was despair.
But Su Lun was not at all afraid, for there were no secrets in the entire space to his eyes.
Whatever "Chekhov" could imagine, it had to be within its own understanding.
Mr. Jing had said that while alive, Chekhov's level was around tier seven, and its understanding of laws was definitely not as high as Su Lun's now.
Facing the sharp spider lances, Su Lun did not even attempt to dodge.
His dragon-marked golden body was augmented by a nine-tier indomitable strength that might not even be broken by a blow from a tier above, let alone the attack he currently faced.
"Ding," "ding," "ding"...
The spider lances struck against Su Lun's body with a brittle sound but did not cause even the slightest injury.
Seeing this, Su Lun swung his black sickle again; this time, the sickle was accompanied by the Space Law, empowered by the "Urobolos Space-Time Ring."
Su Lun had seen that the source of this cursed space was a very special seal. Any attack not above the plane of the space law itself was ineffective against this "Chekhov."
But no matter how high of a tier, none surpassed the Ring!
As expected, this slash did not allow the spider monster's body to recover.
Killing the main source of resentment was the most direct way to break the cursed space.
But apart from Su Lun, there were few who could kill this "Chekhov." Not to mention whether others could see through the true nature of this space, but also whether they had attack means above the plane of this space's law.
As the source of resentment died, the space around them began to show signs of collapse.
Su Lun, in no hurry, reached out his hand and collected all the stacks of documents in the morgue.
On these documents were certainly the crucial finale to the "Research Notes on the Living Dead."
The space around began to collapse, slowly coalescing into a red gemstone ring.
This was the most vital energy source supporting this cursed space.
Indeed, it was a "sealing item".
And its grade was extremely high!
[Dream God's Contemplation (Lesser Divine Artifact Fragment)]
Description: Who can be certain that their life isn't just one in a dream? Yours, or someone else's dream.
Cursed Properties: Made from the magic crystal of the Dragon of Dreams, this is a divine alchemy fragment of a special ring capable of entering others' dreams, having a powerful illusory effect; actively releasing 'Infinite Dreamscape,' it can cause all targets within range to fall into a dreamscape; Illusion Penetration +350%, Spiritual Art Penetration +70%; Within the dreamscape, time, space, and rules are comprised of your perceptions, in the dream space, you are the creator of all; Users who haven't mastered the ring's equivalent abilities of time, space, and illusions, will sink into the dream.
Explanation: The dreamscape contains a special universal law, having its own time, space, and logic, in the dreamscape, you possess the divine power of creation; if you understand the world enough, then you can use this ring to make your dreams (fragmented) come true;
...
The space around twisted into a vortex and disappeared entirely in just a few breaths.
Su Lun found himself back in the pitch-dark basement once more.
He had initially only planned to obtain the materials for the follow-up to the Research Notes on the Living Dead, but he never expected to stumble upon such a ring.
Even though it was incomplete, it was the strongest cursed item related to "illusion techniques" he'd ever seen, bar none.
However, what shocked him more than the ring's powerful illusory effects was one of its additional functions.
It was information he himself could not comprehend.
"Dreams coming true? Illusion manifesting? Is this... a creator-like ability?"
Su Lun looked on in disbelief.
There wasn't much left in this realm that he couldn't understand, and yet now he'd encountered another such thing.
Without much hesitation, he raised his hand and imagined a scene with a water ball in his grasp.
And at that very thought, the gemstone on the ring flashed, and a miraculous scene immediately unfolded.
He watched as a water ball, the size of a fist, condensed within his palm!
"Can it really be?!"
An expression of amazement spread across Su Lun's face.
Although forming a water ball could be achieved with the simplest of alchemy, what baffled him was that there was no process of water element gathering just now.
This water ball was precisely what he had imagined in his mind, then created out of thin air with the ring!
Although the outcome of "forming a water ball" was the same, the process was utterly different.
Creation out of nothing, this was a power only legendary deities were supposed to possess!
This was even in contradiction to the principle of equivalent exchange in alchemy.
In that instant, even Su Lun himself felt that something wasn't quite right.
If the principle of equivalent exchange had collapsed, it would be tantamount to the collapse of his worldview.
But almost immediately, he noticed the anomaly and hastily exclaimed in his mind, "No! The ring's illusory creation still follows the principle of equivalent exchange, it's just that this ring utilizes a higher form of equivalent exchange..."
The intense desire for knowledge drove Su Lun to look further with his All-knowing Eye, delving deeper and a flood of information entered his mind.
He wanted to see more clearly, but clearly, that understanding was far beyond what he could comprehend at the moment.
Suddenly, his eyes began to feel dry and sore, Su Lun only felt his vision was seeing double.
Yet, his face showed a hint of joy.
Although his body couldn't bear the burden of that surge of super-tier knowledge, at this moment, he understood something else: "This imagined creation actually points to the same thing as the world creation in the 'Netherworld Deathly Novel.' Could this be the method gods use to create worlds?"
Su Lun seemed thoughtful.
Novel world... Dream world... Creation... Imagination made real... Equivalent exchange of energy conversion...
A flash of insight crossed his mind, and he felt as if he saw a lighthouse guiding him toward that super-tier domain.
Su Lun possessed an understanding ability that surpassed those of lower beings, and this super-tier power was clearer to him than to anyone else.
This was also a great opportunity.
It was a path leading beyond the ninth tier, and once it was traversed, unimaginable rewards were certain to be gained.
However, this was just an idea, and there was still a long way to go before it could take shape.
Su Lun tried again, and with his current abilities, he could only create something as simple as a water sphere.
At that moment, probably because his own aura was a bit chaotic, another figure suddenly appeared in the basement.
It was Mr. Jing.
She looked at Su Lun, whose pupils were dilated, and expressed concern, "Something went wrong?"
Su Lun shook his head and pointed at the ring in his hand. Before he could speak, Mr. Jing recognized it: "[Dream God's Thought]? This ring is actually here."
Su Lun curiously asked, "Senior sister, you know about this ring?"
"Mm."
Mr. Jing nodded.
In an instant, she understood why Su Lun was in such a state and added, "This is a piece of a Divine Artifact that my father once found in a battlefield of gods. I remember him saying that this ring contains a kind of super-tier illusion ability that only gods can master. You better be careful. Delving too deep into that kind of power might trap you in a dream..."
"Mm."
Su Lun nodded, knowing he had to be cautious.
He had only glimpsed at it a moment ago and hadn't expected such a heavy burden.
[Havier's Resentment Morgue] had completely vanished, and the two of them walked out of the cottage at number 88. The curse in the basement had been lifted, and it would no longer be a "haunted house."
The two walked on the street, and Su Lun asked, "Senior sister, shall we head to Dawn Relic next?"
"Mm."
Mr. Jing nodded and said, "I also need to retrieve a few items that are crucial to my strength, as well as my ninth-tier rig."
....
Before long, Su Lun and his companion had left the city.
Since Old Lington was opened up, it had welcomed many adventurers from the outside world.
Now, many people were exploring the underground world, and all along the way, you could see various wasteland hunting teams wearing gas masks.
However, due to a major wasteland hunting operation a few years ago, a Fallen Angel manipulated Duke Raphael's Princess Teresa to attack the plane's passage seal, causing a massive leak of Abyssal energy and lifting the law's upper limit. Now, the mutated monsters in the underground of Old Lington were much stronger than before.
Even along the way, you could encounter fifth and sixth-tier mutated monsters, so that only the stronger, large adventure groups could venture deep into the underground.
And because Old Lington was a closed environment, the increasingly thick dark spiritual power towards the depths was unfriendly to outsiders, causing mutations with the slightest carelessness.
However, for Su Lun and Mr. Jing, such a dense environment of dark spiritual power not only had no effect on them but was actually quite beneficial.
They teleported downwards, not even disturbing the mutated monsters, and quickly reached deep underground.
The Dawn Relic had become a sea of dark spiritual power.
What they didn't expect, however, was that there were already people inside the Storm Manor.

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - 641: The 5th Notebook
chapters.content:
Su Lun and Mr. Jing arrived at the Dawn Relic and looked at the lights in the Storm Manor, thinking they were some high-level Scavengers.
They didn't plan to disturb them.
After all, this relic was the wealth of all in the Alchemy plane, and anyone could come to scavenge and search for treasures.
However, as the two approached, they realized something was amiss.
Su Lun let out a soft exclamation, "Huh... is there such a strong spatial fluctuation?"
His perception of space had become extremely sensitive.
At a glance, he could see that the spatial fluctuations near Storm Manor were far different from other places.
Mr. Jing, upon hearing this, carefully sensed his surroundings and also frowned deeply, "It seems someone has linked the spatial power of the planar portal here... It appears they are setting up some kind of formation."
A dangerous gleam appeared in Su Lun's eyes as he instantly guessed what was happening and sneered, "Heh heh... Such a vast amount of energy is needed, it seems someone is setting up an ultra-long-distance teleportation array."
If it were the people from Old Lington coming to scavenge, they would certainly not waste an astronomical amount of resources to construct any teleportation arrays.
Even the main base at Luying had no need, as the carrying capacity of their ships was sufficient.
Therefore, seeing someone constructing a large teleportation array here, he immediately thought of some ill-intentioned people causing trouble.
He had once seen the ultra-long-distance teleportation arrays of the Divine plane in the waters of Dragon Country, which required a massive supply of energy, and those people used the "Rainbow Spring," a magical power source. But once constructed, it could transport tens of thousands in a mage troop.
Other places did not have conditions like the Rainbow Spring, but here they did.
Because the Dawn Relic had a "planar portal" that led to the Abyssal plane!
The planar portal itself had a self-circulating, majestic spatial energy, enough to support cross-planar teleportation. It was a perfect source for a teleportation array. Extracting just one billionth was enough to construct a large teleportation array within the same plane.
Upon hearing Su Lun say this, Mr. Jing recalled the multiple sentry posts they had encountered on their way here and commented indifferently, "So the checkpoints earlier were not to prevent low-level professionals from rashly approaching the Dawn Relic but to prevent the secret from being exposed. These guys really did think of everything."
Su Lun also connected all the clues in his head.
Nowadays, there are many high-level monsters in the Dawn Relic, and the death rate is very high for professionals below rank six. They had encountered several checkpoints before and thought they were meant to prevent low-level Scavengers from coming to their deaths.
But now it seemed that they actually served as early warning checkpoints.
If the two of them hadn't teleported here without alerting the sentries, the people here would have been forewarned.
Su Lun said with a grim expression, "Are the people from the Governor's Mansion colluding with those from the Divine plane in secret?"
A fierce light appeared in Mr. Jing's eyes as well, "Even if they aren't directly colluding, there must be some special channels that have allowed people from the Divine plane to come here."
It was also a stroke of luck that they happened upon this; otherwise, if there were a large teleportation array that led directly to the back of Luying, it would be a never-ending hidden danger.
This trend had to be nipped in the bud.
Su Lun said indifferently, "Kill a few, and we'll know."
At this critical juncture, setting up an ultra-long-distance teleportation array, no matter who it was, killing them wouldn't be a mistake.
...
Storm Manor had been refurbished once during a collective scavenging operation a few years ago, and it still looked lavish after several years.
Su Lun and Mr. Jing quietly approached and also discovered many clever magic traps around the manor.
But with the All-knowing Eye, even the hidden traps were plainly visible.
In Su Lun's eyes, he saw layer upon layer of magical runes, and his heart was already certain of something, "The magical restrictions of the Divine plane..."
These prohibitions were not part of the alchemy system but the magic system, so the identities of these people were clear; there was no need to ask. It would be better to just kill them and search their souls.
In his soul perception, there were about two to three hundred people in the manor.
Su Lun also guessed where these people had come from.
When the planar portal was first connected, there was no blockade at sea, and a group of an unknown number of mages slipped into the heart of Luying.
Although most of them went to the waters of Dragon Country and were finished off by the Dawn Group,
a small portion still dispersed throughout Luying.
Fortunately, the strongest among them back then were only seventh rank mage conductors, not too great a threat.
Su Lun and Mr. Jing observed silently from the shadows outside the manor for a moment when suddenly they exchanged glances, and an unspoken understanding passed between them.
Almost simultaneously, their figures vanished from the spot.
One used a spatial technique, while the other used mirror teleportation.
Su Lun made a beeline for the underground space with the most soul fluctuations, instantly moving there just in time to see dozens of mages constructing a space magic array, drawing magical runes, and drawing spatial energy from a dimensional gateway into a nine-pointed star magic circle.
Seeing a stranger suddenly appear in the basement, the expressions of the group of mages all turned to astonishment.
Before they could react, a shadow of the Reaper appeared behind Su Lun, and he released his domain in a wide range.
The black domain that signified Death quickly spread, instantly engulfing the basement's magical light sources. Wherever it passed, the mages fell down in droves.
Su Lun did not give these people a chance to activate the magical alarm; with a swing of his black scythe, the only seventh-tier magic guide on the scene was instantly decapitated.
But in the blink of an eye, not one of the dozens of mages showed any signs of life.
Looking at the dozens of "grey mists," Su Lun harvested them in one sweep.
After sorting through the information he had gathered, all the conspiracies became clear.
"Unicorn Whale Chamber of Commerce, Marquis Soldo..."
Su Lun mentally separated several key figures.
As he had suspected, the dozens of men who died were the first batch of mages to enter the dimensional gateway.
Their mission was to assist the "Heavenly God Sect" in infiltrating Luying and control the big shots of the Alchemy plane. Then, using those people's resources, they would search for various resources and ancient treasures.
Subsequently, Lucien Pepys Grandmaster decisively abandoned the Mafa political power and established a joint empire with Luying. Then he blocked the strait, which halted the invasion efforts of the fellows from the Heavenly God plane.
Without a large fleet of warships, those fellows from the Heavenly God plane simply could not breach Luying Main Island in a short time, prompting them to consider establishing a raid via a teleportation circle to the Luying rear.
Hence the secret mission involving the use of Old Lington's dimensional gateway to establish a teleportation circle came to be.
Fortunately, this group of mages did not have too many high-tier individuals and materials were scarce, so the progress of establishing the magic circle was not fast, and it would still take at least half a month to be successful.
...
"Those big shots at the Governor's Mansion have a bit of a peculiar relationship with those people from the Heavenly God plane..."
Su Lun also felt they were lucky to have stumbled upon this conspiracy that could have brought grave danger to the Alchemy plane.
Moreover, the Reaper's soul-separation ability allowed him to directly obtain a wealth of intelligence.
Although there was no direct evidence to prove that the Old Lington Governor's Mansion, controlled by the family of Master Merlin, was colluding with the "All-seeing Eye Sect," so many mages entering the Black Tower through the Chamber of Commerce must be condoned by some higher-ups.
This was also in line with Mr. Jing's previous speculation that some of the imperial elites were preparing their own way out.
They didn't cozy up to the people of the Heavenly God plane, but they also didn't refuse or offend them. By utilizing this ambiguous attitude to hedge their bets, they maximized their own interests.
"Looks like when I head to Lington, I'll need to eradicate the All-seeing Eye Sect... this malignant tumor as soon as possible," Su Lun said, a flash of severity crossing his face.
The man had already vanished from the spot.
Mr. Jing and Pestoya upstairs had also already killed most of the people, and Su Lun came up to finish off a few more.
He also rooted out a few assassins, concealing themselves with no trace, and got rid of them.
A portion of the people upstairs were members of the sect, and after the harvest, more intelligence was pieced together.
Soon after, the three met in the manor.
Mr. Jing asked, "How is it?"
Su Lun replied, "Pretty much as expected."
He recounted all the intelligence he had harvested before.
After listening, Mr. Jing said, "After we finish up here, when we go back to Old Lington, we will take care of the secret bases of both the Governor's Mansion and the All-seeing Eye Sect."
"Mm."
Su Lun nodded his head, that was indeed his intention.
Old Lington's geographical position was peculiar, and if it turned out that Luying Mainland really couldn't be held, the Alchemy civilization would inevitably move westward.
Old Lington and the four countries of the Northern Continent would all be important rear areas, and they absolutely could not let those fellows infiltrate beforehand.
Having resolved such a significant hidden danger, both Su Lun and Mr. Jing inexplicably let out a sigh of relief.
That's when Su Lun then asked, "Sister, where is the thing you were looking for?"
Mr. Jing gestured towards the ruins in the distance, saying, "It's in the city center, that dimensional gateway."
Su Lun: "Do you need my help?"
"Not for the moment."
Mr. Jing gave a slight smile and added, "If I do, I'll call you."
With that, her figure turned into mirror light and vanished on the spot.
With nothing else to do, Su Lun collected the spoils from the corpses and then teleported back to the teleportation circle in the basement he had used before.
The materials required to construct such a long-distance teleportation circle were worth a fortune, with various spatial gemstones and Demon Cores piled on the ground and a huge Crystal Core at the center of the Formation.
It was quite a small fortune.
After doing all this, he seemed to have nothing to do.
Su Lun and Pestoia began to wander around the estate.
He remembered that on his first day in this world, it was right here, in the study of the third room to the left of the entrance, where he had narrowly escaped being killed by Bald Ivan.
Pestoia transformed into a ghostly child and floated all around the estate, which had been her home for more than a thousand years.
Su Lun had an idea and headed underground.
After the first intersection, left, left, right, up, down...
Even to his now eighth-level vision, these were very clever mechanisms.
It didn't take long for him to find the altar where he had once acquired two S-rank talents.
It looked exactly as it had at first.
Around the original altar stood five cloaked stone sculptures, and behind the cloak of each, a special symbol was inscribed: ⍥, §, ☽, ✹, ꧧ.
The five statues were now covered in web-like cracks and had lost their supernatural power, becoming ordinary stone sculptures.
He had obtained the ꧧ representing wisdom and the ☽ representing death.
Su Lun looked at the statue with the § on its back, the symbol representing destiny.
After all these years, he too marveled at the wonders of fate.
The more he understood this world, the more he marveled and murmured, "Sir Isaac was indeed no ordinary Demigod..."
Now it seemed that everything the Demigod left for future generations was deeply schemed.
Whether it was Mr. Jing, Pestoia, Pandora... or those five notes.
It was as though he had foreseen some major catastrophe a thousand years ago and made all the preparations within his power, linked together by a chain called cause and effect.
Su Lun now had four of the notes in his possession.
But there was absolutely no information on the fifth, not even Mr. Jing knew.
He had come here to see if there was any clue to the fifth note.
Like the information that had been identified, each note had the hint, "This is a note tinged with destiny."
He was now more convinced than ever that Sir Isaac would not have allowed the fifth note to be lost.
After obtaining the four notes, his intuition told him that the fifth should be somewhere in the Dawn Relic.
Looking at the few statues, a special luster flickered in Su Lun's eyes, revealing an indifference as if he had seen through the vicissitudes of the world, now possessing the two-resolved All-knowing Eye.
At that moment, he saw every secret within the room laid bare before him.
Indeed!
As Su Lun began to search the altar inch by inch for any hidden mechanisms, suddenly, he saw some abnormal threads of laws in his eyes.
"Eh..."
A light exclamation in his heart was accompanied by great surprise.
Discovering abnormalities meant that there really was something hidden here.
"What a clever method..."
Looking at those threads of laws, Su Lun sighed inwardly.
Had he not possessed the All-knowing Eye with two resolutions, he believed that even a ninth-level professional would probably not notice anything unusual.
Whatever was hidden using such a method must be tied to some earth-shattering secret!
Su Lun had not felt such anticipation for a long time, and he began to slowly try to decipher those threads of cosmic rules.
Extremely complex, they were the top encryption methods in the field of alchemy.
This seemed like a sort of test.
If one was not well-versed in alchemy, even upon discovery, it would be difficult to decode.
Su Lun also guessed that this was probably Sir Isaac's way of preventing his notes from being taken by those who were not magicians.
The encryption was extremely challenging, but for Su Lun now, it wasn't a big problem.
It could be said that if he couldn't decode it, probably no one else on this plane could.
Before long, those threads of rules were completely decoded, and Su Lun saw a black-covered notebook floating before his eyes and joyfully said to himself, "It's really here!"
He already had four of them in his hands and recognized this as the fifth notebook, the identification showing its name as "Isaac's Alchemy Manuscript V"!
...
Su Lun reached out to take the notebook, barely able to contain his excitement anymore.
He opened the notebook, and lines of powerful, vigorous text caught his eyes.
"Congratulations, if you have obtained this, my last manuscript, then you must be a person favored by destiny. This notebook records my understanding of the ultimate reality of this world, at the time I wrote these words. It may not point to the truth, but if my superficial knowledge can help you open some paths to understanding this world, then all the better..."
"The meaning of alchemy is to seek the truth of the universe. When you carefully observe the world, you will find that all matter has opposites, such as light and dark, life and death, war and peace, decay and growth, heat and cold, chaos and stability, and so on. It is as if the universe has a special rule that ensures everything has its opposing side, without exception."
"This topic is too profound, to the extent that we humans may spend our lifetimes and still not fully glimpse its entirety. Of course, I mention this not to explain the lengthy results of my research but to give you a more accurate concept of the contents of this manuscript I left behind. Like the previous four, this notebook is still a type of alchemic transmutation equipment that uses the special cosmic rules I discovered."
"After delving into this discovery, I had a bold speculation. If everything has its opposing and restraining side, then... what about that so-called divine power? Yes, even divine power can be restrained."
"..."
Su Lun read every word in the manuscript seriously.
Simple descriptions of phenomena were stirring tumultuous waves in his heart.
When he read this passage, Su Lun immediately thought of one person: Pandora!
He had carefully studied the alchemic body before and had understood most of it. But he still didn't understand why Pandora could steal faith and restrain divine power.
However, upon seeing this sentence in the notebook, he instantly realized that he was about to discover a shocking secret that would unravel his confusion.
Su Lun couldn't wait to continue reading.
The more he read, the more the shock in his eyes lingered.
As these segments of text entered into his sight, a whole new world unfolded before him.
"Oh, before that, I should explain the concept of 'rule'. It is a description of a kind of cosmic force that is higher than the appearances, elements, and laws that we humans can see—something above all that. Because it is impossible to describe accurately, many ancient texts confuse them all. You can understand the 'rule' I speak of as the power that only the gods can wield; like mortals who cannot see the gods, it is a mystery hidden in the depths of the universe."
A rule? At this moment, Su Lun felt that there probably wasn't another person who could understand what Sir Isaac was trying to convey more clearly than himself!
After awakening the second solution of the All-knowing Eye, he had in fact already discovered there was an arcane and hard-to-grasp existence beyond the level of rules.
But before, without any reference books to describe this concept, no lower being could understand such a thing.
So even he didn't know what he had seen, vaguely feeling that some powers above the ninth order appeared, to control some cosmic rules.
So this is what "rules" are!
Amidst his shock, Su Lun turned the page again to continue with the text.
"Ultimately returning to the essence, this phenomenon of everything having a restraining opposites is still a clash of opposing energies. I tentatively call this energy 'dark energy'. And of course, everything has its opposite, dark matter, dark universe, and so on... If you are willing to observe, it must exist; it's just that some rules are hidden, unseen. Of course, the notebook doesn't record this. The point is the alchemic transmutation equipment!"
"I once captured a deity and closely studied the essence of divine power, further confirming some of my ideas. I found that the source of a god's divine power is their divinity. And in my understanding, divinity should be the crystallization of the world rules they comprehend. So in theory, as long as one can find the type of 'dark divine power' that restrains divine power, mortals could possess the ability to confront the gods."
"I incorporated my rudimentary understanding of 'dark divine power' into alchemy, designing a special type of transmutation equipment that restrains divine power, which I named—[God Slayer]."
After reading this far, Su Lun already knew what the fifth type of transmutation equipment left by Sir Isaac was.
"[Isaac's God Slayer], a superior type of transmutation equipment that grants mortals the power to slay gods."
The Alchemical Demigod recorded a discovery that could be described as an alchemical miracle using the simplest of words!
Now, upon reviewing Sir Isaac's notebook, a variety of thoughts became instantly clear.
That was the power above the ninth order, the power of rules!
Moreover, Sir Isaac had blazed a new trail, finding the special direction of "dark rules" which Su Lun had never seen recorded in any tome he had read before!

chapters.title: Chapter 607 - 642: Alchemy Divine, Kaleidoscope, Primogenitor
chapters.content:
Su Lun was captivated by the notes in his hand.
Since his awakening as the "Reaper of Death," no alchemical knowledge had ever seemed so crude and incomprehensible to him until this moment.
He flipped through the pages, and when he reached the latter parts, he surprisingly found some twisted, special characters.
The special material of the notebook allowed it to bear some unique Power of Laws, clearly a high prophecy unlike any ordinary text.
Upon seeing this, Su Lun realized it was the language of the Dragon race.
Mr. Jing had once mentioned that his own father mastered the dragon language, and indeed, he had.
And his mastery was profoundly deep.
Su Lun also immediately realized that what Sir Isaac wanted to express next could not be accurately conveyed by ordinary text.
Thus, he used this high language capable of describing cosmic laws.
Su Lun knew this was the final safeguard left by the Alchemical Demigod for his own research.
If it weren't for Su Lun drinking from the Mimir's Well, enabling him to peel apart the dragon language, perhaps only one person in the alchemical plane could understand the latter part of these notes.
That person was Mr. Jing.
No matter whose hands the fifth notebook fell into, ultimately, they would be led by the fate entangled in the translation of the dragon language, eventually finding Mr. Jing.
If the notebook fell into the wrong hands, Mr. Jing's power was also enough to ensure these precious notes could return to the right course of destiny.
What a thorough contingency plan.
Without dwelling on this matter, thoughts in Su Lun's mind wildly scattered in every direction.
Looking at the content expressed in the dragon language,
those rune-like dragon characters transformed into threads of laws, various mysterious symbols, lines of alchemical formulas...constantly appearing, combining, calculating, and elevating in his mind.
The content is as follows:
"So, let me first explain what I understand 'hidden rules' to mean.
Usually, we think that when practicing Alchemy to exchange element A for element B, it is completed directly through an energy transformation.
It's a direct process from A to B.
But when I discovered the existence of 'hidden rules,' I realized that perhaps my thoughts had overlooked a hidden procedure.
That is, this conversion process actually involves a certain 'dark element X' before the transformation occurs.
Which means, it's A→X→B.
Although the result is the same, the path is completely different.
It's just that this process is beyond our human cognition and cannot be directly observed, so it was ignored.
Even though I've reached the pinnacle of alchemy in my professional dimension, and distinctly felt the constraints of this dimension, I still cannot observe the existence of this 'hidden rule.' I even suspect that ordinary gods can't observe it either.
And this hidden pathway is the foundational principle of my embodiment.
This might indeed be the essence of the 'equivalent exchange' in Alchemy.
..."
Sir Isaac, although he tried hard to use the simplest terms to help the reader understand what he wanted to express,
Su Lun felt his thoughts were like a sponge absorbing too much water, growing heavier and heavier.
Even with his current intellectual capacity, understanding the existence of 'hidden rules' was extremely challenging.
As Sir Isaac described, humans cannot directly observe this special cosmic rule; they can only infer its existence through certain experiments.
Using the equivalent exchange in Alchemy to steal a part during the 'hidden rules' process.
Dark energy, dark matter, hidden rules...
All this opened up a new world for Su Lun.
A mystery he had never been aware of, yet it was a high-order secret hidden deep within the mysteries of the universe.
Once mastered, it immediately transcended all the laws within his cognition!
...
"I applied this rudimentary understanding of the 'dark rules' to alchemy, as I happened to have a 'Divine Blood' on hand, which I refined into the prototype of the God Slayer. This also granted mortals the power to oppose deities."
"According to my design, this is a continuously strengthening alchemical artifact. This artifact has already integrated all the alchemical knowledge I have learned in my life, but it is still a 'semi-finished product.' Theoretically, it is perfect, but it lacks materials, which is the 'Divine Blood.' If you can find more Divine Blood to integrate in the future, its function will become increasingly perfect, and perhaps some issues I hadn't considered will emerge..."
"Although I have made this artifact as compatible as possible for human integration, since it is crafted from Divine Blood, the integration conditions are still very stringent. I hope the destined keeper of my notes can find a way to integrate it, at which time you might possess an 'Alchemical Divine Blood,' truly mastering the mysteries above the divine realms. If this is too difficult for you, then please pass along these notes. The fragile alchemic dimension is so delicate that just a single dimensional passage breaking could lead to the vast crisis of the entire dimension's destruction. Fortunately, we stand on the shoulders of giants; countless predecessors have left us numerous alchemical knowledge and volumes. I hope that one day the brilliance of alchemy will illuminate all the dimensions."
"..."
Su Lun fell into a contemplative state, completely unaware of the passage of time.
He placed the five notes beside him, each blessed with "Aike's Blessing Halo," wore the [Blessing of Xerea] ring, drank some [Poet's Honey Wine], and used almost every means available to enhance understanding.
It was only after Su Lun had gathered all five books that he discovered their content was unified!
The content recorded in the last of the fifth note needed some descriptions from the previous four to be decrypted.
This way, even if a deity from another realm got hold of one of the books, it would be difficult for them to understand anything.
However, the content about the "dark rules" was really profound.
It made Sir Aikesa continually express his "shallow understanding."
Initially, Su Lun thought this Alchemical Demigod was being modest, but once he understood some of it, he knew that wasn't the case.
The power above the ninth order was too difficult for mortal cognition to comprehend.
Su Lun decided to read through all the content first.
When he understood the principle of this "Sir Isaac the God Slayer," he exclaimed again, "Sir Isaac really is a genius in alchemy, to think of using a piece of Divine Blood to craft an artifact to counteract the power of gods. And this artifact can even continue to grow..."
The integration will grant an 'Alchemical Divine Blood,' offering a chance to break beyond the ninth order, which is of immeasurable significance for any professionist related to the alchemical dimension.
Su Lun could not express how shocked he felt at the moment.
Besides amazement, all that was left was deep contemplation.
According to Sir Isaac's description, that God Slayer artifact was sealed within the notes.
When he could fully understand the content of the notes, he would be able to break the seal.
According to Sir Isaac, Su Lun felt that even if he truly entered the ninth order
Su Lun did not plan to bring it out now and stored the notes in his small void realm.
At this moment, he finally understood all the profound intentions Sir Isaac had left in the manuscript.
The [Heart of Alchemy] provides humans with an immense amount of Spiritual Power they could not obtain themselves; [Giant's Strength] and [Dragon Patterned Golden Body] enhance the physical body enough to support the integration of 'Alchemical Divine Blood'; [God Profaner] grants the professionists the cognitive ability to understand the rules above divine realms; and the last step, [God Slayer], is for creating an alchemical deity.
The five notes gathered the greatest alchemical wisdom of this age.
It was then that Su Lun understood that the explanations of the artifact systems in the five notes, which moved from complex to simple, were actually to help the reader gradually comprehend, from a layman's perspective of the 'appearance,' a professionist's view of the 'elements,' from higher tiers' perspective of 'laws,' to the top tier's touchable 'rules.'"
This Alchemical Demigod put much thought into each detail.
However, putting aside that artifact for now, Su Lun felt that the concept of 'dark rules' had the greatest impact on him.
He vaguely felt that this might be his direction of exploration for years to come.
Regarding "dark matter," "dark energy," "dark rules"...
Su Lun felt he might understand them more easily than others.
Because his own awakened talent was aligned with the law of Death.
And Sir Isaac mentioned in the notes that there were countless rules in the universe, but two of them were "Creation and Destruction."
In a sense, Death was a manifestation of the destruction of living beings.
And after discovering the "dark rules," Su Lun had a thought, could I apply this to the laws of Death?
He had, after all, once resurrected himself.
He had always been curious about where exactly the power of the gods acted to resurrect the dead.
Now, he seemed to understand a bit more.
Although the methods might differ, Su Lun now had a direction regarding the concept of "death and resurrection."
No longer was he completely clueless about the powers beyond the ninth tier as he had been before.
Following this direction, Su Lun faintly felt he might discover a new world.
...
"The teacher once said that collecting five notebooks hides the ultimate secret of alchemy, but what could it be?"
Su Lun still held great anticipation, but he couldn't yet comprehend or reveal the ultimate secret hidden within the notes.
The time spent reading the notebooks seemed to have passed in a blink, yet Su Lun knew a considerable amount of time had actually gone by.
Since there was nothing urgent, he continued staying at Storm Manor.
Now that he had gone through the notes once, his thoughts circled back and he murmured, "It's been five days already..."
In his perception, Mr. Jing had already been in the manor for two days, probably because he didn't want to disturb him, and so hadn't come down.
Su Lun put away the notebooks, looked around, and found nothing else of note at the underground altar.
He looked at the five hooded figures of Dawn Cross, his eyes flickering with contemplation.
The opportunities left by these Alchemy Sages had fallen into his hands after countless years, feeling like some kind of inheritance, suddenly adding a weight of responsibility on his shoulders.
Without much thought, Su Lun instantly appeared in a bedroom in the manor.
He remembered this was Pestoia's boudoir, where, on his first day in this world, he had almost been killed by this ghostly miss.
Su Lun looked at Mr. Jing and greeted, "Senior sister, sorry to have kept you waiting."
"It's fine. I also needed the time to digest what I found."
Mr. Jing smiled, gave him a look, and curiously said, "I heard from Pestoia you found the fifth alchemy manuscript?"
She was also curious about what her father had recorded in the last notebook.
"Yes."
There was no need to put on airs with his own senior sister, Su Lun couldn't hide his joy, and shared, "Only after solving the All-knowing Eye did I understand the secret hidden in the basement altar. Oh, senior sister, you have no idea, it was such a clever restriction..."
If he hadn't been clever, it might have been hopeless to discover it even above the ninth tier.
"Indeed, it was father's style."
Mr. Jing listened with a smile in her eyes, feeling a sense of familiarity from the hiding technique and reminisced, "When we were kids, father always liked hiding our gifts in places that were right before our eyes, yet inconspicuous. He always warned us not to be deceived by appearances and to look beyond. The truth is often hidden right beside us, yet constantly overlooked."
Pestoia also chimed in with a pout, "Ah... I remember my sixth birthday present, father made me search the whole manor myself. It took me half a month to find it was actually on the doll I played with every day."
Hearing this, Su Lun immediately thought of the "unwritten rules" mentioned in the notebooks.
Wasn't this hiding right in sight, yet unseen?
It turned out that from childhood, Sir Isaac had been cultivating his daughters' perception of things.
This way of thinking, once formed, would benefit them for a lifetime.
At that moment, Su Lun thought of something and asked, "Senior sister, did you find the ninth-tier armor you needed?"
Mr. Jing looked at him, "Yes."
Su Lun continued, "What I mean is, I discovered a very powerful armor in the fifth notebook..."
He broadly described the Divine Blood God Slayer and the scenario of the unwritten rules.
Mr. Jing frowned upon hearing this, while Pestoia completely lost interest.
When Su Lun was about to ask if his senior sister could use such armor, she said, "No. Although the armor is powerful, it doesn't match well with my abilities."
She then took out a plant-like installation resembling an eyeball and added, "This 'Mirror Kaleidoscope' suits me best."
Su Lun originally wanted to introduce more about the "God Slayer," but once he recognized the epic quality attribute of the equipment Mr. Jing was holding, he immediately dismissed the idea and instead asked in amazement, "Sister... after you've merged with this equipment, can you create mirror images of yourself?"
Mr. Jing clearly knew that Su Lun recognized the value of the equipment and didn't elaborate further, simply stating, "Yes. I should be able to replicate three mirror images of myself at almost the same combat strength. Once my rank stabilizes, this number could double. If I am capable enough, theoretically, there is no limit to the complexity."
"That's amazing!"
Su Lun couldn't help but express his admiration.
It was at this moment that he understood why Mr. Jing said that after merging with the equipment, it would be difficult to be defeated by anyone below the level of a god.
Given her own strength was already formidable at the ninth tier, what about... replicating a hundred versions of herself?
Damn, wouldn't that be overwhelmingly powerful?
Mr. Jing clearly saw what he was thinking and laughed, "It's not that exaggerated. My own energy is limited; the more duplicates I make, the weaker each individual's combat strength will be."
Su Lun knew she was being modest.
Because at this moment, he had already sensed the imposing presence in Mr. Jing's bloodline.
Like the Demigod Medusa, it was a pressure that originated from a higher species.
Su Lun knew well; his sister must have found another very important thing, "Sister, did you successfully merge with your 'Primordial Bloodline'?"
"Mm."
Mr. Jing nodded, illuminated by the light, her stunningly beautiful face even revealed a demeaning look characteristic of a vampire progenitor.
The blood race bloodline is unique and not derived from gene potions. They convert blood descendants through "Embrace."
The process is cumbersome and mysterious.
Simply put, it involves extracting half the blood from a blood descendant and then merging it with half of one's own blood.
That's why there are second-generation blood descendants, third-generation... with each generation, the potential of the bloodline decreases significantly.
Mr. Jing's blood race bloodline was originally obtained when Sir Isaac captured a demigod-level vampire progenitor from the abyss and extracted its blood for modification.
Since there was no need to consider the life of that blood race individual, all the progenitor's essence blood was drained.
But at that time, Mr. Jing's strength was not enough to support her undergoing a complete bloodline inheritance, so she only merged with half of the bloodline.
Now, after so many years, Mr. Jing has fully assimilated that half of the bloodline, advanced to the ninth tier, and is also able to bear the other half.
Looking at the current situation, it means that Mr. Jing has all the bloodline inheritance of that demigod vampire, and from a biological level, she has advanced to a higher life form. As a blood race member of the abyss's undead clan, she excels at various combat recoveries and devouring others' power for her own use.
Once she completely absorbs this power, the growth in her strength will be immense, not only in combat strength but also in her life form.
The primordial blood ancestor, who stands on par with Medusa, belongs to a definitive mythical demigod bloodline.
It's conservatively estimated to increase several times over.
With her current "Mirror Kaleidoscope" equipment, who within the ninth tier can still defeat her?
These advancements were probably already planned by an Alchemical Demigod from the very beginning, meant to serve as a trump card for reinforcing the foundation of the alchemical civilization.
Su Lun felt an inexplicable anticipation.
...
Of course, Su Lun was happy about his sister's increase in strength.
This trip to Old Lington not only yielded the fifth notebook, but Mr. Jing also had a considerable boost in power, all to their great delight.
And now, apart from a planar gateway, there was little else worth lingering for in this Dawn Relic. Though it still contained many treasures, they would leave them for future Scavengers.
The three of them talked in the room for a while, and then, Su Lun asked, "Sister, where do we go now?"
Mr. Jing simply said, "First, let's deal with the risks at the Old Lington Governor's mansion and then leave."
Su Lun said with a half-smile, "That's what I was thinking too."
He hadn't forgotten the acolytes of the heaven god who had set up the teleportation circle here and their inextricable connection with the Governor's mansion.
Since they were here, they might as well completely resolve this hidden danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 608 - 643: Making a Big Commotion in Old Lington
chapters.content:
Old Lington, South Norton Street, Camellia Lady Tavern.
After the entertainment venues on Green Street were destroyed in the gang war between the Cross Society and the Steam Party, Norton Street became the liveliest entertainment district in the outer city.
This was the territory of the Cross Society, once tightly supervised by Qian Tiao Kan, and it was still controlled by the people of the Cross Society.
However, many of the original Cross Society executives had chosen to break out of the Black Tower with the Mirror Organization, so now the Cross Society was mostly new faces.
In the corner of the tavern, Su Lun and Mr. Jing were sitting in a booth, drinking.
"Looking at the current situation, those mages from the Storm Manor were evidently sent by the 'Unicorn Commerce Guild.' A vice-chairman by the name of Muriel Sanchez bribed a port inspector. Besides, it's rare for local officials to dare to obstruct such a large commerce guild. There is also no direct evidence to indicate that other people in the Governor's Office were involved."
"It's normal not to have evidence. Since the person who leaked the joint fleet's surprise attack plan has prevented the Ruying Army Intelligence Department from finding anything, that 'high-ranking official' must be extremely meticulous. Even if we dig deeper into this, at best, we will only deal with some insignificant minor characters."
"Once the Cross Society's intelligence arrives and we confirm Muriel's whereabouts, we'll know who's behind it all after we kill her. This time we must completely resolve the situation on the Old Lington side."
"Hmm."
"..."
While Su Lun and Mr. Jing wanted to solve the problem completely, they were uncertain how many people were involved in the infiltration of Old Lington by mages from the Divine Plane.
However, with the ability of the Reaper, things were much easier, bypassing various interrogation processes. Even if the intelligence was as tangled as a knotted mess, as long as Su Lun found a starting thread, he could keep clearing it up and eventually find that last hidden individual.
Since the Mirror Organization had left some intelligence personnel in Old Lington, there was no need for them to seek out people personally.
The music in the tavern was slow and soothing, with scantily clad ladies on stage, swaying their graceful figures.
The two men were drinking and chatting intermittently, also enjoying such rare leisure time.
At that moment, Su Lun suddenly had an idea and said, "Senior Sister, I have a thought."
Mr. Jing, who was sitting opposite him, glanced at him and put down the wine glass at her lips, asking in return, "Oh?"
His senior sister exuded classical elegance in everything she did, sipping her drink in small, delicate sips. Although he was very familiar with her presence, Su Lun still found it pleasing to watch, and he said, "You were attacked before, and under normal circumstances, it would take several years for your injuries to heal. Do you think if the enemy learns of your whereabouts again, they will try to ambush you one more time?"
Upon hearing this, Mr. Jing immediately understood his meaning, raising her eyebrows and asking, "You want to set up a counterplot?"
"Yes."
Su Lun nodded and added, "The forces from the Divine Plane have an important source of intelligence within the United Empire's upper echelon. Last time they failed to kill you, senior sister, and that person must also be worried about being exposed. No one can bear the revenge of a ninth-tier. So once the information about your location leaks, despite the risks, they will surely choose to betray the information again to eliminate the hidden danger. At present, there's only one ninth-tier descending from the Divine Plane, but even if there were one or two more, our Dawn Group can handle it now. By then, we might not only be able to dig out the traitor lurking within the empire but even strike a heavy blow to the Divine Plane's high-tier combat power..."
This plan was nearly an open strategy.
