Also, in the small void world are blueprints of the ancient weapon's casing, with methods on how to precisely release the energy of this dark matter. You might refer to it to apply it to modern machinery..."
When Su Lun obtained the blueprints and the crystal core, he only viewed them as a weapon.
Since he didn't know how to make the dark matter used as ammunition, once it was used up, it was gone.
But he hadn't anticipated that his disciple would coincidentally be researching the same thing.
Once the research yields results, it would mean that this item might become a sustainable technology.
A gram being capable of severely damaging a ten-thousand-member mage group—what about such a large piece?
If the effect is the same as determined by the blueprint, this could become a weapon capable of threatening gods themselves.
If there were a dozen or so cannons like this, wouldn't they be god-slaying weapons?
If armed with all the mechanical troops, then what fear of interdimensional invasions?
However, Su Lun felt that this god-countering weapon should not be exposed before he had the ability to protect himself.
Let's not talk about the cost of production.
If it were to be exposed, it might not only be the celestial planes that would be alerted; gods from other dimensions might come to destroy it as well.
Jike, unable to contain the urgent desire for research within him, excitedly said, "Teacher, I want to go to the small void world!"
Su Lun smiled faintly, "Hmm. But before that, I think you should speak to your companions first."
Jike responded joyfully, "Hmm!"

chapters.title: Chapter 627 - 626: A Demigod Has Arrived
chapters.content:
After the battle of Hebertson, Su Lun and Mr. Jing had stayed in Mafa and then they begun to employ guerilla tactics.
They conducted unexpected assaults on the garrisons of the magic armies in various occupied areas and ambushed their experts.
Although there were many Mages descending from the Divine Plane, the territory of Mafa was very broad. As the frontline elongated, the distribution of the magical legions also became very sparse.
In the occupied areas, one could find at most one or two ten-thousand-strong Mage Corps per city.
That had been more than enough previously.
With the augmentation of magic towers, one or two corps were sufficient to hold off mechanical legions more than ten times their number.
Even if they encountered a large-scale siege and couldn't win, they could still wait for reinforcements.
The beings from the Divine Plane controlled dozens of the great cities of Mafa through this method.
However, once Su Lun and Mr. Jing, two top-tier fighters, joined the battlefield, the situation changed immediately.
One of them could match any ninth-tier opponent without defeat, and one puppet army could easily shatter a ten-thousand-strong Mage Corps.
Under their cooperation, the Mages from the Divine Plane had almost no means to resist.
Even if they gathered together ten or eight ten-thousand-strong Mage Corps, the two of them could easily deal with them.
Even if they were truly ambushed due to some special reason, their exceptional Teleportation ability allowed them to retreat unscathed.
The people from the Divine Plane couldn't deal with Su Lun and Mr. Jing, but the two of them could easily breach various cities and magic camps, ensuring that the battle was one-sided from the start.
They were like sharp bullets zipping in and out of the body of a large and bloated bear.
Moreover, Su Lun's long-distance Spatial Displacement ability allowed them to appear flexibly at any point within Mafa's territory, and with the support of the Joint Empire's intelligence, they always managed to find some isolated Mage Corps or ambush and kill top-tier Mages.
Able to fight and flee, the beings from the Divine Plane could do nothing but passively defend against the two.
Thus, in the following few months, the two of them almost singlehandedly swept across the entire territory of Mafa, killing tens of thousands of enemies.
The Mages from the Divine Plane were unable to continue their scattered garrisons and could only gather several tens of Mage Corps to form super corps for self-protection.
Even when new ninth-tier Sages of Law descended in an attempt to change the course of events, after Su Lun ambushed and killed two of them, they too started to behave.
The top-tier experts, even those at the level of Sages, could only keep hiding within their super corps, no longer daring to be alone.
As for the will of the gods, there were also no more descents.
After the battle in Dragon Country Waters, where a god from the Three-eyed Race suffered heavy injuries while possessing Saint Frank, perhaps due to the injury or fear of something, they no longer descended.
It was probably not an urgent matter for them either.
For mortals, one or two years is a long time, but for gods, it might just be the blink of an eye.
They probably thought that the current state of the Alchemy Plane was already within their grasp and that it would eventually be conquered by the Divine Plane.
A little later or sooner, it didn't make much difference.
Moreover, a mere descent of divine will might not necessarily mean victory in battle.
....
In this manner, Su Lun and Mr. Jing, with their powers alone, forced a million Mages to hunker down in their camps, unable to move.
In just a few months, nearly all the occupied cities within the territory of Mafa were liberated.
During this period, the Joint Empire's relocation fleet was also continuously moving the population among various major coastal cities of Mafa.
In the absence of any obstructions, the hundreds of millions of people remaining within the boundaries of Mafa were successfully relocated.
Likewise, the various large factories and equipment that had not been able to be moved before also had the opportunity to be relocated.
Only part of the resistance forces remained on the front lines, secretly constructing underground fortifications in preparation for future battles.
Another part continued to mine and produce in the major mining areas in secret, providing the Empire with enough resources for construction.
With Su Lun and Mr. Jing stationed on the side of Mafa, they also brought a much-needed respite for the Alchemy Plane.
Ruing, with the influx of a large population, saw an explosive growth in national strength.
The policies of widespread alchemy education across the Empire and the benefits of genetic Potions continued to ferment, with both civilians and the military producing a large number of astounding alchemy talents. With a larger base, various rare A and B grade talents, and even a few S grade talents, began to emerge, with top professionals making breakthroughs frequently...
Then there was also the blossoming development in the field of mechanical technology.
The two great empires each had their own trump cards, such as Lu Ying's divine nerve technology, Ancient Gusmao airships, and the antique mechanical blueprints treasured by the royal families and nobility. Previously lacking the capability to manufacture them, they now had the personnel, technology, and equipment support after forming a united empire with Mafa, and various secret mechanical equipment emerged accordingly.
Internal strife had been eradicated and external threats temporarily posed no hindrance. Empress Yekaterina also demonstrated her astounding ability to govern, implementing policies one after another, leading the United Empire to unprecedented prosperity not seen in thousands of years.
Just like that, two years flashed by.
...
On this day, in Zambula Ironfall Province in the southern region of Mafa.
It was deep autumn, the weather slightly cool—the perfect weather for soaking in hot springs.
It was still the pine forest hot spring deep in the mountains, enveloped in the serenity of the forest with only the sounds of gurgling water.
In the crystal-clear spring water, three people were leisurely soaking in the hot spring.
Su Lun and Mr. Jing would come here to soak once in a while.
After searching high and low, it turned out that the best hot springs within the Mafa region were these mountain springs.
Of course, the most important reason was that nearly all of the Mage fortresses in Mafa had been concentrated near the planar passage. The two of them needed to check frequently on the enemy's arrival, so they would also come here often to soak.
"Pestoya, don't always create mischief while possessing Miss Pandora's body; it's very impolite," one said.
"Ah... but Pandora said it's okay. She has descended as a god to the Northern Quad-Kingdom and Dragon Country to gather faith. She even mentioned that she wants Su Lun to work on figuring out how to amalgamate a divine body for her through alchemy soon. Isn't that right, Junior Brother?"
"..."
In the hot spring, Pestoya controlled Pandora's body, swimming about in the water.
The girl didn't know how to swim before but had finally learned, and now she was showing off at every opportunity.
Suddenly, with a "splash," the submerged figure burst forth.
Pandora's figure was already majestic, and as she rose from the water, waves surged tumultuously.
Su Lun was long accustomed to it.
A wooden tray floated on the spring water, filled with various fresh vegetables and fruits. When they grew weary of soaking, the three would snack on something, a leisurely indulgence.
"More and more magic airships are gathering at the planar passage. It looks like they're preparing to traverse the Imperial Strait. Judging by the rate at which their numbers are accumulating, they will likely take action within the next few months."
"Yes. They couldn't build shipyards along the coast, so they had to use magic airships. Luckily, we've recently received good news from Lyndon—the United Empire has developed quite well in the past two years. The military is also prepared; the Steam Airship Corps has reached a considerable scale and we will have a significant advantage if a battle really breaks out. It's just the sheer number of the enemy's top warriors we fear, if they're too many and go straight for a decapitation strike, that's the big problem."
"Indeed. At least twenty or thirty ninth-rank Sages have appeared over the past two years. There could be others with special abilities. The next great battle is likely to be very bloody."
"Yes. The problem with the planar passage will persist until it is completely resolved."
"Do you have any plans for the Silent Forest?"
"It seems we need to prioritize that. There are now quite a few peak eighth-rank professionals in the Empire, and we have a significant shortfall of primeval essence. If we don't advance a batch of ninth-rankers quickly, future battles will be difficult. And I have a feeling the enemy is preparing for some major move."
"..."
The three of them chatted in the hot spring, exchanging occasional comments.
Others in the Alchemic Plane might feel the crisis had temporarily receded over these two peaceful years, but Su Lun and Mr. Jing, who had always been on the frontline, were well aware that the situation was deteriorating.
The planar portal was becoming increasingly stable, allowing more top-tier masters from the divine planes to descend easier and more frequently.
Although Mr. Jing and Su Lun had been constantly fighting over the past two years and had significantly improved their combat abilities, achieving great victories, the outcome of the plane wars ultimately couldn't depend solely on them.
....
It was an ordinary day, seemingly unremarkable.
The trio had soaked for a while and initially planned to camp overnight as they often did.
But suddenly, Mr. Jing received some news, and her fine eyebrows furrowed.
Su Lun observed and asked, "What's wrong, Senior Sister?"
Mr. Jing replied, "I've just received intelligence from the military. A quarter of an hour ago, a suspected ninth-rank Mage attacked one of the Mithril mines in Manuel Hill with hundreds of men, causing significant casualties. The attackers haven't left; they're still in the mine."
Hearing this, Su Lun's thoughts raced, and he instantly had an idea: "Oh, are they coming for us?"
In the past two years, the two of them had struck down too many from the divine planes, and the enemy was already aware of their tactics.
It would be impossible for a ninth-rank to come out alone just to be killed.
But now that one had appeared, it meant the adversary was confident.
Mr. Jing also nodded, "It should be."
Clearly, this was a deliberate show of force, a provocation meant to draw them out.
After pondering for a moment, she spoke with a grave tone, "I fear a 'Demigod' might have descended."
Su Lun narrowed his eyes slightly as he listened, "A demigod, huh… having hidden for so long, are they finally making their move?"
He thought so too.
Generally, those of the ninth rank stood no chance. And since the enemy dared to provoke with just a few hundred men, the most likely scenario was that among the enemy, there was a power far surpassing the ninth rank.
And it could only be a "Demigod".
Su Lun had harvested the memories of those several ninth-rank Sages of Law before and had come to a precise understanding of the Demigods of the magic plane.
In the understanding of Mages, these were magicians who had not congealed a godhood but had mastered some divine power, commonly referred to as "Magic Gods."
That title represented the pinnacle of human power.
Su Lun wasn't entirely ignorant about the powers above the ninth rank, and in his view, those Magic Gods were likely beings who had grasped some "force of rules."
If such a mighty being did indeed descend, Su Lun himself would not be able to swallow this slight either.
The magicians had been holed up for two years, bound to come out for a breath of malice.
The assailants at the mine had not yet left, and after a brief discussion with Mr. Jing, Su Lun already disappeared into the hot spring pool.
Even if it was a deliberate provocation by the enemy, they had to make the trip.
First was to witness the strength of a Demigod-level Mage;
The second was to find out what exactly the fellows from the divine plane were planning.
The longer they waited, the greater the chance for change, and the sooner they obtained intelligence, the sooner they would be prepared.
...
Su Lun had left spatial coordinates in almost every major city of Mafa, and after a few instances of teleportation, they arrived at Manuel Hill, known as the second-largest city of Mafa.
Once a super-mining city with a population of over ten million, it was now a ruin.
Besides some rebels, there were hardly any residents left in the city.
The population had all relocated to Mafa during the past two years of migration, and even the factories and steel structures in the city that could be moved had been transported to Ruying.
As soon as Su Lun and Mr. Jing arrived, they heard the sound of explosions from the mine outside the city.
There was a high-yield Mithril mine outside the city, immeasurably valuable. This had once been the foundation for the development of this city, and over the past two years, it had continuously been mined by the rebels.
With another instance of teleportation, Su Lun and his companion were already on a desolate mountain.
The moment they arrived, they saw over a hundred individuals dressed in Mage robes levitating in the open-air mine above.
The vast majority of Mages seemed to be spectators.
Only a few of fifth, sixth, and seventh rank were bombarding the area with magic, attempting to collapse the underground mine with the Earthquake Technique.
The rebels, on the other hand, were well prepared, having detonated some explosives that had been buried in advance.
There was a lot of noise, but not many people were seen.
A flash of light passed through Su Lun's eyes as he watched the group of Mages, and he immediately distinguished: "There are two at the ninth rank."
Now his ability was merely to glance once, and along with Soul Perception, he could immediately discern the approximate rank of the target.
Normally, two individuals of the ninth rank wouldn't pose a big problem for the two of them.
But upon seeing the female magician wearing a silver robe and a Golden Mask for a split second, Su Lun's pupils suddenly constricted.
The Golden Mask were identified as a legendary-quality magical artifact, enveloped in a faint halo of light. Ordinary people, upon looking directly at it, felt as though they were beholding a deity and couldn't help but feel a sense of awe.
The female Mage wearing this mask stood at the most conspicuous position.
The other hundred people, including the elderly ninth-rank, appeared to be...servants.
This display had already indicated her exceptionally distinguished identity.
Upon seeing the patterns on the Golden Mask, Su Lun immediately recognized her identity and warned, "Sister, be cautious. That's likely Princess Octavia J. Fielding of the Ascieden Empire. It's said she is a naturally born being with the three-eye anomaly of the divine race!"
The Three-Eyed Divine Race, also known as the holy race of the divine plane, are people closest to the deities.
Mr. Jing's expression also turned stern as he sensed a strong threat.
Clearly, even if the Mage wearing the Golden Mask was not a Demigod, her strength was far beyond that of an ordinary ninth tier.
Su Lun held his black umbrella tightly, his perception fully extended as he squinted and said, "There are no ambushes around, Senior Sister, shall we make a move?"
The other party had obviously not brought many people on purpose, just waiting for them to show up.
Mr. Jing nodded and said calmly, "Let's try it first."
To others, a Demigod might seem unreachable, and even instill a sense of fear due to the unknown.
But to Mr. Jing, that was not much of an issue.
After all, he had seen the presence of the strongest Demigod in the alchemical plane!
...
While Su Lun and Mr. Jing were observing, the Mage with the Golden Mask floating in the sky above the open-air mine seemed to notice something. She suddenly turned her head to look towards the northwest slope.
Su Lun's expression tightened as he muttered, "Strong perception."
The two of them knew they had been discovered and did not hide any longer. As the illusionary disguise dispersed, their figures were revealed.
Seeing the Gold-Patterned Cloaks on them, the woman in the Golden Mask knew that the people she was waiting for had arrived.
As the two sides locked eyes, two terrifying pressures suddenly overwhelmed the entire mine.
Just the mere leaking of aura from top-tier powerhouses was enough to cause the surrounding mountains and rocks to crumble.
No matter if they could win the fight or not, the royals' pomp and circumstance had to be observed; the noble Demigod princess couldn't personally take the field upon her arrival. The moment the aura leaked, more than a hundred accompanying Mages also reacted and rushed towards the slope.
Seeing the ninth tier old man, Su Lun sneered coldly, and his figure vanished from the spot.
He was very self-aware; he knew he was no match for a Demigod, but he could handle a typical ninth tier.
Although he had identified the identity of the woman Mage in the Golden Mask, that was all the limited information he had.
It was said that the woman Mage possessed divine power, but no one had seen her in action.
However, judging by the aura she emitted, she was solidly above the ninth tier.
Besides, even if she wasn't a Demigod that had touched the limits of human strength, her inherent talents of the Third Eye Tribe were not to be underestimated.
[S-009-Myriad Manifestations True Understanding], an eighth tier Saint Frank was already troublesome, let alone a true ninth tier.
Such an expert was better left to his Senior Sister to probe and test first for safety.
Fearlessly, Su Lun charged towards the ninth tier old man, expanding his domain of Death, and a layer of pitch-black and eerie field swirled around his body.
Two years ago, when facing a ninth tier Sage of Law, he might have been wary.
But now...
Without the oppressive aura of rank, while the Sage of Law was still a threat in his eyes, it was no longer a fatal one.
Since the battle with Clemdon up to now, he had harvested a full seven ninth tier Sages of Law, and his understanding of the magic system was also very thorough.
If one were to measure in terms of combat strength, calling him ninth tier would not be an exaggeration.
However, to Su Lun's mild surprise, that ninth tier old man was a physical and magic dual-wielding Rune Thunder Master, not only with immense magical power but also possessed strong close-combat capabilities emblazoned with runes.
The man moved as fast as lightning, with a crack of thunder in the sky, his figure teleported miles in an instant.
Upon a closer look, he had already appeared right in front of Su Lun. He rushed forward with a barrage of close-range heavy punches, each blow causing a sonic boom in the air, capable of punching a large hole in the mine from hundreds of meters away.
Thunder roared in the sky, the old man's body illuminated with purple lightning. With a casual flick, he could throw a thunder spear comparable to the Eight Forbidden Spells, and approaching his sacred domain, one would feel a strong paralyzing sensation.
Fast speed, strong physical body, powerful magic...
This kind of opponent, mastering both physical and magic, is difficult to counter due to lack of obvious weaknesses, and ordinary people really can't cope with them.
Right from the start of the fight, Su Lun had to admit that this guy was the strongest ninth tier Sage, besides that Time Mage he had encountered.
Unfortunately for him, Su Lun's own physical body was not a bit weaker.
He had previously taken the Thunder Dragon Breath Fruit in the Dragon Country Waters, granting him a very high resistance to lightning.
Even in close-quarters combat, he did not fall behind at all.
Furthermore, no matter how fast the thunder magic-enhanced speed was, in Su Lun's eyes, there was no chance of concealing anything!

chapters.title: Chapter 628 - 627 Mirror
chapters.content:
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"..."
Thunder roared in the sky, thunderclouds rolled in and obscured the sun, with a terrifying momentum.
The thunder elements within a radius of tens of miles were gathered above the mine, forming a sacred thunder domain.
The ninth-order Thunder Sage's robe had already shattered in his battle with Su Lun, and now he stood bare-chested, revealing a robust body starkly different from his aged face.
Muscles bulged all over his body, violent thunder elements twined around him, and purple thunder runes spread across his bronze skin, shining brightly.
A ninth-order rune mage, his physical body was also extremely formidable.
The old man chanted arcane spells, raised his hand, and gathered the sky full of purple lightning in his palm, and suddenly struck down with a "crack," a searing ball of lightning coalesced from the atmospheric elements and chopped straight at Su Lun.
Su Lun's pupils narrowed slightly; he had already seen through the magic's foundation and urgently cried out in his mind, "Eh... is that 'Thor's Secret Art·Spherical Lightning'?!"
But how swift is the thunder spell?
It had appeared before him in the blink of an eye.
Instinctively, he flashed away, reappearing hundreds of meters away.
However, surprisingly, although he had teleported away from the path of the thunderball, the moment Su Lun re-emerged from the spatial rift, the thunderball, hundreds of meters away, had already curved in trajectory to appear right in front of his eyes, striking him the instant he reappeared.
"Crack!"
With a blast, the thunderball released searing heat and intense light, exploding with the destructive power of thunder rules and engulfing Su Lun in a sea of lightning.
....
In an instant, a figure charred black, with small lightning serpents flickering over his robe, teleported again to appear hundreds of meters away.
Having endured that strike, Su Lun appeared somewhat disheveled but was not at all surprised in his heart, "Curving thunder spells... tsk, I never thought someone would actually master this Thor's Secret Art. Truly an eye-opener."
As far as he knew, this "Spherical Lightning," despite its common name, was one of the most difficult forbidden spells to learn in the thunder magic category.
It was said to be a god-given spell, and few ninth-order Sages of Law had the opportunity to learn it, let alone master it.
From all the memories he had harvested before, he had only heard of it but never expected to encounter someone capable of it now.
This thunder spell was tricky, not only because of its great might but most importantly because it was a "locking spell"!
Once the target's qi was locked, within the dozens of miles covered by the sacred domain, the thunderball would relentlessly pursue like a tracking missile, not stopping until it exploded on the target.
The only option was to endure it head-on!
Just as Su Lun had done moments before, even if you teleported away, it would catch up in an instant.
Just this one move alone would have obliterated an average eighth-order at first contact.
The blast of magical explosion was like a flashbang, leaving one's vision engulfed in white radiance.
After a brief recovery, as the white light dissipated, Su Lun's focus returned and his vision cleared.
He glanced at the dark golden dragon scale runes blasted open on his body and mused solemnly, "The destructive power has reached the upper limit of thunder rules, no wonder it's so strong."
In the eyes of the All-knowing Eye, there was little mystery left in this spell.
But even with understanding, he didn't have any better method to counter it, only the ability to endure it with his own strength.
Moreover, the old man was very cautious, and the moment he saw the Death God's Fire on Su Lun, he chose not to engage in close combat.
Killing him would not be easy.
However, what made Su Lun even more solemn was that if a mere servant was this formidable, how powerful must Princess Oktaavia J. Fielding be?
Looking again, the old man in the distance had already formed another large thunderball in his hand.
Su Lun narrowed his eyes slightly; this enemy was indeed very strong.
...
But in a blink, Su Lun and the ninth-order Thunder mage had exchanged several rounds of blows in the sky.
Exaggerated energy fluctuations exploded over the mine, the earth cracked open under the tremors of lightning and thunder. The lower-order mages were also hit hard in the battle, suffering heavy casualties.
Although Su Lun's combat power was comparable to a ninth-order, he still wasn't of that rank himself and remained at a disadvantage.
He knew he couldn't kill the Thunder mage quickly, but was in no hurry.
Because the mage couldn't kill him either.
This situation was bound to be a war of attrition.
If it really came to wearing down the opponent, Su Lun would inevitably be the victor in the end.
But obviously, they were not the main characters in this battle.
Mr. Jing and the Golden Masked Mage had been facing off for a while; though it seemed like nothing was happening, Su Lun knew they were already in the midst of confrontation.
For combatants of their caliber, seizing just the slightest opportunity against the adversary ensures a thunderous strike.
Just as Su Lun caught a glimpse in the corner of his eye, the Golden Masked Mage made her move!
Her incantation was completed in an instant, and suddenly a bright white glow lit up in her hands. With a motion like drawing a sword from her waist, the white light in her hand transformed into a Light Sword.
On the edge of his vision, Su Lun identified it as a Divine Artifact Projection, and exclaimed inwardly, "Puni's Holy Sword of Light!"
With the sword drawn, it was as if she held a sun in her hand, its intense white light radiating heat and causing pain to the eyes of those around.
Even from a great distance, Su Lun felt a prickling burn on his skin.
And upon closer inspection, the Mithril Mine beneath their feet had cracked from the high temperature, the gravel showing signs of melting.
Just the mere leakage of its laws was terrifying, demonstrating the sword's fearsome power.
The Golden Masked Mage wielded her Holy Sword without a word and pointed towards the sky. There appeared, from the tip of the sword, a super-gigantic nine-pointed star magic circle, which covered the entire mine in an instant.
Seeing the enchanted symbols on the formation, Su Lun recognized it instantly and blurted out, "A ninth-order forbidden spell—'Holy Shackles'!"
Back during the battle with Luenclayminton, that spell required the combined efforts of nine eighth-order Grand Magicians to formulate the magic circle, yet this Golden Masked woman was unleashing it by herself?
Upon closer inspection, Su Lun noticed the woman's body was enveloped with radiant Holy Light and it didn't take him long to realize she was harnessing the power of the Rule of Light. He thought to himself, "Tapping into the power of the Rule of Light, no wonder she can instantaneously cast forbidden spells. She's a Holy Light Mage too, which obviously counters my sister's vampiric nature..."
In just an instant, he noticed far too many details.
This woman in the Golden Mask was undoubtedly at the Magic God tier.
The magic she had just conjured did not utilize the conventional ascension of rules, but rather, Su Lun saw threads of rules themselves.
Such an ability was beyond what a ninth-tier Sage of Law could master.
No wonder their enemy had the confidence to lure them out, this woman was among the strongest individuals Su Lun had witnessed, aside from Queen Medusa and that Cyclops King from the sea!
Now they were in a predicament, if they didn't take down this woman, the Holy Shackles binding Mr. Jing wouldn't be undone.
It was as if a massive problem had been delivered right to their doorstep.
However, even with the enemy displaying such strength, Su Lun wasn't too worried.
After all, no one knew better than he did the combat strength of his sister!
...
Her "Mirror Guardian" talent ability was extremely unique.
Despite Mr. Jing's apparent lack of overwhelming advantage against ninth-tier opponents previously, her ability's advantage didn't particularly stand out in battles of the same tier, but became exceptionally prominent in cross-tier combat!
Just as in the Lyndon Catastrophe, when facing the pseudo-god Sea Giant that ninth-tier Master Pierre was willing to fight to the death, Mr. Jing, still at tier eight, managed to hold her own.
She was almost invincible within her own tier, and against higher tiers, she could at least achieve one-for-one!
It was at this moment, the Mage in the Golden Mask had already cast the Holy Shackles.
The moment Mr. Jing moved, chains of Holy Light appeared around her. The Holy Light caused charred traces on her skin and not only restricted her movements but its power was much stronger than the last time she faced it.
Unfortunately for them, Mr. Jing's power had also grown since two years ago!
Her sorcerer's seals shifted rapidly as her body suddenly shone with radiant mirror light, and she exclaimed, "Disarmament Solution·Mirror Kaleidoscope."
Once the spell took effect, it was as if her entire being had multiple afterimages, causing dizziness to anyone who looked on.
"Mirror Mystery·Final Boundary Mirror!"
In the blink of an eye, the mirror clone split into nine, transforming into nine identical figures cloaked in runic capes, "Grand Solution·Ninefold Mirror Body."
Watching the appearance of nine Ms. Jings in his field of view, Su Lun muttered to himself, "Has the enemy really forced my sister to use this move just upon confrontation?"
He knew all too well this was his sister going all out.
The Ninefold Mirror Image was the strongest state that Mr. Jing could currently enter.
Going all out from the start indicated that the enemy's strength far exceeded expectations.
Su Lun narrowed his eyes slightly, and said to himself again, "However, with this move, my sister has no reason to lose..."
...
As expected!
After Mr. Jing released the ninefold split of her image, her nine clones suddenly took their positions, each forming sorcerer's seals. Instantly, a gigantic Nonagram Alchemy Formation appeared in the sky, matching the scale of the enemy's magic circle!
With demi-god level power to mobilize rule threads, the enemy could command army-scale magic on their own.
Mr. Jing, divided into nine, could likewise form a super Alchemy Formation all by herself!
As the spell coalesced instantly, all nine Ms. Jings shouted in unison, "Alchemy: Ultimate Element Stealing!"
Mr. Jing excelled at various replications, but she was not limited to just copying.
She was, after all, the teacher of Mr. Hei who was proficient in nearly everything.
She was also well-versed in nearly every school of Alchemy!
Facing the constraints of the Holy Shackles, it was out of the question for her to copy this kind of Holy Light magic that bound her; instead, she used Element Stealing from Alchemy.
Using the equivalent exchange of the alchemy formation, she stole the Holy Light elements that filled the sky.
However, the next second, the abundant Holy Light covering the field converged into the Nonagram Alchemy Formation at her feet, and the light instantly turned from incandescent white to ascendent green.
Seeing his sister's sorcerer's seals, Su Lun guessed what she was about to do, with a flash of surprise in his eyes, "Ah... what a clever countermove!"
Holy Light magic was notoriously difficult for many people to handle.
Because it was an element almost without any counter within the sequence of elements.
Earth, wind, water, fire... Elements in the universe almost all counter each other, but Holy Light element almost has no counters!
Therefore, against Holy Light magic, elemental professionals tend to be easily countered, yet they hardly find a means to counter it.
However.
Not being a counter doesn't mean there's no way to deal with it.
In Alchemy, converting light elements into wood elements yields a high efficiency and conversion rate.
Wood might not counter light, but light elements are the perfect nourishment for wood elements.
Sunlight enables plants to grow, one of the basic laws of the universe!
Su Lun had already figured out what Mr. Jing was going to do.
Indeed.
After Mr. Jing gathered "Element Stealing," the alchemy pulled a huge amount of Holy Light elements from the magic circle, and then her sorcerer's seals changed once more, smoothly transitioning into another spell: "Alchemy Mystery·Ode to the Great Forest."
In that instant, a vast amount of light elements were converted into wood elements.
The previously barren and gray mine instantly burgeoned with vegetation; the ground cracked as trees sprouted and, in moments, grew from saplings to towering hundreds of meters tall.
Verdant canopies dominated the view as everything turned lush and vibrant green.
With the formation in the sky continuously supplying a multitude of wood elements, the trees grew even more robust, expanding in size relentlessly.
Astonishingly, the Holy Light so potent it could scorch sand and stone not only failed to burn the trees but seemed to continually nourish the sprawling greenery.
With this single move, Mr. Jing ingeniously resolved the "Holy Shackles" that restricted her.
But that wasn't the end!
Having perfectly resolved her predicament, each of her nine clones then formed sorcerer's seals.
Clone One: "Alchemy of Wood: Sky-reaching Vine!"
Clone Two: "Mysteries of Wood: Wooden Puppet!"
Clone Three: "Anthem of the Wood Element: Life Absorption!"
Clones Four, Five, Six, Seven combined attack: "Divine Spell: Emerald God's Descent!"
Clone Eight: "..."
In that brief moment, the dense forest on the mine seemed to come alive.
Tendrils spread everywhere like the claws of a demon, reaching out to grab their target...
And those giant trees turned into wooden puppets, causing landslides and earthquakes with every move...
Looking again at the forest, layers of green ripples spread out, not only continuously restoring Mr. Jing's life force but also drawing life from other targets in the forest...
After the final Divine Spell of the Emerald God's Descent, the whole space had turned into a world of forest.
The trees were like cages, imprisoning the mine within a radius of dozens of miles.
With the power of one person, she seemed to suppress the entire space.
The might of a top-tier alchemist was as terrifying as this!
...
A series of advanced spells instantly formed, leaving even Su Lun, the bystander, dazzled and inwardly exclaiming, "How strong..."
He knew his senior sister was powerful, but he had never seen such a formidable enemy, nor had he ever seen her unleash her full firepower.
Now, facing this Magic God, Su Lun realized just how strong Mr. Jing's alchemy was, and how deep was her understanding of spells.
Although the nine clones split some fighting power from her original body, their understanding of the rules was exactly the same.
And Mr. Jing's current understanding of ninth-level laws was intermediate, but her cloning ability included many alchemies and higher-level understandings that exceeded her own limits.
In other words, the woman wearing the Golden Mask had to face nine peak ninth-level alchemists at the same time!
This move was enough to make Mr. Jing unbeatable below the divine level.
Even the Thunder God elder, who was still battling Su Lun, was chased by the various plant tendrils in an extremely awkward manner.
The change came so suddenly that the Golden Masked Mage's expression changed when she saw this. Had her Divine Light Magic been stolen and used to attack her?
Watching as the tendrils attacked in droves, she brandished the Holy Sword of Light in her hand. With one strike, sword light cleaved through, breaking all tendrils hundreds of meters around.
However, with the Alchemy Formation continuously transforming wood elements from afar, those severed tendrils quickly regrouped and attacked her once more.
The Golden Masked Woman fought amidst the tendrils, and although these wood-based spells were far from lethal for her, she was being constrained and couldn't do anything about Mr. Jing.
"To think there would be such strong natives in the Alchemy Plane, hmph, I underestimated it..."
The Golden Masked Woman scoffed in her mind.
She was much stronger than the one mentioned in the reports.
Initially, she thought dealing with a native from a shattered plane would require little effort to resolve.
But she hadn't expected that the battle had just started and she felt like she couldn't possibly give it her all without fighting full force.
But in the blink of an eye, Mr. Jing had unleashed her full firepower and she didn't plan to give her enemies any chance!
The moment the wooden cage trapped the enemy, her nine clones converged to form another army spell. With a fierce chant, she shouted, "Alchemy Mystery·Dark Furnace!"
At that instant, the skies suddenly darkened as if a black curtain had enveloped the world.
With the arrival of the black curtain, a strange and eerie corrosive force quietly took shape.
Seeing this, Su Lun marveled as well: "She intends to refine the enemy... Hehe, senior sister's research on spells is indeed profound!"
Although he understood the principle of the spell, Su Lun had to admit, it was a technique he had never even heard of.
He couldn't help but be moved, realizing that despite Mr. Jing's usually quiet demeanor, her actions never disappointed when she truly made a move.
One sequence of spells after another made it seem like he was watching a top-tier alchemist's demonstration.
His senior sister's pool of techniques was unfathomably deep!
Exquisite and elegant, every move was a textbook demonstration.
Compared to this, Su Lun immediately felt his own techniques crude.
His own methods were almost always to instantly kill his enemies.
Whether it was Death God's Fire, the Domain of Death, or the scythe hacking away, or puppet legions bombarding the enemy.
If he couldn't instantly kill, the flashy spells he knew would also hardly kill the enemy.
He followed a brute path, one that overpowered with raw force.
Whereas Mr. Jing and Mr. Hei were those who used technique to overcome strength, pushing their skills to the utmost perfection.
In front of him, Mr. Jing was truly showcasing the abilities of a traditional alchemist to the fullest.
...
The sky suddenly grew dark, pitch black.
Mr. Jing didn't hold back against the enemy; each of these moves was meant to kill.
The Golden Masked Woman realized she had underestimated her opponent. Even though she wielded the Rule of Light, in this endless darkness, she seemed like a flickering candle in the wind, about to be snuffed out.
Instead of dispersing the darkness, the light seemed to be swallowed by some strange eroding power in the darkness.
And those tendril monsters continued to attack in the dark, as if they wanted to drag their victims into an endless abyss, invoking an ever-growing sense of terror.
"Hmph!"
The Golden Masked Woman uttered a cold snort as the sword light in her hand intensified.
With a sudden slice, she cut through countless tendrils and then slowly removed the Golden Mask she wore on her face.
Upon closer inspection, beneath was an exquisitely beautiful face.
Her expression was indifferent, exuding a lofty aloofness, as if she were a deity.
Not only was this Princess Oktaavia J. Fielding not lacking in appearance, but there was also an extraordinary feature on her face. At a closer glance, there was a slit between her eyebrows.
In that very instant, she suddenly opened her eyes, and the vertical pupil on her forehead promptly unfolded, releasing a blinding golden light from her being.
The moment her third eye emerged, her entire aura soared exponentially, swathed in a sense of the divine as if a god had descended among them.
Compared to before, she seemed like a completely different person!
Having known her identity in advance, Su Lun was not at all surprised by this. But with his second elucidation of the All-knowing Eye, he perceived something else and murmured to himself, "Mage God… So the so-called 'indescribable', 'unutterable', 'unfathomable' really refers to the outward manifestation of the threads of rules."
In a flash, he felt as if he had grasped some higher understanding.
Indeed, one could only see where the gap lay after clashing with the strong.
One could also catch glimpses of the lofty vistas they inhabit.
To Su Lun at this point, this Demigod opponent was an extraordinary opportunity that was hard to come by!
But that was just wishful thinking.
Once the enemy had revealed her third divine eye, she clearly intended to get serious.
Then, a beam of golden light burst forth from Octavia's upright pupil, slicing through the dark veil like a sharp sword. In that split second, the "Absolute Reality" disrupted Mr. Jing's "Dark Furnace".
Suddenly, daylight returned, and the surrounding forest regained its green vibrancy.
Octavia, observing Mr. Jing's nine duplicates from a distance, flashed a sharp gleam in her eyes and vanished from the spot.
Mr. Jing watched unfazed, readying his spellcasting once more!
...
Mr. Jing and Octavia both went all out in the battle, each move more powerful than the last.
Having previously clashed with Saint Frank, Su Lun had a sufficient understanding of the three-eyed heavenly deities. Although the "Absolute Reality" was formidable, its threat to Mr. Jing was not particularly great once accounted for. The only real issue was that her three eyes could practically unravel all spells, making her difficult to trap, let alone kill with sorcery.
Mr. Jing's own nine duplicates were just as bug-like, with ninefold attacks and ninefold replications, rendering the opponent's magic almost useless.
The battle raged on, evolving from long-range to melee, plunging the surroundings into chaos.
Seeing Mr. Jing deploy his nine clones, Su Lun knew she wouldn't be defeated and did not bother to pay further attention to the battle there.
Instead, he continued his pursuit of that ninth-tier Lightning Mage elder.
If he could eliminate the old man, then he'd be free to join forces with his senior sister and possibly decide the victory.
Not long after, only four beings remained in this Mithril mine.
Four parties with top-ranking powers of their planes unleashed their firepower, and Maneuver City felt the repercussions. Fortunately, there weren't many people in the city to begin with; they had evacuated before the fight started, so there weren't many casualties.
However, this once second greatest city of magic was ultimately ravaged by the four, reduced to ruins.
Yet the battle, which from the onset showed no sign of a decisive outcome, was destined to be a grueling conflict. After two to three hours of combat, Su Lun and Mr. Jing still chose to strategically retreat.
The Mage God and Sage of Law of the divine planes couldn't keep them there, so they gave up.
Both parties scattered.
...
Not long after, two silhouettes appeared on the wilderness outskirts of Maneuver City.
This was an orchard, brimming with autumnal charm, laden with heavy fruits that hung from the trees, dispersing a rich fragrance having gone unpicked.
Their steps on the fallen leaves rustled with each move.
Mr. Jing expressed some regret, saying, "If it weren't for the descent of divine will, we might have had the chance to kill her. Too bad… that female Mage God can summon an Artifact Projection, which means a deity must be watching over her."
Su Lun also nodded, "Indeed."
If the gap were wide, a swift kill would solve everything.
But after the fight, they realized that even with minimal differences and the outcome tough to discern,
Continuing the battle indeed harbored a chance to land a killing blow, but as Octavia started to slightly fall behind, Su Lun and his company felt the gaze of a divine will probing them.
Should they continue and divine will descend, without a fierce struggle, they would likely still be unable to prevail.
So they chose to withdraw voluntarily.
Fortunately, they had managed to probe the depths of their enemy, gaining valuable intelligence. Should they encounter them again, a bit of preparation could perhaps offer a chance for a decisive kill.
Mr. Jing then asked, "Su Lun, did you discern anything?"
Su Lun replied, "Mhm. That Octavia is indeed a Mage God. Her realm is not merely about understanding parts of the rules; she can also manipulate and apply them within her magic..."
This battle wasn't without gains; on the contrary, the rewards were immense.
At the very least, they had now experienced firsthand what true Demigod experts were like.
Su Lun's double elucidation of the All-knowing Eye penetrated the application of those rules, which was insight almost unattainable through any other means and of great significance to his own professional path.
Walking through the orchard, he shared the observations made earlier with his senior sister.
"Wisdom" allowed Su Lun to understand and convey it to others as well.
This was also of great significance to Mr. Jing.
Having discussed the recent battle,
Mr. Jing mused, "With the arrival of a Demigod-level expert from the divine planes, the next major battle is looming terribly."
If they could deal with one Demigod but without changing the tide, two or three more could be...
She sighed slightly, "If only I could glimpse the mysteries of the rules, that would be wonderful..."
Su Lun, listening, fell silent for a moment, feeling the weight of that great pressure.
Suddenly, an idea struck him, and he said, "Right, senior sister, I have an idea that might address some of our problems. But it could also be risky."
Mr. Jing looked at him with an inquisitive gaze, "Oh?"
Su Lun, with a steely glance, asserted, "Yes. Since the divine planes managed to send down a Demigod through the plane's passage, then the spatial stability around the passage must already be robust enough to withstand the descent of a lower deity."
Mr. Jing apparently guessed what was coming, "You mean to say..."
Su Lun's gaze hardened as he confirmed, "Yes. I'm planning to open the Voidwalker's Portal and release the Matriarch Worm, a deity-level entity exiled to the endless void!"
PS. Finishing writing early today, so posting early. Wishing everyone a happy New Year, good health—and while I'm at it, asking for a round of monthly tickets in the new year.

chapters.title: Chapter 629 - 628: Dimensional Reduction Strike
chapters.content:
The professional material that Su Lun fused during his advancement to the fifth rank was found in the cursed space within the void plane passage—it was the "Voidwalker's Portal".
This cursed object is very special, not only does it contain an extremely high level of Void Power. It also originates from a small part of the Core of Origin of an endless void. Thus, this spatial door is inherently connected to that plane, just like the communication devices of the Mirror organization, which can sense each other nearly anywhere. The door has a Divine Technique "Void Banishment" fixed onto it, and it is marked with a unidirectional extraplanar Spatial Coordinates 433.1224, 655.874.
Back then, at the Royal Alchemy Academy of the ancient civilization Tarkoru Country, a vice-chancellor named Herbert Hillbilly studied the void worm race and then mutated into the "Void Bidirectional Worm Ultimate Mutant". The monstrous being, possessing dimensional reduction ability, could not be killed by the chancellor at the time, so the already mutated vice-chancellor was exiled into that endless void.
Mister Raven's bidirectional ability was obtained by consuming a piece of flesh from that Matriarch Worm.
After Su Lun left that cursed space, he carefully went over the materials collected from the library there and understood almost everything about the traits of the void worm race.
He estimated that the vice-chancellor who mutated into the bidirectional worm likely had a demigod or even higher rank at the time.
And the life force of the Void Matriarch Worms is incredibly resilient; given enough nutrition, they can spawn countless numbers of their race.
Even without a sufficient source of food, they can enter a hibernation period like the blood race, thus obtaining a lifespan of hundreds of thousands of years.
When the former chancellor exiled the monster at those spatial coordinates, naturally, he did not intend for it to reproduce indefinitely. There is nothing at that coordinate, and if the monster is still alive now, it is presumably in deep hibernation, with its current level at best being that of a lesser deity.
This monster is also a backup measure that Su Lun is considering.
Nowadays, other places in the alchemical plane might not be able to withstand the presence of a lesser deity, but the entrance to the divine plane's plane passage is absolutely sufficient.
Moreover, the brain of the Matriarch Worm is one of the most suitable materials for creating the "God Profaner" alchemical armor noted in Sir Isaac's journal.
If given the chance, Su Lun also plans to use this kind of Matriarch Worm's brain to craft his eighth-rank required alchemical armor, completing the final link of his puppet legion!
...
"The tricky part is that dimensional reduction ability, which makes it almost impossible to kill with ordinary methods..."
Su Lun expressed his thoughts.
Mister Raven now possesses bidirectional abilities, not to mention its innate immortality. The dimensional reduction ability alone makes it invulnerable to other methods that are several orders higher in rank.
Thus a Void Bidirectional Worm of at least demigod rank would be impossible to deal with by any means below the level of a deity.
But the level of a deity is a watershed, and perhaps only a true deity could exterminate it.
"Back then, the Tokester Void Royal Alchemy Academy could not kill this Matriarch Worm; if it were to arrive, those beings from the divine plane might also be unable to handle it. By then, our alchemical plane will have to face this risk. However, the good news is, the Matriarch Worm's own combat strength isn't too strong. In case something goes wrong, I am fairly confident that I can exile it back into the void, but there is still a certain risk..."
Su Lun analyzed the pros and cons.
Mr. Jing listened while nodding his head.
This indeed is a serious problem.
For any race, the void worm race is like a "plague". They can devour and reproduce without limit. Once they invade the alchemical plane, the entire plane might be consumed into a void wasteland.
If it were a normal time, Mr. Jing would definitely not consider such a dangerous plan.
But currently, the alchemical plane is facing an existential catastrophe of its own, and the invasion from the divine plane is worse and more urgent than that of the void worm race.
As things stand, the problem cannot be solved and is of the same apocalyptic magnitude.
At this moment, Su Lun continued his analysis, "There is a cluster of ten magic towers at the planar passage, which is capable of resisting the power of gods. It might not be impossible to deal with the Matriarch Worm. Moreover, the gods of the divine plane will definitely not stand by and watch the foundation they have hardly built be destroyed. When the time comes, divine intervention is inevitable. The conclusion I have deduced is that the Matriarch Worm is very likely to be dealt with, and the magical encampment at the planar passage will also suffer heavy damages. This will give us a long breathing space..."
Having said that, he paused for a moment before adding, "At worst, it might be a severely injured and deformed Matriarch Worm. The probability of us exiling it again is even greater."
The stronger the beings of the divine plane are, the greater the damage they can inflict on the Matriarch Worm.
Even if they don't manage to kill it, both sides will inevitably end up in a mutually damaging situation.
Whichever way one looks at it, the benefits outweigh the drawbacks.
"..."
Mr. Jing fell into thought upon hearing this.
Having spent so much time with him, she knew perfectly well that Su Lun was always cautious in his actions.
The plans he made were always well thought out, with no room for error.
Now that the divine plane had already sent down demi-god level powerhouses, but the preparations on the alchemy plane were obviously still insufficient, delaying for some time would naturally be for the best.
Mr. Jing was also a person of extreme decisiveness. After pondering for a brief moment, her gaze sharpened, "Good! Let's proceed with this plan."
Su Lun nodded in agreement.
The duo vanished from the spot as they spoke.
...
Shortly after, Su Lun and Mr. Jing instantly appeared thousands of kilometers away in the Zambra Ironfall Province.
The enemy most likely did not anticipate that those who had just engaged in a great battle at Manuel Hill's Mithril Mine would appear here.
At the edge of the horizon, the blue pillar of light resembling a sky-piercing tower became even more solid. The All-knowing Eye looked through it to find the planar passage much more stable than it was two years ago.
Beneath that planar passage, the cluster of magic towers was dense like a forest, closely packed, forming what appeared to be a magical city capable of accommodating a million people.
Countless magical airships floated in the sky, with the horns signaling an attack about to sound.
If today, Octavia J. Fielding had killed Su Lun and his companion, then the biggest obstacle that forced them to hunker down in the encampment for two years would be gone.
Today was meant to be the day of a large-scale strike.
But now, the news of the battle probably hadn't been relayed back yet, and the magical legions were eagerly preparing.
Su Lun gazed at those ant-like mages bustling in the planar passage encampment, his eyes narrowing slightly, "Senior sister, I'm starting the preparations."
Mr. Jing beside him nodded, "Hmm."
And they began to get busy.
The disturbance caused by the release of Divine Techniques would be massive; given Su Lun's strength as an eighth-tier spellcaster, he would need a lot of time to prepare.
Moreover, they needed to place the exile portal within the encampment in order for both sides to engage.
But the enemy was not foolish enough to simply watch him cast spells within the magical encampment at the planar gateway.
Moreover, the magic restrictions even included a function to discern faith—only true believers had the chance to approach.
Once the restrictions were triggered, discovery would be immediate.
So, at this time, they had to rely on Mr. Jing's help, as well as a new spell that Su Lun had researched himself.
In a valley twenty-odd kilometers from the planar gateway, Su Lun took out countless materials and began to arrange a huge alchemy array.
After all, concerning the survival of the alchemy plane, he had simulated the feasibility of this plan countless times before, and all the materials needed had been prepared well in advance. First, he used oversized flawless crystals to set the corners of the formation, then with a paint made from a mixture of dragon blood and mithril powder, he drew an enneagram array and a large number of spatial runes, before arranging with astral materials...
On the other side, Mr. Jing was sitting cross-legged in meditation, recovering the physical energy depleted in the previous great battle.
The two busied themselves in the valley for over half an hour before Su Lun completed the arrangement of the alchemy array. After checking several times carefully and finding no mistakes, he said, "Senior Sister, it's ready."
Mr. Jing, who had been waiting for a while, opened her eyes upon hearing this. She examined the array, pinched a sorcerer's seal, and two mirror duplicates appeared beside her.
Su Lun asked, "Shall I begin my action now?"
Mr. Jing replied, "Good!"
Upon hearing this, Su Lun took a deep breath. He pinched a sorcerer's seal, and with a flash of spatial fluctuation, suddenly a dozen mages in robes appeared beside him.
Mr. Jing, watching this, noticed something unusual and said, "Your 'Corpse Soul Reincarnation Secret Technique' is coming closer and closer to the Resurrection Technique. If I didn't know beforehand, I fear I would not be able to tell that these are living corpses."
Impressed, she couldn't help but admire, "That really is an extraordinary spell."
Hearing this, Su Lun chuckled and said, "To deceive those mages as much as possible, I made them look quite real."
This was his plan.
Only mages could enter the encampment, so Su Lun thought of using the living corpses created by the Corpse Soul Secret Technique to infiltrate.
These living corpses almost represented his entire understanding of death up to this point. It wasn't easy for his own Senior Sister to see through them, so it was likely difficult for the enemy to see through them, too.
On the level of perception, these were several normal living beings, with their soul, body, thinking, and aura almost identical to those of the living.
However, these living corpses still had some minor flaws. For instance, upon close inspection, one would notice a layer of corpse wax oily on their bodies.
Furthermore, they had to beware of any special sensory methods or abilities among the enemies.
That's why they needed the help of his own Senior Sister.
Mr. Jing, without any fuss, pinched a sorcerer's seal, and a layer of mirror light began to coil around the living corpses, bestowing upon them the illusion of a mirror disguise.
Now, upon another glance, they truly appeared no different from living people.
Su Lun looked on with satisfaction, his eyes narrowing slightly, "With this, there should be no problem."
As he spoke, he concentrated with a sorcerer's seal and issued commands through his mental tendrils.
Although the souls within these living corpses were complete and had their own consciousness, Su Lun had also made some modifications deep within their souls over these days.
The undead retained their own complete consciousness, but they still carried out Su Lun's commands.
It was like in a dream, where even the most irrational scenes didn't seem out of place to them.
With a single incantation from the magician, over a dozen mages cast the Aerial Control Technique and floated towards the planar passageway.
...
Meanwhile, at the planar passageway's mage camp.
The camp was a hive of busy, bustling activity.
Because of Su Lun and Mr. Jing, these legions of thousands of mages had been gathering nearby, and the camp had amassed over a million mages.
Towering magic towers stood densely packed like apartment buildings, with various invisible barriers defending the camp, capable of stopping any attack with their unseen walls.
Today, probably because the full-scale battle was about to begin, the mages also mobilized, forming squads of ten, hundreds, and thousands... everyone was busy preparing for war.
At that moment, no one noticed that a small squad of about a dozen people had suddenly appeared at the entrance of the busy camp.
These mages were familiar with everything in the camp. They passed through various hidden barriers unnoticed, went through identity verification, and smoothly made their way deep into the camp, with the mages around them not detecting anything unusual.
At this very moment, the only thought in the undead mages' minds was to carry out the order: to find a secluded corner in the camp and set up a magic formation.
The group of about a dozen found an empty tent and crawled inside.
Seeing no one around, they began setting up a magic formation.
This was just an Octagram Array, not complicated.
Because this wasn't the Divine Technique - Void Banishment, it was merely a mirror projection.
After about fifteen minutes, the magic formation was ready.
The leader, a seventh-order mage with a numb expression, poured magic power into his hands and activated the magic formation.
Elsewhere, miles away in a mountain hollow, Su Lun executed the same movements. His hands rapidly moved through sorcerer's seals, and the nine-pointed star formation under his feet began to shine.
A large number of Energy Barytes dissipated in the formation, and the spatial fluctuations became increasingly intense.
Su Lun chanted softly, "Following the laws of equivalent exchange of all things, praising the glory of the primal creator, witnessing the miracle of creation through alchemy..."
In an instant, a simple stone door gradually took shape above the formation. As the runic stones on the door lit up for a moment, an ancient and mysterious aura emerged. The energy converging in the formation was like a large hand, slowly pushing the stone door, cracking a gap open. Peering inside, it appeared to lead to a terrifying, abyssal world of void.
Su Lun's forehead was covered in sweat, and even with the formation, casting this Divine Technique was extremely taxing.
Thankfully, with the ceaseless dark spiritual power provided by the alchemic heart, the stone door eventually opened completely.
It was as if the creatures of the endless darkness saw a light; the monster in the void was instantly attracted. Upon another glance, one could see through the stone door a very abstract and menacing creature, resembling a mud monster roughly outlined in black lines, charging straight for the door.
At that moment, Su Lun's expression sternly tightened, and with a push of his hands forward, he shouted, "Divine Technique - Void Banishment!"
Mr. Jing, at his side, didn't dare to be careless either, casting in perfect sync, "Mirror Projection!"
Upon closer inspection, as the light from the mirror swept past, the magician had already been replicated to the other side. The bifrontal worms that were originally charging up the hillside were now projected into that magical camp.
...
Su Lun skillfully used mirror image projection to conceal the massive energy fluctuations that occurred during the casting of the divine arts.
In the camp, several kilometers away, the magical disturbance inside a tent was only momentary, but it immediately triggered the camp's defensive alarms.
The patrol legion commander on duty quickly realized there was an issue and demanded, "What's going on, why is someone casting high-level magic inside Tent 7754?"
In an instant, the patrol mage unit nearby converged on the scene, and dozens of magic towers in the vicinity instantly gathered dense magic power, ready to deal with any sudden emergencies.
The military ordinances of the Celestial Plane were well-established. Training of magic had a designated area; whether in combat or encampment, no one would cast spells where they shouldn't. There were also a complete set of stringent defensive measures.
Clearly, they all realized that this magic fluctuation was highly abnormal.
But even though the discovery was made in a timely manner, it was already too late!
Su Lun had an unparalleled understanding of the mages of the Celestial Plane, and he had a thorough grasp of everything within the camp.
If it had been anyone else, regardless of how skillful their infiltration abilities, they would not have had any chance at all!
The [Divine Technique - Void Banishment] had long been ready, and this was just a projected outlet of a mirror image; it could no longer be reversed.
In a flash, within the tent, the light from the mirror brilliance surged, and within that light, an archaic rune doorway had already flung wide open.
At that very moment, the ninth-rank Sages of Law guarding the camp were the first to sense the majestic power of the void. It was a terrifying fluctuation that struck fear into the hearts of those who felt it.
This isn't good!
Everyone's expression changed at once.
No one knew exactly what had happened, but they all felt a strong sense of impending death.
In an instant, the horn for casting magic in the camp had already sounded.
Several battalions consisting of ten thousand mage units swiftly formed into battle formations, and at the same time, an old mage clad in a plain white robe had appeared on the scene.
The old man with the white beard, looking at the mirror light appearing in the camp, furrowed his brows and immediately understood what was happening.
But this was the tricky part of mirror image projection; by the time it was discovered, it was too late to stop it, too late to interrupt the casting of the spell!
The old man's gaze darkened as he looked at the Void Gate, his face serious: "A demigod from the Void Worm race?"
Although he had not experienced it personally, where hadn't he heard of the Void Worm race's infamous reputation that countless planes regarded as a plague?
At that moment, the strange creature also crawled out from the stone door.
...
On the other side, Su Lun, who had released the divine arts, was a bit drained, but he was also excitedly pulling out his telescope, watching the magic camp at the edge of his vision.
Now that the spell had been cast, what remained was up to fate.
He had read the notes about the worm race before, and he knew the habits of the bifrontal worms like the back of his hand, which was as he had expected—the worm did not die.
The intense fluctuations of the void, although on a rules level, had apparently not yet crossed the threshold.
But this too was within Su Lun's expectations.
The troublesome thing about the bifrontal worm was not just its ability to attack from lower dimensions, but its unkillability.
Years ago, at the Tokester Void Royal Alchemy Academy of Tarkoru Country, there was the treasure of the Void Gate and the presence of at least a demigod Voidwalker academy head, who could not kill the monster but could banish it.
Su Lun did not believe that those folks in the Celestial Plane could conjure up a demigod or higher level Void mage to banish this monster.
Next, the show was about to begin.
Through the telescope, Su Lun watched as the stone door appeared, and that mass of black lines surged out.
Looking at the old man standing on the tenth level magic tower, he recognized him and let out a curious sound, "Oh... 'Archmage of Evil' Constantine Reiloz, there's actually a demigod master hidden in the camp?"
Mr. Jing beside him also furrowed his brows slightly.
Two demigod powerhouses had quietly arrived in the Celestial Plane, and if a full-blown mobilization were to occur, the consequences would be dire indeed.
Luckily, there was still a bifrontal worm of the void.
This plan truly relieved a great deal of pressure from the Alchemical Plane.
It must be said that the mages' response was extremely quick.
Just as the two of them were focusing their attention, in the distant camp, various magic towers were already lit, and countless spells were launched towards the Void Gate.
[Forbidden Curse - Thunderous Destruction], [Legion Mystery - Light's Interlude], [Piercing Demon Light]...
The legion spells, bolstered by the magic towers, were several times stronger than usual. Judging by the circumstances, those mages apparently intended to destroy the stone gate along with the monster.
Even from such a great distance, Su Lun and his companion could feel the terrifying surge of magic power. In an instant, a seven-colored brilliant "firework" erupted in the camp.
However, what happened next left the mages dumbfounded.
The earth-shattering legion magic aimed at the bifrontal worm not only failed to kill it but instead... utter silence!
It was as if a lit firework had suddenly gone out, without a trace of the expected explosion.
The legion spells, which could easily kill a ninth-rank Sage of Law, fell upon the "line monster," appearing as if they were merely... a few strokes of color on a canvas, adding a bit of color to it and nothing more.
And just in the blink of an eye, those colors also disappeared instantly, and the monster returned to its abstract black-and-white line art form.
The mages did not know what the [Ultimate Mutated Bifrontal Worm] was, let alone understand the worm's dimension-lowering ability.
Su Lun, however, was already accustomed to it.
Because a certain black crow had such ability and he had long been used to it.
But having seen this, he looked again at the crow on his shoulder and complained, "Lord Crow, look at their dimension-lowering ability, then look at yours. I've fed you so many good things for nothing..."
Old Man Crow rolled his eyes in a very human-like display of exasperation upon hearing this, "As if I'd bother with a stupid owner like you. I'm a demigod, and what rank am I?"
Su Lun saw the expression on the crow's face and sighed softly, wishing, "If only you could become that strong one day, Old Man Crow... how great that would be."
If the black crow were that strong, it really would be strutting around.
The black crow, usually quick to retort, didn't say anything this time, but its dark eyes reflected the silhouette of the monster in the distance.
...
The Void Bisector Worm was originally an aberrant creature with an instinct for slaughter. Having been exiled for countless years, it harbored resentment.
Now, having just been released and taking a beating, it was in no mood to be gentle.
As soon as the Bisector Worm's body fully emerged from the stone door, it ignored all kinds of confining spells and charged at the crowd and magical towers around it.
Its body, which had previously resembled a lump of rotten mud, suddenly spread out and became as thin as a sheet of paper.
Spatial Confinement, Physical Confinement, Magic Confinement... and so on, only the Time Dilation had some effect in slowing it down slightly.
Wherever the Bisector Worm went, whether it was magical towers or humans, they would instantly be sucked in like into a black hole, reduced to two dimensions.
Being a creature of the void, it couldn't teleport, but it could hide in the void.
As the various Legion Mages watched the body of the worm, they were unaware that it had secretly hidden itself in the void.
Suddenly, the ground beneath the feet of the Legion Mages, who were casting spells, became muddy, swallowing their feet whole.
"Watch your feet!"
"No good, get out of the way!"
"Too late, ah... someone save me!"
"..."
In the blink of an eye, the camp was filled with howls and screams.
The Worm's dimensional reduction ability was absurdly effective; if untouched, one was safe, but once contacted, it spread like a virus, rapidly spreading through the body and reducing it to two dimensions in a very short time.
The greatest strength of the Legion Mages was their stationary output; they had to form specific formations to unleash certain Legion Spells.
To the Bisector Worm, they were sitting ducks.
Several Legion Mages had no time to react before they were devoured in the twinkling of an eye.
Their Legion Magic Shields were completely useless against the Worm's dimensional reduction ability.
It wasn't just the humans – the magical towers also seemed to be sinking into a marsh, quickly becoming part of the monster's pattern.
If you looked closely, you could see that the patterns had become much more distinct.
Others were clueless about what was happening, but Su Lun knew all too well.
This was the Void Bisector Worm's method of feeding.
It could devour anything rich in energy, replenishing itself.
After consuming several Legion Mages, its movements became even more agile than before.
Years ago, Su Lun had seen this worm in the cursed space of the void passage, where it had been simulated by the curse at a very low tier.
Now, witnessing this demigod-tier Bisector Worm wreaking havoc, he too was shocked and thought, "The abilities of this worm are truly unstoppable..."
Through the eyes of his All-knowing Eye, he could see strands of the laws of reality.
The Bisector Worm's manipulation of spatial laws provided immense inspiration to him.
...
The dimensional reduction ability of this Bisector Worm was almost unbeatable.
It did have a shortcoming, however – its speed wasn't very fast.
With sufficient perception, one could still avoid it.
But, this was a magical battlefield.
Not to mention the density of the mages packed in the city, numbering in the millions, their legion warfare didn't allow for disarray.
What's more was that one could run away, but this was a magical battlefield!
While planar invasions were the best way to plunder wealth, war was costly!
This place was filled with countless magical towers, various strategic materials, Potions, Demon Cores, Energy Barytes... and so on, stored for future full-scale invasions.
These items contained potent energy and were ideal food for the Bisector Worm.
If they were to flee, could they really bear to see the camp, built over years with countless resources, swallowed up by the Bisector Worm?
From the get-go, Su Lun had anticipated this situation.
The beings from the Divine Plane wouldn't give up the camp easily, so they would inevitably fight to the death!
With two demigods and the ability to summon gods, the Divine Plane might have a way to deal with the situation.
But this battle, regardless of the outcome, would surely end with both sides suffering heavy losses.
The Divine Plane's camp would definitely sustain severe damage.
This is what Su Lun and Mr. Jing wanted to see.
The two observed the battle from afar, finally relaxing their furrowed brows a little.
"Now the real show begins."
Su Lun watched intently, the fierce fight within the camp mirroring in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 630 - 629: The Magic Camp is Severely Damaged
chapters.content:
Previously, it was the Imperial Intelligence Division that informed Su Lun and Mr. Jing about the situation at the Manuel Hill Mine, and news of that great battle naturally made its way back to the imperial capital of Lindun at the first opportunity.
When the officials confirmed that those beings from the Heavenly God Plane had already brought forth a Demigod expert, the entire upper echelons of the United Empire were shaken.
Everyone understood that the peace of the past two years was gone forever, and war was imminent.
The upper echelons were very clear that the enemy's overt attack on the mine was meant to lure out the top-tier combat power of the Alchemy Plane and then eliminate it.
If their scheme was successful, it would signal the beginning of a full-scale war.
An emergency meeting was also convened by the Empire Council.
"Your Majesty, we have confirmation from Mafa that Mr. Jing of Dawn and Prince Fick have engaged the enemy. The current intel confirms that the enemy is of Demigod realm. The enemy has showcased formidable methods, with one individual casting the forbidden legion magic 'Holy Shackles,' and her sword is very powerful, likely an Artifact Projection..."
"Mr. Jing split into nine, using a wide-range wood-based alchemy forbidden curse, freeing herself from the constraints of the Holy Light curse and instead trapping the enemies."
"Latest intel, the Demigod from the Heavenly God Plane with a third eye on her forehead is capable of emitting a very powerful piercing light beam. She broke through, and the major battle is currently at a stalemate..."
"..."
In the council chamber, where only a dozen people sat on the hundred mahogany chairs, it appeared somewhat empty.
Yet at this moment, those seated here were without exception the heavyweight officials of the Empire.
Shoulders adorned with five golden stars, marshals of the grand land, sea, and air legions, the Imperial Prime Minister, senior cabinet ministers... every person watched the communications officer with a grave expression.
The atmosphere was extremely heavy.
The battle intel from the Mafa frontline was transmitted here in real-time and decrypted on the spot by cryptographers.
Everyone listened intently to the live battle status.
Hearing that the enemy was a Demigod powerhouse, their brows furrowed tightly; learning that Su Lun and Mr. Jing were gaining the upper hand, they finally relaxed slightly; facing a locked battle situation, everyone tensed up again, afraid to even breathe heavily... fearful of any unexpected developments.
With the volatile and rapidly changing battle conditions, the expressions of those present altered accordingly.
They all knew that this battle would greatly determine the direction of the future plane wars.
And at the main seat of the council, Yekaijelina, wearing her crown, also watched with a heavy gaze.
Finally, hearing that after several hours of a hard-fought battle, it ended in a stalemate, everyone's hanging hearts settled somewhat.
At least there was no defeat, meaning that the top battle strength of the Alchemy Plane currently was not inferior to the enemy's.
Sighs of relief echoed in unison throughout the council hall.
"Mr. Jing truly lives up to his title as the number one expert of the Alchemy Plane, managing to hold his own against a Demigod powerhouse."
"Indeed. This last two years, thanks to Dawn, we've had the chance to catch our breath."
"With Mr. Jing and Prince Fick on the Mafa frontline, the enemy will have to think twice about a large-scale advance. But our time is running short..."
"..."
The tone was filled with respect whenever people mentioned Mr. Jing and Su Lun.
It was not just respect for top-ranking powerhouses but also admiration for the two who had been active at the frontline for the past two years, securing time for the Alchemy Plane.
Sitting upon the throne, Yekaijelina pondered for a moment before speaking, "That's the situation as it stands now. Lords, what do you believe our next move should be?"
Upon her words, the generals and ministers immediately presented their views.
"An all-out war is inevitable. We absolutely cannot hold any illusions that the enemy will give us more time. We must mobilize everyone immediately to prepare for the war!"
