Due to the population migration from Mafa in the last few years, Lingdun's population had skyrocketed tenfold, and the city had expanded manifold. The migration also brought a tremendous number of mechanical engineers and advanced technologies. The construction of new city districts wasn't just about erecting new buildings, but about the mechanization overhaul of the entire city.
"Woo..."
"Woo..."
"Woo..."
The deep and piercing sound of the enemy attack alarm went off, and people in the streets quickly took refuge inside various buildings.
In that moment, the massive city streets became eerily empty. Various hidden steam boilers activated, chugging out white smoke, and the clashing sounds of gears never ceased, making the streets tremble.
Then, a miraculous scene unfolded.
Lingdun's various streets cracked open with a clatter, and chunks of armored steel plates emerged from beneath the streets, quickly enveloping the buildings. Towers and clock towers transformed into artillery towers, revealing large-caliber, dark artillery barrels.
The operators rotated the barrels, all aiming them at the sky.
In just a blink of an eye, a bustling supercity turned into a mechanical warfare fortress, its countless long and short cannons armoring the city like a steel porcupine.
What was even more miraculous was each of the Alchemy Academies—at the first sound of the enemy attack alarm, the students quickly hid in underground bunkers, and the entire academy wasn't just enveloped in steel armor but also lit up with magical glows.
Not just one, but all the Alchemy Academies did this.
From the sky above, you could see that the thousands of Alchemy Academies in Lingdun City were orderly distributed, subtly forming a gigantic Nonagram Alchemy Formation.
This was the super defensive battle formation laid out by the imperial officials over many years.
Shortly after the alchemy formation glowed, an enormous honeycomb-shaped energy shield appeared in the sky, protecting most of the area of Lingdun City.
"First round of artillery, fire at will!"
As there had been drills over the past two years, both the military and civilians were prepared, showing order amidst panic.
The city defense command center issued the order to fire. Instantly, city cannons simultaneously belched flames of different colors, targeting the white-robed mage in the sky executing large-area magic.
"Boom," "Boom," "Boom..."
Alchemy cannonballs exploded in the sky, bursting into splendid flames. Various chaotic elements burst forth above Lingdun.
Although there was only one enemy, a level one alert had been sounded.
Because the intelligence department had recognized that the visitor was a demigod powerhouse from the Celestial Plane!
Tens of thousands of cannons fired at once, making the entire city tremble.
Cannon fire clearly couldn't kill a master of such caliber; firing was only to disrupt the nearby elemental convergence, preventing the mage god from using his high-casualty range magic easily.
But the main offensive force was still the various large army corps stationed in the city—the ten-thousand-strong magician troops!
In these recent years, the combined imperial forces had also specifically trained various ten-thousand-strong magician troops, which had now become well-organized and were being put to use.
The tens of thousands of magician troops from various parts of the city powered up simultaneously, directing multiple ninth-level alchemy spells toward the 'Archmage of Evil,' Constantine Reiloz, in the sky.
Normally, these forces were enough to destroy a nation, but their opponent now was a demigod. Even with all their firepower, the enemy showed no signs of being at a disadvantage.
Instead, a vast area in the sky turned a fiery red, as Constantine had already unleashed a super high-casualty range ninth-tier curse—"City-Burning Flames."
The flames, like raindrops, fell from the sky; the high-grade flames condensed rules of fire, able to melt steel. Even with multiple protections, the fiery rain that fell on the city destroyed many buildings.
After the magic was released, alchemy cannonballs once again dispersed the fire elements in the magical array.
Yet, the demigod mage didn't rest; he quickly gathered new magic.
...
At that very moment, within the Frederic Royal Palace, atop a tower, a stunningly beautiful woman with purple hair was intensely focused on the battle in the sky.
Ekaterina's eyes reflected the figure of the white-robed mage, filled with solemnity.
If the enemy had come in larger numbers, they might have been able to launch a full assault and wound both sides equally.
But with the enemy being only one person, a demigod, that presented a tricky problem.
The battle wouldn't end anytime soon, and casualties within Lingdun City continued to rise.
From the shadows of the tower, where there seemed to be no one, a voice reported, "Your Majesty, Master Merlin has made his move, but even with the Nonagram Alchemy Formation's support, he does not stand a chance of defeating the enemy. Without using the secret weapon, we cannot kill him."
The speaker was 'Black JOKER' March Creton, head of the intelligence sector.
He was also among the few high-ranking officials of the Empire who knew about the hidden strengths of the United Empire.
Upon hearing this, Ekaterina shook her head and said, "It seems the enemy is merely trying to gauge our capabilities. It's not worth exposing our final tactics just for one demigod. The crucial battle that will come later is what truly matters."
March then said, "But Your Majesty... by doing so, Lingdun will be safe, but at that time, many people might die in the other cities of our Empire."
A hint of unusual emotion flashed in Ekaterina's eyes. After contemplating for a moment, she calmly said, "In war, sacrifices are inevitable. If we reveal our trump card too soon, we won't have any chance to turn the tables, and more will die later. Moreover, this demigod has attacked Lingdun without intending to engage in a decisive battle, but merely to tie down Mr. Jing at dawn, preventing her from interfering with the Angelic Realm's main forces on the other side."
March's tone noticeably relaxed, "Are you saying that the experts from the Dawn will come?"
Ekaterina flatly said, "They have already arrived."
...
Since Lingdun is the main base, a long-distance teleportation formation was prepared early on, allowing Su Lun and Mr. Jing to teleport back without any delay.
In a manor on the northern bank of the Lokwarren River, a wave of spatial distortion flickered, and the two appeared on an open lawn in the garden.
Just as they emerged from the spatial rift, they saw the white-robed old man in the sky flaunting his power.
Massive torrents of fire rain fell from the sky, crashing onto various parts of the city in terrifying shockwaves.
On the side of the Empire, other than cannons and the ten thousand Magician Corps, only Master Merlin, the court's chief minister, could directly contend with this.
But being nearly a whole rank lower, he could only hide within Lingdun City's super barrier and defensively resist, without being able to touch the Magic God at all.
The signs indicated that the battle wouldn't yield any immediate results.
However, a combat of such a level spelled disaster for the lower-tier professionals.
Forbidden-magic-level spells were not so simple; after several area coverages, the city had already suffered significant casualties.
After observing for a moment, they naturally wouldn't let the enemy rampage in Lingdun any longer and didn't delay further.
With a flash of light from a mirror, Mr. Jing's figure had already vanished from the spot.
Upon looking again, she had already appeared a kilometer away in the sky, fiercely battling with the Magic God, Constantine Reiloz.
Su Lun didn't join the fight because he had already guessed the outcome.
After their journey to the God Burial Ground, Mr. Jing's strength had surged from a month ago, and even in a one-on-one battle, she would definitely not lose.
If it came down to it, she even had the chance to kill this Constantine.
But obviously, the enemy had never intended to fight to the death from the beginning.
Shortly after Mr. Jing appeared, after a few exchanges, Constantine cautiously distanced himself, pulling further and further away, until finally disappearing altogether.
A demigod trying wholeheartedly to escape is even harder to kill.
Watching the enemy retreat, cheers erupted from various parts of the city.
Successfully repelling an attack by a demigod was certainly a momentous victory for the common folk.
As the main combatant, Mr. Jing, however, silently returned to the manor.
Only she knew that the enemy had never intended to fight seriously.
Instead, it was they who truly suffered in this battle.
As soon as she landed, she frowned and said, "This Constantine Reiloz came here alone just to draw me out. Sigh... the coming days will likely be very busy. That guy will surely appear frequently in the major cities across Ruling, forcing us to tire ourselves out in response..."
"Yes."
Su Lun listened and also showed a trace of helplessness on his face.
He could see that the enemy was employing the same irritating tactics they had used in Mafa.
Using top combat forces to tie down the opponent's main army.
Unable to defeat that Magic God, they could only play defensively.
Being passive in one area led to passivity everywhere.
These beings from the Angelic Realm had invaded for many years and had clearly ascertained the strength of the Alchemy Realm. They knew that aside from Mr. Jing, a ninth-tier, there was no other top expert who posed a threat to a Magic God.
As long as they could tie down Mr. Jing, the million-strong magic army on the southern portal of Mafa could march across the sea without hesitation and push the frontline closer to Ruling.
No one could disturb them anymore.
When the time came, a million-strong army would sweep across, and even the strong defenses of the combined empires would eventually fall.
Although Su Lun's combat strength was not weak, for him to face a demigod at his current eighth rank, even with the support of a puppet legion, there was no chance of victory.
Moreover, another known demigod among the enemies was Princess Oktaavia J. Fielding.
She was a three-eyed tribesperson protected by the will of a deity.
Having already experienced her tactics, this was also proving to be an almost unsolvable problem at present.
The situation now seemed to have reached a deadlock.
Constantine Reiloz would undoubtedly cause trouble in various places in Ruying for a while, and Mr. Jing would have no choice but to confront him.
Knowing full well it was the enemy's strategy of exhausting troops, they were helpless.
The two discussed for a bit in the manor, their brows intensely furrowed throughout.
After much thought, Su Lun muttered, "We need to find a way to kill that guy..."
Mr. Jing sighed slightly, "Yes. But a demigod, not easy to kill."
To break the situation, this "Archmage of Evil," Constantine Reiloz, must be killed.
But the current situation is such that, unless they use something like the hidden trump card "Twilight of the Gods," killing a demigod is very difficult.
But obviously, it's not yet the time to reveal their trump cards.
Either they give themselves some more time, waiting for Mr. Jing to comprehend the rules and ascend to demigod, or wait for Su Lun to advance to the ninth rank.
However, it seems that the enemy will no longer give them this opportunity.
...
After a short conversation, Mr. Jing went to the royal palace.
She had to discuss with the empire's high officials the strategies for the coming period and also to deliver that batch of "Cosmic Essences" to the royal family.
Within the empire, the number of eighth rank professionals was considerable, what was lacking was essence.
If they could add just a few more ninth ranks, it would be a great boon for the future wars.
Su Lun walked alone on the streets of Lingdun.
Having just experienced that brief battle, although the city's buildings suffered damage and there were casualties, the streets were filled with residents celebrating jubilantly.
The news of a demigod's descent on the divine plane was still top secret to most ordinary people, now that they had witnessed such a formidable enemy being repelled, it was naturally a cause for celebration.
As Su Lun walked, observing as mechanical armors retracted back into the walls of houses and turrets hid underneath the ground... he was greatly amazed.
The changes in Lingdun were truly significant, one could truly say it was evolving from day to day.
Under the nationwide frenzy, the collision of mechanics and alchemy had sparked much intellectual creativity and had led to many great inventions, such as turning the entire city into a wartime fortress.
Su Lun felt as if he was witnessing a rising sun, promising a bright future.
As he walked, he thought to himself, "Really looking forward to the renaissance of Alchemy civilization, what a scene it will be..."
Given the current development pace of the empire, he already found it hard to imagine how prospered the Alchemy civilization would be in a hundred years.
Lost in thoughts, Su Lun strolled along the Lokwarren River.
As he walked, suddenly a bright steam carriage stopped at the curb.
The door opened, and Sabina in a black sexy long dress leaned against the window, she blinked her eyes, playfully greeted, "Sir, what a coincidence, are you here too?"
Su Lun glanced, smiled slightly.
He was not the least surprised that his maid could find him.
This was no coincidence.
Sabina was obviously here on purpose.
The succubus contract had a special effect; the master and servant could sense each other when they were close within a certain range.
With Sabina's current strength, her senses were not weak, she could sense him several blocks away.
Looking at Su Lun, Sabina, without a hint of the lady's composure, got out of the car and affectionately wrapped her arm around Su Lun's, her beautiful eyes full of a charming smile, "Sir, I've missed you so much."
Su Lun had grown accustomed to this tenderness, and asked with a smile, "When did you advance to the seventh rank?"
Sabina, body clinging to Su Lun like a boneless creature, responded in a soft, awkward tone, "It's been about half a year~ I wanted to surprise master, but didn't expect to run into you so coincidentally."
"Oh? Already half a year huh..."
Hearing this, Su Lun's expression shifted slightly, he praised, "Not bad."
Although the rules of heaven and earth had become much more refined, the seventh rank was still a monumental threshold for alchemists, and only those with extraordinary talent could step into it.
Moreover, in his perception, Sabrina was not merely at the initial stage of advancement, she had even touched the edge of the eighth rank's overwhelming power.
This rate of advancement could indeed be described as divine.
Hearing the praise, the corners of Sabrina's eyes curled, and she smiled joyfully, "It's all thanks to the master's grace~"
Su Lun's arm was already deeply immersed in tenderness, his expression slightly helpless.
Every time he met with his demonic maid, it inevitably cost him some vital energy.
Sabrina suggested, "Sir, shall we talk in the car?"
Su Lun also thought it inappropriate in public and nodded, "Mhm."
Once they got in the car and closed the door, the carriage was completely isolated from the outside world.
A sultry body immediately trembled upon him, the air filled with a bone-corroding seductive fragrance.
Sabrina's clothes loosened lightly, her long skirt had already slipped to her waist, revealing large areas of her pale skin.
Her figure was soft like water, and while speaking, she said, "Just now, when I saw the leader make a move, I guessed that master must have returned. I thought I might find you walking by the river, so I thought to come over and take a look—never thought I'd actually run into you~"
...
Su Lun smiled and didn't say anything, his hands gently caressing a soft sensation.
From top to bottom, his fingers slipped over tender, delicate skin.
After so many years, it was still the demonic maid who understood his temperament best, and she always managed to be incredibly satisfying.
In a flirtatious swaying, Sabrina seemed to discover something and exclaimed, "Wow... I've noticed that you've become much stronger, master~"
"Yes."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun casually responded.
Sabrina always made leisure times pleasant for both body and mind.
But upon saying this, a slightly odd thought flashed through Su Lun's mind.
His current understanding of the laws had already touched the realm of rules, a transcendental perception that others couldn't comprehend even if it was fed to them.
Yet, peculiarly, the demonic talent of a demon allowed her to absorb some of her master's insights for her own use, and this shortcut was enormous.
Besides, Sabrina was also very diligent herself.
Su Lun had a faint premonition that her cultivation might reach a very high level in the future.
Sabrina seemed to have completely understood her master's thoughts, smiling even more brilliantly, not shy about anything, "Master, the car is going to speed up~"
The car traveled through the streets and alleys of Lingdun City, with the steam boiler roaring, and the body gently trembling.
Inside the car, a scene of enchanting spring unfolded.
...
In the following days, the Unified Empire became busy.
As anticipated, Constantine Reiloz, the Archmage of Evil from the celestial plane, was active in various major cities of Luying, launching frequent surprise attacks.
An Archmage's surprise attack inevitably caused tremendous casualties.
Both Su Lun and Mr. Jing had to frequently support the various cities, leading to a very passive situation.
They tried to kill the man several times, but he didn't engage in battle and escaped directly.
Although they had thought of setting traps and ambushing in advance, Luying had too many major cities, making the probability of an ambush very slim.
On the other hand, the situation in Mafa was also very bad.
The intelligence department had confirmed that Princess Oktaavia J. Fielding was leading an army of a million mages to march out, arriving at the coastline with a momentum of sweeping everything before them.
They were boarding countless magical airships, crossing the Imperial Strait.
This was a terrifying force that no one dared to confront directly, not even Su Lun and Mr. Jing, who could only watch helplessly as the army of a million marched forth.
Everyone realized that once the enemy's air fleet reached Luying, it would be the most fierce battle.
The situation was not optimistic.
The Unified Empire was also actively preparing for war, with everyone ready for a do-or-die battle.
But until this day, an unexpected twist occurred.
Suddenly, Su Lun received a communication.
"Hey, Su Lun, if you're free, come pick me up. Oh, this ghost train, leaving me above the sea and then just ignoring me..."

chapters.title: Chapter 639 - 638: I Have Killed a Demigod
chapters.content:
In the southern part of Anlogos County, Su Lun and Mr. Jing were camping in a forest on the outskirts of the city.
Recently, the "Archmage of Evil" Constantine Reiloz from the Divine Plane had been moving around the major cities in the south, launching surprise attacks. The two of them were also lying in wait nearby, hoping to get lucky and ambush him.
However, instead of encountering the enemy, they received a communication from Chi'en.
"Sister Chi'en, you... you're back?"
Upon hearing this news, Su Lun's expression immediately shook.
Two years ago, when he had adventured to the Dragon Country Waters, Chi'en had unhesitatingly boarded the Ghost Train to the Netherworld in pursuit of her Sword Dao.
Since then, there had been no news from her.
As Fujiwara Hayato described in his travel notes, the Netherworld is the final resting place for the deceased. It is a higher plane of the underworld and a forbidden zone for all living beings.
Su Lun had been worried about Chi'en encountering some accident but was powerless to do anything about it.
Now, hearing this familiar voice, he felt as if the oppressive cloud of bad news that had recently surrounded him suddenly cleared, and his mood brightened.
The voice on the other end of the communicator replied lazily, "Yeah. I'm not really sure where I am right now; the Ghost Train dropped me off when it reached its station. Hmm... Looks like I'm still somewhere in the Dragon Country Waters."
Su Lun replied, "Okay, wait for me, I'll come to pick you up right away."
Mr. Jing, seeing his excitement, looked at him with an inquiring gaze.
Su Lun explained briefly, "Sister Chi'en has returned."
Hearing this, a hint of joy appeared on Mr. Jing's face, "Oh? She's back, huh."
...
Meanwhile, in the Dragon Country Waters, it was precisely midnight.
A thick fog blanketed the sea surface, and the dark waters were dull and devoid of light. In the misty shadows, one could faintly see a steam train speeding past, then disappearing into thin air like a ghost.
After the Ghost Train vanished, the fog over the sea began to thin somewhat.
Upon closer inspection, there was now a swordsman on the sea, wearing a conical hat and tattered Sword Dao robes, with a blade of grass dangling from his mouth.
With his high-tied green hair and his spirited face, if it wasn't Chi'en, then who could it be?
She put down the communicator, took a couple of deep breaths, and mumbled to herself, "Ah, there's nothing like the air of the human world, so comfortable to breathe. Not like in the Netherworld where every breath feels like swallowing ice daggers..."
Chi'en had just returned from the Netherworld, and if anyone could see death Qi, they would notice a thick layer of dark Qi swirling around her like steaming flames.
This dark Qi was entirely incompatible with the living world, like water and fire.
Chi'en glanced at her own body and, upon realizing the issue, slightly raised her eyebrows but didn't seem too concerned about it.
It would take some time for Su Lun to arrive to pick her up, so she appeared somewhat bored.
She casually walked a few steps on the sea, looking around for any islands where she might rest.
Suddenly, a sharp gleam passed through her eyes, and she murmured to herself, "Hmm? The death Qi has attracted some big ones."
This was the Dragon Country Waters, home to countless terrifying sea monsters.
It hadn't been long since she got off the train when she noticed several powerful presences had locked onto her.
But she was not surprised.
It was just like when she first went to the Netherworld; the essence of the living was a fatal attraction to the dead. Now, the death Qi on her was like a beacon in the night, detectable from a great distance.
Chi'en paid no mind to the sensation of being observed by powerful entities. Her hand rested on her sword's hilt while she continued to tread lazily across the surface of the sea.
She had not walked far when suddenly, a shadow appeared under the sea water beneath her feet.
The shadow grew larger and larger until, with a "whoosh" of water, a huge deep-sea monster with sharp teeth leaped out of the water, as if it intended to swallow her whole.
Chi'en's face showed not even a hint of fear as her finger on the hilt of her sword gave a slight flick.
A sound of clanking metal rang out,
With a flash of cold light, the giant sea monster about to close its jaws around her split in two in an instant.
Sea water and blood rained down from the sky, landing on the conical hat and falling into the sea.
This was a seventh-tier sea monster with a Titan bloodline, a Lord-level creature.
Chi'en didn't even spare it a second glance; in the underworld Netherworld, killing was a basic skill for survival, and drawing her blade was pure instinct. A seventh-tier monster wasn't worth her concern.
A few more steps and a breeze blew by, thinning the fog further.
Only then did she see a towering mountain in the distance, which allowed her to recognize her rough location, "West of the Hell Volcano, Dragon Territory. Looks like I'm in a bit of trouble..."
The dangers of the Dragon Country Waters were nothing new to the Dawn Group, who had learned of them long ago. Dangerous high-tier Lord-level sea monsters were rampant throughout these waters.
The most troublesome of all were the dragons.
But without a ship or an island in sight, she had nowhere to go.
It would still take some time for Su Lun to get there.
So Chi'en continued walking east, trying to avoid the dragons' territory.
However, things did not go as she wished.
The deathly aura emanating from her was even more likely to attract powerful monsters than the scent of blood.
Suddenly, a high-pitched dragon's roar resounded through the night sky.
Qian Tiao looked up at the rapidly approaching massive shadow in the sky, pursing her lips slightly.
Su Lun had no idea when he would be able to arrive, and it seemed he would have to wait quite a long time.
In these waters, she really did not want to provoke a giant dragon.
However, facing the oppressive Dragon Might, it was clear that the eighth-tier red dragon in the sky had no intention of giving up on its "delicious food," or perhaps, it coveted the precious death aura from the Netherworld.
An eighth-tier pure-blooded giant dragon, that's equivalent to a level nine combatant's strength.
Qian Tiao's eyes still lacked any particular luster, lazy and indifferent.
Looking at her expression, it seemed her only concern was the hassle.
As for any other thoughts, there were none at all.
The Rakshasa Woman, born for slaughter.
If you dare to come, I dare to draw my sword.
Having been to the Netherworld, she harbored no fear in her heart.
It was just as this thought flashed by that the eighth-tier red dragon was already a few hundred meters away, its neck scales fiercely parting, gathering power before spitting out a terrifying Dragon Breath.
The scorching Dragon Breath swept over the sea surface, the intense heat causing a large amount of steam to rise from the sea. The Dragon Might that caused all life in the vicinity to shiver in fear slammed down like a mountain, yet Qian Tiao's face remained entirely unchanged.
The strong wind blew at her robes, rustling fiercely, and her fighting hat stirred slightly.
She reached out a hand to hold down her hat while the other hand, which grasped the hilt of the Famed Sword "Fó Tú," suddenly exerted force.
With a sudden draw of the sword, thunder roared in the sky.
In an instant, it was as if gods and demons of Hell had descended, exuding a domineering and unrivaled aura that enveloped the sea.
Qian Tiao's eyes sharpened with murderous intent, and she softly chanted, "Lei Ming Ichidō Ryū·Whisper!"
On a second glance, lightning burst from the blade, turning into a crescent moon Sword Qi that slashed towards the front.
With that one sword, it was as though space itself had been cleaved apart.
Sea water, the sky, Dragon Breath, and the ferocious fire-breathing dragon hundreds of meters away... Everything the Sword Qi touched was bisected with a single cut!
"Crash" the sea water split open, the Sword Qi swept across the seabed, and even carved a smooth crack hundreds of meters deep into the ocean floor.
As if some mysterious force was preventing the sea water from closing, the kilometer-long gash on the sea surface was slow to subside.
And coincidentally, at this moment, a spatial fluctuation flashed, and a figure appeared not far from Qian Tiao, just in time to witness this astonishing scene.
...
It was a long distance from Ruying to the Dragon Country Waters.
Although Su Lun did not delay and teleported multiple times, he only just managed to get there.
However, for his last teleportation, he confirmed Qian Tiao's spatial coordinates, and just after he performed Directed Displacement, he was immediately met with a terrifying Dragon Might.
Su Lun instantly recognized it as a high-tier giant dragon.
Just as he thought he was going to encounter some trouble, an unrivaled Sword Qi suddenly descended.
And the Dragon Might dissipated as if blown out by the wind.
Then he saw the amazing sight: Qian Tiao sheathing her sword, a dragon falling from the sky, and a kilometer-long huge fissure appearing on the sea surface.
Su Lun's eyes twitched involuntarily, somewhat incredulous: An eighth-tier giant dragon, killed with one sword?
He himself could kill one, but it definitely wouldn't be this easy.
It was in that momentary daze that Qian Tiao had already looked over.
As if she completely disregarded the exaggeration of the sword she had just swung, she arched an eyebrow and said, "Yo, Su Lun, you've arrived. I thought you would be a bit later."
Two years ago, indeed, it would have taken him quite a while to arrive, but now Su Lun's strength had increased, and naturally, his traveling speed was much faster.
But this wasn't the point.
Su Lun asked curiously, "Sister Qian Tiao, have you advanced to level nine?"
With his All-knowing Eye, how could he not see the deathly aura steaming from Qian Tiao's body?
At this moment, Qian Tiao seemed not so much a living person but more accurately a reanimated corpse, existing in a very strange state.
It was as if she had merged with the laws of heaven and earth, returning to a primordial state.
And that sword she had just swung had already cut through the threads of laws. That was clearly the realm of a Sword God!
But to so casually slay an eighth-tier giant dragon, this was not the capacity of an ordinary Sword God. Even the current peak eighth-tier Old Sword God Bartolo would find it difficult to make such a slash.
Qian Tiao, hearing this, lazily glanced at him and said, "Yeah."
After pondering for a moment, she added meaningfully, "In that place, if you don't become stronger... you really will die."
Her tone was nonchalant.
But one could hear in that voice a sense of composure that came from familiarity with the utmost darkness of the world, as if there were no difficulty left insurmountable.
At those words, the shock in Su Lun's eyes subsided, replaced by joy. With a light sigh, he said, "It's good to have you back."
After more than two years, Qian Tiao seemed unchanged, except for the heroism between her brows, now three parts fiercer.
Su Lun walked over and touched Qian Tiao's body, feeling the death energy that had become increasingly faint, "Is this the real Netherworld energy?"
The Netherworld belonged to a part of the underworld, and he was curious about what the final resting place of the deceased was really like.
Qian Tiao did not respond directly, but upon seeing Su Lun unaffected by the death energy, she expressed her surprise, "Yo~ Su Lun, long time no see. You have become much stronger."
With that, she hooked Su Lun's arm, just like old times.
Su Lun smiled faintly, sensing the surroundings and noticing several dragon roars rising, "Let's head back to Luying first. This isn't a place for chatting."
Qian Tiao nodded.
A fluctuation of space blinked, and the two disappeared from the sea surface.
Along with them, vanished the corpse of the eighth-order red dragon.
....
Before long, in the forests on the outskirts of Anlogos County in the southern part of Luying.
The campfire burned brightly when suddenly, Su Lun and Qian Tiao materialized out of thin air.
Mr. Jing looked up from his meditation at their return, a slight smile in his eyes as he opened them, "Odilea, you're back."
"Yeah."
Qian Tiao greeted Mr. Jing.
But as she looked around the woods, she immediately complained, "Ah... why are you living out in the middle of nowhere? I thought you were in an apartment. I wanted to take a bath when I got back. You have no idea, everything's fine in the Netherworld except the living conditions are absolutely dreadful for humans. The rivers flow with blood, and the rain is always gloomy; there's just no way to bathe... I haven't had a proper bath in two years, and I'm completely pickled."
Mr. Jing listened, his gentle gaze rippling with laughter as he casually explained, "We have to be on guard against enemy attacks, so we've camped out in the wilderness."
No sooner had he spoken than Su Lun noticed that Qian Tiao's Sword Dao robe was not only tattered but nearly encrusted.
Some liquid—blood or otherwise—had solidified into clumps, covering the original color of the clothing and emanating a strong aura of death.
The underworld is the final destination for the deceased, rumored to be the convergence of all that is filthy, dark, and debased in the world; a normal human life simply wouldn't be possible.
For someone of Qian Tiao's temperament not to bathe for two years was sheer torture.
"Ah... Su Lun, hurry up and get a bathtub ready. I can't stand it any longer," Qian Tiao clamored, before stopping as if remembering something and then asked, "Right, what enemy?"
Su Lun replied, "In the time you've been in the Netherworld these two years, there's been a lot of movement on the divine plane... Now a demigod has infiltrated Luying and is attacking cities everywhere, causing quite a headache for the imperial authorities... Sister and I have been dealing with that guy these past few days..."
As he described the recent war of the planes, he took out a large bathtub from the minor void realm, and also a water heater on the side.
These items were plentiful in the minor void realm, and he quickly assembled an outdoor bath.
After some adjustments, hot water gushed from the brass showerhead.
With no outsiders around, Qian Tiao felt no shyness as she stripped off her ragged Swordsman robe in front of Su Lun and Mr. Jing, standing bare under the shower, reveling in the long-missed warmth of the water. Droplets formed chains as they slid down her skin, washing away the clinging death energy.
Her unabashed boldness caused Mr. Jing to look on with a slight sense of resignation.
Su Lun, however, was used to it, though his gaze sharpened a bit upon seeing the unhealed scars on Qian Tiao's body. It was clear to him that these wounds hadn't healed because they had been eroded by high-level laws. Whoever dealt those injuries was of a very high rank!
Qian Tiao seemed entirely unconcerned by the eyes on her body, simply savoring the pleasure as the hot water ran over her. With a contented sigh, she murmured, "Ah... it feels great to be alive."
As she spoke, she seemed to recall the earlier topic, interjecting, "Right, that 'demigod' you mentioned... Is that the kind of being that's a bit more powerful than ninth-tiers, but not quite at the divine level?"
Su Lun nodded, "Yeah. Did you encounter any in the Netherworld, sister Qian Tiao?"
"Mhm. I saw some," Qian Tiao answered.
Su Lun wasn't surprised.
He knew a bit about the Netherworld and figured that a higher plane like that would have demigods.
However, as their conversation continued, he never expected Qian Tiao to add, "I've killed one before. He was quite tough."
Upon her words, it was as if time had hit the pause button.
Su Lun: "..."
Mr. Jing: "..."
Both men turned their heads to look at her, utterly astonished.
Quite tough...
And killed one?
The statement seemed paradoxical.
A tic formed at the corner of Su Lun's eye as he asked in disbelief, "Sister Qian Tiao, you've killed a demigod?"
"Yes, a demon, a 'Gravebane Maggot.' It's said to be a death god, but not quite at the level of a true deity,"
Qiān Tiáo seemed unimpressed.
As she spoke, hot water cascaded down from above, soaking her blue hair and clinging to her skin.
After a pause, she continued, "The Netherworld is the destination of the deceased, not just for our plane, but I've even met many formidable individuals there. Oh, you might not understand that feeling, those exceptional swordsmen who died hundreds, even thousands of years ago, they're all in the Netherworld. Experts from different eras, masters of various schools, I found almost all the origins of Sword Dao there. It was utterly exhilarating, do you know? To exchange swordplay with those masters was the most magical experience of my life..."
"..."
Su Lun and Mr. Jing could not miss the excitement in her tone.
For swordsmen, nothing is better than finding an opponent to exchange Sword Dao with, especially one stronger than themselves.
And in the Netherworld, time accumulates innumerable deceased swordsmen, theoretically providing access to everything about Sword Dao.
But before they could inquire further about what exactly the Netherworld is, Su Lun was curious about something else.
He asked, "Sister Qiān Tiáo, have you seen a deity?"
Qiān Tiáo replied, "I've seen them from a distance. Can't beat them, so I just avoided them."
Hearing this, Su Lun and Mr. Jing exchanged a look, shock apparent in their eyes.
Having seen a deity...
At that moment, Su Lun asked another question, "Sister Qiān Tiáo, have you realized your own 'rule' yet?"
In his mind, anyone who could slay a demigod must have grasped the profundity of rules and might already be a demigod themselves.
However, Qiān Tiáo gave an unexpected answer.
She countered, "Rule? What's that?"
Su Lun explained, "'Rule' is, well, above laws, a special existence in the universe, um... you could say it's a power that only demigods and deities can grasp."
"Rule" is hard to explain in words; if you've not reached that realm, descriptions are futile.
Listening, Qiān Tiáo nodded repeatedly, "Oh..."
Su Lun tried to describe "rule" using his intellect, thinking she might understand.
But to his surprise, after nodding, Qiān Tiáo asked again, "So... what exactly is that thing?"
"..."
Su Lun's eyes twitched as he asked somberly, "You haven't grasped it? But how did you manage to slay that eighth-tier giant dragon before? By slashing through the realm of rules, right?"
Qiān Tiáo, who was lathering her hair, made a knife-hand gesture offhandedly, "Just like that, a casual slash, and it was dead."
With those words, the conversation lapsed into silence again.
Su Lun: "..."
Mr. Jing: "..."
A breeze wafted through, rustling the leaves, while a crow cawed "caw caw" from a treetop.
It was then that the two realized Qiān Tiáo truly didn't know what "rule" meant. Her combat ability was more based on instinct and intuition, rather than intellectual understanding.
But one thing was certain: Qiān Tiáo's current strength could kill a demigod.
With this thought, an idea struck Su Lun suddenly, "Sister, I've got a plan!"
They had been lacking some means to slay a demigod previously, but now with Qiān Tiáo's return, they had filled that gap.
Mr. Jing caught on to what he meant and said, "You mean... not to assassinate this 'Archmage of Evil' Constantine Reiloz, but to ambush Princess Octavia J. Fielding instead?"
Su Lun nodded, "Yes."
The enemy was daring to infiltrate Ru Ying to create havoc, confident that the Alchemy Plane lacked top combat power.
But with Qiān Tiáo here, the Dawn Brigade now truly had the power to kill a demigod.
And this intelligence was a blind spot for the enemy.
If Qiān Tiáo were to show herself, the enemy would certainly be on guard next time.
Therefore, the surprise strike plan could only be used once.
If that was the case, they should go big for this one time!
Killing an ordinary demigod compared to slaying a Grand Princess of an empire, the latter would clearly yield greater gains!
Eliminating the demigod Octavia and then defeating Constantine wouldn't be difficult, and might even allow Su Lun and his allies to confront the million-strong Mage Legion without hesitation.
If the plan succeeded, with the current strength of the Alchemy Plane, they might indeed be able to deal a significant blow to the grand warfare plans of the Celestial Plane!
Mr. Jing also realized this in a flash.
Though the plan was perfect, she thought of a very practical problem, "But Princess Octavia is currently the commander of a million-strong legion; she won't engage lightly. It won't be easy to lure her out alone."
Su Lun's eyes flickered with a ready plan, "Under normal circumstances, it's true we can't draw her out. But I have a divine taboo item in my little void realm that if revealed, will surely bait her."
At this, Mr. Jing obviously realized something, her bright eyes gleaming.
The plan was absolutely feasible!

chapters.title: Chapter 640 - 639 Ambush the Demigod
chapters.content:
In the mountain forest outside Anlogos County, at the temporary campsite, a giant bathtub was emitting wisps of white steam.
Qian Tiao lay lazily in the bathtub, enjoying a large tub of hot water all by herself.
But on closer inspection, the clear warm water was tinged with strands of eerie black air, clearly emanating from Qian Tiao.
At this moment, her skin wasn't the healthy rosy hue of the living; rather, it resembled the dark cyan of the undead, her aura something between human and ghost.
Su Lun was not surprised; only by contracting the aura of death in the Netherworld could she have survived.
Now that she was back, this abnormality would gradually fade away.
Qian Tiao still had many troublesome wounds that hadn't healed, and he took the opportunity to tend to them.
Through the All-knowing Eye, Su Lun noticed some dark energies in the wounds that he had never seen before. Curious, he casually asked, "Sister Qian Tiao, what exactly is the Netherworld like?"
A higher dimensional plane wasn't odd to him, but he was curious about what a world only the dead visit was truly like.
Just from these unseen dark energies, it was clear they challenged some of his existing beliefs.
It was like he had suddenly discovered a new world, everything felt remarkably novel.
Life and death, the worlds of the living and the departed...
It gave him a unique insight, as if he was on the verge of grasping something.
"What's it like?"
Qian Tiao closed her eyes and thought for a moment before responding, "Mmm... it's similar to the novel worlds we've visited before but much larger. There are people there, and monsters, just more formidable. Oh, and real gods too."
Su Lun found this answer too vague, and he continued, "No, I mean, what are the differences in the rules and alchemical laws between the Netherworld and the alchemical planes? And those deceased masters you encountered, how do their comprehensions of laws and rules differ from those of human professionals?"
"Ah... different laws?"
At this question, Qian Tiao stammered and couldn't describe it immediately.
After trying to organize her thoughts to no avail, she gave up decisively and grumbled, "How would I know? There are just a lot of formidable people and monsters. When we meet them, we fight... just killing our way through... that's been the last two years for me."
"..."
Su Lun couldn't help but laugh and cry at her response.
Mr. Jing too couldn't resist chuckling lightly.
They had hoped that Qian Tiao, having experienced it firsthand, could share some insights, but from her response, it was clearly not going to happen.
This was far less informative than what Su Lun could gather from reading "Netherworld" by Fujiwara Hayato himself.
Faced with beautiful landscapes, a great literati could describe the scene as "dusky snow on blue mountains," write about "birds startled into flight," and "dramatic peaks"...
But when described by some others, it was just crude expletives all the way.
Qian Tiao clearly belonged to the latter.
Her two-year experience in the Netherworld as a grand swordmaster who had slain demigods didn't provide as detailed a travelogue as Fujiwara Hayato's stealthy observations and records.
It wasn't to say her understanding of the world was insufficient.
It was just that her path in cultivation differed from others'—she improved through actual combat.
She could do it, but she couldn't necessarily articulate why she had to do it that way.
She understood, but couldn't describe it to others.
Listening to her, Su Lun chuckled, not too surprised, and continued asking about other matters.
Fortunately, Qian Tiao remembered clearly the opponents she had encountered, those grand swordmasters she had fought, and the monsters she had slain.
It could all be summed up in one word: Slaughter...
Su Lun and Mr. Jing indeed found delight in these descriptions, as they too could glean some real glimpses into the Netherworld from them.
....
A few days later, in the southern part of the Imperial Strait, Taganweier Trench.
Several figures stood on the endless sea.
Su Lun, Mr. Jing, Qian Tiao, along with Pandora and Pestroya under a rune-etched black umbrella.
This was their chosen ambush location.
A battle with a demigod could affect hundreds of miles around; this spot was sufficiently remote and the water deep enough that it wouldn't harm the innocent or allow the enemy to escape.
They were here to ambush a demigod, and since class levels below ninth had little role to play, it was just the five of them.
Mr. Jing surveyed the surroundings and softly declared, "Let's get ready to move."
Everyone nodded to each other and began to set up formations on the nearby sea surface.
Mr. Jing split himself into nine, and with a gesture, the sea became turbulent as wood elements wildly converged, forming a divine-scale super alchemical formation [Emerald God's Descent] that was rapidly coalescing.
Having fought before, they knew that Heavenly Imperial Grand Princess Octavia J. Fielding was a Holy Light Mage; only a wood-based ritual would have a better controlling effect on her.
Su Lun also took out various materials and arranged them in the sea.
These measures might not trap a demigod, but with a prepared ambush, they could increase their chances of victory.
The ambush was already prepared.
They met again.
The net had been cast, and all that was missing was the bait.
At that moment, Su Lun raised his hand forward, and from the black void in his palm slowly emerged an iron-coated coffin.
As the coffin slowly emerged from the spatial crack, everyone's gaze focused on it.
The iron coffin was covered in mysterious sealing runes, and its lid bore a human face relief, its features blurred but the vertical pupil in the brow strikingly vivid.
As soon as the coffin appeared, an eerie, bone-chilling aura enveloped the area.
This was one of the royal treasures containing forbidden divine items that Su Lun had once found in the Lingdun Mirror Library.
Qian Tiao frowned slightly at the sight of the coffin.
At that moment, she realized that the deadly aura on her body subtly resonated with that of the coffin, and she muttered, "This coffin is rather ominous... I feel that even the deity I encountered in the Netherworld wasn't as sinister."
Pandora observed for a moment and analyzed as well, "Indeed. The mere essence of the Power of Faith emanating from the coffin could not be condensed by an ordinary deity."
Su Lun explained gravely, "It contains the corpse of a deity from the Three-eyed tribe. And it might not be just any ordinary deity."
According to his current understanding of the world, the rank of the divine corpse inside the coffin was extremely high.
Thus, bringing out the coffin itself posed a great risk.
If there had been a better option at hand, he wouldn't have used this item as bait.
The rank of the coffin was so high that even after a long discussion, no one could fully understand it.
At this point, Qian Tiao asked, "With such an obvious bait, are you sure that the celestial demigod will definitely come?"
It was indeed a transparent stratagem.
Suddenly displaying such an item at this critical juncture, the enemy would be suspicious if they didn't think it was a trap.
Yet, Su Lun's face showed unwavering confidence as he spoke, "She will definitely come."
Pausing for a moment, he further explained, "This coffin is an object from the celestial dimension that the deities have decreed must be found, its priority even above the 'Well of Mimir.' That woman is overly confident, strong, and has the protection of deities, so she will undoubtedly believe that no one in the alchemic dimension could kill her. Even if she suspects a trap, she will still come."
Hearing this, Mr. Jing also showed a look of agreement.
She had fought with that Octavia before and fully agreed with this point.
A demigod's arrogance gave substantial confidence to the lure, making it highly likely to succeed.
Su Lun said nothing more, looking at the coffin, "Everyone, prepare yourselves, I am going to open the coffin."
Mr. Jing and the others nodded, immediately distancing themselves and preparing with full alertness.
No one knew what would happen when the coffin was opened, so caution was paramount.
"Release!"
Su Lun let out a soft command; the sorcerer's seals in his hand swiftly changed.
He had thoroughly studied the seals on the coffin, and at that instant, the runes on the coffin lit up. It was as if a rusty iron door was being opened with a "click click" sound of metal friction near his ears.
But at the same time, Su Lun immediately felt a chilling force attack from behind, as if some terrifying entity had locked onto him.
Su Lun didn't dare to completely break the seal, only cautiously pushing the coffin lid open a crack.
But even in that instant, it felt as if a gate to hell had opened, a terrifying horror striking instantly.
Not far away, Mr. Jing and the others clearly felt it too, all showing a readiness for a significant threat, fearing that some monstrous creature might jump out of the coffin.
Fortunately, having been prepared, Su Lun let only a hint of the presence within the coffin leak out before quickly shutting the lid, sealing away the immense terror.
Upon looking again, he found that his back was drenched with sweat.
A twitch in the corner of Su Lun's eye as he recalled that moment's sensation, his heart pounding, "What exactly is sealed inside that even after so many have died, it still holds such terrifying divine might?"
He also felt relieved that the predecessor who made the coffin had been thorough, preventing the possibility of the corpse within gaining sentience.
Otherwise, from that earlier moment, a monstrosity capable of obliterating everything might have directly emerged.
Su Lun pondered no longer, having already placed the coffin back into the small void realm for safekeeping.
Now that the aura had been emitted, it was just a matter of waiting for the bait to be taken.
...
While Su Lun and his companions were setting the trap, eight hundred nautical miles away in the middle of the Imperial Strait, a massive fleet of magical airships was majestically heading west towards the mainland of Ruthenia.
Looking around, the sky was filled with magical airships, large and small, numbering in the thousands. The magic runes on the airships' gasbags shone brightly, painted with the sacred sun flag of the Ascieden Empire. They resembled giant whales soaring through the sky, their passage stirring magic power turbulently, causing schools of fish to scatter in haste.
The divine dimension's million-strong magic legion hadn't split up, opting instead for a mass march in a large formation.
Wherever the million-strong army passed, no defensive positions could withstand a single blow from the magic legion.
In just a few days, they had already destroyed several of the United Empire's outer defense lines across the Cross-Sea Strait. Engagements concluded after a mere encounter. Not just fortifications, but even islands were flattened with magic, their advance unstoppable.
As the million-strong army neared Ruthenian territory, it was a situation of relentless advance.
They would head straight to Lingdun, the capital, to obliterate the alchemic civilization.
Amidst this fleet of magic airships, there was one flagship, magnificently adorned with gold paint.
In the cabin of the flagship, Princess Oktaavia J. Fielding, wearing a golden mask, had her eyes closed.
However, suddenly, as if sensing something, she abruptly opened her eyes, "The presence of the gods?"
In an instant, she understood something, her gaze piercing the south through the viewport.
The essence was fleeting, but she had clearly identified the direction and discerned the emanating essence as that of the ancestors of their three-eye celestial tribe!
A thought flitted through Oktaavia's eyes, and she made her decision instantly, "I'll go check it out."
Upon hearing this, an elderly servant from the group around her stood up, "But, Your Royal Highness Princess, could it be a trap set by the natives?"
This person was none other than the ninth-tier Thunder Mage who had battled with Su Lun in the mines of Manuel Hill.
Oktaavia responded proudly, "So what if it is?"
Before the words had even finished, she had already vanished from the spot.
She had previously witnessed the pinnacle of combat power in this alchemical plane; while it was somewhat more formidable than expected, it still wasn't enough to make her hesitate!
"Your old servant will accompany Your Royal Highness."
The ninth-tier Thunder Mage did not dare to say more, and with a flash of lightning, he too vanished from the spot.
...
Meanwhile, after opening the coffin, Su Lun and Mr. Jing were leisurely waiting on the ocean surface.
Qiantiao was already wrapped in mortuary cloth, Pestroya was in the rune-covered umbrella, Pandora was in her little void realm...
The ocean surface appeared calm and unruffled.
Barely waiting long, the black crow on the shoulder called out with a "caw."
Su Lun suddenly opened his eyes from his meditation and said, "Sister, they're here!"
Mr. Jing also immediately entered combat mode upon hearing this.
The two of them looked up and suddenly, two figures appeared on the horizon, one using Spatial Displacement and the other riding the winds and thunder.
They made no attempt to conceal their tracks, moving rapidly through teleportation.
Just when they were seen at the horizon, in the blink of an eye, the two figures had already appeared in front of them.
Seeing the female mage with the golden mask and the Thunder Mage old man behind her, Su Lun and Mr. Jing immediately recognized these old acquaintances.
Choosing such a distant ambush location was because they guessed that the enemy would be eager to come and check the situation.
And with the speed of a demigod, hardly any entourage could keep up.
Just as expected, Octavia, the demigod-strength powerhouse, was confident enough to come with just a servant.
...
Under the scrutiny of the All-knowing Eye, the disguise of Su Lun and Mr. Jing was seen through in an instant.
Seeing someone guarding the place, this great princess from the divine plane knew immediately it was an ambush.
But she was not surprised.
Because she had come here to find more about the source of the ancestral essence detected just now.
Now, looking at these two alchemical natives, she felt even better.
Thus, she could confirm that the source of that essence was indeed on these two.
By killing these two natives, not only could the clues be found, but it would also directly eradicate the top experts of the alchemical civilization, once and for all.
Even knowing the traps were set all around, only cold disdain was visible in her eyes.
In her mind, these alchemical natives knew destruction was imminent and probably wanted to make a desperate gamble.
By her calculations, assassinating her, the commanding officer, was the only chance to reverse the outcome of the war.
Unfortunately, it was futile.
...
A month ago, the two sides had fought, knowing each other's strengths and weaknesses.
Seeing his old opponent, Mr. Jing didn't hold back either; the eight clones that had been lying in wait around simultaneously formed seals, "Divine Spell: Emerald God's Descent."
Suddenly, a gigantic entity stirred in the sea, the dense energy of the Wood elemental force converged on the ocean surface, and in the blink of an eye, countless thick vines emerged from beneath the calm sea, swiftly transforming the area into an island formed of vines.
Simultaneously, Mr. Jing altered the sorcerer's seals again, the nine clones once more channeling, "Divine Spell: Eternal Night's Seal!"
Although it had only been a month since their last clash, Mr. Jing's strength had significantly improved.
After observing the stele at the God Burial Ground for a month, he had come close to touching the threshold of the secrets of the rules.
As he was well prepared, the two from the divine plane hadn't even realized before the enormous barrier had already solidified into place.
Su Lun was not idle either; he directly took out an ancient bronze lamp.
The hook connected to the bronze lamp stretched forward, and two beams swept across, astonishingly locking the souls of the two enemies within the range of the lamp's light.
"[Tartaros's Soul Binding Lantern]Once this sealed artifact is used, either you die or I perish, with no third outcome."
To control the demigod, Su Lun used his own soul as the anchor, ensuring that without him being killed, the enemy could not escape."
At this point, Princess Octavia also faintly sensed that something was amiss.
She saw through the effects of the Soul Lantern, her intuition telling her that danger was imminent.
Being a demigod was no small feat, she immediately lifted her Golden Mask, revealing the third eye on her forehead.
Her previous contempt was drowned in an instant, and she struck with her strongest state!
Looking again, the woman's expression was utterly solemn, and she began chanting a mysterious incantation. The moment she opened her mouth, dazzling Divine Light suddenly overflowed from her body!
Having fought before, Octavia knew very well that her strength was not enough to kill the two natives before her, and she clearly sensed that something was off.
So, at this encounter, she chose to summon the Divine Power, aiming for a sure kill!
In that instant, an indescribable will seemed to break through the dimensions, its arrival so fast it was unimaginable.
Even Su Lun was surprised.
Because this speed of divine invocation was several times faster than the dimensional passage before.
Indeed, it was beyond expectation.
Meanwhile, capturing the change in Su Lun's expression, Octavia had already revealed a cold smirk filled with certainty: disappointed, are you, natives!
She was Octavia, Princess of the Ascieden Empire, sheltered by the gods!
Her current realm allowed her to summon the will of the gods instantly, without any need for chanting!
The last time with the dimensional passage, she knew someone was secretly watching, so she deliberately slowed down the summoning time.
It was to mislead the alchemists of this plane!
Now, they had indeed been fooled.
With the will of the gods bolstering her, Princess Octavia was invincible across the alchemic plane!
However, what followed disappointed the Princess greatly.
Su Lun's surprise was just momentary; it seemed that to him, the arrival of the divine will sooner or later, did not matter.
Mr. Jing, using two divine spells instantly, created a sea of vines on the ground, and the sky had already turned pitch black.
The seal was formed.
She restricted the enemy and transformed into a beam of reflective light, charging at the Princess.
The ninth-tier thunder old man wanted to protect his master. Knowing he could not stop Mr. Jing, he charged at Su Lun just like before.
The move of this ninth-tier thunder Sage was quite dramatic; he turned into lightning itself, with snakes of thunder crackling all over the dark sky.
This thunder old man was strong, resilient, and fast, and if it were like the last time, Su Lun wouldn't be able to handle him swiftly.
However, just as the old man made his move, the thunder in the sky, which was purple, suddenly changed, unnervingly coating itself in a layer of dark red.
In an instant, a dense aura of hell swept between heaven and earth.
The frenzy of lightning was as if a regional demon god was about to appear.
This commotion even overshadowed Princess Octavia, who was summoning the divine will in the distance!
"How is this possible?"
The old man's face changed instantly!
Because he clearly sensed that a stronger force had stripped away the control of the thunder he had gathered.
This meant that there was a thunder practitioner stronger than him!
But he himself was a ninth-tier thunder Sage, who else could have greater control over thunder?
The old man's eyes were fierce, his robes billowed, and the thunder runes on his skin glowed to their utmost, as he tried to wrest back control of the thunder.
However, before he had the chance, Su Lun had already brought his hands together, and shouted, "Secret Technique: Hundred Thousand Layers Spatial Seal!"
Normally, this move to control the old man, capable of Thunderclap Teleport, would be difficult. But at this moment, with all the thunder elements in disarray, the old man's use of magic stiffened for an instant, trapping him completely.
And this was just the beginning!
At that moment, as if commanded by fate, someone softly chanted, "God-slaying Single Strike Style - Thunder Walk."
Looking again, amidst the endless darkness, a powerful Sword Qi suddenly slashed down from the void.
The thunder old man couldn't move and felt the lethal danger; magic power surged, and his skin faintly glistened with a bronze metallic sheen.
A moment later, the Sword Qi crossed his waist.
This old man was a rune mage, tough enough to rival dragons; under normal circumstances, his physical body resisting an attack from a ninth-tier professional wouldn't be fatal.
Yet, as the Sword Qi swept past, the thunder old man incredulously looked down at the bloodline at his waist, muttering something, but unable to make a sound.
His life rapidly faded, and he looked towards the direction from which the Sword Qi had come. There, a dual-headed, six-armed golden-bodied rakshasa stood with a sword, domineering like a god or devil.
In an instant, the old man's soul left his body, and he was breathless.

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - 640: Making a Fortune
chapters.content:
Su Lun had previously fought with that ninth-tier Thunder Magician and understood the man's strength all too well.
Among the ninth-tier Sages of Law in the divine realm, he was outstanding, mastering thunder magic to near human limits without any weaknesses.
Even if Su Lun wanted to kill him now, it wasn't certain he could succeed.
However, unexpectedly, he was slain by a single stroke of the sword.
Although Su Lun had helped with restraining control, the fact that this slash broke through the [Thunder God Protection] was still a great surprise to him.
"Realm of slicing through laws... Sister Qian Tiao's sword realm is even more outrageous than Senior Bartolo,"
Upon looking again, Su Lun saw that far in the distance, Qian Tiao's Rakshasa Golden Body shone brilliantly.
At this moment, her natural talent, [Rakshasa Woman], was no longer just a phantom. She had truly transformed into a golden-bodied Rakshasa. Her skin seemed to be cast in gold lacquer, flames flared from her hair, with two heads and six arms, one face fierce and wrathful like a terrifying deity, the other filled with compassion and sorrow like a Rakshasa. Her body was surrounded by a domineering aura, standing in the void, the three magatama thunder drums behind her golden body drawing in a tumultuous convergence of thunder elements around her, creating an expansive field of malevolent thunder.
It was this terrifying control of thunder and lightning that caused the Thunder Magician to stiffen for an instant before he was slashed.
In her six-armed form, Qian Tiao held a sword in each hand, her left wielding the [Ghost Maru Bai Mokuzo Masayoshi] with white demonic qi steaming around it. As she drew the blade, it was as if thousands of demons were unleashed; in her right hand, the number one Famed Sword of the twelve artisans, [Buddha Butcher], mixed golden and crimson qi. It was both Buddhist and demonic, both righteous and evil, barely transcending the mortal realm.
With this golden body form, she looked like a deity guarding the gates of hell.
After that sweep of the sword came the vision of the gates of hell wide open.
"A physical manifestation of the sorcerer's seals?"
Seeing this scene, Su Lun thought of a secret divine technique from Mountain Hermit country.
This was a rare vision that occurred only when certain deities descended to the world.
Qian Tiao's current might was many times stronger than two years ago.
"It seems Sister Qian Tiao has truly grasped something incredible in the Netherworld Sea..."
Joy filled Su Lun's heart as well.
Through the All-knowing Eye, he saw deeper aspects behind this physical manifestation, which described a special rule governing the Yellow Springs Hell.
The descriptions from Qian Tiao over the past few days hadn't impressed him much, but now seeing it firsthand, he realized just how extreme the Sword God realm she had traded her life for these past two years was.
...
Qian Tiao started with her strongest state of triple unraveling, as their main target for this ambush was not the ninth-tier Thunder Magician, but the demigoddess Octavia.
This Grand Princess of the divine realm watched as her servant was slain, the expression on her proud face momentarily stiffening.
She never imagined that her servant would be killed in just one encounter.
Noticing Qian Tiao's form as the Rakshasa Golden Body, Octavia's brows furrowed. She felt a lethal threat from the domineering sword intent.
However, her surprise was fleeting, and she sneered in her heart, "So the Alchemy realm was hiding such a master after all. No wonder they dared to ambush..."
Now with divine power on her side, she believed herself invincible in this realm no matter what her opponents did.
But what followed shocked the half-god of the divine race.
Su Lun and his companions must have been fully assured to dare an ambush.
They had certainly considered that this person would eventually summon the will of a deity to descend.
A demigod combined with the descending will of a True God would indeed be invincible in the Alchemy realm.
But what if the descent was interrupted?
When Su Lun released the bidirectional worm in the realm passageway earlier, he had carefully observed how the will of the deity descended. He discovered that the descent of a god had a direct relationship with the "Power of Faith."
So...what if the faith was disrupted?
In theory, this cross-realm connection was like the wireless signal of a communicator, which could definitely be interfered with if the correct method was found.
Although Grand Princess Octavia summoned the will of the deity instantly, to Su Lun and his companions' surprise, the outcome was the same.
Just then, strands of red streaked across the sealed pitch-black sky, and in a blink, an eerie red moon was suspended overhead.
The light from this red moon bathed the entire sealed space in blood-red, and most strangely, it suppressed the divine light emanating from Octavia's body.
Where previously there had been an ineffable will descending, it now flickered unstably as if the signal was being interfered with, and the divine light on her body flared and dimmed erratically.
Octavia felt this change and her expression darkened sharply as if she had seen something unbelievable, "These natives have interfered with my faith and divine power?!"
Realizing this, her gaze fiercely turned to the red moon in the sky, a vertical pupil on her forehead shining with bright blue light, already seeing through something, "A heretical false deity?"
Hmph!
With a cold snort, Octavia's vertical pupil shot out a light of decomposition, puncturing a huge hole in that red moon.
[Grand Unraveling] could decompose everything!
However, after the red moon was pierced, the skies filled with blood-colored ribbons dancing wildly as if obeying a softly uttered command, "Tsukuyomi - Lunar Divine Path!"
Looking again, another red moon had formed nearby.
The great god Tsukuyomi was not so easy to kill.
From their journey to the God Burial Ground, not only Su Lun and his companions gained much, Pandora, the false deity, gained the most!
That place was filled with remnants of shattered Power of Faith, all of which she absorbed.
In terms of divine power, Pandora might well be the most formidable among the false deities of the realm.
Moreover, as long as her divine vessel remained unbroken, she could not be killed; being pierced by this divine eye meant, at most, a loss of some divine power.
Octavia, seeing her strike fail, her eyes sharpened as she already saw through everything.
In an instant, divine power converged in her hands into a dazzling light, suddenly transforming into a sword and a shield; two divine artifact projections.
In her left hand was "Puni's Holy Sword of Light," and in her right, the "Shield of Purity"!
With both divine artifacts in hand, she transformed into a stream of light and rapidly slashed towards the red moon in the sky.
Only divine power could better deal with false gods!
Although she did not know how the power of faith was stolen, the power of a true god was not something these false gods could withstand.
However, just as the holy light was about to touch the red moon, a bolt of lightning had already intercepted it midway.
With a loud "boom," holy light, thunder, space... various terrifying chaotic rules turned into shockwaves, instantly sweeping across the entire space.
This strike was definitely beyond the ninth tier!
The two figures in the void touched and immediately withdrew. On a closer look, the Rakshasa Golden Body's body sparkled with a thousand thunders. She took Octavia's strike head-on without being at a disadvantage.
Intercepted, Octavia's face darkened, "Strange, how can she be so strong..."
She never imagined there could be such a powerful expert in the Alchemy dimension.
No, experts of this level are impossible to cultivate in a low-level dimension like the current Alchemy dimension!
The will of the gods descended, and in fact, She had already recognized who the Rakshasa Woman was, but the level from a few years ago in the Dragon Country Waters was not impressive enough to warrant further attention, not expecting to see her become so strong now.
You cannot raise a big fish in shallow water, such experts have already touched the limit of the Alchemy dimension's rules, and under normal circumstances, shouldn't appear.
Could she be from a higher dimension?
But before she could ponder further, Qiantiao (Rakshasa Woman) had once again turned into lightning, sending a tyrannical sword qi slashing towards her.
The red moon in the sky grew more eerie, and the power of faith was being stolen more fiercely, like a dam breach.
Mr. Jing was also busy. At the same time as Pandora and Qiantiao made their move, she also freed up her hands, changing her technique once more: "Alchemy Secrets of the Dark Ouroboros!"
As this magician concentrated, the dark elements in the space started to flow like sticky tar, forming into a giant serpent, biting its own tail, creating a special inner circulatory barrier.
Sir Isaac once captured a Fallen Angel, a true god, and he had no shortage of methods to limit the gods.
And as Sir Isaac's daughter, how could Mr. Jing not know those methods?
"Pitch Night Seal" alongside the "Dark Ouroboros," one seals and one transforms, was an excellent combination for restraining any divine power.
The two techniques, using alchemy's law of equivalent exchange, trapped all energy within the sealed space.
It's like stewing meat in a big pot; even the toughest meat will soon soften in the pot.
No matter what method the enemy used, the released energy would be converted into dark energy, and then backlash against them!
Octavia, embroiled in battle, evidently noticed this trap, her expression growing uglier by the moment.
She had the "Shield of Purity," impervious to all laws; she also had "Puni's Holy Sword of Light," indestructible; and the Eyes of a Heavenly God, seeing through all things!
Originally, the intelligence on the Alchemy dimension only included two ninth-tier individuals, and even if ten or eight more ninth-tier individuals were to come, they could not have stopped the Divine Descending Technique.
But regrettably, there arrived a few such troublesome beings.
And it seems as though these individuals' cooperation specifically counters the Divine Descending Technique.
Octavia, now besieged, knew that continuing like this would spell great trouble, her face covered in coldness as she bellowed, "Divine Arts·Holy Light Illumination!"
In an instant, divine power burned, and her presence surged tenfold, the holy light from her body bursting forth like the light of a great sun, so piercing that it forced people to avert their eyes.
For a moment, holy light dispelled the endless darkness, reaching the edges of the barrier, the thick vines burning.
In terms of realm alone, she, a demigod, was higher than anyone present, including Su Lun!
Now with her divine power burning and her strength soaring, there was no way she could lose!
At this moment, Octavia had discarded the idea of swiftly killing the few Alchemy natives in front of her. She wanted to break free from this sealed space first.
However, she forgot about one person!
She wanted to escape, but found her soul restricted within the range of that ancient bronze lamp, and when she tried to use "Flash" to teleport, she discovered that the entire space was like it had been cast with molten iron, completely negating instant movement.
If it were just one type of measure, she could have found a way to counter it, but this series of restrictions had already countered her various abilities at every turn, leaving her with no opportunity whatsoever.
Besides, there was no way Su Lun and the others would let her struggle free from her bonds!
...
"Hehe, burning divine power to escape? How could we possibly let you get away!"
From the corner, Su Lun's second stage of the All-knowing Eye had already seen through everything.
Although the Grand Princess was in an extreme state, just like a raging state, as long as they survived this peak wave, the longer it dragged on, the lower her chances of winning.
Yet a demigod expert burning divine power was already beyond any power scale known to the Alchemy dimension.
Su Lun also had no idea what would happen next.
The moment he saw Octavia burning her divine power, his intuition told him that methods below the level of godhood may not keep her, so he immediately concentrated a technique, using the "Urobolos Space-Time Ring" to weld shut the space within this sealed area!
In the current situation, only this Divine King artifact had a one hundred percent certainty of restraining her!
This almost amounted to the entire Alchemy dimension putting all their chips on a single bet; they must kill Octavia here!
Now that this woman was held back by Qiantiao and the nine Mr. Jings, where could she find the opportunity to deal with him?
Su Lun finally had the space to unleash his attacks.
He didn't waste any time. As he restricted the space, his hands rapidly formed the sorcerer's seals, while behind him, the eight-armed spider spear had already pulled out several scrolls.
The scrolls "pop pop pop" burst open, and in an instant, over a hundred thousand gargoyles had already appeared throughout the space.
In the sky, a colossal cross instantly took shape.
With only one enemy currently, the gargoyles didn't require complex manipulation. They acted like the foundation of an alchemy array, just needing to stand firmly and attack.
Controlling a hundred thousand at once wasn't too great a problem for Su Lun.
In the blink of an eye, runes lit up on the dense mass of gargoyles.
The output capability of more than a hundred thousand gargoyles working together was no weaker than that of a dozen ninth-tier professionals!
Su Lun commanded the puppet army to conjure alchemy comparable to ninth-tier might and bombarded the blinding entity in the sky that resembled the sun.
Su Lun, Mr. Jing, and Qiān Tiáo were all very familiar with each other, and their teamwork was extremely tacit.
The three of them, attacking Princess Oktaavia with a barrage, turned the sealed space into a battlefield where sword qi shot in all directions and a multitude of curses and Divine Arts were cast as if they cost nothing.
The vast space resembled a sealed nuclear explosion site, where high-tier rules and the powers of law were thrown into disarray.
The battle was like a meat grinder. In such an intense fight, an ordinary ninth-tier professional wouldn't last even a moment before being pulverized.
It had to be admitted that this Magic God of the divine realm, burning her Divine Power, was absurdly strong.
So strong that perhaps no matter how many ninth-tier fighters came, they couldn't "invincibly" kill her.
But killing Su Lun and the others was impossible for her too.
Although Mr. Jing's mirror duplication ability was somewhat weaker in offensive power, his self-preservation was exceptionally strong, with an even chance of survival even against a demigod;
Qiān Tiáo was already a ninth-tier Sword Saint, and she had a record of slaying demigod monsters in the Netherworld, so although this one was a bit different, she definitely wouldn't be defeated in a short time;
Su Lun was the same. Although he was only eighth-tier, when it came to survival,
with the "Urobolos Space-Time Ring" being used, he became one with the space, and space became him.
Unless his Spiritual Power was exhausted, it would be hard for him to be killed.
Then there was Pandora who had transformed into the god Tsukuyomi, and the Spiritual Body of Pestoya. They were both extremely special and hard to seriously injure.
In the entire group, the only thing that could be considered a weakness was the puppets themselves.
Although the gargoyles were forged from living silver and could withstand physical and magical attacks of about eighth-tier, they were practically made of paper under the assault of a demigod.
Especially under the Divine Artifact Projection "Puni's Holy Sword of Light," they were sliced down by the dozens; and underneath the penetrating light beam of "Comprehensive Truth," they were obliterated upon contact.
But puppets have no notion of being "killed," at most their structure could be destroyed. Even if they were completely disintegrated by "Comprehensive Truth," Su Lun wouldn't be distressed at all.
After the trip to the God Burial Ground, the living silver in the minor void realm had piled up into mountains, as much as he could want.
Destroy one batch, and he'd create another.
Moreover, Su Lun was certain that the greater the cost of killing an enemy, the richer the spoils of war would definitely be.
...
Thus, the two sides staged a pinnacle battle of the alchemy realm within the sealed space.
If not for Su Lun reinforcing the space, such an intense battle might have even caused the space near the Taganweier Trench to collapse.
Before long, the fierce battle within the sealed space continued.
But after all, there were limits to burning Divine Power.
As Oktaavia burned and failed to break through as expected, the Divine Power in her became thinner and thinner.
It wasn't just Pandora who had stolen her Power of Faith; Mr. Jing also used methods to limit the descent of Divine Power, cutting off the flow. The situation for this Magic God was getting worse.
Burning Divine Power also took a massive toll on the vessel itself.
For a mortal's body to bear a force far beyond its physical capacity was its own kind of destruction.
On the other hand, Qiān Tiáo, the Sword Saint who could sever rules, was not to be underestimated.
Regular methods might struggle to kill Oktaavia who had the "Shield of Innocence" to protect her, but Qiān Tiáo's Sword Dao was capable of killing even a demigod.
From the beginning, where Oktaavia dominated Su Lun and the others, to her Divine Power finally running dry, it became them hunting down the Grand Princess.
