In the pitch-black space, one could see lightning chasing a "sun" everywhere, with lightning bolts crossing in lethal patterns.
Occasionally, there were sneak attacks from reflective mirror lights and entwining moonlight, while the puppet legion on the ground also intermittently unleashed various spells...
Although Su Lun and the others suffered some during the fierce battle, they had prepared for fighting many against one, and clearly, the enemy suffered even more.
During the intense battle of attrition, Oktaavia gradually began to falter.
Over-exhausted from burning her Divine Power, her body, like an over-burnt sun, showed molten lava-like cracks on her fair skin. Amidst the fierce battle, some burnt dust from her skin also began to rise.
And after her body began having issues, it became increasingly difficult for the limited Divine Power to descend again.
But Su Lun and the others didn't give the enemy any time to breathe, continuing the battle of attrition.
Finally, seizing the opportunity, Qiān Tiáo thunderously slashed her sword through.
Pale gold blood spattered the sky as Oktaavia's right arm, holding the Holy Light Sword, was severed at the root!
Seeing this, everyone collectively breathed a sigh of relief.
With a limb gone, combat effectiveness was greatly diminished.
The defeat was certain.
Mr. Jing watched as Qian Tian's strike was successful, and almost immediately pursued the victory, as countless pitch-black chains wrapped around the Grand Princess's ankles. Then, with a flash of mirror light, her entire foot was severed.
Oktaavia, missing an arm and leg, no longer had the strength to fight, and could not even maintain the projections of two Divine Artifacts. She wanted to struggle, but at that moment, Su Lun had already appeared in front of her, clapped his hands, and completely sealed her limbs.
Almost simultaneously, red threads from the moon in the sky completely entangled Oktaavia, cutting off all Divine Power and Power of Faith.
Mr. Jing raised his hand and a silver mirror light, like silk satin, added another layer that wrapped the enemy like a mummy.
...
"Finally got rid of this guy, huh."
"Yeah. The combat power of a Demigod is really outrageous."
"...."
Su Lun and his group, looking at Oktaavia trapped so tightly, let out a collective sigh of relief.
Although the process of besieging her was fraught with danger, the outcome was good.
They had planned to kill her if they couldn't capture her alive.
If they could take her alive, then... the real drama was about to unfold.
Such a perfect bait, the million-strong army from the divine plane would undoubtedly come to rescue, even if it meant abandoning the assault on Luying.
To encircle and strike the reinforcements was the best strategy!
The communicator was now conveying urgent intelligence from the Empire's military: sure enough, the million-strong army from the divine plane had already changed their course to come to the rescue.
Even the "Archmage of Evil" Constantine Reiloz, who had previously been hidden in Luying causing destruction, was rushing over in a hurry.
But it would still take some time for them to arrive.
Su Lun looked at the Demigod who couldn't move, raised his hand and summoned a deformed figure in a white lab coat, "Doctor, I'm counting on you."
"Hmm."
The person who appeared was naturally Dr. Banks.
Without any delay after his arrival, he stretched out his arm, which transformed into a mass of black living tissue, and reached for Oktaavia's face, who couldn't resist.
The black living tissue covered the Demigod's face and pulsated. In a short while, a complete eyeball connected to nerves was extracted.
This was the third eye of the divine race.
Now extracted, even if Oktaavia could fully recover, her combat power would be greatly reduced.
Dr. Banks placed the eyeball in a container and said, "I'm going to the laboratory now. It would be even better if the body could be kept intact."
"Okay."
Su Lun nodded, raised his hand, and took Dr. Banks into the small void realm.
At this moment, Mr. Jing said, "Everyone, take a moment to catch your breath; there are a few tough battles ahead."
Qian Tian, with a battle-eager expression, said, "Is there another Demigod among those guys from the divine plane? Tsk tsk, I wonder if they'll fall for it."
Pandora also took human form and smiled faintly, "They'll probably come."
Mr. Jing also exhaled a long breath, relieved not only for defeating a powerful enemy, but because this battle had great significance for the subsequent campaigns: "Hmm. With this bait, we finally have a breakthrough in the upcoming decisive battle with the million-strong army."
"..."
For Su Lun, it was all the same; his energy was not too depleted, as the "Heart of Isaac Alchemy" was rapidly regenerating. Even if he had to fight immediately, it wouldn't be a big problem.
While speaking, he picked up the severed arm of Oktaavia.
On the five pale fingers, there were three rings.
Two pieces of magical equipment, one an epic-quality magic amplifier "Magic Disaster Ring," and one a sacred relic of the Holy Church's military faction "Original Holy Light Badge,"
Both were top-tier magical equipment, second only to Divine Artifacts.
The last ring was the storage ring.
Su Lun was eager to see the spoils of this battle.
He always thought that Oktaavia J. Fielding, being the Grand Princess of the Ascieden Empire from the divine plane and a Demigod, would naturally be wealthy.
But as he gazed upon the mountainous pile of items inside the spatial fragment-made storage ring, even he couldn't help but swear in awe, "Fuck... I'm rich!"
His eyes scanned over the dense array of various magical equipment, potions, scrolls, gemstones... rows upon rows on shelves, box after box neatly packed.
It looked like a huge part of the million-strong army's high-level resources were right here.
Su Lun himself had several fortunes from past adventures and was considered one of the wealthiest individuals in the alchemy plane. Yet, upon seeing the wealth in this storage ring, he was breathlessly awed.
While he was inspecting the magical equipment, he noticed a magic chest sealed tight within the storage ring. The magical runes on the chest were of such high quality that they stood out even among such a trove of treasures.
"Could it be...?"
Su Lun, seeing the markings, suddenly grew expectant.
Upon opening it, the chest revealed the sealed body of a monster.
It was none other than the corpse of the "Void Bidirectional Worm!"

chapters.title: Chapter 642 - 641: Uncle Crow's Mutation
chapters.content:
The amount of supplies needed for a million-strong legion was astronomical, and the contents of Grand Princess Octavia J. Fielding's storage ring genuinely surprised Su Lun.
If extracted, these supplies could arm a million men with equipment in the minor void realm's war workshop or even create a multitude of puppets.
But what delighted him the most was the body of the "Void Bifurcation Worm" found within the magic box.
Holding those bifurcation-patterned worm bodies, Su Lun was overjoyed, "Hey, they are really here."
Previously, they let the exiled Bifurcation Worms loose through a planar passage and had them killed with the help of the people from the godly realm. Otherwise, even with the combined top combat powers of the Dawn group, such troublesome creatures were untouchable.
The bodies of these bifurcating worms were extremely rare mythic materials. Their brains were particularly suitable for crafting the Isaac Blasphemer.
It was a pity the materials had previously ended up in enemy hands.
But he did not expect to be so lucky.
Perhaps Grand Princess Octavia felt they were her spoils of war, and so the materials were not sent back to the godly realm but carried with her.
This turn of events unwittingly benefited Su Lun.
With the best material for eighth-stage breeding armor secured, he no longer had to consider other materials.
However, just then, Mr. Raven on his shoulder cawed loudly, clearly detecting something edible.
Su Lun glanced at it and retorted, "All you know is eating..."
Still, despite his words, he pulled out a large piece of meat.
All he needed now was the brain of the bifurcational worm. As for the flesh, although precious, it was not essential at the moment.
Feeding Mr. Raven, which had helped him avoid numerous crises, did not pain him in the slightest.
Oozing with heavy void contamination, the meat, along with some of the worm's residual dimensional-reducing power, prompted Su Lun to wrap his hands with a layer of overwhelming aura before tossing the meat into the sky.
The black raven fluttered its wings and darted like lightning to catch the meat in its beak, gladly swallowing it whole.
Then, in the eyes of Su Lun and the others, the raven's body irregularly swelled, unable to withstand the corruption from the meat, and mutated.
Shortly after, with a "pop," the bird burst into a cloud of death energy and vanished into thin air.
But Su Lun was no longer surprised.
This greedy, silly bird was not experiencing such a condition for the first time; it was only a fifth-tier creature, how could it consume the corpse of a demigod monster?
However, the raven's lineage talents allowed it to endure energy far beyond its capacity.
Even if it could not bear it and exploded, it would recover and continue digesting.
Each of these overload explosions granted it some qualitative enhancement.
Sure enough, while the explosion noise still echoed around him, the death energy again emerged on Su Lun's shoulder and quickly reformed into a glossy-feathered black raven.
But it seemed that the contamination from the meat wasn't completely digested yet, and Mr. Raven mutated again, "bang"—exploding once more.
It was not until the third reconstruction that Mr. Raven stopped exploding.
Su Lun watched, both amused and frustrated, not forgetting to taunt, "That's for being greedy."
Mr. Raven shot him a look, retorted sharply, "Make it smaller, smaller. Give me another piece, another piece~"
"..."
Su Lun rolled his eyes but still indulged it by tossing a smaller piece of meat to the black raven.
This time, it went much better; Mr. Raven only exploded once.
Still ever greedy, Su Lun occasionally fed it.
...
The battle was over; the multi-layer barriers had also dissolved.
Sunlight filtered in, still leaving large patches of green vines on the sea surface, which were a mess due to the fierce battle.
All around, not even a fish could be seen, just a deathly stillness.
A demigod-level battle had left the sea brimming with chaotic magic, and likely for many years to come, this area would remain a dead zone.
Mr. Jing, Chill, and Pandora were all greatly exhausted; they sat cross-legged on the vines in meditation.
Pestoya was excited to help feed the raven.
Su Lun continued to inventory the contents of the storage ring, filtering out any potentially dangerous items in advance.
In passing, he also processed the soul of that ninth-tier Lei Pharaoh, along with his storage ring.
It had to be said, the insights from a powerful enemy's soul always brought delightful surprises.
This old man's formidable strength originated from his profound understanding of Lei magic. Even from Su Lun's current perspective, this was the best understanding of the Thunder element he had ever seen.
After digesting it, his comprehension of the elements significantly improved.
Thinking of this, Su Lun glanced at Grand Princess Octavia trussed up like a mummy.
After the value of using the Grand Princess as bait had been exhausted, they could also harvest the soul of a demigod, which was quite a top-tier surprise box.
However, before long, Qian suddenly opened her eyes and lightly exclaimed, "There's a murderous aura."
Almost at the same time, Mr. Jing noticed something, "Someone is coming."
Su Lun looked towards the north. In the sky, a group of mages shielded by a magic barrier was rapidly flying towards them. "Ah, finally, they've arrived."
They had been resting in place for half a day, just waiting for the enemy reinforcements to arrive.
And as expected, given the speed at which they needed to arrive, the enemy's reinforcements wouldn't be too many.
In the field of vision, it was an elite troop of a hundred, led by two ninth-tier and a dozen eighth-tier mages, with the rest being high-level mages of sixth and seventh tiers.
In terms of combat power, this could indeed be considered a law group that could dominate the alchemic plane.
Of course, provided they did not encounter Dawn.
...
According to current intelligence, only two demigods had descended from the plane of gods.
Currently, one, Princess Octavia, had been captured, and the other, "Archmage of Evil" Constantine Reiloz.
According to recent intelligence from the imperial military, it had just been found that Constantine had only just been spotted in the southern Storumga Region of Luying. It looked like he had also received messages and was coming to rescue.
But at such a great distance, it would be impossible for him to arrive quickly.
So, without another demigod, unless the enemy's million mage army pressed on, no matter who else came, it wouldn't pose any threat to Su Lun and his group.
Upon noticing the hurriedly approaching mage squad at the horizon, Qian rested her hand on the hilt of her sword and smacked her lips, "Tsk, tsk, only so many people..."
Pandora spoke in a relaxed tone, "It's quite daring of them to send even this many in such short notice. After all, the main force is still hundreds of sea miles away."
Seeing this, Mr. Jing also slowly stood up, saying, "Let's quickly deal with them. If we can entangle and eliminate some top-tier mages as much as possible, the overall offensive from the imperial legion will also be much easier."
"Alright! Then I'll go first!"
As she spoke, Qian was already eager and ready.
With a "pop" sound of stepping through the air like a thunderclap, she was already transformed into a bolt of thunder, charging towards the hundred-person mage squad on the horizon.
No sooner had she spoken than Mr. Jing also transformed into a streak of mirror light and disappeared on the spot.
Pandora gave Su Lun a sly smile, "Shall we go?"
As soon as she finished speaking, her entire body transformed into wisps of moonlight and vanished on the spot.
Su Lun wouldn't fall behind. After all, among that group, there were two ninth-tier mages, capable not only of reaping souls but also of refining Threads of Law.
Though he moved a moment slower, his spatial displacement was faster.
Almost instantly, the four of them arrived at the same time.
The hundred-person mage squad paused, clearly taken aback by their show of force.
But seeing the "mummy" held by Su Lun's threads, they had no choice but to reluctantly start the rescue.
The two sides then clashed atop the sea.
But even though Su Lun and company had worn themselves out in a fierce battle just before, this hundred-person squad was not tough enough to handle them.
The squad led by two ninth-tier mages gave far less pressure than the earlier demigod.
Once the battle began, it was almost a one-sided affair.
The four of them overwhelmed the hundred with a ruthless slaughter.
Qian was the most fierce, as her path was of the "one-slice stream", where she dealt with most of her opponents with one slice, determining victory or defeat.
Under her ninth-tier Sword God's Sword Qi, sixth and seventh-tier mages simply couldn't withstand a single slice.
Mr. Jing split into nine, instantly breaking the mage squad's battle formation. Qian then turned into a reaper, plunging into the enemy crowd and slashing wildly.
As for Su Lun and Pandora, they were almost just going through the motions, and the battle drew near its end without much suspense.
Before long, after the two ninth-tier mages were killed, the hundred-person mage squad was completely annihilated.
No suspense whatsoever.
...
A battlefield involving swordsmen always smells heavily of blood, with the sea surface tangled with dense threads, and each thread suspending half a body or a segment of a corpse.
Su Lun casually reaped the spoils of war from the hundred mage squad, harvested the souls of the two ninth-tier mages, and then refined the corpses into Threads of Law.
Then, they rested again on the sea surface.
"Let's rest a bit, we're ready to face the next wave of enemy reinforcements. With this bait, the enemy will keep coming to rescue, and we also need to watch out for another demigod."
"It's time to notify the imperial legion as well. They can start their long-distance attacks. This time, we must try to annihilate this million-strong army in the Imperial Strait."
"..."
The group rested and chatted leisurely.
The "mummy" they were with was suspended in midair, swaying in the wind.
This was the most crucial reason they had tried to keep a prisoner alive earlier,
it could even be the "fatal flaw" for a million-strong army of the celestial realm.
Just like that hundred-man squadron earlier, despite knowing they were outmatched, they had still rushed to the rescue like moths to a flame.
Because the identity of Octavia J. Fielding was simply too special.
The celestial realm was the most primal theocratic society, even more so than the earlier aristocratic views of the Emperor Luying Empire; here, identity meant everything.
And Octavia was not only a royal princess of the Ascieden Empire but also the grand marshal of these magic legions.
She was also the sacred maiden of the celestial tribe!
It can be said, her life was more important than those of a million others.
As long as she was alive, the top priority of that hundred-man squadron would inevitably be to rescue her.
Su Lun and his companions didn't need to do anything else, nor did they need to wait in ambush in the major cities of Luying like before for the "Archmage of Evil", Constantine.
Now, they only had to guard the severely injured princess, and the enemies would definitely come to them.
They also weren't afraid that the Archmage could escape; at their next encounter, it would surely be a battle to the death.
Su Lun and his friends rested leisurely on the sea, waiting for the rabbit, ready for the next wave of reinforcements.
The victory today had been breathtakingly narrow, essentially changing the tempo of this grand decisive battle, with the alchemical realm also gaining control of the war initiative.
"Su Lun, are you going to synthesise more equipment now?"
"No rush. Let's deal with the other Archmage first, and then we'll see. By then, I should be able to advance to the ninth rank."
"Indeed, you need to reach the ninth rank as soon as possible. There seems to have been a change at the plane's portal; next time the enemies arrive in large numbers, we'll be under great pressure."
"Yes. The next one will be a tough fight..."
"..."
The group also discussed among themselves.
From their vantage point, they saw not just the immediate situation but the future as well.
Being able to ambush successfully this time was crucial, but with her exposure, the top combat strength of the alchemical realm was almost entirely known to the celestial realm.
The next encounter would inevitably see the enemy prepared.
However, Su Lun was still quite optimistic.
Because the demigod powerhouses of the celestial realm weren't common fare.
To his knowledge, the Ascieden Empire officially had no more than ten Archmages.
Having captured one now, and possibly killing another, it wasn't likely that the remaining Archmages would all appear in the alchemical realm.
At least, there was no immediate worry.
Moreover, once he advanced to the ninth rank and completed the Endless Puppet, Su Lun didn't think his combat abilities would be inferior to any Archmage's.
Mr. Jing, who had previously observed the stele at the God Burial Ground, had already peeked into the secrets of the rules, and with a bit more time, might be able to touch the realm of a demigod.
Not to mention Pandora, who, judging from that last battle, clearly possessed formidable power as the great deity of the moon reading abilities.
The few of them chatted leisurely like this, and Peshtoya, who had little interest in the war, did not join in and just kept feeding the black crow on the side.
But as she fed it, an unexpected situation occurred.
After feeding the black crow a large chunk of two-way worm meat, the ghostly Miss suddenly exclaimed, "Su Lun, look quick... Uncle Crow is mutating!"
Su Lun turned to look and saw Uncle Crow's body swelling as if some sort of growth was about to burst out.
Although the black crow had burst from eating the meat before, it hadn't lasted this long.
This looked... like it was mutating?
The herald of death might not die, but he feared it could mutate into something bizarre.
Su Lun also frowned deeply.
He shared some consciousness with Uncle Crow; he could clearly sense the crow was undergoing a process of "mutation."
Mr. Jing and others also watched with interest, turning their gazes over.
Just as Su Lun considered whether to inject it with a mutation suppression potion, a wondrous scene unfolded.
Under the gaze of several eyes, that lump of "growth" on Uncle Crow's neck finally popped out, and then... it turned into another crow's head identical to the first!
Peshtoya watched, her big playful eyes filled with curiosity, excitedly said, "Look, look! Uncle Crow turned into a two-headed crow!"
Old Crow had been with Su Lun for quite some time now and had grown extremely familiar with everyone at Dawn.
Listening to this, discontent filled both of its heads and four small eyes.
Su Lun also looked puzzled — what was this "mutation"?
Had it sprouted an extra head?
He had always shared his vision with Old Crow, but now he perceived that the vision had sharpened — it was clearly a four-eyed view.
Moreover, Su Lun could feel that Old Crow didn't seem uncomfortable after its mutation; it was just a bit... hungry?
Hearing its caws again, Su Lun fed it another piece of meat.
The two crow heads grabbed it, and in a few bites, they had devoured it.
Su Lun twitched the corner of his eye... could it not change back?
Although he didn't find anything wrong with Old Crow having two heads — it might even be smarter — something still seemed off.
Pestoya, on the other hand, curiously stroked this "new species" and excitedly fed Old Crow a few pieces of bidirectional worm meat.
Just when Su Lun had resigned himself to the idea of raising a "mutant two-headed crow", another change occurred.
After eating too much, Old Crow's body swelled irregularly again and mutated further.
Su Lun felt as if something was about to happen.
Because through his Level Two All-knowing Eye, he saw some kind of evolution in the life scale.
It didn't take long for Old Crow's mutation to complete.
Under everyone's gaze, Old Crow's two heads split, and then... turned into two identical black crows!
Seeing this, Su Lun finally understood and exclaimed in his mind, "The dividing talent of the void Matriarch Worm!"
This divine bird, the Herald of Death, possessed the talent of devouring corpses and acquiring the abilities the corpse possessed in life.
Its bidirectional ability was due to it having eaten a piece of void Matriarch Worm meat.
Now having eaten so much, it had gained a new ability — splitting!
Seeing this, Su Lun's eyes shifted from confusion to delight.
Because he clearly sensed that this mutation caused no harm to Old Crow, it rather elevated its life scale directly.
Moreover, the two split black crows still had one consciousness, but now enjoyed double the vision.
Its vision was Su Lun's vision!
And the void Matriarch Worm could split into countless members of its species...
A spark in Su Lun's mind, he asked eagerly, "Old Crow, can you split further?"
The two black crows cawed: It seems possible, need food, hungry.
Su Lun hurriedly took out a large piece of bidirectional worm meat and fed it to them.
After the crows ate, this transformation was much smoother than before, instantly splitting from two into four!
And in the shared vision that Su Lun possessed, a fourfold view appeared.
It really worked!
A sudden, inexplicable anticipation rose in Su Lun's heart. What if Old Crow could split into countless crows? Wouldn't that mean possessing endless vision?
He asked again, "Can you merge back?"
"Caw~"
Old Crow tilted its slightly confused head, seemingly unfamiliar with the process.
After a moment, three of the black crows burst open and dissipated into nothing, leaving only one.
Seeing this, Su Lun's eyes were filled with joy.
Old Crow had finally undergone a qualitative change.
Old Crow was still young, and in the future, it could certainly split into even more.
Moreover, whether it was the bidirectional ability, splitting ability, shared vision, or crisis prediction ability… all were very practical auxiliary skills.
These also directly benefited Su Lun's combat capability.
Furthermore, Old Crow could devour other advanced corpses in the future and possibly awaken even more abilities.
Thinking of this, Su Lun's eyes burned with excitement, and he couldn't help but laugh, "Ha ha, Old Crow, all that feeding hasn't been in vain..."
The black crow raised its proud head upon hearing this, seemingly quite pleased with the praise: "Caw caw~"
Mr. Jing, nearby, also started laughing as he watched this.

chapters.title: Chapter 643 - 643: 642
chapters.content:
Su Lun and their plan to ambush the demigod of the Divine Plane was top-secret, known only to Catherine, the Empress of the allied empire.
As the battle near the Taganweier Trench began, the entire city of Lingdun in the imperial capital had mobilized, preparing for a decisive battle with the invaders.
However, there was tranquility within Frederic Royal Palace.
Sunlight streamed through the window, and Catherine, wearing a gemstone crown, was browsing through a poetry collection.
Her eyes clear, she sat quietly alone on the sofa in the study.
The spring sunlight was warm, and a mild breeze carried a faint floral fragrance from the royal garden. The golden sunlight shone on her face, making her fair skin glow.
Catherine was well aware that this was a battle upon which the fate of civilization hinged.
If they failed to kill or capture Octavia J. Fielding, the Divine Plane's million-mage army would surely reach the heartlands of Luying, leading to a large-scale battle.
Although the Allied Empire had prepared numerous contingencies and had a fair chance of defeating the enemy's million-strong army,
should a battle commence on home soil, even a victory would come with devastating losses, potentially leading the alchemical civilization toward decline.
Unbeknownst to her, Catherine had been staring at the same page of poetry for a long time without turning it.
Her mind was fraught with thoughts, and touching the rose gold necklace inlaid with a sapphire at her chest, her expression became slightly dazed.
It was as if the scene was paused right there.
However, suddenly, the black ring on her finger began to tremble.
This was the "Dagus Goblin Communicator" from the Dawn Organization.
Her gaze shifted momentarily, as if she had received some information, and then her expression could hardly hide her delight, "Has it really succeeded?!"
Catherine abruptly stood up.
The slight hesitation that had crossed her brow just moments ago had now completely dissipated, replaced with a fierce resolve.
She walked towards the door, her steps brisk, and quickly commanded, "Send orders down, mechanical airship squadron, special service squadron, joint naval fleets eight, nine, and eleven... execute plan S001, all forces strike!"
As soon as her words fell, someone at the door immediately responded, "Yes!"
...
As the Divine Plane's million-strong army crossed the Imperial Strait toward the Luying mainland, the imperial military had continuously monitored the enemy's movements.
To intercept this million-strong enemy, millions of troops and countless ships had already been amassed at several defense lines along the strait.
Yet, the tactical march of the Divine Plane's force was simply too unbeatable, with a hundred thousand-unit groups unleashing legion magic and pushing through everything.
In this half-month period, the forces at the initial defense lines of the empire had been retreating step by step, helpless as they watched the enemy approach the Luying mainland.
But today, commanders at various defense lines suddenly received an urgent battle order.
"All forces strike? But... those mage airships are difficult to break through by the fleet. And with the enemy having ninth-tier and demigod combatants, they might target our leaders..."
"What! A number one order personally issued by Her Majesty?"
"Yes, guarantee to complete the mission!"
"..."
The professional soldiers at the front lines were almost in disbelief upon receiving the order to strike.
They were well aware that although the united empire had strong military power, in the face of the invincible mage army of a million mages, their forces still fell short.
If they tightened the defense perimeter and concentrated their forces, perhaps there was still a chance for a last large-scale battle.
But they never expected that the order from above was to take the offensive?
Wasn't this suicidal?
The empire's soldiers were not afraid of death, but with nearly half of the alchemical plane's military power concentrated on the sea defense line, if all were lost, there would be nothing stopping the enemy's invasion of Luying mainland, and they could even march straight into the imperial capital of Lingdun.
This was what the generals were worried about.
However, the moment the order was delivered to the frontline, the commanders of the various fleets executed the command without hesitation.
If the order had been given by someone else, there might have been doubts.
But it was an order personally given by Empress Ekaterina.
Even if it meant that they had to undertake some sacrificial missions, no one would back down at the moment.
Time had proven everything. The first emperor of the United Empire was the most talented monarch of the Alchemical realm for countless years. In every decision concerning the survival of the Alchemical realm, she had made the most accurate judgments and the wisest decisions, which brought today's brilliance to the Alchemical realm.
Empress Ekaterina now possessed absolute prestige within the empire, and the loyalty of millions of soldiers that could not be shaken.
For a time, thousands upon thousands of legions from various steel armored fleets and steam airship fleets assembled toward the target sea area.
However, before long, the fleets indeed received good news.
"Marshal, we have just received the latest intelligence from the frontline. The million magic legion has stopped marching west and turned south!"
"The magic legion has split up. A part of the elite has quickly detached from the fleet and headed south!"
"..."
Although the vast majority of people did not know exactly what had happened to make the Celestial Realm's magicians suddenly change their course, the division of the million legion was good news for the United Empire.
Before long, the imperial fleet had already arrived at the designated sea area.
The sky was densely filled with mechanical airships, and the sea was crowded with warships.
"Coordinates 3351, 9873, aim the cannons, fire!"
As the commander issued the coordinates, countless cannons fired simultaneously. Alchemical bullets poured down like raindrops towards the sky.
The imperial military sector had prepared secret weapons over the years, each making its debut.
Cannons had a very clear advantage over mages.
And that was the range.
Even legion magic, which could cover several kilometers, was considered extremely long-range.
However, for the current military-grade ship-mounted cannons of the Alchemical realm, hitting several dozens of kilometers was the norm.
And over these years, the Imperial Mechanical Research Institute also developed a large number of alchemical bullets specifically for the magic legion. Like the "Element Eradication Bullet" that could disrupt elemental convergence, the "Magic-Breaking Bullet" that could penetrate magic shields, and the "Magic Inhibition Bullet" that could cause extensive anti-magic...
After this mass firing of alchemical bullets, the area of tens of nautical miles around could turn into a region of extreme elemental chaos or rarity.
For the mages of the Celestial Realm, their combat power had already been greatly weakened before they even saw the enemy.
However, cannons and mechanical soldiers had little dependence on elements, and even if magic was prohibited, they could still fight at full firepower.
This was a crushing technological and tactical superiority.
Although magic airships were originally not slow, with thousands of them grouped together, maintaining formation meant moving very slowly.
Under the cover of tens of thousands of cannon fire, they were nothing but live targets.
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"..."
In an instant, tens of thousands of cannons fired simultaneously, the sound was deafening, and the sea surface was rippled by the impacting shockwaves.
The pouring of tons of ammunition was also an astronomical amount, which, in the past state of Lu Ying, even with these advanced warships and airships, it was not possible to use so extravagantly, as the national power simply did not support such consumption.
And it was after Ekaterina's ascent to the throne in recent years that this changed.
The Empire's comprehensive high-end mechanical engineering fully covered all areas, vastly improving Ruying's resource extraction capabilities by tens of times. Additionally, various resources that had continuously been relocated from the heartland of Mafa to the coasts over recent years fortified the Empire to utilize such a fire-intensive tactic.
...
The bombardment continued unrelentingly.
Each hour, the Imperial military would unleash tens of thousands of tons of ammunition.
The sky, even dozens of nautical miles away, appeared as a brilliant palette as if someone had splashed numerous colors onto a cerulean canvas.
The thousand Mage Airships, holding steady behind their legion's magic shields, resisted the bombardment.
Although such bombardment was not enough to inflict significant losses on the million-member-strong Mage Legion, maintaining the magic shields required energy as well.
In every attack and defense, even the most sophisticated magic circle entailed a corresponding energy consumption.
The enemy's supplies were limited.
Production lines in the Empire's war factories churned out a massive amount of shells continuously, while the mages' power relied entirely on various natural Demon Cores and magic-power Crystal Stones.
Using shells to deplete magic crystals, the enemy's rate of consumption would be dozens of times more than theirs.
With such a tactic, just by maintaining fire coverage, they would eventually break down the million-strong Mage Legions of the Divine Realm.
However, the reality was not that simple.
Under normal circumstances, given the Empire's several million professional soldiers and vast array of warships, they could quite possibly stand a chance even against the Divine Realm's million-strong Mage Corps.
But the major issue was the enemy's overwhelming top-tier combatants.
For instance, the ninth-tier Sages of Law and that formidable, intractable Magic God.
A single individual among them could match the firepower of an entire fleet.
The very moment the official command for a full assault had been issued, those marshals and generals rushing to the battlefield had prepared themselves for the potential of being decapitated by the enemy in direct combat.
However, nobody expected the bombardment to last a day and a night.
For some unknown reason, the anticipated decapitation strategies of the enemy weren't observed, and the demigods mentioned in reports were nowhere to be seen.
Instead, the million-strong Mage Legion seemed somewhat "apprehensive."
Other than passive defense and sailing southward, they hardly organized any significant attacks.
And as the fire coverage persisted, the enemy's Mage Airships even began to be shot down, and casualties emerged within their Mage Corps.
This left those in the combined fleet somewhat puzzled—why had the combat effectiveness of the Divine Realm suddenly fallen short by such a margin?
The soldiers were as yet unaware that a group had restrained most of the enemy's top-tier combatants on their behalf.
....
Meanwhile, in the southern part of the Imperial Strait.
The weather was clear today, and the vast blue ocean presented endless gorgeous vistas.
On a Nameless Deserted Island, the sea water murmured against the white sandy beach, and the fronds of the coconut trees swayed and rustled in the ocean breeze, while a coconut crab with large pincers hid under a tree, waiting for the fruits to fall.
On the beach, Su Lun, Mr. Jing, Sentiao, Pandora, along with Pestoya playing with a crow, lazily basked in the sun.
Unlike the intense battle happening hundreds of nautical miles away, here it was completely tranquil.
"Ah... four rescue squads have already arrived, it seems those guys won't come anymore."
"Yes. Five ninth-tier Sages of Law are dead. If more come, the million-strong Mage Corps over there might collapse. They probably won't come anymore."
"It's unknown when that Magic God named Constantine will come back, but as long as we deal with that guy, the problem should be easy to handle. However, it seems that even if he comes, he most likely won't be fighting us to the death. He should think of some way to rescue us."
"..."
The group idly chatted among themselves.
Throughout this day and night, they had already killed four waves of enemy reinforcements coming to rescue Princess Oktaavia.
In total, five Level 9 Sages of Law and a nearly thousand-strong elite team.
With this wave of top forces extinguished, the pressure on the joined imperial fleet to counterattack was greatly reduced.
Moreover, the effect of deterrence was even more apparent.
Now that the pinnacle forces of the alchemical plane were known to have the capability to capture and kill demigods, those mages from the divine plane didn't dare execute any beheading operations either.
They feared that instead of succeeding in beheading, they would fall into the opponent's trap.
Just like the "mummy" currently hanging from the coconut tree.
Su Lun and his team were also grateful that their plan was prescient.
If they had first gone to ambush the Archmage of Evil, Konstantin, once it was exposed they had this capacity, the enemy would have surely been on guard. As long as the Grand Princess hid within a million troops and did not emerge, even if Su Lun and his team could now kill a demigod, they still couldn't touch her. If the million-strong army continued to group attack the Lu Ying homeland, no one could stop them.
If the defenses at Lunding broke and the morale of the troops collapsed, the dimensional war might have ended directly.
But precisely because the Grand Princess had been captured alive, those guys from the divine plane had no choice but to change their plans, making rescuing her their top priority.
However, because of the special identity of Princess Oktaavia, this ended up delivering them wave after wave of decapitations.
"Though the 'bait' is good, the number of big fish in the pond is limited. After hooking a batch, there weren't many left."
Su Lun and his team had already waited several hours on this deserted island, with no one else coming after them.
Meanwhile, the communicator kept bringing good news, the battle situation on the side of the joint fleet was going smoothly.
Even separated by hundreds of nautical miles, Su Lun and his team could clearly hear the dense sound of cannon fire.
Watching the colorful clouds in the sky, none of them were in the slightest hurry.
The ones who were anxious now were those guys from the divine plane.
"But speaking of which, the firepower on the side of the joint fleet is very fierce, huh? This bombardment has been going on for a day and a night. With this firepower, the million-strong magic army of the divine plane surely isn't getting any advantage."
"Mr. Hei and the Dragon Tongue Squad are also there, so there should be no need for us to go over. If we keep attacking like this, crushing the million magic troops is also very likely..."
"Yes, now we just need to wait for Konstantin's movements."
"Strange...what on earth happened in the past two years I was away in the Yellow Springs? How did the empire's military strength become so strong?"
"Miss Yekaterina has been in power these few years, and the alchemical civilization has undergone tremendous changes. She truly is an emperor with imperial talents..."
"..."
Without any battles to be fought, Qian became somewhat listless.
Mr. Jing, however, remained as indifferent as ever.
Pandora constantly maintained the state of the Great Moon God, neither god nor human.
Su Lun wasn't idling either; he started preparing materials for the God Profaner breeding equipment necessary for his Level 8.
While chatting, the group started discussing Emperor Yekaterina.
In these two years, Mr. Jing had also visited the royal palace many times and had very harmonious exchanges with Yekaterina, similarly giving the empress very high praises.
They would occasionally joke about Su Lun, who was nominally "Prince Fick," now the legitimate husband of that great emperor.
However, just while they were chatting, suddenly a message from the military came through the communicator.
Mr. Jing's gaze sharpened, and he said in a stern voice, "News has come from the joint fleet: the Archmage of Evil, Konstantin, has appeared!"
Upon hearing this, everyone's expression grew tense.
After waiting for so long, he had finally appeared!
Su Lun didn't delay for a moment. With a pinch of the sorcerer's seal, a spatial rift appeared in front of him, and everyone entered one after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 644 - 643: Stripping the Magic God
chapters.content:
After a day and a night of shelling, the morale of the magic airship fleet had greatly declined. However, just as the combined forces of the imperial fleet thought victory was within reach, suddenly, an angry old Mage descended upon the battlefield and disrupted the rhythm.
As soon as the old man in the white magic robe appeared, with just a few instant cast spells, he destroyed several main warships of Sea King-class tonnage, inflicting substantial losses on the allied fleet.
Seeing his power, where would the fleet not know that this must be strength above the ninth order?
Even because this old man had been causing trouble on Luying Main Island lately, wanted notices had already spread throughout the empire, and the staff officers recognized his identity at first glance.
"That's... the enemy's Demigod strongman has come! Be careful, that's the 'Archmage of Evil,' Constantine Reiloz mentioned in the intelligence reports!"
"Not good, that's Forbidden Curse magic, quickly inform the command post over there to intercept with the ten thousand Magician Group..."
"Eh, look quickly, someone blocked the Mage?"
"That's Mr. Hei from the Dawn Group, oh... that's the Dragon Language Magician Group!"
"My God, how can they be so strong? They actually withstood the attack from a Demigod strongman! That's much stronger than the ten thousand Mage Group."
"This must be His Majesty's secret move, haha... Dawn always brings surprises when they appear."
"..."
As soon as the old man appeared, the Eternal Night, hidden within the united fleet, also made its move. Mr. Hei, leading the ten thousand Mage Group, blocked a super wide-range Forbidden Curse spell, at least saving dozens of warships from being sunk.
However, under such absolute power suppression, all numbers are meaningless.
Even after Mr. Hei and the Dragon Language Magician Group had taken two full-blown spells from the Demigod, they were somewhat overwhelmed.
Fortunately, it didn't take long for a spatial fluctuation to flash, and several figures appeared on the deck of the Eternal Night.
At a closer look, several mysterious figures wearing Gold-Patterned Cloaks materialized out of nowhere.
Mr. Hei on the Eternal Night knew who the newcomers were and was not surprised.
But the soldiers of the united fleet burst into cheers.
"Look, those Gold-Patterned Cloaks... are the top combat forces of Dawn!"
"Haha, our reinforcements have arrived!"
"..."
The warriors' eyes brimmed with hot tears of excitement, these Gold-Patterned Cloaks... were the "legends" they had seen countless times in the newspapers!
...
There's no need to be merciful towards the enemy.
As soon as Su Lun made his appearance, looking at that old Mage in the sky, he unceremoniously took out the "Soul-Locking Lantern of Tartaros," intending to lock down the man's soul.
At the same time, Lei's reaction was extremely quick, already drawing his sword and charging forward with the speed of thunder.
Mr. Jing also turned into a beam of light, vanishing from his original spot.
The three wanted to repeat their old tactic, attempting the same method they used against the Grand Princess Octavia J. Fielding.
However, unexpectedly, Mage Constantine seemed to have been prepared. As his gaze hardened at the sight of the brass lantern, his figure eerily dispersed into illusions, dodging the soul light. He swiftly retreated a great distance, causing Lei's Sword Qi and Mr. Jing's attacks to miss.
Another look, and the old man had already transformed into a streak of light. In the blink of an eye, his silhouette flickering, he had disappeared into the horizon.
What Su Lun and the others hadn't expected was that this grand Demigod, without the slightest intent to fight, had chosen to flee.
Feeling the situation was tricky, Su Lun and the others promptly followed in pursuit.
In the blink of an eye, after chasing for dozens of miles, they realized they were already near the nearly one thousand magic airships of the divine realm.
There, the 'Archmage of Evil,' Constantine, was standing in the void in front of the airships, seemingly only then having the courage to stand firm.
And indeed, it was true.
Although Su Lun and his group had followed him, looking at the million Mage army behind the old man, they dared not approach any closer.
No matter how strong the few of them were, it was absolutely impossible to directly withstand the attack of a million Mage army.
...
As an Archmage, he had already reached the pinnacle of power in the Alchemy plane, and now this old man, pulling down the faces of the strong, had hidden behind a million-strong army, leaving Su Lun and his companions truly helpless.
At this moment, Constantine spoke up, "I think, we can negotiate. As long as you release Her Royal Highness Princess, we can agree to some exchange conditions."
The man had used the magic of Language Proficiency, and everyone understood what he was saying.
Mr. Jing's face was cold, with no response.
Lei was coldly watching the activating Formations on those airships, seemingly considering where he could find an entry point.
When Su Lun heard this, he didn't mince words, directly gripping the mummified Princess Octavia J. Fielding in his hand. Without further ado, he looked ready to tear up the hostage.
Negotiation was out of the question.
Even if the divine realm made the greatest concession possible and chose to retreat, there would be no benefit for the alchemy realm.
Once this important hostage was gone, the enemy would have no more concerns, and never again would such an opportunity to capture alive arise.
Interdimensional invasions were by nature battles to the death.
Moreover, the weaker party never had the right to negotiate terms.
But likewise, Su Lun and the others also temporarily didn't dare to kill Princess Oktaavia.
If they killed her, those guys from the divine realm would lose all restraint, possibly attacking Luying Main Island in a desperate act of revenge, resulting in a far more tragic great battle.
The enemy was clearly certain of this.
That's why the old mage could speak so composedly, wanting to negotiate.
To the rest of the magical legion, Princess Oktaavia was more important than their own lives due to her royal status.
But standing before them was Constantine, himself a demigod. In the divine Ascieden Empire, he was a big shot of the highest order, with far fewer concerns.
Besides, it wasn't anyone who could decide the fate of a divine maiden; that was the province of the gods.
Su Lun and the others had pursued her to see what value this bait still held.
Now, seeing the mages' attitude, ready for a forceful attack, it seemed there was no hope of success.
...
At the level of a demigod, schemes and plots almost had no effect.
Upon facing each other, they could already discern the other party's intentions.
Constantine, looking at the hostage in Su Lun's hands, knew that there was no room for negotiation. Decisive as ever, he scoffed and with a wave of his hand commanded, "Attack!"
Right then, a terrifying magical power fluctuation surged from the thousands of magical flying ships behind him; clearly, they were prepared, and multicolored spells were instantly cast.
Just a moment before, Mr. Jing's shoulder crow had already cawed a warning, alerting them to the imminent danger.
Mr. Jing, Su Lun, and Qiantiao all retreated explosively at the same time.
When they had arrived, Su Lun's Eye of Omniscience had already seen through everything, so they had not entered the ambush circle of the enemy.
This sudden retreat perfectly avoided the deadliest coverage area of the legion's magic.
Even though their reactions were so swift, a sky full of light bullets and countless beams of magic still came at them in a wide sweep, impossible to avoid.
To deal with these three, the million-strong magic legion was anything but stingy with their magic power, releasing an area attack terrifying enough to instantly kill any ninth-tier professional.
The fatal crisis was like a mountain collapse, making one's scalp numb from the pressure.
As they retreated, Mr. Jing raised both hands; the reflected light from her mirrors sent the magic that had touched her flying back.
Qiantiao, meanwhile, slashed out with three cuts, instantly cleaving apart several ninth-tier legion spells that had been coming at them from behind.
Su Lun teleported effortlessly.
In a flicker of light and shadow, upon looking again, the three were already several miles away.
The old Archmage Constantine looked on with furrowed brows but made no movement.
Almost immediately, both sides fell into a bizarre standoff.
The magic legion was too slow in teleporting, unable to give chase.
Though Constantine was powerful, he didn't dare to pursue alone.
On the other side, Su Lun and his companions also didn't dare to charge forward.
...
The two parties remained in a stalemate for a moment through the distance.
Constantine, looking at the trio from afar, his expression darkened, but he didn't hesitate any longer and turned back towards the fleet.
Upon looking again, the entire magical legion also ceased focusing on the three and continued their journey westward, heading for Luying Main Island. Despite losing some flying ships in the past two days of artillery warfare, they remained an invincible legion.
Now it was Su Lun and his companions who were left exchanging glances.
Qiantiao commented dispassionately, "This guy is a mighty demigod, yet he doesn't even dare to fight, just hiding away like that?"
They had waited these two days primarily to lure in this 'big fish' at the end.
She had thought there would be a great battle.
Yet, he'd chosen to avoid fighting altogether.
Now hidden within the million-strong legion's formation, even a few more demigods might not be able to break through.
Chian-Tiao could do nothing about it.
Su Lun's eyebrows knitted slightly as he murmured, "It seems that the deities of the Divine Plane have given up on Octavia. This has become troublesome."
They probably felt that she could no longer be rescued and decisively abandoned her.
And now, it's apparent the enemy intends to stick to the original plan, attacking Luying's homeland first to annihilate the alchemical civilization.
If it really came to a direct confrontation, even if the Alchemy Plane could win, it would be a pyrrhic victory.
A hint of solemnity flashed in Mr. Jing's eyes as he said indifferently, "Let's return to the Eternal Night and discuss our long-term plan."
As he spoke, the three of them had already vanished from the spot.
With a change of scenery around them, the three had returned to the deck of the Eternal Night.
No sooner had they returned than the ship's numerous cannons began a new round of fire coverage against the magic airship fleet, with the sound of artillery shaking the heavens.
Despite the busy endeavor, they had not been able to prevent the Divine Plane's total assault, but there was a silver lining: with Su Lun and the others on the fleet, there was no fear of the enemy's top warriors coming over for a beheading strike.
This also ensured that the artillery tactics could continue.
And from these fellows reaching Luying's homeland, if they spared no expense on ammunition, they could at least take out ten to twenty percent of the enemy's forces.
But aside from engaging in long-range artillery warfare, who would dare to clash head-on with a million-strong magic legion.
From the current perspective, the only option seemed to be to gather forces on Luying's homeland for a decisive battle.
Once again, the situation had fallen into a stalemate.
....
Not many knew about Chian-Tiao's message from the netherworld before, but now that she had safely returned and advanced to the ninth rank, it was indeed a cause for celebration.
Cheers erupted from the Dawn's crew on the deck.
Lolota, as her disciple, was especially thrilled, dancing with joy.
Since the Dawn team needn't get involved in the artillery fight, everyone on the ship gathered around Chian-Tiao, eager to hear about her experiences in the netherworld and to learn what exactly the realm of a ninth rank Sword Saint was.
A lively celebration was also prepared.
Whatever the circumstances, the Dawn team always maintained an optimistic outlook—a tradition.
Su Lun didn't mingle much with the festivities but instead returned to the captain's quarters.
Because there were some things he had to do immediately.
If the enemy didn't care about hostages, then keeping prisoners alive was pointless.
Even the body of a demigod was of great use.
Su Lun closed the door, set up an isolating formation, and proceeded to dispose of the demigod captive.
He wanted to extract the soul to strengthen himself and to obtain some necessary intelligence.
'You have extracted the soul of "Octavia J. Fielding"'
'You have acquired a vast amount of Holy Light-specific magic, Light Forbidden Spells, Elemental Experience +1124531'
'You have comprehended the "Elemental Forbidden Curse Secrets" and mastered a multitude of high-ranking elemental magic'
'You have gleaned insight into the "Rule of Light," understanding some of the mysteries of the "Magic God".'
'You have acquired intelligence: The details of Ascieden Empire's military deployment in the Alchemy Plane...'
'You have learned royal Ascieden Empire secrets: The Demon World Tower within the Royal Academy of Magic houses forbidden texts of a heretical sect, which contain secrets to ascending to godhood. It's taboo, and no one is allowed to peruse them...'
'You learned intelligence: Our Ascieden Empire's invasion of the Alchemy Plane is not going well, and it has displeased the great Sir Niedegro. The "Golden Griffon Empire" and the "Holy Crown Empire" have found out about the emergence of the plane's passage. If we cannot eradicate the alchemical indigenous civilization soon, the two empires will join forces to snatch and divide the wealth that should belong to Ascieden...'
'Spiritual Power +75542'
'...'
This extraction went as Su Lun had expected.
He had gained too many important benefits.
...
The body of the demigod truly was extraordinary, directly refined into 97% of the "Cosmic Sixth Essence: Light." With a little stock remaining, it totaled one complete essence.
There was also the demigod's profound understanding of the rules, which was a treasure beyond price for any ninth-order professional.
Comprehension of the rules required more than just talent.
Opportunity, guidance, foundation, resources... all are indispensable.
Even for someone like Mr. Jing, currently, the realm seems as unreachable as the heavens.
And within this Grand Princess's soul, there exists some matured thoughts about the "Rule of Light".
Even though the divine guidance is somewhat lacking, it still suddenly allowed Su Lun, an eighth-tier professional, to glimpse more secrets about rules.
However, these gains were all expected.
Su Lun had guessed so before the battle.
What he cared about more was some special information pilfered from Princess Oktaavia's soul.
In the room, within the center of a nine-pointed star formation.
"No wonder these guys are so anxious to attack, so there's this reason..."
Su Lun had also been puzzled as to why the people from the Divine Plane were so eager to attack, given that waiting a few more months for more experts would be more prudent. Yet now, even that Princess of the Empire had risked coming herself, resulting in her death on a foreign plane, which is clearly abnormal.
Now, looking into it, it turns out there was competition.
A shattered plane without even a demigod, for those mighty empires of the Divine Plane, is like a deer in a trap. Not particularly dangerous, yet a substantial piece of meat.
Years ago, the Ascieden Empire discovered the plane portal, originally monopolizing it. Unexpectedly, after several years, they still hadn't conquered the Alchemy Plane, and had also lost a million mages.
Now, it is estimated that the gods have also run out of patience, and the news has leaked out. The 'Golden Gryphon Empire' and the 'Holy Crown Empire' neighboring the Ascieden Empire are also about to join in.
To prevent competitors from seizing too much of their interests, they launched this total offensive prematurely.
Su Lun digested that segment of memory, his eyes reflecting solemnity as he thought, "This complicates things. There was one empire, now there are three. The enemies are multiplying..."
But on second thought, it didn't really matter.
Whether facing one enemy or three, it was more or less the same.
Anyway, without thoroughly resolving the issue of the plane portal, the war would never end.
The situation would also continue to worsen.
Su Lun also deliberately scoured the memory but found no information that could close the plane portal.
He then searched for some things he was more interested in.
It must be said, those mages previously stripped were mostly ordinary mages who only knew how to battle. It was the royal family that was qualified to possess some top-secret intelligence.
This Grand Princess Oktaavia provided Su Lun with secrets that the ordinary strata could not reach.
This also allowed him a deeper understanding of the Divine Plane.
"Heresy? The secrets to godhood?"
Su Lun pondered for a moment.
He had now touched the secrets of the rules, advancing to the ninth tier almost without any bottleneck.
He naturally also looked forward to whether there were ways to glimpse an even higher realm in the future.
This search indeed found some clues pointing towards the divine rank within the memories of Grand Princess Oktaavia.
"Becoming a god" might be one of the ways to break the stalemate, only by becoming powerful enough would he qualify to contend in future plane wars.
But for the Alchemy Plane, although the existence of gods is known, the path to divinity is almost completely unknown.
Even the legendary Sir Isaac had not left much useful information.
Moreover, to Su Lun's slight surprise, not every faction in the Divine Plane is of the godly order; there are also some "heretics".
And within what the Divine Plane calls "heretics", besides various followers of other gods, there are a small number of Alchemy magicians?
...
After a long while, Su Lun fully digested those memories and developed a keen interest in the Divine Plane, murmuring to himself from time to time, "The secrets of the higher planes are indeed numerous..."
But that interest was quickly submerged.
Compared to that, how to resolve the current grand decisive battle was the pressing issue.
"I need to quickly enhance my combat power. At present, the Ascieden Empire hastily marched, preparations are not adequately thorough, perhaps that million mage legion might just be breakable... Hmm, first to integrate the Constructs!"
Thinking this, Su Lun immediately took out the "Brain of the Bidirectional Void Worm" and a large pile of materials.
He planned to first craft the eighth-tier Constructs.
After integration, the final shortcoming of the endless puppet legion would be filled!

chapters.title: Chapter 645 - 644: God Profaner
chapters.content:
The naval battle at the Imperial Strait continued, with thousands of warships of all sizes relentlessly bombarding the million-strong magical army of the divine plane.
However, as the battle wore on, the effect diminished.
The costly cover of firepower did destroy hundreds of magic airships, but as the weak links were lost, the enemy's formation became more streamlined and their defenses stronger.
The million-strong magic army of the divine plane braved the cannon fire and marched west towards the mainland of Luying, unstoppable by anyone.
Fortunately, the magic airships were slow and could not hide their tracks. The united imperial military was also urgently assembling tens of millions of troops along the East Coast, awaiting the decisive battle.
Two days later.
In the secret chamber aboard the Eternal Night.
The Alchemy Formation "Dwarf's Eternal Forge" was burning with fierce flames.
Su Lun was using the Vulcan lava of the Ulfen to forge a piece resembling a crystal brain in the empty furnace.
This crystal brain shimmered with transparency, its surface adorned with complicated runic neural systems that visibly pulsed and twinkled with tiny blue lights.
It was still an active biological brain.
The forging was approaching its end, and through the All-knowing Eye, one could already see the attributes of this epic-level implant.
[Isaac Blasphemer]
Description: How do gods think?
Detailed Explanation: An alchemic implant crafted from the brain of a Void Matriarch Worm, it is a superbiological computer and also possesses the strong alien invasive characteristics of the void worm race; after integration, brain development is boosted by 10%-30%, neural response speed by +1500%, mental power by +982, world perception ability by +1 and a significant increase in mental endurance; Awakening the 'Thought Tree' grants additional mental power and the ability of [Myriad Hearts, Billion Uses]; immune to all psychic control below divine level, with increased wisdom and cognitive abilities; [Seducer Demon's Psychic Control] evolves into [God's Nightmare]; Integration requirements include Void Affinity of no less than 300, spiritual power no less than Astral Projection, body rating SS+, intelligence rating SSS, and a mutation probability of less than 20%; the 'Dominant Aura' can reduce the probability of brain alienation by 5%;
Evaluation: The implant has growth potential; as the integrator's cognitive development progresses, there is continual efficacy enhancement, current implant development at 30%; after integration, the implant remains unharmed, consciousness undiminished.
Reflected in Su Lun's eyes was the shimmering crystal skull, his expression barely concealing his joy.
He had not expected the implant crafted from the brain of a [Void Bidirectional Worm] to be so effective.
The attributes it boosted, especially in the mental realm, could even cause his own level eight status to surge by several times.
Of course, the most critical was the [Myriad Hearts, Billion Uses] functionality, which far exceeded expectations.
And the "Thought Tree" would allow his spiritual power to grow like a tree's roots and branches, endlessly extending into countless independently thinking sub-minds.
For him, a Puppeteer, this was simply a god-tier skill!
Moreover, this implant was a growth-type that could continuously enhance its performance in the future.
This is the amplification that superior materials bring to an implant; an implant crafted from a Void Bidirectional Worm's brain was even stronger than those possessed by Dora and her teacher, Lucien Pepys Grandmaster.
...
An hour later, the implant was completely forged.
The light of the nine-pointed star Formation dimmed, and a complete crystal brain appeared before him.
Su Lun, who could hardly contain his anticipation, briefly recovered some of the spiritual power he had depleted over the past two days, then raised his hand to summon a man in a white lab coat from the black hole in his palm.
Su Lun said, "Doctor, I need your assistance."
Dr. Banks inspected the implant before him, astonishment visible even through his fly-like compound eyes.
He had discerned some of its intricacies and asked cautiously, "Su Lun, are you sure you want to integrate this implant? I feel it has a very strong 'biological alien nature', enough even to turn a dragon into an insectoid..."
An implant is a cursed object by nature, and this crystal brain carried a curse resembling hypnotic crystal, merely gazing upon it could make one's mind feel hazy.
And since he himself was already in a half-alienated, half-mutated state, he was all the more aware of the danger of these characteristics.
Su Lun nodded at the questions and responded, "Yes. Thank you for your trouble, Doctor."
The integration requirements for this implant were indeed extremely stringent.
One needed tremendous spiritual power and an equally strong body to resist the viral-like alien characteristics of the void worm race.
Even with his own physical quality comparable to that of a ninth-tier professional in the flesh category, there was still a nearly 15% chance of mutation.
For others, successful integration was almost impossible.
If it wasn't for the All-knowing Eye identifying detailed data and Dr. Banks, a top scientist in the field of biological alchemy, lending a hand, Su Lun wouldn't dare touch such dangerous implantation.
Upon hearing his explanation of the implantation's characteristics, Dr. Banks also frowned and said, "In that case, indeed, we can control the mutation probability below 8%. However, there are significant future risks; it will continuously erode your brain..."
Su Lun, of course, was aware of this risk, and said, "After I have digested the implant, I can advance to the ninth tier at any time to suppress the mutation. So it's not a big problem."
Upon hearing this, Dr. Banks didn't say more and nodded, "Hmm."
After a pause, he looked as if he remembered something and then asked, "By the way, Su Lun, what do you plan to do with the 'Divine Eye' that was previously stripped out?"
"That Divine Eye?"
Su Lun, listening, pondered for a moment, slightly indecisive.
That "Divine Eye" had been stripped from Octavia two days ago; the eye of this demigod was far superior to the one Saint Frank had before.
Su Lun originally wanted to transplant it into his own body.
After all, Mr. Hei had already transplanted one, and the effects were very good.
And Dr. Banks's transplantation technology had also matured significantly, with virtually no risk.
But during use, Mr. Hei discovered an issue. Namely, after the transplantation of this "Divine Eye," there was a sort of bloodline suppression against the divine clans. Perhaps there were also other, yet-to-be-discovered hidden dangers.
This made Su Lun hesitate.
If his second solution of the All-knowing Eye were to transplant this organ, indeed, it would add another assassin's blade to his arsenal, but they were currently at war with the divine plane. Later on, he might face the deities from the divine plane; once suppressed, this could be a fatal risk.
But if it were used on a zombie puppet, it would be a waste of divine potential.
Su Lun found it difficult to decide, so he had not proceeded with the transplant.
However, before he could think more about it, Dr. Banks said, "What I mean is, if it's possible, I would like to use it for an experiment."
Su Lun looked up, "Oh?"
He knew that since the doctor had spoken up, there must be some new discovery.
And indeed that was the case.
At this moment, Dr. Banks said, "I've been studying the corpses of two-way void worms recently. I found that the splitting characteristics of the void worm species are a very, very special biological ability; they have strong devouring, advancement, and heterogeneous properties. Simply put, the corpses can 'copy' some characteristics of other organisms."
"Copy?"
Upon hearing this, Su Lun immediately thought of Uncle Raven.
After consuming the corpses of the void worm species, it gained the ability to replicate and divide.
Dr. Banks continued, "So I had an idea, to use these corpses to copy some special biological bloodlines or organs. For example... eyes."
"!!!"
Hearing this, Su Lun suddenly realized just how significant Dr. Banks's idea was.
No wonder he wanted to use this eye for an experiment; that's why!
Dr. Banks went on, "I have studied the genetic chains of Octavia J. Fielding from the divine race and that of Saint Frank McAdam before her. I found that their 'third eye phenotypic characteristic' may be related to some sort of recessive atavistic gene. What I mean is, this talent doesn't necessarily have to be a hereditary trait, but through gene transplantation, there might be a chance to replicate it. And I've also gone through the data about the worm species that we got from the void channel before, and theoretically speaking, it's feasible..."
"..."
The shock Su Lun felt upon hearing this was not lesser than when he first saw the newly refined [Blasphemer] implant.
He had indeed always pondered how talents were awakened.
It's one of the unsolved mysteries in the field of alchemy—there isn't currently any explanation that fully holds water. But it's certain that talents are passed on through some special method.
Just like when he obtained two S-class talents, [S-018-All-knowing Eye] and [S-004-Reaper], at that secret altar in the Storm Manor.
However, this special method must be of a god-tier or higher level, or even within the grasp of superior deities.
But what I didn't expect was that Dr. Banks's project now seems to have taken a different approach, discovering a BUG.
...
This "All-knowing Eye" represents the S-class talent [S-009 Omniscient Insight].
This talent not only allows the decomposition of all things but also possesses a super learning ability. Therefore, even a diluted version of [Omniscient Insight] is one of the most ideal talents for any alchemist!
If one could gain a portion of this talent by transplanting an eye, that would simply be "exploiting a creator's BUG".
This is the magic of Alchemy.
It can do anything.
And now Dr. Banks's experimental project aims to mass-produce this talent.
Dr. Banks was clearly aware of what his project meant. Looking at Su Lun, he didn't hide anything and straightforwardly added, "However, the possibility of this experiment failing is not small. Since there's no substitute for the experimental sample, I estimate the failure rate to be above 85%. When that happens, the eye may be lost. So, I want to ask for your opinion."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun immediately made a decision and casually said, "It's okay. Doctor, just go ahead with your research."
All research is like this,
Investment does not necessarily guarantee a return.
But without the willingness to invest, there will certainly be no results.
This is the inevitable path of exploring the unknown.
An "All-knowing Eye," though precious, if truly successful, would yield countless returns.
And even if it fails, the godly realms are vast; there might be other experimental materials to be found in the future.
Dr. Banks seemed not at all surprised to get such a response and smiled slightly, "That's good."
Ordinary people definitely wouldn't have the courage to waste an invaluable "All-knowing Eye" as experimental material.
But he was sure that Su Lun would.
The two didn't say much more and turned the topic back to the integration of the grafting equipment.
Su Lun had already prepared the materials. Once everything was set up, he began to chant the incantation: "Abide by the law of equivalent exchange of all things, praise the glory of the primal creator, witness the miracle of creation with Alchemy..."
...
Several days later.
The secret room next to the captain's quarters suddenly opened, and Su Lun walked out from it.
In the spacious room, there was the sound of water.
The curtain of the corner bathroom was not drawn, allowing the sight of rising steam; someone was soaking in the bath.
But it wasn't just one person, there were two.
Besides the expected Thousand Stripes, there was Pandora.
This moon-reading deity, having been with them for a while, had also developed the habit of soaking daily.
When Su Lun came out, the two were enjoying a bath and chatting casually.
The bathtub was full of irresistible allure, and Su Lun was not surprised to see Thousand Stripes bare, as she never avoided it.
What slightly surprised Su Lun was that Pandora was also naked, soaking in the hot water without a stitch, looking utterly content.
At a glance, her graceful figure was fully in view.
Seeing Su Lun emerge, the two in the tub did not show any signs of perturbation, remaining tranquil and composed.
Even Pandora made no move to cover herself.
Even her eyes carried a hint that could catalyze human innate desires, with a demeanor as if she felt indifferent to exposing herself, given that Su Lun had already studied her on many occasions.
Su Lun glanced at her briefly before tactfully averting his gaze. He knew that this bewitching demeanor was an effect of the Moon Reading Method.
Qian Tiao looked at him as he came out and greeted him, "Yo, Su Lun, have you finished your seclusion?"
After she asked that, she seemed to sense something and inquired with a peculiar tone, "Eh... have you advanced to the ninth rank?"
Su Lun walked over, responding, "How could it be that fast? I've just merged with the special equipment."
Qian Tiao was puzzled again, "Eh... that's strange. If you haven't advanced to the ninth rank, why do I find your 'aura' has changed so drastically?"
Su Lun had always known Qian Tiao had a special ability to judge.
She could see a person's "aura" and thereby determine their strength and weakness.
Pandora, with her exceptionally beautiful face, also looked on with a smile, "Your spiritual power has changed in a... very special way."
This Great Goddess of Moon Reading had long ago reached the "Soul Travel Realm" with her spiritual power, and she naturally saw through the peculiarity in Su Lun's spiritual power at a glance.
After pondering for a moment, she was also surprised and asked, "Could it be... you have condensed the Divine Flame?"
But no sooner had she spoken than a strange red gleam flashed in Pandora's eyes, as if she had tested something with a divine secret technique.
She immediately denied her own assumption, murmuring to herself, "No, that can't be right. It's not possible to have condensed the Divine Flame. But if you haven't, how can your spiritual power be so strong?"
Strong enough that her divine bewitching technique was completely immune?
"..."
Su Lun looked at the surprise on Pandora's flawless face and smiled slightly.
How could he not know he was targeted by a bewitching technique, which had been immunized by the effect of the "Blasphemer" special equipment?
There were no outsiders here, so naturally, there was nothing to hide. Su Lun simply explained, "This is the effect of the 'Blasphemer' special equipment. This equipment is quite unique, allowing humans to possess some of the cognitive abilities of gods."
"I see..."
Upon hearing this, both Qian Tiao and Pandora instantly realized, showing curiosity on their faces as they looked at Su Lun, whose change was too significant.
The "Blasphemer" special equipment was not easily explained in a few words. Su Lun did not dwell on the topic and instead turned to ask Qian Tiao, "By the way, where is senior apprentice-sister?"
He had sensed a moment ago that Mr. Jing was not on the ship.
Qian Tiao said, "She has been trailing the Magic Army of a million for the past few days, looking to see if there was an opportunity to break through. But, it's not looking good. The divine beings of the Celestial Plane have now retracted their magic airships and created a strange bird war formation. I've checked it out too; it would be impossible even for a demigod to break through it. We might have to wait for the grand battle..."
Upon hearing this, Su Lun's brow furrowed slightly, "Strange bird war formation? Does it involve earth, wind, water, and fire elemental magic airships forming a cross-shaped bird formation?"
After hearing this, Qian Tiao looked at him, "Eh? How do you know?"
"Hmm."
Su Lun nodded, a gleam of understanding flashing in his eyes.
He had previously extracted the memories of Princess Oktaavia and knew all the preparations of the million-strong army, including this million-level magic battle formation—the "Cease Giant Bird Magic Circle."
The characteristic of this battle formation was its stability and incredibly strong defense, especially suitable for large troop movements with low consumption. Unless it faced bombardment from an equally sized million-strong battle formation, it would be virtually impossible to break with any power below the divine rank.
Currently, the alchemy plane's battleships, though powerful, only boasted a range advantage. In a close-range bombardment, unless they were willing to sacrifice several million soldiers' lives, there was no chance of victory.
Therefore, under normal circumstances, the combined fleet could do nothing against this million-strong army and could only wait for the enemy to reach the mainland of Ru'Ying for a final battle on land.
But now, hearing about the battle formation, an insane plan sprung to Su Lun's mind.
He switched on the communicator.
A few minutes later, with a flash of light, a graceful figure appeared in the captain's room.
Mr. Jing looked at Su Lun, her face reflecting an inquiring gaze.
Su Lun said directly, "Senior apprentice-sister, I have an idea, with a high probability of breaking the Celestial Plane's million-strong army!"

chapters.title: Chapter 646 - 645: Surprise Attack on the Enemy's Headquarters
chapters.content:
Eternal Night, inside the Captain's quarters.
Mr. Jing listened to the outrageous plan and, astonished, said, "You're saying you plan to teleport in there alone?"
Su Lun nodded and explained, "Yes! This 'Cease Giant Bird Magic Circle' can't possibly be breached from the outside, so we must find a way from the inside. The weak point of the Cross Bird Battle Array is the main flagship at its core and the dozen or so airships in its belly. If we can destroy the command center, the entire invincible defense formation of the magic airship fleet will instantly crumble. At that point, if the Empire's legions launch a full-scale attack, they are certain to have a chance to break through. However, there are normally nearly a hundred thousand Mages around the command center, including that 'Archmage of Evil' Constantine Reiloz. At that time, I'll need you seniors to hold off those top-tier fighters for me."
