After listening, Mr. Jing furrowed her brows and muttered, "This plan is very risky..."
She had been observing the million-strong magic legion these days, and from every angle, she could not find any flaws in the battle array formed by those thousand magic airships.
She did indeed consider the possibility of breaking through from the inside.
But she immediately dismissed it.
The enemy must have considered the situation of their command center being raided. Thus, they would certainly have all kinds of magic restrictions and defenses in place, ready to counter anyone who broke in. And with demigod-level powerhouses in guard, even ninth-level practitioners would likely die instantly. Even Mr. Jing herself did not have the slightest hope of surviving.
And yet Su Lun's plan was exactly this?
To say the command center is a weakness, but in reality, it is still a brute force approach.
Mr. Jing's crystal-clear eyes flashed with solemnity, and before she had the chance to say anything, she suddenly heard Qian Tiao excitedly ask, "When do we go?"
The gambler of a lady, who had originally been idly soaking in the bathtub, stood up from the water with a splash, paying no heed to the trembling scenery in front of her chest.
With the prospect of a fight, the languid look on her face vanished, replaced by eager anticipation. It was as though she was ready to draw her sword and charge at a moment's notice if only the word was given.
Pandora also leaned on the edge of the bath, looking at Su Lun with an expression full of interest.
Mr. Jing pondered for a moment and asked, "How confident are you?"
She had naturally noticed the changes in Su Lun and guessed that his success in fusing with the eight-tier enhancement gear must have significantly boosted his strength.
But no matter how one looked at it, the plan was simply too insane.
The very meaning of a battle array is to consolidate strength; a million-strong legion is not so easily defeated. Normally speaking, even if they were all ninth-tier practitioners, a head-on charge would lead to their annihilation within minutes.
Su Lun, meeting the gaze of all three, solemnly replied, "I have a method that can instantly control almost all Mages below the seventh tier within range. As long as you seniors can hold off Constantine and a few ninth-tiers, leave the rest to me. Once we take control of the core operating personnel, our opportunity will arise..."
The larger the magic prohibition, the more personnel required to operate it, and 99% of those controlling the airships are Mages below the seventh tier. If they can be controlled, any battle formation will cease to function.
At that time, without the assistance of various magical restrictions, the threat posed by those top-tier Mages will decrease sharply.
This is also feasible?
Upon hearing this, Mr. Jing and the others' eyes all lit up at once.
Indeed, the plan was fraught with risks; after all, launching a surprise attack on the enemy's main base could mean certain death with the slightest mistake.
But if successful, they really might be able to directly break through the invincible battle formation of the million-strong legion with minimal casualties. At that point, this could become the breakthrough that reverses the tide of the war.
And now, Su Lun had thorough knowledge of the million-strong legion of the Divine Plane; if he dared to speak out, the chances of the plan's success were naturally not small.
The three of them listened on with great interest.
...
Visibility at sea was not high today due to the storm and thunder. In particular, thirty nautical miles southeast of the Eternal Night, the area was covered by a thundercloud storm, rendering it completely obscured.
Occasionally, when the mists parted slightly, the shadows of magic airships could be seen.
To guard against shelling, those folks from the Divine Plane kept releasing various large-scale interference magics like 'War Fog' and 'Mirage,' disrupting the aim of the cannons. Plus, with the continuous bombardment over the past few days, the nearby maritime elements are a mess, and every day brings unpredictable extreme weather.
An hour later, Su Lun, Mr. Jing, Qian Tiao, and Pandora were ready with everything they needed.
"Alright, once we're prepared, let's set out."
"Mm."
The group exchanged looks and nodded, a stern sharpness in their eyes.
Su Lun raised his hand and a black hole appeared in his palm, into which Mr. Jing and the other two promptly jumped.
He then wrapped himself in the "Oz Ice-man's Mortcloth," and his presence vanished without a trace. Although he knew that no matter what preparations he made, detection was inevitable, an additional layer of protection was always better. Even if it could delay the enemy's response by just one second, it would significantly increase their chances of success.
With a pinch of the Suren Sorcerer's Seal, Su Lun had disappeared from the captain's room.
...
Tens of miles away within the thunderclouds...
A thousand magic flying ships from the Divine Plane formed a cross-shaped formation, advancing westward at a steady pace.
In the midst of the fleet was a kilometer-long gold flagship. From the outside, it appeared that this flagship and the dozen or so auxiliary warships surrounding it formed a diamond-shaped battle array—the core of the Cease Giant Bird Magic Circle. Upon closer inspection, this diamond magic circle was like a heart, constantly pulsing with surging magic power, flowing into and out of the cross-shaped battle array's wings, then cycling back and forth.
This was the superiority of this epic magic battle formation.
With the elements of wind, water, fire, and earth magic circles supporting the four wings of the cross, converging at the core, they formed an energy circulation system within. This allowed for the maximum defensive effect with minimal consumption.
It was also the primary reason this fleet of flying ships could sail under constant cannon fire.
The magical flying ship fleet sailed steadily, the sound of cannons firing incessantly by their sides.
The joined fleet's firing frequency had lost the intensity of the first two days, but even so, alchemical cannonballs were continuously bombarding the legion's battle array of a million-strong army every moment.
"Boom~"
"Boom~"
"Boom~"
"..."
Some of the cannonballs fell short, while others struck the magic flying ship fleet.
However, the alchemical cannonballs did not explode upon hitting the flying ships, but instead were blocked by a honeycomb-shaped golden magic shield hundreds of meters away, rippling with a visibly thick layer of magic before dissipating.
The legion's magic shields absorbed the shockwaves from the bombardment, instantly diffusing even those comparable to ninth-tier professional attacks. Once the energy shockwaves dispersed, the light from the magic shields also faded, with the flying ships remaining unharmed.
This "Cross Giant Bird" made up of magic flying ships traversed through the thunderclouds, akin to a monstrous beast emerging from the abyss, swimming through the storm, breathing lightning, unstoppable by any.
At this very moment, atop the gold flagship, the "Archmage of Evil" Constantine Reiloz was meditating.
But suddenly, a sense of crisis surged through him, and he opened his eyes abruptly.
"Hmm... strange..."
Constantine's brows furrowed as he looked at the magic crystal ball in front of him with a puzzled expression.
The crystal ball not only displayed various scenes from the magic flying ships but even monitored the warships tens of miles away that were firing their guns.
Everything seemed normal.
Yet, this seasoned mage felt an unfounded palpitation as he observed the calm before him.
A Magic God is the ultimate in human cultivation, second only to the divine. This realm has glimpsed into the mysteries of the universe, possessing abilities that only deities have. For example, sensing targeted malicious intentions is within their capabilities.
That sudden sense of crisis was very abrupt.
It was as if someone harbored ill will and immediately acted upon it, decisively!
Constantine was aware that this was definitely not an illusion.
Years of battle-hardened intuition immediately made him bellow, "Everyone, strengthen your guard!"
No sooner had he spoken than tens of thousands of Mages on the flagship and those on several nearby warships sprang into action. All kinds of defensive magic barriers were maximized, and emergency combat personnel were in place in an instant, entering a pre-battle state.
Constantine Reiloz pondered for a moment and was not careless in the slightest.
He was uncertain of the source of his sudden heart palpitations. After a moment's thought, he chanted a mysterious incantation towards the magic crystal ball, "Great divine beings, please grant me the power to clear the fog of fate, and divinate to inform your devoted followers from where danger approaches..."
Most Mages were adept at divination, and he, a Demigod, was even more proficient in various divination magics.
Yet he knew not to underestimate the top professionals of this alchemic plane, so he immediately invoked Divine Power, hoping for some guidance.
What he didn't know was that Su Lun had anticipated this and had already let Peistoria attach to him.
Not to mention that Constantine was a Demigod, with Peistoria being a special existence that had condensed divine fire, even the gods themselves might not be able to divine any directional clues.
Besides, by the time the divination was happening, they had already arrived!
.....
On the Golden flagship, the "Archmage of Evil," Constantine, furrowed his brows as he stared at a patch of fog on the crystal ball before him.
The less he was able to divine, the stronger the sense of crisis became in his heart.
If borrowing Divine Power could not grant even a glimpse into fate's trajectory, then the problem was serious indeed.
However, just as he was watching intently, the crystal ball suddenly flashed with a scene.
Constantine looked at it in confusion for a moment, thinking, Isn't this the scene of the command center on the flagship before him?
Could something bad happen here?
His thoughts turned in an instant, and he suddenly realized—the enemy had arrived!
It never occurred to him that the enemy would dare to launch a surprise attack on his headquarters!
But before he had time to think further, the next moment, a faint spatial fluctuation flashed about a hundred meters away.
The lower-level Mages were oblivious, but those top-level Mages at rank eight and above clearly saw a space rift. Yet it was so subtle, and no one saw anyone enter, many thought it was an illusion.
However, the command center's magical prohibitions reacted in an instant.
Suddenly, the nine crystal pillars surrounding the chamber flickered with blue lightning, rapidly weaving into a net of lightning that covered the entire space.
The lightning, as if sentient, avoided the Mages and uniformly struck at a particular spot in the void.
What was previously empty was now illuminated by a human figure with the veil of lightning.
This was a top-level magical prohibition specifically designed to defend against various stealth targets—the "Eye of Regulus."
Consisting of nine cores made from ninth-rank thunder magical beast crystal cores, it possessed innate sentience. The constantly activated lightning domain would automatically identify and attack unidentified targets with a power that exceeded rank nine.
With a "crack" of thunder, the transparent silhouette was struck and revealed its true form amidst the thunder elements. It was then that everyone saw clearly that it was a person wrapped like a mummy in bandages.
If not the stealthily teleported Su Lun, then who could it be?
Su Lun was not surprised to be discovered by the prohibitions upon entry, as he knew the flagship like the back of his hand.
But enduring a lightning strike from above rank nine was not easy.
Enduring a barrage of lightning strikes caused a numbing sensation throughout his body. Even with his Rune Golden Body's extremely high magic resistance nullifying the fatal damage of the lightning, the terrifying thunder elements poured into his body from the prohibition, running hot like magma through his veins in an instant, overwhelming him with a searing sensation as if he were to be burned to ashes.
If it had been anyone other than Su Lun, perhaps any other eighth or ninth rank professional, they would have likely been annihilated on the spot.
And it wasn't only thunder strikes. The moment he entered, all kinds of magical lights lit up. Mind control, anti-magic, spatial confinement, life force extraction, element theft, senses disruption, time distortion... about a dozen prohibitions assaulted him all at once.
The Celestial Domain is a magic plane; they had researched magic to its utmost limits.
These prohibitions had considered nearly every scenario; unless the intruder was without any weaknesses, they were bound to fall victim.
If they couldn't withstand even one, the outcome would be either capture or death on the spot.
However, Su Lun the Puppeteer was precisely that kind of professional—almost devoid of any obvious weaknesses!
He had strong life force, his Rune Golden Body gave him strong defense against both physical and magical attacks, his spiritual power was robust, unconstrained by space, with a top-level understanding of all magic laws... no weaknesses!
It was precisely because he withstood that first wave of restrictive attacks that he saw his chance.
In the instant he teleported into the command center, a rift in space opened in the palm of his left hand, and three figures swiftly burst out; his right hand quickly moved, and innumerable threads had already spread out.
...
Constantine Reiloz, the "Archmage of Evil," watching the enemy suddenly appear in the command center, also felt a bad premonition.
Although he couldn't understand why the natives of the alchemic plane dared to storm the command center, in that instant, a domineering Sword Qi was already slashing down towards him.
Meanwhile, nine streaks of light flashed by, quickly entangling several ninth-tier Sages of Law.
And that crimson moonlight spread, the Moon Reading Illusion Technique instantly reflected in the eyes of all the mages present.
"Not good!"
Constantine's eyes chilled as he recognized that these were several of the top combat forces from the alchemic plane.
These were opponents he would be wary of.
Now, Constantine no longer had the time to ponder other things—his magic power surged throughout his body, and he raised a magical light shield in front of him just in time to block the Thunderous Sword Qi.
In his view, the one with the mirror ability was the highest in cultivation and was also very troublesome, but the most fatal was the swordsman capable of slashing through the realms of law.
He had to oppose with all his strength.
"Eh?"
But in the brief exchange, Constantine immediately deduced that the swordsman's actions were not to risk their life but to keep him tied down.
This was also puzzling to him.
He believed that these people storming the command center must have the goal of a decapitation strike.
After all, without killing him, a demigod, such a surprise attack would be completely meaningless.
Once he got the chance, he could easily kill these intruders by mobilizing the legion's prohibitions.
But this swordsman did not seem to have the determination to fight to the death?
Moreover, the significance of a legion lies in them being a team; even if he was tied down, there were countless points of attack to kill the enemy.
What were these guys really trying to do?
As the thought flashed through his mind, Constantine had already blocked several waves of Sword Qi.
At the same time, several ninth-tier mages were also tied up by the mirror images.
But until this moment, Constantine and the other top brass had no significant worries.
The main ship was manned by the Ascieden Empire's elite mages. Even without command, the flawless emergency response plans ensured everyone could counterattack at a moment's notice.
If they did not have the capability to kill all the commanders in the command center instantly, breaking in was pointless.
However, something unanticipated then occurred that the mages of the divine plane had not expected.
They had overlooked someone who had entered and silently begun casting spells.

chapters.title: Chapter 647 - 646: He Seems Like a God
chapters.content:
The plan that Lirong and his companions had discussed was for Mr. Jing and his two associates to distract top-tier Mages at all costs, thereby creating an opportunity for Su Lun.
As long as they could hold on for a moment, the plan would succeed.
And indeed, as they had anticipated, they were immediately met with fierce attacks upon their infiltration.
Especially since Mr. Jing's group's every move was so dramatic, it compelled the enemy to focus their attacks on them.
Even with the support of magic constraints, Mr. Jing's seemingly invincible mirror duplication ability was hit repeatedly by a joint attack from several ninth-tier Sages of Law in a short period and suffered severe injuries with blood spouting.
Pandora's Tsukuyomi Law Phase also was shattered multiple times. Though not fatal, her Divine Power embodiment was faintly disintegrating, putting her in a precarious state.
Qiantiao was even worse off; her style was to use offense as her defense in the Sword Dao. Either she would quickly slay the enemy or, if she failed, she would be at great risk of injury. At the moment, she was holding off Demi-God Constantine Reiloz alone, who, helped by countless magic circles, had combat power not even half as weak as Princess Oktaavia had with Divine Power at her disposal.
Facing this consummate battle strength, Qiantiao's Sword Dao, no matter how sharp, could not prevail. After several clashes, even though her Sword Qi was so fierce it sliced several gashes in the cabin, she was only able to inflict a few non-fatal sword wounds on the old Archmage, while she herself was seriously injured.
In the vast command room, Alchemy and magic were entirely in disarray.
The Mages paid a minimal price to completely suppress the three top-tier combatants from the Alchemy plane, leaving them gasping for air.
Moreover, as soon as they burst in, various defensive constraints were activated to prevent any escape.
If things continued like this, it was feared that it would not be long before all three were slain on the spot.
However, at that moment, an unexpected change occurred.
...
The command cabin of the Gold Airship had turned into complete chaos.
Almost everyone's gaze was concentrated on Mr. Jing, Qiantiao, and Pandora, who had caused a major commotion as soon as they broke in, while they ignored Su Lun, who had been silent after entering.
It was Mr. Jing's group's sacrifice that created the opportunity for Su Lun to execute his technique.
In that instant, it was as if someone softly chanted, "Puppetry Technique: I am the deity!"
With these words barely ending,
Just a second before, those Mages had amplified their Magic Power by a hundredfold, fighting like they were possessed by deities, and had nearly beaten Mr. Jing to death.
Yet in the blink of an eye, they found themselves losing that sense of control, and their magic capabilities plummeted by dozens of times!
The battling Mages were still unsure what had happened, but in that moment of rigidity, Mr. Jing, Qiantiao, and Pandora suddenly burst forth, switching from defense to offense, and in the blink of an eye, they had already slain several people.
The situation seemed to have taken a turn.
"Archmage of Evil," Constantine immediately realized something and his face turned pale as he shouted, "Not good, quickly kill that Puppet Master!"
He had been paying attention to the whole scene all along and had noticed the countless transparent threads.
But until now, he had not understood the significance of these actions.
Because in the context of the Magic Army Legion's battle array, no matter how strong Puppetry Technique was, it would be utterly ineffective.
However, in that fleeting moment, as the Sage watched that vast spiritual power spread along each thread, Constantine realized something: Was this person trying to take control over everyone in the command room?
This idea was fine,
As long as he seized control over the Mages manipulating the constraints, the situation could be reversed instantly.
But for the life of him, he couldn't comprehend how it could be done!
The command room was filled with high-level Mages of fifth or sixth tier; even his demi-god level spiritual power could barely control a hundred people with spiritual secret techniques.
Not to mention someone else?
What was the point of the Puppet Master's actions?
Unaware of the subtleties of Alchemy, Constantine naturally did not know about the "God Profaner."
Although he didn't grasp why that native Alchemist took such actions, his instincts told him he had to be stopped.
Unfortunately, it was already too late.
Mr. Jing and his companions risked their lives to distract the top-tier Mages in the command room, longing for this very moment!
Besides, without the enhancement of the magic circles, nowhere on the Magic Airship, except for Demi-God Constantine, did anyone have the capacity to kill Su Lun.
...
The plan was in place.
Su Lun's Soul Perception accurately locked onto the precise locations of all the Mages aboard the main ship and several nearby airships, as the threads extended accurately toward them.
This Cease Giant Bird Magic Circle was formed from the main ship and several combat airships. It was originally designed with many scenarios in mind, like being invaded by top-tier powerhouses releasing wide-spread Illusion Techniques, intimidating Aura, etc., which could cause low-level Mages to fall en masse.
Therefore, intricate spatial constraints were designed between the cabins and the airships to block various spiritual power techniques and area magic.
Under normal circumstances, even if the threads were extremely sharp, they could only spread within the cabins of the main ship and would have great difficulty penetrating into other cabins.
However, Su Lun had become exceedingly skilled with the use of the "Urobolos Space-Time Ring."
The threads too had the ability to penetrate the void.
Previously, it would have been impossible for Su Lun to create so many sand-grain-like spatial wormholes, but now, having merged with the "God Profaner," he did it with ease. It was as if his concentration could be split into hundreds of thousands of threads, each precisely controlled.
At this moment, one could see that the tips of those threads each had a faint spatial fluctuation.
Countless threads, like needles, pierced directly into the space, silently puncturing through various prohibitions and into the core cabins of the magical fleet's battle array.
Even for the escort airships hundreds of meters away, space folding brought them within arm's reach. With Su Lun's power now comparable to that of a ninth-tier, controlling those sixth or seventh-tier mages was almost unimpeded, as the threads instantly penetrated the bodies of numerous mages.
Almost at the very instant the threads established a connection, spiritual power surged along the threads with a ferocious rush.
In that moment, Su Lun felt as if he were a deity, dominating everything.
Finally,
At this moment.
He finally understood what his teacher, Seria, had taught him about the ultimate essence of being a Puppeteer.
His expression turned solemn as if filled with boundless boldness, and he murmured in his heart, "Puppets are not mere idle playthings; wherever my eyes fall, all is puppets."
In an instant, tens of thousands of mages simultaneously stiffened in expression, their eyes revealing a vacant look, having fallen into an endless nightmare.
....
Controlling a thinking human is thousands of times more complex than manipulating a puppet. This unstable control is also greatly influenced by the target's spiritual power and willpower.
In the past, Su Lun was able to precisely control two or three thousand stone gargoyles, but when it came to humans of around fifth-tier, he could at most control a hundred persons.
But now it was different. After merging with the "God Profaner" symbiont, the mental control technique "Heartstealer's Mental Domination" had advanced into "Nightmare of the Divine."
This was a kind of awe-inspiring power similar to that of gods or dragons, emanating from the depth of one's life force, able to overwhelm the will of most professionals below the eighth-tier. It directly intimidated, then controlled their consciousness.
The controlled would be subjected to a dream realm created by Su Lun, viewing him as a deity.
Moreover, Su Lun's threads were a physical means of conduction, a hundred times more effective than remote conduction.
Once they were controlled, escape was almost impossible.
....
And taking control of the mages in the command center was only the first step.
Su Lun's ultimate goal was to directly destroy the structure of this magical airship fleet!
The "Cease Giant Bird Magic Circle" was a super battle array assembled using countless resources. It was like a massive castle built by ants with time, effort, and materials, something not a single or couple of ants could destroy. Even if the ants were strong, it would be of no use.
Only an attack of equivalent magnitude could destroy this magical airship fleet!
So Su Lun planned to use the various magical prohibitions in the command center to destroy the Big Bird battle array from the inside.
"Success!"
Mr. Jing and his two companions, struggling in battle, heard Su Lun's voice through the communicator and finally breathed a sigh of relief.
The most dangerous step in their surprise attack plan was the time they broke in and Su Lun took control of the command center.
During that time, they had to face various top-tier mages augmented by magical prohibitions, a matter of life and death.
Once they entered, it was a path of no return.
The group had come prepared to die.
If the plan failed, Su Lun wouldn't have a chance to save them; they could only fight to the death.
Fortunately, their resolve allowed the plan to proceed very smoothly. They had even calculated the estimated battle time down to the second. Su Lun too, as planned, successfully took control of the majority of the enemy's command center!
Upon hearing the communication, the three of them in sync retreated their defensive line.
This was just the beginning.
Their most urgent task now was to protect Su Lun, securing him the conditions for safe output.
...
Seeing this, Demi-God Constantine's face changed dramatically!
He too raised his magic wand immediately and cast an instantaneous ninth-tier magic spell towards Su Lun, trying to eliminate this biggest variable.
However, the "Annihilation Beam" that shot through was deflected by a mirror reflection.
The nine clones of Mr. Jing were already guarding Su Lun's sides, forming a defensive formation.
Yet, as soon as this attack landed, another ninth-tier rune mage acted with extreme swiftness. He rushed toward Su Lun like an erupting volcano, launching a fist that was already burning like molten lava.
But just as he surged forward, a "snap" of stepping into nothingness was heard, and space rippled.
Completely covered in blood, Su Lun fearlessly transformed into a thunderbolt to intercept the oncoming attack.
With a "bang," the Sword Qi infused with lightning clashed with the lava magic, explosively bursting apart.
Waves of fiery flames surged through the massive cabin.
The two parties separated immediately upon contact.
However, the mages at the command center were the elite of the elite, their coordination was impeccably in sync.
As Su Lun blocked one mage, three spells struck her transformed form of light together. Her Sword Qi was halved and abruptly stopped.
Her movements were as fast as lightning, normally very difficult to capture.
But the enemy had anticipated that she would certainly come to Su Lun's aid, so they struck with a Combination Attack Technique, hitting their mark!
With a "pfft," Su Lun spat out a mouthful of blood.
Her face was as pale as gold leaf, and the Rakshasa Golden Body behind her was badly damaged and dispersed.
Mr. Jing was tasked with guarding Su Lun and could not withdraw, while Pandora was too late to come to the rescue.
At this moment of extreme crisis, suddenly, an unexpected change occurred!
The nine crystal pillars in the command room lit up with dazzling magical runes, and in an instant, a burst of white light shone forth, followed by the "crackle" and "crackle" of dense lightning strikes.
Everyone looked closely and realized it was the previously employed epic magic restriction, "Eye of Regulus," activating its attack again!
Countless bolts of lightning wove into a net, converging into spears, broadly covering the entire cabin.
This time, however, the target of the lightning wasn't the group of four, but the "Archmage of Evil," Constantine Reiloz, who knew the situation was dire and was invoking the will of the gods to prepare a fierce attack on the intruders.
"Not good!"
The old mage's face changed drastically, muttering to himself that this was bad news.
But he was not of the divine lineage, his divine invocation was much slower compared to the Grand Princess Oktaavia earlier.
Su Lun had already anticipated this.
Yet, even the time it took to chant was enough for the situation to have reversed!
"Crack!"
A thunderous explosion sounded.
The "Eye of Regulus" had a range that covered the entire command center; the old mage had no escape. Lightning struck him in an instant, piercing through the Body-Protecting Sanctuary and blasting him away like a cannonball. With a "thud," he was smashed against the wall a hundred meters away.
The air immediately filled with the thick scent of char.
But he was a demigod after all, and even after taking this horrific blow, he was only injured, not killed.
However, the others were not so lucky.
The magical restrictions within this flagship weren't limited to just the "Eye of Regulus"!
No sooner had that bolt of lightning fallen than the dozen or so super-restrictions on the flagship, having finished gathering energy, were released all at once.
These restrictions were precise and targeted, not just enveloping large areas.
Each was lethal to top-tier professionals.
Moreover, Su Lun knew the strength of everyone present, and the effects of the damage were amplified. He multitasked a thousand ways, almost every restriction targeting a mage's weakness.
Those with weak flesh received mental attacks, those with strong magic power were banned from using magic, those with strong mental power had their life force drained... every move was targeted!
In just an instant, those high-ranking mages in the command room not controlled by the threads were knocked down en masse, with screams of agony echoing non-stop.
How terrifying was the might of the super-restrictions? Just after this round of attacks, the vast majority of mages below the ninth tier were killed on the spot!
As severely suppressed as Su Lun and his companions were before, now the mages faced an equally brutal fate.
The cabin was littered with corpses, with limbs and body parts strewn everywhere.
Controlling those tens of thousands of mages, Su Lun mobilized combat strength hundreds of times greater than his own and wreaked havoc in every corner of the cabin.
The mages struggled, but in the face of such destructive power, there was simply no resistance.
In just a few moments, only Constantine and a few eighth and ninth-tier mages were left, huddling together in defense and barely alive.
And the other mages not under control were all dead!
....
Su Lun knew he could not kill Constantine quickly, and if they tarried, a million legions nearby would reinforce the area.
Seeing this, he unhesitatingly issued the "ship self-destruct" command.
The "Cease Giant Bird Magic Circle" was one of the most sophisticated flying fortress arrays from the divine realms, with a very comprehensive security system. It was composed of independent cabins, each controlled by a separate team. Normally, even if enemies infiltrated and aimed to cause destruction, they could only damage parts of it.
However, Su Lun now forcefully used his spatial ability and threads to directly control almost all the cabins in the core command room.
He was also intimately familiar with nearly all the arrangements within the fleet.
Even the all-access commands and magic keys that only a Marshal would know.
The order for self-destruction was transmitted through the multitude of threads to the minds of nearly a hundred thousand controlled mages. Together, they started manipulating their respective part of the restrictions, initiating the self-destruct protocol.
Right after the command was issued, the runes on the massive Gold flagship and the nearby dozen or so magic airships grew increasingly bright, streaming out destructive magic power.
Constantine and the few surviving ninth-level individuals watched helplessly, unable to do anything.
That surge of magic power showed no sign of stopping, continuing to grow unchecked.
Like a balloon inflated to its limit, it suddenly "Bang!"—burst open.
For a moment, it seemed as though the world had gone silent.
But in the next instant, a terrifying shockwave exploded outward in all directions.
Boom...
Boom...
Boom...
In the sky, the thousand airships forming the Cross Big Bird were shattered into pieces at this moment.
With the core destroyed, the invincible defense of the "Cease Giant Bird Magic Circle" was completely breached.
Hundreds of magic airships, like the feathers of a giant bird, scattered and drifted away.
...
Meanwhile.
In the distance, the United Empire's fleet that was constantly monitoring this million-strong magic army saw this bizarre scene through their lookout glasses.
Watching the sudden fiery explosion in the sky, everyone's faces were filled with disbelief, thinking they were seeing things.
That Cross Big Bird in the Heavenly Divine Plane, which had withstood countless ammunition showers over the past few days, now exploded? And it was the most central command unit?
"What happened!"
"Marshal Sir, urgent report! Urgent report!"
"What? The enemy's magic airships exploded, and their battle array broke on its own?"
"Yes! For whatever reason, a violent explosion occurred, but it's confirmed, the Cross Bird Battle Array is broken, and now the enemy's airship fleet is in complete disarray..."
"..."
Instantly, this sudden situation spread throughout dozens of naval fleets and various steam-powered airship fleets.
Tens of thousands of battleships on the nearby seas came alive all at once.
Everyone, with binoculars in hand, watched from the deck at the terrible explosion amidst the distant storm.
It was a blue mushroom cloud.
This was a sign of a magic energy overload detonation.
The commanders were just as bewildered, completely at a loss as to what had happened.
Nobody had received any prior orders, and now this unexpected event unfolded, leaving everyone briefly dumbfounded.
Seeing this incredible scene, one thought immediately came to everyone's mind: Dawn!
"What's the situation with the Dawn Group?"
"The Eternal Night is already speeding towards the direction of the blast!"
"My goodness, it must be the work of those big shots from Dawn! Hahahaha... it's too incredible. Inform the brothers, charge! All forces, advance!"
"General, shouldn't we wait for orders? If we launch an attack without permission, we might..."
"Hahaha, command won't have a clue what's happening either. Don't worry, the orders will come. Let's move! Otherwise, if we're late, those fellows from the Heavenly Divine Plane might escape!"
"..."
Although no one knew exactly what had happened, those experienced generals immediately recognized this as an unparalleled opportunity not to be missed.
Instantly, even without orders, the fleet that had discovered the explosion moved in unison, racing at full speed towards the site of the incident.
And just as the generals predicted, it wasn't long before the central command of the United Fleet received accurate intel and issued the order for all forces to strike!
Suddenly, millions of soldiers pressed forward towards the Heavenly Divine Plane's million-strong army, in an overwhelming surge.
Nobody could have anticipated that this major showdown between the Alchemy Plane and the Heavenly Divine Plane would come prematurely, due to what seemed like an accidental explosion!

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - 647: I'm Invincible in This World
chapters.content:
Su Lun and his team had devised a surprise attack plan that was kept secret even from those aboard the Eternal Night, including Mr. Hei, to ensure it wouldn't be discovered by any prophecy or divinations.
Thus, when the blue mushroom cloud suddenly exploded in the sky, not only were the members of the Allied Fleet caught off guard, but everyone from the Dawn Group was equally shocked.
However, the solidarity of the team meant that the Dawn members immediately guessed that it was Su Lun's doing, and they went into battle mode without hesitation.
The alchemical sails were activated, and with Tanni the Navigator controlling the boost from the ocean currents and waves, the ship's speed reached its utmost limit. The vast black-sailed ship flew across the sea like a shuttle, leaving a long trail of foam behind it and soon leaving the Empire's steel warships far behind.
On the deck, the Dragon Language Magician group of the Dawn Group had already assembled.
Old Sword God Bartolo, Number Nineteen, 'Blood Duke' Wuzhuasi, Barrett, and other high-level fighters were also gathered on the deck.
The sight of the magical airships falling like raindrops in the distant storm due to the explosion left everyone's faces filled with shock beyond measure.
Once the Cease Giant Bird Magic Circle was destroyed, the fog of war started to fade away, revealing the scattered and falling airships to everyone's view.
"The plan conceived by the Progenitor is truly insane, opting for a surprise attack on the enemy's headquarters. Ha... My old bones haven't felt this fired up in hundreds of years."
"Indeed. The staff officers had conducted countless simulations before. Unless we also had more than five demigod-level powerhouses, there was no chance of success. I can't believe the leaders actually pulled it off."
"It's utterly unbelievable, how did they do it? This legendary battle will surely be recorded in the annals of the alchemical world. If I weren't just at tier seven, I too would wish to join the battle, even if it were to end in death!"
"Regardless, prepare for battle. Our flying war formation has been disrupted, and the mages from the divine plane will be fighting desperately. With the final battle drawn near, the difficult fight begins now..."
"Yes, it's a matter of life and death this time."
"..."
A solitary surprise attack, destroying the enemy's command in the midst of a million troops—what could be more thrilling news?
But everyone was aware of the incredible risk of the operation.
Even for Mr. Jing and his peers, who represented the pinnacle of power in the alchemical world, this mission was likely a life-or-death gamble.
And yet, for all their concern, they were powerless to assist.
The insanity of attacking the enemy headquarters was a plan beyond the capabilities of anyone below tier nine, and even participating was out of the question.
All they could do was rush to the battlefield as quickly as possible. By engaging some of the mages, they hoped to relieve some of the pressure on the others.
On the deck, everyone's expression was uniformly serious.
Only Mr. Hei appeared utterly calm.
Gazing into the distance, a wise light flickered in his eyes.
The others failed to grasp the truth, but he, who had acquired "wisdom," had roughly deduced the reality behind their actions, murmuring to himself, "It seems, Su Lun's endless army of puppets has come to fruition..."
In the entire Dawn Group, aside from Su Lun and Mr. Jing, he was the only one who had read through the complete Isaac's Alchemy Manuscript.
And only he was aware of just how powerful Su Lun would become after integrating with the God Profaner's armor.
Thinking of something, Mr. Hei's pupils contracted as he thought the idea too incredible to believe and muttered to himself, "Perhaps... we are about to witness another miracle."
...
Elsewhere.
Within the fleet of magical airships of the divine plane.
The violent explosion on the golden flagship caused the surrounding airships to fall like rain onto the sea, scattering the thousand-strong formation as they were hit by tidal wave-sized surges.
The heart of the Cross Bird, though not completely dead, was blown up. It had utterly lost its previous force and dominance.
Like a castle with shaken foundations, it was already on the brink of collapse.
The moment the explosion occurred, four figures shot back several miles in an instant. Su Lun, Mr. Jing, Qiantiao, and Pandora stood suspended in the air.
Gazing at the magnificent blue mushroom cloud before them, they showed expressions of overt relief.
Finally, they had succeeded in sabotage—the risk they faced in this surprise attack was not in vain.
With the destruction of the giant bird war formation, the mages from the divine plane had lost their greatest reliance.
Thinking of attacking the mainland of Ruying now?
No, they won't have the chance.
Today marks the day of the demise of the million-strong magical army!
And just as the four of them teleported over, 'Archmage of Evil' Constantine and several surviving eighth and ninth tier mages also teleported in relentless pursuit.
An explosion of this magnitude was insufficient to kill these top-tier mages.
Looking at the completely destroyed airship, the faces of the few people were so grim they seemed as if they could drip with water.
How could they not know? Once the battle formation broke, on this isolated alchemical plane, their million-strong legion awaited a certain death trap.
The direct assault on Luying was chosen precisely because it was the Ascieden Empire's last chance.
Only if their million-man legion destroyed the civilization of alchemy would their previous sacrifices be rewarded, and the benefits from subsequently colonizing the plane maximize. For this, they had even paid the price of the Grand Princess Oktaavia's death in battle.
But now, with the Cease Giant Bird Magic Circle broken, their last hope had shattered.
Without the battle array's enhancement, even though they were a million mages, facing the several millions of alchemists surrounding them by sea, the outcome was already predictable.
If they were to be defeated in this pioneering battle, it would be the most severe and humiliating defeat in the history of the Ascieden Empire. A million troops lost here could even lead the Empire towards decline.
What was more crucial was the failure to fulfill the divine orders!
At the root of it all were these few individuals before them!
They not only killed the Grand Princess but were also the main culprits behind the destruction of the battle formation.
The mages never imagined that there would actually be someone capable of destroying the Cease Giant Bird Formation of a million-man legion.
The bizarrely broad-range mental control method, now recalled, felt like a nightmare.
But there was no point in discussing any of this now.
The blue mushroom cloud before them had not yet fully dissipated, and the stark reality lay before their eyes.
Constantine's expression darkened as he issued the command, "Kill them!"
Although the million-man legion was routed and scattered, they still comprised several ten-thousands-strong mage groups.
This was also a world-ending power!
Now, there was only the resolve for a fight to the death.
The indigenous forces currently before their eyes had already been severely damaged, and there was a chance to turn defeat into victory.
At this command, hundreds of nearby magic airships surged with dense magic fluctuations.
As for Demigod Constantine, he was the first to charge into battle, raising his magic wand and chanting devout prayers, "Great divine beings above, please bestow upon me the power of the divine weapon to slay the heretics..."
Finally, he completed the Divine Arts that he had left unfinished moments before.
Instead of summoning a god, as his prayer concluded, strands of the rules of reality condensed into a light shield in his left hand, manifesting the Artifact Projection—the "Shield of Purity."
Another look revealed that the epic "Helvir Magic Wand" in his right hand, adorned with a colorless gem, also gathered filaments of the rules, displaying the resplendent brilliance only Divine Artifacts could emit, turning it into a "Sub-Divine" grade item.
With the arrival of these two Sub-Divine magical instruments, even the sky seemed to dim in comparison.
"Archmage of Evil" Constantine Reiloz appeared godlike, his robes fluttering amidst rolling magic power.
For a moment, as he unfolded his magical domain, elements within dozens of miles were commandeered, as though he were the sole ruler of this world.
...
Su Lun's All-knowing Eye had already foreseen everything.
The expressions of Mr. Jing and the other two companions by his side could not hide their gravity.
The strength added by the projection of this hundred percent magic-immune Artifact to a Demigod was something they had personally experienced before.
Even without the "Eye of the Heavenly God," Demigod Constantine's prowess was not to be underestimated.
This was the epitome of humanity's ultimate power, and with the enhancement of Artifact Projection, he was an undefeated force on the plane.
Their previous victory was entirely due to the enemy's underestimation and their own thorough preparation. But now, besides Su Lun, the rest—Mr. Jing, Qian Tiao, and Pandora—were all in a severely wounded state.
If they were to truly engage in battle, the odds of winning were extremely low.
There was a chance to retreat.
But at this moment, they did not retreat, nor could they afford to.
If they were to flee, they would likely lose this perfect opportunity to completely annihilate the million-man mage army.
They would also fail to contain this unstoppable Demigod, which would inevitably lead to heavy losses for the united fleet, possibly even a counterattack from the deities of the celestial plane.
Mr. Jing and the others took the time to steady their restive vital energy. They did not strike again, instead forming a triangular formation in silent defense around Su Lun.
Because they knew that what followed would be the time for miracles to unfold.
....
Su Lun looked indifferently at the Mage who was summoning the terrifying elements to cast a forbidden spell, and a flicker of disdain flashed in his eyes, "Still not giving up, huh... Pity that now my endless army of puppets has been established, in front of me, numbers have lost all meaning."
What of a Demigod?
What of a million-strong legion?
Now that his endless army of puppets was assembled, he couldn't think of any reason he would lose in the plane of Alchemy!
It was at this moment that Su Lun raised his hand to summon thousands of space scrolls, and with a light shout, "Unfurl!"
Bang, bang, bang, bang...
The runes on the space scrolls shone brightly and exploded in the void.
Upon looking again, what could be called the most legendary scene since the onset of the planar wars appeared.
Above the sea, puppets materialized out of thin air, densely packed, covering the sky and obscuring the sun.
At a rough count, there were as many as a million!
The number of gargoyles hadn't exceeded two hundred thousand before the trip to God Burial Ground due to the scarcity of the main material "Animating Silver," with various qualities that were inconsistent. Then there were some other animated corpses, ancient puppets, traditional mechanical puppets, combat mecha puppets... all adding up to only about five hundred thousand.
And that dense swarm was made up of octopuses with eight tentacles, which could roam freely in the void, "Void Mechanical Octopuses."
The larger mechanical octopuses spanned hundreds of meters, the smaller ones the length of a single person, but there were countless numbers of them.
Gargoyles were the most perfectly structured puppets, while the mechanical octopuses were the most perfect mechanical creatures!
All of these were produced by the war workshops in the lesser void over the years, consuming endless resources, working day and night.
All for today!
This is the endless puppet army.
He alone,
Is the legion.
Capable of opposing,
An army of a million!
As soon as this million-strong legion appeared, although there were only four members of the Dawn Group, their momentum matched that of the opposing million-strong magic army.
Su Lun summoned the puppet army, like a deity commanding billions of lives, regarded everything born with intention, his aura imposing, "Ultimate Secret Art: Grand Puppet World!"
...
When the million-strong puppet army appeared out of nowhere, the mages from the divine plane were all dumbfounded.
Even as they were preparing to attack, they were so intimidated by the million-strong legion that they halted the magic power they had been gathering in their hands.
Even the Demi-God Constantine Reiloz watched with widened eyes, utterly incredulous.
In his life, he had seen countless powerful beings, having dabbled in professions of all sorts and seen all manner of strange and unusual methods.
But now, looking at this million-strong puppet army, it was unheard of and unseen before!
This old mage truly didn't know how to describe the complex emotions within his heart.
Puppet Masters existed in the magic system too, and Brady Robinson, the head of the Puppetry Academy at the Ascidon Imperial Royal Magic Academy, was one of the top Puppet Masters in the divine plane.
But even Brady, as a level nine Puppet Master capable of controlling hundreds of magic puppets, was already at his limit.
And previously, Constantine was surprised to learn from intelligence reports that there was a native alchemist of the alchemy plane who could control tens of thousands of puppets.
But now, this million-level... How had it been done?!
Tens of thousands could be attributed to exceptional talent, but a million? That level is outright beyond human comprehension, something only a deity could possibly achieve.
And it wasn't just the numbers.
Looking at those densely packed mechanical octopuses in the sky, the mages clearly struggled to comprehend what they were facing.
Biological?
Mechanical?
Mechanical beast?
Looking at the precise components, which should be inanimate, why did they feel the presence of the vibrancy of living flesh and soul?
Everything was beyond belief.
Yet the reality was right before their eyes.
These mages, they had witnessed a miracle.
A miracle of puppets, created by an alchemist!
...
On the other hand, aboard the Eternal Night.
A million-strong legion appeared out of thin air; such a massive commotion could be seen even by the blind.
The lookout on the watchtower saw the anomaly first and shouted, "Come and look over there! Good heavens, what is that?"
The blue mushroom cloud in the distant sky hadn't yet dissipated when suddenly, dense specks appeared in everyone's field of vision.
At first, they suspected the gods' mages of crafting some new battle formation, but once they looked through their telescopes, they realized those points, shimmering with a metallic luster, were actually puppets!
An endless sea of puppets!
This discovery was like cold water sizzling into a hot oil pan, igniting excitement among everyone on the deck.
"That's... puppets! The puppet legion of Mister Su Lun!"
"My god, am I seeing things? Surely, there must be a million puppets?"
"You're not seeing things! Hahaha, I finally understand why the war workshops were producing so many mechanical octopuses; they were all Mister Su Lun's puppets!"
"..."
The members of the Dawn Brigade who looked at the terrifying puppet legion were all shocked yet immensely thrilled.
Somehow, it seemed everyone had grown accustomed to "miracles" happening.
The familiar puppet theatre with crosses, the familiar stone gargoyles, the familiar threads...
It seemed like at every crucial moment of desperation, Su Lun would always step forward.
And every time he did, he was stronger than before!
The excitement from the enemy fleet's explosion was still in their blood, and when they saw the million-strong puppet legion, it was like a flame had been kindled in their hearts. Just looking at those four figures in the sky filled everyone with an ardent reverence!
The Old Sword God Bartolo said with a complex expression, "To control a million puppets, just the number alone means Su Lun no longer has any rivals in this realm..."
Number Nineteen smiled contentedly, "Indeed. When I think about it, I've known him for many years and each time, he brings new surprises."
Wazhwas sighed, "One man is worth a million in the enemy army. Without demi-god level strength to suppress him, numbers have lost all meaning to him."
Mr. Hei's face was touched with a kindly smile, "And that's not all... Su Lun is more than an ordinary Puppet Master. What makes him impressive isn't just controlling puppets. Everything he sees is within his puppetry. This is the art of the Puppeteer..."
Everyone: "..."
Abelc, being a disciple, clenched his fists in excitement, murmuring to himself, "Endless puppets, this is the way of my teacher's puppetry."
In that moment, he saw the light.
He saw the brilliance of a Puppeteer shining endlessly and dazzling from his mentor!
...
Not only were the people of the Dawn Brigade aboard the Eternal Night astonished.
The imperial soldiers from the joint fleet that had gathered around were also stunned.
They had intended to reinforce and help eradicate the enemy's million-strong magic legion.
But looking at the sudden appearance of a million blockades, they started to feel... perhaps they weren't needed after all?
It was just that one lord, Prince Fick, who had control of everything.
One man, capable of contending with an entire magic legion on his own.
On a communication ship that kept in real-time contact with the capital Lyndon, the intelligence officer had already lost words to describe the current situation.
All they could send was a brief message: "Prince Fick summons a million puppets, marshaling forces against the enemy."
The message was instantly relayed back to Lyndon.
In Frederick Palace, where Ekaterina was discussing the details of the final battle with her ministers, she received the urgent news first.
Upon seeing that line of text which not even the communicator could articulate, the worry in her eyes vanished, and she looked southeast through the stained-glass window with a pleasant smile, "As expected..."
Suddenly, the grand empire was abuzz with excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 649 - 648: 1 vs. Million
chapters.content:
In the sky, the moment Su Lun's million puppet legion appeared, they instantly seized the initiative in the battle.
Even though reinforcements from the United Fleet had not yet arrived, the four from Dawn stood midair without a hint of fear on their faces.
Now that the enemy's battle array was broken, the most dangerous moment had passed.
Next, it was time for a head-on major confrontation between legions.
Su Lun's puppet legion VS the magic legion.
Puppets do not care about death, and those gargoyle faces looking fierce as they stared down the mages of the divine realm seemed like devils from hell, cold and devoid of emotion, showing not a trace of fear.
On the other hand, although none of the mages spoke, facing the sea of puppets that filled their vision, they couldn't help but swallow hard.
Beings that surpass one's understanding always instinctively inspire awe.
And this million-puppet legion was such a being.
...
Across the way, the 'Archmage of Evil' Constantine Reiloz's gaze was somber, and he already knew that there was only one choice now: a fight to the death.
"Great Dark Overlord, hear my prayer, I summon the force of the dark elements..."
He was decisively swift as he raised his gleaming magic wand. In an instant, dark mists rolled in waves over tens of miles around him.
As he chanted the magic incantation, the dark elements rapidly converged into the nine-pointed star magic circle, quickly forming into countless jet-black arrows.
Constantine raised his hand and made a motion with his magic wand as if drawing a bow and firing an arrow.
In that moment, the entire sky seemed to lose its color and dimmed.
Su Lun watched coolly, easily recognizing this as a ninth-tier forbidden spell, the "Annihilation Divine Arrow of the Fallen Veras".
This spell could attack targets over a wide area, not only possessing great lethality but more importantly, it could cause sustained corrosive damage, capable of melting metals and eroding magic patterns. It was usually used in sieges to destroy enemy cities, magic patterns, siege engines, and other large targets.
Seeing the opponent respond in this way, Su Lun had to admit that Constantine was truly worthy of being a demigod.
The fellow's sharp combat instincts allowed him to see through one of the few weaknesses of the puppet legion at a glance.
While it is true that gargoyles forged from "Animating Silver" possess high magic immunity and are not affected by corrosion, at present, only a very small part of the million puppets are forged from high-purity Animating Silver. The rest contain many impurities, and should they be covered by this forbidden curse, they would be heavily corroded.
Once the structure is compromised, they are no better than scrap metal.
This is especially true for the hundreds of thousands of mechanical octopuses, whose precision components cannot withstand the corrosion of a ninth-tier forbidden curse.
This old man struck precisely at the weak point with his initial move.
It was a pity, though, that while puppets are lifeless objects, they were controlled by Su Lun's will.
The moment Constantine made his move, Su Lun had a thought, and the runes on the bodies of hundreds of thousands of puppets around him already lit up.
His eyes narrowed with determination, and he declared, "Alchemical Mystery: Element Steal!"
Although this was a commonly seen mastery-level alchemy formula, when used by a legion of hundreds of thousands, it had an unimaginable power.
It was within this flash, the clouds roiled in the sky, as if two controlling forces were tearing at each other.
But almost immediately, a victor emerged.
The dark elements that Constantine had gathered seemed to be extracted by an inexplicable force, pouring like a breached dam into the legion-sized Nonagram Alchemy Formation beneath the puppet legion's feet.
In the contest of elemental control, Su Lun's puppet legion triumphed!
...
Under normal circumstances, it is almost impossible for lower-ranked professions to steal elements from an opponent of a higher rank.
This is due to the gap in understanding the laws of magic caused by rank suppression; the control over elements is simply not on the same level.
Su Lun, being rank eight, was one and a half ranks below a demigod,
A normal rank eight professional's understanding of elements is like gravel, at rank nine it's like a rock layer, and a demigod's is like steel.
Under normal theories, such powerful forbidden magic should not be interruptible at all.
But now, Su Lun's understanding of the laws of all things is certainly not much less than that of Constantine.
Moreover, with the second revelation from the All-knowing Eye, he had already seen through all the secrets of the magic.
Furthermore, however powerful a demigod is, he is still just one person, how could he compete with an alchemy formation that channels the combined will of hundreds of thousands of puppets?
When many ants unite, they can consume an elephant.
With this move that undermined the foundation, once the ninth-tier forbidden spell "Annihilation Divine Arrow of the Fallen Veras" was about to be released, it was like a balloon losing air, and instantly the dark mist dissipated.
The anticipated storm of black arrows never came to be; the sky merely drizzled a light black rain that was hardly bothersome.
In the distance, the 'Archmage of Evil' Constantine saw this and his complexion changed dramatically.
The showdown between masters can be discerned with just one exchange of blows.
The might of this puppet army far exceeded his imagination!
What Constantine failed to realize was that Su Lun's move not only interrupted his spellcasting but also dominantly took control of most of the free elements within tens of miles around the puppet army's battle formation.
Even as a demigod, he found it very difficult to compete for the right to use elements within that puppet army, let alone other mages?
A mage who cannot control elements is like a bird with broken wings.
As such, any mages within this area would be able to gather only a very limited amount of external elements for their spells, effectively putting them at a significant disadvantage without even fighting.
Seeing this, Constantine felt an ominous hunch, and the corner of his eye twitched fiercely.
He never imagined that just four people could drive the million-strong elite forces of the Ascieden Empire into such a dire situation!
But no matter what he thought now was useless, there was only one option left: to fight to the bitter end.
The Ascieden Empire was a powerful magical nation with tens of thousands of years of history, and its depth was not to be underestimated!
Upon realizing this, Constantine decisively shouted, "Legion, focus fire, spare no expense, kill that Puppet Master first!"
It was this command that galvanized the nearby mages into action.
Earlier, due to the explosion of the gold flagship, the thousands of magic airships in the sky had fallen into brief chaos.
In that moment, they gradually rallied together again.
Even if the battle formation was broken and they were scattered, they had at least left behind eighty to ninety fully-formed ten-thousand-person mage battalions.
It wasn't just the terrifying number of people—each ten-thousand-man battalion also had its own large legion magic guide!
"The Prophet Farah's Agony," "Retrospective Magic Lantern," "Void Realm," "The Norn Sisters' Web of Entanglement," "Twilight Holy Sword"...
One by one, those magic airships lit up with various colored lights, emanating from the terrifying magic-powered artifacts.
These epic artifacts each possessed the power to destroy cities. Upon that "at all costs" command, dozens of magic guides simultaneously cast brilliant radiance towards Su Lun and his companions.
...
At this moment, the murderous intent of a million people came overwhelmingly, as if to suffocate the sky.
Su Lun and his companions felt like they were ants targeted by the collective fire of dozens of cannons. If they were hit, they feared that the space around them would collapse along with them.
Seeing this, Mr. Jing, who hadn't had time to catch his breath, once again split into nine, with each clone entering full defense mode.
Lei wiped the faint golden blood from the corner of his mouth as his Sword Qi accumulated once again.
Pandora's pupils were red like the moon, and her divine Moon Reading technique was already being deployed again.
They all knew that if they could withstand this wave, the balance of victory would be completely shifted!
Only Su Lun appeared calm as he undid the "God Profaner" attire and entered a state of absolute rationality for contemplation.
He had already deduced all the possible outcomes in his mind, with no surprise in his eyes, and whispered in a barely perceptible voice, "In my Puppet Theater, the script must be followed... This performance, I call 'The Slaughterhouse'."
As thoughts vanished in a flash, Su Lun the Magician focused his intent.
Following the Element Steal, the cross in the sky swelled once again, quickly covering the entire space above the magic airships. Numerous invisible threads had already silently punctured into the magic airships.
Like previously taking control of the command center, these void-penetrating threads easily pierced through the defenses of those magic airships. Unnoticed by the mages, the threads penetrated their bodies.
The mages on those magic airships were now like insects caught in a spider's web, soon to be completely entangled with no chance of escape.
A few surviving ninth-tier mages had witnessed the terror of this technique, which had wiped out the command center in a moment previously.
Their faces paled as they shouted at the legion, "Trouble! Scatter quickly!"
Unfortunately, it was too late.
With the power of the "Urobolos Space-Time Ring," the threads could ignore distance and puncture any position. In an instant, Su Lun had taken control of the mages operating the legion's magic guides on nearly a dozen warships nearby.
The magic guides, which had just gathered strength and were originally aimed at Su Lun and his companions, suddenly turned, firing upon their "comrades" instead.
And Su Lun's control alone was more precise.
For a moment, dozens of spell-level magic explosions sounded in the sky, like glorious fireworks, a kaleidoscope of colors.
Boom...
Boom...
Boom...
One by one, the magic airships were hit and burst into flames.
In that instant, another dozen or so airships fell from the sky.
Su Lun barely made any grand gestures; a mere flick of his fingers had destroyed over a dozen ten-thousand-man mage battalions.
And this was just the beginning.
In the sky, countless void mechanical octopuses clattered with a sound of metal friction as they surged toward the thousands of magic airships. With void runes enhancing them, they moved as flexibly as if they were in water, with hundreds of thousands of mechanical octopuses swimming through the air, like a swarm of locusts.
Originally designed as a superweapon for breaking ships, the mechanical octopuses had arms fitted with runes and mechanical devices for both magic and physical destruction, such as "Magic Draining," "Armor Piercing," and "Penetrating."
Even though those magic airships had protective shields, whether at the energy level or the physical level of defense, they would be devoured cleanly in minutes in front of the tens of thousands of mechanical octopuses.
One after another, the magic airships were breached; the mages aboard either died tragically or fell from the sky like rain.
The mages organized a counterattack, and various spells exploded in the sky. Mechanical octopuses were also damaged and fell into the sea amidst a clattering noise.
Su Lun was not the least bit anxious.
Let them kill.
Fighting on, the mages finally realized in despair that the number of puppets didn't seem to decrease at all.
No matter how many were destroyed, an equal number of new ones would be replenished.
By now, the war production line in the little void realm had matured. As long as the materials were sufficient, mechanical octopuses could be continuously produced.
Over the years, the warehouse had already accumulated mountains of batches of mechanical octopuses, which were now conveniently used up in this battle to deplete outdated technology stocks.
Even if it was a one-for-one exchange, millions of mechanical octopuses for millions of mages, Su Lun wouldn't feel the slightest bit heartbroken.
They would just clean up the battlefield after the war.
Fighting against a puppet army that did not fear death became increasingly futile as the battle dragged on.
More and more magic airships were destroyed. Soldiers were constantly on guard against their comrades, who might be controlled at any moment... yet they were completely unable to do anything against their opponents.
Gradually, a sense of pessimism grew heavier in the hearts of the mages from the divine realm.
Once morale began to wane, defeat was just an inevitable outcome waiting to happen.
...
"Boom!"
Another forbidden-level spell struck in the direction of Su Lun and the three others.
However, it caused no damage whatsoever.
The energy shield formed by those hundreds of thousands of Puppet Battle Arrays intercepted this eighth forbidden spell.
It wasn't just the ordinary mages who were in despair. Constantine and several top-tier mages watched the scene unfold, their faces turning ashen.
They were already among a small handful of people with the broadest knowledge in the divine realm.
But today, they had truly been schooled in these puppet tactics.
This was a scene they had never witnessed before.
They had thought that the million-strong magic army would march straight to the capital of the Alchemical Empire and that there might be an intense, large-scale battle resulting in millions of casualties. Ultimately, they would destroy this alchemical civilization...
However, they never imagined that an elite army of a million would be stopped here by a Puppet Master.
By,
One person!
Pushed to,
Such a desperate situation.
How could one person hold off a million-strong army? The thought of such combat power was baffling.
If they hadn't experienced it firsthand, no one would dare to imagine it.
They also wanted to break the situation, but they had no way to do so.
The puppet army consisted not only of mechanical octopuses but also hundreds of thousands of gargoyles and other attack puppets, which were the real threat to top-tier mages!
It was Constantine who had just tried all sorts of methods to kill Su Lun and the three with him to break the situation.
But after trying, he realized it was simply impossible.
Whatever type of spell or even forbidden curses were deflected by the Puppet Battle Array.
An equal number of puppet troops were not the least bit weaker than a mage army in combat power. The defensive shield formed by the hundreds of thousands of gargoyles, even a demigod like him was completely unable to do anything about it.
Moreover, there was the one with the mirror ability, the Sword God, the Pseudo-god... all extremely troublesome adversaries.
Even if he wanted to make a desperate attempt, they did not give him any chance at all.
Having not killed them in the command room before, now it was even more impossible.
The more they fought, the more Constantine recognized the strength of his opponents, and the deeper he fell into despair.
How meticulous must one's mind be to control a million puppets?
He also found that the Puppet Master possessed a near-numbing thinking ability; those eyes seemed to see through everything on the battlefield, never revealing any flaw.
This was no longer a battle that could be won through mere tactical cunning.
Constantine knew he couldn't break through the Puppet Battle Array, and now his million-strong magic army was being devoured by hundreds of thousands of mechanical puppets.
The longer the battle dragged on, the worse it would get.
And in the distant seascape and skies, countless steam-belching steel warships and airships were closing in.
Suddenly, Constantine realized that the situation was irretrievable.
As a Demigod, even in such a desperate situation, he still had a chance to escape.
But once he fled, the million-man army would surely perish here.
Living after losing the army would be particularly disgraceful.
Although he did not want to admit it.
He had to accept the reality.
The Empire's campaign had utterly failed.
Suddenly, Constantine's cloudy eyes revealed a hint of determination. The next second, his body's magic power flared up like raging flames, and he bellowed to his subordinates, "Find a chance to break through, save as many as you can!"
...
In the sky, the countless black crows split from Old Mr. Crow were cawing chaotically, providing Su Lun with an endless vista.
Everything his eyes could see was now an actor in the puppet theater.
The "All-knowing Eye" allowed Su Lun to handle everything in his field of vision with poise, and he was controlling more and more Mages.
Every moment, a large number of people were dying, and the battle was becoming more and more ferocious.
But actually, from the moment they had broken through the giant bird battle formation, this outcome had been sealed.
If they continued to wear each other down like this, Su Lun might lose several hundred thousand puppets, but those Mages from the divine realms were sure to be decimated.
However, it was at this moment, upon hearing that old Magic God's explosive shout, that Su Lun's numb face finally showed a trace of surprise, "Magic power burning?"
Mr. Jing, standing beside him, and the others slightly frowned as well.
They all knew that this Demigod was prepared to fight to the death.
But this was also an expected situation.
The stronger one is, the prouder they tend to be.
In the current situation, the Ascieden Empire's royal princess had already died in battle, and the million-strong army was about to perish here; Constantine, the fleet's vice admiral, certainly had no face to flee and live life in disgrace.
A fight to the death was the only option.
Su Lun and the others found this suitable.
In this battle, others could flee, but this Demigod must not leave alive!
...
It was the moment that old Mage roared, his aura suddenly surged several times higher, and with a raise of his hand, a ninth-level spell hurtled towards Su Lun and his party.
Its might was so great that even the Puppet Battle Array trembled, shattering hundreds of stone gargoyles.
A Demigod's desperate last stand was not to be underestimated.
Su Lun and his party did not dare to be distracted and defended with all their might.
They could see what Constantine was planning; he knew he was beaten and wanted to hold them there, to create a chance for others to break through.
Su Lun and his companions didn't engage directly, as Mr. Jing and others needed time to recover from their injuries. So it was fine to continue this deadlock.
As for the Mages trying to break through, that was left to the allied fleet.
Both sides engaged in a fierce battle at sea that lasted a good half of the day before finally coming to an end.
The "Archmage of Evil," Constantine Reiloz, perished in battle, and the divine realm's million-man army was nearly annihilated, with only a very few managing to escape.
Although the allied imperial fleet also paid a significant price, in comparison, this was already a resounding victory.
The news reached the imperial capital Lyndon, and the nation was in an uproar.
Everyone had been preparing for the decisive battle on land but had not expected the conflict to be turned around in such an unexpected way.
The photo of the Twilight Holy Sword group members in their Gold-Patterned Cloaks appeared once again in the major headlines of the newspapers.
The front-page title of the "Lyndon Daily News" was: The Legendary Battle, Puppet Emperor, 1VS Million!

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - 649: The Contract of Those Years
chapters.content:
Upon the azure sea, the Eternal Night was sailing at a steady pace, unhurried.
A few days prior, the battle at the Imperial Strait had come to a definitive close, with nearly the entire million-strong Legion of Mages from the celestial plane annihilated. After clearing the battlefield, the Dawn Brigade set sail toward the God Burial Ground within the Silent Forest to the north.
Inside the captain's quarters.
Sunlight streamed through the windows, brightening the cabin.
The breeze also carried the fresh scent of the ocean.
The room was a picture of tranquility.
"Teacher, the newspaper has arrived,"
Lolota knocked on the door and entered, bringing with her the "Lyndon Daily News" that was printed a few days earlier.
Chian Tiao, covered in bandages, took the newspaper and started to flip through it leisurely while sprawled on the sofa.
Many of them had sustained various degrees of injuries in the battle that erupted several days earlier, especially her. Having charged most fiercely, she had taken the worst beating and nearly lost half her life.
This would require a long period of recuperation.
Therefore, the Eternal Night wasn't in a rush to make its way, instead sailing leisurely.
While healing, neither strenuous exercise nor sword practice was advisable, leaving Chian Tiao listless with boredom. Initially wanting to read the newspaper to pass the time, her expression suddenly brightened with surprise upon seeing the headline on the front page.
She winked at Su Lun, who was flipping through alchemical tomes at a desk off in the distance, and teased, "Yo... Su Lun, you should see this, the paper has granted you the title of 'Puppet Emperor,' sounds rather nice, eh."
Su Lun heard this, glanced sideways with a wry smile, "Hehe, the reporter's description is a bit exaggerated..."
The "God Profaner" had provided him with immense cerebral enhancement. With just a glance, he instantly etched all the contents of the newspaper into his mind.
Wars needed heroes, and so, they of the Dawn appeared on the newspaper once again.
A considerable part of the paper detailed the battle from a few days ago, with many exaggerations in the wording.
Himself receiving the most attention, with the most outrageous descriptions.
Controlling a million puppets was akin to controlling an entire nation's emperor, so the paper coined the title "Puppet Emperor". Normally, the term 'emperor' could not be used lightly, and the "Lyndon Daily News," being the official paper, certainly would not make such a basic error. It was all because Su Lun's other identity was as the legitimate wife of Empress Ekaterina, the current Prince Fick, that the title of "Puppet Emperor" did not breach any taboos.
But it was precisely because of this that Su Lun felt something was off.
Hearing this, Mr. Jing, who was taking notes at Su Lun's side, also looked up with a fleeting smirk, responding with a laugh, "Indeed, it fits quite well."
As she gazed at the photo in the newspaper, the scenes played vividly in her mind.
Even as someone who had experienced it firsthand, she still found it somewhat unbelievable.
To say that Su Lun had turned the tide almost single-handedly during that battle several days ago wasn't an exaggeration, as even the presence of a few demigods wouldn't necessarily have been enough to break through the giant bird formation of the million-strong Legion.
Afterward, it was he alone who stood against the million Mage Legion.
This glorious battle indeed deserved such a grand portrayal in the newspaper.
...
Su Lun was well aware of the slight teasing in his senior sister's praise and chuckled, shaking his head, not wanting to dwell on the topic.
He set down the "Sage's Proclamations" golden scroll he was pondering and instead said, "Senior sister, once the 'God Profaner' implant is fully assimilated, I plan to advance to the ninth rank."
The materials required for the promotion to the ninth rank, the cosmic essence, and legal understanding, he had them all ready, and there was practically no risk of advancement.
Su Lun had previously drunk from the Mimir's Well and received the second resolution of the All-knowing Eye. There were no secrets in the world unseen to him, but his brain could not bear the burden of those higher-level insights that far exceeded his cognition. Now, the brain of the Void Bidirectional Worm, refined into the "God Profaner," acted like a supercomputer, enabling him to process and digest those higher-tier insights.
This had been Sir Isaac's original intention when designing this type of implant, to use alchemical enhancements to grant mortals the cognitive abilities only gods possessed.
