But at this critical moment, a figure flashed in front of Jay, stretching out a finger and pressing it on a vital point.
A bizarre scene ensued.
Jay, who was still swollen as if ready to explode, suddenly had all the fighting spirit gushing out of him as if a dam had burst.
The self-destruction was halted!
Even Jay, the person involved, was shocked: How did he do that?
...
Su Lun's piercing gaze, his All-knowing Eye already saw the flow of qi channels throughout Jay's body, who was in a self-destruct state.
After quick mental analysis of the pressure release points, he found the spot and that solved the problem.
Even if he had guessed wrong, it wasn't a big deal.
Su Lun estimated the destructive power of the explosion, and the chances were he wouldn't die.
This time, Su Lun did not give him a chance.
Compared to interrogating a living person, he preferred to search the soul.
That one fingertip directly touched Jay's life force, causing the fighting spirit to spill out, and a "grey mist" also emerged.
However, at that moment, with no fighting spirit to control it, "Void Poison Flame" immediately backlashed, burning the body to nothing.
An energy as terrifying as a nuclear blast spread wildly.
Su Lun was unafraid of the terrifying spatial fluctuations, reaching out his hand toward it.
A grey flame reflected in his eyes as he murmured to himself, "A strange fire... what a treasure."

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - 657: This Guy Is Also A F***ing Puppet Master?
chapters.content:
The "Void Poison Flame," ranked second in the Dou Qi Continent, is absolutely a treasure that melee vocational practitioners dream of obtaining.
For Su Lun at the moment, it's not that useful. Because he has a higher-level space artifact, the "Urobolos Space-Time Ring," which overlaps in effect with the former somewhat.
But it's excellent for gifting to others.
No matter who it's given to, as long as their body can bear it, a top expert can be created instantly.
For instance, giving it to Qian Tiao.
The Swordsman vocational practitioners also cultivate the strong offensive and fierce Qi style, and the vast Spiritual Power is also perfect for nurturing different fires.
Moreover, Qian Tiao herself has a high comprehension of the Space Law, and a high affinity for the void, making her compatibility with this "Void Poison Flame" very perfect.
By then, with the void burning ability to enhance her Thunder Sword Deity, her Sword Qi would carry spatial law's power of armor-piercing effects, and Su Lun found it hard to imagine who under the gods could block her strike.
The thought flashed through his mind and vanished. Su Lun, no longer fearing the burn, pinched the little grey flame in his palm.
At the same time, he also reaped Jie Clementon's soul and digested it in an instant.
"You have stripped 'Jie·Clementon's' soul"
"You have gained a lot of 'Fire Law' and 'Space Law' insights of the ninth order"
"You have gained insights into the cultivation of Dou Qi, mastering celestial level martial skills 'Imperial Qi,' 'Overbearing Qi,' 'Dou Qi Forming Shape'... and other secret techniques."
"You have learned a great deal about the integration of different fires"
"You have come to know some secrets of the Dou Qi Continent, the cultivation system, the rune system, the martial arts system"
"Spiritual Power +12554"
"..."
Although Jie was still of the same order, this reaping was of great benefit to Su Lun.
The various secrets of the Dou Qi Continent were quite eye-opening for Su Lun.
In terms of "Qi" control, this civilization had researched it to the utmost.
Although the cultivation systems are different, "Qi" in the realm of Alchemy is actually the control and application of Spiritual Power, and there are many intersections.
Having stripped away those techniques, Su Lun estimated that his combat power could at least increase by ten percent.
And this Jie was among the handful of prodigies standing at the pinnacle of the Dou Qi Continent. His broad knowledge also filled in many new things for Su Lun, particularly regarding the creation of "Worlds," where he gained some new insights.
However, Su Lun stripped his soul for another purpose, to find out why he betrayed the team.
But after searching, he found no indicative information left at the memory level.
Because no information was left, Su Lun realized something in an instant, thinking, "So he was under a spiritual charm. It seems that it really was the handiwork of Pharaoh Cleopatra IX."
This situation was a very sophisticated spiritual charm, causing Jie himself to overlook how he was charmed in his subconscious.
Thinking further, Su Lun felt all the pieces were connecting.
Previously, only three people approached the Pharaoh's corpse.
The barbarian Ralph in his berserk state was immune to all forms of spiritual control; moreover, the Dragon Maiden Masia, being half-dragon, had very high immunity to all types.
So, the one who was charmed had to be Jie, the normal human.
Most importantly, he had obtained the "Key of Eternal Life."
....
At that moment, the different fire incinerated the body fully, and a "☥" shaped golden object fell out.
This was a gold cross-shaped ornament with a ring, said to be a divine heirloom given to the Pharaohs guarding the tombs by the gods. In the legacy of the Tares civilization, it symbolized life and was said to hold the secret of eternal life.
Su Lun naturally noticed it first.
But out of caution, he did not rush to touch it.
With his All-knowing Eye, he tried to see through the divine secrets hidden in the Key.
Having reaped a vast amount of Tares godly memories, Su Lun knew that the symbol on this Key was an actual god-level rune called "Ankh," representing life and resurrection.
Before, it was all hearsay because only the Pharaohs were qualified to touch this treasure.
Now seeing the real thing, Su Lun too was greatly interested.
Yet, to his gaze, it was a stretch of the unknown "***" data.
The high-ranking deities of Tares had manifested that high-ranking rule as a rune, solidified in this Key.
Those existences he still couldn't understand were the secrets of the divine.
But although he did not understand the rune, the function was identified. The Key had a function only the Pharaohs knew—resurrection.
...
"Hehe... So not reaping the Pharaoh's soul really meant he wasn't dead."
Having identified the Key's effect, Su Lun had an epiphany.
Meanwhile, the nearby centaur Makamul, the barbarian Ralph, and the Dragon Maiden Masia also saw the Key that had fallen to the ground, their expressions slightly tense.
It was the most important thing for them to dissolve their demon god contract, and it concerned their very lives, so they naturally could not afford any mishap.
They all wanted to grab it in their hands.
But seeing Su Lun, who had not moved from the spot, the three of them also tacitly did not act.
The sight of "Nicholas" killing battle saint Jie in two moves was still fresh in their minds, and at this moment, the three of them were very wary of this legendary alchemist.
They realized that him not grabbing it immediately must mean there was an issue.
Sure enough!
Just then, the "Key of Eternal Life" suddenly burst into a dazzling divine light.
Although it seemed Su Lun was running through various scenarios in his head just now, in reality, it was all just a moment as the corpse was being incinerated.
The moment the god rune fell to the ground, it showed an anomaly. Meanwhile, as another event occurred, Su Lun glanced at the storage ring on his finger and quickly retreated.
In that instant, a faint "crack" like the shattering of glass was heard next to his ear, and the storage ring actually split open, scattering items all over the ground, and a corpse fell out.
It was, unexpectedly, the corpse of Pharaoh Cleopatra IX, which he'd put away earlier!
The divine light emanating from the Key seemed to connect with the blood within the corpse. As the white light representing life poured into the Pharaoh's body, a miracle occurred.
The corpse, which had had no color of blood a moment ago, turned into a vibrant and alive queen.
Cleopatra IX, dressed in a deep-V gold wire long gown with her chest mostly exposed to the air, slender waist and perky buttocks, her bronze skin didn't detract from her allure but added an exotic and ultimate enchantment.
Not only was her appearance breathtakingly beautiful, but those blue, gem-like pupils also emitted a seductive luster that seemed to captivate the soul.
Seeing this, the expressions of Ralph and his two companions changed dramatically. They realized then that the assassination attempt had not completely killed the Pharaoh!
The action taken by the saint Jie earlier was also because he had been affected.
All three simultaneously entered combat mode.
On the other side, Su Lun, who had been violently ejected, showed an expression of "surprise" that one would expect, but in reality, his heart was utterly calm, and in his eyes, he had clearly seen the entire resurrection process: "A treasure indeed..."
Now, there weren't many objects that could evoke envy in Su Lun, but at this moment, having witnessed a corpse resurrect, his gaze towards the "Immortality Key" was burning with desire.
...
Pharaoh Cleopatra IX floated in the middle of the tomb, looking down at Su Lun and his three companions with a naturally enchanting divine light in her eyes.
Su Lun had already known that this woman was skilled in the Bewitching Technique and didn't pay it any mind. After all, not to mention his own exceptional spiritual power, with the "God Profaner" at his side, he was immune to any illusion techniques.
Meanwhile, Ralph, in his berserk state, was already seeing red and radiating tremendous killing intent. A barbarian in a rage had no other thoughts but combat, making them immune to all forms of mind control, a natural ability of theirs.
As for the other two, half-centaur Makamul and Dragon Maiden Masia, neither were normal human beings.
A monkey, no matter how beautiful, cannot attract the gaze of humans.
Even though the temptation of a demigod is on a spiritual level, with the species barrier, the effect is invariably significantly reduced.
The Bewitching Technique deployed by Pharaoh Cleopatra IX failed to control the four of them.
However, they acted without hesitation at the first opportunity!
If they hadn't killed her before, they would kill her again!
Whatever secret technique enabled the resurrection, it surely came at a cost.
All four were top experts, and their grasp of battle opportunities was extremely keen.
At the very moment of the corpse's resurrection, half-centaur Makamul released an arrow with a "whoosh," and although it did not possess the same might as the previous god-killing arrow, this arrow, wrapped in the ultimate rule of destruction, pierced Pharaoh Cleopatra IX's abdomen like lightning, creating a fist-sized hole.
The rule of destruction countered all defenses, and at this distance, even a demigod would not fare well!
Half-centaur Makamul looked at his arrow hitting the mark, and before he had time to feel pleased, as a divine archer, he instinctively sensed something was amiss.
Ralph's attack followed closely behind.
He was the closest to demigod status among the five recruits and his combat power in his berserk state was not the least bit inferior to a demigod's.
As the arrow was fired, Ralph's axe, surrounded by a fiery aura of killing intent, chopped down and cleaved the Pharaoh's body in two.
Seizing the moment, Dragon Maiden Masia unleashed a blast of dragon fire, turning half of the corpse, including the head, into ashes.
Su Lun did not make a move, but the other three had already completed the kill.
The five recruited by the Demon God each had the strength to stand toe-to-toe with a demigod.
Together, what chance did a single demigod stand?
Moreover, as Pharaoh Cleopatra IX's strongest charm had no effect on them, and her physical body was relatively weak, they managed to kill her once more with their combined assault.
But the faces of the four showed not a trace of relief.
After all, the Pharaoh had already performed a death and resurrection once.
However, the next second, the scene they did not wish to see, yet somewhat anticipated, occurred.
The group watched as Cleopatra IX's corpse held the "Key of Eternal Life" which radiated a brilliant light, and once again drew it into her wound, miraculously mending itself!
In the divine glow, the queen's body instantly reformed, and she looked at the four people again with a mocking expression, as if to scoff at them.
Ralph and the other two sharply narrowed their eyes in shock, thinking to themselves, "Infinite revival?"
Meanwhile, Su Lun, with narrowed eyes, saw something different through the All-knowing Eye.
He had encountered more than one person capable of revival, such as the once legendary Undead Demon Monk Rasputin among the top ten bounty hunters of Ruying.
It was impossible to kill such a being by strength alone.
To counter this ability, the source had to be restrained at the level of divine power and faith.
But it wasn't just him who knew this method; Ralph and the other two had, to varying degrees, also encountered similar enemies.
Yet how easy was it to contain?
Here, in the ancestral tomb of Tares civilization, the divine power was endless; how could she be killed?
Seeing this, Su Lun's face flashed with severity, and he charged forward, scythe in hand.
Through his actions, he sent a clear message to the other three teammates: keep killing!
Although Su Lun was somewhat confident, intuition told him that the dangers of this tomb were not limited to just the Pharaoh.
Moreover, he wanted to thoroughly understand the nature of the "Ankh Amulet's" revival.
Only by continuing to kill could there be a chance to gather more clues.
...
The centaur Makamul, the barbarian Ralph, and the Dragon Maiden Masia watched as Su Lun rushed forward; they knew that at this point, they had no choice but to kill first and ask questions later.
The three burly men and one dragon charged at the fragile Cleopatra IX with a flurry of attacks.
Despite her repeated evasions, she could not avoid being killed a second time.
But the light temporarily emitted from the Ankh amulet brought her back to life again.
Eerie laughter that made one's scalp tingle echoed in the tomb: "Giggle giggle giggle..."
At that moment, it seemed the queen was ready to get serious.
Upon her revival, she no longer appeared in human form; her head had transformed into that of a majestic Sphinx cat!
Su Lun's eyes narrowed, for in the memories he had reaped, no one had seen her in this form.
And yet, this feline visage was not uncommon in the murals—it represented the "divine servants" often accompanying deities!
The Sphinx-like Cleopatra IX looked at Su Lun and the others, smiling easily, "Your tactics are indeed surprising... far stronger than those who came three hundred years ago."
Hearing these words, Madame Ralph and the others' faces shifted in unison.
It was as if they saw a massive net of fate descending upon them, and they might be destined to follow in the "footsteps" of those "predecessors."
Only Su Lun remained expressionless, gazing at the feline Pharaoh with a calm like the still waters beneath his eyes.
Just as the four were about to make another move, Cleopatra IX seemed to lose interest in tangling with them and started chanting an ancient curse: "￥&%#&%*&..."
The curse echoed as if reverberating through the vast emptiness of the tomb.
If anyone could understand these ancient hieroglyphic incantations that only pharaohs could master, they would undoubtedly translate them as a spell to summon the dead back to life.
Su Lun listened to the spell and glanced up again at the symbols on the surrounding stone carvings, pinpointing a passage of text and thought, "The summoning spell for the undead from the 'Book of the Dead'? So that's how that segment of the spell is supposed to be used."
The things he had seen, he now had no chance of forgetting.
His brain had been continuously deducing their usage since he glanced at the mysterious symbols on the tomb reliefs.
If it had been anyone else, they might not have caught even a glimpse of a clue, after all, these were secret spells of the Tares deity lineage, taught only to the Pharaohs.
But Su Lun discovered that the 'Book of the Dead' from the Tares civilization seemed to have an inexplicable connection with the "Maxims of the Sages" gold scroll in his hand. By interpreting them together, much of the content became understandable.
However, before he could think further, the moment the spell was cast, the grand tomb suddenly became lively.
"Clang," "Clang," "Clang"...
One by one, the coffins opened, and countless mummies stood up.
There were also the slaves, guards, and skeletal warhorses buried in the sand...various mummies were also struggling to stand up from blocks of dirt and piles of sand.
Looking around, an enormous army of mummies had been "revived"!
...
The three barbarians, including Ralph, looked on in stunned silence.
Whereas Su Lun murmured in his heart, "No souls, only husks...it's just necromancy."
He had thought that the enchanting queen had really resurrected everyone, but it turned out to be only the bodies that were revived.
This was similar to undead magic from the divine planes.
The only difference was that these mummy legions had their own special abilities.
After all, those buried in the tomb were all Tares people of the seventh order or above, plus countless demigods!
Although their combat strength plummeted having turned into mummies, their sheer numbers were overwhelming.
Once the mummies were awakened, they formed ranks and charged toward Su Lun and his group. As the legion charged, the sand surged, and their momentum was even several times stronger than those guards outside!
The three from Makamul grew grim-faced as the tomb door had been completely sealed; in other words, they were to fight these mummies to the death.
Seeing this, the barbarian Ralph roared, "Let's join forces and break through, first find a way to get the 'Key of Immortality' in our hands!"
With that, he fiercely slammed his giant axe into the ground, and immediately beneath his feet, a super-sized frenzied rune formed—this was the barbarian's "Domain of Slaughter."
Both Makamul and Masia responded in unison, "Agreed!"
One released a sky-filling rain of arrows with their bow, the other transformed into a huge dragon and charged into the crowd of mummy statues.
Although Su Lun did not speak, he too rushed forward with his black scythe.
After all, the four were peak combatants of lower planes. Although the mummy legion composed of ten thousand was formidable, they were decimated by the charge of the four, and those dry corpses crumbled into piles of skeletons.
The number of mummies was overwhelming, and chaos ensued as massive assaults shattered hordes of skeletons at each strike.
But as they fought, the four also recognized a problem.
They were combatants at the peak of the ninth order!
A full force blow, and only a few dozen mummies shattered?
By estimate, at least several hundred thousand had been awakened, and even if they fought to exhaustion, there was no end in sight.
Moreover, among them were some ultra-strong mummies with combat power comparable to the eighth and ninth orders.
The other three grew increasingly alarmed as they fought, but Su Lun watched with delight in his heart, "What excellent material for puppets..."
In this battle, he had also witnessed the divine Taris' technique for creating mummies; it wasn't as simple as just reviving corpses with necromancy.
Secret techniques and endless years had endowed these mummies with some miraculous utilities.
Each of these mummies, upon appraisal, came out to be of [silver], [gold], or even [legendary] quality as body material.
In other places, it would be difficult to find even one.
But here, there were countless!
For Su Lun the Puppeteer, creating an army of mummies couldn't be any better.
However, what made these mummies difficult was not just their individual quality; their battle formation was not so simple either.
And it was after this undead army formed its battle formation that an even more despairing scene unfolded.
The cat-people Pharaoh then chanted another spell, and a grey halo formed around each of the mummies.
As soon as this grey light appeared, the hundreds of thousands of mummies joined together, forming a super "field" that covered the entire tomb—the Pharaoh's Curse!
How terrifying was the field formed by several hundred thousand mummies?
One could see with the naked eye that the already sparse water elements in the air were drained in an instant, and Su Lun keenly felt as if all the moisture in his body was being sucked away.
Ralph and the others also changed color drastically.
The all-encompassing field meant that if they continued to waste away like this, they would eventually be drained into mummies.
However, that was not all!
With the All-knowing Eye, Su Lun saw white smoke rising from the heads of the four, himself included.
One look at the attribute panel and sure enough, their lifespans were passing by at more than ten times their usual speed!
The deeper one charged into the monster-dense area, the faster the lifespan flowed; entering the legion of ten thousand, lifespans dwindled thousands of times faster!
It was as if they were cursed, one second was equivalent to an hour of lifespan being consumed, a day, or even several days!
This was a terrifying flow rate that neither his domineering presence nor his own field could reduce by much.
Even though the four were all ninth order, they wouldn't last with their lifespans if the fight continued!
Within a few breaths, Ralph and the others also realized the problem of accelerated lifespan depletion. Yet they were still unable to kill that female Pharaoh, and continuing like this would undoubtedly lead to their deaths.
All of a sudden, their situation had fallen into dire straits!
...
Seeing this "Pharaoh's Curse," the other three felt a hair-raising desperation, but Su Lun saw it as if he had discovered a treasure, exclaiming in surprise, "What a powerful move..."
He had thought mummies were only strong in combat, but he hadn't expected that forming into battalions would have such a delightful surprise.
A field that strips away water elements and accelerates the decline of lifespan?
If there were a million mummies, even a demigod would be drained dry and dead within minutes upon entering.
Although Su Lun's own situation was precarious, he had already considered these mummies to be his puppets.
He was all too familiar with curses...
In Su Lun's possession was a sealed item, [Oz's Corpse Wrapping of the Ice Person]; its curse characteristic was the continuous decline of lifespan, the same as the field of these mummies!
"The inspiration for the alchemist who concocted the mummy wrappings must have come 80% from these Taresian mummies..."
Su Lun also felt it was quite a coincidence.
He had carefully studied the curse on that sealed item before, and although he couldn't completely resist it, he could counter most of it with the death laws.
That is to say, this [Pharaoh's Curse] was not particularly lethal to him.
However, if he were to keep tarrying in the tomb, it would eventually lead to a dead end.
....
Just then, Su Lun suddenly stopped.
He didn't continue to charge into battle with Ralph and the other two but instead rapidly formed sorcerer's seals with his hands.
Originally, he felt there was no immediate danger and wanted to observe a bit more.
Now, it seems he had to solve the problem first.
The moment he stopped, the barbarian Ralph also glanced over from the chaotic battle. Although they were teammates, they never stopped being on guard against each other.
However, seeing the sorcerer's seals shifting in Su Lun's hands, all three focused their gaze in unison for a moment.
It was their first time seeing "Nicholas" perform a spell that required seals.
In the ancient legends of their civilization, that cancer-like alchemy civilization had some magical alchemy that was said to be based on equivalent exchange.
And such magical magicians needed special seals to perform.
Seeing this, the three knew "Nicholas" was about to make a big move.
But they were also curious about what kind of methods this mysteriously powerful alchemist would use.
A shockwave?
An explosion?
Magic?
Wait...
The three of them had already brainstormed various scenarios in their minds in an instant.
Wondering if it was some kind of divine art that could clear out a large number of mummies in one go?
Yet, what they never expected happened.
...
In that moment of focus, Su Lun's spell was complete, and he softly commanded in his heart, "Ultimate Secret Art: Grand Puppet World!"
Instantly, a Nonagram Alchemy Formation lit up under his feet.
Then, as if mirrored, a complex and much larger Nonagram Alchemy Formation appeared in the sky.
The alchemy formation flashed with brilliance, and a gigantic crucifix emerged out of it.
It's not a large-scale destructive spell?
What situation is this?
This scene confused not only Ralph and the other two but even the demigod Cleopatra IX was puzzled.
Faced with at least hundreds of thousands of mummies, what was the significance of the appearance of this crucifix?
But as the crucifix expanded, rapidly covering a vast area nearby, countless transparent threads also descended.
All of the few living beings present were top-notch experts—how could they not notice this?
These threads... they seemed to be associated with a certain profession?
Puppet Masters existed in any realm, always in different forms.
And these threads were almost always a staple for Puppet Masters.
The centaur Makamul twitched the corner of his eye for some reason: This guy... is he a Puppet Master?
You say you're a "Death Magician," and we believed you.
Your physical strength is peerless, your understanding of laws is peerless, your close-combat abilities are peerless... and so on, we also believed you.
But damn it, now you're saying you're a Puppet Master?
Aren't Puppet Masters supposed to be weak in physique?
What's going on here!
For a moment, the established impressions of professions collapsed, as if... this guy had an even deeper hidden profession?
Meanwhile, the barbarian Ralph and the Dragon Maiden Masia were filled with confusion as they watched.
They had their guesses, but found it hard to believe that this "Nicholas" was a Puppet Master.
Moreover, even if he was a Puppet Master, so what?
These were hundreds of thousands of mummies, right?
Could he summon hundreds of thousands of puppets and then kill all these mummies?
But what then?
There were still more unopened coffins in the tomb, and those could be revived by spells at any time!
Su Lun indeed didn't plan to summon any puppets for a counter-attack; as the threads descended, he called out indifferently in his heart, "In my theater, I am the sole sovereign!"
With a clap of his sorcerer's seals, it was like hitting the pause button for the world with a "snap."
Then, a miraculous scene unfolded!
In the vast tomb, the couple of hundred thousand mummies were as though struck by Paralysis Magic, standing still in unison.
And that terrifying [Pharaoh's Curse] domain vanished in an instant as well.
Watching the bizarre turn of events, Ralph and the other two, despite being seasoned and stoic, were astounded and speechless for a moment.
This... Is this guy really a Puppet Master?
Although, well, those legendary alchemists were Puppet Masters... you could understand that.
But how did he do it?
This was an army of hundreds of thousands of mummies!
And there, in the sky, the mocking smile that had constantly adorned the face of Pharaoh Cleopatra IX turned rigid. Reflected in her gem-like eyes were the hundreds of thousands of immobilized mummies, with only three words on her mind: Impossible!

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - 658: Calculated Every Step from the Beginning
chapters.content:
Su Lun had also conducted deep research into necromancy.
He understood clearly that necromancers controlled the undead by using incantations to trigger specific waves of magic power to achieve control.
The principle was much like the exclusive frequency of a communicator, making these encrypted commands difficult to interfere with from the outside.
However, the secret incantation chanted by Cleopatra IX just now was known only to the Pharaohs of the Tares divine lineage, and naturally, Su Lun did not understand it. The reason he was able to render these hundreds of thousands of mummies rigid was entirely due to physical control.
After all, the Tares divine lineage was a humanoid race, and although they had some beast-like forms, their structures were almost identical to humans. Moreover, lifeless bodies are easier to control than living beings. The threads directly interrupted and locked the nerves, joints, energy channels, and the flow of magic power. How could these mummies possibly move?
You have a remote control, I simply cut the power.
This was the best solution Su Lun had researched for dealing with undead legions of such massive scale.
Of course, this was also a method only he could use.
....
Not far away, Kamul, Ralph, and Masia were dumbfounded.
What seemed like a certain death situation had been reversed by a magical Alchemy that appeared to be a Puppetry Technique.
At the same time, they all harbored the same doubt in their hearts: what exactly was this guy's profession?
All of them possessed keen perception and, despite their fleeting doubts, they had already discerned that those energy threads had immobilized the mummies in a clever way.
It looked like a physical restriction at the level of biological structure, achievable in theory by anyone with a mastery of anatomy.
But the difficulty lay in the... quantity.
We're talking about hundreds of thousands of mummies here!
They thought of the Puppet Masters in their respective realms, with controlling a few hundred puppets considered to be the pinnacle of Puppetry, what was the deal with this "Nicholas"?
All three were among the select few mortals who had touched the pinnacle of power beneath the level of the divine, and witnessing the capabilities of this peer of theirs, they felt an incredibly strange sensation.
It wasn't just because he was strong, but because of an indescribable shock.
A Puppet Master isn't a side job.
From what they could see now, this Nicholas, who had kept a low profile, was really a Puppet Alchemist?
Which meant, were all the various abilities he had shown before secondary to his role as a Puppet Master?
Was this the "forbidden" Alchemist spoken of in ancient legends?
Really that outrageously strong?
...
Meanwhile, on the other side, Pharaoh Cleopatra IX, as a summoner of the undead, was also cast into gloom.
The mockery on her face was gone, and as she looked at the rigid mummies, her eyes were filled only with cold murderous intent.
The invincible Divine Arts of the Tares race were being countered?
This gave her an inexplicable sense of crisis.
It was a desecration of the gods as well as a desecration of the ancestors buried in the tombs.
Just then, she began to recite another arcane incantation, "￥%#%#..."
The hundreds of thousands of mummies twitched and struggled, seemingly trying to respond to the call of the incantation and move once more.
But the incantation was not the issue, their bodies needed to be able to move!
As time passed, more and more threads fell, and the number of threads piercing each individual mummy increased. Su Lun had steadily taken control of the entire field.
Although a very small number of higher-ranked mummies were unaffected and still fighting, without the domain of the "Curse of the Pharaoh" at the level of battle formation, these dry carcasses posed little threat to the four summoners of gods and devils.
At that moment, Catwoman Cleopatra still tried to revive more mummies from the coffins with incantations, but to no avail.
No matter how many mummies emerged, they were immediately held fast by the threads. And she looked up at the huge alchemy cross in the sky, realizing that the sorcerer's construction was almost perfect, impossible to disrupt.
With just this one move, the tide had turned.
The entire desert realm was subject to an unknown super-prohibition: the forbiddance of divine beings' descent.
In this sealed tomb, a battle formation composed of hundreds of thousands of mummy troops could kill a demigod in minutes, and under normal divine conditions, it was impossible for anyone to break through.
However, the presence of Su Lun, the Puppeteer, directly shattered this dead end.
And the three Centaur Kamuls were not idle, with the mummy army being restrained, they seized the excellent opportunity without hesitation!
It was at this instant that the three of them launched an attack as swift as lightning, while Pharaoh Cleopatra the Ninth had most of her magic power engaged in the Undead Summoning Technique and had not had time to react properly, was killed once again.
This was the fourth time she had been killed.
Although the divine light twinkled from the "Key of Eternal Life," Pharaoh Cleopatra IX was resurrected once more.
But this time, both Su Lun and the other three people noticed that her resurrection was not as quick as before.
That slight difference confirmed to the group: Resurrection came at a price, and the divine-grade life energy stored in the key was limited!
Seeing this, Kamul, Ralph, and Masia unleashed their full power, preparing to kill this woman again.
Kill her a few more times, and they would eventually find the key to breaking the situation.
However, Su Lun, who was within the alchemy formation, became even more cautious.
Although maintaining the Puppetry Theater did not affect his actual combat strength, he had not been very proactive; instead, he occasionally attacked from a distance with his black scythe.
Meanwhile, his gaze was fixed on every movement of the Catwoman Pharaoh, who was being forced to retreat step by step.
The information gathered had now confirmed his previous conjectures, and he was almost certain he could kill this enchanting Pharaoh.
Now, he was merely waiting for an opportunity that was bound to arise.
But Su Lun was worried about something else.
The actions of the demon summoning Contractors had been ongoing for tens of thousands of years, and within the memories Su Lun had harvested, there had been several attempts of "Pharaoh assassination" and "tomb intrusion incidents" over the past few thousand years.
However, those predecessors had not succeeded, which meant that the dangers were certainly more than what appeared on the surface.
Su Lun did not think that just because his combat abilities were somewhat exceptional compared to his peers, he was entitled to disregard the risks of this pyramid crypt filled with secrets.
All signs indicated that there was certainly still a major event to come.
There was too much in this tomb that even he could not comprehend, so the means by which the Tares tribe protected the crypt could not possibly be limited to just the Pharaoh.
While the battle was in full swing here, Uncle Crow had already flown all over the tomb, scanning the spells from the "Book of the Dead" on those dark environment's rock walls and murals.
...
The rhythm of the battle was nearly as expected; the four of them teamed up and beat the Demi-god Pharaoh so soundly she had no fight left in her.
Ralph, the barbarian, indeed had the combat abilities he claimed to possess before; even on his own, he was confident he could defeat a Demigod. Now, with four top-tier fighters joining forces, they had killed Cleopatra IX for the fifth time in a short period.
However, Su Lun also noticed that a chilling sensation in the entire crypt was growing stronger and stronger.
Upon realizing this, he was not at all surprised, instead, he looked forward with anticipation in his heart, "The Divine Power of Faith, she is finally going to use this power..."
And this was the opportunity he was waiting for!
Sure enough, he was not disappointed. After Cleopatra IX was resurrected again, she began to chant another arcane spell: "￥%#&%..."
Su Lun narrowed his eyes at her lip movements, listened to the spell, and his eyes caught the rules invoked by the spell's syllables, as he also began to whisper, "Underworld God, grant me your Divine Power, summon the sand soldiers to appear..."
This was another incantation from the "Book of the Dead," a secret passed down by the Pharaohs.
But at that moment, in Su Lun's eyes, it was no longer as unfathomable as before.
The longer the battle went on, and the more techniques Cleopatra IX used, the fewer secrets she had left.
And just as that incantation was chanted, Ralph, the barbarian from afar, shouted, "Not good! She's summoning the Divine Power of Faith, kill her quickly, get the key!"
Su Lun knew that these words were more for himself than the others.
The other three were strong and could kill the Pharaoh, but none of their methods could stop the resurrection and the descent of this divine power.
And their only hope lay with the most mysterious alchemist in their team.
Nevertheless, Cleopatra IX was still a Demi-god warrior, and upon hearing these words, a look of scorn appeared on her face again. Being killed those few times wasn't in vain for her; now with the blessing of Divine Power, no one could defeat her within the forbearers' crypt, except for the gods themselves!
Masia, the Dragon Maiden who was closest to her, tried to interrupt the descent of Divine Power, opening her mouth to spew a dragon flame so ardent it distorted the void itself, striking the enchanting Pharaoh right on.
However, the dragon flames, which had previously been able to melt away a Demi-god's domain, were now blocked a few meters in front of Cleopatra IX.
Upon closer inspection, it was a thin layer of sand shield radiating with Divine Power.
Cleopatra IX snorted coldly and said with pride, "For you few to push me this far, indeed, your strength is surprising. It seems, the one who summoned you here is not simple at all!"
With that, she waved her hand, and the sand beside her instantly condensed into several tall sand soldiers wielding long spears.
As the sand soldiers appeared, one raised a shield to block the rain of destruction arrows from the centaur Makamul. Another lightning-fast hurled its spear, clashing with the axe Ralph had chopped down, bloodlight and Divine Power collided, and the barbarian, renowned for his strength, was unexpectedly blasted away.
Seeing this, all four judged at once that the sand soldiers, endowed with Divine Power, each possessed the combat abilities of a Demi-god!
On closer inspection, there were actually eight sand warriors here.
And that didn't include Cleopatra IX, who had been blessed with divine power and whose presence was so overwhelming it made one's scalp tingle!
With a wave of her hand, the eight sand warriors charged towards the four of them like ghosts.
With a two-on-one strategy, the sand warriors were so oppressive that the barbarian Ralph and his two companions were left gasping for air after just one exchange.
They could face a demigod head-on, but that didn't mean they could stand against the power of two demigods.
The centaur Makamul galloped wildly to gain distance, looking for an opportunity to strike.
On the other side, the Dragon Maiden Masia, with dragon scales pierced by divine spears, also urgently said, "Damn it, think of something fast!"
She simply couldn't hold on for long against two opponents.
Only Su Lun, who stood a bit further away, showed no change in his expression.
How could he not know the urgency of his three companions? But these sand warriors, condensed by divine power, were beyond even his own ability to contend with.
The Eye of Omniscience had already determined that the sand warriors were almost completely immune to physical and magical attacks, virtually unkillable. And since they were not living beings, they couldn't be controlled with strings either.
With these eight sand warriors present, not to mention the four of them at Tier 9, even four demigods would be at a loss.
The only hope for breaking the deadlock lay with their controller, Cleopatra IX.
Su Lun saw that the spears raised by two sand warriors were already just a foot away from his head, his expression suddenly turned serious, and he sent a mental command, "Move now!"
In the next instant, a bizarre scene unfolded once more.
The eight sand warriors, though bolstered by divine power, abruptly stopped in their tracks!
...
"What happened!"
The centaur Makamul, the barbarian Ralph, and the Dragon Maiden Masia were all taken aback simultaneously.
They looked at the sand warriors, who had just been pressing them in fight, now motionless, and then their gaze shifted towards "Nicholas."
Although they hoped he could deal with these sand warriors, they didn't believe that the sand warriors, with their half-divine strength, could be killed.
Therefore, the problem must stem from the source!
Turning their heads, they looked over to see Pharaoh Cleopatra IX, floating in the air in the distance, with a stiff expression and her eyes a bloody red, her previously gemstone-blue pupils transformed into two bizarre red moons?
"Mind control?"
Witnessing this, the three of them tentatively formed a hypothesis: The Pharaoh had been controlled!
Yet, at the same time, they wore expressions as if they'd seen a ghost; could Nicholas also wield mental secret techniques?
And more importantly... could he control a demigod blessed with divine power?
That was simply impossible!
A demigod bolstered by the power of faith was absolutely beyond the control of any mental secret technique below deity level.
...
Su Lun didn't have that ability either.
It was Pandora who made the move!
After lurking for a long time, this deity of the Moon Reading Illusion Technique had stolen the divine power and faith from the tomb.
After observing for so long and preparing numerous methods, she was waiting for this moment!
However, now was not the time for explanations. Seizing the opportunity, Su Lun, with his scythe in hand, charged fiercely towards Cleopatra IX.
Seeing this, the other three also realized the opportunity was not to be missed and made their move simultaneously!
However, it seemed that the killing intent, almost tangible, had triggered some secret technique, because the bloody red in Cleopatra IX's eyes quickly faded, and she suddenly snapped back to her senses.
As she saw the four of them closing in on her, she quickly raised her hand in a gesture, using her divine power to block the lethal attacks.
The scythe, the axe, the dragon fist, the arrows — all four attacks hit Cleopatra IX at almost the same moment. Even though the demigod managed to muster a divine shield in the final moment, it lacked the invincible defense from before. Their combined strike broke through with a "thud," and she spat out a mouthful of blood, tumbling a kilometer away like a cannonball, flipping over countless coffins before coming to a stop.
Cleopatra IX stood up from the ruins, bellowing in disbelief, "Damn you, what have you done, why is my divine power fading..."
She hadn't finished speaking when she suddenly remembered something, "No, that's not right, you did something to my body earlier!"
Listening, a glint of cold light flashed in Su Lun's eyes.
It's too late to realize it now!
Actually, the moment Su Lun saw the queen's body without a soul outside, he had already thought of this step in his plan.
That's why he put the body into an ordinary storage ring instead of directly into the miniature void world—he felt the body might be useful.
In the time he possessed the body, he wasn't idle; Pandora had already marked it with various Divine Arts secret techniques, leaving behind a special Divine Power backdoor for siphoning.
The reason Su Lun didn't make his move earlier in the fierce battle was to give Pandora enough time.
Even the tomb battlefield had been carefully chosen by him for the Pharaoh in advance!
From the memories he had harvested from the Taris deity clan, he clearly identified a possibility—that the numerous mummies in the tomb could be resurrected.
Su Lun had guessed at that time that this might be part of the tomb's defense mechanism.
As he himself had extensive research on corpses, this wasn't a big issue for him.
In his Plan A, even if he couldn't control the mummies with his Puppetry Technique, he still had his "Plan B" with his legion of a million puppets!
If all else failed, it would be a direct clash of legions!
Although the risk of mutual destruction wasn't small, risks were great everywhere in this yellow sand realm.
But if the plan succeeded, the risks would be minimized.
With sufficient intelligence to support him, Su Lun had almost anticipated any possibility, such as the Pharaoh resorting to the use of Divine Power after being unable to overpower the four of them upon resurrection.
Su Lun didn't think he had the ability to kill a demi-god strengthened by Divine Power within the Taris clan's tomb.
In this situation, Pandora's Faith Stealing would be crucial!
And, just like the plan, due to the prior tampering with the body, Cleopatra IX had already fallen into the Moon Reading Illusion Technique before she could call upon Divine Power.
Just like now!
Pandora's ability to read the divine also had peaked at the threshold of godhood; she wasn't so easily detected.
Even if Cleopatra IX was vigilant enough, it wouldn't help, because from the moment Su Lun killed Saint Jey earlier, he hadn't given the resurrected her any time to breathe!
Now, Cleopatra IX, severely wounded by the combined efforts of the four, spat blood. Her pupils rapidly alternated between azure and blood moon, as if two wills were fighting within her body for control.
The three barbarians, including Ralph, hadn't grasped what was happening, but seeing this, Su Lun didn't hesitate to charge forward again.
In an instant, he covered hundreds of meters, and in the blink of an eye, his black scythe was already pressed against the Pharaoh's neck.
Even a minute detail could determine the victor in a battle between top fighters, let alone a fatal struggle for control of the body.
Cleopatra IX's face switched between fear and an eerie demeanor; Su Lun's black scythe effortlessly decapitated her.
And this time, the "Key of Eternal Life" in the queen's hand didn't bloom with light.
Because Divine Power requires a connection to Faith, and after the faith was stolen, she could be killed! The resurrection energy in the Ankh amulet, unable to sense the Power of Faith, couldn't protect her soul.
Cleopatra IX's flying severed head wore an expression of unwillingness, revealing that she still desperately tried to grasp the power of resurrection.
But where would Su Lun give her a chance?
With a gesture, the shadow of death that followed him swallowed up that "gray mist."
After harvesting her soul, Su Lun finally took a deep breath, confirming he had truly killed this demi-god of the Taris clan!
Killed her?
In the distance, the three barbarians, including Ralph, who had been eager to rush to help, were overjoyed.
They saw the divine light of the key did not reignite, looking at the corpse which showed no signs of resurrection.
The four in the tomb breathed a sigh of relief, releasing a collective breath of foul air.
Having killed a demi-god endowed with Divine Power, they finally saw hope.
...
With nobody to obstruct them now, as long as they could place the "Key of Eternal Life" on the altar, the Divine-Demon Pact would be undone.
But looking at the key in his hands, Su Lun's expression became grave once more.
There were troubles far greater than the current ones in this mysterious Pyramid Tomb.
The affairs of gods and demons were not something humans could meddle with lightly.
Su Lun felt that what they were about to face might be the real, most significant danger that "predecessors" over tens of thousands of years had failed to overcome.

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - 659: Divine Corpse, Contract, Rat
chapters.content:
Su Lun realized that bringing Pandora along was a wise decision.
He had just carefully observed the various prohibitions in the tomb's underground palace, where had he not discovered that the Power of Faith of the Taris clan was still entangled with even more super prohibitions?
Which meant that if he had forcefully killed Cleopatra the Ninth, the problem would not only have remained unresolved, but it would also have triggered even more terrifying tomb-guarding prohibitions due to the absence of this Pharaoh's control over the Divine Power.
This Pharaoh, bearing the Power of Faith, was like a fuse, once blown, the higher-level prohibitions would most likely indiscriminately kill all outsiders within the tomb.
And Pandora, having stolen that Divine Power and substituting the Pharaoh's role, did not trigger the fuse mechanism, hence there wouldn't be any problems for a while.
Su Lun gazed at the figure made of Divine Power in the sky, and said, "Thank you."
Pandora really had a lot of loyalty for coming along this time.
Although she wouldn't die while the divine artifact was still with her, once her body of Divine Power collapsed, she would have to start all over again with her cultivation.
The loyalty shown was not insignificant.
But in the next moment, from within his sea of consciousness came the carefree response of the great God Tsukuyomi, "Yo, when did you become so polite? Giggles... The Power of Faith here is the largest amount I've encountered, the most pure, and also has the most complete divine incense burning. If I were to steal a part of it, I would likely be able to condense my own Divine Fire. Following you, luck is always on my side~"
Listening, Su Lun merely smiled slightly, non-committal.
Opportunity and risk always coexist.
After all, the Taris civilization was a powerful one, with countless existing followers. The tomb of the Taris in this Yellow Sand Dimension continuously gathered the Power of Faith.
They were now like mice that had sneaked into a farmer's grain silo, at least until they were discovered, they could feast to their fill.
Speaking of which, Pandora did not forget to remind, "Be careful, I feel there might be a true godly aura in this tomb."
Listening to her, Su Lun responded, "Hmm."
Now was not the time for extended discussion, better to wait until they could actually make it out alive.
...
Meanwhile, the centaur Makamul, the barbarian Ralph, and Dragon Maiden Masia also noticed the sudden appearance of a "person" in the tomb.
Initially, they thought it was an enemy, but seeing the attitude of this "Nicholas," they realized it seemed to be the mysterious existence that had just helped them control Cleopatra the Ninth.
This fellow, he had actually brought assistance?
How did he bring them here?
Why hadn't they fully noticed before?
Amidst their confusion, what shook them even more was the realization.
They recognized this was a Demigod.
It was the most powerful Demigod they had ever encountered with Divine Power!
The palpable divine majesty even instinctively prevented the three from looking directly at it.
As Ralph and the others looked again towards this "Nicholas," their eyes filled with more wariness.
...
"You have stripped 'Cleopatra the Ninth' of her soul"
"You have gained some insights about the 'Power of Rules'"
"You have gained a large amount of insights into the laws of wind, earth, and death, elemental experience +684577"
"You have mastered the language, rune system, technique system, and history of the Taris civilization..."
"You have learned the Pharaoh's secret: the seventy-two divine incantations from the Book of the Dead..."
"You have obtained some top-secret information about the Taris Tomb: the tomb is a mysterious realm of death where the divine ancestors await resurrection, slaves are material for extracting the Origin of Life, and it's not just human slaves; there are also divine prisoners at the lower levels... These intruders are probably summoned by some imprisoned deity, though it's unclear where the flaw lies..."
"Spiritual Power +75112"
"..."
Su Lun quickly digested the memories of Cleopatra the Ninth, and a flood of information rushed into his mind, his expression growing increasingly solemn.
The Pharaoh guarding the Sun Temple was the highest-ranking Tomb Guardian among the Taris clan in the entire sandy plane, and she too knew some top-secret information that only Pharaohs were privy to.
For instance, inside this tomb, there lay a true God!
Compared to those cognitive enhancements, this information was the most crucial thing for Su Lun to survive at the moment.
"Divine prisoners?"
Su Lun's eyelids twitched slightly.
He suddenly realized what sort of entity had summoned them.
This also directly confirmed the strength of the Taris clan, so powerful that the demonic god capable of summoning Contractors from other realms had become a prisoner.
In his mind, Su Lun pictured himself as a rat sneaking into a prison through a crack to steal keys, an existence that prisoners and prison guards could snuff out at any moment.
But now was not the time to dwell on it.
Su Lun looked up again at the symbols carved into the walls of the tomb everywhere.
Having harvested the memories, the runes on the Book of the Dead, which he had almost been unable to understand before, made sense to him at this moment.
In almost any divine civilization's practice system, people only need to know the effects of runes, and rarely does anyone research why they have such effects.
But the Alchemy system goes back to the roots to understand the function of every stroke in these divine symbols.
Like this "Secret of Immortality" Ankh rune—even Cleopatra the Ninth, a demigod, did not know why it could resurrect people.
Yet Su Lun could understand; in these divine symbols, there was a kind of anti-life equation.
This knowledge was critically important for his future world comprehension.
By understanding the secrets the runes indicated, he became more certain of a previous conjecture.
"This Taris civilization's legacy scripture truly shares a common origin with the 'Sage's Proverbs'..."
Su Lun affirmed this, feeling increasingly that the predecessors of the Alchemy plane had left too many treasures for future generations.
The gold scroll he held had been obtained from the head of the "Ancient Magic and Archaeology Institute" at the Royal Academy in Lu Ying, a sixth-order professional.
And the secrets recorded in this gold scroll were of a divine level, even older than the Taris divine clan's legacy scripture, the Book of the Dead.
Such a divine treasure ending up in mortal hands was almost impossible in a divine-right state.
...
The thoughts in his mind flashed and faded, and Su Lun did not think too much about it.
He picked up the "Key of Immortality" from the ground with a thread, turned to his three teammates from Makamul, the centaur, and asked, "Gentlemen, should I now place this key on the altar?"
After all, as people also recruited by the demon god, it was good to ask.
Perhaps his teammates had noticed some details he had overlooked.
It also made the three of them a bit less suspicious of each other.
Hearing this, Kamul and the other two instantly became serious.
They knew full well that the situation was completely under the control of this "Nicholas".
If it weren't for him, this infiltration into the tomb would have failed long ago.
But there was nothing much to say, his strength was there for all to see, and the three of them could say that it was because of him that they were still alive.
Now they just needed to place the "Key of Immortality" on the altar, and the magic contract would automatically be lifted.
Their mission would then be completed.
But having experienced the previous mishaps, the four of them were even more cautious.
After pondering for a moment, the centaur Kamul cautiously spoke up, "Mr. Nicholas, what do you think we should do?"
The two had worked together before, so naturally, it was best for him to speak up.
Su Lun candidly said, "The contract must be undone. However, after placing the key there, some unforeseeable events might occur."
Even if he didn't say it, the other three could guess as much.
Although they didn't understand the structure of the tomb, their intuition told them that things involving gods and demons were never going to be simple.
Ralph said, "Open it. Whether we can survive afterward will depend on our own abilities."
Masia said, "Yes, I agree."
"..."
And after the words were spoken in the open, much of the mutual suspicion had dissipated.
Since the three of them all agreed, Su Lun said nothing more.
However, before placing the key on the altar, he had another task to take care of.
Never mind whether they would die or not, the loot still had to be collected first.
In case there was any mysterious power controlling these mummies, it might as well resolve some hidden dangers in advance.
The mummies in this tomb were rare puppet materials that were hard to come by, and he had earlier stripped away the control method of the mummy legion. With a slight modification, he could fully replicate the previous "Pharaoh's Curse" on a grand battle formation.
This army of mummies would potentially be a great weapon in Su Lun's arsenal in the future.
The coffins, too, whether they were the lavish ones cast in pure gold and studded with gemstones, or even the wooden ones made of various rare spiritual woods, possessed very strong cursed properties...
To an alchemist, they were inherently invaluable.
And estimating from this crypt, there might be as many as a million mummies and coffins!
No time like the present.
Su Lun paid no attention to the others. With a pinch of the sorcerer's seals, more and more threads began to fall from the sky.
As the other three watched him perform that miraculous alchemy, they all tensed up, "This isn't good!"
They thought another battle had been triggered.
Especially as they saw the tens of thousands of rigid mummies suddenly start moving, the three, like cats that had their tails stepped on, instantly bristled and prepared for battle.
However, the battle they expected didn't happen. Instead, something unforeseen occurred.
At that moment, they watched as those mummies, under the control of the threads, picked up their own coffins and began moving in unison.
The three were immediately perplexed. What was this for?
Was he planning to control these puppets for battle?
Although they didn't know how this "Nicholas" managed to control tens of thousands of mummies, when they saw him pinch the sorcerer's seals and conjure two giant spatial vortexes in the void, they suddenly realized something was about to happen: Was this guy planning to take these mummies as spoils of war?
Although...
As a Puppet Master, he wouldn't have a problem wanting these corpses.
In fact, Kamul and the others had previously considered that these coffins and corpses were very valuable.
But to take away a million mummies? How was that even possible?
However, the bizarre scene that followed unfolded.
The three of them just watched as the vast army of mummies quickly streamed into the spatial vortex.
The space seemed like a bottomless pit, never filling up.
Even those that were not yet revived and were still in their coffins tumbled out on their own and entered the two void gates.
Kamul and the others watched, their eyelids twitching: How huge was this guy's storage space?
Then, under the shocked gaze of the three, the army of a million mummies had almost all been taken away.
Even the valuable funerary goods and construction materials, the "Asgard stones" of this tomb, had been completely plundered.
Su Lun, having the All-knowing Eye, wasn't afraid of unintentionally triggering any safeguards.
In just a short time, the previously death-filled crypt, because of the absence of mummies and coffins, suddenly became much more spacious.
Leaving Kamul, Ralph, and Masia standing there stunned: This act of plucking feathers after a goose is passed and this mysterious alchemist's demeanor seemed hardly fitting.
...
Su Lun didn't care about the opinions of others and went about his business, and then said, "Ladies and gentlemen, I'm about to start."
Upon hearing this, Kamul and the others came back to their senses from their shock.
The three nodded, each prepared themselves defensively.
Kamul called forth the spirit protection of the centaur tribe, barbarian Ralph entered a deep frenzy, and Dragon Maiden Masia completely transformed into a red dragon.
Su Lun himself arranged a super large multifunctional alchemy formation and stood at the center of the Formation.
Then, he controlled a mummy holding the "Key of Immortality" and walked towards the altar in the center of the crypt.
The four peak human powers held their breath, their expressions serious.
No one knew what would happen next.
The few dozen seconds it took for the mummy to walk towards the altar felt like the longest time of their lives.
Finally, the mummy reached the rune-covered altar and aligned the "Key of Immortality" with the "☥" symbol indented on it.
Su Lun had already understood most of the mysterious symbols on the altar, where not evident, it was beneath: the resting place of the gods!
But at this point, there was no choice.
His eyes hardened, and he decisively cut off all connection.
The key slipped from the mummy's hand, "click," flawlessly fitting into the indentation.
This action was as if a key was inserted into a lock, and the mysterious symbols on the altar all lit up.
Meanwhile, Su Lun glanced at his attribute panel and his expression brightened: the demon god contract had indeed disappeared!
It seemed that the three from Makamul had also confirmed this situation through their own methods, a smile appearing on all their faces.
They had been summoned by the gods and demons, and at this moment, they had finally repaid the debts they once owed!
They were finally free!
However, just as the surprise had not yet let the four of them rejoice for long, the moment the key was inserted into the altar, an indescribable "great terror" instantly swept through the underground palace.
"Danger is coming!"
Su Lun's heart chilled, not surprised that an accident had occurred.
However, what he did not anticipate was that this "great terror" was so oppressive that it even stifled their breathing.
"Could it be a True God descending?"
Su Lun was shocked to the core.
He had witnessed the will of the gods descending many times, but none was comparable to this moment.
How quickly did it come?
So fast that Su Lun's All-knowing Eye only caught a shadow that "whooshed" out from the unknown space beneath the altar.
Upon closer inspection, it was actually a dog-headed mummy!
That "great terror" was emanating from this dog-headed mummy.
To the naked eye, it was surrounded by a force that distorted space itself. Through the All-knowing Eye, it was a protective divine domain formed by strands of rules!
Su Lun instantly understood everything: "Corpse of the Gods!"
However, before he had time to ponder why the god corpse of the Taris deity was so fierce, the dog-headed mummy charged toward Ralph who was holding a huge axe in the distance and threw a punch.
"Boom!"
The sound of shattering gold resonated.
While Su Lun and the others were preparing various lifesaving methods, they caught a glimpse of the dog-headed mummy landing a hit in the corner of their eye.
The mummy's punch landed on Ralph's battle axe, and this epic weapon capable of splitting mountains and seas instantly shattered. Then, the force of that punch continued, turning Ralph's right arm into powder.
What none of them expected was that Ralph, a barbarian with demigod combat abilities, couldn't withstand even a single blow?
If it had not been for the axe, that punch would likely have killed him outright!
Seeing this, even Su Lun couldn't help but gasp.
His eyes had clearly seen everything. The pinnacle of humanity was to utilize a bit of the power of rules, but compared to the fist of the dog-headed mummy, surrounded by a complete divine domain of rules, it was a completely different story!
It was like a stone striking an eggshell, effortlessly shattered.
This punch was simply not something a human could withstand!
Su Lun felt that their survival didn't come from their strength, but rather from good luck.
The first target that the dog-headed mummy chose was Ralph, who had the largest energy fluctuations, not them!
And right after this punch that broke Ralph's right arm, the dog-headed mummy threw another punch.
Seeing this, Ralph, now severely wounded, only had despair in his eyes. Overwhelmed by divine power, he was utterly unable to dodge. And even if he had dodged, it would have been equally certain death.
From their brief contact, he had already understood that this was not an enemy that human strength could contend with!
Su Lun saw this, and a chill shot straight to his forehead.
If he didn't prepare, he might be the next one to die.
But in an instant, his brain had made the best response, hastily pulling out the "Wrap of Oz's Iceman" and wrapping it around his body.
This was his last chance to stay alive!
He had already judged that the mummy probably targeted by detecting energy fluctuations.
The greater the energy fluctuations, the more likely one was to be targeted.
Using Spatial Teleportation to break through the Tomb's restrictions would take considerable time and a lot of energy, enough for the jackal-headed Corpse of the Gods to lock on and kill him!
Meanwhile, Makamul the Centaur and Dragon Maiden Miss Masia also showed signs of great fear. For a moment, instead of choosing to run away or defend, they actually charged towards Su Lun together.
Su Lun saw this out of the corner of his eye, instantly understanding their thoughts.
The judgment capability of top experts was naturally top-notch as well.
These two, knowing that they would surely die by their own means, had no thoughts of resisting and instead chose to place their hopes in "Nicholas," the mysterious Alchemist.
Although they did not know what means he might still have to save his life, it was better than having no hope at all!
...
Seeing the two rushing over, thoughts flashed through Su Lun's mind, and there was no time to stop them. With his hands, the spatial fluctuations flashed, and he hastily brought the two into the mini Void Realm.
At the same time, with a tug of a thread, dozens of animated corpses that he had set up beforehand began to move immediately, serving as targets to attract firepower.
As for Su Lun himself, he was already wrapped in the mummy wrap, his presence completely vanished on the spot.
Just as he finished all this, the barbarian Ralph exploded into a cloud of blood under the mummy's second punch in the distance.
Then, a cold wind swept through, and the jackal-headed mummy quickly eliminated the dozens of animated corpses like lightning. Regardless of how secretly hidden the animated corpses were, each was pulverized into blood and flesh powder with a single punch.
Su Lun was terrified as he watched, fearing that the next punch would land on him, and he quickly concluded in his mind, "Biological recognition, energy fluctuations, sound waves... fuck, there's absolutely no way to hide!"
Those animated corpses weren't randomly arranged; they were to test the mummy's sensory capabilities.
He was also relieved by his choice; if he had chosen to run away just then, he would certainly have been a corpse by now.
And thankfully for "Wrap of Oz's Iceman," this miraculous sealing item.
What he had once thought to be increasingly useless curse item, at this moment, had saved his life again.
Luckily, after killing off all the animated corpses, the jackal-headed mummy did not discover him and just stagnated in the Tomb.
Seeing this, Su Lun's heart that had been hoisted to his throat finally settled down.
But just as he was beginning to calm down, another problem arose.
The jackal-headed mummy had not left, which meant that any noise Su Lun made could potentially expose and kill him.
He thought it best to stay put.
The situation suddenly fell into a deadlock.
The jackal-headed mummy was motionless, and Su Lun dared not move either.
However, not dying on the spot was a lucky break amidst misfortune.
Su Lun looked at the jackal-headed mummy, and saw the glittering brown gemstone at its chest, thinking to himself, "A divine essence?"
He had seen genuine divine essences in the "God Slayer" armament before, so even amidst the complete "chaos," he recognized it as a genuine divine essence.
And before him lay the corpse of a True God.
The only good news was that it was a corpse, devoid of its own consciousness.
This was probably the only opportunity.
Calming himself, Su Lun's mind also became active.
He did not feel that this was a desperate situation.
After all, the bottom layer of the tomb had been opened, and that demon god should appear soon.
Perhaps he still had a chance to slip away.
...
Su Lun glanced over, and saw that a passage had opened up at the altar, emitting a vast amount of mist-like divine aura, reminiscent of a freezer being opened.
The All-knowing Eye revealed, surprisingly, unreadable "****"?
This mysterious vapor escaped, diluting into the vast space of the underground palace. Only then did Su Lun slowly understand—these seemed to be a mix of murky divine powers?
The scene beneath the altar was still unclear, shadowy and foggy, faintly resembling green flames like ghost fires.
With a divine-grade corpse guarding the gates, there was no need to wonder, something incredible was sealed inside.
Looking at it, Su Lun's heart was also heavy.
But there was nothing he could do for now, and his thoughts shifted to another location—the two strangers in the little void realm.
...
To avoid danger, the centaur Makamul and the Dragon Maiden Masia had no choice but to dart into the little void realm.
Upon entering, they were met by the sight of a million orderly arrayed mummies.
Only at that moment did they realize why that "Nicholas's" storage space could contain so many items—it was not a storage space but a whole minor plane!
A castle, mountains, forests, amber—it was quite like a small kingdom.
It seemed like many people had once lived there.
However, what shocked them even more was that not only did this place have a million mummies, it also housed winged metal puppets, countless metal octopuses, and innumerable mechanical equipment...
All these were things Su Lun brought that could be used in battle.
Makamul and Masia, who had never seen machinery, were immediately astonished upon seeing these things.
Only then did they realize that "Nicholas's" trump cards far exceeded what they had seen before.
Exchanging glances, they couldn't help but swallow their saliva.
Was this the legendary Alchemy?
They could hardly imagine how outrageously strong Nicholas must be with these puppets in play.
Before they could explore further, Su Lun's will arrived.
"You two, I saved you just now, and the situation is quite dire..."
With time pressing, after exchanging a few words of small talk, he spoke bluntly, "As a condition of the exchange, I need you both to sign a contract."
His rescue wasn't out of kindness; he simply felt they might be useful later.
The combat capabilities of Makamul and Masia were extremely strong, far exceeding the average rank nine.
One could kill a demigod with a single arrow; the other could transform into a huge dragon.
If there were any battles ahead, Su Lun thought they might be good options to draw fire.
If by any chance they survived and returned to the alchemical plane, they would also be a significant help.
Looking at the two contracts emerging in the sky, Makamul and Masia's expressions changed—they had just ended a divine contract and now another?
Su Lun wasn't about to give them any false hopes.
Having just saved these two, if he couldn't exchange that for some benefits, keeping them would be pointless.
Now, in the small void realm, killing them would be as easy as flipping his hand.
However, for experts, Su Lun still retained the necessary respect, stating, "This is a ten-year cooperation contract. You both need to help me fight... Rest assured, I respect your faith and won't ask you to do anything that contravenes it..."
Upon hearing this, Makamul and Masia's brows relaxed considerably—was this not a slavery contract, but merely a ten-year combat contract?
Naturally, it wasn't a slavery contract; although Su Lun had thought about it, he clearly understood that if that sharpness were dulled, they might remain at this level for their entire lives.
The situation on the alchemical plane needed experts and also those with potential.
These two had been selected by gods and demons, their talents one in a billion from their respective planes.
As long as they could survive, their future might still hold further progress.
Su Lun continued, "As compensation, I will provide all the cultivation resources you need later. You should guess that I come from the alchemical plane; my plane owns many ancient treasures. Mr. Makamul, for your principle of destruction, I can provide a reliable pathway to demigod... As for Miss Masia, I can responsibly tell you that I have a genetic potion which can greatly make your bloodline regress towards a more pristine dragonkin. This, you know I don't speak idly..."
To make people fight hard, naturally, some incentives were necessary.
Speaking thus, Su Lun added, "Of course, you can also refuse. However, I have no interest in assisting those who are not friends."
"..."
Makamul and Masia listened to these words, the corners of their eyes twitching.
They were well aware that having just been rescued, naturally, there was a price to pay.
Their gazes surveyed the small void realm again—they hadn't even seen Su Lun's person, let alone fought.
Furthermore, even if they won the fight to get out, it was a dead-end.
It seemed they had a choice, but in reality, there was none.
If they truly wanted to live, even a slavery contract would have to be signed.
But now, it seemed the terms were better.
Masia confirmed once more, "Just a ten-year contract?"
Su Lun declared emphatically, "Yes! As long as you follow the contents of the contract, you can go wherever you want afterward. We can include that clause."
Upon hearing this, Makamul and Masia both breathed a sigh of relief, "Alright."
They added a few clauses, and the three quickly signed the contract.
Su Lun also breathed a sigh of relief.
Meanwhile, elsewhere in the underground palace, that white-smoke-like divine vapor had already spread everywhere.
At that moment, a little mouse, unbeknownst to them from where it had come, quietly appeared in their field of vision.
Su Lun knew—the demon god was finally about to show up.

chapters.title: Chapter 661 - 660 Fusion [God Slayer]
chapters.content:
Su Lun was wrapped up in a death shroud, not daring to move, when suddenly a dusty grey rat scurried out from some corner in his field of vision.
The rat, with shifty eyes, scuttled around the tomb chamber as if it were scanning for dangers.
Then, from the cracks in the walls, a sudden "squeak squeak squeak" rang out, a chorus of tiny, rapid sounds.
Upon closer inspection, throngs of grey rats gushed forth like a fountain.
Su Lun watched with astonishment.
Although he knew that these rats were under the control of the "demon god," after all, he had already seen one earlier.
But now, he was surprised that these rats hadn't been discovered by the jackal-headed mummy?
Su Lun had already tested with a living corpse earlier; the jackal-headed mummy could sense both living creatures and energy fluctuations. Although these rats were small, they were definitely not something to be overlooked.
"Strange, why haven't they been discovered? Or is there something special about the rats that doesn't trigger the jackal-headed mummy's killing mechanism?"
Su Lun observed carefully as more and more rats appeared in the tomb chamber, his thoughts racing.
Before he could fully understand, he saw the horde of rats bustling toward the mysterious sealed space beneath the altar.
Since the seal on the altar had been open for some time, with the heavy mist dissipating, Su Lun could now see clearly that it was an immense space. Inside, there were colorful statues embodying the visage of the Taris pantheon—jackal heads, eagle heads, crocodile heads, baboon heads... all seated on thrones like emperors, majestically lined along both sides of the pathway to the gods.
"Could it be that the coffins here are all filled with gods from the Taris tribe?"
Su Lun speculated in his heart.
These hundred-meter-tall sculptures were actually special coffins, sealed tightly.
Su Lun could now tell that this was a burial standard not even a pharaoh could dream of deserving.
Apart from these coffins, the most eye-catching thing in the tomb chamber was the obelisk radiating white light and transparency.
This crystal-like obelisk was engraved with a large golden ankh ☥, followed by a dense array of various golden runes.
Su Lun couldn't understand what the divine runes pointed to, but he immediately guessed the function of this crystal obelisk.
The countless efforts of a lifespan were converging on this crystal cup, to be used by those beings inside the coffins.
It looked like some kind of divine equation operating against life.
Each statue also held an antique-looking bronze lamp in hand, within which a greenish flame burned.
The source of light seen when the altar seal was opened was from these bronze lamps.
"Soul-Binding Lamp?"
Su Lun looked on with an inexplicable sense of familiarity.
Although everything inside that burial chamber was "divine," beyond the comprehension of humanity.
But he still recognized the flame burning inside the bronze lamps.
Wasn't that "Godly Fire"?
Pestoya's soul was merged with the Godly Fire, how could Su Lun mistake it?
So it meant that some of the Taris pantheon's beings were actually using the Godly Fire of a deity to light the lamps and maintain the operation of some special formation?
Su Lun was left speechless.
There must be dozens of these lamps.
Such a grand gesture?
And next, a bizarre scene unfolded before his eyes.
Su Lun watched as rats pouring from the crevices headed straight for the third lamp from the entrance on the left, swarming toward it as if drawn to a flame.
With a phosphorescent halo extending a few meters around the bronze lamp, the rats were instantly incinerated to ash as soon as they touched the eerie green light.
Nevertheless, countless rats surged toward the bronze lamp fearlessly, one after another.
With each passing moment, a multitude of rats were burned to ashes.
However, using the All-knowing Eye, Su Lun could clearly see that they were targeting the runes on the lamp to nibble and gnaw!
For every tens of thousands of rats consumed, the runes' luster dimmed a bit.
It seemed they planned to use their numbers to gradually damage the lamp.
....
Seeing this, how could Su Lun not understand that the Godly Fire imprisoned in that bronze lamp was the demon god that summoned him!
"Such a powerful being has actually been used by the Taris tribe to light the sky lamps?"
Su Lun also found it hard to believe.
Simultaneously, he felt a chill down his spine.
He felt that the only reason he had survived this long after intruding into the tomb was sheer luck.
