Ekaterina's tone inexplicably became innocent and cheerful, for a moment it was as if two shadows overlapped, "Katyusha probably often thinks of that Mr. Su Lun too..."
The two exchanged a smile.
Just then, this delicate atmosphere was interrupted.
Ekaterina was about to say something more when her expression subtly changed.
Su Lun asked, "What's wrong?"
Ekaterina said calmly, "Survivors from the Divine Sect have appeared; they're likely to take action tonight."
Su Lun showed no surprise, "Oh? The Divine Sect is still active?"
Ekaterina replied, "Yes. Faith is hard to eradicate. We've purged it many times before, but remnants still persist. Moreover, with the recent invasive efforts from the Divine Realm, a group of believers has infiltrated Luying."
As she spoke, she added, "I've already been the target of three assassination attempts. They're not regular troops but magic mercenaries out to collect the bounty on this empress."
Hearing this, Su Lun didn't show any surprise.
Apart from the imperial legions, the Divine Realm also employed a large number of mercenaries. The Ascieden Empire had suffered heavy casualties before, and now that the three empires were attacking together, all sorts of riffraff had joined the fray.
The battlefield was never short of mercenaries willing to exchange their lives for coin.
They might not be good at group warfare, but they were perfect for small squad maneuvers and various assassinations.
Ekaterina wasn't panicked in the least and continued, "I just received intelligence that the ninth-rank magic mercenary identified by military intelligence has appeared; I've already sent March to handle it. However, the enemy has shown their hand as soon as I left the palace, likely a diversion tactic."
She had deliberately shifted away 'Black JOKER' March Creton, the deputy commander of the intelligence agency guarding the manor, to attract the assassins.
Continuing, she glanced at Su Lun, "I wasn't so sure before, but now that you're here, it's perfect. After all, the divination was very vague. I suspect there is not only that ninth-rank Sage of Law among the assassins but possibly also a 'demigod.' If that's the case, I'm not certain I can capture them."
"Hmm."
Su Lun's eyes narrowed slightly upon hearing these words, and a trace of cold light flashed through his gaze.
His current range of perception already covered several miles, and he had sensed a very powerful presence stealthily infiltrating the streets of Lingdun City.
That person obviously had high-level stealth abilities since he hadn't triggered any magical restraints.
The two people at the dining table remained calm.
Vivian, that girl, also ate her meal with focus on her own.
It was then that faint dark red threads started to spread into Su Lun's eyes.
These were strands of law invisible to the naked eye, which meant the newcomer was definitely a Magic God.
Su Lun acted as if he hadn't noticed anything, continuing to eat his grilled meat with relish, as always.
Although Yekaterina remained motionless by his side, her eyes gradually took on a deep profundity. When she looked again, her two blue pupils were already a dazzling starry sky.
The Assassin's stealth technique was very clever, managing to enter the dining room without setting off the estate's magical restraints.
The mercenaries of the celestial domain might not have access to the intelligence of the three great Empires' regular armies, and this Assassin probably thought he had gone undetected, already silently concentrating his efforts.
What he didn't know was that everything was clear in Su Lun's eyes.
He watched the figure that was using the power of the law to hide in the void silently enter, muttering to himself, "[S-026 Plaguebearer], so it's a Pestilence Mage. Tch tch, quite a rare talent..."
It was also the first time he had seen the legendary talent that could condense the divine attribute of [Plague], interesting him enough to take a few extra glances.
He did not take action.
Because he knew that his old friend beside him seemed to not need his help.
And sure enough!
Just as the Assassin approached the dining table and was about to reveal his killing intent, a layer of nebula shimmered around Yekaterina's figure, revealing the second form of [Starry Sky Patronage].
At the same time, she exclaimed, "Domain - Starry Sky Sanctuary!"
In that instant, the scenery around the dining room abruptly changed, the galaxy flowed, and in the blink of an eye, the three of them were traversing the boundless starry space.
Su Lun was one of the very few who had seen her domain. But the starry domain of a few years ago was still nascent, and now, even with his broad vision, he was shocked, thinking, "Her domain really has become a complete world now, huh..."
He still did not act, but simply shifted slightly to shield the little girl beside him.
Vivian's eyes widened in wonder, her face full of curiosity, "Wow... Is Mommy going to pick stars for Vivian again~"
Su Lun found this amusing.
In ordinary families, picking the stars would be inconceivable; in this family, it was indeed possible.
Some children are born to witness the pinnacle scenery of the world.
It was only now that Su Lun understood Mr. Jing, that easy grace in dealing with matters, cultivated from a young environment.
...
The Assassin apparently realized that he had been discovered too, but at this distance, whether he had been discovered or not didn't matter anymore, he would have to make a move either way.
Normally, a Magic God would not be confined by the domain of a ninth-rank professional.
But Yekaterina's "Starry Sky Sanctuary" was too special, leaving even this Magic God Assassin puzzled as to how to escape.
Su Lun also had to use the second form of the All-knowing Eye for a moment to understand it.
Was it actually drawing upon the power of the heavenly bodies?
The entire city of Lingdun seemed like a super massive alchemical array, attracting the power of innumerable stars to converge upon her alone.
Su Lun realized where her confidence came from, knowing full-well that there were followers of the Heavenly God in Lingdun, yet she had lured the enemy in with herself.
It could be said with great responsibility that in Lingdun, it was almost impossible for anyone below the level of a god to kill her!
She had just recently advanced to the ninth rank, with insufficient comprehension of the rules, sufficient to kill those of the ninth rank, but not quite enough to defeat a demigod.
The assassin had not yet figured out what was happening before his form became visible within her domain.
This was a figure wearing a black cloak, faint and elusive, with a dark red glow over his skin, reminiscent of pus and blood, upon the expansion of the plague sanctuary.
Suddenly, both sides engaged in combat.
The incantations of the Plague God of Law formed instantly, and on his exposed arms appeared what looked like smallpox virus lesions, densely packed like goosebumps, making one's scalp tingle. It wasn't just physical mutations; the sanctuary around him also emitted a dizzying, nauseating stench. He was like a carrier of viruses, as if all diseases were concentrated on his body.
Su Lun frowned slightly as he watched. He didn't dwell on whether this guy was strong or not; it was seriously disgusting regardless.
If it came to close combat, one touch of his body might burst into a pool of concentrated plague.
And if the battle was at range, the longer it went on, the more likely this space would be contaminated.
It was like stepping on a toad, careful not to get splashed with its poisonous fluid, even as you crushed it.
For Su Lun to kill him, he'd have to put in a great deal of effort.
However, Yekaterina faced this Mage, her demeanor and methods not the least bit inferior.
She pinched the sorcerer's seal with her left hand and cried out, "Astrological Alchemy: Gravitational Attraction!"
In an instant, the stars in the sky turned into magnets, with gravity suddenly converging in her palm.
Even a demigod would lurch toward her hand, overwhelmed by this terrifying gravitational pull.
The moment they clashed, the assassin's heart shook violently, "What a terrifying force!"
The information he had received placed the Emperor of this alchemical realm at most a power level of the eighth rank.
However, nobody could have imagined that this Empress, with hardly any battle achievements known, possessed the power of a demigod!
But even if the target of assassination turned out to be far stronger than expected, the assassin knew he had no way out. Not just because of the Empress who controlled the power of the stars, his peripheral vision also caught a glimpse of the man observing the battle from a distance, and he felt a foreboding sense of dread. The man's composure was so profound that it even made a demigod's heart skip a beat!
However, this wasn't the time to be thinking about other things.
As the assassin's body was being pulled in, his mouth formed a spell instantly, and he cried out, "Forbidden Spell·Pestilence Poison Puppet!"
As he spoke, he spewed two globules of acid, with magical power forming two massive acid giants that sizzled and corroded the air around them.
If the star power continued to attract, it would assuredly pull in the two acid giants first.
However, Yekaterina's crystal eyes hardened, and with her right hand, she formed another seal, "Astrological Alchemy: Gravitational Repulsion!"
The moment the sorcerer's seal was completed, the two previously fast-approaching acid giants were suddenly shoved away by a repulsive force, two opposing powers acting upon the same object.
"Plop!"
"Plop!"
Like two exploding balloons, the two constructs formed from the eighth-level forbidden spell instantly burst into a cloud of noxious green fluid.
However, seeing his magic shattered, the assassin was not surprised, but instead, his eyes turned cold.
This was what made Plague Mages so troublesome; regardless of whether the spell succeeded, once they cast it, various toxins in the air would amplify their sanctuary.
The moment the two giants were destroyed, the sanctuary swirling around him strengthened threefold, with visible signs of the surrounding void being corroded and warped.
Yekaterina grasped with one hand, and the gravitational force of the surrounding stars surged multiple times over.
The assassin's body endured immense pressure, pustules on his skin bursting one after another, oozing out viscous fluids.
Though he appeared disheveled, his momentum grew increasingly terrifying.
From a human being, he transformed into a plague monster.
He cackled as he chanted the final magic spell and exclaimed, "Divine Arts·Origin of the Plague!"
It was this magic that, instead of being limited by the vast expanse of the starry sky, turned it into the main battlefield for the virus to rampage.
....
From afar, Su Lun watched with a glint of cold light in his eyes, ready to make a move at any moment.
The assassin knew he was possibly in danger today, and his use of Divine Arts that operated on a level of rules, was something not just any ninth-tier could withstand.
However, Yekaterina had still not planned to call for help.
If she were facing the enemy alone, she might have considered whether, after using the Secret Technique and not killing the foe, she would be unable to cope.
But now with Su Lun present to bolster the situation, she could go all out without any worries!
With a demigod ramping up his power, Yekaterina naturally could no longer hide her capabilities.
As the poisonous clouds enveloped her, she hastily retreated, and even so, her star nebula gauze dress began to corrode with a sizzling noise.
While retreating, the sorcerer's seals in her hands also rapidly shifted, causing the countless stars in the sky to shine ever brighter.
Seeing from afar the terrifying power of the stars converging from all directions, Su Lun was also astonished, "Is she doing...?"
The power of the converging stars had already surpassed the energy fluctuation level of the ninth tier and was condensing into an abnormal form in her hands.
The density continued to increase.
Through the All-knowing Eye, Su Lun saw a black dot, the size of a sesame seed, appear in her palms.
Yet this tiny dot was perhaps as heavy as a hundred thousand mountains combined.
And the black point was still growing.
Su Lun murmured to himself, "She's going to use that technique, isn't she..."
He had seen this move before, when, then at sixth tier, Yekaterina barely managed to use it while killing Rasputin.
Now at ninth tier, it truly possessed the majesty of divine arts!
Yekaterina dodged the plague magic while rapidly changing the sorcerer's seals, gathering the power of the stars and continuously compressing it.
In a blink of an eye, the sesame-sized black dot in her palm coalesced into a fist-sized black hole, twisting the space around it completely.
Even Su Lun, observing from a distance, winced.
Even with his current pinnacle understanding of space law, the sight of that twisted space inexplicably made his heart quiver.
A celestial body dense enough to warp light seemed beyond human control.
By that time, sweat had begun to form on Yekaterina's forehead, clearly indicating that the concentration of the formula had reached the limits her body could withstand.
Controlling the collapsing celestial body in her palm, she suddenly cried out, "Astrological Alchemy: Black Hole!"
With the spell complete, Yekaterina stopped dodging.
She thrust the black hole in her hands towards the imposing plague magic head-on.
What happened next was astounding!
Everything around, including the toxic gases and plague, could no longer harm her; anything that came close was bizarrely absorbed by the black hole's mysterious suction force.
The Plague God of Law watched as his expression turned grim.
For the first time, he, a demigod, faced an opponent a tier and a half below him and felt the threat of death.
And this "Black Hole Formula" was like a BUG, capable of absorbing everything.
How could he fight back against this method?
"Thud!"
"Thud!"
"Thud!"
Two figures clashed desperately amidst the stars.
All sorts of powerful magic and forbidden spells were unleashed.
However, Yekaterina absorbed them all with a single black hole spell.
...
Su Lun, seeing this, completely relaxed, a smile curling up the corners of his mouth.
With Yekaterina using this move, she could not lose, even if she was not victorious.
With just this one move, she had made up the gap between their tiers.
But Su Lun also saw that while Yekaterina's Black Hole Formula seemed without solution, it actually had a flaw.
That is, the energy absorbed by her black hole also placed a burden on her own body, having an upper limit for bearing it.
The consumption was also incredibly high.
You could say, the longer the fight went on, the less favorable it was for Yekaterina.
However, it looked like the Plague God of Law was not going to see through it.
Or perhaps he would not live long enough to see through it.
Yekaterina would not give the enemy a chance.
Nor would Su Lun.
But he also realized that Yekaterina seemed to want to test her moves on this demigod.
After all, she was the emperor, and she didn't have the opportunity to find such enemies to go all out against every day. Neither did she have such a good opportunity with someone to hold the line.
Therefore, Su Lun had not joined in the fight but remained an onlooker.
The two of them clashed in the starry sky for hundreds of rounds.
Yekaterina's mastery over various astrological techniques became more and more refined in her hands.
But after all, the enemy was a demigod, so to defeat him alone, Yekaterina was still somewhat lacking.
Seeing the right moment, Su Lun casually lent a hand to control the situation for a moment, and Yekaterina threw the black hole in her hand, breaking through the Plague God of Law's sacred domain and bisecting his body.
The battle ended.
In the starry sky, Su Lun quickly rushed over to stitch the severed body back together.
Such an intact corpse was excellent material for making wax figures.
He also chose not to harvest the soul but instead preserved it with a rune umbrella.
Having witnessed the capabilities of the Plague God of Law, Su Lun could already imagine the scene of turning him into a wax figure and throwing it into the million-strong legions of the celestial plane.
This thing was absolutely a viral bomb, a bane to whoever it touched.
...
"Hu... hu..."
The battle ended, and Ekaterina was gasping for air.
The fight had been a heavy burden on her, and her complexion had turned somewhat pale.
Watching Su Lun stitching up the corpses, a smile flickered across Ekaterina's beautiful eyes. It was just then she truly understood the extent of how high her old friend had risen.
Yet, the stronger Su Lun became, the happier she felt from the bottom of her heart.
As the boiling spiritual power within her calmed down, she asked, "Su Lun, did you help me check if there are any weaknesses in my domain?"
It's estimated that in the alchemical plane, you couldn't find anyone who could answer that question.
If there were any such person, it would probably only be the one in front of her now.
Su Lun looked at her, then around at the starry sky, and said, "You have already mastered 'the World'; this starry sky domain is already perfect without any flaw that humans can find."
In fact, when he had seen the 'Sunflower Windmill', he knew that Ekaterina had mastered this power.
Even now, looking at the starry sky, not even the All-knowing Eye could find any major issues.
Demigods couldn't trap her.
But below the level of demigods, unless she was killed, there was no coming out.
This was a very special world.
Ekaterina, through the 'Poetry', which directly connects to the demigod rules, had grasped 'the World'.
Demigods?
Right after Su Lun spoke, he seemed to think of something, and then said, "Well... if I really have to mention something that could be perfected, I've recently come into contact with a new power that might inspire you..."
Ekaterina's eyebrows perked up, showing significant interest, "Oh?"
She was the emperor of the United Empire and, in theory, had touched the pinnacle secrets of the plane. Even if there were things she didn't understand, she should have at least heard of them.
But she hadn't imagined that her Starry Sky Sanctuary could still be improved.
Since it was not an outsider, Su Lun spoke frankly, "It is a 'dark rule'... a special existence. It's a domain that even typical demigods can't access."
Listening, Ekaterina's gaze instantly turned stern, and she looked straight ahead.
Su Lun continued, "It's an unknown realm that Sir Isaac found. However, this 'dark rule' cannot be observed by any known methods thus far, and it is instantly annihilated when encountering the regular rule. I can't even describe to you what it really is."
Ekaterina's eyes shimmered, and she asked, "Have you mastered that power?"
Since it was the great decider, of course, she guessed that Dawn must have had some means to slay gods, especially since Mr. Jing was Sir Isaac's daughter.
But those methods couldn't be discussed in detail, lest the gods become aware.
Su Lun nodded, "Yes."
Unseen and intangible; naturally, it couldn't be described.
He used his spiritual power to convey a message, roughly describing to her what the concept of that entirely opposite realm to the real world might be.
But even though Ekaterina was extraordinarily intelligent, she was still befuddled after listening to the explanation.
Su Lun thought about it, then said, "This Starry Sky Sanctuary is your domain. I'm going to use it for a moment; see if you can perceive anything."
Ekaterina nodded, "Okay."
Talking playfully, Su Lun formed the sorcerer's seals with his hand and stretched it out.
It seemed like nothing had happened, no change at all.
But only he knew that his hand was surrounded by a special dark energy ripple.
He had tried before, even Mr. Jing and thousands like him could not perceive it at all.
He thought Ekaterina would be the same, but just as the power coalesced, she exclaimed in surprise, "I can sense it!"
Su Lun was pleased, "Oh?"
However, Ekaterina frowned and said, "But... it's something I completely fail to understand. I have detected a mysterious force that obliterated some things within my domain. It's like light being sucked into a black hole, disappearing in an instant."
Su Lun was quite surprised and laughed, "You are the only one who can sense the 'dark rules'."
But the moment he thought of that black hole, he suddenly had an idea—could it be that beneath the black hole lies the "Dark World" Sir Isaac hypothesized?
Ekaterina could use that power but could not understand it.
Isn't this just like himself?
He could wield the "God Slayer," but also did not understand the dark rules.
Ekaterina was also delighted, her eyes sparkling with excitement, as if her thoughts were whirling swiftly.
After pondering for a moment, she added, "Is this the counter to divine secrets? I think I've got some ideas!"
Listening, Su Lun was also filled with joy, "Really?"
He had thought that after he merged with the "God Profaner," these dark rules would become the unique pinnacle of mankind.
If a mortal could master it, wouldn't it mean that the Alchemical Plane would have another powerful force to pass down through legacy?
"Mm."
Ekaterina nodded earnestly and said, "I've remembered the feeling. It may take a very long time to understand. I feel that after I truly master that power, my world will be truly complete!"
Su Lun naturally understood that the dark rules could not be comprehended in a short time; even now, after such long research, he had just a trivial outcome.
He said, "There's no rush for this. Let's go out. The guards are probably quite anxious."
Ekaterina's expression became serious, "Okay!"
...
There was a battle to the north of Lingdun City, but it soon subsided; the ninth-tier Sage of Law who was making decoy moves was quickly surrounded and killed by the intelligence department.
The secret stronghold of the remnant believers of the Heavenly God Plane was also eradicated once again.
The news that Rose Manor had been attacked made little impact. No one would have thought that a demigod assassin had come and that the manor suffered no damage at all. The shadow guards also left the mansion quietly.
The manor returned to its peace.
It was as if nothing had happened at all.
Su Lun released Vivian from the little void realm; the girl was sleepy as it was her bedtime, so she was taken to her bedroom by her nanny.
Despite the slight interlude of an assassination, it seemed not to affect the atmosphere of the reunion.
They continued to talk, discussing literature, cultivation, life, and the girl... There seemed to be too many topics to cover.
Before they knew it, the moon had climbed above the treetops.
Suddenly, the careful inquiry of the maid Jessica came from outside the study.
"Miss, the bathwater is ready. Are you and the gentleman preparing to bathe?"
It was just like during that period in the past, this time of the evening was for bathing and rest.
Hearing this, Ekaterina was in no hurry to respond. Instead, she turned to look at Su Lun, smiled slightly, and asked, "Are you staying at the manor tonight?"
Su Lun looked at her and gladly said, "Yes, I would like that."

chapters.title: Chapter 669 - 668: Twilight of the Gods
chapters.content:
Su Lun spent the night resting at Rose Manor.
He was here to bid farewell, and now, it seemed that all his thoughts had become resolute.
He and Yekaterina were like long-lost friends reuniting, or lovers who had been separated for a long time, sharing a house as they once had, taking baths together, drinking wine, and chatting.
Whether it was the imperial emperor with grand strategies or the naively delightful poet Katusha, Su Lun felt that for him, they were irreplaceable people who gave meaning to his existence.
The next morning, Yekaterina left the manor early.
The mobilization had already been called the day before, and today she would lead a million well-prepared royal alchemy troops from the port to the Imperial Strait to participate in the ultimate battle.
The imperial emperor went to war himself, and the whole united empire was plunged into a tense atmosphere of warfare.
Su Lun didn't stay long in Lingdun either. After meeting with Sabina and Reyna, he visited Yuta in the Emerald Forest. Then he visited the Mountain Hermit in the north continents and saw the old friend Princess Shinfuku Mitsuko. Afterward, he directly headed to the Far West Dragon Kingdom Waters.
He was going to meet Queen Medusa because her ability would be the key breakthrough in the great battle.
...
Before he knew it, half a month had passed.
Imperial Strait, near the East Ronyesia islands.
Here, once the first coastal defense line of the Luying Empire, had now become the last line of defense to protect Luying Main Island from the gods' realm.
Within the several hundred miles of the frontline, more than ten million elite imperial troops had gathered. Various steel warships and mechanical airships formed battle groups, constantly bombarding eastward day and night.
One hundred miles away, the three grand empires of the divine realm had also assembled over seven million troops. Various magical airships shone with dazzling colors, a scene like a splendid rainbow across the horizon.
The two sides had been tugging at each other for nearly half a month.
The iron flood of the alchemy realm and the magical army of the divine realm were like two terrifying behemoths biting each other, the battle situation also intensifying.
However, since the divine realm was a complete realm with an unbroken heritage, which was much stronger than the alchemy realm. The number of high-level mages was also much greater than in the alchemy realm. While the three grand empires previously fought independently, giving rise to a tit-for-tat battle, now combined into one massive "Trident War God Formation," even the much larger assembled troops of the alchemy realm were continuously forced back.
Fortunately, fighting on their home ground, the imperial troops had ample ammunition supply, and they fought while retreating without being scattered.
Until now in the war, aside from skirmishes among scouting groups, almost no small troop battles had been seen.
It was like a clash between two knightly orders; tactics and strategies had minimal significance, and what really mattered now was the hard, bloodletting capabilities.
If the divine realm breached the East Ronyesia island defense line, it would then directly threaten the Luying homeland.
The two sides kept deadlocked in a tug of war.
This day, there was finally a change in the situation.
Because the elite imperial troops led by Emperor Yekaterina had arrived at the frontline.
Her arrival greatly boosted the morale of the millions of alchemy soldiers.
...
The people of the divine realm had actually received news half a month ago that the Alchemy Emperor was coming to the front.
They were also waiting for this moment.
In their view, if they could deal with the Alchemy Emperor on the sea, it would be much easier than breaking through Lingdun, which was armed to the teeth.
So, although they had the strength to push through, their advance was also deliberately slow.
In the azure sky, thousands of magical airships stretched over several miles.
The three empires split into three corps.
The yellow magic shield belonged to the Ascieden Empire's Sun Corps, the red magic shield belonged to the Golden Griffon Empire's Judgment Corps, and the blue light shield was the Holy Crown Empire's Thunder Corps.
The three forces advanced in a triangular formation towards the west.
If anyone familiar with military formations were present, they could tell at a glance that this was a 'Trident War God Formation.'
A legendary large-scale military formation capable of battling gods.
United as one, its structure stable, any attack on one side could be immediately supported by the other two sides.
This was a mature legion formation that had been deduced for countless years on the divine plane, with absolutely no flaws.
In the void, the cannons were deafening.
Alchemy bullets exploded on the outer protective shields of the airship fleet, bursting into flames before quickly extinguishing.
The mages on the airships had long grown accustomed to such sights.
This kind of super-large legion protective shield could resist a strike from a demigod—it simply wasn't something any human force could break through.
The bombardment did not cause much damage, its only purpose was to continuously deplete their supplies and magical stones.
However, this time the three great empires were fully prepared; even if they had to face the cannons head-on while heading to Lingdun, they had brought enough magical stones.
Just as the imperial legion led by Yekaterina was about to reach the frontline, the command layers of the three great empires in the divine plane also held an urgent meeting.
At that moment, in the command rooms on the main ships of the Trident War God Formation, the magic screens displayed the faces of the three commanders.
The overall commander from the Ascieden Empire was a blond, handsome young man, Crown Prince Gordon Fielding, the younger brother of Princess Octavia J. Fielding, who Su Lun and his group had killed previously.
Another magic screen showed a middle-aged sword mage in armor, the expedition marshal of the Golden Griffon Empire and demigod powerhouse, "Magic Sword God" Karlo Lankrisas.
The last one was an old mage wearing a magic hat, the court chief Magic God of the Holy Crown Empire, "Holy Thunder God of Law" Hogan Chapman.
As soon as the magic screens connected, the three began to discuss.
"Even the native emperor of the gold plane has arrived, so the decisive battle must be impending. Gentlemen, do you have anything to say?"
"The results of the war divination are getting more obscure. Among those alchemists, there seems to be someone blessed with the fate of the plane. That's not good news for us."
"What's the situation with 'Pestilence', Humphrey Johnston, the vice-president of the Black Magic Mercenary Guild? Didn't he say half a month ago that he had infiltrated Lingdun to assassinate that emperor? Now the emperor appears here and there's no word from him."
"Most likely dead."
"Humphrey wasn't weak. Even if his mission truly failed, how could there be no news at all?"
"I have already divined this before, the possibility of assassination success was very slim. Although the Alchemy plane has shattered, it still has a long legacy. Who knows what treasures those ancient alchemy powers left on this shattered plane…"
"Yes. It's probably some extremely powerful prohibitive treasure in Lingdun. It would make sense if Humphrey died there."
"Let's drop it. After all, it's just a mercenary who died. It also serves to weaken the strength of the Black Magic Guild."
"Indeed, now we need to consider how to conduct the decisive battle. Don't be careless; the annihilation of the previous million-strong legion was a lesson. The Alchemy plane also has its capable people…"
"…"
The three commanders proceeded to discuss in front of the magical screen.
Yet, it was clear to any onlooker that the three commanders were not in harmony.
After all, the three great empires were also attacking each other in the divine plane, inherently hostile relations.
They only joined forces to invade the Alchemy plane because the gods had issued a divine command.
Otherwise, they would not have launched campaigns independently before, only uniting now.
While speaking, the "Wind and Thunder Sword God" Karlo suddenly initiated a topic, scornfully saying, "Humph, just because your Ascieden can't fight the battle, doesn't mean our Golden Griffon Empire can't. It's just a shattered plane. I really can't understand how you couldn't conquer it, with such heavy losses? Even your sister Octavia actually died at the hands of a native..."
Upon hearing this, Crown Prince Gordon immediately got angry, "Karlo, what do you mean?"
Karlo responded lightly, "Prince Gordon, by seniority, you should call me 'Uncle Karlo' or 'Marshal Karlo'. Otherwise, it would seem very impolite."
A demigod powerhouse certainly wouldn't lack the nerve to merely engage in verbal sparring with a junior.
It was about splitting the spoils of war, where only the wolves would get to eat meat.
With such vast interests in the Alchemy plane at stake, politeness would only mean loss for oneself.
The cunning old marshal provoked the young prince, directly stating, "Just proceed according to the plan. His Majesty Luis intends for our Golden Griffon Empire to contribute the most troops and bring the most powerful forces. Once we crush the Alchemy plane, our empire needs six central provinces of Luying Main Island, including development rights for the capital, Lingdun."
Hearing this, Crown Prince Gordon immediately stood up in dissent, retorting, "Impossible! This is a plane discovered by our Ascieden! We also suffered the greatest losses in developing it! Most of Luying Mainland and Lingdun City must be taken over by our Ascieden!"
The reason they had previously divided their forces into three routes, aside from mutual hostility, was mainly because the interests had not been agreed upon.
Despite countless discussions on how to divide the cake, it never seemed to divide evenly.
Each party wanted the bigger share.
Until now, it remains the same.
Seeing that the two sides were about to argue even before the battle had started, the "Holy Thunder God of Law" of the Holy Crown Empire, Hogan, flashed a shrewd light in his eyes and suddenly said, "Gentlemen, with the battle imminent, continuing to argue is pointless. I think we can decide on the division of the final profits based on the number of enemies killed..."
Upon hearing this, the "Wind and Thunder Sword God," Carlo, also said, "Agreed!"
Both empires had brought their fully staffed elite forces, naturally more confident than the Ascieden Empire, which had lost a million troops just six months ago.
Although Prince Gordon was displeased, he couldn't say much.
At any time, strength was what gave one a voice – that was the truth.
Right before the battle, the command of the three great empires didn't discuss tactics but started planning how to divide up the Alchemy plane.
In their view, the magic legions already had an overwhelming advantage and absolutely could not be defeated.
He Zhen Shen had already descended into the plane channel, and even if the unimaginable occurred, no accident was possible.
...
Meanwhile,
Contrary to the enemy's underestimation, the situation was quite different with the joint empires' fleet.
The arrival of Yekaterina marked that the moment for the decisive battle had come.
The top combat power and elite legions of the Alchemy plane were nearly all assembled here.
This battle would determine the fate of the Alchemy plane.
While the three great empires of the Divine plane discussed how to split the Alchemy plane, an urgent meeting was being held in the command room of the Sky Castle.
Su Lun, Mr. Jing, Thousand, Yekaterina, Mr. Hei, Pandora, Bartolo, and Nineteen... high-ranking members of the Dawn Group gathered together.
In front of them, the war sand table, equipped with alchemy devices, projected the image of the enemy's fleet.
It was a triangle formation comprised of thousands of magic airships.
"This is the 'Trident War God Formation,' very stable, with a ninth-level TR-3 type magic energy spiderweb barrier; the farther the attack, the stronger the defense. Unless the energy is exhausted or there is a sudden close combat approach, it's impossible to break through external force..."
Su Lun, the most knowledgeable about the Divine plane, was explaining the features of the battle formation to the group.
"The key to this formation is the connections between the three sides; if one side is attacked, the other two will provide timely support. If we really want to confront, we must break their stable structure. I will charge with my senior sister and try to cripple one legion in a short time. The rest will depend on you all..."
He carefully continued, and everyone nodded without interruption.
This wasn't a discussion but a tactical arrangement.
This grand final battle involved too much, and the Dawn's high command had almost guessed that divine beings from the Divine plane were paying attention to this battle.
Thus, many plans could not be explicitly stated.
Everyone unspokenly understood to follow Su Lun's arrangements and simply do their part.
Though everyone was aware of the great risks, all were prepared to die in this battle.
"Dora, you control the ship's island and prepare to release 'Twilight of the Gods'; you must hit the enemy's command center accurately."
"Yes, no problem!"
"Katyusha, the first wave of attack depends on you."
"Alright!"
"Mr. Hei, after I charge in, the enemy will surely interfere with my Puppetry Theater. The Dragon Language Magician Group must seize the opportunity to destroy the enemy legion's magic conduits."
"Yes!"
"Nineteen, you lead the mechanical warrior troops to prepare; no matter the cost, you must break the magic shields of the other two million legions."
"Yes! Mission guaranteed!"
"Thousand, Elder Bartolo, Mr. Kamur, Miss Masia... once the legions engage in melee, lead the ninth rank and above to restrain the enemy demigods..."
"No problem!"
"After breaking the formation, everyone push forward with full force!"
"..."
Su Lun issued command after command.
The crowd responded solemnly, one by one.
In this grand final battle, almost no one knew the complete battle plan except for Su Lun himself.
But everyone's beliefs were incredibly steadfast.
They had absolute trust in Su Lun and a sure heart of victory for this grand final battle!
...
"All troops, charge!"
After arranging the tactics, the allied imperial legions issued the charge command.
In the blink of an eye, thousands of warships sailed out from the defense lines, numerous steam airships appeared in the sky, and submarines emerged from the sea.
Their numbers were so vast and dense like a school of sardines.
The warships assembled into squadrons, and squadrons into super battle formations, their momentum fierce.
The Alchemy Legion did not retreat eastward again, but charged full speed toward the west, picking up pace.
Aboard the ships, the warriors, solemn-faced, operated the alchemy cannons and unleashed an unprecedented barrage of ammunition at the enemy.
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"..."
This barrage held nothing back.
It was not only conventional shells; even those costly high-capacity alchemy shells stored in the warehouse were fired from various cannons regardless of cost.
The first round of shelling was itself ten times, a hundred times stronger than any previous fire coverage!
This was the grand final battle.
If they were to lose this battle, having any stock left would be meaningless.
The alchemy shells poured down like a torrential rain toward the magic airships of the Divine Plane.
The cannons had longer range than magic, and even before the two armies could see each other, the first round of artillery had already hit the Divine Plane's magic airship fleet.
"Crackle...crackle...crackle..."
Countless alchemy shells exploded on the energy shields, bursting forth with firework-like colorful splendor.
Although the army's magic shields were not broken, the barrage caused countless magic airships to violently tremble. Many magic devices overloaded and became damaged, and the technicians frantically made repairs.
After this round of artillery, the Mages of the Divine Plane knew that the Alchemy Plane meant serious business.
"Sir! The natives from the Alchemy Plane have launched a full assault!"
Commanders from the three great empires also arrived immediately outside the airships.
However, upon seeing the sky full of incoming shells, rather than surprise, their faces showed a satisfaction as if things were going according to plan.
"Ha, among these natives, there's actually a capable one who knows only close combat holds a chance in the 'Trident War God Formation', choosing the only tactic with a possibility of victory—a direct charge..."
"Probably still thinking of that ambush tactic from last time, teleporting over to disrupt the structure of our forces, and then charging with all troops. Heh, really thought we couldn't handle them... This time, whoever it is, is undoubtedly doomed."
"That Puppetry Technician is indeed troublesome; he has a divine-grade spatial artifact, very slippery. Tsk tsk, whoever kills him will claim that treasure."
"Hmph! Just hope he dares to come."
"..."
They were quite aware that once such a large-scale battalion charged, it was impossible to change direction.
That is to say, unless they changed direction immediately, a collision between the two sides was inevitable.
But when the three great empires of the divine realm gathered such forces, they were intent on crushing the Alchemy realm.
Previously, while the "Alchemy natives" were fighting and retreating, there was no chance to annihilate them completely.
Now, they were finally set for a head-on collision. How could they miss this opportunity?
"Everyone, all troops, attack!"
"All legions prepare legion magic; sink those natives' ships!"
"Legion magic devices, gather magic power, open the spatial restrictions..."
"..."
Upon an order, the magic legions of the divine realm also faced the cannons and sailed toward the west.
Although they felt certain of victory over the Alchemy realm in their minds, tactically, the experienced commanders of the three great empires didn't underestimate their enemy at all. They arranged various tactics, protecting the airship fleet tightly.
...
Aboard the sky fortress, Su Lun stood in the observation room of the watchtower, watching the distant scene.
Beside him, besides Mr. Jing, there was also a mysterious person covered with a black cloak.
At that moment, waves as high as a hundred meters surged on the sea, the enemy legion's Tsunami Technique affecting countless steel warships floating on the sea.
Even the most advanced aiming systems had extremely low accuracy in such a violently tossing environment.
It was not just the sea surface; at the moment, the surrounding hundred miles were engulfed in an apocalyptic, extremely adverse environment.
Thunderclouds pressed down from the sky, and hurricanes blew chaotically.
The wind was so strong that it could toss some small airships around like kites with snapped strings.
One had to admit, Mages truly had superior control over the elements compared to Alchemists.
Especially in the realm of legion magic, the legions of the Alchemy realm were still quite lacking.
If it were a regular fleet, in such an extremely harsh environment, it would likely have suffered heavy losses before even getting close.
However, fortunately, Alchemy can create miracles.
The sky fortress and most of the airships were equipped with the most advanced large-scale energy recycling systems. No matter how big the storm, they could convert it into other forms of energy.
This fierce storm not only didn't hinder their marching speed, but the rich elemental power also added some energy to the fleet.
The three of them just stood in the observation room without saying a word.
Both legions charged forward at full speed.
Before long, the shadows of the magic legions appeared on the horizon.
Alchemy shells rained down densely on the magical shields, igniting bursts of firelight, like brief and fleeting flowers.
Su Lun's eyes reflected the intense explosions, calm and profound.
It was only after both sides could see each other that they entered the range for long-distance magic release.
Previously, relying on their range advantage, it had always been the cannons on the battleships overpowering the magic legions.
Now, the Mages had also begun their maneuvers.
With the All-knowing Eye, Su Lun could even clearly see the faces of the Mages on the magic airships. At that moment, he watched as the legion magic barriers on those magic airships lit up.
Seven million—seven hundred legions of ten thousand each, and countless various legion magic devices, they already possessed the ability to destroy heaven and earth.
Just as Su Lun looked over, a lightning bolt thick as a water tank struck over. It was the ninth-tier long-range legion forbidden spell, "Punishment of the Thunder God."
The lightning bolt came from a large magic airship; the legion flag on it bore the pattern of "Lightning and Crown"—the royal emblem of the Crown Imperial Empire.
The Crown Imperial Empire, rich in lightning Mages, had a powerful tradition of thunder magic.
Su Lun watched, his eyes showing no surprise.
His gaze was eagle-like, focusing ahead.
Not just his own pair of eyes, but hundreds of black crows in the sky had already flown in every direction, taking in the entire structure of the divine realm's legions.
And in his mind, the "God Profaner" was operating rapidly, deducing various combat scenarios.
Right after the first flash of lightning, a "crackling" thunder illuminated the entire sky.
Several hundred magic airships released their legion curses simultaneously, creating a scene like the apocalypse, instantly turning everything into a flash of white light.
Lightning woven into a net gave the allied empire's fleet a baptism.
But Su Rian's ironclad battleships and steam airships all had magic guiding runes, yet being metal, they attracted the electricity even more.
These hundreds of strikes, deemed capable of ninth-level magic power, "Punishment of the Thunder God," also made the entire fleet tremble.
The sky fortresses had pieces of the "Divine Artifact · Thunder Lance," making them immune to even the strongest electric magic. However, the smaller vessels were not so fortunate.
Even with the protection of legion barriers, after this round of legion magic, dozens of airships were severely damaged, and a few crashed into the sea, resulting in immediate casualties.
And it wasn't just the lightning, following closely were the "Apocalypse Storm," "Meteor Fire Cloud," "Holy Light Judgment," "Dark Canopy"... etc., a series of ninth-level legion curses followed one after another.
At sea, colossal whirlpools formed, and several thousand-kilometer-tall "Sea Giants" also emerged.
Each warship in these stormy seas looked like a small boat that could capsize at any moment, offering no sense of security at all.
Mr. Hei also organized the Dragon Language Magicians to retaliate, while the Royal Legion's magicians began their counterattack... In the sky, gigantic alchemy formations materialized.
The two sides, separated by the void, began a fierce magical bombardment.
In a blink, the elements within this part of the world started boiling, turning the sky into a hellish dark red.
War opened the gates of hell, giving everyone plunged into battle a terrifying experience like never before.
It was as if Death itself was looming behind, ready to claim the lives of everyone at any moment.
...
The two legions were still charging fiercely, continuously bombarding each other, their distance growing ever closer.
But clearly, in this magic bombardment, the gods' plane of magic legions held the upper hand.
Mages have a more finely honed understanding of magic power than alchemists do.
The defensive capabilities of legion magic shields were even stronger than ironclad battleships; seven million mages against ten million alchemy troops not only held their ground but also managed a divide of twenty-eighty!
The alchemy plane suffered eighty percent casualties, whereas the gods' plane suffered only twenty percent!
And this was just the beginning, both legions still intact.
To clash head-on was inevitably like an egg striking a rock.
The "Trident War God Formation" acted like a triple-bladed military spike, sharp and deadly.
This was also the confidence of the gods' plane to engage in a head-on collision!
One by one, airships were falling, warships sinking, the casualties of the allied fleet escalating.
Yet Commander Su Lun still took no action.
This distance was not yet enough!
They needed to get even closer!
The sky fortress, against the barrage of firepower, charged ahead as steam airships fell around it.
Finally!
When the allied fleet had lost hundreds of warships, the moment arrived!
Su Lun's eyes narrowed sharply, and he suddenly issued a command, "Katyusha, make your move!"
Then he added, "Dora, 'Twilight of the Gods' charge up ready!"
From the communicator came simultaneous replies, "Yes!"
Just with that command, at this very moment, on the heavily protected "Royal Airship One," Ekaterina stood within a gigantic alchemy formation.
Around the alchemy formation were nine massive crystal columns, inscribed with countless stars.
Within the alchemy formation, mountains of energy crystal cores had already accumulated.
Adorned in celestial nebulae, Ekaterina formed a magician's seal and shouted fiercely, "Astrology Alchemy · Ten Thousand Stars Traction!"
As soon as the seal was made, the enormous alchemy formation's light surged, slowly absorbing countless streams of energy.
Ekaterina's eyes were already filled with stars, controlling that energy exaggerated to the extreme.
In an instant, that vast power converged into an endless force of stars within the formation.
Suddenly, she looked up into the sky, as if through the dark clouds, she sensed a star in the universe responding to her call.
Ekaterina's aura rapidly soared, even the airship was distorted and deformed by that terrifying force.
Suddenly, responding to a star that had been drawn months before, she rapidly formed another set of magician's seals, shouting, "Divine Art · Red Emperor!"
....
Such massive energy fluctuations were surely noticed by the divine realm instantly.
The mages also saw, amidst the steam airship fleet, a burst of blinding white light shooting into the sky, disappearing into the boundless depths of space.
"What's that situation!"
"Be careful, it seems to be a divine-grade astrological technique!"
"Quick, disperse the clouds!"
"..."
However, even if the mages could understand it, they could no longer stop it.
Because this was an irreversible alchemy technique.
Just as that white light shot into the sky, not long after, a burst sound suddenly rang beside their ears, growing clearer and louder.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh...
Upon closer listening, it seemed like the sound of a meteorite rubbing against the air, mixed with explosive noises.
But because the sky was filled with dark clouds, everyone couldn't see clearly what it was.
Countless people looked up, and as the mages dispersed the dark clouds, that was when they saw a meteor trailing a long tail plummeting down from the sky.
No!
Not a meteorite!
But a small star!
A tiny supernova just miles in size!
The fleet of seven million mages stretched over dozens of miles, completely unable to avoid it.
This is the downside of large-scale troop movement, possessing great combat power while also being unable to turn around or disperse!
Were these alchemical natives willing to perish together?
The commanders from the divine realm were terrified out of their wits.
If such a meteorite were to accelerate and fall like this, hundreds of miles of sea area would become a wasteland.
Not to mention them, the alchemical realm's fleet was equally doomed to disaster.
This was not a level of energy humans could resist.
This was a power capable of destroying the world!
"Are there still such powerful beings among the alchemical natives?"
The mages had not expected this at all.
Because they knew very well, to mobilize a star of this magnitude was definitely not something a demigod could accomplish.
Who could it be?
At this moment, it was already too late to investigate.
The natives might wish to "perish together," but they certainly did not.
"Prepare Legion Magic, shatter that meteor!"
Crown Prince Gordon, "Wind and Thunder Sword God" Karlo, "Holy Thunder God of Law" Hogan, the three great commanders of the three great empires bellowed in unison, and countless legion magic spells turned direction, bombarding towards the giant meteor in the sky.
At that moment, these battle-hardened leaders felt they had discerned the natives' intentions.
Karlo narrowed his eyes, "Hmph! The technique isn't bad, but thinking to restrain us with this is far too naive!"
Crown Prince Gordon, "Even if we gave them the chance to come closer, they still wouldn't stand a chance!"
"Holy Thunder God of Law" Hogan: "Be careful, divination makes me feel an inexplicable danger. It seems like something terrifying is about to happen..."
....
The meteor was incredibly fast, but after all, it was too far away.
In that instant, countless magics roared toward the meteor in the sky.
In the sky, numerous fragments exploded, turning into a sky full of fire rain, which fell onto the sea.
In the end, even though the extremely fast meteor hit the magic legion, it caused hardly any casualties. At least, the Trident War God Formation was still intact.
It seemed, the meteor that had just brought hope to the alchemy plane, vanished in this spectacular explosion, even mistakenly injuring numerous mechanical airships and warships.
However.
Su Lun's plan was far more than this.
With his current calculating ability, how could he not have figured out that even if that meteor fell, it wouldn't cause significant damage?
Seven million mage legion was completely capable of easily destroying the meteor.
Indeed, the meteor would take some of the firepower, but that wasn't Su Lun's ultimate goal.
Instead, it was to use the opportunity provided by Yekaterina's meteor fall to cover up the noise of "Twilight of the Gods."
Just as the meteor exploded in the sky and everyone's attention was drawn there, nobody noticed the steel walls of the sky fortress 'clicking' and 'clicking' quietly opening up, revealing a giant cannon barrel.
It was a super massive cannon spanning the entire fortress.
This was no ordinary cannon.
It was the secret weapon—"Twilight of the Gods"—created from the ancient weapon blueprints found in the Zheng Gorgon Temple.
It possessed the power to slay gods!
In that blink of an eye, the alchemy runes on the cannon were already fully lit, and the energy was fully charged.
"Fire!"
At Su Lun's command, the cannon barrel suddenly erupted with an eerie shockwave invisible to the naked eye.
It was like a misfire, with nobody seeing what was actually launched, but the entire sky fortress trembled violently from a huge recoil force.
But in another blink, a miraculous scene occurred.
The defensive shield of the magic legion, which had just withstood the meteor fall unscathed, suddenly showed a hole, utterly silently.
How did it appear?
It was as if haunted, nobody felt any energy fluctuations, yet it just mysteriously broke.
The mages hadn't yet understood what had happened; staring agape at the breach on the magic shield.
Upon closer inspection, the command airship of the most bustling Holy Crown Empire's legion also had a hole pierced through it, spanning several meters in diameter.
The loss was minimal, but once the command was broken... that perfect defensive structure was now breached!
....
"Take action!"
Su Lun eyed the big hole blasted in the enemy's Trident War God Formation and softly shouted.
Without waiting for the enemy to react, with a flash of spatial disturbance, he, Mr. Jing, and the cloaked mysterious person decisively vanished from the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 670 - 669: The Epic Battle
chapters.content:
"What's going on?"
The commanders of the three great magic empires were completely befuddled.
Looking at the hole around ten meters in diameter that had been pierced through the Thunder Legion's fleet, everyone was filled with astonishment.
Was that some kind of shockwave that just passed through? But no one had observed it.
They couldn't fathom what power, other than that of the gods, could so easily puncture a defense formation of a million-strong legion.
Moreover, the location of the hole was precisely targeted, hitting right at the pivot point of the battle formation's barrier.
It was then that they realized, among these people from the Alchemy plane, there wasn't only someone who knew of the "Trident War God Formation," but mastered it! He had seen through the constantly changing "barrier node."
How terrifying was this observational power?
The fact that this shot had accurately hit the shifting pivot point, what an exaggerated feat of trajectory calculation was that?
Although the breach wasn't big enough to render the formation entirely ineffective, a large area around the hole could no longer be covered by magic power, and it was impossible to repair in a short time.
This created a huge vulnerability within an otherwise impenetrable battle formation.
In other words, if someone wanted to breach their defenses, this was the best opportunity.
The commanders from the Demigod plane were all seasoned warriors who realized this without hesitation; they instinctively roared out a warning, "Be careful, the enemy is going to break through!"
They might have been shocked,
but the emergency plans of a million-strong legion were sufficient to handle any unexpected situations.
In that instant, the emergency mage group had acted, deploying control, disruption, execution... A series of combined magic attacks were already executed.
All preparations made, even if a demigod were to approach, they would inevitably be annihilated on the spot!
...
It was normal for those guys from the Demigod plane to not understand how that "hole" was made.
The ammunition loaded into the "Twilight of the Gods" ancient demonic energy cannon was "Zosimus Dark Matter." The energy blast it released was also an undetectable dark energy fluctuation to human senses.
Dark energy, dark matter bombs, and the sinister rules of the "God Slayer."
Su Lun had already come across three similar concepts.
Because they were unobservable, even he didn't know what differentiated them. But judging from their different release methods and forms, he could deduce that they were distinct entities.
It was probably like the difference between elemental energy, laws, and rules in the regular world.
Those things from the dark world realm were indescribable.
And now, in the midst of a decisive battle, there was no need for the "Twilight of the Gods" to remain hidden.
Just as expected, this secret weapon fired a shot that pierced through the enemy's million-strong legion defensive shield.
However, this ancient artifact needed a long time to accumulate energy, so it couldn't be used as a conventional weapon for frequent firing.
Seeing the right moment, Su Lun had already teleported over.
A flicker of spatial fluctuation.
By the recently breached command center of the Holy Crown Empire, a figure in a black robe stepped out.
The mages from the Demigod plane instantly locked onto the target.
With a presence, a soul, a demigod expert... he must be slain instantly!
"Focus fire!"
Without any surprises, as soon as the black-robed person showed his face, without waiting for "him" to take any action, the legion's magic had already restrained him on the spot. Then, a destructive magic surge abruptly erupted, poised to turn him into dust on the spot.
However, what everyone failed to notice was that the skin of the black-robed person was covered in viral pustules, and there was a candle-like sheen on the surface of his skin.
When he had arrived, the magic power within him was already surging like a volcano.
Even without any external forces, it would have exploded on its own.
This was naturally not Su Lun himself, but a Plague God of Law who had been killed in Lington half a month ago.
He had made this person into a living corpse wax figure, and when he had stuffed it into the spatial rift, he had also cast the strongest curse plague magic known to this individual - the Black Death Plague.
The self-explosion of a mage of law, what tremendous power was that?
It was not just the uncontrolled explosion of magic power at a tenfold magnitude, the plague contamination was the greatest threat.
This was a contamination that even ninth-tier mages would go to great lengths to avoid.
Moreover, Su Lun had specifically inscribed void runes on the wax figure to prevent its exploding flesh from being constrained by conventional spatial techniques.
It would be like a volcanic eruption, sending a shower of plague-infested flesh into the sky.
...
"Boom!"
The black-robed person burst apart.
The mages from the Demigod plane thought they had instantly slain a formidable enemy, but before they could celebrate, they saw the flesh pieces enveloped in a foul wind sweeping through the entire Holy Crown Empire's command center.
The mages were collectively taken aback.
What's going on?
The explosion wasn't contained?
As the supreme commander of the Holy Crown Empire, the 'Holy Thunder God of Law' Hogan Chapman saw the dark red power of laws within the flesh and suddenly realized who the black-robed person was. His expression changed drastically as he shouted, "No good, that's 'Plague God' Humphrey Johnston's curse! Get away from it!"
However, it was already too late.
The flesh burst apart, and the nearby high-ranking mages were too preoccupied to stop it, instantly contaminating the space for several miles around.
Bits and pieces of flesh splattered everywhere with a crackling sound.
Landing on the airship, it corroded like strong acid, hissing and emitting nauseating noxious fumes.
And those contaminated chunks of flesh that splattered on the mages meant instant death for those below the eighth rank. Even those defended by magical shields found that the laws of corruption wielded by a demigod penetrated easily.
With the wind's blow, the stench of plague carried for miles, filling the air with the scent of death.
This wave alone claimed the lives of hundreds of elite commanders.
And that wasn't the worst of it.
Once the plague began to spread, the death toll would multiply exponentially in a short period.
"This is high-level plague magic! Quickly purify and disperse it!"
"Isolate the explosion area immediately!"
"..."
The commanders of the Ascieden Empire were in a state of panic.
Compared to other kinds of magic, plague magic was almost the last thing they wanted to encounter.
The reason why plague mages were despised by the orthodox magical system of the divine realms was precisely because their methods were too disgusting and left endless troubles.
This type of plague magic could affect an area for years or even centuries.
There was once a notorious plague mage in a kingdom who released plague magic in a city's rat den, which led to centuries of epidemic diseases in that kingdom and over a million deaths.
It single-handedly drove a powerful kingdom to its downfall.
Now that a Plague God of Law had exploded within an army of a million, they could cause severe casualties over time without even needing to fight.
The most correct response was isolation and then purification.
However, the area covered by the explosion was not small, and complete isolation would cause a significant gap in the previously unified war formation of the legion.
A dam is sturdy because every stone plays a vital role.
Missing one is a weakness.
In this way, the countless cannons in the distance would be able to focus their fire on this breakthrough point!
And that was indeed the case.
Almost the instant after the robed figure exploded, countless alchemical projectiles had already poured down. The already chaotic command center became even more desperate.
But the worst was yet to come.
....
Having just been hit by an unexpected attack and now this, the commanders of the Ascieden Empire's million-strong legion immediately sensed that something terrible was afoot.
Because they immediately realized that this was a clear tactic of "feint to the east, attack in the west."
Now their first round of strongest emergency measures had been used on dealing with this self-destructing puppet.
That meant the real enemy was about to arrive.
As expected!
Right at the moment the Plague God of Law self-destructed, another location where the Ascieden Empire's legion had been breached showed spatial fluctuations.
This time, three figures emerged from the spatial crack.
The million-strong battle groups had foolproof magic restrictions for energy identification, and the levels of response varied depending on the type of enemy invasion. Those fancy tricks were useless.
Su Lun had no second demigod wax figure to use.
They had come in person.
The strength of the Trident War God Formation lies in its three cores, which allowed it to continue support fire from the other two even if one was under attack and unable to defend itself.
As soon as Su Lun and his companions landed, they triggered the magical lock-on once again.
Not only the Ascieden Empire's Thunder Legion but also the Sun Legion of the Ascieden Empire and the Judgement Legion of the Golden Gryphon Empire provided support. A variety of magical instruments emitted beams of magical light in an instant.
Even though Su Lun now possessed pinnacle-level combat power of the plane, his arrival was met by rising goosebumps, as the sense of danger from all around was as intense as needle pricks.
All kinds of curse-level magic attacks came at them from all sides, unavoidable.
Whoever rushed in, died!
...
Clearly, after Su Lun and his team used this tactic to eliminate a million-strong legion last time, the enemy had learned from the experience.
This was a strategy specifically designed against them.
Su Lun had also long anticipated this.
Under normal circumstances, the only chance for survival now would be to immediately use the Space-Time Ring of Urobolos to escape.
But after teleporting in, he ignored the curse-level magic coming from all sides and started forming sorcerer's seals autonomously, "Ultimate Secret Art: Grand Puppet World!"
Just like before, strands of thread emerged from his body.
He still intended to use the same old trick, first taking control of the nearby airships' magic controllers.
As for the rest, that was up to the two beside him!
In that moment of grave danger, the cloaked figure next to Su Lun suddenly flung open his cloak, revealing an extraordinarily beautiful face.
Yet, what was eerie was that this beautiful face was crowned with a head full of ferocious snake hair. Among these, nine golden serpent hairs shimmered brilliantly, imbuing them with a divine sanctity akin to that of gods, yet also a fiendish evil that contrasted starkly.
This was none other than Queen Medusa!
Not only did she have a demigod's lineage, but her strength was also that of a demigod.
"Swoosh!"
It was the moment she unveiled her cloak that her amber snake eyes and the divine glow of her snake hair flashed, suddenly bursting forth with a gray light.
This was the divine-grade innate technique of the Medusa clan—Petrification Curse!
And it was the Gaze of the Queen.
An eerie scene immediately unfolded.
As the gray petrification light spread, everything around it turned to the gray of limestone.
Be it magic, airships, energy fluctuations... all fell into utter silence.
It was as though this part of the world had been paused.
Aside from the three individuals including Su Lun, the rest was shrouded in darkness.
With just one glance, Queen Medusa directly petrified the sweeping magical curse on the spot, instantly resolving the crisis.
"It worked!"
Su Lun felt a surge of elation within him; the most dangerous wave had passed.
His gamble had paid off, and he now held the winning ticket.
When they first met, he didn't understand what level the Petrification Curse was at, and why it could restrain everything.
But now, with his current level of insight, he recognized it as a "Rule of the Earth" that only deities could wield.
With Medusa's demigod-level strength, the suppression of her higher being's bloodline, plus the bolstering of ancient divine power from her nine golden hairs, it could be said that she could petrify nearly anything below divine level.
...
"No, it's Medusa! Don't look into her eyes!"
The high-ranking mages from the heavenly plane also recognized the unique image of Medusa with her serpent hair.
However, their shouts were meaningless.
Within the range of the curse's light, any mage who saw Medusa's true face had their eyes turn instantly to the color of gray limestone. Then the gray white power of the curse swiftly spread throughout their bodies, turning them into statues in the blink of an eye.
The ally Su Lun had brought with him blocked the fatal attack on his behalf, buying precious time, while Su Lun himself swiftly alternated the sorcerer's seals and the brightness of the nine-pointed star formation at his feet increased.
However, powerful as Medusa was, she was still only a demigod.
And although the Petrification Curse was insoluble, it, like any technique, required intervals between uses.
The greater its power and range of effect, the longer it took to release.
Just now, Medusa had charged up her gaze to ward off the sky full of magic and even turned thousands of magicians to stone. But such an extensive Petrification Curse could not be maintained indefinitely.
Yet, the three major magical legions of the heavenly plane were not equipped with only one set of emergency plans.
Seeing the sudden turn of events here, the Grand Commander of the Holy Crown Empire, "Holy Thunder God of Law" Hogan, didn't even care about the spreading plague in the distance. He personally wielded his magic wand and released a forbidden-grade thunder magic.
The Expeditionary Marshal of the Golden Gryphon Empire, "Wind and Thunder Sword God" Karlo, roared, "Concentrate fire, take out those three first!"
Prince Gorden of the Ascieden Empire, who had initially wanted to watch the Holy Crown Empire fail, also did not dare delay, issuing the command, "Take them out!"
The commanders of the three great empires were very clear that they absolutely could not allow the puppetry magician's alchemy to succeed, or else they would follow in the footsteps of that earlier million-strong army.
When the first wave of attacks failed to eliminate the three who had teleported over, the second wave of magical barrage was already descending.
Even if Medusa were even stronger, she couldn't possibly release another large-scale Petrification Curse so soon after having just unleashed one with her full strength.
If they were to be engulfed by this second wave of magic, Su Lun and his two companions would surely not survive.
However, at that moment, a miracle occurred once again.
As the sky filled with magic surged towards them, Medusa's face was cold as she continued to accumulate magic power, with no signs of hastily dealing with the situation.
On the other side, Mr. Jing made his move.
His long-prepared sorcerer's seal was finally complete, and with a light shout, he declared, "Divine Art: All-Encompassing Replication!"
That Queen Medusa was able to block the previous barrage of magic was entirely due to her racial talent.
She could, but that didn't mean others could as well.
A magical legion of a million-strong was enough to cause any demigod to meet their end right then and there.
Let alone seven or eight hundred million!
But what no one expected happened.
As Mr. Jing's sorcerer's seal took effect, instead of using any alchemy, a flash appeared in front of him, and faintly, an image with snake hair just like Medusa's could be seen. In a flash, that mirror image's snake hair released the same gray light as Queen Medusa's had just moments before!
"Swoosh!"
The scene seemed to replay itself, the gray light released in a wide area, and everything around turned to a gray white petrified color.
Mr. Jing had used his mirroring ability to perfectly replicate Queen Medusa's Petrification Curse!
The barrage of magic that filled the sky crashed into the range of the gray light and was petrified.
In the distance, the mages who witnessed this scene widened their eyes in disbelief: Can it really be done like this?
Medusas were already a rare mythological race.
Legend has it that a plane would only give birth to one Medusa queen.
It was one thing for her to have blocked a round of attacks just now.
But now she could also replicate herself with mirrors?
Before they could express their surprise, Mr. Jing split into three, instantly creating three mirror clones and protecting Su Lun.
Their alternating defense was already enough to buy him more time.
Meanwhile, aboard the various ships of the allied fleet, Yekaterina, Senajo, Mr. Hei, Number Nineteen, Bartolo... and all the others were invigorated and then overjoyed!
They did not know the detailed plan of the battle, and though a few might have guessed that Queen Medusa would come, none had anticipated the tactics Su Lun and the other two had employed to block the two deadly waves of attacks.
"Boss is mighty! Mr. Su Lun is dominating! Hahaha..."
"Charge!"
The allied fleet was in an uproar.
The plan they had discussed before hinged on this crucial moment.
If Su Lun and his two companions could hold their ground within the enemy fleet, it meant it was time for a charge!
...
"Success!"
The precious time that Queen Medusa and Mr. Jing had bought by blocking those two deadly attacks was enough for Su Lun to gather the formations.
Innumerable threads emitting from his body had quietly pierced into the various control cabins of the Ascieden Empire's Thunder Legion.
Using the old method he had used before, Su Lun instantly commandeered the command of hundreds of magic flying ships near the Thunder Legion's headquarters using the threads and his spatial ability!
In an instant, all sorts of magical lights went out, and the defense restrictions were lifted.
The alchemical cannonballs, which could previously only explode outside the magic light shields, now fell one by one, blasting apart the flying ships!
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"..."
The splendid alchemical fireworks exploded inside the enemy legion for the first time.
The three great magic legions of the divine plane, akin to three lighthouses, now had one instantly extinguished.
More importantly, the stable structure of the Trident War God Formation was broken, and the defense was immediately reduced by more than half. The other two legions could only fight on their own now.
Without the threat of a million-tier legion formation, the pressure on Su Lun and the other two plummeted instantaneously.
Not far away, the "Holy Thunder God of Law" Hogan Chapman and a host of high-ranking magicians from the Ascieden Empire tried to charge in to stop Su Lun and his two companions, but they had already missed the best opportunity!
They were all demigods, how could they let themselves be instantly slain?
As long as they drag out the time, the balance of victory would start to tilt towards the alchemy plane.
Mr. Jing and Queen Medusa once again withstood several deadly attacks; although it was tough, it was still much easier compared to the first two waves.
And at this point, there was no need to hold out any longer.
Because Su Lun was ready!
He controlled the magic flying ships to attack each other and, seizing the moment when the enemy was plunged into chaos, quickly pulled out a series of spatial scrolls and barked, "Release!"
Boom, boom, boom...
The alchemical scrolls burst open, and tens of thousands of gargoyle puppets appeared in the air. They formed into a spherical formation, surrounding Su Lun and the other two tightly.
With the puppet army out, Su Lun also took a long breath of relief.
With or without puppets, his combat power was of two different concepts!
Now with the gargoyle protection, even if there were a million enemies around, Su Lun felt no fear.
"Thud!"
"Thud!"
"Thud!"
"..."
Countless spells were cast, but all were blocked by the gargoyle army.
These hundred thousand were high-grade alchemical golems made of pure activated silver; simply in terms of material, their immunity to magic was nearly 100%.
And after forming into the structurally stable spherical formation, how could they be easily broken?
Within the puppet barrier, Mr. Jing and Queen Medusa took the opportunity to catch their breath, while Su Lun's sorcerer's seals transformed again, conjuring a massive cross in the sky above.
A hundred thousand gargoyles were far from enough.
To control even more, he needed to perform the Super "Puppet Theatre"!
...
As the alchemical cross in the sky grew larger, the magicians of the divine plane turned pale with shock.
They had previously heard rumors from intelligence reports that the alchemy plane had a Puppet Master who could match a million-man legion, but many did not believe it.
Only now, seeing it with their own eyes, did they realize the horror!
The gargoyle puppets were truly outrageous, essentially the bane of mages.
Just a hundred thousand was already troublesome enough, how could they let him create even more?
"Quick! Disrupt his Puppetry Technique!"
"At all costs, kill the Puppet Master first!"
"..."
The mages knew the seriousness of the situation and wanted to immediately deal with Su Lun and his two companions who had broken into the center of the battlefield.
However, Su Lun and his companions were not fighting alone.
As soon as he had broken through the barrier of the Holy Crown Empire's Thunder Legion, countless cannons had already targeted the legion, raining down cannonballs like a torrential downpour.
The artillery barrage left those ten-thousand-strong mage formations completely unable to care for themselves.
And Su Lun had made arrangements well in advance.
Without the interference of the magical barrier, Mr. Hei leading a two-hundred-thousand-strong Dragonspeak Magician Battalion from afar also unleashed alchemy of the forbidden spell level!
Their purpose was not to kill the enemy but to prevent the enemy from disrupting Su Lun's Puppetry Technique.
While the legion tactics of the Alchemy plane truly weren't on par with those of the Divine plane, the Dragonspeak Magician Battalion was the strongest magician battalion of the Alchemy plane. And with the enhancement of the superb war fortress, the Sky Battle Castle, it could be said that at this moment, no mage battalion of equal size from the Divine plane could compare to them.
Elemental Stealing, Magic Power Interference, Rule Distorting, Space Light Kill Cannon...
Wherever there was activity, Mr. Hei and the Dragonspeak Magician Battalion would certainly greet them with a forbidden spell.
And Makamul the centaur was there too!
This demigod archer was now playing a tremendous role.
With the absolutely safe output environment provided by the Sky Battle Castle, he became the nightmare of any mage.
Without the protection of a legion's magical shields, one arrow fired and there would certainly be an eighth or ninth-rank Sage of Law dead on the spot!
Just the sight of him firing one arrow after another terrified the high-ranking mages of the Holy Crown Empire so much that they hastily sought cover and dared not show their heads.
This also gave Su Lun more time.
Without the protection of a million-strong legion's shields, it was quite literally a knife fight.
It wasn't just long-range attacks; the Combined Empire's fleet had already launched a full-scale charge.
With the protective shield of the Holy Crown Empire broken by Su Lun's three-man squad, it created an excellent breach. As long as they could break through, then when the battle came down to melee and mixed fighting, the advantage of the mages would vanish, and the mechanical warriors would rule the field!
