Even if steam airships and steel battleships exploded and perished under magic, and tens of thousands of soldiers died in magical attacks, the men of the Empire charged fearlessly towards the Divine plane mage battalions, determined to fight to the death.
They were sacrificing their lives to relieve the pressure on Su Lun's side.
Everyone was clear; the closer the distance, the greater their chances of victory would be!
And at that moment, the cross in the sky had already covered an area of over ten kilometers.
Finally!
Su Lun's "Puppet Theatre" was complete!
In the spherical battle formation, he once again pulled out several puppet scrolls.
Upon exploding, more than a million gargoyles spread across the sky, forming a massive battle formation.
Within this formation, Su Lun was like an emperor, commanding an army of a million with a single thought.
A ten-thousand-strong mage battalion?
Su Lun's gargoyle army was also a million-strong legion formation, where his will commanded, a million gargoyles would converge alchemy, reducing the mage battalion to ashes in an instant!
Seeing this, soldiers on airships and battleships were moved to tears.
They might not all have seen Su Lun, but they had seen this legendary scene numerous times in the newspapers.
With the descent of the million-strong puppet army, both gods and demons step aside!
That one man was equivalent to an entire army of a million!
"Su Lun's puppet army has appeared!"
"The Puppet Emperor... The Puppet Emperor has come!"
"Hahaha... we are going to win!"
"..."
This was the moment they had been waiting for.
It was as if all previous sacrifices had been worth it.
Onboard the Royal Numero Uno airship, Yekaterina looked toward the man standing alone amongst the enemy legions, her eyes shimmering with tears, and she murmured, "He has truly become a legend..."
Aboard the Sky Battle Castle, Mr. Hei's eyes also filled with satisfaction as he exclaimed, "Alchemy creates miracles..."
In the thunderclouds, Lei stood in the void with a slight smile, "Finally, you've become very strong, Su Lun, my boy."
Abel was extremely exhilarated, his whole body trembling with excitement, "The teacher's puppet army!"
Seeing this, members of the Dawn Group like Number Nineteen, Bartolo, Vazhovs, Barrett, and Lolota were all invigorated.
And Makamul the centaur, an ally from the outside, was so astonished by the scene that he dropped his jaw, muttering to himself, "This is ridiculously exaggerated... This guy can actually control a million puppet army..."
The Dragon Maiden Masia beside him also expressed her amazement, "Yes, before this, I thought these guys were crazy, that there's no way they could defeat a higher plane's magic army. Now I know, he's ridiculously strong..."
They had both witnessed Su Lun's tactics on the Sandy Plane and had been amazed even then.
Now, facing this million-strong stone gargoyle army.
They only realized,
that what they had seen before was merely that fellow's own combat strength.
Now, with a million puppets augmented, this was the true combat power of a Puppet Master!
...
The gods of the celestial plane never imagined that the people from the celestial plane would use the same tactic again, and succeed!
Gazing upon the overwhelming tide of stone gargoyles, the people of the Holy Crown Empire had nothing left in their eyes but terror and despair. Despite their two to three million-strong force, they seemed to stand no chance against the uniform ranks of a million puppets.
The thought of the gargoyles' near-perfect magic immunity was simply despairing.
But no one was able to penetrate the million puppet army to kill the controller.
Even demigods had no hope.
However, the Sun Legion of the Ascieden Empire and the Judgment Legion of the Golden Gryphon Empire still had their formations intact, and they still had a great chance of victory.
"Damn it! Can nobody stop that native? Are all those people from the Holy Crown Empire useless?"
"This is bad, now that the puppet's million-strong legion has emerged, not even a ten-thousand-member mage group poses any threat to him."
"This native's methods are far stronger than reported! Weren't they supposed to be mostly fourth or fifth-tier puppets? These are clearly high-purity 'Living Silver' puppets! Damn it, where did these natives find so much Living Silver?"
"Talking about this now is useless. Put away your petty schemes. While your two legions are still intact, focus fire and kill that Puppet Master first, and we still may win. Otherwise, if we of the Holy Crown fall, don't think you'll fare any better!"
"Okay!"
"..."
Just minutes ago, the three empires each harbored their own schemes, aiming to maximize their benefits while stabbing their allies in the back.
Initially, the other two empires were pleased to see the Holy Crown Empire suffer heavy losses.
But after witnessing the terrifying combat power of the million puppet legion, they immediately changed their minds.
They instantly decided to focus fire and kill the controller first.
However, at that moment, an unexpected situation occurred again.
Without any warning, a huge hole with a diameter of over ten meters suddenly exploded near the Judgment Legion's headquarters.
The hole stretched for dozens of kilometers, with the million-strong legion's shield failing to have any effect.
Again?
Seeing this scene, the face of the Judgment Legion's supreme commander, the 'Wind and Thunder Sword God' Karlo Lankrisas changed dramatically as he bellowed, "Everyone be on guard, kill all enemies who break into the formation!"
As he spoke, his gaze turned towards the cannon ports revealed atop the distant sky fortress, gritting his teeth, "Damn it! We need to deal with that floating city first, that cannon might be some kind of ancient forbidden weapon!"
Seeing this, how could he not understand that this was probably a force beyond the divine level.
This was simply a transdimensional strike.
However, as much as the hole had been opened, they didn't believe that the Alchemy plane had another group of peak combatants daring to break through like the three before.
Even if there were, they would not be fooled by the same tactic a second time.
Now, whoever came would be doomed!
And indeed this was the case.
Even though 'Twilight of the Gods' had opened a second breach, the Alchemy plane no longer had a second group with the combat strength of Su Lun and his companions.
But the absence of another group did not mean no one would take the plunge!
The moment the breach opened, spatial fluctuations immediately emerged. Not just in one place, but like a hive, densely packed rifts appeared everywhere.
Looking closely, mechanical soldiers with a metallic luster were transported through the spatial rifts.
These were the Super Mechanical Warrior Legions!
Yet the enemy was prepared, and even though the mechanical soldiers were made of steel, the moment they were teleported they fell into a sea of magic.
Like moths to a flame, they were incinerated in an instant.
"Eh… Are they here to die?"
Karlo, the 'Wind and Thunder Sword God,' frowned deeply as he watched. He had seen reports of super warriors before.
But the combat strength of these super mechanical soldiers was not particularly high, with the best among them being around eighth-tier. There was only one ninth-tier Golden Winged Warrior, but just one.
Merely relying on numbers for an attack could never break through the magic defense line.
What was the reason behind this suicidal method?
One by one, space rifts appeared, and as super mechanical warriors charged out they were annihilated by magic. In a blink of an eye, over a thousand super soldiers had fallen.
Yet as Karlo watched this scene, instead of feeling the ease of killing the enemy, a growing unease settled in his heart.
But he couldn't figure out where this unease came from.
Theoretically, no matter how many super mechanical soldiers there were, they couldn't breach the magic defense line.
Then why continue this suicidal onslaught?
Just as Karlo thought it was some feint, scanning the surroundings for the real attack, suddenly a strange green mushroom cloud erupted near one of the rifts.
"BOOM!"
The explosive force wasn't particularly large; compared to the continuous bombardment of alchemical bombs, it was even relatively mild.
Yet this explosion caused Karlo's complexion to change dramatically.
For he saw that the shockwave from the exploding green mushroom cloud had actually torn directly through the magic defense shield, creating a huge gap.
"What's happening?"
After all, Karlo was a commander and had seen a fair share of the world.
But even he couldn't make any sense of the explosion that had annihilated the magic shield.
This was an explosive force that exceeded his understanding.
Seeing the first self-preservation bomb detonate successfully, the Mechanic Warrior Cannon Fodder Unit charged forward one after another, rushing in like mad.
"BOOM," "BOOM," "BOOM"...
One after another, green mushroom clouds exploded within the Judgement Fleet. The once perfect legion defense shields were now riddled with holes.
In a blink of an eye, a hail of alchemically-enhanced rounds fire, tearing the gaps wider and wider.
The gods from the Heavenly Plane were completely stunned; they could not fathom, by any means, how such an explosion could penetrate the legion's defense shield.
However, thought of it or not, the reality was that after the defensive barrier was breached, the battle suddenly turned gruesome.
...
This was no ordinary bomb.
It was the "Dark Matter Bomb" developed by Jekyll!
This kind of bomb was extremely effective against shields.
But dark matter is highly unstable, annihilating upon contact with regular matter and requiring extremely high temperatures and a perfect vacuum to maintain its existence. Therefore, this bomb required ultra-precision instruments to mix the components and someone to control the timing of the detonation precisely.
Previously, only Jekyll had mastered this technique, but over the years, the Allied Empire had spent enormous military funds to research this secret project.
And the Mechanics found out that the bodies of the Mechanic Warriors themselves were like precision instruments, perfectly meeting the conditions to be made into bombs.
After spending countless efforts, they finally had this Mechanical Explosive Corps!
At this moment, the self-sacrificing explosion of thousands of Mechanical Warriors successfully tore open another enemy battle group.
As soon as the battle formation's shield was torn apart, the magic mages of the Golden Griffon Empire who once prided themselves on their invincible defense saw it vanish into thin air.
Not far away, the Empire's vanguard ships had already charged over, and close-quarter brutal contact began between the rival legions. Various heavy-armored Mechanic Warriors who had been holding back were now thriving in the battlefield!
The moment the two sides came into contact, those steamship vessels burst forth like beehives, unleashing countless bee-like Mechanic Warriors.
They charged fearlessly at the various magic airships, with no regard for their own lives.
The melee had begun!
Karlo Lankrisas, the "Wind and Thunder Sword God," and a host of high-ranking mages were also shocked.
They had never expected that the tables would turn so quickly; they were just laughing at the Holy Crown Empire, and now the joke was on them.
As mages, the last thing they wanted was to be drawn into close combat.
But now, that was the situation they were in.
And the only remaining intact Ascieden Empire's Sun Legion had no sense of relief either.
The defense formations of two legions had been shattered by two shots from ancient forbidden weapons; who knew when the third shot would come?
However, the disaster didn't stop there.
An even more desperate scene emerged.
...
Su Lun summoned an army of a million gargoyle-like figures, standing alone.
Mr. Jing and Queen Medusa had gone to aid another front.
Now with a million puppets by his side, Su Lun no longer needed any teammates. With the shelter of a formation of a million gargoyles, there was no one and no legion that could interfere with his Puppetry Technique.
Even if legions clashed head-on, what had he to fear?
Amidst the tens of thousands of the Holy Crown Empire's legions, Su Lun stood completely unfazed.
The tremendous computational power provided by the "God Profaner" allowed him to control a million puppets with ease, using those threads to command various magical airships to self-detonate in battle.
But it wasn't over yet.
An invincible legion was already formed with a million gargoyles, but it wasn't sharp enough.
Every moment wasted meant tens of thousands of empire soldiers fell, a massive loss for the Alchemical Plane.
So once Su Lun had secured his footing, he took out another Spatial Scroll, his eyes flashing with a fierce light: "Appear, Mummy Legion!"
"Bang," "Bang," "Bang"... the scroll burst open.
Looking up, the sky once again filled with a million puppets.
But this time, instead of gargoyles, there were mummies wrapped in bandages, withered with an earthy scent.
...
"What is that?!"
Seeing the mummies appearing all over the sky, the mages from the Heavenly Plane were taken aback again.
A million gargoyles had already driven them to despair; what were these mummies about?
They seemed... not quite as formidable as the gargoyles?
But the mages did not feel any relief, only despair.
What does it mean for one person to control two million puppets?
You must know that there are only eight million mages in the entire Divine Realm, and yet this guy alone is equivalent to two million?
Seeing these mummies—a type of puppet that has never appeared before—even the people from the Alchemy Realm are completely bewildered.
Corpses?
Looking left and right, they can't believe that these are something from the Alchemy Realm.
Even those in the Dawn Brigade who are very familiar with Su Lun have never seen them before.
But, having never seen them before
does not prevent them from realizing the might of this newly emerged puppet legion!
"Hahaha... Look, those are Mr. Su Lun's new puppets!"
"Isn't that exaggerated? Another million-level puppet legion?"
"Hahaha... The guys from the Divine Realm are going to despair, who could stop Mr. Su Lun's two million-strong legions?"
"..."
With the arrival of the puppets, the morale of the Alchemy Realm's side soared.
And as people were buzzing with discussions, the expressions on the faces of centaur Makamul and dragon maiden Masia, who were on the Sky War Castle, grew odd.
"Ah... I was wondering why this guy took out all the corpses from the Taris Tomb, so he was using them as puppets."
"Tsk tsk, the mages are going to be in trouble now."
"Yes, this guy is ridiculously strong. I'm afraid he's on par with a True God now."
"..."
Only the two of them had personally experienced the terror of the Mummy Legion.
The "Pharaoh's Curse" Formation could strip away water elements and draw out lifespans; even Half-Gods could not withstand it.
...
"Everyone, stay away from within ten miles of me!"
Su Lun summoned the million-strong army of mummies and roared into the communicator.
Then he began to chant a mysterious spell in his mouth, "￥&￥#%￥￥&..."
This was a universal resurrection spell for summoning the undead from the "Book of the Dead" of the Taris deity race and was key for the intelligent mummies.
As soon as this spell was uttered, a strange, earthy yellow glow enveloped the million mummies, converging into the army's formation—the "Pharaoh's Curse".
Suddenly, as this formation emerged, the million mummies swept over like a sandstorm, darkening the skies.
The outlandish scene unfolded!
Within the range covered by the million mummies, every water element disappeared without a trace. In an instant, even the seawater beneath their feet was stripped away, making a vast hole several miles in diameter, as if the power of rules prevented the surrounding seawater from closing in.
Witnessing this terrifying scene, the mages from the distant Holy Crown Empire fell into complete despair.
"Holy Thunder God of Law" Hogan Chapman recognized part of the mummies' formation and was greatly alarmed, "The power of a high-level curse!"
He understood, but there was nothing he could do.
This was a terrifying formation that even he, a demigod, found frightening.
"Damn it, how did these guys from the Alchemy Realm get hold of these corpses?"
In Hogan Chapman's heart, all will to fight had vanished, as the sight of these two million-strong legions convinced him, even without knowing, that he and the Thunder Legion had no chance of victory.
The Holy Crown Empire had brought just over two million mages, and the enemy had two million puppets—how could they win?
At that moment, he made a decision, "Quick, summon the Divine Being!"
...
In Su Lun's All-knowing Eye, he could see that a wisp of the Power of Faith was already drifting towards the sky.
But the million mummies he summoned were not for show.
In that instant, the million mummy legion and the million gargoyle legion charged in all directions.
Even if the mages coordinated seamlessly, could they match the synergy of Su Lun alone?
He controlled the million-strong legion effortlessly, crushing any ten-thousand mage phalanx they encountered with a single touch.
The Mummy Legion didn't need any attack methods; wherever they went, life spans and water elements were stripped clean, leaving only sand and dry bones.
The Gargoyle Legion, akin to reckless brutes, smashed through everything in their path; even if a phalanx of ten thousand mages could hold for a moment, the endless stream of gargoyles following could shatter them into bits.
The stand lasted only an instant before, like a glass falling to the ground, the Thunder Legion of the Holy Crown Empire shattered completely.
Su Lun controlled the two-million-strong legion, causing chaos wherever he went.
He first routed the Thunder Legion, leaving the remnants for the imperial fleet to deal with.
Then he turned to the battlefield, controlling the puppet legion once more, heading towards the magical forces of the Golden Griffon Empire.
He reversed the entire situation with his power alone.
And the last Sun Legion was broken open by Number Nineteen and the league of mechanical warriors, regardless of the cost. The opposing fleets had already collided; on the sea's surface, spanning tens of miles, they engaged in a ferocious melee combat.
Tragic, heroic…
This was an epic battle that would be recorded in the history of the Alchemy Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 671 - 700 [Final Chapter: The Battle with the Gods]
chapters.content:
The balance of victory in the great decisive battle had already tipped toward the Alchemy plane from the moment Su Lun summoned the puppet army of a million.
Armed with secret weapons like "Twilight of the Gods" and "dark matter bombs," which could be considered dimensionally-reducing strikes, as well as warriors who disregarded life and death, the mages from the Divine plane were naturally beaten back step by step.
Following a broken formation, it was often Su Lun's million puppet legions charging ahead first, smashing through various large magical armies; after which the mechanical warriors swarmed forth.
Once it entered the melee combat phase, the Alchemy plane completely became the dominant side.

"Crack!"

However, in the eyes of the Three-Eyed God Nideglow, there was only disdain as his hands condensed into a dark red armor of the divine domain, catching the hellish sword Qi capable of slaying a demigod with his bare hands.
The sword light that dazzles human eyes was clear and distinct to the eyes of the gods, each punch precisely caught.
Though appearing nonchalant, He couldn't help but reveal a trace of eagerness when looking at the Rakshasa Woman in her third transformation: "Third form[Rakshasa Woman], an excellent vessel for a divine being."
The Alchemy plane really had given Him many surprises.
Not just treasures, but also various humans with extraordinary talents. If He could truly transform them into His own nation of believers, that might give Him a chance to break through to the middle tier of godhood.
"Clang, Clang, Clang"...
As fist met sword, the shrill sound pierced the air, and space itself cracked.
But no matter how sharp Su Lun's sword was, it was like a light swordsman hacking at a knight's heavy armor, leaving only a mark without injuring the knight inside.
Su Lun's understanding of the laws of Hell had not yet reached the level of a lesser god who could condense the laws into divine nature.
The good news was, after planar suppression, this lesser god's combat power had weakened by at least fifty percent!
It was no longer a case of instant defeat upon contact.
While Su Lun sprang into action, Mr. Jing was not idle either. She divided into nine, and her nine mirror clones stood apart as she shouted, "Myriad Reflections Wheel!"
Against a divine tier, magicians who couldn't manipulate the rules directly were entirely ineffective.
Confinement, Slowing, Attack… Mr. Jing utilized all kinds of Divine Arts she had replicated over the millennia, unleashing them upon the Three-eyed Deity.
Su Lun watched in awe, witnessing the depths of his senior sister's arsenal of spells.
One could say that, in the entire Alchemy plane, no one could compare to her in the number of Divine Arts mastered.
Mr. Jing had mastered almost all known Divine Arts!
Nevertheless, even with such prowess, the Divine Arts that humans could utilize only managed to tug a bit at the strings of the laws. After several exchanges between the two of them, they had not caused any substantial harm to the Three-eyed Deity, God Nideglow; instead, they were surrounded by danger.
To kill this Three-eyed God, they still lacked considerably!
It was during the distraction provided by Mr. Jing and Su Lun that the figure bathed in starlight, Yekaterina, had already conjured a black sphere in her hands: "Astrological Alchemy·Black Hole!"
With a repulsive force, she thrust the black hole in her hands toward the Three-eyed God, who was restrained by runic chains.
The moment the terrifyingly dense black hole appeared, everything around it was sucked in.
In an instant, Yekaterina had rushed a kilometer forward and thrust her palm against the protective divine domain of God Nideglow, as tough as armor.
Looking at the black hole in her hand, Nideglow initially didn't take it seriously; after all, Divine Arts released by humans posed no threat to one who had condensed divine nature.
However, the moment the black hole touched the divine domain, He abruptly noticed something odd: "Astrology? No, there's something else..."
To His surprise, He found an unrecognized force within the black hole, eroding His divine domain.
If completely ignored, that astrologer might indeed break through His divine domain.
But, He also immediately saw the flaw in this technique, and divine power surged through His body as He pushed forward: "God said, let there be light!"
No sooner had He spoken than His words became law, as divine power gathered in His palm, turning into dazzling white light.
This boundless white light was infused into the black hole, causing Yekaterina's face to drastically change, forcing her to retreat quickly. Her Black Hole Formula was powerful, but she couldn't bear too much of it; if it came down to attrition, how could a mere mortal outlast a deity?
However, as soon as this Divine Art was released, forcing the enemy back, the expression of the Three-eyed Deity, God Nideglow, changed once again: "Hm??"
The might of the Divine Art was far less than expected, not only suppressed by the planar confinement but also because His divine power was being stolen?
At that moment, the creepy red moon in the sky grew even more bizarre, with strands of red moonlight diffusing into the air.
Seeing this, the eyes of God Nideglow turned cold as He murmured, "Faith Stealing."
When He had descended in spirit on the Alchemy plane before, He knew that there was a pseudo-god with such a power.
At the time, He thought little of it.
After all, such a pseudo-god could be annihilated with the flick of a hand.
Yet to His amazement, in just a few short years, this pseudo-god had advanced to the point of condensing divine fire.
Such a level of Faith Stealing, if protracted, would become increasingly disadvantageous for Him.
Truth be told, among these Alchemy natives, the greatest threat was still that pseudo-god in the sky.
The Three-eyed God Niedegro sneered inwardly, the vertical pupil in the middle of his forehead slowly opening to gaze upon the red moon in the sky, from which brilliant light burst forth: "Divine Art·All-Encompassing Truth."
Finally, He had deployed the innate ability of the Celestial deities.
....
Pandora must continually steal faith to create opportunities for her companions.
Moreover, with the Power of Faith entangling her, she had no means to evade. If struck by it, she would not die but be severely crippled.
Yet, at this critical juncture, a figure teleported in front of the red moon, calling out lightly, "Armor Dispel!"
Three-eyed God Niedegro looked at that overconfident human trying to protect his comrade from the devastating divine light and his face was filled with scorn.
With [All-Encompassing Truth] unleashed, it was time to end this farce.
However, what unfolded next was something the True God could never have anticipated.
The beam directly hit the man in the black robe, but instead of seeing him disintegrate into primal matter,
Rather, His own divine light... was extinguished!
"What is this?"
The Three-eyed God Niedegro's expression finally changed, He had clearly witnessed the human employ a power beyond His own understanding!
It was somewhat similar to the Black Hole Formula used earlier, yet stronger.
However, before He could comprehend what that power was, in the next instant, the figure had teleported close to his face, appearing right before Him.
[All-Encompassing Truth], like the gaze of Queen Medusa, was inescapable; however, there was still a gap in time!
Su Lun seized the opportunity, and threw a punch.
A miraculous scene unfolded, where the God's Domain Armor that none managed to penetrate just moments ago now cracked under the impact of one punch.
A seemingly invisible force wrapped around the fist, managed to penetrate the indestructible sanctuary, as though a mysterious energy neutralized and obliterated those [Rules of War].
This was the "unspoken rule" power from [Isaac the God Slayer], capable of annihilating the rules of gods.
On the knight's indestructible armor, a large hole appeared!
How did he manage that?
The Three-eyed God Niedegro was shocked, not because His divine domain was breached, but because He did not understand how.
Before He had time to ponder any further, Su Lun, struggling, pressed forward with his punch, and at this moment, Chientiao, seizing the chance, had already swung down her sword: "God-slaying Blade Style·Flower Blade Twenty-six Facets!"
This strike, carrying the might of the Hell's Mirror, pierced fiercely.
Although Chientiao, as a demigod, could not fully grasp the rules on par with a True God, the swordsman managed to apply the few rules she did understand onto the tip of her blade.
"Swoosh~"
The Sword Qi tore through the skin of the Three-eyed Deity, from where golden blood then flowed.
The wound was shallow, but it was the first breach of defense!
Chientiao wanted to strike again, but a divine gust blew past, sending them flying a thousand meters back, creating a series of explosive sounds in the air.
Although in disarray, Su Lun and his companions were simultaneously overjoyed.
They had wounded the body of the True God!
...
The Three-eyed God Niedegro observed the small wound on His abdomen that was oozing golden blood, his eyes full of disbelief.
At this moment, He truly felt threatened.
His face betraying incredulity, He looked at the humans before Him and realized that these ants, whom He had never taken seriously, indeed possessed the means to slay a god.
A deity that had always been held in high esteem was now thoroughly enraged.
Su Lun wouldn't offer this being any time to be shocked; rising from the fall, his fists once again gathered the layer of "unspoken rules" as he charged forward vigorously.
Chientiao followed closely behind.
At that time, Mr. Jing suddenly changed his previous tactic, forming a series of complex sorcerer's seals, "Divine Art: All-Encompassing Replication!"
Yekaterina was the weakest among the few, and she hadn't recovered from the hit by a Divine Art just now. But at this moment, she was shocked to see the sorcerer's seals in Mr. Jing's assassin hands.
Because, that was her unique spell!
Mr. Jing's expression became stern, his eyes already full of stars, as he declared lightly, "Astrological Alchemy·Black Hole!"
Another look, and she had also condensed a black hole in her hands.
She couldn't replicate the "God Slayer" because that was a capability of the prosthesis, but she could replicate any ninth-tier professional's spell!
Yekaterina knew Mr. Jing was powerful, but not being familiar with him, she hadn't expected him to replicate even her own sorcerer's seals.
A great opportunity!
Forcing down a surge of restless blood, Yekaterina set her face determinedly and followed at Mr. Jing's side, charging towards the Three-eyed Deity.
...
The prosthesis of "Sir Isaac's God Slayer," although able to obliterate God's Domain, was like breaking through a knight's armor. Once the armor was broken, your own strength had to be sufficient to defeat the knight himself.
Beings capable of condensing a divine element and stepping into Divinity, their insight, spells, and experience, without exception, were matchless.
Su Lun and his companions exhausted all their techniques, seizing the advantages of time and place, but the fight was still brutal.
If Yekaterina hadn't touched upon the secrets of the "Dark World," only Su Lun could have breached the defenses, but now, it was different!
Mr. Jing replicated Yekaterina's "Black Hole" spell, and with the penetrating swords after breaking the defense, and Pandora's Faith Stealing, their group, united, already had several fatal breakthrough points.
Su Lun stood at the forefront with the dark rules protecting his body, fearing not even the "Word Becomes Law" in its entirety.
The Three-eyed Deity's first defensive target was also him.
But he withstood Su Lun.
Two black holes struck simultaneously, and the myriad swords had already pierced through.
"Thud!"
After another collision, Su Lun and his companions were once again pushed back a thousand meters by the shockwave of the Divine Art.
However, seeing the new wounds on the body of God Niedegro, joy was evident on their faces.
Now, with planar suppression and faith being stolen, this being could not replenish his Divine Power and would only grow weaker.
From the beginning, this had been Su Lun's complete plan to slay a god.
It was a matter of which side could last until the end.
It was only after truly battling a god that Su Lun fully understood the profound intentions behind Sir Isaac's five notebooks.
"Isaac's Alchemical Heart" provided him with a constant support of Spiritual Power, "Giant's Strength" and "Dragon-Emblazoned Golden Body" provided the physical strength needed to contest a True God, "God Profaner" had the vision of the divine, and "God Slayer" had the power to slay a god!
The five notebooks, five types of prostheses, were all designed to allow mortals to possess the battle strength to stand shoulder to shoulder with deities.
At this moment, Su Lun was filled with surging gratitude.
That Alchemical Demigod truly left a great treasure for the future generations.
However, after crossing swords, Su Lun once again marveled at how powerful Sir Isaac must have been a thousand years ago?
Without further thought, the two sides already clashed several more rounds.
As divine arts collided with the earth shattering, they fiercely contested over a hundred rounds in a flash. Were it not for this sealed "God-Forbidden Space," even the plane itself would have crumbled.
...
As time passed, Niedegro, observing his increasing number of wounds, could no longer maintain the arrogance of a deity and felt a real threat of death.
But now, the divine fire was forbidden, Divine Power was suppressed by planar forces, "Word Becomes Law" and God's Domain were restrained by that bizarre power capable of annihilating everything. This made him, a True God, rage at being restricted at every turn.
In any other plane, those below Divinity, even so-called Demigods, were nothing but insects that could be crushed at will.
But these alchemists, with their odd alchemical prostheses and abilities, managed to restrain him at every turn.
His divine dignity offended, God Niedegro's rage surged to his head.
Imprisoned within this space, there was no possibility of escape, and the only option was to fight relentlessly.
Niedegro, seeing that divine arts couldn't kill Su Lun, ceased using conventional divine arts and instead began to cast curse magic, "In the name of the gods, call forth the realm of agony, enslave the suffering souls of gods, heed my narration... Divine Art·Calamity Entwined!"
If physical means were to be eradicated, then the shift would be to the mystical realm of magic.
The moment the curse was uttered, it seemed as though a malevolent force was summoned from the void.
However, at that moment when the curse was unleashed, something unexpected happened.
He had intended to curse the Puppet Master first, yet he was completely unaware that a pair of All-knowing Eyes had already seen through the divine art.
....
Su Lun had always deliberately concealed Pestoya's existence.
He was waiting for this very moment!
Watching as this Three-eyed Deity suddenly concentrated the power of curse rules and targeted him, he was far from alarmed, instead, he was thrilled.
This fellow dared to use curse magic, and Su Lun became certain of one thing: He didn't know about Pestoya's existence!
Back in the Dragon Country Waters, there was a necromancer named Robins who had used a divine curse, and Su Lun had deceived him. After collecting his soul, Su Lun learned that the necromancer worshipped a deity known as "God of Death Calas."
Su Lun guessed then that the deity who had been tricked, in all likelihood, wouldn't go around broadcasting the embarrassing incident of being severely injured by a lower being, so Pestoya might not be in the intelligence of the celestial realms!
If he could conceal her as a "trump card," it might prove to be tremendously effective.
And indeed, it was!
This Three-eyed Deity Niedegro was completely oblivious and had used curse magic!
"Thud!"
Before he could think further, the curse magic collided with his soul as if two vehicles had clashed head-on.
Normally, a True God with divine fire is like a locomotive that could easily shatter the glass-like soul of a human.
However, this time Niedegro miscalculated.
The moment his curse was cast, it felt as though two steel trains had collided.
Far from shattering the opponent, both parties were injured in the process.
Niedegro, hit by the backlash of the curse, couldn't help but spew out a mouthful of golden blood, and he realized in an instant, "Dammit, that's how Calas was wounded!"
Watching Su Lun's body surface, he was even more shocked, "Divine fire! These activations have actually stolen the divine fire of a True God?"
He realized that something disastrous was afoot.
If one could steal the divine fire of a True God, it meant that the beings of this alchemical world had actually slaughtered a True God?
However, before he could make sense of it all, the confusion caused by the curse's backlash provided an excellent opportunity for his opponent.
...
"Success!"
Su Lun felt great joy in his heart.
Pestoya was not weak in combat, but he had never let her show herself, waiting for this moment.
The Three-eyed Deity, upon realizing that his divine power could be countered by the [God Slayer], would certainly think to use some mystical means.
Casting a curse was one of the best options.
And the gamble paid off!
Not caring about Pestoya who was also gravely injured, Su Lun's fists once again thundered against Niedegro's God's Domain. Currently, with his divine power unstable and scattered, it was several times easier than before!
"Boom!"
His punches eradicated most of the God's Domain, and Mr. Jing and Ekaterina's black hole arrived an instant later.
As soon as the God's Domain was breached, Chientiao transformed into a stream of sword light, fearlessly slashing from the opening.
Chientiao, turning into a Golden Body Rakshasa, unleashed his strongest strike: "God's Profound Truth·Dawn of the New World!"
This sword strike was like slicing through a divine kingdom, with a thousand unhesitant piercings thrusting forward.
"Swish"
Bisected with a single slash.
The three-eyed God Nideglow was cut in half at the waist, the blade striking upon His divinity, as golden blood sprayed a thousand streams over His body.
This strike not only cut through the flesh but also caused cracks upon the divinity itself.
With both the divine fire and body severely damaged, Nideglow couldn't help but vomit a large mouthful of blood.
It was during this moment that the sky's red moon flourished greatly.
Pandora didn't care about her safety and frantically absorbed the spreading divine power from the deity's spilled faith with strands of crimson moonlight quickly falling down.
In that brief instant, Nideglow felt the divine power inside of Him surge out uncontrollably, worsening His injuries beyond repair.
"Scram!"
After all, He was a True God, and, raging, He waved His hand, shattering much of the bloody moonlight—not without vomiting another mouthful of golden blood.
In the void, Pandora also let out a stifled grunt from her injury.
Su Lun and the others didn't dare to delay, seizing upon the enemy's weakness, intent on taking their life!
...
When Nideglow sensed the oncoming murderous intent, He still didn't let go of His divine arrogance and sneered, "Foolish humans, go to die!"
He used the Curse Magic again!
But this time, the target was not Su Lun, but Qian Tiao who was covered in divine blood.
Using divine blood as the medium, there was no escape.
He couldn't believe there was a second divine fire spirit to protect the body!
He had noticed that, while the other few could break through the God's Domain, this swordsman was the genuinely fatal "blade."
As long as He killed her first, the alchemists' methods would be insufficient, and He would still have a chance to turn defeat into victory!
"Boom!"
Suddenly, without any warning, Qian Tiao collapsed, spirit extinguished, dead on the spot, even before her blade fell.
Seeing this,
Mr. Jing and the others paled drastically.
Only a glint of sharpness flashed through Su Lun's eyes.
"Hahaha..."
Nideglow sneered viciously in triumph, with the pressure instantly lessened by half.
Su Lun and his companions frowned but didn't care for Qian Tiao, charging fiercely once again.
Nideglow, enduring his injuries, reconvened His divine realm into form, delivering a heavy fist in response.
Even with the divine realm breached, the remaining trio's attacks were not enough to kill Him.
If only He could survive this moment, He would have the chance to kill off these few one by one.
However, He could never have imagined that just after Qian Tiao's sudden death, a cross from an Anka divine symbol lit up in the sky.
Using the divine power of the Taris clan, Pandora activated the resurrection power of the "Key of Eternity"!
Qian Tiao, who had died on the spot, suddenly opened her eyes and, without having time to contemplate, she drew her sword and slashed down once again.
...
Su Lun had anticipated while strategizing the God-slaying battle that if a fight were to break out, the divine being's first target would definitely be him, the one who could breach His divine realm.
But with Pestoya and the "God Slayer" armor to protect him, as long as he was careful, even a True God wouldn't possibly kill him in a short time.
So, the second target He would want to kill would undoubtedly be Qian Tiao, the greatest threat to Him!
The "Key to Immortality" was thousands of backups even she didn't know about, only because in her heart there was no way to retreat into resurrection, not even a god could divine it.
...
With one slash, Qiantiao cut right into the godhood that had just been cracked.
With a clang,
the godhood shattered on impact.
The rules of hell converged on the blade, creating a huge gap on the divinely condensed godhood.
The Three-Eyed God Nideglow, heavily injured by these continuous major attacks, no longer had the capacity to struggle.
Even so, a True God is not so easily killed.
As long as the divine fire burns, the deity remains indestructible!
In such a situation, others might be helpless, but Sir Isaac had left behind many methods to seal a god.
Seeing that Three-Eyed God Nideglow was still trying to use some Divine Arts to resist, Su Lun, Mr. Jing, Qiantiao, and Yekaterina acted swiftly, dismembering its limbs and then taking out several rune caskets to seal each part separately!
If it couldn't be killed, then seal it away.
As for the divine fire, having been severely damaged by the backlash of Curse Magic, it was now weak and chaotic.
Without the slightest delay, Su Lun was enveloped in the green flames of the "Death God's Fire," seizing the frail divine fire. Beside him, Mr. Jing performed the sorcerer's seals, and chains of runes tightly bound the divine fire.
The crisis was averted.
They had truly defeated a True God!
Success!
Su Lun and the others sealed the caskets tightly, still finding it hard to believe as they looked at the golden blood spilled on the ground that they had really done it.
"Pestoya, are you alright?"
"I'm fine, just a little dizzy..."
"Miss Pandora?"
"A minor issue. My divine body took a heavy blow, but with the Divine Power stolen today, I should recover in a few years."
...
Su Lun inquired, and though his companions all bore injuries, thankfully there were no casualties.
Mr. Jing, Qiantiao, Pestoya, Pandora, Yekaterina... They exchanged glances, each seeing the thrill and relief in the others' eyes.
They had done it, they had slain a True God!
The greatest crisis of the grand battle was resolved.
And they were only a step away from resolving the crisis of the Alchemy plane.
After catching their breath for a moment, Su Lun immediately said, "Let's get out of here fast."
Mr. Jing and the others nodded in agreement, "Right."
They were well aware that after slaying a deity, they wouldn't have much time left.
...
Once the "Forbidden God Space" was dispelled, Su Lun and the others reemerged on the ocean surface.
The battle outside was still raging.
Although the magic legions from the Heavenly Plane had been routed, the arrival of the deity had suddenly invigorated the previously desperate Heavenly Plane mages like a shot of adrenaline, leading them to furiously counterattack. This was especially true for the Demigod powerhouses, who were now banding together to confront the Empire's experts.
They believed a god could solve everything.
However, when the mages saw Su Lun and his party emerging alive, their faith collapsed in an instant.
The mages couldn't believe it; why were the living ones those Alchemy natives?
Despite all the confusion, the reality was right before their eyes.
The deity they worshipped, had been defeated!
Otherwise, it would not have failed to appear.
On the other hand, as soon as Su Lun and Mr. Jing—those pinnacle fighters from the Dawn Era—appeared, and the moment Empress Yekaterina showed herself, the entire United Empire's tens of millions of fleets immediately boiled over with fervor.
...
"Let's go!"
But Su Lun and his companions didn't dare linger; the battlefield at the Imperial Strait no longer needed their worry.
They had more important matters to attend to.
Mr. Jing and the others nodded, Su Lun then gathered them into the minor void realm with one hand and teleported onto an airship dozens of nautical miles away, which was already furnished with a long-distance spatial transmission formation.
The transmission formation activated instantly, and the scenery around them changed in a flash. Su Lun had crossed tens of thousands of miles to appear in a cellar.
This was a secret base in Zambra of the Southern Mafa province, equipped with a teleportation formation for easy translocation.
Without delay, Su Lun followed the previously set spatial coordinates and teleported to a desolate mountain.
In the midst of deep autumn, the rustling of leaves filled the air, and the natural hot spring still flowed with clear, gurgling waters.
Many times, Su Lun, Mr. Jing, and Qiantiao had soaked in this hot spring.
All this familiarity, it was time to say goodbye.
Thoughts flew through his mind, and Su Lun looked off into the distance at the blue column piercing the sky, once again utilizing directed displacement.
The camp of the planar passageway, where magic towers stood tall, was originally an impregnable magic castle. But at this moment, only a few hundred thousand people were garrisoned there, and not even a demigod was present.
After all, no one imagined that a planar passageway guarded by a deity would require any army to be stationed there.
Su Lun and his group had just dealt with that Three-eyed Deity, the news of which had not yet seeped back.
The mages in the camp were completely unprepared, and a few strangers had already teleported in.
The magic towers lit up with radiance, but it was nothing compared to the threat of the earlier seven million-strong army.
The Puppet Theater of Su Lun reemerged, and with help from Mr. Jing and the others, they quickly overcame the magic legion within the camp.
Before long, the battle ended.
With a slap of the Suren Sorcerer's Seal, countless "Asgardian gemstones" fell to the ground.
These stones were incredibly durable, and in the days to come, Mr. Jing and others would build a sufficiently sturdy Sky-piercing Tower at the mouth of the planar passageway, enclosing the exit. At the very least, this would inflict heavy damage on any enemies that might emerge.
The fall of a deity in the Alchemy plane would certainly be detected by other deities of the Heavenly plane.
There was no time for the slightest delay.
Having done everything, Su Lun moved to the front of the passageway.
In the last moment before stepping through the spatial passageway, he looked back at his several companions and his lips curled into a faint smile. "I'm off."
Mr. Jing was as elegantly composed as ever, his eyes brimming with tenderness, "Hmm. Take care."
Qiantiao's eyes were sharp, and smacking her lips, she said, "Kid Su Lun, stay alive. I'll come find you. The Heavenly plane, I'll make sure to visit someday."
Yekaterina waved goodbye, her eyes full of stars, "Goodbye, Mr. Su Lun."
Pestoya was already bawling, her little face filled with grievance as she asked, "Su Lun, when can we see each other again?"
Su Lun pondered for a moment, then smiled slightly, "It should be... in the near future."
With that, he patted the girl's head, hesitated no longer, and stepped into the blue light of the planar passageway.
He didn't stay any longer, nor did he dare to.
With the planar passageway camp being attacked, the Heavenly plane must already be aware of the incident, any delay could bring changes.
Although reluctant,
Goodbyes had already been said before.
His thoughts were not yet concluded, but the scenery around him became a void.
Entering the dimensional passage was like entering a space-time wormhole; as soon as he entered, he was already far, far away.
Su Lun did not dare to delay. He took out the space debris he had found in the cracks of the void, and a mighty spiritual power surged from within him. His eyes turned sharp, "Divine Art: Star Shatter!"
In an instant, the space debris exploded.
It was like shattered glass strewn all over the ground, scattering everywhere within the spatial channel.
He passed through, scattering shards all along the way.
Now, whoever tried to pass through would not be able to avoid these pieces of space debris.
The death rate would be very high.
After doing all this, Su Lun finally felt a weight lift off his shoulders.
The mission was, at last, complete.
Annihilating the magic legion, slaying gods, destroying the alchemical dimension... these were all part of the plan.
At least for the next few decades, the alchemical dimension should be relatively peaceful.
Only at this moment did he truly relax.
Su Lun couldn't help but look back at the entrance of the spatial passage that had shrunk to a small bright spot in his field of vision, and in his heart he said to himself, "Alchemy dimension, goodbye. Everyone, goodbye too."
Just like when he came to the alchemical dimension alone,
he was now leaving,
alone.
For a moment, many memories flashed through Su Lun's mind. From traveling to Old Spiriton's dark underground city, to the ancient ruins of Luying, to the Mechanical Holy Land Mafa, to the Western Sea, all the way to... The mysterious veil of the alchemical dimension seemed to be fully lifted before him just now, revealing an astonishingly beautiful truth. However, looking back at all the friends he had met and experiences he had had over the years, it was those friends that brought a smile to his face.
...
Traveling through the spatial passage seemed to make one forget about time.
It felt like a long time had passed, and yet it seemed like a mere moment of wandering thought.
Suddenly, Su Lun saw the exit, where powerful magical fluctuations were already surging.
Knowing that mages from the divine dimension must be waiting at the exit, he wrapped himself in unspoken rules for full defense. The space-time power of the [Urobolos Space-Time Ring] was also ready to be unleashed. Mr. Crow transformed into a bidirectional crow form, staying by his side.
The exit came in an instant, and Su Lun immediately felt an overwhelming magical suppression, his eyes flickering with dazzling magical brilliance. Before he could understand what was happening, he lost consciousness.
Fortunately, the power of space from the ring was triggered.
He didn't know how much time had passed when he heard a voice at his side.
"Eh... Captain Katherine, there's someone here who has fainted. He seems to be seriously injured..."
"He might be an adventurer who came to hunt magical beasts in the Blacktooth Forest. Alman, go see if he can be saved, then bring him along."
"Oh~ Captain, you're just too kind. Bringing an injured person will be troublesome. When we return to Silverwind City, the leader will again say you..."
"..."
Su Lun opened his eyes and saw a small magic team of seventeen or eighteen adventurers. They were all dressed as adventurers, with the insignia of the Bloodthorn Adventure Group on their chests.
Blacktooth Forest, Silverwind City, Bloodthorn...
His mind automatically searched for relevant information, and instantaneously, he had the results.
In the southern part of the Ascieden Empire, the Graceland Principality near the Blacktooth Mountain Range, there lies the famous "Bloodthorn Magical Adventure Group" in Silverwind City. The group's leader is a seventh-order Magic Conductor, "Holy Demon" Bart Gallah, with a good reputation.
Having thought this, Su Lun breathed a long sigh of relief in his heart.
Lucky.
He was more or less at the displacement location he had anticipated. At least he hadn't fainted in a big city of the Ascieden Empire or in some dangerous magical beast's lair.
The first step in his journey to the divine dimension was, at last, safe.
Above in the tree, Mr. Crow leisurely preened his glossy feathers.
